OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.QuadraticAf.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.posDef_quadratic_linear_equiv
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.QuadraticAf.text:
lemma posDef_quadratic_linear_equiv {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) : ∃ L : Space n ≃ₗ[ℝ] Space n,
      ∀ x, (∑ i, (L x i)^2) = ∑ i, ∑ j, x i*A i j*x j := by
  open scoped MatrixOrder in
  classical
  let S := CFC.sqrt A
  have hS : S.IsSymm := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).posSemidef.isHermitian
  have hSS : S*S=A := by simpa only [S,pow_two] using CFC.sq_sqrt A hA.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hSd : IsUnit S.det := by
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro H
    have hd := congrArg Matrix.det hSS
    rw [Matrix.det_mul,H,zero_mul] at hd
    exact hA.det_pos.ne' hd.symm
  let L := Matrix.toLinearEquiv (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ).toBasis S hSd
  refine ⟨L,fun x => ?_⟩
  have hL : (fun i => L x i) = S*ᵥ (fun i => x i) := funext (matrixLinearEquiv_apply S hSd x)
  calc
    _ = (S*ᵥ (fun i => x i)) ⬝ᵥ (S*ᵥ (fun i => x i)) := by
      rw [← hL]
      simp only [dotProduct,pow_two]
    _ = (fun i => x i) ⬝ᵥ ((S*S)*ᵥ (fun i => x i)) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,hS.eq]
      exact dotProduct_comm _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [hSS]; simp only [dotProduct,Matrix.mulVec,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.QuadraticAf.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.paraboloidLinearEquiv
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.QuadraticAf.text:
def paraboloidLinearEquiv {n : ℕ} (L : Space n ≃ₗ[ℝ] Space n)
    (ℓ : Space n →L[ℝ] ℝ) : (Space n × ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Space n × ℝ) where
  toFun p := (L.symm p.1,(1/2:ℝ)*p.2+ℓ (L.symm p.1))
  invFun p := (L p.1,2*(p.2-ℓ p.1))
  left_inv := by
    intro p
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp
    · ring
  right_inv := by
    intro p
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp
    · simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      ring
  map_add' := by
    intro p q
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp
    · simp only [Prod.fst_add,Prod.snd_add,map_add]
      ring
  map_smul' := by
    intro a p
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp
    · change (1/2:ℝ)*(a*p.2)+ℓ (L.symm (a • p.1)) = a*((1/2:ℝ)*p.2+ℓ (L.symm p.1))
      rw [map_smul,map_smul]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      ring

theorem affineMaximal_entire_and_balance {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hn9 : n ≤ 9)
    {Ω : Set (Space n)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hne : Ω.Nonempty) (hcv : Convex ℝ Ω)
    {u : Space n → ℝ} (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u Ω)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ Ω, (hessian u x).PosDef) (hm : AffineMaximalOn Ω u)
    (hc : EuclideanGraphComplete Ω u) :
    Ω = univ ∧ ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 ∧ SectionBalance univ u ρ := by
  obtain ⟨ρ,hρ,hρ1,hbal⟩ := affineMaximal_section_balance hn hn9 hΩ hne hcv hu hp hm hc
  have hU := eq_univ_of_sectionBalance hΩ hne hcv hu hp hc hρ hbal
  exact ⟨hU,ρ,hρ,hρ1,hU ▸ hbal⟩

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.QuadraticIn.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.quadratic_of_third_fderiv_zero
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.QuadraticIn.text:
theorem quadratic_of_third_fderiv_zero (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 3 f)
    (hthird : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) x = 0) :
    ∀ x, f x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) 0 x x) +
      fderiv ℝ f 0 x + f 0 := by
  let B := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) 0
  let L := fderiv ℝ f 0
  have hf₂ : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fderiv ℝ f) := hf.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hf₁ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) :=
    hf₂.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hB (x : E) : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x = B :=
    is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero (hf₁.differentiable (by norm_num)) hthird x 0
  have hL (x : E) : fderiv ℝ f x = B x + L := by
    have hd (y : E) : HasFDerivAt (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z - B z)
        (0 : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := by
      convert (((hf₂.differentiable (by norm_num)) y).hasFDerivAt.sub
        (B.hasFDerivAt (x := y))) using 1
      rw [hB, sub_self]
    have heq := is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero (fun y => (hd y).differentiableAt)
      (fun y => (hd y).fderiv) x 0
    simp only [map_zero, sub_zero] at heq
    simpa only [add_comm] using sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp heq
  have hsym (x y : E) : B x y = B y x := by
    exact (hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by norm_num)) x y
  let q : E → ℝ := fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B x x) + L x + f 0
  have hq (x : E) : HasFDerivAt q (B x + L) x := by
    have hBi : HasFDerivAt (fun y => B y y) (B x + B.flip x) x := by
      convert B.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) x) using 1 <;>
        rfl
    have hBx : B.flip x = B x := by
      ext y
      exact hsym y x
    have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (B x + B.flip x) = B x := by
      rw [hBx, ← two_smul ℝ (B x), smul_smul]
      norm_num
    convert ((hBi.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)).add (L.hasFDerivAt (x := x))).add_const (f 0)
      using 1
    simp only [hhalf]
  have hd (x : E) : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f y - q y) (0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
    convert (((hf.differentiable (by norm_num)) x).hasFDerivAt.sub (hq x)) using 1
    rw [hL, sub_self]
  intro x
  have hconst := is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero (fun y => (hd y).differentiableAt)
    (fun y => (hd y).fderiv) x 0
  simp only [q, map_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, sub_self] at hconst
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hconst

end AffineBernstein

end

end OAI

lemma hessian_closure_det {n : ℕ} {u : Space n → ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ x y, (hessian u x).det=(hessian u y).det)
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A ∈ closure (range (hessian u))) : A.det=(hessian u 0).det := by
  have hc : IsClosed {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ | A.det=(hessian u 0).det} :=
    isClosed_eq continuous_id.matrix_det continuous_const
  have hs : range (hessian u) ⊆ {B | B.det=(hessian u 0).det} := by
    rintro B ⟨x,rfl⟩
    exact hD x 0
  exact closure_minimal hs hc hA

end HessianCompactness

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.QuadraticAf.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.quadratic_graph_affine_image
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.QuadraticAf.text:
lemma quadratic_graph_affine_image {n : ℕ} {u : Space n → ℝ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (ℓ : Space n →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ x, u x=(1/2:ℝ)*(∑ i, ∑ j, x i*A i j*x j)+ℓ x+c) :
    ∃ e : (Space n × ℝ) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] (Space n × ℝ),
      e '' standardParaboloid n=graph univ u := by
  obtain ⟨L,hL⟩ := posDef_quadratic_linear_equiv hA
  let e := (paraboloidLinearEquiv L ℓ).toAffineEquiv.trans
    (AffineEquiv.constVAdd ℝ (Space n × ℝ) ((0:Space n),c))
  have he (p : Space n × ℝ) : e p=(L.symm p.1,(1/2:ℝ)*p.2+ℓ (L.symm p.1)+c) := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> simp [e,paraboloidLinearEquiv,add_comm]
  refine ⟨e,?_⟩
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
    change q.2=∑ i, (q.1 i)^2 at hq
    rw [he]
    refine ⟨mem_univ _,?_⟩
    rw [hu,← hL,hq]
    simp
  · intro hp
    have hp' : p.2=u p.1 := hp.2
    refine ⟨(L p.1,∑ i, (L p.1 i)^2),rfl,?_⟩
    rw [he]
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp
    · simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [hL,← hu,← hp']

end AffineBernstein

end

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.HessianDomi.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.balanced_dominating_hessian
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.HessianDomi.text:
theorem balanced_dominating_hessian {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {u : Space n → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hp : ∀ x, (hessian u x).PosDef)
    (hm : AffineMaximalOn univ u) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
    (hbal : SectionBalance univ u ρ)
    (hD : ∀ x y, (hessian u x).det=(hessian u y).det) :
    ∃ A ∈ closure (range (hessian u)), ∀ x, (A-hessian u x).PosSemidef := by
  classical
  let f := fun e : Space n => dirDeriv e (dirDeriv e u)
  let m := fun e : Space n => sSup (range (f e))
  have hbd (e : Space n) : BddAbove (range (f e)) :=
    balanced_global_directional_bddAbove hn hu hp hm hρ hρ1 hbal e
  have hfm (e x : Space n) : f e x ≤ m e := le_csSup (hbd e) ⟨x,rfl⟩
  have hfc (e : Space n) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f e) := contDiff_dirDeriv (contDiff_dirDeriv hu e) e
  let I := Space n × {r : ℝ // 0 < r}
  let Q := fun (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (e : Space n) =>
    (fun i => e i) ⬝ᵥ (A*ᵥ (fun i => e i))
  have hQ (e : Space n) : Continuous (fun A => Q A e) := by
    dsimp only [Q,dotProduct,Matrix.mulVec]
    fun_prop
  let T := fun i : I => {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ | m i.1-i.2.val ≤ Q A i.1}
  have hT (i : I) : IsClosed (T i) := isClosed_le continuous_const (hQ i.1)
  have hfinite (s : Finset I) : (closure (range (hessian u)) ∩ ⋂ i∈s, T i).Nonempty := by
    have htol : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ i∈s, ε ≤ i.2.val := by
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => exact ⟨1,by norm_num,by simp⟩
      | @insert a s _ ih =>
        obtain ⟨ε,hε,Hε⟩ := ih
        refine ⟨min a.2.val ε,lt_min a.2.property hε,?_⟩
        intro i hi
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
        · exact min_le_left _ _
        · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (Hε i hi)
    obtain ⟨ε,hε,Hε⟩ := htol
    let F := fun i : s => fun x => m i.val.1-f i.val.1 x
    have hF (i : s) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F i) := contDiff_const.sub (hfc i.val.1)
    have hFp (i : s) (x : Space n) : 0 ≤ F i x := sub_nonneg.mpr (hfm _ _)
    have hFL (i : s) (x : Space n) : inverseHessianTrace u (F i) x ≤ 0 := by
      change inverseHessianTrace u (fun y => m i.val.1-f i.val.1 y) x ≤ 0
      rw [inverseHessianTrace_sub isOpen_univ contDiffOn_const (hfc _).contDiffOn (mem_univ x),
        inverseHessianTrace_constant,zero_sub]
      exact neg_nonpos.mpr (constant_det_directional_subsolution hn hu hp hD _ x)
    have hsmall (i : s) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ x, F i x < δ := by
      obtain ⟨r,⟨x,rfl⟩,hx⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup (range_nonempty (f i.val.1))
        (show m i.val.1-δ < m i.val.1 by linarith)
      exact ⟨x,by dsimp [F]; linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := balanced_simultaneous_minima hn hu hp hm hρ hρ1 hbal F hF hFp hFL hsmall hε
    refine ⟨hessian u x,subset_closure ⟨x,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    simp only [mem_iInter]
    intro i hi
    have H := hx ⟨i,hi⟩
    change m i.1-i.2.val ≤ Q (hessian u x) i.1
    have he : Q (hessian u x) i.1=f i.1 x := (second_directional_eq_quadratic hu _ _).symm
    rw [he]
    have hεi := Hε i hi
    dsimp only [F] at H
    linarith
  obtain ⟨A,hA,HA⟩ := (balanced_hessian_range_compact hn hu hp hm hρ hρ1 hbal).inter_iInter_nonempty T hT hfinite
  have hq (e x : Space n) : Q (hessian u x) e ≤ Q A e := by
    have hmA : m e ≤ Q A e := by
      apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
      intro ε hε
      have H := mem_iInter.mp HA (e,⟨ε,hε⟩)
      change m e-ε ≤ Q A e at H
      linarith
    rw [show Q (hessian u x) e=f e x from (second_directional_eq_quadratic hu e x).symm]
    exact (hfm e x).trans hmA
  refine ⟨A,hA,fun x => ?_⟩
  apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
    ((Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr (hessian_closure_isSymm hu hA)).sub (hp x).isHermitian)
  intro p
  have H := hq (WithLp.toLp 2 p) x
  change p ⬝ᵥ ((hessian u x)*ᵥ p) ≤ p ⬝ᵥ (A*ᵥ p) at H
  simpa only [star_trivial,Matrix.sub_mulVec,dotProduct_sub] using sub_nonneg.mpr H

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.MatrixDetRi.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.posDef_eq_of_posSemidef_sub_det_eq
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.MatrixDetRi.text:
lemma posDef_eq_of_posSemidef_sub_det_eq {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosDef) (hBA : (B-A).PosSemidef) (hdet : B.det=A.det) : B=A := by
  classical
  let S := CFC.sqrt A
  have hS : S.conjTranspose=S := (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A).isSelfAdjoint
  have hSS : S*S=A := by simpa only [S,pow_two] using CFC.sq_sqrt A hA.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hSd : S.det ≠ 0 := by
    have hd := congrArg Matrix.det hSS
    rw [Matrix.det_mul] at hd
    intro H
    rw [H,zero_mul] at hd
    exact hA.det_pos.ne' hd.symm
  have hSI : S⁻¹*S=1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul S (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hSd)
  have hIS : S*S⁻¹=1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv S (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hSd)
  have hI : (S⁻¹).conjTranspose=S⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv,hS]
  have he : S⁻¹*A*S⁻¹=1 := by
    rw [← hSS]
    calc
      _ = (S⁻¹*S)*(S*S⁻¹) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hSI,hIS,Matrix.one_mul]
  let P := S⁻¹*(B-A)*S⁻¹
  have hP : P.PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [hI] using hBA.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same S⁻¹
  have hEP : 1+P=S⁻¹*B*S⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [P]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,he]
    abel
  have hPD : (1+P).det=1 := by
    rw [hEP,Matrix.det_mul,Matrix.det_mul,hdet]
    simpa only [Matrix.det_mul,Matrix.det_one] using congrArg Matrix.det he
  have hP0 := posSemidef_det_one_add_eq_zero hP hPD
  have hh := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => S*M*S) hP0
  have hc : S*P*S=B-A := by
    dsimp [P]
    calc
      _ = (S*S⁻¹)*(B-A)*(S⁻¹*S) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = B-A := by rw [hIS,hSI,Matrix.one_mul,Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hc,Matrix.mul_zero,Matrix.zero_mul] at hh
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hh

end AffineBernstein

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.ConstantDet.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.balanced_affineMaximal_constant_det
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.ConstantDet.text:
theorem balanced_affineMaximal_constant_det {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {u : Space n → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hp : ∀ x, (hessian u x).PosDef)
    (hm : AffineMaximalOn univ u)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hbal : SectionBalance univ u ρ) :
    ∀ x y, (hessian u x).det=(hessian u y).det := by
  obtain ⟨c,C,hc,hC,Hb⟩ := balanced_global_det_bounds hn hu hp hm hρ hρ1 hbal
  have hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (affineWeight u) := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    exact contDiffAt_affineWeight hu.contDiffAt (hp x)
  have hβ : -(((n:ℝ)+1)/((n:ℝ)+2))<0 := neg_neg_of_pos (div_pos (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have hwbelow : BddBelow (range (affineWeight u)) := by
    refine ⟨(C:ℝ)^(-(((n:ℝ)+1)/((n:ℝ)+2))),?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨x,rfl⟩
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (hp x).det_pos (Hb x).2 hβ.le
  have hwupper : BddAbove (range (affineWeight u)) := by
    refine ⟨(c:ℝ)^(-(((n:ℝ)+1)/((n:ℝ)+2))),?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨x,rfl⟩
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hc (Hb x).1 hβ.le
  have H := balanced_bounded_harmonic_constant hn hu hp hm hρ hρ1 hbal hw hwbelow hwupper
    (fun x => affineMaximal_inverseHessianTrace_zero hm (mem_univ x) (hp x))
  intro x y
  exact (Real.rpow_left_inj (hp x).det_pos.le (hp y).det_pos.le hβ.ne).mp (H x y)

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.ModelCenter.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.eq_univ_of_sectionBalance
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.ModelCenter.text:
theorem eq_univ_of_sectionBalance {n : ℕ} {Ω : Set (Space n)}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hne : Ω.Nonempty) (hcv : Convex ℝ Ω) {u : Space n → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u Ω) (hp : ∀ x ∈ Ω, (hessian u x).PosDef)
    (hc : EuclideanGraphComplete Ω u) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hbal : SectionBalance Ω u ρ) : Ω = univ := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hne
  apply eq_univ_of_dilation hΩ ha (c := 1 + ρ) (by linarith)
  intro x hx
  have he := (sectionBalance_reflection hΩ hcv hu hp hc hbal hx ha).1
  have hv : x - ρ • (a - x) = a + (1 + ρ) • (x - a) := by module
  rwa [hv] at he

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.ConstantHes.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.second_fderiv_bilinear_eq_sum
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.ConstantHes.text:
lemma second_fderiv_bilinear_eq_sum {n : ℕ} {u : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n}
    (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ u x) (v w : Space n) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x v w = ∑ i, ∑ j, v i*hessian u x i j*w j := by
  calc
    _ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x (∑ i, v i • coordinateVector n i)
        (∑ j, w j • coordinateVector n j) := by rw [sum_coordinateVector,sum_coordinateVector]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [map_sum,map_smul,sum_apply,smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,
        Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [hessian_eq_second hu]
      ring

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.ConstantHes.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.quadratic_of_constant_hessian
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.ConstantHes.text:
lemma quadratic_of_constant_hessian {n : ℕ} {u : Space n → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u)
    (hH : ∀ x y, hessian u x=hessian u y) :
    ∀ x, u x = (1/2:ℝ)*(∑ i, ∑ j, x i*hessian u 0 i j*x j)+fderiv ℝ u 0 x+u 0 := by
  have he : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) = fun _ => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) 0 := by
    funext x
    ext v w
    rw [second_fderiv_bilinear_eq_sum hu.contDiffAt,second_fderiv_bilinear_eq_sum hu.contDiffAt,hH x 0]
  have ht (x : Space n) : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u)) x=0 := by
    rw [he]
    simp
  intro x
  rw [quadratic_of_third_fderiv_zero u (hu.of_le (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 3)) ht x,second_fderiv_eq_sum hu.contDiffAt]

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.CapCovarian.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.second_fderiv_eq_sum
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.CapCovarian.text:
theorem second_fderiv_eq_sum {n : ℕ} {u : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n}
    (hu : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ u x) (v : Space n) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x v v =
    ∑ i, ∑ j, v i * hessian u x i j * v j := by
  calc
    _ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x (∑ i, v i • coordinateVector n i)
        (∑ j, v j • coordinateVector n j) := by rw [sum_coordinateVector]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [hessian_eq_second hu,
        hu.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)
          (coordinateVector n j) (coordinateVector n i)]
      ring

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.HessianDomi.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.balanced_constant_hessian
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.HessianDomi.text:
theorem balanced_constant_hessian {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {u : Space n → ℝ} (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hp : ∀ x, (hessian u x).PosDef)
    (hm : AffineMaximalOn univ u) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
    (hbal : SectionBalance univ u ρ) : ∀ x y, hessian u x=hessian u y := by
  have hD := balanced_affineMaximal_constant_det hn hu hp hm hρ hρ1 hbal
  obtain ⟨A,hA,HA⟩ := balanced_dominating_hessian hn hu hp hm hρ hρ1 hbal hD
  have he (x : Space n) : A=hessian u x :=
    posDef_eq_of_posSemidef_sub_det_eq (hp x) (HA x) ((hessian_closure_det hD hA).trans (hD _ _))
  exact fun x y => (he x).symm.trans (he y)

end HessianDominance

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.MaximalMode.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.affineMaximal_section_balance
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.MaximalMode.text:
theorem affineMaximal_section_balance {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hn9 : n ≤ 9)
    {Ω : Set (Space n)} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hne : Ω.Nonempty) (hcv : Convex ℝ Ω)

    (hc : EuclideanGraphComplete Ω u) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 ∧ SectionBalance Ω u ρ := by
  apply sectionBalance_of_no_two_model hΩ hne hcv hu hp hc
  intro d _ C hC hf
  have hh := affineMaximal_model_directions_le_one hn hn9 hΩ hne hcv hu hp hm hc hC hf

end MaximalModelExclusion

OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.Main:18.name: OAI.AffineBernstein.affine_bernstein
OAI.Analysis.AffineBernstein.Main:18.text:
theorem affine_bernstein
    (n : ℕ) (hn₃ : 3 ≤ n) (hn₉ : n ≤ 9)
    (Ω : Set (Space n)) (hΩne : Ω.Nonempty) (hΩopen : IsOpen Ω)
    (hΩconvex : Convex ℝ Ω) (u : Space n → ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u Ω)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ω, (hessian u x).PosDef)
    (hmax : AffineMaximalOn Ω u)
    (hcomplete : EuclideanGraphComplete Ω u) :
    Ω = univ ∧
      (∃ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (b : Space n) (c : ℝ),
        A.IsSymm ∧ A.PosDef ∧
        ∀ x, u x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, x i * A i j * x j)
          + (∑ i : Fin n, b i * x i) + c) ∧
      (∃ e : (Space n × ℝ) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] (Space n × ℝ),
        e '' standardParaboloid n = graph Ω u) := by
  obtain ⟨hU,ρ,hρ,hρ1,hbal⟩ := affineMaximal_entire_and_balance hn₃ hn₉ hΩopen hΩne
    hΩconvex hu hpos hmax hcomplete
  refine ⟨hU,?_⟩
  subst Ω
  have hu' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u := contDiffOn_univ.mp hu
  have hp' : ∀ x, (hessian u x).PosDef := fun x => hpos x (mem_univ x)
  have hH := balanced_constant_hessian (by omega) hu' hp' hmax hρ hρ1 hbal
  have hq := quadratic_of_constant_hessian hu' hH
  constructor
  · refine ⟨hessian u 0, WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => fderiv ℝ u 0 (coordinateVector n i)), u 0,
      Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp (hp' 0).isHermitian, hp' 0, ?_⟩
    intro x
    change u x = (1/2:ℝ)*(∑ i, ∑ j, x i*hessian u 0 i j*x j) +
      (∑ i, fderiv ℝ u 0 (coordinateVector n i)*x i) + u 0
    rw [← continuousLinearMap_coordinate_sum]
    exact hq x
  · exact quadratic_graph_affine_image (hp' 0) (fderiv ℝ u 0) (u 0) hq



end
end AffineBernstein

end

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.name: OAI.AlgorithmicThinTrees.Iteration.tree_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.text:
lemma tree_bound {R : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) (hb : RoundBound R)
    (d m k : ℕ) (G : MultiGraph (d+1) m) (hn : 2 ≤ d+1) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hc : G.EdgeConnected k) :
    G.SpanningTree (tree R k G) ∧ ∀S : Finset (Fin (d+1)),
      ((G.cut (tree R k G) S).card:ℝ) ≤
        (3*R*Real.exp lossB)/(k:ℝ)*(G.cut univ S).card := by
  have hRR : (0:ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < R by omega)
  obtain ⟨hT,hthin⟩ := iterate_bound hR hb (initialCount k) (initialCount k) d m G
    (initialCount_pos k) le_rfl hn (initial_packable G (by omega) hk hc)
  refine ⟨hT,fun S => (hthin S).trans ?_⟩
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hrR : (0:ℝ) < initialCount k := by exact_mod_cast initialCount_pos k
  have hkR : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  rw [←mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hrR hkR).mpr
  have hrk : (k:ℝ) ≤ 3*(initialCount k:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast initialCount_lower k
  have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (potential_le (initialCount k)) hRR.le
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrk (mul_pos hRR (Real.exp_pos lossB)).le
  have hl := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx hkR.le
  nlinarith only [hm,hl]

    ((largeRun R).reindex (fun x : {x : Good // x.val.n≠1} => goodCode x.val)
      makeLarge (fun _ => rfl))

variable {R : ℕ} {C : ℝ}
variable (hC : 0<C)
variable (hcorrect : ∀p : Problem,2≤p.d+1 → 1≤p.r → p.G.EdgeConnected p.r →
  ThinTree C p.r p.G (Iteration.tree R p.r p.G))
include hC hcorrect in

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.name: OAI.AlgorithmicThinTrees.Iteration.explicit_program
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.text:
theorem explicit_program : ∃R : ℕ, ∃C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    (∀p : Problem,2 ≤ p.d+1 → 1 ≤ p.r → p.G.EdgeConnected p.r →
      ThinTree C p.r p.G (tree R p.r p.G)) ∧
    (∀{ι : Type} {L : ι → ℕ} (a : ι → Problem),
      IsPoly L (fun i => (problemCode (a i)).length) →
      (∀i,2 ≤ (a i).d+1 ∧ 1 ≤ (a i).r ∧ (a i).G.EdgeConnected (a i).r) →
      RunsPoly L (treeProgram R) a) := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hb⟩ := sparsification_correct
  obtain ⟨T,_,ht⟩ := sparsify_program_polynomial
  let R' := max R T
  have hR' : 4 ≤ R' := hR.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hb' : RoundBound R' := fun r hr => hb r ((le_max_left R T).trans hr)
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < R' := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<R' by omega)
  refine ⟨R',3*R'*Real.exp lossB,by positivity,?_,?_⟩
  · intro p hn hk hc
    have h := tree_bound hR' hb' p.d p.m p.r p.G hn hk hc
    exact ⟨h.1,fun S _ _ => h.2 S⟩
  · exact fun a ha hp => runsPoly_tree hR' hb' (le_max_right R T) ht a ha hp

end AlgorithmicThinTrees.Iteration

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.name: OAI.AlgorithmicThinTrees.GraphicHalf.sparsification_correct
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.text:
theorem sparsification_correct : ∃R : ℕ, 4 ≤ R ∧ ∀r : ℕ, R ≤ r →
    ∀(d m : ℕ) (G : MultiGraph (d+1) m), 2 ≤ d+1 → G.TreePackable univ r →
      (r:ℝ)/4 ≤ nextCount r ∧ (nextCount r:ℝ) ≤ (r:ℝ)/2 ∧ 0 < nextCount r ∧
      G.TreePackable (sparsify G r) (nextCount r) ∧
      (∀S : Finset (Fin (d+1)), ((G.cut (sparsify G r) S).card:ℝ) ≤
        (1/2+3*halfError r)*(G.cut univ S).card) ∧
      (1/2+3*halfError r)*(r:ℝ) ≤ (1+80*errorU r)*nextCount r := by
  obtain ⟨R₁,hR₁,hstep⟩ := shortcut_correct
  obtain ⟨R₂,hnum⟩ := eventual_numeric
  refine ⟨max R₁ R₂,?_,?_⟩
  · exact (by norm_num : 4 ≤ 64^16).trans (hR₁.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  intro r hr d m G hn hp
  have hr₁ := (le_max_left _ _).trans hr
  have hr₂ := (le_max_right _ _).trans hr
  have hnumer := hnum r hr₂
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by have := hnumer.rlarge; omega
  have hconn := packing_connected G hr0 hp
  obtain ⟨hX,hpack,hqpos,hqr,hqbound,hres⟩ := hstep r hr₁ (d+1) m G hn hp
  let a := extractState G r
  let B := a.active
  let q := a.packingTarget
  let s := normalizedScales q r (graphColumns G B)
  have hX' : a.realMatrix ∈ metricDomain G := hX
  have hqr' : (1-6*errorU r)*(r:ℝ) ≤ q := hqbound
  obtain ⟨hs,hleverage,hbits⟩ := graphic_normalization G B hqpos hqr hpack
  change (∀e, 0 < s e ∧ s e ≤ 1) at hs
  change (∀e, leverage (realColumns (graphColumns G B)) (realWeights s) e ≤ (1+4/(r:ℝ))/(q:ℝ)) at hleverage
  have hQ : ((scaledForm G B s).map (fun x : ℚ => (x:ℝ))).PosDef := by
    rw [scaledForm_cast]
    obtain ⟨F⟩ := graph_containedPacking G B hqpos hpack
    exact F.covariance_posDef _ (realWeights_box hs).1
  have hnorm : ∀e, realVec (fullColumns G B) e ⬝ᵥ
      (((positiveForm a.matrix).map (fun x : ℚ => (x:ℝ)))⁻¹*ᵥrealVec (fullColumns G B) e)+
      leverage (realColumns (graphColumns G B)) (realWeights s) e ≤ varianceBound r := by
    intro e
    have hlev := (hleverage e).trans (normalized_size hnumer hqr')
    have hfirst : realVec (fullColumns G B) e ⬝ᵥ
        (((positiveForm a.matrix).map (fun x : ℚ => (x:ℝ)))⁻¹*ᵥrealVec (fullColumns G B) e) ≤
        (r:ℝ)^(-1/4:ℝ) := by
      rw [fullColumns_cast,positiveForm_cast]
      by_cases he : e ∈ B
      · rw [ite_eq_left he]
        exact hres e he
      · rw [ite_eq_right he,zero_dotProduct]
        exact Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _
    unfold varianceBound
    linarith only [hfirst,hlev]
  obtain ⟨hlap,hframe⟩ := half_bounds G B a.matrix s hconn hX' hQ
    (show 0 ≤ varianceBound r by unfold varianceBound; positivity) hnorm
  change G.laplacian (sparsify G r) ≤ (1/2:ℝ) • G.laplacian B+
    halfError r • regularize a.realMatrix at hlap
  change (1/2-halfError r) • (scaledForm G B s).map (fun x : ℚ => (x:ℝ)) ≤
    StackedSigning.gram (realVec (scaledColumns G B s)) (sparsify G r) at hframe
  obtain ⟨hlo,hhi,hpos⟩ := nextCount_bounds hnumer
  refine ⟨hlo,hhi,hpos,?_,?_,half_ratio hnumer⟩
  · apply packing_bound G hn B (sparsify G r) inter_subset_right s (fun e => (hs e).1) hQ
      (c:=1/2-halfError r) (h:=(1+4/(r:ℝ))/(q:ℝ))
    · linarith only [hnumer.loss,hnumer.small]
    · positivity
    · exact packing_numeric hnumer hqpos hqr'
    · intro e _; exact hleverage e
    · exact hframe
  · intro S
    exact cut_bound G (by omega) (sparsify G r) B hX'
      (by unfold halfError; positivity) hlap S

end AlgorithmicThinTrees.GraphicHalf
end

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Encoding.Inp.name: OAI.AlgorithmicThinTrees.InputStack.runsPoly_largeRun
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Encoding.Inp.text:
lemma runsPoly_largeRun {ι : Type} {L : ι → ℕ} (a : ι → Large)
    (ha : IsPoly L (fun i => (largeCode (a i)).length)) : RunsPoly L (largeRun R) a := by
  unfold largeRun
  apply RunsPoly.dite_families (RunsPoly.of_poly _ a ha)
  · have ht := RunsPoly.of_poly binaryTail (fun i : {i // isBinary (a i).val=true} =>
      ⟨a i.val,i.property⟩) (ha.reindex Subtype.val)
    exact ht.then (runsPoly_bRun htime _ ht.output)
  · have ht := RunsPoly.of_poly explicitTail (fun i : {i // ¬isBinary (a i).val=true} =>
      ⟨a i.val,i.property⟩) (ha.reindex Subtype.val)
    exact ht.then (runsPoly_eRun htime _ ht.output)

lemma runsPoly_tree {R T : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) (hb : RoundBound R) (hTR : T ≤ R)
    (htime : ∀{ι : Type} {L : ι → ℕ} (a : ι → Problem),
      IsPoly L (fun i => (problemCode (a i)).length) →
      (∀i,T ≤ (a i).r ∧ 2 ≤ (a i).d+1 ∧ (a i).G.TreePackable univ (a i).r) →
      RunsPoly L sparsifyProgram a)
    {ι : Type} {L : ι → ℕ} (a : ι → Problem)
    (ha : IsPoly L (fun i => (problemCode (a i)).length))
    (hp : ∀i,2 ≤ (a i).d+1 ∧ 1 ≤ (a i).r ∧ (a i).G.EdgeConnected (a i).r) :
    RunsPoly L (treeProgram R) a := by
  have hs := RunsPoly.of_poly startProgram a ha
  unfold treeProgram
  apply RunsPoly.congr
  apply hs.then
  apply runsPoly_run hR hb hTR htime _ hs.output
  intro i
  exact ⟨(hp i).1,initial_packable _ (by omega) (hp i).2.1 (hp i).2.2⟩

end AlgorithmicThinTrees.Iteration.Stack

theorem algorithmic_strong_thin_trees : AlgorithmicStrongThinTrees := by
  obtain ⟨R,C,hC,hcorrect,htime⟩ := Iteration.explicit_program
  have ht := InputStack.runsPoly_program htime (fun x : InputStack.Good => x)
    (isPoly_self (fun x : InputStack.Good => x.val.length))
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := ht.cost
  refine ⟨2*C,by positivity,InputStack.machine R,p.coefficient+1,p.degree,Nat.succ_pos _,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  let y : InputStack.Good := ⟨x,hx⟩
  have hr := InputStack.machine_correct hC hcorrect y
  have hbound : (InputStack.program R).cost y ≤
      (p.coefficient+1)*(x.length+1)^p.degree :=
    ((hp y).trans (p.eval_le_input_polynomial x.length)).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ p.coefficient))
  have he := CurrentKS.Machine.run_halted hr.1 hbound
  dsimp only [y] at he hr
  dsimp only
  rw [he]
  exact hr

end AlgorithmicThinTrees
end

def RoundBound (R : ℕ) : Prop := ∀r : ℕ, R ≤ r →
    ∀(d m : ℕ) (G : MultiGraph (d+1) m), 2 ≤ d+1 → G.TreePackable univ r →
      (r:ℝ)/4 ≤ nextCount r ∧ (nextCount r:ℝ) ≤ (r:ℝ)/2 ∧ 0 < nextCount r ∧
      G.TreePackable (sparsify G r) (nextCount r) ∧
      (∀S : Finset (Fin (d+1)), ((G.cut (sparsify G r) S).card:ℝ) ≤
        (1/2+3*halfError r)*(G.cut univ S).card) ∧
      (1/2+3*halfError r)*(r:ℝ) ≤ (1+80*errorU r)*nextCount r

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.name: OAI.AlgorithmicThinTrees.GraphicHalf.Stack.sparsify_program_polynomial
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.text:
theorem sparsify_program_polynomial : ∃R : ℕ, 4 ≤ R ∧ ∀{ι : Type} {L : ι → ℕ}
    (a : ι → Problem), IsPoly L (fun i => (problemCode (a i)).length) →
    (∀i, R ≤ (a i).r ∧ 2 ≤ (a i).d+1 ∧ (a i).G.TreePackable univ (a i).r) →
    RunsPoly L sparsifyProgram a := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hstep⟩ := shortcut_correct
  refine ⟨R,(by norm_num : 4 ≤ 64^16).trans hR,?_⟩
  intro ι L a ha hp
  have hforms := RunsPoly.of_poly forms a ha
  have hsigns : RunsPoly L signsProgram a := by
    apply hforms.then
    apply Signing.Stack.runsPoly_simultaneousSigns _ hforms.output
    · intro i
      obtain ⟨hX,_,_,_,_,_⟩ := hstep (a i).r (hp i).1 _ _ (a i).G (hp i).2.1 (hp i).2.2
      change ((positiveForm (a i).state.matrix).map (fun q : ℚ => (q:ℝ))).PosDef
      rw [positiveForm_cast]
      have hr : 0 < (a i).r := (by norm_num : 0 < 64^16).trans_le (hR.trans (hp i).1)
      exact regularize_pd (by omega) (domain_positive (a i).G (by omega)
        (packing_connected (a i).G hr (hp i).2.2) hX)
    · intro i
      obtain ⟨hX,hpack,hqpos,hqr,_,_⟩ := hstep (a i).r (hp i).1 _ _ (a i).G (hp i).2.1 (hp i).2.2
      obtain ⟨hs,_,_⟩ := graphic_normalization (a i).G (a i).active hqpos hqr hpack
      change ((scaledForm (a i).G (a i).active (a i).scales).map (fun q : ℚ => (q:ℝ))).PosDef
      rw [scaledForm_cast]
      obtain ⟨F⟩ := graph_containedPacking (a i).G (a i).active hqpos hpack
      exact F.covariance_posDef _ (realWeights_box hs).1
  unfold sparsifyProgram
  apply RunsPoly.congr
  exact ((RunsPoly.of_poly (identity problemCode) a ha).both hsigns).then_poly mask

end AlgorithmicThinTrees.GraphicHalf.Stack
end

end OAI

OAI.InformationTheory.AmplitudeDamping.M.name: OAI.GAD.capacity_holevo
OAI.InformationTheory.AmplitudeDamping.M.text:
theorem capacity_holevo (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : capacity γ ν=holevo γ ν 1 := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hmax⟩ := exists_maximizer γ ν
  rw [capacity_formula γ ν hγ hν ⟨hp,hmax⟩,holevo_formula γ ν hγ hν ⟨hp,hmax⟩ 1]
  norm_num
  ring

OAI.InformationTheory.AmplitudeDamping.M.name: OAI.GAD.capacity_formula
OAI.InformationTheory.AmplitudeDamping.M.text:
theorem capacity_formula (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : Maximizes γ ν p) :
    capacity γ ν=objective γ ν p/Real.log 2 := by
  have hzero := zero_achievable γ ν hγ hν
  have hbdd : BddAbove {R : ℝ | Achievable γ ν R} :=
    ⟨objective γ ν p/Real.log 2,fun _ hR ↦ achievable_upper γ ν hγ hν hp hR⟩
  have hnonempty : {R : ℝ | Achievable γ ν R}.Nonempty := ⟨0,hzero⟩
  have hcap0 : 0 ≤ capacity γ ν := le_csSup hbdd hzero
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact csSup_le hnonempty (fun _ hR ↦ achievable_upper γ ν hγ hν hp hR)
  · by_contra! hbad
    let R := (capacity γ ν+objective γ ν p/Real.log 2)/2
    have hRcap : capacity γ ν < R := by dsimp [R]; linarith
    have hRχ : R < objective γ ν p/Real.log 2 := by dsimp [R]; linarith
    have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := hcap0.trans hRcap.le
    have hl : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hrχ : R*Real.log 2 < objective γ ν p := (lt_div_iff₀ hl).mp hRχ
    have ha := phase_rate_achievable γ ν hγ hν hp.1 (mul_nonneg hR0 hl.le) hrχ
    rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ R hl.ne'] at ha
    exact (not_le_of_gt hRcap) (le_csSup hbdd ha)

OAI.InformationTheory.AmplitudeDamping.M.name: OAI.GAD.main
OAI.InformationTheory.AmplitudeDamping.M.text:
theorem main (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → holevo γ ν n = (n : ℝ) * holevo γ ν 1) ∧
    (∃ p : ℝ, Maximizes γ ν p ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → holevo γ ν n = (n : ℝ) / Real.log 2 * objective γ ν p) ∧
    capacity γ ν = holevo γ ν 1 ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ, Maximizes γ ν p → ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      (∀ s : Basis n, IsState (phaseState p s)) ∧
      holevo γ ν n = phaseValue γ ν p n) := by
  exact ⟨fun n _ ↦ holevo_additive γ ν hγ hν n,
    holevo_maximizer γ ν hγ hν,capacity_holevo γ ν hγ hν,
    fun p hp n _ ↦ phase_attainment γ ν hγ hν hp n⟩

end GAD

end

end OAI

  have hD := ((pathLinear 1).hasFDerivAt.comp zeroVector

  rw [hD.fderiv]

def mainHamiltonianPath : HamiltonianPath mainEquiv where
  forward := forward
  backward := backward
  hamiltonian := hamiltonian
  forward_smooth := forward_smooth
  backward_smooth := backward_smooth
  hamiltonian_smooth := hamiltonian_smooth
  forward_preserves t _ z := forward_preserves t z
  backward_preserves t _ z := backward_preserves t z
  forward_phase t _ z c hc := forward_phase (t,z) c hc
  backward_phase t _ z c hc := backward_phase (t,z) c hc
  hamiltonian_phase t _ z c hc := hamiltonian_phase (t,z) c hc
  left_inverse t _ z := backward_forward_full (t,z)
  right_inverse t _ z := forward_backward_full (t,z)
  start z := forward_start z
  finish z := (mainEquiv_project z).symm
  equation t _ z v _ := forward_equation t z v

OAI.GroupTheory.ArtinCAT0.Main:26.text:
theorem not_geometric (X : Type u) [MetricSpace X] [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    [MulAction MainGroup X] : ¬GeometricAction MainGroup X := by
  classical
  intro hG
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hY⟩ := exists_sublevel_nonempty (X:=X) sentinelMain
  let Y := displacementSublevel (X:=X) sentinelMain A
  let : Nonempty Y := hY
  let : ProperSpace Y := sublevel_properSpace hG.2.1 sentinelMain A
  let := sublevelAction hG.2.1 sentinelMain A
  have hC := geometric_tupleCentralizer hG sentinelMain A hA
  let := MulAction.compHom Y triangleCentralizer
  have hT : GeometricAction TriangleGroup Y := geometric_compHom triangleCentralizer triangleCentralizer_bijective hC
  let y : Y := Classical.choice inferInstance
  have hl (g : TriangleGroup) : stableLengthAt y g=stableLengthAt y.val (triangleMain g) := by
    rw [stableLength_compHom triangleCentralizer]
    exact sublevelAction_stableLength hG.2.1 sentinelMain A y (triangleCentralizer g)
  apply SixSector.no_strict_ratios hT y
  intro i
  have hp : 0<stableLengthAt y.val ((blockMain i (braidGen 39 0))^2) := by
    rw [blockMain_zero]
    exact generator_square_positive explicitMatrix hG y.val (corner i)
  have hr := (braid_forty_ratio hG y.val (blockMain_relations i) hp).2.1
  simpa only [hl,triangleH,map_pow,map_mul,triangleMain_gen,blockMain_zero,blockMain_one] using hr
end Assembly

universe u

OAI.GroupTheory.ArtinCAT0.Detour:521.name: OAI.ArtinCAT0.SixSector.no_strict_ratios
OAI.GroupTheory.ArtinCAT0.Detour:521.text:
theorem no_strict_ratios (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) : ¬StrictRatios y := by
  classical
  intro hR
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hchart⟩ := chart_uniform hG y hR
  obtain ⟨E,hE,hdense⟩ := orbit_uniformly_dense hG y
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hc1,hcos⟩ := common_cosine hG y hR
  obtain ⟨r,hr,_,_,hd2⟩ := detour_gap hc hc1
  let d : ℝ := 2*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+r
  have hd : 0≤d := by dsimp [d]; positivity
  have hdetour : ∀ R : ℝ, 0≤R → ∀ i t, t∈Set.Icc 0 1 →
      dist (axis y 0 R•y) (circle y R i t•y)≤d*R+3*C := by
    intro R hR0 i t ht
    exact circle_detour hG y hR hC hchart hcos hr.le hR0 i ht
  let B := 22+4*C+4*E
  have hB : 0≤B := by dsimp [B]; positivity
  obtain ⟨K,H,hK,hlib⟩ := WordDiagram.controlled_refinement hG y B hB
  let : NeZero K := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨C₀,D,hC₀,hD,hlib⟩ := hlib
  let w := D+2
  let a := 1-d/2
  let T := rayLength y 0+rayLength y 1
  have ha : 0<a := by dsimp [a,d]; linarith
  have hT : 0<T := add_pos (ray_length_pos hG y hR 0) (ray_length_pos hG y hR 1)
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (T*(2*w+2*D+2)) ((T*(w+D+2)+C+2*C₀+5*C/2+E)/a))
  have hn1 : T*(2*w+2*D+2)<(n+1:ℕ) := by
    have hh := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left (T*(2*w+2*D+2)) _) hn
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hn2 : T*(w+D+2)+C+2*C₀ < (1-d/2)*(n+1:ℕ)-5*C/2-E := by
    have hh := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right (T*(2*w+2*D+2)) _) hn
    have hh' := (div_lt_iff₀ ha).mp hh
    dsimp only [a] at ha hh'
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hve,hvr⟩ := cap_exists hG y hR hC hE hd hd2 hchart hdense hdetour n
  have hagree (i) : innerLabel y n (Sum.inl (Fin.last (n+1),i)) = v (Sum.inl (Fin.last (n+1),-i)) := by
    rw [hv]
    simp only [neg_neg,innerLabel,Fin.val_last]
  let M := GridSphere.mesh n (2*(n+1))
  let z := GridSphere.label n (2*(n+1)) (innerLabel y n) v hagree
  have hedge : ∀ f i, dist (z (M.tail (f,i))•y) (z (M.tail (f,i+1))•y)≤B := by
    apply GridSphere.edges n (2*(n+1)) (innerLabel y n) v hagree (fun g => g•y)
    · intro f i
      exact (innerLabel_edges hG y hR hC hchart n f i).trans (by dsimp [B]; linarith)
    · exact hve
  obtain ⟨L,hmetric,hmirror,hcorner⟩ := hlib _ _ M z hedge
  let P := GridDisk.patch H (3*K)
  let S := GridDisk.sides H K
  have hone := refined_inner_index hG y hR n v hagree P S L hD
    (show D<w by dsimp [w]; linarith) hn1 hmirror hcorner
  have hinner (f : GridSphere.Face n (2*(n+1))) (hf : f.1=false) :
      ∃ i p, 0≤p.1 ∧ 0≤p.2 ∧ z (M.tail (f,0))=chart y i p := by
    rcases f with ⟨b,f⟩
    change b=false at hf
    subst b
    exact innerLabel_chart hG y hR n (GridDisk.tail n (AngularSize n) (f,0))
  have houter (f : GridSphere.Face n (2*(n+1))) (hf : ¬f.1=false) :
      (1-d/2)*(n+1:ℕ)-5*C/2-E≤dist y (z (M.tail (f,0))•y) := by
    rcases f with ⟨b,f⟩
    cases b
    · exact False.elim (hf rfl)
    · exact hvr (GridDisk.tail n (AngularSize n) (f,0))
  have hzero := refined_index_zero hG y hR M P S z L (fun f => f.1=false)
    (GridSphere.exact n (2*(n+1))) (GridDisk.exact H (3*K))
    (show D+1<w by dsimp [w]; linarith) hchart hmetric hmirror hinner houter hn2
  have hs : (1:ℤ)=0 := hone.symm.trans hzero
  norm_num at hs

end ArtinCAT0.SixSector

end OAI

    let := MulAction.compHom X f
    GeometricAction H X := by
  let := MulAction.compHom X f
  refine ⟨hG.1,fun h => hG.2.1 (f h),?_,?_⟩
  · intro K hK
    change (f ⁻¹' {g : G | ((fun x : X => g • x) '' K ∩ K).Nonempty}).Finite
    exact (hG.2.2.1 K hK).preimage (fun _ _ _ _ h => hf.1 h)
  · obtain ⟨K,hK,hcov⟩ := hG.2.2.2
    refine ⟨K,hK,?_⟩
    intro x
    obtain ⟨g,k,hk,hgk⟩ := hcov x
    obtain ⟨h,rfl⟩ := hf.2 g
    exact ⟨h,k,hk,hgk⟩

OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections.TreeAction.acylindricallyHyperbolic_of_free_segment
OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.text:
theorem acylindricallyHyperbolic_of_free_segment
    (hT : T.IsTree) (hA : PreservesAdj (G := G) T)
    (hbranch : ∀ x y : V,T.Adj x y →
      ∃ a : G,a • x=x ∧ Function.Injective (fun n : ℤ => a^n • y))
    (u v : V) (hne : u≠v) (hnadj : ¬T.Adj u v)
    (hfree : pairStabilizer (G := G) u v=⊥) : AcylindricallyHyperbolic G := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := hT.connected.exists_isPath u v
  have hpn : ¬p.Nil := fun h => hne (hp.nil_iff_eq.mp h)
  have hprn : ¬p.reverse.Nil := by
    intro h
    have hl := h.length_eq_zero
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] at hl
    exact hpn (SimpleGraph.Walk.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hl)
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ha'⟩ := hbranch u p.snd (p.adj_snd hpn)
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hb'⟩ := hbranch v p.reverse.snd (p.reverse.adj_snd hprn)
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqn,hqt,hqu,hqv⟩ := translation_segment T hA hT.isAcyclic p hp hpn
    a b ha hb (zpow_orbit_moves ha') (zpow_orbit_moves hb')
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hc'⟩ := hbranch u q.snd (q.adj_snd hqn)
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hd₁,hd₂⟩ := zpow_third_direction (z := (a*b)⁻¹ • q.reverse.snd) hc hc'
  let H := avoidingGraph (G := G) T u v
  have hH := avoidingGraph_connected T u v hT hA hne hnadj
  have hB := avoidingGraph_preservesAdj T u v hA
  let X := Space H hH
  let _ := action H hB hH
  obtain ⟨hgeo,hhyp,hiso,hacyl⟩ := avoiding_realization_geometry T u v hT hA hfree hne hnadj
  have hlim : HasThreeOrbitLimitPoints G X :=
    periodic_three_limit_points T u v hT hA hfree hne hnadj (a*b) q hq hqn hqt a hqu hqv d hd hd₁ hd₂
  exact ⟨X,inferInstance,action H hB hH,hgeo,hhyp,hiso,hacyl,hlim⟩

end HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections.TreeAction

OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections.visual_infinite_branching
OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.text:
theorem visual_infinite_branching {u v : VisualVertex M Y Z}
    (h : (visualGraph M Y Z).Adj u v) :
    ∃ a : Artin M, a∈MulAction.stabilizer (Artin M) u ∧
      Function.Injective (fun n : ℤ => a^n • v) := by
  obtain ⟨g,hu,hv⟩ := visual_adj_representatives M Y Z h
  have hside : visualSide Y Z v.1≠Set.univ := by
    cases v.1
    · exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hSplit.out.2.1).2
    · exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hSplit.out.2.2.1).2
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := Set.nonempty_compl.mpr hside
  have hgen : generator M t∈artinParabolic M (visualSide Y Z u.1) := by
    apply (generator_mem_standard_iff M _ _).mpr
    have hcover : visualSide Y Z u.1 ∪ visualSide Y Z v.1=Set.univ := by
      have hne := h.1
      cases hu' : u.1 <;> cases hv' : v.1
      · exact False.elim (hne (hu'.trans hv'.symm))
      · exact hSplit.out.1
      · exact Set.union_comm Y Z ▸ hSplit.out.1
      · exact False.elim (hne (hu'.trans hv'.symm))
    exact (hcover.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ t : t∈visualSide Y Z u.1 ∪ visualSide Y Z v.1).resolve_right ht
  let a := g*generator M t*g⁻¹
  have hapow (n : ℤ) : a^n=g*(generator M t)^n*g⁻¹ := by
    exact (map_zpow (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom (generator M t) n).symm
  refine ⟨a,?_,injective_zpow_orbit a v ?_⟩
  · rw [hu,visual_vertex_stabilizer,mem_conjugate]
    have he : g⁻¹*a*g=generator M t := by dsimp only [a]; group
    rw [he]
    exact hgen
  · intro n hn hm
    rw [hv,visual_vertex_stabilizer,mem_conjugate,hapow] at hm
    have he : g⁻¹*(g*generator M t^n*g⁻¹)*g=generator M t^n := by group
    rw [he] at hm
    exact generator_zpow_not_mem M (visualSide Y Z v.1) t ht n hn hm

end HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections

      ∀ P : Subgroup (Artin M),IsParabolic M P → P≠⊤ → WeaklyMalnormal P := by

theorem visual_acylindricallyHyperbolic (hIrred : IsIrreducible M) :
    AcylindricallyHyperbolic (Artin M) := by
  obtain ⟨u,v,hne,hu,hv,hfree⟩ := visual_trivial_pair_distinct_type M Y Z hIrred false
  apply acylindricallyHyperbolic_of_free_segment (visualGraph M Y Z)
    (visualGraph_isTree M Y Z) (visual_preservesAdj M Y Z) ?_ u v hne ?_ hfree
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨a,ha,hinj⟩ := visual_infinite_branching M Y Z hxy
    exact ⟨a,ha,hinj⟩
  · intro h
    exact h.1 (hu.trans hv.symm)

lemma visual_trivial_pair_distinct_type (hIrred : IsIrreducible M) (b : Bool) :
    ∃ u v : VisualVertex M Y Z, u≠v ∧ u.1=b ∧ v.1=b ∧
      pairStabilizer (G := Artin M) u v=⊥ := by
  obtain ⟨u,v,hne,he⟩ := visual_exists_trivial_pair M Y Z hIrred
  obtain ⟨w,hnw,hw,hew⟩ := trivial_pair_endpoint_type M Y Z u v hne he b
  have he' : pairStabilizer (G := Artin M) w u=⊥ := by
    simpa only [pairStabilizer,inf_comm] using hew
  obtain ⟨x,hnx,hx,hex⟩ := trivial_pair_endpoint_type M Y Z w u hnw.symm he' b
  exact ⟨w,x,hnx,hw,hx,hex⟩

    (hMesh : ∀ X : Set S, PublishedMeshInput (relativeMatrix M X))
    (E : Set (Artin M)) :

OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections.relative_embedding_input
OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.text:
theorem relative_embedding_input : VanDerLekRelativeEmbedding M X := by
  let N := relativeMatrix M X
  let T : Set (S⊕Unit) := Set.range Sum.inl
  let e : S ≃ T := Equiv.ofInjective (Sum.inl : S → S⊕Unit) Sum.inl_injective
  let R := restrictedMatrix N T
  have hu : ∀ i j : S, R (e i) (e j)=M i j := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hd : ∀ i j : T, M (e.symm i) (e.symm j)=R i j := by
    intro i j
    have hi : Sum.inl (e.symm i)=i.val := congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply i)
    have hj : Sum.inl (e.symm j)=j.val := congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply j)
    change M (e.symm i) (e.symm j)=N i.val j.val
    rw [←hi,←hj]
    rfl
  let up := artinMap M R e hu
  have hup : Function.Injective up := (artinMap_leftInverse M R e hu e.symm hd e.left_inv).injective
  have hfactor : (restrictedArtinHom N T).comp up=relativeArtinHom M X := by
    apply PresentedGroup.ext
    intro s
    change restrictedArtinHom N T (artinMap M R e hu (generator M s)) =
      relativeArtinHom M X (generator M s)
    rw [artinMap_generator,restrictedArtinHom_generator,relativeArtinHom_generator]
    rfl
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [←hfactor]
  exact (standardArtinEmbedding N T).comp hup

end HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections

OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections.relativeMatrix
OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.text:
noncomputable def relativeMatrix : CoxeterMatrix (S ⊕ Unit) := by
  classical
  exact {
    M := fun a b => match a, b with
      | .inl s, .inl t => M s t
      | .inl s, .inr _ => if s ∈ X then 2 else 3
      | .inr _, .inl s => if s ∈ X then 2 else 3
      | .inr _, .inr _ => 1
    isSymm := by
      apply Matrix.ext
      intro a b
      cases a <;> cases b <;> dsimp [Matrix.transpose]
      exact M.symmetric _ _
    diagonal := by intro a; cases a <;> simp
    off_diagonal := by
      intro a b h
      cases a with
      | inl s =>
        cases b with
        | inl t => exact M.off_diagonal s t (fun e => h (congrArg Sum.inl e))
        | inr u => dsimp; split_ifs <;> norm_num
      | inr u =>
        cases b with
        | inl t => dsimp; split_ifs <;> norm_num
        | inr v => exact (h (by cases u; cases v; rfl)).elim }

OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.text:
theorem proper_parabolic_weaklyMalnormal (hIrred : IsIrreducible M)
    (P : Subgroup (Artin M)) (hP : IsParabolic M P) (hne : P≠⊤) : WeaklyMalnormal P := by
  obtain ⟨X,g,rfl⟩ := hP
  have hX : X≠Set.univ := by
    intro he
    apply hne
    rw [he,standard_univ,conjugate_top]
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab⟩ := standard_parabolic_trivial_conjugates M Y Z hIrred X hX
  exact (weaklyMalnormal_of_conjugates_inf_bot _ a b hab).conjugate_subgroup g

OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections.infinite_pair_visual_split
OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.ParabolicInters.text:
lemma infinite_pair_visual_split (s t : S) (hst : s ≠ t) (hlabel : M s t=0) :
    IsVisualSplit M {s}ᶜ {t}ᶜ := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_union,Set.mem_compl_iff,Set.mem_singleton_iff,Set.mem_univ,iff_true]
    by_cases ha : a=s
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa [ha] using hst)
    · exact Or.inl ha
  · apply Set.ssubset_univ_iff.mpr
    intro h
    have hs : s ∈ ({s}ᶜ : Set S) := h.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ s
    simp at hs
  · apply Set.ssubset_univ_iff.mpr
    intro h
    have ht : t ∈ ({t}ᶜ : Set S) := h.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ t
    simp at ht
  · intro a ha b hb
    have hat : a=t := by simpa using ha.2
    have hbs : b=s := by simpa using hb.2
    subst a
    subst b
    rw [M.symmetric]
    exact hlabel

end HarmonicArtin.ParabolicIntersections

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:187.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.main
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:187.text:
theorem main : MainStatement := by
  intro η hη
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδ20,hbudget⟩ := small_delta_budget hη
  obtain ⟨X,L,C,hC,hL,hX,hE,hmax⟩ := almost_sign_sampler hδ hδ20
  let B := Real.sqrt ((1+δ)^3/(1-δ))+393216*Real.sqrt (δ*Real.log (20/δ))
  have hB : B<1+η := by dsimp [B]; linarith
  have hcast : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ (N : ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hsqrt : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp hcast
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ 1/Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    convert (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hsqrt) using 1
    funext N
    simp only [Function.comp_apply,one_div]
  have hrem : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ C/(N : ℝ)+196608*(1/Real.sqrt (N : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_add,mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat C).add (hinv.const_mul 196608)
  have her : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      C/(N : ℝ)+196608*(1/Real.sqrt (N : ℝ))<1+η-B :=
    hrem.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (sub_pos.mpr hB))
  have hen : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, 1-8*δ<(∑ k, (X N k)^2)/(N : ℝ) :=
    hE.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (show 1-8*δ<L by linarith))
  have hall : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      1≤N ∧ 1-8*δ<(∑ k, (X N k)^2)/(N : ℝ) ∧
        C/(N : ℝ)+196608*(1/Real.sqrt (N : ℝ))<1+η-B := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℕ),hen,her] with N hN hn hr
    exact ⟨hN,hn,hr⟩
  obtain ⟨N₀,hN₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hall
  refine ⟨N₀,(hN₀ N₀ le_rfl).1,?_⟩
  intro N hN
  obtain ⟨hN1,hen,her⟩ := hN₀ N hN
  have hNr : (0:ℝ)<N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<N by omega)
  have hener : (1-8*δ)*(N : ℝ)≤∑ k, (X N k)^2 :=
    ((lt_div_iff₀ hNr).mp hen).le
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hεb⟩ := round_sample_once hN1 hδ hδ20 (X N) (hX N hN1)
    hener (hmax N hN1)
  refine ⟨ε,hε,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNr)).mp
  have hb := hεb z hz
  dsimp [B] at her
  linarith

end
end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:74.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.small_delta_budget
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:74.text:
lemma small_delta_budget {η : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1/20 ∧
      Real.sqrt ((1+δ)^3/(1-δ))+393216*Real.sqrt (δ*Real.log (20/δ))<1+η/2 := by
  let f (x : ℝ) := Real.sqrt ((1+x)^3/(1-x))+
    393216*Real.sqrt (x*Real.log 20-x*Real.log x)
  have hf : ContinuousAt f 0 := by
    apply ContinuousAt.add
    · exact Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.comp
        (((continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id).pow 3).div
          (continuousAt_const.sub continuousAt_id) (by norm_num))
    · exact continuousAt_const.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.comp
        ((continuousAt_id.mul continuousAt_const).sub Real.continuous_mul_log.continuousAt))
  have hf0 : f 0=1 := by norm_num [f]
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hh⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hf (η/2) (by positivity)
  let δ := min (r/2) (1/40)
  have hδ : 0<δ := lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  have hδ20 : δ<1/20 := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hδr : δ<r := (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
  have hd : dist δ (0:ℝ)<r := by simpa only [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_pos hδ] using hδr
  have hval := hh hd
  rw [hf0,Real.dist_eq] at hval
  have he : f δ=Real.sqrt ((1+δ)^3/(1-δ))+393216*Real.sqrt (δ*Real.log (20/δ)) := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num : (20:ℝ)≠0) hδ.ne',mul_sub]
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,hδ20,?_⟩
  rw [he] at hval
  have := (abs_lt.mp hval).2
  linarith

end
end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:22.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.littlewood_phase
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:22.text:
lemma littlewood_phase {N : ℕ} (X : Fin N → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :

      ∑ k : Fin N, (X k : ℂ)*realPhase (2*Real.pi*t*k) := by

  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  congr 1
  rw [realPhase,← Complex.exp_nat_mul,realPhase]
  congr 1

  ring

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.BlockSampling:23.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Sampling.sample_packed
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.BlockSampling:23.text:
theorem sample_packed {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (a : I → J → ℤ) (c : I → ℂ) (v : J → ℝ) {H : ℕ} (hH : 1≤H)
    (θ : Fin H → J → ℝ)
    (hreal : ∀ y : J → UnitAddCircle, (∑ i, c i*mFourier (a i) y).im=0)
    (hbound : ∀ y : J → UnitAddCircle, ‖∑ i, c i*mFourier (a i) y‖≤1)
    (hlam : ∀ i, (∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*v j)≠0)
    (hwidth : ∀ i, |∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*v j|/(H : ℝ)<1)
    (hpack : ∀ h h' : Fin H, ∀ i i' : I, (h,i)≠(h',i') →
      Disjoint (circleInterval (((∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*θ h j : ℝ)) : UnitAddCircle)
        (|∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*v j|/H))
      (circleInterval (((∑ j, (a i' j : ℝ)*θ h' j : ℝ)) : UnitAddCircle)
        (|∑ j, (a i' j : ℝ)*v j|/H)))
    {K δ : ℝ} (hK : 0≤K) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (hc : ∀ i, ‖c i‖/Real.sqrt |∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*v j|≤K) :
    ∃ X : (N : ℕ) → Fin N → ℝ, ∃ L C : ℝ,
      0≤C ∧ (1-δ)*(∑ i, ‖c i‖^2)≤L ∧
      (∀ N : ℕ, 1≤N → ∀ k, |X N k|≤1) ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ (∑ k : Fin N, (X N k)^2)/(N : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 L) ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 1≤N → ∀ t∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        ‖(1/(Real.sqrt N : ℂ))*∑ k : Fin N, (X N k : ℂ)*realPhase (2*Real.pi*t*k)‖≤K+C/N := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨χ,hχs,hχc,hχi,hχb,hχm⟩ := block_cutoffs hH hδ
  let lam₀ (i : I) := ∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*v j
  let α (p : Fin H × I) := ∑ j, (a p.2 j : ℝ)*θ p.1 j
  let xstar (h : Fin H) := ((h : ℝ)+1/2)/H
  let lam (p : Fin H × I) := lam₀ p.2
  let b (p : Fin H × I) := α p-lam p*xstar p.1
  let d (p : Fin H × I) := lam p*(xstar p.1)^2/2
  let g (p : Fin H × I) (x : ℝ) : ℂ := (χ p.1 x : ℂ)
  let cp (p : Fin H × I) := c p.2
  have hgc (p : Fin H × I) : HasCompactSupport (g p) :=
    (hχc p.1).comp_left (show Complex.ofReal 0=0 by simp)
  have hgs (p : Fin H × I) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g p) :=
    Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp (hχs p.1)
  have hgb (p : Fin H × I) (x : ℝ) : ‖g p x‖≤1 := by
    simpa only [g,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hχb p.1 x).1] using (hχb p.1 x).2
  have hgis (p : Fin H × I) : tsupport (g p)⊆Set.Ioo ((p.1 : ℝ)/H) (((p.1 : ℝ)+1)/H) :=
    (tsupport_comp_subset (show Complex.ofReal 0=0 by simp) (χ p.1)).trans (hχi p.1)
  have hgi (p : Fin H × I) : tsupport (g p)⊆Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 := by
    apply (tsupport_comp_subset (show Complex.ofReal 0=0 by simp) (χ p.1)).trans
    exact block_support_unit hH p.1 (hχi p.1)
  have hsparse := stationary_unique hH Prod.fst g α lam (fun p ↦ hlam p.2)
    (fun p ↦ hwidth p.2) hgis (fun p q hpq ↦ hpack p.1 q.1 p.2 q.2 hpq)
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hmax⟩ := mode_maximum g cp lam b d hgc hgs hgi hgb
    (fun p ↦ hlam p.2) hK (fun p ↦ hc p.2) (by
      simpa only [b,xstar,mul_div_assoc] using hsparse)
  have hfreq (p q : Fin H × I) (hpq : p≠q) :
      (lam p≠lam q ∨ ∀ l : ℤ, (l : ℝ)≠b p-b q) ∨ ∀ x, g p x*conj (g q x)=0 := by
    by_cases hh : p.1=q.1
    · left
      by_cases hl : lam p=lam q
      · right
        have hd := disjoint_centers_noninteger
          (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg (lam p)) (Nat.cast_nonneg H))
          (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg (lam q)) (Nat.cast_nonneg H))
          (hpack p.1 q.1 p.2 q.2 hpq)
        have he : b p-b q=α p-α q := by dsimp [b]; rw [hh,hl]; ring
        simpa only [he] using hd
      · exact Or.inl hl
    · right
      intro x
      have hh' := blocks_disjoint hH χ hχi hh x
      simp only [g,Complex.conj_ofReal,← Complex.ofReal_mul,hh',Complex.ofReal_zero]
  have henergy := mode_energy g cp lam b d hgc hgs hgi hgb hfreq
  let L := (∑ h : Fin H, ∫ x : ℝ, (χ h x)^2)*(∑ i, ‖c i‖^2)
  have hL : (∑ p : Fin H × I, ‖cp p‖^2*(∫ x : ℝ, ‖g p x‖^2))=L := by
    simp only [cp,g,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs,Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [L,Finset.sum_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro h _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hL] at henergy
  let X (N : ℕ) (k : Fin N) := (modeSum g cp lam b d N k).re
  have hmode (N : ℕ) (hN : 1≤N) (k : Fin N) :
      modeSum g cp lam b d N k=
      ∑ h, (χ h ((k : ℝ)/N) : ℂ)*(∑ i, c i*mFourier (a i)
        (fun j ↦ (((k : ℝ)*θ h j+(N : ℝ)/2*v j*((k : ℝ)/N-xstar h)^2 : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle))) := by
    simp only [modeSum,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro h _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [mFourier_chirp (a i) (θ h) v (show 0<N by omega)]
    dsimp [g,cp,lam,lam₀,b,d,α]
    ring
  have hX (N : ℕ) (hN : 1≤N) (k : Fin N) : (X N k : ℂ)=modeSum g cp lam b d N k := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · rfl
    · simp only [Complex.ofReal_im,hmode N hN,Complex.im_sum,Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.ofReal_re,hreal,mul_zero,zero_mul,add_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hXb (N : ℕ) (hN : 1≤N) (k : Fin N) : |X N k|≤1 := by
    have hv := block_value_bound (fun h ↦ χ h ((k : ℝ)/N))
      (fun h ↦ ∑ i, c i*mFourier (a i)
        (fun j ↦ (((k : ℝ)*θ h j+(N : ℝ)/2*v j*((k : ℝ)/N-xstar h)^2 : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)))
      (fun h ↦ hχb h _) (fun h ↦ hbound _) (fun i j hn ↦ blocks_disjoint hH χ hχi hn _)
    rw [← hmode N hN k,← hX N hN k,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs] at hv
    exact hv
  refine ⟨X,L,C,hC,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hχm.le (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ sq_nonneg _)),hXb,?_,?_⟩
  · apply henergy.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℕ)] with N hN
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [← hX N hN k,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
  · intro N hN t ht
    simpa only [hX N hN] using hmax N hN t ht

end
end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Sampling

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.AlmostSign:12.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.almost_sign_sampler
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.AlmostSign:12.text:
theorem almost_sign_sampler {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ20 : δ<1/20) :
    ∃ X : (N : ℕ) → Fin N → ℝ, ∃ L C : ℝ,
      0≤C ∧ 1-7*δ≤L ∧
      (∀ N : ℕ, 1≤N → ∀ k, |X N k|≤1) ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ (∑ k : Fin N, (X N k)^2)/(N : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 L) ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 1≤N → ∀ t∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        ‖(1/(Real.sqrt N : ℂ))*∑ k : Fin N, (X N k : ℂ)*realPhase (2*Real.pi*t*k)‖≤
          Real.sqrt ((1+δ)^3/(1-δ))+C/N := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := Auxiliary.exists_auxiliary_packet hδ hδ20
  let D := P.data
  let a := D.frequency
  let c := D.coefficient
  let v := D.velocity
  let lam (i : P.I) := ∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*v j
  have hlam0 (i : P.I) : lam i≠0 := D.curvature i
  have hw : 2*∑ i, |lam i|<1 := D.width
  obtain ⟨H,hH,θ,hθ⟩ := Packing.signed_interval_packing_general a D.nonzero
    (fun i j hij t ↦ D.nonparallel j i hij.symm t) (fun i ↦ |lam i|)
    (fun i ↦ abs_pos.mpr (hlam0 i)) hw
  have hθlift (h : Fin H) (j : P.J) : ∃ t : ℝ, (t : UnitAddCircle)=θ h j :=
    QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective (θ h j)
  choose θr hθr using hθlift
  let A (ei : Bool × P.I) := if ei.1 then a ei.2 else -a ei.2
  let Cc (ei : Bool × P.I) := if ei.1 then c ei.2 else conj (c ei.2)
  have hal (ei : Bool × P.I) : |∑ j, (A ei j : ℝ)*v j|=|lam ei.2| := by
    rcases ei with ⟨e,i⟩
    cases e <;> simp [A,lam,Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hcn (ei : Bool × P.I) : ‖Cc ei‖=‖c ei.2‖ := by
    rcases ei with ⟨e,i⟩
    cases e <;> simp [Cc]
  have henergy : (∑ ei : Bool × P.I, ‖Cc ei‖^2)=2*∑ i, ‖c i‖^2 := by
    simp only [hcn,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.sum_bool]
    ring
  have hfourier (y : P.J → UnitAddCircle) :
      (∑ ei, Cc ei*mFourier (A ei) y)=
        (∑ i, c i*mFourier (a i) y)+conj (∑ i, c i*mFourier (a i) y) :=
    Sampling.signed_fourier_sum a c y
  have hreal (y) : (∑ ei, Cc ei*mFourier (A ei) y).im=0 := by
    rw [hfourier]
    simp only [Complex.add_im,Complex.conj_im,add_neg_cancel]
  have hbound (y) : ‖∑ ei, Cc ei*mFourier (A ei) y‖≤1 := by
    rw [hfourier]
    exact D.bounded y
  have hlam (ei : Bool × P.I) : (∑ j, (A ei j : ℝ)*v j)≠0 := by
    have hh : 0 < |∑ j, (A ei j : ℝ)*v j| := by rw [hal]; exact abs_pos.mpr (hlam0 ei.2)
    exact abs_pos.mp hh
  have hwidth (ei : Bool × P.I) : |∑ j, (A ei j : ℝ)*v j|/(H : ℝ)<1 := by
    rw [hal]
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i (_ : i∈Finset.univ) ↦ abs_nonneg (lam i)) (Finset.mem_univ ei.2)
    have hHr : (1:ℝ)≤H := by exact_mod_cast hH
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) hHr) (by linarith)
  have hlift (h : Fin H) (ei : Bool × P.I) :
      (((∑ j, (A ei j : ℝ)*θr h j : ℝ)) : UnitAddCircle)=
        Packing.signedCircle ei.1 (∑ j, a ei.2 j • θ h j) := by
    rcases ei with ⟨e,i⟩
    have hh : (((∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*θr h j : ℝ)) : UnitAddCircle)=
        ∑ j, a i j • θ h j := by
      change (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (AddSubgroup.zmultiples (1:ℝ))) (∑ j, (a i j : ℝ)*θr h j)=_
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [← zsmul_eq_mul,map_zsmul]
      change a i j • (θr h j : UnitAddCircle)=_
      rw [hθr]
    cases e <;> simp [A,Packing.signedCircle,Finset.sum_neg_distrib,hh]
  have hpack (h h' : Fin H) (ei ei' : Bool × P.I) (hne : (h,ei)≠(h',ei')) :
      Disjoint (Packing.circleInterval (((∑ j, (A ei j : ℝ)*θr h j : ℝ)) : UnitAddCircle)
        (|∑ j, (A ei j : ℝ)*v j|/H))
      (Packing.circleInterval (((∑ j, (A ei' j : ℝ)*θr h' j : ℝ)) : UnitAddCircle)
        (|∑ j, (A ei' j : ℝ)*v j|/H)) := by
    rw [hlift,hlift,hal,hal]
    apply hθ ei.1 ei'.1 ei.2 ei'.2 h h'
    intro he
    have he1 := congrArg (fun x : Bool × P.I × Fin H ↦ x.1) he
    have he2 := congrArg (fun x : Bool × P.I × Fin H ↦ x.2.1) he
    have he3 := congrArg (fun x : Bool × P.I × Fin H ↦ x.2.2) he
    exact hne (Prod.ext he3 (Prod.ext he1 he2))
  let K := Real.sqrt ((1+δ)^3/(1-δ))
  have hδ1 : δ<1 := by linarith
  have hbudget : 0≤(1+δ)^3/(1-δ) := by positivity
  have hc (ei : Bool × P.I) : ‖Cc ei‖/Real.sqrt |∑ j, (A ei j : ℝ)*v j|≤K := by
    rw [hal,hcn]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (abs_pos.mpr (hlam0 ei.2)))).mpr
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))).mp
    rw [mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt (abs_nonneg _),show K^2=(1+δ)^3/(1-δ) by exact Real.sq_sqrt hbudget]
    exact D.size ei.2
  obtain ⟨X,L,C,hC,hL,hX,hE,hmax⟩ := Sampling.sample_packed A Cc v hH θr
    hreal hbound hlam hwidth hpack (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hδ hc
  refine ⟨X,L,C,hC,?_,hX,hE,hmax⟩
  rw [henergy] at hL
  have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left D.energy (show 0≤1-δ by linarith)
  have hn : 1-7*δ≤(1-δ)*(1-3*δ)^2 := by
    have hp : 0≤δ^2*(15-9*δ) := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  exact hn.trans (he.trans hL)

end
end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:8.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.unitCircle_parameter
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:8.text:
lemma unitCircle_parameter {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖=1) :
    ∃ t∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, z=realPhase (2*Real.pi*t) := by
  let Z : Circle := ⟨z,by change dist z 0=1; simpa using hz⟩
  let u := (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle (T := (1:ℝ)) one_ne_zero).symm Z
  let t := AddCircle.equivIco (1:ℝ) 0 u
  refine ⟨t.val,⟨t.property.1,by simpa using t.property.2.le⟩,?_⟩
  have hu : (t.val : UnitAddCircle)=u := AddCircle.coe_equivIco
  have hs : Circle.exp (2*Real.pi*t.val)=Z := by
    rw [show 2*Real.pi*t.val=2*Real.pi/(1:ℝ)*t.val by ring]
    rw [← AddCircle.toCircle_apply_mk,hu,← AddCircle.homeomorphCircle_apply one_ne_zero]
    exact (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero).apply_symm_apply Z
  have hcoe := congrArg (fun w : Circle ↦ (w : ℂ)) hs
  simpa only [Circle.coe_exp,realPhase,mul_comm] using hcoe.symm

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.IntervalPacking:.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.signed_interval_packing_general
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.IntervalPacking:.text:
theorem signed_interval_packing_general {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [Nonempty I] (a : I → J → ℤ) (ha : ∀ i, a i≠0)
    (hnp : ∀ i j, i≠j → ∀ c : ℝ, ¬∀ k, (a j k : ℝ)=c*(a i k : ℝ))
    (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0<w i) (hs : 2*∑ i, w i<1) :
    ∃ H : ℕ, 1≤H ∧ ∃ θ : Fin H → J → UnitAddCircle,
      ∀ e f : Bool, ∀ i j : I, ∀ h v : Fin H, (e,i,h)≠(f,j,v) →
        Disjoint (circleInterval (signedCircle e (∑ k, a i k • θ h k)) (w i/H))
          (circleInterval (signedCircle f (∑ k, a j k • θ v k)) (w j/H)) := by
  classical
  let A : Option I → Option J → ℤ := fun i k ↦ match i,k with
    | none,none => 1 | some i,some k => a i k | _,_ => 0
  let W : Option I → ℝ := fun i ↦ match i with
    | none => (1-2*∑ i, w i)/4 | some i => w i
  have hcard : 2≤Fintype.card (Option I) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_option]
    have := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr (inferInstance : Nonempty I)
    omega
  have hA (i : Option I) : A i≠0 := by
    cases i with
    | none => intro h; have := congrFun h none; simp [A] at this
    | some i =>
      intro h
      apply ha i
      funext k
      have := congrFun h (some k)
      simpa [A] using this
  have hNP (i j : Option I) (hij : i≠j) (c : ℝ) :
      ¬∀ k, (A j k : ℝ)=c*(A i k : ℝ) := by
    intro he
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact hij rfl
      | some j =>
        apply ha j
        funext k
        have hh := he (some k)
        simpa [A] using hh
    | some i =>
      cases j with
      | none => have hh := he none; norm_num [A] at hh
      | some j =>
        exact hnp i j (fun h ↦ hij (congrArg some h)) c (fun k ↦ by simpa [A] using he (some k))
  have hW (i : Option I) : 0<W i := by
    cases i with
    | none => dsimp [W]; linarith
    | some i => exact hw i
  have hsum : 2*∑ i, W i<1 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_option]
    change 2*((1-2*∑ i, w i)/4+∑ i, w i)<1
    linarith
  obtain ⟨H,hH,θ,hθ⟩ := signed_interval_packing_fintype hcard A hA hNP W hW hsum
  refine ⟨H,hH,(fun h k ↦ θ h (some k)),?_⟩
  intro e f i j h v hne
  have hh := hθ e f (some i) (some j) h v (by
    intro he
    apply hne
    obtain ⟨hef,hij,hv⟩ := Prod.mk.inj he |>.imp id Prod.mk.inj
    exact Prod.ext hef (Prod.ext (Option.some.inj hij) hv))
  simpa only [Fintype.sum_option,A,zero_smul,zero_add,W] using hh

end
end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.IntervalPacking:.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.signedCircle
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.IntervalPacking:.text: def signedCircle (e : Bool) (z : UnitAddCircle) : UnitAddCircle := if e then z else -z

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:132.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.round_sample_once
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:132.text:
lemma round_sample_once {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) {δ K C : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ20 : δ<1/20) (X : Fin N → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ k, |X k|≤1)
    (hE : (1-8*δ)*(N : ℝ)≤∑ k, (X k)^2)
    (hmax : ∀ t∈Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
      ‖(1/(Real.sqrt N : ℂ))*∑ k : Fin N, (X k : ℂ)*realPhase (2*Real.pi*t*k)‖≤K+C/N) :
    ∃ ε : Fin N → ℝ, IsRealSigning ε ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖=1 →
      ‖littlewoodValue ε z‖/Real.sqrt N≤
        K+C/N+196608*(1/Real.sqrt N+2*Real.sqrt (δ*Real.log (20/δ))) := by
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hround⟩ := defect_rounding hN X hX
  refine ⟨ε,hε,?_⟩
  have hNr : (0:ℝ)<N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<N by omega)
  have hNs : 0<Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNr
  have hDL : 0≤δ*Real.log (20/δ) := mul_nonneg hδ.le
    (Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr (by linarith)))
  obtain ⟨hμ0,hμb⟩ := defect_from_energy hN X hX hE
  have hentr := entropy_small_defect hδ hδ20 hNr hμ0 hμb
  have hroot : Real.sqrt (defectMass X*Real.log (80*(N : ℝ)/defectMass X))≤
      2*Real.sqrt (δ*Real.log (20/δ))*Real.sqrt N := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)).mpr
    rw [mul_pow,mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt hDL,Real.sq_sqrt hNr.le]
    nlinarith
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := unitCircle_parameter hz
  have hm := hmax t ht
  rw [← littlewood_phase] at hm
  have hn : ‖(1/(Real.sqrt N : ℂ))*littlewoodValue X (realPhase (2*Real.pi*t))‖=
      ‖littlewoodValue X (realPhase (2*Real.pi*t))‖/Real.sqrt N := by
    rw [norm_mul,norm_div,norm_one,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hNs]
    ring
  rw [hn] at hm
  have hr := hround (realPhase (2*Real.pi*t)) (by simp)
  have hr' : ‖littlewoodValue ε (realPhase (2*Real.pi*t))-
      littlewoodValue X (realPhase (2*Real.pi*t))‖≤
        196608*(1+2*Real.sqrt (δ*Real.log (20/δ))*Real.sqrt N) := by
    exact hr.trans (by nlinarith)
  have hd := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hr' hNs.le
  have he : (196608*(1+2*Real.sqrt (δ*Real.log (20/δ))*Real.sqrt N))/Real.sqrt N=
      196608*(1/Real.sqrt N+2*Real.sqrt (δ*Real.log (20/δ))) := by
    field_simp
  rw [he] at hd
  have ht := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (norm_le_norm_sub_add (littlewoodValue ε (realPhase (2*Real.pi*t)))
      (littlewoodValue X (realPhase (2*Real.pi*t)))) hNs.le
  rw [add_div] at ht
  linarith

end
end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood

noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators Topology

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.BlockSampling:19.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Sampling.signed_fourier_sum
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.BlockSampling:19.text:
lemma signed_fourier_sum {I : Type uI} {J : Type uJ} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (a : I → J → ℤ) (c : I → ℂ) (y : J → UnitAddCircle) :
    (∑ ei : Bool × I, (if ei.1 then c ei.2 else conj (c ei.2))*
      mFourier (if ei.1 then a ei.2 else -a ei.2) y)=
      (∑ i, c i*mFourier (a i) y)+conj (∑ i, c i*mFourier (a i) y) := by
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.sum_bool,ite_true,Bool.false_eq_true,
    ite_false,mFourier_neg,map_sum,map_mul]

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.IntervalPacking:.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.Packing.circleInterval
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.IntervalPacking:.text:
def circleInterval (c : UnitAddCircle) (ℓ : ℝ) : Set UnitAddCircle :=
  {z | ∃ t : ℝ, |t|≤ℓ/2 ∧ z=c+(t : UnitAddCircle)}

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:111.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.defect_from_energy
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:111.text:
lemma defect_from_energy {N : ℕ} (_hN : 1≤N) {δ : ℝ} (X : Fin N → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ k, |X k|≤1)
    (hE : (1-8*δ)*(N : ℝ)≤∑ k, (X k)^2) :
    0≤defectMass X ∧ defectMass X≤4*δ*N := by
  have hμ : 0≤defectMass X := div_nonneg
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ ↦ sub_nonneg.mpr (hX k))) (by norm_num)
  have hs : (∑ k, (1-|X k|))≤∑ k, (1-(X k)^2) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k _
    have hh := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg (X k)) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hX k))
    nlinarith [sq_abs (X k)]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one] at hs
  refine ⟨hμ,?_⟩
  dsimp [defectMass]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one]
  nlinarith

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:41.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.entropy_small_defect
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.Main:41.text:
lemma entropy_small_defect {δ N u : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hδ20 : δ<1/20)
    (hN : 0<N) (hu : 0≤u) (hub : u≤4*δ*N) :
    u*Real.log (80*N/u)≤4*δ*N*Real.log (20/δ) := by
  have hlog2 : (1/2:ℝ)≤Real.log 2 := by
    have := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)
    norm_num at this ⊢
    exact this
  have hL : 1≤Real.log (20/δ) := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4)
      (show 4≤20/δ by apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr; linarith)
    rw [show (4:ℝ)=2^2 by norm_num,Real.log_pow] at hh
    norm_num at hh
    linarith
  by_cases hz : u=0
  · rw [hz]
    simp only [zero_mul]
    positivity
  have hup : 0<u := lt_of_le_of_ne hu (Ne.symm hz)
  have hb : 0<4*δ*N := by positivity
  have hsplit : Real.log (80*N/u)=Real.log (20/δ)+Real.log ((4*δ*N)/u) := by
    rw [← Real.log_mul (by positivity : 20/δ≠0) (by positivity : (4*δ*N)/u≠0)]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  have hs : u*Real.log ((4*δ*N)/u)≤4*δ*N-u := by
    calc
      _ ≤ u*((4*δ*N)/u-1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)) hu
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hub (sub_nonneg.mpr hL)
  rw [hsplit,mul_add]
  nlinarith

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Lattice.LatticeG.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.dualA_integer_coordinates
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Lattice.LatticeG.text:
lemma dualA_integer_coordinates {w : Plane} (hw : w∈dualA) :
    ∃ j k : ℤ,w 0=(Real.sqrt b)*(j:ℝ) ∧ (Real.sqrt b)*w 1=(k:ℝ)-(j:ℝ)/2 := by
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hw (triangularPoint (1,0)) ⟨(1,0),rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hw (triangularPoint (0,1)) ⟨(0,1),rfl⟩
  have hr : (Real.sqrt b)^2=b := Real.sq_sqrt b_pos.le
  have hp : 0 < Real.sqrt b := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr b_pos
  simp [triangularPoint,inner_smul_left,inner_add_left,EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left] at hj hk
  refine ⟨j,k,?_,?_⟩
  · field_simp at hj
    nlinarith
  · field_simp at hj hk
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hp.ne')
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t*w 1) hr]

lemma fourier_inputComplex (a : InputCoefficients) : 𝓕 (inputComplex a) = outputComplex a := by
  ext w
  simp only [Real.fourier_eq,inputComplex_spectral,smul_add]
  rw [integral_add ((Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff w).mpr (integrable_spectral (tailSpectral a) h_pos))
    ((Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff w).mpr (integrable_spectral (finiteSpectral a) H_pos))]
  change 𝓕 (fun x => exp (-(Real.pi:ℂ)*h*(radial x:ℂ))*tailSpectral a (phaseFunction (radial x:ℂ))) w +
    𝓕 (fun x => exp (-(Real.pi:ℂ)*H*(radial x:ℂ))*finiteSpectral a (phaseFunction (radial x:ℂ))) w = _
  rw [fourier_spectral _ h_pos h,fourier_spectral _ H_pos h]
  simp only [outputComplex,transformedInput,mul_add]

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Main:40.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.Construction.largeGaussian_hasAtomicConstruction
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Main:40.text:
lemma largeGaussian_hasAtomicConstruction {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) :
    HasAtomicConstruction α (largeGaussianPair hα).first := by
  let z := gaussianZ α
  have hz : 0 < z := (gaussianZ_bounds hα).1
  have hzB : z ≤ Z := (gaussianZ_bounds hα).2.le
  refine ⟨FiniteCertificate.minusBlock_isUnit, FiniteCertificate.plusBlock_isUnit,
    Uplus_equation, Uminus_equation,
    (fun side => actualInput side z hz hzB),
    (fun side i => actualFiniteError side z hz hzB i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro side
    obtain ⟨hc, hd⟩ := actualInput_fixed_zero side hz hzB
    refine ⟨rfl, hc, hd, ?_⟩
    intro i
    dsimp only
    rw [actualInput, finiteCoordinates_coefficientInput]
    rfl
  · intro side
    refine ⟨?_, (actualInput side z hz hzB).summable, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [AtomicTriangular.L1Kernel.l1_norm, tsum_fintype] using
        actualFiniteError_norm side hz hzB
    · change (∑' n : TailNode,
        (|actualTail side z hz hzB (n,0)| + |actualTail side z hz hzB (n,1)|)) < _
      rw [tail_pairs_norm]
      exact actualTail_norm side hz hzB
  · intro x
    change ((((normalizingDen z)⁻¹ *
        pairSchwartz (actualInput 0 z hz hzB) (actualInput 1 z hz hzB) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) = _
    rw [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_inv, ← pairComplex_eq, fourier_inputComplex]
    simp only [pairComplex, Pi.add_apply]
    ring

end AtomicTriangular.Construction

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Lattice.LatticeG.text:
lemma A_radial_node {x : Plane} (hx : x∈A) (hx0 : x≠0) :
    ∃ n : Construction.Node,Construction.radial x=n.val := by
  obtain ⟨⟨j,k⟩,rfl⟩ := hx
  let n : ℤ := j^2+j*k+k^2
  have he : Construction.radial (triangularPoint (j,k))=(n:ℝ) := by
    change b*‖triangularPoint (j,k)‖^2=_
    rw [triangularPoint_norm_sq]
    dsimp [n]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    have hp : 0 < Construction.radial (triangularPoint (j,k)) :=
      mul_pos b_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx0))
    rw [he] at hp
    exact_mod_cast hp
  exact ⟨⟨n,hn,eisenstein_mod36 j k⟩,he⟩

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Schwartz.Gaussia.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.reciprocalGaussianPair
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Schwartz.Gaussia.text:
def reciprocalGaussianPair {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (p : GaussianPair α⁻¹) : GaussianPair α where
  first := gaussianSchwartz α hα-α⁻¹ • p.second
  second := α⁻¹ • (gaussianSchwartz α⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hα)-p.first)
  first_radial := by
    intro x y hxy
    simp only [sub_apply,smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,gaussianSchwartz_apply,
      gaussian_radial α x y hxy,p.second_radial x y hxy]
  second_radial := by
    intro x y hxy
    simp only [sub_apply,smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,gaussianSchwartz_apply,
      gaussian_radial α⁻¹ x y hxy,p.first_radial x y hxy]
  fourier_first w := by
    rw [realFourier_sub,gaussianSchwartz_coe]
    change realFourier (gaussian α) w-realFourier (α⁻¹ • (p.second:Plane → ℝ)) w=_
    rw [realFourier_gaussian hα,realFourier_smul,p.fourier_second]
    simp only [smul_apply,sub_apply,smul_eq_mul,gaussianSchwartz_apply,ofReal_mul,ofReal_sub]
    ring
  fourier_second w := by
    change realFourier (α⁻¹ • ((gaussianSchwartz α⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hα)-p.first : 𝓢(Plane,ℝ)):Plane → ℝ)) w=_
    rw [realFourier_smul,realFourier_sub,gaussianSchwartz_coe]
    rw [realFourier_gaussian (inv_pos.mpr hα),p.fourier_first,inv_inv]
    simp only [sub_apply,smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,gaussianSchwartz_apply,ofReal_mul,ofReal_sub,ofReal_inv]
    field_simp [hα.ne']
  minorant x := by
    change gaussianSchwartz α hα x-α⁻¹*p.second x ≤ _
    rw [gaussianSchwartz_apply]
    exact sub_le_self _ (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hα.le) (p.positive x))
  positive x := by
    change 0 ≤ α⁻¹*(gaussianSchwartz α⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hα) x-p.first x)
    rw [gaussianSchwartz_apply]
    exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hα.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr (p.minorant x))
  contact x n hx := by
    change gaussianSchwartz α hα x-α⁻¹*p.second x=_
    rw [p.zeros x n hx,mul_zero,sub_zero,gaussianSchwartz_apply]
  zeros x n hx := by
    change α⁻¹*(gaussianSchwartz α⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hα) x-p.first x)=0
    rw [p.contact x n hx,gaussianSchwartz_apply,sub_self,mul_zero]

lemma tail_pairs_norm (w : TailCoefficients) :
    (∑' n, (|w (n,0)| + |w (n,1)|))=‖w‖ := by
  rw [l1_norm]
  symm
  calc
    (∑' p, |w p|) = ∑' n : TailNode, ∑' d : Fin 2, |w (n,d)| := (l1_summable w).tsum_prod

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Main:75.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.sharp_gaussian_minorants_atomic
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Main:75.text:
theorem sharp_gaussian_minorants_atomic (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ f : SchwartzMap Plane ℝ,
      Radial f ∧ (∀ x, f x ≤ gaussian α x) ∧
      (∀ w, (realFourier f w).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (realFourier f w).re) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ A, a ≠ 0 → f a = gaussian α a) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ dualA, w ≠ 0 → realFourier f w = 0) ∧
      (1 ≤ α → Construction.HasAtomicConstruction α f) := by
  let p := gaussianPair α hα
  refine ⟨p.first, p.first_radial, p.minorant, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w
    rw [p.fourier_first]
    exact ⟨rfl, p.positive w⟩
  · intro a ha ha0
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := A_radial_node ha ha0
    exact p.contact a n hn
  · intro w hw hw0
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := dualA_radial_node hw hw0
    rw [p.fourier_first, p.zeros w n hn, ofReal_zero]
  · intro hlarge
    change Construction.HasAtomicConstruction α (gaussianPair α hα).first
    rw [gaussianPair, dite_eq_left hlarge]
    exact Construction.largeGaussian_hasAtomicConstruction hlarge

end AtomicTriangular

end

lemma actualInput_fixed_zero (side : Fin 2) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (hzB : z ≤ Z) :

    (actualInput side z hz hzB).finiteD 0 = 0 := by

    erw [finiteApprox_fixed side (actualParameter z) 1,

def largeGaussianPair {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 ≤ α) : GaussianPair α where
  first := actualSchwartz 0 (gaussianZ α) (gaussianZ_bounds hα).1 (gaussianZ_bounds hα).2.le
  second := actualSchwartz 1 (gaussianZ α) (gaussianZ_bounds hα).1 (gaussianZ_bounds hα).2.le
  first_radial := actualSchwartz_radial 0 _ _
  second_radial := actualSchwartz_radial 1 _ _
  fourier_first := actualSchwartz_fourier _ _
  fourier_second := actualSchwartz_fourier_side 1 _ _
  minorant x := (actualSchwartz_signs hα x).1
  positive x := (actualSchwartz_signs hα x).2
  contact x n hx := (actualSchwartz_node hα x n hx).1
  zeros x n hx := (actualSchwartz_node hα x n hx).2

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Schwartz.Gaussia.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.GaussianPair
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Schwartz.Gaussia.text:
structure GaussianPair (α : ℝ) where
  first : 𝓢(Plane,ℝ)
  second : 𝓢(Plane,ℝ)
  first_radial : Radial first
  second_radial : Radial second

  fourier_second : ∀ w, realFourier second w=(first w:ℂ)
  minorant : ∀ x, first x ≤ gaussian α x
  positive : ∀ x, 0 ≤ second x
  contact : ∀ x (n : Construction.Node), Construction.radial x=n.val → first x=gaussian α x
  zeros : ∀ x (n : Construction.Node), Construction.radial x=n.val → second x=0
