OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Lattice.LatticeG.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.eisenstein_mod36
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Lattice.LatticeG.text:
lemma eisenstein_mod36 (j k : ℤ) :
    (j^2+j*k+k^2)%36∈Construction.residues := by
  let j' : Fin 36 := ⟨(j%36).toNat,by have := Int.emod_nonneg j (by norm_num : (36:ℤ)≠0); have := Int.emod_lt_of_pos j (by norm_num : (0:ℤ)<36); omega⟩
  let k' : Fin 36 := ⟨(k%36).toNat,by have := Int.emod_nonneg k (by norm_num : (36:ℤ)≠0); have := Int.emod_lt_of_pos k (by norm_num : (0:ℤ)<36); omega⟩
  have hj : (j'.val:ℤ)=j%36 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg j (by norm_num))
  have hk : (k'.val:ℤ)=k%36 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg k (by norm_num))
  have hh := eisenstein_mod36_finite j' k'
  rw [hj,hk] at hh
  simpa [Int.add_emod,Int.mul_emod,pow_two,Int.emod_emod] using hh

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Lattice.LatticeG.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.dualA_radial_node
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Lattice.LatticeG.text:
lemma dualA_radial_node {w : Plane} (hw : w∈dualA) (hw0 : w≠0) :
    ∃ n : Construction.Node,Construction.radial w=n.val := by
  obtain ⟨j,k,hj,hk⟩ := dualA_integer_coordinates hw
  let n : ℤ := j^2-j*k+k^2
  have he : Construction.radial w=(n:ℝ) := by
    change b*‖w‖^2=_
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
    have hr : (Real.sqrt b)^2=b := Real.sq_sqrt b_pos.le
    have hb := b_sq
    have hk' := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t^2) hk
    rw [mul_pow,hr] at hk'
    rw [hj,mul_pow,hr]
    dsimp [n]
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    have hpos : 0 < Construction.radial w := mul_pos b_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0))
    rw [he] at hpos
    exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hm : n%36∈Construction.residues := by
    convert eisenstein_mod36 j (-k) using 1
    dsimp [n]
    congr 1
    ring
  exact ⟨⟨n,hn,hm⟩,he⟩
end AtomicTriangular
end

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Basic:214.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.Construction.HasAtomicConstruction
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Basic:214.text:
def HasAtomicConstruction (α : ℝ) (f : Plane → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsUnit (1 - R) ∧ IsUnit (1 + R) ∧
  (1 - R) * Uplus = Yf + R0 * (gamma 1 + gamma 0) ∧
  (1 + R) * Uminus = Yf + R0 * (gamma 1 - gamma 0) ∧
  ∃ (a : Fin 2 → InputCoefficients) (u : Fin 2 → Fin 20 → ℝ),
    (∀ side,
      (a side).C = (if side.val = 0 then -(3/500) else 3/500) ∧
      (a side).finiteC 0 = 11/25 ∧ (a side).finiteD 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 22,
        finiteCoordinates (a side) i =
          (∑ j : Fin 8, Acoefficient side ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ j *
            actualParameter (gaussianZ α) j) +
          (if hi : i.val < 2 then 0 else u side ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩)) ∧
    (∀ side,
      (∑ i : Fin 20, |u side i|) < 1/10^5 ∧
      Summable (fun n : TailNode => |(a side).tailC n| + |(a side).tailD n|) ∧
      (∑' n : TailNode, (|(a side).tailC n| + |(a side).tailD n|)) < 3/10^9) ∧
    (∀ x : Plane, (f x : ℂ) =
      (inputComplex (a 0) x + 𝓕 (inputComplex (a 1)) x) /
        (normalizingDen (gaussianZ α) : ℂ))

end AtomicTriangular.Construction

lemma Uplus_equation : (1-R)*Uplus = Yf+R0*(gamma 1+gamma 0) := by

OAI.Algebra.AuslanderReiten.BaseChange.S.name: OAI.ArExplicit.scalarExtension_smul_tmul

theorem scalarExtension_smul_tmul (e e' : E) (r : R) (m : M) :
    (e ⊗ₜ[k] r) • (e' ⊗ₜ[k] m) = (e * e') ⊗ₜ[k] (r • m) := by
  change ((scalarExtensionRepresentation k E R M) (e ⊗ₜ[k] r)) (e' ⊗ₜ[k] m) = _
  rfl

instance scalarExtensionIsScalarTower :
    IsScalarTower E (E ⊗[k] R) (E ⊗[k] M) :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun e x => by
    change ((scalarExtensionRepresentation k E R M)
      (algebraMap E (E ⊗[k] R) e)) x = e • x
    rw [AlgHom.commutes]
    rfl

instance scalarExtensionBaseIsScalarTower :
    IsScalarTower k (E ⊗[k] R) (E ⊗[k] M) :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun a x => by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k E (E ⊗[k] R),
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (E ⊗[k] R), IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul E]

end BaseChange

OAI.Algebra.AuslanderReiten.StatementEqu.text:
theorem fullStatement_of_mainConclusions (c : ArExplicit.Candidate)
    (h : ArExplicit.MainConclusions ArExplicit.BaseField c.R c.M) : FullStatement.{v} := by
  let s : System :=
    { algebraCarrier := c.R
      ring := c.ring
      scalarAlgebra := c.algebra
      moduleCarrier := c.M
      additiveGroup := c.addCommGroup
      action := c.module
      scalarAction := c.baseModule
      actionTower := c.tower }
  refine ⟨ArExplicit.parameters_algebraicallyIndependent,s,conclusions_iff.mp h,?_⟩
  intro E _ _
  let := ArExplicit.scalarExtensionModule K E c.R c.M
  refine ⟨ArExplicit.scalarExtensionModule K E c.R c.M,
    ArExplicit.scalarExtensionIsScalarTower K E c.R c.M,?_,?_⟩
  · intro a b r z
    exact ArExplicit.scalarExtension_smul_tmul K E c.R c.M a b r z
  · exact conclusions_iff.mp (h.scalarExtension E)

end ArExplicit.Statement

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Algebr.text:
lemma direct_mainClaim : Hyperinvariant233.MainClaim (H:=GlobalHilbert) :=
  ⟨forwardOperator,forwardOperator_ne_zero,forwardOperator_quasinilpotent,forward_transitiveCommutant⟩
open scoped ENNReal
instance fiber_separable : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace Fiber := by
  let s : Set Fiber := Set.range (fun j : ℤ => lp.single 2 j (1:ℂ))
  have hs : TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable s := (Set.countable_range _).isSeparable
  have hc : closure (Submodule.span ℂ s : Set Fiber) = Set.univ := by
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro v
    let P := (Submodule.span ℂ s).topologicalClosure
    change v ∈ P
    apply (Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).mem_of_tendsto
      (lp.hasSum_single (by norm_num : (2:ENNReal) ≠ ∞) v)
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro t
    apply P.sum_mem
    intro j _
    apply Submodule.le_topologicalClosure
    have hj : (lp.single 2 j (1:ℂ) : Fiber) ∈ Submodule.span ℂ s :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨j,rfl⟩
    simpa only [←lp.single_smul,smul_eq_mul,mul_one] using
      (Submodule.span ℂ s).smul_mem (v j) hj
  exact TopologicalSpace.isSeparable_univ_iff.mp (hc ▸ hs.span.closure)
instance global_nontrivial : Nontrivial GlobalHilbert :=
  not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp (by
    intro hs
    let := hs
    exact globalHilbert_infinite inferInstance)
instance global_separable : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace GlobalHilbert := by
  change TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (Lp Fiber 2 baseMeasure)
  let : Fact ((2:ENNReal) ≠ ∞) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  infer_instance

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Hilber.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.exists_nat_hilbertBasis
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Hilber.text:
theorem exists_nat_hilbertBasis (hInf : ¬FiniteDimensional ℂ H) :
    Nonempty (HilbertBasis ℕ ℂ H) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨w, b, hb⟩ := exists_hilbertBasis ℂ H
  have hw : Orthonormal ℂ (Subtype.val : w → H) := by
    simpa only [hb] using b.orthonormal
  let : Countable w := orthonormal_subtype_countable w hw
  let : Infinite w := by
    refine not_finite_iff_infinite.mp ?_
    intro hfin
    let : Finite w := hfin
    let : Fintype w := Fintype.ofFinite w
    exact hInf (Module.Finite.of_basis b.toOrthonormalBasis.toBasis)
  let e : ℕ ≃ w := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (ℕ ≃ w))
  have ho : Orthonormal ℂ (b ∘ e) := b.orthonormal.comp e e.injective
  have hr : Set.range (b ∘ e) = Set.range b := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e n, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e.symm i, by simp⟩
  exact ⟨HilbertBasis.mk ho (by rw [hr, b.dense_span])⟩

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.norm_conjugate
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.text:
theorem norm_conjugate (e : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖e.conjStarAlgEquiv T‖ = ‖T‖ := by
  apply le_antisymm (norm_conjugate_le e T)
  have he : e.symm.conjStarAlgEquiv (e.conjStarAlgEquiv T) = T := by
    ext x
    simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply,
      LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm, LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h := norm_conjugate_le e.symm (e.conjStarAlgEquiv T)
  rwa [he] at h

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Hilber.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.strongOperatorTopology

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.commutant_ne_top_of_nonzero_quasinilpotent
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.text:
theorem commutant_ne_top_of_nonzero_quasinilpotent [Nontrivial H]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : T ≠ 0)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖T ^ n‖ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    commutant T ≠ ⊤ := by
  intro htop
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := scalar_of_commutant_top T htop
  have hroot (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : ‖T ^ n‖ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) = ‖c‖ := by
    rw [← hc, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_pow, one_pow,
      norm_smul, norm_pow, norm_one, mul_one, one_div]
    exact Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast (norm_nonneg c) hn
  have hevent : (fun n : ℕ => ‖T ^ n‖ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) =ᶠ[atTop]
      (fun _ : ℕ => ‖c‖) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
    exact hroot n (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => ‖c‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := hlim.congr' hevent
  have hc0 : ‖c‖ = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds hconst
  apply hT
  rw [← hc, norm_eq_zero.mp hc0, map_zero]

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Algebr.name: OAI.BackwardIntertwiners.direct_algebra_corollary
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Algebr.text:
theorem direct_algebra_corollary (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace H] (hInf : ¬FiniteDimensional ℂ H) :
    Hyperinvariant233.FullClaim (H:=H) := by
  let : Nontrivial H := not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp (by
    intro hs
    let : Subsingleton H := hs
    exact hInf inferInstance)
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Hyperinvariant233.nonempty_linearIsometryEquiv
    (H:=GlobalHilbert) (K:=H) globalHilbert_infinite hInf
  exact Hyperinvariant233.fullClaim_of_mainClaim (Hyperinvariant233.mainClaim_transport e direct_mainClaim)

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Hilber.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.nonempty_linearIsometryEquiv
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Hilber.text:
theorem nonempty_linearIsometryEquiv
    {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    [CompleteSpace K] [SeparableSpace K]
    (hH : ¬FiniteDimensional ℂ H) (hK : ¬FiniteDimensional ℂ K) :
    Nonempty (H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) := by
  obtain ⟨bH⟩ := exists_nat_hilbertBasis hH
  obtain ⟨bK⟩ := exists_nat_hilbertBasis hK
  exact ⟨bH.repr.trans bK.repr.symm⟩

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Hilber.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.TransitiveCommutant
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Hilber.text:
def TransitiveCommutant (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : Prop :=
  ∀ K : Submodule ℂ H, IsClosed (K : Set H) →
    (∀ A : H →L[ℂ] H, A * T = T * A → ∀ x ∈ K, A x ∈ K) →
    K = ⊥ ∨ K = ⊤

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.commutant_isClosed_strong
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.text:
theorem commutant_isClosed_strong [CompleteSpace H] (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    @IsClosed (H →L[ℂ] H) strongOperatorTopology (commutant T : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
  let : TopologicalSpace (H →L[ℂ] H) := strongOperatorTopology
  have heval : ∀ x : H, Continuous (fun A : H →L[ℂ] H => A x) := by
    intro x
    exact (continuous_apply x).comp continuous_induced_dom
  have hset : (commutant T : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) =
      ⋂ x : H, {A : H →L[ℂ] H | A (T x) = T (A x)} := by
    ext A
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_commutant_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h x
      exact congrArg (fun B : H →L[ℂ] H => B x) h
    · intro h
      ext x
      exact h x
  rw [hset]
  exact isClosed_iInter (fun x => isClosed_eq (heval (T x)) (T.continuous.comp (heval x)))



omit completeSpace in

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.transitiveCommutant_conjugate
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.text:
theorem transitiveCommutant_conjugate (e : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : TransitiveCommutant T) : TransitiveCommutant (e.conjStarAlgEquiv T) := by
  intro W hW hInv
  let U : Submodule ℂ H := W.comap e.toLinearMap
  have hU : IsClosed (U : Set H) := hW.preimage e.continuous
  have hUI : ∀ A : H →L[ℂ] H, A * T = T * A → ∀ x ∈ U, A x ∈ U := by
    intro A hA x hx
    change e (A x) ∈ W
    have hc : e.conjStarAlgEquiv A * e.conjStarAlgEquiv T =
        e.conjStarAlgEquiv T * e.conjStarAlgEquiv A := by
      simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg e.conjStarAlgEquiv hA
    have hm := hInv (e.conjStarAlgEquiv A) hc (e x) hx
    simpa using hm
  rcases hT U hU hUI with hz | ho
  · left
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    intro y hy
    have hx : e.symm y ∈ U := by change e (e.symm y) ∈ W; simpa using hy
    rw [hz] at hx
    have hzero : e.symm y = 0 := hx
    have := congrArg e hzero
    simpa using this
  · right
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    intro y _
    have hx : e.symm y ∈ U := by rw [ho]; trivial
    change e (e.symm y) ∈ W at hx
    simpa using hx

OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.name: OAI.Hyperinvariant233.mainClaim_transport
OAI.Analysis.BackwardIntertwiners.Operat.text:
theorem mainClaim_transport (e : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (h : MainClaim (H := H)) :
    MainClaim (H := K) := by
  obtain ⟨T, hT0, hq, ht⟩ := h
  refine ⟨e.conjStarAlgEquiv T, ?_, ?_, transitiveCommutant_conjugate e T ht⟩
  · exact fun hzero => hT0 (e.conjStarAlgEquiv.injective (by simpa using hzero))
  · have he : (fun n : ℕ => ‖(e.conjStarAlgEquiv T) ^ n‖ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) =
        (fun n : ℕ => ‖T ^ n‖ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ))) := by
      funext n
      rw [← map_pow, norm_conjugate]
    rwa [he]

end Hyperinvariant233

OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Routing:146.name: OAI.BoxTransport.Routing.Computation.representable_routedField

theorem representable_routedField {n : ℕ} (a b h k : Fin n → RationalSpace)
    (hh : ∀ i j, 0 < h i j) (hk : ∀ i j, 0 < k i j) (η : ℚ) (j : Fin 3) :
    Representable (fun p => routedField a b h k η p j) := by
  have hc (i : Fin n) (j : Fin 3) : Representable (fun p : SpaceTime =>
      routeCenters a b (30 * (boxDataBound h k : ℝ)) i p.1 j) := by
    simpa only [Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_ofNat] using representable_routeCenters a b (30 * boxDataBound h k) i j
  apply representable_spatialCurl
  apply representable_familyPotential
  · exact hc
  · intro i j
    exact representable_curve_deriv (contDiff_routeCenters a b _ i) (hc i) j
  · exact representable_diagonalLogVelocity hh hk
  · intro i j
    exact (representable_routeScales hh hk i j).mul (Representable.rational (h i j))

theorem balanced_box_routing
    (n : ℕ) (a b h k : Fin n → RationalSpace)
    (hh : ∀ i j, 0 < h i j) (hk : ∀ i j, 0 < k i j)
    (ha : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (solidBox (a i) (h i)) (solidBox (a j) (h j)))
    (hb : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (solidBox (b i) (k i)) (solidBox (b j) (k j)))
    (hvol : ∀ i, ∏ j : Fin 3, k i j / h i j = 1) :
    ∃ U : Field, ∃ Φ : ℝ → Space → Space,
      AdmissibleField U ∧ IsGlobalFlow U Φ ∧ Delivers a b h k Φ := by
  obtain ⟨η, _, hs, hc, hdiv, ht, Φ, hΦ, hdel⟩ := exists_routedField_realization n a b h k hh hk ha hb hvol
  exact ⟨routedField a b h k η, Φ, ⟨hs, hc, Computation.effective_routedField a b h k hh hk η hs hc,
    hdiv, ht⟩, hΦ, hdel⟩

end BoxTransport.Routing

OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Motion:407.name: OAI.BoxTransport.Routing.boxDataBound_ge_one
OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Motion:407.text:
theorem boxDataBound_ge_one {n : ℕ} (h k : Fin n → RationalSpace) : 1 ≤ boxDataBound h k := by
  unfold boxDataBound
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin 3, (|h i j| + |k i j| + |k i j / h i j| + 1) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => by positivity))
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Expressions:73.name: OAI.BoxTransport.Routing.Computation.effective_of_expressions
OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Expressions:73.text:
theorem effective_of_expressions {U : Field} (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hc : HasCompactSupport U)
    (es : Fin 3 → Expr) (he : ∀ j, Valid (es j)) (hval : ∀ p j, value (es j) p = U p j) :
    Effective U := by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := exists_supportRadius hc
  let ev : EvaluationRequest → RationalCode := fun r =>
    evalPrecise (mixedE r.1 (es r.2.2.2)) r.2.1 (2 * r.2.2.1 + 1)
  let md : List Axis × ℕ → ℕ := fun r =>
    ((2 * r.2 + 1) + 1) * (4 * gradientBound R es r.1 + 1)
  have hes : Primrec es := Primrec.dom_finite _
  have hev : Computable ev := by
    unfold ev
    have hs : Primrec (fun r : EvaluationRequest => es r.2.2.2) :=
      hes.comp (Primrec.snd.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))
    have hm : Primrec (fun r : EvaluationRequest => mixedE r.1 (es r.2.2.2)) :=
      primrec_mixedE.comp (Primrec.fst.pair hs)
    have hp : Primrec (fun r : EvaluationRequest => 2 * r.2.2.1 + 1) := by fun_prop
    have hq : Primrec (fun r : EvaluationRequest => r.2.1) := Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd
    have hreq : Computable (fun r : EvaluationRequest => (mixedE r.1 (es r.2.2.2), r.2.1, 2 * r.2.2.1 + 1)) :=
      (hm.pair (hq.pair hp)).to_comp
    have h := computable_evalPrecise.comp hreq
    exact h
  have hmd : Computable md := by unfold md; fun_prop
  refine ⟨ev, md, familyBound R es, hev, hmd, (primrec_familyBound R es).to_comp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ds q N p hp j
    have hl := (mixed_component_lipschitz hU he hval R hR ds j).dist_le_mul p (codeSpaceTime q)
    simp only [dist_eq_norm, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat, NNReal.coe_natCast] at hl
    have heval := evalPrecise_error (valid_mixedE (he j) ds) q (2 * N + 1)
    rw [mixedDerivative_component hU he hval ds (codeSpaceTime q) j] at heval
    change |mixedDerivative ds U p j - (Qval (evalPrecise (mixedE ds (es j)) q (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ)| ≤ _
    calc
      _ ≤ |mixedDerivative ds U p j - mixedDerivative ds U (codeSpaceTime q) j| +
          |mixedDerivative ds U (codeSpaceTime q) j - (Qval (evalPrecise (mixedE ds (es j)) q (2 * N + 1)) : ℝ)| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
      _ ≤ (4 * (gradientBound R es ds : ℝ)) * ((md (ds, N) : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ +
          (((2 * N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by
        apply add_le_add _ heval
        exact hl.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity))
      _ ≤ (((2 * N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ + (((2 * N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by
        apply add_le_add _ le_rfl
        simpa only [md, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using amplification_precision (4 * gradientBound R es ds) (2 * N + 1)
      _ = ((N : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by push_cast; field_simp; ring
  · exact uniform_mixed_bound hU he hval R hR

end BoxTransport.Routing.Computation

OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Motion:584.name: OAI.BoxTransport.Routing.routedField_realizes
OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Motion:584.text:
theorem routedField_realizes {n : ℕ} (a b h k : Fin n → RationalSpace)
    (hh : ∀ i j, 0 < h i j) (hk : ∀ i j, 0 < k i j)
    (hvol : ∀ i, ∏ j : Fin 3, k i j / h i j = 1)
    {η : ℚ} (hη : 0 < η) (hηR : η < boxDataBound h k / 8)
    (ha : Pairwise fun i j =>
      Disjoint (realBox (realPoint (a i)) (fun l => (h i l : ℝ) + 2 * η))
        (realBox (realPoint (a j)) (fun l => (h j l : ℝ) + 2 * η)))
    (hb : Pairwise fun i j =>
      Disjoint (realBox (realPoint (b i)) (fun l => (k i l : ℝ) + 2 * η))
        (realBox (realPoint (b j)) (fun l => (k j l : ℝ) + 2 * η))) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (routedField a b h k η) ∧ HasCompactSupport (routedField a b h k η) ∧
    (∀ t x, spatialDivergence (routedField a b h k η) t x = 0) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) x, t ∉ Set.Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ) → routedField a b h k η (t, x) = 0) ∧
    ∃ Φ, IsGlobalFlow (routedField a b h k η) Φ ∧ Delivers a b h k Φ := by
  let R : ℝ := boxDataBound h k
  have hR₁ : 1 ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; exact_mod_cast boxDataBound_ge_one h k
  have hR : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hR₁
  have hη' : (0 : ℝ) < η := by exact_mod_cast hη
  have hηR' : (η : ℝ) < R / 8 := by dsimp [R]; exact_mod_cast hηR
  have hbound (i : Fin n) (j : Fin 3) :
      (h i j : ℝ) ≤ R ∧ (k i j : ℝ) ≤ R ∧ scaleRatio h k i j ≤ R := by
    dsimp [R, scaleRatio]
    exact_mod_cast boxDataBound_bounds h k i j
  have hstart (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :
      routeCenters a b (30 * R) i t = realPoint (a i) ∧ routeScales h k i t = 1 :=
    ⟨routeCenters_before a b (30 * R) i ht, routeScales_before h k i ht⟩
  have hend (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) (ht : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ t) :
      routeCenters a b (30 * R) i t = routeCenters a b (30 * R) i 1 ∧
      routeScales h k i t = routeScales h k i 1 := by
    rw [routeCenters_after a b (30 * R) i ht, routeCenters_after a b (30 * R) i (t := 1) (by norm_num),
      routeScales_after h k hvol i ht, routeScales_after h k hvol i (t := 1) (by norm_num)]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hsep := route_padded_disjoint hh hk hvol hR hη' hηR'
    (fun i j => (hbound i j).1) (fun i j => (hbound i j).2.1) ha hb
  obtain ⟨hsm, hcp, hdiv, htime, Φ, hΦ, hn⟩ :=
    stationaryMotionField_realizes (fun i => realPoint (a i)) (fun i => realPoint (h i))
      hη' hR (contDiff_routeCenters a b (30 * R)) (contDiff_routeScales hh hk)
      hstart hend (routeScales_det hh hk hvol) (routeScales_pos hh hk)
      (routeScales_le hh hk hvol hR₁ (fun i j => (hbound i j).2.2)) hsep
  refine ⟨hsm, hcp, hdiv, htime, Φ, hΦ, ?_⟩
  intro i
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hbO, hmap⟩ := hn i
  refine ⟨O, hO, hbO, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rw [hmap x hx 1]
  ext j
  simp only [affineTrajectory, routeCenters_after a b (30 * R) i (t := 1) (by norm_num),
    routeScales_after h k hvol i (t := 1) (by norm_num), scaleRatio, realPoint, prescribedAffine]

OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Motion:633.name: OAI.BoxTransport.Routing.exists_routedField_realization
OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Motion:633.text:
theorem exists_routedField_realization
    (n : ℕ) (a b h k : Fin n → RationalSpace)
    (hh : ∀ i j, 0 < h i j) (hk : ∀ i j, 0 < k i j)
    (ha : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (solidBox (a i) (h i)) (solidBox (a j) (h j)))
    (hb : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (solidBox (b i) (k i)) (solidBox (b j) (k j)))
    (hvol : ∀ i, ∏ j : Fin 3, k i j / h i j = 1) :
    ∃ η : ℚ, 0 < η ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (routedField a b h k η) ∧ HasCompactSupport (routedField a b h k η) ∧
      (∀ t x, spatialDivergence (routedField a b h k η) t x = 0) ∧
      (∀ (t : ℝ) x, t ∉ Set.Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ) → routedField a b h k η (t, x) = 0) ∧
      ∃ Φ, IsGlobalFlow (routedField a b h k η) Φ ∧ Delivers a b h k Φ := by
  have hR : 0 < boxDataBound h k := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (boxDataBound_ge_one h k)
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηR, hap, hbp⟩ := exists_rational_padding a b h k
    (fun i j => (hh i j).le) (fun i j => (hk i j).le) ha hb (boxDataBound h k) hR
  exact ⟨η, hη, routedField_realizes a b h k hh hk hvol hη hηR hap hbp⟩
end BoxTransport.Routing

OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Definitions:58.name: OAI.BoxTransport.Routing.Effective
OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Definitions:58.text:
def Effective (U : Field) : Prop :=
  ∃ eval : EvaluationRequest → RationalCode,
    ∃ modulus : List Axis × ℕ → ℕ,
      ∃ bound : List Axis → ℕ,
        Computable eval ∧ Computable modulus ∧ Computable bound ∧
        (∀ (ds : List Axis) (q : RationalPointCode) (n : ℕ) (p : SpaceTime),
          ‖p - codeSpaceTime q‖ ≤ ((modulus (ds, n) : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ →
          ∀ j : Fin 3,
            |mixedDerivative ds U p j - (rationalValue (eval (ds, q, n, j)) : ℝ)| ≤
              ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) ∧
        (∀ (ds : List Axis) (p : SpaceTime) (j : Fin 3),
          |mixedDerivative ds U p j| ≤ (bound ds : ℝ))

OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Geometry:260.name: OAI.BoxTransport.Routing.exists_rational_padding
OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Geometry:260.text:
theorem exists_rational_padding {n : ℕ} (a b h k : Fin n → RationalSpace)
    (hh : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ h i j) (hk : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ k i j)
    (ha : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (solidBox (a i) (h i)) (solidBox (a j) (h j)))
    (hb : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (solidBox (b i) (k i)) (solidBox (b j) (k j)))
    (R : ℚ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ η : ℚ, 0 < η ∧ η < R / 8 ∧
      (Pairwise fun i j =>
        Disjoint (realBox (realPoint (a i)) (fun l => (h i l : ℝ) + 2 * η))
          (realBox (realPoint (a j)) (fun l => (h j l : ℝ) + 2 * η))) ∧
      (Pairwise fun i j =>
        Disjoint (realBox (realPoint (b i)) (fun l => (k i l : ℝ) + 2 * η))
          (realBox (realPoint (b j)) (fun l => (k j l : ℝ) + 2 * η))) := by
  obtain ⟨ga, hga, haga⟩ := uniform_rational_gap a h hh ha
  obtain ⟨gb, hgb, hbgb⟩ := uniform_rational_gap b k hk hb
  let m := min R (min ga gb)
  have hm : 0 < m := lt_min hR (lt_min hga hgb)
  let η := m / 16
  have hη0 : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; positivity
  have hmR : m ≤ R := min_le_left _ _
  have hmga : m ≤ ga := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hmgb : m ≤ gb := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hηR : η < R / 8 := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hηa : 4 * η < ga := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hηb : 4 * η < gb := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  refine ⟨η, hη0, hηR, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := haga i j hij
    apply realBox_disjoint_of_gap
    refine ⟨l, ?_⟩
    have hlt : (h i l + 2 * η) + (h j l + 2 * η) < |a i l - a j l| := by linarith
    change ((h i l : ℝ) + 2 * (η : ℝ)) + ((h j l : ℝ) + 2 * (η : ℝ)) <
      |(a i l : ℝ) - (a j l : ℝ)|
    exact_mod_cast hlt
  · intro i j hij
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hbgb i j hij
    apply realBox_disjoint_of_gap
    refine ⟨l, ?_⟩
    have hlt : (k i l + 2 * η) + (k j l + 2 * η) < |b i l - b j l| := by linarith
    change ((k i l : ℝ) + 2 * (η : ℝ)) + ((k j l : ℝ) + 2 * (η : ℝ)) <
      |(b i l : ℝ) - (b j l : ℝ)|
    exact_mod_cast hlt

OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Routing:161.name: OAI.BoxTransport.Routing.Computation.effective_routedField
OAI.Analysis.BoxTransport.Routing:161.text:
theorem effective_routedField {n : ℕ} (a b h k : Fin n → RationalSpace)
    (hh : ∀ i j, 0 < h i j) (hk : ∀ i j, 0 < k i j) (η : ℚ)
    (hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (routedField a b h k η)) (hc : HasCompactSupport (routedField a b h k η)) :
    Effective (routedField a b h k η) := by
  choose es he hv using representable_routedField a b h k hh hk η
  exact effective_of_expressions hs hc es he (fun p j => congrFun (hv j) p)

  ∀ i, ∃ O : Set Space, IsOpen O ∧ solidBox (a i) (h i) ⊆ O ∧

  (∀ x, Φ 0 x = x) ∧

    (∀ (x : Space) (γ : ℝ → Space), γ 0 = x →
      (∀ t, HasDerivAt γ (U (t, γ t)) t) → ∀ t, γ t = Φ t x)

OAI.Combinatorics.BalancedRyser.Incidenc.name: OAI.Balanced.corePencilResult_of_robustDeletion_primeStability
OAI.Combinatorics.BalancedRyser.Incidenc.text:
theorem corePencilResult_of_robustDeletion_primeStability
    (hdeletion : RobustDeletionResult.{u}) (hstable : PrimeStability.{u}) :
    CorePencilResult.{u} := by
  intro k hk K hK ζ hζ ε hε
  have hδ : 0 < stabilityDensity ζ := StabilityArithmetic.delta_pos hζ
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (hdeletion k hk K hK).2.2 (stabilityDensity ζ) hδ ε hε
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_nat_ge (max (100 : ℝ) (4 / ζ))
  refine ⟨max N M, ?_⟩
  intro F _ _ _ hprime hq hkq Q hQ
  have hNq : N ≤ Fintype.card F := (le_max_left N M).trans hq
  have hMq : M ≤ Fintype.card F := (le_max_right N M).trans hq
  have hlarge : max (100 : ℝ) (4 / ζ) ≤ (Fintype.card F : ℝ) :=
    hM.trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hMq)
  calc
    deletionEventProbability Q (fun D => ¬ CorePencilEvent ζ D.val) ≤
        deletionEventProbability Q (fun D => BadCoreCover (stabilityDensity ζ) D.val) := by
      apply CorePencilAssembly.eventProbability_mono
      intro D hD
      exact corePencilFailure_subset_nearCoverFailure hstable hprime hζ hlarge hD
    _ < ε := hN F hNq hkq Q hQ

end Balanced

OAI.Combinatorics.BalancedRyser.Probabil.name: OAI.Balanced.mainResult_of_selected_results_and_transports
OAI.Combinatorics.BalancedRyser.Probabil.text:
theorem mainResult_of_selected_results_and_transports
    (hdet : DeterministicReduction.{0})
    (hselected : SelectedDeletionResult.{0})
    (hcore : CorePencilResult.{0}) (hlocal : Local.PencilLocalResult.{0})
    (hLocalTransport : SelectedLocalTransport)
    (hCoreTransport : SelectedCoreTransport) : MainResult := by
  obtain ⟨c, Cbound, K, ρ, a₀, C₀, ε, N,
    hc, hC, hK, hρ0, hρ1, ha₀, hC₀, hNfour, hεnonneg, hεlim, hkernel⟩ := hselected
  have hKpos : 0 < K := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hK
  obtain ⟨εL, hεLlim, hεLnonneg, NL, hlocalBound⟩ := hlocal K hKpos
  have htol : 0 < a₀ / 4 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨NC, hcoreBound⟩ := hcore 3 (by norm_num) C₀ hC₀.le (ρ / 4)
    (by positivity) (a₀ / 4) htol
  obtain ⟨NE, hE⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 (hεlim.eventually_lt_const htol)
  obtain ⟨NEL, hEL⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 (hεLlim.eventually_lt_const htol)
  let Nall := max N (max NL (max NC (max NE NEL)))
  apply mainResult_of_prime_configurations hdet ρ hρ0 hρ1 Nall
  intro q hprime hlarge
  let : Fact q.Prime := ⟨hprime⟩
  have hNq : N ≤ q := (le_max_left N _).trans hlarge
  have hNLq : NL ≤ q := by dsimp [Nall] at hlarge; omega
  have hNCq : NC ≤ q := by dsimp [Nall] at hlarge; omega
  have hNEq : NE ≤ q := by dsimp [Nall] at hlarge; omega
  have hNELq : NEL ≤ q := by dsimp [Nall] at hlarge; omega
  have hcard : Fintype.card (ZMod q) = q := ZMod.card q
  obtain ⟨κ, hexp, _, hcylinder, hsuccess, hoccupancy, Q, hreal, hdom⟩ :=
    hkernel (ZMod q) (by simpa only [hcard] using hNq)
  have hsuccesspos : 0 < SelectedDeletion.successMass κ := ha₀.trans_le hsuccess
  have hsuccessone : SelectedDeletion.successMass κ ≤ 1 :=
    SelectedJointAssembly.successMass_le_one κ hexp.2.1
  obtain ⟨R, w, hw, hevent⟩ := hLocalTransport (ZMod q) κ c Cbound K hKpos.le hexp hcylinder
  have hlocalError := hlocalBound (ZMod q) (by simpa only [hcard] using hNLq) R w hw
  rw [hevent] at hlocalError
  have hcoreError := hcoreBound (ZMod q) (by simpa only [hcard] using hprime)
    (by simpa only [hcard] using hNCq)
    (by rw [hcard]; omega) Q hdom
  have hcoreIdentity := hCoreTransport (ZMod q) κ c Cbound Q hexp hreal hsuccesspos
    (fun D => ¬ CorePencilEvent (ρ / 4) D)
  have hcoreIdentity' :
      SelectedDeletion.jointMass κ (fun M s =>
        ¬ (SelectedDeletion.configuration M s).CoreConcentration ρ) =
      SelectedDeletion.successMass κ *
        deletionEventProbability Q (fun D => ¬ CorePencilEvent (ρ / 4) D.val) := by
    simpa only [SelectedJointAssembly.coreConcentration_iff_pencilEvent] using hcoreIdentity
  have hprobNonneg : 0 ≤
      deletionEventProbability Q (fun D => ¬ CorePencilEvent (ρ / 4) D.val) := by
    unfold deletionEventProbability
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro D _
    split_ifs
    · exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    · exact le_rfl
  have hjointCore : SelectedDeletion.jointMass κ (fun M s =>
      ¬ (SelectedDeletion.configuration M s).CoreConcentration ρ) < a₀ / 4 := by
    rw [hcoreIdentity']
    calc
      _ ≤ 1 * deletionEventProbability Q
          (fun D => ¬ CorePencilEvent (ρ / 4) D.val) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsuccessone hprobNonneg
      _ < a₀ / 4 := by simpa only [one_mul] using hcoreError
  have hsmallO : SelectedDeletion.occupancyFailureMass κ ρ < a₀ / 4 := by
    exact hoccupancy.trans_lt (by simpa only [hcard] using hE q hNEq)
  have hsmallL : SelectedDeletion.jointMass κ (fun M s =>
      ¬ (SelectedDeletion.configuration M s).LocalCondition) < a₀ / 4 := by
    exact hlocalError.trans_lt (by simpa only [hcard] using hEL q hNELq)
  obtain ⟨C, hV, hCompat, hO, hConcentration, hLoc⟩ :=
    SelectedJointAssembly.exists_configuration_of_joint_errors κ hexp
      (by linarith)
  exact ⟨C, hV, hCompat, by simpa only [hcard] using hO, hConcentration, hLoc⟩

end

OAI.Combinatorics.BalancedRyser.Construc.name: OAI.Balanced.deterministicReduction_proof
OAI.Combinatorics.BalancedRyser.Construc.text:
theorem deterministicReduction_proof : DeterministicReduction.{u} := by
  classical
  intro F _ _ _ C ρ B hq hρ0 hρ1 hV hC hO hCore hLocal hsize
  refine ⟨C.constructedHypergraph hV hC hq,
    C.constructedHypergraph_intersecting hV hC hq,
    C.constructedHypergraph_nonisolated hV hC hq hρ0 hO,
    ?_, C.constructedHypergraph_realization hV hC hq hρ1 hO hsize⟩
  apply C.constructedHypergraph_hasCoverNumber hV hC hq
  intro A hA hCover
  apply C.block_cover_card_lower_bound hV hC hρ0 hq hO hsize hCore hLocal A
  · intro b hb
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hA hb)).2
  · intro x hx
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mp (hCover hx)

end Balanced

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.ElementaryPieces

def ElementaryPieces {d : ℕ} (L V : (Fin d → ℝ) → Velocity)
    (κ : ℕ → Fin d → ℚ) (F : Family Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ M w t, 0 ≤ t →
    if t < 1 then
      F M w =ᶠ[𝓝 t] L (fun i => (κ (inputCode M w) i : ℝ))
    else F M w =ᶠ[𝓝 t]
      (fun s => V (fun i => (κ (inputCode M w) i : ℝ)) (s - (⌊t⌋ : ℤ)))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.effectiveFamily_of_elementary_pieces
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem effectiveFamily_of_elementary_pieces {d : ℕ}
    {L V : (Fin d → ℝ) → Velocity} (hL : ElementaryField L) (hV : ElementaryField V)
    (hsL : ∀p, JointSmooth (L p)) (hsV : ∀p, JointSmooth (V p))
    {κ : ℕ → Fin d → ℚ} (hκ : Computable κ) (C R : ℕ)
    (hC : ∀n i, |(κ n i : ℝ)| ≤ C) {F : Family Velocity}
    (hF : ∀M w, JointSmooth (F M w))
    (hS : ∀M w, SpatiallySupported (Metric.closedBall (0 : Space) R) (F M w))
    (hp : ElementaryPieces L V κ F) : EffectiveFamily F := by
  obtain ⟨EL,bL,hEL,hbL,heL,hmL⟩ := elementary_jet_evaluators hL hsL hκ C hC
  obtain ⟨EV,bV,hEV,hbV,heV,hmV⟩ := elementary_jet_evaluators hV hsV hκ C hC
  let phaseInput : (ℕ × MultiIndex × RationalPoint × ℕ) →
      (ℕ × MultiIndex × RationalPoint × ℕ) :=
    fun z => (z.1,z.2.1,(rationalPhase z.2.2.1.1,z.2.2.1.2),z.2.2.2)
  have hc : Computable phaseInput := by
    dsimp only [phaseInput]
    exact Computable.fst.pair ((Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd).pair
      (((computable_rationalPhase.comp (Computable.fst.comp
        (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)))).pair
        (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)))).pair
        (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))))
  let E : (ℕ × MultiIndex × RationalPoint × ℕ) → Fin 3 → ℚ :=
    fun z => if z.2.2.1.1 < 1 then EL (phaseInput z) else EV (phaseInput z)
  have hE : Computable E :=
    computable_ite (computable_rat_lt.comp (Computable.fst.comp
      (Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))) (Computable.const 1))
      (hEL.comp hc) (hEV.comp hc)
  let b : ℕ × MultiIndex → ℕ := fun z => bL (z.2,R) + bV (z.2,R)
  have hb : Computable b := Primrec.nat_add.to_comp.comp
    (hbL.comp (Computable.snd.pair (Computable.const R)))
    (hbV.comp (Computable.snd.pair (Computable.const R)))
  refine ⟨E,b,(fun _ => R),hE,hb,Computable.const R,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro M w a z n hz i
    have ht : 0 ≤ (z.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hz
    rw [← fullMixedD_eq_mixedD (hF M w) a _ ht _, hp.jet M w a _ ht _]
    dsimp only [E,phaseInput]
    by_cases hz' : z.1 < 1
    · have hr : (z.1 : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hz'
      simp only [ite_eq_left hz',ite_eq_left hr]
      have he := heL (inputCode M w) a (rationalPhase z.1,z.2) n
        (rationalPhase_bound _ hz) i
      simpa only [rationalPhase,ite_eq_left hz'] using he
    · have hr : ¬(z.1 : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hz'
      simp only [ite_eq_right hz',ite_eq_right hr]
      have he := heV (inputCode M w) a (rationalPhase z.1,z.2) n
        (rationalPhase_bound _ hz) i
      simpa only [rationalPhase_cast _ hz,ite_eq_right hr] using he
  · intro M w a t ht x
    rw [← fullMixedD_eq_mixedD (hF M w) a _ ht _]
    by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ≤ (R : ℝ)
    · rw [hp.jet M w a t ht x]
      split_ifs with hlt
      · have he := hmL (inputCode M w) a t x R
          (by rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]; exact hlt.le) hx
        exact he.trans (by dsimp [b]; push_cast; exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      · have hlo := Int.floor_le t
        have hhi := Int.lt_floor_add_one t
        have he := hmV (inputCode M w) a (t-(⌊t⌋ : ℤ)) x R
          (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; linarith) hx
        exact he.trans (by dsimp [b]; push_cast; exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    · have he := (hS M w).fullMixedD Metric.isClosed_closedBall a t x
        (by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hx)
      rw [he, norm_zero]
      exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  · intro M w t _ x hx
    exact hS M w t x (by simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] using hx)

end BalancedTransport.Effectivity
end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.materialFlow_unique
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem materialFlow_unique {U : Velocity} {X Y : MaterialFlow} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hl : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → LipschitzWith K (U t))
    (hX : IsMaterialFlow U X) (hY : IsMaterialFlow U Y)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (a : Space) : X t a = Y t a := by
  apply curves_agree_on_overlap hl
      (HasDerivWithinAt.continuousOn (fun s hs => (hX.2 a s hs.1).mono Icc_subset_Ici_self))
      (HasDerivWithinAt.continuousOn (fun s hs => (hY.2 a s hs.1).mono Icc_subset_Ici_self))
      (fun s hs => (hX.2 a s hs.1).mono Icc_subset_Ici_self)
      (fun s hs => (hY.2 a s hs.1).mono Icc_subset_Ici_self)
      ((hX.1 a).trans (hY.1 a).symm) ht le_rfl le_rfl

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.loadingSupport_ball
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma loadingSupport_ball {z : Space} {C : ℕ} (hz : ∀i, |z i| ≤ C) :
    loadingSupport z 1 ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Space) (C+6 : ℕ) := by
  intro x hx
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)).mpr
  intro i
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  have hh := (mem_closedEnlargement _ _ _ x).mp hx i
  have h₀ := (abs_le.mp (fixedLabel_bound i))
  have hz' := abs_le.mp (hz i)
  have hlo : -(C : ℝ)-4 ≤ min (fixedLabel i) (z i) := le_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hhi : max (fixedLabel i) (z i) ≤ (C : ℝ)+4 := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
  push_cast
  constructor <;> linarith [hh.1,hh.2]

end BalancedTransport.Effectivity

    (hv : JointSmooth v) (hc : TimeCollars v) : JointSmooth (loadedRepeat load v) := by
  have hg : JointSmooth (fun t (_ : Space) => afterLoadingGate t) := by
    dsimp [JointSmooth, afterLoadingGate]
    fun_prop
  exact hl.add (hg.smul (repeatTemplate_jointSmooth hv hc))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.repeatTemplate_jointSmooth
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma repeatTemplate_jointSmooth {v : Velocity} (hv : JointSmooth v) (hc : TimeCollars v) :
    JointSmooth (repeatTemplate v) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro z
  let n : ℤ := ⌊z.1⌋
  have ht : z.1 - n ∈ Ioo (-1 / 4 : ℝ) (5 / 4) := by
    have h₁ := Int.floor_le z.1
    have h₂ := Int.lt_floor_add_one z.1
    change -1 / 4 < z.1 - (⌊z.1⌋ : ℤ) ∧ z.1 - (⌊z.1⌋ : ℤ) < 5 / 4
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun y : ℝ × Space => v (y.1 - n) y.2) :=
    hv.comp ((contDiff_fst.sub contDiff_const).prodMk contDiff_snd)
  apply hg.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  have hnn : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ × Space in 𝓝 z, y.1 - n ∈ Ioo (-1 / 4 : ℝ) (5 / 4) :=
    ((continuous_fst.sub continuous_const).continuousAt).eventually (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht)
  exact hnn.mono (fun y hy => repeatTemplate_eq hc hy y.2)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.residual_zero_pressure_solution
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem residual_zero_pressure_solution (ν : ℝ) (U : Velocity)
    (hU : Smooth U) (hzero : ∀ x, U 0 x = 0)
    (hdiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, div U t x = 0) :
    ZeroDataSolution ν (affineForce (inertialCoefficient U) (viscousCoefficient U) ν)
      U (fun _ _ => 0) := by
  refine ⟨hU, contDiffOn_const, hzero, hdiv, ?_⟩
  intro t ht x
  have hp : gradient (fun _ _ => 0) t x = 0 := by
    ext i
    simp [gradient, spaceD]
  rw [hp]
  simp only [affineForce, inertialCoefficient, viscousCoefficient, smul_neg, neg_zero, zero_add]
  abel

end BalancedTransport

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.loadingVelocity_supported
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma loadingVelocity_supported (z : Space) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    SpatiallySupported (loadingSupport z η) (loadingVelocity z η) := by
  intro t x hx
  apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
  intro ht
  apply hx
  have hh := tsupport_movingBoxVelocity_subset fixedLabel fixedLabel
      (loadingCenter z) (fun _ => 1) hη t ht
  unfold loadingSupport
  rw [mem_closedEnlargement] at hh ⊢
  intro i

  have hpoint : lowerEndpoint fixedLabel (loadingCenter z) (fun _ => 1) t = loadingPath z t := rfl

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Universal.exists_universal_code
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma exists_universal_code : ∃ c : Turing.ToPartrec.Code, ∀ n,
    (c.eval [n]).Dom ↔ (universalPartial n).Dom := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := Turing.ToPartrec.Code.exists_code (Nat.Partrec'.part_iff₁.mpr universalPartial_partrec)
  refine ⟨c, fun n => ?_⟩

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Universal.finite_machine_of_code
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem finite_machine_of_code (c : ToPartrec.Code) :
    ∃ M : FiniteMachine, ∃ δ : ℕ → Input M,
      Computable δ ∧ ∀ n, Halts M (δ n) ↔ (c.eval [n]).Dom := by
  let : Inhabited PartrecToTM2.Λ' := ⟨trNormal c Cont'.halt⟩
  let P₁ := TM2to1.tr PartrecToTM2.tr
  let S₁ := TM2to1.trSupp PartrecToTM2.tr (codeSupp c Cont'.halt)
  have ss₁ : TM1.Supports P₁ S₁ := TM2to1.tr_supports PartrecToTM2.tr (PartrecToTM2.tr_supports c Cont'.halt)
  let P₀ := TM1to0.tr P₁
  let S₀ := TM1to0.trStmts P₁ S₁
  have ss₀ : TM0.Supports P₀ S₀ := TM1to0.tr_supports P₁ ss₁
  let δ : ℕ → List (Fin (Fintype.card StackAlphabet + 1)) := fun n =>
    (TM2to1.trInit (Γ := fun _ : K' => Γ') K'.main (trList [n])).map
      (finiteIndex (α := StackAlphabet))
  refine ⟨finitePostMachine P₀ S₀ ss₀, δ, computable_translatedInput, ?_⟩
  intro n
  rw [halts_finitePostMachine, TM1to0.tr_eval]
  refine (TM2to1.tr_eval_dom PartrecToTM2.tr K'.main (trList [n])).trans ?_
  have hi : (TM2.init K'.main (trList [n]) : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : K' => Γ') PartrecToTM2.Λ' (Option Γ')) =
      PartrecToTM2.init c [n] := by
    unfold TM2.init PartrecToTM2.init
    congr 1
    funext k
    cases k <;> simp [K'.elim,Function.update]
  change (eval (TM2.step PartrecToTM2.tr) (TM2.init K'.main (trList [n]))).Dom ↔ _
  rw [hi, PartrecToTM2.tr_eval]
  rfl

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.computable_rationalInitial
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma computable_rationalInitial (N : FiniteMachine) :
    Computable (Recorder.Checkpoint.rationalInitial N.normalized (some N.initial)) := by
  let S := Recorder.Letter (Option (Fin (N.states+1))) (Fin (N.symbols+1))
  let : Primcodable S := Primcodable.ofEquiv (Fin (Fintype.card S)) (Fintype.equivFin S)
  let : Inhabited S := ⟨.boundary⟩
  have hwork : Primrec (fun a : Fin (N.symbols+1) => (Letter.work a : S)) := Primrec.dom_finite _
  have hh : Computable (fun w : Input N => w.headD N.blank) := by
    exact (Primrec.option_getD.comp Primrec.list_head? (Primrec.const N.blank)).to_comp.of_eq
      (fun w => by cases w <;> rfl)
  have hw : Computable (fun w : Input N =>
      (Letter.work (w.headD N.blank) : S) :: (w.tail.map Letter.work ++ [Letter.boundary])) :=
    Primrec.list_cons.to_comp.comp (hwork.to_comp.comp hh)
      (Primrec.list_append.to_comp.comp
        ((Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_tail (hwork.comp Primrec.snd).to₂).to_comp)
        (Computable.const [Letter.boundary]))
  apply computable_fin_lam
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact Computable.const _
  · exact (computable_rationalTailCode (Recorder.digit (Q := Option (Fin (N.states+1)))
      (Γ := Fin (N.symbols+1))) (Letter.work N.blank)).comp hw
  · exact Computable.const _

lemma loadedRepeat_before {load v : Velocity} (hc : TimeCollars v)
    {t : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 1) : loadedRepeat load v t = load t := by
  have hs : afterLoadingGate t • repeatTemplate v t = (0 : Space → Space) := by
    by_cases ht : t ≤ 3 / 4
    · have he : afterLoadingGate t = 0 := Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
      rw [he, zero_smul]
    · rw [repeatTemplate_on_unit hc ⟨ht₀, ht₁⟩, hc t (Or.inr (lt_of_not_ge ht)), smul_zero]
  ext x i
  change (load t x + (afterLoadingGate t • repeatTemplate v t) x) i = load t x i
  rw [hs]
  simp

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Recorder.Checkpoint.rationalInitial_cast
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem rationalInitial_cast (M : Machine Q Γ) (q₀ : Q) (w : List Γ) :
    rationalSpace (rationalInitial M q₀ w) = ((initial M q₀ w).expand M).code M := by
  have hb := Coding.rationalTailCode_cast (base_gt_one (Q := Q) (Γ := Γ))
    digit [] (work M.blank : Letter Q Γ)
  have hr := Coding.rationalTailCode_cast (base_gt_one (Q := Q) (Γ := Γ))
    digit (work (w.headD M.blank) :: (w.tail.map work ++ [boundary]))
    (work M.blank : Letter Q Γ)
  have hr' : (Coding.rationalTailCode (digit (Q := Q) (Γ := Γ))
      (work (w.headD M.blank) :: (w.tail.map work ++ [boundary])) (work M.blank) : ℝ) =
      Coding.stream (digit (Q := Q) (Γ := Γ)) (work (w.headD M.blank) ::
        (w.tail.map work ++ₛ (boundary :: Stream'.const (work M.blank)))) := by
    simpa only [Stream'.appendStream', Stream'.append_append_stream] using hr
  simp only [Stream'.nil_append_stream] at hb
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · simp [rationalSpace, rationalInitial, Configuration.code, Configuration.stacks,
      Coding.codedPoint, Coding.origin, expand, initial, Stream'.map_const, hb]
  · simpa [rationalSpace, rationalInitial, Configuration.code, Configuration.stacks,
      Coding.codedPoint, Coding.origin, expand, initial] using hr'
  · simpa [rationalSpace, rationalInitial, Configuration.code, Configuration.stacks,
      Coding.codedPoint, Coding.origin, expand, initial] using hb

end BalancedTransport.Recorder.Checkpoint

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.exists_elementary_guarded_template
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem exists_elementary_guarded_template {Q Γ : Type*} [Fintype Q] [Fintype Γ]
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq Γ] (M : Recorder.Machine Q Γ) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ (v : Velocity) (K : Set Space), IsCompact K ∧ JointSmooth v ∧ TimeCollars v ∧
      SpatiallySupported K v ∧ (∀ t x, div v t x = 0) ∧ Recorder.GuardedTemplate M v ∧
      ElementaryField (fun _ : Fin d → ℝ => v) := by
  obtain ⟨η,hη,m,hm⟩ := elementary_guarded_solid_box_motion (Recorder.sourceLayout M)
    (Recorder.targetLayout M) (Recorder.safeRows M) (rational_sourceLayout M) (rational_targetLayout M)
    (Recorder.sourceLayout_positive M) (Recorder.targetLayout_positive M)
    (Recorder.sourceLayout_separated M) (Recorder.targetLayout_separated M)
    (Recorder.layouts_equal_volume M) (Recorder.sourceLayout_guard M) (Recorder.targetLayout_guard M)
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < (η : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hη
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hs⟩ := m.velocity_compact_support hp
  refine ⟨m.velocity,K,hK,m.velocity_jointSmooth,m.velocity_collars,hs,m.velocity_divergence,?_,
    elementary_motion_velocity (RationalConstant.rat η) (rational_sourceLayout M) hm d⟩
  intro r hr x hx
  let i : Recorder.ActiveRow M := ⟨r, (Recorder.mem_table M r).mpr hr⟩
  have hm : x ∈ (Recorder.sourceLayout M).solid i := by rwa [Recorder.sourceLayout_solid]
  refine ⟨m.path i x,m.path_start i x,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [m.path_end, Recorder.layouts_affineMap]
  · intro t _
    exact (m.path_hasDerivAt hp hm t).hasDerivWithinAt
  · intro hsafe t _
    exact m.path_guarded hsafe hm t

end BalancedTransport.Effectivity
end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.loadedRepeat_germ_after
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma loadedRepeat_germ_after {load v : Velocity} (hl : TimeCollars load) (hc : TimeCollars v)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    loadedRepeat load v =ᶠ[𝓝 t] (fun s => v (s-(⌊t⌋ : ℤ))) := by
  have hi : t - (⌊t⌋ : ℤ) ∈ Ioo (-1/4 : ℝ) (5/4) := by
    have := Int.floor_le t
    have := Int.lt_floor_add_one t
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hn : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝 t, s - (⌊t⌋ : ℤ) ∈ Ioo (-1/4 : ℝ) (5/4) :=
    (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hi)
  filter_upwards [hn, eventually_gt_nhds (show (3 : ℝ)/4 < t by linarith)] with s hs hst
  rw [loadedRepeat_after_open hl hc hst]
  exact funext (repeatTemplate_eq hc hs)

end BalancedTransport.Geometry

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.effective_loaded_family
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem effective_loaded_family {κ : ℕ → Fin 3 → ℚ} (hκ : Computable κ)
    (C : ℕ) (hC : ∀n i, |(κ n i : ℝ)| ≤ C)
    {v : Velocity} {K : Set Space} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hv : JointSmooth v) (hc : TimeCollars v) (hs : SpatiallySupported K v)
    (he : ElementaryField (fun _ : Fin 3 → ℝ => v)) :
    let U : Family Velocity := fun M w =>
      loadedRepeat (loadingVelocity (rationalSpace (κ (inputCode M w))) 1) v
    EffectiveFamily U ∧ EffectiveFamily (fun M w => inertialCoefficient (U M w)) ∧
      EffectiveFamily (fun M w => viscousCoefficient (U M w)) := by
  dsimp only
  let U : Family Velocity := fun M w =>
    loadedRepeat (loadingVelocity (rationalSpace (κ (inputCode M w))) 1) v
  have hU (M : FiniteMachine) (w : Input M) : JointSmooth (U M w) :=
    loadedRepeat_jointSmooth (loadingVelocity_jointSmooth _ _) hv hc
  have hp : ElementaryPieces (fun p : Fin 3 → ℝ => loadingVelocity p 1)
      (fun _ : Fin 3 → ℝ => v) κ U := by
    intro M w t ht
    split_ifs with hlt
    · exact loadedRepeat_germ_before hc hlt
    · exact loadedRepeat_germ_after (fun _ ht => loadingVelocity_zero ht) hc (le_of_not_gt hlt)
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hK.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : Space)
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge r
  let R : ℕ := max n (C+6)
  have hS (M : FiniteMachine) (w : Input M) :
      SpatiallySupported (Metric.closedBall (0 : Space) R) (U M w) := by
    intro t x hx
    apply loadedRepeat_support (loadingVelocity_supported _ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)) hs t x
    intro hm
    apply hx
    rcases hm with hm | hm
    · exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_max_right n (C+6)))
        (loadingSupport_ball (hC (inputCode M w)) hm)
    · exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall
        (hn.trans (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_max_left n (C+6)))) (hr hm)
  have el : ElementaryField (fun p : Fin 3 → ℝ => loadingVelocity p 1) :=
    elementary_loadingVelocity ⟨1, by simp⟩
  have sl := fun p : Fin 3 → ℝ => loadingVelocity_jointSmooth p 1
  have eu := effectiveFamily_of_elementary_pieces el he sl (fun _ => hv) hκ C R hC hU hS hp
  have e₀ := effectiveFamily_of_elementary_pieces el.fullInertial he.fullInertial
    (fun p => (sl p).fullInertial) (fun _ => hv.fullInertial) hκ C R hC
    (fun M w => (hU M w).fullInertial) (fun M w => (hS M w).fullInertial) hp.fullInertial
  have e₁ := effectiveFamily_of_elementary_pieces el.viscous he.viscous
    (fun p => (sl p).viscousCoefficient) (fun _ => hv.viscousCoefficient) hκ C R hC
    (fun M w => (hU M w).viscousCoefficient)
    (fun M w => (hS M w).viscousCoefficient Metric.isClosed_closedBall) hp.viscous
  exact ⟨eu,EffectiveFamily.forwardEq e₀ (fun M w => fullInertial_forwardEq (hU M w)),e₁⟩

end BalancedTransport.Effectivity
end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Coding.rationalTailCode
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
def rationalTailCode {B : ℕ} (digit : S → Fin B) (w : List S) (a : S) : ℚ :=
  rationalWord digit w + (B : ℚ)⁻¹ ^ w.length * ((digit a : ℚ) / ((B : ℚ) - 1))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Recorder.Checkpoint.rationalInitial
OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.rationalInitial_bounded
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma rationalInitial_bounded (N : FiniteMachine) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ w : Input N, ∀ i,
      |(Recorder.Checkpoint.rationalInitial N.normalized (some N.initial) w i : ℝ)| ≤ C := by
  let k := Recorder.placement N.normalized (.ready (some N.initial))
  refine ⟨4*k+1, ?_⟩
  intro w i
  have he := congrFun (Recorder.Checkpoint.rationalInitial_cast N.normalized (some N.initial) w) i
  change (Recorder.Checkpoint.rationalInitial N.normalized (some N.initial) w i : ℝ) = _ at he
  rw [he]
  change |Coding.origin k i + Coding.stream Recorder.digit _| ≤ _
  have hh := Coding.stream_mem_unit Recorder.digit
    (((Recorder.Checkpoint.initial N.normalized (some N.initial) w).expand N.normalized).stacks i)
  have ho : 0 ≤ Coding.origin k i ∧ Coding.origin k i ≤ 4*(k : ℝ) := by
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [Coding.origin] <;> constructor <;>
      first | positivity | exact le_rfl
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg ho.1 hh.1)]
  push_cast
  linarith [hh.2, ho.2]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.elementary_guarded_solid_box_motion
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem elementary_guarded_solid_box_motion (A B : BoxLayout ι) (safe : Set ι)
    (Ar : RationalLayout A) (Br : RationalLayout B)
    (hA : A.Positive) (hB : B.Positive)
    (hsA : A.Separated 0) (hsB : B.Separated 0)
    (hvol : ∀ i, ∏ k, A.width i k = ∏ k, B.width i k)
    (hgA : A.Guarded safe) (hgB : B.Guarded safe) :
    ∃ η : ℚ, 0 < η ∧ ∃ m : BoxMotion A B safe (η : ℝ), ElementaryMotion m := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ηA, hηA, hmA⟩ := hsA.positive_margin
  obtain ⟨ηB, hηB, hmB⟩ := hsB.positive_margin
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqm⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (lt_min hηA hηB)
  let η : ℝ := q
  have hη : 0 < η := hq
  have ηr : RationalConstant η := RationalConstant.rat q
  have hmA' := hmA.mono (hqm.le.trans (min_le_left ηA ηB))
  have hmB' := hmB.mono (hqm.le.trans (min_le_right ηA ηB))
  obtain ⟨RA, hRA⟩ := finite_upper_bound_nat (fun p : ι × Fin 3 => A.width p.1 p.2)
  obtain ⟨RB, hRB⟩ := finite_upper_bound_nat (fun p : ι × Fin 3 => B.width p.1 p.2)
  let R : ℝ := max 1 (max (RA : ℝ) (RB : ℝ))
  have Rr : RationalConstant R := RationalConstant.one.max
    ((RationalConstant.nat RA).max (RationalConstant.nat RB))
  have hR : 1 ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
  have hAR : ∀ i k, A.width i k ≤ R := fun i k => (hRA (i,k)).le.trans
    ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have hBR : ∀ i k, B.width i k ≤ R := fun i k => (hRB (i,k)).le.trans
    ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  let D := 2 * R + 4 * η
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by dsimp [D]; linarith
  obtain ⟨L, hΛ, hΛR, hΛA, hΛB⟩ := exists_nat_expansion
    (BoxLayout.center_injective hA hsA) (BoxLayout.center_injective hB hsB) (R := R) hD
  let Λ : ℝ := L
  have Λr : RationalConstant Λ := RationalConstant.nat L
  let a : ι → Space := fun i k => Λ * A.center i k
  let b : ι → Space := fun i k => Λ * B.center i k
  have ar : RationalCenters a := fun i k => Λr.mul (Ar.1 i k)
  have br : RationalCenters b := fun i k => Λr.mul (Br.1 i k)
  have Dr : RationalConstant D := ((RationalConstant.nat 2).mul Rr).add
    ((RationalConstant.nat 4).mul ηr)
  obtain ⟨p, pr, hpa, hpb, hpp, hpg⟩ := exists_rational_parking a b (R := R) hD Dr Rr
  have hag : ∀ i ∈ safe, 2 + R < a i 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hh : 2 < A.center i 0 := by have := hgA i hi; linarith [hA i 0]
    have hΛp : 0 < Λ := by linarith
    have hh' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hh hΛp
    dsimp [a]
    nlinarith
  have hbg : ∀ i ∈ safe, 2 + R < b i 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hh : 2 < B.center i 0 := by have := hgB i hi; linarith [hB i 0]
    have hΛp : 0 < Λ := by linarith
    have hh' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hh hΛp
    dsimp [b]
    nlinarith
  have hga : (BoxLayout.mk a B.width).Guarded safe := by
    intro i hi
    change 2 < a i 0 - B.width i 0
    linarith [hag i hi, hBR i 0]
  have hgb : (BoxLayout.mk b B.width).Guarded safe := by
    intro i hi
    change 2 < b i 0 - B.width i 0
    linarith [hbg i hi, hBR i 0]
  have hgp : (BoxLayout.mk p B.width).Guarded safe := by
    intro i _
    change 2 < p i 0 - B.width i 0
    linarith [hpg i, hBR i 0]
  have hsize : ∀ i j k, B.width i k + B.width j k + 4 * η ≤ D := by
    intro i j k
    dsimp [D]
    linarith [hBR i k, hBR j k]
  obtain ⟨HA, hHA⟩ := finite_upper_bound_nat (fun i => a i 1)
  obtain ⟨HB, hHB⟩ := finite_upper_bound_nat (fun i => b i 1)
  obtain ⟨HP, hHP⟩ := finite_upper_bound_nat (fun i => p i 1)
  let H : ℝ := max (HA : ℝ) (max (HB : ℝ) (HP : ℝ)) + D + 1
  have Hr : RationalConstant H := ((RationalConstant.nat HA).max
    ((RationalConstant.nat HB).max (RationalConstant.nat HP))).add Dr |>.add RationalConstant.one
  have hhA : ∀ i, D < H - a i 1 := by
    intro i
    have := le_max_left (HA : ℝ) (max (HB : ℝ) (HP : ℝ))
    have := hHA i
    dsimp [H]; linarith
  have hhB : ∀ i, D < H - b i 1 := by
    intro i
    have := (le_max_left (HB : ℝ) (HP : ℝ)).trans (le_max_right (HA : ℝ) (max (HB : ℝ) (HP : ℝ)))
    have := hHB i
    dsimp [H]; linarith
  have hhP : ∀ i, D < H - p i 1 := by
    intro i
    have := (le_max_right (HB : ℝ) (HP : ℝ)).trans (le_max_right (HA : ℝ) (max (HB : ℝ) (HP : ℝ)))
    have := hHP i
    dsimp [H]; linarith
  let m₁ := expandCenters hA hmA' hgA hΛ
  let m₂ := reshapeMotion hA hB hAR hBR hvol (le_refl D) hΛA hag
  obtain ⟨m₃,e₃⟩ := elementary_evacuateToParking ar pr Br.2 Hr hB hsize hΛA hpa hpp hhA hhP hD hga hgp
  obtain ⟨m₄,e₄⟩ := elementary_evacuateToParking br pr Br.2 Hr hB hsize hΛB hpb hpp hhB hhP hD hgb hgp
  let m₅ := expandCenters hB hmB' hgB hΛ
  have e₁ : ElementaryMotion m₁ := ElementaryMotion.expansion Ar.1 Ar.2 Λr _ _ _ _
  have e₂ : ElementaryMotion m₂ := ElementaryMotion.reshape ar Ar.2 Br.2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  have e₅ : ElementaryMotion m₅ := ElementaryMotion.expansion Br.1 Br.2 Λr _ _ _ _
  exact ⟨q, by exact_mod_cast hq, _,
    (((e₁.trans e₂ ⟨ar,Ar.2⟩).trans e₃ ⟨ar,Br.2⟩).trans e₄.reverse ⟨pr,Br.2⟩).trans
      e₅.reverse ⟨br,Br.2⟩⟩

end BalancedTransport.Effectivity
end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Analysis.unique_in_comparison
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem unique_in_comparison {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) {f U : Velocity}
    (hU : ZeroDataSolution ν f U (fun _ _ => 0)) (hUC : ComparisonClass U (fun _ _ => 0)) :
    UniqueInComparison ν f U := by
  intro u p hu hc
  obtain ⟨Vu, Wu, hVu, _, hdu⟩ := hc.2.1
  obtain ⟨VU, WU, hVU, _, hdU⟩ := hUC.2.1
  let V : ℝ → Lp Space 2 (volume : Measure Space) := fun t => Vu t - VU t
  let W : ℝ → Lp Space 2 (volume : Measure Space) := fun t => Wu t - WU t
  have hV : ContinuousOn V (Ici 0) := hVu.sub hVU
  have hv (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : (V t : Space → Space) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => u t x - U t x :=
    (Lp.coeFn_sub _ _).trans ((hdu t ht).1.sub (hdU t ht).1)
  have hw (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : (W t : Space → Space) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => timeD u t x - timeD U t x :=
    (Lp.coeFn_sub _ _).trans ((hdu t ht).2.1.sub (hdU t ht).2.1)
  have hd (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : HasDerivWithinAt V (W t) (Ici 0) t :=
    (hdu t ht).2.2.sub (hdU t ht).2.2
  have hzero : V 0 = 0 := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [hv 0 le_rfl, Lp.coeFn_zero Space 2 (volume : Measure Space)] with x hx hy
    rw [hx, hu.2.2.1, hU.2.2.1, sub_self, hy]
    rfl
  have he : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, u t x = U t x := by
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hbU⟩ := hUC.2.2.1 T hT
    obtain ⟨A, _, hbu⟩ := hc.2.2.1 T hT
    obtain ⟨c, hpc⟩ := hc.2.2.2
    have hbound (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T) :
        l2EnergyRate (V t) (W t) ≤ (12 * C) * l2Energy (V t) := by
      have hpair := energy_pairing_bound
        ((sliceH2_of_CH hu.1 hc.1 ht.1).sub (sliceH2_of_CH hU.1 hUC.1 ht.1))
        (Smooth.slice hu.1 ht.1) (Smooth.slice hU.1 ht.1)
        ((Smooth.slice hu.2.1 ht.1).sub contDiff_const) hν hC
        (fun x => (hbu t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩ x).1)
        (fun x j => (hbu t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩ x).2 j)
        (fun x j => (hbU t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩ x).2 j)
        (hu.2.2.2.1 t ht.1)
        (difference_divergence hu.1 hU.1 ht.1 (hu.2.2.2.1 t ht.1) (hU.2.2.2.1 t ht.1))
        (CH.memLp hpc [] (by simp) ht.1) (fun j => CH.memLp hpc [j] (by simp) ht.1)
        (difference_equation hu hU ht.1 (c t))
      simp only [l2EnergyRate, l2Inner_integral (hv t ht.1) (hw t ht.1),
        l2Energy_integral (hv t ht.1), Pi.sub_apply]
      simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, ← mul_assoc, show (2 : ℝ) * 6 = 12 from by norm_num] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpair (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
    have hz := l2Energy_eq_zero_of_bound hV hd hzero hT hbound
    have hzv := l2Energy_zero_pointwise (hv T hT)
      ((Smooth.slice hu.1 hT).continuous.sub (Smooth.slice hU.1 hT).continuous) hz
    intro x
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (congrFun hzv x)
  exact ⟨he, constant_pressure_of_velocity_eq hu hU he⟩

end BalancedTransport.Analysis
end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Recorder.GuardedTemplate
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
def GuardedTemplate (M : Machine Q Γ) (v : Velocity) : Prop :=
  ∀ r : Row Q Γ, r.valid M → ∀ x,
    x ∈ (r.instruction M).sourceBox (base Q Γ : ℝ)⁻¹
      (fun a => (digit a : ℝ)) (placement M) →
    ∃ γ : ℝ → Space,
      γ 0 = x ∧ γ 1 = (r.instruction M).fullMap M x ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt γ (v t (γ t)) (Set.Icc 0 1) t) ∧
      ((r.instruction M).targetControl ≠ .ready M.halt →
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ t ∉ observer)

end BalancedTransport.Recorder
end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.balanced_three_stack_realization
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem balanced_three_stack_realization :
    ∃ U f₀ f₁ : Family Velocity,
    ∃ X : Family MaterialFlow,
    ∃ repeated : FiniteMachine → Velocity,
      EffectiveFamily U ∧ EffectiveFamily f₀ ∧ EffectiveFamily f₁ ∧
      (∀ M, Function.Periodic (repeated M) 1) ∧
      ∀ (M : FiniteMachine) (w : Input M),
        Smooth (U M w) ∧ Smooth (f₀ M w) ∧ Smooth (f₁ M w) ∧
        f₀ M w = inertialCoefficient (U M w) ∧
        f₁ M w = viscousCoefficient (U M w) ∧
        CommonCompactSupport (U M w) (f₀ M w) (f₁ M w) ∧
        BoundedMixed (U M w) ∧
        PeriodicAfterOne (U M w) ∧
        (∀ t, 1 ≤ t → ∀ x, U M w t x = repeated M t x) ∧
        ComparisonClass (U M w) (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
        IsMaterialFlow (U M w) (X M w) ∧
        ((∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ X M w t fixedLabel ∈ observer) ↔ Halts M w) ∧
        ∀ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν →
          let f := affineForce (f₀ M w) (f₁ M w) ν
          ZeroDataSolution ν f (U M w) (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
          Smooth f ∧ BoundedMixed f ∧ PeriodicAfterOne f ∧
          UniqueInComparison ν f (U M w) ∧
          (ComputableReal ν → EffectiveFieldIn ∅ f) ∧
          (∀ name : ℕ → ℚ, RealName name ν → EffectiveFieldIn {nameOracle name} f) := by
  obtain ⟨N, δ, hδ, hh⟩ := Universal.exists_universal_machine
  obtain ⟨v, K, hK, hv, hc, hs, hd, hg, he⟩ :=
    Effectivity.exists_elementary_guarded_template N.normalized 3
  let κ : ℕ → Fin 3 → ℚ := fun n =>
    Recorder.Checkpoint.rationalInitial N.normalized (some N.initial) (δ n)
  have hκ : Computable κ := (Effectivity.computable_rationalInitial N).comp hδ
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Effectivity.rationalInitial_bounded N
  let z : Family Space := fun M w => rationalSpace (κ (inputCode M w))
  let U : Family Velocity := fun M w => loadedRepeat (loadingVelocity (z M w) 1) v
  have hz (M : FiniteMachine) (w : Input M) : z M w =
      ((N.initialWork (δ (inputCode M w))).expand N.normalized).code N.normalized :=
    Recorder.Checkpoint.rationalInitial_cast N.normalized (some N.initial) (δ (inputCode M w))
  have hu (M : FiniteMachine) (w : Input M) :=
    loaded_template_realization (z M w) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hK hv hc hs hd
  have hlc (M : FiniteMachine) (w : Input M) : TimeCollars (loadingVelocity (z M w) 1) :=
    fun _ ht => loadingVelocity_zero ht
  have hr (M : FiniteMachine) (w : Input M) :=
    prescribed_residual_realization ((loadingSupport_compact (z M w) 1).union hK)
      (hu M w).1 (hu M w).2.1 (loadedRepeat_repeats (hlc M w)) (hu M w).2.2.2.1
      (fun t (_ : 0 ≤ t) x => loadedRepeat_divergence
        (loadingVelocity_jointSmooth (z M w) 1) hv hc
        (loadingVelocity_divergence (z M w) 1) hd t x)
  have ef : EffectiveFamily U ∧
      EffectiveFamily (fun M w => inertialCoefficient (U M w)) ∧
      EffectiveFamily (fun M w => viscousCoefficient (U M w)) :=
    Effectivity.effective_loaded_family hκ C (fun n => hC (δ n)) hK hv hc hs he
  choose X hX using (fun M w => (hu M w).2.2.2.2.2.2.1)
  refine ⟨U, (fun M w => inertialCoefficient (U M w)),
    (fun M w => viscousCoefficient (U M w)), X, (fun _ => repeatTemplate v),
    ef.1, ef.2.1, ef.2.2, (fun _ => repeatTemplate_zero_period v), ?_⟩
  intro M w
  obtain ⟨hsm, hsm₀, hsm₁, hsupp, hb, _, _, hp, hclass, _, hres⟩ := hr M w
  refine ⟨hsm, hsm₀, hsm₁, rfl, rfl, hsupp, hb, hp, ?_, hclass, hX M w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht x
    exact congrFun ((hu M w).2.2.2.2.2.1 t ht) x
  · have hx : IsMaterialFlow
        (loadedRepeat (loadingVelocity
          (((N.initialWork (δ (inputCode M w))).expand N.normalized).code N.normalized) 1) v)
        (X M w) := by
      rw [← hz M w]
      exact hX M w
    exact (N.compiled_continuous_halting_iff (δ (inputCode M w))
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hK hv hc hs hg hx).trans (hh M w)
  · intro ν hν
    obtain ⟨hsol, hsf, hbf, hpf, huniq⟩ := hres ν hν
    have heff := Effectivity.residual_effective_viscosity (fun M w => (hu M w).1)
      ef.2.1 ef.2.2 M w ν
    exact ⟨hsol, hsf, hbf, hpf, huniq, heff.1, heff.2⟩

end BalancedTransport
end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.EffectiveFamily.forwardEq
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma EffectiveFamily.forwardEq {V W : Family Velocity} (hV : EffectiveFamily V)
    (h : ∀M w, ForwardEq (V M w) (W M w)) : EffectiveFamily W := by
  obtain ⟨E,b,R,hE,hb,hR,he,hB,hs⟩ := hV
  refine ⟨E,b,R,hE,hb,hR,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro M w a z n hz i
    rw [← (h M w).mixedD a _ (by exact_mod_cast hz)]
    exact he M w a z n hz i
  · intro M w a t ht x
    rw [← (h M w).mixedD a t ht]
    exact hB M w a t ht x
  · intro M w t ht x hx
    rw [← h M w t ht]
    exact hs M w t ht x hx

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.repeatTemplate_zero_period

lemma repeatTemplate_zero_period (v : Velocity) : Function.Periodic (repeatTemplate v) 1 := by
  intro t
  funext x
  change (∑' n : ℤ, v (t + 1 - n) x) = ∑' n : ℤ, v (t - n) x
  have hh := (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ)).tsum_eq (fun n : ℤ => v (t + 1 - n) x)
  simpa only [Equiv.coe_addRight, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using hh.symm

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.elementary_loadingVelocity
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma elementary_loadingVelocity {η : ℝ} (hr : RationalConstant η) :
    ElementaryField (fun p : Fin 3 → ℝ => loadingVelocity p η) := by
  have labelRat : ∀ i, RationalConstant (fixedLabel i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact RationalConstant.nat 4
    · exact RationalConstant.zero
    · exact RationalConstant.zero
  apply elementary_movingBoxVelocity fixedLabel fixedLabel labelRat labelRat
  · intro i
    simpa only [loadingCenter, loadingSwitch, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_ofNat] using
      ((((ElementaryScalar.literal 2).mul ElementaryScalar.time).sub
        (ElementaryScalar.literal (1/2))).transition.mul
        ((ElementaryScalar.parameter i).sub (ElementaryScalar.rational (labelRat i))))
  · intro i
    simpa using (ElementaryScalar.literal (d:=3) 1)
  · intro i
    exact ⟨0, by intro p t; norm_num⟩
  · exact hr

end BalancedTransport.Effectivity
end

lemma spatial_lipschitz_of_boundedMixed {U : Velocity}
    (hU : JointSmooth U) (hb : BoundedMixed U) :
    ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → LipschitzWith K (U t) := by
  choose C hC hbound using fun i : Fin 3 => hb [some i]
  let K : ℝ≥0 := ⟨∑ i, C i, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hC i)⟩

    ((hU.slice t).differentiable (by simp)) (fun x => ?_)⟩
  change ‖fderiv ℝ (U t) x‖ ≤ ∑ i, C i
  apply (norm_linearMap_le_sum_basis _).trans
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hbound i t ht x)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.loaded_template_realization
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem loaded_template_realization (z : Space) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    {K : Set Space} (hK : IsCompact K) {v : Velocity}
    (hv : JointSmooth v) (hc : TimeCollars v) (hs : SpatiallySupported K v)
    (hd : ∀ t x, div v t x = 0) :
    let U := loadedRepeat (loadingVelocity z η) v
    JointSmooth U ∧ SpatiallySupported (loadingSupport z η ∪ K) U ∧
    BoundedMixed U ∧ (∀ x, U 0 x = 0) ∧
    Function.Periodic (repeatTemplate v) 1 ∧
    (∀ t, 1 ≤ t → U t = repeatTemplate v t) ∧
    (∃ X, IsMaterialFlow U X) ∧
    ∀ ν : ℝ, ZeroDataSolution ν
      (affineForce (inertialCoefficient U) (viscousCoefficient U) ν) U (fun _ _ => 0) := by
  let load := loadingVelocity z η
  have hl : JointSmooth load := loadingVelocity_jointSmooth z η
  have hlc : TimeCollars load := fun _ ht => loadingVelocity_zero ht
  have hU := loadedRepeat_jointSmooth hl hv hc
  have hUs := loadedRepeat_support (loadingVelocity_supported z hη) hs
  have hUp := loadedRepeat_repeats (v := v) hlc
  have hUc := (loadingSupport_compact z η).union hK
  have hzero : ∀ x, loadedRepeat load v 0 x = 0 := by
    intro x
    rw [loadedRepeat_before hc le_rfl (by norm_num), hlc 0 (Or.inl (by norm_num))]
    rfl
  exact ⟨hU, hUs, boundedMixed_of_compact_repeating hUc hU hUs hUp, hzero,
    repeatTemplate_zero_period v, fun _ ht => loadedRepeat_after hlc ht,
    exists_materialFlow_of_compact_repeating hUc hU hUs hUp,
    fun ν => residual_zero_pressure_solution ν _ hU.smooth hzero
      (fun t _ x => loadedRepeat_divergence hl hv hc (loadingVelocity_divergence z η) hd t x)⟩

end BalancedTransport.Geometry
end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.repeatTemplate_divergence
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma repeatTemplate_divergence {v : Velocity} (hc : TimeCollars v)
    (hd : ∀ t x, div v t x = 0) (t : ℝ) (x : Space) :

  have he : repeatTemplate v t = v (t - (⌊t⌋ : ℤ)) := by
    funext y
    apply repeatTemplate_eq hc
    have h₁ := Int.floor_le t
    have h₂ := Int.lt_floor_add_one t
    constructor <;> linarith
  simpa only [div, spaceD, he] using hd (t - (⌊t⌋ : ℤ)) x

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Effectivity.elementary_motion_velocity
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma elementary_motion_velocity {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {A B : BoxLayout ι} {safe : Set ι}
    {η : ℝ} (hr : RationalConstant η) (Ar : RationalLayout A) {m : BoxMotion A B safe η}
    (hm : ElementaryMotion m) (d : ℕ) : ElementaryField (fun _ : Fin d → ℝ => m.velocity) := by
  apply ElementaryField.sum Finset.univ
  intro i _
  have ht : ElementaryCurve (fun t : ℝ => 2*t-1/2) := by
    simpa using
      ((ElementaryCurve.const (RationalConstant.nat 2)).mul ElementaryCurve.id).sub
        (ElementaryCurve.const (RationalConstant.rat (1/2)))
  have hc : ElementaryField (fun _ : Fin d → ℝ => fun t _ => m.fieldCenter i t) :=
    fun k => ElementaryScalar.time.curve ((hm.1 i k).comp ht)
  have hw : ElementaryField (fun _ : Fin d → ℝ => fun t _ => m.fieldScale i t) :=
    fun k => (ElementaryScalar.time.curve ((hm.2 i k).comp ht)).div_const (Ar.2 i k)
  apply elementary_movingBoxVelocity (-A.width i) (A.width i)
    (fun k => (Ar.2 i k).neg) (Ar.2 i) hc hw
  · intro k
    obtain ⟨t,ht,hmin⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn
      (show (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).Nonempty from ⟨0, by simp⟩)
      (contDiff_pi.mp (m.fieldScale_smooth i) k).continuous.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (m.fieldScale_pos i t k)
    have hn' : (((n+1:ℕ):ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ m.fieldScale i t k := by simpa [one_div] using hn.le
    refine ⟨n, fun _ s => hn'.trans ?_⟩
    have hh : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, m.fieldScale i t k ≤ m.fieldScale i s k := hmin
    by_cases hs : s ≤ 1/4
    · simpa only [m.fieldScale_before i hs, m.fieldScale_before i (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/4),
        Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, one_div] using hh 0 (by simp)
    · by_cases hs' : 3/4 ≤ s
      · simpa only [m.fieldScale_after i hs', m.fieldScale_after i (by norm_num : (3:ℝ)/4 ≤ 1)] using hh 1 (by simp)
      · exact hh s ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩
  · exact hr

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.prescribed_residual_realization
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
theorem prescribed_residual_realization {K : Set Space} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {U : Velocity} (hU : JointSmooth U) (hs : SpatiallySupported K U)
    (hp : RepeatsAfter 1 U) (hzero : ∀ x, U 0 x = 0)
    (hdiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, div U t x = 0) :
    Smooth U ∧ Smooth (inertialCoefficient U) ∧ Smooth (viscousCoefficient U) ∧
    CommonCompactSupport U (inertialCoefficient U) (viscousCoefficient U) ∧
    BoundedMixed U ∧ BoundedMixed (inertialCoefficient U) ∧ BoundedMixed (viscousCoefficient U) ∧
    PeriodicAfterOne U ∧ ComparisonClass U (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
    (∃ X, IsMaterialFlow U X ∧ ∀ Y, IsMaterialFlow U Y →
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, X t x = Y t x) ∧
    ∀ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν → let f := affineForce (inertialCoefficient U) (viscousCoefficient U) ν
      ZeroDataSolution ν f U (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
      Smooth f ∧ BoundedMixed f ∧ PeriodicAfterOne f ∧ UniqueInComparison ν f U := by
  obtain ⟨hf₀, hf₁, hsupport, hbound, hb₀, hb₁, hperiod, hres⟩ :=
    prescribed_residual_regularity hK hU hs hp hzero hdiv
  have hclass := comparisonClass_of_compact_boundedMixed hK hU hs hbound
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := exists_materialFlow_of_boundedMixed hU hbound
  obtain ⟨K', hK'⟩ := spatial_lipschitz_of_boundedMixed hU hbound
  refine ⟨hU.smooth, hf₀, hf₁, hsupport, hbound, hb₀, hb₁, hperiod, hclass,
    ⟨X, hX, fun Y hY t ht x => materialFlow_unique hK' hX hY ht x⟩, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν
  obtain ⟨hsol, hsm, hb, hp'⟩ := hres ν
  exact ⟨hsol, hsm, hb, hp', Analysis.unique_in_comparison hν.le hsol hclass⟩

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.loadedRepeat_divergence
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
lemma loadedRepeat_divergence {load v : Velocity} (hl : JointSmooth load)
    (hv : JointSmooth v) (hc : TimeCollars v)
    (hld : ∀ t x, div load t x = 0) (hvd : ∀ t x, div v t x = 0) (t : ℝ) (x : Space) :
    div (loadedRepeat load v) t x = 0 := by
  have hr := repeatTemplate_jointSmooth hv hc
  have hg : JointSmooth (fun t (_ : Space) => afterLoadingGate t) := by
    dsimp [JointSmooth, afterLoadingGate]
    fun_prop
  change div (fun t x => load t x + afterLoadingGate t • repeatTemplate v t x) t x = 0
  have hgr : JointSmooth (fun t x => afterLoadingGate t • repeatTemplate v t x) := hg.smul hr
  rw [div_add hl hgr, div_time_smul hr, hld t x, repeatTemplate_divergence hc hvd]
  ring

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.name: OAI.BalancedTransport.Geometry.loadedRepeat
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Bal.text:
def loadedRepeat (load template : Velocity) : Velocity :=
  fun t x => load t x + afterLoadingGate t • repeatTemplate template t x

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Main:17.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.main_theorem
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Main:17.text:
theorem main_theorem (n k : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (R : ℝ) (r : Fin k → ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) :
    HasPacking n k R r ↔ PackingInequalities n k R r := by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    exact ⟨hp.volume_lt (by omega) hR hr,hp.strict_pair_bound hn hR hr⟩
  · exact hasPacking_of_inequalities hn hk hR hr

end HigherDimensionalBallPacking

end
