OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.packing_pair_obstruction
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
theorem packing_pair_obstruction (n k : ℕ) (hn : 3≤n) (hk : 1≤k)
    (R : ℝ) (r : Fin k → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i,0<r i) (hp : HasPacking n k R r) :
    ∀ i j, i≠j → r i+r j<R := by
  obtain ⟨U,f,hf,hd⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨σ,hσ,hσR,hσbound⟩ := packing_exists_smaller_capacity hk hr hf
  let τ : ℝ := (σ+R)/2
  have hστ : σ<τ := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
  have hτR : τ<R := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
  have hτ : 0<τ := hσ.trans hστ
  have hpτ : HasPacking n k τ r := by
    refine ⟨U,f,?_,hd⟩
    intro i
    refine ⟨(hf i).1,(hf i).2.1,?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hb := hσbound (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i,mem_image_of_mem (f i) hx⟩)
    exact hb.trans_lt hστ
  intro i j hij
  exact (two_ball_obstruction n hn τ (r i) (r j) hτ (hr i) (hr j)
    (packing_two_of_pair hpτ i j hij)).trans_lt hτR

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.two_ball_obstruction
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
theorem two_ball_obstruction (n : ℕ) (hn : 3≤n) (R a b : ℝ)
    (hR : 0<R) (ha : 0<a) (hb : 0<b) (hp : HasPacking n 2 R ![a,b]) :
    a+b≤R := by
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hR.le
  have hc : Real.sqrt R≠0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hR).ne'
  have hp' := packing_dilation hp (Real.sqrt R) hc
  rw [hsq,div_self hR.ne'] at hp'
  have hr : (fun i : Fin 2 => ![a,b] i/R)=![a/R,b/R] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hr] at hp'
  have h := normalized_two_ball_obstruction n hn (a/R) (b/R) (div_pos ha hR) (div_pos hb hR) hp'
  rw [←add_div] at h
  exact (div_le_one hR).mp h

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Rigidity.Adapte.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.Rigidity.closedBall_isCompact
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Rigidity.Adapte.text:
theorem closedBall_isCompact (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : IsCompact (closedBall n R) := by
  apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Phase n) (max R 0 + 1)).of_isClosed_subset
    (closedBall_isClosed n R)
  intro z hz
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ max R 0 + 1)).mpr
  intro j
  have hj : Complex.normSq (z j) ≤ ∑ k, Complex.normSq (z k) :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg (z k)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hj' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj Real.pi_pos.le
  have hq : 0 ≤ Complex.normSq (z j) := Complex.normSq_nonneg (z j)
  have hs : (∑ k, Complex.normSq (z k)) * Real.pi ≤ R := by
    simpa [closedBall, capacity, mul_comm] using hz
  have hb : Complex.normSq (z j) ≤ max R 0 := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three, le_max_left R 0]
  rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at hb
  have hm := le_max_right R 0
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖z j‖ - 1)]

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.packing_necessity
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
theorem packing_necessity (n k : ℕ) (hn : 3≤n) (hk : 1≤k)
    (R : ℝ) (r : Fin k → ℝ) (hR : 0<R) (hr : ∀ i,0<r i)
    (hp : HasPacking n k R r) : PackingInequalities n k R r :=
  ⟨packing_volume_obstruction n k hn hk R r hR hr hp,
    packing_pair_obstruction n k hn hk R r hr hp⟩

end HigherDimensionalBallPacking

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.Rigidity.packing_exists_smaller_capacity
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
theorem packing_exists_smaller_capacity {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {R : ℝ} {r : Fin k → ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    {U : Fin k → Set (Phase n)} {f : Fin k → Phase n → Phase n}
    (hf : ∀ i, closedBall n (r i) ⊆ U i ∧ SymplecticOn (U i) (f i) ∧
      MapsTo (f i) (closedBall n (r i)) (openBall n R)) :
    ∃ σ, 0 < σ ∧ σ < R ∧ (⋃ i, f i '' closedBall n (r i)) ⊆ closedBall n σ := by
  let K := ⋃ i, f i '' closedBall n (r i)
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_iUnion fun i =>
    (closedBall_isCompact n (r i)).image_of_continuousOn
      ((hf i).2.1.2.1.continuousOn.mono (hf i).1)
  have hne : K.Nonempty := by
    let i : Fin k := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    refine ⟨f i 0, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨0, ?_, rfl⟩⟩⟩
    simp only [closedBall, mem_ofPred_eq, capacity, Pi.zero_apply,
      map_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero]
    exact (hr i).le
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hm⟩ := hK.exists_isMaxOn hne (capacity_smooth n).continuous.continuousOn
  have hxR : capacity x < R := by
    obtain ⟨i, y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact (hf i).2.2 hy
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ capacity x := mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨(capacity x + R) / 2, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hxy : capacity y ≤ capacity x := hm hy
  change capacity y ≤ (capacity x + R) / 2
  linarith

end Rigidity

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.Rigidity.symplecticOn_volume_closedBall
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
theorem symplecticOn_volume_closedBall {n : ℕ} {r : ℝ}
    {U : Set (Phase n)} {f : Phase n → Phase n}
    (hf : SymplecticOn U f) (hU : closedBall n r ⊆ U) :
    volume (f '' closedBall n r) = volume (closedBall n r) := by
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ closedBall n r, HasFDerivWithinAt f (fderiv ℝ f x)
      (closedBall n r) x := by
    intro x hx
    exact ((hf.2.1.contDiffAt (hf.1.mem_nhds (hU hx))).differentiableAt
      (by simp)).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hi : InjOn f (closedBall n r) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have he := hf.2.2.1.injective (a₁ := ⟨x, hU hx⟩) (a₂ := ⟨y, hU hy⟩) hxy
    exact congrArg Subtype.val he
  rw [← lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_eq_addHaar_image volume
    (closedBall_isClosed n r).measurableSet hd hi]
  calc
    (∫⁻ x in closedBall n r, ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ f x).det|) =
        ∫⁻ _ in closedBall n r, (1 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (closedBall_isClosed n r).measurableSet
      intro x hx
      change ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ f x).det| = 1
      rw [abs_det_of_standardForm _ (hf.2.2.2 x (hU hx)), ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    _ = volume (closedBall n r) := by simp

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.Rigidity.volume_closedBall_capacity
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
theorem volume_closedBall_capacity (n : ℕ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    volume (closedBall n r) = ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n) * volume (closedBall n 1) := by
  rw [closedBall_eq_smul_unit n hr,
    Measure.addHaar_smul_of_nonneg volume (Real.sqrt_nonneg r)]
  have hd : Module.finrank ℝ (Phase n) = 2 * n := by
    simp [Phase, Module.finrank_pi_fintype, Complex.finrank_real_complex, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [hd, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt hr.le]

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.Rigidity.unit_capacity_volume_pos
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
private theorem unit_capacity_volume_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < volume (closedBall n 1) := by
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le ((openBall_isOpen n 1).measure_pos volume ?_)
    (measure_mono (show openBall n 1 ⊆ closedBall n 1 from fun _ hz => (show capacity _ ≤ 1 from le_of_lt hz)))
  exact ⟨0, by simp [openBall, capacity]⟩

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.packing_two_of_pair
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
theorem packing_two_of_pair {n k : ℕ} {R : ℝ} {r : Fin k → ℝ}
    (hp : HasPacking n k R r) (i j : Fin k) (hij : i≠j) :
    HasPacking n 2 R ![r i,r j] := by
  have he : Injective (![i,j] : Fin 2 → Fin k) := by
    intro x y hxy
    fin_cases x <;> fin_cases y <;> simp_all
  have hr : (r ∘ (![i,j] : Fin 2 → Fin k))=![r i,r j] := by
    funext x
    fin_cases x <;> rfl
  simpa only [hr] using packing_reindex hp (![i,j] : Fin 2 → Fin k) he

OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.name: OAI.HigherDimensionalBallPacking.packing_volume_obstruction
OAI.Geometry.BallPacking.Necessity.Packi.text:
theorem packing_volume_obstruction (n k : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (R : ℝ) (r : Fin k → ℝ) (_hR : 0 < R) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hp : HasPacking n k R r) : (∑ i, r i ^ n) < R ^ n := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, f, hf, hdisj⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσR, hsub⟩ := Rigidity.packing_exists_smaller_capacity hk hr hf
  have hmeas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (f i '' closedBall n (r i)) := by
    intro i
    exact ((Rigidity.closedBall_isCompact n (r i)).image_of_continuousOn
      ((hf i).2.1.2.1.continuousOn.mono (hf i).1)).measurableSet
  have hvol : (∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (r i ^ n)) * volume (closedBall n 1) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ n) * volume (closedBall n 1) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, volume (f i '' closedBall n (r i)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Rigidity.symplecticOn_volume_closedBall (hf i).2.1 (hf i).1,
          Rigidity.volume_closedBall_capacity n (hr i)]
      _ = volume (⋃ i, f i '' closedBall n (r i)) := by
        rw [measure_iUnion hdisj hmeas, tsum_fintype]
      _ ≤ volume (closedBall n σ) := measure_mono hsub
      _ = _ := Rigidity.volume_closedBall_capacity n hσ
  have hV0 := ne_of_gt (Rigidity.unit_capacity_volume_pos n)
  have hVtop := (Rigidity.closedBall_isCompact n 1).measure_ne_top (μ := volume)
  rw [mul_comm _ (volume (closedBall n 1)), mul_comm _ (volume (closedBall n 1))] at hvol
  have hsum := (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_right hV0 hVtop).mp hvol
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hr i).le n)] at hsum
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hsum
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hσ.le n),
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => pow_nonneg (hr i).le n))] at hreal
  exact hreal.trans_lt (pow_lt_pow_left₀ hσR hσ.le (by omega))

OAI.Combinatorics.Hamiltonian.Main:47.name: OAI.Barnette.main
OAI.Combinatorics.Hamiltonian.Main:47.text:
theorem main : MainStatement.{u} := by
  intro V hV dV G dG hc hb hp h3
  have hdeq : dV = Classical.decEq V := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst dV
  have hdrel : dG = fun a b => Classical.propDecidable (G.Adj a b) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst dG
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := hp
  have hconn := h3.connected
  let : Nonempty V := hconn.nonempty
  have horder := cubic_bipartite_order hc hb
  obtain ⟨N,F,f,D,hr,hd⟩ := E.exists_exact_dual hconn
  let : Fintype F := f
  have hN : N.Simple := by
    refine ⟨hr.loopless,?_⟩
    intro e f hef
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← hr e,← hr f]
    exact hef
  have hc' : N.graph.IsRegularOfDegree 3 := by rw [hr.graph_eq]; exact hc
  have h3' : ThreeVertexConnected N.graph := hr.graph_eq.symm ▸ h3
  have hec : N.ThreeEdgeConnected := by
    intro A ha ho
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := ho
    exact N.cut_card_three h3' (by omega) A ha ⟨w,Finset.mem_compl.mp hw⟩
  obtain ⟨color⟩ := hb
  let black : V → Prop := fun v => color v = 0
  have hcolor (e : G.edgeSet) : black (N.tail e) ↔ ¬black (N.head e) := by
    have hne := color.valid (G.mem_edgeSet.mp ((hr e).symm ▸ e.property))
    have ht := (color (N.tail e)).isLt
    have hh := (color (N.head e)).isLt
    have hne' : (color (N.tail e)).val ≠ (color (N.head e)).val := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
    change color (N.tail e) = 0 ↔ ¬color (N.head e) = 0
    simp only [Fin.ext_iff,Fin.val_zero]
    omega
  have hh := hd.hamiltonian N D hN hc' hec black hcolor
  rwa [hr.graph_eq] at hh
end
end Barnette

end OAI

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:13.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.TorsionFree
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:13.text:
def TorsionFree (G : Type*) [Group G] : Prop := ∀ g : G, IsOfFinOrder g → g = 1

variable {G : Type*} [Group G]

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:70.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.matrix_trace_eq_augmentation
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:70.text:
lemma matrix_trace_eq_augmentation (hG : TorsionFree G) {q : ℕ}
    (e : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) (he : e * e = e) :
    matrixTrace e = augmentation (Matrix.trace e) := by
  let tr := BassTrace.K0.classTrace (Matrix.trace e)
  have htr (c : ConjClasses G) (hc : c ≠ ConjClasses.mk 1) : tr c = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := ConjClasses.mk_surjective c
    rw [BassTrace.K0.classTrace_apply]
    apply BassTrace.bassTrace e he g
    intro hg
    exact hc (congrArg ConjClasses.mk (hG g hg))
  rw [matrixTrace_eq_classCoefficient, ← BassTrace.K0.classTrace_apply,
    ← classTrace_sum]
  symm
  apply Finsupp.sum_eq_single (ConjClasses.mk (1 : G))
  · intro c _ hc
    exact htr c hc
  · simp

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TorsionFree:27.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.complex_idempotent
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TorsionFree:27.text:
theorem complex_idempotent (hG : TorsionFree G)
    (e : MonoidAlgebra ℂ G) (he : e * e = e) : e = 0 ∨ e = 1 := by
  have ht : e.coeff 1 = augmentation e := scalar_trace_eq_augmentation hG e he
  have haug : augmentation e * (augmentation e - 1) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← map_mul, he, sub_self]
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp haug with hz | ho
  · exact Or.inl (Regular.idempotent_eq_zero_of_coeff_one_eq_zero e he (ht.trans hz))
  · have ht' : e.coeff 1 = 1 := ht.trans (sub_eq_zero.mp ho)
    have hc : (1 - e) * (1 - e) = 1 - e := by
      rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub, one_mul, one_mul, mul_one, he]
      abel
    have hz : (1 - e).coeff 1 = 0 := by simp [ht']
    exact Or.inr (sub_eq_zero.mp
      (Regular.idempotent_eq_zero_of_coeff_one_eq_zero (1 - e) hc hz)).symm

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.Definitions:52.name: OAI.BassTrace.K0.rawCoefficient
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.Definitions:52.text:
def rawCoefficient (g : G) : FreeAbelianGroup (Idempotent (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) →+ ℂ :=
  FreeAbelianGroup.lift (fun e=>classCoefficient g (Matrix.trace e.matrix))

end

variable {G : Type*} [_root_.Group G]

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:26.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.canonicalTrace
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:26.text: def canonicalTrace (a : MonoidAlgebra ℂ G) : ℂ := a.coeff 1

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.CoefficientDesc.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.descend_idempotents
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.CoefficientDesc.text:
theorem descend_idempotents {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (hC : ∀ e : MonoidAlgebra ℂ G, e * e = e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1)
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CharZero R]
    (e : MonoidAlgebra R G) (he : e * e = e) : e = 0 ∨ e = 1 := by
  let S := e.coeff.support
  let v : S → R := fun g => e.coeff g
  let f : MvPolynomial S ℤ →+* R := MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Int.castRingHom R) v
  let R₀ := f.range
  have hmem (g : G) : e.coeff g ∈ R₀ := by
    by_cases h : g ∈ S
    · exact ⟨MvPolynomial.X ⟨g,h⟩, by simp [f, v]⟩
    · have hz : e.coeff g = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp h
      rw [hz]
      exact R₀.zero_mem
  have : Countable (MvPolynomial S ℤ) :=
    Function.Injective.countable AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective
  have : Countable R₀ := Function.Surjective.countable f.rangeRestrict_surjective
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := countable_domain_embeds_complex R₀
  let a : MonoidAlgebra R₀ G := MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
    (Finsupp.onFinset S (fun g : G => (⟨e.coeff g, hmem g⟩ : R₀))
      (fun g hg => Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (by simpa using hg)))
  let i : MonoidAlgebra R₀ G →+* MonoidAlgebra R G := MonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom G R₀.subtype
  have hi : Function.Injective i := MonoidAlgebra.map_injective R₀.subtype.toAddMonoidHom
    Subtype.val_injective
  have ha : i a = e := by ext g; rfl
  have ha' : a * a = a := hi (by rw [map_mul, ha, he])
  let k := MonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom G j
  have hk : Function.Injective k := MonoidAlgebra.map_injective j.toAddMonoidHom hj
  rcases hC (k a) (by rw [← map_mul, ha']) with hz | ho
  · left
    have : a = 0 := hk (hz.trans (map_zero k).symm)
    rw [← ha, this, map_zero]
  · right
    have : a = 1 := hk (ho.trans (map_one k).symm)
    rw [← ha, this, map_one]

end TorsionFreeBass
end

end OAI

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:18.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.augmentation
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:18.text:
def augmentation : MonoidAlgebra ℂ G →+* ℂ :=
  (MonoidAlgebra.lift ℂ ℂ G (1 : G →* ℂ)).toRingHom

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:45.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.augmentedMatrix_mul
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:45.text:
lemma augmentedMatrix_mul {m n p : ℕ}
    (a : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G))
    (b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) :
    augmentedMatrix (a * b) = augmentedMatrix a * augmentedMatrix b := by
  exact Matrix.map_mul

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TorsionFree:43.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.domain_idempotent
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TorsionFree:43.text:
theorem domain_idempotent (hG : TorsionFree G)
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CharZero R]
    (e : MonoidAlgebra R G) (he : e * e = e) : e = 0 ∨ e = 1 :=
  descend_idempotents (complex_idempotent hG) R e he

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:56.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.idempotent_matrix_trace_eq_rank
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:56.text:
lemma idempotent_matrix_trace_eq_rank {q : ℕ} (a : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℂ)
    (ha : a * a = a) : Matrix.trace a = (a.rank : ℂ) := by
  have h : IsIdempotentElem a.toLin' := by
    change a.toLin'.comp a.toLin' = a.toLin'
    rw [← Matrix.toLin'_mul, ha]
  rw [← Matrix.trace_toLin'_eq, (LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isProj_range _ h).trace]
  rfl

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:51.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.augmentedMatrix_trace
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:51.text:
lemma augmentedMatrix_trace {q : ℕ}
    (e : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) :
    Matrix.trace (augmentedMatrix e) = augmentation (Matrix.trace e) := by
  simp [augmentedMatrix, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag]

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:197.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.traceK0_range
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:197.text:
theorem traceK0_range (hG : TorsionFree G) :
    Set.range (traceK0 (G := G)) = Set.range (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℂ)) := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨augmentationRank x, by rw [traceK0_eq_augmentationRank hG]; rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨z • BassTrace.K0.classOf (unitIdempotent (G := G)), ?_⟩
    rw [map_zsmul, traceK0_unit]
    simp

end TorsionFreeBass
end

end OAI

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TorsionFree:50.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.torsion_free_corollary
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TorsionFree:50.text:
theorem torsion_free_corollary (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : TorsionFree G) :
    ((∀ (q : ℕ), 1 ≤ q →
      ∀ e : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G), e ^ 2 = e →
        matrixTrace e = ((augmentedMatrix e).rank : ℂ)) ∧
      traceK0 (G := G) = (Int.castAddHom ℂ).comp augmentationRank ∧
      Set.range (traceK0 (G := G)) = Set.range (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℂ))) ∧
    (∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CharZero R]
      (e : MonoidAlgebra R G), e ^ 2 = e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1) := by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, traceK0_eq_augmentationRank hG, traceK0_range hG⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro q _ e he
    exact matrix_trace_eq_rank hG e (by simpa only [pow_two] using he)
  · intro R _ _ _ e he
    exact domain_idempotent hG R e (by simpa only [pow_two] using he)

end TorsionFreeBass
end

end OAI

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:89.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.matrix_trace_eq_rank
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:89.text:
theorem matrix_trace_eq_rank (hG : TorsionFree G) {q : ℕ}
    (e : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) (he : e * e = e) :
    matrixTrace e = ((augmentedMatrix e).rank : ℂ) := by
  rw [matrix_trace_eq_augmentation hG e he, ← augmentedMatrix_trace]
  apply idempotent_matrix_trace_eq_rank
  rw [← augmentedMatrix_mul, he]

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:29.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.matrixTrace
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:29.text:
def matrixTrace {q : ℕ} (e : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i, canonicalTrace (e i i)

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:191.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.traceK0_unit
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:191.text:
lemma traceK0_unit : traceK0 (BassTrace.K0.classOf (unitIdempotent (G := G))) = 1 := by
  rw [traceK0_classOf]
  change matrixTrace (1 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) = 1
  simp [matrixTrace, canonicalTrace]

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:40.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.matrixTrace_eq_classCoefficient
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:40.text:
lemma matrixTrace_eq_classCoefficient {q : ℕ}
    (e : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) :
    matrixTrace e = BassTrace.classCoefficient 1 (Matrix.trace e) := by
  simp [matrixTrace, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, canonicalTrace_eq_classCoefficient]

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:169.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.traceK0_eq_augmentationRank
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:169.text:
theorem traceK0_eq_augmentationRank (hG : TorsionFree G) :
    traceK0 (G := G) = (Int.castAddHom ℂ).comp augmentationRank := by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with | H z =>
    change BassTrace.K0.rawCoefficient 1 z = (rawAugmentationRank z : ℂ)
    induction z using FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, Int.cast_zero]
    | of e =>
      simp only [BassTrace.K0.rawCoefficient, rawAugmentationRank,
        FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of, Int.cast_natCast]
      rw [← matrixTrace_eq_classCoefficient]
      exact matrix_trace_eq_rank hG e.matrix e.idem
    | neg z hz => simp only [map_neg, Int.cast_neg, hz]
    | add z w hz hw => simp only [map_add, Int.cast_add, hz, hw]

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:186.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.unitIdempotent
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:186.text:
def unitIdempotent : BassTrace.K0.Idempotent (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G) where
  size := 1
  matrix := 1
  idem := one_mul _

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:33.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.augmentedMatrix
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:33.text:
def augmentedMatrix {m n : ℕ} (e : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) :
    Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ := e.map augmentation

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:111.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.augmentationRank_relations
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:111.text:
lemma augmentationRank_relations : BassTrace.K0.relations (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G) ≤
    (rawAugmentationRank (G := G)).ker := by
  apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨e,f,a,b,hab,hba,rfl⟩ | ⟨e,f,rfl⟩
  · change rawAugmentationRank (FreeAbelianGroup.of e - FreeAbelianGroup.of f) = 0
    apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℂ)
    rw [map_sub, Int.cast_sub, rawAugmentationRank_of, rawAugmentationRank_of, Int.cast_zero]
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    rw [← augmentedMatrix_trace, ← augmentedMatrix_trace, ← hab, ← hba,
      augmentedMatrix_mul, augmentedMatrix_mul]
    exact Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
  · change rawAugmentationRank (FreeAbelianGroup.of (BassTrace.K0.directSum e f) -
      FreeAbelianGroup.of e - FreeAbelianGroup.of f) = 0
    apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℂ)
    simp only [map_sub, Int.cast_sub, rawAugmentationRank_of, Int.cast_zero,
      BassTrace.K0.trace_directSum, map_add]
    abel

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:100.name: OAI.TorsionFreeBass.rawAugmentationRank
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.TraceRank:100.text:
def rawAugmentationRank : FreeAbelianGroup (Idempotent (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) →+ ℤ :=
  FreeAbelianGroup.lift (fun e => ((augmentedMatrix e.matrix).rank : ℤ))

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.Main:23.name: OAI.BassTrace.RightProjective.bassTraceModules_vanishing_and_support
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.Main:23.text:
theorem bassTraceModules_vanishing_and_support {G : Type u} [_root_.Group G]
    (x : ModuleK0.{u,v} (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) :
    (∀ g : G, ¬IsOfFinOrder g → HattoriStallings x (ConjClasses.mk g) = 0) ∧
      ↑(HattoriStallings x).support ⊆
        {c | ∃ g : G, IsOfFinOrder g ∧ ConjClasses.mk g = c} :=
  ⟨fun g hg => bassTraceModules x g hg, bassTraceModules_support x⟩

end BassTrace.RightProjective

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.MatrixK0:112.name: OAI.BassTrace.K0.bassTraceK0_support
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.MatrixK0:112.text:
theorem bassTraceK0_support {G : Type*} [_root_.Group G]
    (x : Group (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) :
    ↑(HattoriStallings x).support ⊆
      {c : ConjClasses G | ∃g : G,IsOfFinOrder g ∧ ConjClasses.mk g=c} := by
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨g,rfl⟩ := ConjClasses.mk_surjective c
  refine ⟨g,?_,rfl⟩
  by_contra hg
  exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hc) (bassTraceK0 x g hg)

end BassTrace.K0

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.Main:18.name: OAI.BassTrace.RightProjective.bassTraceModules_support
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.Main:18.text:
theorem bassTraceModules_support {G : Type u} [_root_.Group G]
    (x : ModuleK0.{u,v} (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) :
    ↑(HattoriStallings x).support ⊆ {c | ∃g : G,IsOfFinOrder g ∧ ConjClasses.mk g=c} :=
  K0.bassTraceK0_support (presentation x)

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.MatrixK0:98.name: OAI.BassTrace.K0.bassTraceK0
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.MatrixK0:98.text:
theorem bassTraceK0 {G : Type*} [_root_.Group G]
    (x : Group (MonoidAlgebra ℂ G)) (g : G) (hg : ¬IsOfFinOrder g) :
    HattoriStallings x (ConjClasses.mk g)=0 := by
  rw [HattoriStallings_apply]
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with | H z =>
    change rawCoefficient g z=0
    induction z using FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on with
    | zero => exact map_zero _
    | of e =>
      simp only [rawCoefficient,FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of]
      exact BassTrace.bassTrace e.matrix e.idem g hg
    | neg z hz => rw [map_neg,hz,neg_zero]
    | add z w hz hw => rw [map_add,hz,hw,add_zero]

OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.Definitions:302.name: OAI.BassTrace.RightProjective.presentation
OAI.RingTheory.BassTrace.Definitions:302.text:
def presentation : ModuleK0.{u,v} R →+ K0.Group R := by
  have unopTranspose_mul {l m n : ℕ}
      (a : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin m) Rᵐᵒᵖ) (b : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) Rᵐᵒᵖ) :
      unopTranspose (a*b)=unopTranspose b*unopTranspose a := by
    ext i j
    simp only [unopTranspose,Matrix.mul_apply]
    change (opAddEquiv.symm : Rᵐᵒᵖ≃+R) (∑k,a j k*b k i)=_
    rw [map_sum]
    rfl
  have rightMatrix_comp {l m n : ℕ}
      (f : (Fin l →Rᵐᵒᵖ) →ₗ[Rᵐᵒᵖ] (Fin m →Rᵐᵒᵖ))
      (g : (Fin m →Rᵐᵒᵖ) →ₗ[Rᵐᵒᵖ] (Fin n →Rᵐᵒᵖ)) :
      rightMatrix (g.comp f)=rightMatrix g*rightMatrix f := by
    simp only [rightMatrix,LinearMap.toMatrixRight'_comp,unopTranspose_mul]
  have classOf_eq_of_rectangular (e f : K0.Idempotent R)
      (a : Matrix (Fin e.size) (Fin f.size) R)
      (b : Matrix (Fin f.size) (Fin e.size) R) (hab : a*b=e.matrix) (hba : b*a=f.matrix) :
      K0.classOf e=K0.classOf f := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    change (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (K0.relations R)) (FreeAbelianGroup.of e)-
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (K0.relations R)) (FreeAbelianGroup.of f)=0
    rw [←map_sub]
    change (QuotientAddGroup.mk (FreeAbelianGroup.of e-FreeAbelianGroup.of f) : K0.Group R)=0
    apply (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨e,f,a,b,hab,hba,rfl⟩)
  have Retraction.class_eq {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M] (r s : Retraction R M) :
      K0.classOf r.idempotent=K0.classOf s.idempotent := by
    apply classOf_eq_of_rectangular _ _
      (rightMatrix (r.inc.comp s.proj)) (rightMatrix (s.inc.comp r.proj))
    · change rightMatrix (r.inc.comp s.proj)*rightMatrix (s.inc.comp r.proj)=
        rightMatrix (r.inc.comp r.proj)
      rw [←rightMatrix_comp]
      congr 1
      calc (r.inc.comp s.proj).comp (s.inc.comp r.proj) =
          r.inc.comp ((s.proj.comp s.inc).comp r.proj) := by simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
        _ = r.inc.comp r.proj := by rw [s.split,LinearMap.id_comp]
    · change rightMatrix (s.inc.comp r.proj)*rightMatrix (r.inc.comp s.proj)=
        rightMatrix (s.inc.comp s.proj)
      rw [←rightMatrix_comp]
      congr 1
      calc (s.inc.comp r.proj).comp (r.inc.comp s.proj) =
          s.inc.comp ((r.proj.comp r.inc).comp s.proj) := by simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
        _ = s.inc.comp s.proj := by rw [r.split,LinearMap.id_comp]
  have Retraction.transport_idempotent {M N : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ N] (r : Retraction R M) (u : M≃ₗ[Rᵐᵒᵖ] N) :
      (r.transport u).idempotent=r.idempotent := by
    dsimp only [Retraction.idempotent]
    congr 1
    change rightMatrix ((r.inc.comp u.symm.toLinearMap).comp (u.toLinearMap.comp r.proj))=
      rightMatrix (r.inc.comp r.proj)
    congr 1
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change r.inc (u.symm (u (r.proj x)))=r.inc (r.proj x)
    rw [u.symm_apply_apply]
  have freeSplit_apply_left (n m : ℕ) (v : Fin (n+m)→Rᵐᵒᵖ) (i : Fin n) :
      (freeSplit n m v).1 i=v (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i)) := rfl
  have freeSplit_apply_right (n m : ℕ) (v : Fin (n+m)→Rᵐᵒᵖ) (i : Fin m) :
      (freeSplit n m v).2 i=v (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr i)) := rfl
  have freeSplit_symm_left (n m : ℕ) (v : Fin n→Rᵐᵒᵖ) (w : Fin m→Rᵐᵒᵖ) (i : Fin n) :
      (freeSplit n m).symm (v,w) (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i))=v i := by
    have h := congrArg (fun x=>(x.1 : Fin n→Rᵐᵒᵖ) i) ((freeSplit (R := R) n m).apply_symm_apply (v,w))
    exact h
  have freeSplit_symm_right (n m : ℕ) (v : Fin n→Rᵐᵒᵖ) (w : Fin m→Rᵐᵒᵖ) (i : Fin m) :
      (freeSplit n m).symm (v,w) (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr i))=w i := by
    have h := congrArg (fun x=>(x.2 : Fin m→Rᵐᵒᵖ) i) ((freeSplit (R := R) n m).apply_symm_apply (v,w))
    exact h
  have freeSplit_single_left (n m : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
      freeSplit (R := R) n m (Pi.single (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i)) 1)=(Pi.single i 1,0) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · ext j
      rw [freeSplit_apply_left]
      simp only [Pi.single_apply,Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq,Sum.inl.injEq]
    · ext j
      rw [freeSplit_apply_right]
      simp only [Pi.single_apply,Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq,Sum.inr_ne_inl,ite_false,Pi.zero_apply]
  have freeSplit_single_right (n m : ℕ) (i : Fin m) :
      freeSplit (R := R) n m (Pi.single (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr i)) 1)=(0,Pi.single i 1) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · ext j
      rw [freeSplit_apply_left]
      simp only [Pi.single_apply,Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq,Sum.inl_ne_inr,ite_false,Pi.zero_apply]
    · ext j
      rw [freeSplit_apply_right]
      simp only [Pi.single_apply,Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq,Sum.inr.injEq]
  have Retraction.prod_matrix {M N : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ N] (r : Retraction R M) (s : Retraction R N) :
      (r.prod s).idempotent.matrix=(K0.directSum r.idempotent s.idempotent).matrix := by
    ext i j
    obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective i
    obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := finSumFinEquiv.surjective j
    change unop ((freeSplit r.size s.size).symm ((r.inc.prodMap s.inc)
      ((r.proj.prodMap s.proj) ((freeSplit r.size s.size)
        (Pi.single (finSumFinEquiv j) 1)))) (finSumFinEquiv i))=
      Matrix.fromBlocks (rightMatrix (r.inc.comp r.proj)) 0 0 (rightMatrix (s.inc.comp s.proj))
        (finSumFinEquiv.symm (finSumFinEquiv i)) (finSumFinEquiv.symm (finSumFinEquiv j))
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    cases i with | inl i => ?_ | inr i => ?_
    all_goals cases j with | inl j => ?_ | inr j => ?_
    · rw [freeSplit_single_left]
      simp only [LinearMap.prodMap_apply,map_zero,freeSplit_symm_left,Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
      rfl
    · rw [freeSplit_single_right]
      simp only [LinearMap.prodMap_apply,map_zero,freeSplit_symm_left,Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂,
        Pi.zero_apply,unop_zero,Matrix.zero_apply]
    · rw [freeSplit_single_left]
      simp only [LinearMap.prodMap_apply,map_zero,freeSplit_symm_right,Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁,
        Pi.zero_apply,unop_zero,Matrix.zero_apply]
    · rw [freeSplit_single_right]
      simp only [LinearMap.prodMap_apply,map_zero,freeSplit_symm_right,Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂]
      rfl
  have Retraction.prod_idempotent {M N : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ N] (r : Retraction R M) (s : Retraction R N) :
      (r.prod s).idempotent=K0.directSum r.idempotent s.idempotent := by
    dsimp only [Retraction.idempotent, K0.directSum]
    congr 1
    exact Retraction.prod_matrix r s
  have classOf_directSum (e f : K0.Idempotent R) :
      K0.classOf (K0.directSum e f)=K0.classOf e+K0.classOf f := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    change QuotientAddGroup.mk' (K0.relations R) (FreeAbelianGroup.of (K0.directSum e f))-
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (K0.relations R) (FreeAbelianGroup.of e)+
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' (K0.relations R) (FreeAbelianGroup.of f))=0
    rw [←map_add,←map_sub]
    change (QuotientAddGroup.mk (FreeAbelianGroup.of (K0.directSum e f)-
      (FreeAbelianGroup.of e+FreeAbelianGroup.of f)) : K0.Group R)=0
    apply (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr
    rw [sub_add_eq_sub_sub]
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨e,f,rfl⟩)
  have Object.presentationClass_eq (P : Object.{u,v} R) (r : Retraction R P.carrier) :
      P.presentationClass=K0.classOf r.idempotent := Retraction.class_eq P.retraction r
  have Object.presentationClass_iso (P Q : Object.{u,v} R)
      (i : P.carrier ≃ₗ[Rᵐᵒᵖ] Q.carrier) : P.presentationClass=Q.presentationClass := by
    rw [Object.presentationClass_eq Q (P.retraction.transport i), Retraction.transport_idempotent]
    rfl
  have Object.presentationClass_prod (P Q : Object.{u,v} R) :
      (P.prod Q).presentationClass=P.presentationClass+Q.presentationClass := by
    calc
      _ = K0.classOf (P.retraction.prod Q.retraction).idempotent :=
        Object.presentationClass_eq (P.prod Q) (P.retraction.prod Q.retraction)
      _ = P.presentationClass+Q.presentationClass := by
        rw [Retraction.prod_idempotent,classOf_directSum]
        rfl
  have moduleRelations_in_kernel : moduleRelations R≤(rawPresentation.{u,v} (R := R)).ker := by
    apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨P,Q,⟨i⟩,rfl⟩ | ⟨P,Q,rfl⟩
    · change rawPresentation (FreeAbelianGroup.of P-FreeAbelianGroup.of Q)=0
      simp only [map_sub,rawPresentation,FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (Object.presentationClass_iso P Q i)
    · change rawPresentation
        (FreeAbelianGroup.of (P.prod Q)-FreeAbelianGroup.of P-FreeAbelianGroup.of Q)=0
      simp only [map_sub,rawPresentation,FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of,Object.presentationClass_prod]
      abel
  exact QuotientAddGroup.lift (moduleRelations R) rawPresentation moduleRelations_in_kernel

variable {G : Type u} [_root_.Group G]

    (G : BondGraph V E) (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)

    (hutchcroft2019 :

        (subdivision_connected G hconn) (subdivision_locallyFinite G hloc) →
      pc (subdivision G) < ptwo (subdivision G))
    (hradii : HutchcroftCriticalRadiiInput (subdivision G)) :
    MainConclusion G ∧ CriticalLawsConclusion G := by
  exact full_application_volume_radii G hconn hloc hqt hh hutchcroft2019
    (criticalVolumeInput_of_nonamenable (subdivision G) (subdivision_hV_pos G hloc hqt hh)) hradii

OAI.Probability.BenjaminiSchramm.Uncondi.name: OAI.Percolation.BenjaminiSchramm.subdivision_gap_input_proved
OAI.Probability.BenjaminiSchramm.Uncondi.text:
theorem subdivision_gap_input_proved
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hc : Connected G) (hl : LocallyFinite G)
    (hq : QuasiTransitive G) (hh : 0 < hV G) :
    ¬ AutUnimodular (subdivision G) (subdivision_injective G)
      (subdivision_connected G hc) (subdivision_locallyFinite G hl) →
    pc (subdivision G) < ptwo (subdivision G) := by
  intro _hu
  exact simple_strict_gap (subdivision G) (subdivision_injective G)
    (subdivision_connected G hc) (subdivision_locallyFinite G hl)
    (subdivision_quasiTransitive G hl hq) (subdivision_hV_pos G hl hq hh)

end Percolation.BenjaminiSchramm

OAI.Probability.BenjaminiSchramm.Main:14.name: OAI.Percolation.BenjaminiSchramm.critical_laws

    (G : BondGraph V E) (hc : Connected G) (hl : LocallyFinite G)
    (hq : QuasiTransitive G) (hh : 0 < hV G) : CriticalLawsConclusion G :=
  (full_application_gap G hc hl hq hh (subdivision_gap_input_proved G hc hl hq hh)).2

    (G : BondGraph V E) (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)

    (hutchcroft2019 :

        (subdivision_connected G hconn) (subdivision_locallyFinite G hloc) →
      pc (subdivision G) < ptwo (subdivision G)) :

noncomputable def AutUnimodular [Nonempty V] (G : BondGraph V E)
    (hG : Function.Injective G) (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G) : Prop :=

OAI.Probability.BenjaminiSchramm.RadiusT.name: OAI.Percolation.BenjaminiSchramm.criticalRadiiInput_of_nonamenable
OAI.Probability.BenjaminiSchramm.RadiusT.text:
theorem criticalRadiiInput_of_nonamenable [Infinite V]
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hh : 0 < hV G) : HutchcroftCriticalRadiiInput G := by
  intro hgraph hgap x
  let : Countable V := countable_vertices hgraph.locallyFinite hgraph.connected
  let : Countable E := countable_edges hgraph.locallyFinite
  have hp1 : (pc G : ℝ) < 1 :=
    (show (pc G : ℝ) < (ptwo G : ℝ) from hgap).trans_le (ptwo G).2.2
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hpq⟩ := lt_sSup_iff.mp hgap
  obtain ⟨T,hT⟩ := operatorBounded_of_le G hpq.le hq
  have hfin := critical_finite_general G hgraph.connected hgraph.locallyFinite hgraph.quasiTransitive hp1
  rw [criticalFiniteTail_eq G (intrinsicRadiusEvent G) x (hfin x),
    criticalFiniteTail_eq G (extrinsicRadiusEvent G) x (hfin x)]
  exact critical_radius_powerTails_of_operator G hgraph.connected hgraph.locallyFinite
    hgraph.quasiTransitive hh hp1 T hT x

end Percolation.BenjaminiSchramm

OAI.Analysis.BernoulliCone.GlobalMinimiz.name: OAI.Bernoulli.DeSilvaJerison.U_global_minimizer
OAI.Analysis.BernoulliCone.GlobalMinimiz.text:
theorem U_global_minimizer : GlobalMinimizer U := by
  refine ⟨isOpen_univ,gradient U,U_h1loc,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [Measure.restrict_univ] using (Eventually.of_forall U_nonneg : ∀ᵐ x:Space 7 ∂volume,0≤U x)
  intro c r hr hB v V hv hvn htrace
  let B:=Metric.ball c r
  let G:=gradient U
  have hu:H1 B U G:=U_h1loc c r hr (subset_univ _)
  have hpos:=SobolevCalculus.h10_positivePart Metric.isOpen_ball htrace
  have hneg:H10 B (fun x=>max (U x-v x) 0)
      (fun x=>(if 0<U x-v x then (1:ℝ) else 0) • (G x-V x)):=by
    simpa only [neg_sub] using SobolevCalculus.h10_positivePart Metric.isOpen_ball htrace.neg
  let p:=fun x=>U x+max (v x-U x) 0
  let P:=fun x=>G x+(if 0<v x-U x then (1:ℝ) else 0) • (V x-G x)
  let m:=fun x=>U x-max (U x-v x) 0
  let M:=fun x=>G x-(if 0<U x-v x then (1:ℝ) else 0) • (G x-V x)
  have hp:H1 B p P:=hu.add hpos.1
  have hm:H1 B m M:=hu.sub hneg.1
  have hpt:H10 B (fun x=>p x-U x) (fun x=>P x-G x):=by
    apply hpos.congr
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x=>by dsimp [p]; ring)
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x=>by dsimp [P]; abel)
  have hmt:H10 B (fun x=>m x-U x) (fun x=>M x-G x):=by
    apply hneg.neg.congr
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x=>by dsimp [m]; ring)
    · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x=>by dsimp [M]; abel)
  have hUp:∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict B,U x≤p x:=
    Eventually.of_forall fun x=>le_add_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _)
  have hmU:∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict B,m x≤U x:=
    Eventually.of_forall fun x=>sub_le_self _ (le_max_right _ _)
  have hmn:∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict B, 0 ≤ m x:=by
    filter_upwards [hvn] with x hx
    change 0≤U x-max (U x-v x) 0
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (max_le (by linarith) (U_nonneg x))
  have hupper:=U_upper_comparison c r hr hp hUp hpt
  have hlower:=U_lower_comparison c r hr hm hmn hmU hmt
  let :IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict B):=isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  have hI {f:Space 7→ℝ} {F:Space 7→Space 7} (h:H1 B f F):
      Integrable (fun x=>‖F x‖^2+if 0<f x then (1:ℝ) else 0) (volume.restrict B):=
    (h.2.1.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)).add (integrable_phase h.1.aestronglyMeasurable)
  have henergy:energy B m M+energy B p P=energy B U G+energy B v V:=by
    rw [energy,energy,energy,energy,←integral_add (hI hm) (hI hp),←integral_add (hI hu) (hI hv)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [SobolevCalculus.gradient_zero_on_zero_set Metric.isOpen_ball htrace.1] with x hz
    rcases lt_trichotomy (v x) (U x) with hlt|he|hgt
    · have h1:¬0<v x-U x:=by linarith
      have h2:0<U x-v x:=by linarith
      have he:m x=v x:=by dsimp [m]; rw [max_eq_left h2.le]; ring
      simp only [he,p,P,M,ite_eq_right h1,ite_eq_left h2,zero_smul,one_smul,add_zero,
        sub_sub_cancel,max_eq_right (not_lt.mp h1)]
      ring
    · have hVG:V x=G x:=sub_eq_zero.mp (hz (by rw [he,sub_self]))
      simp only [p,P,m,M,he,hVG,sub_self,lt_self_iff_false,ite_false,zero_smul,
        max_self,add_zero,sub_zero]
    · have h1:0<v x-U x:=by linarith
      have h2:¬0<U x-v x:=by linarith
      have he:p x=v x:=by dsimp [p]; rw [max_eq_left h1.le]; ring
      simp only [he,m,M,P,ite_eq_left h1,ite_eq_right h2,zero_smul,one_smul,sub_zero,
        add_sub_cancel,max_eq_right (not_lt.mp h2)]
  change energy B U G≤energy B p P at hupper
  change energy B U G≤energy B m M at hlower
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Duality.C.name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.normalizeDualPair_mem
OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Duality.C.text:
lemma normalizeDualPair_mem (x0 : M) (v : M →ᵇ ℝ) :
    normalizeDualPair x0 v ∈ normalizedDualPairs x0 := by
  let a := boundedCTransform v
  change (a x0 + -a x0 = 0) ∧ _ ∧ _
  refine ⟨add_neg_cancel _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
    intro x
    change cTransform (fun y => cTransform a y + a x0) x = a x + -a x0
    rw [cTransform_add_const (continuous_cTransform a.continuous)]
    have hh := congrFun (cTransform_triple v.continuous) x
    change cTransform (cTransform a) x = a x at hh
    exact (congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t - a x0) hh).trans (by ring)
  · apply BoundedContinuousFunction.ext
    intro x
    change cTransform (fun y => a y + -a x0) x = cTransform a x + a x0
    rw [cTransform_add_const a.continuous]
    ring

OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Oscillati.name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.densityDualClass_nonempty
OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Oscillati.text:
lemma densityDualClass_nonempty {vol : Measure M} {lam cap : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hclass : ∃ rho : M → ℝ, AdmissibleDensity vol lam cap rho) (x0 : M) :
    (densityDualClass vol lam cap x0).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho⟩ := hclass
  have := densityMeasure_probability hlam hrho
  let mu := densityMeasure vol rho
  obtain ⟨uv, huv, hmin⟩ := exists_minimizing_normalizedDualPair mu mu x0
  refine ⟨uv, huv, rho, rho, hrho, hrho, ?_⟩
  intro a b hab
  exact (hmin (normalizeDualPair_mem x0 b)).trans
    (dualObjective_normalize_le mu mu x0 a b hab)

omit [BorelSpace M] in

OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Oscillati.name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.densityDualClass
OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Oscillati.text:
def densityDualClass (vol : Measure M) (lam cap : ℝ) (x0 : M) :
    Set ((M →ᵇ ℝ) × (M →ᵇ ℝ)) :=
  {uv | uv ∈ normalizedDualPairs x0 ∧
    ∃ rho0 rho1 : M → ℝ, AdmissibleDensity vol lam cap rho0 ∧
      AdmissibleDensity vol lam cap rho1 ∧
      ∀ a b : M →ᵇ ℝ, (∀ x y, 0 ≤ contactGap a b x y) →
        dualObjective (densityMeasure vol rho0) (densityMeasure vol rho1) uv ≤
          dualObjective (densityMeasure vol rho0) (densityMeasure vol rho1) (a,b)}

OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Duality.C.name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.dualObjective_normalize_le
OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Duality.C.text:
lemma dualObjective_normalize_le (mu nu : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (x0 : M) (u v : M →ᵇ ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ contactGap u v x y) :
    dualObjective mu nu (normalizeDualPair x0 v) ≤ dualObjective mu nu (u,v) := by
  rw [normalizeDualPair, dualObjective_add_constants]
  apply add_le_add
  · apply integral_mono (boundedCTransform v |>.integrable mu) (u.integrable mu)
    intro x
    rw [boundedCTransform_apply, cTransform_le_iff v.continuous]
    intro y
    have hh := h x y
    dsimp [contactGap] at hh
    linarith
  · apply integral_mono (boundedCTransform (boundedCTransform v) |>.integrable nu)
      (v.integrable nu)
    exact cTransform_cTransform_le v.continuous

end WeakMTWTransport

OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Main:27.name: OAI.WeakMTWTransport.uniform_biHolder_transport
OAI.Analysis.BiholderTransport.Main:27.text:
theorem uniform_biHolder_transport
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {M : Type*}
    [MetricSpace M] [CompactSpace M] [ConnectedSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace (Model n) M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) ∞ M]
    [RiemannianBundle (fun x : M => TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) x)]
    [IsContMDiffRiemannianBundle 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) ∞ (Model n)
      (fun x : M => TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) x)]
    [IsRiemannianManifold 𝓘(ℝ, Model n) M]
    [MeasurableSpace M] [BorelSpace M]
    (hmtw : WeakMTW (n := n) (M := M))
    (lam cap : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hcap : lam ≤ cap)
    (hclass : ∃ rho : M → ℝ, AdmissibleDensity (metricVolume n) lam cap rho) :
    ∃ alpha C : ℝ, 0 < alpha ∧ alpha ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ rho0 rho1 : M → ℝ,
        AdmissibleDensity (metricVolume n) lam cap rho0 →
        AdmissibleDensity (metricVolume n) lam cap rho1 →
        ∃ T : M ≃ₜ M,
          IsOptimalMap (metricVolume n) rho0 rho1 T ∧
          (∀ S : M → M, IsOptimalMap (metricVolume n) rho0 rho1 S →
            S =ᵐ[densityMeasure (metricVolume n) rho0] T) ∧
          BiHolderEstimate alpha C T := by
  classical
  let x0:M:=Classical.choice (inferInstance:Nonempty M)
  exact hmtw.transport_endpoint_of_class_power hlam x0
    (hmtw.class_power (by omega) hlam hcap x0 (densityDualClass_nonempty hlam hclass x0))

end WeakMTWTransport

end

    (∀ c : ℕ, ∃ I : Instance, ∃ B : ℕ,
      I.n = 5 * B ∧

      B + c < opt I ∧ individualLP I = (B : ℝ) ∧ typeLP I = (B : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ c : Nat, PackingGapNPHard c) ∧
    ((∃ c : Nat, Nonempty (AbsoluteAdditiveAlgorithm c)) ↔ PEqualsNP) ∧
    (PEqualsNP → ∃ algorithm : AbsoluteAdditiveAlgorithm 0,
    (∀ (items : RawInstance) (valid : items.Valid), ∃ packing : RawPacking,
      algorithm.run (BinaryEncoding.rawInstanceBits items) = some packing ∧
      packing.Feasible items ∧ packing.bins = opt (items.toInstance valid)) ∧
    algorithm.run (BinaryEncoding.rawInstanceBits []) = some ⟨0, []⟩ ∧
    (∀ input : List Bool, BinaryEncoding.decodeRawInstance input = none →
      algorithm.run input = none) ∧
    (∀ items : RawInstance, ¬ items.Valid →
      algorithm.run (BinaryEncoding.rawInstanceBits items) = none)) := by
  refine ⟨structural_additive_gap, packingGapNPHard,
    exists_absoluteAdditiveAlgorithm_iff_pEqualsNP, ?_⟩
  intro h
  exact ⟨absoluteAdditiveAlgorithm_of_pEqualsNP h,
    absoluteAdditiveAlgorithm_of_pEqualsNP_optimal h,
    absoluteAdditiveAlgorithm_of_pEqualsNP_empty h,

theorem packingGapNPHard (c : Nat) : PackingGapNPHard c := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨source, runtime, hfinite, hsource⟩ := PCPFoundation.normalizedSource L hL
  let normalized : List Bool → LiteralSlotGraphMachine.NonemptyFormula := fun input =>
    ⟨PCPSourceHardness.formula source input, (hsource input).2.1⟩
  let first : TM2ComputableInPolyTime (id : List Bool → List Bool)
      LiteralSlotGraphMachine.inputBits normalized := {
    tm := runtime.tm
    inputAlphabet := runtime.inputAlphabet
    outputAlphabet := runtime.outputAlphabet
    time := runtime.time
    outputsFun input := runtime.outputsFun input }
  let graphRun := MachineSequential.composeBits first LiteralSlotGraphMachine.computation
  let packingRun := MachineSequential.composeBits graphRun
    (graphPackingComputation c PCPFoundation.rho)
  refine ⟨{
    reduce := fun input => PCPFoundation.packingOutput c (source.reduce input)
    computation := packingRun
    finiteAlphabet := ?_
    valid := fun input => PCPFoundation.packingOutput_valid c (source.reduce input)
    itemCount := fun input => PCPFoundation.packingOutput_count c (source.reduce input)
    itemLower := fun input i => PCPFoundation.packingOutput_size_lower c (source.reduce input) i
    completeness := ?_
    soundness := ?_ }⟩
  · exact MachineFiniteAlphabet.composeBits graphRun
      (graphPackingComputation c PCPFoundation.rho)
      (MachineFiniteAlphabet.composeBits first LiteralSlotGraphMachine.computation
        hfinite LiteralSlotGraphMachine.computation_finiteAlphabet)
      (graphPackingComputation_finiteAlphabet c PCPFoundation.rho)
  · intro input accepted
    exact PCPFoundation.packingOutput_complete c (source.reduce input)
      ((source.correct input).mp accepted)
  · intro input rejected
    exact PCPFoundation.packingOutput_sound c (source.reduce input)
      (fun satisfiable => rejected ((source.correct input).mpr satisfiable))

    (membership : Complexity.CookLevin.InNP language) :
    ∃ source : Complexity.CookLevin.PolynomialThreeSATReduction language,
    ∃ runtime : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (id : List Bool → List Bool)
        Complexity.formulaBits (PCPSourceHardness.formula source),
      Complexity.MachineFiniteAlphabet.FiniteAlphabet runtime.tm ∧
      ∀ input : List Bool,
        ((PCPSourceHardness.formula source input).Satisfiable ↔ language input) ∧
        (PCPSourceHardness.formula source input).clauses ≠ [] ∧
        (∀ (clause : Clause (PCPSourceHardness.formula source input).variables),
          clause ∈ (PCPSourceHardness.formula source input).clauses →
          ∀ i j : Fin 3, clause[i].variableIndex = clause[j].variableIndex → i = j) ∧
        (¬ language input →
          SourceAmplification.ClauseGap (PCPSource.clauseFamily (source.reduce input))
            PCPSource.sourceGap) :=
  PCPSourceHardness.normalizedSource language membership

theorem exists_binary_image_of_code {α : Type u} {M P : ℕ}
    (c : α → Word Bool P) (hP : 0 < P)
    (W : Finset (Word α M)) (hW : 2 ≤ W.card)
    (hlower : ∀ x y : Word α M,
      ((P : ℝ) / 804) * (ed x.val y.val : ℝ) ≤
        (ed (encode c x.val) (encode c y.val) : ℝ)) :
    ∃ V : Finset (Word Bool (M * P)), 2 ≤ V.card ∧
      c1 {x : Word α M // x ∈ W}
        (fun x y => (ed x.val.val y.val.val : ℝ)) / 804 ≤
          binarySetDistortion V := by
  have hPR : (0 : ℝ) < P := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hP
  refine ⟨encodedSet c W, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [encodedSet_card c (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < P / 804) hlower W]
    exact hW
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 804)).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using c1_le_804_encodedSet c hP W hW hlower

end TreeEdit.BinaryLower

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.ParameterIm.text:
theorem exists_word_image_lower_of_root_bound {Γ : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    [AddCommGroup A] (G : A → Word Γ n) (z : A)
    (lower upper : ℝ) (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 < upper)
    (hsep : ∀ x, lower ≤ (ed (G x).val (G (x + z)).val : ℝ))
    (hroot : ∀ F : A → RealL1,
      (∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ (ed (G x).val (G y).val : ℝ)) →
      (∑ x : A, ‖F (x + z) - F x‖) / Fintype.card A ≤ upper) :
    ∃ W : Finset (Word Γ n),
      (∀ w, w ∈ W ↔ ∃ a, G a = w) ∧ 2 ≤ W.card ∧
      lower / upper ≤ c1 {w : Word Γ n // w ∈ W}
        (fun x y => (ed x.val.val y.val.val : ℝ)) := by
  apply exists_word_image_lower G
  · refine ⟨0, z, ?_⟩
    have h := hlower.trans_le (hsep 0)
    simp only [zero_add] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  · intro F C hC hF
    have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card A := by
      exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card A)
    have hl : ∀ x, lower / C ≤ ‖F (x + z) - F x‖ := by
      intro x
      calc
        lower / C ≤ (ed (G x).val (G (x + z)).val : ℝ) / C :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hsep x) hC.le
        _ ≤ ‖F x - F (x + z)‖ := (hF x (x + z)).1
        _ = ‖F (x + z) - F x‖ := norm_sub_rev _ _
    have havg : lower / C ≤
        (∑ x : A, ‖F (x + z) - F x‖) / Fintype.card A := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hcard).2
      calc
        lower / C * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) = ∑ _x : A, lower / C := by
          simp [mul_comm]
        _ ≤ ∑ x : A, ‖F (x + z) - F x‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => hl x)
    have hb : lower / C ≤ upper := havg.trans (hroot F (fun x y => (hF x y).2))
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hupper).2
    simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ hC).1 hb

end TreeEdit.BinaryLower.ParameterImage

end

end OAI

theorem finiteWord_root_mean_bound34 {m k : ℕ}
    (p : Fin k → Fin m → ℕ) (i₀ : Fin m) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hppos : ∀ q i, 0 < p q i) (hp : ∀ q i, p q i ≤ k ^ 5)
    [Fintype (State (wordPeriods p))]
    (F : State (wordPeriods p) → RealL1)
    (hF : ∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤
      (ed (finiteWord p i₀ (k ^ (20 * k)) k [] x)
        (finiteWord p i₀ (k ^ (20 * k)) k [] y) : ℝ)) :
    (𝔼 x : State (wordPeriods p), ‖F (x + wordW p i₀ []) - F x‖) ≤
      34 * ((m * k ^ (20 * k) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / (k : ℝ) ^ k := by
  apply FiniteActivity.source_mean_bound34 F (wordW p i₀ []) (by omega) (by positivity)
  have hroot := finiteWord_root_mean_bound p i₀ (by omega) hppos hp
    (k ^ (20 * k)) (by positivity) (FiniteNumeric.averaging_length_le_rows hk) F hF
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hroot

        1 ≤ Fintype.card Γ → Fintype.card Γ ≤ M →
        ∃ c : Γ → Word Bool (M ^ 2), ∀ x y : Word Γ M,
          (((M ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 804) * (ed x.val y.val : ℝ) ≤
            (ed (encode c x.val) (encode c y.val) : ℝ))
    (hfamily : ∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k →
      ∃ Γ : Type u, ∃ inst : Fintype Γ,
        1 ≤ @Fintype.card Γ inst ∧ @Fintype.card Γ inst ≤ finiteSourceLength k ∧
        ∃ W : Finset (Word Γ (finiteSourceLength k)), 2 ≤ W.card ∧
          c₀ * ((k : ℝ) / 4) ^ k ≤
            c1 {x : Word Γ (finiteSourceLength k) // x ∈ W}
              (fun x y => (ed x.val.val y.val.val : ℝ))) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
      ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ d ∧
        ∃ W : Finset (Word Bool n), 2 ≤ W.card ∧
          growth c d ≤ binarySetDistortion W := by
  obtain ⟨M₀, hcode⟩ := hcode
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, K, hfamily⟩ := hfamily
  apply binary_lower_bound_of_finite_family
  refine ⟨c₀ / 804, by positivity, max K (max M₀ 1), ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hkK : K ≤ k := (le_max_left _ _).trans hk
  have hkM : M₀ ≤ k := (le_max_left M₀ 1).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hk)
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := (le_max_right M₀ 1).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hk)
  have hMk : k ≤ finiteSourceLength k := le_finiteSourceLength hk1
  obtain ⟨Γ, inst, hΓ1, hΓM, W, hW, hdist⟩ := hfamily k hkK
  let : Fintype Γ := inst
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hcode (finiteSourceLength k) (hkM.trans hMk) Γ hΓ1 hΓM
  have hP : 0 < finiteSourceLength k ^ 2 := by
    have : 0 < finiteSourceLength k := hk1.trans hMk
    positivity
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVdist⟩ := exists_binary_image_of_code c hP W hW hc
  have hresult : ∃ V : Finset (Word Bool (finiteSourceLength k * finiteSourceLength k ^ 2)),
      2 ≤ V.card ∧ (c₀ / 804) * ((k : ℝ) / 4) ^ k ≤ binarySetDistortion V := by
    refine ⟨V, hV, ?_⟩
    calc
      _ = (c₀ * ((k : ℝ) / 4) ^ k) / 804 := by ring
      _ ≤ c1 {x : Word Γ (finiteSourceLength k) // x ∈ W}
          (fun x y => (ed x.val.val y.val.val : ℝ)) / 804 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hdist (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ binarySetDistortion V := hVdist
  rw [finiteSourceLength_mul_sq] at hresult
  exact hresult

end TreeEdit.BinaryLower

end

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteTreeI.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.FiniteTree.rootWord
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteTreeI.text:

  ⟨finiteWord primes i₀ T k [] x, finiteWord_length primes i₀ T k [] x⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteAlpha.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.FiniteAlphabet.prime_product_alphabet_bounds
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteAlpha.text:
theorem prime_product_alphabet_bounds {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (p : Fin k → Fin (20 * k) → ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ q i, 0 < p q i) (hupper : ∀ q i, p q i ≤ k ^ 5) :
    let Q : Word (Fin (20 * k)) k → ℕ := fun a =>
      2 * ∏ q, p q ((Equiv.vectorEquivFin (Fin (20 * k)) k a) q)
    Finite (Σ a : Word (Fin (20 * k)) k, ZMod (Q a)) ∧
    1 ≤ Nat.card (Σ a : Word (Fin (20 * k)) k, ZMod (Q a)) ∧
    Nat.card (Σ a : Word (Fin (20 * k)) k, ZMod (Q a)) ≤
      (20 * k * k ^ (20 * k)) ^ k := by
  apply finite_tree_alphabet_bounds hk
  · intro a
    exact leaf_period_pos p hpos _
  · intro a
    exact leaf_period_le p hupper _

end TreeEdit.BinaryLower.FiniteAlphabet

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteFamil.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.finiteSourceLength
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteFamil.text: def finiteSourceLength (k : ℕ) : ℕ := (20 * k * k ^ (20 * k)) ^ k

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteCapTr.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.binary_lower_bound_of_finite_family
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteCapTr.text:
theorem binary_lower_bound_of_finite_family
    (hfamily : ∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k →
      ∃ W : Finset (Word Bool (Parameters.finiteLength k)),
        2 ≤ W.card ∧ c₀ * ((k : ℝ) / 4) ^ k ≤ binarySetDistortion W) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
      ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ d ∧
        ∃ W : Finset (Word Bool n), 2 ≤ W.card ∧
          growth c d ≤ binarySetDistortion W := by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, K, hfamily⟩ := hfamily
  obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀⟩ := Parameters.exists_finite_cap_parameters hc₀ K
  refine ⟨1 / 160, by norm_num, d₀, ?_⟩
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨k, hkK, hk20, hkcap, hkgrowth⟩ := hd₀ d hd
  obtain ⟨W, hWcard, hWdist⟩ := hfamily k hkK
  refine ⟨Parameters.finiteLength k, ?_, hkcap, W, hWcard, ?_⟩
  · exact Parameters.finiteLength_pos (by omega : 0 < k)
  · exact hkgrowth.trans hWdist

end TreeEdit.BinaryLower

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteTreeI.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.FiniteTree.finiteWord_length
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteTreeI.text:
@[simp] theorem finiteWord_length {m k : ℕ} (primes : Fin k → Fin m → ℕ)
    (i₀ : Fin m) (T h : ℕ) (p : List (Fin m)) (x : State (wordPeriods primes)) :
    (finiteWord primes i₀ T h p x).length = (m * T) ^ h := by
  simp [finiteWord]

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteSourc.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.exists_finite_source_family
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteSourc.text:
theorem exists_finite_source_family :
    ∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k →
      ∃ Γ : Type, ∃ inst : Fintype Γ,
        1 ≤ @Fintype.card Γ inst ∧ @Fintype.card Γ inst ≤ finiteSourceLength k ∧
        ∃ W : Finset (Word Γ (finiteSourceLength k)), 2 ≤ W.card ∧
          c₀ * ((k : ℝ) / 4) ^ k ≤
            c1 {x : Word Γ (finiteSourceLength k) // x ∈ W}
              (fun x y => (ed x.val.val y.val.val : ℝ)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := PrimeSupply.finite_tree_odd_prime_family
  refine ⟨1 / 34, by norm_num, K, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨hk2, primes, hprimes⟩ := hK k hk
  let p : Fin k → Fin (20 * k) → ℕ := fun q i => primes (q, i)
  have hpprime : ∀ q i, Nat.Prime (p q i) := fun q i => (hprimes (q, i)).1
  have hppos : ∀ q i, 0 < p q i := fun q i => (hpprime q i).pos
  have hplarge : ∀ q i, k ^ 4 ≤ p q i := fun q i => (hprimes (q, i)).2.2.1
  have hpupper : ∀ q i, p q i ≤ k ^ 5 := fun q i => (hprimes (q, i)).2.2.2
  have hpinj : Function.Injective (fun z : Fin k × Fin (20 * k) => p z.1 z.2) :=
    primes.injective
  let i₀ : Fin (20 * k) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let Γ := Symbol (wordPeriods p)
  let A := State (wordPeriods p)
  let : Finite Γ := finite_wordSymbol p hppos
  let : Fintype Γ := Fintype.ofFinite Γ
  let : Finite A := finite_wordState p hppos
  let : Fintype A := Fintype.ofFinite A
  have hΓ := FiniteAlphabet.prime_product_alphabet_bounds hk2 p hppos hpupper
  change Finite Γ ∧ 1 ≤ Nat.card Γ ∧ Nat.card Γ ≤ finiteSourceLength k at hΓ
  have hΓ1 : 1 ≤ Fintype.card Γ := by simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hΓ.2.1
  have hΓM : Fintype.card Γ ≤ finiteSourceLength k := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hΓ.2.2
  let G : A → Word Γ (finiteSourceLength k) := rootWord p i₀ (k ^ (20 * k))
  let z : A := wordW p i₀ []
  have hMnat : 0 < finiteSourceLength k := by
    unfold finiteSourceLength
    positivity
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < finiteSourceLength k := by exact_mod_cast hMnat
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
  have hsep : ∀ x : A, (finiteSourceLength k : ℝ) / (4 : ℝ) ^ k ≤
      (ed (G x).val (G (x + z)).val : ℝ) := by
    intro x
    have hd := finiteWord_root_deficit hk2 p i₀ hpinj hpprime hplarge x
    have he := deficit_le_editDistance
      (finiteWord_length p i₀ (k ^ (20 * k)) k [] x)
      (finiteWord_length p i₀ (k ^ (20 * k)) k [] (x + z))
    exact hd.trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr he)
  have hmean : ∀ F : A → RealL1,
      (∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ (ed (G x).val (G y).val : ℝ)) →
      (∑ x : A, ‖F (x + z) - F x‖) / Fintype.card A ≤
        34 * (finiteSourceLength k : ℝ) / (k : ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro F hF
    have h := finiteWord_root_mean_bound34 p i₀ hk2 hppos hpupper F hF
    simpa only [Fintype.expect_eq_sum_div_card, finiteSourceLength, Nat.cast_pow] using h
  obtain ⟨W, _, hW, hdist⟩ := ParameterImage.exists_word_image_lower_of_root_bound
    G z ((finiteSourceLength k : ℝ) / (4 : ℝ) ^ k)
    (34 * (finiteSourceLength k : ℝ) / (k : ℝ) ^ k)
    (by positivity) (by positivity) hsep hmean
  refine ⟨Γ, inferInstance, hΓ1, hΓM, W, hW, ?_⟩
  have hratio : (finiteSourceLength k : ℝ) / (4 : ℝ) ^ k /
      (34 * (finiteSourceLength k : ℝ) / (k : ℝ) ^ k) =
        (1 / 34 : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) / 4) ^ k := by
    rw [div_pow]
    field_simp
  rw [hratio] at hdist
  exact hdist

end TreeEdit.BinaryLower

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.EditDeficit.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.deficit_le_editDistance
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.EditDeficit.text:
theorem deficit_le_editDistance {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} {x y : List α}
    (hx : x.length = n) (hy : y.length = n) :
    deficit n x y ≤ ed x y := by
  have h := delta_le_twice_editDistance x y
  rw [hx, hy] at h
  unfold deficit
  omega

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteFamil.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.le_finiteSourceLength
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteFamil.text:
lemma le_finiteSourceLength {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) : k ≤ finiteSourceLength k := by
  have hp : 1 ≤ k ^ (20 * k) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hk
  have hb : k ≤ 20 * k * k ^ (20 * k) := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (20 * k) hp
    nlinarith
  exact hb.trans (Nat.le_pow hk)

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteTreeI.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.FiniteTree.finite_wordSymbol
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteTreeI.text:
theorem finite_wordSymbol {m k : ℕ} (primes : Fin k → Fin m → ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ j i, 0 < primes j i) : Finite (Symbol (wordPeriods primes)) := by
  let (l : Leaf m k) : NeZero (wordPeriods primes l) :=
    ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (wordPeriods_pos primes hpos l)⟩
  infer_instance

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.PrimeSupply.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.PrimeSupply.finite_tree_odd_prime_family
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.PrimeSupply.text:
theorem finite_tree_odd_prime_family :
    ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, k₀ ≤ k →
      2 ≤ k ∧ ∃ p : (Fin k × Fin (20 * k)) ↪ ℕ,
        ∀ ji, Nat.Prime (p ji) ∧ 2 < p ji ∧ k ^ 4 ≤ p ji ∧ p ji ≤ k ^ 5 := by
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := finite_tree_prime_family
  refine ⟨max 2 k₀, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk
  have hkk₀ : k₀ ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hk₀ k hkk₀
  refine ⟨hk2, p, ?_⟩
  intro ji
  obtain ⟨hprime, hlow, hupp⟩ := hp ji
  have hpow : 2 ^ 4 ≤ k ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hk2 4
  refine ⟨hprime, ?_, hlow, hupp⟩
  norm_num at hpow
  omega

OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteFamil.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.finiteSourceLength_mul_sq
OAI.Combinatorics.BinaryEdit.FiniteFamil.text:
lemma finiteSourceLength_mul_sq (k : ℕ) :
    finiteSourceLength k * finiteSourceLength k ^ 2 = Parameters.finiteLength k := by
  unfold finiteSourceLength Parameters.finiteLength
  calc
    _ = ((20 * k * k ^ (20 * k)) ^ k) ^ 3 := by ring
    _ = (20 * k * k ^ (20 * k)) ^ (k * 3) := (pow_mul _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [Nat.mul_comm k 3]

OAI.Computability.MatchingCount.BinarySo.name: OAI.BinaryMatching.Raw.InputData.deterministic_approximate_counting
OAI.Computability.MatchingCount.BinarySo.text:
theorem deterministic_approximate_counting :
    ∃ A : Input → ℕ,
      ∃ machine : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime encodeInput Nat.bits A,
        (∀ k, Finite (machine.tm.Γ k)) ∧
        (∃ P : Polynomial ℕ, ∀ G,(A G).bits.length≤P.eval (encodeInput G).length) ∧
        ∀ G,A G≤count G ∧ count G≤2^(9*G.n)*A G ∧ (A G=0 ↔ count G=0) := by
  refine ⟨sparseEstimate,countingRoutine.machine,countingRoutine.machine_alphabets_finite,?_,sparseEstimate_correct⟩
  refine ⟨Polynomial.X+countingRoutine.time,?_⟩

OAI.Computability.MatchingCount.BinarySo.name: OAI.BinaryMatching.Raw.InputData.sparseEstimate_correct
OAI.Computability.MatchingCount.BinarySo.text:
lemma sparseEstimate_correct (G : Input) :
    sparseEstimate G≤count G ∧ count G≤2^(9*G.n)*sparseEstimate G ∧ (sparseEstimate G=0 ↔ count G=0) := by
  unfold sparseEstimate
  split_ifs with hguard
  · have hz := count_zero_of_uncovered G (lt_of_le_of_lt (covered_card_le_records G) hguard)
    simp [hz]
  · unfold smallEstimate
    split_ifs with hn0 hodd hn2
    · rw [count_zero_vertices G hn0,hn0]
      norm_num
    · rw [count_odd_vertices G (Nat.odd_iff.mpr hodd)]
      simp
    · rw [count_two_vertices G hn2]
      refine ⟨le_rfl,?_,Iff.rfl⟩
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
    · have hn : 4≤G.n := by omega
      have he : Even G.n := Nat.even_iff.mpr (by omega)
      rw [integralEstimate_eq G (by omega)]
      exact estimate_correct G hn he

OAI.Computability.MatchingCount.BinarySo.name: OAI.BinaryMatching.Raw.InputData.sparseEstimate

OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Model:84.name: OAI.BinaryCoordinateSweeps.UniformSweepMixingTarget
OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Model:84.text:

  ∃ w : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d ≥ d₀,
    ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Slot d),
      totalVariation (fun g => sweepLaw d w (g * τ⁻¹))
        (uniformLaw (Equiv.Perm (Slot d))) ≤ ε

OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Mixing.Binar.name: OAI.BinaryCoordinateSweeps.binary_contraction
OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Mixing.Binar.text:
theorem binary_contraction : BinaryContractionTarget := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,g,hg,hgrid⟩ := grid_analytic_contraction
  refine ⟨g,hg,r,?_⟩
  intro d hd D ρ hi hu
  have := hi
  obtain ⟨b,hb,bits,hbits,hsum⟩ := exists_bit_blocks r hr d hd
  obtain ⟨d',hd',e,he⟩ := gridLaw_binary b hb bits
  have hdd : d'=d := hd'.trans hsum
  cases hdd
  have hσ : Representation.IsIrreducible (ρ.comp e.permCongrHom.toMonoidHom) :=
    Irrep.irreducible_comp_equiv e.permCongrHom ρ
  have hunit : IsUnitaryRep (ρ.comp e.permCongrHom.toMonoidHom) := fun g v => hu _ _
  have hh := hgrid b hb bits hbits D (ρ.comp e.permCongrHom.toMonoidHom) hσ hunit
  rwa [gridAverage_relabel bits e ρ he] at hh
