variable {G V : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
  [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]

OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Mixing.Binar.name: OAI.BinaryCoordinateSweeps.uniform_sweep_mixing
OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Mixing.Binar.text:
theorem uniform_sweep_mixing : UniformSweepMixingTarget := by
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := constant_sweep_mixing
  refine ⟨w,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨d₀,hd₀⟩ := hw ε hε
  exact ⟨d₀,fun d hd τ => (hd₀ d hd τ).le⟩

OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Model:55.name: OAI.BinaryCoordinateSweeps.BinaryContractionTarget
OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Model:55.text:
def BinaryContractionTarget : Prop :=
  ∃ g : ℝ, 0 < g ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d ≥ d₀, ∀ D : ℕ,
    ∀ ρ : Representation ℂ (Equiv.Perm (Slot d)) (RepSpace D),
      ρ.IsIrreducible → IsUnitaryRep ρ →
      ‖averageOperator (binaryLaw d) ρ‖ ≤ (D : ℝ) ^ (-g)

OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Model:46.name: OAI.BinaryCoordinateSweeps.IsUnitaryRep
OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Model:46.text:
def IsUnitaryRep {G : Type*} [Monoid G]
    {D : ℕ} (ρ : Representation ℂ G (RepSpace D)) : Prop :=
  ∀ g x, ‖ρ g x‖ = ‖x‖

OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Model:35.name: OAI.BinaryCoordinateSweeps.totalVariation
OAI.Probability.BinarySweep.Model:35.text:
def totalVariation {G : Type*} [Fintype G] (p q : G → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ∑ g, |p g - q g|

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.EvenCrossingL.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.crossing_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.EvenCrossingL.text:
theorem crossing_lower_bound (m n : ℕ) (D : AdmissibleDrawing m n) :
    axisPairs m*axisPairs n ≤ crossingCount D := by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with h | h
  · obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := h
    cases s with
    | zero =>
      have hn : n=0 := by omega
      cases hn
      simp [axisPairs]
    | succ s =>
      have he : n=(2*s+1)+1 := by omega
      cases he
      exact even_successor_crossing_lower_bound m s D
  · obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := h
    have hn : n=2*s+1 := by omega
    cases hn
    exact odd_crossing_lower_bound m s D

end Zarankiewicz

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.EvenCrossingL.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.even_successor_crossing_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.EvenCrossingL.text:
theorem even_successor_crossing_lower_bound (m s : ℕ) (D : AdmissibleDrawing m ((2*s+1)+1)) :
    axisPairs m*axisPairs ((2*s+1)+1) ≤ crossingCount D := by
  by_cases hs : 0 < s
  · obtain ⟨A,hcount,hpoly,hnorm,hstraight,htrans⟩ := polygonal_no_adjacent_locally_transverse D
    have hsum : (∑ v : Fin ((2*s+1)+1), axisPairs m*axisPairs (2*s+1)) ≤
        ∑ v : Fin ((2*s+1)+1), crossingCount (deleteRightVertex A v) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v hv
      exact odd_crossing_lower_bound m s (deleteRightVertex A v)
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    rw [sum_delete_crossingCount A hnorm] at hsum
    have hN : (2*s+1)+1=2*(s+1) := by omega
    have hprev : 2*s+1=2*(s+1)-1 := by omega
    have hfloor : ((2*s+1)+1)*axisPairs (2*s+1)=
        (((2*s+1)+1)-2)*axisPairs ((2*s+1)+1) := by
      rw [hN,hprev]
      exact even_deletion_floor (s+1)
    have hmul : (((2*s+1)+1)-2)*(axisPairs m*axisPairs ((2*s+1)+1)) ≤
        (((2*s+1)+1)-2)*crossingCount A := by
      calc
        _ = axisPairs m*((((2*s+1)+1)-2)*axisPairs ((2*s+1)+1)) := by ring
        _ = axisPairs m*(((2*s+1)+1)*axisPairs (2*s+1)) := by rw [← hfloor]
        _ = ((2*s+1)+1)*(axisPairs m*axisPairs (2*s+1)) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := hsum
    exact (Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmul (by omega)).trans hcount
  · have he : s=0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hs
    subst s
    simp [axisPairs]

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.AxisGenericPo.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.exists_axis_generic_positions
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.AxisGenericPo.text:
theorem exists_axis_generic_positions (lo hi : BipartiteVertex m n → ℝ)
    (hinterval : ∀ j, lo j < hi j) :
    ∃ x : BipartiteVertex m n → ℝ, (∀ j, x j ∈ Set.Ioo (lo j) (hi j)) ∧
      ∀ e f g : BipartiteEdge m n, AxisIndependentTriple e f g →
        axisConcurrency (x (Sum.inl e.1)) (x (Sum.inr e.2)) (x (Sum.inl f.1)) (x (Sum.inr f.2))
          (x (Sum.inl g.1)) (x (Sum.inr g.2)) ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  let P : (BipartiteEdge m n × BipartiteEdge m n × BipartiteEdge m n) → MvPolynomial (BipartiteVertex m n) ℝ :=
    fun t => if AxisIndependentTriple t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 then axisConcurrencyPolynomial t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 else 1
  have hP : ∀ t, P t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t
    dsimp only [P]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact axisConcurrencyPolynomial_ne_zero _ _ _ h.1 (Ne.symm h.2.2.1)
        (Ne.symm h.2.2.2.1) (Ne.symm h.2.2.2.2.1)
    · exact one_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨x,hx,havoid⟩ := exists_box_avoiding_polynomials P hP lo hi hinterval
  refine ⟨x,hx,?_⟩
  intro e f g htriple
  have hh := havoid (e,f,g)
  simpa only [P,ite_eq_left htriple,axisConcurrencyPolynomial_eval] using hh

end Zarankiewicz

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisI.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.axisIntervalLo
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisI.text: def axisIntervalLo (r : ℕ) (i : Fin r) : ℝ := if i.val < r/2 then 2*(i.val : ℝ)+1 else -(2*(i.val : ℝ)+2)

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.DrawingDefini.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.MainTarget
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.DrawingDefini.text:
def MainTarget : Prop :=
  ∀ m n : ℕ, 0 < m → 0 < n →
    (∃ D : AdmissibleDrawing m n, crossingCount D = axisPairs m * axisPairs n) ∧
    (∀ D : AdmissibleDrawing m n, axisPairs m * axisPairs n ≤ crossingCount D)

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisI.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.axisIntervalHi
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisI.text: def axisIntervalHi (r : ℕ) (i : Fin r) : ℝ := if i.val < r/2 then 2*(i.val : ℝ)+2 else -(2*(i.val : ℝ)+1)

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.DrawingDefini.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.AdmissibleDrawing
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.DrawingDefini.text:
structure AdmissibleDrawing (m n : ℕ) extends ContinuousDrawing m n where
  crossings_finite : (crossingPoints toContinuousDrawing).Finite
  crossings_proper : ∀ e f, e ≠ f → ∀ x,
    x ∈ edgeInterior toContinuousDrawing e → x ∈ edgeInterior toContinuousDrawing f →
    ProperCrossing (edgeInterior toContinuousDrawing e) (edgeInterior toContinuousDrawing f) x
  no_triples : ∀ e f g, e ≠ f → e ≠ g → f ≠ g →
    edgeInterior toContinuousDrawing e ∩ edgeInterior toContinuousDrawing f ∩
      edgeInterior toContinuousDrawing g = ∅

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.DrawingDefini.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.crossingCount
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.DrawingDefini.text: def crossingCount {m n : ℕ} (D : AdmissibleDrawing m n) : ℕ := D.crossings_finite.toFinset.card

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisD.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.BalancedAxisRealization
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisD.text:
structure BalancedAxisRealization (m n : ℕ) where
  vertical : Fin m → ℝ
  horizontal : Fin n → ℝ
  vertical_interval : ∀ i, vertical i ∈ Set.Ioo (axisIntervalLo m i) (axisIntervalHi m i)
  horizontal_interval : ∀ p, horizontal p ∈ Set.Ioo (axisIntervalLo n p) (axisIntervalHi n p)
  generic : ∀ e f g : BipartiteEdge m n, AxisIndependentTriple e f g →
    axisConcurrency (vertical e.1) (horizontal e.2) (vertical f.1) (horizontal f.2)
      (vertical g.1) (horizontal g.2) ≠ 0

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisI.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.axisInterval_nonempty
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisI.text:
theorem axisInterval_nonempty (r : ℕ) (i : Fin r) : axisIntervalLo r i < axisIntervalHi r i := by
  unfold axisIntervalLo axisIntervalHi
  split_ifs <;> linarith

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.DrawingDefini.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.BipartiteVertex
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.DrawingDefini.text: abbrev BipartiteVertex (m n : ℕ) := Fin m ⊕ Fin n

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisD.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.nonempty_balancedAxisRealization
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.BalancedAxisD.text:
theorem nonempty_balancedAxisRealization (m n : ℕ) : Nonempty (BalancedAxisRealization m n) := by
  let lo : BipartiteVertex m n → ℝ
    | .inl i => axisIntervalLo m i
    | .inr p => axisIntervalLo n p
  let hi : BipartiteVertex m n → ℝ
    | .inl i => axisIntervalHi m i
    | .inr p => axisIntervalHi n p
  have hinterval : ∀ j, lo j < hi j := by
    rintro (i|p)
    · exact axisInterval_nonempty m i
    · exact axisInterval_nonempty n p
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hgeneric⟩ := exists_axis_generic_positions lo hi hinterval
  exact ⟨⟨fun i => x (Sum.inl i),fun p => x (Sum.inr p),fun i => hx (Sum.inl i),
    fun p => hx (Sum.inr p),hgeneric⟩⟩

namespace BalancedAxisRealization
variable {m n : ℕ} (R : BalancedAxisRealization m n)

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.OddCrossingLo.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.odd_crossing_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.OddCrossingLo.text:
theorem odd_crossing_lower_bound (m s : ℕ) (D : AdmissibleDrawing m (2*s+1)) :
    axisPairs m*axisPairs (2*s+1) ≤ crossingCount D := by
  by_cases hm : 0 < m
  · by_cases hs : 0 < s
    · obtain ⟨A,hcount,hpoly,hnorm,hstraight,htrans⟩ := polygonal_no_adjacent_locally_transverse D
      obtain ⟨V⟩ := nonempty_vertexTruncation A.toContinuousDrawing hpoly
      obtain ⟨C⟩ := nonempty_truncatedSpokeCoordinates V hnorm
      rw [axisPairs_odd]
      exact (C.odd_normalized_crossing_lower_bound hnorm hstraight htrans s hs rfl hm).trans hcount
    · have he : s=0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hs
      subst s
      simp [axisPairs]
  · have he : m=0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hm
    subst m
    simp [axisPairs]

end Zarankiewicz

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.Main:8.name: OAI.Zarankiewicz.mainTarget_proof
OAI.Combinatorics.Crossing.Main:8.text:
theorem mainTarget_proof : MainTarget := by
  intro m n hm hn
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := nonempty_balancedAxisRealization m n
  exact ⟨⟨R.drawing,R.crossingCount_eq⟩,crossing_lower_bound m n⟩

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:105.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.PullbackGraph
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:105.text:
def PullbackGraph {ell : ℕ} {k K l L : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L]
    (α : PerfectIsom k K l L) (φ : IsomC ell K L) : Prop :=
  ∃ β : AlgebraicClosure K ≃+* AlgebraicClosure L,
    (∀ x : PerfectFieldClosure K, β x = ((α.1 x : PerfectFieldClosure L) :
      AlgebraicClosure L)) ∧
    ∀ σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L, ∃ τ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K,
      (∀ x : AlgebraicClosure K,
        β (absoluteAction τ x) = absoluteAction σ (β x)) ∧
      φ.1 (absoluteToPiA ell L σ) = absoluteToPiA ell K τ

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:93.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.IsomCUnits
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:93.text:
abbrev IsomCUnits (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (K L : Type*) [Field K] [Field L] :=
  Quotient (Relation.EqvGen.setoid (ScalarStep (ell := ell) (K := K) (L := L)))

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:684.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.canonicalPullback
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:684.text:
def canonicalPullback (ell : ℕ) {k K l L : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L]
    (α : PerfectIsom k K l L) : IsomC ell K L :=
  isomCOfExtension ell α.1 (extendPerfectEquiv α.1) (extendPerfectEquiv_spec α.1)

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:651.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.pullbackGraph_eq_extension
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:651.text:
theorem pullbackGraph_eq_extension (ell : ℕ) {k K l L : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L]
    (α : PerfectIsom k K l L) (φ : IsomC ell K L) (hφ : PullbackGraph α φ) :
    φ = isomCOfExtension ell α.1 (extendPerfectEquiv α.1) (extendPerfectEquiv_spec α.1) := by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ, h⟩ := hφ
  have heq : φ = isomCOfExtension ell α.1 β hβ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := absoluteToPiA_surjective ell L x
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hφτ⟩ := h σ
    have hτ' : τ = absoluteConjugate α.1 β hβ σ := by
      apply AlgEquiv.ext
      intro x
      apply β.injective
      exact (hτ x).trans (β.apply_symm_apply _).symm
    change φ.1 (absoluteToPiA ell L σ) =
      absoluteToPiA ell K (absoluteConjugate α.1 β hβ σ)
    exact hφτ.trans (congrArg (absoluteToPiA ell K) hτ')
  exact heq.trans (isomCOfExtension_eq ell α.1 β (extendPerfectEquiv α.1) hβ
    (extendPerfectEquiv_spec α.1))

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Injectivity:305.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.main_graph_injective
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Injectivity:305.text:
theorem main_graph_injective (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (k K l L : Type*) [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed l] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K] [Algebra.EssFiniteType l L]
    (hk : (ell : k) ≠ 0) (hl : (ell : l) ≠ 0)
    (hK : 2 ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (hL : 2 ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L) :
    ∀ (a a' : IsomF k K l L) (b : IsomCUnits ell K L),
      PhiGraph a b → PhiGraph a' b → a = a'  := by
  intro a a' b ha ha'
  apply main_canonical_injective ell k K l L hk hl hK hL
  exact (phiGraph_eq_canonicalPhi ell ha).symm.trans (phiGraph_eq_canonicalPhi ell ha')

end BogomolovPop

end
end

end OAI

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:751.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.phiGraph_eq_canonicalPhi
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:751.text:
theorem phiGraph_eq_canonicalPhi (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] {k K l L : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L]
    {a : IsomF k K l L} {b : IsomCUnits ell K L} (h : PhiGraph a b) :
    b = canonicalPhi ell a := by
  obtain ⟨α, φ, rfl, rfl, hφ⟩ := h
  change Quotient.mk _ φ = Quotient.mk _ (canonicalPullback ell α)
  rw [pullbackGraph_eq_extension ell α φ hφ]
  rfl

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:297.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.scalarEqvGen_iff
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:297.text:
theorem scalarEqvGen_iff {ell : ℕ} [Fact ell.Prime] {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (φ χ : IsomC ell K L) :
    Relation.EqvGen ScalarStep φ χ ↔ ScalarStep φ χ := by
  exact scalarStep_equivalence.eqvGen_iff

end BogomolovPop

namespace BogomolovPop
open scoped Topology commutatorElement

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Injectivity:276.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.main_canonical_injective
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Injectivity:276.text:
theorem main_canonical_injective (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (k K l L : Type*) [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed l] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K] [Algebra.EssFiniteType l L]
    (hk : (ell : k) ≠ 0) (_hl : (ell : l) ≠ 0)
    (hK : 2 ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (_hL : 2 ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L) :
    Function.Injective (canonicalPhi ell (k := k) (K := K) (l := l) (L := L)) := by
  have hchar : (ell : K) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using (map_ne_zero (algebraMap k K)).mpr hk
  have ht : Algebra.Transcendental k K := trdeg_ne_zero_iff.mp (by
    intro he
    rw [he] at hK
    norm_num at hK)
  let := ht
  have hx : ∃ x : K, Transcendental k x := Algebra.Transcendental.transcendental
  intro a b hab
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | h α =>
    induction b using Quotient.inductionOn with | h β =>
      apply Quotient.sound
      change Quotient.mk _ (canonicalPullback ell α) = Quotient.mk _ (canonicalPullback ell β) at hab
      have hs := (scalarEqvGen_iff (canonicalPullback ell α) (canonicalPullback ell β)).mp
        (Quotient.exact hab)
      exact pullback_scalar_frobenius ell hchar hx α β _ _
        (canonicalPullback_spec ell α) (canonicalPullback_spec ell β) hs
end BogomolovPop

namespace BogomolovPop

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:69.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.PerfectIsom
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:69.text:
def PerfectIsom (k K l L : Type*) [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L]
    [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L] :=
  { α : PerfectFieldClosure K ≃+* PerfectFieldClosure L //
    α '' Set.range (algebraMap k (PerfectFieldClosure K)) =
      Set.range (algebraMap l (PerfectFieldClosure L)) }

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:116.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.PhiGraph
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:116.text:
def PhiGraph {ell : ℕ} [Fact ell.Prime] {k K l L : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L]
    (a : IsomF k K l L) (b : IsomCUnits ell K L) : Prop :=
  ∃ α : PerfectIsom k K l L, ∃ φ : IsomC ell K L,
    Quotient.mk _ α = a ∧ Quotient.mk _ φ = b ∧ PullbackGraph α φ

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:738.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.canonicalPhi
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:738.text:
def canonicalPhi (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] {k K l L : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L] :
    IsomF k K l L → IsomCUnits ell K L :=
  Quotient.lift (fun α => Quotient.mk _ (canonicalPullback ell α)) (by
    intro α χ h
    rw [canonicalPullback_eq_of_frobeniusOrbit ell h])

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:87.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.ScalarStep
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Foundations:87.text:
def ScalarStep {ell : ℕ} [Fact ell.Prime] {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    (φ χ : IsomC ell K L) : Prop :=
  ∃ u : (PadicInt ell)ˣ, ∀ x : PiA ell L,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (φ.1 x) ^ PadicInt.appr (u : PadicInt ell) n)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (χ.1 x))

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:689.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.canonicalPullback_spec
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Canonical:689.text:
theorem canonicalPullback_spec (ell : ℕ) {k K l L : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L]
    (α : PerfectIsom k K l L) : PullbackGraph α (canonicalPullback ell α) :=
  pullbackGraph_of_extension ell α _ (extendPerfectEquiv_spec α.1)

OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Injectivity:213.name: OAI.BogomolovPop.pullback_scalar_frobenius
OAI.Algebra.BogomolovPop.Injectivity:213.text:
theorem pullback_scalar_frobenius (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    {k K l L : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Field l] [Field L]
    [Algebra k K] [Algebra l L] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed l]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K]
    (hchar : (ell : K) ≠ 0) (hx : ∃ x : K, Transcendental k x)
    (α β : PerfectIsom k K l L) (φ χ : IsomC ell K L)
    (hφ : PullbackGraph α φ) (hχ : PullbackGraph β χ)
    (hu : ScalarStep φ χ) : Relation.EqvGen FrobeniusStep α β := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩ := hφ
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hfb⟩ := hχ
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
  let δ : PerfectIsom k K k K := ⟨β.1.trans α.1.symm, by
    calc (α.1.symm ∘ β.1) '' Set.range (algebraMap k (PerfectFieldClosure K)) =
        α.1.symm '' (β.1 '' Set.range (algebraMap k (PerfectFieldClosure K))) := Set.image_comp _ _ _
      _ = α.1.symm '' Set.range (algebraMap l (PerfectFieldClosure L)) := congrArg _ β.2
      _ = α.1.symm '' (α.1 '' Set.range (algebraMap k (PerfectFieldClosure K))) := congrArg _ α.2.symm
      _ = Set.range (algebraMap k (PerfectFieldClosure K)) := by
        simp only [Set.image_image, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
        exact Set.image_id _⟩
  let γ : AlgebraicClosure K ≃+* AlgebraicClosure K := b.trans a.symm
  have hγ : ∀ x : PerfectFieldClosure K, γ x = (δ.1 x : AlgebraicClosure K) := by
    intro x
    change a.symm (b x) = _
    rw [hb, perfectExtension_symm α.1 a ha]
    rfl
  have hγg : ∀ σ : AlgebraicClosure K ≃ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure K,
      ∃ τ : AlgebraicClosure K ≃ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure K,
        (∀ x, γ (τ x) = σ (γ x)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => absoluteToPiA ell K σ ^ (u : PadicInt ell).appr n)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (absoluteToPiA ell K τ)) := by
    intro σ
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := (absoluteConjugateEquiv α.1 a ha).surjective σ
    change absoluteConjugate α.1 a ha ρ = σ at hρ
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hχτ⟩ := hfb ρ
    change AlgebraicClosure K ≃ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure K at τ
    change (∀ x, b (τ x) = ρ (b x)) at hτ
    obtain ⟨ν, hν, hφν⟩ := hfa ρ
    have hνσ : ν = σ := by
      rw [← hρ]
      apply AlgEquiv.ext
      intro x
      apply a.injective
      exact (hν x).trans (a.apply_symm_apply _).symm
    refine ⟨τ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      change a.symm (b (τ x)) = σ (a.symm (b x))
      rw [hτ, ← hρ, absoluteConjugate_apply, a.apply_symm_apply]
    · have ht := hu (absoluteToPiA ell L ρ)
      rw [hφν, hνσ, hχτ] at ht
      exact ht
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := ExpChar.exists K
  let := hq
  let : ExpChar (AlgebraicClosure K) q :=
    expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).injective q
  let : ExpChar (AlgebraicClosure L) q := expChar_of_injective_ringHom (f := a.toRingHom) a.injective q
  let : ExpChar L q := (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L)).expChar
    (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L)).injective q
  obtain ⟨n, m, hm⟩ := perfect_scalar_iterates ell k K hchar q δ γ hγ u hγg hx
  apply frobenius_orbit_of_iterates q α β m n
  intro x
  have he := congrArg α.1 (hm x)
  simpa only [map_pow, δ, RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using he.symm

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Model:.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.sphereArea
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Model:.text: def sphereArea : Measure Sphere := (volume : Measure Velocity).toSphere

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.relativeDensity
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text: def relativeDensity (F : Evolution) (t : ℝ) (z : Phase) : ℝ := F t z / maxwellian z.2

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Approx.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.MildCollisionSolution.momentum_conservation
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Approx.text:
theorem momentum_conservation (S : MildCollisionSolution T f₀ g) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hf₀m : Measurable f₀) (hf₀ : FiniteEntropyDatum f₀)
    (hfinite : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, FiniteEntropyDatum (positiveEvolution T f₀ g t))
    (hE : Integrable (CollisionCompactness.exponentialPair g)
      ((AnnularEnvelope.timePositionVolume T).prod volume))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : momentum (positiveEvolution T f₀ g t) = momentum f₀ := by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  let L := PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) i
  have h₀ := L.integrable_comp hf₀.integrable_momentum
  have h₁ := L.integral_comp_comm hf₀.integrable_momentum
  have h₂ := L.integral_comp_comm (hfinite t ht).integrable_momentum
  have hc : Integrable (fun p : Phase => p.2 i*f₀ p) := by
    simpa only [L,PiLp.proj_apply,PiLp.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,mul_comm] using h₀
  have h := S.coordinate_conservation hT hf₀m hf₀.integrable hc hE ht
  change (momentum (positiveEvolution T f₀ g t)) i = (momentum f₀) i
  simp only [L,PiLp.proj_apply,PiLp.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul] at h₁ h₂
  calc
    _ = ∫ p : Phase, positiveEvolution T f₀ g t p*p.2 i := h₂.symm
    _ = ∫ p : Phase, p.2 i*positiveEvolution T f₀ g t p := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => mul_comm _ _)
    _ = ∫ p : Phase, p.2 i*f₀ p := h
    _ = ∫ p : Phase, f₀ p*p.2 i := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => mul_comm _ _)
    _ = _ := h₁

end BoltzmannNonuniqueness.MildCollisionSolution

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.maxwellian
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
def maxwellian (v : Velocity) : ℝ :=
  (2 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-‖v‖ ^ 2 / 2)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.boundedTimes
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text: def boundedTimes (T : ℝ) : Set SpaceTimePhase := Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Compac.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.LocalMildSolution.weak_continuity
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Compac.text:
theorem weak_continuity {T : ℝ} {f₀ : Density} {F : Evolution}
    (S : LocalMildSolution T f₀ F) {ψ : Phase → ℝ} (hψ : Measurable ψ)
    (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p, |ψ p| ≤ C) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => ∫ p, F t p*ψ p) (Icc 0 T) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hb
  let c : ℝ≥0 := ⟨|C|,abs_nonneg C⟩
  have hm t : Measurable (F t) := S.measurable.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  have hi t : Integrable (fun p => F t p*ψ p) :=
    (S.integrable_each_time t).mul_bdd hψ.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ hC)
  intro t ht
  apply tendsto_integral_of_L1' (fun p => F t p*ψ p) (Eventually.of_forall hi)
  have hu := ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul (a := (c : ℝ≥0∞))
    (S.strong.strong_continuity t ht) (Or.inr ENNReal.coe_ne_top)
  simp only [mul_zero] at hu
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hu (fun _ => zero_le)
  intro s
  have hbnd : ∀ᵐ p ∂(volume : Measure Phase),
      ‖F s p*ψ p-F t p*ψ p‖₊ ≤ c*‖F s p-F t p‖₊ := by
    filter_upwards [] with p
    have hh : ‖F s p*ψ p-F t p*ψ p‖ ≤ |C| * ‖F s p-F t p‖ := by
      rw [← sub_mul,norm_mul,Real.norm_eq_abs (ψ p)]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hC p).trans (le_abs_self C)) (norm_nonneg _)).trans_eq
        (mul_comm _ _)
    exact_mod_cast hh
  exact eLpNorm_le_nnreal_smul_eLpNorm_of_ae_le_mul
    (((hm s).mul hψ).sub ((hm t).mul hψ)).aestronglyMeasurable hbnd 1

end BoltzmannNonuniqueness.LocalMildSolution

end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.NonuniquenessStatement
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
def NonuniquenessStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ f₀ : Density, BoundedVelocitySupport f₀ ∧
    ∃ (F G : Evolution) (T : ℝ), AdmissibleGlobal f₀ F ∧ AdmissibleGlobal f₀ G ∧
      StrongEarly T F ∧ StrongEarly T G ∧
      ∃ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ¬(F t =ᵐ[volume] G t)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.StrongEarly
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
structure StrongEarly (T : ℝ) (F : Evolution) : Prop where
  positive_time : 0 < T
  strong_continuity : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
    Tendsto (fun s => eLpNorm (fun z => F s z - F t z) 1 volume)
      (𝓝[Icc 0 T] t) (𝓝 0)
  gain_integrable : IntegrableOn (fun p : SpaceTimePhase => gain (F p.1) p.2.1 p.2.2)
    (boundedTimes T)
  loss_integrable : IntegrableOn (fun p : SpaceTimePhase => loss (F p.1) p.2.1 p.2.2)
    (boundedTimes T)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Compac.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.PeriodicApproximation.BoundedCutoffSolution.renormalized_equation
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Compac.text:
theorem BoundedCutoffSolution.renormalized_equation (S : BoundedCutoffSolution N T f₀)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (β : Renormalization) (φ : KineticTest)
    (hφ : ∀ x v, φ.toFun T x v = 0) :
    (∫ z, S.renormalizedIntegrand β φ z
      ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)).prod (volume : Measure Phase))+
      (∫ p : Phase, maxwellian p.2*β.toFun (f₀ p/maxwellian p.2)*φ.toFun 0 p.1 p.2) = 0 := by
  rw [S.renormalized_balance hN hT β φ]
  simp only [hφ,mul_zero,integral_zero,zero_sub,neg_add_cancel]

end BoltzmannNonuniqueness.PeriodicApproximation

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.MassTest
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
structure MassTest where
  toFun : ℝ → Position → ℝ
  regular : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × Velocity => toFun p.1 (torusProjection p.2))
  compact_time : ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ t x, R < |t| → toFun t x = 0

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.KineticTest
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
structure KineticTest where
  toFun : ℝ → Position → Velocity → ℝ
  regular : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun p : LiftedSpaceTimePhase =>
    toFun p.1 (torusProjection p.2.1) p.2.2)
  compact_time_velocity : ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ t x v,
    R < |t| ∨ R < ‖v‖ → toFun t x v = 0

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.AdmissibleGlobal
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
structure AdmissibleGlobal (f₀ : Density) (F : Evolution) : Prop where
  datum : FiniteEntropyDatum f₀
  spacetime_measurable : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : SpaceTimePhase => F p.1 p.2)
    (volume.restrict nonnegativeTimes)
  finite_each_time : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), FiniteEntropyDatum (F t)
  initial : F 0 =ᵐ[volume] f₀
  weak_continuity : ∀ ψ : Phase → ℝ, Measurable ψ →
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ C) →
    ContinuousOn (fun t => ∫ z, F t z * ψ z) (Ici 0)
  uniform_moment : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
    (∫ z, entropyMoment (F t) z) ≤ C
  
  
  collision_fibers : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T → ∀ᵐ p ∂volume.restrict (boundedTimes T),
    Integrable (fun q : Velocity × Sphere =>
      collisionKernel p.2.2 q.1 q.2 *
        F p.1 (p.2.1, scatterLeft p.2.2 q.1 q.2) *
        F p.1 (p.2.1, scatterRight p.2.2 q.1 q.2))
      ((volume : Measure Velocity).prod sphereArea) ∧
    Integrable (fun q : Velocity × Sphere =>
      collisionKernel p.2.2 q.1 q.2 * F p.1 p.2 * F p.1 (p.2.1, q.1))
      ((volume : Measure Velocity).prod sphereArea)
  gain_integrable : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T → IntegrableOn
    (fun p : SpaceTimePhase => gain (F p.1) p.2.1 p.2.2 /
      (1 + relativeDensity F p.1 p.2)) (boundedTimes T)
  loss_integrable : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T → IntegrableOn
    (fun p : SpaceTimePhase => loss (F p.1) p.2.1 p.2.2 /
      (1 + relativeDensity F p.1 p.2)) (boundedTimes T)
  renormalized_integrable : ∀ β φ, IntegrableOn (renormalizedIntegrand F β φ)
    nonnegativeTimes
  renormalized_equation : ∀ β : Renormalization, ∀ φ : KineticTest,
    (∫ p in nonnegativeTimes, renormalizedIntegrand F β φ p) +
      (∫ z, maxwellian z.2 * β.toFun (f₀ z / maxwellian z.2) *
        φ.toFun 0 z.1 z.2) = 0
  local_mass_integrable : ∀ φ : MassTest, IntegrableOn
    (fun p : SpaceTimePhase => F p.1 p.2 * φ.transportDerivative p.1 p.2)
    nonnegativeTimes
  local_mass : ∀ φ : MassTest,
    (∫ p in nonnegativeTimes, F p.1 p.2 * φ.transportDerivative p.1 p.2) +
      (∫ z, f₀ z * φ.toFun 0 z.1) = 0
  momentum_conservation : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), momentum (F t) = momentum f₀
  energy_inequality : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ), energy (F t) ≤ energy f₀
  entropy_inequality : ∀ t ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ),
    ENNReal.ofReal (relativeEntropy (F t)) +
      (∫⁻ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) t, entropyDissipation (F s)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (relativeEntropy f₀)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Compac.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.PeriodicApproximation.BoundedCutoffSolution.entropy_inequality
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Compac.text:
theorem BoundedCutoffSolution.entropy_inequality (S : BoundedCutoffSolution N T f₀)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hT : 0 ≤ T) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    (∫ p, scalarRelativeEntropy (maxwellian p.2) (S.density (t,p))) ≤
      ∫ p, scalarRelativeEntropy (maxwellian p.2) (f₀ p) := by
  obtain ⟨B,hSb⟩ := S.bounded
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := (S.nonnegative (0,0)).trans (hSb (0,0))
  have h0 := S.endpoint_entropy_tendsto 0
  simp only [S.initial hT] at h0
  have hL := (S.endpoint_entropy_tendsto t).sub h0
  have hR := (entropy_error_tendsto
    ((volume.restrict (Icc 0 t)).prod (volume : Measure Position)) N B).mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds : 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 0)
  have hle : ∀ᶠ δ : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      (∫ p, regularizedEntropy (maxwellian p.2) (maxwellian p.2) δ (S.density (t,p)))-
        (∫ p, regularizedEntropy (maxwellian p.2) (maxwellian p.2) δ (f₀ p)) ≤
      entropyErrorCoefficient ((volume.restrict (Icc 0 t)).prod (volume : Measure Position)) N*
        δ*(|Real.log δ|+logRegularizationConstant N B) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show (0:ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)] with δ hδ
    rw [S.integrated_entropy_balance hN hT ht hδ.1 hδ.2.le]
    exact S.entropy_production_bound hN hB hSb hδ.1 hδ.2.le t
  have h := le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hL hR hle
  linarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Model:.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.scatterLeft
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Model:.text: def scatterLeft (v w ω : Velocity) : Velocity := v - normalComponent v w ω • ω

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.momentum
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text: def momentum (f : Density) : Velocity := ∫ z, f z • z.2

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.entropyDissipation
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
def entropyDissipation (f : Density) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  (4 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ p : Position × (Velocity × (Velocity × Sphere)),
    ENNReal.ofReal (collisionKernel p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2) *
      extendedEntropyProduction
        (f (p.1, scatterLeft p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2) *
          f (p.1, scatterRight p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2))
        (f (p.1, p.2.1) * f (p.1, p.2.2.1))
    ∂((volume : Measure Position).prod ((volume : Measure Velocity).prod
      ((volume : Measure Velocity).prod sphereArea)))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.renormalizedIntegrand
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
def renormalizedIntegrand (F : Evolution) (β : Renormalization) (φ : KineticTest)
    (p : SpaceTimePhase) : ℝ :=
  maxwellian p.2.2 * β.toFun (relativeDensity F p.1 p.2) *
      φ.transportDerivative p.1 p.2 +
    derivWithin β.toFun (Ici 0) (relativeDensity F p.1 p.2) *
      collision (F p.1) p.2.1 p.2.2 * φ.toFun p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.relativeEntropy
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Admiss.text:
def relativeEntropy (f : Density) : ℝ :=
  ∫ z, f z * Real.log (f z / maxwellian z.2) - f z + maxwellian z.2

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Compac.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.periodicExistenceInput
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Compac.text:
theorem periodicExistenceInput : PeriodicExistenceInput := by
  intro f hf
  let g : Density := fun p => max 0 (hf.2.1.mk f p)
  have hgm : Measurable g := measurable_const.max hf.2.1.stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable
  have hgn (p : Phase) : 0 ≤ g p := le_max_left _ _
  have he : f =ᵐ[volume] g := by
    filter_upwards [hf.1,hf.2.1.ae_eq_mk] with p hp he
    change f p = max 0 (hf.2.1.mk f p)
    rw [← he,max_eq_right hp]
  have hgi : Integrable (entropyMoment g) := hf.2.2.congr
    (he.mono (fun p hp => by unfold entropyMoment; rw [hp]))
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := exists_globalCollisionLimit g hgm hgn hgi
  exact ⟨physicalEvolution g G.weakLimit.kineticProfile,
    (G.physical_admissible hgn hgi).congr_datum hf he.symm⟩

end BoltzmannNonuniqueness

end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Collis.name: OAI.BoltzmannNonuniqueness.CollisionCompactness.collision_fibers
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Boltzmann.Collis.text:
theorem collision_fibers {μ : Measure X} [SFinite μ] {f : X × Velocity → ℝ}
    (hfm : Measurable f) (hf : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z)
    (hpair : Integrable (pairDensity f) (μ.prod (volume : Measure (Velocity × Velocity)))) :
    ∀ᵐ p ∂μ.prod (volume : Measure Velocity),
      Integrable (fun q : Velocity × Sphere =>
        collisionKernel p.2 q.1 q.2*f (p.1,scatterLeft p.2 q.1 q.2)*
          f (p.1,scatterRight p.2 q.1 q.2)) ((volume : Measure Velocity).prod sphereArea) ∧
      Integrable (fun q : Velocity × Sphere =>
        collisionKernel p.2 q.1 q.2*f p*f (p.1,q.1))
        ((volume : Measure Velocity).prod sphereArea) := by
  have hp := (collisionGrouping_measurePreserving μ).symm.integrable_comp_of_integrable
    (postRate_integrable hfm hf hpair)
  have hl := (collisionGrouping_measurePreserving μ).symm.integrable_comp_of_integrable
    (preRate_integrable hfm hf hpair)
  filter_upwards [hp.prod_right_ae,hl.prod_right_ae] with p hp hl
  constructor
  · have he : (fun q : Velocity × Sphere => postRate f (collisionGrouping.symm (p,q))) =
        (fun q => collisionKernel p.2 q.1 q.2*f (p.1,scatterLeft p.2 q.1 q.2)*
          f (p.1,scatterRight p.2 q.1 q.2)) := by
      funext q
      exact postRate_formula f _
    change Integrable (fun q => postRate f (collisionGrouping.symm (p,q))) _ at hp
    rw [he] at hp
    exact hp
  · exact hl

end BoltzmannNonuniqueness.CollisionCompactness

theorem gain_integrable {K α γ s d t : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hd : 0 < d) (ht : 0 < t) (htmax : t ≤ 1)
    (hε : JetSupersolution.epsilon K s d ≤ 1) (η b : ℝ) (a : Bool) (p : JetPrototype.Phase) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => CollisionCutoff.gain b
      (fun v => JetSupersolution.U η K α γ s d r a ((JetBarrier.flight r p).1, v)) p.2) volume 0 t := by
  have hb : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => JetEnvelopeBound.gainAmplitude K α s d p.2) (Ioc 0 t) :=
    integrableOn_const measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne
  have hi : IntegrableOn (positiveGain η K α γ s d b a p) (Ioc 0 t) := by
    apply hb.mono' (measurable_positiveGain hα hγ hs η K d b a p).aestronglyMeasurable.restrict
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, positiveGain_eq hr.1.le]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (JetPicardComparison.gain_nonneg
      (fun v => JetSupersolution.nonneg hK hs hd η α γ r a ((JetBarrier.flight r p).1, v)) b p.2)]
    exact JetEnvelopeBound.cutoff_gain_bound hK hα hγ hs hd hr.1 (hr.2.trans htmax) hε η b a _ p.2
  apply (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le ht.le).mpr
  apply hi.congr_fun _ measurableSet_Ioc
  intro r hr
  exact positiveGain_eq hr.1.le η K α γ s d b a p

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.ActionEnvelo.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.envelope
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.ActionEnvelo.text:
theorem envelope (G : Type u) [Group G] [Group.FG G]
    (hG : HasDecidableWordProblem G) : HasActionEnvelope G := by
  obtain ⟨Γ,hΓ,X,hX,hfp,hcount,hinf,hfaith,htwo,hstab,f,hf⟩ := input_finite_action_envelope hG
  let : MulAction (ULift.{u} Γ) (ULift.{u} X) := LiftedAction.action
  let : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (ULift.{u} Γ) :=
    Group.IsFinitelyPresented.equiv (MulEquiv.ulift.symm : Γ ≃* ULift.{u} Γ)
  refine ⟨ULift.{u} Γ,inferInstance,ULift.{u} X,inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,
    inferInstance,LiftedAction.faithful,?_,?_,(MulEquiv.ulift.symm.toMonoidHom).comp f,
    MulEquiv.ulift.symm.injective.comp hf⟩
  · intro x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ hx hy
    obtain ⟨g,hg₁,hg₂⟩ := htwo x₁.down x₂.down y₁.down y₂.down
      (fun h => hx (ULift.ext _ _ h)) (fun h => hy (ULift.ext _ _ h))
    refine ⟨ULift.up g,?_,?_⟩
    · apply ULift.ext; exact hg₁
    · apply ULift.ext; exact hg₂
  · intro x
    let := hstab x.down
    let e : MulAction.stabilizer Γ x.down ≃* MulAction.stabilizer (ULift.{u} Γ) x :=
      (LiftedAction.stabilizerEquivalence x).symm
    exact Group.fg_of_surjective (f:=e.toMonoidHom) (show Function.Surjective e.toMonoidHom from e.surjective)

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Basic:17.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.evalWord
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Basic:17.text:
def evalWord {G : Type u} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → G) (w : Word n) : G :=
  (w.map fun a => if a.2 then s a.1 else (s a.1)⁻¹).prod

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Basic:21.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.HasDecidableWordProblem
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Basic:21.text:
def HasDecidableWordProblem (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : ℕ) (s : Fin n → G),
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range s) = ⊤ ∧
    ComputablePred (fun w : Word n => evalWord s w = 1)

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.WordProblem:.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.WordProblem.finitelyPresentedSimple_wordProblem
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.WordProblem:.text:
theorem finitelyPresentedSimple_wordProblem (H : Type*) [Group H]
    [Group.IsFinitelyPresented H] [IsSimpleGroup H] : HasDecidableWordProblem H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, φ, hφ, S, hS, hker⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := H)
  let := hS.fintype
  let m := Fintype.card S
  let e : S ≃ Fin m := Fintype.equivFin S
  let r : Fin m → Word n := fun i => FreeGroup.toWord (e.symm i).val
  have hrel : (Set.range fun i => FreeGroup.mk (r i)) = S := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      simpa only [r, FreeGroup.mk_toWord] using (e.symm i).property
    · intro hg
      refine ⟨e ⟨g, hg⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [r, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, FreeGroup.mk_toWord]
  refine ⟨n, (fun i => φ (FreeGroup.of i)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure]
    have he : FreeGroup.lift (fun i => φ (FreeGroup.of i)) = φ := by ext i; simp
    rw [he]
    exact MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr hφ
  · exact (simple_presentation_computable φ hφ r (hrel.symm ▸ hker)).of_eq
      fun w => by rw [hom_mk_eval]

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Main:115.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.main
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Main:115.text:
theorem main (G : Type u) [Group G] [Group.FG G] :
    HasDecidableWordProblem G ↔ EmbedsInFinitelyPresentedSimpleGroup G :=
  ⟨main_forward G, main_reverse G⟩

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.WordProblem:.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.WordProblem.wordProblem_of_injective
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.WordProblem:.text:
theorem wordProblem_of_injective {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] [Group.FG G]
    (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hH : HasDecidableWordProblem H) :
    HasDecidableWordProblem G := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, t, ht, hc⟩ := hH
  obtain ⟨S, hSgen, hSfin⟩ := Group.fg_iff.mp (inferInstance : Group.FG G)
  let := hSfin.fintype
  let n := Fintype.card S
  let e : S ≃ Fin n := Fintype.equivFin S
  let s : Fin n → G := fun i => (e.symm i).val
  have hs : Set.range s = S := by
    ext g
    exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => hi ▸ (e.symm i).property,
      fun hg => ⟨e ⟨g, hg⟩, by simp [s]⟩⟩
  have hsurj := FreeGroup.lift_surjective_iff_closure_range_eq_top.mpr ht
  choose v hv using fun i : Fin n => hsurj (f (s i))
  let r : Fin n → Word m := fun i => FreeGroup.toWord (v i)
  have hr (i) : evalWord t (r i) = f (s i) := by
    rw [evalWord_eq_lift]
    change FreeGroup.lift t (FreeGroup.mk (FreeGroup.toWord (v i))) = _
    rw [FreeGroup.mk_toWord, hv]
  refine ⟨n, s, hs ▸ hSgen, ?_⟩
  have hh : ComputablePred (fun w : Word n => evalWord t (substitute r w) = 1) :=
    ⟨inferInstance, hc.decide.comp (substitute_primrec r).to_comp⟩
  exact hh.of_eq fun w => by
    rw [evalWord_substitute, show (fun i => evalWord t (r i)) = (fun i => f (s i)) from funext hr,
      ← evalWord_map, ← map_one f]
    exact hf.eq_iff

end WordProblem

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Main:101.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.main_forward
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Main:101.text:
theorem main_forward (G : Type u) [Group G] [Group.FG G]
    (hG : HasDecidableWordProblem G) : EmbedsInFinitelyPresentedSimpleGroup G := by
  obtain ⟨Γ,hΓ,X,hX,hfp,hcount,hinf,hfaith,htwo,hstab,f,hf⟩ := envelope G hG
  let := hfp
  let := hcount
  let := hinf
  let := hfaith
  refine ⟨TwistedBrinThompson.group (Γ:=Γ) (X:=X),inferInstance,
    TwistedBrinThompson.finitelyPresented htwo hstab,inferInstance,
    (TwistedBrinThompson.embedding (X:=X)).comp f,?_⟩
  exact TwistedBrinThompson.embedding_injective.comp hf

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Basic:27.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.EmbedsInFinitelyPresentedSimpleGroup
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Basic:27.text:
def EmbedsInFinitelyPresentedSimpleGroup (G : Type u) [Group G] : Prop :=
  ∃ (H : Type u) (_ : Group H),
    Group.IsFinitelyPresented H ∧ IsSimpleGroup H ∧
    ∃ f : G →* H, Function.Injective f

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.WordProblem:.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.main_reverse
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.WordProblem:.text:
theorem main_reverse (G : Type u) [Group G] [Group.FG G]
    (hG : EmbedsInFinitelyPresentedSimpleGroup G) : HasDecidableWordProblem G := by
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hfp, hsimple, f, hf⟩ := hG
  let _ := hH
  let _ := hfp
  let _ := hsimple
  exact WordProblem.wordProblem_of_injective f hf (WordProblem.finitelyPresentedSimple_wordProblem H)

end FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes

OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Main:70.name: OAI.FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.TwistedBrinThompson.finitelyPresented
OAI.GroupTheory.BooneHigman.Main:70.text:
theorem finitelyPresented [Group.IsFinitelyPresented Γ] [Infinite X]
    [FaithfulSMul Γ X]
    (htwo : ∀ x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : X, x₁ ≠ x₂ → y₁ ≠ y₂ →
      ∃ g : Γ, g • x₁ = y₁ ∧ g • x₂ = y₂)
    (hstab : ∀ x : X, Group.FG (MulAction.stabilizer Γ x)) :
    Group.IsFinitelyPresented (group (Γ:=Γ) (X:=X)) := by
  classical
  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive Γ X := ⟨by
    intro a b
    obtain ⟨a',ha⟩ := exists_ne a
    obtain ⟨b',hb⟩ := exists_ne b
    obtain ⟨g,hg,_⟩ := htwo a a' b b' (Ne.symm ha) (Ne.symm hb)
    exact ⟨g,hg⟩⟩
  let x : X := Classical.arbitrary X
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := exists_ne x
  let : Group.FG (Generators.Seed (Γ:=Γ) x) := by
    obtain ⟨n,φ,hφ,_⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G:=Generators.Seed (Γ:=Γ) x)
    exact Group.fg_of_surjective hφ
  let := hstab x
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := Group.fg_def.mp (inferInstance : Group.FG (Generators.Seed (Γ:=Γ) x))
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := Group.fg_def.mp (inferInstance : Group.FG (MulAction.stabilizer Γ x))
  exact Group.IsFinitelyPresented.equiv
    (Generators.endpointEquivalence x s t y hs ht (Ne.symm hy) htwo)

end FiniteAlgebraicEnvelopes.TwistedBrinThompson

OAI.Analysis.ModularRecovery.Recovery:12.name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exists_recovery_cutoff
OAI.Analysis.ModularRecovery.Recovery:12.text:
lemma exists_recovery_cutoff (T : H →L[ℂ] H) {gamma : ℝ} (hg : 0 < gamma) (s : ℝ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ‖T‖^2 * (K^2)⁻¹ * recoveryMomentBound s ≤ gamma/4 := by
  let A := 4 * ‖T‖^2 * recoveryMomentBound s / gamma
  let K := A+1
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact div_nonneg (by have := (recoveryMomentBound_pos s).le; positivity) hg.le
  have hK : 0 < K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  have hKsq : A ≤ K^2 := by dsimp [K]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg A]
  have hh : 4 * ‖T‖^2 * recoveryMomentBound s ≤ K^2 * gamma := (div_le_iff₀ hg).mp hKsq
  refine ⟨K,hK,?_⟩
  have he : ‖T‖^2 * (K^2)⁻¹ * recoveryMomentBound s =
      (‖T‖^2 * recoveryMomentBound s) / K^2 := by ring
  rw [he]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hK)).mpr
  nlinarith

OAI.Analysis.ModularRecovery.Recovery:22.name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.bounded_recovery
OAI.Analysis.ModularRecovery.Recovery:22.text:
theorem bounded_recovery (S : StandardModularData H) (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer)
    (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hfree : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ Filter.atTop)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (s : ℝ) (delta : ℕ → ℝ) (hdelta : ∀ n, 0 < delta n)
    (hdelta0 : Tendsto delta atTop (𝓝 0)) (h : ℕ → H) (hunit : ∀ n, ‖h n‖ = 1)
    (hband : ∀ n, S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s - delta n) (s + delta n)) (h n))
    (hpositive : 0 < Filter.limsup
      (fun n => fixedMean omega (fun t => ‖T (S.D.unitary t (h n))‖ ^ 2)) atTop) :
    RecoveryConclusion S T s delta := by
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T (h n))
  let gamma : ℝ := Filter.limsup a atTop / 8
  have hpos : 0 < Filter.limsup a atTop := hpositive
  have hg : 0 < gamma := by dsimp [gamma]; positivity
  have hlt : 4 * gamma < Filter.limsup a atTop := by dsimp [gamma]; linarith
  have hco := Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le atTop
    (fun n => S.D.mean_orbitDefect_nonneg omega T (h n))
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, 4 * gamma < a n :=
    Filter.frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup hco hlt
  have hw : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 2 * delta n ≤ 1 := by
    filter_upwards [hdelta0.eventually_lt_const (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2)] with n hn
    linarith
  obtain ⟨nj,hnj,hs⟩ := Filter.extraction_of_frequently_atTop (hfreq.and_eventually hw)
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hcut⟩ := exists_recovery_cutoff T hg s
  have hex : ∀ j, ∃ v : H →L[ℂ] H, v ∈ S.M ∧ ‖v‖ ≤ filterL1*K ∧
      Real.sqrt gamma/2 ≤ ‖T (v S.xi)‖ ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-4*delta (nj j)) (s+4*delta (nj j))) (v S.xi) := by
    intro j
    exact S.bounded_recovery_single hscalar omega hfree T (hdelta _) (hs j).2 hg hK
      hcut (hunit _) (hband _) (hs j).1.le
  choose v hv using hex
  refine ⟨nj,hnj,v,filterL1*K,Real.sqrt gamma/2,?_,hv⟩
  exact div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hg) (by norm_num)

end BoundedRecovery

end

def averagedModulusReal (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ⨅ x : {x : E // ‖x‖=1},⨆ F : ClosedFiniteCodim E,
    ⨅ y : {y : E // y ∈ F.space ∧ 1≤‖y‖},

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.Main:11.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.nonempty_tree_decomposition
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.Main:11.text:
theorem nonempty_tree_decomposition [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
    (hG : G.Connected) (k : ℕ) (hdec : HasTreeDecomposition G k) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : SimpleGraph (Fin n), ∃ bag : Fin n → Finset V,
      T.IsTree ∧
      (∀ v : V, ∃ t, v ∈ bag t) ∧
      (∀ u v : V, G.Adj u v → ∃ t, u ∈ bag t ∧ v ∈ bag t) ∧
      (∀ v : V, (T.induce {t | v ∈ bag t}).Connected) ∧
      (∀ t, (bag t).card ≤ k) ∧ (∀ t, (bag t).Nonempty) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, T, B, hT, hcover, hedge, hocc, hsize⟩ := hdec
  let S : Set (Fin n) := {i | (B i).Nonempty}
  have hS : (T.induce S).Connected := by
    have hc : (G.induce Set.univ).Connected := G.induceUnivIso.connected_iff.mpr hG
    have := touched_bags_connected_set G T B hedge hocc Set.univ hc
    have heq : {t | ∃ z ∈ (Set.univ : Set V), z ∈ B t} = S := by
      ext t
      simp [S, Finset.nonempty_def]
    rw [heq] at this
    exact this
  let I := {i : Fin n // i ∈ S}
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card I) ≃ I := (Fintype.equivFin I).symm
  let T' : SimpleGraph (Fin (Fintype.card I)) := (T.induce S).comap e
  let B' : Fin (Fintype.card I) → Finset V := fun i => B (e i).val
  have hT' : T'.IsTree :=
    (SimpleGraph.Iso.comap e (T.induce S)).isTree_iff.mpr ⟨hS, hT.isAcyclic.induce S⟩
  refine ⟨Fintype.card I, T', B', hT', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover v
    refine ⟨e.symm ⟨i, v, hi⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [B'] using hi
  · intro u v huv
    obtain ⟨i, hui, hvi⟩ := hedge u v huv
    refine ⟨e.symm ⟨i, u, hui⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simpa [B']
  · intro v
    let f : {i : Fin n // v ∈ B i} → {j : Fin (Fintype.card I) // v ∈ B' j} :=
      fun i => ⟨e.symm ⟨i.val, v, i.property⟩, by simpa [B'] using i.property⟩
    let hf : (T.induce {i | v ∈ B i}) →g (T'.induce {j | v ∈ B' j}) :=
      ⟨f, by
        intro i j hij
        change T.Adj (e (f i).val).val (e (f j).val).val
        simpa [f] using hij⟩
    apply (hocc v).map hf
    intro j
    refine ⟨⟨(e j.val).val, j.property⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change e.symm _ = j.val
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  · intro i
    exact hsize _
  · intro i
    exact (e i).property

end BoundedTreewidthL1

lemma small_scale_active (A : Finset V) (x y : V) (hx : x ∈ A) (hy : y ∈ A)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    LaunchNoise.bandIndex 1 (dist x y) ∈ active dist A := by
  have hb := LaunchNoise.band_bounds 1 (dist x y) (by norm_num) (dist_pos.mpr hxy)

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagNoise.text:
lemma origin_fresh (R : RootedForest I) (A : I → Finset J) (root i : I)
    (a : J) (ha : a ∈ A i) : a ∈ fresh R A (origin R A root i a) := by
  induction hn : R.depth i using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [origin_eq]
    by_cases hk : a ∈ retained R A i
    · rw [ite_eq_left hk]
      cases hp : R.parent i with
      | none => simp [retained,hp] at hk
      | some p =>
        simp only [Option.elim_some]
        have hap : a ∈ A p := (Finset.mem_inter.mp (by simpa [retained,hp] using hk)).2
        exact ih (R.depth p) (by rw [← hn]; exact R.decreases i p hp) p hap rfl
    · rw [ite_eq_right hk]
      exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨ha,hk⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagEmbed.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.cobag_embedding
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagEmbed.text:
theorem cobag_embedding :
    ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∃ U c : ℝ, 0 < U ∧ 0 < c ∧
    ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nontrivial V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) (_ : G.Connected)
      (ℓ : G.edgeSet → ℝ) (_ : ∀ e, 0 < ℓ e)
      (m : ℕ) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin m)) (_ : T.IsTree) (_ : Fin m)
      (B : Fin m → Finset V),
      (∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ B i) →
      (∀ u v, G.Adj u v → ∃ i, u ∈ B i ∧ v ∈ B i) →
      (∀ v, (T.induce {i | v ∈ B i}).Connected) →
      (∀ i, (B i).card ≤ k) →
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ Φ : V → PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ),
        (∀ u v, ‖Φ u - Φ v‖ ≤ U*shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v) ∧
        ∀ i u v, u ∈ B i → v ∈ B i →
          c*shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v ≤ ‖Φ u - Φ v‖ := by
  classical
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨α,π,hα,hα8,hπ,hπ1,hsampler⟩ := graph_cobag_sampler k hk
  let q := 4*k.choose 2
  let N := 2*q + k.factorial + 2
  have hN : 2 ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; omega
  have hNr : (2:ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hNm : 0 < (N:ℝ)-1 := by linarith
  refine ⟨(N:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)-1),π*α/64,mul_pos (by linarith) hNm,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro V _ _ _ G hG ℓ hℓ m T hT root B hcover hedge hrun hbag
  let : MetricSpace V := weightedMetricSpace G ℓ hG hℓ
  let R := RootedTree.forest T hT root
  let K : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i => active dist (B i))
  let J := ↥K
  let A : Fin m → Finset J := fun i => (active dist (B i)).subtype (fun j => j ∈ K)
  have hA : ∀ i, (A i).card ≤ q := by
    intro i
    calc
      (A i).card ≤ (active dist (B i)).card := by
        rw [Finset.card_subtype]
        exact Finset.card_filter_le _ _
      _ ≤ 4*(B i).card.choose 2 := active_card _ _
      _ ≤ q := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 (Nat.choose_le_choose 2 (hbag i))
  have hdec : HasTreeDecomposition G k := ⟨m,T,B,hT,hcover,hedge,hrun,hbag⟩
  have hs (p : Fin m × J) := hsampler V G hG hdec ℓ hℓ
    (interface R B p.1 : Set V) ((2:ℝ)^p.2.val/16) (by positivity)
  choose ν f hprob hf hprop hsep using hs
  let (p : Fin m × J) : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν p) := hprob p
  let Ω := (Fin m × J) → FiniteSampleSpace V
  let law : Measure Ω := Measure.pi ν
  let g : Ω → Fin m → J → V → ℝ := fun ω i a => f (i,a) (ω (i,a))
  let H : ℝ := 1 + ∑ a : J, (2:ℝ)^a.val
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    have hh : 0 ≤ ∑ a : J, (2:ℝ)^a.val := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).le)
    dsimp [H]; linarith
  have hh (a : J) : (2:ℝ)^a.val/16 ≤ H := by
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun b (_ : b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset J)) =>
      (zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) b.val).le) (Finset.mem_univ a)
    have hp := zpow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) a.val
    dsimp [H]
    linarith
  have hg : ∀ i a v, Measurable (fun ω : Ω => g ω i a v) := by
    intro i a v
    exact ((measurable_pi_apply v).comp (hf (i,a))).comp (measurable_pi_apply (i,a))
  have hLip : ∀ ω i a, ∀ u v, |g ω i a u-g ω i a v| ≤ 1*shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v := by
    intro ω i a u v
    change |f (i,a) (ω (i,a)) u-f (i,a) (ω (i,a)) v| ≤ 1*dist u v
    exact (hprop (i,a) (ω (i,a))).1.dist_le_mul u v
  have hHeight : ∀ ω i a v, |g ω i a v| ≤ H := by
    intro ω i a v
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ((hprop (i,a) (ω (i,a))).2.1 v).1]
    exact ((hprop (i,a) (ω (i,a))).2.1 v).2.trans (hh a)
  have hz : ∀ ω i a, ∀ v ∈ interface R B i, g ω i a v = 0 := by
    intro ω i a v hv
    exact (hprop (i,a) (ω (i,a))).2.2 v hv
  obtain ⟨n,Φ,hup,hlo⟩ := averaged_origin_realization (ι := Fin N) G hG ℓ hℓ T hT root B
    hcover hedge (fun v => (hrun v).preconnected) A k q hbag hA (by simp [N])
    law 1 H 1 (by norm_num) hH (by norm_num) g hg hLip hHeight hz
  refine ⟨n,Φ,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,mul_one] using hup
  · intro i u v hu hv
    by_cases huv : u = v
    · subst v
      simp only [shortestPathDistance_self G ℓ hG (fun e => (hℓ e).le),mul_zero,sub_self,norm_zero,le_refl]
    let j := bandIndex 1 (dist u v)
    have hb : 0 < (2:ℝ)^j ∧ (2:ℝ)^j ≤ dist u v ∧ dist u v < 2*(2:ℝ)^j := by
      simpa only [bandLower,one_mul] using band_bounds 1 (dist u v) (by norm_num) (dist_pos.mpr huv)
    have haj : j ∈ active dist (B i) := small_scale_active (B i) u v hu hv huv
    let a : J := ⟨j,Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,haj⟩⟩
    have ha : a ∈ A i := Finset.mem_subtype.mpr haj
    let o := origin R A root i a
    have hof : a ∈ fresh R A o := origin_fresh R A root i a ha
    have hge (x y : V) (hxy : (2:ℝ)^j/16 < dist x y)
        (hcap : (interface R B o : Set V).Nonempty →
          α*((2:ℝ)^j/16) ≤ infDist x (interface R B o : Set V)) :
        π*α*((2:ℝ)^j/16)/4 ≤ ∫ ω : Ω, |g ω o a x-g ω o a y| ∂law := by
      have heq := integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := (o,a))
        (((measurable_pi_apply x).comp (hf (o,a))).sub
          ((measurable_pi_apply y).comp (hf (o,a)))).abs.aestronglyMeasurable
      change (∫ ω : Ω, |g ω o a x-g ω o a y| ∂law) = _ at heq
      rw [heq]
      exact hsep (o,a) x y hxy hcap
    have hgap : π*α*((2:ℝ)^j/16)/4 ≤ ∫ ω : Ω, |g ω o a u-g ω o a v| ∂law := by
      have hsmall : (2:ℝ)^j/16 < dist u v := by linarith [hb.1,hb.2.1]
      have hscale : α*((2:ℝ)^j/16) ≤ (2:ℝ)^j/8 := by nlinarith [hb.1]
      cases hp : R.parent o with
      | none =>
        apply hge u v hsmall
        simp only [interface,hp,Option.elim_none,Finset.coe_empty,Set.not_nonempty_empty,IsEmpty.forall_iff]
      | some p =>
        have hn : j ∉ active dist (B p) := by
          intro hj
          have hap : a ∈ A p := Finset.mem_subtype.mpr hj
          exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hof).2 (by
            simpa only [retained,hp,Option.elim_some,Finset.mem_inter] using
              And.intro (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hof).1 hap)
        by_cases hne : (B p : Set V).Nonempty
        · rcases inactive_far (B p) j u v hn hb.2.1 hb.2.2 hne with hfar | hfar
          · apply hge u v hsmall
            intro _
            simpa only [interface,hp,Option.elim_some] using hscale.trans hfar
          · have he := hge v u (by simpa only [dist_comm] using hsmall) (by
              intro _
              simpa only [interface,hp,Option.elim_some] using hscale.trans hfar)
            apply he.trans_eq
            apply integral_congr_ae
            exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => abs_sub_comm _ _)
        · apply hge u v hsmall
          simpa only [interface,hp,Option.elim_some] using (fun h => False.elim (hne h))
    have hl := hlo i a ha ⟨u,hu⟩ ⟨v,hv⟩
    have hpos : 0 < π*α := mul_pos hπ hα
    change 2*(∫ ω : Ω, |g ω o a u-g ω o a v| ∂law) ≤ ‖Φ u-Φ v‖ at hl
    change π*α/64*dist u v ≤ ‖Φ u-Φ v‖
    nlinarith [hb.2.2]
end BoundedTreewidthL1

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.Main:75.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.l1Append_norm_sub
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.Main:75.text:
lemma l1Append_norm_sub {m n : ℕ} (x x' : PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ))
    (y y' : PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ)) :
    ‖l1Append x y-l1Append x' y'‖ = ‖x-x'‖+‖y-y'‖ := by
  simp only [PiLp.norm_eq_sum (by simp : 0 < (1 : ENNReal).toReal), ENNReal.toReal_one,
    Real.rpow_one, div_self (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≠ 0)]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp [l1Append, PiLp.sub_apply]

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagNoise.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.LaunchNoise.graph_cobag_sampler
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagNoise.text:
theorem graph_cobag_sampler :
    ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∃ α π : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α ≤ 1/8 ∧ 0 < π ∧ π ≤ 1 ∧
    ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nontrivial V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.Connected), HasTreeDecomposition G k →
      ∀ (ℓ : G.edgeSet → ℝ) (hℓ : ∀ e, 0 < ℓ e),
      let : MetricSpace V := weightedMetricSpace G ℓ hG hℓ
      ∀ (A : Set V) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ∃ ν : Measure (FiniteSampleSpace V), ∃ g : FiniteSampleSpace V → V → ℝ,
        IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧ Measurable g ∧
        (∀ ω, LipschitzWith 1 (g ω) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ g ω x ∧ g ω x ≤ r) ∧
          (∀ x ∈ A, g ω x = 0)) ∧
        ∀ x y, r < shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y →
          (A.Nonempty → α*r ≤ infDist x A) →
          π*α*r/4 ≤ ∫ ω, |g ω x - g ω y| ∂ν := by
  classical
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨α,π,hα,hα8,hπ,hπ1,hpart⟩ := PaddedPartitions.uniform_padded_partitions k hk
  refine ⟨α,π,hα,hα8,hπ,hπ1,?_⟩
  intro V _ _ _ G hG hdec ℓ hℓ metric
  let _ : MetricSpace V := metric
  intro A r hr
  obtain ⟨μ,hμ,hμ1,hdiam,hpad⟩ := hpart V G hG hdec ℓ hℓ r hr
  have hd : ∀ P, 0 < μ P → ∀ x y, P x = P y → dist x y ≤ r := by
    intro P hP x y hxy
    exact hdiam P hP x y hxy
  have hp : ∀ x, π ≤ ∑ P, if (∀ z, dist x z ≤ α*r → P z = P x) then μ P else 0 := by
    intro x
    change π ≤ ∑ P, if (∀ z, shortestPathDistance G ℓ x z ≤ α*r → P z = P x) then μ P else 0
    have hx := hpad x
    unfold PaddedPartitions.paddingProbability PaddedPartitions.PaddedAt at hx
    convert! hx using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext; simp only [Finset.mem_univ]
    · intro P hP
      split_ifs <;> rfl
  refine finite_padded_sampler A μ r α π hμ ?_ hr hα (by linarith) hd ?_
  · convert! hμ1 using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext; simp only [Finset.mem_univ]
    · intro _ _; rfl
  · intro x
    convert! hp x using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext; simp only [Finset.mem_univ]
    · intro P hP
      split_ifs <;> rfl

end BoundedTreewidthL1.LaunchNoise

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.AnchorEmbe.name: BoundedTreewidthL1.AnchorExperiment.test_parameters_exist
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.AnchorEmbe.text:
theorem test_parameters_exist (k : ℕ) (α π : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1/8)
    (hπ : 0 < π) (hπ1 : π ≤ 1) :
    ∃ J H η Q : ℝ, J = 10*(upper k+4) ∧ 10^5*J < H ∧
      Nonempty (TestParameters k α π η H Q) := by
  let J := 10*(upper k+4)
  let H := 10^5*J+1
  have hU := upper_pos k
  have hL := particleLip_pos k
  have hJ : 0 < J := by dsimp [J]; positivity
  have hH : 1 < H := by dsimp [H]; nlinarith
  let η := 1/(16*H)
  have hη : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; positivity
  have hη4 : η < 1/4 := by
    dsimp [η]; apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)).mpr; nlinarith
  have hr : 4*η*H < 1 := by
    have hH0 : H ≠ 0 := by linarith
    dsimp [η]; field_simp; norm_num
  let c := α/8*η
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hc2 : c ≤ 1/2 := by
    have hαη := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα1 hη.le
    dsimp [c]; nlinarith
  let b := c/(8*((k:ℝ)+1))
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hb1 : b ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [b]; apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0:ℝ) ≤ k)]
  let w := π/8*b
  have hw : 0 < w := by dsimp [w]; positivity
  let Q := (1+upper k+particleLip k)/w+(upper k+1)
  have hQ : upper k+1 ≤ Q := by
    dsimp [Q]; have hh : 0 ≤ (1+upper k+particleLip k)/w := by positivity
    linarith
  have hbound : 1+upper k+particleLip k ≤ (π/8*b)*Q := by
    have hh : w*((1+upper k+particleLip k)/w) = 1+upper k+particleLip k :=
      mul_div_cancel₀ _ hw.ne'
    change _ ≤ w*Q
    dsimp only [Q]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hw.le (show 0 ≤ upper k+1 by positivity)]
  refine ⟨J,H,η,Q,rfl,by dsimp [H]; linarith,⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact {
    c := c, b := b, c_eq := rfl, c_pos := hc, c_half := hc2,
    b_eq := rfl, b_pos := hb, b_one := hb1, eta_pos := hη, eta_small := hη4,
    pi_pos := hπ, pi_one := hπ1, radius := hr, qbound := hbound, qlarge := hQ }
end
end BoundedTreewidthL1.AnchorExperiment

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagScale.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.CobagScales.inactive_far
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagScale.text:
theorem inactive_far (A : Finset V) (j : ℤ) (x y : V)
    (hj : j ∉ active dist A) (hl : (2:ℝ)^j ≤ dist x y)
    (hu : dist x y < 2*(2:ℝ)^j) (hA : (A : Set V).Nonempty) :
    (2:ℝ)^j/8 ≤ infDist x (A : Set V) ∨
      (2:ℝ)^j/8 ≤ infDist y (A : Set V) := by
  by_contra h
  have hx : infDist x (A : Set V) < (2:ℝ)^j/8 := by
    exact lt_of_not_ge (fun hx => h (Or.inl hx))
  have hy : infDist y (A : Set V) < (2:ℝ)^j/8 := by
    exact lt_of_not_ge (fun hy => h (Or.inr hy))
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hxa⟩ := (infDist_lt_iff hA).mp hx
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hyb⟩ := (infDist_lt_iff hA).mp hy
  have hs : 0 < (2:ℝ)^j := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hxy := dist_triangle4 x a b y
  have hab := dist_triangle4 a x y b
  rw [dist_comm b y] at hxy
  rw [dist_comm a x] at hab
  have habpos : 0 < dist a b := by linarith
  apply hj
  apply (mem_active dist dist_comm (fun u v huv => dist_pos.mpr huv) A j).mpr
  exact ⟨a,ha,b,hb,dist_pos.mp habpos,by linarith,by linarith⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.YoungestCr.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.CacheControl.uniform_lower
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.YoungestCr.text:
theorem CacheControl.uniform_lower (N : ℕ) (Q H : ℝ) (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ C : CacheControl N Q H, c ≤ C.error := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have hex (n : ℕ) : ∃ C : CacheControl N Q H, C.error < 1/((n:ℝ)+1) :=
    hn _ (by positivity)
  choose C hC using hex
  let U := Ultrafilter.of (atTop : Filter ℕ)
  apply CacheControl.no_failure U N Q H hQ C
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1/ε)
  apply (Ultrafilter.of_le atTop) (mem_atTop_sets.mpr ⟨n,?_⟩)
  intro m hm
  have hnm : (n:ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmpos : 0 < (m:ℝ)+1 := by positivity
  apply (hC m).trans
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ hmpos).mpr
  have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp (hn.trans_le hnm)
  nlinarith
end BoundedTreewidthL1

namespace BoundedTreewidthL1

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.Main:135.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.main_theorem
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.Main:135.text:
theorem main_theorem : MainStatement := by
  classical
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨Ua,ca,hUa,hca,hanchor⟩ := AnchorExperiment.anchor_common_bag_embedding k hk
  obtain ⟨Ub,cb,hUb,hcb,hcobag⟩ := cobag_embedding k hk
  let lam : ℝ := 2*(Ub+cb)/ca
  have hlam : 0 < lam := by dsimp [lam]; positivity
  let C : ℝ := max 1 ((lam*Ua+Ub)/cb)
  refine ⟨C,le_max_left _ _,?_⟩
  intro V _ _ _ G hG hdec ℓ hℓ
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial V with hsub | hnontriv
  · let := hsub
    refine ⟨0,fun _ => 0,?_⟩
    intro x y
    have hxy : x = y := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst y
    simp [shortestPathDistance_self G ℓ hG (fun e => (hℓ e).le)]
  · let := hnontriv
    obtain ⟨n,T,B,hT,hcover,hedge,hrun,hbag,hne⟩ := nonempty_tree_decomposition G hG k hdec
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨i,_⟩ := hcover (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty V))
      exact Fin.elim0 i
    | succ n =>
      let root : Fin (n+1) := ⟨0,Nat.succ_pos n⟩
      obtain ⟨ma,Φ,hΦu,hΦa⟩ := hanchor V G hG ℓ hℓ n T hT root B hne hcover hedge hrun hbag
      obtain ⟨mb,Ψ,hΨu,hΨb⟩ := hcobag V G hG ℓ hℓ (n+1) T hT root B hcover hedge hrun hbag
      let F : V → PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin (ma+mb) => ℝ) :=
        fun x => cb⁻¹ • l1Append (lam • Φ x) (Ψ x)
      refine ⟨ma+mb,F,?_⟩
      intro x y
      have hnorm : ‖F x-F y‖ = cb⁻¹*(lam*‖Φ x-Φ y‖+‖Ψ x-Ψ y‖) := by
        dsimp only [F]
        rw [← smul_sub,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hcb),
          l1Append_norm_sub,← smul_sub,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hlam]
      rw [hnorm]
      constructor
      · have hh := common_bag_comparison G hG ℓ hℓ B hne Φ Ψ Ub cb ca hUb.le hcb hca
          hΨu hΨb hΦa x y
        have hh' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (inv_nonneg.mpr hcb.le)
        simpa only [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hcb.ne',one_mul,add_comm] using hh'
      · calc
          cb⁻¹*(lam*‖Φ x-Φ y‖+‖Ψ x-Ψ y‖) ≤
              cb⁻¹*(lam*(Ua*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y)+Ub*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hΦu x y) hlam.le) (hΨu x y)) (inv_nonneg.mpr hcb.le)
          _ = ((lam*Ua+Ub)/cb)*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y := by ring
          _ ≤ C*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _)
            (shortestPathDistance_nonneg G ℓ hG (fun e => (hℓ e).le) x y)

end
end BoundedTreewidthL1

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.AnchorEmbe.name: BoundedTreewidthL1.AnchorExperiment.anchor_common_bag_embedding
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.AnchorEmbe.text:
theorem anchor_common_bag_embedding (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    ∃ U c : ℝ, 0 < U ∧ 0 < c ∧
    ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nontrivial V]
      (G : SimpleGraph V) (_ : G.Connected) (ℓ : G.edgeSet → ℝ) (_ : ∀ e, 0 < ℓ e)
      (n : ℕ) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin (n+1))) (_ : T.IsTree) (_ : Fin (n+1))
      (B : Fin (n+1) → Finset V) (hne : ∀ i, (B i).Nonempty)
      (_ : ∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ B i)
      (_ : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → ∃ i, u ∈ B i ∧ v ∈ B i)
      (_ : ∀ v, (T.induce {i | v ∈ B i}).Connected)
      (_ : ∀ i, (B i).card ≤ k),
      ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ Φ : V → PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ),
        (∀ x y, ‖Φ x-Φ y‖ ≤ U*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y) ∧
        ∀ x y, ∃ i, c*bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) x ≤ ‖Φ x-Φ y‖ ∧
          c*bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) y ≤ ‖Φ x-Φ y‖ := by
  obtain ⟨α,π,hα,hα8,hπ,hπ1,hsampler⟩ := graph_ordinary_noise k hk
  obtain ⟨J,H,η,Q,hJ,hH,⟨C⟩⟩ := test_parameters_exist k α π hα hα8 hπ hπ1
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by linarith [C.qlarge,upper_pos k]
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hccontrol⟩ := CacheControl.uniform_lower (cacheBound k+1) Q H hQ
  refine ⟨upper k,c,upper_pos k,hc,?_⟩
  intro V _ _ _ G hG ℓ hℓ n T hT root B hne hcover hedge hrun hbag
  let := weightedMetricSpace G ℓ hG hℓ
  let D := fun i => bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i)
  have hdec : HasTreeDecomposition G k := ⟨n+1,T,B,hT,hcover,hedge,hrun,hbag⟩
  have hnoise (i : Fin (n+1)) : HasOrdinaryNoise (D i) α π η := by
    have hn := hsampler V G hG hdec ℓ hℓ (B i : Set V) (hne i) η C.eta_pos C.eta_small
    have heq : D i = fun x => Metric.infDist x (B i : Set V) := by
      funext x
      exact bagDistance_eq_infDist G hG ℓ hℓ (B i) (hne i) x
    rw [heq]
    exact hn
  let seed : (i : Fin (n+1)) → OrdinarySeed (D i) α π η :=
    fun i => Classical.choice (OrdinarySeed.exists_of_has (hnoise i))
  obtain ⟨P,hbound⟩ := model_exists G hG ℓ hℓ T hT root B hne hcover hedge hrun k hbag J α π η seed
  refine ⟨P.dim,P.map,P.upper_bound,?_⟩
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨X,hx⟩ := hcover x
  obtain ⟨Y,hy⟩ := hcover y
  obtain ⟨s,hsx,hsy,hs,hmax⟩ := exists_join_index T hT root X Y
  refine ⟨(downPath T hT root X).getVert s,?_,?_⟩
  · exact P.join_lower G hG ℓ hℓ (fun _ _ => rfl) hne (fun _ => rfl) hedge hrun hbag hbound
      C hJ hH c hc.le hccontrol X Y x y hx hy s hsx hsy hs hmax
  · have hm : ∀ a b, a ≤ (forest T hT root).depth Y → b ≤ (forest T hT root).depth X →
        (downPath T hT root Y).getVert a = (downPath T hT root X).getVert b → a = b ∧ a ≤ s := by
      intro a b ha hb he
      obtain ⟨hab,hbs⟩ := hmax b a hb ha he.symm
      exact ⟨hab.symm,hab ▸ hbs⟩
    have hh := P.join_lower G hG ℓ hℓ (fun _ _ => rfl) hne (fun _ => rfl) hedge hrun hbag hbound
      C hJ hH c hc.le hccontrol Y X y x hy hx s hsy hsx hs.symm hm
    rw [norm_sub_rev,← hs] at hh
    exact hh
end
end BoundedTreewidthL1.AnchorExperiment

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagScale.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.CobagScales.active_card
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagScale.text:
theorem active_card (d : V → V → ℝ) (B : Finset V) :
    (active d B).card ≤ 4 * B.card.choose 2 := by
  calc
    (active d B).card ≤ ∑ p ∈ B.powersetCard 2, (distanceScales (pairDistance d p)).card :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _ ∈ B.powersetCard 2, 4 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p _ => distanceScales_card _)
    _ = 4 * B.card.choose 2 := by simp [Finset.card_powersetCard, Nat.mul_comm]

end BoundedTreewidthL1.CobagScales

open Metric
variable {V : Type*} [MetricSpace V] [DecidableEq V]

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.Main:85.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.common_bag_comparison
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.Main:85.text:
lemma common_bag_comparison {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.Connected) (ℓ : G.edgeSet → ℝ) (hℓ : ∀ e, 0 < ℓ e)
    {I : Type*} (B : I → Finset V) (hne : ∀ i, (B i).Nonempty)
    {m n : ℕ} (Φ : V → PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ))
    (Ψ : V → PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ))
    (U c a : ℝ) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hc : 0 < c) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hupper : ∀ x y, ‖Ψ x-Ψ y‖ ≤ U*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y)
    (hcobag : ∀ i x y, x ∈ B i → y ∈ B i →
      c*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y ≤ ‖Ψ x-Ψ y‖)
    (hanchor : ∀ x y, ∃ i, a*bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) x ≤ ‖Φ x-Φ y‖ ∧
      a*bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) y ≤ ‖Φ x-Φ y‖) (x y : V) :
    c*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y ≤
      ‖Ψ x-Ψ y‖ + (2*(U+c)/a)*‖Φ x-Φ y‖ := by
  obtain ⟨i,hix,hiy⟩ := hanchor x y
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hpx⟩ := bagDistance_attained G ℓ (B i) (hne i) x
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqy⟩ := bagDistance_attained G ℓ (B i) (hne i) y
  have hd := shortestPathDistance_triangle G ℓ hG (fun e => (hℓ e).le) x p y
  have hd' := shortestPathDistance_triangle G ℓ hG (fun e => (hℓ e).le) p q y
  have hs := shortestPathDistance_comm G ℓ hG (fun e => (hℓ e).le) q y
  have hΨ := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (Ψ p) (Ψ x) (Ψ q)
  have hΨ' := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (Ψ x) (Ψ y) (Ψ q)
  have hxp := hupper x p
  have hyq := hupper y q
  rw [norm_sub_rev (Ψ p) (Ψ x)] at hΨ
  have hco := hcobag i p q hp hq
  rw [← hpx] at hd hxp
  rw [hs,← hqy] at hd'
  rw [← hqy] at hyq
  have hda : a*(bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) x+bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) y) ≤
      2*‖Φ x-Φ y‖ := by linarith
  have hmain : c*shortestPathDistance G ℓ x y ≤ ‖Ψ x-Ψ y‖+
      (U+c)*(bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) x+bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) y) := by
    nlinarith
  have hsum : (U+c)*(bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) x+bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) y) ≤
      (2*(U+c)/a)*‖Φ x-Φ y‖ := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ ha).mp
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hda (by linarith : 0 ≤ U+c)
    calc
      a*((U+c)*(bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) x+bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) y)) =
        (U+c)*(a*(bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) x+bagDistance G ℓ (B i) (hne i) y)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (U+c)*(2*‖Φ x-Φ y‖) := hh
      _ = a*((2*(U+c)/a)*‖Φ x-Φ y‖) := by field_simp
  exact hmain.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hsum)

end
end BoundedTreewidthL1

OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagNoise.name: OAI.BoundedTreewidthL1.TreeParticles.averaged_origin_realization
OAI.Combinatorics.TreewidthL1.CobagNoise.text:
theorem averaged_origin_realization
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hG : G.Connected) (ℓ : G.edgeSet → ℝ) (hℓ : ∀ e, 0 < ℓ e)
    (T : SimpleGraph I) (hT : T.IsTree) (root : I) (B : I → Finset V)
    (hcover : ∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ B i)
    (hedge : ∀ u v, G.Adj u v → ∃ i, u ∈ B i ∧ v ∈ B i)
    (hrun : ∀ v, (T.induce {i | v ∈ B i}).Preconnected)
    (A : I → Finset J) (k q : ℕ) (hbag : ∀ i, (B i).card ≤ k)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).card ≤ q) (hN : Fintype.card ι = 2*q + k.factorial + 2)
    (ν : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (L H Δ : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hH : 0 < H) (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (g : Ω → I → J → V → ℝ) (hmeas : ∀ i a v, Measurable (fun ω => g ω i a v))
    (hLip : ∀ ω i a, ∀ u v, |g ω i a u - g ω i a v| ≤ L*shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v)
    (hHeight : ∀ ω i a v, |g ω i a v| ≤ H)
    (hzero : ∀ ω i a, ∀ v ∈ interface (RootedTree.forest T hT root) B i, g ω i a v = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ Φ : V → PiLp (1 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin n => ℝ),
      (∀ u v, ‖Φ u - Φ v‖ ≤
        (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*L*((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)-1)*shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v) ∧
      ∀ i (a : J), a ∈ A i → ∀ (u v : B i),
        2*(∫ ω, |g ω (origin (RootedTree.forest T hT root) A root i a) a u -
          g ω (origin (RootedTree.forest T hT root) A root i a) a v| ∂ν) ≤
          ‖Φ u.val - Φ v.val‖ := by
  classical
  let : MeasurableSpace ι := ⊤
  let : MeasurableSingletonClass ι := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩
  let R := RootedTree.forest T hT root
  let S := fun ω => state (ι := ι) R B A (g ω)
  let M := H*((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)-1)+2*Δ
  have hreach : ∀ ω i, FunctionParticleReachable (shortestPathDistance G ℓ) L H (S ω i).1 := by
    intro ω
    exact (forest_particle_realization R B A k q hbag hA hN
      (shortestPathDistance G ℓ) L H Δ hH hΔ (g ω) (hLip ω) (hHeight ω) (hzero ω)).1
  have hsmeas : ∀ i t v, Measurable (fun ω => (S ω i).1 t v) := by
    intro i t v
    exact (measurable_pi_apply v).comp ((measurable_pi_apply t).comp
      (measurable_state R B A g hmeas i).fst)
  have hcons : ∀ ω i j, T.Adj i j →
      particleTrace M (S ω i).1 (B i ∩ B j) = particleTrace M (S ω j).1 (B i ∩ B j) := by
    intro ω i j hij
    have ht := (forest_particle_realization R B A k q hbag hA hN
      (shortestPathDistance G ℓ) L H Δ hH hΔ (g ω) (hLip ω) (hHeight ω) (hzero ω)).2.1
    rcases RootedTree.edge_orientation T hT root hij with hp | hp
    · exact trace_eq_of_subset M _ _ (B j) _ Finset.inter_subset_right (ht i j hp)
    · exact (trace_eq_of_subset M _ _ (B i) _ Finset.inter_subset_left (ht j i hp)).symm
  obtain ⟨n,Φ,hup,heq⟩ := averaged_particle_realization G hG ℓ hℓ T hT B hcover hedge hrun
    ν L H Δ hL hH hΔ (by omega : 1 ≤ Fintype.card ι) (fun ω i => (S ω i).1)
    hsmeas (by
      have hd : (Classical.decEq ι) = (inferInstance : DecidableEq ι) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [hd]
      exact hreach) hcons
  refine ⟨n,Φ,hup,?_⟩
  intro i a ha u v
  rw [heq i u v,← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_mono
  · apply Integrable.const_mul
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hmeas _ a u).sub (hmeas _ a v)).abs.aestronglyMeasurable (2*H)
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_abs]
    have hu := hHeight ω (origin R A root i a) a u
    have hv := hHeight ω (origin R A root i a) a v
    exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith)
  · apply integrable_finsetSum
    intro t ht
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hsmeas i t u).sub (hsmeas i t v)).abs.aestronglyMeasurable
      (2*H*((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)-1))
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_abs]
    have hu := function_particles_height_bound hH (hreach ω i) t u
    have hv := function_particles_height_bound hH (hreach ω i) t v
    exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith)
  · intro ω
    exact origin_particle_gap R root B A k q hbag hA hN (shortestPathDistance G ℓ)
      L H Δ hH hΔ (g ω) (hLip ω) (hHeight ω) (hzero ω) i a ha u v
end BoundedTreewidthL1.TreeParticles
