OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Sharpness:170.name: OAI.Problem358.sharpnessBoundsExample
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Sharpness:170.text:
def sharpnessBoundsExample (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (haSmall : a < 1 / 2) : SharpnessBoundsExample d a := by
  have ha1 : a < 1 := by linarith
  have hb : 0 < a / 2 := by positivity
  have hbabs : |a / 2| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos hb]; linarith
  have hpush0 := map_sharpSlab_uniform_cube d hd a 0 le_rfl ha.le (by linarith)
  have hpushb := map_sharpSlab_uniform_cube d hd a (a / 2) hb.le (by linarith) (by linarith)
  refine {
    μ := sharpTarget d hd a 0
    ν := sharpTarget d hd a (a / 2)
    Tμ := Sharpness.slabMap (sharpAxis0 d hd) (sharpAxis1 d hd) a 0
    Tν := Sharpness.slabMap (sharpAxis0 d hd) (sharpAxis1 d hd) a (a / 2)
    probability_μ := sharpTarget_isProbabilityMeasure d hd 0 ha.le ha1.le
    probability_ν := sharpTarget_isProbabilityMeasure d hd (a / 2) ha.le ha1.le
    supported_μ := sharpTarget_isSupported d hd a 0 (by norm_num)
    supported_ν := sharpTarget_isSupported d hd a (a / 2) hbabs
    threeAtoms_μ := sharpTarget_hasExactlyThreeAtoms d hd ha ha1 (by norm_num)
    threeAtoms_ν := sharpTarget_hasExactlyThreeAtoms d hd ha ha1 hbabs
    different := sharpTarget_ne d hd ha (ne_of_gt hb)
    optimal_μ := Sharpness.slabMap_isUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap_sharpTarget d hd a 0 hpush0
    optimal_ν := Sharpness.slabMap_isUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap_sharpTarget d hd a (a / 2) hpushb
    wasserstein_pos := wasserstein2_sharpTarget_pos d hd ha ha1.le (ne_of_gt hb)
    wasserstein_le := (wasserstein2_sharpTarget d hd (a / 2) ha.le ha1.le).le
    mapDistance_ge := ?_
  }
  have h := Sharpness.slabMap_mapL2_lower (sharpAxis0 d hd) (sharpAxis1 d hd)
    (sharpAxis_ne d hd) ha.le hb (by linarith : a + (a / 2) / 2 ≤ 1)
  have he : (a / 2) / 16 = a / 32 := by ring
  simpa only [he] using h

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Stability:48.name: OAI.Problem358.one_third_exponent_is_sharp
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Stability:48.text:
theorem one_third_exponent_is_sharp :
    ∀ (d : ℕ), 2 ≤ d → ∀ α : ℝ, (1 / 3 : ℝ) < α →
      ∀ C : ℝ, 0 < C →
        ∃ (μ ν : Measure (E d)) (Tμ Tν : E d → E d),
          IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
          IsSupported μ (cube d) ∧ IsSupported ν (cube d) ∧
          HasExactlyThreeAtoms μ (cube d) ∧ HasExactlyThreeAtoms ν (cube d) ∧
          μ ≠ ν ∧
          IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure (cube d)) μ Tμ ∧
          IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure (cube d)) ν Tν ∧
          0 < wasserstein2 μ ν ∧
          C * Real.rpow (wasserstein2 μ ν) α <
            mapL2Dist (uniformMeasure (cube d)) Tμ Tν := by
  exact one_third_exponent_is_sharp_via_rectangle

end Problem358

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.CanonicalPaths:17.name: OAI.Problem358.FixedMassIntercepts.exists_canonical_atomic_intercept_path
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.CanonicalPaths:17.text:
theorem exists_canonical_atomic_intercept_path
    {d : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    {K : Set (E d)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hKi : (interior K).Nonempty)
    (m : ι → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hsum : ∑ i, m i = 1)
    (y z : ι → E d) {κ : ℝ} {R : ℝ≥0}
    (hinj : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Function.Injective (fun i => (1-t) • y i + t • z i))
    (hregular : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun (q : ℝ) => intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum
        (fun i => (1-q) • y i + q • z i)) t)
    (henergy : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      let C := fun (q : ℝ) => intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum
        (fun i => (1-q) • y i + q • z i)
      (∑ i, m i * ((deriv C t : CellLaplacian.normalizedSpace m) : ι → ℝ) i ^ 2) ≤
        κ * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ i, m i * ‖y i-z i‖ ^ 2) :
    ∃ c r : ι → ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ContinuousOn (r i) (Ioo 0 1)) ∧
      (∀ i t, t ∈ Ioo 0 1 → HasDerivAt (c i) (r i t) t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, ∀ i,
        (uniformMeasure K).real (CellGeometry.closedCell K
          (fun j => (1-t) • y j + t • z j) (fun j => c j t) i) = m i) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, (∑ i, m i * c i t) = 0) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, (∑ i, m i * r i t ^ 2) ≤
        κ * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ i, m i * ‖y i-z i‖ ^ 2 := by
  let C := fun (q : ℝ) => intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum
    (fun i => (1-q) • y i + q • z i)
  let c : ι → ℝ → ℝ := fun i t => (C t : ι → ℝ) i
  let L : ι → CellLaplacian.normalizedSpace m →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun i =>
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp (CellLaplacian.normalizedSpace m).subtypeL
  have hcoord : ∀ i t, t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      HasDerivAt (c i) (((deriv C t : CellLaplacian.normalizedSpace m) : ι → ℝ) i) t := by
    intro i t ht
    exact (L i).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
      ((hregular t ht).differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
  refine ⟨c, fun i => deriv (c i), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact (measurable_pi_apply i).comp
      ((measurable_intercepts_coe hK hconv hKi m hm hsum).comp (by fun_prop))
  · intro i
    have hci : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (c i) (Ioo 0 1) := by
      intro t ht
      exact ((L i).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp t (hregular t ht)).contDiffWithinAt
    exact hci.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_Ioo le_rfl
  · intro i t ht
    exact (hcoord i t ht).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  · intro t ht i
    exact congrFun (intercepts_spec hK hconv hKi m hm hsum
      (fun j => (1-t) • y j + t • z j) (hinj t ht)) i
  · intro t _
    exact (C t).property
  · intro t ht
    have heq : ∀ i, deriv (c i) t =
        ((deriv C t : CellLaplacian.normalizedSpace m) : ι → ℝ) i :=
      fun i => (hcoord i t ht).deriv
    simp_rw [heq]
    exact henergy t ht

end Problem358.FixedMassIntercepts

end

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:29.name: OAI.Problem358.wasserstein2
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:29.text:
def wasserstein2 {d : ℕ} (μ ν : Measure (E d)) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt
    (ENNReal.toReal
      (sInf {r : ℝ≥0∞ |
        ∃ π : Measure (E d × E d),
          IsCoupling μ ν π ∧ quadraticPlanCost π = r}))

    (p : (ι → E d) × CellLaplacian.normalizedSpace m)
    (hM : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun z : (ι → E d) × (ι → ℝ) => fun i =>
        (uniformMeasure K).real (closedCell K z.1 z.2 i))
      (p.1, (p.2 : ι → ℝ))) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (normalizedMassMap K m) p :=
  hM.comp p (normalizedConfigInclusion m).contDiff.contDiffAt

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:48.name: OAI.Problem358.IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap

def IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap {d : ℕ} (ρ μ : Measure (E d))
    (T : E d → E d) : Prop :=
  IsQuadraticOptimalMap ρ μ T ∧
    ∀ π : Measure (E d × E d),
      IsCoupling ρ μ π →
        quadraticPlanCost π ≤ quadraticPlanCost (graphPlan ρ T) →
          π = graphPlan ρ T

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.InterceptEnergy:241.name: OAI.Problem358.FixedMassIntercepts.intercepts_comp_deriv_energy_le_of_massC1_convex_midpoint
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.InterceptEnergy:241.text:
theorem intercepts_comp_deriv_energy_le_of_massC1_convex_midpoint
    {d : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    {K : Set (E d)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hKi : (interior K).Nonempty)
    (m : ι → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hsum : ∑ i, m i = 1)
    (Y : ℝ → (ι → E d)) (v : ι → E d) (t : ℝ)
    (hY : HasDerivAt Y v t) (hy : Function.Injective (Y t))
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) {w : ℝ}
    (hbounded : ∀ᵐ x ∂uniformMeasure K, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hspeed : (∑ i, m i * ‖v i‖ ^ 2) ≤ w ^ 2)
    (hC1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap K m)
      (Y t, intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum (Y t)))
    (hmid : ∀ (U V : Set (E d)), IsCompact U → Convex ℝ U → 0 < volume U →
      IsCompact V → Convex ℝ V → 0 < volume V →
      ∃ π : Measure (E d × E d), IsCoupling (uniformMeasure U) (uniformMeasure V) π ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt ((volume U).toReal * (volume V).toReal)) •
          Measure.map (fun p : E d × E d => (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (p.1 + p.2)) π ≤ volume) :
    let C := fun q => intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum (Y q)
    HasDerivAt C (deriv C t) t ∧
      (∑ i, m i * ((deriv C t : CellLaplacian.normalizedSpace m) : ι → ℝ) i ^ 2) ≤
        162 * R ^ 2 * w ^ 2 := by
  classical
  let c := intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum (Y t)
  let g := PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight K (Y t) c
  let b := CellGeometry.faceMoment K (Y t) c
  have hρ : uniformMeasure K ≪ (volume : Measure (E d)) :=
    Measure.absolutelyContinuous_restrict.smul_left _
  have hpos : ∀ i, uniformMeasure K (CellGeometry.closedCell K (Y t) c i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hz
    have hi := congrFun (intercepts_spec hK hconv hKi m hm hsum (Y t) hy) i
    change (uniformMeasure K).real (CellGeometry.closedCell K (Y t) c i) = m i at hi
    simp only [Measure.real, hz, ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hi
    exact (hm i).ne' hi.symm
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hGp⟩ := PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight_connected
    (uniformMeasure K) hρ K hK hconv (Y t) c hy hpos
  let A := fderiv ℝ (CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap K m) (Y t, c)
  have hD : HasFDerivAt (CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap K m) A (Y t, c) :=
    (hC1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
  have hformula := CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap_derivative_apply
    hρ hK hconv m (Y t) c hy hpos A hD
  apply intercepts_comp_deriv_energy_le_of_convex_midpoint hK hconv hKi m hm hsum
    Y v t hY hy R hR hbounded g b
    (PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight_symm K (Y t) c)
    (CellGeometry.faceMoment_symm K (Y t) c)
    (PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight_nonneg K (Y t) c) G hG hGp A hC1 hD
  · intro q
    funext i
    simpa [CellLaplacian.siteFlux, b, g] using congrFun (hformula 0 q) i
  · funext i
    simpa [CellLaplacian.apply, b, g] using congrFun (hformula v 0) i
  · exact hspeed
  · intro q i
    exact PositiveCellFullDerivative.hasDerivAt_uniform_closedCell_moment_stationary
      hρ hK hconv (Y t) c q hy hpos i
  · intro q i
    simpa [CellLaplacian.apply, g, PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight] using
      CellGeometry.hasDerivAt_uniformMass_line hρ hK hconv (Y t) (fun _ => 0) c q hy hpos i
  · exact hmid

end Problem358.FixedMassIntercepts

end

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:56.name: OAI.Problem358.mapL2Dist

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Stability:20.name: OAI.Problem358.one_third_stability
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Stability:20.text:
theorem one_third_stability :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (K Y : Set (E d)),
      2 ≤ d → IsCompact K → Convex ℝ K → (interior K).Nonempty →
      IsCompact Y → Y.Nonempty →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
        ∀ (μ ν : Measure (E d)),
          IsProbabilityMeasure μ → IsProbabilityMeasure ν →
          IsSupported μ Y → IsSupported ν Y →
          ∃ Tμ Tν : E d → E d,
            IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure K) μ Tμ ∧
            IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure K) ν Tν ∧
            mapL2Dist (uniformMeasure K) Tμ Tν ≤
              C * Real.rpow (wasserstein2 μ ν) (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
  intro d K Y _hd hK hKconv hKint hY hYne
  obtain ⟨R, hRpos, hKR⟩ := hK.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  obtain ⟨L, hLpos, hYL⟩ := hY.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  let Rn : ℝ≥0 := ⟨R, hRpos.le⟩
  let Ln : ℝ≥0 := ⟨L, hLpos.le⟩
  have hxR : ∀ᵐ x ∂uniformMeasure K, ‖x‖ ≤ Rn := by
    filter_upwards [UniformSource.ae_mem hK.measurableSet] with x hx
    exact hKR x hx
  apply one_third_stability_of_closedCell_intercept_paths hK hKconv hKint hY hYne
    Rn Ln hxR hYL (κ := 162) (by norm_num)
  intro n hn m y z hm hsum _hyL _hzL hinj
  let : NeZero n := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hn⟩
  exact FixedMassIntercepts.exists_actual_atomic_intercept_path hK hKconv hKint
    m hm hsum y z Rn hxR (fun t ht => hinj t ht.1 ht.2)

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.NormalizedPaths:266.name: OAI.Problem358.exists_supporting_pair_of_closedCell_path
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.NormalizedPaths:266.text:
theorem exists_supporting_pair_of_closedCell_path
    {d : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    {K : Set (E d)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hKint : (interior K).Nonempty)
    (y v : ι → ℝ → E d) (c r : ι → ℝ → ℝ) (m : ι → ℝ)
    {w κ : ℝ} {R L : ℝ≥0} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hxR : ∀ᵐ x ∂uniformMeasure K, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hpositive : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hsum : ∑ i, m i = 1)
    (hy : ∀ i, Continuous (y i)) (hc : ∀ i, Measurable (c i))
    (hv : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (v i) (Ioo 0 1))
    (hr : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (r i) (Ioo 0 1))
    (hdy : ∀ i q, q ∈ Ioo 0 1 → HasDerivAt (y i) (v i q) q)
    (hdc : ∀ i q, q ∈ Ioo 0 1 → HasDerivAt (c i) (r i q) q)
    (hinj : ∀ q ∈ Ioo 0 1, Function.Injective (fun i => y i q))
    (hm : ∀ q ∈ Ioo 0 1, ∀ i,
      (uniformMeasure K).real
        (CellGeometry.closedCell K (fun j => y j q) (fun j => c j q) i) = m i)
    (hnormal : ∀ q ∈ Ioo 0 1, (∑ i, m i * c i q) = 0)
    (hvEnergy : ∀ q ∈ Ioo 0 1, (∑ i, m i * ‖v i q‖ ^ 2) ≤ w ^ 2)
    (hrEnergy : ∀ q ∈ Ioo 0 1,
      (∑ i, m i * r i q ^ 2) ≤ κ * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * w ^ 2)
    (hy0 : ∀ i, ‖y i 0‖ ≤ L) (hy1 : ∀ i, ‖y i 1‖ ≤ L) :
    ∃ (u₀ u₁ : E d → ℝ) (T₀ T₁ : E d → E d),
      SupportingMapInterpolation.Supports u₀ T₀ ∧
      SupportingMapInterpolation.Supports u₁ T₁ ∧
      Measurable T₀ ∧ Measurable T₁ ∧
      (∀ x, ‖T₀ x‖ ≤ L) ∧ (∀ x, ‖T₁ x‖ ≤ L) ∧
      Measure.map T₀ (uniformMeasure K) =
        ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (m i) • Measure.dirac (y i 0) ∧
      Measure.map T₁ (uniformMeasure K) =
        ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (m i) • Measure.dirac (y i 1) ∧
      (∫ x, (u₀ x - u₁ x) ^ 2 ∂uniformMeasure K) ≤
        2 * (1 + κ) * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨active, hactiveMeas, hactive, hmass⟩ :=
    CellGeometry.exists_joint_measurable_selector_prescribed_masses hK.measurableSet
      (fun q i => y i q) (fun q i => c i q) (fun _ i => m i) (Ioo 0 1)
      (fun i => (hy i).measurable) hc hinj hm
  exact exists_supporting_pair_of_normalized_affine_path hK hKconv hKint
    y v c r active m hw hκ hxR hpositive hsum hy hv hr hactiveMeas hdy hdc
    hinj (fun q _ => hactive q) hmass hnormal hvEnergy hrEnergy hy0 hy1

end Problem358

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:26.name: OAI.Problem358.quadraticPlanCost
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:26.text:
def quadraticPlanCost {d : ℕ} (π : Measure (E d × E d)) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2) ∂π

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.ClosedPaths:70.name: OAI.Problem358.one_third_stability_of_closedCell_intercept_paths
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.ClosedPaths:70.text:
theorem one_third_stability_of_closedCell_intercept_paths
    {d : ℕ} {K Y : Set (E d)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hKint : (interior K).Nonempty) (hY : IsCompact Y) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (R L : ℝ≥0) (hxR : ∀ᵐ x ∂uniformMeasure K, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hYL : ∀ z ∈ Y, ‖z‖ ≤ L) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hpaths : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n →
      ∀ (m : Fin n → ℝ) (y z : Fin n → E d),
      (∀ i, 0 < m i) → (∑ i, m i) = 1 →
      (∀ i, ‖y i‖ ≤ L) → (∀ i, ‖z i‖ ≤ L) →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 →
        Function.Injective (fun i => (1-t) • y i + t • z i)) →
      ∃ c r : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ,
        (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) ∧
        (∀ i, ContinuousOn (r i) (Ioo 0 1)) ∧
        (∀ i t, t ∈ Ioo 0 1 → HasDerivAt (c i) (r i t) t) ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, ∀ i,
          (uniformMeasure K).real (CellGeometry.closedCell K
            (fun j => (1-t) • y j + t • z j) (fun j => c j t) i) = m i) ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, (∑ i, m i * c i t) = 0) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, (∑ i, m i * r i t ^ 2) ≤
          κ * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ i, m i * ‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (μ ν : Measure (E d)),
      IsProbabilityMeasure μ → IsProbabilityMeasure ν →
      IsSupported μ Y → IsSupported ν Y →
      ∃ Tμ Tν : E d → E d,
        IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure K) μ Tμ ∧
        IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure K) ν Tν ∧
        mapL2Dist (uniformMeasure K) Tμ Tν ≤
          C * Real.rpow (wasserstein2 μ ν) (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
  apply one_third_stability_of_atomic_potential_estimate hK hKconv hKint hY hYne
    L hYL (Real.sqrt (2 * (1 + κ)) * R)
  intro n hn m y z hm hsum hyL hzL hinj
  let : NeZero n := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hn⟩
  obtain ⟨c, r, hc, hr, hdc, hmass, hnormal, henergy⟩ :=
    hpaths n hn m y z hm hsum hyL hzL hinj
  let e : ℝ := ∑ i, m i * ‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2
  have he : 0 ≤ e := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hm i).le (sq_nonneg _)
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt e ^ 2 = e := Real.sq_sqrt he
  let path : Fin n → ℝ → E d := fun i t => (1-t) • y i + t • z i
  let velocity : Fin n → ℝ → E d := fun i _ => z i - y i
  have hpath : ∀ i, Continuous (path i) := by intro i; dsimp [path]; fun_prop
  have hdpath : ∀ i t, HasDerivAt (path i) (velocity i t) t := by
    intro i t
    have heq : path i = fun q : ℝ => y i + q • (z i - y i) := by
      funext q
      dsimp [path]
      module
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [velocity, one_smul] using!
      ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (z i - y i)).const_add (y i)
  have hvEnergy : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      (∑ i, m i * ‖velocity i t‖ ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt e ^ 2 := by
    intro t _
    rw [hsqrt]
    exact le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [velocity, norm_sub_rev])
  obtain ⟨u₀, u₁, T₀, T₁, hu₀, hu₁, hT₀, hT₁, hT₀L, hT₁L, hμ, hν, hb⟩ :=
    exists_supporting_pair_of_closedCell_path hK hKconv hKint path velocity c r m
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg e) hκ hxR hm hsum hpath hc
      (fun _ => continuousOn_const) hr (fun i t _ => hdpath i t) hdc
      (fun t ht => hinj t ht.1 ht.2) hmass hnormal hvEnergy
      (fun t ht => by simpa only [hsqrt] using henergy t ht)
      (fun i => by simpa [path] using hyL i)
      (fun i => by simpa [path] using hzL i)
  refine ⟨u₀, u₁, T₀, T₁, hu₀, hu₁, hT₀, hT₁, hT₀L, hT₁L,
    ?_, ?_, 0, ?_⟩
  · simpa [path] using hμ
  · simpa [path] using hν
  · have hP : (Real.sqrt (2 * (1 + κ)) * (R : ℝ)) ^ 2 =
        2 * (1 + κ) * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    simpa only [sub_zero, hP, hsqrt] using hb

end Problem358

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Sharpness:138.name: OAI.Problem358.one_third_exponent_is_sharp_of_bounds_examples
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Sharpness:138.text:
theorem one_third_exponent_is_sharp_of_bounds_examples (d : ℕ)
    (examples : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 / 2 → Nonempty (SharpnessBoundsExample d a)) :
    ∀ α : ℝ, (1 / 3 : ℝ) < α → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 < C →
      ∃ (μ ν : Measure (E d)) (Tμ Tν : E d → E d),
        IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
        IsSupported μ (cube d) ∧ IsSupported ν (cube d) ∧
        HasExactlyThreeAtoms μ (cube d) ∧ HasExactlyThreeAtoms ν (cube d) ∧
        μ ≠ ν ∧
        IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure (cube d)) μ Tμ ∧
        IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure (cube d)) ν Tν ∧
        0 < wasserstein2 μ ν ∧
        C * Real.rpow (wasserstein2 μ ν) α <
          mapL2Dist (uniformMeasure (cube d)) Tμ Tν := by
  intro α hα C hC
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haSmall, hgap⟩ := exists_sharpness_rectangle_parameter hα hC
  obtain ⟨ex⟩ := examples a ha haSmall
  refine ⟨ex.μ, ex.ν, ex.Tμ, ex.Tν, ex.probability_μ, ex.probability_ν,
    ex.supported_μ, ex.supported_ν, ex.threeAtoms_μ, ex.threeAtoms_ν,
    ex.different, ex.optimal_μ, ex.optimal_ν, ex.wasserstein_pos, ?_⟩
  have hα0 : 0 ≤ α := by linarith
  have hbound : C * Real.rpow (wasserstein2 ex.μ ex.ν) α ≤
      C * Real.rpow (Real.sqrt (a * (a / 2) ^ 2)) α :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow ex.wasserstein_pos.le ex.wasserstein_le hα0) hC.le
  exact (hbound.trans_lt hgap).trans_le ex.mapDistance_ge

end Problem358

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.FixedMass:86.name: OAI.Problem358.FixedMassIntercepts.intercepts_spec
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.FixedMass:86.text:
theorem intercepts_spec {K : Set (E d)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K) (hne : (interior K).Nonempty)
    (m : ι → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hsum : ∑ i, m i = 1)
    (y : ι → E d) (hy : Function.Injective y) :
    masses K y (intercepts hK hconv hne m hm hsum y) = m := by
  simp only [intercepts, dite_eq_left hy]
  exact (existsUnique_normalized hK hconv hne m hm hsum y hy).choose_spec.1

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Sharpness:201.name: OAI.Problem358.one_third_exponent_is_sharp_via_rectangle
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Sharpness:201.text:
theorem one_third_exponent_is_sharp_via_rectangle :
    ∀ (d : ℕ), 2 ≤ d → ∀ α : ℝ, (1 / 3 : ℝ) < α → ∀ C : ℝ, 0 < C → ∃ (μ ν : Measure (E d)) (Tμ Tν : E d → E d), IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧ IsSupported μ (cube d) ∧ IsSupported ν (cube d) ∧ HasExactlyThreeAtoms μ (cube d) ∧ HasExactlyThreeAtoms ν (cube d) ∧ μ ≠ ν ∧ IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure (cube d)) μ Tμ ∧ IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure (cube d)) ν Tν ∧ 0 < wasserstein2 μ ν ∧ C * Real.rpow (wasserstein2 μ ν) α < mapL2Dist (uniformMeasure (cube d)) Tμ Tν := by
  intro d hd
  exact one_third_exponent_is_sharp_of_bounds_examples d
    (fun a ha haSmall => ⟨sharpnessBoundsExample d hd a ha haSmall⟩)

end Problem358

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.AtomicPaths:216.name: OAI.Problem358.one_third_stability_of_atomic_potential_estimate
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.AtomicPaths:216.text:
theorem one_third_stability_of_atomic_potential_estimate
    {d : ℕ} {K Y : Set (E d)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hKint : (interior K).Nonempty) (hY : IsCompact Y) (hYne : Y.Nonempty)
    (L : ℝ≥0) (hYL : ∀ z ∈ Y, ‖z‖ ≤ L) (P : ℝ)
    (hpotential : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n →
      ∀ (m : Fin n → ℝ) (y z : Fin n → E d),
      (∀ i, 0 < m i) → (∑ i, m i) = 1 →
      (∀ i, ‖y i‖ ≤ L) → (∀ i, ‖z i‖ ≤ L) →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 →
        Function.Injective (fun i => (1-t) • y i + t • z i)) →
      ∃ (u v : E d → ℝ) (T S : E d → E d),
        SupportingMapInterpolation.Supports u T ∧
        SupportingMapInterpolation.Supports v S ∧
        Measurable T ∧ Measurable S ∧
        (∀ x, ‖T x‖ ≤ L) ∧ (∀ x, ‖S x‖ ≤ L) ∧
        Measure.map T (uniformMeasure K) =
          ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (m i) • Measure.dirac (y i) ∧
        Measure.map S (uniformMeasure K) =
          ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (m i) • Measure.dirac (z i) ∧
        ∃ c : ℝ, (∫ x, (u x - v x - c) ^ 2 ∂uniformMeasure K) ≤
          P ^ 2 * ∑ i, m i * ‖y i - z i‖ ^ 2) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (μ ν : Measure (E d)),
      IsProbabilityMeasure μ → IsProbabilityMeasure ν →
      IsSupported μ Y → IsSupported ν Y →
      ∃ Tμ Tν : E d → E d,
        IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure K) μ Tμ ∧
        IsUniqueQuadraticOptimalMap (uniformMeasure K) ν Tν ∧
        mapL2Dist (uniformMeasure K) Tμ Tν ≤
          C * Real.rpow (wasserstein2 μ ν) (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
  apply one_third_stability_of_finite_potential_estimate hK hKconv hKint hY hYne L P
  intro μ ν hμprob hνprob hμfinite hνfinite
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hμprob
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hνprob
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFY, hμF⟩ := hμfinite
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hGY, hνG⟩ := hνfinite
  obtain ⟨n, hn, m, y, z, hm, hsum, hyF, hzG, hμeq, hνeq, _, henergy, hinj⟩ :=
    exists_finite_atomic_motion hF hG hμF hνG
  obtain ⟨u, v, T, S, hu, hv, hT, hS, hTL, hSL, hTlaw, hSlaw, c, hc⟩ :=
    hpotential n hn m y z hm hsum (fun i => hYL _ (hFY (hyF i)))
      (fun i => hYL _ (hGY (hzG i))) hinj
  refine ⟨u, v, T, S, hu, hv, hT, hS, hTL, hSL,
    hTlaw.trans hμeq.symm, hSlaw.trans hνeq.symm, c, ?_⟩
  simpa only [henergy] using hc

end Problem358

end

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:20.name: OAI.Problem358.IsCoupling
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:20.text:
def IsCoupling {d : ℕ} (μ ν : Measure (E d))
    (π : Measure (E d × E d)) : Prop :=
  IsProbabilityMeasure π ∧
    Measure.map Prod.fst π = μ ∧
    Measure.map Prod.snd π = ν

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:63.name: OAI.Problem358.HasExactlyThreeAtoms
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.Basic:63.text:
def HasExactlyThreeAtoms {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (E d))
    (Y : Set (E d)) : Prop :=
  ∃ y : Fin 3 → E d, Function.Injective y ∧
    (∀ i, y i ∈ Y) ∧
    ∃ w : Fin 3 → ℝ≥0∞, (∀ i, 0 < w i) ∧
      (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
      μ = ∑ i, (w i) • Measure.dirac (y i)

end Problem358

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.CanonicalPaths:158.name: OAI.Problem358.FixedMassIntercepts.exists_actual_atomic_intercept_path
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.CanonicalPaths:158.text:
theorem exists_actual_atomic_intercept_path
    {d : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    {K : Set (E d)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hKi : (interior K).Nonempty)
    (m : ι → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hsum : ∑ i, m i = 1)
    (y z : ι → E d) (R : ℝ≥0)
    (hbounded : ∀ᵐ x ∂uniformMeasure K, ‖x‖ ≤ R)
    (hinj : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Function.Injective (fun i => (1-t) • y i + t • z i)) :
    ∃ c r : ι → ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ContinuousOn (r i) (Ioo 0 1)) ∧
      (∀ i t, t ∈ Ioo 0 1 → HasDerivAt (c i) (r i t) t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, ∀ i,
        (uniformMeasure K).real (CellGeometry.closedCell K
          (fun j => (1-t) • y j + t • z j) (fun j => c j t) i) = m i) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, (∑ i, m i * c i t) = 0) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 1, (∑ i, m i * r i t ^ 2) ≤
        162 * (R : ℝ) ^ 2 * ∑ i, m i * ‖y i-z i‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  let Y : ℝ → (ι → E d) := fun t i => (1-t) • y i + t • z i
  let C := fun t => intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum (Y t)
  let v : ι → E d := fun i => z i - y i
  have hmassC1 : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap K m) (Y t, C t) := by
    intro t ht
    apply CellGeometry.contDiffAt_normalizedMassMap_of_raw m (Y t, C t)
    apply CellGeometry.contDiffAt_uniformMassMap hK hconv (Y t) (C t) (hinj t ht)
    intro i
    have hi := congrFun (intercepts_spec hK hconv hKi m hm hsum (Y t) (hinj t ht)) i
    change (uniformMeasure K).real (CellGeometry.closedCell K (Y t) (C t) i) = m i at hi
    rw [hi]
    exact hm i
  apply exists_canonical_atomic_intercept_path hK hconv hKi m hm hsum y z
    (κ := 162) (R := R) hinj
  · intro t ht
    have hYc : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 Y t := by dsimp [Y]; fun_prop
    exact (contDiffAt_intercepts_of_normalizedMassC1 hK hconv hKi m hm hsum
      (Y t) (hinj t ht) (hmassC1 t ht)).comp t hYc
  · intro t ht
    have hYd : HasDerivAt Y v t := by
      apply hasDerivAt_pi.mpr
      intro i
      have heq : (fun q : ℝ => Y q i) = fun q => y i + q • (z i - y i) := by
        funext q
        dsimp [Y]
        module
      rw [heq]
      simpa only [v, one_smul] using!
        ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (z i - y i)).const_add (y i)
    let e : ℝ := ∑ i, m i * ‖y i-z i‖ ^ 2
    have he : 0 ≤ e := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hm i).le (sq_nonneg _)
    have hspeed : (∑ i, m i * ‖v i‖ ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt e ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt he]
      exact le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [v, norm_sub_rev])
    have henergy := intercepts_comp_deriv_energy_le_of_massC1_convex_midpoint
      hK hconv hKi m hm hsum Y v t hYd (hinj t ht) R R.property
      hbounded hspeed (hmassC1 t ht)
      (fun U V hU hcU hvU hV hcV hvV =>
        exists_convexBody_midpoint_coupling_of_pos hU hcU hvU hV hcV hvV)
    simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt he] using henergy.2

end Problem358.FixedMassIntercepts

end

OAI.Analysis.Brenier.InterceptEnergy:202.name: OAI.Problem358.FixedMassIntercepts.contDiffAt_intercepts_of_normalizedMassC1
OAI.Analysis.Brenier.InterceptEnergy:202.text:
theorem contDiffAt_intercepts_of_normalizedMassC1
    {d : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    {K : Set (E d)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hKi : (interior K).Nonempty)
    (m : ι → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hsum : ∑ i, m i = 1)
    (y : ι → E d) (hy : Function.Injective y)
    (hC1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap K m)
      (y, intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum y)) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum) y := by
  classical
  let c := intercepts hK hconv hKi m hm hsum y
  let g := PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight K y c
  have hρ : uniformMeasure K ≪ (volume : Measure (E d)) :=
    Measure.absolutelyContinuous_restrict.smul_left _
  have hpos : ∀ i, uniformMeasure K (CellGeometry.closedCell K y c i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hz
    have hi := congrFun (intercepts_spec hK hconv hKi m hm hsum y hy) i
    change (uniformMeasure K).real (CellGeometry.closedCell K y c i) = m i at hi
    simp only [Measure.real, hz, ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hi
    exact (hm i).ne' hi.symm
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hGp⟩ := PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight_connected
    (uniformMeasure K) hρ K hK hconv y c hy hpos
  let A := fderiv ℝ (CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap K m) (y, c)
  have hD : HasFDerivAt (CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap K m) A (y, c) :=
    (hC1.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
  apply contDiffAt_intercepts_of_massDifferential hK hconv hKi m hm hsum y hy g
    (PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight_symm K y c)
    (PositiveFacet.canonicalFaceWeight_nonneg K y c) G hG hGp A hC1 hD
  intro q
  funext i
  simpa [CellLaplacian.siteFlux, g] using congrFun
    (CellGeometry.normalizedMassMap_derivative_apply hρ hK hconv m y c hy hpos A hD 0 q) i

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:27.name: OAI.Brennan.normalizeDisk_schlicht
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:27.text:
lemma normalizeDisk_schlicht {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f disk) : Schlicht (normalizeDisk f) := by
  have h0 : (0:ℂ) ∈ disk := by simp [disk]
  have hn := univalent_deriv_ne_zero Metric.isOpen_ball hf h0
  refine ⟨⟨?_,?_⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact (normalizeDisk_hasDeriv hf hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro z hz w hw he
    have hh : f z-f 0 = f w-f 0 := (div_left_inj' hn).mp he
    exact hf.2 hz hw (sub_left_inj.mp hh)
  · simp [normalizeDisk]
  · rw [(normalizeDisk_hasDeriv hf h0).deriv,div_self hn]

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:61.name: OAI.Brennan.univalent_inverse_hasDerivAt
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:61.text:
lemma univalent_inverse_hasDerivAt {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) {φ : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hφ : UnivalentOn φ U) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ U) :
    HasDerivAt (Function.invFunOn φ U) (deriv φ z)⁻¹ (φ z) := by
  have ha := hφ.1.analyticOnNhd hU z hz
  apply (ha.hasStrictDerivAt.to_local_left_inverse (univalent_deriv_ne_zero hU hφ hz) ?_).hasDerivAt
  filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
  exact hφ.2.leftInvOn_invFunOn hw

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:23.name: OAI.Brennan.normalizeDisk_hasDeriv
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:23.text:
lemma normalizeDisk_hasDeriv {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f disk) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    HasDerivAt (normalizeDisk f) (deriv f z/deriv f 0) z :=
  ((hf.1.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt.sub_const (f 0)).div_const _

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:39.name: OAI.Brennan.univalent_disk_area
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:39.text:
lemma univalent_disk_area {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : UnivalentOn f disk) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : -2 < t) (ht2 : t < 2/3) : IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖deriv f z‖^t) disk := by
  have h0 : (0:ℂ) ∈ disk := by simp [disk]
  have hn := univalent_deriv_ne_zero Metric.isOpen_ball hf h0
  have hg := schlicht_area (normalizeDisk_schlicht hf) ht ht2
  apply IntegrableOn.congr_fun (hg.const_mul (‖deriv f 0‖^t)) _ Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  intro z hz
  have he : deriv f z = deriv f 0 * deriv (normalizeDisk f) z := by
    rw [(normalizeDisk_hasDeriv hf hz).deriv]
    field_simp
  dsimp only
  rw [he,norm_mul,Real.mul_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]

end Brennan

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.CircleBounds:.name: OAI.Brennan.dyadic_growth_compare
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.CircleBounds:.text:
lemma dyadic_growth_compare {a δ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hδ : 0 < δ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : δ ≤ 2*(1/2:ℝ)^n) :
    ((2:ℝ)^a)^n ≤ (2:ℝ)^a * δ^(-a) := by
  have hv : 0 < (1/2:ℝ)^n := by positivity
  have he : ((2:ℝ)^a)^n = ((1/2:ℝ)^n)^(-a) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast,← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num),← Real.rpow_natCast (1/2:ℝ),
      ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
    rw [show (1/2:ℝ) = 2^(-1:ℝ) by norm_num,← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hb := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity : 0 < δ/2)
    (show δ/2 ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^n by linarith) (neg_nonpos.mpr ha)
  refine hb.trans_eq ?_
  rw [Real.div_rpow hδ.le (by norm_num),Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2),div_inv_eq_mul,mul_comm]

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.CircleBounds:.name: OAI.Brennan.full_circle_dyadic_bound
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.CircleBounds:.text:
lemma full_circle_dyadic_bound {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Schlicht f) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 1/2 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (n : ℕ)
    (hvδ : (1/2:ℝ)^n ≤ 1-r) (hδv : 1-r ≤ 2*(1/2:ℝ)^n) :
    (∫ θ in -Real.pi..Real.pi, ‖deriv f (circlePoint r θ)‖^(-2:ℝ)) ≤
      (1600000000*‖horizontalMass 1 zero_lt_one‖)*‖transferOperator^n‖ := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => ‖deriv f (circlePoint r θ)‖^(-2:ℝ)
  have hF := (continuous_circle_deriv_rpow hf.1 (by linarith) hr1 (-2)).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume)
  have hper : Periodic F (2*Real.pi) := (periodic_circlePoint r).comp (fun z => ‖deriv f z‖^(-2:ℝ))
  have hshift := hper.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-Real.pi) (-Real.pi/4)
  have h1 := circle_arc_dyadic_bound hf hr hr1 n hvδ hδv 0
  have h2 := circle_arc_dyadic_bound hf hr hr1 n hvδ hδv (Real.pi/2)
  have h3 := circle_arc_dyadic_bound hf hr hr1 n hvδ hδv Real.pi
  have h4 := circle_arc_dyadic_bound hf hr hr1 n hvδ hδv (3*Real.pi/2)
  have e1 : (0:ℝ)-Real.pi/4 = -Real.pi/4 := by ring
  have e2 : (0:ℝ)+Real.pi/4 = Real.pi/4 := by ring
  have e3 : Real.pi/2-Real.pi/4 = Real.pi/4 := by ring
  have e4 : Real.pi/2+Real.pi/4 = 3*Real.pi/4 := by ring
  have e5 : Real.pi-Real.pi/4 = 3*Real.pi/4 := by ring
  have e6 : Real.pi+Real.pi/4 = 5*Real.pi/4 := by ring
  have e7 : 3*Real.pi/2-Real.pi/4 = 5*Real.pi/4 := by ring
  have e8 : 3*Real.pi/2+Real.pi/4 = 7*Real.pi/4 := by ring
  rw [e1,e2] at h1
  rw [e3,e4] at h2
  rw [e5,e6] at h3
  rw [e7,e8] at h4
  have ha := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hF (-Real.pi/4) (Real.pi/4)) (hF (Real.pi/4) (3*Real.pi/4))
  have hb := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hF (-Real.pi/4) (3*Real.pi/4)) (hF (3*Real.pi/4) (5*Real.pi/4))
  have hc := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hF (-Real.pi/4) (5*Real.pi/4)) (hF (5*Real.pi/4) (7*Real.pi/4))
  have es1 : -Real.pi+2*Real.pi = Real.pi := by ring
  have es2 : -Real.pi/4+2*Real.pi = 7*Real.pi/4 := by ring
  rw [es1,es2] at hshift
  dsimp only [F] at hshift
  linarith

end Brennan

lemma conformal_lintegral_eq {F : ℂ → ℂ} {s : Set ℂ} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hF : ∀ z ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℂ F z) (hi : InjOn F s) (b : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ w in F '' s, b w) = ∫⁻ z in s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv F z‖^2)*b (F z) := by
  rw [lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_mul volume hs
    (fun z hz => (hF z hz).hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ |>.hasFDerivWithinAt) hi b]
  apply setLIntegral_congr_fun hs
  intro z hz
  have hd := (hF z hz).hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ
  have hf : (ContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ (fderiv ℂ F z)) = fderiv ℝ F z := hd.fderiv.symm
  dsimp only
  have hd' : (fderiv ℝ F z).det = ‖deriv F z‖^2 := det_fderiv_complex (hF z hz)
  rw [hf,hd',abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]

end Brennan

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.CircleBounds:.text:
lemma transferOperator_uniform_growth {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 2 < lam) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ‖transferOperator^n‖ ≤ C*lam^n := by
  have hl : 0 < lam := by linarith
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (norm_pow_eventually_le transferOperator transferOperator_pow_norm_ge_one
    (lt_of_le_of_lt transferRho_le_two hlam))
  let C : ℝ := 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ‖transferOperator^j‖/lam^j
  have hC : 1 ≤ C := le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => div_nonneg (norm_nonneg (transferOperator^j)) (pow_pos hl j).le))
  refine ⟨C,zero_lt_one.trans_le hC,fun n => ?_⟩
  by_cases hn : N ≤ n
  · exact (hN n hn).trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (pow_pos hl n).le hC)
  · have hs : ‖transferOperator^n‖/lam^n ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, ‖transferOperator^j‖/lam^j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => div_nonneg (norm_nonneg (transferOperator^j)) (pow_pos hl j).le) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hn))
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hl n)).mp
    exact hs.trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith)

end Brennan

end

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.Spectrum:51.name: OAI.Brennan.beta_inverse_le_one
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.Spectrum:51.text:
lemma beta_inverse_le_one {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Schlicht f) : beta f (-2) ≤ 1 := by
  have hb (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : beta f (-2) ≤ ((1+ε:ℝ):EReal) := by
    obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := uniform_inverse_square_bound ε hε
    have hc : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ((Real.log C/Real.log (1/(1-r))+(1+ε):ℝ):EReal))
        (𝓝[<] (1:ℝ)) (𝓝 ((1+ε:ℝ):EReal)) := by
      have hh := (tendsto_log_boundary.const_div_atTop (Real.log C)).add_const (1+ε)
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using continuous_coe_real_ereal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hh
    rw [← hc.limsup_eq]
    refine limsup_le_limsup ?_ (by isBoundedDefault) (by isBoundedDefault)
    filter_upwards [eventually_radius] with r hr
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe
    exact log_power_upper (integralMean_pos hf.1 (by linarith [hr.1]) hr.2 (-2)) hC
      (by linarith [hr.1]) hr.2 (by simpa only [show -(1+ε) = -1-ε by ring] using hbound f hf r hr.1 hr.2)
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hfa⟩ := EReal.exists_between_coe_real (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have ha' : 1 < a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have he := hb ((a-1)/2) (by linarith)
  have he' : ((1+(a-1)/2:ℝ):EReal) < a := EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge he) (he'.trans hfa)

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:10.name: OAI.Brennan.conformal_domain_area
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:10.text:
lemma conformal_domain_area {W : Set ℂ} (hW : IsOpen W) {φ : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hφ : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ W) (hb : BijOn φ W disk) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 4/3 < s) (hs4 : s < 4) : IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖deriv φ z‖^s) W := by
  let f := Function.invFunOn φ W
  have hf : UnivalentOn f disk := bijOn_inverse_univalent hW hφ hb
  have himage : f '' disk = W := bijOn_inverse_image hb
  have hfi : IntegrableOn (fun w => ‖deriv f w‖^(2-s)) disk := univalent_disk_area hf (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hderiv (w : ℂ) (hw : w ∈ disk) : deriv φ (f w) = (deriv f w)⁻¹ := by
    have hz : f w ∈ W := hb.surjOn.mapsTo_invFunOn hw
    have hv : φ (f w) = w := hb.surjOn.rightInvOn_invFunOn hw
    have hd := (univalent_inverse_hasDerivAt hW ⟨hφ,hb.injOn⟩ hz).deriv
    change deriv f (φ (f w)) = (deriv φ (f w))⁻¹ at hd
    rw [hv] at hd
    rw [hd,inv_inv]
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun z => ‖deriv φ z‖^s) W := by
    apply (hφ.deriv hW).continuousOn.norm.rpow_const
    intro z hz
    exact Or.inl (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (univalent_deriv_ne_zero hW ⟨hφ,hb.injOn⟩ hz))
  refine ⟨hc.aestronglyMeasurable hW.measurableSet,?_⟩
  apply (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Eventually.of_forall (fun z : ℂ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) s))).mpr
  have he := conformal_lintegral_eq Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
    (fun z hz => hf.1.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)) hf.2
    (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv φ z‖^s))
  change (∫⁻ z in f '' disk, ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv φ z‖^s)) =
    ∫⁻ z in disk, ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv f z‖^2)*ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv φ (f z)‖^s) at he
  rw [himage] at he
  rw [he]
  have hp : (∫⁻ w in disk, ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv f w‖^2)*ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv φ (f w)‖^s)) =
      ∫⁻ w in disk, ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv f w‖^(2-s)) := by
    apply setLIntegral_congr_fun Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
    intro w hw
    dsimp only
    rw [hderiv w hw,norm_inv,Real.inv_rpow (norm_nonneg _),← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _)]
    congr 1
    have hn : 0 < ‖deriv f w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (univalent_deriv_ne_zero Metric.isOpen_ball hf hw)
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast ‖deriv f w‖ 2,← Real.rpow_neg hn.le,← Real.rpow_add hn]
    rfl
  rw [hp]
  exact (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Eventually.of_forall
    (fun w : ℂ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg (deriv f w)) (2-s)))).mp hfi.hasFiniteIntegral

end Brennan

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.Koebe:27.name: OAI.Brennan.koebeMap_schlicht
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.Koebe:27.text:
lemma koebeMap_schlicht : Schlicht koebeMap := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun z hz => (koebeMap_hasDerivAt hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,?_⟩,by simp [koebeMap],?_⟩
  · intro z hz w hw he
    have hnz := one_sub_ne_zero_disk hz
    have hnw := one_sub_ne_zero_disk hw
    have he' : (z-w)*(1-z*w) = 0 := by
      have hh := (div_eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 hnz) (pow_ne_zero 2 hnw)).mp he
      linear_combination hh
    have hzw : 1-z*w ≠ 0 := by
      have hz' : ‖z‖ < 1 := by simpa [disk] using hz
      have hw' : ‖w‖ < 1 := by simpa [disk] using hw
      have hn : ‖z*w‖ < 1 := by rw [norm_mul]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg z,norm_nonneg w]
      intro h
      have : z*w = 1 := by linear_combination -h
      simp [this] at hn
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp he').resolve_right hzw)
  · simpa using (koebeMap_hasDerivAt (show (0:ℂ) ∈ disk by simp [disk])).deriv

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:10.name: OAI.Brennan.schlicht_area
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.DomainArea:10.text:
lemma schlicht_area {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Schlicht f) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : -2 < t) (ht2 : t < 2/3) : IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖deriv f z‖^t) disk := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy t 0 with h | h | h
  · exact schlicht_negative_area hf ht h
  · subst t
    simp only [Real.rpow_zero]
    exact integrableOn_const (by
      apply ne_of_lt
      exact Metric.isBounded_ball.measure_lt_top)
  · exact schlicht_positive_area hf h ht2

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.CircleBounds:.name: OAI.Brennan.uniform_inverse_square_bound
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.CircleBounds:.text:
lemma uniform_inverse_square_bound (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ, Schlicht f → ∀ r : ℝ, 1/2 ≤ r → r < 1 →
      integralMean f (-2) r ≤ C*(1-r)^(-1-ε) := by
  have hlam : 2 < (2:ℝ)^(1+ε) := by
    calc
      (2:ℝ) = 2^(1:ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
      _ < 2^(1+ε) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hKn⟩ := transferOperator_uniform_growth hlam
  let A := (2*Real.pi)⁻¹*(1600000000*‖horizontalMass 1 zero_lt_one‖)*K*(2:ℝ)^(1+ε)
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by dsimp [A]; positivity
  refine ⟨A+1,by linarith,fun f hf r hr hr1 => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n,hn1,hn2⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near_of_lt_one (by linarith : 0 < 1-r)
    (by linarith : 1-r ≤ 1) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2) (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)
  have hn : 1-r ≤ 2*(1/2:ℝ)^(n+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith
  have hb := full_circle_dyadic_bound hf hr hr1 (n+1) hn1.le hn
  have hc := dyadic_growth_compare (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1+ε) (by linarith : 0 < 1-r) hn
  have hx : 0 ≤ (2*Real.pi)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hy : 0 ≤ 1600000000*‖horizontalMass 1 zero_lt_one‖ := by positivity
  have he : (-1-ε:ℝ) = -(1+ε) := by ring
  change (2*Real.pi)⁻¹*(∫ θ in -Real.pi..Real.pi, ‖deriv f (circlePoint r θ)‖^(-2:ℝ)) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (2*Real.pi)⁻¹*((1600000000*‖horizontalMass 1 zero_lt_one‖)*‖transferOperator^(n+1)‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hx
    _ ≤ (2*Real.pi)⁻¹*((1600000000*‖horizontalMass 1 zero_lt_one‖)*(K*((2:ℝ)^(1+ε))^(n+1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hKn (n+1)) hy) hx
    _ ≤ (2*Real.pi)⁻¹*((1600000000*‖horizontalMass 1 zero_lt_one‖)*(K*((2:ℝ)^(1+ε)*(1-r)^(-(1+ε))))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hK.le) hy) hx
    _ = A*(1-r)^(-1-ε) := by rw [he]; dsimp [A]; ring
    _ ≤ (A+1)*(1-r)^(-1-ε) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)

end Brennan

end

end OAI

lemma koebe_positive_endpoint_area : areaMoment koebeMap disk (2 / 3) = ⊤ := by

      (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))) (1 - w))

      intro r hr θ hθ

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.InverseMoment.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.koebe_inverse_areaMoment
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.InverseMoment.text:
lemma koebe_inverse_areaMoment (s : ℝ) :
    areaMoment koebeInverse koebeDomain s = areaMoment koebeMap disk (2 - s) := by
  have hdisk : MeasurableSet disk := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  have hopen : IsOpen disk := Metric.isOpen_ball
  unfold areaMoment koebeDomain
  rw [conformal_lintegral_eq (F := koebeMap) (s := disk) hdisk
    (fun z hz => (koebeMap_hasDerivAt hz).differentiableAt)
    koebeMap_schlicht.1.2]
  apply setLIntegral_congr_fun hdisk
  intro z hz
  change ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
    ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeInverse (koebeMap z)‖ ^ s) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ (2 - s))
  have hderiv : deriv koebeInverse (koebeMap z) = (deriv koebeMap z)⁻¹ :=
    (univalent_inverse_hasDerivAt hopen koebeMap_schlicht.1 hz).deriv
  rw [hderiv, norm_inv, Real.inv_rpow (norm_nonneg _),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _)]
  congr 1
  have hn : 0 < ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ :=
    norm_pos_iff.mpr (univalent_deriv_ne_zero hopen koebeMap_schlicht.1 hz)
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast ‖deriv koebeMap z‖ 2,
    ← Real.rpow_neg hn.le, ← Real.rpow_add hn]
  rfl

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpModel:13.text: def koebeInverse : ℂ → ℂ := Function.invFunOn koebeMap disk

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpEndpoint.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.koebe_inverse_four_thirds_area
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpEndpoint.text:
lemma koebe_inverse_four_thirds_area :
    areaMoment koebeInverse koebeDomain (4 / 3) = ⊤ := by
  rw [koebe_inverse_areaMoment]
  norm_num
  exact koebe_positive_endpoint_area

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.Koebe:18.name: OAI.Brennan.koebeMap_hasDerivAt
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.Koebe:18.text:
lemma koebeMap_hasDerivAt {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) :
    HasDerivAt koebeMap ((1+z)/(1-z)^3) z := by
  have hn := one_sub_ne_zero_disk hz
  have h := (hasDerivAt_id z).div (((hasDerivAt_const z (1:ℂ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id z)).pow 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hn)
  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
  dsimp
  field_simp [hn]
  ring

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpEndpoint.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.sharp_endpoints
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpEndpoint.text:
theorem sharp_endpoints : SharpEndpointStatement := by
  refine ⟨koebeMap_schlicht, koebe_negative_endpoint_area,
    koebe_positive_endpoint_area, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact not_integrable_of_areaMoment_top koebe_inverse_four_area
  · exact not_integrable_of_areaMoment_top koebe_inverse_four_thirds_area

end Brennan.Sharp

end

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.AffineArea:37.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.lintegral_left_disk_indicator
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.AffineArea:37.text:
lemma lintegral_left_disk_indicator (t : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ w, disk.indicator (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ t)) (-1 + w)) =
      areaMoment koebeMap disk t := by
  have h := lintegral_affine_unit (-1) 1 (by simp)
    (disk.indicator (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ t)))
  have hdisk : MeasurableSet disk := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  rw [lintegral_indicator hdisk] at h
  simpa only [one_mul, areaMoment] using h

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpModel:18.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.SharpEndpointStatement
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpModel:18.text:
def SharpEndpointStatement : Prop :=
  Schlicht koebeMap ∧
  areaMoment koebeMap disk (-2) = ⊤ ∧
  areaMoment koebeMap disk (2 / 3) = ⊤ ∧
  ¬ IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖deriv koebeInverse z‖ ^ (4 : ℝ)) koebeDomain volume ∧
  ¬ IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖deriv koebeInverse z‖ ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)) koebeDomain volume

end Brennan.Sharp

end

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpEndpoint.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.koebe_inverse_four_area
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SharpEndpoint.text:
lemma koebe_inverse_four_area : areaMoment koebeInverse koebeDomain 4 = ⊤ := by

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.KoebePolar:34.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.polar_left_mem_disk
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.KoebePolar:34.text:
lemma polar_left_mem_disk {r θ : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2))
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (-(Real.pi / 3)) (Real.pi / 3)) :
    -1 + Complex.polarCoord.symm (r, θ) ∈ disk := by
  obtain ⟨hn, hc⟩ := polar_cone_data hr.1 hθ
  exact left_cone_mem_disk (w := Complex.polarCoord.symm (r, θ)) (by rw [hn]; exact hr.1) (by rw [hn]; exact hr.2) hc

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.Koebe:12.name: OAI.Brennan.one_sub_ne_zero_disk
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.Koebe:12.text:
lemma one_sub_ne_zero_disk {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ disk) : 1-z ≠ 0 := by
  have h : ‖z‖ < 1 := by simpa [disk] using hz
  intro he
  have : z = 1 := by linear_combination -he
  simp [this] at h

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SectorDiverge.name: OAI.Brennan.Sector.lintegral_eq_top_of_sector_lower_bound
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.SectorDiverge.text:
theorem lintegral_eq_top_of_sector_lower_bound (f : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (R a b c : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hab : a < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (ha : -Real.pi ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ Real.pi)
    (hlower : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) R, ∀ θ ∈ Ioo a b,
      ENNReal.ofReal (c / r ^ 2) ≤ f (Complex.polarCoord.symm (r, θ))) :
    (∫⁻ z, f z) = ⊤ := by
  let box : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Ioo (0 : ℝ) R ×ˢ Ioo a b
  let radial : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun p => ENNReal.ofReal c * ENNReal.ofReal p.1⁻¹
  have hradial : Measurable radial :=
    measurable_const.mul (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp measurable_fst.inv)
  have hcinv : (∫⁻ r in Ioo (0 : ℝ) R, ENNReal.ofReal c * ENNReal.ofReal r⁻¹) = ⊤ := by
    have hmeas : Measurable (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal r⁻¹) :=
      ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp measurable_inv
    rw [lintegral_const_mul (ENNReal.ofReal c) hmeas,
      lintegral_inv_Ioo_eq_top R hR,
      ENNReal.mul_top (ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hc))]
  have hbox : (∫⁻ p in box, radial p) = ⊤ := by
    change (∫⁻ p in Ioo (0 : ℝ) R ×ˢ Ioo a b, radial p ∂volume.prod volume) = ⊤
    rw [setLIntegral_prod_symm _ hradial.aemeasurable]
    simp only [radial, hcinv]
    rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Ioo,
      ENNReal.top_mul (ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (sub_pos.mpr hab)))]
  have hsub : box ⊆ polarCoord.target := by
    rw [polarCoord_target]
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨hp.1.1, lt_of_le_of_lt ha hp.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2.2 hb⟩
  have hlower' (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ box) :
      radial p ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p.1 • f (Complex.polarCoord.symm p) := by
    have hr : 0 < p.1 := hp.1.1
    have hid : ENNReal.ofReal c * ENNReal.ofReal p.1⁻¹ =
        ENNReal.ofReal p.1 * ENNReal.ofReal (c / p.1 ^ 2) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc.le, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hr.le]
      congr 1
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hr]
    change ENNReal.ofReal c * ENNReal.ofReal p.1⁻¹ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal p.1 * f (Complex.polarCoord.symm p)
    rw [hid]
    exact mul_le_mul_right (hlower p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2) _
  apply top_unique
  calc
    ⊤ = ∫⁻ p in box, radial p := hbox.symm
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ p in box, ENNReal.ofReal p.1 • f (Complex.polarCoord.symm p) :=
      setLIntegral_mono' (measurableSet_Ioo.prod measurableSet_Ioo) hlower'
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ p in polarCoord.target, ENNReal.ofReal p.1 • f (Complex.polarCoord.symm p) :=
      lintegral_mono_set hsub
    _ = ∫⁻ z, f z := Complex.lintegral_comp_polarCoord_symm f

end Brennan.Sector

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.InverseMoment.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.not_integrable_of_areaMoment_top
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.InverseMoment.text:
lemma not_integrable_of_areaMoment_top {f : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {t : ℝ}
    (h : areaMoment f U t = ⊤) :
    ¬ IntegrableOn (fun z => ‖deriv f z‖ ^ t) U volume := by
  intro hi
  have hf := (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Eventually.of_forall
    (fun z : ℂ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg (deriv f z)) t))).mp hi.hasFiniteIntegral
  change areaMoment f U t < ⊤ at hf
  rw [h] at hf
  exact lt_irrefl _ hf

end Brennan.Sharp

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.AffineArea:46.name: OAI.Brennan.Sharp.lintegral_right_disk_indicator
OAI.Analysis.IntegralMeans.AffineArea:46.text:
lemma lintegral_right_disk_indicator (t : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ w, disk.indicator (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ t)) (1 - w)) =
      areaMoment koebeMap disk t := by
  have h := lintegral_affine_unit 1 (-1) (by simp)
    (disk.indicator (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv koebeMap z‖ ^ t)))
  have hdisk : MeasurableSet disk := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  rw [lintegral_indicator hdisk] at h
  simpa only [neg_one_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg, areaMoment] using h

end Brennan.Sharp

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.Ising.Basic:11.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.FiniteGraph
OAI.Probability.Ising.Basic:11.text:
structure FiniteGraph (n m : ℕ) where
  left : Fin m → Fin n
  right : Fin m → Fin n
  coupling : Fin m → ℝ
  coupling_nonneg : ∀ e, 0 ≤ coupling e
  no_loops : ∀ e, left e ≠ right e

OAI.Probability.Ising.Main:59.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.extremeLogOdds_le_zero
OAI.Probability.Ising.Main:59.text:
lemma extremeLogOdds_le_zero {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n))
    (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIF : Disjoint I F) (hJF : Disjoint J F)
    (i j : KeptVertex F) (hi : i.val ∈ I) (hj : j.val ∈ J) (τ : Spins n) :
    extremeLogOdds G h I J F τ ≤ 4 * Real.artanh (qZero G I J F i j) := by
  rw [extremeLogOdds_eq_actualCoupling G h I J F hIJ hIF hJF i j hi hj τ,
    artanh_qZero_eq_actualCoupling G I J F hIJ i j hi hj]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (effectiveCouplingBound _ _ (actualComparisonGraph G I J F)
      (actualComparisonField G h I J F τ) _ _
      (actualTerminal_ne G I J F hIJ i j hi hj)) (by norm_num)

OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:183.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.extremeLogOdds
OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:183.text:
noncomputable def extremeLogOdds {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n)) (τ : Spins n) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (jointWeight G h I J F τ ⊤ ⊤) +
    Real.log (jointWeight G h I J F τ ⊥ ⊥) -
    Real.log (jointWeight G h I J F τ ⊤ ⊥) -
    Real.log (jointWeight G h I J F τ ⊥ ⊤)

OAI.Probability.Ising.Basic:40.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.conditionalProb
OAI.Probability.Ising.Basic:40.text:
noncomputable def conditionalProb {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n)) (a b τ : Spins n) : ℝ :=
  constrainedSum G h (fun σ => AgreesOn I σ a ∧ AgreesOn J σ b ∧ AgreesOn F σ τ) /
    constrainedSum G h (fun σ => AgreesOn J σ b ∧ AgreesOn F σ τ)

OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:237.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.mixture_ratio_of_pointwise
OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:237.text:
lemma mixture_ratio_of_pointwise {B : Type*} [Fintype B]
    (p : B → ℝ) (hp : ∀ b, 0 < p b) (L U : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ b b', L ≤ p b / p b' ∧ p b / p b' ≤ U)
    (μ ν : B → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ b, 0 ≤ μ b) (hν : ∀ b, 0 ≤ ν b)
    (hμsum : ∑ b, μ b = 1) (hνsum : ∑ b, ν b = 1) :
    L ≤ (∑ b, μ b * p b) / (∑ b, ν b * p b) ∧
      (∑ b, μ b * p b) / (∑ b, ν b * p b) ≤ U := by
  have havg := positive_average p ν hp hν hνsum
  have honeL : ∀ b, L * (∑ c, ν c * p c) ≤ p b := by
    intro b
    calc
      L * (∑ c, ν c * p c) = ∑ c, ν c * (L * p c) := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; ext c; ring
      _ ≤ ∑ c, ν c * p b := Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((le_div_iff₀ (hp c)).mp (hbound b c).1) (hν c)
      _ = p b := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hνsum, one_mul]
  have honeU : ∀ b, p b ≤ U * (∑ c, ν c * p c) := by
    intro b
    calc
      p b = ∑ c, ν c * p b := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hνsum, one_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ c, ν c * (U * p c) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((div_le_iff₀ (hp c)).mp (hbound b c).2) (hν c)
      _ = U * (∑ c, ν c * p c) := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; ext c; ring
  constructor
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ havg).mpr
    calc
      _ = ∑ b, μ b * (L * ∑ c, ν c * p c) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hμsum, one_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (honeL b) (hμ b)
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ havg).mpr
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ b, μ b * (U * ∑ c, ν c * p c) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (honeU b) (hμ b)
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hμsum, one_mul]

OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:299.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.actualComparisonField
OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:299.text:
noncomputable def actualComparisonField {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n)) (τ : Spins n) :=
    fun x => quotientField (comparisonSetoid G I J F ∅) (pinField G h F τ)
      ((Fintype.equivFin (ContractedVertex G I J F)).symm x)

OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:316.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.extremeLogOdds_eq_actualCoupling
OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:316.text:
lemma extremeLogOdds_eq_actualCoupling {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n))
    (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIF : Disjoint I F) (hJF : Disjoint J F)
    (i j : KeptVertex F) (hi : i.val ∈ I) (hj : j.val ∈ J) (τ : Spins n) :
    extremeLogOdds G h I J F τ = 4 * tableCoupling (pairTable
      (weight (actualComparisonGraph G I J F) (actualComparisonField G h I J F τ))
      (actualTerminal G I J F i) (actualTerminal G I J F j)) := by
  classical
  rw [extremeLogOdds_eq_effective G h I J F hIF hJF i j hi hj τ]
  congr 1
  have H : pairTable (contractedPinnedWeight G h I J F τ) i j =
      fun s t => Real.exp (pinConstant G h F τ) * pairTable
        (interactionWeight (contractedInteraction G I J F)
          (quotientField (comparisonSetoid G I J F ∅) (pinField G h F τ)))
        (Quotient.mk _ i) (Quotient.mk _ j) s t := by
    funext s t
    exact contractedPinned_pairTable_quotient G h I J F τ i j s t
  have hp : ∀ s t, 0 < pairTable
      (interactionWeight (contractedInteraction G I J F)
        (quotientField (comparisonSetoid G I J F ∅) (pinField G h F τ)))
      (Quotient.mk _ i) (Quotient.mk _ j) s t :=
    pairTable_pos_of_weight_pos _ (fun σ => Real.exp_pos _)
      _ _ (contractedTerminal_ne G I J F hIJ i j hi hj)
  rw [H, tableCoupling_scale _ hp (Real.exp (pinConstant G h F τ)) (Real.exp_pos _)]
  exact (interactionGraph_coupling _ _ _ _ (contractedTerminal_ne G I J F hIJ i j hi hj)).symm

OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:273.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.mixture_ratio_extreme
OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:273.text:
lemma mixture_ratio_extreme {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n))
    (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIF : Disjoint I F) (hJF : Disjoint J F)
    (a τ : Spins n) (mix mix' : Spins n → ℝ)
    (hmix : ∀ b, 0 ≤ mix b) (hmix' : ∀ b, 0 ≤ mix' b)
    (hmixsum : ∑ b, mix b = 1) (hmix'sum : ∑ b, mix' b = 1) :
    Real.exp (-extremeLogOdds G h I J F τ) ≤
        mixtureProb G h I J F a τ mix / mixtureProb G h I J F a τ mix' ∧
      mixtureProb G h I J F a τ mix / mixtureProb G h I J F a τ mix' ≤
        Real.exp (extremeLogOdds G h I J F τ) :=
  mixture_ratio_of_pointwise
    (fun b => conditionalProb G h I J F a b τ)
    (fun b => conditionalProb_pos G h I J F hIJ hIF hJF a b τ) _ _
    (fun b b' => conditional_ratio_extreme G h I J F hIJ hIF hJF τ a b b')
    mix mix' hmix hmix' hmixsum hmix'sum

OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:343.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.artanh_qZero_eq_actualCoupling
OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:343.text:
lemma artanh_qZero_eq_actualCoupling {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (I J F : Finset (Fin n)) (hIJ : Disjoint I J)
    (i j : KeptVertex F) (hi : i.val ∈ I) (hj : j.val ∈ J) :
    Real.artanh (qZero G I J F i j) = tableCoupling (pairTable
      (weight (actualComparisonGraph G I J F) (fun _ => 0))
      (actualTerminal G I J F i) (actualTerminal G I J F j)) := by
  classical
  rw [artanh_qZero_eq_effective G I J F hIJ i j hi hj]
  have H : pairTable (contractedZeroWeight G I J F) i j =
      pairTable (interactionWeight (contractedInteraction G I J F) (fun _ => 0))
        (Quotient.mk _ i) (Quotient.mk _ j) := by
    funext s t
    exact contractedZero_pairTable_quotient G I J F i j s t
  rw [H]
  exact (interactionGraph_coupling _ (fun _ => 0) _ _
    (contractedTerminal_ne G I J F hIJ i j hi hj)).symm

end BufferedIsing

end OAI

OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:209.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.conditionalProb_pos
OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:209.text:
lemma conditionalProb_pos {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n))
    (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIF : Disjoint I F) (hJF : Disjoint J F)
    (a b τ : Spins n) : 0 < conditionalProb G h I J F a b τ := by
  apply div_pos (jointWeight_pos G h I J F hIJ hIF hJF τ a b)
  apply constrainedSum_pos G h _ (fun v => if v ∈ J then b v else τ v)
  constructor
  · intro v hv
    simp [hv]
  · intro v hv
    have hvJ : v ∉ J := fun hvJ => Finset.disjoint_left.mp hJF hvJ hv
    simp [hvJ]

OAI.Probability.Ising.Basic:91.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.mixtureProb
OAI.Probability.Ising.Basic:91.text:
noncomputable def mixtureProb {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n)) (a τ : Spins n)
    (mix : Spins n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ b, mix b * conditionalProb G h I J F a b τ

OAI.Probability.Ising.Basic:49.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.KeptVertex
OAI.Probability.Ising.Basic:49.text: abbrev KeptVertex {n : ℕ} (F : Finset (Fin n)) := {v : Fin n // v ∉ F}

OAI.Probability.Ising.Main:72.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.finite_graph_comparison
OAI.Probability.Ising.Main:72.text:
theorem finite_graph_comparison {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n))
    (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIF : Disjoint I F) (hJF : Disjoint J F)
    (i j : KeptVertex F) (hi : i.val ∈ I) (hj : j.val ∈ J)
    (a τ : Spins n) (mix mix' : Spins n → ℝ)
    (hmix : ∀ b, 0 ≤ mix b) (hmix' : ∀ b, 0 ≤ mix' b)
    (hmixsum : ∑ b, mix b = 1) (hmix'sum : ∑ b, mix' b = 1) :
    Real.exp (-4 * Real.artanh (qZero G I J F i j)) ≤
        mixtureProb G h I J F a τ mix / mixtureProb G h I J F a τ mix' ∧
      mixtureProb G h I J F a τ mix / mixtureProb G h I J F a τ mix' ≤
        Real.exp (4 * Real.artanh (qZero G I J F i j)) := by
  have H := mixture_ratio_extreme G h I J F hIJ hIF hJF a τ mix mix'
    hmix hmix' hmixsum hmix'sum
  have HB := extremeLogOdds_le_zero G h I J F hIJ hIF hJF i j hi hj τ
  exact ⟨(Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)).trans H.1,
    H.2.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr HB)⟩

end

end BufferedIsing

end OAI

OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:308.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.actualTerminal_ne
OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:308.text:
lemma actualTerminal_ne {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (I J F : Finset (Fin n)) (hIJ : Disjoint I J)
    (i j : KeptVertex F) (hi : i.val ∈ I) (hj : j.val ∈ J) :
    actualTerminal G I J F i ≠ actualTerminal G I J F j := by
  intro H
  exact contractedTerminal_ne G I J F hIJ i j hi hj ((Fintype.equivFin _).injective H)

OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:296.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.actualComparisonGraph
OAI.Probability.Ising.Contraction:296.text:
noncomputable def actualComparisonGraph {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (I J F : Finset (Fin n)) := interactionGraph (contractedInteraction G I J F)

OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:191.name: OAI.BufferedIsing.conditional_ratio_extreme
OAI.Probability.Ising.Marginals:191.text:
lemma conditional_ratio_extreme {n m : ℕ} (G : FiniteGraph n m)
    (h : Fin n → ℝ) (I J F : Finset (Fin n))
    (hIJ : Disjoint I J) (hIF : Disjoint I F) (hJF : Disjoint J F)
    (τ a b b' : Spins n) :
    Real.exp (-extremeLogOdds G h I J F τ) ≤
        conditionalProb G h I J F a b τ / conditionalProb G h I J F a b' τ ∧
      conditionalProb G h I J F a b τ / conditionalProb G h I J F a b' τ ≤
        Real.exp (extremeLogOdds G h I J F τ) := by
  have H := normalized_ratio_of_rectangles
    (fun (α : I → Bool) β => jointWeight G h I J F τ (extendSpin I α) β)
    (fun α β => jointWeight_pos G h I J F hIJ hIF hJF τ (extendSpin I α) β)
    (extremeLogOdds G h I J F τ)
    (fun α α' β β' => marginal_extreme_rectangle G h I J F hIJ hIF hJF τ
      (extendSpin I α) (extendSpin I α') β β')
    (restrictSpin I a) b b'
  simp only [sum_jointWeight_eq_denominator, jointWeight_extend_restrict] at H
  simpa only [jointWeight, conditionalProb] using H

OAI.Analysis.C0Absorption.Absorption:55.name: OAI.C0Absorption.concreteAbsorption_bilip
OAI.Analysis.C0Absorption.Absorption:55.text:
theorem concreteAbsorption_bilip : BiLip concreteAbsorption := by
  let D := max (1+3*‖correctionQ‖/(22/125)) (‖correctionQ‖/(22/125))
  let U := 1+3*max 1 ‖correctionQ‖
  have hD : 0<D := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨1/D,max U (1/D),one_div_pos.mpr hD,le_max_right _ _,fun x y => ⟨?_,?_⟩⟩
  · have h := concreteAbsorption_inverse_bound x y
    rw [one_div,mul_comm,← div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hD).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using h)
  · exact (concreteAbsorption_upper x y).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) dist_nonneg)

OAI.Analysis.C0Absorption.Absorption:73.name: OAI.C0Absorption.noLinearC0_not_product_equiv
OAI.Analysis.C0Absorption.Absorption:73.text:
theorem noLinearC0_not_product_equiv {Z : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Z] [NormedSpace ℝ Z]
    (hZ : NoLinearC0 Z) : ¬ Nonempty ((Z × C0) ≃L[ℝ] Z) := by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  let T : C0 →L[ℝ] Z := e.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ Z C0)
  let B : ℝ := max 1 ‖e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖
  have hB : 0<B := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
  apply hZ T
  refine ⟨1/B,one_div_pos.mpr hB,fun x => ?_⟩
  have hh : ‖x‖≤B*‖T x‖ := by
    calc
      ‖x‖ = ‖((0,x) : Z × C0)‖ := by simp
      _ = ‖e.symm (T x)‖ := by simp [T]
      _ ≤ ‖e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap‖*‖T x‖ := e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ B*‖T x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
  rw [one_div,mul_comm,← div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hB).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hh)

    realHomologyMap 2 SphereDoubling.sphereMap SphereDoubling.continuous_sphereMap v =
      (2 : ℝ) • v := by

      ActualSingularSubdivision.chainMap ActualSingularSubdivision.chainMap_app_zero

        (by rw [iUnion_coverFamily]))

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:327.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.AEC.directed_union
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:327.text:
theorem directed_union {J : Type u} [Preorder J] [IsDirectedOrder J] [Nonempty J]
    (F : J → RelModel.{u} Language) (ho : ∀ i, Object (hCH := hCH) (F i))
    (hs : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → Strong (hCH := hCH) (F i) (F j)) :
    ∃ U, Object (hCH := hCH) U ∧ RelModel.IsUnion F U ∧
      (∀ i, Strong (hCH := hCH) (F i) U) ∧
      (∀ N, Object (hCH := hCH) N → (∀ i, Strong (hCH := hCH) (F i) N) → Strong (hCH := hCH) U N) := by
  classical
  let P (i : J) : Presentation (F i) := (ho i).choose
  have hp (i : J) : (P i).data.IsObject hCH := (ho i).choose_spec
  let maps (i j : J) (h : i ≤ j) : Map (P i).data (P j).data :=
    (strong_rebase (hs i j h) (P i) (P j)).choose
  have hm (i j : J) (h : i ≤ j) : (maps i j h).Strong hCH :=
    (strong_rebase (hs i j h) (P i) (P j)).choose_spec.1
  have hi (i j : J) (h : i ≤ j) : (P i).Inclusion (P j) (maps i j h) :=
    (strong_rebase (hs i j h) (P i) (P j)).choose_spec.2
  let S : System.Data (J := J) := {
    obj := fun i => (P i).data
    map := maps
    map_id := fun i => (P i).inclusion_unique (hi i i le_rfl) (P i).inclusion_refl
    map_comp := fun i j k h h' => (P i).inclusion_unique ((hi j k h').comp (hi i j h)) (hi i k (h.trans h')) }
  have hconv : ∀ i j h, (Set.range (S.map i j h).base).OrdConnected := fun i j h => (hm i j h).convex
  let A : ZFSet.{u} := ZFSet.iUnion (fun i => (F i).carrier)
  let stage (i : J) (x : (S.obj i).Carrier) : A :=
    ⟨((P i).equiv x).val, ZFSet.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, ((P i).equiv x).property⟩⟩
  let val : S.X → A := DirectLimit.lift S.pointMap stage (by
    intro i j h x
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (hi i j h x).symm)
  have hv (i : J) (x : (S.obj i).Carrier) : val (S.point i x) = stage i x := rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective val := by
    intro x y
    induction x, y using DirectLimit.induction₂ S.pointMap with
    | ih i x y =>
      intro h
      apply congrArg (S.point i)
      apply (P i).equiv.injective
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun z : A => z.val) h
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective val := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨i, hai⟩ := ZFSet.mem_iUnion.1 a.property
    refine ⟨S.point i ((P i).equiv.symm ⟨a.val, hai⟩), ?_⟩
    rw [hv]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((P i).equiv ((P i).equiv.symm ⟨a.val, hai⟩)).val = a.val
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  let e : (S.limitData hconv).Carrier ≃ A :=
    (S.equivalence hconv).symm.trans (Equiv.ofBijective val ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩)
  have he (i : J) (x : (S.obj i).Carrier) :
      e ((S.toLimit hconv i).onPoint x) = stage i x := by
    change val ((S.equivalence hconv).symm ((S.toLimit hconv i).onPoint x)) = _
    rw [S.equivalence_symm_stage, hv]
  let U := Coding.model (S.limitData hconv) A e
  let Q := Coding.presentation (S.limitData hconv) A e
  have hu : Q.data.IsObject hCH := S.limit_object hconv hp hm
  have hstage (i : J) : Strong (hCH := hCH) (F i) U :=
    strong_of (P := P i) (Q := Q) (hp i) hu (S.toLimit hconv i)
      (S.toLimit_strong hconv hm i) (fun x => congrArg Subtype.val (he i x))
  refine ⟨U, ⟨Q, hu⟩, ⟨fun i => substructure (hstage i), ?_⟩, hstage, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    exact ZFSet.mem_iUnion.1 x.property
  · intro N hn hc
    obtain ⟨O, ho'⟩ := hn
    let q (i : J) : Map (S.obj i) O.data := (strong_rebase (hc i) (P i) O).choose
    have hq_strong (i : J) : (q i).Strong hCH := (strong_rebase (hc i) (P i) O).choose_spec.1
    have hq_inc (i : J) : (P i).Inclusion O (q i) := (strong_rebase (hc i) (P i) O).choose_spec.2
    have hq (i j : J) (h : i ≤ j) : (q j).comp (S.map i j h) = q i :=
      (P i).inclusion_unique ((hq_inc j).comp (hi i j h)) (hq_inc i)
    let f := S.liftMap hconv q hq
    refine strong_of hu ho' f (S.liftMap_strong hconv q hq hq_strong) ?_
    intro x
    obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := S.toLimit_covers hconv x
    change (O.equiv ((S.liftMap hconv q hq).onPoint ((S.toLimit hconv i).onPoint y))).val =
      (e ((S.toLimit hconv i).onPoint y)).val
    rw [S.liftMap_stage, he]
    exact hq_inc i y

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:82.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.Presentation.comparison
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:82.text:
def comparison (Q : Presentation R) : RawIso P.data Q.data :=
  rawIsoOfTyped (P.equiv.trans Q.equiv.symm) (fun n s a => by
    have h := Q.relates_symm n s (P.equiv ∘ a)
    exact h.symm.trans (P.relates n s a))

theorem main (hCH : CH.{u}) :
    ∃ (L : ℕ → Type), Countable (Σ n, L n) ∧
      ∃ K : ClassData.{u} L, K.IsAEC ∧ K.HasLSNumber ℵ₀ ∧
        endpoint = hanf (ℵ₀ : Cardinal.{u}) ∧ K.TwoModels endpoint ∧
        ∀ μ, tailThreshold ≤ μ → K.Categorical μ := by
  refine ⟨Arrays.Language, Arrays.language_countable, Arrays.classData hCH,
    Arrays.AEC.isAEC, Arrays.AEC.hasLSNumber, ThresholdArithmetic.endpoint_eq_hanf hCH,

    max_eq_left endpoint_infinite]

    dsimp at h
    subst r
    cases hs
    cases hr

    ⟨Coding.codedPresentation _, countableData_object hCH μ hμ⟩, ?_⟩

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:73.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.Existence.countableData_cardinal
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:73.text:
theorem countableData_cardinal (μ : Cardinal.{u}) (hμ : ℵ₀ ≤ μ) :
    #(countableData μ hμ).Carrier = μ := by
  rw [Data.cardinal_eq, countableData_index]
  change max (max μ #RationalBase.{u}) ℵ₀ = μ
  rw [max_eq_left ((Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0 (α := RationalBase.{u})).trans hμ), max_eq_left hμ]

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:32.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.Existence.RationalBase
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:32.text:
abbrev RationalBase := ULift.{u} ℚ

instance : DenselyOrdered RationalBase.{u} where
  dense a b h := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hd⟩ := exists_between (show a.down < b.down from h)
    exact ⟨⟨c⟩, hc, hd⟩

instance : NoMinOrder RationalBase.{u} where
  exists_lt a := by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_lt a.down
    exact ⟨⟨b⟩, hb⟩

instance : NoMaxOrder RationalBase.{u} where
  exists_gt a := by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_gt a.down
    exact ⟨⟨b⟩, hb⟩

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:171.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.AEC.strong_objects
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:171.text:
theorem strong_objects (h : Strong (hCH := hCH) R T) : Object (hCH := hCH) R ∧ Object (hCH := hCH) T := by
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hp, hq, f, hf, he⟩ := h
  exact ⟨⟨P, hp⟩, ⟨Q, hq⟩⟩

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.ArrayEmbedd.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.countable_isomorphic
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.ArrayEmbedd.text:
theorem countable_isomorphic [Countable M.B] [Countable N.B] (hI : #M.I = #N.I) :
    ∃ f : Map M N, Function.Surjective f.index ∧ Function.Surjective f.base := by
  obtain ⟨ei⟩ := Cardinal.eq.1 hI
  obtain ⟨eb⟩ := Order.iso_of_countable_dense M.B N.B
  exact ⟨countableMap ei eb, ei.surjective, eb.surjective⟩

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:110.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.Categoricity.tail
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:110.text:
theorem tail (hCH : CH.{u}) (μ : Cardinal.{u}) (hμ : tailThreshold.{u} ≤ μ) :
    (classData hCH).Categorical μ := by
  refine ⟨Existence.models hCH μ
    ((Cardinal.aleph0_le_aleph 1).trans (aleph_one_lt.le.trans hμ)), ?_⟩
  intro R T hr ht hc hd
  obtain ⟨P, hp⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨Q, hq⟩ := ht
  have hpc : #P.data.Carrier = μ := (Coding.cardinal P.equiv).trans hc
  have hqc : #Q.data.Carrier = μ := (Coding.cardinal Q.equiv).trans hd
  have := countable P.data hCH hp hμ hpc
  have := countable Q.data hCH hq hμ hqc
  obtain ⟨f, hi, hb⟩ := countable_isomorphic
    ((index_eq P.data hμ hpc).trans (index_eq Q.data hμ hqc).symm)
  exact ⟨P.isoOfMap Q f (f.surjective hi hb)⟩

end Categoricity

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:409.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.AEC.isAEC
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:409.text:
theorem isAEC : (classData hCH).IsAEC where
  strong_objects := strong_objects
  refl := refl
  antisymm := antisymm
  trans := trans
  substructure := substructure
  iso_objects h e := iso_objects h e.some
  iso_strong := iso_strong
  coherence := coherence
  chain_union γ hγ F ho hs := by
    let : Nonempty γ.ToType := Ordinal.nonempty_toType_iff.2 hγ
    exact directed_union F ho hs
  downward := ⟨ℵ₀, lsBound⟩

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:225.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.AEC.coherence
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:225.text:
theorem coherence (hsub : R.IsSubstructure T) (h : Strong (hCH := hCH) R V)
    (k : Strong (hCH := hCH) T V) : Strong (hCH := hCH) R T := by
  obtain ⟨P, O, hp, ho, f, hf, he⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨Q, hq⟩ := (strong_objects k).1
  obtain ⟨g, hg, he'⟩ := strong_rebase k Q O
  have hr : ∀ x : P.data.Carrier, ∃ y, g.onPoint y = f.onPoint x := by
    intro x
    let y : T.carrier := ⟨(P.equiv x).val, hsub.subset (P.equiv x).property⟩
    refine ⟨Q.equiv.symm y, O.equiv.injective (Subtype.ext ?_)⟩
    rw [he', he, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := f.factor g hr
  refine strong_of hp hq l (hf.factor hCH hl) ?_
  intro x
  have hv := congrArg (fun m : Map P.data O.data => (O.equiv (m.onPoint x)).val) hl
  rw [Map.comp_onPoint] at hv
  rw [he', he] at hv
  exact hv

end AEC

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:92.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.Categoricity.index_eq
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:92.text:
theorem index_eq (M : Data.{u}) {μ : Cardinal.{u}} (hμ : tailThreshold.{u} ≤ μ)
    (hM : #M.Carrier = μ) : #M.I = μ := by
  have hi : #M.I ≤ μ := (Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective (fun _ _ h => Point.index.inj h)).trans_eq hM
  apply le_antisymm hi
  by_contra! hn
  have hb : #M.B < μ := M.base_bound.trans_lt (aleph_one_lt.trans_le hμ)
  have hz : ℵ₀ < μ := (Cardinal.aleph0_le_aleph 1).trans_lt (aleph_one_lt.trans_le hμ)
  have hc := max_lt (max_lt hn hb) hz
  rw [← M.cardinal_eq, hM] at hc
  exact hc.false

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:103.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.Categoricity.countable
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:103.text:
theorem countable (M : Data.{u}) (hCH : CH.{u}) (ho : M.IsObject hCH)
    {μ : Cardinal.{u}} (hμ : tailThreshold.{u} ≤ μ) (hM : #M.Carrier = μ) : Countable M.B := by
  by_contra hn
  have hh := M.uncountable_index_bound hCH ho hn
  rw [index_eq M hμ hM] at hh
  exact hh.not_ge hμ

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:49.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.Existence.countableData
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:49.text:
def countableData (μ : Cardinal.{u}) (hμ : ℵ₀ ≤ μ) : Data.{u} where
  I := μ.ord.ToType
  B := RationalBase
  indexNonempty := by
    have : Infinite μ.ord.ToType := Cardinal.aleph0_le_mk_iff.1 (by simpa using hμ)
    infer_instance
  baseNonempty := inferInstance
  order := inferInstance
  dense := inferInstance
  noMin := inferInstance
  noMax := inferInstance
  locallyCountable _ _ := Set.to_countable _
  bits _ _ _ := false

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:209.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.EndpointModels.twoModels
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:209.text:
theorem twoModels (hCH : CH.{u}) : (classData hCH).TwoModels endpoint.{u} := by
  let M := countableData endpoint endpoint_infinite
  let N := data hCH
  let P := Coding.codedPresentation M
  let Q := Coding.codedPresentation N
  refine ⟨Coding.coded M, Coding.coded N,
    ⟨P, countableData_object hCH endpoint endpoint_infinite⟩, ⟨Q, object hCH⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Coding.coded_cardinal]
    exact countableData_cardinal endpoint endpoint_infinite
  · rw [Coding.coded_cardinal]
    exact cardinal hCH
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    let f := (P.transport e).comparison Q
    have : Countable (P.transport e).data.B := by change Countable RationalBase; infer_instance
    have : Countable N.B := f.base_surjective.countable
    have hc := Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0 (α := N.B)
    change #Base.{u} ≤ ℵ₀ at hc
    rw [base_cardinal] at hc
    exact (Cardinal.aleph0_lt_aleph.2 (by norm_num : (0 : Ordinal.{u}) < 1)).not_ge hc

end EndpointModels

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:63.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.Existence.countableData_object
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.Main:63.text:
theorem countableData_object (hCH : CH.{u}) (μ : Cardinal.{u}) (hμ : ℵ₀ ≤ μ) :
    (countableData μ hμ).IsObject hCH := by
  have : Countable (countableData μ hμ).B := by change Countable RationalBase; infer_instance

OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:212.name: OAI.CHObstruction.Arrays.AEC.iso_strong
OAI.ModelTheory.Categoricity.AEC:212.text:
theorem iso_strong {R' T' : RelModel.{u} Language} (h : Strong (hCH := hCH) R T)
    (e : R.Iso R') (f : T.Iso T')
    (he : ∀ x : R.carrier, (e.toEquiv x).val =
      (f.toEquiv ⟨x.val, (substructure h).subset x.property⟩).val) :
    Strong (hCH := hCH) R' T' := by
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hp, hq, g, hg, hinc⟩ := h
  refine strong_of (P := P.transport e) (Q := Q.transport f) hp hq g hg ?_
  intro x
  change (f.toEquiv (Q.equiv (g.onPoint x))).val = (e.toEquiv (P.equiv x)).val
  rw [he]
  congr 2
  exact Subtype.ext (hinc x)

  exact ⟨P.transport e, hp⟩
