OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.critical_bounded_of_transport_finiteness
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem critical_bounded_of_transport_finiteness [Infinite V]
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hG : Function.Injective G)
    (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G) (hqt : QuasiTransitive G) (hh : 0 < hV G)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (root : ι → V) (weight : ι → ℝ)
    (htr : RootTransport root weight (vertexAut G))
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ r, ∃ g ∈ vertexAut G, g (root r) = x)
    (hw : ∀ r, 0 < weight r) (hw1 : ∑ r, weight r = 1)
    (hfin : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), (cluster G ω (root i)).Finite) :
    OperatorBounded G (pc G) := by
  classical
  let : Countable V := countable_vertices hloc hconn
  let : Countable E := countable_edges hloc
  let : Nonempty E := nonempty_bonds_of_connected G hconn
  let : Nonempty ι := ⟨(hcov (Classical.arbitrary V)).choose⟩
  let c := ∑ i, (weight i)⁻¹
  have hc : 0 < c := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => inv_pos.mpr (hw i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hmin (i) : 1 ≤ c*weight i := by
    have hi : (weight i)⁻¹ ≤ c := Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j _ => (inv_pos.mpr (hw j)).le) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel₀ (hw i).ne'] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (hw i).le
  obtain ⟨d,P,hdpos,hd,hρ,hPs,hP⟩ := exists_strict_walk_operator G hloc hqt hh
  let a := (1:ℝ)/(2*d)
  have hdr : (0:ℝ) < d := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hdpos
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have had : a*d = 1/2 := by dsimp [a]; field_simp
  have hPe : ∀ x y, matrixCoeff P x y = (walkKernel G hloc a x y : ℂ) := hP
  have hPpos : PositiveRealMatrix P := by
    intro x y
    rw [hPe]
    refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
    exact walkKernel_nonneg G hloc d hd a ha.le (by rw [had]; norm_num) x y
  have hdiag (x) : 1/2 ≤ (matrixCoeff P x x).re := by
    rw [hPe,Complex.ofReal_re]
    exact walkKernel_lazy G hloc d hd a ha.le had.le x
  exact critical_bounded_of_fixed_data G hG hconn hloc hqt hh a ha root weight htr hcov hw hw1 c hc hmin
    P hPpos hPs.isSelfAdjoint hPe hdiag hρ d hd (pc_pos G hloc hqt)
    (pc_lt_one_of_nonamenable G hconn hloc hqt hh) hfin

end Percolation

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
theorem arbitrary_cayley {Λ : Type u} [Group Λ] [Group.FG Λ]
    (hna : ¬ AmenableGroup Λ) (S : Finset Λ)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S) (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set Λ) = ⊤)
    (h1 : 1 ∉ S) :
    OperatorBounded (cayleyGraph S) (pc (cayleyGraph S)) ∧
    pc (cayleyGraph S) < ptwo (cayleyGraph S) ∧
    ptwo (cayleyGraph S) ≤ pu (cayleyGraph S) ∧
    (∃ p₁ p₂ : unitInterval, pc (cayleyGraph S) < p₁ ∧ p₁ < p₂ ∧ p₂ < 1 ∧
      ∀ᵐ labels ∂(labelLaw : Measure (CayleyEdge S → unitInterval)),
        ∀ p ∈ Set.Icc p₁ p₂, (infiniteClusters (cayleyGraph S) (openEdges labels p)).Infinite) ∧
    (∀ p : unitInterval, pc (cayleyGraph S) < p → p < pu (cayleyGraph S) →
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂law p, (infiniteClusters (cayleyGraph S) ω).Infinite) := by
  classical
  let : Infinite Λ := infinite_of_nonamenable hna
  let G := cayleyGraph S
  have hconn : Connected G := cayley_connected S hgen
  have hloc : LocallyFinite G := cayley_locallyFinite S
  have hqt : QuasiTransitive G := cayley_quasiTransitive S
  have hh : 0 < hV G := cayley_hV_pos S hgen hna
  have hsimple : Function.Injective G := cayleyGraph_injective S
  have hloop : ∀ x, ¬ Adj G x x := cayley_loopless S hsym h1
  let : Countable Λ := countable_vertices hloc hconn
  let : Countable (CayleyEdge S) := countable_edges hloc
  let root : Unit → Λ := fun _ => 1
  let weight : Unit → ℝ := fun _ => 1
  have hw : ∀ i, 0 < weight i := fun _ => zero_lt_one
  have hw1 : ∑ i, weight i = 1 := by simp [weight]
  have htr : RootTransport root weight (vertexAut G) := cayley_rootTransport S
  have hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, ∃ a ∈ vertexAut G, a (root i) = x := by
    intro x
    exact ⟨(), Equiv.mulLeft x, cayley_translation_mem S x, mul_one x⟩
  have hfinite := critical_finite_ae_of_transport G hconn hloc hqt hh root weight htr hw hw1 hcov
  have hb : OperatorBounded G (pc G) := by
    apply critical_bounded_of_transport_finiteness G hsimple hconn hloc hqt hh
      root weight htr hcov hw hw1
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hfinite] with ω hω
    exact hω (root i)
  have hgap := strict_gap_of_critical_bounded G hloc hqt
    (pc_lt_one_of_nonamenable G hconn hloc hqt hh) hb
  have hm := mainConclusion_of_strict_gap G hconn hloc hqt hgap
  exact ⟨hb, hgap, hm.2.2.2.1, hm.2.2.2.2,
    fun p hc hu => infinitely_many_of_pc_lt_lt_pu G hconn hloc hqt p hc hu⟩

end Percolation

lemma amenableGroup_of_finite [Finite Λ] : AmenableGroup Λ := by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite Λ
  intro K ε hε
  refine ⟨Finset.univ, Finset.univ_nonempty, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  have he : (Finset.univ.image (fun x : Λ => x * g)) \ Finset.univ = ∅ :=
    Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mpr (Finset.subset_univ _)
  rw [he, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, Finset.card_univ]

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.rightDefect_le_boundary
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma rightDefect_le_boundary (S : Finset Λ)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set Λ) = ⊤) (g : Λ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ A : Finset Λ,
      rightDefect A g ≤ n * (vertexBoundary (cayleyGraph S) A).ncard := by
  have hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (S : Set Λ) := by rw [hgen]; trivial
  induction hg using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem g hg =>
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    intro A
    rw [one_mul]
    change (rightTranslate A g \ A).card ≤ _
    rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset]
    apply Set.ncard_le_ncard ?_ (finite_vertexBoundary _ (cayley_locallyFinite S) A)
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hy, hnot⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    exact ⟨hnot, x, hx, cayley_adj_of_mem S x g hg⟩
  | one =>
    exact ⟨0, fun A => by simp [rightDefect]⟩
  | mul g h hg hh ig ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ig
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨n + m, fun A => ?_⟩
    exact (rightDefect_mul_le A g h).trans (by simpa [add_mul] using Nat.add_le_add (hn A) (hm A))
  | inv g hg ig =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ig
    exact ⟨n, fun A => by simpa only [rightDefect_inv] using hn A⟩

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.rightDefect
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
noncomputable def rightDefect (A : Finset Λ) (g : Λ) : ℕ :=
  (rightTranslate A g \ A).card

omit [Group Λ] in

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.name: OAI.Percolation.exists_strict_walk_operator
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.text:
theorem exists_strict_walk_operator (G : BondGraph V E) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)
    (hqt : QuasiTransitive G) (hh : 0 < hV G) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (P : Hilbert V →L[ℂ] Hilbert V), 0 < D ∧
      (∀ x, degree G x ≤ D) ∧ ‖P‖ < 1 ∧ P.toLinearMap.IsSymmetric ∧
      ∀ x y, P (lp.single 2 y (1:ℂ)) x =
        (walkKernel G hloc (1/(2*(D:ℝ))) x y : ℂ) := by
  obtain ⟨D,hDp,hD⟩ := exists_degree_bound G hqt
  have hDp' : 0 < (D:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hDp
  have ha : 0 < (1:ℝ)/(2*D) := by positivity
  have haD : (1:ℝ)/(2*D)*D ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨P,_,hPs,hP⟩ := exists_walk_operator G hloc D hD _ ha.le haD
  exact ⟨D,P,hDp,hD,walk_operator_norm_lt_one G hloc hh D hDp hD _ ha haD P hP,hPs,hP⟩

end SymmetricWalk

section PositiveConnectionKernel
open scoped ComplexOrder Matrix
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.critical_finite_count_empty_ae
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem critical_finite_count_empty_ae [Infinite V] (G : BondGraph V E)
    (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G) (hqt : QuasiTransitive G)
    (hh : 0 < hV G) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), (infiniteClusters G ω).Finite → infiniteClusters G ω = ∅ := by
  let : Countable V := countable_vertices hloc hconn
  let : Countable E := countable_edges hloc
  have ha (x : V) (R : Finset V) :
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), ¬((cluster G ω x).Infinite ∧ InfiniteCover G R ω) := by
    apply ae_iff.mpr
    simpa only [not_not] using critical_infiniteCover_survival_zero G hconn hloc hqt hh x R
  have hall : ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), ∀ x : V, ∀ R : Finset V,
      ¬((cluster G ω x).Infinite ∧ InfiniteCover G R ω) := by
    exact ae_all_iff.mpr fun x => ae_all_iff.mpr (ha x)
  filter_upwards [hall] with ω hω
  intro hfin
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hn
  obtain ⟨hx,x,rfl⟩ := hC
  let f : Set V → V := fun C => if hc : C ∈ infiniteClusters G ω then
    Classical.choose hc.2 else x
  have hf (C : Set V) (hC : C ∈ infiniteClusters G ω) : C = cluster G ω (f C) := by
    simp only [f,dite_eq_left hC]
    exact Classical.choose_spec hC.2
  let R : Finset V := hfin.toFinset.image f
  apply hω x R ⟨hx,?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hc : cluster G ω y ∈ infiniteClusters G ω := ⟨hy,y,rfl⟩
  refine ⟨f (cluster G ω y),Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_,hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hc,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  have he := hf _ hc
  exact (Set.ext_iff.mp he _).mpr (mem_cluster_self G ω (f (cluster G ω y)))

end Percolation

end OAI

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.name: OAI.Percolation.walkKernel
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.text:
noncomputable def walkKernel (G : BondGraph V E) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)
    (a : ℝ) (x y : V) : ℝ :=
  (if x = y then 1 - a * (neighbors G hloc x).card else 0) +
    (if Adj G x y then a else 0)

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayleyGraph
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
def cayleyGraph {Λ : Type u} [Group Λ] (S : Finset Λ) :
    BondGraph Λ (CayleyEdge S) := Subtype.val

section GroupGeometry
variable {Λ : Type u} [Group Λ]
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable Classical.decEq

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.name: OAI.Percolation.walkKernel_nonneg
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.text:
theorem walkKernel_nonneg (G : BondGraph V E) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)
    (D : ℕ) (hD : ∀ x, degree G x ≤ D) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haD : a*D ≤ 1)
    (x y : V) : 0 ≤ walkKernel G hloc a x y := by
  have hn : ((neighbors G hloc x).card : ℝ) ≤ D := by
    exact_mod_cast (neighbors_card_le_degree G hloc x).trans (hD x)
  have hh : 0 ≤ 1-a*(neighbors G hloc x).card := by nlinarith
  unfold walkKernel
  split_ifs <;> positivity

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Es.name: OAI.Percolation.walkKernel_lazy
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Es.text:
theorem walkKernel_lazy (G : BondGraph V E) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)
    (D : ℕ) (hD : ∀ x, degree G x ≤ D) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haD : a*D ≤ 1/2)
    (x : V) : 1/2 ≤ walkKernel G hloc a x x := by
  have hn : ((neighbors G hloc x).card : ℝ) ≤ D := by
    exact_mod_cast (neighbors_card_le_degree G hloc x).trans (hD x)
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn ha
  simp only [walkKernel,ite_true]
  split_ifs <;> linarith

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.infinitely_many_of_pc_lt_lt_pu
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem infinitely_many_of_pc_lt_lt_pu [Infinite V]
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)
    (hqt : QuasiTransitive G) (p : unitInterval) (hc : pc G < p) (hu : p < pu G) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂law p, (infiniteClusters G ω).Infinite := by
  let : Countable V := countable_vertices hloc hconn
  let : Countable E := countable_edges hloc
  have he : ∀ᵐ ω ∂law p, (infiniteClusters G ω).Nonempty := by
    rw [← map_openEdges p]
    apply (ae_map_iff (measurable_openEdges p).aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · simpa only [infiniteClusters_nonempty_iff] using ae_exists_infinite_cluster_of_pc_lt G p hc
    · simpa only [infiniteClusters_nonempty_iff] using measurableSet_exists_infinite_cluster G
  filter_upwards [he, finite_count_empty_ae_of_lt_pu G hconn hloc hqt p
    ((pc_pos G hloc hqt).trans hc) hu] with ω hne hf
  intro hfin
  exact hne.ne_empty (hf hfin)
end Percolation

end OAI

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_quasiTransitive
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_quasiTransitive (S : Finset Λ) : QuasiTransitive (cayleyGraph S) := by
  refine ⟨{1}, ?_⟩
  intro x
  exact ⟨1, Finset.mem_singleton_self _, Equiv.mulLeft x, cayleyEdgeTranslation S x,
    cayley_translation_isAut S x, mul_one x⟩

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_rootTransport
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_rootTransport (S : Finset Λ) :
    RootTransport (fun _ : Unit => (1 : Λ)) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
      (vertexAut (cayleyGraph S)) := by
  intro m hm hr hc
  simp only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
  calc
    (∑' y, m 1 y) = ∑' y, m y⁻¹ 1 := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro y
      simpa using (hm (Equiv.mulLeft y⁻¹) (cayley_translation_mem S y⁻¹) 1 y).symm
    _ = ∑' x, m x 1 := (Equiv.inv Λ).tsum_eq (fun x => m x 1)

end GroupGeometry
end Percolation

end OAI

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_hV_pos
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_hV_pos (S : Finset Λ) (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set Λ) = ⊤)
    (hna : ¬ AmenableGroup Λ) : 0 < hV (cayleyGraph S) := by
  by_contra hh
  apply hna
  intro K ε hε
  choose n hn using rightDefect_le_boundary S hgen
  let N : ℕ := (∑ g ∈ K, n g) + 1
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < N := by dsimp [N]; positivity
  have hng (g : Λ) (hg : g ∈ K) : n g ≤ N :=
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hg).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  let B : Set ℝ := {r | ∃ A : Finset Λ, A.Nonempty ∧
    r = (vertexBoundary (cayleyGraph S) A).ncard / (A.card : ℝ)}
  have hb : BddBelow B := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro r ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
    positivity
  have hB : B.Nonempty :=
    ⟨_, {1}, Finset.singleton_nonempty 1, rfl⟩
  have hlt : sInf B < ε / N :=
    (le_of_not_gt hh).trans_lt (div_pos hε hN)
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩, hr⟩ := (csInf_lt_iff hb hB).mp hlt
  have hAc : (0 : ℝ) < A.card := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hA.card_pos
  have hbound : (N : ℝ) * (vertexBoundary (cayleyGraph S) A).ncard < ε * A.card := by
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ hAc).mp hr
    have hh' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hh hN
    have heq : (N : ℝ) * (ε / N * A.card) = ε * A.card := by
      field_simp
    rwa [heq] at hh'
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  have hd : (rightDefect A g : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) *
      (vertexBoundary (cayleyGraph S) A).ncard := by
    exact_mod_cast (hn g A).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hng g hg))
  exact hd.trans_lt hbound

end GroupGeometry
end Percolation

end OAI

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.name: OAI.Percolation.vertexAut
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.text: def vertexAut (G : BondGraph V E) : Set (V ≃ V) := {a | ∃ b : E ≃ E, IsAut G a b}

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_adj_of_mem
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_adj_of_mem (S : Finset Λ) (x s : Λ) (hs : s ∈ S) :
    Adj (cayleyGraph S) x (x * s) :=
  ⟨⟨s(x, x * s), x, s, hs, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.infinite_of_nonamenable
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma infinite_of_nonamenable (h : ¬ AmenableGroup Λ) : Infinite Λ := by
  by_contra hi
  let : Finite Λ := not_infinite_iff_finite.mp hi
  exact h amenableGroup_of_finite

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayleyEdgeTranslation
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
noncomputable def cayleyEdgeTranslation (S : Finset Λ) (a : Λ) : CayleyEdge S ≃ CayleyEdge S where
  toFun e := ⟨e.val.map (fun x => a * x), by
    obtain ⟨e, x, s, hs, rfl⟩ := e
    exact ⟨a * x, s, hs, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩⟩
  invFun e := ⟨e.val.map (fun x => a⁻¹ * x), by
    obtain ⟨e, x, s, hs, rfl⟩ := e
    exact ⟨a⁻¹ * x, s, hs, by simp [mul_assoc]⟩⟩
  left_inv e := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [Sym2.map_map]
  right_inv e := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [Sym2.map_map]

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.name: OAI.Percolation.matrixCoeff
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.text:
noncomputable def matrixCoeff (A : Hilbert V →L[ℂ] Hilbert V) (x y : V) : ℂ :=
  A (lp.single 2 y (1:ℂ)) x

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.AmenableGroup
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
noncomputable def AmenableGroup (Λ : Type u) [Group Λ] : Prop := by
  classical
  exact ∀ K : Finset Λ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ A : Finset Λ, A.Nonempty ∧
    ∀ g ∈ K, (((A.image (fun x => x * g)) \ A).card : ℝ) < ε * A.card

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_locallyFinite
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_locallyFinite (S : Finset Λ) : LocallyFinite (cayleyGraph S) := by
  intro x
  let F : Set (Sym2 Λ) :=
    ((fun s => s(x, x * s)) '' (S : Set Λ)) ∪
    ((fun s => s(x * s⁻¹, x)) '' (S : Set Λ))
  have hF : F.Finite :=
    (S.finite_toSet.image _).union (S.finite_toSet.image _)
  apply (hF.preimage (cayleyGraph_injective S).injOn).subset
  rintro ⟨e, z, s, hs, rfl⟩ hx
  change x ∈ s(z, z * s) at hx
  rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hx with hx | hx
  · left
    exact ⟨s, hs, by simp [hx, cayleyGraph]⟩
  · right
    refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
    simp [hx, cayleyGraph]

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_connected
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_connected (S : Finset Λ) (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set Λ) = ⊤) :
    Connected (cayleyGraph S) := by
  have paths (g : Λ) : ∀ x : Λ,
      Relation.ReflTransGen (Adj (cayleyGraph S)) x (x * g) := by
    have hg : g ∈ Subgroup.closure (S : Set Λ) := by rw [hgen]; trivial
    induction hg using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem g hg => exact fun x => .single (cayley_adj_of_mem S x g hg)
    | one => intro x; simpa using (Relation.ReflTransGen.refl (a := x))
    | mul a b ha hb ia ib =>
      intro x
      simpa [mul_assoc] using (ia x).trans (ib (x * a))
    | inv a ha ia =>
      intro x
      have h := ia (x * a⁻¹)
      rw [inv_mul_cancel_right] at h
      let : Std.Symm (Adj (cayleyGraph S)) := ⟨fun _ _ => adj_symm (cayleyGraph S)⟩
      exact symm h
  intro x y
  simpa using paths (x⁻¹ * y) x

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_translation_mem
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_translation_mem (S : Finset Λ) (a : Λ) :
    Equiv.mulLeft a ∈ vertexAut (cayleyGraph S) :=
  ⟨cayleyEdgeTranslation S a, cayley_translation_isAut S a⟩

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_adj_iff
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_adj_iff (S : Finset Λ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S) (x y : Λ) :
    Adj (cayleyGraph S) x y ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, x * s = y := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨e, z, s, hs, rfl⟩, he⟩
    change s(z, z * s) = s(x, y) at he
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp he with ⟨hz, hy⟩ | ⟨hz, hx⟩
    ·
      exact ⟨s, hs, hz ▸ hy⟩
    · refine ⟨s⁻¹, hS s hs, ?_⟩
      rw [← hx, mul_inv_cancel_right, hz]
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact cayley_adj_of_mem S x s hs

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.CayleyEdge
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
def CayleyEdge {Λ : Type u} [Group Λ] (S : Finset Λ) :=
  {e : Sym2 Λ // ∃ x : Λ, ∃ s ∈ S, e = s(x, x * s)}

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.name: OAI.Percolation.adj_symm
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.text:
theorem adj_symm (G : BondGraph V E) {x y : V} (h : Adj G x y) : Adj G y x := by
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e,he.trans (Sym2.eq_swap)⟩

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.name: OAI.Percolation.cayley_loopless
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ca.text:
lemma cayley_loopless (S : Finset Λ) (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S) (h1 : 1 ∉ S)
    (x : Λ) : ¬ Adj (cayleyGraph S) x x := by
  rintro hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs, he⟩ := (cayley_adj_iff S hS x x).mp hx
  have : s = 1 := mul_left_cancel (by simpa using he : x * s = x * 1)
  exact h1 (this ▸ hs)

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.nonempty_bonds_of_connected
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem nonempty_bonds_of_connected [Infinite V] (G : BondGraph V E) (hconn : Connected G) : Nonempty E := by
  classical
  by_contra he
  let : IsEmpty E := not_nonempty_iff.mp he
  obtain ⟨x,y,hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne V
  have hh := conn_univ_of_connected G hconn x y
  have heq : (Set.univ : Set E) = ∅ := Set.eq_empty_of_isEmpty _
  rw [heq,conn_empty_iff] at hh
  exact hxy hh

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.critical_finite_count_ae_of_transport
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem critical_finite_count_ae_of_transport [Infinite V] [Fintype ι]
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)
    (hqt : QuasiTransitive G) (hh : 0 < hV G)
    (root : ι → V) (weight : ι → ℝ)
    (htr : RootTransport root weight (vertexAut G)) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < weight i)
    (hw1 : ∑ i, weight i = 1)
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, ∃ a ∈ vertexAut G, a (root i) = x) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), (infiniteClusters G ω).Finite := by
  let : Countable V := countable_vertices hloc hconn
  let : Countable E := countable_edges hloc
  have hp := pc_pos G hloc hqt
  have hp1 := pc_lt_one_of_nonamenable G hconn hloc hqt hh
  have he (F P : Finset E) (x : V) :
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), P ⊆ F → ¬ IsEncounter G (finiteOverwrite F P ω) x := by
    by_cases hPF : P ⊆ F
    · have hz := finiteOverwrite_preimage_zero (pc G) hp hp1 F P hPF
        {ω | IsEncounter G ω x} (measurableSet_isEncounter G x)
        (critical_encounter_zero G hconn hloc hp root weight htr hw hw1 hcov x)
      apply ae_iff.mpr
      simpa only [hPF,true_implies,not_not,Set.preimage_ofPred_eq] using hz
    · filter_upwards [] with ω
      exact fun h => False.elim (hPF h)
  have hall : ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), ∀ F P : Finset E, ∀ x : V,
      P ⊆ F → ¬ IsEncounter G (finiteOverwrite F P ω) x :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun F => ae_all_iff.mpr fun P => ae_all_iff.mpr (he F P)
  filter_upwards [hall] with ω hω
  by_contra hinf
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hsep⟩ := three_of_infinite_count G ω hinf
  obtain ⟨F,P,hPF,x,hx⟩ := encounter_surgery_of_three G hconn hloc ω z hz hsep
  exact hω F P x hPF hx

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.finite_count_empty_ae_of_lt_pu
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem finite_count_empty_ae_of_lt_pu [Infinite V]
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)
    (hqt : QuasiTransitive G) (p : unitInterval) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp : p < pu G) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂law p, (infiniteClusters G ω).Finite → infiniteClusters G ω = ∅ := by
  let : Countable V := countable_vertices hloc hconn
  let : Countable E := countable_edges hloc
  have hp1 : p < 1 := hp.trans_le (pu G).2.2
  have ha (x : V) (R : Finset V) :
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂law p, ¬((cluster G ω x).Infinite ∧ InfiniteCover G R ω) := by
    have hz : law p {ω | (cluster G ω x).Infinite ∧ InfiniteCover G R ω} = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have ht := unique_pos_of_cover_pos G hconn p hp0 hp1 x R (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr h)
      rw [unique_probability_zero_of_lt_pu G hconn hloc hqt p hp] at ht
      exact lt_irrefl _ ht
    apply ae_iff.mpr
    simpa only [not_not] using hz
  have hall : ∀ᵐ ω ∂law p, ∀ x : V, ∀ R : Finset V,
      ¬((cluster G ω x).Infinite ∧ InfiniteCover G R ω) :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun x => ae_all_iff.mpr (ha x)
  filter_upwards [hall] with ω hω
  intro hfin
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hn
  obtain ⟨hx, x, rfl⟩ := hC
  let f : Set V → V := fun C => if hc : C ∈ infiniteClusters G ω then
    Classical.choose hc.2 else x
  have hf (C : Set V) (hC : C ∈ infiniteClusters G ω) : C = cluster G ω (f C) := by
    simp only [f, dite_eq_left hC]
    exact Classical.choose_spec hC.2
  let R : Finset V := hfin.toFinset.image f
  apply hω x R ⟨hx, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hc : cluster G ω y ∈ infiniteClusters G ω := ⟨hy, y, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨f (cluster G ω y), Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hc, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  have he := hf _ hc
  exact (Set.ext_iff.mp he _).mpr (mem_cluster_self G ω (f (cluster G ω y)))

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.name: OAI.Percolation.operatorBounded_of_quantitative_gap
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.text:
theorem operatorBounded_of_quantitative_gap [Countable V] [Countable E]
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hloc : LocallyFinite G) (D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ x, degree G x ≤ D) (p r : unitInterval)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hpr : p < r) (hr : r < 1)
    (A : Hilbert V →L[ℂ] Hilbert V) (hA : HasKernel G p A)
    (hsmall : ((r:ℝ)-(p:ℝ))*(4*D)*‖A‖ < 1-(r:ℝ)) : OperatorBounded G r := by
  let a := ((r:ℝ)-(p:ℝ))/(1-(r:ℝ))
  have hden : 0 < 1-(r:ℝ) := sub_pos.mpr hr
  have ha : 0 < a := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hpr) hden
  obtain ⟨m,q,hq,hqp⟩ := exists_orParameter_small p (hpr.trans hr) (min a 1)
    (lt_min ha zero_lt_one) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q := by
    by_contra hn
    have hqe : q = 0 := Subtype.ext ((le_of_not_gt hn).antisymm q.2.1)
    have hpe : p = 0 := by rw [←hqp,hqe]; apply Subtype.ext; simp [orParameter]
    exact (ne_of_gt hp) hpe
  let n := ⌈a/(q:ℝ)⌉₊
  have hna : a ≤ (n:ℝ)*(q:ℝ) := (div_le_iff₀ hq0).mp (Nat.le_ceil _)
  have han : (n:ℝ)*(q:ℝ) < a+(q:ℝ) := by
    have hn := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg ha.le hq0.le)
    have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hn hq0
    dsimp only [n] at *
    field_simp at hh
    nlinarith
  have hn2 : (n:ℝ)*(q:ℝ) < 2*a := by linarith [hq.trans (min_le_left _ _)]
  have hbase : (2*a)*(2*D)*‖A‖ < 1 := by
    rw [show (2*a)*(2*D)*‖A‖ = (((r:ℝ)-(p:ℝ))*(4*D)*‖A‖)/(1-(r:ℝ)) by dsimp [a]; ring]
    exact (div_lt_one hden).mpr hsmall
  have hnsmall : (q:ℝ)*(2*D)*(n:ℝ)*‖A‖ < 1 := by
    have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn2.le (show 0 ≤ (2*(D:ℝ))*‖A‖ by positivity)
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨B,hB,_⟩ := sprinkling_iterated_bound G hloc q m D hD A (hqp ▸ hA) n hnsmall
  apply operatorBounded_of_le G (q := orParameter q (m+n)) ?_ ⟨B,hB⟩
  have hgap := orParameter_gap_bound p q m n hqp
  have hae : a*(1-(r:ℝ)) = (r:ℝ)-(p:ℝ) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hden)
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hna hden.le
  change (r:ℝ) ≤ (orParameter q (m+n):ℝ)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) q.2.1]

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.critical_bounded_of_fixed_data
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem critical_bounded_of_fixed_data
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hG : Function.Injective G)
    (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G) (hqt : QuasiTransitive G) (hh : 0 < hV G)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (root : ι → V) (weight : ι → ℝ)
    (htr : RootTransport root weight (vertexAut G))
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ r, ∃ g ∈ vertexAut G, g (root r) = x)
    (hw : ∀ r, 0 < weight r) (hw1 : ∑ r, weight r = 1)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hmin : ∀ r, 1 ≤ c*weight r)
    (P : Hilbert V →L[ℂ] Hilbert V) (hpos : PositiveRealMatrix P) (hsym : IsSelfAdjoint P)
    (hP : ∀ x y, matrixCoeff P x y = (walkKernel G hloc a x y : ℂ))
    (hdiag : ∀ x, 1/2 ≤ (matrixCoeff P x x).re) (hρ : ‖P‖ < 1)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : ∀ z, degree G z ≤ d)
    (hpcrit : 0 < (pc G:ℝ)) (hpcrit₁ : (pc G:ℝ) < 1)
    (hfin : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), (cluster G ω (root i)).Finite) :
    OperatorBounded G (pc G) := by
  by_contra hu
  obtain ⟨C,hC,J,hJ,C₁,hC₁,k₀,hk₀,ε,M,hε,_,hbad⟩ :=
    exists_finite_scale_obstruction G hG hconn hloc hqt a ha root weight htr hcov hw hw1 c hc hmin
      P hpos hsym hP hdiag hρ d hd hpcrit hpcrit₁
  let p := criticalApproach (pc G)
  have hpnear (n) : (pc G:ℝ)/2 ≤ (p n:ℝ) := criticalApproach_half (pc G) n
  have hp (n) : p n < pc G := criticalApproach_lt (pc G) hpcrit n
  have hpzero (n) : 0 < (p n:ℝ) := (half_pos hpcrit).trans_le (hpnear n)
  let A := fun n => Classical.choose (operatorBounded_of_lt_pc G hloc hqt (p n) (hp n))
  have hA (n) : HasKernel G (p n) (A n) := Classical.choose_spec (operatorBounded_of_lt_pc G hloc hqt (p n) (hp n))
  let m := fun n => ‖A n‖
  let R := fun n => maxSusceptibility G (p n)/m n
  let Q := fun n => rootTriangle G root weight (p n:ℝ)
  have hR (n) : 1 ≤ R n := (one_le_div (zero_lt_one.trans_le ((hA n).norm_one_le G (p n) (A n)))).mpr
    ((hA n).norm_le_maxSusceptibility G hloc hqt (p n) (hp n) (A n))
  have hQ (n) : 1 ≤ Q n := rootTriangle_one_le G hloc hqt root weight (fun i => (hw i).le) hw1 (p n) (hp n)
  have hlogR : Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (R n)/(n:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply log_sublinear_of_geometric_gap R ((pc G:ℝ)/2) (half_pos hpcrit) hR
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨K,hK,hRK⟩ := critical_normRatio_subpower G hloc hconn hqt hh root weight (vertexAut G)
      (Set.Subset.refl _) htr hcov hw hw1 hpcrit hpcrit₁ hfin hu η hη
    refine ⟨K,hK,fun n => ?_⟩
    simpa only [p,criticalApproach_gap] using (hRK (p n) (hpnear n) (hp n) (A n) (hA n)).2
  have hlogQ : Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (Q n)/(n:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply log_sublinear_of_geometric_gap Q ((pc G:ℝ)/2) (half_pos hpcrit) hQ
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨K,hK,hQK⟩ := critical_rootTriangle_subpower G hloc hconn hqt hh root weight (vertexAut G)
      (Set.Subset.refl _) htr hcov hw hw1 hpcrit hpcrit₁ hfin η hη
    refine ⟨K,hK,fun n => ?_⟩
    simpa only [p,criticalApproach_gap] using hQK (p n) (hpnear n) (hp n)
  obtain ⟨cm,hcm,hm⟩ := critical_norm_inverse_lower G hloc hqt hpcrit₁ hu
  have hmlower (n : ℕ) : (cm/((pc G:ℝ)/2))*Real.exp (n:ℝ) ≤ m n := by
    have hh := hm (p n) (hpzero n) (hp n) (A n) (hA n)
    rw [show (pc G:ℝ)-(p n:ℝ) = (pc G:ℝ)/2*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)) from criticalApproach_gap (pc G) n,
      Real.exp_neg,div_mul_eq_div_div,div_inv_eq_mul] at hh
    exact hh
  have hρpos : 0 < ‖P‖ := by
    let x : V := Classical.arbitrary V
    have hh := (hdiag x).trans ((Complex.re_le_norm _).trans (matrixCoeff_norm_le P x x))
    linarith only [hh]
  obtain ⟨n,k,B,hk,hB,hsmall,htime,herror,hlarge⟩ := exists_corridor_scales
    ‖P‖ ((pc G:ℝ)/2) C C₁ ε M (cm/((pc G:ℝ)/2)) J k₀ hρpos hρ (half_pos hpcrit) hC hC₁ hε
    (div_pos hcm (half_pos hpcrit)) hJ m R Q hR hQ hmlower hlogR hlogQ
  exact hbad (p n) (hpnear n) (hp n) (A n) (hA n) k hk B hB hsmall htime herror hlarge

end AnalyticCritical

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.critical_finite_ae_of_transport
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem critical_finite_ae_of_transport [Infinite V] [Fintype ι]
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hconn : Connected G) (hloc : LocallyFinite G)
    (hqt : QuasiTransitive G) (hh : 0 < hV G)
    (root : ι → V) (weight : ι → ℝ)
    (htr : RootTransport root weight (vertexAut G)) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < weight i)
    (hw1 : ∑ i, weight i = 1)
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, ∃ a ∈ vertexAut G, a (root i) = x) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂law (pc G), ∀ x, (cluster G ω x).Finite := by
  filter_upwards [critical_finite_count_ae_of_transport G hconn hloc hqt hh
    root weight htr hw hw1 hcov,critical_finite_count_empty_ae G hconn hloc hqt hh] with ω hf he
  have hempty := he hf
  intro x
  by_contra hx
  have hc : cluster G ω x ∈ infiniteClusters G ω := ⟨hx,x,rfl⟩
  rw [hempty] at hc
  exact hc

end Percolation

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.name: OAI.Percolation.strict_gap_of_critical_bounded
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Cr.text:
theorem strict_gap_of_critical_bounded [Countable V] [Countable E]
    (G : BondGraph V E) (hloc : LocallyFinite G) (hqt : QuasiTransitive G)
    (hp1 : pc G < 1) (hb : OperatorBounded G (pc G)) : pc G < ptwo G := by
  obtain ⟨D, hDpos, hD⟩ := exists_degree_bound G hqt
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hb
  let c : ℝ := (4 * D) * ‖A‖
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  let ε : ℝ := (1 - (pc G : ℝ)) / (2 * (c + 1))
  have hε : 0 < ε := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hp1) (by positivity)
  have heq : ε * (2 * (c + 1)) = 1 - (pc G : ℝ) :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (c + 1)))
  have hr1 : (pc G : ℝ) + ε < 1 := by nlinarith
  let r : unitInterval := ⟨(pc G : ℝ) + ε, add_nonneg (pc G).2.1 hε.le, hr1.le⟩
  have hpr : pc G < r := by change (pc G : ℝ) < (pc G : ℝ) + ε; linarith
  have hrb : OperatorBounded G r := by
    apply operatorBounded_of_quantitative_gap G hloc D hD (pc G) r
      (pc_pos G hloc hqt) hpr hr1 A hA
    change (((pc G : ℝ) + ε) - (pc G : ℝ)) * (4 * D) * ‖A‖ < 1 - ((pc G : ℝ) + ε)
    have he : (((pc G : ℝ) + ε) - (pc G : ℝ)) * (4 * D) * ‖A‖ = ε * c := by
      dsimp [c]
      ring
    rw [he]
    nlinarith
  exact hpr.trans_le (le_sSup hrb)

OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.name: OAI.Percolation.RootTransport
OAI.Probability.UnimodularPercolation.Ke.text:
def RootTransport (Γ : Set (V ≃ V)) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : V → V → ℂ,
    (∀ a ∈ Γ, ∀ x y, m (a x) (a y) = m x y) →
    (∀ x, Summable (m x)) → (∀ y, Summable (fun x => m x y)) →
    (∑ i, (weight i : ℂ) * ∑' y, m (root i) y) =
    (∑ i, (weight i : ℂ) * ∑' x, m x (root i))

OAI.Analysis.CharacterCriterion.Definiti.text:
abbrev Algebra (A : Type*) [CStarAlgebra A] (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) :=
  OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.BoundedSeq A ⧸ OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.nullIdeal (A := A) ω

noncomputable instance quotientNormedRing {R : Type uQuot} [NormedRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    [I.IsTwoSided] [IsClosed (I : Set R)] : NormedRing (R ⧸ I) :=
  KirchbergRordam.QuotientNormSupport.normedRing I

instance quotientNormedAlgebra (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) : NormedAlgebra ℂ (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.Algebra A ω) where
  norm_smul_le := norm_smul_le

instance quotientStar (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) : Star (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.Algebra A ω) := by
  classical
  have h_NormUltrapower_exists_norm_limit  (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) (x : OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.BoundedSeq A) :
      ∃ r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) ‖x‖, Tendsto (fun n => ‖x n‖) (ω : Filter ℕ) (𝓝 r) := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := isCompact_Icc.ultrafilter_le_nhds'
      (Ultrafilter.map (fun n => ‖x n‖) ω) (by
        change ∀ᶠ n in (ω : Filter ℕ), ‖x n‖ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) ‖x‖
        exact Eventually.of_forall fun n => ⟨norm_nonneg _, x.norm_coe_le_norm n⟩)
    exact ⟨r, hr, h⟩
  have h_NormUltrapower_tendsto_norm  (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) (x : OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.BoundedSeq A) :
      Tendsto (fun n => ‖x n‖) (ω : Filter ℕ) (𝓝 (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.normLimit ω x)) :=
    (h_NormUltrapower_exists_norm_limit ω x).choose_spec.2
  have h_NormUltrapower_normLimit_star  (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) (x : OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.BoundedSeq A) :
      OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.normLimit ω (star x) = OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.normLimit ω x := by
    apply tendsto_nhds_unique (h_NormUltrapower_tendsto_norm ω (star x))
    simp [h_NormUltrapower_tendsto_norm]
  exact {
    star := Quotient.map' star fun x y h => by
      rw [Submodule.quotientRel_def] at h ⊢
      change OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.normLimit ω (star x - star y) = 0
      rw [← star_sub, h_NormUltrapower_normLimit_star]
      exact h
  }

instance quotientStarRing (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) : StarRing (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.Algebra A ω) where
  star_involutive := by
    rintro ⟨x⟩
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.nullIdeal ω) (star (star x)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x
    rw [star_star]
  star_mul := by
    rintro ⟨x⟩ ⟨y⟩
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.nullIdeal ω) (star (x*y)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (star y * star x)
    rw [star_mul]
  star_add := by
    rintro ⟨x⟩ ⟨y⟩
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.nullIdeal ω) (star (x+y)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (star x + star y)
    rw [star_add]

instance quotientStarModule (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) : StarModule ℂ (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.Algebra A ω) where
  star_smul := by
    intro z
    rintro ⟨x⟩
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (OAI.KirchbergRordam.NormUltrapower.nullIdeal ω) (star (z • x)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (star z • star x)
    rw [star_smul]

OAI.Analysis.CharacterCriterion.Main:23.name: OAI.KirchbergRordam.unitalCharacter
OAI.Analysis.CharacterCriterion.Main:23.text:
def unitalCharacter {A : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A]
    (χ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] ℂ) (hχ : χ≠0) : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun := χ
  map_zero' := map_zero χ
  map_one' := nonzero_character_one χ hχ
  map_add' := map_add χ
  map_mul' := map_mul χ
  commutes' z := by
    change χ (algebraMap ℂ A z)=z
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,map_smul,nonzero_character_one χ hχ,
      smul_eq_mul,mul_one]
  map_star' := map_star χ

  classical
  have h_StarCompletion_star_coe  (x : R) : star (x : Completion R) = (star x : R) :=
    Completion.map_coe star_isometry.uniformContinuous x
  exact {
    star_involutive x := by
      induction x using Completion.induction_on with
      | hp => exact isClosed_eq (continuous_star.comp continuous_star) continuous_id
      | ih x => simp only [h_StarCompletion_star_coe, star_star]
    star_mul x y := by
      induction x, y using Completion.induction_on₂ with
      | hp => exact isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      | ih x y => simp only [← Completion.coe_mul, h_StarCompletion_star_coe, star_mul]
    star_add x y := by
      induction x, y using Completion.induction_on₂ with
      | hp => exact isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      | ih x y => simp only [← Completion.coe_add, h_StarCompletion_star_coe, star_add]
  }

  norm_smul_le := norm_smul_le

instance completionStarModule : StarModule ℂ (Completion R) := by

  have h_StarCompletion_star_coe  (x : R) : star (x : Completion R) = (star x : R) :=
    Completion.map_coe star_isometry.uniformContinuous x
  exact {
    star_smul z x := by
      induction x using Completion.induction_on with
      | hp =>
        exact isClosed_eq
          (continuous_star.comp (continuous_const_smul z))
          ((continuous_const_smul (star z)).comp continuous_star)
      | ih x =>
        rw [← Completion.coe_smul, h_StarCompletion_star_coe, star_smul, Completion.coe_smul, h_StarCompletion_star_coe]
  }

      | ih x =>
        rw [(h_StarCompletion_star_coe), ← UniformSpace.Completion.coe_mul]
        simpa only [UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe] using CStarRing.norm_mul_self_le x
  }

 haltList machine (GaussMachine.boolCode b) := by

OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.QueryMachine:.name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.polynomial_eval_mono
OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.QueryMachine:.text:
lemma polynomial_eval_mono (p : Polynomial ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : p.eval a ≤ p.eval b := by
 induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
 | add p q hp hq => simpa only [Polynomial.eval_add] using add_le_add hp hq
 | monomial n c => simpa only [Polynomial.eval_monomial] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h n)

OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.QueryMachine:.name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.polynomialAlgorithm
OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.QueryMachine:.text:
noncomputable def polynomialAlgorithm :
 TM2ComputableInPolyTime TableMachine.code GaussMachine.boolCode answer := by
 let p := Classical.choose time_polynomial
 have hp := Classical.choose_spec time_polynomial
 refine ⟨⟨machine,Equiv.refl _,Equiv.refl _⟩,p,?_⟩
 rintro ⟨N,S⟩
 let m := Classical.choose (program_runs S)
 have hm := (Classical.choose_spec (program_runs S)).1
 let h := Classical.choice (Classical.choose_spec (program_runs S)).2
 have hc := StackLang.Program.compiles h (.inl CounterLang.Reg.input) (.inr GaussMachine.Reg.output) (none,initialLocal)
 dsimp only [StackLang.Program.machine] at hc
 rw [initial_configuration ⟨N,S⟩,final_configuration] at hc
 change TM2OutputsInTime machine ((TableMachine.code ⟨N,S⟩).map id)
   (some ((GaussMachine.boolCode (answer ⟨N,S⟩)).map id)) (p.eval (TableMachine.code ⟨N,S⟩).length)
 dsimp only [machine, StackLang.Program.machine, TM2OutputsInTime]
 simp only [List.map_id, Option.map_some]
 refine ⟨hc.toEvalsTo,?_⟩
 have hn : N ≤ (TableMachine.code ⟨N,S⟩).length := by rw [code_length]; dsimp only; omega
 exact hc.steps_le_m.trans (hm.trans ((hp N).le.trans (polynomial_eval_mono p hn)))

end CPTSeparation.QueryMachine

end OAI

OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.QueryMachine:.name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.program_runs
OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.QueryMachine:.text:
lemma program_runs {N} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) :
 Runs program (combined (cs 0 (TableMachine.code ⟨N,S⟩) []) (GaussMachine.ctrl 0 true) {})
   (finalStore (SerialGaussian.solve (SerialGaussian.queryRows S))) (time N) := by
 have h₁ := (build_runs S).compiles.frameLeft ((none,GaussMachine.ctrl 0 true) : GaussMachine.Local)
   ({} : GaussMachine.Data).tapes
 have h₂ := transfers_runs
   (cs N (TableMachine.tableInput S) (SerialGaussian.payload (SerialGaussian.queryRows S)).reverse)
   (N+N) (SerialGaussian.payload (SerialGaussian.queryRows S)) rfl rfl
 have h₃ := solver_framed
   ({cs N (TableMachine.tableInput S) [] with nums := Function.update (TableMachine.headerNums N) .width 0})
   (SerialGaussian.queryRows S)
 have h₄ := finish_runs N (TableMachine.tableInput S) (SerialGaussian.solve (SerialGaussian.queryRows S))
 have h := h₁.seq (h₂.seq (h₃.seq h₄))
 convert h using 1
 · rfl
 · rfl
 · simp only [time,TableMachine.tableInput_length,SerialGaussian.payload_length,
     SerialGaussian.queryRows,List.length_map,OrderedQuery.rows_length]
   ring

OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.QueryMachine:.name: OAI.CPTSeparation.QueryMachine.time_polynomial
OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.QueryMachine:.text:
lemma time_polynomial : ∃ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∀ N, time N = p.eval N := by
 obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := Bounded.Program.time_polynomial MatrixProgram.program
 refine ⟨p + 2*(Polynomial.X+Polynomial.X^2)*(2*Polynomial.X+2) +
  300*(Polynomial.X+Polynomial.X^2+1)*(2*Polynomial.X+3)^2 +
  14*Polynomial.X+16*Polynomial.X^2+23, ?_⟩
 intro N
 simp [time,hp]
 ring

OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.Separation:7.name: OAI.CPTSeparation.main
OAI.ModelTheory.Choiceless.Separation:7.text:
theorem main :
    (∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (S : Input A) (T : Input B),
      S.Iso T → (S.query ↔ T.query)) ∧
    OrdinaryPolynomialTime ∧
    ¬ FullCPT.EvaluationDefinable (fun {_} [_] I => I.query) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, FullCPT.query_not_evaluationDefinable⟩
  · intro A B _ _ S T e
    exact Input.query_invariant e
  · refine ⟨QueryMachine.answer, QueryMachine.polynomialAlgorithm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      change Finite QueryMachine.Letter
      infer_instance
    · intro A _ N e S
      let iso : S.Iso (S.ordered e) :=
        { toEquiv := e
          rel_eq := by intro r x y; simp [Input.ordered] }
      exact (QueryMachine.answer_correct ⟨N,S.ordered e⟩).trans
        (Input.query_invariant iso).symm

end CPTSeparation

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.TwoA.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.exists_two_adic_square_decomposition_of_positive_square
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.TwoA.text:
theorem exists_two_adic_square_decomposition_of_positive_square {n : ℕ}
    (hsquare : ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ n = m ^ 2) (heven : Even n) :
    ∃ s u : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ 0 < u ∧ Odd u ∧ n = 2 ^ (2 * s) * u ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hnm⟩ := hsquare
  exact exists_two_adic_square_decomposition_of_eq_sq hm hnm heven

end CirculantHadamard

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Mode.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.RealMatrix
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Mode.text: abbrev RealMatrix (n : ℕ) := Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Orde.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.exists_odd_cyclic_projection
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Orde.text:
theorem exists_odd_cyclic_projection {n s u : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hu : Odd u) (heq : n = 2 ^ (2 * s) * u ^ 2)
    (f : CyclicRing.Elem ℤ n) (hsign : CyclicSignRow f)
    (hnorm : f * CyclicRing.ringStar f = CyclicRing.scalar n (n : ℤ)) :
    ∃ T : CyclicRing.Elem ℤ (2 ^ (2 * s)),
      (∀ a, Odd (T.coeff a)) ∧
        T * CyclicRing.ringStar T =
          CyclicRing.scalar _ ((2 ^ (2 * s) * u ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  let : NeZero (2 ^ (2 * s)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (by decide)⟩
  have hdiv : 2 ^ (2 * s) ∣ n := ⟨u ^ 2, heq⟩
  refine ⟨cyclicProjection ℤ hdiv f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact cyclicProjection_odd_coefficients hdiv heq hu.pow f hsign
  · calc
      _ = CyclicRing.scalar _ (n : ℤ) := cyclicProjection_norm hdiv hnorm
      _ = CyclicRing.scalar _ ((2 ^ (2 * s) * u ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [heq]

end CirculantHadamard

end

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Orde.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.order_reduction
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Orde.text:
theorem order_reduction {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n)
    (h : ExistsRealCirculantHadamard n) :
    ∃ u : ℕ, 0 < u ∧ Odd u ∧ n = 4 * u ^ 2 := by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨hsquare, heven⟩ := order_square_even hn h
  obtain ⟨s, u, hs, huPos, hu, horder⟩ :=
    exists_two_adic_square_decomposition_of_positive_square hsquare heven
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hnorm⟩ := (exists_cyclicSignRow_iff_real (n := n)).2 h
  have hsOne : s = 1 := by
    by_contra hsOne
    have hsTwo : 2 ≤ s := by omega
    obtain ⟨T, hodd, hTnorm⟩ :=
      exists_odd_cyclic_projection hu horder f hf hnorm
    exact odd_norm_impossible (by omega : 1 ≤ s) (by omega : s + 2 ≤ 2 * s)
      hu T hodd hTnorm
  refine ⟨u, huPos, hu, ?_⟩
  simpa [hsOne] using horder

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Mode.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.IsSignHadamard
OAI.CirculantHadamard.ExistsRealCirculantHadamard
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Mode.text:
def ExistsRealCirculantHadamard (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : RealMatrix n, IsCirculant H ∧ IsSignHadamard H

end CirculantHadamard

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Bina.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.binary_sign_norm_impossible
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Bina.text:
theorem binary_sign_norm_impossible {u : ℕ} [NeZero u]
    (hu : 1 < u) (hodd : Odd u)
    (f : Elem ℤ (4 * u ^ 2)) (hsign : ∀ a, IsSign (f.coeff a))
    (hnorm : f * ringStar f = scalar (4 * u ^ 2) ((4 * u ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) :
    False := by
  let hu0 : 0 < u := lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hu
  let H := BinaryBlocks.blocks (BinaryBlocks.crt ℤ u hodd f)
  have hH : BinaryCoefficients.Signs (fun j => (H j).coeff) :=
    BinaryBlocks.crt_blocks_signs hodd f hsign
  obtain ⟨hc, hd, hg⟩ := gaussian_norms_of_cyclic_norm hodd f hsign hnorm
  apply BinaryLocalFamily.contradiction_of_evaluated_data u hu0 hodd
    (cG H) (dG H) (gG H) hc hd hg
    (aValue u hu0 H) (bValue u hu0 H) (UValue u hu0 H)
  · exact fun S => cValue_eq u hu0 H S
  · exact fun S => dValue_eq u hu0 H S
  · exact fun S => gValue_eq u hu0 hH S
  · exact alternatingProduct_odd_torsion u hu hodd (cG H)
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hc)
  · exact alternatingProduct_odd_torsion u hu hodd (dG H)
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hd)
  · exact alternatingProduct_odd_torsion u hu hodd (gG H)
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hg)

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Mode.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.IsCirculant
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Mode.text:
def IsCirculant {n : ℕ} (H : RealMatrix n) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : Fin n → ℝ, ∀ i j, H i j = h (j - i)

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Orde.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.order_square_even
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Orde.text:
theorem order_square_even {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n)
    (h : ExistsRealCirculantHadamard n) :
    (∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ n = m ^ 2) ∧ Even n := by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hn)⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hsign, hnorm⟩ := exists_cyclicSignRow_iff_real.mpr h
  exact order_square_even_of_sign_norm hn f hsign hnorm

end CirculantHadamard

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Main.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.exists_iff_order_one_or_four
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Main.text:
theorem exists_iff_order_one_or_four (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ExistsRealCirculantHadamard n ↔ n = 1 ∨ n = 4 := by
  constructor
  · intro hH
    by_cases hn1 : n = 1
    · exact Or.inl hn1
    · have hnlarge : 1 < n := by omega
      rcases order_reduction hnlarge hH with ⟨u, hu, hodd, rfl⟩
      by_cases hu1 : u = 1
      · right
        simp [hu1]
      · have hul : 1 < u := by omega
        exact (not_exists_four_mul_odd_square hul hodd hH).elim
  · exact exists_of_order_one_or_four

end CirculantHadamard

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Witn.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.exists_of_order_one_or_four
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Witn.text:
theorem exists_of_order_one_or_four {n : ℕ} (hn : n = 1 ∨ n = 4) :
    ExistsRealCirculantHadamard n := by
  rcases hn with rfl | rfl
  · exact exists_one
  · exact exists_four

end CirculantHadamard

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Cycl.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.exists_cyclicSignRow_iff_real
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Cycl.text:
theorem exists_cyclicSignRow_iff_real :
    (∃ f : CyclicRing.Elem ℤ n,
      CyclicSignRow f ∧ f * CyclicRing.ringStar f = CyclicRing.scalar n (n : ℤ)) ↔
      ExistsRealCirculantHadamard n := by
  rw [← integerSignRow_iff_real]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hn⟩
    refine ⟨integerRow f, (integerSignRow_iff_cyclicSignNorm _).2 ?_⟩
    simpa only [cyclicRow_integerRow] using And.intro hf hn
  · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
    exact ⟨cyclicRow h, (integerSignRow_iff_cyclicSignNorm h).1 hh⟩

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Orde.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.odd_norm_impossible
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Orde.text:
theorem odd_norm_impossible {k t u : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hkt : t + 2 ≤ k) (hu : Odd u)
    (T : Elem ℤ (2 ^ k)) (hodd : ∀ a, Odd (T.coeff a))
    (hnorm : T * ringStar T = scalar (2 ^ k) ((2 ^ (2 * t) * u ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) :
    False := by
  suffices main : ∀ t k : ℕ, 1 ≤ t → t + 2 ≤ k →
      ∀ T : Elem ℤ (2 ^ k), (∀ a, Odd (T.coeff a)) →
        T * ringStar T = scalar (2 ^ k) ((2 ^ (2 * t) * u ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) →
          False by
    exact main t k ht hkt T hodd hnorm
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
      intro k ht
      omega
  | succ t ih =>
      intro k ht hkt T hodd hnorm
      cases t with
      | zero =>
          have hcard : 8 ∣ 2 ^ k := by
            have hpow : (2 : ℕ) ^ 3 ∣ 2 ^ k := pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega)
            norm_num at hpow
            exact hpow
          apply odd_norm_four_impossible hcard hu T hodd
          simpa only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.reducePow] using hnorm
      | succ t =>
          cases k with
          | zero => omega
          | succ k =>
              obtain ⟨U, hUodd, hUnorm⟩ := exists_odd_halving
                k (t + 1 + 1) u T (by omega) hu hodd hnorm
              apply ih k (by omega) (by omega) U hUodd
              simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hUnorm

OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Bina.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.not_exists_four_mul_odd_square
OAI.LinearAlgebra.CirculantHadamard.Bina.text:
theorem not_exists_four_mul_odd_square {u : ℕ}
    (hu : 1 < u) (hodd : Odd u) :
    ¬ ExistsRealCirculantHadamard (4 * u ^ 2) := by
  let : NeZero u := ⟨(lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hu).ne'⟩
  intro hH
  obtain ⟨f, hsign, hnorm⟩ :=
    (exists_cyclicSignRow_iff_real (n := 4 * u ^ 2)).mpr hH
  exact binary_sign_norm_impossible hu hodd f hsign hnorm

end CirculantHadamard

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.name: OAI.ClassicalON.block_fiber_partition
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.text:
theorem block_fiber_partition (k : ℕ) (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ) (s : V → Spin (3+k)) :
    (∫ t,Real.exp (freeSpinEnergy (3+k) left right b (blockFiberConfiguration k s t)) ∂freeSpinReference 3)=
      Real.exp (blockTailEnergy k left right b s)*freeSpinPartition 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s) := by
  simp_rw [blockFiberConfiguration_energy,Real.exp_add]
  rw [integral_mul_const]
  exact mul_comm _ _

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.name: OAI.ClassicalON.blockCoupling
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.text:
def blockCoupling (k : ℕ) (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ) (s : V → Spin (3+k)) : E → ℝ :=
  fun e => b e*blockRadius k (s (left e))*blockRadius k (s (right e))

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.Main:19.name: OAI.ClassicalON.main
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.Main:19.text:
theorem main : ExponentialDecay := by
  intro n hn β hβ
  obtain ⟨k,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  let : NeZero (3+k) := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨m,hm,hexp⟩ := LatticeGraph.connection_exponential β hβ.le
  refine ⟨(3+k:ℕ)*4,m,hm,?_⟩
  intro G b hb x y
  have hthree (c : G.edges → ℝ) (hc : ∀ e,0 ≤ c e ∧ c e ≤ b e) :
      0 ≤ freeSpinMean 3 (fun e : G.edges => e.val.1) (fun e => e.val.2) c (firstSpinProduct x y) ∧
      freeSpinMean 3 (fun e : G.edges => e.val.1) (fun e => e.val.2) c (firstSpinProduct x y) ≤
        4*Real.exp (-m*siteDistance x.val y.val) := by
    have hfirst := firstSpinMean_bounds (fun e : G.edges => e.val.1) (fun e => e.val.2) c
      (fun e => (hc e).1) x y
    exact ⟨hfirst.1,hfirst.2.trans (hexp G c (fun e => ⟨(hc e).1,(hc e).2.trans (hb e).2⟩) x y)⟩
  have hbound := coordinateSpinMean_block_bounds k (fun e : G.edges => e.val.1) (fun e => e.val.2) b
    (fun e => (hb e).1) x y (4*Real.exp (-m*siteDistance x.val y.val)) hthree
  rw [correlation_eq_freeSpinMean,innerSpinMean_eq_coordinate (3+k)
    (fun e : G.edges => e.val.1) (fun e => e.val.2) b ⟨0,by omega⟩ x y]
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hbound.1
  · calc
      _ ≤ (3+k:ℕ)*(4*Real.exp (-m*siteDistance x.val y.val)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring

end ClassicalON

end

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.name: OAI.ClassicalON.freeSpinPartition_pos
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.text:
theorem freeSpinPartition_pos (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ) :

  compact_integral_pos (continuous_freeSpinEnergy _ _ _ _).rexp (fun _ => Real.exp_pos _)

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockReducti.name: OAI.ClassicalON.coordinateSpinMean_block_bounds
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockReducti.text:
theorem coordinateSpinMean_block_bounds (k : ℕ) (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ e,0 ≤ b e) (x y : V) (C : ℝ)
    (hthree : ∀ c : E → ℝ,(∀ e,0 ≤ c e ∧ c e ≤ b e) →
      0 ≤ freeSpinMean 3 left right c (firstSpinProduct x y) ∧
        freeSpinMean 3 left right c (firstSpinProduct x y) ≤ C) :
    0 ≤ freeSpinMean (3+k) left right b (coordinateSpinProduct (3+k) ⟨0,by omega⟩ x y) ∧
      freeSpinMean (3+k) left right b (coordinateSpinProduct (3+k) ⟨0,by omega⟩ x y) ≤ C := by
  let : NeZero (3+k) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let W : (V → Spin (3+k)) → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (freeSpinEnergy (3+k) left right b s)
  let F := coordinateSpinProduct (3+k) ⟨0,by omega⟩ x y
  have hW : Continuous W := (continuous_freeSpinEnergy _ _ _ _).rexp
  have hF : Continuous F := continuous_coordinateSpinProduct _ _ _ _
  have hWF : Continuous (fun s => W s*F s) := hW.mul hF
  have hpoint (s : V → Spin (3+k)) :
      0 ≤ (∫ t,W (blockFiberConfiguration k s t)*F (blockFiberConfiguration k s t) ∂freeSpinReference 3) ∧
      (∫ t,W (blockFiberConfiguration k s t)*F (blockFiberConfiguration k s t) ∂freeSpinReference 3) ≤
        C*(∫ t,W (blockFiberConfiguration k s t) ∂freeSpinReference 3) := by
    dsimp only [W,F]
    rw [block_fiber_numerator,block_fiber_partition]
    have h3 := hthree (blockCoupling k left right b s) (blockCoupling_bounds k left right b hb s)
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ blockRadius k (s x)*blockRadius k (s y) :=
      mul_nonneg (blockRadius_nonneg _ _) (blockRadius_nonneg _ _)
    have hr1 : blockRadius k (s x)*blockRadius k (s y) ≤ 1 :=
      (mul_le_of_le_one_left (blockRadius_nonneg _ _) (blockRadius_le_one _ _)).trans
        (blockRadius_le_one _ _)
    have hD : 0 ≤ Real.exp (blockTailEnergy k left right b s)*
        freeSpinPartition 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s) :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (freeSpinPartition_pos _ _ _ _).le
    constructor
    · exact mul_nonneg hD (mul_nonneg hr0 h3.1)
    · calc
        _ ≤ (Real.exp (blockTailEnergy k left right b s)*
            freeSpinPartition 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s))*C :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            ((mul_le_of_le_one_left h3.1 hr1).trans h3.2) hD
        _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  have hNi : Integrable (fun s : V → Spin (3+k) =>
      ∫ t,W (blockFiberConfiguration k s t)*F (blockFiberConfiguration k s t) ∂freeSpinReference 3)
        (freeSpinReference (3+k)) :=
    compact_integrable (compact_parametric_integral _
      (hWF.comp (continuous_blockFiberConfiguration k)))
  have hDi : Integrable (fun s : V → Spin (3+k) =>
      ∫ t,W (blockFiberConfiguration k s t) ∂freeSpinReference 3) (freeSpinReference (3+k)) :=
    compact_integrable (compact_parametric_integral _
      (hW.comp (continuous_blockFiberConfiguration k)))
  have hN : 0 ≤ ∫ s,W s*F s ∂freeSpinReference (3+k) := by
    rw [integral_freeSpinReference_block k _ hWF]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun s => (hpoint s).1)
  have hND : (∫ s,W s*F s ∂freeSpinReference (3+k)) ≤ C*(∫ s,W s ∂freeSpinReference (3+k)) := by
    rw [integral_freeSpinReference_block k _ hWF,integral_freeSpinReference_block k _ hW,← integral_const_mul]
    exact integral_mono hNi (hDi.const_mul C) (fun s => (hpoint s).2)
  have hD : 0 < ∫ s,W s ∂freeSpinReference (3+k) :=
    compact_integral_pos hW (fun _ => Real.exp_pos _)
  constructor
  · exact div_nonneg hN hD.le
  · exact (div_le_iff₀ hD).mpr hND

end ClassicalON

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.Main:10.name: OAI.ClassicalON.correlation_eq_freeSpinMean
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.Main:10.text:
theorem correlation_eq_freeSpinMean (n : ℕ) (G : LatticeGraph) (b : G.edges → ℝ) (x y : G.vertices) :
    correlation n G b x y=freeSpinMean n (fun e : G.edges => e.val.1) (fun e => e.val.2) b
      (fun s => ⟪(s x).val,(s y).val⟫_ℝ) := by
  unfold correlation partition interaction referenceLaw freeSpinMean weightedMean freeSpinEnergy freeSpinReference
  congr 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with s
  exact mul_comm _ _

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.SpinIsotropy.name: OAI.ClassicalON.coordinateSpinProduct
OAI.ClassicalON.innerSpinMean_eq_coordinate
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.SpinIsotropy.text:
theorem innerSpinMean_eq_coordinate (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (x y : V) :
    freeSpinMean n left right b (fun s => ⟪(s x).val,(s y).val⟫_ℝ)=
      n*freeSpinMean n left right b (coordinateSpinProduct n i x y) := by
  have he (s : V → Spin n) : ⟪(s x).val,(s y).val⟫_ℝ=
      ∑ j : Fin n,coordinateSpinProduct n j x y s := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    simp only [dotProduct,coordinateSpinProduct,star_trivial]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  have hh : freeSpinMean n left right b (fun s => ⟪(s x).val,(s y).val⟫_ℝ)=
      ∑ j : Fin n,freeSpinMean n left right b (coordinateSpinProduct n j x y) := by
    unfold freeSpinMean weightedMean
    simp_rw [he,Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [integral_finsetSum]
    · rw [Finset.sum_div]
    · intro j _
      exact compact_integrable ((continuous_freeSpinEnergy _ _ _ _).rexp.mul
        (continuous_coordinateSpinProduct _ _ _ _))
  rw [hh]
  simp_rw [coordinateSpinMean_eq n left right b _ i x y]
  simp

end ClassicalON

end

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockGeometr.name: OAI.ClassicalON.blockRadius_le_one

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.name: OAI.ClassicalON.blockCoupling_bounds
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.text:
theorem blockCoupling_bounds (k : ℕ) (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ) (hb : ∀ e,0 ≤ b e)
    (s : V → Spin (3+k)) (e : E) : 0 ≤ blockCoupling k left right b s e ∧ blockCoupling k left right b s e ≤ b e := by
  unfold blockCoupling
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hb e) (blockRadius_nonneg _ _)) (blockRadius_nonneg _ _)
  · calc
      _ ≤ b e*1*1 := mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (blockRadius_le_one _ _) (hb e))
        (blockRadius_le_one _ _) (blockRadius_nonneg _ _) (by simpa using hb e)
      _ = b e := by ring

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockGeometr.name: OAI.ClassicalON.blockRadius
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockGeometr.text: def blockRadius (k : ℕ) (s : Spin (3+k)) : ℝ := ‖blockHead k s‖

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.SpinIsotropy.name: OAI.ClassicalON.coordinateSpinMean_eq
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.SpinIsotropy.text:
theorem coordinateSpinMean_eq (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (x y : V) :
    freeSpinMean n left right b (coordinateSpinProduct n i x y)=
      freeSpinMean n left right b (coordinateSpinProduct n j x y) := by
  let U := coordinateRotation n i j
  have he (s : V → Spin n) :
      coordinateSpinProduct n i x y (SpinSystem.rotateConfiguration (fun _ : V => U) s)=
        coordinateSpinProduct n j x y s := by
    change (U (s x).val) i*(U (s y).val) i=_
    simp only [U,coordinateRotation_apply,Equiv.swap_apply_left,coordinateSpinProduct]
  have hi := (freeSpinReference_rotation (V := V) n U).integral_comp
    (SpinSystem.rotateConfiguration (fun _ : V => U)).measurableEmbedding
    (fun s => Real.exp (freeSpinEnergy n left right b s)*coordinateSpinProduct n i x y s)
  simp_rw [freeSpinEnergy_rotation,he] at hi
  unfold freeSpinMean weightedMean
  rw [hi]

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockOrbit:8.name: OAI.ClassicalON.integral_freeSpinReference_block
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockOrbit:8.text:
theorem integral_freeSpinReference_block (k : ℕ) (f : (V → Spin (3+k)) → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ s,f s ∂freeSpinReference (3+k))=
      ∫ s,∫ t,f (blockFiberConfiguration k s t) ∂freeSpinReference 3 ∂freeSpinReference (3+k) := by
  let : NeZero (3+k) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : (V → Spin (3+k))×(V → SpinOrthogonal 3) =>
      f (blockRotateConfiguration k p.2 p.1)) :=
    hf.comp ((continuous_blockRotateConfiguration k).comp
      (f := (Prod.swap : (V → Spin (3+k))×(V → SpinOrthogonal 3) →
        (V → SpinOrthogonal 3)×(V → Spin (3+k)))) continuous_swap)
  have he := integral_integral_swap (μ := freeSpinReference (3+k)) (ν := orthogonalConfigurationLaw)
    (f := fun s Q => f (blockRotateConfiguration k Q s)) (compact_integrable hc)
  have hi (Q : V → SpinOrthogonal 3) :
      (∫ s,f (blockRotateConfiguration k Q s) ∂freeSpinReference (3+k))=∫ s,f s ∂freeSpinReference (3+k) :=
    (blockRotateConfiguration_preserves k Q).integral_comp
      (blockRotateConfiguration k Q).measurableEmbedding f
  simp_rw [hi] at he
  simp only [integral_const,probReal_univ,one_smul] at he
  rw [← he]
  exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (integral_block_orbit k f hf))

end ClassicalON

end

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.name: OAI.ClassicalON.freeSpinPartition
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.text:
def freeSpinPartition (n : ℕ) (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s,Real.exp (freeSpinEnergy n left right b s) ∂freeSpinReference n

OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.name: OAI.ClassicalON.block_fiber_numerator
OAI.Probability.ClassicalON.BlockKernel:.text:
theorem block_fiber_numerator (k : ℕ) (left right : E → V) (b : E → ℝ)
    (x y : V) (s : V → Spin (3+k)) :
    (∫ t,Real.exp (freeSpinEnergy (3+k) left right b (blockFiberConfiguration k s t))*
      coordinateSpinProduct (3+k) ⟨0,by omega⟩ x y (blockFiberConfiguration k s t) ∂freeSpinReference 3)=
      (Real.exp (blockTailEnergy k left right b s)*freeSpinPartition 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s))*
        ((blockRadius k (s x)*blockRadius k (s y))*
          freeSpinMean 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s) (firstSpinProduct x y)) := by
  have hz := (freeSpinPartition_pos 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s)).ne'
  simp_rw [blockFiberConfiguration_energy,Real.exp_add,blockFiberConfiguration_first]
  have he (t : V → Spin 3) :
      Real.exp (freeSpinEnergy 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s) t)*
        Real.exp (blockTailEnergy k left right b s)*
          (blockRadius k (s x)*blockRadius k (s y)*firstSpinProduct x y t)=
      (Real.exp (blockTailEnergy k left right b s)*(blockRadius k (s x)*blockRadius k (s y)))*
        (Real.exp (freeSpinEnergy 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s) t)*firstSpinProduct x y t) := by ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  unfold freeSpinMean weightedMean
  change _=(_*freeSpinPartition 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s))*
    (_*(_/freeSpinPartition 3 left right (blockCoupling k left right b s)))
  field_simp

end ClassicalON

end

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.MaxDegree:8.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.indepNum_induce_le
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.MaxDegree:8.text:
lemma indepNum_induce_le (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V) :
    (G.induce (A : Set V)).indepNum ≤ G.indepNum := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨I,hI⟩ := (G.induce (A : Set V)).exists_isNIndepSet_indepNum

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Independent.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.maximum_degree_potential_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Independent.text:
lemma maximum_degree_potential_bound (k : ℕ) {B Δ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hΔ : 3 ≤ Δ)
    (htri : ∀ {U : Type u} [Fintype U] (H : SimpleGraph U) (w : U → ℝ),
      IsOptimizer H w → H.CliqueFree (k+2) → triangleMass H w ≤ B * edgeMass H w)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hf : G.CliqueFree (k+2)) (hdeg : ∀ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ Δ) :
    ∃ I : Finset V, G.IsIndepSet (I : Set V) ∧
      ∀ q : V → ℝ, (∀ v, 0 ≤ q v) →
        potential G q ≤ ((3+3*B/2)*Real.log Δ) * (I.card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have aux : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (U : Type u) [Fintype U], Fintype.card U = n →
      ∀ H : SimpleGraph U, H.CliqueFree (k+2) → (∀ v, (H.degree v : ℝ) ≤ Δ) →
        ∃ I : Finset U, H.IsIndepSet (I : Set U) ∧
          ∀ q : U → ℝ, (∀ v, 0 ≤ q v) →
            potential H q ≤ ((3+3*B/2)*Real.log Δ) * (I.card : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro U _ hn H hfree hdegree
      rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty U with hU | hU
      · let _ := hU
        refine ⟨∅,by simp,?_⟩
        intro q _
        simp [potential,edgeMass,crossMass]
      · let _ := hU
        obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := exists_optimizer H
        obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := exists_cheap_vertex hw hΔ hB hdegree (htri H w hw hfree)
        let A : Finset U := (closedNeighbors H v)ᶜ
        have hA : ∀ b ∈ A, b ≠ v ∧ ¬H.Adj v b := by
          intro b hb
          simpa [A] using hb
        have hcard : Fintype.card (A : Set U) < n := by
          rw [← hn]
          exact Fintype.card_subtype_lt (x := v) (by simp [A])
        have hfreeA : (H.induce (A : Set U)).CliqueFree (k+2) :=
          (H.cliqueFree_induce_iff _ _).2 hfree.cliqueFreeOn
        have hdegA (a : (A : Set U)) : ((H.induce (A : Set U)).degree a : ℝ) ≤ Δ :=
          (Nat.cast_le.2 (degree_induce_le H A a)).trans (hdegree a)
        obtain ⟨I,hI,hIp⟩ := ih _ hcard (A : Set U) rfl (H.induce (A : Set U)) hfreeA hdegA
        obtain ⟨hJ,hJcard⟩ := indepSet_insert_induce H A v hA I hI
        refine ⟨insert v (I.map ⟨Subtype.val,Subtype.val_injective⟩),hJ,?_⟩
        intro q hq
        have hres := hIp (fun a ↦ w a) (fun a ↦ hw.1 a)
        rw [potential_induce] at hres
        have hcost := optimizer_deletion_cost hw (closedNeighbors H v)
        change potential H w - potential H (restrict A w) = _ at hcost
        rw [hJcard,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
        have hmax := hw.2 q hq
        nlinarith
  exact aux _ V rfl G hf hdeg

end CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph

end

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Model:7.name: OAI.CliqueFreeLog.averageDegree
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Model:7.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Independent.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.indepSet_image_induce
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Independent.text:
lemma indepSet_image_induce (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V) (I : Finset (A : Set V))
    (hI : (G.induce (A : Set V)).IsIndepSet (I : Set (A : Set V))) :
    G.IsIndepSet (I.map ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩ : Set V) := by
  classical
  intro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨a',ha',rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 ha
  obtain ⟨b',hb',rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hb

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Main:22.name: OAI.CliqueFreeLog.logarithmic_independence_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Main:22.text:
theorem logarithmic_independence_bound (r : ℕ) (hr : 4 ≤ r) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      ∀ {V : Type} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
        G.CliqueFree r → 2 ≤ averageDegree G →
        c * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * Real.log (averageDegree G) / averageDegree G ≤
          (G.indepNum : ℝ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B,hB,htri⟩ := exists_optimizer_triangle_bound.{0} (r-2)
  let D : ℝ := 3+3*B/2
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  refine ⟨1/(16*D),by positivity,?_⟩
  intro V _ G hf hd
  let d : ℝ := averageDegree G
  have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := hd
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by linarith
  have hn : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hn
    have hz : averageDegree G = 0 := by simp [averageDegree,hn]
    rw [hz] at hd
    norm_num at hd
  have hsum : (∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ)) = (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*d := by
    rw [sum_degrees_real]
    dsimp [d, averageDegree]
    field_simp
  let A : Finset V := univ.filter fun v ↦ (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ 2*d
  have hAcard : (Fintype.card V : ℝ)/2 ≤ (Fintype.card (A : Set V) : ℝ) := by
    have he : Fintype.card (A : Set V) = A.card := Fintype.card_coe A
    rw [he]
    exact degree_cutoff_card G hdpos hsum
  have hk : r-2+2 = r := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)
  have hfree : (G.induce (A : Set V)).CliqueFree (r-2+2) := by
    rw [hk]
    exact (G.cliqueFree_induce_iff _ _).2 hf.cliqueFreeOn
  have hdeg (v : (A : Set V)) : ((G.induce (A : Set V)).degree v : ℝ) ≤ 2*d := by
    have hv : (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ 2*d := (mem_filter.1 v.property).2
    exact (Nat.cast_le.2 (degree_induce_le G A v)).trans hv
  have hmax := maximum_degree_independence (r-2) hB.le (by linarith : 3 ≤ 2*d)
    htri (G.induce (A : Set V)) hfree hdeg
  have hi : ((G.induce (A : Set V)).indepNum : ℝ) ≤ G.indepNum :=
    Nat.cast_le.2 (indepNum_induce_le G A)
  have hlog : Real.log d ≤ Real.log (2*d) :=
    Real.log_le_log hdpos (by linarith)
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log d := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hnum : (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*Real.log d/2 ≤
      (Fintype.card (A : Set V) : ℝ)*Real.log (2*d) := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAcard hlog0
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (Fintype.card (A : Set V)))
    nlinarith
  have hden : 0 < 8*D*d := by positivity
  have hcompare := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hden.le
  change (Fintype.card (A : Set V) : ℝ)*Real.log (2*d)/(4*D*(2*d)) ≤ _ at hmax
  have heq : (1/(16*D))*(Fintype.card V : ℝ)*Real.log d/d =
      ((Fintype.card V : ℝ)*Real.log d/2)/(8*D*d) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  change (1/(16*D))*(Fintype.card V : ℝ)*Real.log d/d ≤ _
  rw [heq]
  apply hcompare.trans
  have hdeneq : 8*D*d = 4*D*(2*d) := by ring
  rw [hdeneq]
  exact hmax.trans hi

end CliqueFreeLog

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.MaxDegree:7.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.maximum_degree_independence
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.MaxDegree:7.text:
lemma maximum_degree_independence (k : ℕ) {B Δ : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hΔ : 3 ≤ Δ)
    (htri : ∀ {U : Type u} [Fintype U] (H : SimpleGraph U) (w : U → ℝ),
      IsOptimizer H w → H.CliqueFree (k+2) → triangleMass H w ≤ B * edgeMass H w)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (hf : G.CliqueFree (k+2)) (hdeg : ∀ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ Δ) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*Real.log Δ/(4*(3+3*B/2)*Δ) ≤ (G.indepNum : ℝ) := by
  have hΔpos : 0 < Δ := by linarith
  have ht : 0 < Real.log Δ := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hD : 0 < 3+3*B/2 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨I,hI,hIp⟩ := maximum_degree_potential_bound k hB hΔ htri G hf hdeg
  have hupper := hIp (fun _ ↦ Real.log Δ/Δ) (fun _ ↦ (div_pos ht hΔpos).le)
  have hlower := potential_const_lower G (by linarith : 1 < Δ) hdeg
  have hc : (I.card : ℝ) ≤ G.indepNum := Nat.cast_le.2 hI.card_le_indepNum
  have hfinal := hupper.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc (mul_pos hD ht).le)
  have hbound := hlower.trans hfinal
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (mul_pos hD ht)).1
  convert hbound using 1 <;> field_simp

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.WeightedGra.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.triangleMass
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.WeightedGra.text:
noncomputable def triangleMass (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ u, w u * triangleAt G w u) / 6

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.MaxDegree:4.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.potential_const_lower
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.MaxDegree:4.text:
lemma potential_const_lower (G : SimpleGraph V) {Δ : ℝ} (hΔ : 1 < Δ)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ Δ) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*(Real.log Δ)^2/(4*Δ) ≤
      potential G (fun _ ↦ Real.log Δ / Δ) := by
  have hΔpos : 0 < Δ := lt_trans zero_lt_one hΔ
  have ht : 0 < Real.log Δ := Real.log_pos hΔ
  have hp : 0 < Real.log Δ / Δ := div_pos ht hΔpos
  have hlog := log_le_one_add_quarter ht
  have hhe : Δ*(Real.log Δ/Δ) = Real.log Δ := by field_simp
  have hterm : Real.log Δ/4 ≤ 1-Real.log (Real.log Δ/Δ)-Δ*(Real.log Δ/Δ)/2 := by
    rw [Real.log_div ht.ne' hΔpos.ne', hhe]
    linarith
  have hc : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hterm (mul_nonneg hc hp.le)
  have he := edgeMass_const_le G hdeg (Real.log Δ/Δ)
  simp only [potential,vertexPotential,sum_const,card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]
  have heq : (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*(Real.log Δ)^2/(4*Δ) =
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*(Real.log Δ/Δ)*(Real.log Δ/4) := by ring
  rw [heq]
  nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Independent.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.degree_induce_le
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Independent.text:
lemma degree_induce_le (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Finset V) (v : (A : Set V)) :
    (G.induce (A : Set V)).degree v ≤ G.degree v := by
  classical
  rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree, ← SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (fun u : (G.induce (A : Set V)).neighborSet v ↦
      (⟨u.val.val, u.property⟩ : G.neighborSet v))
    (fun u z h ↦ by
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun x : G.neighborSet v ↦ (x : V)) h)

omit [Fintype V] in

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Optimizer:1.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.IsOptimizer
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.Optimizer:1.text:
def IsOptimizer (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) ∧ ∀ q : V → ℝ, (∀ v, 0 ≤ q v) → potential G q ≤ potential G w

OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.MaxDegree:9.name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.degree_cutoff_card
OAI.Combinatorics.CliqueFree.MaxDegree:9.text:
lemma degree_cutoff_card (G : SimpleGraph V) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hsum : (∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ)) = (Fintype.card V : ℝ)*d) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ)/2 ≤ ((univ.filter fun v ↦ (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ 2*d).card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let A : Finset V := univ.filter fun v ↦ (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ 2*d
  have hv (v : V) (h : v ∈ Aᶜ) : 2*d ≤ (G.degree v : ℝ) := by
    have hh : ¬(G.degree v : ℝ) ≤ 2*d := by simpa [A] using h
    exact le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hh)
  have hlow := sum_le_sum (s := Aᶜ) fun v h ↦ hv v h
  simp only [sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul] at hlow
  have hu : (∑ v ∈ Aᶜ, (G.degree v : ℝ)) ≤ ∑ v, (G.degree v : ℝ) := by
    exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (subset_univ _) (fun _ _ _ ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hcard : (A.card : ℝ)+(Aᶜ.card : ℝ) = Fintype.card V := by
    exact_mod_cast card_add_card_compl A
  change (Fintype.card V : ℝ)/2 ≤ (A.card : ℝ)
  rw [hsum] at hu
  nlinarith

end CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph

end

OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.Definitions:.text:
def fiberedGraph (S : Finset OAI.CoarseAssembly.Congruence.ArithmeticGroup) (t : ℤ_[2]ˣ) (j : ℕ) :
    SimpleGraph (OAI.CoarseAssembly.FiberVertex j) := by
  classical
  have OAI.CoarseAssembly.liftStep_reverse {S : Finset OAI.CoarseAssembly.Congruence.ArithmeticGroup} {t : ℤ_[2]ˣ} {j : ℕ}
      {x y : OAI.CoarseAssembly.FiberVertex j} (h : OAI.CoarseAssembly.LiftStep S t x y) : OAI.CoarseAssembly.LiftStep S t y x  :=
    open OAI OAI.CoarseAssembly in
    open Congruence in
    by
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hp, he⟩ := h
      refine ⟨s⁻¹, (
      let local_proof {S : Finset OAI.CoarseAssembly.Congruence.ArithmeticGroup} {s : OAI.CoarseAssembly.Congruence.ArithmeticGroup}
          (h : s ∈ OAI.CoarseAssembly.symmetricMoves S) : s⁻¹ ∈ OAI.CoarseAssembly.symmetricMoves S :=
        open OAI OAI.CoarseAssembly in
          open Congruence in
          by
            simp only [OAI.CoarseAssembly.symmetricMoves, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image] at *
            rcases h with h | h | ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
            · left; simp [h]
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨s, h, rfl⟩)
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by simpa using ha))
      local_proof) hs, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases hp with hp | ⟨hp, rfl⟩
        · exact Or.inl hp.symm
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hp.symm, inv_one⟩
      · intro l hy hx
        have hc : OAI.CoarseAssembly.fiberCharge y x = -OAI.CoarseAssembly.fiberCharge x y := (
      let local_proof (u v : OAI.CoarseAssembly.LatticeVertex) : OAI.CoarseAssembly.latticeCharge v u = -OAI.CoarseAssembly.latticeCharge u v :=
        open OAI OAI.CoarseAssembly in
          by
            simp only [OAI.CoarseAssembly.latticeCharge]
            split_ifs <;> omega
      local_proof) _ _
        rw [hc, map_inv, zpow_neg, he l hx hy]
        group
  exact {
    Adj x y := x ≠ y ∧ OAI.CoarseAssembly.LiftStep S t x y
    symm := ⟨fun _ _ h => ⟨Ne.symm h.1, OAI.CoarseAssembly.liftStep_reverse h.2⟩⟩
    loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩
  }

end CoarseAssembly

OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.FiberDegree:.text:
theorem card_baseNeighbors_le {j : ℕ} (u : Disc j) : (baseNeighbors u).card ≤ 7 := by
  classical
  have himage : (baseNeighbors u).image Subtype.val ⊆ insert u.val (latticeNeighbors u.val) := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    rcases (mem_baseNeighbors u w).mp hw with hw | hw
    · subst w; exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ((mem_latticeNeighbors_iff _ _).mpr hw)
  calc
    (baseNeighbors u).card = ((baseNeighbors u).image Subtype.val).card :=
      (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective).symm
    _ ≤ (insert u.val (latticeNeighbors u.val)).card := Finset.card_le_card himage
    _ ≤ (latticeNeighbors u.val).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _
    _ ≤ 7 := by have := card_latticeNeighbors_le u.val; omega

OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.FiberConnect.name: OAI.CoarseAssembly.fiberBoundary_reaches
OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.FiberConnect.text:
theorem fiberBoundary_reaches (S : Finset ArithmeticGroup) (t : ℤ_[2]ˣ)
    {j : ℕ} (x : FiberVertex j) :
    (fiberedGraph S t j).Reachable (fiberBoundaryBase j) x := by
  classical
  have hsub : Subsingleton (Quotient (discDepth j (discBoundaryBase j))) := by
    rw [discBoundaryBase_depth]
    infer_instance
  let : Unique (Quotient (discDepth j (discBoundaryBase j))) :=
    ⟨⟨1⟩, fun q => hsub.elim q 1⟩
  have hc : fiberConstant (Quotient (discDepth j (discBoundaryBase j))) (1 : ℂ) =
      lp.single 2 1 1 := by
    apply lp.ext
    funext q
    simp [fiberConstant_apply, lp.single_apply, hsub.elim q 1]
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := discGraph_connected j (discBoundaryBase j) x.1
  obtain ⟨O, hnorm, hconst, hsupp⟩ := exists_base_walk_operator S t p
  have hn : O (lp.single 2 1 1) x.2 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hc, hconst]
    exact constant_coordinate_ne_zero _ _
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsupp 1 x.2 hn
  exact ⟨w⟩
