OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.Transcendent.name: OAI.CoarseAssembly.exists_transcendental_principal_unit
OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.Transcendent.text:
theorem exists_transcendental_principal_unit :
    ∃ t : ℤ_[p]ˣ, Transcendental ℤ (t : ℤ_[p]) ∧
      ∃ a : ℤ_[p], (t : ℤ_[p]) = 1 + (p : ℤ_[p]) * a := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hclose⟩ :=
    (dense_padic_transcendental (p := p)).exists_dist_lt (1 : ℚ_[p]) zero_lt_one
  have hnear : ‖x - 1‖ < 1 := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hclose
  have hxnorm : ‖x‖ = 1 := by
    simpa only [norm_one] using Padic.norm_eq_of_norm_sub_lt_right
      (show ‖x - 1‖ < ‖(1 : ℚ_[p])‖ by simpa using hnear)
  let z : ℤ_[p] := ⟨x, hxnorm.le⟩
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ = 1 := hxnorm
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := PadicInt.isUnit_iff.mpr hznorm
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ht]
    intro hzalg
    let f : ℤ_[p] →ₐ[ℤ] ℚ_[p] :=
      { PadicInt.Coe.ringHom with commutes' := fun n => by simp }
    exact hx (hzalg.algHom f)
  · have hzclose : ‖z - 1‖ < 1 := hnear
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (PadicInt.norm_lt_one_iff_dvd (z - 1)).mp hzclose
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    rw [ht]
    linear_combination ha

end CoarseAssembly

OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.Definitions:.name: OAI.CoarseAssembly.Congruence.chosenHolonomyUnit
OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.Definitions:.text:
noncomputable def chosenHolonomyUnit : ℤ_[2]ˣ := by
  classical
  have OAI.CoarseAssembly.exists_transcendental_principal_unit {p : ℕ} [inst_local_1 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] :
      ∃ t : ℤ_[p]ˣ, Transcendental ℤ (t : ℤ_[p]) ∧
        ∃ a : ℤ_[p], (t : ℤ_[p]) = 1 + (p : ℤ_[p]) * a  :=
    open OAI OAI.CoarseAssembly in
    open Set in
    by
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hclose⟩ :=
        ((
      let local_proof {p : ℕ} [inst_local_1 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] : Dense {x : ℚ_[p] | Transcendental ℤ x} :=
        open OAI OAI.CoarseAssembly in
          open Set in
          by
            have hcount : Set.Countable {x : ℚ_[p] | IsAlgebraic ℤ x} :=
              Algebraic.countable ℤ ℚ_[p]
            have hd : Dense (⋂ x ∈ {x : ℚ_[p] | IsAlgebraic ℤ x}, ({x}ᶜ : Set ℚ_[p])) :=
              dense_biInter_of_isOpen (fun _ _ => isOpen_compl_singleton) hcount
                (fun x _ => dense_compl_singleton x)
            apply hd.mono
            intro x hx hxalg
            have hxnot := Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hx x hxalg
            exact hxnot (Set.mem_singleton x)
      @local_proof) (p := p)).exists_dist_lt (1 : ℚ_[p]) zero_lt_one
      have hnear : ‖x - 1‖ < 1 := by
        simpa only [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hclose
      have hxnorm : ‖x‖ = 1 := by
        simpa only [norm_one] using Padic.norm_eq_of_norm_sub_lt_right
          (show ‖x - 1‖ < ‖(1 : ℚ_[p])‖ by simpa using hnear)
      let z : ℤ_[p] := ⟨x, hxnorm.le⟩
      have hznorm : ‖z‖ = 1 := hxnorm
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := PadicInt.isUnit_iff.mpr hznorm
      refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [ht]
        intro hzalg
        let f : ℤ_[p] →ₐ[ℤ] ℚ_[p] :=
          { PadicInt.Coe.ringHom with commutes' := fun n => by simp }
        exact hx (hzalg.algHom f)
      · have hzclose : ‖z - 1‖ < 1 := hnear
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (PadicInt.norm_lt_one_iff_dvd (z - 1)).mp hzclose
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        rw [ht]
        linear_combination ha
  exact (OAI.CoarseAssembly.exists_transcendental_principal_unit (p := 2)).choose

end CoarseAssembly.Congruence

OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.FiberDegree:.name: OAI.CoarseAssembly.neighborCode_injective

private theorem neighborCode_injective {S : Finset ArithmeticGroup} {t : ℤ_[2]ˣ} {j : ℕ}
    (x : FiberVertex j) : Function.Injective (neighborCode (S := S) (t := t) x) := by
  intro y z he
  have hb : y.val.1 = z.val.1 := congrArg (fun c => c.1.val) he
  have hs : neighborMove x y = neighborMove x z := congrArg (fun c => c.2.1.val) he
  have hc : fiberBits _ y.val.2 = fiberBits _ z.val.2 := congrArg (fun c => c.2.2) he
  apply Subtype.ext
  rcases y with ⟨⟨v, q⟩, hy⟩
  rcases z with ⟨⟨w, r⟩, hz⟩
  dsimp only at hb
  subst w
  apply congrArg (Sigma.mk v)
  apply target_eq_of_same_code x v q r (neighborMove x ⟨⟨v, q⟩, hy⟩)
    (neighborMove_spec x ⟨⟨v, q⟩, hy⟩).2.1
  · exact (neighborMove_spec x ⟨⟨v, q⟩, hy⟩).2.2
  · simpa only [hs, fiberCoordinate, fiberCharge] using (neighborMove_spec x ⟨⟨v, r⟩, hz⟩).2.2
  · exact hc

theorem bounded_geometry_graph_counterexample_unconditional :
    (∀ j, Finite (FiberVertex j) ∧
      (fiberedGraph elementaryMoves chosenHolonomyUnit j).Connected) ∧
    (∃ D : ℕ, ∀ j (x : FiberVertex j),
      Nat.card {y // (fiberedGraph elementaryMoves chosenHolonomyUnit j).Adj x y} ≤ D) ∧
    ProperSpace VertexUnion ∧ UniformFiniteBalls VertexUnion ∧
      (∀ x y : VertexUnion, x ≠ y → 1 ≤ dist x y) ∧
      ∃ α : KX1 VertexUnion,
        (∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → n • α ≠ 0) ∧ constructedCoarseAssembly α = 0 ∧
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] α ≠ 0 ∧
        ¬ Function.Injective constructedCoarseAssembly ∧
        ¬ Function.Injective (constructedCoarseAssembly.toIntLinearMap.lTensor ℚ) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, bounded_geometry_counterexample_unconditional⟩
  · intro j
    exact ⟨inferInstance, fiberedGraph_connected elementaryMoves chosenHolonomyUnit j⟩
  · exact ⟨7 * (symmetricMoves elementaryMoves).card * 2 ^ 9,
      fun _ x => card_fibered_neighbors_le elementaryMoves chosenHolonomyUnit x⟩

OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.FiberDegree:.name: OAI.CoarseAssembly.card_fibered_neighbors_le
OAI.Topology.CoarseAssembly.FiberDegree:.text:
theorem card_fibered_neighbors_le (S : Finset ArithmeticGroup) (t : ℤ_[2]ˣ)
    {j : ℕ} (x : FiberVertex j) :
    Nat.card {y // (fiberedGraph S t j).Adj x y} ≤
      7 * (symmetricMoves S).card * 2 ^ 9 := by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ (neighborCode_injective (S := S) (t := t) x)
  simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_fin, FiberBits] at h
  calc
    _ ≤ (baseNeighbors x.1).card * ((symmetricMoves S).card * (2 ^ 3) ^ 3) := h
    _ ≤ 7 * ((symmetricMoves S).card * (2 ^ 3) ^ 3) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (card_baseNeighbors_le x.1)
    _ = _ := by ring

OAI.Geometry.Coboundary.LatticeCones:839.name: OAI.CoboundaryExpanders.Construction.uniform_infinite_coset_exact
OAI.Geometry.Coboundary.LatticeCones:839.text:
theorem uniform_infinite_coset_exact (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Q : ℕ, ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Q < p →
      ∀ r < n-1, ExactIn (TypedCosetFaces.complex (uLocalGroup p n (by omega))).faces (r+1) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k,rfl⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, n = k+2 := ⟨n-2,by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := uniform_codistanceStage_zero_exact (k+2-1)
  refine ⟨Q,?_⟩
  intro p _ hq r hr
  have hh := hQ (ZMod p) (by simpa only [ZMod.card] using hq) r hr
  rw [← opposition_faces_eq_codistance_zero] at hh
  have hk : 1 ≤ k+2 := by omega
  let : Nonempty (TypedCosetFaces.Vertex (uLocalGroup p (k+2) hk)) :=
    ⟨TypedCosetFaces.vertex (uLocalGroup p (k+2) hk) 1 0⟩
  apply exactIn_of_image (oppositionVertex p (k+2) hk) (oppositionVertex_injective p (k+2) hk)
    _ _ ?_ ?_ (r+1) hh
  · intro s hs
    exact (opposition_mem_image p (k+2) hk _).mpr ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩
  · intro s hs
    exact (opposition_mem_image p (k+2) hk s).mp hs

OAI.Geometry.Coboundary.LatticeCones:859.name: OAI.CoboundaryExpanders.Construction.uniform_infinite_coset_positive
OAI.Geometry.Coboundary.LatticeCones:859.text:
theorem uniform_infinite_coset_positive (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Q : ℕ, ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Q < p →
      ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < n-1 →
        (TypedCosetFaces.complex (uLocalGroup p n (by omega))).chainComplex.ExactAt j := by
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := uniform_infinite_coset_exact n hn
  refine ⟨Q,?_⟩
  intro p _ hq j hj hjn
  obtain ⟨r,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : j ≠ 0)
  exact chainComplex_exactAt_of_exactIn _ r (hQ p hq (r+1) hjn)
end CoboundaryExpanders.Construction

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Skeleton:27.text:
theorem cosystolic_of_typed_raw (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hh : ∀ f : Finset (Vertex H) → ZMod 2, ∃ h,
      FatLadders.norm (fun s => (cofaces (TypedCosetFaces.complex H) (n+1) s : ℝ)) (i+2)
        (FatLadders.delta (f+h)) = 0 ∧
      FatLadders.norm (fun s => (cofaces (TypedCosetFaces.complex H) (n+1) s : ℝ)) (i+1) h ≤
        K*FatLadders.norm (fun s => (cofaces (TypedCosetFaces.complex H) (n+1) s : ℝ)) (i+2)
          (FatLadders.delta f)) :
    ∀ f : (complex H).Cochain i,
      (1/(K*2^(n+1))) * (complex H).distance n i f ((complex H).cocycles i) ≤
        (complex H).norm n (i+1) ((complex H).coboundary i f) := by
  apply Complex.cosystolic_of_raw (pure H) hi hK
  have he := FatLadders.correction_image (labelEquiv H)
    (fun s => (cofaces (TypedCosetFaces.complex H) (n+1) s : ℝ))
    (fun s => ((complex H).cofaceCount n s : ℝ))
    (fun s => by rw [labelled_cofaces]) (i+2) K
  simpa only [show i+2-1=i+1 by omega] using he hh
end CoboundaryExpanders.CosetConstruction

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Expansion:8.name: OAI.CoboundaryExpanders.Construction.uniform_actual_raw_cosystolic
OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Expansion:8.text:
theorem uniform_actual_raw_cosystolic (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Q : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, ∀ _ : Fact p.Prime, Q < p →
      ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m →
      letI : Fintype (Gquot p (n+1) m) := Fintype.ofFinite _
      let w := fun t => (cofaces (TypedCosetFaces.complex (reducedLocalGroup p n (by omega) m)) (n+1) t : ℝ)
      ∀ r : ℕ, r < n+1 → ∀ f : Finset (Vertex (reducedLocalGroup p n (by omega) m)) → ZMod 2,
        ∃ h, FatLadders.norm w r (FatLadders.delta (f+h)) = 0 ∧
          FatLadders.norm w (r-1) h ≤ K * FatLadders.norm w r (FatLadders.delta f) := by
  obtain ⟨Q₀,C,hC⟩ := uniform_actual_linkCorrection n (by omega)
  have hCp : 0 < (C:ℝ)+1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨lam,K,hlam,hK,hraw⟩ := FatLadders.uniform_raw_cosystolic_from_local (n+1) (by omega) ((C:ℝ)+1) hCp
  obtain ⟨Q₁,hmix⟩ := uniform_actual_mixing n hn hlam
  refine ⟨max Q₀ Q₁,K,hK,?_⟩
  intro p hp hq m hm
  let : Fintype (Gquot p (n+1) m) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  dsimp only
  have hP := finite_pure (reducedLocalGroup p n (by omega) m)
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hP
  apply hraw _ _ (cofaces_balanced _ (n+1))
  · exact_mod_cast (cofaces_pos_iff hP ∅).mpr (TypedCosetFaces.complex _).empty_mem
  · exact hmix p hp ((le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hq) m hm
  · intro r hr
    exact (hC p hp ((le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hq) m hm r hr).mono
      (fun s => Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith)
end CoboundaryExpanders.Construction

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Main:88.name: OAI.CoboundaryExpanders.main
OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Main:88.text:
theorem main : MainStatement := by
  apply reduction_to_positive_open_inputs
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨Q₁,hQ₁⟩ := uniform_infinite_coset_positive (2*d) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨Q₂,hQ₂⟩ := actual_uniform_cosystolic (2*d) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨Q₃,hQ₃⟩ := uniform_gamma_vanishing (2*d+1)
  obtain ⟨p,hbound,hp⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes (max 3 (max Q₁ (max Q₂ Q₃))+1)
  have hQ : max 3 (max Q₁ (max Q₂ Q₃)) < p := by omega
  have hp2 : p ≠ 2 := by have := le_max_left 3 (max Q₁ (max Q₂ Q₃)); omega
  have ho : Odd p := hp.odd_of_ne_two hp2
  let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have h₁ : Q₁ < p := lt_of_le_of_lt ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)) hQ
  have h₂ : Q₂ < p := lt_of_le_of_lt
    ((le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))) hQ
  have h₃ : Q₃ < p := lt_of_le_of_lt
    ((le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))) hQ
  refine ⟨p,hp,ho,hQ₁ p h₁,?_,hQ₂ p inferInstance h₂⟩
  intro j hj hjd
  constructor
  · apply proZero_of_target_vanishing
    intro m hm
    exact hQ₃ p ho h₃ j hj (2*d-1+1) (by omega) (by omega) m hm
  · apply proZero_of_target_vanishing
    intro m hm
    exact hQ₃ p ho h₃ j hj (2*d+1) (by omega) (by omega) m hm

end CoboundaryExpanders

end

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Main:19.name: OAI.CoboundaryExpanders.uniform_u_homology
OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Main:19.text:
theorem uniform_u_homology (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q : ℕ, ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Odd p → Q < p →
      ∀ a : ℕ, 4 ≤ a → a ≤ N → ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < a-2 →
        IsZero (groupHomology (Rep.trivial (ZMod 2) (U p a) (ZMod 2)) j) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact ⟨0,fun _ _ _ _ a ha hN => by omega⟩
  | succ N ih =>
    by_cases hN : 4 ≤ N+1
    · obtain ⟨Q₁,hQ₁⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨Q₂,hQ₂⟩ := uniform_infinite_coset_positive N (by omega)
      refine ⟨max Q₁ Q₂,?_⟩
      intro p inst hp hQ a ha haN j hj hja
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le haN with hlt | rfl
      · exact hQ₁ p hp (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hQ) a ha (by omega) j hj hja
      · apply u_homology_isZero_of_opposition p N (by omega) hp
          ((oppositionAcyclic_iff_positive p N (by omega)).mpr
            (hQ₂ p (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hQ))) j hj
        omega
    · exact ⟨0,fun _ _ _ _ a ha haN => by omega⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Skeleton:32.name: OAI.CoboundaryExpanders.Construction.actual_uniform_cosystolic
OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Skeleton:32.text:
theorem actual_uniform_cosystolic (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Q : ℕ, ∀ p : ℕ, ∀ _ : Fact p.Prime, Q < p → UniformCosystolic p n (by omega) := by
  obtain ⟨Q,K,hK,hraw⟩ := uniform_actual_raw_cosystolic n hn
  refine ⟨Q,?_⟩
  intro p hp hqp
  have hM : 0 < (localBound p n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast localBound_pos p n
  have heta : 0 < (1/(K*2^(n+1)) : ℝ) := by positivity
  refine ⟨(1/(K*2^(n+1)))/(localBound p n),div_pos heta hM,?_⟩
  intro m hm i hi
  apply (Complex.skeleton_cosystolic_iff hi _).mpr
  apply Complex.skeleton_cosystolic_of_ambient (finiteCosetComplex_pure p n (by omega) m) hi
    (by omega) hM heta.le (finiteCosetComplex_coface_bounds p n (by omega) m (n-1))
  let : Fintype (Gquot p (n+1) m) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  apply CosetConstruction.cosystolic_of_typed_raw (reducedLocalGroup p n (by omega) m) i (by omega) hK
  exact hraw p hp hqp m hm (i+2) (by omega)
end CoboundaryExpanders.Construction

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Realization.name: OAI.CoboundaryExpanders.Complex.skeleton_cosystolic_iff
OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Realization.text:
theorem skeleton_cosystolic_iff {X : Complex} {s i : ℕ} (hi : i < s) (η : ℝ) :
    (∀ f : (X.skeleton s).Cochain i,
      η * (X.skeleton s).distance s i f ((X.skeleton s).cocycles i) ≤
        (X.skeleton s).norm s (i+1) ((X.skeleton s).coboundary i f)) ↔
    (∀ f : X.Cochain i,
      η * X.distance s i f (X.cocycles i) ≤ X.norm s (i+1) (X.coboundary i f)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h f
    have hh := h (X.skeletonCochainEquiv hi.le f)
    rw [← skeleton_cocycles hi, skeleton_distance_image,
      skeleton_coboundary X hi, skeleton_norm] at hh
    exact hh
  · intro h f
    obtain ⟨f₀,rfl⟩ := (X.skeletonCochainEquiv hi.le).surjective f
    rw [← skeleton_cocycles hi, skeleton_distance_image,
      skeleton_coboundary X hi, skeleton_norm]
    exact h f₀

theorem reduction_to_three_open_inputs
    (hinputs : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ hd : 3 ≤ d, ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ hp : p.Prime, Odd p ∧
      letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
      OppositionAcyclic p (2*d) (by omega) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i → i < d →
        CongruenceCokernels.ProZero p (2*d-1) i ∧ CongruenceCokernels.ProZero p (2*d) i) ∧
      UniformCosystolic p (2*d) (by omega)) : MainStatement := by
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨p,hp,ho,hL,hz,hq⟩ := hinputs d hd
  let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨D,hPC,hgrowth,hdegree⟩ := constructed_connected_pure_bounded_growing p d hd
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hexp⟩ := constructed_expansion_of_open_inputs p d hd ho hL hz hq
  exact ⟨D,ε,hε,finiteSkeleton p (2*d) (by omega) d,hPC,hgrowth,hdegree,hexp⟩

def UniformCosystolic (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Prop :=
  ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ i : ℕ, i < n-1 →
    ∀ f : ((finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).skeleton (n-1)).Cochain i,
      η * ((finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).skeleton (n-1)).distance (n-1) i f
          (((finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).skeleton (n-1)).cocycles i) ≤
        ((finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).skeleton (n-1)).norm (n-1) (i+1)
          (((finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).skeleton (n-1)).coboundary i f)

theorem uniform_gamma_vanishing (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q : ℕ, ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Odd p → Q < p →
      ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → ∀ a : ℕ, 2*j+2 ≤ a → a ≤ N →
        ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
          IsZero (groupHomology (Rep.trivial (ZMod 2) (Gamma p a m) (ZMod 2)) j) := by
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := uniform_u_homology N
  exact ⟨Q,fun p _ hp hQp => gamma_vanishing_of_u p N hp (hQ p hp hQp)⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Realization.text:
theorem finiteCosetComplex_coface_bounds (hn : 1 ≤ n) (m i : ℕ)
    (σ : (finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).Face i) :
    1 ≤ ((finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).cofaceCount n σ.val : ℝ) ∧
    ((finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).cofaceCount n σ.val : ℝ) ≤ localBound p n := by
  constructor
  · exact_mod_cast cofaceCount_pos_of_pure (finiteCosetComplex_pure p n hn m) σ
  · have hp : σ.val.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [face_card σ]; omega)
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hp
    have h := (cofaceCount_le_topDegree σ n v hv).trans
      (finiteCosetComplex_degree p n hn m n v)
    simpa only [Nat.choose_self, Nat.mul_one] using (show
      ((finiteCosetComplex p n hn m).cofaceCount n σ.val : ℝ) ≤
        (localBound p n * Nat.choose n n : ℕ) from by exact_mod_cast h)

def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ d : ℕ, 3 ≤ d →
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧
      ∃ X : ℕ → Complex,
        (∀ m, (X m).Pure d ∧ (X m).Connected) ∧
        Tendsto (fun m => ((X m).facesOf 0).card) atTop atTop ∧
        (∀ m (v : Fin (X m).vertexCount), (X m).topDegree d v ≤ D) ∧
        ∀ m i, i < d → ∀ f : (X m).Cochain i,
          ε * (X m).distance d i f ((X m).coboundaries i) ≤
            (X m).norm d (i + 1) ((X m).coboundary i f)

end CoboundaryExpanders

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Skeleton:29.text:
theorem skeleton_cosystolic_of_ambient {X : Complex} {i s n : ℕ}
    (hX : X.Pure n) (hi : i < s) (hs : s ≤ n) {M η : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hc : ∀ ρ : X.Face s, 1 ≤ (X.cofaceCount n ρ.val : ℝ) ∧
      (X.cofaceCount n ρ.val : ℝ) ≤ M)
    (hquant : ∀ f : X.Cochain i,
      η * X.distance n i f (X.cocycles i) ≤ X.norm n (i+1) (X.coboundary i f))
    (f : X.Cochain i) :
    (η/M) * X.distance s i f (X.cocycles i) ≤ X.norm s (i+1) (X.coboundary i f) := by
  have hZ : (X.cocycles i).Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [cocycles]⟩
  have hdist := (skeleton_distance_comparison hX hi.le hs zero_lt_one hc f hZ).2
  have hnorm := (skeleton_norm_comparison hX hi hs zero_lt_one hc (X.coboundary i f)).1
  simp only [div_one] at hdist
  calc
    (η/M) * X.distance s i f (X.cocycles i) ≤
        (η/M) * (X.skeletonScale n s * X.distance n i f (X.cocycles i)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist (div_nonneg hη hM.le)
    _ = (X.skeletonScale n s/M) * (η * X.distance n i f (X.cocycles i)) := by ring
    _ ≤ (X.skeletonScale n s/M) * X.norm n (i+1) (X.coboundary i f) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hquant f) (div_nonneg (skeletonScale_pos hX hs).le hM.le)
    _ ≤ _ := hnorm
end CoboundaryExpanders.Complex

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Main:73.text:
theorem proZero_of_target_vanishing (p a j : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
      IsZero (groupHomology (Rep.trivial (ZMod 2) (Gamma p (a+1) m) (ZMod 2)) j)) :
    CongruenceCokernels.ProZero p a j := by
  intro m hm
  have : Subsingleton (CongruenceCokernels.H p (a+1) m j) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (hz m hm)
  have hs : Function.Surjective (CongruenceCokernels.stabilization p a m j) :=
    fun x => ⟨0,Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  have : Subsingleton (CongruenceCokernels.C p a m j) :=
    (Cokernel.surjective_iff_coker_subsingleton _).mp hs
  exact ⟨m,le_refl m,Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.Coboundary.Main:42.text:
theorem gamma_vanishing_of_u (p N : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : Odd p)
    (hU : ∀ a : ℕ, 4 ≤ a → a ≤ N → ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < a-2 →
      IsZero (groupHomology (Rep.trivial (ZMod 2) (U p a) (ZMod 2)) j)) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → ∀ a : ℕ, 2*j+2 ≤ a → a ≤ N →
      ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
        IsZero (groupHomology (Rep.trivial (ZMod 2) (Gamma p a m) (ZMod 2)) j) := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h j ih =>
    intro hj a ha haN m hm
    obtain ⟨q,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : j ≠ 0)
    obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : a ≠ 0)
    apply QuotientVanishing.gamma_isZero_of_U_and_action p (a+1) m Fact.out hp hm (q+1)
    · exact hU (a+1) (by omega) haN (q+1) (by omega) (by omega)
    · intro g
      exact CongruenceFrames.conjugation_trivial p a m hm hp q ha (by
        intro t ht htq
        exact ih (q+1-t) (by omega) (by omega) (a+1-(t+1)) (by omega) (by omega) m hm) g

theorem reduction_to_positive_open_inputs
    (hinputs : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ hd : 3 ≤ d, ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ hp : p.Prime, Odd p ∧
      letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < 2*d-1 →
        (infiniteCosetComplex p (2*d) (by omega)).chainComplex.ExactAt j) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i → i < d →
        CongruenceCokernels.ProZero p (2*d-1) i ∧ CongruenceCokernels.ProZero p (2*d) i) ∧
      UniformCosystolic p (2*d) (by omega)) : MainStatement := by
  apply reduction_to_three_open_inputs
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨p,hp,ho,hL,hz,hq⟩ := hinputs d hd
  let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  exact ⟨p,hp,ho,(oppositionAcyclic_iff_positive p (2*d) (by omega)).mpr hL,hz,hq⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma frozen_machine (fp fq : SizePolynomial) (n r : ℕ)
    (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hε : 0<ε)
    (hp : Safe O (fp.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) preambleCode (frozenValue n r ε δ))
    (hq : ∀ w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ),
      Safe O (fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) postambleCode (rawValue n r ε δ w))
    (B : ℕ) (hB : (totalResourcePoly fp fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)≤B) :
    ∃ (v : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) → ℚ) (start : ℕ),
      OutputCertificate r M₁ M₂ O ε δ v ∧ start+3*fairBitCount n ε δ+1≤B ∧
      ∀ bits : ℕ → Bool,
        let out := execution fprasBlock.code O (initialConfig 1 fprasBlock.size n r ε δ) bits B
        out.output=some (v (physicalWord start (fairBitCount n ε δ) bits)) ∧
          out.oracleCalls≤B ∧ out.bitOperations≤B := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := output_certificate r M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ ε δ
  obtain ⟨counter,hc,hpc⟩ := run_preambleCode O r ε δ hε
  have hn := (master_fields n r ε δ).1
  have hpre := compile_majorant O preambleCode fp (masterParameter n r ε δ) hn _ _ hp hpc
  have hpost (w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ)) :
      Bounded (compile postambleCode) O (pair (List.ofFn w) (encode (preparedValue n r ε δ)))
        (pair (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits)
        ((compiledMajorant postambleCode fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) ∧
      2*(rationalPair (v w)).1.bits.length+1+(rationalPair (v w)).2.bits.length≤
        fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) := by
    constructor
    · have hm := compile_majorant O postambleCode fq (masterParameter n r ε δ) hn
        (rawValue n r ε δ w) (rationalPair (v w)) (hq w) (hv.1 w)
      rw [encode_rawValue,encode_natPair] at hm
      exact hm
    · have hw := safe_output (hq w) (hv.1 w)
      rw [width_natPair] at hw
      exact hw
  have hb := (totalResourcePoly_budget fp fq n r ε δ (rank_le_ground M₁ hr₁)).trans hB
  obtain ⟨start,hs,he⟩ := pipeline_budgeted_length O n.bits r.bits ε.num.natAbs.bits ε.den.bits
    δ.num.natAbs.bits δ.den.bits (compile preambleCode) (compile postambleCode)
    counter (encode (preparedValue n r ε δ)) (fairBitCount n ε δ)
    ((compiledMajorant preambleCode fp).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ))
    ((compiledMajorant postambleCode fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ))
    (fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) B hc hpre v (fun w => (hv.2.1 w).1) hpost hb
  exact ⟨v,start,hv,hs,he⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.MainTheorem
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
def MainTheorem : Prop :=
  ∃ (k s : ℕ) (P : Program k s) (C d : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (n r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
      (ε δ : ℚ),
      M₁.E = Set.univ → M₂.E = Set.univ →
      M₁.eRank = (r : ℕ∞) → M₂.eRank = (r : ℕ∞) →
      ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 0 < δ → δ < 1 →
      let B := resourceBound C d n r ε δ
      let Z := commonBaseCount M₁ M₂
      (∀ bits : ℕ → Bool,
        let out := execution P O (initialConfig k s n r ε δ) bits B
        out.output.isSome ∧ out.oracleCalls ≤ B ∧ out.bitOperations ≤ B ∧
        ∀ z, out.output = some z → 0 ≤ z ∧ (Z = 0 → z = 0)) ∧
      (1 - δ) * (2 : ℚ) ^ B ≤
        (Nat.card {bits : Fin B → Bool //
          ∃ z, (execution P O (initialConfig k s n r ε δ) (finiteBits bits) B).output
            = some z ∧ relativeAccuracy ε Z z} : ℚ)

lemma pipeline_budgeted_length {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (a b c d e f : Word) (pre post : Block 1) (counter params : Word)
    (F cp cq W B : ℕ) (hF : counter.length=F)
    (hp : Bounded pre O (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))
      (pair counter params) cp)
    (v : BitWord F → ℚ) (hv : ∀ w,0≤v w)
    (hq : ∀ w,Bounded post O (pair (List.ofFn w) params)
      (pair (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits) cq ∧
      2*(rationalPair (v w)).1.bits.length+1+(rationalPair (v w)).2.bits.length≤W)
    (hB : pipelineBudget (inputTime a b c d e f) F cp cq W≤B) :
    ∃ start,start+3*F+1≤B ∧ ∀ bits : ℕ → Bool,
      let out := execution (pipeline pre post).code O (state (sixRegs a b c d e f) 0 0 0) bits B
      out.output=some (v (physicalWord start F bits)) ∧
        out.oracleCalls≤B ∧ out.bitOperations≤B := by
  subst F
  exact pipeline_budgeted O a b c d e f pre post counter params cp cq W B hp v hv hq hB

def machineStep {k s n : ℕ} (P : Program k s) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (randomBit : Bool) (c : MachineConfig k s) : MachineConfig k s :=
  if c.output.isSome then c else
  match P c.control with
  | .push i b next =>
    { c with
      registers := Function.update c.registers i (b :: c.registers i)
      control := next
      bitOperations := c.bitOperations + 1 }
  | .pop i empty zero one =>
    match c.registers i with
    | [] => { c with
      control := empty
      bitOperations := c.bitOperations + 1 }
    | b :: l =>
      { c with
      registers := Function.update c.registers i l
      control := if b then one else zero
      bitOperations := c.bitOperations + 1 }
  | .coin zero one =>
    { c with
      control := if randomBit then one else zero
      bitOperations := c.bitOperations + 1 }
  | .query which i no yes =>
    if (c.registers i).length = n then
      { c with
      control := if O which (fun j => (c.registers i)[j.val]?.getD false)
          then yes else no
      oracleCalls := c.oracleCalls + 1
      bitOperations := c.bitOperations + (c.registers i).length + n + 1 }
    else
      { c with
      output := some 0
      bitOperations := c.bitOperations + (c.registers i).length + n + 1 }
  | .halt =>
    { c with
      output := some ((binaryValue (c.registers ⟨6, by omega⟩) : ℚ) /
        (binaryValue (c.registers ⟨7, by omega⟩) : ℚ))
      bitOperations := c.bitOperations + (c.registers ⟨6, by omega⟩).length +
        (c.registers ⟨7, by omega⟩).length + 1 }

lemma frozen_preamble_scope {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (hr : r≤n) (hε : 0<ε) :
    width (frozenValue n r ε δ)≤ scopeEnvelope.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) ∧
      ∀ k,run O frozenBitCount (frozenValue n r ε δ)=some k →
        k≤ scopeEnvelope.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) := by
  have hh := envelope_parameters n r ε δ hr
  dsimp only at hh
  constructor
  · have hw := width_frozen n r ε δ
    simp only [scopeEnvelope,SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  · intro k hk
    rw [run_frozenBitCount O r ε δ hε,Option.some.injEq] at hk
    rw [←hk]
    exact hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.trans (scopeEnvelope_ge _)

OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.canonical_bounded_fair_experiment
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
theorem canonical_bounded_fair_experiment (n r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O)
    (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞))
    (ε δ : ℚ) (hε0 : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε<1) (hδ : 0<δ) :
    (∀ bits : FPRASBank n ε δ,0≤canonicalBoundedOutput n r O ε δ bits ∧
      (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂=0 → canonicalBoundedOutput n r O ε δ bits=0)) ∧
    1-(δ:ℝ)≤uniformAverage (fun bits : FPRASBank n ε δ =>
      if relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) (canonicalBoundedOutput n r O ε δ bits) then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
  by_cases hn : 0<n
  · constructor
    · intro bits
      simp only [canonicalBoundedOutput,dite_eq_left hn]
      exact canonicalAmplifiedOutput_all n hn r O _ _ M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ δ bits
    · simp only [canonicalBoundedOutput,dite_eq_left hn]
      have hlaw := canonicalAmplifiedOutput_law n hn r O
        (sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε)
        (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂
        (by unfold sampleCount; omega) δ
        (fun z => if relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) z then (1:ℝ) else 0)
      rw [hlaw]
      exact (bounded_fair_experiment n hn M₁ M₂ hE₁ hE₂ (hr₁.trans hr₂.symm) ε δ hε0 hε1 hδ).2
  · have hn0 : n=0 := by omega
    subst n
    have ho : ∀ bits : FPRASBank 0 ε δ,canonicalBoundedOutput 0 r O ε δ bits=1 := by intro bits; simp [canonicalBoundedOutput]
    constructor
    · intro bits
      rw [ho bits,commonBaseCount_empty]
      norm_num
    · have hac : 1-ε≤(1:ℚ) ∧ (1:ℚ)≤1+ε := by constructor <;> linarith
      simpa only [ho,commonBaseCount_empty,relativeAccuracy,Nat.cast_one,mul_one,ite_eq_left hac,
        uniformAverage_const] using (sub_le_self (1:ℝ) (by exact_mod_cast hδ.le : (0:ℝ)≤δ))

def OutputCertificate {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (v : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) → ℚ) : Prop :=
  (∀ w,run O postambleCode (rawValue n r ε δ w)=some (rationalPair (v w))) ∧
  (∀ w,0≤v w ∧ (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂=0 → v w=0)) ∧
  (∀ φ : ℚ → ℝ,uniformAverage (fun w => φ (v w))=
    uniformAverage (fun banks : FPRASBank n ε δ => φ (canonicalBoundedOutput n r O ε δ banks)))

lemma rank_le_ground {n r : ℕ} (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (hr : M.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) : r ≤ n := by
  have h := M.eRank_le_encard_ground
  rw [hr] at h
  have hg : M.E.encard ≤ n := (Set.encard_mono (Set.subset_univ _)).trans_eq (by simp)
  exact_mod_cast h.trans hg

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma safe_postamble : OracleSafe postambleCode rawScope := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := safe_reshapePrepared
  let g : SizePolynomial := .add f .input
  unfold postambleCode
  apply oracleSafe_compose _ _ rawScope (fun n O S z => finishScope n O (g.eval S) z)
    ⟨f,hf⟩ (oracleSafe_reparam _ _ safe_finish g)
  intro n O S z hz y hy
  have he : z.2.1=y.1 := Option.some.inj (run_both_parts O _ _ z y hy).1
  refine ⟨(safe_output (hf O S z hz) hy).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),?_,?_⟩
  · rw [←he]; exact hz.2.2.2.1
  · intro hn
    rw [←he]
    exact algorithmScope_mono (hz.2.2.2.2 hn) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

lemma compile_majorant {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (f : SizePolynomial) (T : ℕ) (hn : n≤T)
    (x : Value a) (y : Value b) (hs : Safe O (f.eval T) p x) (hr : run O p x=some y) :
    Bounded (compile p) O (encode x) (encode y) ((compiledMajorant p f).eval T) := by
  apply bounded_mono (compile_safe_bound O p (f.eval T) x y hs hr)
  simp only [compiledMajorant,SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_pow]
  gcongr

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.MachineCode.totalResourcePoly_budget
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma totalResourcePoly_budget (fp fq : SizePolynomial) (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) (hr : r≤n) :
    pipelineBudget
      (inputTime n.bits r.bits ε.num.natAbs.bits ε.den.bits δ.num.natAbs.bits δ.den.bits)
      (fairBitCount n ε δ) ((compiledMajorant preambleCode fp).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ))
      ((compiledMajorant postambleCode fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ))
      (fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) ≤
      (totalResourcePoly fp fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) := by
  have hi := inputTime_bound n.bits r.bits ε.num.natAbs.bits ε.den.bits δ.num.natAbs.bits δ.den.bits
  change _ ≤ 100*inputLength n r ε δ at hi
  have ha := envelope_parameters n r ε δ hr
  have hF := ha.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hI := ha.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  simp only [pipelineBudget,totalResourcePoly,SizePolynomial.eval]
  omega

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.MachineCode.output_certificate
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma output_certificate {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞))
    (ε δ : ℚ) : ∃ v,OutputCertificate r M₁ M₂ O ε δ v := by
  let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
  let N := sampleCount n L ε
  by_cases hn : 0<n
  · obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩ := algorithmCode_source M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ r N L hn
    have ht := canonicalTree_all hn r N L M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂
    have huall := hu.all _ ht
    let v : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) → ℚ := fun w =>
      treeBanksOutput u (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i)))
    refine ⟨v,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro w
      rw [postambleCode,run_compose,run_reshapePrepared,Option.bind_some]
      have hz : ∀ bank∈List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i)),
          0≤(bankEval u bank).1.join.getD 0 := fun bank _ => (treeBankOutput_all u _ huall bank).1
      have hh := run_amplifiedCode O (params n r N L) u he _ hz
      have hc : run O (Expression.compose fst (Expression.compose fst (Expression.compose fst natEqZero)) : Expression AmplifyInput .bool)
          (params n r N L,List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i)))=some false := by
        simp [params,run_natEqZero,run_compose,run_fst,ne_of_gt hn]
      rw [finishCode,run_applyIf,hc,Option.bind_some]
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
      exact hh
    · intro w; exact treeBanksOutput_all u _ huall _
    · intro φ
      have hfit := canonicalAlgorithmTree_fits n hn r O N L M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂
        (by dsimp [N,sampleCount]; omega)
      have hb := reindexed_banks_law hu (drawWordBound n N L) (algorithmDrawBound n N L+6)
        (algorithmDrawBound n N L) (repetitionCount δ) hfit φ
      calc
        _ = uniformAverage (fun banks : FPRASBank n ε δ =>
            φ (treeBanksOutput u (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (banks i))))) :=
          uniformAverage_equiv (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ) _
        _ = _ := by simpa only [canonicalBoundedOutput,dite_eq_left hn,
          canonicalAmplifiedOutput,canonicalFairOutput] using hb
  · refine ⟨fun _ => 1,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro w
      rw [postambleCode,run_compose,run_reshapePrepared,Option.bind_some]
      have hc : run O (Expression.compose fst (Expression.compose fst (Expression.compose fst natEqZero)) : Expression AmplifyInput .bool)
          (params n r N L,List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i)))=some true := by
        simp [params,run_natEqZero,run_compose,run_fst,show n=0 by omega]
      rw [finishCode,run_applyIf,hc,Option.bind_some,ite_eq_left rfl]
      rfl
    · intro w
      have hn0 : n=0 := by omega
      subst n
      simp [commonBaseCount_empty]
    · intro φ
      simp only [canonicalBoundedOutput,dite_eq_right hn,uniformAverage_const]

open Expression

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.MachineCode.sourceEnvelope

def sourceEnvelope : SizePolynomial :=
  .add (.add (.add (.add atomPoly tauPoly) capPoly) fairPoly) (.constant 6)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.accuracyExponent
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text: def accuracyExponent (ε : ℚ) : ℕ := ε.den.bits.length+5

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.MachineCode.frozen_uniform_safe
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma frozen_uniform_safe : ∃ fp fq : SizePolynomial,
    ∀ (n r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ),
      ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O → M₁.E=Set.univ → M₂.E=Set.univ → M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞) → 0<ε →
      Safe O (fp.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) preambleCode (frozenValue n r ε δ) ∧
      ∀ w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ),
        Safe O (fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) postambleCode (rawValue n r ε δ w) := by
  obtain ⟨fp,hp⟩ := safe_preamble
  obtain ⟨fq,hq⟩ := safe_postamble
  refine ⟨fp.subst scopeEnvelope,fq.subst scopeEnvelope,?_⟩
  intro n r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr hε
  simp only [SizePolynomial.eval_subst]
  refine ⟨hp O _ _ (frozen_preamble_scope O r ε δ (rank_le_ground M₁ hr) hε),?_⟩
  intro w
  exact hq O _ _ (rawValue_scope r M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ hr ε δ w)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.common_bases_fpras
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
theorem common_bases_fpras : CommonBasesFPRAS.MainTheorem := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨fp,fq,hs⟩ := frozen_uniform_safe
  let p := totalResourcePoly fp fq
  refine ⟨1,fprasBlock.size,fprasBlock.code,p.coefficient*2^p.degree+1,p.degree,by omega,?_⟩
  intro n r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ hO hε hε1 hδ hδ1
  have hh := hs n r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hε
  let B := resourceBound (p.coefficient*2^p.degree+1) p.degree n r ε δ
  have hB : p.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)≤B :=
    p.monomial_bound _ (master_pos n r ε δ)
  obtain ⟨v,start,hv,hstart,he⟩ := frozen_machine fp fq n r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ hε hh.1 hh.2 B hB
  constructor
  · intro bits
    have h := he bits
    refine ⟨?_,h.2.1,h.2.2,?_⟩
    · rw [h.1]; rfl
    · intro z hz
      rw [h.1] at hz
      have hez := Option.some.inj hz
      subst z
      exact hv.2.1 _
  · have ha := physical_accuracy r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ hε hε1 hδ v hv start B hstart
    have hpred (bits : BitWord B) :
        (∃ z,(execution fprasBlock.code O (initialConfig 1 fprasBlock.size n r ε δ) (finiteBits bits) B).output=some z ∧
          relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) z) ↔
        relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) (v (physicalWord start (fairBitCount n ε δ) (finiteBits bits))) := by
      rw [(he (finiteBits bits)).1]
      simp only [Option.some.injEq,exists_eq_left']
    change (1-δ)*(2:ℚ)^B ≤ (Nat.card {bits : BitWord B // ∃ z,
      (execution fprasBlock.code O (initialConfig 1 fprasBlock.size n r ε δ) (finiteBits bits) B).output=some z ∧
        relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) z}:ℚ)
    simpa only [hpred] using ha

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.MachineCode.run_preambleCode
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma run_preambleCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∃ counter : Word,counter.length=fairBitCount n ε δ ∧
      run O preambleCode (frozenValue n r ε δ)=some (counter,preparedValue n r ε δ) := by
  exact run_preamble_generic O _ _ _ (run_frozenBitCount O r ε δ hε) (run_frozenPrepared O r ε δ hε)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.MachineCode.physicalWord_law
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma physicalWord_law (start m B : ℕ) (h : start+3*m+1≤B) (φ : BitWord m → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun w : BitWord B => φ (physicalWord start m (finiteBits w)))=uniformAverage φ := by
  simp_rw [physicalWord_finite start m B h]
  exact uniformAverage_bitEmbedding m B _ (physicalPosition_injective start m B h) φ

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.relativeAccuracy
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
def relativeAccuracy (ε : ℚ) (Z : ℕ) (z : ℚ) : Prop :=
  (1-ε)*(Z:ℚ)≤z ∧ z≤(1+ε)*(Z:ℚ)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.name: OAI.CommonBasesFPRAS.MachineCode.rawValue_scope
OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma rawValue_scope {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (ε δ : ℚ) (w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ)) :
    rawScope n O (scopeEnvelope.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) (rawValue n r ε δ w) := by
  have hr := rank_le_ground M₁ hr₁
  have hs := scopeEnvelope_ge (masterParameter n r ε δ)
  have hh := envelope_parameters n r ε δ hr
  dsimp only at hh
  have hw := width_prepared_bound n r ε δ hr
  refine ⟨?_,hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.trans hs,hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.trans hs,rfl,?_⟩
  · rw [rawValue,width_pair (a:=.word) (b:=PreparedData),width_word,List.length_ofFn]
    simp only [scopeEnvelope,SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  · intro hn
    let m : SamplerModel n O := ⟨M₁,M₂,hO,hE₁,hE₂,hn,r,
      sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε,annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)⟩
    refine ⟨m,?_,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hh.1.trans hs,hh.2.1.trans hs,hh.2.2.1.trans hs,hh.2.2.2.1.trans hs,
      hh.2.2.2.2.1.trans hs,hh.2.2.2.2.2.1.trans hs⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.MatroidCounting.Common.text:
lemma physical_accuracy {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞))
    (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε<1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (v : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) → ℚ) (hv : OutputCertificate r M₁ M₂ O ε δ v)
    (start B : ℕ) (hstart : start+3*fairBitCount n ε δ+1≤B) :
    (1-δ)*(2:ℚ)^B ≤ (Nat.card {bits : BitWord B // relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂)
      (v (physicalWord start (fairBitCount n ε δ) (finiteBits bits)))}:ℚ) := by
  have h := (canonical_bounded_fair_experiment n r O M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ ε δ hε hε1 hδ).2
  rw [←hv.2.2 (fun z => if relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) z then (1:ℝ) else 0)] at h
  rw [←physicalWord_law start (fairBitCount n ε δ) B hstart
    (fun w => if relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) (v w) then (1:ℝ) else 0)] at h
  rw [uniformAverage_indicator_card] at h
  have hcard : Fintype.card (BitWord B)=2^B := by simp [BitWord]
  rw [hcard,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
  have hh := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<2^B)).mp h
  exact_mod_cast hh
end MachineCode

    width x≤S ∧ ∀ k,run O frozenBitCount x=some k → k≤S) := by
  unfold preambleCode
  apply oracleSafe_both
  · apply oracleSafe_compose _ unary _ (fun _ _ S k => k≤S)
      (oracleSafe_controlled _ controlled_frozenBitCount _ .input (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1))
      (oracleSafe_lift _ _ polySafe_unary)
    intro n O S x hx k hk; exact hx.2 k hk
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ controlled_frozenPrepared _ .input (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
theorem descended_kernel (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι)
    (c : A) (hu : IsUnit (ι c)) (N : ℕ)
    (D : Derivation K L L) (d : Derivation K A A)
    (hdesc : ∀ a, ι (d a) = (ι c)^N * D (ι a)) (a : A) :
    d a = 0 ↔ D (ι a) = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have he := hdesc a
    rw [hz, map_zero] at he
    exact (hu.pow N).mul_right_eq_zero.mp he.symm
  · intro hz
    apply hinj
    simpa [hz] using hdesc a

theorem extended_isLocalization {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) :

    IsLocalization.Away (extendedF hn+1) (ExtendedLocalizedAmbient n) := by
  let := extendedAlgebra hn
  let : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin (n-4)) R) (ExtendedLocalizedAmbient n) :=
    MvPolynomial.algebraMvPolynomial
  have : IsLocalization ((Submonoid.powers ambientC).map
      (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin (n-4)) R)) (ExtendedLocalizedAmbient n) :=
    MvPolynomial.isLocalization _ _
  apply IsLocalization.of_ringEquiv_left (splitAmbient hn).toRingEquiv
    (M₁ := (Submonoid.powers ambientC).map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin (n-4)) R))
  · simp [Submonoid.map_powers, splitAmbient_F, ambientC]
  · intro f
    rfl

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.exists_common_denominator_descent
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
theorem exists_common_denominator_descent (c : MvPolynomial σ K)
    [IsLocalization.Away c L]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L))
    (D : τ → Derivation K L L) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (d : τ → Derivation K (MvPolynomial σ K) (MvPolynomial σ K)),
      ∀ (i : τ) (p : MvPolynomial σ K),
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L (d i p) =
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L c)^N *
            D i (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L p) := by
  let ι : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] L := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (MvPolynomial σ K) L
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := finite_localization_denominator_bound c
    (fun i j => D i (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L (X j)))
  have hstable (i : τ) : ∀ p : MvPolynomial σ K,
      ∃ q : MvPolynomial σ K, ι q =
        ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L c)^N • D i) (ι p) := by
    apply derivation_preserves_polynomial_image ι
    intro j
    simpa [ι, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hN i j
  choose d hd using fun i => exists_descendDerivation ι hinj
    ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L c)^N • D i) (hstable i)
  refine ⟨N, d, ?_⟩
  intro i p
  simpa [ι, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hd i p

end Clearing

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.descended_commute
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
theorem descended_commute (ι : A →ₐ[K] L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι)
    (c : A) (N : ℕ) (D E : Derivation K L L) (d e : Derivation K A A)
    (hd : ∀ a, ι (d a) = (ι c)^N * D (ι a))
    (he : ∀ a, ι (e a) = (ι c)^N * E (ι a))
    (hD : D (ι c) = 0) (hE : E (ι c) = 0)
    (hDE : ∀ a, D (E a) = E (D a)) (a : A) : d (e a) = e (d a) := by
  have hDp : D ((ι c)^N) = 0 := by simp [Derivation.leibniz_pow, hD]
  have hEp : E ((ι c)^N) = 0 := by simp [Derivation.leibniz_pow, hE]
  exact descendDerivation_commute ι hinj ((ι c)^N • D) ((ι c)^N • E) d e
    (by simpa only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hd)
    (by simpa only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using he)
    (scaleDerivation_commute D E ((ι c)^N) ((ι c)^N) hDp hEp hDE) a

theorem extendedParameter_localization_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.exists_commuting_family_of_localization
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
theorem exists_commuting_family_of_localization
    (c : MvPolynomial σ K) [IsLocalization.Away c L]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L))
    (e : L ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ B) (b : B)
    (hec : e (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L c) = C b)
    (S : Subalgebra K (MvPolynomial σ K))
    (hintersection : ∀ p : MvPolynomial σ K,
      (∃ b : B, e (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L p) = C b) ↔ p ∈ S) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (d : τ → Derivation K (MvPolynomial σ K) (MvPolynomial σ K)),
      (∀ i p, algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L (d i p) =
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L c)^N *
          localizedPartial e i (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) L p)) ∧
      (∀ i, d i c = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j p, d i (d j p) = d j (d i p)) ∧
      (∀ i, LocallyNilpotent (d i)) ∧
      LinearIndependent (MvPolynomial σ K) d ∧
      (∀ p, (∀ i, d i p = 0) ↔ p ∈ S) := by
  classical
  let ι : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] L :=
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (MvPolynomial σ K) L
  let D : τ → Derivation K L L := localizedPartial e
  have hfix (i : τ) : D i (ι c) = 0 :=
    localizedPartial_fixes_relative e i (ι c) b hec
  have hu : IsUnit (ι c) := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit c
  obtain ⟨N, d, hd⟩ := exists_common_denominator_descent c hinj D
  have hd' (i : τ) (p : MvPolynomial σ K) :
      ι (d i p) = (ι c)^N * D i (ι p) := hd i p
  refine ⟨N, d, hd, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact descended_fixes_parameter ι hinj c N (D i) (d i) (hd' i) (hfix i)
  · intro i j p
    exact descended_commute ι hinj c N (D i) (D j) (d i) (d j)
      (hd' i) (hd' j) (hfix i) (hfix j) (localizedPartials_commute e i j) p
  · intro i
    exact descended_locallyNilpotent ι hinj c N (D i) (d i) (hd' i) (hfix i)
      (localizedPartial_locallyNilpotent e i)
  · apply descended_linearIndependent ι hinj c hu N D d hd' hfix
      (fun j => e.symm (X j)) (localizedPartial_coordinate e)
    intro j
    exact IsLocalization.Away.surj c (e.symm (X j))
  · intro p
    calc
      (∀ i, d i p = 0) ↔ ∀ i, D i (ι p) = 0 :=
        forall_congr' (fun i => descended_kernel ι hinj c hu N (D i) (d i) (hd' i) p)
      _ ↔ ∃ b : B, e (ι p) = C b := localizedPartials_common_kernel e (ι p)
      _ ↔ p ∈ S := hintersection p

end AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations

end

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.element_of_extendedF_subring_not_coordinate
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
theorem element_of_extendedF_subring_not_coordinate {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.transportDerivation
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
def transportDerivation (e : A ≃ₐ[K] B) (D : Derivation K B B) : Derivation K A A where
  toLinearMap := e.symm.toLinearMap.comp (D.toLinearMap.comp e.toLinearMap)
  map_one_eq_zero' := by
    change e.symm (D (e 1)) = 0
    simp
  leibniz' a b := by
    change e.symm (D (e (a * b))) = a * e.symm (D (e b)) + b * e.symm (D (e a))
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul]

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.exists_aeval_add_one_iff
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
theorem exists_aeval_add_one_iff {K A : Type*} [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    (f a : A) :
    (∃ q : Polynomial K, a = Polynomial.aeval (f + 1) q) ↔
      ∃ q : Polynomial K, a = Polynomial.aeval f q := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨q.comp (Polynomial.X + 1), ?_⟩
    simp [Polynomial.aeval_comp]
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨q.comp (Polynomial.X - 1), ?_⟩
    simp [Polynomial.aeval_comp]

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.extendedLocMap_extra_pderiv
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
theorem extendedLocMap_extra_pderiv {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (i : Fin (n-4)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) :
    pderiv i (extendedLocMap hn p) =
      extendedLocMap hn (pderiv (blocksToAmbient hn (Sum.inl i)) p) := by
  change pderiv i (MvPolynomial.map loc (splitAmbient hn p)) =
    MvPolynomial.map loc
      (splitAmbient hn (pderiv (blocksToAmbient hn (Sum.inl i)) p))
  rw [pderiv_map, splitAmbient_extra_pderiv]

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.name: OAI.AbhyankarSathaye.CommutingDerivations.localizedPartials_common_kernel
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.CommutingDerivatio.text:
theorem localizedPartials_common_kernel [IsDomain B] [CharZero B]
