OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sobolev.Sobole.name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.WeightedAnnihilation
OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sobolev.Sobole.text:
def WeightedAnnihilation (a : R3 → ℝ) (w u : H1) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (f : R3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) f →
    HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f⊆ball →
      ∫ x, a x*inner ℝ (weakGradient w x)
        ((weakValue u x-c) • gradient f x+f x • weakGradient u x) ∂ballMeasure=0

OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sobolev.Sobole.name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.gaugeCoefficient_bounds
OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sobolev.Sobole.text:
lemma gaugeCoefficient_bounds {a : R3 → ℝ} {w : H1} {c C : ℝ}
    (hc : 0<c) (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, c≤a x ∧ a x≤C)
    (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |weakValue w x|≤1/2) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, c/4≤gaugeCoefficient a w x ∧ gaugeCoefficient a w x≤9*C/4 := by
  filter_upwards [ha,hw] with x hx hy
  have hlo := (abs_le.mp hy).1
  have hup := (abs_le.mp hy).2
  have hp : 0≤a x := le_trans hc.le hx.1
  have hrlo : (1/4:ℝ)≤(1+weakValue w x)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hrup : (1+weakValue w x)^2≤(9/4:ℝ) := by nlinarith
  constructor
  · change c/4≤a x*(1+weakValue w x)^2
    calc
      _ = c*(1/4:ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ a x*(1/4:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx.1 (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrlo hp
  · change a x*(1+weakValue w x)^2≤9*C/4
    calc
      _ ≤ a x*(9/4:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrup hp
      _ ≤ C*(9/4:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx.2 (by norm_num)
      _ = _ := by ring

lemma sourceSupported_collar {u : H1} (hu : SourceSupported u) :
    ∀ᵐ x∂ballMeasure, (5/2:ℝ)<‖x‖ → weakValue u x=0 ∧ weakGradient u x=0 := by
  filter_upwards [(sourceSupported_iff u).mp hu] with x hx hn
  apply hx
  intro hd
  have hd' := sourceClosure_subset_ball hd
  simp only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] at hd'
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Main:42.name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.actual_nested_weighted_source_exists
OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Main:42.text:
theorem actual_nested_weighted_source_exists :
    ∃ (a : R3 → ℝ) (c C : ℝ) (w : H1),
      Measurable a ∧ 0<c ∧ c<C ∧
      (∀ᵐ x∂ballMeasure,c ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ C) ∧ EqualOneNearBoundary a ∧
      w∈H10 ∧ (∀ᵐ x∂ballMeasure,abs (weakValue w x) ≤ 1/2) ∧
      0<ballMeasure {x | weakValue w x≠0} ∧
      (∀ᵐ x∂ballMeasure,(5/2:ℝ)<‖x‖ → weakValue w x=0 ∧ weakGradient w x=0) ∧
      ∀ u : H1,Harmonic a u → (∃ M : ℝ,∀ᵐ x∂ballMeasure,abs (weakValue u x) ≤ M) →
        ∃ d : ℝ,WeightedAnnihilation a w u d := by
  let r : BoundedRootSources := Classical.choice boundedRootSources_nonempty
  obtain ⟨w,hw,⟨M,hM,hMb⟩,ht⟩ := r.nested_source_limit_exists
  let δ : ℝ := 1/(2*M)
  have hδ : 0<δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hδM : δ*M=1/2 := by dsimp [δ]; field_simp
  have hwne := r.nested_source_nonzero ht
  have hvne : δ • w.val≠(0:H1) := smul_ne_zero hδ.ne' hwne.1
  refine ⟨r.coefficient,min r.c 1,max r.C 1+1,δ • w.val,
    r.coefficient_measurable,lt_min r.c_pos (by norm_num),?_,?_,
    copiedScalarCoefficient_collar r.b,H10.smul_mem δ w.property,?_,
    nonzero_h1_positive_value_measure hvne,sourceSupported_collar (hw.smul δ),?_⟩
  · have hmin := min_le_left r.c 1
    have hmax := le_max_left r.C 1
    have hcc := r.c_lt_C
    linarith
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ⟨(copiedScalarCoefficient_bounds r.bounds x).1,
      (copiedScalarCoefficient_bounds r.bounds x).2.trans (by linarith)⟩)
  · have hh := weakValue_bound_smul hMb δ
    simpa only [abs_of_pos hδ,hδM] using hh
  · intro u hu hb
    exact ⟨sourceMeanCLM 0 u,(r.nested_source_weighted ht hu hb).smul δ⟩

OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Model:54.name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.Harmonic
OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Model:54.text:
def Harmonic (γ : R3 → ℝ) (u : H1) : Prop :=
  ∀ h : H1, h ∈ H10 → energy γ u h = 0

OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sources.Physic.name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.boundedRootSources_nonempty
OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sources.Physic.text:
theorem boundedRootSources_nonempty : Nonempty BoundedRootSources := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hres⟩ := exists_nonresonant_angular_tensor
  let z : PhysicalFiniteEndingData s := Classical.choice (physicalFiniteEndingData_nonempty hs hres)
  obtain ⟨σ,c,C,w,q,hσ,hσLp,hc,hcC,hσb,hq0,hwc,hwe,⟨Z,hZ,hq⟩,hgreen⟩ := z.scalar_pair_green_exists hs
  obtain ⟨η,hη,hηc,hT⟩ := z.terminal_band_exists
  let t := η/4
  have ht : 0<t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have htc : 2*t<centralThickness := by dsimp [t]; linarith
  have hT' : ∀ i : Fin 3,∀ r : ℝ,|r|≤t → (z.ending i).R<z.compression i*(r-PhysicalFiniteEndingData.terminalBase i) := by
    intro i r hr
    apply hT i r
    dsimp [t] at hr
    linarith
  choose W hW hWv hWt using z.source_patch_trace_exists hs ht htc hT' w q hwe
    (Z-originalPairVoltageJet physicalOpenBlock w) hZ hq
  let b : Coord3 → ℝ := fun y => max c (min C (σ y))
  have hbm : Measurable b := measurable_const.max (measurable_const.min hσ)
  have hbb (y : Coord3) : b y∈Icc c C := ⟨le_max_left _ _,max_le hcC.le (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  have hbe : b=ᵐ[volume.restrict physicalOpenBlock] σ := by
    filter_upwards [hσb] with y hy
    exact max_eq_right (by simpa only [min_eq_right hy.2] using hy.1) |>.trans (min_eq_right hy.2)
  let a : R3 → ℝ := fun x => b (WithLp.ofLp x)
  have ham : AEStronglyMeasurable a ballMeasure :=
    (hbm.comp (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ)).measurable).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hC : 0≤C := (hc.trans hcC).le
  have hab : ∀ᵐ x∂ballMeasure,|a x|≤C := Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
    rw [abs_of_pos (hc.trans_le (hbb _).1)]; exact (hbb _).2)
  have hap : ∀ᵐ x∂ballMeasure,0<a x := Eventually.of_forall (fun x => hc.trans_le (hbb _).1)
  have hae : ∀ᵐ y∂volume.restrict physicalOpenBlock,a (WithLp.toLp 2 y)=σ y := hbe
  let M : ℝ := ∑ j : Fin 2,∑ i : Fin 3,|z.terminalValue i j-z.terminalValue 0 j|
  have hM : 0≤M := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _))
  have hMi (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin 2) : |z.terminalValue i j-z.terminalValue 0 j|≤M := by
    have h1 : |z.terminalValue i j-z.terminalValue 0 j|≤∑ i : Fin 3,|z.terminalValue i j-z.terminalValue 0 j| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun i : Fin 3 => |z.terminalValue i j-z.terminalValue 0 j|) (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h2 : (∑ i : Fin 3,|z.terminalValue i j-z.terminalValue 0 j|)≤M :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun j : Fin 2 => ∑ i : Fin 3,|z.terminalValue i j-z.terminalValue 0 j|) (fun k _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    exact h1.trans h2
  have hWb (j : Fin 2) : ∀ᵐ x∂ballMeasure,|weakValue (W j) x|≤M :=
    physical_source_bounded a ham C hC hab hap (hW j) (centralBasisSlopes j)
      (z.source_patch_green ht htc a σ (q j) (W j) j hae (hWv j) (hgreen j)) hM
      (fun i => (hWt j i).mono (fun θ hθ => by rw [hθ]; exact hMi i j))
  let K := M+(∑ j : Fin 2,‖weakGradientL (W j)‖^2)+1
  have he0 : 0≤∑ j : Fin 2,‖weakGradientL (W j)‖^2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hMK : M≤K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  have hWK (j : Fin 2) : ‖weakGradientL (W j)‖^2≤K := by
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun k _ => sq_nonneg ‖weakGradientL (W k)‖) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    dsimp [K]; linarith
  have hWg (j : Fin 2) := z.source_patch_gradient ht htc (q j) (W j) j (hWv j)
  refine ⟨⟨b,hbm,c,C,K,hc,hcC,(by dsimp [K]; linarith),hbb,W,hW,
    fun j => (hWb j).mono (fun _ h => h.trans hMK),hWK,?_,?_,?_⟩⟩
  · intro j
    filter_upwards [hWv j,hWg j] with x hv hg hx
    have ht0 : sourceCollarTime (WithLp.ofLp x)<0 := by
      apply lt_of_not_ge
      intro hn
      apply hx
      exact (sourceDomain_closure_time (WithLp.ofLp x)).mpr hn
    have hn : WithLp.ofLp x∉physicalOpenBlock := by
      intro hn
      have hh := (sourceOpenBlock_time_iff _).mp hn
      exact (not_lt.mpr ht0.le) hh.1
    rw [ite_eq_right hn] at hv hg
    refine ⟨?_,hg⟩
    rw [hv]
    exact z.terminalProfile_zero_outside ht htc j ht0.le
  · intro j
    filter_upwards [hWg j] with x hx hn
    simpa only [ite_eq_right hn] using hx
  · intro a ha j h
    exact z.source_patch_green ht htc a σ (q j) (W j) j (Filter.EventuallyEq.trans ha hbe) (hWv j) (hgreen j) h

end ScalarConductivity

end

OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sources.Weight.text:
theorem weighted_gauge_DN (a : R3 → ℝ) (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a ballMeasure)
    (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0<c) (hC : 0≤C)
    (hab : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, c≤a x ∧ a x≤C)
    (w : H1) (hw0 : w∈H10) (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |weakValue w x|≤1/2)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) (hr3 : r<3)
    (hsupp : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, r<‖x‖ → weakValue w x=0 ∧ weakGradient w x=0)
    (hweighted : ∀ u : H1, Harmonic a u →
      (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |weakValue u x|≤M) →
      ∃ d : ℝ, WeightedAnnihilation a w u d) :
    ∃ Λ : DNOperator, IsDirichletToNeumann a Λ ∧
      IsDirichletToNeumann (gaugeCoefficient a w) Λ := by
  have habs : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |a x|≤C := hab.mono
    (fun x hx => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (hc.le.trans hx.1)]; exact hx.2)
  obtain ⟨Λ₀,hΛ₀⟩ := exists_DirichletToNeumann a ha C hC habs c hc
    (hab.mono (fun _ hx => hx.1))
  have hbb := gaugeCoefficient_bounds hc hab hw
  have hbabs : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |gaugeCoefficient a w x|≤9*C/4 := hbb.mono
    (fun x hx => by rw [abs_of_nonneg ((div_pos hc (by norm_num)).le.trans hx.1)]; exact hx.2)
  obtain ⟨Λ₁,hΛ₁⟩ := exists_DirichletToNeumann _ (gaugeCoefficient_aeStronglyMeasurable a ha w)
    (9*C/4) (by positivity) hbabs (c/4) (by positivity) (hbb.mono (fun _ hx => hx.1))
  have heq : Λ₀=Λ₁ := by
    apply DN_eq_of_smooth_pairings
    intro f g hf hg
    obtain ⟨u,ht,hu,_,_⟩ := hΛ₀ (trace (smoothH1 f hf))
    obtain ⟨M,hM,hfM⟩ := smoothH1_bounded f hf
    have huM := harmonic_bounded_of_trace_bounded a ha C hC habs
      (hab.mono (fun _ hx => hc.trans_le hx.1)) hu ht hM hfM
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := hweighted u hu ⟨M,huM⟩
    obtain ⟨u₁,ht₁,_,hflux⟩ := exists_gauge_transform huM hw hw0 d
    have hflux' : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure,
        gaugeCoefficient a w x • weakGradient u₁ x=
        ((1+weakValue w x)*a x) • weakGradient u x-
          ((weakValue u x-d)*a x) • weakGradient w x := hflux.mono (fun x hx => hx (a x))
    have hu₁ := gauge_harmonic_of_weighted a ha C hC habs huM hw hu d hd hflux'
    obtain ⟨N,_,hgN⟩ := smoothH1_bounded g hg
    obtain ⟨V,hV,hVg⟩ := exists_outer_test hgN hr hr3
    have he : energy a u V=energy (gaugeCoefficient a w) u₁ V := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hflux',hsupp,hVg] with x hx hy hz
      by_cases hh : ‖x‖≤r
      · simp only [hz hh, inner_zero_right, mul_zero]
      · obtain ⟨hv,hg⟩ := hy (lt_of_not_ge hh)
        simp only [←real_inner_smul_left]
        rw [hx,hv,hg,smul_zero,sub_zero,add_zero,one_mul]
    calc
      Λ₀ (trace (smoothH1 f hf)) (trace (smoothH1 g hg)) = Λ₀ (trace u) (trace V) := by rw [ht,hV]
      _ = energy a u V := hΛ₀.pairing hu V
      _ = energy (gaugeCoefficient a w) u₁ V := he
      _ = Λ₁ (trace u₁) (trace V) := (hΛ₁.pairing hu₁ V).symm
      _ = Λ₁ (trace (smoothH1 f hf)) (trace (smoothH1 g hg)) := by rw [ht₁,ht,hV]
  exact ⟨Λ₀,hΛ₀,heq.symm ▸ hΛ₁⟩

end ScalarConductivity

end
end

def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (γ₀ γ₁ : R3 → ℝ) (c C : ℝ) (Λ : DNOperator),
    0 < c ∧ c < C ∧
    Measurable γ₀ ∧ Measurable γ₁ ∧
    MemLp γ₀ ∞ ballMeasure ∧ MemLp γ₁ ∞ ballMeasure ∧
    (∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, c ≤ γ₀ x ∧ γ₀ x ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, c ≤ γ₁ x ∧ γ₁ x ≤ C) ∧
    EqualOneNearBoundary γ₀ ∧ EqualOneNearBoundary γ₁ ∧
    0 < ballMeasure {x | γ₀ x ≠ γ₁ x} ∧
    IsDirichletToNeumann γ₀ Λ ∧ IsDirichletToNeumann γ₁ Λ

end ScalarConductivity

OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sources.Weight.name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.MainStatement_of_weighted_source
OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sources.Weight.text:
theorem MainStatement_of_weighted_source
    (a : R3 → ℝ) (ha : Measurable a) (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0<c) (hcC : c<C)
    (hab : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, c≤a x ∧ a x≤C) (hnear : EqualOneNearBoundary a)
    (w : H1) (hw0 : w∈H10) (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |weakValue w x|≤1/2)
    (hwne : 0<ballMeasure {x | weakValue w x≠0})
    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) (hr3 : r<3)
    (hsupp : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, r<‖x‖ → weakValue w x=0 ∧ weakGradient w x=0)
    (hweighted : ∀ u : H1, Harmonic a u →
      (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |weakValue u x|≤M) →
      ∃ d : ℝ, WeightedAnnihilation a w u d) : MainStatement := by
  have hC : 0<C := hc.trans hcC
  have habs : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |a x|≤C := hab.mono
    (fun x hx => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (hc.le.trans hx.1)]; exact hx.2)
  have hbb := gaugeCoefficient_bounds hc hab hw
  have hbabs : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |gaugeCoefficient a w x|≤9*C/4 := hbb.mono
    (fun x hx => by rw [abs_of_nonneg ((div_pos hc (by norm_num)).le.trans hx.1)]; exact hx.2)
  have ham : MemLp a ∞ ballMeasure := MemLp.of_bound ha.aestronglyMeasurable C
    (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using habs)
  have hbm : MemLp (gaugeCoefficient a w) ∞ ballMeasure :=
    MemLp.of_bound (gaugeCoefficient_aeStronglyMeasurable a ha.aestronglyMeasurable w) (9*C/4)
      (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbabs)
  obtain ⟨Λ,hΛ₀,hΛ₁⟩ := weighted_gauge_DN a ha.aestronglyMeasurable c C hc hC.le hab
    w hw0 hw r hr hr3 hsupp hweighted
  refine ⟨a,gaugeCoefficient a w,c/4,9*C/4+1,Λ,by positivity,by linarith,
    ha,gaugeCoefficient_measurable ha w,ham,hbm,?_,?_,hnear,?_,?_,hΛ₀,hΛ₁⟩
  · filter_upwards [hab] with x hx
    exact ⟨by linarith [hx.1],by linarith [hx.2]⟩
  · filter_upwards [hbb] with x hx
    exact ⟨hx.1,by linarith [hx.2]⟩
  · exact gaugeCoefficient_equalOneNearBoundary hnear hr hr3
      (hsupp.mono (fun _ hx h => (hx h).1))
  · have he := gaugeCoefficient_ne_ae_iff (hab.mono (fun _ hx => hc.trans_le hx.1)) hw
    have hm : ballMeasure {x | a x≠gaugeCoefficient a w x}=ballMeasure {x | weakValue w x≠0} :=
      measure_congr (he.mono (fun _ hx => propext hx))
    rw [hm]; exact hwne

end ScalarConductivity

end
end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sources.Weight.name: OAI.ScalarConductivity.gaugeCoefficient_ne_ae_iff
OAI.Analysis.Conductivity.Sources.Weight.text:
lemma gaugeCoefficient_ne_ae_iff {a : R3 → ℝ} {w : H1}
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, 0<a x)
    (hw : ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, |weakValue w x|≤1/2) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂ballMeasure, a x≠gaugeCoefficient a w x ↔ weakValue w x≠0 := by
  filter_upwards [ha,hw] with x ha hw
  apply not_congr
  change a x=a x*(1+weakValue w x)^2 ↔ weakValue w x=0
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hs : (1+weakValue w x)^2=1 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha.ne'
      simpa only [mul_one] using h.symm
    have hm : weakValue w x*(2+weakValue w x)=0 := by nlinarith
    have hp : 0<2+weakValue w x := by have := (abs_le.mp hw).1; linarith
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_right hp.ne'
  · intro h; simp [h]

OAI.Geometry.ConjugatePoints.ThreeManifo.name: OAI.ThreeManifold.CompactMetric.fiberClass_ne_one
OAI.Geometry.ConjugatePoints.ThreeManifo.text:
theorem fiberClass_ne_one (i : Bool) : fiberClass i ≠ 1 := by
  let : LocallyPathConnectedSpace Surface := ChartedSpace.locallyPathConnectedSpace ℂ Surface
  let : PathConnectedSpace Surface := PathConnectedSpace.of_locallyPathConnectedSpace
  intro hnull
  have hb : FundamentalGroup.map (blockMap i) wholeBase (pair 1 circleClass) = 1 :=
    (mapOfEq_eq_one_iff (blockMap i) (blockMap_base i) (pair 1 circleClass)).mp hnull
  apply block_fiber_low_nontrivial i
  exact (fiber_null_transfer (blockMap i)
    (PathConnectedSpace.somePath (projection lowPoint) baseSurface) circleClass).mpr hb

lemma identity_smooth_forward : let := charts (M := M) e
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ,E) 𝓘(ℝ,F) ∞ (id : M → M) := by
  dsimp only
  let := charts (M := M) e
  let := isManifold (M := M) e
  intro x
  have h1 := contMDiffAt_of_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ,E))
    (chart_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ,E)) (n := ∞) x) (mem_chart_source _ _)
  have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ,E) 𝓘(ℝ,F) ∞ e (chartAt E x x) :=
    e.contDiff.contMDiff.contMDiffAt
  have ht : e (chartAt E x x) ∈ (chartAt F x).target := by
    rw [show chartAt F x = chart e (chartAt E x) from rfl,chart_target]
    exact ⟨chartAt E x x,(chartAt E x).map_source (mem_chart_source _ _),rfl⟩
  have h3 := contMDiffAt_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ,F))
    (chart_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ,F)) (n := ∞) x) ht
  apply (h3.comp x (h2.comp x h1)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [(chartAt E x).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_chart_source _ _)] with y hy
  change y = (chartAt E x).symm (e.symm (e (chartAt E x y)))
  rw [e.symm_apply_apply,(chartAt E x).left_inv hy]

lemma positive (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (h : AtlasOrientation.Positive (E := E) (M := M)) :
    let := charts (M := M) e
    AtlasOrientation.Positive (E := F) (M := M) := by
  let := charts (M := M) e
  change AtlasOrientation.Positive (E := F) (M := M)
  rintro _ _ ⟨c,hc,rfl⟩ ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩ x hx hy
  have hcx : e.symm x ∈ c.target := hx.2
  have hdx : c.symm (e.symm x) ∈ d.source := hy.1
  have ht := (AtlasOrientation.transition_contDiffAt hc hd hcx hdx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hg := e.hasFDerivAt.comp x (ht.hasFDerivAt.comp x e.symm.hasFDerivAt)
  change 0 < LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ (e ∘ (d ∘ c.symm) ∘ e.symm) x).toLinearMap
  rw [hg.fderiv]
  change 0 < LinearMap.det ((e.toLinearEquiv : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) ∘ₗ
    (fderiv ℝ (d ∘ c.symm) (e.symm x)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (e.toLinearEquiv.symm : F →ₗ[ℝ] E))
  rw [LinearMap.det_conj]
  exact h c d hc hd (e.symm x) hcx hdx
end ThreeManifold.Rechart

OAI.Geometry.ConjugatePoints.ThreeManifo.name: OAI.ThreeManifold.CompactMetric.realCompact_noNPC
OAI.Geometry.ConjugatePoints.ThreeManifo.text:
theorem realCompact_noNPC (g : SmoothMetric Manifold) : ¬ NonpositiveSectionalCurvature g := by
  let : LocallyPathConnectedSpace Manifold := ChartedSpace.locallyPathConnectedSpace E3 Manifold
  let : PathConnectedSpace Manifold := PathConnectedSpace.of_locallyPathConnectedSpace
  intro hn
  let hp := npc_exponential_isCoveringMap g hn basePoint
  let e : FundamentalGroup Manifold basePoint ≃* UniversalDeck.group (exponential g basePoint) :=
    ((groupBasepointEq (exponential_zero g basePoint).symm).trans
      (UniversalDeck.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp 0)).trans (MulEquiv.inv' _).symm
  have hne (x : FundamentalGroup Manifold basePoint) (hx : x ≠ 1) : e x ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    apply hx
    apply e.injective
    exact he.trans e.map_one.symm
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,hfh,hfa,hfb,hhc,hhd,hrel,hrel2⟩ := actual_loop_relations
  apply npc_deck_shear_impossible g hn basePoint
    (e (fiberClass false)) (e (fiberClass true)) (e a) (e b) (e c) (e d)
    (hne _ (fiberClass_ne_one false)) (hne _ (fiberClass_ne_one true))
    (hfh.map e.toMonoidHom) (hfa.map e.toMonoidHom) (hfb.map e.toMonoidHom)
    (hhc.map e.toMonoidHom) (hhd.map e.toMonoidHom)
  · simpa only [map_mul,map_inv] using congrArg e hrel
  · simpa only [map_mul,map_inv] using congrArg e hrel2
end ThreeManifold.CompactMetric

  inv_mem' := by
    rintro a ⟨ha,hai,hap⟩
    refine ⟨hai,ha,fun z => ?_⟩
    simpa using (hap (a.symm z)).symm

OAI.Geometry.ConjugatePoints.Returning:1.text:
theorem uniform_turning_parameters : ∃ δ₀ C : ℝ,
    0 < δ₀ ∧ δ₀ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 18 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ δ ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
      SmallParameter (3 * C) (sourceMixed C) δ ∧
      ∀ right : Bool, ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ q : TVec,
        (sqnorm q / 9 ≤ qform (coordinateCometric right δ u) q ∧
          qform (coordinateCometric right δ u) q ≤ 18 * sqnorm q) ∧
        sqnorm (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ) u *ᵥ q) ≤ C ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 * sqnorm q ∧
        0 ≤ qform (-deriv (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ)) u) q ∧
        sqnorm (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ) u *ᵥ q) ≤
          C * δ * qform (-deriv (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ)) u) q := by
  obtain ⟨ε, D, hε, hhalf, hD, hb⟩ := uniform_cometric_bounds
  let C := 18 + D
  have hC : 18 ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; linarith
  have hCp : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hDC : D ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; linarith
  have hDCsq : D ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hm := sourceMixed_pos C
  have ha := aZero_pos
  have hβ := beta_lt_one
  let ε' := min ε (min 1 (min (1 / (2 * sourceMixed C))
    ((1 - beta) / (2 * sourceMixed C + (3 * C) * aZero))))
  have hep : 0 < ε' := by dsimp only [ε']; positivity
  have hea : ε' ≤ ε := min_le_left _ _
  refine ⟨ε', C, hep, hea.trans hhalf, hC, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  have hδ' : δ ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) ε := ⟨hδ.1, hδ.2.trans hea⟩
  have hs : SmallParameter (3 * C) (sourceMixed C) δ := by
    have hh := hδ.2.trans (min_le_right ε _)
    refine ⟨hδ.1, hh.trans (min_le_left _ _),
      (hh.trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_left _ _),
      (hh.trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_right _ _)⟩
  refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
  intro right u hu q
  obtain ⟨hq, _, hd, hc, hdom⟩ := hb δ hδ' right u hu q
  refine ⟨hq, ?_, hc, ?_⟩
  · exact hd.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDCsq (sq_nonneg _)) (sqnorm_nonneg q))
  · exact hdom.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDC hδ.1.le) hc)

end ThreeManifold.ReturningPassage

OAI.Geometry.ConjugatePoints.ThreeManifo.text:
theorem npc_deck_shear_impossible [PathConnectedSpace M]
    (g : SmoothMetric M) (hn : NonpositiveSectionalCurvature g) (p : M)
    (f h a b c d : UniversalDeck.group (exponential g p))
    (hf : f ≠ 1) (hh : h ≠ 1)
    (hfh : Commute f h) (hfa : Commute f a) (hfb : Commute f b)
    (hhc : Commute h c) (hhd : Commute h d)
    (hrel : h = a*b*a⁻¹*b⁻¹) (hrel2 : h*f = c*d*c⁻¹*d⁻¹) : False := by
  let : MetricSpace E3 := universalMetric g hn p
  let : PseudoMetricSpace E3 := (universalMetric g hn p).toPseudoMetricSpace
  let : PseudoEMetricSpace E3 := (universalMetric g hn p).toPseudoEMetricSpace
  let : ProperSpace E3 := universalMetric_proper g hn p
  let F := npcDeckIsometry g hn p
  have hfree (k : UniversalDeck.group (exponential g p)) (hk : k ≠ 1) (x : E3) : F k x ≠ x := by
    intro heq
    apply hk
    apply UniversalDeck.deck_ext (npc_exponential_isCoveringMap g hn p) (z := x)
    exact heq
  have hmin (k : UniversalDeck.group (exponential g p)) :
      (NonpositiveMetric.CNMidpoint.minset (F k : E3 → E3)).Nonempty :=
    npc_deck_displacement_minimum g hn p k
  apply (universalCN g hn p).cyclic_shear_obstruction (universalMetric_segments g hn p)
    (F f) (F h) (F a) (F b) (F c) (F d) (hmin f) (hmin h)
    (hfree f hf) (hfree h hh) (hfh.map F) (hfa.map F) (hfb.map F) (hhc.map F) (hhd.map F)
  · simpa only [map_mul,map_inv] using congrArg F hrel
  · simpa only [map_mul,map_inv] using congrArg F hrel2

end ThreeManifold.RiemannianCoordinates

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Coun.text:
theorem value_source_sameLaw (hEK : PublishedEdmondsKarp.EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1)
    (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
    (hne : ∃ X,TableTightening.Feasible r c b X) (epsilon delta : ℚ) (he : 0<epsilon) :
    SameLaw
      (fun bits : Fin (bitCount (CountingDirectProgram.request r c b epsilon delta))→Bool =>
        TreeFraction.val (output (CountingDirectProgram.request r c b epsilon delta,List.ofFn bits)))
      (RootedCountingWords.flatEstimate (ComputedCountingParameters.data hEK r c b hne epsilon he)
        (ComputedCountingWords.root hEK r c b hne epsilon he)
        (ComputedCountingParameters.settings hEK r c b hne epsilon he)) := by
  let A := ComputedCountingParameters.data hEK r c b hne epsilon he
  let s := ComputedCountingParameters.settings hEK r c b hne epsilon he
  let req := CountingDirectProgram.request r c b epsilon delta
  let initial := CompanionInitialStoredProgram.output (CompanionInitialStoredProgram.data A ∅)
  let fixed := CountingActualPhase.fixed hEK r c b hne epsilon he initial
  let reserve := List.replicate (bitCount req) false
  have hlen : 2*Fintype.card (Labels A) ≤ reserve.length := by
    rw [List.length_replicate]
    exact initialReserve_le hEK r c b hne epsilon he (TreeFraction.repr delta)
  have hstart : start (req,reserve)=fixed :=
    start_data hEK r c b hne epsilon he (TreeFraction.repr delta) reserve hlen
  have hi := start_view hEK r c b hne epsilon he (TreeFraction.repr delta) reserve hlen
  change CompanionPhaseFinishProgram.view (start (req,reserve)).2 = _ at hi
  rw [hstart] at hi
  have hrep : CompanionStoredRepresentation.StoredRep
      (CanonicalInitialEncoding.copyOrder (CompanionComputedInitial.capacities A)).length initial :=
    CompanionStoredRepresentation.initial_output_rep A ∅
  have h := CompanionProjectedHistory.output_sameLaw A (CompanionComputedProposal.pairLabels A)
    (ComputedCountingWords.root hEK r c b hne epsilon he) s fixed hi
    (fun history hh hj => CountingActualPhase.output_rep hEK r c b hne epsilon he
      (TreeFraction.repr delta) initial hrep history hh hj)
    (fun history hh hj => CountingActualPhase.output_sameLaw hEK r c b hne epsilon he
      (TreeFraction.repr delta) initial hrep hi history hh hj)
  have hc : phaseCount req=s.H := phaseCount_data hEK r c b hne epsilon he (TreeFraction.repr delta)
  have hw := value_sameLaw req
  unfold independentOutput at hw
  rw [hstart,hc] at hw
  simp only [List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def] at h
  intro phi
  have hf := uniformAverage_equiv (gridWordEquiv s.H (RootedPhaseHistory.totalWidth A s))
    (fun words => phi (RootedCountingWords.estimate A
      (ComputedCountingWords.root hEK r c b hne epsilon he) s words))
  exact (hw phi).trans ((h phi).trans hf.symm)

end

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.ExactPublicLaw.tableMass_limit
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
theorem tableMass_limit (X : Table r c) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => Algorithms.tableMass machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) t X.val)
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((Fintype.card (Table r c):ℝ)⁻¹)) := by
  apply tendsto_of_prefix_bounds _
    (fun N => ((ExactTablePrefix.experiment r c N).mean (fun o => if o=some X then 1 else 0):ℝ))
    (prefixError r c) _ (ExactTablePrefix.point_limit r c (hPL _) (hCheeger _ d) htotal X) (error_limit r c)
  intro N
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hm⟩ := prefix_correct r c htotal N
  refine ⟨p.cost,?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have h := stopped_event_bounds program.table (output r c)
    (program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (ExactTablePrefix.input r c))) p hp
    (output_halted r c) (outputs (Algorithms.encodeMatrix X.val)) t ht
  have he : (fun o : Option (Table r c) => o.elim 0
      (fun Y => event (outputs (Algorithms.encodeMatrix X.val)) (output r c (some Y))))=
      (fun o => if o=some X then 1 else 0) := by
    funext o
    cases o with
    | none => simp
    | some Y => simp only [Option.elim_some,event,event_output,Option.some.injEq]
  rw [he,hm,hm] at h
  have hl : ((ExactTablePrefix.experiment r c N).mean
      (fun o => if o=some X then 1 else 0):ℝ)≤
      ((experiment program.table t (program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).mean
        (event (outputs (Algorithms.encodeMatrix X.val))):ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h.1
  have hu : ((experiment program.table t (program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).mean
        (event (outputs (Algorithms.encodeMatrix X.val))):ℝ)≤
      ((ExactTablePrefix.experiment r c N).mean (fun o => if o=some X then 1 else 0):ℝ)+
        ((ExactTablePrefix.experiment r c N).mean (fun o => if o=none then 1 else 0):ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h.2
  have hm : Algorithms.tableMass machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) t X.val=
      ((experiment program.table t (program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).mean
        (event (outputs (Algorithms.encodeMatrix X.val))):ℝ) := tableMass_eq program _ t X.val
  exact ⟨hl.trans_eq hm.symm,hm.le.trans
    (hu.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (prefix_error r c hPL hCheeger htotal N)))⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.ExactExpectedTime.summable
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
theorem summable
    (hPL : ∀ q,PublishedInputs.FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler q)
    (hCheeger : ∀ q k,PublishedInputs.FiniteCheeger
      (GridBoundary.Grid (I := Fin q) (4*k^8)))
    (htotal : (∑ i,r i)=∑ j,c j) :
    Summable (fun t => 1-Algorithms.haltMass ExactPublicPrefix.machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) t) := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := ExactPrintCost.polynomial_print_bound
  let B := p.eval (ExactPrintCost.matrixSize (n := n) r)
  have hB (X : Table r c) : GreedyFeasibleTable.printMatrixRealizer.cost (matrixCode X.val)≤B :=
    (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (hp m n r c X)
  have hL (X : Table r c) : (ExactPublicPrefix.word r c X).length≤B :=
    (MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.list_length_le_weight _).trans
      ((Nat.le_add_left _ _).trans (hp m n r c X))
  have hs := (bound r c hPL hCheeger htotal B B hB hL).1
  have he : (fun t => 1-Algorithms.haltMass ExactPublicPrefix.machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) t)=
      PhysicalRetryTail.tail ExactPublicPrefix.program.table
        (ExactPublicPrefix.program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c))) := by
    funext t
    exact PhysicalPublicLaw.tail_eq _ _ _
  rw [he]
  exact hs

end
end ContingencyTables.ExactExpectedTime

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.allSamplingMachineTime_public_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
lemma allSamplingMachineTime_public_bound :
    ∃ C d : ℕ,0<C ∧ ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
      (∑ i,r i)=∑ j,c j → ∀ k,
      allSamplingMachineTime (encodeSamplingInput r c k)≤C*(samplingSize n r k)^d := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := allSamplingMachineTime_polynomial
  refine ⟨p.eval (344^644+91)+1,1288*p.natDegree,by omega,?_⟩
  intro m n r c htotal k
  have hS : 1 ≤ samplingSize n r k := by unfold samplingSize; omega
  calc
    _ ≤ p.eval (FiniteWordExecution.wordMeasure publicWordCount (encodeSamplingInput r c k)) := hp _
    _ ≤ p.eval ((344^644+91)*(samplingSize n r k)^1288) :=
      polynomial_eval_monotone p (public_wordMeasure_bound r c htotal k)
    _ ≤ p.eval (344^644+91)*(samplingSize n r k)^(1288*p.natDegree) :=
      polynomial_scaled_power p (344^644+91) (samplingSize n r k) 1288 hS
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)

variable {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ)

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.CountingStatement
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.text:
def CountingStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : Machine) (C d : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (m n : ℕ), 0 < m → 0 < n →
    ∀ (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ),
      (∑ i, r i) = ∑ j, c j →
      ∀ ε δ : ℚ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 0 < δ → δ < 1 →
        let input := encodeCountingInput r c b ε δ
        let t := countingTime C d r c b ε δ
        (∀ bits : Fin t → Bool, ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ q ∧ MatchingFPRAS.Outputs A input bits q) ∧
        (count r c b = 0 → ∀ bits : Fin t → Bool, MatchingFPRAS.Outputs A input bits 0) ∧
        ((goodCountingTapes A r c b ε δ t).card : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ t ≥ 1 - δ

end ContingencyTables.Algorithms

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.BoundedSamplingStatement
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.text:
def BoundedSamplingStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : Machine) (C d : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
      (∑ i, r i) = ∑ j, c j → ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
        let input := encodeSamplingInput r c k
        let t := C * (samplingSize n r k) ^ d
        (∀ bits : Fin t → Bool, ∃ X : Table r c, OutputsTable A input bits X.val) ∧
        (∑ X : Table r c,
          |tableMass A input t X.val - (Fintype.card (Table r c) : ℝ)⁻¹|) / 2 ≤
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.samplingSize
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.text:
def samplingSize (n : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  m + n + Nat.clog 2 ((∑ i, r i) + 1) + k + 1

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.CheegerProof.finiteCheeger
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
theorem finiteCheeger : PublishedInputs.FiniteCheeger X := by
  intro C κ hk hcut f
  obtain ⟨a,hbelow,habove⟩ := exists_median C f
  let p : X → ℝ := fun x => max (f x-a) 0
  let n : X → ℝ := fun x => max (a-f x) 0
  have hp : mass C (Finset.univ.filter fun x => 0 < p x) ≤ 1/2 := by
    simpa only [p,lt_max_iff,lt_self_iff_false,or_false,sub_pos] using habove
  have hn : mass C (Finset.univ.filter fun x => 0 < n x) ≤ 1/2 := by
    simpa only [n,lt_max_iff,lt_self_iff_false,or_false,sub_pos] using hbelow
  have hcut' : ∀ S : Finset X, κ*min (mass C S) (mass C Sᶜ) ≤ cut C S := hcut
  have hpe := positive_energy C κ hk hcut' p (fun _ => le_max_right _ _) hp
  have hne := positive_energy C κ hk hcut' n (fun _ => le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hnorm : (∑ x, C.π x*(p x)^2)+(∑ x, C.π x*(n x)^2) =
      ∑ x, C.π x*(f x-a)^2 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    dsimp [p,n]
    rw [← mul_add,show a-f x = -(f x-a) by ring,split_square]
  have he : C.energy p+C.energy n ≤ C.energy f := by
    rw [C.energy_eq,C.energy_eq,C.energy_eq,← add_div,
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by norm_num)
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro x _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro y _
    rw [← mul_add]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (mul_nonneg (C.positive x).le (C.nonnegative x y))
    dsimp [p,n]
    convert split_difference (f x-a) (f y-a) using 1 <;> ring_nf
  have hv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (variance_le_centered C f a) (sq_nonneg κ)
  have hb : κ^2*C.variance f ≤ 2*C.energy f := by
    rw [← hnorm] at hv
    nlinarith [hpe,hne,he]
  have hk2 : 0 < κ^2 := sq_pos_of_pos hk
  calc
    C.variance f ≤ (2*C.energy f)/κ^2 := (le_div_iff₀ hk2).mpr (by nlinarith [hb])
    _ = (2/κ^2)*C.energy f := by ring

end
end ContingencyTables.CheegerProof

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.ExactPublicLaw.haltMass_limit
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
theorem haltMass_limit :
    Filter.Tendsto (Algorithms.haltMass machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
  have h := (tail_limit r c hPL hCheeger htotal).const_sub 1
  have he : (fun t => 1-PhysicalRetryTail.tail program.table
      (program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c))) t)=
      Algorithms.haltMass machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) := by
    funext t
    rw [←tail_eq]
    change 1-(1-Algorithms.haltMass program.machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) t)=
      Algorithms.haltMass program.machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) t
    ring
  simpa only [he,sub_zero] using h

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.CheegerProof.variance_le_centered
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
theorem variance_le_centered (f : X → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    C.variance f ≤ ∑ x, C.π x*(f x-a)^2 := by
  have he : (∑ x, C.π x*(f x-a)^2) = C.inner f f-2*a*C.mean f+a^2 := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ x, C.π x*f x*f x)-2*a*(∑ x,C.π x*f x)+a^2*(∑ x,C.π x) := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x _
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [C.normalized,mul_one]; rfl
  rw [C.variance_formula,he]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (C.mean f-a)]

end
end ContingencyTables.CheegerProof

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.CheegerProof.split_difference
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
private lemma split_difference (u v : ℝ) :
    (max u 0-max v 0)^2+(max (-u) 0-max (-v) 0)^2 ≤ (u-v)^2 := by
  by_cases hu : 0 ≤ u <;> by_cases hv : 0 ≤ v
  · rw [max_eq_left hu,max_eq_left hv,max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hu),
      max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hv)]
    simp
  · have hv' : v ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hv
    rw [max_eq_left hu,max_eq_right hv',max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hu),
      max_eq_left (neg_nonneg.mpr hv')]
    nlinarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hu hv']
  · have hu' : u ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hu
    rw [max_eq_right hu',max_eq_left hv,max_eq_left (neg_nonneg.mpr hu'),
      max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hv)]
    nlinarith [mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hu' hv]
  · have hu' : u ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hu
    have hv' : v ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hv
    rw [max_eq_right hu',max_eq_right hv',max_eq_left (neg_nonneg.mpr hu'),
      max_eq_left (neg_nonneg.mpr hv')]
    nlinarith

variable {X : Type*} [Fintype X]

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:74.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.Outputs
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:74.text:
def Outputs (A : RandomMachine) (input : List Symbol) {t : ℕ}
    (bits : Fin t → Bool) (q : ℚ) : Prop :=
  (run A input bits).state = none ∧
    (run A input bits).tape.right₀ = Turing.ListBlank.mk (encodeRat q)

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.ExactPublicPrefix.machine
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
def machine : RandomMachine := program.machine

variable {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ)

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.exactSampling_conditional
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
theorem exactSampling_conditional
    (hPL : ∀ q,PublishedInputs.FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler q)
    (hCheeger : ∀ q k,PublishedInputs.FiniteCheeger (GridBoundary.Grid (I := Fin q) (4*k^8))) :
    ExactSamplingStatement := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := exact_expected_polynomial
  refine ⟨ExactPublicPrefix.machine,p.eval 1+1,p.natDegree,by omega,?_⟩
  intro m n r c htotal
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨ExactPublicLaw.halted_feasible r c hPL hCheeger htotal,
    ExactPublicLaw.tableMass_limit r c hPL hCheeger htotal,
    ExactPublicLaw.haltMass_limit r c hPL hCheeger htotal,
    ExactExpectedTime.summable r c hPL hCheeger htotal,?_⟩
  have hS : 1 ≤ samplingSize n r 0 := by unfold samplingSize; omega
  have hpoly : p.eval (samplingSize n r 0) ≤ p.eval 1*(samplingSize n r 0)^p.natDegree := by
    simpa only [one_mul,pow_one] using polynomial_scaled_power p 1 (samplingSize n r 0) 1 hS
  have hnat := hpoly.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _))
  have hreal : ((p.eval (samplingSize n r 0):ℕ):ℝ) ≤
      (p.eval 1+1:ℕ)*(samplingSize n r 0:ℝ)^p.natDegree := by exact_mod_cast hnat
  exact (hp hPL hCheeger m n r c htotal).trans hreal

end
end ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.PublishedInputs.FiniteCheeger
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
def FiniteCheeger : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : FiniteChain X) (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
    (∀ S : Finset X,
      κ * min (∑ x ∈ S, C.π x) (∑ x ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x) ≤
        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

end

end ContingencyTables.PublishedInputs

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Coun.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.CountingExecutedMachine.statement_of_single_law
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Coun.text:
theorem statement_of_single_law
    (hEK : PublishedEdmondsKarp.EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1)
    (hPL : ∀ q,PublishedInputs.FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler q)
    (hCheeger : ∀ q k,PublishedInputs.FiniteCheeger (Grid (I := Fin q) k))
    (hlaw : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m→ℕ) (c : Fin n→ℕ) (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ)
      (hne : ∃ X,TableTightening.Feasible r c b X) (epsilon delta : ℚ) (he : 0<epsilon),
      SameLaw
        (fun bits : Fin (CountingPositiveProgram.bitCount (CountingDirectProgram.request r c b epsilon delta))→Bool =>
          TreeFraction.val (CountingPositiveProgram.output
            (CountingDirectProgram.request r c b epsilon delta,List.ofFn bits)))
        (RootedCountingWords.flatEstimate (ComputedCountingParameters.data hEK r c b hne epsilon he)
          (ComputedCountingWords.root hEK r c b hne epsilon he)
          (ComputedCountingParameters.settings hEK r c b hne epsilon he))) :
    Algorithms.CountingStatement := by
  obtain ⟨C,d,hC,ht⟩ := public_time hEK
  refine ⟨machine,C,d,hC,?_⟩
  intro m n _ _ r c b _ epsilon delta he he1 hd _
  have htime := ht m n r c b epsilon delta he hd
  refine ⟨outputs_nonnegative r c b epsilon delta _ htime,
    (fun hz => outputs_zero hEK r c b epsilon delta hz _ htime),?_⟩
  apply public_success hEK hPL hCheeger r c b epsilon delta he he1 hd
  · intro hne hp
    exact positive_success hEK hPL hCheeger r c b hne epsilon delta he he1 hd hp
      (hlaw m n r c b hne epsilon delta he)
  · exact htime

end
end ContingencyTables.CountingExecutedMachine

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Publ.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.PublishedInputs.FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Publ.text:
def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤
      ∫ z in S₀, f₀ z

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.goodCountingTapes
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.text:
noncomputable def goodCountingTapes (A : Machine) {m n : ℕ}
    (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ)
    (ε δ : ℚ) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin t → Bool) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter fun bits => ∃ q : ℚ,
    MatchingFPRAS.Outputs A (encodeCountingInput r c b ε δ) bits q ∧
      (1 - ε) * count r c b ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (1 + ε) * count r c b

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.scheduledTableDraw_accuracy
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
theorem scheduledTableDraw_accuracy
    (hPL : PublishedInputs.FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler q)
    (hCheeger : PublishedInputs.FiniteCheeger (GridBoundary.Grid (I := Fin q) (4*d^8)))
    (htotal : (∑ i,r i)=∑ j,c j) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1≤k) :
    let _ : Nonempty (Table r c) := ⟨GreedyFeasibleTable.table r c htotal⟩
    (variation (mapLaw (uniformLaw (α := Fin (finiteSamplerBits r c k) → Bool))
      (scheduledTableDraw r c htotal k)) (uniformLaw (α := Table r c)):ℝ)≤1/(2:ℝ)^k := by
  let : Nonempty (Table r c) := ⟨GreedyFeasibleTable.table r c htotal⟩
  let : Nonempty (PaperStates r c) := ⟨tableState r c (GreedyFeasibleTable.table r c htotal)⟩
  dsimp only
  unfold scheduledTableDraw
  split_ifs with h
  · exact listedScheduledDraw_accuracy r c (computedCellEquiv r c)
      ((hasLargeRectangle_spec r c k).mp h).1 ((hasLargeRectangle_spec r c k).mp h).2
      hPL hCheeger htotal (tableState r c (GreedyFeasibleTable.table r c htotal))
      (GreedyFeasibleTable.table r c htotal) k hk
  · have hs := allSmall_of_no_large r c k h
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (Fin m) with hm|hm
    · let := hm
      let : Subsingleton (Table r c) := ⟨fun X Y => Subtype.ext (by funext i; exact isEmptyElim i)⟩
      rw [variation_uniform_of_subsingleton,Rat.cast_zero]
      positivity
    · rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (Fin n) with hn|hn
      · let := hn
        let : Subsingleton (Table r c) := ⟨fun X Y => Subtype.ext (by funext i j; exact isEmptyElim j)⟩
        rw [variation_uniform_of_subsingleton,Rat.cast_zero]
        positivity
      · let := hm
        let := hn
        rw [padded_draw_law,unitCodeOuterDraw_law r c (computedCellEquiv r c) htotal]
        exact unitOuterDraw_accuracy r c hs htotal k hk (allSmallFibre r c hs)
          (tableState r c (GreedyFeasibleTable.table r c htotal)) (GreedyFeasibleTable.table r c htotal)

end
end ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:70.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.run

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Tran.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.EdmondsKarpBound.shortest_trace_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Tran.text:
theorem shortest_trace_bound (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (F : Fin (K+1)→Flow n)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin K,ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)) : K ≤ n^3 := by
  choose u v hu using (fun i : Fin K => critical_arc (h i))
  let code : Fin K→Fin n×Fin n×Fin n := fun i =>
    (u i,v i,⟨label c (F i.castSucc) s (u i),(hu i).2.2.2⟩)
  have hordered (i j : Fin K) (hij : i < j) (huv : u i=u j) (hvv : v i=v j) :
      label c (F i.castSucc) s (u i) < label c (F j.castSucc) s (u j) := by
    have hres : F j.castSucc (u i) (v i) < (c (u i) (v i):ℤ) := by
      simpa only [huv,hvv] using (hu j).1
    have hr := repeated_critical h i j hij (u i) (v i) (hu i).2.1 (hu i).2.2.1 hres
    rw [←huv]
    omega
  have hinj : Function.Injective code := by
    intro i j he
    have huij := congrArg Prod.fst he
    have hvij := congrArg (fun p : Fin n×Fin n×Fin n => p.2.1) he
    have hdij := congrArg (fun p : Fin n×Fin n×Fin n => p.2.2.val) he
    dsimp only [code] at huij hvij hdij
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hij|hji
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hordered i j hij huij hvij)) hdij
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hordered j i hji huij.symm hvij.symm)) hdij.symm
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective code hinj
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_prod,pow_succ,pow_zero,mul_one,one_mul,mul_assoc] using hc

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.CheegerProof.exists_median
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
theorem exists_median (f : X → ℝ) : ∃ a : ℝ,
    mass C (Finset.univ.filter fun x => f x < a) ≤ 1/2 ∧
    mass C (Finset.univ.filter fun x => a < f x) ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset X).Nonempty := by
    by_contra hn
    have hz := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn
    have h := C.normalized
    rw [hz,Finset.sum_empty] at h
    norm_num at h
  let M := Finset.univ.filter fun x =>
    1/2 ≤ mass C (Finset.univ.filter fun y => f y ≤ f x)
  have hM : M.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hm⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ f hne
    have he : (Finset.univ.filter fun y => f y ≤ f x) = Finset.univ := by
      ext y
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
      exact iff_true_intro (hm y (Finset.mem_univ _))
    refine ⟨x,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx,?_⟩⟩
    rw [he]
    simp only [mass,C.normalized]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image M f hM
  have hxM : 1/2 ≤ mass C (Finset.univ.filter fun y => f y ≤ f x) :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
  refine ⟨f x,?_,?_⟩
  · let L := Finset.univ.filter fun y => f y < f x
    change mass C L ≤ 1/2
    by_contra hn
    have hL : 1/2 < mass C L := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hLn : L.Nonempty := by
      by_contra he
      rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp he] at hL
      norm_num [mass] at hL
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hymax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image L f hLn
    have hyx : f y < f x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
    have he : (Finset.univ.filter fun z => f z ≤ f y) = L := by
      ext z
      simp only [L,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
      exact ⟨fun hz => hz.trans_lt hyx,fun hz => hymax z (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hz⟩)⟩
    have hyM : y ∈ M := by
      apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,?_⟩
      rw [he]
      exact hL.le
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmin y hyM)) hyx
  · have he : (Finset.univ.filter fun y => f y ≤ f x)ᶜ =
        Finset.univ.filter (fun y => f x < f y) := by
      ext y
      simp
    have h := mass_compl C (Finset.univ.filter fun y => f y ≤ f x)
    rw [he] at h
    linarith

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.tableMass

noncomputable def tableMass (A : Machine) (input : List Symbol) (t : ℕ)
    {m n : ℕ} (X : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ((Finset.univ.filter fun bits : Fin t → Bool => OutputsTable A input bits X).card : ℝ) /
    (2 : ℝ) ^ t

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.OutputsTable
OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.ExactSamplingStatement
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Algo.text:
def ExactSamplingStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : Machine) (C d : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
      (∑ i, r i) = ∑ j, c j →
        let input := encodeMargins r c
        let tail : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => 1 - haltMass A input t
        (∀ t (bits : Fin t → Bool), (MatchingFPRAS.run A input bits).state = none →
          ∃ X : Table r c, OutputsTable A input bits X.val) ∧
        (∀ X : Table r c, Tendsto (fun t => tableMass A input t X.val) atTop
          (nhds ((Fintype.card (Table r c) : ℝ)⁻¹))) ∧
        Tendsto (haltMass A input) atTop (nhds 1) ∧
        Summable tail ∧
        tsum tail ≤ C * (samplingSize n r 0) ^ d

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.PublishedInputs.integral_interpolation
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
private theorem integral_interpolation {q : ℕ} {f g h : Point q → ℝ}
    (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) (hh0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ h x)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) (hh : Measurable h)
    (hfi : Integrable f) (hgi : Integrable g) (hhi : Integrable h)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    (hfg : ∀ x y, f x ^ t * g y ^ (1-t) ≤ h (t • x+(1-t) • y)) :
    (∫ x, f x)^t * (∫ y, g y)^(1-t) ≤ ∫ z, h z := by
  have hp := AsymptoticStatistics.prekopaLeindler hf.ennreal_ofReal hg.ennreal_ofReal
    hh.ennreal_ofReal ht ht1 (fun x y => by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (hf0 x) ht.le,
        ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (hg0 y) (sub_pos.mpr ht1).le,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg (hf0 x) t)]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hfg x y))
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hfi (ae_of_all _ hf0),
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hgi (ae_of_all _ hg0),
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hhi (ae_of_all _ hh0)] at hp
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg hf0) ht.le,
    ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg hg0) (sub_pos.mpr ht1).le,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg (integral_nonneg hf0) t)] at hp
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (integral_nonneg hh0)).mp hp

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.PublishedInputs.finiteBoxPrekopaLeindler
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
theorem finiteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler q := by
  intro t ht ht1 lower upper S₀ S₁ S₂ f₀ f₁ f₂ hS₀ hS₁ hS₂
    hb₀ hb₁ hb₂ hc₀ hc₁ hc₂ hp₀ hp₁ hp₂ hcover hle
  obtain ⟨h₀,hm₀,hi₀⟩ := box_indicator hS₀ hb₀ hc₀ hp₀
  obtain ⟨h₁,hm₁,hi₁⟩ := box_indicator hS₁ hb₁ hc₁ hp₁
  obtain ⟨h₂,hm₂,hi₂⟩ := box_indicator hS₂ hb₂ hc₂ hp₂
  have ht' : 0 < 1-t := sub_pos.mpr ht1
  have ht1' : 1-t < 1 := by linarith
  have H := integral_interpolation h₁ h₂ h₀ hm₁ hm₂ hm₀ hi₁ hi₂ hi₀ ht' ht1'
    (fun x y => by
      rw [show 1-(1-t)=t by ring]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ S₁
      · by_cases hy : y ∈ S₂
        · have hz : (1-t) • x+t • y ∈ S₀ := hcover ⟨x,hx,y,hy,rfl⟩
          simpa only [indicator_of_mem hx,indicator_of_mem hy,indicator_of_mem hz]
            using hle x hx y hy
        · rw [indicator_of_notMem hy,Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt ht),mul_zero]
          exact h₀ _
      · rw [indicator_of_notMem hx,Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt ht'),zero_mul]
        exact h₀ _)
  simpa only [integral_indicator hS₀.isOpen.measurableSet,
    integral_indicator hS₁.isOpen.measurableSet,integral_indicator hS₂.isOpen.measurableSet,
    sub_sub_cancel] using H

end
end ContingencyTables.PublishedInputs

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.allSamplingMachine_outputs
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
lemma allSamplingMachine_outputs (htotal : (∑ i,r i)=∑ j,c j) (k t : ℕ)
    (ht : allSamplingMachineTime (encodeSamplingInput r c k)≤t) :
    ∀ bits : Bits t,∃ X : Table r c,
      OutputsTable allSamplingMachine (encodeSamplingInput r c k) bits X.val := by
  let as := encodeSamplingInput r c k
  let P : Tape MatchingFPRAS.Symbol → Prop := fun tape => ∃ X : Table r c,
    tape.right₀=ListBlank.mk (encodeMatrix X.val)
  have hf : ∀ bits : Bits (publicWordCount as),P (Tape.mk₁ (publicSamplingAll (as,List.ofFn bits))) := by
    dsimp only [as]
    rw [publicWordCount_spec]
    intro bits
    refine ⟨scheduledTableDraw r c htotal k bits,?_⟩
    rw [publicSamplingAll_spec r c htotal]
    simp only [Tape.mk₁,Tape.mk₂,Tape.mk'_right₀]
  have hP := FiniteWordExecution.machine_all publicWordCountRealizer publicSamplingAllRealizer as
    (samplingInput_nonzero r c k) (publicSamplingAll_alphabet as) P hf t ht
  have hhalt := (FiniteWordExecution.machine_law publicWordCountRealizer publicSamplingAllRealizer as
    (samplingInput_nonzero r c k) (publicSamplingAll_alphabet as) t ht).1
  intro bits
  obtain ⟨X,hX⟩ := hP bits
  exact ⟨X,hhalt bits,hX⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.ExactPublicLaw.halted_feasible
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
theorem halted_feasible (t : ℕ) (bits : Bits t)
    (hh : (MatchingFPRAS.run machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) bits).state=none) :
    ∃ X : Table r c,Algorithms.OutputsTable machine (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) bits X.val := by
  let bad : Cfg Symbol program.State → Prop := fun cfg => cfg.state=none ∧
    ¬∃ X : Table r c,cfg.tape.right₀=ListBlank.mk (Algorithms.encodeMatrix X.val)
  have hb (N : ℕ) :
      ((experiment program.table t (program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).mean
        (event bad):ℝ)≤prefixError r c N := by
    obtain ⟨p,hp,hm⟩ := prefix_correct r c htotal N
    have h := absent_event_bound program.table (output r c) _ p hp (output_halted r c) bad
      (fun cfg hd => hd.1) (by intro X hX; exact hX.2 ⟨X,output_tape r c X⟩) t
    rw [hm] at h
    exact (show ((experiment program.table t (program.initial
      (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).mean (event bad):ℝ)≤
      ((ExactTablePrefix.experiment r c N).mean (fun o => if o=none then 1 else 0):ℝ) by
        exact_mod_cast h).trans (prefix_error r c hPL hCheeger htotal N)
  have hzR := ge_of_tendsto' (error_limit r c) hb
  have hz : (experiment program.table t (program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).mean
      (event bad)=0 := by
    have hnonneg := (experiment program.table t (program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).mean_nonneg
      (event bad) ((Experiment.all_true _).mono (fun cfg _ => event_nonneg bad cfg))
    exact le_antisymm (by exact_mod_cast hzR) hnonneg
  have hall : (experiment program.table t (program.initial
      (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).All (fun cfg => ¬bad cfg) := by
    rw [Experiment.all_indicator]
    change (experiment program.table t (program.initial
      (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c)))).mean (fun cfg => if ¬bad cfg then 0 else 1)=0
    have he : (fun cfg : Cfg Symbol program.State => if ¬bad cfg then (0:ℚ) else 1)=event bad := by
      funext cfg
      by_cases hb : bad cfg <;> simp [event,hb]
    rw [he]
    exact hz
  have hn := Experiment.all_run _ _ hall (extend bits)
  rw [experiment_run] at hn
  have hh' := (run_halted_iff program (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c) t bits).mp hh
  have hout : ∃ X : Table r c,(execute program.table t (program.initial
      (Tape.mk₁ (Algorithms.encodeMargins r c))) (extend bits)).tape.right₀=
      ListBlank.mk (Algorithms.encodeMatrix X.val) := by
    by_contra h
    exact hn ⟨hh',h⟩
  obtain ⟨X,hX⟩ := hout
  exact ⟨X,hh,(congrArg Tape.right₀ (Program.run_tape program _ t bits)).trans hX⟩

end Conditional
end

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.exact_expected_polynomial
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
theorem exact_expected_polynomial : ∃ p : Polynomial ℕ,
    ∀ (_hPL : ∀ q,PublishedInputs.FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler q)
      (_hCheeger : ∀ q k,PublishedInputs.FiniteCheeger (GridBoundary.Grid (I := Fin q) (4*k^8))),
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ), (∑ i,r i)=∑ j,c j →
    (∑' (t : ℕ), (1 - haltMass ExactPublicPrefix.machine (encodeMargins r c) t)) ≤
      ((p.eval (samplingSize n r 0) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨print,hprint⟩ := ExactPrintCost.polynomial_print_bound
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := ExactGatePolynomial.public_bound print
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := exact_public_correction_bound print
  refine ⟨p+11*q,?_⟩
  intro hPL hCheeger m n r c htotal
  let B := print.eval (ExactPrintCost.matrixSize (n := n) r)
  let S := ExactGatePublic.budget r c B B
  let T := ExactPublicCost.budget r c 1 B B+1
  let den : ℝ := (2:ℝ)^correctionPrecision r c
  have hB (X : Table r c) : GreedyFeasibleTable.printMatrixRealizer.cost (matrixCode X.val) ≤ B :=
    (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans (hprint m n r c X)
  have hL (X : Table r c) : (ExactPublicPrefix.word r c X).length ≤ B :=
    (list_length_le_weight _).trans ((Nat.le_add_left _ _).trans (hprint m n r c X))
  have htail := (ExactExpectedTime.bound r c hPL hCheeger htotal B B hB hL).2
  have hgate : (S:ℝ) ≤ ((p.eval (samplingSize n r 0):ℕ):ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp m n r c htotal
  have hT : (T:ℝ) ≤ den*((q.eval (samplingSize n r 0):ℕ):ℝ) := by
    have hn : T ≤ 2^(correctionPrecision r c)*q.eval (samplingSize n r 0) := hq m n r c htotal
    have ht : (T:ℝ) ≤ ((2^(correctionPrecision r c)*q.eval (samplingSize n r 0):ℕ):ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hn
    simpa only [Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat,den] using ht
  have hrare : (1/den)*T ≤ ((q.eval (samplingSize n r 0):ℕ):ℝ) := by
    have hden : 0 < den := by unfold den; positivity
    have ht : (T:ℝ)/den ≤ ((q.eval (samplingSize n r 0):ℕ):ℝ) :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hT)
    simpa only [one_div,div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm,one_mul] using ht
  have he : (fun t => 1-haltMass ExactPublicPrefix.machine (encodeMargins r c) t)=
      PhysicalRetryTail.tail ExactPublicPrefix.program.table
        (ExactPublicPrefix.program.initial (Tape.mk₁ (encodeMargins r c))) := by
    funext t
    exact PhysicalPublicLaw.tail_eq _ _ _
  rw [←he] at htail
  change _ ≤ (S:ℝ)+11*(1/den)*T at htail
  simp only [eval_add,eval_mul,eval_ofNat,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat]
  nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.CheegerProof.positive_energy
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
theorem positive_energy (κ : ℝ) (hk : 0 < κ)
    (hcut : ∀ S : Finset X, κ*min (mass C S) (mass C Sᶜ) ≤ cut C S)
    (g : X → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    (hsmall : mass C (Finset.univ.filter fun x => 0 < g x) ≤ 1/2) :
    κ^2*(∑ x, C.π x*(g x)^2) ≤ 2*C.energy g := by
  let N := ∑ x, C.π x*(g x)^2
  let W := ∑ x, ∑ y, C.π x*C.P x y*|(g x)^2-(g y)^2|
  have hE : 0 ≤ C.energy g := C.energy_nonneg g
  have hN : 0 ≤ N := Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => mul_nonneg (C.positive x).le (sq_nonneg _)
  have hW : 0 ≤ W := Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun y _ =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (C.positive x).le (C.nonnegative x y)) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hsquare : mass C (Finset.univ.filter fun x => 0 < (g x)^2) ≤ 1/2 := by
    apply le_trans (mass_mono C ?_) hsmall
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] at hx ⊢
    nlinarith [hg x]
  have hc : 2*κ*N ≤ W := coarea C κ hcut (fun x => (g x)^2) (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) hsquare
  have hsqW : (2*κ*N)^2 ≤ W^2 := (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) hW).mpr hc
  have ha (x y : X) : |(g x)^2-(g y)^2| = |g x-g y| * (g x+g y) := by
    rw [show (g x)^2-(g y)^2 = (g x-g y)*(g x+g y) by ring,
      abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (hg x) (hg y))]
  have hcs := weighted_cauchy
    (fun z : X×X => C.π z.1*C.P z.1 z.2)
    (fun z => |g z.1-g z.2|) (fun z => g z.1+g z.2)
    (fun z => mul_nonneg (C.positive _).le (C.nonnegative _ _))
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,sq_abs] at hcs
  have he : (∑ x, ∑ y, C.π x*C.P x y*(g x-g y)^2) = 2*C.energy g := by
    rw [C.energy_eq]; ring
  have hW' : W = ∑ x, ∑ y, C.π x*C.P x y*|g x-g y| * (g x+g y) := by
    dsimp [W]
    simp_rw [ha,mul_assoc]
  rw [← hW',he] at hcs
  have hb := sum_pair_add_square_le C g
  have hall : (2*κ*N)^2 ≤ (2*C.energy g)*(4*N) :=
    (hsqW.trans hcs).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*C.energy g))
  rcases hN.eq_or_lt with hz | hp
  · change κ^2*N ≤ _
    rw [← hz,mul_zero]
    positivity
  · change κ^2*N ≤ _
    have h : 4*N*(κ^2*N) ≤ 4*N*(2*C.energy g) := by nlinarith [hall]
    exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4*N)).mp h

end
end ContingencyTables.CheegerProof

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.boundedSampling_conditional
OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
theorem boundedSampling_conditional
    (hPL : ∀ q,PublishedInputs.FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler q)
    (hCheeger : ∀ q d,PublishedInputs.FiniteCheeger
      (GridBoundary.Grid (I := Fin q) (4*d^8))) : BoundedSamplingStatement := by
  obtain ⟨C,D,hC,hbound⟩ := allSamplingMachineTime_public_bound
  refine ⟨allSamplingMachine,C,D,hC,?_⟩
  intro m n r c htotal k hk
  dsimp only
  have ht := hbound m n r c htotal k
  refine ⟨allSamplingMachine_outputs r c htotal k _ ht,?_⟩
  let : Nonempty (Table r c) := ⟨GreedyFeasibleTable.table r c htotal⟩
  have hv := scheduledTableDraw_accuracy r c (hPL _)
    (hCheeger _ (dimensionAllowance (I := Fin m) (J := Fin n))) htotal k hk
  dsimp only at hv
  simp_rw [allSamplingMachine_mass r c htotal k _ ht]
  simpa only [variation,Rat.cast_div,Rat.cast_sum,Rat.cast_abs,Rat.cast_sub,
    Rat.cast_ofNat,Rat.cast_inv,uniformLaw,uniformMass,Rat.cast_one,Rat.cast_natCast,one_div] using hv

end
end ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Dens.text:
private theorem box_indicator {q : ℕ} {lower upper : Point q} {S : Set (Point q)}
    {f : Point q → ℝ} (hS : IsFiniteBoxUnion S)
    (hbox : closure S ⊆ Icc lower upper) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc lower upper))
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ Icc lower upper, 0 < f x) :
    (∀ x, 0 ≤ S.indicator f x) ∧ Measurable (S.indicator f) ∧
      Integrable (S.indicator f) := by
  classical
  have hs := hS.isOpen.measurableSet
  have hsub : S ⊆ Icc lower upper := subset_closure.trans hbox
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S
    · simpa only [indicator_of_mem hx] using (hp x (hsub hx)).le
    · simp only [indicator_of_notMem hx, le_refl]
  · change Measurable (S.piecewise f (fun _ => 0))
    exact (hf.mono hsub).measurable_piecewise continuousOn_const hs
  · exact (hf.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set hsub).integrable_indicator hs

OAI.Combinatorics.ContingencyTables.Samp.text:
lemma polynomial_scaled_power (p : Polynomial ℕ) (A x b : ℕ) (hx : 1≤x) :
    p.eval (A*x^b)≤p.eval A*x^(b*p.natDegree) := by
  rw [p.eval_eq_sum_range,p.eval_eq_sum_range,Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  have hi' : i≤p.natDegree := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [mul_pow,←pow_mul]
  calc
    p.coeff i*(A^i*x^(b*i))=(p.coeff i*A^i)*x^(b*i) := by ring
    _ ≤ (p.coeff i*A^i)*x^(b*p.natDegree) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hx (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b hi'))
    _ = _ := by ring

end ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms

theorem continuousOperator_no_projection (p : CircleFiberOperator) (hp : IsStarProjection p)
    (hcomm : ∀ B∈fiberCommutant parameterAngle,Commute p B)
    (hinv : (1-p)*(fiberShiftL2 1*realPi modelAngle (RealBorel.ofContinuous finalWeight))*p=0) : p=0 ∨ p=1 := by
  by_cases hp0 : p=0
  · exact Or.inl hp0
  by_cases hp1 : p=1
  · exact Or.inr hp1
  exfalso
  obtain ⟨a,ham,hapos,ha⟩ := finalWeight_coboundary
  have he : ∀ᵐ x ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle,RealBorel.ofContinuous finalWeight x*a (x+modelAngle)=modelBorel x*a x := by
    rw [Sampling.haarAddCircle_one_eq_volume]
    filter_upwards [ha] with x hx
    exact (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt (hapos _))).mp hx
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqc,hq0,hq1,hqi⟩ := borel_weight_transport parameterAngle (RealBorel.ofContinuous finalWeight) modelBorel a ham hapos he p hp hcomm hp0 hp1 hinv
  exact (modelOperator_no_projection q hq hqc hqi).elim hq0 hq1

OAI.Analysis.RotationWeights.ContinuousW.name: OAI.ContinuousCircleWeight.continuous_concentratedWeight
OAI.Analysis.RotationWeights.ContinuousW.text:
theorem continuous_concentratedWeight {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] [T1Space X]
    (H : ℕ → X → ℝ) (z : X) (hc : ∀ i, Continuous (H i)) (hH : ∀ i x, 0 ≤ H i x)
    (hlocal : LocallyFiniteOff H z)
    (hdiv : ∀ B : ℝ, ∃ s : Finset ℕ, B < ∑ i ∈ s, H i z) :
    Continuous (concentratedWeight H z) := by
  classical
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x = z
  · subst x
    rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hdiv (-Real.log ε)
    have he : Real.exp (-∑ i ∈ s, H i z) < ε := by
      rw [← Real.exp_log hε]
      exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 z, Real.exp (-∑ i ∈ s, H i x) < ε :=
      ((continuous_finsetSum s (fun i _ ↦ hc i)).neg.rexp.continuousAt).eventually (gt_mem_nhds he)
    filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
    rw [concentratedWeight_self, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (concentratedWeight_bounds H z hH x).1]
    exact (concentratedWeight_le_finite H z hH hlocal s x).trans_lt hx
  · exact concentratedWeight_continuousAt_off H z hc hlocal hx

OAI.Analysis.RotationWeights.Main:267.text:
theorem main_theorem : MainStatement := by
  refine ⟨parameterAngle, finalWeight, regularU, regularV (rotationScalar parameterAngle),
    regularVacuum, parameterAngle_spec.1, parameterAngle_spec.2.1,
    parameterAngle_spec.2.2.1, regular_isTracialRotation parameterAngle,
    finalWeight_bounds, ⟨0, finalWeight_zero⟩, finalWeight_log, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hppr hinv
  have hi : (1-fiberConjugacy p)*
      (fiberShiftL2 1*realPi modelAngle (RealBorel.ofContinuous finalWeight))*fiberConjugacy p=0 := by
    have h := congrArg fiberConjugacy hinv
    simpa only [map_mul,map_sub,map_one,map_zero,fiberConjugacy_weighted,modelAngle] using h
  have hq := continuousOperator_no_projection (fiberConjugacy p) (hppr.map fiberConjugacy)
    (fiber_commutes_of_regularAlgebra parameterAngle p hp) hi
  rcases hq with hq|hq
  · left
    apply fiberConjugacy.injective
    change fiberConjugacy p=fiberConjugacy 0
    simpa only [map_zero] using hq
  · right
    apply fiberConjugacy.injective
    change fiberConjugacy p=fiberConjugacy 1
    simpa only [map_one] using hq

OAI.Analysis.RotationWeights.Main:115.text:
lemma finalWeight_log : (∫⁻ x : CircleModel.CircleX,negativeLog (finalWeight x))=∞ := by
  change (∫⁻ x : CircleModel.CircleX,negativeLog (concentratedWeight blockH 0 x))=_
  rw [lintegral_negativeLog_concentratedWeight volume blockH 0 blockH_continuous blockH_nonneg blockH_locallyFinite blockH_diverges_zero]
  apply top_unique
  calc
    ∞ = ∑' _j : ℕ,(1:ℝ≥0∞) := (ENNReal.tsum_const_eq_top_of_ne_zero one_ne_zero).symm
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
      intro j
      have hi : Integrable (blockH j) (volume : Measure CircleModel.CircleX) := (blockH_continuous j).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
      rw [←ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (Eventually.of_forall (blockH_nonneg j))]
      rw [←ENNReal.ofReal_one]
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      have hK : (1:ℝ)≤polynomialWindow j := by exact_mod_cast polynomialWindow_pos j
      exact hK.trans (blockH_integral_lower j)

OAI.Analysis.RotationWeights.Main:145.name: OAI.CircleSampling.finalWeight_coboundary
OAI.Analysis.RotationWeights.Main:145.text:
lemma finalWeight_coboundary : ∃ a : CircleModel.CircleX → ℝ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ x,0<a x) ∧
    ∀ᵐ x : CircleModel.CircleX, finalWeight x=modelWeight x*a x/a (x+modelAngle) := by
  have h0 : volume ({(0:CircleModel.CircleX)} : Set CircleModel.CircleX)=0 := by
    rw [←Metric.closedBall_zero,AddCircle.volume_closedBall]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨a,ham,hapos,ha⟩ := concentrated_coboundary (volume:Measure CircleModel.CircleX)
    (fun x => x+modelAngle) (measurePreserving_add_right volume modelAngle) blockH blockG blockW 0 h0
    blockW_measurable blockG_support_sum blockW_support_sum (Eventually.of_forall (fun x j => block_coboundary j x))
  refine ⟨a,ham,hapos,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [ha,model_good_ae] with x hax hx
  change concentratedWeight blockH 0 x=_
  rw [hax,blockG_exponent hx]
  simp only [modelWeight,modelF,cocycle,ite_eq_left (show x ∈ good modelFrequency modelAngle from hx)]
end

theorem modelOperator_no_projection (p : CircleFiberOperator) (hp : IsStarProjection p)
    (hcomm : ∀ B∈fiberCommutant parameterAngle,Commute p B)
    (hinv : (1-p)*(fiberShiftL2 1*realPi modelAngle modelBorel)*p=0) : p=0 ∨ p=1 := by
  by_cases hp0 : p=0
  · exact Or.inl hp0
  by_cases hp1 : p=1
  · exact Or.inr hp1
  exfalso
  obtain ⟨P,hPproj,hPbound,hPmeas,hP,hcov⟩ := extract_projection_field parameterAngle p hp hcomm
  let Q : ModelProjectionField :=
    { p := P
      projection := hPproj
      norm_le := hPbound
      measurable := hPmeas
      invariant := by
        have h := decomposable_invariant p P hP modelAngle modelBorel hinv
        simpa only [Sampling.haarAddCircle_one_eq_volume,modelBorel_field] using h
      covariance := by
        intro n
        simpa only [Sampling.haarAddCircle_one_eq_volume,CircleModel.shift,modelAngle] using hcov n }
  apply model_no_strict_projection Q
  have hs := borel_invariant_diagonal_strict parameterAngle modelAngle_ergodic p P hP hPproj hcov modelBorel
    (fun x => ne_of_gt (modelWeight_bounds x).1) hinv hp0 hp1
  simpa only [Sampling.haarAddCircle_one_eq_volume,lp.inner_single_left,RCLike.inner_apply,map_one,mul_one,
    modelDiagonal,modelColumn,Q] using hs

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.ContinuumCoulomb.text:
theorem literal_accepting (c : QMACircuit) (hc : c.WellFormed) {k : ℕ}
    (hp : (value c).PolynomialPromise k)
    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (SourceSpinBasis c.witness)) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1)
    (ha : 2/3 ≤ qmaAcceptance c hc psi) :
    value c ∈ (sourceHeisenbergPromise k).yes := by
  rw [value_eq_latticeOutput] at hp ⊢
  obtain ⟨hs,Q,hQ,hgrid⟩ := routed_realization c hc
  exact QuantumListRouteProgram.latticeOutput_yes _ hs Q hQ hgrid
    (routed_vertices_pos c hc) _ _ (thresholds_lt c) hp
    (routed_accepting c hc psi hpsi ha)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.ContinuumCoulomb.name: OAI.ContinuumCoulomb.QuantumHistorySourceProgram.circuit_polynomialPromise
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.ContinuumCoulomb.text:
theorem circuit_polynomialPromise : ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧
    ∀ (c : QMACircuit) (_hc : c.WellFormed), (value c).PolynomialPromise k := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := source_data_power
  refine ⟨2*a+6,by omega,fun c hc => ?_⟩
  let d := qmaNonemptyCircuit c
  let hd := qmaNonemptyCircuit_wellFormed c hc
  let ht := qmaNonemptyCircuit_sparse_pos c
  let he := qmaNonemptyCircuit_nearest c
  let I := QuantumHistorySpatial.input d hd ht he (precision c)
  let n := qubitCount (qmaPreparedCircuit c)
  have hn : 0 < n := qubitCount_positive _
  obtain ⟨L,hL,hC,hx,hy,hw⟩ := ha d hd ht he
  have lift (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ (n+2)^a) : (m:ℝ) ≤ (n+1:ℝ)^(2*a+6) := by
    have hb : m ≤ (n+1)^(2*a+6) := hm.trans
      ((power_base_change hn).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by omega : 1 ≤ n+1) (by omega)))
    exact_mod_cast hb
  have hsize : n ≤ I.model.n := by
    have h := model_vertices_ge d hd ht he (precision c)
    rw [QuantumPaddedLabelProgram.historyQubits_eq] at h
    have hn' : n ≤ 4*(qubitCount (qmaSparseCircuit d)+3717*termCount (qmaSparseCircuit d)) := by
      change n ≤ 4*(n+_)
      omega
    exact hn'.trans h
  rw [value_actual c hc]
  apply QuantumFinalRoutingProgram.spatial_polynomialPromise I finalDensity_pos
    (N := (precision c:ℚ)) (T := precision c) (n := n)
    (by exact_mod_cast precision_pos c) (model_vertices_pos d hd ht he (precision c)) hsize
    hL (by simp only [Rat.cast_natCast,abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _ : (0:ℝ) ≤ precision c)]; exact le_rfl)
    hC _ _ (xz_threshold_lt (qmaPreparedCircuit c)) (lift _ hx) (lift _ hy)
  · rw [route_rounds_eq]
    exact lift _ hw
  · exact final_threshold_gap_bound (qmaPreparedCircuit c) hn (time_le_qubitCount _) (by omega)

end ContinuumCoulomb.QuantumHistorySourceProgram

end

theorem publishedCMPHardness : PublishedCMPHardness := by
  obtain ⟨k,hk,hpromise⟩ := QuantumHistorySourceProgram.circuit_polynomialPromise
  refine ⟨k,hk,?_⟩
  intro P hP
  obtain ⟨V,hyes,hno⟩ := hP

    polynomialTime := QuantumHistorySourceProgram.fromVerifier_uniform V
    maps_yes := ?_
    maps_no := ?_

  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨psi,hpsi,ha⟩ := hyes x hx
    exact QuantumHistorySourceProgram.literal_accepting (V.generate x) (V.wellFormed x)
      (hpromise _ (V.wellFormed x)) psi hpsi ha
  · intro x hx
    exact QuantumHistorySourceProgram.literal_rejecting (V.generate x) (V.wellFormed x)
      (hpromise _ (V.wellFormed x)) (hno x hx)

OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Cons.name: OAI.ContinuumTemperature.ConstructionData
OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Cons.text:
structure ConstructionData (p : ℝ) where
  t : ℝ
  τ : ℝ
  γ : ℝ
  τ_pos : 0 < τ
  τ_small : τ ≤ p/100
  γ_pos : 0 < γ
  cap : ConstructionCap t (firstMass p+1)
  geometry : ∀ w : Fin 3 → Parameter, (∀ i, dist (w i) (triangleVertex p i) ≤ τ) →
    closedBall (triangleCenter p) γ ⊆ convexHull ℝ (range w)
  stages : ∀ n, ConstructionStage t p τ n
  ranges : ℕ → ℝ
  initial_zero : (stages 0).σ = fun _ => 0
  initial_mass : (stages 0).a = firstMass p
  transitions : ∀ n, StageTransition (stages n) (stages (n+1)) (ranges n)

OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Cons.name: OAI.ContinuumTemperature.sequence_of_initial
OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Cons.text:
lemma sequence_of_initial {t p τ γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτp : τ ≤ p/100)
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hcap : ConstructionCap t (firstMass p+1))
    (hgeom : ∀ w : Fin 3 → Parameter, (∀ i, dist (w i) (triangleVertex p i) ≤ τ) →
      closedBall (triangleCenter p) γ ⊆ convexHull ℝ (range w))
    (s₀ : ConstructionStage t p τ 0) (hzero : s₀.σ = fun _ => 0) (hfirst : s₀.a = firstMass p) :
    Nonempty (ConstructionData p) := by
  have hex := fun n (s : ConstructionStage t p τ n) => construction_step hp hτ hτp hγ hcap hgeom s
  let next := fun n (s : ConstructionStage t p τ n) => Classical.choose (hex n s)
  let length := fun n (s : ConstructionStage t p τ n) => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hex n s))
  have hn (n) (s : ConstructionStage t p τ n) : StageTransition s (next n s) (length n s) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hex n s))
  let seq : ∀ n, ConstructionStage t p τ n := Nat.rec s₀ (fun n s => next n s)
  refine ⟨⟨t,τ,γ,hτ,hτp,hγ,hcap,hgeom,seq,(fun n => length n (seq n)),hzero,hfirst,?_⟩⟩
  intro n
  exact hn n (seq n)

OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Cons.name: OAI.ContinuumTemperature.exists_constructionData
OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Cons.text:
lemma exists_constructionData : Nonempty (ConstructionData packingDensity) := by
  have hp := packingDensity_pos
  obtain ⟨τ₀,γ,hτ₀,hγ,hgeom₀⟩ := robust_vertex_triangle hp
  let τ := min τ₀ (packingDensity/100)
  have hτ : 0 < τ := lt_min hτ₀ (by positivity)
  have hτp : τ ≤ packingDensity/100 := min_le_right _ _
  have hgeom : ∀ w : Fin 3 → Parameter, (∀ i, dist (w i) (triangleVertex packingDensity i) ≤ τ) →
      closedBall (triangleCenter packingDensity) γ ⊆ convexHull ℝ (range w) :=
    fun w hw => hgeom₀ w (fun i => (hw i).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have ha : 0 < firstMass packingDensity := firstMass_pos hp
  obtain ⟨T,hT⟩ := exists_constructionCap (show 0 < firstMass packingDensity+1 by linarith)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,x,hx,htr⟩ := physical_initial_triple hτ hγ (show (0:ℝ) < 1/64 by norm_num)
    (show (1:ℝ)/64 < 1/2 by norm_num) hT.t_large (hT.lt_gap (by linarith : firstMass packingDensity ≤ firstMass packingDensity+1))
    (hgeom (triangleVertex packingDensity) (fun _ => by simp only [dist_self]; exact hτ.le))
  let s₀ : ConstructionStage t packingDensity τ 0 := {
    σ := fun _ => 0, R := fun _ => 1, a := firstMass packingDensity, x := x,
    σ_nonneg := fun _ => le_refl _, R_one := fun _ => le_refl _, σ_summable := summable_zero,
    a_pos := ha, mass := by simp [geometricBudget],
    referenceBounded := ⟨1,by norm_num,fun _ _ => le_refl _⟩,
    location := by
      change dist x initialPoint < 1/64 at hx
      norm_num [locationRadius,geometricBudget]
      linarith,
    triple := by
      have he : groupRadius τ 0 = τ/2 := by norm_num [groupRadius,geometricBudget]; ring
      rw [he,physicalProfile_zero]
      exact htr }
  exact sequence_of_initial hp hτ hτp hγ (hT.mono_t ht) hgeom s₀ rfl rfl

end ContinuumTemperature
end
end

OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Main.name: OAI.ContinuumTemperature.SlopeBall_subset_closedBall
OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Main.text:
lemma SlopeBall_subset_closedBall {g : Parameter} {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) :
    SlopeBall g γ ⊆ closedBall g γ := by
  intro v hv
  change (v.1-g.1)^2+(v.2-g.2)^2 ≤ γ^2 at hv
  simp only [mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm_sub,Prod.norm_def,Prod.fst_sub,Prod.snd_sub,
    Real.norm_eq_abs,max_le_iff]
  constructor
  · nlinarith only [hv,sq_nonneg (v.2-g.2),sq_abs (v.1-g.1),abs_nonneg (v.1-g.1),hγ]
  · nlinarith only [hv,sq_nonneg (v.1-g.1),sq_abs (v.2-g.2),abs_nonneg (v.2-g.2),hγ]

OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Main.name: OAI.ContinuumTemperature.main_theorem
OAI.Probability.ContinuumTransition.Main.text:
theorem main_theorem : MainStatement := by
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := exists_constructionData
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hnear⟩ := C.exists_limit_position
  have ht : 1 < C.t := C.cap.t_large
  have ht0 : 0 < C.t := lt_trans zero_lt_one ht
  have hsmall : 2197*C.t*kernelHeight*(∑' k, C.masses k)/2 ≤ C.t^2/8 := by
    have hh := C.cap.small C.mass_bound
    nlinarith only [hh,sq_nonneg C.t]
  have hφ : Measurable (radialPotential C.profile) :=
    measurable_radialPotential (measurable_physicalProfile C.t C.masses_nonneg C.ranges_one C.masses_summable)
  have hstable := physicalProfile_stable ht0.le C.masses_nonneg C.ranges_one C.masses_summable hsmall
  have hcore : ∀ r, 0 < r → C.profile r ≤ coreProfile C.t r :=
    fun r _ => physicalProfile_le_core ht0.le C.masses_nonneg C.ranges_one r
  have hβ : 0 < x.1 := moderateBox_subset (initial_near_moderate hnear)
  have hball : ∀ v ∈ SlopeBall (triangleCenter packingDensity) C.γ, Supports C.pressure x v := by
    intro v hv
    apply supports_iff_supportOn.mpr
    exact C.limit_support_ball packingDensity_pos hx hnear (SlopeBall_subset_closedBall C.γ_pos.le hv)
  have hg : 0 < (triangleCenter packingDensity).2 := by
    change 0 < 5*packingDensity/3
    positivity [packingDensity_pos]
  obtain ⟨I,hIo,hIc,hIn,hIp,hjump⟩ := canonical_interval_of_support_ball
    (physical_partialConjugate hφ ht hstable hcore) ht0 hβ C.γ_pos hg
    (fun d hd => concaveOn_physicalCanonical hφ ht hstable hcore hd.le) hball
  refine ⟨C.profile,canonicalFreeEnergy C.profile,I,x.1,?_,?_,?_,hIo,hIc,hIn,hIp,initial_near_beta hnear,?_⟩
  · exact admissible_physicalProfile ht C.masses_nonneg C.ranges_one C.masses_summable hsmall
      (C.stages 0).a_pos (C.transitions 0).range_large.le
  · exact physicalProfile_isLittleO ht C.masses_nonneg C.ranges_one C.masses_summable
  · exact hasCanonicalFreeEnergy_of_core hφ ht hstable hcore
  · intro d hd
    obtain ⟨l,r,hl,hr,_,hstrict⟩ := hjump d hd
    have he : (fun β => C.t*physicalCanonical C.profile C.t β d/β) =
        fun β => canonicalFreeEnergy C.profile β d := by
      funext β
      simp only [physicalCanonical,canonicalFreeEnergy]
      congr 1
      field_simp
    rw [he] at hl hr
    exact ⟨l,r,hl,hr,hstrict⟩

end ContinuumTemperature
end
end

      Real.norm_eq_abs,max_le_iff,initialPoint] using hx
