OAI.Analysis.CoulombRadii.Model:15.name: OAI.NeutralAtom.Wavefunction
OAI.Analysis.CoulombRadii.Model:15.text: abbrev Wavefunction (n : ℕ) := Spins n → Configuration n → ℂ

OAI.Analysis.CoulombRadii.Variational.Co.name: OAI.NeutralAtom.iterated_limits_of_radius_brackets
OAI.Analysis.CoulombRadii.Variational.Co.text:
theorem iterated_limits_of_radius_brackets (Ψ : ∀ N : ℕ, Wavefunction (N + 1))
    (h : ∀ l u : ℝ, 0 < l → l < bTF → bTF < u →
      ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop, ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        l ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * radius (Ψ N) m ∧
        (m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * radius (Ψ N) m ≤ u) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) * upperRadius Ψ m)
      atTop (𝓝 (bTF : EReal)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) * lowerRadius Ψ m)
      atTop (𝓝 (bTF : EReal)) := by
  have hb : ∀ l u : ℝ, 0 < l → l < bTF → bTF < u →
      ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
        (((l : EReal) ≤ ((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) * lowerRadius Ψ m ∧
        ((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) * lowerRadius Ψ m ≤ (u : EReal)) ∧
        ((l : EReal) ≤ ((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) * upperRadius Ψ m ∧
        ((m : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) : ℝ) * upperRadius Ψ m ≤ (u : EReal))) := by
    intro l u hl hlb hbu
    filter_upwards [h l u hl hlb hbu, eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℕ)] with m hm hp
    apply inner_limits_bracket Ψ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp) _) hm
  constructor
  · apply tendsto_ereal_of_eventual_brackets bTF_pos
    intro l u hl hlb hbu
    exact (hb l u hl hlb hbu).mono fun _ hi => hi.2
  · apply tendsto_ereal_of_eventual_brackets bTF_pos
    intro l u hl hlb hbu
    exact (hb l u hl hlb hbu).mono fun _ hi => hi.1

OAI.Analysis.CoulombRadii.LimitTheory.Ne.name: OAI.NeutralAtom.physical_uniform_count_control
OAI.Analysis.CoulombRadii.LimitTheory.Ne.text:
theorem physical_uniform_count_control : UniformGroundStateCountControl := by
  obtain ⟨D,hD,Zmin,H⟩:=physical_neutral_energy_offset
  refine ⟨D,Zmin,hD,?_,?_⟩
  · intro α β hα hαβ
    obtain ⟨C,hC,HC⟩:=Coulomb.atomic_annular_second_moment hα hαβ
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt C,Real.sqrt_nonneg _,?_⟩
    intro N ψ hNZ hψ u hu
    obtain ⟨g,hd,hn,hmin⟩:=hψ
    let v:=asH1 ψ g hd.2.1 hd.2.2.1 hd.2.2.2.1
    have hm:Coulomb.mass v=1 := (asH1_mass ..).trans hn
    have hz:1≤N+1:=by omega
    have he:Coulomb.form (Coulomb.atom (N+1) hz) v≤
        (Coulomb.unrestrictedFormBottom (Coulomb.atom (N+1) hz)).toReal+D := by
      rw [asH1_energy]; exact H (N+1) hNZ hz hd hn hmin
    have hE:=Coulomb.atom_unrestricted_bottom_real (N+1) hz v (asH1_antisymmetric hd) hm
    have HH:=HC (Coulomb.atom (N+1) hz) (fun _ => rfl) v (asH1_antisymmetric hd) hm hE.le he hD hu
    rw [raw_second_expectation_asH1 hd (S:={y:Position | α*u<‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖<β*u}) (measurableSet_lt measurable_const continuous_norm.measurable |>.inter
      (measurableSet_lt continuous_norm.measurable measurable_const))]
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt HH).trans_eq
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hC,Real.sqrt_sq (Coulomb.screenMass_pos D u).le]
    rfl
  · refine ⟨2*Coulomb.atomicInnerFieldConstant,mul_nonneg (by norm_num) Coulomb.atomicInnerFieldConstant_nonneg,?_⟩
    intro N ψ hNZ hψ
    obtain ⟨g,hd,hn,hmin⟩:=hψ
    let v:=asH1 ψ g hd.2.1 hd.2.2.1 hd.2.2.2.1
    have hm:Coulomb.mass v=1 := (asH1_mass ..).trans hn
    have hz:1≤N+1:=by omega
    have he:Coulomb.form (Coulomb.atom (N+1) hz) v≤
        (Coulomb.unrestrictedFormBottom (Coulomb.atom (N+1) hz)).toReal+D := by
      rw [asH1_energy]; exact H (N+1) hNZ hz hd hn hmin
    have hE:=Coulomb.atom_unrestricted_bottom_real (N+1) hz v (asH1_antisymmetric hd) hm
    have HH:=Coulomb.atomic_inner_deficit_upper (Coulomb.atom (N+1) hz) (fun _ => rfl)
      v (asH1_antisymmetric hd) hm hE.le he hD (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)
    rw [physical_exterior_deficit hd hn]
    simpa [Coulomb.totalCharge,Coulomb.atom,Coulomb.screenMass,Coulomb.screenBaseMass] using HH
end NeutralAtom
end

OAI.Analysis.CoulombRadii.ThomasFermi.Qu.name: OAI.NeutralAtom.physical_profile_constants
OAI.Analysis.CoulombRadii.ThomasFermi.Qu.text:
theorem physical_profile_constants : ∃ ε B C L M : ℝ,0 < ε ∧ 0 < B ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧
    ∃ Zbar : ℝ → ℕ, ∀ q : ℝ,2 ≤ q → ∃ Cq : ℝ,0 < Cq ∧
      ∃ sq : ℝ,0 < sq ∧ ∀ {N : ℕ} (ψ : Wavefunction (N+1)),
        ∀ hψ : IsNormalizedGroundState (N+1) ψ, ∀ s : ℝ,0 < s → s < sq → Zbar s ≤ N+1 →
        initialAtomicRadius ε ((N+1:ℕ):ℝ)/s ≤ q⁻¹ →
         let := rawLaw_isProbability (hψ.choose_spec.1.2.2.1)
          (hψ.choose_spec.2.1)
        Nonempty (QuantumProfileDatum ψ ε B C L M s q Cq) := by
  obtain ⟨ε,B,C,L,M,hε,hB,hC,hM,HB⟩ := physical_barrier_data
  obtain ⟨D,hD,Zmin,Henergy⟩ := physical_neutral_energy_offset
  obtain ⟨sB,hsB,hsB1,HB⟩ := HB D hD
  choose ZB HZB using HB
  let Zbar := fun s => max Zmin (if H : 0 < s ∧ s < sB then ZB s H.1 H.2 else 0)
  refine ⟨ε,B,C,L,M,hε,hB,hM,Zbar,?_⟩
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨Cq,hCq,Hinv⟩ := physical_tf_band hq
  obtain ⟨sI,hsI,hsI1,Hinv⟩ := Hinv D hD
  refine ⟨Cq,hCq,min sB sI,lt_min hsB hsI,?_⟩
  intro N ψ hψ s hs hss hZbar hsmall
  have hZm : Zmin ≤ N+1 := (le_max_left ..).trans hZbar
  have hsBs : s < sB := hss.trans_le (min_le_left ..)
  have hsIs : s < sI := hss.trans_le (min_le_right ..)
  have hZB : ZB s hs hsBs ≤ N+1 := by
    have H := (le_max_right Zmin _).trans hZbar
    simpa only [Zbar,dite_eq_left (show 0 < s ∧ s < sB from ⟨hs,hsBs⟩)] using H
  obtain ⟨g,hd,hn,hmin⟩ := hψ
  have := rawLaw_isProbability hd.2.2.1 hn
  have hZ : 1 ≤ N+1 := by omega
  have hZpos : 0 < ((N+1:ℕ):ℝ) := by positivity
  have hr₀ := initialAtomicRadius_pos hε hZpos
  obtain ⟨j,hjl,hju⟩ := dyadic_radius_choice hr₀ hs (by linarith only [hq]) hsmall
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by linarith only [hq]
  have hrjs : profileRadius ε N j ≤ s := hju.trans ((div_le_self hs.le hq1))
  have he := Henergy (N+1) hZm hZ hd hn hmin
  have hE := Coulomb.atom_unrestricted_bottom_real (N+1) hZ
    (asH1 ψ g hd.2.1 hd.2.2.1 hd.2.2.2.1) (asH1_antisymmetric hd) ((asH1_mass ..).trans hn)
  obtain ⟨d,hdcost⟩ := HZB s hs hsBs (N+1) hZB hZ hd hn hmin hE.le he
    (show (N+1:ℝ) ≤ 3*((N+1:ℕ):ℝ) by push_cast; nlinarith only [Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) N]) (K:=j+1) ⟨j,by omega⟩ hrjs
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hVp,HV⟩ := d.valid_event hdcost
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hGp,HG⟩ := Hinv (N+1) hZ hd hn hmin hE.le he hr₀ hs hsIs
    (J:=j+1) ⟨j,by omega⟩ hrjs
  refine ⟨⟨j,hjl,hju,d,V∩G,hV.inter hG,?_,?_,?_⟩⟩
  · rw [compl_inter]
    exact (measureReal_union_le Vᶜ Gᶜ).trans ((add_le_add hVp hGp).trans
      (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀
        (mul_pos hr₀ (by positivity)).le hrjs 9) hM) le_rfl))
  · intro o ho
    exact HV o ho.1
  · intro o ho x hx hxq
    exact HG o ho.2 x hx (hxq.trans (profile_band_coverage hq hs hjl))
end NeutralAtom
end

OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.EuclideanTr.name: OAI.CoveringOrder.euclidean_lattice_upper
OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.EuclideanTr.text:
theorem euclidean_lattice_upper :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      ∀ K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), TranslativeCovering.ConvexBody K →
        ∃ (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (_ : DiscreteTopology L),
          IsZLattice ℝ L ∧ (∀ y, ∃ l : L, y - l.val ∈ K) ∧
            volume K / ENNReal.ofReal (ZLattice.covolume L volume) ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal (C * (n : ℝ) * Real.log n) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hupper⟩ := SingleLatticeCovering.single_lattice_covering
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro n hn K hK
  let e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin n → ℝ)).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hp : MeasurePreserving e volume volume := PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin n)
  have hc : IsCompact (e '' K) := hK.1.image e.continuous
  have hbody : SingleLatticeCovering.IsConvexBody (e '' K) := by
    refine ⟨hc, hK.2.1.linear_image e.toLinearMap, ?_⟩
    change (interior (e.toHomeomorph '' K)).Nonempty
    rw [← e.toHomeomorph.image_interior]
    exact hK.2.2.image e
  have hvol : volume (e '' K) = volume K := by
    have hm := hp.measure_preimage hc.measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet
    rw [Set.preimage_image_eq _ e.injective] at hm
    exact hm.symm
  obtain ⟨L, hd, hf, hcover, hbound⟩ := hupper n hn (e '' K) hbody
  let : DiscreteTopology L := hd
  let : IsZLattice ℝ L := hf
  let Λ := ZLattice.comap ℝ L e.toLinearMap
  have hcov : ZLattice.covolume Λ volume = ZLattice.covolume L volume :=
    ZLattice.covolume_comap L volume volume hp
  refine ⟨Λ, inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    have hy : e y ∈ e '' K + (L : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) := by
      rw [hcover]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨k, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, l, hl, heq⟩ := hy
    have hl' : e.symm l ∈ Λ := by
      change e (e.symm l) ∈ L
      rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hl
    refine ⟨⟨e.symm l, hl'⟩, ?_⟩
    have hxy : x + e.symm l = y := by
      apply e.injective
      simpa only [map_add, e.apply_symm_apply] using heq
    have hdiff : y - e.symm l = x := by rw [← hxy]; abel
    simpa only [hdiff] using hx
  · rw [hvol] at hbound
    have hpos : 0 < ZLattice.covolume L volume := ZLattice.covolume_pos L volume
    rw [hcov]
    calc
      volume K / ENNReal.ofReal (ZLattice.covolume L volume) =
          ENNReal.ofReal ((volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume L volume) := by
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos hpos, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hK.1.measure_ne_top]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (n : ℝ) * Real.log n) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound

end CoveringOrder

OAI.Geometry.TranslativeCovering.Main:11.name: OAI.SourceMain.main
OAI.Geometry.TranslativeCovering.Main:11.text:
theorem main : TranslativeCovering.MainStatement := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,n₁,hselect⟩ := BodySelection.uniform
  obtain ⟨n₂,hn₂⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp ((SourceScale.dimension hc).and LocalizationRates.dimension)
  refine ⟨c/2,by positivity,max n₁ n₂,?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hdim := hn₂ n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
  let : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  let : Fact (2≤n) := ⟨hdim.1.1⟩
  let e : SphericalLaw.Sphere n := ⟨(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) (0:Fin n),by
    simp only [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ).norm_eq_one _⟩
  let R := c*(n:ℝ)*Real.log n
  obtain ⟨U,hvol,hbad⟩ := hselect n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) e R hdim.1.2.1 le_rfl hdim.1.2.2
  let K := RandomBody.body (b n) 1 U
  have hb : 0<b n := by have ha := a_pos; dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hbody : ConvexBody K := RandomBody.body_isBody _ _ _ hb (by norm_num)
  have hKtop : volume K≠∞ := hbody.1.measure_ne_top
  have hK0 : volume K≠0 := ne_of_gt ((isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume hbody.2.2).trans_le (measure_mono interior_subset))
  have hP (P : PeriodicCover K) : ENNReal.ofReal R ≤ volume K*P.intensity := by
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hlt
    let := P.discrete
    let := P.fullrank
    let B := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ P.lattice
    let F := ZSpan.fundamentalDomain (B.ofZLatticeBasis ℝ)
    have hF : IsAddFundamentalDomain P.lattice F volume := ZLattice.isAddFundamentalDomain B volume
    have hF0 : volume F≠0 := ZSpan.measure_fundamentalDomain_ne_zero _
    have hFtop : volume F≠∞ := (ZSpan.fundamentalDomain_isBounded _).measure_lt_top.ne
    have hFvol : ENNReal.ofReal (ZLattice.covolume P.lattice volume)=volume F := by
      rw [ZLattice.covolume_eq_measure_fundamentalDomain _ _ hF,Measure.real,ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hFtop]
    have hdensity : volume K*((Fintype.card (Fin P.m):ℝ≥0∞)/volume F)≤ENNReal.ofReal R := by
      simpa only [PeriodicCover.intensity,Fintype.card_fin,hFvol] using hlt.le
    have hno := AllLatticeExclusion.no_cover hdim.1.2.1 hdim.1.2.2 hdim.2.1 hdim.2.2.1 hdim.2.2.2.1
      hdim.2.2.2.2.1 hdim.2.2.2.2.2.1 hdim.2.2.2.2.2.2 U hvol hbad P.lattice
      P.offsets hF hF0 hFtop hdensity
    exact hno P.covers
  have hlower : ENNReal.ofReal R≤thetaT K := by
    rw [periodization_exact hbody,thetaPer]
    exact le_iInf fun P => hP P.val
  refine ⟨K,hbody,RandomBody.body_symm _ _ _,?_⟩
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ hlower
  have hRpos : 0<R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hdim.1.2.1
  have hhalf : c/2*(n:ℝ)*Real.log n=R/2 := by dsimp [R]; ring
  rw [hhalf]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hRpos |>.mpr (by linarith only [hRpos])
end SourceMain

OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:50.name: OAI.CoveringOrder.thetaT_le_thetaL
OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:50.text:
theorem thetaT_le_thetaL {n : ℕ} {K : Set (Space n)}
    (hK : TranslativeCovering.ConvexBody K) :
    TranslativeCovering.thetaT K ≤ thetaL K := by
  rw [thetaL_eq_iInf_latticeCover, TranslativeCovering.periodization_exact hK,
    ← TranslativeCovering.listed_eq_distinct K]
  apply le_iInf
  intro P
  have h := iInf_le
    (fun Q : TranslativeCovering.PeriodicCover K => volume K * Q.intensity)
    P.toPeriodic
  simpa only [TranslativeCovering.thetaPerListed,
    TranslativeCovering.PeriodicCover.intensity, LatticeCover.toPeriodic,
    Nat.cast_one, one_div, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] using h

OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:30.name: OAI.CoveringOrder.thetaL_eq_iInf_latticeCover
OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:30.text:
theorem thetaL_eq_iInf_latticeCover {n : ℕ} (K : Set (Space n)) :
    thetaL K = ⨅ P : LatticeCover K,
      volume K / ENNReal.ofReal (ZLattice.covolume P.lattice volume) := by
  unfold thetaL
  exact iInf_congr latticeDensity_eq_volume_div_covolume

OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Model:85.name: OAI.CoveringOrder.symmetricTranslativeSup
OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Model:85.text:

OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:65.name: OAI.CoveringOrder.uniform_lattice_density_upper
OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:65.text:
theorem uniform_lattice_density_upper :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → ∀ K : Set (Space n),
      TranslativeCovering.ConvexBody K →
      thetaL K ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, h⟩ := euclidean_lattice_upper
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro n hn K hK
  obtain ⟨L, hd, hf, hc, hb⟩ := h n hn K hK
  let P : LatticeCover K := ⟨L, hd, hf, hc⟩
  rw [thetaL_eq_iInf_latticeCover]
  exact (iInf_le (fun Q : LatticeCover K =>
    volume K / ENNReal.ofReal (ZLattice.covolume Q.lattice volume)) P).trans hb

OAI.Geometry.TranslativeCovering.Periodi.name: OAI.TranslativeCovering.PeriodicCover.intensity
OAI.Geometry.TranslativeCovering.Periodi.text:
noncomputable def PeriodicCover.intensity {n : ℕ} {K : Set (Space n)} (P : PeriodicCover K) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  (P.m:ℝ≥0∞)/ENNReal.ofReal (ZLattice.covolume P.lattice volume)

OAI.Geometry.TranslativeCovering.Distinc.name: OAI.TranslativeCovering.listed_eq_distinct
OAI.Geometry.TranslativeCovering.Distinc.text:
lemma listed_eq_distinct {n : ℕ} (K : Set (Space n)) : thetaPerListed K=thetaPer K := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_iInf
    intro P
    exact iInf_le (fun Q : PeriodicCover K => volume K*Q.intensity) P.val
  · apply le_iInf
    intro P
    obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hQP⟩ := P.remove_repeats
    exact (iInf_le (fun Q : {P : PeriodicCover K // P.Distinct} => volume K*Q.val.intensity) ⟨Q,hQ⟩).trans
      (mul_le_mul le_rfl hQP bot_le bot_le)

OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:79.name: OAI.CoveringOrder.optimal_order
OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:79.text:
theorem optimal_order : OptimalOrder := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, n₀, hlower⟩ := TranslativeCovering.main
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hupper⟩ := uniform_lattice_density_upper
  refine ⟨c, C, hc, hC, max n₀ 2, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hn₀ : n₀ ≤ n := (le_max_left _ _).trans hn
  have hn₂ : 2 ≤ n := (le_max_right _ _).trans hn
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hsym, hlow⟩ := hlower n hn₀
  let B : Body n := ⟨K, hK⟩
  let S : SymmetricBody n := ⟨B, hsym⟩
  have t_upper (A : Body n) :
      TranslativeCovering.thetaT A.val ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ)) :=
    (thetaT_le_thetaL A.property).trans (hupper n hn₂ A.val A.property)
  have l_upper (A : Body n) :
      thetaL A.val ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ)) :=
    hupper n hn₂ A.val A.property
  have tl : ENNReal.ofReal (c * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ)) ≤
      TranslativeCovering.thetaT K := hlow.le
  have ll : ENNReal.ofReal (c * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ)) ≤ thetaL K :=
    tl.trans (thetaT_le_thetaL hK)
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact tl.trans (le_iSup (fun A : Body n => TranslativeCovering.thetaT A.val) B)
  · exact iSup_le t_upper
  · exact tl.trans (le_iSup
      (fun A : SymmetricBody n => TranslativeCovering.thetaT A.val.val) S)
  · exact iSup_le (fun A : SymmetricBody n => t_upper A.val)
  · exact ll.trans (le_iSup (fun A : Body n => thetaL A.val) B)
  · exact iSup_le l_upper
  · exact ll.trans (le_iSup (fun A : SymmetricBody n => thetaL A.val.val) S)
  · exact iSup_le (fun A : SymmetricBody n => l_upper A.val)

end CoveringOrder

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:37.name: OAI.CoveringOrder.LatticeCover.toPeriodic
OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Main:37.text:
def LatticeCover.toPeriodic {n : ℕ} {K : Set (Space n)} (P : LatticeCover K) :
    TranslativeCovering.PeriodicCover K where
  lattice := P.lattice

  fullrank := P.fullrank

OAI.Geometry.CoveringDensity.Model:64.name: OAI.TranslativeCovering.upperCenterIntensity

OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Grap.name: OAI.CriticalPercolation.GraphTopology.quotient_sparse_polynomial_word_growth
OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Grap.text:
theorem quotient_sparse_polynomial_word_growth
    [TopologicalSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X]
    (hc : Γ.Connected) (hl : ∀ x, (Γ.neighborSet x).Finite)
    (ht : ∀ u v, ∃ g : Γ ≃g Γ, g u=v) (o : X) (d : ℕ)
    (hpoly : ∀ R : ℕ, ∃ n≥R, (reachBall Γ o n).ncard≤n^d)
    (H : Subgroup (Γ ≃g Γ)) [H.Normal]
    (ho : @IsOpen (Γ ≃g Γ) (autTopology Γ) (H : Set (Γ ≃g Γ))) :
    CompactQuotient.HasSparsePolynomialWordGrowth ((Γ ≃g Γ) ⧸ H) := by
  obtain ⟨M,_,hT,h1,hinv,hgen,hncard⟩ :=
    quotient_powers_ncard_le Γ hc hl ht o H ho
  refine ⟨(QuotientGroup.mk' H) '' displacement Γ o 1,hT,h1,hinv,hgen,d+1,?_⟩
  intro R
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hp⟩ := hpoly (max R (max M 1))
  have hnR : R≤n := (le_max_left _ _).trans hn
  have hnM : M≤n := (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hn)
  have hn1 : 1≤n := (le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hn)
  refine ⟨n,hnR,?_⟩
  calc
    (((QuotientGroup.mk' H) '' displacement Γ o 1)^n).ncard ≤
        (reachBall Γ o n).ncard*M := hncard n hn1
    _ ≤ n^d*M := Nat.mul_le_mul_right M hp
    _ ≤ n^d*n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hnM
    _ = n^(d+1) := (pow_succ n d).symm

OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Grap.name: OAI.CriticalPercolation.GraphTopology.autTopology
OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Grap.text:
@[instance_reducible] def autTopology : TopologicalSpace (Γ ≃g Γ) :=
  TopologicalSpace.induced (coordinates Γ) inferInstance

local instance : TopologicalSpace (Γ ≃g Γ) := autTopology Γ

omit [DiscreteTopology X] in

OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Clas.name: OAI.CriticalPercolation.GraphTopology.compact_open_virtually_nilpotent_quotient_of_sparse_polynomial
OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Clas.text:
theorem compact_open_virtually_nilpotent_quotient_of_sparse_polynomial
    (hc : Γ.Connected) (hl : ∀ x, (Γ.neighborSet x).Finite)
    (ht : ∀ u v, ∃ g : Γ ≃g Γ, g u=v) (o : X) (d : ℕ)
    (hpoly : ∀ R : ℕ, ∃ n≥R, (reachBall Γ o n).ncard≤n^d) :
    HasCompactOpenVirtuallyNilpotentQuotient Γ := by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace X := ⊥
  let _ : DiscreteTopology X := ⟨rfl⟩
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (Γ ≃g Γ) := autTopology Γ
  obtain ⟨H,hHn,hcH,hoH⟩ := compact_open_normal_of_sparse_polynomial Γ hc hl ht o d hpoly
  let := hHn
  have hg := quotient_sparse_polynomial_word_growth Γ hc hl ht o d hpoly H hoH
  obtain ⟨N,hNn,hNi⟩ := CompactQuotient.virtuallyNilpotent_of_sparse_word_growth hg
  exact ⟨H,hHn,hcH,hoH,N,hNn,hNi.index_ne_zero⟩

end CriticalPercolation.GraphTopology
end
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Grap.name: OAI.CriticalPercolation.GraphTopology.HasCompactOpenVirtuallyNilpotentQuotient
OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Grap.text:
def HasCompactOpenVirtuallyNilpotentQuotient : Prop :=
  let _ : TopologicalSpace X := ⊥
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (Γ ≃g Γ) := autTopology Γ
  ∃ H : Subgroup (Γ ≃g Γ), ∃ hn : H.Normal,
    let _ := hn
    IsCompact (H : Set (Γ ≃g Γ)) ∧ IsOpen (H : Set (Γ ≃g Γ)) ∧
      ∃ N : Subgroup ((Γ ≃g Γ) ⧸ H), Group.IsNilpotent N ∧ N.index≠0

OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Grap.name: OAI.CriticalPercolation.GraphTopology.reachBall
OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Grap.text:
def reachBall (o : X) (r : ℕ) : Set X :=
  {x | ∃ p : Γ.Walk o x, p.length≤r}

OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Main.name: OAI.CriticalPercolation.BondGraph.no_percolation_at_criticality
OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Main.text:
theorem no_percolation_at_criticality [Infinite V]
    (hconnected : G.fullGraph.Connected)
    (hlocal : G.LocallyFinite)
    (hquasi : G.QuasiTransitive)
    (hpc : G.criticalProbability < 1) :
    G.law G.criticalProbability G.percolates = 0 := by
  by_contra hper
  obtain ⟨o⟩ := hconnected.nonempty
  obtain ⟨d,hd,C,hconn,hinf,hloc,htrans,hscales,happrox,hnot⟩ :=
    G.main_failure_topological_classification_counterexample
      hconnected hlocal hquasi hpc hper o
  let u : MulAction.orbit G.Aut o := ⟨o,MulAction.mem_orbit_self o⟩
  apply hnot
  exact GraphTopology.compact_open_virtually_nilpotent_quotient_of_sparse_polynomial
    (G.orbitPower o (2*C+1)) hconn hloc htrans u (d+1) (fun R => by
      obtain ⟨n,hn,hp⟩ := hscales R
      exact ⟨n,hn,hp u⟩)

end CriticalPercolation.BondGraph

end
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Clas.name: OAI.CriticalPercolation.GraphTopology.compact_open_normal_of_sparse_polynomial
OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Clas.text:
theorem compact_open_normal_of_sparse_polynomial
    [TopologicalSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X]
    (hc : Γ.Connected) (hl : ∀ x, (Γ.neighborSet x).Finite)
    (ht : ∀ u v, ∃ g : Γ ≃g Γ, g u=v) (o : X) (d : ℕ)
    (hpoly : ∀ R : ℕ, ∃ n≥R, (reachBall Γ o n).ncard≤n^d) :
    let _ : TopologicalSpace (Γ ≃g Γ) := autTopology Γ
    ∃ H : Subgroup (Γ ≃g Γ), H.Normal ∧ IsCompact (H:Set (Γ ≃g Γ)) ∧ IsOpen (H:Set (Γ ≃g Γ)) := by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (Γ ≃g Γ) := autTopology Γ
  let K := vertexStabilizer Γ o
  let S := displacement Γ o 1
  have h1 : (1:Γ ≃g Γ)∈S := one_mem_displacement Γ o 1
  have hi : S⁻¹=S := by ext g; exact displacement_inv Γ
  have hgen : Subgroup.closure S=⊤ := displacement_generates Γ hc ht o
  obtain ⟨N,hNn,hNb,hNi⟩ := RelativeGrowth.bounded_normal_commensurable d
    (Γ ≃g Γ) K S h1 hi hgen (vertexStabilizer_bounded Γ o) (displacement_relativeDegree Γ hl o d hpoly)
  let := hNn
  let H := N.topologicalClosure
  have hHn : H.Normal := Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure N
  have hcH : IsCompact (H:Set (Γ ≃g Γ)) := by
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := hNb
    have hNs : (N:Set (Γ ≃g Γ))⊆displacement Γ o n := hn.trans (displacement_pow_subset Γ o n)
    apply (compact_displacement Γ hc hl o n).of_isClosed_subset N.isClosed_topologicalClosure
    exact closure_minimal hNs (isClosed_eval_mem Γ o _)
  have hoH : IsOpen (H:Set (Γ ≃g Γ)) :=
    RelativeGrowth.topologicalClosure_open_of_relIndex K N (open_stabilizer Γ o) hNi
  exact ⟨H,hHn,hcH,hoH⟩

OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Clas.name: OAI.CriticalPercolation.CompactQuotient.virtuallyNilpotent_of_sparse_word_growth
OAI.Probability.CriticalPercolation.Clas.text:
lemma virtuallyNilpotent_of_sparse_word_growth {A : Type*} [Group A]
    (hg : HasSparsePolynomialWordGrowth A) : Group.IsVirtuallyNilpotent A := by
  obtain ⟨S,hSf,h1,hi,hgen,d,hg⟩ := hg
  exact SparseGrowth.sparse_polynomial_virtuallyNilpotent d A
    ⟨S,hSf,h1,hi,hgen,1,by simpa only [one_mul] using hg⟩
end CriticalPercolation.CompactQuotient

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.variance
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def variance {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  mean W (fun x => (f x - mean W f) ^ 2)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratio_continuous
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
lemma linear_ratio_continuous (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a)) :=
  (variance_linear_continuous a).div (dirichlet_linear_continuous a) (fun W => (dirichlet_linear_pos W ha).ne')

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_continuous
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.text:
lemma covariance_continuous (n : ℕ) : Continuous (covariance (n := n)) := by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  apply continuous_pi
  intro j
  simp only [covariance_eq,mean]
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro x _
  exact (gibbs_continuous x).mul continuous_const

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def covariance {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  fun i j => mean W (fun x =>
    (spinValue (x i) - mean W (fun y => spinValue (y i))) *
    (spinValue (x j) - mean W (fun y => spinValue (y j))))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousGoodMass
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def continuousGoodMass {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x : Spin n, if 1 / 4 < continuousDistance W t x then gibbs W x else 0

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuous_bad_subset
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.text:
lemma continuous_bad_subset {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    {a δ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (_hδ : 0 < δ) (hinc : 2*t/a^2 < δ/8) :
    {W : Disorder n | δ ≤ |continuousGoodMass W t-1|} ⊆ smallBallObstruction n a (δ/8) := by
  intro W hW u hu
  have hb := continuous_good_mass_bound W hn t ht u a ha
  change 1-continuousGoodMass W t ≤ 4*(linearSmallBall W u a+(2*t*∑ i, (u i)^2)/a^2) at hb
  rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq,hu,one_pow,mul_one] at hb
  have he : |continuousGoodMass W t-1| = 1-continuousGoodMass W t := by
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (continuousGoodMass_le_one W t))]
    ring
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq,he] at hW
  linarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteGoodMass_le_one
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.text:
lemma discreteGoodMass_le_one {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) (k : ℕ) : discreteGoodMass W k ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← gibbs_sum W]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro x _
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact gibbs_nonneg W x

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousMixingTime_lower
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.text:
lemma continuousMixingTime_lower (hn : 0 < n) {t : ℝ} (h : 0 < continuousGoodMass W t) :
    t ≤ continuousMixingTime W := by
  apply le_csInf (continuous_mixing_set_nonempty W hn)
  intro s hs
  by_contra hst
  have hzero : continuousGoodMass W t = 0 := by
    unfold continuousGoodMass
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x _
    have hx := (continuousDistance_antitone W hn hs.1 (le_of_not_ge hst) x).trans (hs.2 x)
    rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hx)]
  linarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearObservable
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def linearObservable {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, a i * spinValue (x i)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.disorderLaw
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def disorderLaw (n : ℕ) : Measure (Disorder n) :=
  Measure.pi fun _ : Edge n => gaussianReal 0 (n : ℝ≥0)⁻¹

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_upper_tight
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.text:
lemma covariance_upper_tight {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
      {W | C*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) ≤ covarianceNorm W} < α := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hp⟩ := natural_GibbsOverlap_tight hα
  refine ⟨K+1,by positivity,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hp] with n hn
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (measureReal_mono ?_) hn
  intro W hW
  let S := (n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)
  have hS : 0 < S := by dsimp [S]; positivity
  change K/S ≤ gibbsOverlap W
  change (K+1)*S ≤ covarianceNorm W at hW
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (show 0 ≤ (K+1)*S by positivity) hW 2
  have hN := covarianceNorm_sq_le_overlap (by omega : 0 < n+4) W
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hN
  rw [← two_thirds_cube (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ n+4)] at hN
  change covarianceNorm W^2 ≤ S^3*gibbsOverlap W at hN
  have hmul : (K+1)^2*S^2 ≤ (S*gibbsOverlap W)*S^2 := by
    calc
      _ = ((K+1)*S)^2 := by ring
      _ ≤ covarianceNorm W^2 := hsq
      _ ≤ S^3*gibbsOverlap W := hN
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hc := le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul (sq_pos_of_pos hS)
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hS).mpr
  nlinarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.Disorder
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text: abbrev Disorder (n : ℕ) := Edge n → ℝ

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_lower_tight
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
lemma linearRayleigh_lower_tight {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
      {W | linearRayleigh W ≤ c*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)} < α := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hp⟩ := natural_smallBall_tight (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2) hα
  refine ⟨b^2/2,by positivity,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hp] with n hn
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (measureReal_mono ?_) hn
  intro W hW u hu
  have husq : ∑ i, u i^2 = 1 := by
    rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq u,hu,one_pow]
  have hV := linearRayleigh_smallBall W (fun i => u i) husq (show 0 ≤ b*(n+4:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ) by positivity)
  rw [mul_pow,third_power_square (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ n+4)] at hV
  change linearRayleigh W ≤ b^2/2*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) at hW
  have hP : 0 < b^2*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) := by positivity
  nlinarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteMixingTime_lower
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.text:
lemma discreteMixingTime_lower (hn : 0 < n) {k : ℕ} (h : 0 < discreteGoodMass W k) :
    k ≤ discreteMixingTime W := by
  have hs := Nat.sInf_mem (discrete_mixing_set_nonempty W hn)
  by_contra hk
  have hzero : discreteGoodMass W k = 0 := by
    unfold discreteGoodMass
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x _
    have hx := (discreteDistance_antitone W hn (le_of_not_ge hk) x).trans (hs x)
    rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hx)]
  linarith

end MixingLower

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_natural_scale
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.text:
theorem covariance_natural_scale (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hMpos : ∀ n, 0 < M n) (hM : Tendsto M atTop atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n).real {W |
      (n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)/M n ≤ covarianceNorm W ∧ covarianceNorm W ≤ M n*(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)}) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 4).mp
  have hh := tight_interval_limit (fun n => disorderLaw (n+4)) (fun _ W => covarianceNorm W)
    (fun n => (covarianceNorm_continuous (n+4)).measurable)
    (fun n => (n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)) (fun _ => by positivity)
    (fun _ hα => covariance_lower_tight hα) (fun _ hα => covariance_upper_tight hα)
    (fun n => M (n+4)) (fun n => hMpos (n+4)) (hM.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 4))
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh

end CriticalSK

end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_natural_scale
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
theorem linearRayleigh_natural_scale (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hMpos : ∀ n, 0 < M n) (hM : Tendsto M atTop atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n).real {W |
      (n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)/M n ≤ linearRayleigh W ∧ linearRayleigh W ≤ M n*(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)}) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 4).mp
  have hh := tight_interval_limit (fun n => disorderLaw (n+4)) (fun _ W => linearRayleigh W)
    (fun n => linearRayleigh_measurable (n+4))
    (fun n => (n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)) (fun _ => by positivity)
    (fun _ hα => linearRayleigh_lower_tight hα) (fun _ hα => linearRayleigh_upper_tight hα)
    (fun n => M (n+4)) (fun n => hMpos (n+4)) (hM.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 4))
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.covarianceNorm
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def covarianceNorm {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) : ℝ :=
  ‖(covariance W).toEuclideanLin.toContinuousLinearMap‖

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_lower_tight
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.text:
lemma covariance_lower_tight {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
      {W | covarianceNorm W ≤ c*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)} < α := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hp⟩ := natural_smallBall_tight (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2) hα
  refine ⟨b^2/2,by positivity,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hp] with n hn
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (measureReal_mono ?_) hn
  intro W hW u hu
  have hN := variance_linear_le_norm W u
  rw [hu,one_pow,mul_one] at hN
  have hV := variance_linear_smallBall W u (show 0 ≤ b*(n+4:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ) by positivity)
  rw [mul_pow,third_power_square (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ n+4)] at hV
  change covarianceNorm W ≤ b^2/2*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) at hW
  have hP : 0 < b^2*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) := by positivity
  nlinarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.name: OAI.CriticalSK.discrete_bad_subset
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.text:
lemma discrete_bad_subset {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ)
    {a δ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (_hδ : 0 < δ) (hinc : ((2*k:ℝ)/n)/a^2 < δ/8) :
    {W : Disorder n | δ ≤ |discreteGoodMass W k-1|} ⊆ smallBallObstruction n a (δ/8) := by
  intro W hW u hu
  have hb := discrete_good_mass_bound W hn k u a ha
  change 1-discreteGoodMass W k ≤ 4*(linearSmallBall W u a+((2*k:ℝ)/n*∑ i, (u i)^2)/a^2) at hb
  rw [← EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq,hu,one_pow,mul_one] at hb
  have he : |discreteGoodMass W k-1| = 1-discreteGoodMass W k := by
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (discreteGoodMass_le_one W k))]
    ring
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq,he] at hW
  linarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Power.name: OAI.CriticalSK.third_power_square
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Power.text:
lemma third_power_square {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : (x^(1/3:ℝ))^2 = x^(2/3:ℝ) := by
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hx]
  norm_num

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousMixingTime
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def continuousMixingTime {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) : ℝ :=
  sInf {t : ℝ | 0 ≤ t ∧ ∀ x, continuousDistance W t x ≤ 1 / 4}

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousDistance
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def continuousDistance {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) (t : ℝ) (x : Spin n) : ℝ :=
  totalVariation W (continuousKernel W t x)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.name: OAI.CriticalSK.realized_continuous_initial_states
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.text:
lemma realized_continuous_initial_states (t : ℕ → ℝ) (ht : ∀ n, 0 ≤ t n)
    (hscale : Tendsto (fun n => t n/(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n).real {W | δ ≤ |continuousGoodMass W (t n)-1|}) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 4).mp
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => lt_of_lt_of_le ha measureReal_nonneg)
  · intro α hα
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hprob⟩ := natural_smallBall_tight (show 0 < δ/8 by positivity) hα
    have hinc : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2*t (n+4)/(b*(n+4:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ))^2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hh := (hscale.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 4)).const_mul (2/b^2)
      convert hh using 1
      · ext n
        simp only [Function.comp_def,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat,mul_pow,third_power_square (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ n+4)]
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_inv_rev]
        ring
      · ring_nf
    filter_upwards [hprob,hinc.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show 0 < δ/8 by positivity))] with n hn hi
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (measureReal_mono (continuous_bad_subset (by omega : 0 < n+4)
      (t (n+4)) (ht _) (by positivity) hδ hi)) hn

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.name: OAI.CriticalSK.realized_equilibrium_initial_states
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.text:
theorem realized_equilibrium_initial_states :
    (∀ t : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 ≤ t n) →
      Tendsto (fun n => t n / (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3)) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
        Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n {W |
          δ ≤ |continuousGoodMass W (t n) - 1|}).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ → ℕ,
      Tendsto (fun n => (k n : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ ((5 : ℝ) / 3)) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
        Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n {W |
          δ ≤ |discreteGoodMass W (k n) - 1|}).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0)) := by
  exact ⟨realized_continuous_initial_states,realized_discrete_initial_states⟩

end CriticalSK

end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.name: OAI.CriticalSK.realized_discrete_initial_states
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.text:
lemma realized_discrete_initial_states (k : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hscale : Tendsto (fun n => (k n:ℝ)/(n:ℝ)^(5/3:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n).real {W | δ ≤ |discreteGoodMass W (k n)-1|}) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 4).mp
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => lt_of_lt_of_le ha measureReal_nonneg)
  · intro α hα
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hprob⟩ := natural_smallBall_tight (show 0 < δ/8 by positivity) hα
    have hinc : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((2*k (n+4):ℝ)/(n+4:ℝ))/(b*(n+4:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ))^2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hh := (hscale.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 4)).const_mul (2/b^2)
      convert hh using 1
      · ext n
        simp only [Function.comp_def,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat,mul_pow,
          third_power_square (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ n+4), fifth_third_power (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < n+4)]
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_inv_rev]
        ring
      · ring_nf
    filter_upwards [hprob,hinc.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show 0 < δ/8 by positivity))] with n hn hi
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (measureReal_mono (discrete_bad_subset (by omega : 0 < n+4)
      (k (n+4)) (by positivity) hδ (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hi))) hn

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Power.name: OAI.CriticalSK.fifth_third_power
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Power.text:
lemma fifth_third_power {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : x^(5/3:ℝ) = x*x^(2/3:ℝ) := by
  rw [show (5/3:ℝ) = 1+2/3 by ring,Real.rpow_add hx,Real.rpow_one]

open Set Filter MeasureTheory

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_eq_iSup
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
lemma linearRayleigh_eq_iSup (W : Disorder n) : linearRayleigh W =
    ⨆ a : {a : Fin n → ℝ // a ≠ 0}, variance W (linearObservable a.val)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a.val) := by
  change sSup _ = sSup _
  congr 1
  ext r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a,ha⟩,rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a.val,a.property,rfl⟩

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_and_linear_tests
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
theorem covariance_and_linear_tests (M : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hMpos : ∀ n, 0 < M n) (hM : Tendsto M atTop atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw n {W |
      (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) / M n ≤ covarianceNorm W ∧
      covarianceNorm W ≤ M n * (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ∧
      (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) / M n ≤ linearRayleigh W ∧
      linearRayleigh W ≤ M n * (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3)}).toReal) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hh := probability_intersection_tendsto_one disorderLaw
    (fun n => {W | (n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)/M n ≤ covarianceNorm W ∧ covarianceNorm W ≤ M n*(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)})
    (fun n => {W | (n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)/M n ≤ linearRayleigh W ∧ linearRayleigh W ≤ M n*(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)})
    (fun n => (measurableSet_le measurable_const (covarianceNorm_continuous n).measurable).inter (measurableSet_le (covarianceNorm_continuous n).measurable measurable_const))
    (fun n => (measurableSet_le measurable_const (linearRayleigh_measurable n)).inter (measurableSet_le (linearRayleigh_measurable n) measurable_const))
    (covariance_natural_scale M hMpos hM) (linearRayleigh_natural_scale M hMpos hM)
  simpa only [Set.inter_def,Set.mem_ofPred_eq,and_assoc,Measure.real] using hh

end CriticalSK

end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.name: OAI.CriticalSK.critical_mixing_lower_bounds
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.text:
theorem critical_mixing_lower_bounds (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n).real {W | (n:ℝ)^(2/3-ε) ≤ continuousMixingTime W}) atTop (𝓝 1) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n).real {W | (n:ℝ)^(5/3-ε) ≤ (discreteMixingTime W:ℝ)}) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  constructor
  · exact continuousMixingTime_lower_limit (fun n => (n:ℝ)^(2/3-ε)) (fun _ => by positivity) (rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero hε)
  · have hh := discreteMixingTime_lower_limit (fun n => ⌈(n:ℝ)^(5/3-ε)⌉₊)
      (ceil_rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 5/3) hε)
    apply tendsto_order.mpr
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp hh).1 a ha] with n hn
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hn (measureReal_mono ?_)
      intro W hW
      exact (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hW)
    · intro a ha
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => lt_of_le_of_lt measureReal_le_one ha)

end CriticalSK

end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.name: OAI.CriticalSK.covarianceNorm_continuous
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.text:
lemma covarianceNorm_continuous (n : ℕ) : Continuous (covarianceNorm (n := n)) := by
  unfold covarianceNorm
  have h : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => (covariance W).toEuclideanLin.toContinuousLinearMap) := by
    exact (LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℝ)).toAlgEquiv.toLinearMap).comp (covariance_continuous n)
  exact h.norm

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.name: OAI.CriticalSK.event_probability_one_of_error_zero
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.text:
lemma event_probability_one_of_error_zero {X : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (X n)]
    (μ : ∀ n, Measure (X n)) [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (E B : ∀ n, Set (X n)) (hcover : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, E n ∪ B n = univ)
    (hB : Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (B n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (E n)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    filter_upwards [hcover,hB.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show 0 < 1-a by linarith))] with n hn hnb
    have hh := measureReal_union_le (μ := μ n) (E n) (B n)
    rw [hn,probReal_univ] at hh
    linarith
  · intro a ha
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => lt_of_le_of_lt measureReal_le_one ha)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Power.name: OAI.CriticalSK.ceil_rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Power.text:
lemma ceil_rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero {a ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (⌈(n:ℝ)^(a-ε)⌉₊:ℝ)/(n:ℝ)^a) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have he := (rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero (a := a) hε).add
    (((tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop ha).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop))
  rw [zero_add] at he
  apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => by positivity)) _ he
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
  have hc := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ (n:ℝ)^(a-ε) by positivity)).le
  have hp : 0 < (n:ℝ)^a := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn) a
  calc
    _ ≤ ((n:ℝ)^(a-ε)+1)/(n:ℝ)^a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hc hp.le
    _ = _ := by simp only [Function.comp_def]; rw [add_div,one_div,Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]

end CriticalSK

end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Cavit.name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityNormalization
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Cavit.text:
def cavityNormalization (W : Disorder n) (i : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  mean (deleteDisorder W i) (fun x => Real.cosh (localField W i x))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteDistance
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def discreteDistance {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) (k : ℕ) (x : Spin n) : ℝ :=
  totalVariation W ((discreteKernel W ^ k) x)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def dirichlet {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, mean W (fun x => (f x - ∑ y : Spin n, siteKernel W i x y * f y) ^ 2)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteMixingTime_lower_limit
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.text:
lemma discreteMixingTime_lower_limit (k : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hscale : Tendsto (fun n => (k n:ℝ)/(n:ℝ)^(5/3:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n).real {W | k n ≤ discreteMixingTime W}) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply event_probability_one_of_error_zero (μ := disorderLaw)
    (B := fun n => {W | (1:ℝ) ≤ |discreteGoodMass W (k n)-1|})
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro W
    by_cases hW : 0 < discreteGoodMass W (k n)
    · exact Or.inl (discreteMixingTime_lower W hn hW)
    · exact Or.inr (by change (1:ℝ) ≤ |discreteGoodMass W (k n)-1|; rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [discreteGoodMass_le_one W (k n)])]; linarith)
  · exact realized_discrete_initial_states k hscale 1 zero_lt_one

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Power.name: OAI.CriticalSK.rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Power.text:
lemma rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero {a ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)^(a-ε)/(n:ℝ)^a) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hh := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hε).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  apply hh.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
  simp only [Function.comp_def]
  rw [← Real.rpow_sub (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn)]
  congr 1
  ring

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteGoodMass

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.name: OAI.CriticalSK.tight_interval_limit
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Covar.text:
lemma tight_interval_limit {X : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (X n)]
    (μ : ∀ n, Measure (X n)) [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (f : ∀ n, X n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n))
    (s : ℕ → ℝ) (hs : ∀ n, 0 < s n)
    (hlower : ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (μ n).real {x | f n x ≤ c*s n} < α)
    (hupper : ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (μ n).real {x | C*s n ≤ f n x} < α)
    (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hMpos : ∀ n, 0 < M n) (hM : Tendsto M atTop atTop) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real {x | s n/M n ≤ f n x ∧ f n x ≤ M n*s n}) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨c,hc,hl⟩ := hlower ((1-a)/2) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨C,hC,hu⟩ := hupper ((1-a)/2) (by linarith)
    filter_upwards [hl,hu,(tendsto_atTop.mp hM (1/c)),(tendsto_atTop.mp hM C)] with n hnlo hnup hnM hnC
    let E : Set (X n) := {x | s n/M n ≤ f n x ∧ f n x ≤ M n*s n}
    have hE : MeasurableSet E := (measurableSet_le measurable_const (hf n)).inter
      (measurableSet_le (hf n) measurable_const)
    have hlow : s n/M n ≤ c*s n := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (hMpos n)).mpr
      have hh : 1 ≤ M n*c := (div_le_iff₀ hc).mp hnM
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (hs n).le]
    have hset : Eᶜ ⊆ {x | f n x ≤ c*s n} ∪ {x | C*s n ≤ f n x} := by
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxl : s n/M n ≤ f n x
      · right
        have hxu : M n*s n < f n x := by
          apply lt_of_not_ge
          intro hh
          exact hx ⟨hxl,hh⟩
        exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnC (hs n).le).trans hxu.le
      · left
        exact (lt_of_not_ge hxl).le.trans hlow
    have hbad := (measureReal_mono (μ := μ n) hset).trans (measureReal_union_le _ _)
    have hadd := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl (μ := μ n) hE
    rw [probReal_univ] at hadd
    change a < (μ n).real E
    linarith
  · intro a ha
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => lt_of_le_of_lt measureReal_le_one ha)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratio_global_bound
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
lemma linear_ratio_global_bound (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a) ≤
      covarianceNorm W*(∑ i : Fin n, cavityNormalization W i)^2 := by
  let B := ∑ i : Fin n, cavityNormalization W i
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by linarith [cavityNormalization_ge_one W i]
  have hZ (i : Fin n) (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) : cavityNormalization W i ≤ B :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => by linarith [cavityNormalization_ge_one W j]) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hd := linear_dirichlet_coeff_bound W Finset.univ a hB hZ
  have hV := variance_linear_norm_bound W a
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (dirichlet_linear_pos W ha)).mpr
  have hN : 0 ≤ covarianceNorm W := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hN]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_measurable
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
lemma linearRayleigh_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (linearRayleigh (n := n)) := by
  have hh : LowerSemicontinuous (linearRayleigh (n := n)) := by
    change LowerSemicontinuous (fun W : Disorder n => linearRayleigh W)
    simp_rw [linearRayleigh_eq_iSup]
    apply lowerSemicontinuous_ciSup
    · intro W
      refine ⟨covarianceNorm W*(∑ i : Fin n, cavityNormalization W i)^2,?_⟩
      rintro r ⟨a,rfl⟩
      exact linear_ratio_global_bound W a.val a.property
    · intro a
      exact (linear_ratio_continuous a.val a.property).lowerSemicontinuous
  exact hh.measurable

end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousMixingTime_lower_limit
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Mixin.text:
lemma continuousMixingTime_lower_limit (t : ℕ → ℝ) (ht : ∀ n, 0 ≤ t n)
    (hscale : Tendsto (fun n => t n/(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (disorderLaw n).real {W | t n ≤ continuousMixingTime W}) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply event_probability_one_of_error_zero (μ := disorderLaw)
    (B := fun n => {W | (1:ℝ) ≤ |continuousGoodMass W (t n)-1|})
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro W
    by_cases hW : 0 < continuousGoodMass W (t n)
    · exact Or.inl (continuousMixingTime_lower W hn hW)
    · exact Or.inr (by change (1:ℝ) ≤ |continuousGoodMass W (t n)-1|; rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [continuousGoodMass_le_one W (t n)])]; linarith)
  · exact realized_continuous_initial_states t ht hscale 1 zero_lt_one

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.name: OAI.CriticalSK.discreteMixingTime
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.SpinM.text:
def discreteMixingTime {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) : ℕ :=
  sInf {k : ℕ | ∀ x, discreteDistance W k x ≤ 1 / 4}

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuousGoodMass_le_one
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Equil.text:
lemma continuousGoodMass_le_one {n : ℕ} (W : Disorder n) (t : ℝ) : continuousGoodMass W t ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← gibbs_sum W]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro x _
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact gibbs_nonneg W x

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_upper_tight
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
lemma linearRayleigh_upper_tight {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
      {W | C*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) ≤ linearRayleigh W} < α := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hp⟩ := covariance_upper_tight (show 0<α/2 by positivity)
  let C := 2*(Real.exp 1+1)^2*K+3
  refine ⟨C,by dsimp [C]; positivity,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hp,linearRayleigh_cavity_comparison (α/2) (by positivity)] with n hn hc
  have hs : {W : Disorder (n+4) | C*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) ≤ linearRayleigh W} ⊆
      {W | K*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) ≤ covarianceNorm W} ∪
      {W | 2*(Real.exp 1+1)^2*covarianceNorm W+2*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) < linearRayleigh W} := by
    intro W hW
    by_cases hh : K*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) ≤ covarianceNorm W
    · exact Or.inl hh
    · right
      change C*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) ≤ linearRayleigh W at hW
      have hN := lt_of_not_ge hh
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hN (show 0<2*(Real.exp 1+1)^2 by positivity)
      dsimp only [C] at hW
      have hpN : 0<(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) := by positivity
      change 2*(Real.exp 1+1)^2*covarianceNorm W+2*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) < linearRayleigh W
      nlinarith
  have hb := (measureReal_mono (μ := disorderLaw (n+4)) hs).trans (measureReal_union_le _ _)
  linarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Small.name: OAI.CriticalSK.natural_smallBall_tight
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Small.text:
lemma natural_smallBall_tight {δ α : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ b : ℝ, 0 < b ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
      (smallBallObstruction (n+4) (b*(n+4:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)) δ) < α := by
  obtain ⟨h,hh,hfail⟩ := exists_spectral_failure_parameter (show 0 < α/4 by positivity)
  obtain ⟨L,hL,hcost⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop (262144:ℝ)).and
    ((edgeFixedCost_tendsto h).eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/100)))).exists
  have hLp : 0 < L := by linarith
  let C := naturalSmallBallConstant L
  have hC : 0 < C := naturalSmallBallConstant_pos hLp
  let b := α*δ/(16*C)
  let ε := α*δ/32
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  refine ⟨b,hb,?_⟩
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => naturalOrientationTail (n+3) L) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hs := (naturalOrientationTail_scaled_tendsto hLp 0).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 3)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,Real.rpow_zero,one_mul] using hs
  filter_upwards [natural_smallBallObstruction_probability hh hL hcost hε hb.le hδ,
    ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with n hn htail
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt hn
  have hbc : 2*C*b = α*δ/8 := by dsimp only [b]; field_simp; ring
  change 32*Real.exp (-h^2)+(2*C*b+4*(ε+naturalOrientationTail (n+3) L))/δ < α
  rw [hbc]
  have hfrac : (α*δ/8+4*(ε+naturalOrientationTail (n+3) L))/δ < 3*α/4 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mpr
    dsimp only [ε] at htail ⊢
    nlinarith
  linarith

end CriticalSK

end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.name: OAI.CriticalSK.probability_intersection_tendsto_one
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.Rayle.text:
lemma probability_intersection_tendsto_one {X : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (X n)]
    (μ : ∀ n, Measure (X n)) [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (A B : ∀ n, Set (X n)) (_hA : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n)) (hB : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (B n))
    (hpA : Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (A n)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hpB : Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (B n)) atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (A n ∩ B n)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le (g := fun n => (μ n).real (A n)+(μ n).real (B n)-1) (h := fun _ => (1:ℝ))
  · simpa using (hpA.add hpB).sub_const 1
  · exact tendsto_const_nhds
  · intro n
    have hadd := measureReal_union_add_inter (μ := μ n) (s := A n) (hB n)
    have hle : (μ n).real (A n ∪ B n) ≤ 1 := measureReal_le_one
    linarith
  · exact fun _ => measureReal_le_one

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.name: OAI.CriticalSK.mixingGapReduction_lower
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.text:
lemma mixingGapReduction_lower {ε β C : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) (hβ : β≤1)
    (hsmall : 6*(1-β)≤ε/2) (hC : 1≤C) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (disorderLaw n).real (poincareEvent n β C)-mixingReductionError n ε ≤
        (disorderLaw n).real (twoClockMixingEvent n ε) := by
  filter_upwards [tempered_mixing_eventual_implication hε hβ hsmall hC,
    eventually_gt_atTop (0:ℕ)] with n hn hnp
  let B : Set (Disorder n) := {W | ∃ x : Spin n, 3*(n:ℝ)≤|hamiltonian W x|}
  let Lc : Set (Disorder n) := {W | (1:ℝ)≤|continuousGoodMass W ((n:ℝ)^(2/3-ε))-1|}
  let Ld : Set (Disorder n) := {W | (1:ℝ)≤|discreteGoodMass W ⌈(n:ℝ)^(5/3-ε)⌉₊-1|}
  have hs : poincareEvent n β C ⊆ ((twoClockMixingEvent n ε ∪ B) ∪ Lc) ∪ Ld := by
    intro W hW
    by_cases hb : W∈B
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr hb))
    by_cases hc : W∈Lc
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hc)
    by_cases hd : W∈Ld
    · exact Or.inr hd
    apply Or.inl ∘ Or.inl ∘ Or.inl
    have hH : ∀ x, |hamiltonian W x|≤3*(n:ℝ) := by
      intro x
      by_contra hx
      exact hb ⟨x,(lt_of_not_ge hx).le⟩
    have hu := hn W hH hW
    have hc' : 0<continuousGoodMass W ((n:ℝ)^(2/3-ε)) := by
      have hh : |continuousGoodMass W ((n:ℝ)^(2/3-ε))-1|<1 := lt_of_not_ge hc
      have hl := (abs_lt.mp hh).1
      linarith
    have hd' : 0<discreteGoodMass W ⌈(n:ℝ)^(5/3-ε)⌉₊ := by
      have hh : |discreteGoodMass W ⌈(n:ℝ)^(5/3-ε)⌉₊-1|<1 := lt_of_not_ge hd
      have hl := (abs_lt.mp hh).1
      linarith
    exact ⟨continuousMixingTime_lower W hnp hc',hu.1,
      (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr (discreteMixingTime_lower W hnp hd')),hu.2⟩
  have hp := measureReal_mono (μ := disorderLaw n) hs
  have h1 := measureReal_union_le (μ := disorderLaw n) ((twoClockMixingEvent n ε ∪ B) ∪ Lc) Ld
  have h2 := measureReal_union_le (μ := disorderLaw n) (twoClockMixingEvent n ε ∪ B) Lc
  have h3 := measureReal_union_le (μ := disorderLaw n) (twoClockMixingEvent n ε) B
  have hb := maximum_energy_tail hnp
  change (disorderLaw n).real B ≤ _ at hb
  change (disorderLaw n).real (poincareEvent n β C)-
    (2*Real.exp (-(3/2:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))+(disorderLaw n).real Lc+(disorderLaw n).real Ld) ≤ _
  linarith

end CriticalSK

end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.name: OAI.CriticalSK.mixingReductionError
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.text:
noncomputable def mixingReductionError (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2*Real.exp (-(3/2:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)) +
    (disorderLaw n).real {W | (1:ℝ)≤|continuousGoodMass W ((n:ℝ)^(2/3-ε))-1|} +
    (disorderLaw n).real {W | (1:ℝ)≤|discreteGoodMass W ⌈(n:ℝ)^(5/3-ε)⌉₊-1|}

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalMixing.M.name: OAI.CriticalSK.critical_mixing_bounds
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalMixing.M.text:
theorem critical_mixing_bounds (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw n {W |
      (n : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3 - ε) ≤ continuousMixingTime W ∧
      continuousMixingTime W ≤ Real.exp (ε * n)}).toReal) atTop (𝓝 1) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw n {W |
      (n : ℝ) ^ ((5 : ℝ) / 3 - ε) ≤ (discreteMixingTime W : ℝ) ∧
      (discreteMixingTime W : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (ε * n)}).toReal) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hp := critical_two_clock_mixing ε hε
  constructor
  · apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le hp tendsto_const_nhds
    · intro n
      refine measureReal_mono ?_
      intro W hW
      exact ⟨hW.1, hW.2.1⟩
    · intro n
      exact measureReal_le_one
  · apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le hp tendsto_const_nhds
    · intro n
      refine measureReal_mono ?_
      intro W hW
      exact ⟨hW.2.2.1, hW.2.2.2⟩
    · intro n
      exact measureReal_le_one

end CriticalSK
end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.name: OAI.CriticalSK.temperature_close_to_one
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.text:
lemma temperature_close_to_one {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) : ∃ β : ℝ, 0<β ∧ β<1 ∧ 6*(1-β)≤ε/2 := by
  let δ := min (ε/12) (1/2)
  have hδ : 0<δ := lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  have hδ1 : δ≤1/2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hδε : δ≤ε/12 := min_le_left _ _
  refine ⟨1-δ,by linarith,by linarith,?_⟩
  linarith

end

open Set Filter MeasureTheory

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalMixing.M.name: OAI.CriticalSK.critical_two_clock_mixing
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalMixing.M.text:
theorem critical_two_clock_mixing (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw n).real (twoClockMixingEvent n ε))
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ0, hβ1, hsmall⟩ := temperature_close_to_one hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hP⟩ := fixed_temperature_poincare β hβ0 hβ1
  have hl : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw n).real (poincareEvent n β C) -
      mixingReductionError n ε) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hP.sub (mixingReductionError_tendsto hε)
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hl tendsto_const_nhds
    (mixingGapReduction_lower hε hβ1.le hsmall hC)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => measureReal_le_one))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.name: OAI.CriticalSK.mixingReductionError_tendsto
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.text:
lemma mixingReductionError_tendsto {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n => mixingReductionError n ε) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hc := realized_continuous_initial_states (fun n => (n:ℝ)^(2/3-ε))
    (fun _ => by positivity) (rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero hε) 1 zero_lt_one
  have hd := realized_discrete_initial_states (fun n => ⌈(n:ℝ)^(5/3-ε)⌉₊)
    (ceil_rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<5/3) hε) 1 zero_lt_one
  have he : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2*Real.exp (-(3/2:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => -(3/2:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)) atTop atBot :=
      (tendsto_const_mul_atBot_of_neg (by norm_num : -(3/2:ℝ)<0)).mpr tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    simpa using (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp ht).const_mul 2
  simpa only [mixingReductionError,add_zero] using (he.add hc).add hd

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalSK.HighT.name: OAI.CriticalSK.twoClockMixingEvent

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalMixing.C.name: OAI.CriticalSK.fixed_temperature_poincare
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.CriticalMixing.C.text:
theorem fixed_temperature_poincare (β : ℝ) (hβ0 : 0 < β) (hβ1 : β < 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      (disorderLaw n).real (poincareEvent n β C)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hP, _⟩ := SKGap.sk_main β hβ0 hβ1
  have hp : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw n).real (poincareEvent n β C))
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simp_rw [companion_poincare_probability] at hP
    simpa only [Measure.real, ENNReal.toReal_one, Function.comp_def] using
      (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal (by simp : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)).comp hP
  refine ⟨max 1 C, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le hp tendsto_const_nhds
  · intro n
    refine measureReal_mono ?_
    intro W hW f
    exact (hW f).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _)
      (dirichlet_nonneg (β • W) f))
  · intro n
    exact measureReal_le_one

end CriticalSK
end

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.bandVertices
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text: def bandVertices (H : ℕ) (v : Vertex) : Prop := 0≤v.2.1 ∧ v.2.1<(H:ℤ)

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.boundaryPathWeight_strip_top
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
lemma boundaryPathWeight_strip_top (H : ℕ) (hH : 1≤H) (i j : ℤ) (p : List Triangle) :
    boundaryPathWeight (stripBoundaryPorts H hH) H i (.inr j,p)=betweenBridgeWeight H i j p := by
  have hc : ValidBoundaryPath (stripBoundaryPorts H hH) H i (.inr j,p) ↔
      0<H ∧ PathBetween H (up i 0) (down j (H-1)) p := by
    simp only [ValidBoundaryPath,stripBoundaryPorts,stripPort,retract_top H hH]
    have hb : bottom i≠top H j := by simp [bottom,top]
    change (bottom i≠top H j ∧ PathBetween H (up i 0) (down j (H-1)) p ∧ _) ↔ _
    rw [and_iff_right hb]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hp,_⟩; exact ⟨by omega,hp⟩
    · rintro ⟨_,hp⟩
      exact ⟨hp,fun v hv=>⟨by simp [embedTriangle],by change (v.2.1:ℤ)<(H:ℤ); exact_mod_cast hp.2.2.2.2 v hv⟩⟩
  simp only [boundaryPathWeight,betweenBridgeWeight,hc]

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.stepBoundary_summable
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
theorem stepBoundary_summable {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) (s i : ℤ) :
    Summable (boundaryPathWeight (stepBoundaryPorts N hN s) (N+1) i) := by
  apply summable_sumProd
  · simpa only [boundaryPathWeight_step_bottom] using stepArchWeight_summable hN s i
  · apply summable_sumProd
    · exact stepBoundary_top_summable hN s i
    · have hs := (stepSideWeight_summable s (stripSumsFinite (show 1≤N+1 by omega))).prod_factor i
      apply (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun x=>boundaryPathWeight_nonneg _ _ _ _)).mpr
      refine ⟨?_,(hasSum_fintype _).summable⟩
      intro u
      cases u
      simpa only [boundaryPathWeight_step_side] using hs

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.NorthMass:40.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.moment_eq_realNorthSeparator
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.NorthMass:40.text:
theorem moment_eq_realNorthSeparator {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) :
    moment N=realNorthSeparator N := by
  rw [←CrossTopArch.tsum_weight N hN]
  have hs:=CrossTopArch.summable_sigma N hN
  have he : (∑' D : CrossTopArch N,D.weight)=
      ∑' D : Sigma (fun x : ℕ×ℕ=>TopArchConfiguration N (-1-(x.1:ℤ)) (x.2:ℤ)),
        D.2.toHoneycombAssignment.weight :=
    (CrossTopArch.sigmaEquiv N).tsum_eq (fun D=>D.2.toHoneycombAssignment.weight)
  rw [he,hs.tsum_sigma' ((CrossTopArch.sigma_sums N hN).1)]
  have hi (x : ℕ×ℕ) :
      (∑' D : TopArchConfiguration N (-1-(x.1:ℤ)) (x.2:ℤ),D.toHoneycombAssignment.weight)=
        K N ((x.1+x.2:ℕ)+1) := by
    rw [TopArchConfiguration.weight_sum N hN _ _ (by omega)]
    congr 1
    omega
  simp_rw [hi]
  exact (tsum_add_diagonal (fun n=>K_nonneg N (n+1)) (moment_summable hN)).symm

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.StepEndpoint
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text: abbrev StepEndpoint := ℤ⊕(ℤ⊕Unit)

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.FluxWindow:4.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.steppedVertices_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.FluxWindow:4.text:
lemma steppedVertices_bound (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) (v : Vertex) (hv : steppedVertices N s v) :
    0≤v.2.1 ∧ v.2.1<((N+1:ℕ):ℤ) := by
  dsimp [steppedVertices] at hv
  exact ⟨hv.1,by omega⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.step_bottom_imaginary_tsum
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
lemma step_bottom_imaginary_tsum {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) (s i : ℤ) :
    (∑'x : ℤ×List Triangle,stepArchWeight N s i x.1 x.2 * Real.sin ((stepTurn i (.inl x.1):ℝ)*lambda))=
    Real.sin (3*lambda)*(stepArchLeft N s i-stepArchRight N s i) := by
  have hB:=summable_sumProd_left (boundary_imaginary_summable (stepBoundaryPorts N hN s)
    (stepBoundary_summable hN s i) (stepTurn i))
  simp only [boundaryPathWeight_step_bottom] at hB
  let f : ℤ→ℝ:=fun j=>stepArchKernel N s i j * Real.sin ((stepTurn i (.inl j):ℝ)*lambda)
  have hprod (j : ℤ) : (∑'p,stepArchWeight N s i j p * Real.sin ((stepTurn i (.inl j):ℝ)*lambda))=f j := by
    rw [tsum_mul_right]; rfl
  have hf : Summable f := hB.prod.congr hprod
  have hr := hf.comp_injective (i:=fun n : ℕ=>i+(n:ℤ)+1) (by intro a b hh; dsimp at hh; omega)
  have hl := hf.comp_injective (i:=fun n : ℕ=>i-1-(n:ℤ)) (by intro a b hh; dsimp at hh; omega)
  have he (n : ℕ) : i+ -((n:ℤ)+1)=i-1-(n:ℤ) := by ring
  have hh := tsum_of_add_one_of_neg_add_one (f:=fun j : ℤ=>f (i+j))
    (by simpa only [Function.comp_def,add_assoc] using hr)
    (by simpa only [Function.comp_def,he] using hl)
  rw [hB.tsum_prod]
  simp_rw [hprod]
  rw [←(Equiv.addLeft i).tsum_eq f]
  change (∑'j : ℤ,f (i+j))=_
  rw [hh]
  have hr' (n : ℕ) : f (i+((n:ℤ)+1)) = stepArchKernel N s i (i+(n:ℤ)+1) * (-Real.sin (3*lambda)) := by
    simp only [f,←add_assoc,stepTurn_sine_right]
  have hl' (n : ℕ) : f (i+ -((n:ℤ)+1)) = stepArchKernel N s i (i-1-(n:ℤ)) * Real.sin (3*lambda) := by
    simp only [f,he,stepTurn_sine_left]
  have hz : f (i+0)=0 := by simp only [f,add_zero,stepArchKernel_self,zero_mul]
  simp_rw [hr',hl',hz,add_zero,tsum_mul_right]
  change stepArchRight N s i * (-Real.sin (3*lambda)) + stepArchLeft N s i * Real.sin (3*lambda) = _
  ring

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.NorthMass:42.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.physical_arch_formula
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.NorthMass:42.text:
theorem physical_arch_formula {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) :
    ∃ g : Polynomial ℝ, MonicProblem N g ∧ moment N=(N:ℝ)*C-eta*g.coeff (N-1) := by
  rw [moment_eq_realNorthSeparator hN]
  exact realNorthSeparator_arch hN

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.physical_stepped_flux
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
theorem physical_stepped_flux {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) (s : ℤ) : SteppedBoundaryFlux N s := by
  intro i
  let P:=stepBoundaryPorts N hN s
  let F : StepEndpoint×List Triangle→ℝ :=
    fun x=>boundaryPathWeight P (N+1) i x*Real.sin ((stepTurn i x.1:ℝ)*lambda)
  have hs : Summable F := boundary_imaginary_summable P (stepBoundary_summable hN s i) (stepTurn i)
  have hf : (∑'x,F x)=0 := boundary_imaginary_flux P (by omega)
    (by dsimp [steppedVertices,bottom]; omega) (steppedVertices_bound N s)
      (stepBoundary_summable hN s i) (stepTurn i) (step_turn N hN s i)
  have hb:=summable_sumProd_left hs
  have hn:=summable_sumProd_right hs
  have ht:=summable_sumProd_left hn
  have hp:=summable_sumProd_right hn
  have hsplit : (∑'x : ℤ×List Triangle,F (.inl x.1,x.2)) +
      ((∑'x : ℤ×List Triangle,F (.inr (.inl x.1),x.2)) +
       (∑'x : Unit×List Triangle,F (.inr (.inr x.1),x.2)))=0 :=
    (congrArg (fun y : ℝ => (∑'x : ℤ×List Triangle,F (.inl x.1,x.2)) + y)
      (tsum_sumProd (f:=fun x : (ℤ⊕Unit)×List Triangle => F (.inr x.1,x.2)) ht hp)).symm.trans ((tsum_sumProd (f:=F) hb hn).symm.trans hf)
  have hbot : (∑'x : ℤ×List Triangle,F (.inl x.1,x.2))=
      Real.sin (3*lambda)*(stepArchLeft N s i-stepArchRight N s i) := by
    simpa only [F,P,boundaryPathWeight_step_bottom] using step_bottom_imaginary_tsum hN s i
  have htop : (∑'x : ℤ×List Triangle,F (.inr (.inl x.1),x.2))=0 := by
    simp [F,stepTurn]
  have hside : (∑'x : Unit×List Triangle,F (.inr (.inr x.1),x.2))=
      Real.sin lambda*stepSideKernel N s i := by
    rw [hp.tsum_prod]
    simp [F,P,stepTurn,boundaryPathWeight_step_side,tsum_mul_left,stepSideKernel,mul_comm]
  have hvalue := congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℝ => a+b) hbot
    (congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℝ => a+b) htop hside)
  have hresult := hvalue.symm.trans hsplit
  simpa only [zero_add] using hresult

end
end CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.ReflectionIn.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.homogeneous_arch_coefficient_growth
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.ReflectionIn.text:
theorem homogeneous_arch_coefficient_growth :
    ∃ lo hi : ℝ, 0 < lo ∧ 0 < hi ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
      ∀ g : Polynomial ℝ, MonicProblem N g →
        lo*(N:ℝ)^(3/4:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)*C - eta*g.coeff (N-1) ∧
          (N:ℝ)*C - eta*g.coeff (N-1) ≤ hi*(N:ℝ)^(3/4:ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hl, hh, hbound⟩ := positive_arch_integral_growth
  have hc : 0 < eta/Real.pi := div_pos eta_pos Real.pi_pos
  refine ⟨(eta/Real.pi)*lo, (eta/Real.pi)*hi, mul_pos hc hl, mul_pos hc hh, ?_⟩
  intro N hN g hg
  rw [homogeneous_arch_coefficient_integral N hN hg]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hbound N hN
  constructor
  · simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hc.le
  · simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hc.le

end
end CriticalStrip

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.strip_turn

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.NorthMass:38.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.archWeight_summable
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.NorthMass:38.text:
theorem archWeight_summable {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) (k : ℤ) : Summable (archWeight N k) := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy k 0 with hk|rfl|hk
  · have hp := archWeight_summable_positive hN (-k) (by omega)
    let e:=mirrorTriangles_involutive.toPerm _
    have hh := (e.summable_iff).mpr hp
    apply hh.congr
    intro p
    exact archWeight_mirror N k p
  · change Summable (fun p : List Triangle=>archWeight N 0 p)
    simp only [archWeight,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,false_and,ite_false]
    exact summable_zero
  · exact archWeight_summable_positive hN k hk

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.SidePaths:42.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.increment_comparable_of_boundary
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.SidePaths:42.text:
theorem increment_comparable_of_boundary
    (hfinite : ∀ N : ℕ,1≤N → StripSumsFinite N)
    (hstrip : ∀ N : ℕ,1≤N → c*archMass N+bridgeMass N=1)
    (hstep : ∀ N : ℕ,1≤N → ∃ s : ℤ,SteppedBoundaryFlux N s) :
    Comparable (fun N =>moment (N+1)-moment N) bridgeMass := by
  have hs := step_sines_pos
  refine ⟨(Real.sin lambda/Real.sin (3*lambda))*rho,
    (Real.sin lambda/Real.sin (3*lambda))/rho,
    mul_pos (div_pos hs.1 hs.2) rho_pos,div_pos (div_pos hs.1 hs.2) rho_pos,?_⟩
  intro N hN
  obtain ⟨s,h⟩ := hstep N hN
  exact moment_increment_bounds_of_boundary hN s (hfinite (N+1) (by omega))
    (hfinite N hN) h (hstrip N hN) (hstrip (N+1) (by omega))

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.summable_sumProd_left

lemma summable_sumProd_left {A B C E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (A⊕B)×C→E} (hf : Summable f) :
    Summable (fun x : A×C=>f (.inl x.1,x.2)) := by
  apply hf.comp_injective
  intro x y h
  exact Prod.ext (Sum.inl.inj (congrArg (fun z : (A⊕B)×C=>z.1) h)) (congrArg (fun z : (A⊕B)×C=>z.2) h)

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.boundaryPathWeight_strip_bottom
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
lemma boundaryPathWeight_strip_bottom (H : ℕ) (hH : 1≤H) (i j : ℤ) (p : List Triangle) :
    boundaryPathWeight (stripBoundaryPorts H hH) H i (.inl j,p)=betweenArchWeight H i j p := by
  have hc : ValidBoundaryPath (stripBoundaryPorts H hH) H i (.inl j,p) ↔
      i≠j ∧ PathBetween H (up i 0) (up j 0) p := by
    simp only [ValidBoundaryPath,stripBoundaryPorts,stripPort,retract_bottom]
    have hb : bottom i≠bottom j ↔ i≠j := by simp [bottom]
    rw [hb]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h,hp,_⟩; exact ⟨h,hp⟩
    · rintro ⟨h,hp⟩
      exact ⟨h,hp,fun v hv=>⟨by simp [embedTriangle],by change (v.2.1:ℤ)<(H:ℤ); exact_mod_cast hp.2.2.2.2 v hv⟩⟩
  simp only [boundaryPathWeight,betweenArchWeight,hc]

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.betweenArchWeight_summable
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
lemma betweenArchWeight_summable (H : ℕ) (hH : 1≤H) (i : ℤ) :
    Summable (fun x : ℤ×List Triangle=>betweenArchWeight H i x.1 x.2) := by
  have hf:=stripSumsFinite hH
  apply (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun x=>betweenArchWeight_nonneg H i x.1 x.2)).mpr
  refine ⟨fun j=>(summable_betweenArchWeight_iff H i j).mpr (hf.1 _),?_⟩
  change Summable (fun j=>betweenArchKernel H i j)
  simp_rw [betweenArchKernel_eq]
  exact hf.2.2.1.comp_injective (i:=fun j : ℤ=>j-i) (by intro a b hh; dsimp at hh; omega)

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.boundary_real_flux
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
theorem boundary_real_flux (hH : 1≤H) (hi : D (bottom i).1)
    (hD : ∀v,D v→0≤v.2.1 ∧ v.2.1<(H:ℤ)) (hs : Summable (boundaryPathWeight P H i))
    (θ : B→ℤ) (hθ : ∀x : ExitWord D i,turn x.val=θ (exitPort P x)) :
    (∑'x : B×List Triangle,boundaryPathWeight P H i x*Real.cos ((θ x.1:ℝ)*lambda))=1 := by
  have hh:=congrArg Complex.re (boundary_flux P hH hi hD hs θ hθ)
  rw [Complex.re_tsum (boundary_complex_summable P hs θ)] at hh
  simpa only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,sub_zero,phase_re,Complex.one_re] using hh

def steppedVertices (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) (v : Vertex) : Prop :=

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.BridgeUnfold.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.stripSumsFinite
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.BridgeUnfold.text:
theorem stripSumsFinite {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) : StripSumsFinite N := by
  have hb:=(summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun x : ℤ×List Triangle=>bridgeWeight_nonneg N x.1 x.2)).mp
    (summable_bridgeWeight hN)
  exact ⟨archWeight_summable hN,hb.1,summable_K_of_moment (moment_summable hN),hb.2,moment_summable hN⟩

end

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.step_turn
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
lemma step_turn (N : ℕ) (hN : 1≤N) (s i : ℤ) (x : ExitWord (steppedVertices N s) i) :
    turn x.val=stepTurn i (exitPort (stepBoundaryPorts N hN s) x) := by

  · exact bottom_turn i j x.val x.property.1 (ribbonSimple_of_nodup x.property.2.1)

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.boundary_imaginary_summable

  have hh := (Complex.hasSum_im (boundary_complex_summable P hs θ).hasSum).summable

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.HoneycombBranch.tsum_sumProd
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.PhysicalPort.text:
lemma tsum_sumProd {A B C E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (A⊕B)×C→E}
    (ha : Summable (fun x : A×C=>f (.inl x.1,x.2)))
    (hb : Summable (fun x : B×C=>f (.inr x.1,x.2))) :
    (∑'x,f x)=(∑'x : A×C,f (.inl x.1,x.2))+(∑'x : B×C,f (.inr x.1,x.2)) := by
  rw [←(Equiv.sumProdDistrib A B C).symm.tsum_eq f]
  exact ha.tsum_sum hb

theorem critical_strip_mass : CriticalStripMass := by
  exact criticalStripMass_of_physical_identities
    (fun _ hN => stripSumsFinite hN)
    (fun _ hN => HoneycombBranch.physical_strip_flux hN)
    (fun _ hN => ⟨0,HoneycombBranch.physical_stepped_flux hN 0⟩)
    (fun _ hN => physical_arch_formula hN)

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.BridgeUnfold.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.summable_bridgeWeight

theorem summable_bridgeWeight {N : ℕ} (hN : 1≤N) :
    Summable (fun x : ℤ×List Triangle=>bridgeWeight N x.1 x.2) := by
  have hh:= (summable_subtype_iff_indicator
    (f:=fun x : ℤ×List Triangle=>rho^x.2.length)
    (s:={x : ℤ×List Triangle | IsPath N (down x.1 (N-1)) x.2})).mp
      (BridgePath.summable_weight hN)
  apply hh.congr
  intro x
  dsimp [Set.indicator]
  unfold bridgeWeight
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.NorthMass:39.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.SidePaths:44.name: OAI.CriticalStrip.criticalStripMass_of_physical_identities
OAI.Combinatorics.StripMass.SidePaths:44.text:
theorem criticalStripMass_of_physical_identities
    (hfinite : ∀ N : ℕ,1≤N → StripSumsFinite N)
    (hstrip : ∀ N : ℕ,1≤N → c*archMass N+bridgeMass N=1)
    (hstep : ∀ N : ℕ,1≤N → ∃ s : ℤ,SteppedBoundaryFlux N s)
    (hArch : ∀ N : ℕ,1≤N → ∃ g : Polynomial ℝ,
      MonicProblem N g ∧ moment N=(N:ℝ)*C-eta*g.coeff (N-1)) :
    CriticalStripMass := by
  apply criticalStripMass_iff_four_estimates.mpr
  refine ⟨hfinite,hstrip,increment_comparable_of_boundary hfinite hstrip hstep,?_⟩
  obtain ⟨lo,hi,hl,hh,hg⟩ := homogeneous_arch_coefficient_growth
  refine ⟨lo,hi,hl,hh,?_⟩
  intro N hN
  obtain ⟨g,hgm,he⟩ := hArch N hN
  simpa only [he] using hg N hN g hgm

end
end CriticalStrip

theorem realNorthSeparator_arch {n : ℕ} (hn : 1≤n) :
    ∃ g : Polynomial ℝ, MonicProblem n g ∧
      realNorthSeparator n=(n:ℝ)*C-eta*g.coeff (n-1) := by
  have hh:=congrArg (angleEvaluation (fun _ : Fin n=>lambda))
    (polynomialNorthGluing_eq_archCandidate n)
  rw [polynomialNorthGluing_physical,archCandidate_physical] at hh
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hnext⟩:=nextScalar_homogeneous hn
  refine ⟨g,hg,?_⟩
  simp only [scalarArchNumerator,hnext,previousCoeff,show n≠0 by omega,ite_false,
    Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,Polynomial.coeff_map,Complex.ofRealHom_eq_coe,
    Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,RingHom.id_apply] at hh
  have hc : (realNorthSeparator n:ℂ)=(n:ℂ)*(C:ℂ)-(2*(d:ℂ)-1)*(g.coeff (n-1):ℂ) := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 (scalarValue_homogeneous_ne_zero n))
    rw [hh]
    ring

lemma summable_sumProd_right {A B C E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : (A⊕B)×C→E} (hf : Summable f) :
    Summable (fun x : B×C=>f (.inr x.1,x.2)) := by
  apply hf.comp_injective
  intro x y h
