OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.Main:57.name: OAI.CenteredDiskEndpoint.hasGradient_iff_hasWeakGradient
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.Main:57.text:
lemma hasGradient_iff_hasWeakGradient {f : Plane → ℝ} {g : Plane → Plane}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f) (hg : Integrable g) :
    HasGradient (μ := volume) f g ↔ HasWeakGradient f g := by
  constructor
  · intro hw φ hφ hc i
    simpa only [testPartial,EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right,RCLike.conj_to_real,one_mul]
      using hw φ hφ hc (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
  · intro hw φ hφ hc v
    have hv : v=∑ i : Fin 2,v i • EuclideanSpace.single i 1 := by
      simpa only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr,EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply] using
        ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).sum_repr v).symm
    have hleft i : Integrable (fun x => f x*testPartial φ i x) :=
      hf.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport
        ((hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const) (hc.fderiv_apply ℝ _)
    have hright i : Integrable (fun x => g x i*φ x) :=
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).integrable_comp hg).locallyIntegrable.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ.continuous hc
    have hd x : f x*fderiv ℝ φ x v=∑ i : Fin 2,v i*(f x*testPartial φ i x) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [_root_.map_sum,map_smul,smul_eq_mul,Finset.mul_sum,testPartial]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    have hi x : ⟪g x,v⟫*φ x=∑ i : Fin 2,v i*(g x i*φ x) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [inner_sum,real_inner_smul_right,EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right,RCLike.conj_to_real,one_mul,Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    simp_rw [hd,hi]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hleft i).const_mul _),
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hright i).const_mul _)]
    simp only [integral_const_mul,hw φ hφ hc,Finset.sum_neg_distrib,mul_neg]

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.AbsoluteContinu.name: OAI.SobolevBand.smooth_diagonal_local_L1
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.AbsoluteContinu.text:
lemma smooth_diagonal_local_L1 {f : ℂ → ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ} {u : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f) (hg : Integrable g) (hw : HasGradient (μ := volume) f g)
    (hu : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ 1 (u n) ∧ HasCompactSupport (u n))
    (he : ∀ n x, ‖band (u n) (low n) (high n) x-band (fun y => |f y|) (low n) (high n) x‖ ≤ 1/((n:ℝ)+1))
    {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in K, ‖band (u n) (low n) (high n) x-maximalComplexReal f x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let H := fun n => band (u n) (low n) (high n)
  let A := fun n => band (fun y => |f y|) (low n) (high n)
  have hUi n : Integrable (u n) := (hu n).1.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hu n).2
  have hGi n : Integrable (gradient (u n)) := (continuous_gradient (hu n).1).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (gradient_hasCompactSupport (hu n).2)
  have hH n : Continuous (H n) := (band_lipschitz (hUi n) (hGi n) (contDiff_hasGradient (hu n).1) (low_pos n) (low_le_high n)).continuous
  have hA n : Continuous (A n) := (band_lipschitz hf.abs (abs_gradient_bound hf hg).1 (hw.abs hf hg) (low_pos n) (low_le_high n)).continuous
  have hM := (locallyIntegrable_maximal hf hg hw).integrableOn_isCompact hK
  have hHi n : IntegrableOn (H n) K := (hH n).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hAi n : IntegrableOn (A n) K := (hA n).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict K) := ⟨by simpa using hK.measure_lt_top⟩
  have hb (n : ℕ) : (∫ x in K, ‖H n x-maximalComplexReal f x‖) ≤
      (1/((n:ℝ)+1))*volume.real K+(∫ x in K,‖A n x-maximalComplexReal f x‖) := by
    have hcst : (∫ _ : ℂ in K,(1/((n:ℝ)+1)))=(1/((n:ℝ)+1))*volume.real K := by simp only [setIntegral_const,smul_eq_mul,mul_comm]
    have hdiff : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖A n x-maximalComplexReal f x‖) K := ((hAi n).sub hM).norm
    have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℂ => (1/((n:ℝ)+1))) K := integrable_const _
    rw [← hcst,← integral_add hconst hdiff]
    apply integral_mono ((hHi n).sub hM).norm ((integrable_const _).add ((hAi n).sub hM).norm)
    intro x
    change ‖H n x-maximalComplexReal f x‖ ≤ 1/((n:ℝ)+1)+‖A n x-maximalComplexReal f x‖
    exact (norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (H n x) (A n x) (maximalComplexReal f x)).trans (add_le_add (he n x) le_rfl)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1/((n:ℝ)+1))*volume.real K+(∫ x in K,‖A n x-maximalComplexReal f x‖)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul,zero_add] using
      ((tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).mul_const (volume.real K)).add (diagonal_local_L1 hf hg hw hK)
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => integral_nonneg (fun x => norm_nonneg _)) hb hlim
end SobolevBand

variable {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.WeakLimits:657.name: OAI.SobolevBand.smooth_band_integrable_gradient
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.WeakLimits:657.text:
lemma smooth_band_integrable_gradient {f : ℂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport f) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0<a) (hab : a≤b) :
    Integrable (gradient (band f a b)) :=
  _root_.OAI.LipschitzWith.integrable_gradient (smooth_band_lipschitz hf hc ha hab) (run_envelope_hasCompactSupport hf hc ha hab)

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.AbsoluteContinu.name: OAI.SobolevBand.exists_diagonal_smooth
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.AbsoluteContinu.text:
lemma exists_diagonal_smooth {f : ℂ → ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : Integrable f) (hg : Integrable g) (hw : HasGradient (μ := volume) f g) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ, (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ 1 (u n) ∧ HasCompactSupport (u n)) ∧
      (∀ n, (∫ x,‖gradient (u n) x‖) ≤ (∫ x,‖g x‖)+1) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x,‖gradient (u n) x-g x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      (∀ n x, ‖band (u n) (low n) (high n) x-band f (low n) (high n) x‖ ≤ 1/((n:ℝ)+1)) := by
  have he (n : ℕ) : 0 < min (1/((n:ℝ)+1)) (Real.pi*(low n)^2/((n:ℝ)+1)) := by
    have := low_pos n
    apply lt_min <;> positivity
  choose u hu hc he1 he2 using fun n => exists_smooth_compact_approx hf hg hw (he n)
  have hi (n) : Integrable (u n) := (hu n).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hc n)
  have h1 n : ContDiff ℝ 1 (u n) := (hu n).of_le (by simp)
  refine ⟨u,fun n => ⟨h1 n,hc n⟩,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro n
    apply (gradient_integral_le (h1 n) (hc n) hg).trans
    gcongr
    have hn : 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤1 := (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
    exact ((he2 n).le.trans (min_le_left _ _)).trans hn
  · apply squeeze_zero (fun n => integral_nonneg (fun x => norm_nonneg _))
      (fun n => (he2 n).le.trans (min_le_left _ _))
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ))
  · intro n x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    apply (band_sub_le (hi n) hf (low_pos n) (low_le_high n) x).trans
    have := low_pos n
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<Real.pi*(low n)^2)).mpr
    have h := (he1 n).le.trans (min_le_right _ _)
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc,one_mul] using h

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.AbsoluteContinu.name: OAI.WeakSobolev.direction_identity_limit
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.AbsoluteContinu.text:
lemma direction_identity_limit {F : ℂ → ℝ} {H : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ} {q : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ}
    (hF : LocallyIntegrable F) (hH : ∀ n, LocallyIntegrable (H n))
    (hqi : ∀ n, Integrable (q n)) (hw : ∀ n, HasGradient (μ := volume) (H n) (q n))
    (ht : ∀ K : Set ℂ, IsCompact K → Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in K,‖H n x-F x‖) atTop (𝓝 0))
    {d e : ℂ → ℝ} (hd : Integrable d) (he : Integrable e) (v : ℂ)
    (hv : ∀ φ : C_c(ℂ,ℝ), Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x,(‖q n x‖+⟪q n x,v⟫)*φ x)
      (hyperfilter ℕ) (𝓝 (∫ x,d x*φ x)))
    (h0 : ∀ φ : C_c(ℂ,ℝ), Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x,(‖q n x‖+⟪q n x,(0:ℂ)⟫)*φ x)
      (hyperfilter ℕ) (𝓝 (∫ x,e x*φ x))) :
    ∀ φ : ℂ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      (∫ x,F x*fderiv ℝ φ x v) = -∫ x,(d x-e x)*φ x := by
  intro φ hφ hc
  let φ' : C_c(ℂ,ℝ) := ⟨⟨φ,hφ.continuous⟩,hc⟩
  have hn n : Integrable (fun x => ‖q n x‖*φ x) :=
    (hqi n).norm.locallyIntegrable.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ.continuous hc
  have hp n : Integrable (fun x => (‖q n x‖+⟪q n x,v⟫)*φ x) :=
    ((hqi n).norm.add ((hqi n).inner_const (𝕜 := ℝ) v)).locallyIntegrable.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ.continuous hc
  have hd' : Integrable (fun x => d x*φ x) := hd.locallyIntegrable.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ.continuous hc
  have he' : Integrable (fun x => e x*φ x) := he.locallyIntegrable.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ.continuous hc
  have hvn n : (∫ x,(‖q n x‖+⟪q n x,v⟫)*φ x)-(∫ x,(‖q n x‖+⟪q n x,(0:ℂ)⟫)*φ x) =
      ∫ x,⟪q n x,v⟫*φ x := by
    simp only [inner_zero_right,add_zero]
    rw [← integral_sub (hp n) (hn n)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all _ (fun x => by ring)
  have hde : (∫ x,d x*φ x)-(∫ x,e x*φ x) = ∫ x,(d x-e x)*φ x := by
    rw [← integral_sub hd' he']
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all _ (fun x => by ring)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x,H n x*fderiv ℝ φ x v) (hyperfilter ℕ)
      (𝓝 (-∫ x,(d x-e x)*φ x)) := by
    have h := ((hv φ').sub (h0 φ')).neg
    change Tendsto (fun n => -((∫ x,(‖q n x‖+⟪q n x,v⟫)*φ x)-(∫ x,(‖q n x‖+⟪q n x,(0:ℂ)⟫)*φ x)))
      (hyperfilter ℕ) (𝓝 (-((∫ x,d x*φ x)-(∫ x,e x*φ x)))) at h
    simp only [hvn,hde,← hw _ φ hφ hc v] at h
    exact h
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique
    ((local_L1_test_converges hF hH ht ((hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const)
      (hc.fderiv_apply ℝ v)).mono_left Nat.hyperfilter_le_atTop) hlim

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.WeakLimits:365.name: OAI.SobolevBand.smooth_band_lipschitz
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.WeakLimits:365.text:
lemma smooth_band_lipschitz {f : ℂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hc : HasCompactSupport f)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0<a) (hab : a≤b) :
    LipschitzWith (⟨(∫ y, ‖gradient f y‖)/(Real.pi*a^2),by positivity⟩ : ℝ≥0) (band f a b) :=
  RadiusEnvelope.lipschitz hab (fun x => signedAverage_radius_continuousOn hf x ha)
    (fun _ hr => smooth_average_lipschitz hf hc ha hr.1)

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.WeakLimits:536.name: OAI.SobolevBand.low_le_high
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.WeakLimits:536.text:
lemma low_le_high (n : ℕ) : low n ≤ high n := by
  have hp : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2^n := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  unfold low high
  have hi : ((2:ℝ)^n)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ (by positivity)).mpr hp
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.AbsoluteContinu.name: OAI.SobolevBand.complex_endpoint
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.AbsoluteContinu.text:
lemma complex_endpoint : ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ (f : ℂ → ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
    Integrable f → Integrable g → HasGradient (μ := volume) f g →
    LocallyIntegrable (maximalComplexReal f) ∧ ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ,
      Integrable G ∧ HasGradient (μ := volume) (maximalComplexReal f) G ∧
        (∫ x,‖G x‖)≤C*(∫ x,‖g x‖) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hlim⟩ := positive_direction_limit
  refine ⟨8*C,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro f g hf hg hw
  let a := fun x => absCoefficient (f x) • g x
  have ha : Integrable a := (abs_gradient_bound hf hg).1
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hV,ht,he⟩ := exists_diagonal_smooth hf.abs ha (hw.abs hf hg)
  let H := fun n => band (u n) (low n) (high n)
  let q := fun n => gradient (H n)
  have hqi n : Integrable (q n) := smooth_band_integrable_gradient (hu n).1 (hu n).2 (low_pos n) (low_le_high n)
  have hH n : LocallyIntegrable (H n) := (smooth_band_lipschitz (hu n).1 (hu n).2 (low_pos n) (low_le_high n)).continuous.locallyIntegrable
  have hwH n : HasGradient (μ := volume) (H n) (q n) :=
    lipschitz_hasGradient (smooth_band_lipschitz (hu n).1 (hu n).2 (low_pos n) (low_le_high n))
  have hF := locallyIntegrable_maximal hf hg hw
  have htH (K : Set ℂ) (hK : IsCompact K) :
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in K,‖H n x-maximalComplexReal f x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    smooth_diagonal_local_L1 hf hg hw hu he hK
  obtain ⟨d0,hd0,h0pos,h0mass,h0lim⟩ := hlim hu ha hV ht 0 (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d1,hd1,h1pos,h1mass,h1lim⟩ := hlim hu ha hV ht 1 (by simp)
  obtain ⟨dI,hdI,hIpos,hImass,hIlim⟩ := hlim hu ha hV ht Complex.I (by simp)
  let G := fun x => ((d1 x-d0 x : ℝ):ℂ)+((dI x-d0 x : ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I
  have hG : Integrable G := ((hd1.sub hd0).ofReal).add (((hdI.sub hd0).ofReal).mul_const Complex.I)
  have hGre x : (G x).re=d1 x-d0 x := by simp [G]
  have hGim x : (G x).im=dI x-d0 x := by simp [G]
  refine ⟨hF,G,hG,?_,?_⟩
  · apply complex_hasGradient_of_coordinates hF hG
    · simpa only [hGre] using direction_identity_limit hF hH hqi hwH htH hd1 hd0 1 h1lim h0lim
    · simpa only [hGim] using direction_identity_limit hF hH hqi hwH htH hdI hd0 Complex.I hIlim h0lim
  · have hb x : ‖G x‖≤d1 x+dI x+2*d0 x := by
      have h := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (G x)
      rw [hGre,hGim] at h
      have h1 : |d1 x-d0 x| ≤ d1 x+d0 x := by
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [h1pos x,h0pos x],by linarith [h1pos x,h0pos x]⟩
      have hI : |dI x-d0 x| ≤ dI x+d0 x := by
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hIpos x,h0pos x],by linarith [hIpos x,h0pos x]⟩
      linarith
    have hi := integral_mono hG.norm ((hd1.add hdI).add (hd0.const_mul 2)) hb
    simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
    rw [integral_add (f := fun x => d1 x+dI x) (hd1.add hdI) (hd0.const_mul 2),integral_add hd1 hdI,integral_const_mul] at hi
    have hba : (∫ x,‖a x‖)≤∫ x,‖g x‖ := (abs_gradient_bound hf hg).2
    have hh : (∫ x,‖G x‖)≤8*C*(∫ x,‖a x‖) := by linarith
    exact hh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hba (by positivity))
end SobolevBand

namespace WeakSobolev
variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.Main:113.name: OAI.CenteredDiskEndpoint.gradientNorm_comp_complexPlane_symm
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.Main:113.text:
lemma gradientNorm_comp_complexPlane_symm (G : ℂ → ℂ) :
    gradientNorm (fun x => complexPlane (G (complexPlane.symm x)))=∫ z,‖G z‖ := by
  simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map,gradientNorm]
  exact complexPlane.symm.measurePreserving.integral_comp complexPlane.symm.toMeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding (fun z => ‖G z‖)
end CenteredDiskEndpoint

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.Main:144.name: OAI.CenteredDiskEndpoint.main_endpoint
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.Main:144.text:
theorem main_endpoint : EndpointStatement := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hendpoint⟩ := SobolevBand.complex_endpoint
  refine ⟨C,hC.le,?_⟩
  intro f g hf hg hw
  let f' := fun z => f (complexPlane z)
  let g' := fun z => complexPlane.symm (g (complexPlane z))
  have hf' : Integrable f' := integrable_comp_complexPlane.mpr hf
  have hg0 : Integrable (fun z => g (complexPlane z)) := integrable_comp_complexPlane.mpr hg
  have hg' : Integrable g' := complexPlane.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hg0
  have hw0 : HasGradient (μ := volume) f g := (hasGradient_iff_hasWeakGradient hf.locallyIntegrable hg).mpr hw
  have hw' : HasGradient (μ := volume) f' g' := hw0.comp_isometry complexPlane
  obtain ⟨hM',G',hG'i,hwG',hbound⟩ := hendpoint f' g' hf' hg' hw'
  have he : maximalComplexReal f'=fun z => maximalReal f (complexPlane z) := maximalComplexReal_comp_complexPlane f
  rw [he] at hM'
  have hM : LocallyIntegrable (maximalReal f) := locallyIntegrable_comp_complexPlane.mp hM'
  let G := fun x => complexPlane (G' (complexPlane.symm x))
  have hG0 : Integrable (fun x => G' (complexPlane.symm x)) := integrable_comp_complexPlane_symm.mpr hG'i
  have hG : Integrable G := complexPlane.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hG0
  have hwG0 := hwG'.comp_isometry complexPlane.symm
  have hwG : HasWeakGradient (maximalReal f) G := by
    apply (hasGradient_iff_hasWeakGradient hM hG).mp
    simpa only [he,complexPlane.apply_symm_apply,LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm] using hwG0
  refine ⟨ae_maximal_ne_top hf,hM,inW11Loc_of_gradient hM hG hwG,G,hG,hwG,?_⟩
  rw [show gradientNorm G=∫ z,‖G' z‖ from gradientNorm_comp_complexPlane_symm G']
  exact hbound.trans_eq (congrArg (fun v => C*v) (gradientNorm_comp_complexPlane g))
end CenteredDiskEndpoint

end

OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.Main:124.name: OAI.CenteredDiskEndpoint.maximalComplex_comp_complexPlane
OAI.Analysis.DiskMaximal.Main:124.text:
lemma maximalComplex_comp_complexPlane (f : Plane → ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    maximalComplex (fun w => f (complexPlane w)) z=maximal f (complexPlane z) := by
  rw [maximalComplex_eq_all_radii,maximal]
  apply iSup_congr
  intro r
  apply iSup_congr
  intro hr
  rw [absoluteDiskAverage,absoluteMeasure,withDensity_apply _ measurableSet_ball,
    volume_disk_real z hr.le]
  congr 1
  have h := complexPlane.measurePreserving.setLIntegral_comp_emb
    complexPlane.toMeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal |f x|) (Metric.ball z r)
  rw [complexPlane.image_ball] at h
  exact h

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Parameters:.name: OAI.Dixmier.endpointCapacity_pos
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Parameters:.text:
theorem endpointCapacity_pos {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    0 < endpointCapacity d ρ ℓ := by
  apply Nat.ceil_pos.mpr
  exact mul_pos (pow_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < d)) _) (pow_pos hρ _)

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.MaskAlgebra.name: OAI.Dixmier.Masked.difference_norm_le
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.MaskAlgebra.text:
theorem difference_norm_le (v : I → Fibre K) (s : I → G) (a : G → I → Bool)
    {r : ℕ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hv : FiniteSynthesis.FrameBound v (min (2*r) (Fintype.card I)) b)
    (hr : ∀ x, (rowOnes a x).card ≤ r) (hc : ∀ y, (columnZeros a s y).card ≤ r) (g : G) :
    ‖coboundary KernelObstruction.translation (oriented v s a) g‖ ≤ b^2 := by
  rw [difference_operator]
  apply masked_bound_of_frame _ _ _ _ hb hv
  · intro x
    have h : rowSet (fun x i => boolComplex (a x i) - boolComplex (a (g⁻¹*x) i)) x = rowDifference a g x := by
      ext i
      simp [rowSet, rowDifference, difference_mask_ne_zero]
    rw [h]
    exact rowDifference_card_le a r hr g x
  · intro y
    have h : columnSet s (fun x i => boolComplex (a x i) - boolComplex (a (g⁻¹*x) i)) y = columnDifference a s g y := by
      ext i
      simp [columnSet, columnDifference, difference_mask_ne_zero]
    rw [h]
    exact columnDifference_card_le a s r hc g y

end Masked
end Dixmier

end

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Parameters:.name: OAI.Dixmier.fiberDimension

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.KernelObstr.name: OAI.Dixmier.KernelObstruction.translation
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.KernelObstr.text:
def translation : G →* Op G K where
  toFun g := (reindexIsometry (K := K) (Equiv.mulLeft g⁻¹)).toContinuousLinearMap
  map_one' := by ext ξ x a; simp [reindexIsometry, reindex]
  map_mul' g h := by ext ξ x a; simp [reindexIsometry, reindex]

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Parameters:.name: OAI.Dixmier.fiberDimension_pos
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Parameters:.text:
theorem fiberDimension_pos {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    0 < fiberDimension d ρ ℓ := by
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) < endpointCapacity d ρ ℓ := by exact_mod_cast endpointCapacity_pos hd hρ ℓ
  have hdR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ d)
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ)^ℓ := one_le_pow₀ hdR
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (2 * (d : ℝ)^ℓ) := Real.log_pos (by nlinarith)
  apply Nat.ceil_pos.mpr
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) hr) hlog

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.LocalBounds.name: OAI.Dixmier.Masked.local_row_bound
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.LocalBounds.text:
theorem local_row_bound (v : I → Fibre K) (s : I → G) (a : G → I → Bool)
    {r : ℕ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hv : FiniteSynthesis.FrameBound v (min (2*r) (Fintype.card I)) b)
    (hr : ∀ x, (rowOnes a x).card ≤ r) (x₀ : G) :
    ‖KernelObstruction.row (oriented v s a) x₀‖ ≤ b^2 := by
  have hJ : (rowOnes a x₀).card ≤ min (2*r) (Fintype.card I) :=
    le_min ((hr x₀).trans (by omega)) (Finset.card_le_univ _)
  have h := support_bound v s (rowMask a x₀) (rowMask_norm a x₀) hb hv (rowOnes a x₀) hJ
    (rowMask_support a x₀)
  rw [row_localization]
  exact (KernelObstruction.row_norm_le _ _).trans h

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Regular:80.name: OAI.Dixmier.word_card
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Regular:80.text:
theorem word_card {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Word I n) = (Fintype.card I) ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change Fintype.card PUnit = 1
    exact Fintype.card_unique
  | succ n ih =>
    change Fintype.card (I × Word I n) = _
    rw [Fintype.card_prod, ih, pow_succ']

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.UniverseTra.name: OAI.Dixmier.main_theorem_all_universes
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.UniverseTra.text:
theorem main_theorem_all_universes : MainTheorem.{u,v} := by
  intro G _ _ _ _ hG
  let Q := Shrink.{v} G
  let e : G ≃* Q := Shrink.mulEquiv.symm
  let : Countable Q := e.surjective.countable
  let : TopologicalSpace Q := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology Q := ⟨rfl⟩
  have hQ : ¬ Amenable Q := fun h => hG (amenable_of_mulEquiv e h)
  exact witness_of_mulEquiv e (nonamenable_witness hQ)

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Cocycle:25.name: OAI.Dixmier.coboundary
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Cocycle:25.text: def coboundary (U : G →* R) (T : R) (g : G) : R := T - conjugate U g T

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.UniverseTra.name: OAI.Dixmier.amenable_of_mulEquiv
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.UniverseTra.text:
theorem amenable_of_mulEquiv (e : G ≃* Q) (hQ : Amenable Q) : Amenable G := by
  rcases hQ with ⟨m, h1, hp, hi⟩
  refine ⟨m.comp (meanPullback e), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hc : meanPullback e (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G 1) =
        BoundedContinuousFunction.const Q 1 := by ext q; rfl
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, hc] using h1
  · intro f hf
    exact hp _ (fun q => hf (e.symm q))
  · intro g f
    have hc : meanPullback e (leftTranslate g f) = leftTranslate (e g) (meanPullback e f) := by
      ext q
      simp [meanPullback_apply, leftTranslate, map_mul, map_inv]
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, hc] using hi (e g) (meanPullback e f)

omit [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] [TopologicalSpace Q] [DiscreteTopology Q] in

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.FrameParame.name: OAI.Dixmier.FrameParameters.dimension

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.KernelObstr.name: OAI.Dixmier.KernelObstruction.Commutant
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.KernelObstr.text: def Commutant : Set (Op G K) := {F | ∀ g, Commute F (translation g)}

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.SumObstruct.name: OAI.Dixmier.DirectSumObstruction.direct_sum_obstruction
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.SumObstruct.text:
theorem direct_sum_obstruction (k : ℕ → ℕ) (hk : ∀ j, 0 < k j)
    (A T : ∀ j, Stage G k j →L[ℂ] Stage G k j)
    (hA : ∀ j, A j ∈ KernelObstruction.Commutant)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hr : ∀ j, ‖KernelObstruction.row (T j) 1‖ ≤ κ)
    (hc : ∀ j, ‖KernelObstruction.col (A j-T j) 1‖ ≤ κ)
    (hb : ∀ j g, ‖coboundary KernelObstruction.translation (T j) g‖ ≤ κ)
    (he : Tendsto (fun j => KernelObstruction.energy (A j) / k j) atTop atTop) :
    ∃ π : G →* (Carrier G k →L[ℂ] Carrier G k),
      (∀ g, ‖π g‖ ≤ 1 + κ) ∧ ¬ SimilarToUnitary π := by
  let U : ∀ j, G →* (Stage G k j →L[ℂ] Stage G k j) := fun _ => KernelObstruction.translation
  have hU : ∀ j g x, ‖U j g x‖ = ‖x‖ := stage_unitary k
  let D : ∀ j, G → (Stage G k j →L[ℂ] Stage G k j) := fun j => coboundary (U j) (T j)
  have h1 : ∀ j, D j 1 = 0 := fun j => coboundary_one (U j) (T j)
  have hD : ∀ j g h, D j (g*h) = D j g + conjugate (U j) g (D j h) :=
    fun j => coboundary_cocycle (U j) (T j)
  let V := HilbertSum.representation U hU
  let δ := HilbertSum.cocycle D hκ hb
  have hδ1 : δ 1 = 0 := HilbertSum.cocycle_one D hκ hb h1
  have hδ : ∀ g h, δ (g*h) = δ g + conjugate V g (δ h) :=
    HilbertSum.cocycle_identity U hU D hκ hb hD
  let π := Triangular.representation V δ hδ1 hδ
  have hδb : ∀ g, ‖δ g‖ ≤ κ := fun g => HilbertSum.boundedSum_norm_le _ hκ _
  refine ⟨π, Triangular.representation_bound V δ hδ1 hδ
    (HilbertSum.representation_norm_map U hU) hδb, ?_⟩
  intro hπ
  rcases Triangular.implementer_of_similar V δ hδ1 hδ hπ with ⟨B, hB⟩
  have hbound (j : ℕ) : KernelObstruction.energy (A j) / k j ≤ 4 * (κ + ‖B‖)^2 := by
    let Bj := HilbertSum.compression B j
    have hBj (g : G) : D j g = coboundary (U j) Bj g :=
      HilbertSum.compression_implementer U hU D hκ hb B hB j g
    have hC : T j - Bj ∈ KernelObstruction.Commutant := by
      intro g
      exact ((equal_coboundaries_iff_commute_sub (U j) (T j) Bj g).mp (hBj g)).symm
    have henergy := KernelObstruction.kernel_obstruction (hA j) hκ (hr j) (hc j) hC
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin, sub_sub_cancel] at henergy
    have hnorm : ‖Bj‖ ≤ ‖B‖ := HilbertSum.compression_norm_le B j
    have hs : (κ + ‖Bj‖)^2 ≤ (κ + ‖B‖)^2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (add_nonneg hκ (norm_nonneg _)) (add_le_add (le_refl _) hnorm) 2
    have henergy' : KernelObstruction.energy (A j) ≤ 4 * (k j : ℝ) * (κ + ‖B‖)^2 :=
      henergy.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by positivity))
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (hk j))).mpr
    nlinarith [henergy']
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (he.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop (4 * (κ + ‖B‖)^2))).exists
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbound j)) hj

omit [Group G] in

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Contracting.name: OAI.Dixmier.sparse_splitting_of_nonamenable
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Contracting.text:
theorem sparse_splitting_of_nonamenable (hG : ¬ Amenable G) :
    ∃ S : Finset G, 1 ∈ S ∧ 2 ≤ S.card ∧ ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < 1 ∧
      ∀ ℓ : ℕ, 0 < ℓ → ∃ a : G → Word S ℓ → Bool,
        (∀ x, (rowOnes a x).card ≤ ⌈(S.card : ℝ)^ℓ * ρ^ℓ⌉₊) ∧
        ∀ y, (columnZeros a (wordProduct (fun s : S => (s : G)) ℓ) y).card ≤
          ⌈(S.card : ℝ)^ℓ * ρ^ℓ⌉₊ := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, h1, hd, ρ, hρ, hρ1, hsum⟩ := exists_contracting_sum hG
  refine ⟨S, h1, hd, ρ, hρ, hρ1, fun ℓ hℓ => ?_⟩
  have hsum' : ‖∑ g : S, rightRegular (g : G)‖ ≤ (Fintype.card S : ℝ) * ρ := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe, Finset.sum_coe_sort] using hsum
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using
    sparse_mask_for_words (fun s : S => (s : G)) hρ.le hsum' ℓ hℓ

end Dixmier

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.LocalBounds.name: OAI.Dixmier.Masked.local_column_bound
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.LocalBounds.text:
theorem local_column_bound (v : I → Fibre K) (s : I → G) (a : G → I → Bool)
    {r : ℕ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hv : FiniteSynthesis.FrameBound v (min (2*r) (Fintype.card I)) b)
    (hc : ∀ y, (columnZeros a s y).card ≤ r) (y₀ : G) :
    ‖KernelObstruction.col (constant v s - oriented v s a) y₀‖ ≤ b^2 := by
  have hJ : (columnZeros a s y₀).card ≤ min (2*r) (Fintype.card I) :=
    le_min ((hc y₀).trans (by omega)) (Finset.card_le_univ _)
  have h := support_bound v s (columnMask a s y₀) (columnMask_norm a s y₀) hb hv (columnZeros a s y₀) hJ
    (columnMask_support a s y₀)
  rw [column_localization]
  exact (KernelObstruction.col_norm_le _ _).trans h

end Masked
end Dixmier

end

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.UniverseTra.name: OAI.Dixmier.witness_of_mulEquiv
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.UniverseTra.text:
theorem witness_of_mulEquiv (e : G ≃* Q) (hQ : NonamenableWitness.{v,w} Q) :
    NonamenableWitness.{u,w} G := by
  rcases hQ with ⟨H, hnorm, hinner, hcomplete, hsep, π, hb, hn⟩
  refine ⟨H, hnorm, hinner, hcomplete, hsep, π.comp e.toMonoidHom, fun g => hb (e g), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨S, hS⟩
  apply hn
  refine ⟨S, ?_⟩
  intro q x
  simpa only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, e.apply_symm_apply] using hS (e.symm q) x

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.KernelObstr.name: OAI.Dixmier.KernelObstruction.col
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.KernelObstr.text:
def col (F : Op G K) (y : G) : Fibre K →L[ℂ] Space G K :=
  F.comp (inclusion y)

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Model:16.name: OAI.Dixmier.leftTranslate
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Model:16.text:
def leftTranslate {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [DiscreteTopology G] (g : G) (f : G →ᵇ ℂ) : G →ᵇ ℂ :=
  f.compContinuous ⟨fun x => g⁻¹ * x, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Model:21.name: OAI.Dixmier.Amenable
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Model:21.text:
def Amenable (G : Type u) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    [DiscreteTopology G] : Prop :=
  ∃ m : (G →ᵇ ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ,
    m (BoundedContinuousFunction.const G 1) = 1 ∧
    (∀ f : G →ᵇ ℂ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0) →
      0 ≤ (m f).re ∧ (m f).im = 0) ∧
    ∀ (g : G) (f : G →ᵇ ℂ), m (leftTranslate g f) = m f

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Main:18.name: OAI.Dixmier.nonamenable_witness
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Main:18.text:
theorem nonamenable_witness (hG : ¬ Amenable G) : NonamenableWitness.{u,u} G := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hd, ρ, hρ, hρ1, hmask⟩ := sparse_splitting_of_nonamenable hG
  let d := S.card
  let k : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => fiberDimension d ρ (j+1)
  let r : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => endpointCapacity d ρ (j+1)
  let Labels : ℕ → Type u := fun j => Word S (j+1)
  let s : ∀ j, Labels j → G := fun j => wordProduct (fun x : S => (x : G)) (j+1)
  have hlabel (j : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Labels j) = d^(j+1) := by
    simp [Labels, word_card, d]
  have hn (j : ℕ) : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (Labels j) := by
    rw [hlabel]
    have hp : 1 ≤ d^j := one_le_pow₀ (by omega : 1 ≤ d)
    rw [pow_succ']
    dsimp [d] at *
    nlinarith
  have hr (j : ℕ) : 1 ≤ r j := endpointCapacity_pos hd hρ (j+1)
  have hk (j : ℕ) : 0 < k j := fiberDimension_pos hd hρ (j+1)
  have hdim (j : ℕ) : FrameParameters.dimension (Fintype.card (Labels j)) (r j) = k j := by
    simp [FrameParameters.dimension, hlabel, k, fiberDimension, r, Nat.cast_pow]
  have hframes (j : ℕ) : ∃ v : Labels j → EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin (k j)),
      (∀ i, ‖v i‖ = 1) ∧
      FiniteSynthesis.FrameBound v (min (2*r j) (Fintype.card (Labels j))) 10 := by
    have h := SignMatrix.frames_for_fintype (hn j) (hr j)
    rw [hdim j] at h
    exact h
  choose v hvunit hvframe using hframes
  have hmasks (j : ℕ) : ∃ a : G → Labels j → Bool,
      (∀ x, (rowOnes a x).card ≤ r j) ∧ ∀ y, (columnZeros a (s j) y).card ≤ r j :=
    hmask (j+1) (by omega)
  choose a har hac using hmasks
  let A : ∀ j, DirectSumObstruction.Stage G k j →L[ℂ] DirectSumObstruction.Stage G k j :=
    fun j => Masked.constant (v j) (s j)
  let T : ∀ j, DirectSumObstruction.Stage G k j →L[ℂ] DirectSumObstruction.Stage G k j :=
    fun j => Masked.oriented (v j) (s j) (a j)
  have hA (j : ℕ) : A j ∈ KernelObstruction.Commutant := Masked.constant_commutant _ _
  have hrow (j : ℕ) : ‖KernelObstruction.row (T j) 1‖ ≤ 100 := by
    have h := Masked.local_row_bound (v j) (s j) (a j) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 10) (hvframe j) (har j) 1
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have hcol (j : ℕ) : ‖KernelObstruction.col (A j-T j) 1‖ ≤ 100 := by
    have h := Masked.local_column_bound (v j) (s j) (a j) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 10) (hvframe j) (hac j) 1
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have hdiff (j : ℕ) (g : G) : ‖coboundary KernelObstruction.translation (T j) g‖ ≤ 100 := by
    have h := Masked.difference_norm_le (v j) (s j) (a j) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 10) (hvframe j) (har j) (hac j) g
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have henergy (j : ℕ) : (d : ℝ)^(j+1) ≤ KernelObstruction.energy (A j) := by
    have h := Masked.constant_energy_ge_card (v j) (hvunit j) (s j)
    rw [hlabel] at h
    simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using h
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun j => KernelObstruction.energy (A j) / k j) atTop atTop := by
    have hbase := (reciprocal_dimension_ratio_tendsto hd hρ hρ1).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    apply tendsto_atTop_mono _ hbase
    intro j
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (henergy j) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨π, hπbound, hπnot⟩ := DirectSumObstruction.direct_sum_obstruction k hk A T hA
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 100) hrow hcol hdiff hratio
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (DirectSumObstruction.Carrier G k) :=
    DirectSumObstruction.carrier_separable k
  refine ⟨DirectSumObstruction.Carrier G k, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    π, ?_, hπnot⟩
  intro g
  convert hπbound g using 1
  norm_num

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Parameters:.name: OAI.Dixmier.reciprocal_dimension_ratio_tendsto
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Parameters:.text:
theorem reciprocal_dimension_ratio_tendsto {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {ρ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) :
    Tendsto (fun ℓ : ℕ => (d : ℝ)^ℓ / (fiberDimension d ρ ℓ : ℝ)) atTop atTop := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun ℓ : ℕ => (fiberDimension d ρ ℓ : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)^ℓ)
      atTop (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) := by
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨dimension_ratio_tendsto hd hρ.le hρ1, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ℓ => ?_)⟩
    change 0 < (fiberDimension d ρ ℓ : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)^ℓ
    apply div_pos
    · exact_mod_cast fiberDimension_pos hd hρ ℓ
    · exact pow_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < d)) _
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, inv_div] using tendsto_inv_nhdsGT_zero.comp ht

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Frames:85.name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.frames_for_fintype
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Frames:85.text:
theorem frames_for_fintype {r : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card I) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    ∃ v : I → EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin (FrameParameters.dimension (Fintype.card I) r)),
      (∀ i, ‖v i‖ = 1) ∧
      FiniteSynthesis.FrameBound v (FrameParameters.subfamilySize (Fintype.card I) r) 10 := by
  have hk : 0 < FrameParameters.dimension (Fintype.card I) r := (FrameParameters.bounds hn hr).1
  let : Nonempty (Fin (FrameParameters.dimension (Fintype.card I) r)) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hk
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_sign_matrix hk (FrameParameters.exact_failure_bound hn hr)
  let q := Fintype.equivFin I
  let σ' : Fin (FrameParameters.dimension (Fintype.card I) r) × I → Bool := fun ai => σ (ai.1, q ai.2)
  have hσ' (e : Fin (FrameParameters.subfamilySize (Fintype.card I) r) ↪ I) : ‖synthesis σ' e‖ ≤ 10 := by
    have hid : synthesis σ' e = synthesis σ (e.trans q.toEmbedding) := rfl
    rw [hid]
    exact hσ _
  refine ⟨fun i => ComplexFrames.ofReal (vector σ' i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [ComplexFrames.ofReal_norm, vector_norm]
  · exact all_subfamilies (Nat.min_le_right _ _) σ' hσ'


end SignMatrix

    constant v s ∈ KernelObstruction.Commutant := by

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Amenable:12.name: OAI.Dixmier.DayDixmier.representation_similar
OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.Amenable:12.text:
theorem representation_similar {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (hG : Amenable G) (π : G →* (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hb : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g, ‖π g‖ ≤ C) : SimilarToUnitary π := by
  obtain ⟨m, h1, hp, hinv⟩ := hG
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb
  let M : ℝ := max C 1
  have hM : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  have hπ : ∀ g, ‖π g‖ ≤ M := fun g => (hC g).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  let B : H →L⋆[ℂ] H →L[ℂ] ℂ := (averagedForm π hM.le hπ m).mkContinuous₂
    (2 * M^2) (averagedForm_bound π hM.le hπ m h1 hp)
  let Q : H →L[ℂ] H := InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin B
  have hQ (x y : H) : inner ℂ (Q x) y = m (coefficient π hM.le hπ x y) := by
    exact InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin_apply B x y
  have hQpos : Q.IsPositive := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff_complex]
    intro x
    rw [hQ]
    have h := averagedForm_nonneg π hM.le hπ m hp x
    refine ⟨?_, h.1⟩
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [h.2]
  have hQnonneg : 0 ≤ Q := ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive.mpr hQpos
  have hunit : IsUnit Q := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_of_forall_le_norm_inner_map Q
      (c := ⟨(M^2)⁻¹, inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg M)⟩)
        (by change (0 : ℝ) < (M^2)⁻¹; positivity)
    intro x
    change ‖x‖^2 * (M^2)⁻¹ ≤ _
    rw [hQ]
    calc
      ‖x‖^2 * (M^2)⁻¹ ≤ (m (coefficient π hM.le hπ x x)).re := by
        rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hM)]
        simpa only [mul_comm] using averagedForm_lower π hM.le hπ m h1 hp x
      _ ≤ ‖m (coefficient π hM.le hπ x x)‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (CFC.isUnit_sqrt_iff Q hQnonneg).mpr hunit
  let S : H ≃L[ℂ] H := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofUnit s
  have hS (x : H) : S x = CFC.sqrt Q x := by
    change (s : H →L[ℂ] H) x = _
    rw [hs]
  have hSsymmetric := (ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive.mp
    (CFC.sqrt_nonneg Q)).isSymmetric
  have hdiag (x : H) : ‖S x‖^2 = (m (coefficient π hM.le hπ x x)).re := by
    rw [hS, ← inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ)]
    have heq : inner ℂ (CFC.sqrt Q x) (CFC.sqrt Q x) = inner ℂ (Q x) x := by
      calc
        _ = inner ℂ (CFC.sqrt Q (CFC.sqrt Q x)) x := (hSsymmetric _ _).symm
        _ = inner ℂ (Q x) x := by
          congr 1
          exact congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T x) (CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self Q hQnonneg)
    rw [heq, hQ, RCLike.re_to_complex]
  refine ⟨S, ?_⟩
  intro g x
  have hequal : ‖S (π g (S.symm x))‖^2 = ‖x‖^2 := by
    rw [hdiag, coefficient_translate, hinv, ← hdiag, S.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp hequal

end DayDixmier

universe v

OAI.Analysis.Unitarizability.AllDiscrete.text:
theorem current_main_theorem : CurrentMainTheorem.{u,v} := by
  intro G _ _ _
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro hG
      exact amenable_unitarizable hG
    · intro hunit
      by_contra hnot
      obtain ⟨H, hnorm, hinner, hcomplete, π, _, hb, hn⟩ :=
        nonamenable_near_one_large.{u,v} hnot 1 zero_lt_one
      exact hn (@hunit H hnorm hinner hcomplete π ⟨1 + 1, hb⟩)
  · intro ε hε hG
    exact nonamenable_near_one_large.{u,v} hG ε hε

end Dixmier

OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Main:57.name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.main
OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Main:57.text:
theorem main : ∃ S : Set RealL2,
    DoublingAtMost S 76800 ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → ¬ AdmitsBiLipschitzEmbedding S k := by
  refine ⟨constructedSet, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x r hr
    exact constructedSet_cover x hr
  · intro k _ hEmbedding
    obtain ⟨f, a, ha, D, hD, hf⟩ := hEmbedding
    exact no_scaled_embedding f ha hD hf

OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Main:29.name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.no_scaled_embedding
OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Main:29.text:
theorem no_scaled_embedding (f : constructedSet → E) {a D : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hD : 1 ≤ D)
    (hf : ∀ x y, a * dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y) ∧
      dist (f x) (f y) ≤ D * a * dist x y) : False := by
  let g : constructedSet → E := fun x => a⁻¹ • f x
  let D' : NNReal := ⟨D, le_trans zero_le_one hD⟩
  have hdist (x y : constructedSet) : dist (g x) (g y) = a⁻¹ * dist (f x) (f y) := by
    simp only [g, dist_eq_norm, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos ha]
  have hg : LipschitzWith D' g := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x y => by
    rw [hdist]
    change a⁻¹ * dist (f x) (f y) ≤ D * dist x y
    calc
      _ ≤ a⁻¹ * (D * a * dist x y) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf x y).2 (inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le)
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  apply no_normalized_embedding hg
  intro x y
  rw [hdist]
  calc
    dist x y = a⁻¹ * (a * dist x y) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf x y).1 (inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le)

end Nonembedding

OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Model:10.name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.DoublingAtMost
OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Model:10.text:
def DoublingAtMost (S : Set RealL2) (bound : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : S, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
    ∃ centers : Finset S, centers.card ≤ bound ∧
      ∀ y : S, dist y x < r → ∃ c ∈ centers, dist y c < r / 2

OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Main:20.name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.no_normalized_embedding
OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Main:20.text:
theorem no_normalized_embedding {f : constructedSet → E} {D : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzWith D f) (hlower : ∀ p q, dist p q ≤ dist (f p) (f q)) : False := by
  obtain ⟨bound, hbound⟩ := isCompact_exists_packing_bound
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) (D : ℝ)) (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hsep⟩ := exists_separated_family hf hlower (bound + 1) (by omega)
  have hc := hbound z (fun i => by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hz i) hsep
  omega

OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Model:16.name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.AdmitsBiLipschitzEmbedding
OAI.Geometry.DoublingHilbert.Model:16.text:
def AdmitsBiLipschitzEmbedding (S : Set RealL2) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : S → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k),
    ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ ∃ D : ℝ, 1 ≤ D ∧
      ∀ x y : S, a * dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y) ∧
        dist (f x) (f y) ≤ D * a * dist x y

end DoublingHilbert

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.HaarUnique.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.isHaarProbability_unique
OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.HaarUnique.text:
theorem isHaarProbability_unique {n : ℕ} {μ ν : Measure (X n)}
    (hμ : IsHaarProbability μ) (hν : IsHaarProbability ν) : μ = ν := by
  let : MeasurableSpace (G n) := borel (G n)
  let : BorelSpace (G n) := ⟨rfl⟩
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hμ.1
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν.1
  exact invariant_probability_unique_transitive (@rightAction n)
    (continuous_rightAction_uncurry n).measurable
    (fun g => (rightActionHomeomorph g).toMeasurableEquiv) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun x g h => rightAction_mul x g h) (rightAction_transitive n)
    (Measure.haar : Measure (G n)) μ ν hμ.2 hν.2

end PrimeDegreePackets

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.orbitProbability

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.IsHaarProbability

OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainUnc.name: OAI.DukePrimeDegree.prime_degree_packet_equidistribution_unconditional
OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainUnc.text:
theorem prime_degree_packet_equidistribution_unconditional
    (d : ℕ) (hprime : Nat.Prime (d+1)) (hfive : 5 ≤ d+1)
    (K : ℕ → Type u) [∀ i, Field (K i)] [∀ i, NumberField (K i)]
    [∀ i, NumberField.IsTotallyReal (K i)]
    (M : ∀ i, PrimeDegreePackets.FullLattice (d+1) (K i))
    (σ : ∀ i, OrderedEmbeddings (d+1) (K i))
    (hn : ∀ i, Module.finrank ℚ (K i)=d+1)
    (hD : Tendsto (fun i => PrimeDegreePackets.multiplierDiscriminant (M i)) atTop atTop) :
    ∃ ν : ProbabilityMeasure (X (d+1)),
      IsHaarProbability (ν : Measure (X (d+1))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun i => packetProbability (M i) (σ i) (hn i)
        (hprime.odd_of_ne_two (by omega))) atTop (𝓝 ν) ∧
      IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range (fun i => packetMeasure (M i) (σ i))) := by
  exact prime_degree_packet_equidistribution_of_EKL d hprime hfive
    (eklPrimeInput_unconditional d) K M σ hn hD

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.multiplierOrder
OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.text:
def multiplierOrder {n : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (M : FullLattice n K) : AddSubgroup K where
  carrier := {a | ∀ x ∈ M.carrier, a * x ∈ M.carrier}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro a b ha hb x hx
    simpa only [add_mul] using M.carrier.add_mem (ha x hx) (hb x hx)
  neg_mem' := by
    intro a ha x hx
    simpa only [neg_mul] using M.carrier.neg_mem (ha x hx)

OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainSta.name: OAI.DukePrimeDegree.prime_degree_packet_equidistribution_of_EKL
OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainSta.text:
theorem prime_degree_packet_equidistribution_of_EKL
    (d : ℕ) (hprime : Nat.Prime (d+1)) (hfive : 5 ≤ d+1)
    (ekl : EKLPrimeInput d)
    (K : ℕ → Type u) [∀ i, Field (K i)] [∀ i, NumberField (K i)]
    [∀ i, NumberField.IsTotallyReal (K i)]
    (M : ∀ i, PrimeDegreePackets.FullLattice (d+1) (K i))
    (σ : ∀ i, OrderedEmbeddings (d+1) (K i))
    (hn : ∀ i, Module.finrank ℚ (K i)=d+1)
    (hD : Tendsto (fun i => PrimeDegreePackets.multiplierDiscriminant (M i)) atTop atTop) :
    ∃ ν : ProbabilityMeasure (X (d+1)),
      IsHaarProbability (ν : Measure (X (d+1))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun i => packetProbability (M i) (σ i) (hn i)
        (hprime.odd_of_ne_two (by omega))) atTop (𝓝 ν) ∧
      IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range (fun i => packetMeasure (M i) (σ i))) := by
  exact prime_degree_packet_equidistribution_of_real_zero_exclusion d hprime hfive
    (exceptionalRealZeroExclusion_unconditional d (hprime.odd_of_ne_two (by omega)))
    ekl K M σ hn hD

end DukePrimeDegree

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.packetMeasure
OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.text:
def packetMeasure {d : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (M : FullLattice (d + 1) K) (σ : OrderedEmbeddings (d + 1) K) : Measure (X (d + 1)) :=
  (∑' O : packetOrbits M σ, orbitVolume (orbitBasepoint O))⁻¹ •
    Measure.sum (fun O : packetOrbits M σ =>
      orbitVolume (orbitBasepoint O) • orbitProbability (orbitBasepoint O))

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.integralElements

def integralElements (K : Type*) [Field K] : AddSubgroup K :=

OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainUnc.name: OAI.DukePrimeDegree.prime_degree_packet_measure_equidistribution_unconditional
OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainUnc.text:
theorem prime_degree_packet_measure_equidistribution_unconditional
    (d : ℕ) (hprime : Nat.Prime (d+1)) (hfive : 5 ≤ d+1)
    (K : ℕ → Type u) [∀ i, Field (K i)] [∀ i, NumberField (K i)]
    [∀ i, NumberField.IsTotallyReal (K i)]
    (M : ∀ i, PrimeDegreePackets.FullLattice (d+1) (K i))
    (σ : ∀ i, OrderedEmbeddings (d+1) (K i))
    (hn : ∀ i, Module.finrank ℚ (K i)=d+1)
    (hD : Tendsto (fun i => PrimeDegreePackets.multiplierDiscriminant (M i)) atTop atTop) :
    ∃ ν : Measure (X (d+1)), IsHaarProbability ν ∧
      WeakProbabilityConvergence (fun i => packetMeasure (M i) (σ i)) ν ∧
      IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range (fun i => packetMeasure (M i) (σ i))) := by
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, hconv, htight⟩ :=
    prime_degree_packet_equidistribution_unconditional d hprime hfive K M σ hn hD
  refine ⟨(ν : Measure (X (d+1))), hν, ?_, htight⟩
  exact (weakProbabilityConvergence_iff
    (fun i => packetProbability (M i) (σ i) (hn i)
      (hprime.odd_of_ne_two (by omega))) ν).mpr hconv

OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainUnc.name: OAI.DukePrimeDegree.prime_degree_packets_tendsto_haar_unconditional
OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainUnc.text:
theorem prime_degree_packets_tendsto_haar_unconditional
    (d : ℕ) (hprime : Nat.Prime (d+1)) (hfive : 5 ≤ d+1)
    (K : ℕ → Type u) [∀ i, Field (K i)] [∀ i, NumberField (K i)]
    [∀ i, NumberField.IsTotallyReal (K i)]
    (M : ∀ i, PrimeDegreePackets.FullLattice (d+1) (K i))
    (σ : ∀ i, OrderedEmbeddings (d+1) (K i))
    (hn : ∀ i, Module.finrank ℚ (K i)=d+1)
    (hD : Tendsto (fun i => PrimeDegreePackets.multiplierDiscriminant (M i)) atTop atTop)
    (m : ProbabilityMeasure (X (d+1)))
    (hm : IsHaarProbability (m : Measure (X (d+1)))) :
    Tendsto (fun i => packetProbability (M i) (σ i) (hn i)
      (hprime.odd_of_ne_two (by omega))) atTop (𝓝 m) := by
  obtain ⟨ν,hν,hconv,_⟩ :=
    prime_degree_packet_equidistribution_unconditional d hprime hfive K M σ hn hD
  have heq : ν=m := Subtype.ext (isHaarProbability_unique hν hm)
  rwa [heq] at hconv

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.rightAction
OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.text:
def rightAction {n : ℕ} (x : X n) (g : G n) : X n :=
  Quotient.map (fun h => h * g) (by
    intro a b hab
    change (QuotientGroup.rightRel (integralGroup n)) a b at hab
    change (QuotientGroup.rightRel (integralGroup n)) (a * g) (b * g)
    rw [QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply] at hab ⊢
    simpa only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left] using hab) x

OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainUnc.name: OAI.DukePrimeDegree.prime_degree_packet_measures_tendsto_haar_unconditional
OAI.NumberTheory.DukePrimeDegree.MainUnc.text:
theorem prime_degree_packet_measures_tendsto_haar_unconditional
    (d : ℕ) (hprime : Nat.Prime (d+1)) (hfive : 5 ≤ d+1)
    (K : ℕ → Type u) [∀ i, Field (K i)] [∀ i, NumberField (K i)]
    [∀ i, NumberField.IsTotallyReal (K i)]
    (M : ∀ i, PrimeDegreePackets.FullLattice (d+1) (K i))
    (σ : ∀ i, OrderedEmbeddings (d+1) (K i))
    (hn : ∀ i, Module.finrank ℚ (K i)=d+1)
    (hD : Tendsto (fun i => PrimeDegreePackets.multiplierDiscriminant (M i)) atTop atTop)
    (m : ProbabilityMeasure (X (d+1)))
    (hm : IsHaarProbability (m : Measure (X (d+1)))) :
    WeakProbabilityConvergence (fun i => packetMeasure (M i) (σ i))
      (m : Measure (X (d+1))) := by
  exact (weakProbabilityConvergence_iff
    (fun i => packetProbability (M i) (σ i) (hn i)
      (hprime.odd_of_ne_two (by omega))) m).mpr
    (prime_degree_packets_tendsto_haar_unconditional d hprime hfive K M σ hn hD m hm)

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.packetOrbits
OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.text:
def packetOrbits {d : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (M : FullLattice (d + 1) K) (σ : OrderedEmbeddings (d + 1) K) :
    Set (Set (X (d + 1))) :=
  {O | ∃ M' : FullLattice (d + 1) K, LocallyHomothetic M M' ∧
    ∃ w ∈ signMatrices (d + 1), O = diagonalOrbit (rightAction (latticePoint M' σ) w)}

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.name: OAI.PrimeDegreePackets.WeakProbabilityConvergence
OAI.NumberTheory.PrimePackets.PacketAlge.text:
def WeakProbabilityConvergence {n : ℕ} (μ : ℕ → Measure (X n)) (m : Measure (X n)) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)) ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure m ∧
    ∀ f : BoundedContinuousFunction (X n) ℝ,
    Tendsto (fun i => ∫ x, f x ∂μ i) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂m))

end PrimeDegreePackets

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.ResidueExten.name: OAI.Lech.residueExtension
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.ResidueExten.text:
def residueExtension : ResidueExtension R := by
  let k := R ⧸ maximalIdeal R
  letI : Field k := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  let φ := ArbitraryCoefficientField.localSection R p
  letI : Algebra k R := φ.toAlgebra
  have hres : Function.Bijective (algebraMap k (ResidueField R)) := by
    have h : ∀ a : k,algebraMap k (ResidueField R) a=a :=
      ArbitraryCoefficientField.localSection_rightInverse R p
    exact ⟨fun a b hab => (h a).symm.trans (hab.trans (h b)), fun a => ⟨a,h a⟩⟩
  let K := AlgebraicClosure k
  let T := R ⊗[k] K
  letI : IsLocalRing T := ResidueTensor.isLocal k R K hres
  have hmax : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R T)=maximalIdeal T :=
    (ResidueTensor.maximalIdeal_eq_map k R K hres).symm
  have fg : (maximalIdeal T).FG := hmax ▸ (maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing.map _
  let ψ : K →+* T := (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R:=k) (A:=R)).toRingHom
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ((residue T).comp ψ) :=
    ResidueTensor.residue_surjective k R K hres hmax.symm
  let S := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal T) T
  letI : IsLocalRing S := AdicCompletion.isLocalRing_of_fg fg
  letI : IsNoetherianRing S := ResidueCompletion.noetherian fg ψ hψ
  letI : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal S) S := AdicCompletion.isAdicComplete_of_fg fg
  letI : IsScalarTower R T S := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  letI : Module.Free R T := inferInstance
  letI : Module.Flat R S := ResidueCompletion.flat hmax inferInstance
  have hmaxS : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S)=maximalIdeal S := by
    rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map_of_fg fg]
    calc
      (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S)=
          ((maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R T)).map (algebraMap T S) := by
            rw [Ideal.map_map]
            rfl
      _ = (maximalIdeal T).map (algebraMap T S) := congrArg (Ideal.map (algebraMap T S)) hmax
  let e : K ≃+* ResidueField S := RingEquiv.ofBijective
    ((residue S).comp (ResidueCompletion.coefficient ψ))
    ⟨RingHom.injective _,ResidueCompletion.coefficient_surjective fg ψ hψ⟩
  exact ⟨S,inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,
    inferInstance,hmaxS,IsAlgClosed.of_ringEquiv K (ResidueField S) e⟩

end Lech

end

end OAI

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaBaseCha.name: OAI.Lech.duttaSequence_baseChange
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaBaseCha.text:
lemma duttaSequence_baseChange (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP R p] [CharP S p]
    (hmax : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S)=maximalIdeal S)
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    duttaSequence S p (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj F) n=duttaSequence R p F n := by
  unfold duttaSequence shortEuler
  rw [dimension_eq_of_map_maximalIdeal hmax]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have he := (homologyMapIso (frobeniusBaseChangeIso p (algebraMap R S) F n) (-(i:ℤ))).toLinearEquiv.length_eq
  rw [← he,flat_homology_length hmax]

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaBaseCha.name: OAI.Lech.shortComplex_baseChange
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaBaseCha.text:
lemma shortComplex_baseChange
    (hmax : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S)=maximalIdeal S)
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (hF : IsShortComplex R F) :
    IsShortComplex S (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj F) := by
  let G := (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F)
  have hG := finiteHomology_extendScalars (algebraMap R S)
    (dimension_eq_of_map_maximalIdeal hmax)
    (by rw [hmax]; exact Ideal.IsPrime.radical inferInstance) F hF.finiteHomology
  refine ⟨hG.term_free,hG.term_finite,hG.bounded,hG.homology_finite_length,?_⟩
  intro hz
  have : Subsingleton (G.homology 0) := ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hz
  have he : Module.length R (F.homology 0)=0 :=
    (flat_homology_length hmax F 0).symm.trans (Module.length_eq_zero (R:=S) (M:=G.homology 0))
  exact hF.homology_zero_nonzero
    (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr (Module.length_eq_zero_iff.mp he))

end Lech

end

end OAI

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaFrobeni.name: OAI.Lech.frobenius_finiteHomology
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaFrobeni.text:
lemma frobenius_finiteHomology (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hF : IsFiniteHomologyComplex R F) (n : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteHomologyComplex R (frobeniusComplex R p n F) := by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_,fun i => ?_,fun i hi => ?_,fun i => ?_⟩
  · let := hF.term_free i
    exact free_extendScalars (iterateFrobenius R p n) (F.X i)
  · let := hF.term_finite i
    exact finite_extendScalars (iterateFrobenius R p n) (F.X i)
  · exact (ModuleCat.extendScalars (iterateFrobenius R p n)).map_isZero (hF.bounded i hi)
  · exact frobenius_shortComplex_homology_finiteLength p F hF n i
end Lech

end

end OAI

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaAlgClos.name: OAI.Lech.dutta_algClosed
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaAlgClos.text:
lemma dutta_algClosed (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP R p]
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (hF : IsShortComplex R F) :
    Tendsto (duttaSequence R p F) atTop (𝓝 (duttaMultiplicity R p F)) ∧
      multiplicity R ≤ duttaMultiplicity R p F := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ps,hps⟩ := PrimeFiltration.factors_of_above
    (PrimeFiltration.exists_above (⊥ : Submodule R R))
  have he (n : ℕ) : duttaSequence R p F n=
      (ps.map (fun P => cyclicDuttaSequence p F P n)).sum := by
    unfold duttaSequence cyclicDuttaSequence
    rw [List.sum_map_mul_left,hps.euler_self _ (frobenius_finiteHomology p F hF.finiteHomology n)]
  have ht := tendsto_list_sum ps (fun P hP => by
    have := hps.isPrime P hP
    exact cyclicDuttaSequence_tendsto p F hF P)
  have ht' : Tendsto (duttaSequence R p F) atTop
      (𝓝 (ps.map (cyclicDuttaContribution p F)).sum) := ht.congr (fun n => (he n).symm)
  have hl : duttaMultiplicity R p F=(ps.map (cyclicDuttaContribution p F)).sum := ht'.limUnder_eq
  rw [hl]
  refine ⟨ht',?_⟩
  rw [hps.multiplicity_self]
  apply List.sum_le_sum
  intro P hP
  have := hps.isPrime P hP
  exact cyclicDuttaContribution_lower p F hF P
end Lech

end

end OAI

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.FlatLocalSup.name: OAI.Lech.multiplicity_eq_of_map_maximalIdeal
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.FlatLocalSup.text:
lemma multiplicity_eq_of_map_maximalIdeal
    (h : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S) = maximalIdeal S) :
    multiplicity S = multiplicity R := by
  have hd : dimension S = dimension R := by
    unfold dimension
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_map_maximalIdeal h]
  have hn : normalizedColength S = normalizedColength R := by
    funext n
    unfold normalizedColength
    rw [hd, colength_eq_of_map_maximalIdeal h]
  unfold multiplicity
  rw [hn]
end Lech

end

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaDomain:.text:

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaDomain:.name: OAI.Lech.dutta_complete_charp
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaDomain:.text:
lemma dutta_complete_charp (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP R p]
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (hF : IsShortComplex R F) :
    (∀ n i,IsFiniteLength R ((frobeniusComplex R p n F).homology i)) ∧
      Tendsto (duttaSequence R p F) atTop (𝓝 (duttaMultiplicity R p F)) ∧
      multiplicity R ≤ duttaMultiplicity R p F := by
  let E := residueExtension R p
  let S := E.S
  have : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S) := isLocalHom_of_map_maximal _ E.maximal_map
  have : CharP S p := (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime)).mpr (by
    have h := congrArg (algebraMap R S) (CharP.cast_eq_zero R p)
    simpa only [map_natCast,map_zero] using h)
  let G := (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F)
  have hG : IsShortComplex S G := shortComplex_baseChange E.maximal_map F hF
  have he : duttaSequence S p G=duttaSequence R p F :=
    funext (duttaSequence_baseChange p E.maximal_map F)
  have hm : duttaMultiplicity S p G=duttaMultiplicity R p F := congrArg (limUnder atTop) he
  obtain ⟨ht,hl⟩ := dutta_algClosed p G hG
  rw [he,hm] at ht
  rw [hm,multiplicity_eq_of_map_maximalIdeal E.maximal_map] at hl
  exact ⟨fun n i => (frobenius_finiteHomology p F hF.finiteHomology n).homology_finite_length i,ht,hl⟩

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.SubalgebraSt.name: OAI.Lech.multiplicity
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.SubalgebraSt.text:

OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaDomain:.name: OAI.Lech.isLocalHom_of_map_maximal
OAI.RingTheory.Multiplicity.DuttaDomain:.text:
lemma isLocalHom_of_map_maximal {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (hmax : (maximalIdeal R).map φ=maximalIdeal S) : IsLocalHom φ := by
  constructor
  intro x hx
  by_contra hn
  have hm : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := (mem_maximalIdeal x).mpr hn
  have hm' : φ x ∈ maximalIdeal S := hmax ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ hm
  exact hm' hx

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Constr.name: OAI.Problem310.Construction.periodic_hitting_of_window_failure
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Constr.text:
theorem periodic_hitting_of_window_failure
    {M d g r₀ : ℕ} (W : WindowData (M + 1) d g r₀)
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (G : Set ℝ) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (hbad : volume (Gᶜ ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p)
    (hgood : ∀ x ∈ G,
      ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress (selectorEndpoints W))
        (TerminalAddress (terminalEndpoints W)) p hp.le hp1.le
        {ω | x ∈ Auxiliary.exceptionalCenters
          (RoutedSetDensity.routedSet (selectorEndpoints W) (terminalEndpoints W) ω)
          (Ici 1) (fun n => (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n)} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * p)) :
    ∃ H : Set ℝ, IsOpen H ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, x + 1 ∈ H ↔ x ∈ H) ∧
      volume (H ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (6 * p) ∧
      ∀ x t : ℝ, t ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 →
        ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ x + t * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n) ∈ H := by
  classical
  apply Auxiliary.periodic_hitting_of_raw_construction
    (ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress (selectorEndpoints W))
      (TerminalAddress (terminalEndpoints W)) p hp.le hp1.le)
    p hp (RoutedSetDensity.routedSet (selectorEndpoints W) (terminalEndpoints W))
    (RoutedSetDensity.routedSet_periodic _ _) (Ici 1) (fun _ hn => hn)
    G hG hbad
  · have hmean := RoutedSetDensity.expected_routedSet_density
      (selectorEndpoints W) (terminalEndpoints W)
      (ConcreteLabels.selectorLaw (SelectorAddress (selectorEndpoints W)))
      (ConcreteLabels.bitLaw p hp.le hp1.le)
    simpa only [ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw, ConcreteLabels.terminalLaw,
      ConcreteLabels.bitLaw_true] using hmean.le
  · exact hgood

end Problem310.Construction

end

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Main:8.name: OAI.Problem310.periodic_hitting_set
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Main:8.text:
theorem periodic_hitting_set :
    ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → p < 1 → ∃ H : Set ℝ, IsOpen H ∧ OnePeriodic H ∧ periodDensity H ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (6 * p) ∧ ∀ x t : ℝ, t ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 → ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ x + t * dyadicPoint n ∈ H := by
  intro p hp hp1
  obtain ⟨M, d, R, hM, hd, hR, _, hsurvival, hbudget⟩ :=
    RoutingBudget.exists_nondefault_parameters p hp hp1
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgeo⟩ := exists_windowData_selector_stability M d p hp
  let W := WindowConstruction.windowData (M + 1) d g R (by omega) hR
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hGp, hbad, hstable⟩ := hgeo R W
  apply Construction.periodic_hitting_of_window_failure W p hp hp1 G hG hbad
  intro x hx
  apply CenterFailureBound.raw_failure_le_of_outcome_center_atoms
    (FiniteTableModel.selectorEndpoints W) (FiniteTableModel.terminalEndpoints W)
    p hp.le hp1.le
    (RoutedSetDensity.routedSet (FiniteTableModel.selectorEndpoints W)
      (FiniteTableModel.terminalEndpoints W)) (Set.Ici 1) x
    (RoutingBudget.ennreal_survival_lt hp M d hsurvival).le
  intro ξ hξ
  apply ConcreteWindowAtom.raw_failure_on_good_atom W hM p hp.le hp1.le
    (fun r hr N hN => (hbudget r hr N hN).le) x ?_ ξ hξ
  intro P i n hn t ht ω
  exact (hstable x hx P i n hn t ht ω).symm

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.name: OAI.Problem310Support.dyadic_density_budget
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.text:
theorem dyadic_density_budget {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) :
    (∑' j : ℕ, (2 : ENNReal) *
      ENNReal.ofReal (6 * (η / 48 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j)))) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (η / 2) := by
  have hterm (j : ℕ) : (2 : ENNReal) *
      ENNReal.ofReal (6 * (η / 48 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j))) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (η / 4) * ((2 : ENNReal)⁻¹ ^ j) := by
    calc
      (2 : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (6 * (η / 48 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j))) =
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (6 * (η / 48 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j)))) := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
        norm_num
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (η / 4 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j)) := by
        congr 1
        ring
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (η / 4) * ((2 : ENNReal)⁻¹ ^ j) := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity),
          ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
        norm_num
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two]
  calc
    ENNReal.ofReal (η / 4) * 2 = ENNReal.ofReal ((η / 4) * 2) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
      norm_num
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (η / 2) := by congr 1; ring

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Routin.name: OAI.Problem310.RoutingBudget.exists_nondefault_parameters
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Routin.text:
theorem exists_nondefault_parameters (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    ∃ M d R : ℕ, 1 ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ d ∧ 1 ≤ R ∧
      10 ≤ p * (M : ℝ) / 2 ∧
      (1 - ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ M) ^ d < p ∧
      ∀ r : ℕ, R ≤ r → ∀ N : ℕ,
        N ≤ 1 + M * r * 2 ^ (2 * r + 2) →
        (N : ENNReal) * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - p / 2)) ^ (M * r) <
          ENNReal.ofReal p := by
  obtain ⟨T, d, hT, hd, hmargin, hdepth⟩ :=
    WindowBudget.exists_tree_parameters p hp
  obtain ⟨M, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : T ≠ 0)
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hsmall⟩ :=
    WindowBudget.exists_probability_threshold p hp hp1 (M + 1) hT hmargin
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := by omega
  have hmargin' : 10 ≤ p * (M : ℝ) / 2 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_succ, add_sub_cancel_right] using hmargin
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hdepth hsmall
  refine ⟨M, d, R, hM, hd, hR, hmargin', hdepth, ?_⟩
  intro r hr N hN
  have hrpos : 1 ≤ r := hR.trans hr
  have hcard := ScaleDiscretization.representative_card_budget
    (M + 1) r (2 ^ (2 * r + 2)) (by omega) hrpos
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hcard
  have hNbig : N ≤ 20 * (M + 1) * r * (1 + 2 ^ (2 * r + 2)) :=
    hN.trans hcard
  have hNreal : (N : ℝ) ≤ 20 * ((M + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (r : ℝ) *
      (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * r + 2)) := by
    exact_mod_cast hNbig
  apply ennreal_card_mul_pow_lt hp (by linarith) N (M * r)
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNreal (pow_nonneg (by linarith) _)).trans_lt
    (hsmall r hr)

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.name: OAI.Problem310Support.signedDyadicUnion_hits
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.text:
theorem signedDyadicUnion_hits {H : ℕ → Set ℝ}
    (hH : ∀ j (x t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 →
      ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ x + t * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n) ∈ H j) :
    ∀ x s : ℝ, s ≠ 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
      x + s * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n) ∈ signedDyadicUnion H := by
  have hpos : ∀ x s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
      x + s * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n) ∈ signedDyadicUnion H := by
    intro x s hs
    obtain ⟨j, m, hscale⟩ := positive_scale_normalization hs
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hhit⟩ := hH j ((2 : ℝ) ^ j * x)
      (s * (2 : ℝ) ^ j * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ m)) hscale
    refine ⟨m + n, by omega, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    change (2 : ℝ) ^ j * (x + s * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (m + n))) ∈ H j
    have heq : (2 : ℝ) ^ j * (x + s * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ (m + n))) =
        (2 : ℝ) ^ j * x +
          (s * (2 : ℝ) ^ j * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ m)) * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n) := by
      rw [pow_add]
      ring
    rwa [heq]
  intro x s hs
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hs with hs | hs
  · obtain ⟨n, hn, hhit⟩ := hpos (-x) (-s) (neg_pos.mpr hs)
    refine ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    have := signedDyadicUnion_neg hhit
    simpa only [neg_add, neg_neg, neg_mul] using this
  · exact hpos x s hs

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Window.name: OAI.Problem310.exists_windowData_selector_stability
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Window.text:
theorem exists_windowData_selector_stability (M d : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∃ g : ℕ, 2 ≤ g ∧ ∀ r₀ : ℕ, ∀ W : WindowData (M + 1) d g r₀,
      ∃ G : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet G ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, x + 1 ∈ G ↔ x ∈ G) ∧
        MeasureTheory.volume (Gᶜ ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p ∧
        ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ P : Node M d, ∀ i : Fin M, ∀ n : ℕ,
          W.b (P.val ++ [i.castSucc]) + g < n →
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
          ∀ ω : SelectorTable (fun P : Node M d => fun i : Fin M =>
            W.b (P.val ++ [i.castSucc])),
          selectorValue (fun P : Node M d => fun i : Fin M =>
            W.b (P.val ++ [i.castSucc])) ω P.val i (x + t * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ n) =
          selectorValue (fun P : Node M d => fun i : Fin M =>
            W.b (P.val ++ [i.castSucc])) ω P.val i x := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgeometry⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_grid_stability (ι := Node M d × Fin M) p hp
  refine ⟨g, hg, fun r₀ W ↦ ?_⟩
  let bS : Node M d → Fin M → ℕ := fun P i => W.b (P.val ++ [i.castSucc])
  obtain ⟨G, hGm, hGp, hGbudget, hGkey⟩ := hgeometry (fun e => bS e.1 e.2)
  refine ⟨G, hGm, hGp, hGbudget, ?_⟩
  intro x hx P i n hn t ht ω
  have hk := hGkey x hx (P, i) n (by dsimp [bS]; omega) t ht
  have ha : selectorAddress bS P i (x + t * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ n) =
      selectorAddress bS P i x := by
    unfold selectorAddress
    rw [hk]
  change selectorValue bS ω P.val i (x + t * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ n) =
    selectorValue bS ω P.val i x
  rw [selectorValue_valid, selectorValue_valid, ha]

end Problem310

end

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.name: OAI.Problem310Support.compact_complement_volume
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.text:
theorem compact_complement_volume {C : Set ℝ} (hC : IsOpen C)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hsmall : volume (C ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (η / 2)) :
    IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 \ C) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - η) < volume (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 \ C) := by
  refine ⟨isCompact_Icc.diff hC, ?_⟩
  have hfinite : volume (C ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hsmall
  have hdiff : Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 \ C =
      Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 \ (C ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_inter_iff]
    tauto
  rw [hdiff, measure_sdiff inter_subset_right
    (hC.measurableSet.inter measurableSet_Icc).nullMeasurableSet hfinite,
    Real.volume_Icc]
  norm_num only [sub_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  have hstrict : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - η) < ENNReal.ofReal (1 - η / 2) :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
  refine hstrict.trans_le ?_
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sub 1 (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  exact tsub_le_tsub_left hsmall 1

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Routin.name: OAI.Problem310.RoutingBudget.ennreal_survival_lt
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Routin.text:
lemma ennreal_survival_lt {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (M d : ℕ)
    (h : (1 - ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ M) ^ d < p) :
    (1 - ((2 : ENNReal)⁻¹) ^ M) ^ d < ENNReal.ofReal p := by
  have hbase0 : 0 ≤ 1 - ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ M := by
    have hpow : ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ M ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hbase : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ M) =
      1 - ((2 : ENNReal)⁻¹) ^ M := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sub 1 (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_one,
      ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num), ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have he := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hp).2 h
  rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_pow hbase0, hbase] at he

end Problem310.RoutingBudget

end

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.name: OAI.Problem310Support.signedDyadicUnion_volume_le
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.text:
theorem signedDyadicUnion_volume_le {H : ℕ → Set ℝ}
    (hH : ∀ j, ∀ x : ℝ, x + 1 ∈ H j ↔ x ∈ H j) :
    volume (signedDyadicUnion H ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ≤
      ∑' j : ℕ, 2 * volume (H j ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
  rw [signedDyadicUnion, iUnion_inter]
  refine (measure_iUnion_le _).trans (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun j => ?_)
  rw [union_inter_distrib_right, two_mul]
  refine (measure_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      periodic_dilate_unit_volume_le (hH j) (n := 2 ^ j) (by positivity)
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      periodic_neg_dilate_unit_volume_le (hH j) (n := 2 ^ j) (by positivity)

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Center.name: OAI.Problem310.CenterFailureBound.raw_failure_le_of_outcome_center_atoms
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Center.text:
theorem raw_failure_le_of_outcome_center_atoms {M d : ℕ}
    (bS : Node M d → Fin M → ℕ) (bT : Leaf M d → ℕ)
    (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (B : SelectorTable bS × TerminalTable bT → Set ℝ) (N : Set ℕ) (x : ℝ)
    (htail : (1 - ((2 : ENNReal)⁻¹) ^ M) ^ d ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p)
    (hatom : ∀ ξ : Node M d × Fin M → Bool, GoodExposure bS x ξ →
      ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress bS) (TerminalAddress bT) p hp0 hp1
        ({ω | x ∈ Auxiliary.exceptionalCenters (B ω) N (fun n => (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n)} ∩
          centerAtom bS bT x ξ) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal p *
          ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress bS) (TerminalAddress bT) p hp0 hp1
            (centerAtom bS bT x ξ)) :
    ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress bS) (TerminalAddress bT) p hp0 hp1
      {ω | x ∈ Auxiliary.exceptionalCenters (B ω) N (fun n => (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n)} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * p) := by
  apply raw_failure_le_of_center_atoms bS bT
    (ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress bS) (TerminalAddress bT) p hp0 hp1)
    p hp0 B N x _ hatom
  rw [outcomeLaw_noDefaultEvent]
  exact htail

end Problem310.CenterFailureBound

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.name: OAI.Problem310Support.avoidance_of_periodic_hitting
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Global.text:
theorem avoidance_of_periodic_hitting
    (hperiodic : ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → p < 1 → ∃ H : Set ℝ,
      IsOpen H ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, x + 1 ∈ H ↔ x ∈ H) ∧
      volume (H ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (6 * p) ∧
      ∀ x t : ℝ, t ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 → ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
        x + t * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n) ∈ H) :
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η < 1 → ∃ E : Set ℝ,
      E ⊆ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ IsCompact E ∧
      volume E > ENNReal.ofReal (1 - η) ∧
      ∀ x s : ℝ, s ≠ 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
        x + s * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n) ∉ E := by
  intro η hη hη1
  let p : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => η / 48 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j)
  have hp₀ (j : ℕ) : 0 < p j := by dsimp [p]; positivity
  have hp₁ (j : ℕ) : p j < 1 := by
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ j ≤ 1 :=
      pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ η / 48 := by positivity
    have hp_le : p j ≤ η / 48 := by
      dsimp [p]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hcoef hpow
    linarith
  choose H hOpen hPer hDensity hHit using fun j => hperiodic (p j) (hp₀ j) (hp₁ j)
  have hsmall : volume (signedDyadicUnion H ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (η / 2) := by
    refine (signedDyadicUnion_volume_le hPer).trans ?_
    calc
      (∑' j : ℕ, (2 : ENNReal) * volume (H j ∩ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ≤
          ∑' j : ℕ, (2 : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (6 * p j) :=
        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun j => mul_le_mul_right (hDensity j) 2
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (η / 2) := dyadic_density_budget hη.le
  have hcompact := compact_complement_volume (signedDyadicUnion_open hOpen) hη hη1 hsmall
  refine ⟨Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 \ signedDyadicUnion H, sdiff_subset, hcompact.1, hcompact.2, ?_⟩
  intro x s hs
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hhit⟩ := signedDyadicUnion_hits hHit x s hs
  exact ⟨n, hn, fun hx => hx.2 hhit⟩

end Problem310Support

end

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Concre.name: OAI.Problem310.ConcreteWindowAtom.raw_failure_on_good_atom
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Concre.text:
theorem raw_failure_on_good_atom
    (W : WindowData (M + 1) d g r₀) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (hbudget : ∀ r : ℕ, r₀ ≤ r → ∀ N : ℕ,
      N ≤ 1 + M * r * 2 ^ (2 * r + 2) →
      (N : ENNReal) * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - p / 2)) ^ (M * r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p)
    (x : ℝ) (hstable : StableAt W x)
    (ξ : Node M d × Fin M → Bool) (hgood : GoodExposure (selectorEndpoints W) x ξ) :
    ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress (selectorEndpoints W))
      (TerminalAddress (terminalEndpoints W)) p hp0 hp1
      ({ω | x ∈ Auxiliary.exceptionalCenters
        (routedSet (selectorEndpoints W) (terminalEndpoints W) ω)
        (Ici 1) (fun n => (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n)} ∩
        centerAtom (selectorEndpoints W) (terminalEndpoints W) x ξ) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal p *
      ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress (selectorEndpoints W))
        (TerminalAddress (terminalEndpoints W)) p hp0 hp1
        (centerAtom (selectorEndpoints W) (terminalEndpoints W) x ξ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, U, hlen, hfirst⟩ :=
    RoutedExposure.actual_firstDefaultNode_on_atom (selectorEndpoints W) x ξ hgood
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hcard, htransfer⟩ :=
    exists_representatives_failure_transfer W U k.val x ξ hfirst hstable
  let μ := ConcreteLabels.outcomeLaw (SelectorAddress (selectorEndpoints W))
    (TerminalAddress (terminalEndpoints W)) p hp0 hp1
  let A := centerAtom (selectorEndpoints W) (terminalEndpoints W) x ξ
  let q := (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - p / 2)) ^ (M * W.r (d - U.val.length))
  have hthreshold : r₀ ≤ W.r (d - U.val.length) := by
    have h := W.length_threshold (selectorEdge U (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin M))
      (selectorEdge_valid U _)
    simpa [WindowData.length, selectorEdge] using h
  have hsmall : (R.card : ENNReal) * q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p :=
    hbudget _ hthreshold _ hcard
  have hsub : ({ω | x ∈ Auxiliary.exceptionalCenters
      (routedSet (selectorEndpoints W) (terminalEndpoints W) ω)
      (Ici 1) (fun n => (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n)} ∩ A) ⊆
      ⋃ t ∈ R, localMiss W U x t ξ := by
    rintro ω ⟨hfail, hatom⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hmiss⟩ := htransfer ω hatom hfail
    refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨t, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨ht, hatom, ?_⟩⟩
    intro z
    exact hmiss z.1 z.2
  change μ _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p * μ A
  calc
    μ _ ≤ μ (⋃ t ∈ R, localMiss W U x t ξ) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ R, μ (localMiss W U x t ξ) := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ = ∑ _t ∈ R, q * μ A := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      exact localMiss_mass W U x t (hR t ht) p hp0 hp1 ξ
    _ = (R.card : ENNReal) * (q * μ A) := by simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ = ((R.card : ENNReal) * q) * μ A := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p * μ A := mul_le_mul hsmall le_rfl (by positivity) (by positivity)

end Problem310.ConcreteWindowAtom

end

OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Window.name: OAI.Problem310.WindowConstruction.windowData
OAI.MeasureTheory.DyadicAvoidance.Window.text:
def windowData (q d g r₀ : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr₀ : 1 ≤ r₀) :
    WindowData q d g r₀ where
  r := WindowRecursion.length q g r₀
  a P := start (lengthAt q d g r₀) g (edgeRank d P)
  b P := finish (lengthAt q d g r₀) g (edgeRank d P)
  bstar P := start (lengthAt q d g r₀) g (edgeRank d P) +
    2 * WindowRecursion.length q g r₀ (d + 1 - P.length) - 1
  length_pos P hP := hr₀.trans (WindowRecursion.threshold_le_length _ _ _ _)
  length_threshold P hP := WindowRecursion.threshold_le_length _ _ _ _
  start_three P hP := WindowPlacement.three_le_start _ _ _
  endpoint P hP := by
    rw [WindowPlacement.finish_add_one, lengthAt_edgeRank hP]
  gap_prefix P Q hP hQ hpref hne := by
    apply WindowPlacement.gap_of_lt
    have hr := (isPrefix_iff_edgeRank_bounds hP.2 hQ.2 hP.1 hQ.1).mp hpref
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne hr.1
    intro heq
    exact hne (edgeRank_injective_on hP.2 hQ.2 hP.1 hQ.1 heq)
  gap_sibling P i j tail hij hP hQ := by
    apply WindowPlacement.gap_of_lt
    exact edgeRank_sibling_descendants_lt (p := []) hij hP.2 hQ.2
  descendant_bounds P Q hP hQ hpref := by
    constructor
    · apply WindowPlacement.finish_mono
      exact ((isPrefix_iff_edgeRank_bounds hP.2 hQ.2 hP.1 hQ.1).mp hpref).1
    · have hb := descendant_endpoint_bound (g := g) (r₀ := r₀) hq hP hQ hpref
      omega
  padding P hP := by
    have hstart := WindowPlacement.three_le_start (lengthAt q d g r₀) g (edgeRank d P)
    omega

theorem signedDyadicUnion_open {H : ℕ → Set ℝ} (hH : ∀ j, IsOpen (H j)) :

  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro j
  exact ((hH j).preimage (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).union
    ((hH j).preimage (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).neg)

OAI.Combinatorics.EditApproximation.Spec.name: OAI.EditApproximation.integerBinaryAnswerRawBand_eq

theorem almostLinearEditDistance_main (epsilon : BinaryFraction)
    (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon.value) (_hepsilonOne : epsilon.value < 1)
    :
    (∀ (source target : List ℤ) (N : ℕ), source.length + target.length ≤ N →
      (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (computedFullLaw (source.map integerSymbolCode) (target.map integerSymbolCode) N epsilon).real
        {outcome | EditDistortion.edit source target ≤ integerBinaryAnswer source target N epsilon outcome ∧
          (integerBinaryAnswer source target N epsilon outcome : ℝ) ≤
            (1 + (epsilon.value : ℝ)) * EditDistortion.edit source target}) ∧
    (∀ (source target : List ℤ) (N : ℕ), source = target → ∀ outcome,
      integerBinaryAnswer source target N epsilon outcome = 0) ∧
    (∀ (C : ℕ) (eta : ℝ), 0 < eta → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ source target : List ℤ, source.length + target.length ≤ N →
        (∀ z ∈ source ++ target, z.natAbs ≤ (N + 2) ^ C) →
        (∫ outcome, integerBinaryWork source target N epsilon outcome
          ∂computedFullLaw (source.map integerSymbolCode) (target.map integerSymbolCode) N epsilon) ≤
            (N + 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 + eta)) ∧
    (∀ C : ℕ, ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ source target : List ℤ,
      source.length + target.length ≤ N →
        (∀ z ∈ source ++ target, z.natAbs ≤ (N + 2) ^ C) →
        ∀ outcome, integerBinarySpaceFootprint source target N epsilon outcome ≤ (N + 2) ^ (C + 65564)) := by
  simpa only [integerBinarySpaceFootprint_eq] using
    almostLinearEditDistance epsilon hepsilon _hepsilonOne

end OAI.EditApproximation

    (outcome : ComputedFullOutcome (source.map integerSymbolCode) (target.map integerSymbolCode) N) : ℕ :=
  if physicalLargeInput N epsilon then
    match outcome with
    | .inl _ => exactSuffixAnswer (source.map integerSymbolCode) (target.map integerSymbolCode)

        (computedExecutionAccepted _ _ N execution)).1

  obtain ⟨c,hc,dL,hL⟩ := EditLower.all_lower_clauses.{u}
  obtain ⟨dU,hU⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp EditUpper.eventual_upper.{u}
