OAI.Probability.EntangledGames.Exponenti.name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.analytic_threshold_bound
OAI.Probability.EntangledGames.Exponenti.text:
lemma analytic_threshold_bound {v δ θ R E q : ℝ}
    (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hs : v+δ ≤ 1)
    (hθ : 2 ≤ θ) (hδθ : 8 ≤ δ*θ)
    (hθR : θ/δ ≤ R/4) (hR : 2/δ ≤ R/4) (hE : E ≤ δ*θ/8)
    (hq : q*(v+δ)^(⌊θ⌋₊) ≤ (v+δ/2)^(⌊θ⌋₊)+Real.exp (-R)*(2/δ)) :
    q ≤ Real.exp (-E) := by
  let T := ⌊θ⌋₊
  let L := δ*θ/4
  have hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ := by linarith
  have hT : (T : ℝ) ≤ θ := Nat.floor_le hθ0
  have hT' : θ/2 ≤ (T : ℝ) := by
    have hh := Nat.lt_floor_add_one θ
    dsimp [T]; linarith
  have hs0 : 0 < v+δ := by linarith
  have hp0 : 0 < (v+δ)^T := pow_pos hs0 _
  have hq' : q ≤ (v+δ/2)^T/(v+δ)^T + Real.exp (-R)*(2/δ)/(v+δ)^T := by
    rw [← add_div]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hp0).mpr hq
  have hfirst : (v+δ/2)^T/(v+δ)^T ≤ Real.exp (-L) := by
    apply (power_ratio_bound hv hδ hs T).trans
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    dsimp [L]
    nlinarith
  have hTδ : (T : ℝ)/δ ≤ R/4 := (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hT hδ.le).trans hθR
  have hfac : 2/δ ≤ Real.exp (2/δ) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (2/δ)]
  have hbad : Real.exp (-R)*(2/δ)/(v+δ)^T ≤ Real.exp (-R/2) := by
    calc
      Real.exp (-R)*(2/δ)/(v+δ)^T = Real.exp (-R)*(2/δ)*(1/(v+δ)^T) := by ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-R)*Real.exp (2/δ)*Real.exp ((T : ℝ)/δ) := by
        apply mul_le_mul
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfac (Real.exp_pos _).le
        · exact inverse_power_bound hδ (by linarith) T
        · positivity
        · positivity
      _ = Real.exp (-R+2/δ+(T : ℝ)/δ) := by rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-R/2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hδ2 : δ*δ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hL : L ≤ R/2 := by
    have hh : δ*θ ≤ θ/δ := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ2 hθ0]
    have hR0 : 0 < R := by have := div_pos (show (0:ℝ)<2 by norm_num) hδ; linarith
    dsimp [L]; linarith
  have hqL : q ≤ 2*Real.exp (-L) := by
    have hb : Real.exp (-R)*(2/δ)/(v+δ)^T ≤ Real.exp (-L) :=
      hbad.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
    linarith
  have htwo : 2 ≤ Real.exp (L/2) := by
    have hh := Real.add_one_le_exp (L/2)
    dsimp [L] at *
    linarith
  calc
    q ≤ 2*Real.exp (-L) := hqL
    _ ≤ Real.exp (L/2)*Real.exp (-L) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htwo (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (-L/2) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-E) := by apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr; dsimp [L]; linarith

OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.name: OAI.EntropyPhotonNumber.epni_entropy_interior
OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.text:
theorem epni_entropy_interior {n : ℕ} (hn : 1≤n) {η : ℝ} (hη : η∈Set.Ioo 0 1)
    {ρ σ : State n} (hρ : FiniteEnergy ρ) (hσ : FiniteEnergy σ) :
    g (η*gInv (entropy ρ/n)+(1-η)*gInv (entropy σ/n)) ≤
      entropy (beamOutput η ⟨hη.1.le,hη.2.le⟩ ρ σ)/n := by
  have hnR : 0<(n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn)
  let a := gInv (entropy ρ/n)
  let b := gInv (entropy σ/n)
  have ha : 0≤a := gInv_nonneg (div_nonneg (entropy_nonneg ρ) hnR.le)
  have hb : 0≤b := gInv_nonneg (div_nonneg (entropy_nonneg σ) hnR.le)
  have hga : g a=entropy ρ/n := g_gInv (div_nonneg (entropy_nonneg ρ) hnR.le)
  have hgb : g b=entropy σ/n := g_gInv (div_nonneg (entropy_nonneg σ) hnR.le)
  have hρeq : entropy ρ=(n:ℝ)*g a := by rw [hga]; field_simp
  have hσeq : entropy σ=(n:ℝ)*g b := by rw [hgb]; field_simp
  have hc0 : 0≤η*a+(1-η)*b := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hη.1.le ha) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hη.2.le) hb)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc0 with hzero | hpos
  · rw [← hzero,g_zero]
    exact div_nonneg (entropy_nonneg _) hnR.le
  have hrlim := ((positiveReference_limit a).const_mul η).add
    ((positiveReference_limit b).const_mul (1-η))
  have hg := continuous_g.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hrlim
  have hh := (continuousAt_h_pos hpos).tendsto.comp hrlim
  have heρ := (reference_error_limit ha).const_mul ((n:ℝ)*η)
  have heσ := (reference_error_limit hb).const_mul ((n:ℝ)*(1-η))
  have hout := ((hg.const_mul (n:ℝ)).const_sub
    (entropy (beamOutput η ⟨hη.1.le,hη.2.le⟩ ρ σ))).div hh (h_pos hpos).ne'
  have hmain := (hout.sub heρ).sub heσ
  simp only [mul_zero,sub_zero] at hmain
  have hnonneg : 0≤(entropy (beamOutput η ⟨hη.1.le,hη.2.le⟩ ρ σ)-(n:ℝ)*g (η*a+(1-η)*b))/h (η*a+(1-η)*b) := by
    apply ge_of_tendsto hmain
    filter_upwards [] with m
    have ht := entropy_tangent_finiteEnergy hη (positiveReference_pos ha m) (positiveReference_pos hb m) hρ hσ
    rw [hρeq,hσeq] at ht
    convert! ht using 1
    dsimp only [Pi.div_apply,Function.comp_apply]
    ring
  have ht := (le_div_iff₀ (h_pos hpos)).mp hnonneg
  change g (η*a+(1-η)*b)≤_
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hnR).mpr (by nlinarith)

OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Conti.name: OAI.EntropyPhotonNumber.beamOutput_spec

OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.name: OAI.EntropyPhotonNumber.g_surjective_nonneg
OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.text:
theorem g_surjective_nonneg {s : ℝ} (hs : 0  ≤  s) : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ g t=s := by
  have hb : s ≤ g (Real.exp s) := by
    calc
      s = Real.log (Real.exp s) := (Real.log_exp s).symm
      _  ≤  Real.log (Real.exp s+1) := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos s) (by linarith)
      _  ≤  g (Real.exp s) := g_ge_log (Real.exp_pos s)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,he⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (Real.exp_pos s).le continuous_g.continuousOn
    (show s∈Set.Icc (g 0) (g (Real.exp s)) from ⟨by simpa using hs,hb⟩)
  exact ⟨t,ht.1,he⟩

OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.name: OAI.EntropyPhotonNumber.epni_entropy_closed
OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.text:
theorem epni_entropy_closed {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {η : ℝ} (hη : η∈Set.Icc 0 1)
    {ρ σ : State n} (hρ : FiniteEnergy ρ) (hσ : FiniteEnergy σ) :
    g (η*gInv (entropy ρ/n)+(1-η)*gInv (entropy σ/n))  ≤ 
      entropy (beamOutput η hη ρ σ)/n := by
  let ηm : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => interiorTransmission m*η+(1-interiorTransmission m)/2
  have hηm (m : ℕ) : ηm m∈Set.Ioo 0 1 := by
    have ht := interiorTransmission_mem m
    have hp := mul_nonneg ht.1.le hη.1
    have hu : interiorTransmission m*η ≤ interiorTransmission m :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_right ht.1.le hη.2
    dsimp [ηm]
    constructor <;> linarith [ht.1,ht.2]
  have hlim : Tendsto ηm atTop (𝓝 η) := by
    have hh := (interiorTransmission_limit.mul_const η).add
      ((interiorTransmission_limit.const_sub 1).div_const 2)
    simpa only [one_mul,sub_self,zero_div,add_zero,ηm] using hh
  have hout := (tendsto_entropy_beamOutput_parameter
    (fun m => ⟨(hηm m).1.le,(hηm m).2.le⟩) hη hlim hρ hσ).div_const (n:ℝ)
  have harg := (hlim.mul_const (gInv (entropy ρ/n))).add
    ((hlim.const_sub 1).mul_const (gInv (entropy σ/n)))
  have hg := continuous_g.continuousAt.tendsto.comp harg
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hg hout (Eventually.of_forall (fun m => epni_entropy_interior hn (hηm m) hρ hσ))

OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.name: OAI.EntropyPhotonNumber.entropy_photon_number_inequality
OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.text:
theorem entropy_photon_number_inequality
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (ρA ρB ρC : State n)
    (hA : FiniteEnergy ρA) (hB : FiniteEnergy ρB)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : η ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
    (hC : IsBeamSplitterOutput η ρA ρB ρC) :
    η * gInv (entropy ρA / n) + (1 - η) * gInv (entropy ρB / n) ≤
      gInv (entropy ρC / n) := by
  have hnR : 0<(n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn)
  have ha := gInv_nonneg (div_nonneg (entropy_nonneg ρA) hnR.le)
  have hb := gInv_nonneg (div_nonneg (entropy_nonneg ρB) hnR.le)
  have hw := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hη.1 ha) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hη.2) hb)
  apply (le_gInv_iff hw (div_nonneg (entropy_nonneg ρC) hnR.le)).mpr
  rw [output_eq hη hC]
  exact epni_entropy_closed hn hη hA hB
end EntropyPhotonNumber

end

      (QuantumTrace.entropyOperator ρ.op (numberBasis n k))).re := by

  op := partialTrace (mixedVector η hη ρA ρB)

OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.name: OAI.EntropyPhotonNumber.tendsto_entropy_beamOutput_parameter
OAI.InformationTheory.PhotonNumber.Inequ.text:
theorem tendsto_entropy_beamOutput_parameter {n : ℕ} {A : Type*} {l : Filter A} {η : A → ℝ}
    (hη : ∀ a, η a∈Set.Icc 0 1) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ∈Set.Icc 0 1)
    (hlim : Tendsto η l (𝓝 θ)) {ρ σ : State n} (hρ : FiniteEnergy ρ) (hσ : FiniteEnergy σ) :
    Tendsto (fun a => entropy (beamOutput (η a) (hη a) ρ σ)) l
      (𝓝 (entropy (beamOutput θ hθ ρ σ))) := by
  exact tendsto_entropy (E:=energy ρ+energy σ)
    (fun a => beamOutput_finiteEnergy (η a) (hη a) hρ hσ)
    (beamOutput_finiteEnergy θ hθ hρ hσ)
    (fun a => beamOutput_energy_bound (η a) (hη a) hρ hσ)
    (beamOutput_energy_bound θ hθ hρ hσ)
    (tendsto_beamOutput_parameter hη hθ hlim ρ σ)

OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.BorelTransfer.name: OAI.PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.exists_label_field
OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.BorelTransfer.text:
lemma exists_label_field : ∃ H : Fin k → ℂ × Space k → ℝ,
    (∀ i, Measurable (H i)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℂ, ∀ᵐ η ∂measure k ω, ∑ i, H i (x,η) = 1) ∧
    (∀ x : ℂ, ∀ u : Circle, ∀ᵐ η ∂measure k ω, ∀ i, H i (x,η)*H i (x+u,η) = 0) := by
  have hex (i : Fin k) := exists_measurable_field (measure k ω) (fieldVector k ω i) (fieldVector_continuous k ω i)
  choose F hm hae using hex
  refine ⟨fun i p => (F i p).re,fun i => Complex.continuous_re.measurable.comp (hm i),?_,?_⟩
  · intro x
    have hs := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin k => fieldVector k ω i x)
    rw [fieldVector_sum] at hs
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => hae i x),hs,one_ae k ω] with η he hs h1
    have hc : ∑ i : Fin k, F i (x,η) = 1 := by
      simp_rw [he]
      exact hs.symm.trans h1
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re hc
    simpa only [map_sum,Complex.re_sum,Complex.one_re] using hr
  · intro x u
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro i
    have hz := positive_orthogonal (measure k ω) (fieldVector k ω i x) (fieldVector k ω i (x+u))
      ((fieldVector_range k ω i x).mono fun _ h => ⟨h.1,h.2.1⟩)
      ((fieldVector_range k ω i (x+u)).mono fun _ h => ⟨h.1,h.2.1⟩)
      (fieldVector_unit_correlation k ω i x u)
    filter_upwards [hae i x,hae i (x+u),hz] with η h1 h2 h3
    simpa only [h1,h2] using h3
end PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel
end

theorem no_measurable_weak_five_coloring {c : ℂ → Fin 5}
    (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) : False := by
  let t : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => min (1/16) (1/((n:ℝ)+1))
  have hpos (n : ℕ) : 0<t n := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hsmall (n : ℕ) : t n≤1/16 := min_le_left _ _
  have ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0) := squeeze_zero (fun n => (hpos n).le)
    (fun n => min_le_right _ _) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  let F : ∀n,FullApprox c (1/10) (t n) := fun n =>
    Classical.choice (fullApprox_exists hc hw (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (hpos n))
  have hbad : ∃ᶠn in atTop,∃i : Fin 5,∃K : Set ℂ,IsPreconnected K ∧ K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 ∧
      (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<((F n).map z).val i) ∧
      ∃x∈K,∃y∈K,2<dist x y :=
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => graph_map_large_positive (F n).map)).frequently
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Filter.frequently_exists.mp hbad
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,hφbad⟩ := extraction_of_frequently_atTop hi
  exact FullApprox.no_large_positive_sequence hc hw (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (fun n => F (φ n)) (ht.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => hsmall (φ n)) i hφbad

OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.BorelTransfer.name: OAI.EuclideanFiveColor.sample_field
OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.BorelTransfer.text:
lemma sample_field (H : Fin k → ℂ × Ω → ℝ) (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (H i))
    (hp : ∀ x : ℂ, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∑ i, H i (x,ω) = 1)
    (ho : ∀ x : ℂ, ∀ s : S, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ i, H i (x,ω)*H i (x+d s,ω) = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℂ → Fin k, Measurable c ∧ ∀ᵐ p ∂(volume : Measure ℂ).prod ν, c p.1 ≠ c (p.1+d p.2) := by
  let c : ℂ × Ω → Fin k := positiveSelect H
  have hc : Measurable c := positiveSelect_measurable H hm
  have ha (p : ℂ × S) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, c (p.1,ω) ≠ c (p.1+d p.2,ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hp p.1,hp (p.1+d p.2),ho p.1 p.2] with ω h1 h2 h3
    intro he
    have hpos1 := positiveSelect_pos H (p.1,ω) h1
    have hpos2 := positiveSelect_pos H (p.1+d p.2,ω) h2
    change 0 < H (c (p.1,ω)) (p.1,ω) at hpos1
    change 0 < H (c (p.1+d p.2,ω)) (p.1+d p.2,ω) at hpos2
    rw [← he] at hpos2
    exact (mul_pos hpos1 hpos2).ne' (h3 _)
  have hm1 : Measurable (fun q : (ℂ × S) × Ω => c (q.1.1,q.2)) :=
    hc.comp ((measurable_fst.fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hm2 : Measurable (fun q : (ℂ × S) × Ω => c (q.1.1+d q.1.2,q.2)) :=
    hc.comp (((measurable_fst.fst).add (hd.comp measurable_fst.snd)).prodMk measurable_snd)
  have hh : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ᵐ p ∂(volume : Measure ℂ).prod ν, c (p.1,ω) ≠ c (p.1+d p.2,ω) :=
    (Measure.ae_ae_comm (measurableSet_eq_fun hm1 hm2).compl).mp (.of_forall ha)
  obtain ⟨ω,hω⟩ := hh.exists
  exact ⟨fun x => c (x,ω),hc.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const),hω⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

lemma proper_to_borel_weak {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : ProperColoring k c) :

OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Mesh:92.name: OAI.EuclideanFiveColor.FullApprox.no_large_positive_sequence
OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Mesh:92.text:
theorem no_large_positive_sequence {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (F : ∀n,FullApprox c α (t n)) (htlim : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0))
    (htsmall : ∀n,t n≤1/16) (i : Fin 5)
    (hbad : ∀n,∃K : Set ℂ, IsPreconnected K ∧ K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 ∧
      (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<((F n).map z).val i) ∧
      ∃x∈K,∃y∈K,2<dist x y) : False := by
  choose K hK hsub hprob x hx y hy hxy using hbad
  have hxy' (n : ℕ) : 2*t n<dist (x n) (y n) := by linarith [htsmall n,hxy n]
  have hyx' (n : ℕ) : 2*t n<dist (y n) (x n) := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hxy' n
  choose a haK haH hax using fun n => connected_escape_holes
    (fun d hd => ((F n).positive d hd).le) (F n).disjoint (F n).sum_lt (hK n) (hx n) (hy n) (hxy' n)
  choose b hbK hbH hby using fun n => connected_escape_holes
    (fun d hd => ((F n).positive d hd).le) (F n).disjoint (F n).sum_lt (hK n) (hy n) (hx n) (hyx' n)
  have hab (n : ℕ) : 3/2≤dist (a n) (b n) := by
    have h1 := dist_triangle (x n) (a n) (y n)
    have h2 := dist_triangle (a n) (b n) (y n)
    rw [dist_comm (b n) (y n)] at h2
    linarith [hxy n,hax n,hby n,htsmall n]
  obtain ⟨p,hp,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5).prod
    (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5)).tendsto_subseq (x := fun n => (a n,b n)) (fun n => ⟨hsub n (haK n),hsub n (hbK n)⟩)
  have halim : Tendsto (fun n => a (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 p.1) := (continuous_fst.tendsto p).comp hlim
  have hblim : Tendsto (fun n => b (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 p.2) := (continuous_snd.tendsto p).comp hlim
  have hpdist : 3/2≤dist p.1 p.2 := ge_of_tendsto (halim.dist hblim) (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hab (φ n)))
  have hεlim := (ε_tendsto F htlim).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hE := (annuli_tendsto F htlim).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hasup : p.1∈spatialSupport c i := support_of_positive_diskAverage_limit hc hεlim halim i
    (fun n => hα.trans (positive_average hc hα' (F (φ n)) i ⟨a (φ n),hsub _ (haK _)⟩
      (haH _) (hprob _ _ (haK _))))
  have hexc : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Metric.ball p.1 (1/8)) := by
    apply diskAverage_support_exclusion hc hεlim (fun n => (F (φ n)).ε_pos) hE hα Metric.isOpen_ball i
    intro z hz
    have hane : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (a (φ n)) p.1<1/8 :=
      halim.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num))
    have hbne : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (b (φ n)) p.2<1/8 :=
      hblim.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num))
    filter_upwards [hane,hbne] with n han hbn hzE
    have hza : dist z (a (φ n))<1 := by
      have hh := dist_triangle z p.1 (a (φ n))
      rw [dist_comm p.1 (a (φ n))] at hh
      change dist z p.1<1/8 at hz
      linarith
    have hzb : 1<dist z (b (φ n)) := by
      have h1 := dist_triangle p.1 z p.2
      have h2 := dist_triangle z (b (φ n)) p.2
      rw [dist_comm p.1 z] at h1
      change dist z p.1<1/8 at hz
      linarith
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hunit⟩ := straddle_connected_unit (hK (φ n))
      ⟨a (φ n),haK _,b (φ n),hbK _,hza,hzb⟩
    have hqH : q∉diskHoles (F (φ n)).disks := fun hh => hzE (unit_from_hole_mem_annuli hh hunit)
    have hqprob := positive_average hc hα' (F (φ n)) i ⟨q,hsub _ hq⟩ hqH (hprob _ _ hq)
    have hu : ‖q-z‖=1 := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_rev] using hunit
    have hh := diskAverage_unit_pair hc hw (F (φ n)).ε_pos hu i
    change diskAverage c (F (φ n)).ε i z≤1-α
    change α<diskAverage c (F (φ n)).ε i q at hqprob
    linarith
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hexc hasup (Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num))
end FullApprox
end EuclideanFiveColor

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Colori.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.finite_coloring_compactness
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Colori.text:
theorem finite_coloring_compactness {s : ℕ} (a : Fin s → FiniteEuclidean) (r : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ c : FiniteEuclidean → Fin r,∃ b : Fin s → FiniteEuclidean,
      (∀ i j,‖b i-b j‖=‖a i-a j‖) ∧ ∃ k : Fin r,∀ i,c (b i)=k) :
    ∃ D : ℕ,1≤D ∧ ∀ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D) → Fin r,
      ∃ b : Fin s → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D),
      (∀ i j,‖b i-b j‖=‖a i-a j‖) ∧ ∃ k : Fin r,∀ i,c (b i)=k := by
  classical
  by_contra hbad
  have hc : ∀ n : ℕ,∃ c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)) → Fin r,
      ¬ ∃ b : Fin s → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)),
        (∀ i j,‖b i-b j‖=‖a i-a j‖) ∧ ∃ k : Fin r,∀ i,c (b i)=k := by
    intro n
    by_contra hh
    push Not at hh
    exact hbad ⟨n+1,by omega,hh⟩
  choose c hc using hc
  let U : Ultrafilter ℕ := Ultrafilter.of Filter.atTop
  let C : FiniteEuclidean → Fin r := fun z => ultraColor
    (fun n => c n (FiniteEuclidean.truncate (n+1) z)) U
  obtain ⟨b,hb,k,hbk⟩ := h C
  have hcolor : ∀ᶠ n in (U : Filter ℕ),∀ i,c n (FiniteEuclidean.truncate (n+1) (b i))=k := by
    apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    have hh := ultraColor_spec (fun n => c n (FiniteEuclidean.truncate (n+1) (b i))) U
    change ∀ᶠ n in (U : Filter ℕ),c n (FiniteEuclidean.truncate (n+1) (b i))=C (b i) at hh
    rwa [hbk i] at hh
  have he : ∀ᶠ n in (U : Filter ℕ),∀ i,FiniteEuclidean.embed (n+1)
      (FiniteEuclidean.truncate (n+1) (b i))=b i := by
    apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    exact (Ultrafilter.of_le Filter.atTop) (FiniteEuclidean.eventually_embed_truncate (b i))
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hcol⟩ := (he.and hcolor).exists
  apply hc n
  refine ⟨fun i => FiniteEuclidean.truncate (n+1) (b i),?_,k,hcol⟩
  intro i j
  rw [← (FiniteEuclidean.embed (n+1)).norm_map, map_sub,hn i,hn j,hb]
end EuclideanRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Colori.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.paths_monochromatic
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Colori.text:
theorem paths_monochromatic {s : ℕ} (a : Fin s → FiniteEuclidean)
    (hpaths : ∀ n : ℕ,1 ≤ n → ∃ w lmb μ,Path a w lmb ∧ Path a w μ ∧
      0 < lmb ∧ μ/lmb < 1/(n:ℝ))
    {κ : Type uColor} [Finite κ] (c : FiniteEuclidean → κ) :
    ∃ b : Fin s → FiniteEuclidean,(∀ i j,‖b i-b j‖=‖a i-a j‖) ∧
      ∃ k : κ,∀ i,c (b i)=k := by
  classical
  let := ultrafilterMonoid (M:=Strings)
  obtain ⟨β,hβ,hHJ⟩ := Combinatorics.Line.exists_mono_in_high_dimension (Fin s) κ
  let := hβ
  obtain ⟨w,lmb,μ,hp,hm,hlmb,hratio⟩ := hpaths (Fintype.card β+1) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨W,hW⟩ := synchronize_paths (Fintype.card β+1) (by omega) hp hm hlmb hratio
  obtain ⟨p,Ψ,hgen⟩ := exists_corner_map
  let coloring : Strings → κ := fun x => c (FiniteEuclidean.flatten x.toList)
  let L : List β := Finset.univ.toList
  let C : (β → Fin s) → κ := fun x => ultraColor coloring ((L.map (fun j => Ψ (W (x j)))).prod)
  obtain ⟨line,k,hline⟩ := hHJ C
  let S : Finset β := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => line.idxFun j=none)
  let t := S.card
  have ht : 1 ≤ t := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := line.proper
    exact ⟨j,by simp [S,hj]⟩
  have htn : t ≤ Fintype.card β+1 := le_trans (Finset.card_le_univ S) (Nat.le_succ _)
  obtain ⟨qs,hqs,hqe⟩ := (hW t ht htn).expand Ψ p hgen
  let q (j : β) : List (UltraColumn (Fin s) Strings) :=
    (line.idxFun j).elim qs (fun i => [.common (Ψ (W i))])
  let u (j : β) : ℝ := if line.idxFun j=none then 1/(t:ℝ) else 0
  have hcol : ∀ j∈L,ColumnPath a (q j) (u j) := by
    intro j _
    cases he : line.idxFun j with
    | none => simpa [q,u,he] using hqs
    | some i => simpa [q,u,he] using (ColumnPath.common (a:=a) (Ψ (W i)))
  have hprod : ∀ j∈L,∀ i,((q j).map (fun q => q.value i)).prod=Ψ (W (line i j)) := by
    intro j _ i
    cases he : line.idxFun j with
    | none => simpa [q,he,Combinatorics.Line.coe_apply] using hqe i
    | some x => simp [q,he,Combinatorics.Line.coe_apply,UltraColumn.value]
  have hweight : (L.map u).sum=1 := by
    have he : (L.map u).sum=∑ j,u j := by
      simp [L]
    rw [he]
    change (∑ j,if line.idxFun j=none then 1/(t:ℝ) else 0)=1
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    change (∑ j∈S,1/(t:ℝ))=1
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul]
    change (t:ℝ)*(1/(t:ℝ))=1
    exact mul_one_div_cancel (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))
  have hfull : ColumnPath a ((L.map q).flatten) 1 := by
    convert ColumnPath.flatten L q u hcol using 1
    exact hweight.symm
  have hmem : ∀ i,{x : Strings | coloring x=k}∈
      ((((L.map q).flatten).map (fun q => q.value i)).prod : Ultrafilter Strings) := by
    intro i
    rw [flattened_ultra_product L q (fun j i => Ψ (W (line i j))) hprod i]
    have hk := ultraColor_spec coloring ((L.map (fun j => Ψ (W (line i j)))).prod)
    change {x | coloring x=C (line i)}∈_ at hk
    rwa [hline i] at hk
  obtain ⟨xs,hxs,hxB⟩ := UltraColumn.simultaneously_realize ((L.map q).flatten)
    (fun _ => {x : Strings | coloring x=k}) hmem
  let b (i : Fin s) := FiniteEuclidean.flatten ((xs.map (fun x => x i)).prod : Strings).toList
  refine ⟨b,(hfull.realizes xs hxs).congruent,k,?_⟩
  exact hxB
end EuclideanRamsey
namespace EuclideanRamsey
namespace FiniteEuclidean
open Filter
open scoped BigOperators

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Main:6.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.classification
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Main:6.text:
theorem classification {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (hs : 2 ≤ s) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    Ramsey a ↔ FieldCriterion a :=
  ⟨ramsey_fieldCriterion a (by omega) hspan,fieldCriterion_ramsey a hs hd ha⟩
end EuclideanRamsey

namespace EuclideanRamsey

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Correc.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.permutation_equal_endpoints
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Correc.text:
theorem permutation_equal_endpoints {s d ℓ : ℕ} (a : Fin s → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (f g : Fin s → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin ℓ))
    (q δ : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hf : ∀ i j,‖f i-f j‖^2=‖a i-a j‖^2)
    (hg : ∀ i j,‖g i-g j‖^2=q*‖a i-a j‖^2)
    (hperm : ∀ i,∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin ℓ),∀ x,g i (σ x)=f i x) :
    ∃ w lmb μ,Path (fun i => FiniteEuclidean.embed d (a i)) w lmb ∧
      Path (fun i => FiniteEuclidean.embed d (a i)) w μ ∧ 0 < lmb ∧ 0 ≤ μ ∧ μ/lmb ≤ q+s*δ := by
  classical
  choose σ hσ using hperm
  let H := Equiv.Perm (Fin ℓ)
  let X := H×Fin s
  let : MulAction H X :=
    { smul := fun h x => (h*x.1,x.2)
      one_smul := by intro x; exact Prod.ext (one_mul _) rfl
      mul_smul := by intro h k x; exact Prod.ext (mul_assoc _ _ _) rfl }
  let z : X → FiniteEuclidean := fun x => FiniteEuclidean.embed ℓ (permute x.1 (f x.2))
  have hσ' (i : Fin s) : permute (σ i) (f i)=g i := by
    ext j
    simpa using (hσ i ((σ i).symm j)).symm
  have hcopy (h : H) (i : Fin s) :
      z (h • ((σ i,i):X))=FiniteEuclidean.embed ℓ (permute h (g i)) := by
    change FiniteEuclidean.embed ℓ (permute (h*σ i) (f i))=_
    rw [permute_mul,hσ']
  have ht := averaged_equal_endpoints (H:=H) (X:=X) (fun i => FiniteEuclidean.embed d (a i))
    ((FiniteEuclidean.embed d).injective.comp ha) z (fun i => (1,i)) (fun i => (σ i,i))
    q δ hq hδ
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at ht
  apply ht
  · intro h
    refine ⟨zero_le_one,?_⟩
    intro i j
    change ‖FiniteEuclidean.embed ℓ (permute (h*1) (f i))-
      FiniteEuclidean.embed ℓ (permute (h*1) (f j))‖^2=_
    simp only [mul_one,← map_sub,LinearIsometry.norm_map,LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map,one_mul]
    exact hf i j
  · intro h
    refine ⟨hq.le,?_⟩
    intro i j
    dsimp only
    rw [hcopy h i,hcopy h j]
    simp only [← map_sub,LinearIsometry.norm_map,LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    exact hg i j
  · intro i
    exact ⟨σ i,by change (σ i*1,i)=(σ i,i); simp⟩
end EuclideanRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Main:2.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.fieldCriterion_ramsey
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Main:2.text:
theorem fieldCriterion_ramsey {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (hs : 2 ≤ s) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (h : FieldCriterion a) : Ramsey a := by
  have hreal := fieldCriterion_realCriterion a h
  have hpaths : ∀ n : ℕ,1 ≤ n → ∃ w lmb μ,
      Path (fun i => FiniteEuclidean.embed d (a i)) w lmb ∧
      Path (fun i => FiniteEuclidean.embed d (a i)) w μ ∧
      0 < lmb ∧ μ/lmb < 1/(n:ℝ) := by
    intro n hn
    have hn' : (0:ℝ)<n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have hs' : (0:ℝ)<s := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    let η : ℝ := 1/(4*n)
    let δ : ℝ := 1/(4*n*s)
    have hη : 0<η := by dsimp [η]; positivity
    have hδ : 0<δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
    obtain ⟨ℓ,hℓ,f,g,hf,hg,hperm⟩ := realCriterion_two_scale a hd (by omega) hreal η hη
    have hq : 0<η/(1+η) := div_pos hη (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨w,lmb,μ,hp,hm,hlmb,hμ,hr⟩ :=
      permutation_equal_endpoints a ha f g (η/(1+η)) δ hq hδ hf hg hperm
    refine ⟨w,lmb,μ,hp,hm,hlmb,lt_of_le_of_lt hr ?_⟩
    have hq' : η/(1+η)<η := (div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith : 0<1+η)).mpr (by nlinarith)
    have he : η+(s:ℝ)*δ=1/(2*n) := by
      dsimp [η,δ]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hhalf : (1:ℝ)/(2*n)<1/n := by
      apply one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt hn'
      nlinarith
    rw [← he] at hhalf
    linarith
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨D,hD,hmono⟩ := finite_coloring_compactness
    (fun i => FiniteEuclidean.embed d (a i)) r
    (fun c => paths_monochromatic _ hpaths c)
  refine ⟨D,hD,?_⟩
  intro c
  obtain ⟨b,hb,k,hk⟩ := hmono c
  refine ⟨b,?_,k,hk⟩
  intro i j
  rw [dist_eq_norm,dist_eq_norm,hb,← map_sub,LinearIsometry.norm_map]

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence.at_most_five_circle_points_ramsey
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.text:
theorem at_most_five_circle_points_ramsey {s : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space 2)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs5 : s ≤ 5) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (hsphere : ∃ c : Space 2, ∃ r : ℝ, ∀ i, dist (a i) c = r) : Ramsey a := by
  obtain ⟨c, r, hc⟩ := hsphere
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by
    rw [← hc ⟨0, hs⟩]
    exact dist_nonneg
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · exact zero_radius_ramsey a c (by simpa [hr0] using hc)
  · have hrpos : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hr (Ne.symm hr0)
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbc, f, hf⟩ := extend_to_five a hs5 ha c r hrpos hc
    have hramsey := ramsey_restrict b f (five_circle_points_ramsey b hb c r hbc)
    have he : b ∘ f = a := funext hf
    rwa [he] at hramsey

end EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence.extend_to_five
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.text:
theorem extend_to_five {s : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space 2)
    (hs : s ≤ 5) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (c : Space 2) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hc : ∀ i, dist (a i) c = r) :
    ∃ b : Fin 5 → Space 2, Function.Injective b ∧
      (∀ j, dist (b j) c = r) ∧ ∃ f : Fin s → Fin 5, ∀ i, b (f i) = a i := by
  classical
  let S : Finset (Space 2) := Finset.univ.image a
  have hS : S.card = s := by simp [S, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ ha]
  have hSc : ∀ p ∈ S, dist p c = r := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    exact hc i
  obtain ⟨T, hTc, hT⟩ := (circle_infinite c r hr).exists_subset_card_eq 5
  have hST : 5 ≤ (S ∪ T).card := by
    rw [← hT]
    exact Finset.card_le_card Finset.subset_union_right
  obtain ⟨U, hSU, hUst, hU⟩ := Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq
    (Finset.subset_union_left : S ⊆ S ∪ T) (by omega : S.card ≤ 5) hST
  let e : U ≃ Fin 5 := Finset.equivFinOfCardEq hU
  let b : Fin 5 → Space 2 := fun j => (e.symm j).val
  refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    exact e.symm.injective (Subtype.ext hij)
  · intro j
    have hj : b j ∈ S ∪ T := hUst (e.symm j).property
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hj with hj | hj
    · exact hSc _ hj
    · exact hTc hj
  · let f : Fin s → Fin 5 := fun i => e ⟨a i, hSU (by simp [S])⟩
    refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
    intro i
    simp [b, f]
end EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence.circle_five_rows_independent
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.text:
theorem circle_five_rows_independent (a : Fin 5 → Space 2)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (c : Space 2) (r : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, dist (a i) c = r) :
    LinearIndependent (Coeff a) (fun i : Fin 5 => fun q : QIndex =>
      augmented a i q.1 * augmented a i q.2) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := normalized_isolators a ha c r hc
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg i
  have hzero (q : QIndex) : ∑ j, g j * quadraticRow a j q = 0 := by
    simpa [quadraticRow] using congrFun hg q
  have hpair : ∑ q, L i q * (∑ j, g j * quadraticRow a j q) = 0 := by
    simp [hzero]
  have hcalc : (∑ q, L i q * (∑ j, g j * quadraticRow a j q)) = g i := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      _ = ∑ j, g j * (∑ q, L i q * quadraticRow a j q) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro q hq
        ring
      _ = g i := by simp [hL]
  exact hcalc.symm.trans hpair
end EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.spherical_quadraticIndependent_ramsey
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.text:
theorem spherical_quadraticIndependent_ramsey {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (hs : 0 < s) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤)
    (hsphere : ∃ c : Space d, ∃ r : ℝ, ∀ i, dist (a i) c = r)
    (hrows : LinearIndependent (Coeff a)
      (fun i : Fin s => fun q : Option (Fin d) × Option (Fin d) =>
        augmented a i q.1 * augmented a i q.2)) : Ramsey a := by
  classical
  by_cases hs1 : s = 1
  · subst s
    exact singleton_ramsey a
  have hs2 : 2 ≤ s := by omega
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := by
    by_contra hd
    have hd0 : d = 0 := by omega
    subst d
    have he : a ⟨0, by omega⟩ = a ⟨1, by omega⟩ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hi := congrArg Fin.val (ha he)
    norm_num at hi
  obtain ⟨h, hzero, hspatial⟩ := sphere_field_quadratic a hsphere
  apply (classification a hs2 hd ha hspan).mpr
  exact quadraticIndependent_fieldCriterion a hrows h hzero hspatial

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence.circle_five_affineSpan
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.text:
theorem circle_five_affineSpan (a : Fin 5 → Space 2)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (c : Space 2) (r : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, dist (a i) c = r) : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤ := by
  classical
  let A := affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a)
  have hp (i : Fin 5) : a i ∈ A := mem_affineSpan ℝ (Set.mem_range_self i)
  let u := a 1 - a 0
  let v := a 2 - a 0
  let D : ℝ := u 0 * v 1 - v 0 * u 1
  have hfield := secantValue_ne_zero a ha c (r^2) (circle_coordinates a c r hc)
    0 1 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hD : D ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hfield
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [D, u, v, secantValue, coordinate, mul_comm] using h
  have hu : u ∈ A.direction := by
    simpa [u, vsub_eq_sub] using AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction (hp 1) (hp 0)
  have hv : v ∈ A.direction := by
    simpa [v, vsub_eq_sub] using AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction (hp 2) (hp 0)
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  let w := x - a 0
  let α : ℝ := (w 0 * v 1 - v 0 * w 1) / D
  let β : ℝ := (u 0 * w 1 - w 0 * u 1) / D
  have hcomb : α • u + β • v = w := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;>
      simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;>
      dsimp [α, β] <;>
      field_simp [hD] <;>
      dsimp [D] <;> ring
  have hm : α • u + β • v ∈ A.direction :=
    A.direction.add_mem (A.direction.smul_mem α hu) (A.direction.smul_mem β hv)
  have he := AffineSubspace.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hm (hp 0)
  simpa [hcomb, w, vadd_eq_add] using he
end EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence.ramsey_restrict
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.text:
theorem ramsey_restrict {s t d : ℕ} (a : Fin t → Space d)
    (f : Fin s → Fin t) (ha : Ramsey a) : Ramsey (a ∘ f) := by
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨D, hD, h⟩ := ha r hr
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro c
  obtain ⟨b, hb, k, hk⟩ := h c
  exact ⟨b ∘ f, fun i j => hb (f i) (f j), k, fun i => hk (f i)⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence.five_circle_points_ramsey
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.text:
theorem five_circle_points_ramsey (a : Fin 5 → Space 2)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (c : Space 2) (r : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, dist (a i) c = r) : Ramsey a := by
  exact spherical_quadraticIndependent_ramsey a (by decide) ha
    (circle_five_affineSpan a ha c r hc) ⟨c, r, hc⟩
    (circle_five_rows_independent a ha c r hc)

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence.circle_infinite
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.text:
theorem circle_infinite (c : Space 2) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    {p : Space 2 | dist p c = r}.Infinite := by
  apply (Set.infinite_range_of_injective (stereographic_injective c r hr)).mono
  rintro p ⟨t, rfl⟩
  exact stereographic_on_circle c r t hr

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.CircleConsequence.zero_radius_ramsey
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Circle.text:
theorem zero_radius_ramsey {s : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space 2)
    (c : Space 2) (h : ∀ i, dist (a i) c = 0) : Ramsey a := by
  intro r hr
  refine ⟨1, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro coloring
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, coloring 0, fun _ => rfl⟩
  intro i j
  have hi : a i = c := dist_eq_zero.mp (h i)
  have hj : a j = c := dist_eq_zero.mp (h j)
  simp [hi, hj]

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.NineGe.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.NineGeometry.circleConfig
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.NineGe.text: def circleConfig (t : Fin 9 → ℝ) (i : Fin 9) : Space 2 := circlePoint (t i)

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.NineSt.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.NineStatement.nine_circle_configuration
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.NineSt.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Nine:8.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.NineMain.nine_circle_configuration
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Nine:8.text:
theorem nine_circle_configuration (t : Fin 9 → ℝ)

      (∀ i, dist (circleConfig t i) 0 = 1) ∧ ¬ Ramsey (circleConfig t) :=

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Nine:7.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.NineMain.nine_circle_not_ramsey

theorem nine_circle_not_ramsey (t : Fin 9 → ℝ)
    (ht : AlgebraicIndependent ℚ t) : ¬ Ramsey (circleConfig t) := by
  exact NineLinearObstruction.not_ramsey_of_det_ne_zero (circleConfig t)
    (by decide) (by decide) (circleConfig_affineSpan t ht)
    (NineField.coordinateTensorEmbedding t ht)
    (NineField.coordinateTensorEmbedding_injective t ht) rowEquiv
    (evaluationMatrix_det_ne_zero t ht)

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.NineSt.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.NineStatement.literalCircleConfig
OAI.EuclideanRamsey.NineStatement.literalCircleConfig_eq
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.NineSt.text:
theorem literalCircleConfig_eq (t : Fin 9 → ℝ) :

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.quadratic_empty_ramsey
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.text:
theorem quadratic_empty_ramsey {d : ℕ} (a : Fin 0 → Space d) : Ramsey a := by
  intro r hr
  refine ⟨1, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro c
  refine ⟨fun i => Fin.elim0 i, ?_, ⟨0, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  · intro i
    exact Fin.elim0 i

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.spherical_quadraticIndependent_ramsey_all
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.text:
theorem spherical_quadraticIndependent_ramsey_all {s d : ℕ}
    (a : Fin s → Space d) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤)
    (hsphere : ∃ c : Space d, ∃ r : ℝ, ∀ i, dist (a i) c = r)
    (hrows : LinearIndependent (Coeff a)
      (fun i : Fin s => fun q : Option (Fin d) × Option (Fin d) =>
        augmented a i q.1 * augmented a i q.2)) : Ramsey a := by
  by_cases hs : 0 < s
  · exact spherical_quadraticIndependent_ramsey a hs ha hspan hsphere hrows
  · have hs0 : s = 0 := by omega
    subst s
    exact quadratic_empty_ramsey a

end EuclideanRamsey

end

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.sphere_field_quadratic
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.text:
theorem sphere_field_quadratic {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (hsphere : ∃ c : Space d, ∃ r : ℝ, ∀ i, dist (a i) c = r) :
    ∃ h : QuadraticIndex d → Coeff a,
      augmentedQuadraticRows a *ᵥ h = 0 ∧
      ∀ j k : Fin d, h (some j, some k) = if j = k then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, r, hr⟩ := hsphere
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one (Coeff a)
    (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
  have hfix (x : Coeff a) : φ (x : ℝ) = x := by
    have ht := φ.map_smul x (1 : ℝ)
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def, hφ] using ht
  have hmul (x : Coeff a) (t : ℝ) : φ ((x : ℝ) * t) = x * φ t := by
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using φ.map_smul x t
  let C : ℝ := (∑ j, (c j)^2) - r^2
  let h : QuadraticIndex d → Coeff a := fun q =>
    match q.1, q.2 with
    | none, none => φ C
    | none, some j => φ (-2 * c j)
    | some _, none => 0
    | some j, some k => if j = k then 1 else 0
  refine ⟨h, ?_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  funext i
  have hreal : C + (∑ j, a i j * (-2 * c j)) + (∑ j, (a i j)^2) = 0 := by
    have hdist : (∑ j, (a i j - c j)^2) = r^2 := by
      calc
        (∑ j, (a i j - c j)^2) = dist (a i) c ^ 2 := by
          simpa only [Real.dist_eq, sq_abs] using
            (EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq (a i) c).symm
        _ = r^2 := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x^2) (hr i)
    have hexpand : (∑ j, (a i j - c j)^2) =
        (∑ j, (a i j)^2) + (∑ j, a i j * (-2*c j)) + (∑ j, (c j)^2) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring
    dsimp [C]
    linarith
  have hdesc := congrArg φ hreal
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_zero] at hdesc
  have hlinear (j : Fin d) : φ (a i j * (-2*c j)) =
      coordinate a i j * φ (-2*c j) := hmul (coordinate a i j) _
  have hsquare (j : Fin d) : φ ((a i j)^2) = (coordinate a i j)^2 := by
    change φ (((coordinate a i j)^2 : Coeff a) : ℝ) = (coordinate a i j)^2
    exact hfix _
  simp only [hlinear, hsquare] at hdesc
  change (∑ q : QuadraticIndex d, augmentedQuadraticRows a i q * h q) = 0
  simpa [augmentedQuadraticRows, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option,
    augmented, h, mul_ite, ite_mul, pow_two, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
    mul_assoc] using hdesc

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.quadraticIndependent_fieldCriterion
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Quadra.text:
theorem quadraticIndependent_fieldCriterion {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (hrows : LinearIndependent (Coeff a) (augmentedQuadraticRows a).row)
    (h : QuadraticIndex d → Coeff a)
    (hzero : augmentedQuadraticRows a *ᵥ h = 0)
    (hspatial : ∀ j k : Fin d, h (some j, some k) = if j = k then 1 else 0) :
    FieldCriterion a := by
  classical
  let D : Matrix (Fin s) (QuadraticIndex d) (TensorRing a) :=
    fun i q => augmented a i q.1 ⊗ₜ[ℚ] augmented a i q.2
  let μ : TensorRing a →+* Coeff a := (multiply a).toRingHom
  let σ : Coeff a →+* TensorRing a := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
  have hsection (x : Coeff a) : μ (σ x) = x := by
    simp [μ, σ, multiply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom]
  have hD : D.map μ = augmentedQuadraticRows a := by
    funext i q
    change Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' ℚ
      (augmented a i q.1 ⊗ₜ[ℚ] augmented a i q.2) =
        augmented a i q.1 * augmented a i q.2
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_apply_tmul _ _
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hm⟩ := Quadratic.lift_kernel μ σ hsection D
    (by simpa only [hD] using hrows) h (by simpa only [hD] using hzero)
  refine ⟨fun α β => z (α, β), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have ht := congrFun hz i
    change (∑ q, D i q * z q) = 0 at ht
    have hsand (x y : Coeff a) (T : TensorRing a) :
        (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : Coeff a)) * T * ((1 : Coeff a) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y) =
          (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y) * T := by
      have hpair :
          ((x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : Coeff a)) : TensorRing a) *
              ((1 : Coeff a) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y) = x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y :=
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul x (1 : Coeff a) (1 : Coeff a) y).trans
          (congrArg₂ (fun u v : Coeff a => u ⊗ₜ[ℚ] v) (mul_one x) (one_mul y))
      exact (mul_right_comm ((x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : Coeff a)) : TensorRing a) T
        (((1 : Coeff a) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y) : TensorRing a)).trans
          (congrArg (fun U : TensorRing a => U * T) hpair)
    simp only [hsand]
    simpa only [D, Fintype.sum_prod_type] using ht
  · intro j k
    exact (congrFun hm (some j, some k)).trans (hspatial j k)

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.arrayEvaluation
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
def arrayEvaluation {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) (i : Fin s) :
    RealArray d →ₗ[ℚ] RealTensor where
  toFun P := ∑ α, ∑ β, ((realAugmented a i α) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℝ)) * P α β *
    ((1 : ℝ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (realAugmented a i β))
  map_add' P Q := by
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, mul_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' q P := by
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
      Finset.smul_sum]

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Main:7.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.full_affine_representative
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Main:7.text:
theorem full_affine_representative {s D : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space D)
    (hs : 2 ≤ s) (ha : Function.Injective a) :
    ∃ d : ℕ,1 ≤ d ∧ ∃ b : Fin s → Space d,Function.Injective b ∧
      Congruent a b ∧ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range b)=⊤ := by
  classical
  let i₀ : Fin s := ⟨0,by omega⟩
  let i₁ : Fin s := ⟨1,by omega⟩
  let V : Submodule ℝ (Space D) := Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun i => a i-a i₀))
  have hx (i : Fin s) : a i-a i₀∈V := Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)
  let x (i : Fin s) : V := ⟨a i-a i₀,hx i⟩
  have hxspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range x)=⊤ :=
    (Submodule.span_range_subtype_eq_top_iff V hx).mpr rfl
  have hpos : 0<Module.finrank ℝ V := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    refine ⟨x i₁,?_⟩
    intro he
    have hv := congrArg (fun z : V => (z : Space D)) he
    change a i₁-a i₀=0 at hv
    have hi := ha (sub_eq_zero.mp hv)
    have hi' := congrArg Fin.val hi
    norm_num [i₀,i₁] at hi'
  let E := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ V).repr
  let b : Fin s → Space (Module.finrank ℝ V) := fun i => E (x i)
  have hbspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range b)=⊤ := by
    change Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (E.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap ∘ x))=⊤
    rw [Set.range_comp,Submodule.span_image,hxspan,Submodule.map_top]
    exact LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr E.surjective
  have hb0 : b i₀=0 := by
    change E (x i₀)=0
    have hx0 : x i₀=0 := by apply Subtype.ext; exact sub_self _
    rw [hx0,map_zero]
  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℝ V,hpos, b,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i j he
    have hx' := E.injective he
    have hv := congrArg (fun z : V => (z : Space D)) hx'
    change a i-a i₀=a j-a i₀ at hv
    exact ha (sub_left_injective hv)
  · intro i j
    change dist (E (x i)) (E (x j))=dist (a i) (a j)
    rw [dist_eq_norm,dist_eq_norm,← map_sub,LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    change ‖(a i-a i₀)-(a j-a i₀)‖=‖a i-a j‖
    rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
  · apply (AffineSubspace.direction_eq_top_iff_of_nonempty
      ⟨b i₀,subset_affineSpan ℝ (Set.range b) (Set.mem_range_self i₀)⟩).mp
    rw [direction_affineSpan,vectorSpan_range_eq_span_range_vsub_right ℝ b i₀]
    simpa only [vsub_eq_sub,hb0,sub_zero] using hbspan
end EuclideanRamsey

namespace EuclideanRamsey

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Model:.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.Congruent
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Model:.text:
def Congruent {s d D : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) (b : Fin s → Space D) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, dist (b i) (b j) = dist (a i) (a j)

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.spatialMultiply
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
def spatialMultiply {d : ℕ} : RealArray d →ₗ[ℚ] Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ where
  toFun P := fun α β => Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' ℚ (P (some α) (some β))
  map_add' P Q := by
    ext α β
    exact map_add (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' ℚ) _ _
  map_smul' q P := by
    ext α β
    exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' ℚ).toLinearMap.map_smul q _

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Congru.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.ramsey_congruent_iff
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Congru.text:
theorem ramsey_congruent_iff {s d D : ℕ} {a : Fin s → Space d}
    {b : Fin s → Space D} (h : Congruent a b) : Ramsey a ↔ Ramsey b := by
  constructor
  · intro ha r hr
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := ha r hr
    refine ⟨n, hn, fun c => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, k, hk⟩ := hn' c
    exact ⟨x, fun i j => (hx i j).trans (h i j).symm, k, hk⟩
  · intro ha r hr
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := ha r hr
    refine ⟨n, hn, fun c => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, k, hk⟩ := hn' c
    exact ⟨x, fun i j => (hx i j).trans (h i j), k, hk⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.ramsey_realCriterion
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
theorem ramsey_realCriterion {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤)
    (hR : Ramsey a) : RealCriterion a := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨f, L, hL, heq, hcancel⟩ := exists_separated_functions a h
  let K := 2 * s + 1
  let Colors := Fin s → ZMod K
  have hK : 1 < K := by dsimp [K]; omega
  have hr : 2 ≤ Fintype.card Colors := by
    change 2 ≤ Fintype.card (Fin s → ZMod K)
    simp only [Fintype.card_fun, ZMod.card, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega) hK
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hD'⟩ := hR (Fintype.card Colors) hr
  let H : Fin s → Space D → ℝ := fun i z => ∑ j, f i (z j)
  have hH (z : Space D) : ∑ i, H i z = 0 := by
    simp only [H]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [hcancel, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  let color : Space D → Colors := fun z i => (⌊(K : ℝ) / 2 * H i z⌋ : ZMod K)
  obtain ⟨b, hb, k, hk⟩ := hD' (fun z => Fintype.equivFin Colors (color z))
  have hmono : ∀ i, color (b i) = color (b ⟨0, hs⟩) := by
    intro i
    apply (Fintype.equivFin Colors).injective
    exact (hk i).trans (hk ⟨0, hs⟩).symm
  have hnot := floor_coloring_obstruction hs H hH b hmono
  apply hnot
  obtain ⟨Q, t, hQ⟩ := congruent_linearIsometry a b ⟨0, hs⟩ hspan hb
  simp only [H, hQ]
  exact separated_copy_sum a f L hL heq Q t

end EuclideanRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.floor_coloring_obstruction
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
theorem floor_coloring_obstruction {X : Type uPoint} {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (H : Fin s → X → ℝ) (hcancel : ∀ z, ∑ i, H i z = 0)
    (b : Fin s → X)
    (hmono : ∀ i, (fun j : Fin s =>
      (⌊((2 * s + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * H j (b i)⌋ : ZMod (2 * s + 1))) =
      (fun j : Fin s =>
      (⌊((2 * s + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * H j (b ⟨0, hs⟩)⌋ : ZMod (2 * s + 1)))) :
    ∑ i, H i (b i) ≠ -1 := by
  intro hsum
  let K : ℕ := 2 * s + 1
  let x : Fin s → ℝ := fun i => (K : ℝ) / 2 * H i (b i)
  let y : Fin s → ℝ := fun i => (K : ℝ) / 2 * H i (b ⟨0, hs⟩)
  have hx : ∑ i, x i = -(K : ℝ) / 2 := by
    simp [x, ← Finset.mul_sum, hsum]; ring
  have hy : ∑ i, y i = 0 := by
    simp [y, ← Finset.mul_sum, hcancel]
  let A : ℤ := ∑ i, ⌊x i⌋
  let B : ℤ := ∑ i, ⌊y i⌋
  have hAB : (A : ZMod K) = (B : ZMod K) := by
    simp only [A, B, Int.cast_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact congrFun (hmono i) i
  have hdvd : (K : ℤ) ∣ B - A := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub A B K).mp hAB
  obtain ⟨hxlo, hxhi⟩ := sum_floor_bounds hs x
  obtain ⟨hylo, hyhi⟩ := sum_floor_bounds hs y
  change (∑ i, x i) - s < (A : ℝ) at hxlo
  change (A : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, x i at hxhi
  change (∑ i, y i) - s < (B : ℝ) at hylo
  change (B : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, y i at hyhi
  rw [hx] at hxlo hxhi
  rw [hy] at hylo hyhi
  have hK : (K : ℝ) = 2 * (s : ℝ) + 1 := by simp [K]
  have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < B - A := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (B : ℝ) - (A : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hlt : B - A < (K : ℤ) := by
    have : (B : ℝ) - (A : ℝ) < (K : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) (Int.le_of_dvd hpos hdvd)

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.exists_separated_functions
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
theorem exists_separated_functions {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (h : ¬ RealCriterion a) :
    ∃ f : Fin s → ℝ → ℝ, ∃ L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℝ,
      L 1 = 1 ∧
      (∀ v u, (∑ i, f i (affineEvaluation a i v u)) + L (gradientRankOne u) = 0) ∧
      ∀ x, ∑ i, f i x = 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hℓ₀⟩ := separate_arrayMap a h
  let f : Fin s → ℝ → ℝ := fun i x => ℓ (Pi.single i (x ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x), 0)
  let L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℝ := ℓ.comp (LinearMap.inr ℚ _ _)
  have hsplit (x : Fin s → RealTensor) (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :
      ℓ (x, M) = (∑ i, ℓ (Pi.single i (x i), 0)) + L M := by
    change ℓ (x, M) = (∑ i, ℓ (Pi.single i (x i), 0)) + ℓ (0, M)
    rw [← map_sum, ← map_add]
    congr 1
    ext <;> simp [Prod.fst_sum, Prod.snd_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  have heq (v : ℝ) (u : Space d) :
      (∑ i, f i (affineEvaluation a i v u)) + L (gradientRankOne u) = 0 := by
    have hp := hℓ (diagonalArray v u)
    change ℓ ((fun i => arrayEvaluation a i (diagonalArray v u)),
      spatialMultiply (diagonalArray v u)) = 0 at hp
    simp only [arrayEvaluation_diagonal, spatialMultiply_diagonal] at hp
    rw [hsplit] at hp
    exact hp
  refine ⟨f, L, hℓ₀, heq, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hz : gradientRankOne (0 : Space d) = 0 := by ext; simp [gradientRankOne]
  simpa [affineEvaluation, hz] using heq x (0 : Space d)

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.realCriterion_cospherical
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
theorem realCriterion_cospherical {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (hs : 0 < s) (h : RealCriterion a) :
    EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical (Set.range a) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hzero, hidentity⟩ := h
  let H : Matrix (Option (Fin d)) (Option (Fin d)) ℝ :=
    fun α β => Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' ℚ (P α β)
  have hspatial (j k : Fin d) : H (some j) (some k) = if j = k then 1 else 0 := by
    have hentry := congrFun (congrFun hidentity j) k
    change Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' ℚ (P (some j) (some k)) =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) j k at hentry
    simpa only [H, Matrix.one_apply] using hentry

  
  have hquad (i : Fin s) :
      H none none +
        (∑ j, (H none (some j) + H (some j) none) * a i j) +
        (∑ j, (a i j) ^ 2) = 0 := by
    have htensor :
        (∑ α, ∑ β,
          ((realAugmented a i α) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (1 : ℝ)) * P α β *
            ((1 : ℝ) ⊗ₜ[ℚ] (realAugmented a i β))) = 0 :=
      hzero i
    have hreal := congrArg (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' ℚ (S := ℝ)) htensor
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_apply_tmul,
      mul_one, one_mul, map_zero] at hreal
    change (∑ α, ∑ β,
      realAugmented a i α * H α β * realAugmented a i β) = 0 at hreal
    simp only [Fintype.sum_option, realAugmented, one_mul, mul_one,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hreal
    have hdiagonal :
        (∑ j : Fin d, ∑ k : Fin d, a i j * H (some j) (some k) * a i k) =
          ∑ j : Fin d, (a i j) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      simp [hspatial, mul_ite, ite_mul, pow_two]
    have hlinear :
        (∑ j : Fin d, H none (some j) * a i j) +
          (∑ j : Fin d, a i j * H (some j) none) =
          ∑ j : Fin d, (H none (some j) + H (some j) none) * a i j := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring
    rw [hdiagonal] at hreal
    linarith [hlinear]

  
  let center : Space d := WithLp.toLp 2
    (fun j => -((H none (some j) + H (some j) none) / 2))
  have hdist (i : Fin s) :
      dist (a i) center ^ 2 = (∑ j, (center j) ^ 2) - H none none := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq]
    simp only [Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
    calc
      (∑ j, (a i j - center j) ^ 2) =
          (∑ j, (a i j) ^ 2) +
            (∑ j, (H none (some j) + H (some j) none) * a i j) +
            (∑ j, (center j) ^ 2) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        dsimp [center]
        ring
      _ = (∑ j, (center j) ^ 2) - H none none := by
        linarith [hquad i]

  
  let first : Fin s := ⟨0, hs⟩
  refine ⟨center, dist (a first) center, ?_⟩
  rintro p ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).mp ((hdist i).trans (hdist first).symm)

end EuclideanRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Congru.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.congruent_linearIsometry
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Congru.text:
theorem congruent_linearIsometry {s d D : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (b : Fin s → Space D) (i₀ : Fin s)
    (hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤) (h : Congruent a b) :
    ∃ Q : Space d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space D, ∃ t : Space D, ∀ i, b i = t + Q (a i) := by
  have hv : vectorSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤ := by
    simpa only [direction_affineSpan, AffineSubspace.direction_top] using
      congrArg AffineSubspace.direction hspan
  have hs : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun i => a i - a i₀) = ⊤ := by
    rw [vectorSpan_range_eq_span_range_vsub_right ℝ a i₀] at hv
    exact hv
  have hg (i j : Fin s) : ⟪b i - b i₀, b j - b i₀⟫ =
      ⟪a i - a i₀, a j - a i₀⟫ := by
    simp only [real_inner_eq_norm_mul_self_add_norm_mul_self_sub_norm_sub_mul_self_div_two,
      sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, ← dist_eq_norm]
    rw [h i i₀, h j i₀, h i j]
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := linearIsometry_of_equal_gram
    (fun i => a i - a i₀) (fun i => b i - b i₀) hs hg
  refine ⟨Q, b i₀ - Q (a i₀), fun i => ?_⟩
  have hi := hQ i
  rw [map_sub] at hi
  calc
    b i = (b i - b i₀) + b i₀ := (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm
    _ = (Q (a i) - Q (a i₀)) + b i₀ := by rw [hi]
    _ = b i₀ - Q (a i₀) + Q (a i) := by abel

end EuclideanRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.separated_copy_sum
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
theorem separated_copy_sum {s d D : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (f : Fin s → ℝ → ℝ) (L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℝ)
    (hL : L 1 = 1)
    (heq : ∀ v u, (∑ i, f i (affineEvaluation a i v u)) + L (gradientRankOne u) = 0)
    (Q : Space d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space D) (t : Space D) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, f i ((t + Q (a i)) j) = -1 := by
  have hrows : (∑ j, gradientRankOne (isometryRows Q j)) = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := by
    ext α β
    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, gradientRankOne, Matrix.one_apply, isometryRows_gram]
  have heach (j : Fin D) :
      (∑ i, f i ((t + Q (a i)) j)) = -L (gradientRankOne (isometryRows Q j)) := by
    have h := heq (t j) (isometryRows Q j)
    apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
    convert h using 2
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    congr 1
    simp only [PiLp.add_apply, affineEvaluation, isometryRows_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [heach, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← map_sum, hrows, hL]

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Spheri.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.ramsey_cospherical
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Spheri.text:
theorem ramsey_cospherical {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (hR : Ramsey a) :
    EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical (Set.range a) := by
  by_cases hs0 : s = 0
  · subst s
    refine ⟨0, 0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  · by_cases hs1 : s = 1
    · subst s
      refine ⟨a 0, 0, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [hi, dist_self]
    · have hs2 : 2 ≤ s := by omega
      obtain ⟨D, _hD, b, _hb, hab, hspan⟩ :=
        full_affine_representative a hs2 ha
      have hbR : Ramsey b := (ramsey_congruent_iff hab).mp hR
      have hbCriterion : RealCriterion b :=
        ramsey_realCriterion b (by omega) hspan hbR
      have hbSphere : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical (Set.range b) :=
        realCriterion_cospherical b (by omega) hbCriterion
      exact cospherical_transport a b hspan hab hbSphere

end EuclideanRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.realAugmented
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
def realAugmented {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) (i : Fin s) : Option (Fin d) → ℝ
  | none => 1
  | some j => a i j

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.RealCriterion
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text:
def RealCriterion {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) : Prop :=
  ∃ P : RealArray d, (∀ i, arrayEvaluation a i P = 0) ∧ spatialMultiply P = 1

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.RealArray
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Tensor.text: abbrev RealArray (d : ℕ) := Matrix (Option (Fin d)) (Option (Fin d)) RealTensor

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Sphere.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.cospherical_transport
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Sphere.text:
theorem cospherical_transport {s D d : ℕ}
    (a : Fin s → Space D) (b : Fin s → Space d)
    (hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range b) = ⊤)
    (hab : Congruent a b)
    (hb : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical (Set.range b)) :
    EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical (Set.range a) := by
  by_cases hs : s = 0
  · subst s
    refine ⟨0, 0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  · have hspos : 0 < s := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hs
    have hba : Congruent b a := fun i j => (hab i j).symm
    obtain ⟨Q, t, hQ⟩ :=
      congruent_linearIsometry b a ⟨0, hspos⟩ hspan hba
    obtain ⟨center, radius, hcenter⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨t + Q center, radius, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    calc
      dist (a i) (t + Q center) =
          dist (t + Q (b i)) (t + Q center) := by rw [hQ i]
      _ = dist (Q (b i)) (Q center) := by
        simp only [dist_eq_norm]
        congr 1
        abel
      _ = dist (b i) center := Q.dist_map _ _
      _ = radius := hcenter (b i) (Set.mem_range_self i)

end EuclideanRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.TransitiveConsequence.averaged_realCriterion
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.text:
theorem averaged_realCriterion {s d t D : ℕ}
    (a : Fin s → Space d) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤)
    (y : Fin t → Space D) (hy : IsTransitive y)
    (e : Fin s → Fin t) (he : Congruent a (fun i => y (e i))) :
    RealCriterion a := by
  classical
  let H := distancePermutationGroup y
  let i₀ : Fin s := ⟨0, hs⟩
  have hcopies (σ : H) :
      ∃ Q : Space d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space D, ∃ z : Space D,
        ∀ i, y (σ.val (e i)) = z + Q (a i) := by
    apply congruent_linearIsometry a (fun i => y (σ.val (e i))) i₀ hspan
    intro i j
    exact (σ.property (e i) (e j)).trans (he i j)
  choose Q z hz using hcopies
  let S : RealArray d := ∑ σ : H, ∑ j : Fin D,
    (diagonalArray (z σ j) (isometryRows (Q σ) j) -
      diagonalArray (y (σ.val (e i₀)) j) 0)
  let q : ℚ := (Fintype.card H : ℚ)⁻¹
  have hcard : (Fintype.card H : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card H ≠ 0)
  have haff (σ : H) (i : Fin s) (j : Fin D) :
      affineEvaluation a i (z σ j) (isometryRows (Q σ) j) =
        y (σ.val (e i)) j := by
    calc
      affineEvaluation a i (z σ j) (isometryRows (Q σ) j) =
          z σ j + Q σ (a i) j := by
        rw [isometryRows_apply]
        rfl
      _ = y (σ.val (e i)) j := by
        simpa only [PiLp.add_apply] using
          (congrArg (fun v : Space D => v j) (hz σ i)).symm
  have heval (i : Fin s) :
      (∑ σ : H, ∑ j : Fin D,
        ((y (σ.val (e i)) j ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y (σ.val (e i)) j) -
          (y (σ.val (e i₀)) j ⊗ₜ[ℚ] y (σ.val (e i₀)) j))) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    exact orbit_sum_eq y hy (fun x => x j ⊗ₜ[ℚ] x j) (e i) (e i₀)
  have hS_eval (i : Fin s) : arrayEvaluation a i S = 0 := by
    dsimp only [S]
    simp only [map_sum, map_sub, arrayEvaluation_diagonal, haff]
    simpa [affineEvaluation] using heval i
  have hgram (σ : H) :
      (∑ j : Fin D,
        (gradientRankOne (isometryRows (Q σ) j) - gradientRankOne (0 : Space d))) =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := by
    ext α β
    simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, gradientRankOne, PiLp.zero_apply,
      zero_mul, sub_zero, Matrix.one_apply] using
      isometryRows_gram (Q σ) α β
  have hS_spatial : spatialMultiply S =
      (Fintype.card H : ℚ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [S]
    simp only [map_sum, map_sub, spatialMultiply_diagonal]
    simp_rw [hgram]
    ext α β
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, Rat.smul_def]
  refine ⟨q • S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [map_smul, hS_eval i, smul_zero]
  · rw [map_smul, hS_spatial, smul_smul]
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hcard, one_smul]

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.TransitiveConsequence.subset_of_finite_transitive_ramsey
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.text:
theorem subset_of_finite_transitive_ramsey {s t D : ℕ}
    (a : Fin s → Space D) (y : Fin t → Space D)
    (hs : 0 < s) (ha : Function.Injective a) (_hy : Function.Injective y)
    (htrans : ∀ i j : Fin t, ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin t),
      (∀ k l : Fin t, dist (y (σ k)) (y (σ l)) = dist (y k) (y l)) ∧ σ i = j)
    (hsub : Set.range a ⊆ Set.range y) : Ramsey a := by
  classical
  have htrans' : IsTransitive y := by
    intro i j
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hij⟩ := htrans i j
    exact ⟨⟨σ, hσ⟩, hij⟩
  have hex (i : Fin s) : ∃ j : Fin t, y j = a i :=
    hsub (Set.mem_range_self i)
  choose e he using hex
  apply isometric_subconfiguration_ramsey a hs ha y htrans' e
  intro i j
  change dist (y (e i)) (y (e j)) = dist (a i) (a j)
  rw [he i, he j]

end TransitiveConsequence
end EuclideanRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.TransitiveConsequence.isometric_subconfiguration_ramsey
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.text:
theorem isometric_subconfiguration_ramsey {s d t D : ℕ}
    (a : Fin s → Space d) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (y : Fin t → Space D) (hy : IsTransitive y)
    (e : Fin s → Fin t) (he : Congruent a (fun i => y (e i))) : Ramsey a := by
  classical
  by_cases hs1 : s = 1
  · subst s
    exact singleton_ramsey a
  have hs2 : 2 ≤ s := by omega
  obtain ⟨d', hd', b, hb, hab, hspan⟩ := full_affine_representative a hs2 ha
  have hbe : Congruent b (fun i => y (e i)) := by
    intro i j
    exact (he i j).trans (hab i j).symm
  have hreal : RealCriterion b :=
    averaged_realCriterion b hs hspan y hy e hbe
  have hrb : Ramsey b := fieldCriterion_ramsey b hs2 hd' hb
    (realCriterion_fieldCriterion b hreal)
  exact (ramsey_congruent_iff hab).mpr hrb

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.TransitiveConsequence.distancePermutationGroup
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.text:
def distancePermutationGroup {t D : ℕ} (y : Fin t → Space D) :
    Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (Fin t)) where
  carrier := {σ | ∀ i j, dist (y (σ i)) (y (σ j)) = dist (y i) (y j)}
  one_mem' := by intro i j; rfl
  mul_mem' := by
    intro σ τ hσ hτ i j
    change dist (y (σ (τ i))) (y (σ (τ j))) = dist (y i) (y j)
    rw [hσ, hτ]
  inv_mem' := by
    intro σ hσ i j
    have h := hσ (σ.symm i) (σ.symm j)
    simpa using h.symm

noncomputable instance distancePermutationFintype {t D : ℕ} (y : Fin t → Space D) :
    Fintype (distancePermutationGroup y) := Fintype.ofFinite _

OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.TransitiveConsequence.IsTransitive
OAI.Combinatorics.EuclideanRamsey.Transi.text:
def IsTransitive {t D : ℕ} (y : Fin t → Space D) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Fin t, ∃ σ : distancePermutationGroup y, σ.val i = j

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Main:33.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.Barker.periodic_offpeak_zero
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Main:33.text:
theorem periodic_offpeak_zero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {h : Fin n → ℤ}
    (hb : IsBarker h) (hn : Even n) (hnlarge : 2 < n)
    (a : Fin n) (ha : a ≠ 0) : periodic h a = 0 := by
  have ha0 : 0 < a.val := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hz : a.val = 0 := by omega
    apply ha
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa using hz
  have hab := aperiodic_bounds hb a.val ha0 a.isLt
  have hac := aperiodic_bounds hb (n - a.val) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hp := periodic_eq_aperiodic_add h a ha
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := periodic_mod_four h hb.1 a
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := four_dvd_length hb hn hnlarge
  omega

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Main:49.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.Barker.existsRealCirculantHadamard_of_even_barker
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Main:49.text:
theorem existsRealCirculantHadamard_of_even_barker {n : ℕ} {h : Fin n → ℤ}
    (hb : IsBarker h) (hn : Even n) (hnlarge : 2 < n) :
    ExistsRealCirculantHadamard n := by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  apply existsReal_iff_integer_autocorrelation.mpr
  refine ⟨h, hb.1, ?_⟩
  intro a
  change periodic h a = if a = 0 then (n : ℤ) else 0
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst a
    simp [periodic_zero h hb.1]
  · rw [ite_eq_right ha]
    exact periodic_offpeak_zero hb hn hnlarge a ha

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Main:63.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.Barker.even_length_eq_two_or_four
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Main:63.text:
theorem even_length_eq_two_or_four {n : ℕ} (h : Fin n → ℤ)
    (hnpos : 0 < n) (hn : Even n) (hb : IsBarker h) : n = 2 ∨ n = 4 := by
  by_cases hsmall : n ≤ 2
  · left
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hn
    omega
  · have hnlarge : 2 < n := by omega
    have hH := existsRealCirculantHadamard_of_even_barker hb hn hnlarge
    have hc := (exists_iff_order_one_or_four n hnpos).mp hH
    right
    omega

end CirculantHadamard.Barker

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Model:16.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.Barker.IsBarker
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Model:16.text:
def IsBarker {n : ℕ} (h : Fin n → ℤ) : Prop :=
  (∀ j, IsSign (h j)) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → k < n → |aperiodic h k| ≤ 1

end CirculantHadamard.Barker

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Parity:37.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.Barker.periodic_zero
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Parity:37.text:
theorem periodic_zero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (h : Fin n → ℤ)
    (hs : ∀ j, IsSign (h j)) : periodic h 0 = (n : ℤ) := by
  have hp (j : Fin n) : h j * h j = 1 := by
    rcases hs j with hj | hj <;> simp [hj]
  simp [periodic, hp]

end CirculantHadamard.Barker

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Model:13.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.Barker.periodic
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Model:13.text:
def periodic {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (h : Fin n → ℤ) (a : Fin n) : ℤ :=
  ∑ j : Fin n, h j * h (j - a)

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Model:10.name: OAI.CirculantHadamard.Barker.aperiodic
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Barker.Model:10.text:
def aperiodic {n : ℕ} (h : Fin n → ℤ) (k : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  ∑ j : Fin (n - k), h ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ * h ⟨j.val + k, by omega⟩

OAI.Computability.FourierCircuit.Main:17.name: OAI.ExactFourier.FourierTransfer.shifted_log_power_ratio
OAI.Computability.FourierCircuit.Main:17.text:
theorem shifted_log_power_ratio {a c : ℝ} (ha : a<1) :
 Tendsto (fun m : ℕ=>(Real.log ((m:ℝ)+c)+1)^2*((m:ℝ)+c)^a/(m:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
 have ht : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ=>(m:ℝ)+c) atTop atTop :=
  (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop c tendsto_id).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
 have h1 := (log_power_ratio ha).comp ht
 have h2 : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ=>((m:ℝ)+c)/(m:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have h := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).add ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := c)).mul (tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)))
  apply (show Tendsto (fun m : ℕ=>1+c*(m:ℝ)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 1) by simpa using h).congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0:ℕ)] with m hm
  have hm' : (m:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hm)
  field_simp
 have h := h1.mul h2
 apply (show Tendsto (fun m : ℕ=>((Real.log ((m:ℝ)+c)+1)^2*((m:ℝ)+c)^a/((m:ℝ)+c))*(((m:ℝ)+c)/(m:ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) by simpa using h).congr'
 filter_upwards [ht.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop (0:ℝ))] with m hm
 field_simp
end ExactFourier.FourierTransfer

OAI.Computability.FourierCircuit.Main:10.text:
theorem family_cost {q h : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℂ) (hq : 2≤q)
 (gen : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℂ,IsUnit M → PositiveGeneration.Pattern A h M)
 {a C : ℝ} (ha : 0≤a) (hC : 0≤C)
 (amp : ∀ k,(cost (TensorAxis.power A k) : ℝ)≤C*(q : ℝ)^k*(k+1 : ℝ)^a)
 (m : ℕ) : ∃ n : ℕ,2^m≤n ∧
 (cost (fourierMatrix n) : ℝ)≤536870917*(q*(h+1)+1 : ℕ)*(C+1)*n*
   (Real.log ((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)+1)^2*((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)^a := by
 obtain ⟨r,hr,hi,hlo,hup⟩ := PrimeInventory.family q m
 obtain ⟨ω,hω,e,he⟩ := FourierCRT.factorization r (fun i=>(hr i).pos)
   (PrimeInventory.family_coprime hr hi)
 let n := ∏ i,r i
 have hn : 2^m≤n := by
  have hp := Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i (_ : i∈(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)))=>(hr i).two_le)
  simpa [n] using hp
 have hlayer : ∀ i,Layered (RadixTwo.dft (r i) (ω i)) (depth q m) := by
  intro i
  apply (NewtonFourier.dft_layers (hr i).pos (hω i)).weaken
  dsimp [depth]
  have hh := Nat.log_mono_right (b := 2) (hup i)
  gcongr
 have hc := ParallelTensorCost.layered_cost ha hC amp hq gen m (depth q m)
   (fun i=>Fin (r i)) (fun i=>RadixTwo.dft (r i) (ω i)) hlayer
   (fun i=>by simpa using hlo i)
 rw [← he,CircuitCost.cost_reindex] at hc
 simp only [Fintype.card_pi,Fintype.card_fin] at hc
 let x : ℝ := (m:ℝ)+2*q+10
 have hx : 1≤x := by dsimp [x]; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) m,Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) q]
 have hxm : (m:ℝ)+1≤x := by dsimp [x]; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) q]
 have hp := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity : (0:ℝ)≤(m:ℝ)+1) hxm ha
 have hp1 : 1≤x^a := Real.one_le_rpow hx ha
 have hbudget : C*((m:ℝ)+1)^a+1≤(C+1)*x^a := by nlinarith
 have hd := depth_bound q m
 have hb0 : 0≤C*((m:ℝ)+1)^a+1 := by positivity
 refine ⟨n,hn,hc.trans ?_⟩
 change ((depth q m*(q*(h+1)+1) : ℕ):ℝ)*(C*(n:ℝ)*((m:ℝ)+1)^a+(n:ℝ))≤_
 calc
  _ = (depth q m : ℝ)*(q*(h+1)+1 : ℕ)*n*(C*((m:ℝ)+1)^a+1) := by push_cast; ring
  _ ≤ (536870917*(Real.log x+1)^2)*(q*(h+1)+1 : ℕ)*n*((C+1)*x^a) := by
   exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)) hbudget hb0 (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg n))
  _ = _ := by dsimp [x]; ring
end ExactFourier.FourierTransfer

end

OAI.Computability.FourierCircuit.Amplifi.text:
theorem tensor_amplification {q b : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℂ)
 (hb : 2≤b) (W : List (WordStep A (q^b))) (hW : wordMatrix W=tensorPower A b)
 (hw : wordCalls W<b*q^(b-1)) :
 ∃ a C : ℝ,0<a ∧ a<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ k,
 (cost (power A k) : ℝ)≤C*(q : ℝ)^k*(k+1 : ℝ)^a := by
 have hq : 0<q := by
  by_contra h
  have he : q=0 := by omega
  simp only [he,zero_pow (by omega : b-1≠0),mul_zero] at hw
  omega
 have hb0 : b≠0 := by omega
 have hbR : (0:ℝ)<b := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<b by omega)
 have hqR : (0:ℝ)<q := by exact_mod_cast hq
 have hp : (0:ℝ)<(q : ℝ)/(q^b : ℕ) := by positivity
 have hp1 : (q : ℝ)/(q^b : ℕ)≤1 := by
  apply (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_self_pow hb0 q
 have hs : (wordCalls W : ℝ)*(((q : ℝ)/(q^b : ℕ))/b)<1 := by
  have hwR : (wordCalls W : ℝ)<b*(q : ℝ)^(b-1) := by exact_mod_cast hw
  have he : (q : ℝ)^b=(q : ℝ)^(b-1)*q := by
   conv_lhs => rw [show b=b-1+1 by omega,pow_succ]
  push_cast
  rw [he]
  field_simp
  nlinarith
 obtain ⟨a,C,ha0,ha1,hC,hbound⟩ := recurrence_bound (normalizedCost A) hb hp hp1
  (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (show (0:ℝ)≤W.length+2*q*b by positivity) hs
  (normalized_recurrence hq A (by omega) W hW)
 refine ⟨a,C,ha0,ha1,hC,fun k=>?_⟩
 have hh := (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hqR k)).mp (hbound k)
 nlinarith only [hh]
end ExactFourier.Amplification

end

OAI.Computability.FourierCircuit.Main:22.text:
theorem win_to_fourier (win : FiniteWinStatement) : MainStatement := by
 obtain ⟨q,A,hA,hn,b,hb,W,hW,hw⟩ := win
 have hn' : ¬MonomialMatrix A := hn
 obtain ⟨h,hh,gen⟩ := PositiveGeneration.positive_generation A hA hn'
 obtain ⟨a,C,ha,ha1,hC,amp⟩ := Amplification.tensor_amplification A hb W hW hw
 have hq : 2≤q := by
  obtain ⟨k,i,j,hij,_⟩ := PositiveGeneration.exists_nondiagonal_projector A hA hn'
  have hne : i.val≠j.val := fun e=>hij (Fin.ext e)
  have hi := i.isLt
  have hj := j.isLt
  omega
 intro c hc N₀ hN₀
 let K : ℝ := 536870917*(q*(h+1)+1 : ℕ)*(C+1)
 have hK : 0<K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
 have ht := (FourierTransfer.shifted_log_power_ratio (c := (2:ℝ)*q+10) ha1).const_mul K
 have hlim : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ=>K*(Real.log ((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)+1)^2*((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)^a/(m:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  convert ht using 1 <;> try simp only [mul_zero]
  funext m
  simp only [add_assoc]
  ring
 have hsmall : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,K*(Real.log ((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)+1)^2*((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)^a/(m:ℝ)<c :=
  hlim.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hc)
 obtain ⟨m,hm,hmsmall⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop N₀).and hsmall).exists
 have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
 have hmR : (0:ℝ)< m := by exact_mod_cast hmpos
 obtain ⟨n,hnpow,hncost⟩ := FourierTransfer.family_cost A hq gen ha.le hC.le amp m
 have hmn : m≤n := (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := m))).trans hnpow
 have hnpos : 0 < n := hmpos.trans_le hmn
 have hnR : (0:ℝ)< n := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
 have hlog : (m:ℝ)≤Real.logb 2 (n:ℝ) := by
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^m≤(n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnpow
  have hl := Real.logb_le_logb_of_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)<2) (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(2:ℝ)^m) hp
  simpa only [Real.logb_pow,Real.logb_self_eq_one (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)<2),mul_one] using hl
 have hstrict : K*(Real.log ((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)+1)^2*((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)^a<c*(m:ℝ) :=
  (div_lt_iff₀ hmR).mp hmsmall
 have hcost : (cost (fourierMatrix n) : ℝ)<c*(n:ℝ)*Real.logb 2 (n:ℝ) := by
  calc
   _ ≤ (n:ℝ)*(K*(Real.log ((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)+1)^2*((m:ℝ)+2*q+10)^a) := by
    convert hncost using 1 ; dsimp [K] ; ring
   _ < (n:ℝ)*(c*(m:ℝ)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hstrict hnR
   _ ≤ c*(n:ℝ)*Real.logb 2 (n:ℝ) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (mul_nonneg hc.le hnR.le)
    nlinarith only [hh]
 obtain ⟨D,hD,hd⟩ := CircuitCost.exists_circuit (fourierMatrix n)
 exact ⟨n,hm.trans hmn,D,hd,by simpa only [hD] using hcost⟩
end ExactFourier

end
end

OAI.Computability.FourierCircuit.Main:19.text:
theorem exists_circuit {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
 ∃ C : Circuit n,C.size=cost M ∧ C.Computes M := by
 obtain ⟨T,hT,ht⟩ := optimal M
 let e := Fintype.equivFin (Fin n)
 let D : LinearDAG n n := (T.circuit.withInputs e.symm).withOutputs e
 let C : Circuit n := ⟨D.size,D.program,D.outputs⟩
 refine ⟨C,?_,?_⟩
 · change D.size=cost M
   change (T.circuit.withInputs e.symm).size=cost M
   rw [LinearDAG.size_withInputs]
   exact hT
 · intro x
   change D.eval x=M.mulVec x
   rw [LinearDAG.eval_withOutputs,LinearDAG.eval_withInputs]
   exact ht x
end ExactFourier.CircuitCost

lemma hereditarySubalgebra_inner (h : A) (hh : IsSelfAdjoint h) :
    IsClosedInner (hereditarySubalgebra h hh) := by
  refine ⟨NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _,?_⟩
  intro a ha b hb x
  have hc : IsClosed {a : A | a*x*b ∈ hereditarySubalgebra h hh} :=
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).preimage (by fun_prop)
  apply closure_minimal _ hc ha
  rintro _ ⟨u,rfl⟩
  have hc' : IsClosed {b : A | (h*u*h)*x*b ∈ hereditarySubalgebra h hh} :=
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).preimage (by fun_prop)
  apply closure_minimal _ hc' hb
  rintro _ ⟨v,rfl⟩
  have he : (h*u*h)*x*(h*v*h)=h*(u*h*x*h*v)*h := by noncomm_ring
  change (h*u*h)*x*(h*v*h) ∈ hereditarySubalgebra h hh
  rw [he]
  exact sandwich_mem h (u*h*x*h*v) hh

lemma hereditary_le_generatedClosedIdeal (h : A) (hh : IsSelfAdjoint h) :
    hereditarySubalgebra h hh ≤ generatedClosedIdeal h hh := by
  intro x hx
  apply closure_minimal _ (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _) hx
  rintro _ ⟨a,rfl⟩
  have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun e : A => (h*a)*h*e) (CStarAlgebra.approximateUnit A)
      (𝓝 (h*a*h)) := (CStarAlgebra.increasingApproximateUnit A).tendsto_mul_left _
  exact (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).mem_of_tendsto ht
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun e => (algebraicIdealSubalgebra h hh).le_topologicalClosure
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(h*a,e),rfl⟩)))

lemma algebraicIdealSpan_mul_right (h a : A) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ algebraicIdealSpan h) :
    x*a ∈ algebraicIdealSpan h := by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨⟨c,d⟩,rfl⟩ := hy
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(c,d*a),by simp only [mul_assoc]⟩
  | zero => simpa only [zero_mul] using (algebraicIdealSpan h).zero_mem
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => simpa only [add_mul] using (algebraicIdealSpan h).add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => simpa only [smul_mul_assoc] using (algebraicIdealSpan h).smul_mem c hy

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.PrimitiveI.text:
theorem exists_irreducible_separating_closed_ideal
    (I : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A) (hI : IsClosed (I : Set A))
    (hIL : ∀ x ∈ I,∀ a : A,a*x ∈ I) (hIR : ∀ x ∈ I,∀ a : A,x*a ∈ I)
    {b : A} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hbI : b ∉ I) :
    ∃ (H : ComplexHilbert.{u}) (π : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)),
      NonUnitalRepresentationIrreducible π ∧ (∀ x ∈ I,π x=0) ∧ π b ≠ 0 := by
  let J := unitizationClosedIdeal I
  let u : Unitization ℂ A := (b : Unitization ℂ A)
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := map_nonneg (Unitization.inrNonUnitalStarAlgHom ℂ A) hb
  have huJ : u ∉ J := fun h => hbI h.2
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgb⟩ := exists_annihilator_state_of_not_mem J
    (unitizationClosedIdeal_isClosed I hI)
    (fun x hx a => unitizationClosedIdeal_mul_left I hIL hx a)
    (fun x hx a => unitizationClosedIdeal_mul_right I hIR hx a) hu huJ
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hfJ,hgf⟩ := exists_extreme_annihilator_state hg ⟨u,hu.isSelfAdjoint⟩
  let Φ := realStateComplexification f hf.1
  let π := Φ.gnsStarAlgHom.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp (Unitization.inrNonUnitalStarAlgHom ℂ A)
  let H : ComplexHilbert.{u} := { Carrier := Φ.GNS }
  refine ⟨H,π,irreducible_restrict_unitization Φ.gnsStarAlgHom
    (extreme_real_state_gns_irreducible f hf),?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact annihilatorStates_gns_zero hfJ (show (x : Unitization ℂ A) ∈ J from ⟨rfl,hx⟩)
  · intro hz
    have he := DFunLike.congr_fun (gns_vectorFunctional_eq f hf.1) ⟨u,hu.isSelfAdjoint⟩
    change (inner ℂ (gnsCyclicVector Φ) (Φ.gnsStarAlgHom u (gnsCyclicVector Φ))).re =
      f ⟨u,hu.isSelfAdjoint⟩ at he
    change Φ.gnsStarAlgHom u=0 at hz
    rw [hz,zero_apply,inner_zero_right,Complex.zero_re] at he
    linarith
