OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.UniverseIn.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.exists_binary_splitting_over_norm_slice_any
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.UniverseIn.text:
lemma exists_binary_splitting_over_norm_slice_any
    (hA : Exact A) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hpi : ∀ a : A,0 ≤ a → a ≠ 0 → ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies n a))
    {a : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ z : A,0 ≤ z ∧ CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies (2^j) z) (diagonalCopies 1 a) ∧
      ∀ (H : ComplexHilbert.{u}) (π : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)),r ≤ ‖π a‖ → π z ≠ 0 := by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨a,ha,cuntzSubequiv_refl _,?_⟩
    intro H π hπ hnz
    rw [hnz,norm_zero] at hπ
    linarith
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hza,hzn⟩ := ih
    have hlocal : NonzeroOnNormSlice (hereditarySubalgebra z hz.isSelfAdjoint) a r := by
      intro H π _ hπa
      exact ⟨z,self_mem_hereditary z hz,hz,hzn H π hπa⟩
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hxx,hxn⟩ := exists_square_zero_on_norm_slice_any hA hn hpi
      (hereditarySubalgebra z hz.isSelfAdjoint) (hereditarySubalgebra_inner z hz.isSelfAdjoint) ha hr hlocal
    refine ⟨star x*x,star_mul_self_nonneg x,
      ((square_zero_two_copies hz hx hxx).power_two_binary j).trans hza,?_⟩
    intro H π hπa
    rw [map_mul,map_star]
    exact (CStarRing.star_mul_self_eq_zero_iff (π x)).not.mpr (hxn H π hπa)

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.CoreSelect.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.positiveCut_eq_zero_of_norm_le
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.CoreSelect.text:
lemma positiveCut_eq_zero_of_norm_le {B : Type*} [CStarAlgebra B]
    (b : B) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hbn : ‖b‖ ≤ α) : positiveCut α b=0 := by
  obtain hB | hB := subsingleton_or_nontrivial B
  · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  let : Nontrivial B := hB
  change cfcₙ (fun s : ℝ => max (s-α) 0) b=0
  calc
    cfcₙ (fun s : ℝ => max (s-α) 0) b=cfcₙ (0 : ℝ → ℝ) b := by
      apply cfcₙ_congr
      intro s hs
      change max (s-α) 0=0
      apply max_eq_right
      rcases mem_quasispectrum_iff.mp hs with rfl | hs
      · linarith
      · have := spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hs
        have := Real.le_norm_self s
        linarith
    _ = 0 := cfcₙ_zero ℝ b

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.ScalingAss.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.stronglyPurelyInfinite_of_contractive
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.ScalingAss.text:
lemma stronglyPurelyInfinite_of_contractive
    (hc : ∀ a b : A,0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ ε : ℝ,0 < ε → ∃ s t : A, ‖star s*(a*a)*s-a*a‖ < ε ∧
        ‖star t*(b*b)*t-b*b‖ < ε ∧ ‖star s*a*b*t‖ < ε) :
    StronglyPurelyInfinite A := by
  intro a b ha hb ε hε
  let M := max 1 (max ‖a‖ ‖b‖)
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  have hM : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM1
  have hMa : ‖a‖ ≤ M := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hMb : ‖b‖ ≤ M := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  let a' := M⁻¹ • a
  let b' := M⁻¹ • b
  have ha' : 0 ≤ a' := smul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hM.le) ha
  have hb' : 0 ≤ b' := smul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hM.le) hb
  have han : ‖a'‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [show a'=M⁻¹ • a from rfl,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hM),inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact (div_le_one₀ hM).mpr hMa
  have hbn : ‖b'‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [show b'=M⁻¹ • b from rfl,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hM),inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact (div_le_one₀ hM).mpr hMb
  obtain ⟨s,t,hs,ht,hst⟩ := hc a' b' ha' hb' han hbn (ε/M^2) (by positivity)
  have he (x y : A) : M^2 • ((M⁻¹ • x)*(M⁻¹ • y))=x*y := by
    rw [smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm,smul_smul,smul_smul]
    have : M^2*M⁻¹*M⁻¹=1 := by field_simp
    rw [this,one_smul]
  have hes : M^2 • (star s*(a'*a')*s-a'*a')=star s*(a*a)*s-a*a := by
    calc
      _=star s*(M^2 • (a'*a'))*s-M^2 • (a'*a') := by
        simp only [smul_sub,smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm]
      _=_ := by rw [he]
  have het : M^2 • (star t*(b'*b')*t-b'*b')=star t*(b*b)*t-b*b := by
    calc
      _=star t*(M^2 • (b'*b'))*t-M^2 • (b'*b') := by
        simp only [smul_sub,smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm]
      _=_ := by rw [he]
  have hest : M^2 • (star s*a'*b'*t)=star s*a*b*t := by
    calc
      _=star s*(M^2 • (a'*b'))*t := by simp only [smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm,mul_assoc]
      _=_ := by rw [he]; simp only [mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨s,t,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [← hes,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hM)]
    exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs (sq_pos_of_pos hM)).trans_le (by field_simp; rfl)
  · rw [← het,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hM)]
    exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ht (sq_pos_of_pos hM)).trans_le (by field_simp; rfl)
  · rw [← hest,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hM)]
    exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hst (sq_pos_of_pos hM)).trans_le (by field_simp; rfl)

end

end WeakPureInfiniteness
end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.IdealSpan:.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.algebraicIdealSpan_mul_left

lemma algebraicIdealSpan_mul_left (h a : A) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ algebraicIdealSpan h) :
    a*x ∈ algebraicIdealSpan h := by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨⟨c,d⟩,rfl⟩ := hy
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(a*c,d),by simp only [mul_assoc]⟩
  | zero => simpa only [mul_zero] using (algebraicIdealSpan h).zero_mem
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => simpa only [mul_add] using (algebraicIdealSpan h).add_mem hy hz
  | smul c y _ hy => simpa only [mul_smul_comm] using (algebraicIdealSpan h).smul_mem c hy

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Elementary.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.cuntzSubequiv_iff_mem_closure
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Elementary.text:
lemma cuntzSubequiv_iff_mem_closure {a : CStarMatrix m m A} {b : CStarMatrix k k A} :
    CuntzSubequiv a b ↔
      a ∈ closure (Set.range fun v : CStarMatrix k m A => v.conjTranspose * b * v) := by
  rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h ε hε
    exact ⟨_, ⟨v, rfl⟩, by simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hv⟩
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨v, rfl⟩, hv⟩ := h ε hε
    exact ⟨v, by simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hv⟩

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.SquareZero.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.CuntzSubequiv.power_two_binary
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.SquareZero.text:
lemma CuntzSubequiv.power_two_binary {a b : A}
    (hab : CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies 2 a) (diagonalCopies 1 b)) (j : ℕ) :
    CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies (2^(j+1)) a) (diagonalCopies (2^j) b) := by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact hab
  | succ j ih =>
    have h := ih.double_copies
    have he : 2^(j+1+1)=2^(j+1)+2^(j+1) := by rw [pow_succ,Nat.mul_two]
    have hf : 2^(j+1)=2^j+2^j := by rw [pow_succ,Nat.mul_two]
    rw [he,hf]
    rw [hf] at h
    exact h

end

end WeakPureInfiniteness

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Individual.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.blockSum_diagonalCopies_one
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Individual.text:
lemma blockSum_diagonalCopies_one (a : A) :
    matrixSubmatrix (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → Fin 2) finSumFinEquiv
      (diagonalCopies 2 a)=blockSum (diagonalCopies 1 a) (diagonalCopies 1 a) := by
  have he := congrArg
    (matrixSubmatrix (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → Fin 2) finSumFinEquiv)
      (diagonalCopies_double a 1)
  have hleft : matrixSubmatrix finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv
      (matrixSubmatrix finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm
        (blockSum (diagonalCopies 1 a) (diagonalCopies 1 a)))=
        blockSum (diagonalCopies 1 a) (diagonalCopies 1 a) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [matrixSubmatrix,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hleft] at he
  exact he.symm

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.SquareZero.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.square_zero_two_copies
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.SquareZero.text:
lemma square_zero_two_copies {a x : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hx : x ∈ hereditarySubalgebra a ha.isSelfAdjoint) (hxx : x*x=0) :
    CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies 2 (star x*x)) (diagonalCopies 1 a) := by
  let D := hereditarySubalgebra a ha.isSelfAdjoint
  have hx' : x ∈ D := hx
  have hxs : star x ∈ D := star_mem hx'
  have hz : star x*x ∈ D := D.mul_mem hxs hx'
  have hw : x*star x ∈ D := D.mul_mem hx' hxs
  have hzw : (star x*x)*(x*star x)=0 := by
    calc
      _ = star x*(x*x)*star x := by noncomm_ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hxx,mul_zero,zero_mul]
  have hwz : (x*star x)*(star x*x)=0 := by
    simpa only [star_mul,star_star,star_zero] using congrArg star hzw
  let y : Fin 2 → A := ![star x*x,x*star x]
  apply copies_cuntz_of_common_orthogonal ha y
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact ⟨star_mul_self_nonneg x,hz⟩
    · exact ⟨mul_star_self_nonneg x,hw⟩
  · intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · exact hzw
    · exact hwz
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact cuntzSubequiv_refl _
    · exact element_initial_cuntz_range x

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.CuntzCompa.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.StronglyPurelyInfinite
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.CuntzCompa.text:
def StronglyPurelyInfinite : Prop :=
  ∀ a b : A, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ s t : A, ‖star s * (a * a) * s - a * a‖ < ε ∧
      ‖star t * (b * b) * t - b * b‖ < ε ∧ ‖star s * a * b * t‖ < ε

end Definitions

end WeakPureInfiniteness
end

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Elementary.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.cuntzSubequiv_refl
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Elementary.text:
lemma cuntzSubequiv_refl (a : CStarMatrix m m A) : CuntzSubequiv a a := by
  let au := CStarAlgebra.increasingApproximateUnit (CStarMatrix m m A)
  intro ε hε
  have hl := Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (au.tendsto_mul_left a) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  have hr := Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (au.tendsto_mul_right a) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨u, hleft, hright, hstar, hnorm⟩ :=
    (hl.and (hr.and (au.eventually_star_eq.and au.eventually_norm))).exists
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [← CStarMatrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hstar]
  have heq : u * a * u - a = (u * a - a) * u + (a * u - a) := by noncomm_ring
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(u * a - a) * u‖ + ‖a * u - a‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖u * a - a‖ * ‖u‖ + ‖a * u - a‖ := add_le_add (norm_mul_le _ _) le_rfl
    _ ≤ ‖u * a - a‖ + ‖a * u - a‖ := by
      have hbound : ‖u * a - a‖ * ‖u‖ ≤ ‖u * a - a‖ := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (u * a - a)]
      exact add_le_add hbound le_rfl
    _ < ε := by simp only [dist_eq_norm] at hleft hright; linarith

end ElementaryComparison

end WeakPureInfiniteness
end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Individual.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.properlyInfinite_of_cuts
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Individual.text:
lemma properlyInfinite_of_cuts {a : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hcuts : ∀ r : ℝ,0 < r →
      CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies 2 (positiveCut r a)) (diagonalCopies 1 a)) :
    ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies 1 a) := by
  have hc : CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies 2 a) (diagonalCopies 1 a) := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hcuts (ε/3) (by positivity) (ε/3) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨v,?_⟩
    have hn := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le (diagonalHom (A := A) 2)
      (a-positiveCut (ε/3) a)
    rw [map_sub] at hn
    have hn' := norm_sub_positiveCut_le ha (by positivity : 0 ≤ ε/3)
    have he : v.conjTranspose*diagonalCopies 1 a*v-diagonalCopies 2 a =
      (v.conjTranspose*diagonalCopies 1 a*v-diagonalCopies 2 (positiveCut (ε/3) a))+
      (diagonalCopies 2 (positiveCut (ε/3) a)-diagonalCopies 2 a) := by abel
    rw [he]
    have ht := norm_add_le
      (v.conjTranspose*diagonalCopies 1 a*v-diagonalCopies 2 (positiveCut (ε/3) a))
      (diagonalCopies 2 (positiveCut (ε/3) a)-diagonalCopies 2 a)
    rw [norm_sub_rev (diagonalCopies 2 (positiveCut (ε/3) a))] at ht
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt ht (by change ‖_-_‖+‖(diagonalHom 2) a-(diagonalHom 2) (positiveCut (ε/3) a)‖<ε; linarith)
  have h := hc.submatrix_left (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → Fin 2)
  rw [blockSum_diagonalCopies_one] at h
  exact h

end General

section UniverseOne

variable {A : Type 1} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A]

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Individual.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.norm_sub_positiveCut_le
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Individual.text:
lemma norm_sub_positiveCut_le {a : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ‖a-positiveCut r a‖ ≤ r := by
  have he : a-positiveCut r a=cfcₙ (fun t : ℝ => t-max (t-r) 0) a := by
    rw [cfcₙ_sub (fun t : ℝ => t) (fun t : ℝ => max (t-r) 0) a
      (by fun_prop) rfl (by fun_prop) (by simpa using (max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hr)))]
    change a-positiveCut r a=cfcₙ (id : ℝ → ℝ) a-positiveCut r a
    rw [cfcₙ_id ℝ a ha.isSelfAdjoint]
  rw [he]
  apply norm_cfcₙ_le
  intro t ht
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := NonnegSpectrumClass.nonneg_of_mem_quasispectrum ha ht
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor
  · have : max (t-r) 0 ≤ t := max_le (by linarith) ht0
    linarith
  · have := le_max_left (t-r) 0
    linarith

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.IdealCompa.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.algebraicIdealSpan_square_cuntz
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.IdealCompa.text:
lemma algebraicIdealSpan_square_cuntz {h : A} (hh : 0 ≤ h) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hpi : ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies n h)) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ algebraicIdealSpan h) :
    CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies 1 (star x*x)) (diagonalCopies n h) := by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨⟨a,b⟩,rfl⟩ := hy
    have hc : ElementCuntzSubequiv (star (a*h*b)*(a*h*b)) (star (h*b)*(h*b)) := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using star_mul_product_cuntz a (h*b)
    apply hc.trans ((element_initial_cuntz_range (h*b)).trans _)
    apply (elementCuntzSubequiv_of_hereditary (mul_star_self_nonneg (h*b)) hh ?_).trans
      (diagonalCopies_cuntzSubequiv h hn)
    have he : (h*b)*star (h*b)=h*(b*star b)*h := by rw [star_mul,hh.star_eq]; noncomm_ring
    rw [he]
    exact sandwich_mem h (b*star b) hh.isSelfAdjoint
  | zero =>
    have he : diagonalCopies 1 (star (0 : A)*0)=0 := by ext i j; simp [diagonalCopies]
    rw [he]
    exact zero_cuntzSubequiv _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    apply (elementCuntzSubequiv_of_le_smul (star_mul_self_nonneg (x+y))
      (add_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg x) (star_mul_self_nonneg y)) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      (star_add_mul_add_le x y)).trans
    exact (sum_two_cuntz_block (star x*x) (star y*y)).trans ((hx.blockSum hy).trans hpi)
  | smul c x _ hx =>
    apply (elementCuntzSubequiv_of_hereditary (star_mul_self_nonneg (c•x))
      (star_mul_self_nonneg x) ?_).trans hx
    have hm := (hereditarySubalgebra (star x*x) (star_mul_self_nonneg x).isSelfAdjoint).smul_mem
      (c*star c) (self_mem_hereditary (star x*x) (star_mul_self_nonneg x))
    simp only [star_smul,smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm,smul_smul]
    exact hm

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.CuntzCompa.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.WeaklyPurelyInfinite

def WeaklyPurelyInfinite : Prop :=

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.IdealSpan:.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.generatedClosedIdeal_mul_right
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.IdealSpan:.text:
lemma generatedClosedIdeal_mul_right (h a : A) (hh : IsSelfAdjoint h) {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ generatedClosedIdeal h hh) : x*a ∈ generatedClosedIdeal h hh := by
  apply closure_minimal _ ((NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).preimage
    (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)) hx
  intro y hy
  exact (algebraicIdealSubalgebra h hh).le_topologicalClosure (algebraicIdealSpan_mul_right h a hy)

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.CuntzCopie.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.CuntzSubequiv.submatrix_left
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.CuntzCopie.text:
lemma CuntzSubequiv.submatrix_left {a : CStarMatrix n n A} {b : CStarMatrix k k A}
    (hab : CuntzSubequiv a b) (e : m → n) : CuntzSubequiv (matrixSubmatrix e e a) b := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hcont⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp
    (continuous_matrixSubmatrix (A := A) e e).continuousAt ε hε
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hab δ hδ
  refine ⟨matrixSubmatrix id e v, ?_⟩
  have he : (matrixSubmatrix id e v).conjTranspose*b*matrixSubmatrix id e v =
      matrixSubmatrix e e (v.conjTranspose*b*v) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [CStarMatrix.mul_apply, CStarMatrix.conjTranspose_apply, matrixSubmatrix, id_eq]
  rw [he]
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hcont (by simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hv)

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Hereditary.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.hereditarySubalgebra
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Hereditary.text:
def hereditarySubalgebra (h : A) (hh : IsSelfAdjoint h) : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A :=
  (sandwichSubalgebra h hh).topologicalClosure

instance (h : A) (hh : IsSelfAdjoint h) :
    IsClosed (hereditarySubalgebra h hh : Set A) :=
  NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _

  (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).isComplete.completeSpace_coe

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.UniverseIn.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.exact_weaklyPurelyInfinite_individuallyProperlyInfinite_any
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.UniverseIn.text:
theorem exact_weaklyPurelyInfinite_individuallyProperlyInfinite_any
    (hA : Exact A) (hW : WeaklyPurelyInfinite A) {a : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies 1 a) := by
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hpi⟩ := hW
  apply properlyInfinite_of_cuts ha
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hza,hzn⟩ := exists_binary_splitting_over_norm_slice_any hA hn hpi ha hr n
  have hznn : CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies n z) (diagonalCopies 1 a) :=
    (diagonalCopies_cuntzSubequiv z (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := n)).le).trans hza
  have hcut : positiveCut r a ∈ generatedClosedIdeal z hz.isSelfAdjoint := by
    apply mem_closed_ideal_of_irreducible_test _
      (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _)
      (fun x hx d => generatedClosedIdeal_mul_left z d hz.isSelfAdjoint hx)
      (fun x hx d => generatedClosedIdeal_mul_right z d hz.isSelfAdjoint hx)
      (positiveCut_nonneg r a)
    intro H π _ hπI
    have hpiz : π z=0 := hπI z (self_mem_generatedClosedIdeal z hz)
    have hnorm : ‖π a‖ ≤ r := (lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hzn H π h hpiz)).le
    have he := π.map_cfcₙ (fun t : ℝ => max (t-r) 0) a (by fun_prop)
      (by simpa using max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hr.le)) (by fun_prop)
      ha.isSelfAdjoint (map_nonneg π ha).isSelfAdjoint
    change π (positiveCut r a)=positiveCut r (π a) at he
    rw [he]
    exact positiveCut_eq_zero_of_norm_le _ hr.le hnorm
  exact (generatedClosedIdeal_copies_cuntz hz (positiveCut_nonneg r a) hn
    (weak_amplification_all hpi hz) hcut 2).trans hznn

end UniverseOne

end

end WeakPureInfiniteness
end

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.UniverseSq.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.exists_square_zero_on_norm_slice_any
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.UniverseSq.text:
theorem exists_square_zero_on_norm_slice_any
    (hA : Exact A) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hpi : ∀ a : A,0 ≤ a → a ≠ 0 → ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies n a))
    (D : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A) (hD : IsClosedInner D)
    {b : A} (hb : 0 ≤ b) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
    (hlocal : NonzeroOnNormSlice D b α) :
    ∃ x ∈ D,x*x=0 ∧
      ∀ (H : ComplexHilbert.{u}) (π : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)), α ≤ ‖π b‖ → π x ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨γ,hγ,hgap⟩ := exists_uniform_gap_any
  exact exists_square_zero_on_norm_slice_of_gap_any (σ := γ/2) (by positivity)
    (by linarith) hgap hA hn hpi D hD hb hα hlocal

end

lemma generatedClosedIdeal_mul_left (h a : A) (hh : IsSelfAdjoint h) {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ generatedClosedIdeal h hh) : a*x ∈ generatedClosedIdeal h hh := by
  apply closure_minimal _ ((NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).preimage
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)) hx
  intro y hy

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Individual.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.weak_amplification_all
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Individual.text:
lemma weak_amplification_all {n : ℕ}
    (hpi : ∀ a : A,0 ≤ a → a ≠ 0 → ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies n a))
    {a : A} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies n a) := by
  by_cases h : a=0
  · subst a
    have he : diagonalCopies n (0 : A)=0 := (diagonalHom n).map_zero
    rw [he]
    exact properlyInfinite_zero _
  · exact hpi a ha h

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.IdealCompa.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.generatedClosedIdeal_copies_cuntz
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.IdealCompa.text:
theorem generatedClosedIdeal_copies_cuntz {h x : A} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hpi : ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies n h))
    (hm : x ∈ generatedClosedIdeal h hh.isSelfAdjoint) (k : ℕ) :
    CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies k x) (diagonalCopies n h) := by
  have hs : CFC.sqrt x ∈ generatedClosedIdeal h hh.isSelfAdjoint := by
    rw [CFC.sqrt_eq_real_sqrt x hx]
    exact cfcₙ_mem Real.sqrt hm
  have hclosed : IsClosed {a : A | CuntzSubequiv
      (diagonalCopies 1 (star a*a)) (diagonalCopies n h)} := by
    simp only [cuntzSubequiv_iff_mem_closure]
    exact isClosed_closure.preimage
      ((map_continuous (diagonalHom (A := A) 1)).comp (continuous_star.mul continuous_id))
  have hc : CuntzSubequiv (diagonalCopies 1 (star (CFC.sqrt x)*CFC.sqrt x))
      (diagonalCopies n h) :=
    closure_minimal (fun a ha => algebraicIdealSpan_square_cuntz hh hn hpi ha) hclosed hs
  rw [(CFC.sqrt_nonneg x).star_eq,CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self x hx] at hc
  exact hc.copies_of_properlyInfinite_right hpi k

end

end WeakPureInfiniteness

OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Quantitati.name: OAI.WeakPureInfiniteness.contractive_spi_of_quantitative_separation
OAI.Analysis.WeakInfiniteness.Quantitati.text:
theorem contractive_spi_of_quantitative_separation
    (hpi : ∀ x : A,0 ≤ x → ProperlyInfinite (diagonalCopies 1 x))
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hsep : QuantitativeSeparatingPositives A σ)
    (a b : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (han : ‖a‖ ≤ 1) (hbn : ‖b‖ ≤ 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ s t : A, ‖star s*(a*a)*s-a*a‖ < ε ∧
      ‖star t*(b*b)*t-b*b‖ < ε ∧ ‖star s*a*b*t‖ < ε := by
  obtain ⟨r,l,δ,hr,hr1,hl,hl1,hδ,hδ1,hrε,hδε,hlε⟩ := separation_parameter_choices hε hσ
  let m := r*σ^2/1024
  have hm : 0 < m := by dsimp [m]; positivity
  obtain ⟨Q,R,hQ,hR,hQa,hRb,hcover,hQR⟩ := hsep a b ha hb han hbn r l hr hr1 hl hl1
  have hca := cut_square_cuntz_of_norm_coverage hpi ha hQ hr hm (fun H π hπ => (hcover H π hπ).1)
  have hcb := cut_square_cuntz_of_norm_coverage hpi hb hR hr hm (fun H π hπ => (hcover H π hπ).2)
  have haa : 0 ≤ a*a := by simpa only [ha.star_eq] using star_mul_self_nonneg a
  have hbb : 0 ≤ b*b := by simpa only [hb.star_eq] using star_mul_self_nonneg b
  have hcan : ‖positiveCut (r^2) (a*a)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      _≤‖a*a‖ := norm_positiveCut_le haa (sq_nonneg r)
      _≤‖a‖*‖a‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _≤1*1 := by gcongr
      _=1 := by norm_num
  have hcbn : ‖positiveCut (r^2) (b*b)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      _≤‖b*b‖ := norm_positiveCut_le hbb (sq_nonneg r)
      _≤‖b‖*‖b‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _≤1*1 := by gcongr
      _=1 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨x,hxe,hxn,hx⟩ := exists_bounded_cut_implementation hQ (positiveCut_nonneg _ _) hcan hm hca hδ hδ1
  obtain ⟨y,hye,hyn,hy⟩ := exists_bounded_cut_implementation hR (positiveCut_nonneg _ _) hcbn hm hcb hδ hδ1
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := exists_left_approx_of_hereditary ha hQa x hδ
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := exists_left_approx_of_hereditary hb hRb y hδ
  have hcross : ‖star (Q*x)*(R*y)‖ ≤ ε/4 := by
    calc
      _=‖star x*(Q*R)*y‖ := by congr 1; rw [star_mul,hQ.star_eq]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _≤‖star x‖*‖Q*R‖*‖y‖ := (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _≤(4/m)*(20*Real.sqrt l)*(4/m) := by rw [norm_star]; gcongr
      _=320*Real.sqrt l/m^2 := by ring
      _≤ε/4 := hlε
  have hsa := norm_star_mul_approx_le (a*s) (a*s) (Q*x) (Q*x) hδ.le hxn hxn hs.le hs.le
  have htb := norm_star_mul_approx_le (b*t) (b*t) (R*y) (R*y) hδ.le hyn hyn ht.le ht.le
  have hst := norm_star_mul_approx_le (a*s) (b*t) (Q*x) (R*y) hδ.le hxn hyn hs.le ht.le
  have haerr : ‖star (a*s)*(a*s)-a*a‖ < ε := by
    have hcut := norm_sub_positiveCut_le haa (sq_nonneg r)
    calc
      _=‖(star (a*s)*(a*s)-star (Q*x)*(Q*x))+
        (star (Q*x)*(Q*x)-positiveCut (r^2) (a*a))+(positiveCut (r^2) (a*a)-a*a)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _≤‖star (a*s)*(a*s)-star (Q*x)*(Q*x)‖+
        ‖star (Q*x)*(Q*x)-positiveCut (r^2) (a*a)‖+‖positiveCut (r^2) (a*a)-a*a‖ :=
          (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
      _< (4+δ)*δ+δ+r^2 := by rw [norm_sub_rev (positiveCut _ (a*a)) (a*a)]; linarith
      _< ε := by linarith
  have hberr : ‖star (b*t)*(b*t)-b*b‖ < ε := by
    have hcut := norm_sub_positiveCut_le hbb (sq_nonneg r)
    calc
      _=‖(star (b*t)*(b*t)-star (R*y)*(R*y))+
        (star (R*y)*(R*y)-positiveCut (r^2) (b*b))+(positiveCut (r^2) (b*b)-b*b)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _≤‖star (b*t)*(b*t)-star (R*y)*(R*y)‖+
        ‖star (R*y)*(R*y)-positiveCut (r^2) (b*b)‖+‖positiveCut (r^2) (b*b)-b*b‖ :=
          (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
      _< (4+δ)*δ+δ+r^2 := by rw [norm_sub_rev (positiveCut _ (b*b)) (b*b)]; linarith
      _< ε := by linarith
  refine ⟨s,t,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [star_mul,ha.star_eq,mul_assoc] using haerr
  · simpa only [star_mul,hb.star_eq,mul_assoc] using hberr
  · have hn : ‖star (a*s)*(b*t)‖ ≤ (4+δ)*δ+ε/4 := by
      calc
        _=‖(star (a*s)*(b*t)-star (Q*x)*(R*y))+star (Q*x)*(R*y)‖ := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
        _≤‖star (a*s)*(b*t)-star (Q*x)*(R*y)‖+‖star (Q*x)*(R*y)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _≤_ := add_le_add hst hcross
    have : ‖star (a*s)*(b*t)‖ < ε := by linarith
    simpa only [star_mul,ha.star_eq,mul_assoc] using this

end

end WeakPureInfiniteness
end

end OAI

OAI.Computability.QuantumFactoring.Facto.name: OAI.ExactQuantumFactoring.PhysicalTree.finalCircuit_exact
OAI.Computability.QuantumFactoring.Facto.text:
theorem finalCircuit_exact (ℓ N : ℕ) (hN : 2≤N) (hb : N<2^ℓ) :
    (finalCircuit ℓ).correctProbability ℓ N=1 := by
  have hh : 128≤paddedLength ℓ:=le_max_left _ _
  have hb' : N<2^paddedLength ℓ:=lt_of_lt_of_le hb (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (le_max_right _ _))
  change outcomeMass (fun x=>CorrectEncoding N (paddedLength ℓ) (outputList ℓ x))
    ((finalCircuit ℓ).apply (basisVector (inputBasis (finalCircuit ℓ).qubits ℓ N)))=1
  rw [Circuit.apply_eq_matrix]
  change outcomeMass (fun x : Basis (readoutWidth (paddedLength ℓ) (paddedLength_pos ℓ))=>
      CorrectEncoding N (paddedLength ℓ) (outputList ℓ x))
    ((programMatrix ((factoringProgram (paddedLength ℓ) (paddedLength_pos ℓ)).map
      (Instruction.place (finalRegister ℓ)))).mulVec
      (basisVector (inputBasis (readoutWidth (paddedLength ℓ) (paddedLength_pos ℓ)) ℓ N)))=1
  rw [Register.placed_basis_state]
  have hin := final_input ℓ N hb
  change inputBasis (readoutWidth (paddedLength ℓ) (paddedLength_pos ℓ)) ℓ N ∘ finalRegister ℓ = _ at hin
  rw [hin]
  rw [outcomeMass_encode _ (Register.replace_injective _ _)]
  have he : ((fun x=>CorrectEncoding N (paddedLength ℓ) (outputList ℓ x)) ∘
      ((finalRegister ℓ).replace (inputBasis (readoutWidth (paddedLength ℓ) (paddedLength_pos ℓ)) ℓ N)))=
      (fun x=>CorrectEncoding N (paddedLength ℓ)
        (guessWords (paddedLength ℓ) (factoringResult (paddedLength ℓ) (paddedLength_pos ℓ) x))) := by
    funext x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply,final_output]
  rw [he]
  exact factoringProgram_exact hh hN hb'

def markedMapTest (scale : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (F : MetricMeasureData → ℝ)

theorem finite_fk_maps_converge_to_brownian_crt : MainStatement := by
  intro q hq
  let P := Parameters.ofQ q hq
  refine ⟨crtScale P,crtScale_pos P,?_⟩
  intro Ω mΩ μ hμ B hB hI F hF
  have hh := actual_map_tests P hB hI F hF
  convert hh using 1
  ext n
  exact finiteExpectation_marked q hq (edgeScale P n) n F

OAI.Probability.FKMaps.Model:194.name: OAI.FKCRT.MainStatement
OAI.Probability.FKMaps.Model:194.text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℝ, 4 < q → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
    ∀ (Ω : Type) (mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω) (P : @Measure Ω mΩ),
      @IsProbabilityMeasure Ω mΩ P →
      ∀ B : Fin 3 → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ,
        (∀ i, @IsBrownianReal Ω mΩ (B i) P) →
        @iIndepFun Ω (Fin 3) mΩ (fun _ => ℝ≥0 → ℝ) (fun _ => inferInstance)
          (fun i ω t => B i t ω) P →
        ∀ F : MetricMeasureData → ℝ, IsGHPTest F →
          Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => finiteExpectation q (c / Real.sqrt (n + 1)) n F)
            atTop (𝓝 (@brownianExpectation Ω mΩ P B F))

end FKCRT
end

OAI.Probability.FKMaps.FiniteLaw:350.name: OAI.FKCRT.actual_marked_normalized
OAI.Probability.FKMaps.FiniteLaw:350.text:
lemma actual_marked_normalized (q : ℝ) (hq : 4<q) (n : ℕ) :
    (actualOffspring (Parameters.ofQ q hq)).markedCodeLaw
      (fun k => (CoreLabel.markLaw (Parameters.ofQ q hq) k).toMeasure) (n+1)=
      ∑ w : SuccessfulWord n,
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1+Real.sqrt q)^flexibleCount (List.ofFn w.val) []/typedPartition q n) •
          Measure.dirac (CoreTree.successfulMarkedEquiv n w).val := by
  let P := Parameters.ofQ q hq
  let K := (Real.sqrt (radiusParameter P))^(2*(n+1))/emptyTotal P/
    codePartition (actualOffspring P) (2*(n+1)+1)
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := le_of_lt (div_pos (div_pos
    (pow_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (radiusParameter_pos P)) _) (emptyTotal_pos P))
    (codePartition_odd_pos (actualOffspring P) (n+1)))
  apply atomic_normalize _ _ _ (fun _ => pow_nonneg (by positivity) _) hK _
    (typedPartition_pos q (by linarith) n)
  rw [actual_marked_atomic P n]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  congr 1
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (codePartition_odd_pos (actualOffspring P) (n+1))]
  congr 1
  change (flexParameter P)^flexibleCount (List.ofFn w.val) []*
    (Real.sqrt (radiusParameter P))^(List.ofFn w.val).length/emptyTotal P/
      codePartition (actualOffspring P) (2*(n+1)+1)=_
  rw [List.length_ofFn]
  have hp : flexParameter P=1+Real.sqrt q := by
    exact congrArg (fun t : ℝ => 1+t) (Parameters.ofQ_ratio q hq)
  rw [hp]
  dsimp [K]
  ring

end FKCRT
end

OAI.Probability.FKMaps.MetricLimit:325.name: OAI.FKCRT.Inventory.metric_test_local
OAI.Probability.FKMaps.MetricLimit:325.text:
theorem metric_test_local (P : Parameters) (F : FKCRT.MetricMeasureData → ℝ)
    (hF : FKCRT.IsGHPTest F) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) (f : C(unitInterval,ℝ)) :
    ∃ r : ℝ,0<r ∧ ∃ a : ℝ,0<a ∧ ∃ N : ℕ,∀ n≥N,∀ x : ActualDraw n,
      dist (actualHeight P n x) f<r → x∉metricBad P n a →
      |FKCRT.markedMapTest (edgeScale P n) n F x-F (FKCRT.treeSpace (actualHeight P n x))| ≤ ε := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hcont⟩ := hF.2 (FKCRT.treeSpace f) (FKCRT.treeSpace_valid f.continuous) (ε/2) (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨r₀,hr₀,hG⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hF.continuous_treeSpace.continuousAt (x := f)) (ε/2) (half_pos hε)
  let L := (actualOffspring P).sigma/(2*metricMean P)+1
  have hL : 0<L := by dsimp [L];have hβ := metricMean_pos P;have hσ := (actualOffspring P).sigma_pos; positivity
  let r := min r₀ (δ/16)
  let a := δ/(32*(L+1))
  have hr : 0<r := lt_min hr₀ (by positivity)
  have ha : 0<a := by dsimp [a];positivity
  have hLbound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,edgeScale P n*Real.sqrt ((2*(n+1)+1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ L := by
    exact ((edgeScale_sqrt_size_tendsto P).eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by dsimp [L];linarith))).mono (fun _ h => h.le)
  obtain ⟨ζ,hζ,hmod⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mp (CompactSpace.uniformContinuous_of_continuous f.continuous) (δ/16) (by positivity)
  have hmesh : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1/(2*((n:ℝ)+1))) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds).const_mul_atTop (by norm_num))
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hLbound.and (hmesh.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hζ)))
  refine ⟨r,hr,a,ha,N,?_⟩
  intro n hn x hx hbad
  have hcompat : ∀ i,(x.2 i).arity=(x.1.val i).val := by
    by_contra hc
    exact hbad (Or.inl (Or.inl hc))
  let y : CoreTree.MarkedCode (2*(n+1)+1) := ⟨x,hcompat⟩
  have hcore : ((CoreTree.ofMarkedCode y).maxDegree:ℝ) ≤ a*Real.sqrt ((2*(n+1)+1:ℕ):ℝ) := by
    by_contra hc
    exact hbad (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hcompat,lt_of_not_ge hc⟩))
  have herr : ∀ j : Fin (2*(n+1)+1),|markedSpineSum coreIncrement x.1 j.isLt.le x.2-
      metricMean P*height x.1.val j.val| ≤ a*Real.sqrt ((2*(n+1)+1:ℕ):ℝ) := by
    intro j
    by_contra hc
    exact hbad (Or.inr ⟨j,lt_of_not_ge hc⟩)
  have hghp := CoreTree.marked_nearby_ghp_bound P n y f a r (δ/16) (δ/2) (half_pos hδ) herr hx.le
    (fun s u hsu => by
      have hh := hmod (hsu.trans_lt (hN n hn).2)
      simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hh.le) ?_
  · have htest := hcont _ (FKCRT.mapSpace_valid (edgeScale_pos P n) _)
      (hghp.trans_lt ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hδ).mpr (half_lt_self hδ)))
    have htree := hG (hx.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at htree
    rw [FKCRT.markedMapTest,dite_eq_left hcompat]
    have ht := abs_sub_le
      (F (FKCRT.mapSpace (edgeScale P n) ((FKCRT.rootedWordEquiv n).symm ((CoreTree.successfulMarkedEquiv n).symm y)).1))
      (F (FKCRT.treeSpace f)) (F (FKCRT.treeSpace (actualHeight P n x)))
    rw [abs_sub_comm (F (FKCRT.treeSpace f))] at ht
    linarith
  have hb₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcore (edgeScale_pos P n).le
  have hb₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hN n hn).1 ha.le
  have har : 8*a*L≤δ/4 := by
    have hh : a*(32*(L+1))=δ := by
      dsimp [a]
      field_simp
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha.le hL.le]
  have hrδ : r≤δ/16 := min_le_right _ _
  nlinarith

end FKCRT.Inventory
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FKMaps.Convergence:15.name: OAI.FKCRT.Inventory.actual_map_tests
OAI.Probability.FKMaps.Convergence:15.text:
theorem actual_map_tests (P : Parameters)
    {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {B : Fin 3 → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (hB : ∀ i,IsBrownianReal (B i) μ)
    (hI : iIndepFun (fun i ω t => B i t ω) μ)
    (F : FKCRT.MetricMeasureData → ℝ) (hF : FKCRT.IsGHPTest F) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x,FKCRT.markedMapTest (edgeScale P n) n F x ∂actualDrawLaw P n)
      atTop (𝓝 (FKCRT.brownianExpectation μ B F)) := by
  have hp := local_probability_transfer (actualHeight_CLT P hB hI)
    (fun _ => measurable_of_countable _) (fun n => FKCRT.markedMapTest (edgeScale P n) n F)
    (fun f => F (FKCRT.treeSpace f)) (metricBad P)
    (fun a ha => metricBad_limit P (hB 0) ha) (metric_test_local P F hF)
  have hh := (actualHeight_CLT P hB hI).continuous_comp hF.continuous_treeSpace
  have hy : TendstoInDistribution (fun n => FKCRT.markedMapTest (edgeScale P n) n F) atTop
      (fun ω => F (FKCRT.treeSpace (excursionPath B ω))) (actualDrawLaw P) μ := by
    apply tendstoInDistribution_of_close hh (fun _ => (measurable_of_countable _).aemeasurable)
    intro ε hε
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,Real.dist_eq,abs_sub_comm] using hp ε hε
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hF.1
  have hC0 : 0≤C := (abs_nonneg (F (FKCRT.treeSpace (0 : C(unitInterval,ℝ))))).trans (hC _)
  let clip : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max (-C) (min C x)
  have hclip : Continuous clip := continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
  have hclipB : ∀ x,‖clip x‖≤C := by
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
    exact ⟨le_max_left _ _,max_le (by linarith) (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  have hclipId : ∀ x,|x|≤C → clip x=x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [abs_le] at hx
    exact max_eq_right (hx.1.trans_eq (min_eq_right hx.2).symm) |>.trans (min_eq_right hx.2)
  have hY : ∀ n x,clip (FKCRT.markedMapTest (edgeScale P n) n F x)=
      FKCRT.markedMapTest (edgeScale P n) n F x := by
    intro n x
    apply hclipId
    unfold FKCRT.markedMapTest
    split
    · exact hC _
    · simpa only [abs_zero] using hC0
  have hz : ∀ ω,clip (F (FKCRT.treeSpace (excursionPath B ω)))=F (FKCRT.treeSpace (excursionPath B ω)) :=
    fun _ => hclipId _ (hC _)
  have hi := integral_tendsto_of_tendstoInDistribution hy hclip hclipB
  simp only [hY,hz] at hi
  have he : (fun ω => F (FKCRT.treeSpace (excursionPath B ω)))=ᵐ[μ]
      (fun ω => F (FKCRT.treeSpace (FKCRT.standardExcursion B ω))) := by
    filter_upwards [excursionPath_ae_eq hB] with ω hω
    exact congrArg (fun e => F (FKCRT.treeSpace e)) hω
  simpa only [integral_congr_ae he,FKCRT.brownianExpectation] using hi

end FKCRT.Inventory

open Inventory

OAI.Probability.FKMaps.MetricLimit:303.name: OAI.FKCRT.Inventory.metricBad_limit
OAI.Probability.FKMaps.MetricLimit:303.text:
lemma metricBad_limit (P : Parameters)
    {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (hB : IsBrownianReal B μ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0<a) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (actualDrawLaw P n).real (metricBad P n a)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hcore := (actual_max_core P ha).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have herr := (actual_uniform_metric_spine P hB ha).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have ht := hcore.add herr
  simp only [zero_add] at ht
  apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => measureReal_nonneg) _ ht
  intro n
  have hc : (actualDrawLaw P n).real {x | ¬∀ i,(x.2 i).arity=(x.1.val i).val}=0 := by
    unfold Measure.real
    rw [ae_iff.mp (actual_marked_compatible P (n+1)),ENNReal.toReal_zero]
  apply (measureReal_union_le _ _).trans
  apply add_le_add _ le_rfl
  apply (measureReal_union_le _ _).trans
  rw [hc,zero_add]
  exact le_rfl

theorem actualHeight_CLT (P : Parameters)
    {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

  exact distribution_smul_one hr (fun _ => measurable_of_countable _) heightFactor_tendsto

OAI.Probability.FKMaps.MetricLimit:177.name: OAI.FKCRT.TreeCoding.local_probability_transfer
OAI.Probability.FKMaps.MetricLimit:177.text:
theorem local_probability_transfer {E Ω' : Type*} {Ω : ℕ → Type*}
    [MetricSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [∀ n,MeasurableSpace (Ω n)] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    {μ : ∀ n,Measure (Ω n)} {ν : Measure Ω'} [∀ n,IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {X : ∀ n,Ω n → E} {Z : Ω' → E} (h : TendstoInDistribution X atTop Z μ ν)
    (hm : ∀ n,Measurable (X n)) (Y : ∀ n,Ω n → ℝ) (G : E → ℝ)
    (Bad : ∀ n,ℝ → Set (Ω n))
    (hBad : ∀ a,0<a → Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real (Bad n a)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hloc : ∀ ε,0<ε → ∀ f : E,∃ r : ℝ,0<r ∧ ∃ a : ℝ,0<a ∧ ∃ N : ℕ,
      ∀ n≥N,∀ x : Ω n,dist (X n x) f<r → x∉Bad n a → |Y n x-G (X n x)| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ ε,0<ε → Tendsto (fun n => (μ n).real {x | ε < |Y n x-G (X n x)|}) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  intro ε hε
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro η hη
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν.map Z) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hKμ⟩ := isTightMeasureSet_iff_exists_isCompact_measure_compl_le.mp
    (isTightMeasureSet_singleton (μ := ν.map Z)) (ENNReal.ofReal (η/4)) (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by positivity))
  have hKμ' := hKμ (ν.map Z) (Set.mem_singleton _)
  choose r hr a ha N hfit using hloc ε hε
  obtain ⟨S,hSK,hS,hcover⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover_image
    (fun f (_ : f∈K) => Metric.isOpen_ball (x := f) (ε := r f)) (by
      intro f hf
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨f,hf,Metric.mem_ball_self (hr f)⟩)
  let I := hS.toFinset
  let O : Set E := ⋃ f∈I,Metric.ball f (r f)
  have hO : IsOpen O := isOpen_iUnion (fun f => isOpen_iUnion (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball))
  have hKO : K⊆O := by simpa only [O,I,Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using hcover
  have hclosed := ProbabilityMeasure.limsup_measure_closed_le_of_tendsto h.tendsto hO.isClosed_compl
  have hlim : limsup (fun n => (μ n) ((X n) ⁻¹' Oᶜ)) atTop≤ENNReal.ofReal (η/4) := by
    simpa only [ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk,Measure.map_apply (hm _) hO.measurableSet.compl] using
      hclosed.trans ((measure_mono (Set.compl_subset_compl.mpr hKO)).trans hKμ')
  have hev : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(μ n).real ((X n) ⁻¹' Oᶜ)<η/2 := by
    have hh : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(μ n) ((X n) ⁻¹' Oᶜ)<ENNReal.ofReal (η/2) :=
      eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (hlim.trans_lt ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (half_pos hη)).mpr (by linarith)))
    filter_upwards [hh] with n hn
    rw [← ofReal_measureReal] at hn
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity)).mp hn
  have hsum : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ f∈I,(μ n).real (Bad n (a f))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const_zero] using tendsto_finsetSum I (fun f _ => hBad (a f) (ha f))
  have hN : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,∀ f∈I,N f≤n := by
    exact (eventually_all_finset I).mpr (fun f _ => eventually_ge_atTop (N f))
  filter_upwards [hev,hsum.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (half_pos hη)),hN] with n hn hn' hNn
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg measureReal_nonneg]
  have hs : {x | ε < |Y n x-G (X n x)|}⊆(X n) ⁻¹' Oᶜ ∪ ⋃ f∈I,Bad n (a f) := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxO : X n x∈O
    · right
      obtain ⟨f,hf,hxf⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxO
      apply Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr
      refine ⟨f,hf,?_⟩
      by_contra hbad
      exact not_lt_of_ge (hfit f n (hNn f hf) x hxf hbad) hx
    · exact Or.inl hxO
  have hh := (measureReal_mono (μ := μ n) hs (measure_ne_top _ _)).trans
    ((measureReal_union_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add le_rfl (measureReal_biUnion_finset_le I (fun f => Bad n (a f)))))
  linarith

end FKCRT.TreeCoding
end

theorem finiteExpectation_typed (q : ℝ) (hq : 0<q) (scale : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (F : MetricMeasureData→ℝ) :
    finiteExpectation q scale n F=
      ∑ w : SuccessfulWord n,
        ((1+Real.sqrt q)^flexibleCount (List.ofFn w.val) []/typedPartition q n)*
          F (mapSpace scale ((rootedWordEquiv n).symm w).1) := by
  unfold finiteExpectation
  have h := fk_word_transport q hq (n:=n) (fun M => F (mapSpace scale M))
  have hs : Real.sqrt q≠0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq)
  have hnum : (∑ M : RootedMap n,∑ A : Finset (Edge M),
      fkWeight q M A*F (mapSpace scale M))=
      Real.sqrt q*∑ w : SuccessfulWord n,
        (1+Real.sqrt q)^flexibleCount (List.ofFn w.val) []*F (mapSpace scale ((rootedWordEquiv n).symm w).1) := by
    calc
      _=(∑ M : RootedMap n,∑ A : Finset (Edge M),F (mapSpace scale M)*fkWeight q M A) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A _
        exact mul_comm _ _
      _=_ := h
      _=_ := by
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro w _
        exact mul_comm _ _
  simp_rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div,← Finset.sum_div]
  rw [hnum,partition_typedPartition q hq n,mul_div_mul_left _ _ hs]

end FKCRT
end

theorem finiteExpectation_marked (q : ℝ) (hq : 4<q) (scale : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (F : MetricMeasureData → ℝ) :
    finiteExpectation q scale n F=
      ∫ x,markedMapTest scale n F x ∂(actualOffspring (Parameters.ofQ q hq)).markedCodeLaw
        (fun k => (CoreLabel.markLaw (Parameters.ofQ q hq) k).toMeasure) (n+1) := by
  rw [actual_marked_normalized q hq n]
  rw [integral_finsetSum_measure (fun w _ =>
    (integrable_dirac (f := markedMapTest scale n F) (by simp)).smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)]
  simp only [integral_smul_measure,integral_dirac,smul_eq_mul,markedMapTest_word]
  rw [finiteExpectation_typed q (by linarith)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
    (typedPartition_pos q (by linarith) n).le)]

theorem traceFreeHilbertClosure_isII1Factor : IsII1Factor (N).toStarSubalgebra := by
  have hM : IsII1Factor M.toStarSubalgebra := {
    nonzero := fun h => hunit (Subtype.ext h.symm)
    weaklyClosed := traceHilbertVonNeumann_wotClosed M
    factor := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hfactor a ha
      exact ⟨z,hz.trans (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one z).symm⟩
    finite := hfinite
    diffuse := hdiff }

OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.TraceTrans.text:
theorem traceHilbertVonNeumann_wotClosed {J : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup J] [InnerProductSpace ℂ J] [CompleteSpace J]
    (P : VonNeumannAlgebra J) : WOTClosed P.toStarSubalgebra := by
  change IsClosed {T : J →WOT[ℂ] J | T.toCLM ∈ (P : Set (J →L[ℂ] J))}
  rw [← P.centralizer_centralizer]
  change IsClosed {T : J →WOT[ℂ] J |
    ∀ S ∈ Set.centralizer (P : Set (J →L[ℂ] J)),S*T.toCLM=T.toCLM*S}
  simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro S
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro hS
  have he : {T : J →WOT[ℂ] J | S*T.toCLM=T.toCLM*S} =
      {T : J →WOT[ℂ] J |
        (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.equiv.symm S)*T=T*(ContinuousLinearMapWOT.equiv.symm S)} := by
    ext T
    let e : (J →WOT[ℂ] J) ≃ (J →L[ℂ] J) := ContinuousLinearMapWOT.equiv
    exact e.injective.eq_iff
  rw [he]
  exact isClosed_eq (continuous_const_mul _) (continuous_mul_const _)

OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.Main:15.name: OAI.Generator.single_generation_of_II1_separable_predual
OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.Main:15.text:
theorem single_generation_of_II1_separable_predual
    (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (hS : IsII1Factor S)
    (hsep : HasSeparablePredual S) : SinglyGenerated S := by
  let M := vonNeumannOfWOTClosed S hS.weaklyClosed
  have hf : ∀ c : M.toStarSubalgebra,
      (∀ a : M.toStarSubalgebra, a*c=c*a) → ∃ z : ℂ, c=z • (1 : M.toStarSubalgebra) := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hS.factor c hc
    exact ⟨z, hz.trans (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one z)⟩
  have hunit : (1 : M.toStarSubalgebra) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hS.nonzero (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  let E := Tracial.TraceFreePreHilbert hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hunit
  let : NormedAddCommGroup E :=
    Tracial.traceFreePreHilbertNormedAddCommGroup hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hunit
  let : InnerProductSpace ℂ E :=
    Tracial.traceFreePreHilbertInnerProductSpace hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hunit
  let N := Tracial.traceFreeHilbertClosure hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hunit
  let τ := Tracial.traceFreeHilbertClosureTrace hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hunit
  have hN := Tracial.traceFreeHilbertClosure_isII1Factor hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hunit
  have hpre := Tracial.traceFreeHilbertClosure_hasSeparablePredual hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hunit hsep
  have htrace := Tracial.traceOrbit_isSeparable_of_separablePredual τ hpre
  exact Tracial.traceFreeHilbert_singlyGenerated_pullback hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hunit
    (Tracial.singlyGenerated_of_tracialRepresentation hN τ htrace)

def TraceFreePreHilbert
(_hfactor : ∀ c : M.toStarSubalgebra,
  (∀ a : M.toStarSubalgebra, a*c=c*a) → ∃ z : ℂ, c=z • (1 : M.toStarSubalgebra))
(_hdiff : ∀ p : M.toStarSubalgebra, IsStarProjection p → p ≠ 0 →
  ∃ q : M.toStarSubalgebra, IsStarProjection q ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧ q ≠ p ∧ p*q=q ∧ q*p=q)
(_hfinite : ∀ a : M.toStarSubalgebra, star a*a=1 → a*star a=1)
(_hunit : (1 : M.toStarSubalgebra) ≠ 0)
    : Type _ := M.toStarSubalgebra

local instance traceHilbertStarOrder : StarOrderedRing M.toStarSubalgebra := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _

  ∃ q : M.toStarSubalgebra, IsStarProjection q ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧ q ≠ p ∧ p*q=q ∧ q*p=q)
variable (hfinite : ∀ a : M.toStarSubalgebra, star a*a=1 → a*star a=1)
variable (hunit : (1 : M.toStarSubalgebra) ≠ 0)

local notation "τ₀" => traceFreeTrace hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit

OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.Target:56.name: OAI.Generator.IsII1Factor

structure IsII1Factor (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Prop where
  nonzero : (0 : H →L[ℂ] H) ≠ 1
  weaklyClosed : WOTClosed S
  factor : ∀ x : S, (∀ y : S, y * x = x * y) → ∃ c : ℂ, x = algebraMap ℂ S c
  finite : ∀ v : S, star v * v = 1 → v * star v = 1
  diffuse : ∀ p : S, IsStarProjection p → p ≠ 0 →
    ∃ q : S, IsStarProjection q ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧ q ≠ p ∧ p * q = q ∧ q * p = q

  toStarSubalgebra := StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ
    (StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ ((π).range : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) : Set (K →L[ℂ] K))
  centralizer_centralizer' := by
    change Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer
      ((StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ (StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ
        ((π).range : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) : Set (K →L[ℂ] K))) : Set (K →L[ℂ] K))) =
      ((StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ (StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ
        ((π).range : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) : Set (K →L[ℂ] K))) : Set (K →L[ℂ] K))
    rw [StarSubalgebra.coe_centralizer_centralizer]
    simp only [Set.centralizer_centralizer_centralizer]

local notation "N" => traceFreeHilbertClosure hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit

theorem wotClosed_bicommutant (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (hS : WOTClosed S) :
    Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))=S := by
  classical
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro T hT
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := bicommutant_exists_strong_net S T hT
    have hw : Tendsto (fun d => ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM (a d).val) atTop
        (𝓝 (ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM T)) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMapWOT.tendsto_iff_forall_inner_apply_tendsto.mpr
      intro x y
      exact (continuous_const.inner continuous_id).continuousAt.tendsto.comp (ha x)
    exact hS.mem_of_tendsto hw (Eventually.of_forall (fun d => (a d).property))
  · intro T hT a ha
    exact (ha T hT).symm

OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.TraceTrans.name: OAI.Generator.isII1Factor_of_starAlgEquiv
OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.TraceTrans.text:
theorem isII1Factor_of_starAlgEquiv (e : S ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] T)
    (hS : IsII1Factor S) (hT : WOTClosed T) : IsII1Factor T where
  nonzero := by
    intro h
    have ht : (0 : T) = 1 := Subtype.ext h
    have hs : (0 : S) = 1 := e.injective (by simpa only [map_zero, map_one] using ht)
    exact hS.nonzero (congrArg Subtype.val hs)
  weaklyClosed := hT
  factor := by
    intro x hx
    have hc : ∀ y : S, y * e.symm x = e.symm x * y := by
      intro y
      apply e.injective
      change e (y * e.symm x) = e (e.symm x * y)
      simpa only [map_mul, e.apply_symm_apply] using hx (e y)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hS.factor (e.symm x) hc
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    calc x = e (e.symm x) := (e.apply_symm_apply x).symm
         _ = e (algebraMap ℂ S c) := congrArg e hc
         _ = algebraMap ℂ T c := e.toAlgEquiv.commutes c
  finite := by
    intro v hv
    have h : star (e.symm v) * e.symm v = 1 := by
      simpa only [map_mul, map_star, map_one] using congrArg e.symm hv
    have hf := hS.finite (e.symm v) h
    simpa only [map_mul, map_star, map_one, e.apply_symm_apply] using congrArg e hf
  diffuse := by
    intro p hp hp0
    have hsp : IsStarProjection (e.symm p) := hp.map e.symm
    have hsp0 : e.symm p ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hp0
      simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] using congrArg e hz
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0, hqp, hpq, hqp'⟩ := hS.diffuse (e.symm p) hsp hsp0
    refine ⟨e q, hq.map e, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hz
      apply hq0
      apply e.injective
      change e q = e 0
      simpa only [map_zero] using hz
    · intro heq
      apply hqp
      apply e.injective
      change e q = e (e.symm p)
      simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using heq
    · simpa only [map_mul, e.apply_symm_apply] using congrArg e hpq
    · simpa only [map_mul, e.apply_symm_apply] using congrArg e hqp'

OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.Target:36.name: OAI.Generator.wstar_closed
OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.Target:36.text:
theorem wstar_closed (s : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) : WOTClosed (wstar s) := by
  unfold WOTClosed
  have heq : {T : H →WOT[ℂ] H | T.toCLM ∈ wstar s} =
      ⋂ (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (_ : WOTClosed S ∧ s ⊆ S),
        {T : H →WOT[ℂ] H | T.toCLM ∈ S} := by
    ext T
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter, wstar, StarSubalgebra.mem_sInf]
  rw [heq]

theorem traceFreeHilbert_singlyGenerated_pullback
    (hgen : SinglyGenerated (N).toStarSubalgebra) : SinglyGenerated M.toStarSubalgebra := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hgen⟩ := hgen
  let a : M.toStarSubalgebra := (e).symm ⟨b,hb⟩
  let Q := wstar {a.val}
  have hQM : Q ≤ M.toStarSubalgebra :=
    wstar_le (traceHilbertVonNeumann_wotClosed M) (by
      intro c hc
      obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hc
      exact a.property)
  let P := (Q.comap M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype).map π
  have hbP : b ∈ P := by
    refine ⟨a,subset_wstar {a.val} (Set.mem_singleton a.val),?_⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((e).apply_symm_apply ⟨b,hb⟩)
  have hNP : (N).toStarSubalgebra ≤ P := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact wstar_le (traceFreeSubalgebraImage_wotClosed hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit Q
      (wstar_closed {a.val})) (by
        intro c hc
        obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hc
        exact hbP)
  refine ⟨a.val,a.property,le_antisymm hQM ?_⟩
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨d,hdQ,hd⟩ := hNP (traceFreeHilbertAction_mem_closure hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit ⟨c,hc⟩)
  have hd' : d = (⟨c,hc⟩ : M.toStarSubalgebra) :=
    traceFreeHilbertAction_injective hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit hd
  change d.val ∈ Q at hdQ
  rw [hd'] at hdQ
  exact hdQ

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Incidence.Inc.name: OAI.Falconer.incidence_block_scale_choice
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Incidence.Inc.text:
theorem incidence_block_scale_choice {B M : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsmall : δ ≤ 1/(4*(2:ℝ)^(B*M))) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ m ∧ 4*δ ≤ 1/(2:ℝ)^(m*B) ∧
      1/(2:ℝ)^(m*B) ≤ 4*(2:ℝ)^B*δ := by
  have hp : 1 < (2:ℝ)^B := one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) hB.ne'
  have hxM : ((2:ℝ)^B)^M ≤ 1/(4*δ) := by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4*δ)).2
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4*(2:ℝ)^(B*M))).mp hsmall
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ 1/(4*δ) := (one_le_pow₀ hp.le).trans hxM
  obtain ⟨m,hmlo,hmhi⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near hx1 hp
  have hMm : M ≤ m := by
    by_contra h
    have hle : m+1 ≤ M := by omega
    have hh := pow_le_pow_right₀ hp.le hle
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hh.trans hxM)) hmhi
  refine ⟨m,hMm,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [← pow_mul] at hmlo
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ)^(m*B))).2
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4*δ)).mp hmlo
    simpa only [mul_comm,Nat.mul_comm] using hh
  · rw [pow_succ,← pow_mul] at hmhi
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ)^(m*B))).2
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 4*δ)).mp hmhi
    convert hh.le using 1
    simp only [Nat.mul_comm]
    ring

end Falconer

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Radial.Radial.text:
theorem published_radial_moment : PublishedRadialMoment := by
  intro n hn α β δ hδ hδ1 hα hβ _hsep hEα hEβ
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hs,hsn,ht,_htn,_hut,hp,hpt,hps⟩ := radial_moment_parameters hn1 hδ hδ1
  have hu0 : 0 < 2*(n : ℝ)-((n : ℝ)+δ/2) := by linarith
  have hs0 : 0 < (n : ℝ)+δ/2 := by linarith
  have hs2 : (n : ℝ)+δ/2 < 2*n := by linarith
  have hp2 : 1+δ/(8*(n : ℝ)) < 2 :=
    hpt.trans_le (sub_le_self _ (div_nonneg ht.le hn0.le))
  have hupt : (2*(n : ℝ)-((n : ℝ)+δ/2))*(1+δ/(8*(n : ℝ))) < (n : ℝ)-δ/4 :=
    by simpa only [mul_comm] using (lt_div_iff₀ hu0).mp hps
  have htr : ((n : ℝ)-δ/4)/(2-(1+δ/(8*(n : ℝ)))) < n := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)).mpr
    have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hpt hn0
    have he : (((n : ℝ)-δ/4)/(n : ℝ))*(n : ℝ) = (n : ℝ)-δ/4 :=
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ hn0.ne'
    nlinarith
  have hpq : (1+δ/(8*(n : ℝ))).HolderConjugate
      ((1+δ/(8*(n : ℝ)))/((1+δ/(8*(n : ℝ)))-1)) :=
    (Real.holderConjugate_iff_eq_conjExponent hp).mpr rfl
  exact finite_euclidean_radial_moment n α (β : Measure (Space (n+1))) hα hβ
    (α : Measure (Space (n+1))).support_mem_ae (β : Measure (Space (n+1))).support_mem_ae
    hs0 hs hsn hs2 ht hpq hp2 hupt htr hEα hEβ

end Falconer

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Campaign123Pl.name: OAI.Falconer.publishedPlanarFurstenberg_proved
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Campaign123Pl.text:
theorem publishedPlanarFurstenberg_proved : PublishedPlanarFurstenberg := by
  intro b f hb hbhalf hbf hf1
  let κ := min b (min (f-b) (1/100:ℝ))/16
  have hκ : 0 < κ := div_pos (lt_min hb (lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hbf) (by norm_num))) (by norm_num)
  have hκb : κ ≤ b/16 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
  have hκg : κ ≤ (f-b)/16 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)) (by norm_num)
  have hκone : κ ≤ (1/100:ℝ)/16 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨B,hB,_,lam,ζ,hlam,hζ,M,hM,hblock⟩ := original_block_incidence hκ
    (by linarith : κ ≤ 1/100) (by linarith : κ ≤ b) (by linarith : b ≤ 1-8*κ)
    (by linarith : b+8*κ ≤ f) (by linarith : f ≤ 2)
  have hC : 0 ≤ originalIncidenceCost B := by unfold originalIncidenceCost; positivity
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hε1,_,_,N0,hN0,habsorb⟩ := exists_incidence_absorption_parameters hlam hζ
    (originalIncidenceCost B) hC
  let δ0 := min 1 (1/(4*(2:ℝ)^(B*(M+N0+1))))
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ0 := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨ε,δ0,hε,hδ0,min_le_left _ _,?_⟩
  intro δ hδ hδsmall P hP hPchart hPsep hPball V hV
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := hδsmall.le.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hsmall : δ ≤ 1/(4*(2:ℝ)^(B*(M+N0+1))) := hδsmall.le.trans (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨m,hm,hscale,hscale'⟩ := incidence_block_scale_choice hB hδ hsmall
  have hmM : M ≤ m := by omega
  have hNm : m ≤ m*B := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right m hB
  have hNN : N0 ≤ m*B := by omega
  obtain ⟨hpoly,hfinal⟩ := habsorb (m*B) hNN
  have hcost := original_weak_costs hδ hδ1 hε.le hε1 hlam.le hb.le
    (by linarith : b ≤ 1) (by linarith : 0 ≤ f) (by linarith : f ≤ 2) hscale' hpoly hfinal
  have hK : 1 ≤ δ^(-ε) := Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hδ hδ1 (by linarith)
  have hcard := hblock m hmM δ (δ^(-ε)) hδ hδ1 hK hscale hcost.1
    P hP hPchart hPsep hPball V hV
  have hcoeff : 0 < 162*δ^(-ε)*δ^b*(16*(1/(2:ℝ)^(m*B))/δ+1)^2 := by positivity
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hcoeff).mp (hcost.2.trans hcard)

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Incidence.Inc.name: OAI.Falconer.exists_incidence_absorption_parameters
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Incidence.Inc.text:
theorem exists_incidence_absorption_parameters {lam ζ : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hζ : 0 < ζ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1/8 ∧ ε ≤ lam/16 ∧ ε ≤ ζ/8 ∧
      ∃ N0 : ℕ, 0 < N0 ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N →
        C*((N:ℝ)+1)*(2:ℝ)^(ε*(N:ℝ)) ≤ (2:ℝ)^((lam/4)*(N:ℝ)) ∧
        C*(2:ℝ)^((2*ε)*(N:ℝ)) ≤ (2:ℝ)^(ζ*(N:ℝ)) := by
  let ε := min (1/8:ℝ) (min (lam/16) (ζ/8))
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have hε1 : ε ≤ 1/8 := min_le_left _ _
  have he_lam : ε ≤ lam/16 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hεζ : ε ≤ ζ/8 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  let σ := min (lam/8) (ζ/2)
  have hσ : 0 < σ := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨N0,hN0,hpoly⟩ := dyadic_polynomial_loss hσ hC 1
  refine ⟨ε,hε,hε1,he_lam,hεζ,N0,hN0,?_⟩
  intro N hN
  have hc : C*((N:ℝ)+1) ≤ (2:ℝ)^(σ*(N:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := hpoly N hN
    rw [pow_one] at hh
    simpa only [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2),mul_comm (Real.log 2)] using hh
  have hsigma_lam : σ ≤ lam/8 := min_le_left _ _
  have hσζ : σ ≤ ζ/2 := min_le_right _ _
  constructor
  · calc
      _ ≤ (2:ℝ)^(σ*(N:ℝ))*(2:ℝ)^(ε*(N:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (by positivity)
      _ = (2:ℝ)^((σ+ε)*(N:ℝ)) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]; congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ _ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [hsigma_lam,he_lam,hlam]) (Nat.cast_nonneg N))
  · have hCsmall : C ≤ (2:ℝ)^(σ*(N:ℝ)) :=
      (le_mul_of_one_le_right hC (by linarith only [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) N])).trans hc
    calc
      _ ≤ (2:ℝ)^(σ*(N:ℝ))*(2:ℝ)^((2*ε)*(N:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCsmall (by positivity)
      _ = (2:ℝ)^((σ+2*ε)*(N:ℝ)) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]; congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ _ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [hσζ,hεζ,hζ]) (Nat.cast_nonneg N))

end Falconer

end OAI

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Estimates.Ori.name: OAI.Falconer.original_weak_costs
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Estimates.Ori.text:
theorem original_weak_costs {N B : ℕ} {δ ε lam ζ s t : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1/8)
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (_ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht2 : t ≤ 2)
    (hscale : 1/(2:ℝ)^N ≤ (4*(2:ℝ)^B)*δ)
    (hpoly : originalIncidenceCost B*((N:ℝ)+1)*(2:ℝ)^(ε*(N:ℝ)) ≤ (2:ℝ)^((lam/4)*(N:ℝ)))
    (hfinal : originalIncidenceCost B*(2:ℝ)^((2*ε)*(N:ℝ)) ≤ (2:ℝ)^(ζ*(N:ℝ))) :
    let K := δ^(-ε);
    let J : ℝ := (Nat.log 2 (Nat.ceil ((4/δ+1)^2))+1:ℕ);
    let F := (16*(1/(2:ℝ)^N)/δ+1)^2;
    (41472*K*J*F*2^t ≤ (2:ℝ)^((lam/4)*(N:ℝ)) ∧
      41472*K*J*F*4^s ≤ (2:ℝ)^(lam*(N:ℝ)) ∧
      81*F ≤ (2:ℝ)^(lam*(N:ℝ))) ∧
    (162*K*δ^s*F)*δ^(-2*s-ε) ≤ (2:ℝ)^((s+ζ)*(N:ℝ)) := by
  dsimp only
  let K := δ^(-ε)
  let J : ℝ := (Nat.log 2 (Nat.ceil ((4/δ+1)^2))+1:ℕ)
  let F := (16*(1/(2:ℝ)^N)/δ+1)^2
  let C := 4*(2:ℝ)^B
  let D := 2*(B:ℝ)+13
  let F0 := (64*(2:ℝ)^B+1)^2
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := by
    have hh : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2^B := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    dsimp [C]
    linarith
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  have hF0 : 0 ≤ F0 := sq_nonneg _
  have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos hδ hδ1 (by linarith)
  have hJ1 : 1 ≤ J := by dsimp [J]; exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ Nat.log 2 (Nat.ceil ((4/δ+1)^2))+1 by omega)
  have hF : 0 ≤ F := sq_nonneg _
  have hCb : C^ε ≤ C := by
    calc
      _ ≤ C^(1:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hC1 (by linarith)
      _ = _ := Real.rpow_one _
  have hKb : K ≤ C*(2:ℝ)^(ε*(N:ℝ)) :=
    (incidence_inverse_scale_power hδ (zero_le_one.trans hC1) hε N hscale).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCb (by positivity))
  have hJb : J ≤ D*((N:ℝ)+1) := incidence_bucket_linear_bound hδ N B hscale
  have hFb : F ≤ F0 := incidence_packing_factor_bound hδ (by positivity) B hscale
  have hweak : 41472*K*J*F*4 ≤ (2:ℝ)^((lam/4)*(N:ℝ)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 41472*(C*(2:ℝ)^(ε*(N:ℝ)))*(D*((N:ℝ)+1))*F0*4 := by gcongr
      _ = (165888*C*D*F0)*((N:ℝ)+1)*(2:ℝ)^(ε*(N:ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ originalIncidenceCost B*((N:ℝ)+1)*(2:ℝ)^(ε*(N:ℝ)) := by
        gcongr
        exact le_max_left _ _
      _ ≤ _ := hpoly
  have hweakbig : (2:ℝ)^((lam/4)*(N:ℝ)) ≤ (2:ℝ)^(lam*(N:ℝ)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith : lam/4 ≤ lam) (Nat.cast_nonneg N))
  refine ⟨⟨?_,?_,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · apply le_trans _ hweak
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
    calc
      _ ≤ (2:ℝ)^(2:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) ht2
      _ = 4 := by norm_num
  · apply le_trans _ (hweak.trans hweakbig)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
    calc
      _ ≤ (4:ℝ)^(1:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hs1
      _ = 4 := by norm_num
  · apply le_trans _ (hweak.trans hweakbig)
    have hKJ := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hK1 hJ1
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKJ (show 0 ≤ 165888*F by positivity)
    nlinarith only [hh,hF]
  · have ha : 0 ≤ s+2*ε := by positivity
    have ha2 : s+2*ε ≤ 2 := by linarith
    have hCa : C^(s+2*ε) ≤ C^2 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ C^(2:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hC1 ha2
        _ = C^2 := by norm_num
    have he : K*δ^s*δ^(-2*s-ε) = δ^(-(s+2*ε)) := by
      dsimp [K]
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hδ,← Real.rpow_add hδ]
      congr 1
      ring
    calc
      _ = 162*F*(K*δ^s*δ^(-2*s-ε)) := by ring
      _ = 162*F*δ^(-(s+2*ε)) := by rw [he]
      _ ≤ 162*F0*(C^(s+2*ε)*(2:ℝ)^((s+2*ε)*(N:ℝ))) := by
        gcongr
        exact incidence_inverse_scale_power hδ (zero_le_one.trans hC1) ha N hscale
      _ ≤ 162*F0*(C^2*(2:ℝ)^((s+2*ε)*(N:ℝ))) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ originalIncidenceCost B*(2:ℝ)^((s+2*ε)*(N:ℝ)) := by
        have hh : 162*F0*C^2 ≤ originalIncidenceCost B := le_max_right _ _
        nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (show 0 ≤ (2:ℝ)^((s+2*ε)*(N:ℝ)) by positivity)]
      _ = (2:ℝ)^(s*(N:ℝ))*(originalIncidenceCost B*(2:ℝ)^((2*ε)*(N:ℝ))) := by
        rw [show (s+2*ε)*(N:ℝ) = s*(N:ℝ)+(2*ε)*(N:ℝ) by ring,
          Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
        ring
      _ ≤ (2:ℝ)^(s*(N:ℝ))*(2:ℝ)^(ζ*(N:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfinal (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]; congr 1; ring

end Falconer

end OAI

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Incidence.Pub.name: OAI.Falconer.PublishedPlanarFurstenberg
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Incidence.Pub.text:
def PublishedPlanarFurstenberg : Prop := by
  classical
  exact ∀ b f : ℝ, 0 < b → b ≤ 1 / 2 → b < f → f < 1 →
    ∃ ε δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < δ₀ ∧ δ₀ ≤ 1 ∧
    ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₀ →
    ∀ P : Finset (Space 2), P.Nonempty → InBoundedLineChart P →
      FiniteSeparatedAt δ P → NormalizedFiniteBallBound δ f (δ ^ (-ε)) P →
    ∀ T : Space 2 → Finset (Space 2),
      (∀ x ∈ P, (T x).Nonempty ∧ InBoundedLineChart (T x) ∧
        FiniteSeparatedAt δ (T x) ∧ NormalizedFiniteBallBound δ b (δ ^ (-ε)) (T x) ∧
        ∀ l ∈ T x, TubeIncident δ x l) →
      δ ^ (-2 * b - ε) ≤ ((P.biUnion T).card : ℝ)

end Falconer

end OAI

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Incidence.Ori.name: OAI.Falconer.original_block_incidence
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Incidence.Ori.text:
theorem original_block_incidence {κ s t : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκ1 : κ ≤ 1/100)
    (hs : κ ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1-8*κ) (ht : s+8*κ ≤ t) (ht2 : t ≤ 2) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, 0 < B ∧ Even B ∧ ∃ lam ζ : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ 0 < ζ ∧
    ∃ M : ℕ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, M ≤ m →
    ∀ δ K : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ K → 4*δ ≤ 1/(2:ℝ)^(m*B) →
      (let J : ℝ := (Nat.log 2 (Nat.ceil ((4/δ+1)^2))+1:ℕ);
       let F := (16*(1/(2:ℝ)^(m*B))/δ+1)^2;
       41472*K*J*F*2^t ≤ (2:ℝ)^((lam/4)*(m*B:ℕ)) ∧
       41472*K*J*F*4^s ≤ (2:ℝ)^(lam*(m*B:ℕ)) ∧
       81*F ≤ (2:ℝ)^(lam*(m*B:ℕ))) →
    ∀ P : Finset (Space 2), P.Nonempty → InBoundedLineChart P → FiniteSeparatedAt δ P →
      NormalizedFiniteBallBound δ t K P →
    ∀ V : Space 2 → Finset (Space 2),
      (∀ x ∈ P, (V x).Nonempty ∧ InBoundedLineChart (V x) ∧ FiniteSeparatedAt δ (V x) ∧
        NormalizedFiniteBallBound δ s K (V x) ∧ ∀ l ∈ V x, TubeIncident δ x l) →
      (2:ℝ)^((s+ζ)*(m*B:ℕ)) ≤
        (162*K*δ^s*(16*(1/(2:ℝ)^(m*B))/δ+1)^2)*((P.biUnion V).card:ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hBeven,lam,ζ,hlam,hζ,M,hM,hcentered⟩ := uniform_centered_planar_incidence hκ hκ1 hs hs1 ht
  refine ⟨B,hB,hBeven,lam,ζ,hlam,hζ,M,hM,?_⟩
  intro m hm δ K hδ hδ1 hK hscale hcost P hP hPchart hPsep hPball V hV
  let N := m*B
  let J : ℝ := (Nat.log 2 (Nat.ceil ((4/δ+1)^2))+1:ℕ)
  let F := (16*(1/(2:ℝ)^N)/δ+1)^2
  have hJ : 1 ≤ J := by dsimp [J]; exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ Nat.log 2 (Nat.ceil ((4/δ+1)^2))+1 by omega)
  have hF : 0 < F := by dsimp [F]; positivity
  obtain ⟨hcost1,hcost2,hcost3⟩ := hcost
  obtain ⟨k,P0,V0,hP0,_hP0P,hchart0,hsep0,hball0,hnumber,hV0,hunion0⟩ :=
    original_pencil_equalization hδ hδ1 hK P V hP hPchart hPsep hPball hV
  let K0 := 2*K*J
  have hK0 : 1 ≤ K0 := by
    have hh := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hK hJ
    dsimp [K0]
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hKJ : K*J ≤ K0 := by dsimp [K0]; nlinarith only [mul_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hK) (zero_le_one.trans hJ)]
  have h2K : 2*K ≤ K0 := by
    dsimp [K0]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (by linarith) hJ
  have mono {a b u : ℝ} {S : Finset (Space 2)} (hab : a ≤ b)
      (hb : NormalizedFiniteBallBound δ u a S) : NormalizedFiniteBallBound δ u b S := by
    intro z r hr hr1
    exact (hb z r hr hr1).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab (Real.rpow_nonneg (hδ.le.trans hr) _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  have hv0 : ∀ x ∈ P0, (2:ℝ)^k ≤ ((V0 x).card:ℝ) ∧ ((V0 x).card:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ)^k ∧
      InBoundedLineChart (V0 x) ∧ FiniteSeparatedAt δ (V0 x) ∧
      NormalizedFiniteBallBound δ s K0 (V0 x) ∧ ∀ l ∈ V0 x, TubeIncident δ x l := by
    intro x hx
    have hh := hV0 x hx
    have hc : ((V0 x).card:ℝ) = (2:ℝ)^k := by exact_mod_cast hh.1
    exact ⟨hc.ge,hc.le,hh.2.1,hh.2.2.1,mono h2K hh.2.2.2.1,hh.2.2.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hcarry,hRsep,hRball,U,hU,hunion⟩ := coarse_squashed_pencil_configuration hδ
    (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/(2:ℝ)^N) (hκ.le.trans hs) (by linarith) (by linarith) ht2
    hK0 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ)^k) P0 V0 hP0 hchart0 hsep0 (mono hKJ hball0) hv0
  have hKfinal : 1 ≤ 20736*K0*F := by
    have hF1 : 1 ≤ F := by
      dsimp [F]
      have hh : 0 ≤ 16*(1/(2:ℝ)^N)/δ := by positivity
      nlinarith only [hh]
    have hh := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hK0 hF1
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hQside : (centeredUnitCube 2).side = 1 := rfl
  have hQcenter : (centeredUnitCube 2).center = 0 := by
    ext i
    change -(1/2:ℝ)+1/2 = 0
    ring
  have hsize : (2:ℝ)^k ≤ (2:ℝ)^(lam*(N:ℝ))*((2:ℝ)^k/(81*F)) := by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 81*F)).2
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcost3 (show 0 ≤ (2:ℝ)^k by positivity)
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hgain := hcentered m hm (centeredUnitCube 2) hQside hQcenter (δ/4) (20736*K0*F)
    ((2:ℝ)^k/(81*F)) ((2:ℝ)^k) (by positivity) hKfinal (by positivity)
    (by nlinarith only [hscale])
    (by dsimp [K0]; convert hcost1 using 1; ring)
    (by dsimp [K0]; convert hcost2 using 1; ring) hsize R hR hcarry (by simpa only [mul_one_div,N] using hRsep) hRball U hU
  have hUorig : ((R.biUnion U).card:ℝ) ≤ ((P.biUnion V).card:ℝ) := hunion.trans hunion0
  have hga := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ)^k/(81*F))).mp hgain
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hga.trans hUorig) (show 0 ≤ 81*F by positivity)
  have hcancel : (2:ℝ)^((s+ζ)*(N:ℝ))*((2:ℝ)^k/(81*F))*(81*F) =
      (2:ℝ)^((s+ζ)*(N:ℝ))*(2:ℝ)^k := by field_simp
  rw [hcancel] at hmul
  calc
    _ ≤ (2:ℝ)^((s+ζ)*(N:ℝ))*(2*K*δ^s*(2:ℝ)^k) :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hnumber
    _ = (2*K*δ^s)*((2:ℝ)^((s+ζ)*(N:ℝ))*(2:ℝ)^k) := by ring
    _ ≤ (2*K*δ^s)*(((P.biUnion V).card:ℝ)*(81*F)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by dsimp [F]; ring

end Falconer

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Currents.P.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.CurrentOperations.pushCurrent_boundarySucc
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Currents.P.text:
lemma pushCurrent_boundarySucc {k : ℕ} (T : Functional X (k+1))
    {f : X → Y} {K : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith K f) :
    boundarySucc (pushCurrent f T) = pushCurrent f (boundarySucc T) := by
  funext b π
  by_cases h : Admissible b π
  · have hcons : Admissible (fun _ : Y => (1 : ℝ)) (Matrix.vecCons b π) := by
      refine ⟨BoundedLip.const 1, ?_⟩
      intro i
      refine Fin.cases h.1.1 (fun j => h.2 j) i
    rw [boundarySucc, ite_eq_left h, pushCurrent_apply f T hcons,
      pushCurrent_apply f (boundarySucc T) h, boundarySucc,
      ite_eq_left (admissible_comp h hf)]
    congr 1
    funext i x
    exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
  · simp only [boundarySucc, pushCurrent, ite_eq_right h]

omit [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] in

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.push_compactlySupported
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma push_compactlySupported {X Y : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X k} (hT : IsMetricCurrent T) {f : X → Y} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hf : LipschitzWith L f) : CompactlySupported (pushCurrent f T) := by
  refine ⟨range f, isCompact_range hf.continuous, ?_⟩
  intro b π had hb
  rw [pushCurrent_apply f T had]
  have he : b ∘ f = fun _ => 0 := funext fun x => hb (f x) ⟨x,rfl⟩
  rw [he]
  have h0 := hT.linearFirst (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun i => π i ∘ f) 0 0
    (BoundedLip.const 0) (BoundedLip.const 0) (admissible_comp had hf).2
  simpa only [zero_mul,add_zero] using h0

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Main:60.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.coefficient_optimal
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Main:60.text:
theorem coefficient_optimal (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ T : IntegralCurrent (Euc (n + 1)) n,
      CompactlySupported T.val ∧ IsCycle T.val ∧ 0 < mass T.val ∧
      ∀ S : IntegralCurrent (Euc (n + 1)) (n + 1),
        CompactlySupported S.val → boundarySucc S.val = T.val →
        fillingCoefficient n * (mass T.val) ^ fillingPower n ≤ mass S.val := by
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hI,hM⟩ := Optimality.exists_good_inner_ball n
  have hAI := Optimality.ambientBall_integral hI
  let B := Optimality.ambientBall (n+1) t
  let T : IntegralCurrent (Euc (n+1)) n := ⟨boundarySucc B,Optimality.integral_boundary hAI⟩
  refine ⟨T,Optimality.ambientBall_boundary_compact n t hI.2.2.1,
    Optimality.boundary_isCycle hAI.1, Optimality.ambientBall_boundary_mass_pos n ht hAI.2.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro S hSc hSb
  have hmass : mass T.val ≤ sphereArea n * (-t)^n :=
    (Optimality.ambientBall_boundary_mass_le n t hI.2.2.1).trans hM
  calc fillingCoefficient n * mass T.val ^ fillingPower n ≤ omega (n+1)*(-t)^(n+1) :=
      Optimality.sharp_ball_bound (by omega) (neg_pos.mpr ht.2) (mass_nonneg _) hmass
    _ = (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Euc (n+1)) (-t))).toReal :=
      (Optimality.ball_volume_scaling (n+1) (neg_pos.mpr ht.2)).symm
    _ ≤ mass S.val := Optimality.allFillings_mass_ge_ball n ht.1 S.property.1 hSb

end SharpIntegralFillings

end

lemma integral_push_of_bilipschitz {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X k}
    (hT : IsIntegral k T) {f : X → Y} {K J : ℝ≥0}
    (hf : LipschitzWith K f) (hfJ : AntilipschitzWith J f) :
    IsIntegral k (pushCurrent f T) := by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact ⟨pushCurrent_isMetricCurrent hT.1 hf,
      integerRectifiable_push_of_bilipschitz hT.2 hf hfJ⟩

    refine ⟨pushCurrent_isMetricCurrent hT.1 hf,
      integerRectifiable_push_of_bilipschitz hT.2.1 hf hfJ,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [pushCurrent_boundarySucc T hf]
      exact pushCurrent_isMetricCurrent hT.2.2.1 hf
    · rw [pushCurrent_boundarySucc T hf]
      exact integerRectifiable_push_of_bilipschitz hT.2.2.2 hf hfJ

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.exists_le_of_integral_le_ae
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma exists_le_of_integral_le_ae {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {f g : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hi : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, g x ∂μ) {P : α → Prop} (hP : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x) :
    ∃ x, P x ∧ f x ≤ g x := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hlt : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, g x < f x := hP.mono fun x hx => h x hx
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun x => f x - g x := hlt.mono fun x hx => sub_nonneg.mpr hx.le
  have hzero : (∫ x, f x - g x ∂μ) = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [integral_sub hf hg]
      linarith
    · exact integral_nonneg_of_ae hnonneg
  have hae := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hnonneg (hf.sub hg)).mp hzero
  have : NeZero μ := ⟨hμ⟩
  obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := (hlt.and hae).exists
  exact (sub_pos.mpr hx).ne' he

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.abs_apply_le_mass
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma abs_apply_le_mass {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X k} (hT : IsMetricCurrent T) {b : X → ℝ}
    {π : Fin k → X → ℝ} (hb : BoundedLip b) (hb1 : ∀ x, |b x| ≤ 1)
    (hπ : ∀ i, LipschitzWith 1 (π i)) : |T b π| ≤ mass T := by
  apply le_csInf
  · obtain ⟨μ,hμ,hctrl⟩ := hT.finiteMass
    exact ⟨μ.real univ, μ,hμ,hctrl,rfl⟩
  · rintro r ⟨μ,hμ,hctrl,rfl⟩
    let := hμ
    apply (hctrl b π hb hπ).trans
    calc (∫ x, |b x| ∂μ) ≤ ∫ _ : X, (1:ℝ) ∂μ :=
          integral_mono ((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).mono' hb.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
            (Eventually.of_forall fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb1 x)).abs
            (integrable_const 1) hb1
      _ = μ.real univ := by simp

end SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.ambientBall_boundary_mass_pos
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma ambientBall_boundary_mass_pos (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0)
    (hT : IsMetricCurrent (boundarySucc (ambientBall (n+1) t))) :
    0 < mass (boundarySucc (ambientBall (n+1) t)) := by
  have htest := abs_apply_le_mass hT (clippedCoord_boundedLip (0 : Fin (n+1)))
    (clippedCoord_abs_le 0) (fun i => ambientCoord_lipschitz i.succ)
  rw [ambientBall_boundary_coords n ht.1,abs_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg,
    ball_volume_scaling (n+1) (neg_pos.mpr ht.2)] at htest
  exact (mul_pos (omega_pos (n+1)) (pow_pos (neg_pos.mpr ht.2) _)).trans_le htest

end SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality

end

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.clippedCoord_lipschitz

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.ball_volume_scaling
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma ball_volume_scaling (d : ℕ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Euc d) r)).toReal = omega d * r^d := by
  rw [Measure.addHaar_ball_of_pos volume 0 hr, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hr.le _)]
  simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin, omega]
  ring

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.ambientCoord_lipschitz
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma ambientCoord_lipschitz {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) : LipschitzWith 1 (ambientCoord i) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, Real.dist_eq]
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  change ‖(x-y) i‖ ≤ ‖x-y‖
  exact PiLp.norm_apply_le (x-y) i

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.ambientBall_boundary_coords
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma ambientBall_boundary_coords (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : -1 < t) :
    boundarySucc (ambientBall (n+1) t) (clippedCoord 0) (fun i => ambientCoord i.succ) =
      (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Euc (n+1)) (-t))).toReal := by
  have had : Admissible (clippedCoord (0 : Fin (n+1))) (fun i => ambientCoord i.succ) :=
    ⟨clippedCoord_boundedLip 0,fun i => ⟨1,ambientCoord_lipschitz i.succ⟩⟩
  rw [boundarySucc,ite_eq_left had,ambientBall,
    pushCurrent_apply _ _ (Foundations.admissible_vecCons (BoundedLip.const 1) had.1.1 had.2)]
  have he : (fun i => Matrix.vecCons (clippedCoord (0 : Fin (n+1)))
        (fun j => ambientCoord j.succ) i ∘ (fun x : UnitBall (n+1) => x.val)) = unitCoord := by
    funext i x
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact clippedCoord_on_unitBall 0 x
    | succ i => rfl
  rw [he]
  exact innerBallCurrent_coords (n+1) ht

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Currents.P.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.CurrentOperations.mass_pushCurrent_le
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Currents.P.text:
lemma mass_pushCurrent_le [CompactSpace X] {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X k}
    (hT : IsMetricCurrent T) {f : X → Y} {K : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith K f) :
    mass (pushCurrent f T) ≤ (K : ℝ)^k * mass T := by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hc, hm⟩ := hT.exists_controls_mass_eq
  let := hμ
  have hfin : IsFiniteMeasure ((↑(K^k) : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.map f) := by
    constructor
    simp only [Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.coe_lt_top (measure_lt_top (μ.map f) univ)
  calc
    mass (pushCurrent f T) ≤ (((↑(K^k) : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.map f)).real univ :=
      mass_le_measure hfin (pushCurrent_controls hT hc hf)
    _ = (K : ℝ)^k * mass T := by
      rw [hm]
      simp only [Measure.real, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
        ENNReal.coe_toReal, NNReal.coe_pow, Measure.map_apply hf.continuous.measurable
          MeasurableSet.univ, preimage_univ]

end CurrentOperations
end SharpIntegralFillings

end
