OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Currents.W.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Foundations.boundarySucc_boundarySucc
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Currents.W.text:
lemma boundarySucc_boundarySucc {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X (k + 1 + 1)}
    (hT : IsMetricCurrent T) : boundarySucc (boundarySucc T) = fun _ _ => 0 := by
  funext b π
  by_cases h : Admissible b π
  · rw [boundarySucc, ite_eq_left h]
    have hadm : Admissible (fun _ : X => (1 : ℝ)) (Matrix.vecCons b π) :=
      admissible_vecCons (BoundedLip.const 1) h.1.1 h.2
    rw [boundarySucc, ite_eq_left hadm]
    apply hT.eq_zero_of_const_coord (admissible_vecCons (BoundedLip.const 1)
      ⟨0, LipschitzWith.const 1⟩ hadm.2) 0 1
    intro x
    rfl
  · rw [boundarySucc, ite_eq_right h]

omit [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] in

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.exists_good_inner_ball
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
theorem exists_good_inner_ball (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0,
      IsIntegral (n+1) (innerBallCurrent (n+1) t) ∧
      mass (boundarySucc (innerBallCurrent (n+1) t)) ≤
        ((n:ℝ)+1)*omega (n+1)*(-t)^n := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hG0,hGI,hgood⟩ := innerBall_ae_integral n
  let μ := volume.restrict (Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0)
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ((n:ℝ)+1)*omega (n+1)*(-t)^n
  have hμ : μ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg (fun m : Measure ℝ => m univ) h
    norm_num [μ] at hh
  have hf : Integrable f μ := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc (a := (-1:ℝ)) (b := 0) (by unfold f; fun_prop) |>.mono_set
    exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self
  have hi : (∫ t, G t ∂μ) ≤ ∫ t, f t ∂μ := by
    calc (∫ t, G t ∂μ) ≤ ∫ t, G t :=
        setIntegral_le_integral hG (Eventually.of_forall hG0)
      _ ≤ omega (n+1) := hGI
      _ = ∫ t, f t ∂μ := (integral_radial_area n).symm
  obtain ⟨t,⟨ht,htI,htM⟩,hle⟩ := exists_le_of_integral_le_ae hμ hG.restrict hf hi
    ((ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo).and hgood)
  exact ⟨t,ht,htI,htM.trans hle⟩

end SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.ambientBall
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Model:24.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Admissible
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Model:24.text:
def Admissible {k : ℕ} (b : X → ℝ) (π : Fin k → X → ℝ) : Prop :=
  BoundedLip b ∧ ∀ i, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (π i)

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.innerBall_ae_integral
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
theorem innerBall_ae_integral (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable G ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ G t) ∧
      (∫ t : ℝ, G t) ≤ omega (k+1) ∧
      ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0),
        IsIntegral (k+1) (innerBallCurrent (k+1) t) ∧
        mass (boundarySucc (innerBallCurrent (k+1) t)) ≤ G t := by
  let C := ballChart (k+1)
  have hT := C.action_isMetricCurrent
  have hI := chart_integerRectifiable C
  have hu := radiusFunction_boundedLip (k+1)
  obtain ⟨S,G,hG,hG0,hS,hGI,hact,hweight⟩ := integerRectifiable_scalar_coarea
    hT hI (unitBall_CAT0 (k+1)) (radiusFunction_lipschitz (k+1))
  have hs : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0),
      IsMetricCurrent (S t) ∧ IntegerRectifiable (S t) ∧ mass (S t) ≤ G t :=
    hS.filter_mono (ae_mono Measure.restrict_le_self)
  have htest (b : UnitBall (k+1) → ℝ) (π : Fin k → UnitBall (k+1) → ℝ)
      (hab : Admissible b π) :
      ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0),
        boundarySucc (innerBallCurrent (k+1) t) b π = (-S t) b π := by
    have hh := (ae_tendsto_dprofile_integral (hact b π hab).1).filter_mono
      (ae_mono (Measure.restrict_le_self (s := Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0)))
    filter_upwards [hh, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t ht hti
    have hl := profile_boundary_tendsto hT hu t b π hab
    have he : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        boundarySucc (weightedCurrent (currentMassMeasure hT) hT
          (profile ((n:ℝ≥0)+1) t ∘ radiusFunction (k+1))) b π =
          -(∫ s : ℝ, dprofile ((n:ℝ≥0)+1) t s * S s b π) := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_profile_smooth t hti.2] with n hn
      apply ball_boundary_profile_coarea hact hweight hti.1 _ hab
      simpa only [NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_natCast, NNReal.coe_one] using hn
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hl.congr' he) ht.neg
  have heq : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0),
      boundarySucc (innerBallCurrent (k+1) t) = -S t :=
    Foundations.ae_boundary_eq_of_ae_test_eq _
      (Eventually.of_forall fun t => innerBallCurrent_metric _ t)
      (hs.mono fun t ht => ht.1.neg) htest
  refine ⟨G, hG, hG0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hg : (∫ t : ℝ, G t) ≤ mass C.action := by simpa using hGI
    exact hg.trans (ballChart_mass_le (k+1))
  · filter_upwards [hs,heq] with t ht he
    refine ⟨⟨innerBallCurrent_metric _ t, innerBallCurrent_rectifiable _ t,
      he.symm ▸ ht.1.neg, he.symm ▸ ht.2.1.neg⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [he, mass_neg]
    exact ht.2.2

end SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Model:105.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.CompactlySupported

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.integral_boundary
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma integral_boundary {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X (k+1)} (hT : IsIntegral (k+1) T) :
    IsIntegral k (boundarySucc T) := by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact ⟨hT.2.2.1,hT.2.2.2⟩
  | succ k =>
    refine ⟨hT.2.2.1,hT.2.2.2,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [Foundations.boundarySucc_boundarySucc hT.1]
      exact isMetricCurrent_zero _
    · rw [Foundations.boundarySucc_boundarySucc hT.1]
      exact integerRectifiable_zero _

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Main:49.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.sharp_ball_bound
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Main:49.text:
lemma sharp_ball_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {r m : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hmle : m ≤ sphereArea n*r^n) :
    fillingCoefficient n * m^fillingPower n ≤ omega (n+1)*r^(n+1) := by
  rw [← sharp_ball_identity hn hr.le]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (fillingCoefficient_pos n).le
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow hm hmle
  unfold fillingPower
  positivity

end Optimality

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Model:36.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.IsMetricCurrent
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Model:36.text:
structure IsMetricCurrent {k : ℕ} (T : Functional X k) : Prop where
  offDomain : ∀ b π, ¬Admissible b π → T b π = 0
  linearFirst : ∀ b₁ b₂ π (a c : ℝ), BoundedLip b₁ → BoundedLip b₂ →
    (∀ i, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (π i)) →
    T (fun x => a * b₁ x + c * b₂ x) π = a * T b₁ π + c * T b₂ π
  linearCoord : ∀ b π i f (a c : ℝ), Admissible b π →
    (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K f) →
    T b (Function.update π i (fun x => a * π i x + c * f x)) =
      a * T b π + c * T b (Function.update π i f)
  sequentialContinuity : ∀ b π (πs : ℕ → Fin k → X → ℝ), BoundedLip b →
    (∀ i, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (πs j i)) →
    (∀ i x, Tendsto (fun j => πs j i x) atTop (𝓝 (π i x))) →
    Tendsto (fun j => T b (πs j)) atTop (𝓝 (T b π))
  locality : ∀ b π, Admissible b π →
    (∃ (i : Fin k) (U : Set X) (c : ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ Function.support b ⊆ U ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, π i x = c) → T b π = 0
  finiteMass : ∃ μ : Measure X, IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ Controls T μ

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.clippedCoord_abs_le
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma clippedCoord_abs_le {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) (x : Euc d) : |clippedCoord i x| ≤ 1 := by
  rw [abs_le]
  exact ⟨le_max_left _ _,max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left _ _)⟩

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Currents.B.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.mass_nonneg
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Currents.B.text:
lemma mass_nonneg {k : ℕ} (T : Functional X k) : 0 ≤ mass T := by
  apply Real.sInf_nonneg
  rintro r ⟨μ, _, _, rfl⟩
  exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.integral_radial_area
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma integral_radial_area (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ t in Ioo (-1:ℝ) 0, ((n:ℝ)+1)*omega (n+1)*(-t)^n) = omega (n+1) := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => -omega (n+1)*(-t)^(n+1)
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ((n:ℝ)+1)*omega (n+1)*(-t)^n
  have hc : Continuous f := by unfold f; fun_prop
  have hd (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F (f t) t := by
    have hh := (((hasDerivAt_id t).neg.pow (n+1)).const_mul (-omega (n+1)))
    convert hh using 1 <;> first | rfl | simp only [f, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Pi.neg_apply, id_eq]; ring
  have hh := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun t _ => hd t) (hc.intervalIntegrable (-1) 0)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) ≤ 0)] at hh
  rw [Measure.restrict_congr_set Ioo_ae_eq_Ioc]
  change (∫ t in Ioc (-1:ℝ) 0, f t) = _
  rw [hh]
  simp [F]

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.innerBallCurrent
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.allFillings_mass_ge_ball
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma allFillings_mass_ge_ball (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : -1 < t)
    {S : Functional (Euc (n+1)) (n+1)} (hS : IsMetricCurrent S)
    (hb : boundarySucc S = boundarySucc (ambientBall (n+1) t)) :
    (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Euc (n+1)) (-t))).toReal ≤ mass S := by
  have he := congrArg (fun U : Functional (Euc (n+1)) n =>
    U (clippedCoord 0) (fun i => ambientCoord i.succ)) hb
  rw [ambientBall_boundary_coords n ht] at he
  have had : Admissible (clippedCoord (0 : Fin (n+1))) (fun i => ambientCoord i.succ) :=
    ⟨clippedCoord_boundedLip 0,fun i => ⟨1,ambientCoord_lipschitz i.succ⟩⟩
  rw [boundarySucc,ite_eq_left had] at he
  rw [← he]
  apply (le_abs_self _).trans
  apply abs_apply_le_mass hS (BoundedLip.const 1) (fun _ => by norm_num)
  intro i
  induction i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => exact clippedCoord_lipschitz 0
  | succ i => exact ambientCoord_lipschitz i.succ

lemma clippedCoord_boundedLip {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) : BoundedLip (clippedCoord i) :=

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Model:115.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.sphereArea
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Model:115.text: noncomputable def sphereArea (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n + 1 : ℝ) * omega (n + 1)

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.omega_pos
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Optimality.text:
lemma omega_pos (d : ℕ) : 0 < omega d := by
  exact ENNReal.toReal_pos (Metric.measure_ball_pos volume (0 : Euc d) (by norm_num)).ne'
    Metric.isBounded_ball.measure_lt_top.ne

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Main:29.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.Optimality.sharp_ball_identity
OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Main:29.text:
lemma sharp_ball_identity {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    fillingCoefficient n * (sphereArea n * r^n) ^ fillingPower n = omega (n+1)*r^(n+1) := by
  have hn0 : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  have hp : fillingPower n = 1 + 1/(n:ℝ) := by unfold fillingPower; field_simp
  have hnp : (n:ℝ)*fillingPower n = ((n+1:ℕ):ℝ) := by
    unfold fillingPower
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (sphereArea_pos n).le (pow_nonneg hr _),
    ← Real.rpow_natCast_mul hr, hnp, Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [hp, Real.rpow_add (sphereArea_pos n),Real.rpow_one]
  unfold fillingCoefficient
  have hroot : (sphereArea n)^(1/(n:ℝ)) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (sphereArea_pos n) _).ne'
  have hdn : (n:ℝ)+1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  calc 1 / (((n:ℝ)+1) * (sphereArea n)^(1/(n:ℝ))) *
        (sphereArea n * (sphereArea n)^(1/(n:ℝ)) * r^(n+1)) =
       (sphereArea n / ((n:ℝ)+1))*r^(n+1) := by field_simp
    _ = omega (n+1)*r^(n+1) := by unfold sphereArea; field_simp

OAI.Geometry.IntegralFillings.Model:97.name: OAI.SharpIntegralFillings.IsIntegral

def IsIntegral : (k : ℕ) → Functional X k → Prop

OAI.Combinatorics.FiniteCircle.Main:89.name: OAI.FiniteCircle.uniformUpper_E
OAI.Combinatorics.FiniteCircle.Main:89.text:
theorem uniformUpper_E {C : ℝ} {d₀ : ℕ} (hu : UniformUpper C d₀)
    (α : Type) [Fintype α] (hα : 2≤Fintype.card α) {d : ℕ} (hd : d₀≤d) (hd1 : 1≤d) :
    E α d≤Real.exp (C*exponentScale d) := by
  classical
  let : Nontrivial α := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp hα
  let : Nontrivial (Words α d) := words_nontrivial α hd1
  obtain ⟨M,F,hF⟩ := hu α hα d hd
  let f : Words α d → RealL1 := fun x => finiteL1 M (F x)
  have hb := distortion_upper (fun x : Words α d => x.val) Subtype.val_injective
    f (Real.exp (C*exponentScale d)) 1 (Real.exp_pos _).le
    (fun x y => by simpa only [f,finiteL1_norm_sub] using (hF x y).2)
    (fun x y => by simpa only [f,one_mul,finiteL1_norm_sub] using (hF x y).1)
  exact (optimalDistortion_le (fun x : Words α d => x.val) f hb.1).trans (by simpa only [mul_one] using hb.2)

theorem alphabetSupremum_bounds {d : ℕ} {lo hi : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ A : ℕ, 2≤A → lo≤E (Fin A) d ∧ E (Fin A) d≤hi) :
    lo≤alphabetSupremum d ∧ alphabetSupremum d≤hi := by
  have hne : {r : ℝ | ∃ A : ℕ, 2≤A ∧ r=E (Fin A) d}.Nonempty := ⟨_,2,by norm_num,rfl⟩
  have hub : BddAbove {r : ℝ | ∃ A : ℕ, 2≤A ∧ r=E (Fin A) d} := by
    refine ⟨hi,?_⟩
    rintro r ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩
    exact (hb A hA).2
  refine ⟨(hb 2 (by norm_num)).1.trans (le_csSup hub ⟨2,by norm_num,rfl⟩),?_⟩
  apply csSup_le hne
  rintro r ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩
  exact (hb A hA).2

theorem uniform_upper : ∃ d₀ : ℕ, UniformUpper 32 d₀ := by
  refine ⟨⌈Real.exp 16⌉₊, fun α _ _ d hd => ?_⟩
  have hdexp : Real.exp 16 ≤ (d:ℝ) := (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by exact_mod_cast hd)
  have hlog : 16 ≤ Real.log d := by
    have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 16) hdexp
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using h
  exact uniform_upper_of_log_large hlog

end FiniteCircle

OAI.Combinatorics.FiniteCircle.Main:116.name: OAI.FiniteCircle.full_main
OAI.Combinatorics.FiniteCircle.Main:116.text:
theorem full_main : FullMain := by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := uniform_upper
  let d₀ := max u (lowerCap 1000000)
  have hlow {d : ℕ} (hd : d₀≤d) : lowerCap 1000000≤d := (le_max_right _ _).trans hd
  have hu' : UniformUpper 32 d₀ := by
    intro α _ hα d hd
    exact hu α hα d ((le_max_left _ _).trans hd)
  have hb : ∀ (α : Type) [Fintype α], 2≤Fintype.card α → ∀ d : ℕ, d₀≤d →
      Real.exp ((1/8192)*exponentScale d)≤E α d ∧ E α d≤Real.exp (32*exponentScale d) := by
    intro α _ hα d hd
    have hd1 : 1≤d := by have := lowerCap_ge 1000000; have := hlow hd; omega
    exact ⟨maskWitness_lower_E (both_witnesses (hlow hd)).1 α hα,
      uniformUpper_E hu' α hα hd hd1⟩
  refine ⟨1/8192,32,1/268435456,67108928,1/1048576,1/1048576,d₀,
    by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num,
    two_codes,hu',hb,?_⟩
  intro d hd
  have hw := both_witnesses (hlow hd)
  refine ⟨hw.1,hw.2,?_⟩
  exact alphabetSupremum_bounds (fun A hA => hb (Fin A) (by simpa using hA) d hd)

end FiniteCircle

OAI.Combinatorics.FiniteCircle.Main:82.name: OAI.FiniteCircle.maskWitness_lower_E

theorem maskWitness_lower_E {a C δ c : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (hw : MaskWitness a C δ c d)

  apply hD.trans (setDistortion_le_E α hα _)
  rintro x ⟨v,rfl⟩
  exact (hlen v).le.trans hnd

  apply le_antisymm

def principal (alg : Algebra Carrier) (left right : Carrier) : Congruence alg :=
  ⟨⟨fun first second => ∀ rel : Congruence alg, rel left right → rel first second,
     ⟨fun point rel _ => rel.refl point,
       fun related rel contains => rel.symm (related rel contains),
       fun first second rel contains => rel.trans (first rel contains) (second rel contains)⟩⟩,
   by
    intro index first second related rel contains
    exact rel.compatible index first second (fun coord => related coord rel contains)⟩

theorem principalColor_reflect (equiv : Lat ≃o Congruence alg) (lower upper : Lat)
    (notBelow : ¬ lower ≤ upper) :
    ∃ left right, principalColor equiv left right ≤ lower ∧
      ¬ principalColor equiv left right ≤ upper := by
  classical
  by_contra noPair
  apply notBelow
  apply equiv.le_iff_le.mp
  intro left right related
  by_contra notRelated
  exact noPair ⟨left, right, (principalColor_le equiv).mpr related,

OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:38.name: OAI.FiniteCongruence.IsGraphWitness
OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:38.text:
def IsGraphWitness {Lat Carrier : Type} [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat]
    (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat) : Prop :=
  (∀ left right, color left right = color right left) ∧
  (∀ left right, color left right = ⊥ ↔ left = right) ∧
  (∀ left right middle, color left right ≤ color left middle ⊔ color middle right) ∧
  (∀ lower upper : Lat, ¬ lower ≤ upper →
    ∃ left right, color left right ≤ lower ∧ ¬ color left right ≤ upper) ∧
  (∀ seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier), seeds.Nonempty → ∀ left right,
    color left right ≤ seeds.sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2) →
      Connected color seeds left right)

        ((labelCongruence_le_iff color witness upper lower).mp equal.ge),

OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:210.name: OAI.FiniteCongruence.labelCongruence
OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:210.text:
noncomputable def labelCongruence (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (witness : IsGraphWitness color) (bound : Lat) : Congruence (graphAlgebra color) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨⟨fun left right => color left right ≤ bound, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro point
    rw [(witness.2.1 point point).mpr rfl]
    exact bot_le
  · intro left right below
    rwa [witness.1 right left]
  · intro left middle right first second
    exact (witness.2.2.1 left right middle).trans (sup_le first second)
  · intro index left right below
    exact ((((Fintype.equivFin
      {placement : Carrier → Carrier // Admissible color placement}).symm index).2) _ _).trans
        (below ⟨0, by change 0 < 1; decide⟩)

theorem principalColor_triangle (equiv : Lat ≃o Congruence alg) (left right middle : Carrier) :
    principalColor equiv left right ≤
      principalColor equiv left middle ⊔ principalColor equiv middle right := by
  apply (principalColor_le equiv).mpr
  apply (equiv _).trans
  · exact (principalColor_le equiv).mp le_sup_left
  · exact (principalColor_le equiv).mp le_sup_right

OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:230.name: OAI.FiniteCongruence.labelCongruence_le_iff
OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:230.text:
theorem labelCongruence_le_iff (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (witness : IsGraphWitness color) (lower upper : Lat) :
    labelCongruence color witness lower ≤ labelCongruence color witness upper ↔ lower ≤ upper := by
  constructor
  · intro below
    by_contra notBelow
    obtain ⟨left, right, belowLower, notBelowUpper⟩ := witness.2.2.2.1 lower upper notBelow
    exact notBelowUpper (below belowLower)
  · intro below left right belowLower
    exact belowLower.trans below

omit [OrderBot Lat] in

theorem graph_criterion (Lat : Type) [Fintype Lat] [Lattice Lat] [OrderBot Lat] :
    Representable Lat ↔ HasGraphWitness Lat := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨size, positive, alg, ⟨equiv⟩⟩
    exact ⟨size, positive, principalColor equiv, principalColor_isGraphWitness equiv⟩
  · rintro ⟨size, positive, color, witness⟩
    have : Nonempty (Fin size) := ⟨⟨0, positive⟩⟩
    exact ⟨size, positive, graphAlgebra color, ⟨graphOrderIso color witness⟩⟩

OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:256.name: OAI.FiniteCongruence.labelCongruence_surjective
OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:256.text:
theorem labelCongruence_surjective [Nonempty Carrier] (color : Carrier → Carrier → Lat)
    (witness : IsGraphWitness color) : Function.Surjective (labelCongruence color witness) := by
  classical
  intro rel
  let seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier) := Finset.univ.filter (fun edge => rel edge.1 edge.2)
  have membership : ∀ edge, edge ∈ seeds ↔ rel edge.1 edge.2 := by simp [seeds]
  have nonempty : seeds.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨point⟩ := ‹Nonempty Carrier›
    exact ⟨(point, point), (membership _).mpr (rel.refl point)⟩
  refine ⟨seeds.sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2), ?_⟩
  apply Congruence.ext
  intro left right
  constructor
  · intro below
    exact connected_below_congruence color rel seeds (fun edge member => (membership edge).mp member)
      (witness.2.2.2.2 seeds nonempty left right below)
  · intro related
    change color left right ≤ seeds.sup (fun edge => color edge.1 edge.2)
    exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun edge : Carrier × Carrier => color edge.1 edge.2)
      ((membership (left, right)).mpr related)

OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:154.name: OAI.FiniteCongruence.principalColor_connected
OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:154.text:
theorem principalColor_connected (equiv : Lat ≃o Congruence alg)
    (seeds : Finset (Carrier × Carrier)) (left right : Carrier)
    (below : principalColor equiv left right ≤
      seeds.sup (fun edge => principalColor equiv edge.1 edge.2)) :
    Connected (principalColor equiv) seeds left right := by
  have supBelow : seeds.sup (fun edge => principalColor equiv edge.1 edge.2) ≤
      equiv.symm (pathCongruence equiv seeds) := by
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro edge member
    change equiv.symm (Congruence.principal alg edge.1 edge.2) ≤
      equiv.symm (pathCongruence equiv seeds)
    apply equiv.symm.monotone
    apply Congruence.principal_le.mpr
    exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨id, admissible_id _, edge, member, rfl, rfl⟩
  have principalBelow : Congruence.principal alg left right ≤ pathCongruence equiv seeds :=
    equiv.symm.le_iff_le.mp (below.trans supBelow)
  exact Congruence.principal_le.mp principalBelow

OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:172.name: OAI.FiniteCongruence.principalColor_isGraphWitness
OAI.Algebra.Universal.GraphCriterion:172.text:
theorem principalColor_isGraphWitness (equiv : Lat ≃o Congruence alg) :
    IsGraphWitness (principalColor equiv) := by
  refine ⟨?_, principalColor_eq_bot equiv, principalColor_triangle equiv,
    principalColor_reflect equiv, ?_⟩
  · intro left right
    simp only [principalColor, Congruence.principal_comm left right]
  · intro seeds _ left right below
    exact principalColor_connected equiv seeds left right below

theorem main :
    ∃ (H : Type) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup H) (_ : InnerProductSpace ℂ H)
      (_ : CompleteSpace H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (τ : TracialVector M)
      (n : ℕ) (X S : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H),
      2 ≤ n ∧
      (∀ i, X i ∈ M ∧ IsSelfAdjoint (X i)) ∧
      (∀ i, S i ∈ M ∧ IsSelfAdjoint (S i)) ∧
      FreeStandardNoise τ X S ∧
      (⊥ : EReal) < chi τ X ∧
      chi τ X ≤ chiStar τ X S - (1 / 2 : EReal) ∧
      chiStar τ X S - (1 / 2 : EReal) < (⊤ : EReal) := by
  obtain ⟨δ,Δ,hδ,hΔ,hδΔ,hsep,hq⟩ := exists_spectral_parameters chosenP_ge_two
  obtain ⟨h,hh0,hh1,hh⟩ := exists_small_h_spectralGood chosenP_ge_two hδ hΔ
  refine ⟨Model.H chosenP,inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,Model.M chosenP,
    Model.τ chosenP,chosenP+1,Model.X chosenP h,Model.auxiliaryNoise chosenP,
    by have := chosenP_ge_two; omega,
    (fun i => ⟨Model.X_mem chosenP h i,Model.X_selfAdjoint chosenP h i⟩),
    (fun i => ⟨Model.auxiliaryNoise_mem chosenP i,Model.auxiliaryNoise_selfAdjoint chosenP i⟩),
    Model.auxiliaryNoise_free chosenP h,Model.chi_gt_bot chosenP chosenP_ge_two hh0,
    chosen_chi_bound hh0 hh1 hδ hΔ hδΔ hsep hq hh,?_⟩
  rw [Model.chiStar_tail_formula chosenP chosenP_ge_two h hh0]
  change ((Model.gaussianEntropy chosenP h-(1/2:ℝ)*(∫u in Set.Ioi h,Model.fisherDeficit chosenP u):ℝ):EReal)-(((1/2:ℝ):ℝ):EReal)<⊤
  rw [← EReal.coe_sub]

OAI.Analysis.FiniteFactor.CrossedProduct.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.sourceProjectionEvent_eventually_positive
OAI.Analysis.FiniteFactor.CrossedProduct.text:
theorem sourceProjectionEvent_eventually_positive
    (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ) (hr : SourceRationalIndependent θ)
    {p : SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate →L[ℂ] SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate}
    (hp : p ∈ sourceAlgebra θ) (hproj : IsStarProjection p) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hp1 : p ≠ 1)
    (hinv : (1-p)*sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg*p = 0) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, Real.exp (-82)/2 ≤ (sourceBiasedLaw j).real (sourceProjectionEvent p j) := by
  have hdiag := sourceProjection_strict_diagonal θ hθ hr hp hproj hp0 hp1 hinv
  have hm : Measurable (fun x => (sourceCentralCoefficient p x).re) :=
    Complex.continuous_re.measurable.comp (sourceCentralCoefficient_measurable p)
  have hpos0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂sourceBaseMeasure, 0 < (sourceCentralCoefficient p x).re :=
    hdiag.mono fun _ h => h.1
  have hpos1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂sourceBaseMeasure, 0 < 1-(sourceCentralCoefficient p x).re :=
    hdiag.mono fun _ h => sub_pos.mpr h.2.1
  have ht0 : Tendsto (fun j => (sourceBiasedLaw j).real (sourceDiagonalLossSet p j false)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    sourceBiased_positive_endpoint_loss _ hm hpos0 false
  have ht1 : Tendsto (fun j => (sourceBiasedLaw j).real (sourceDiagonalLossSet p j true)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    sourceBiased_positive_endpoint_loss _ (measurable_const.sub hm) hpos1 true
  have ht := (sourceFutureBoundary_loss_tendsto.add ht0).add ht1
  simp only [zero_add] at ht
  have he := ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (half_pos (Real.exp_pos (-82))))
  filter_upwards [he] with j hj
  have hh := sourceProjectionEvent_mass_losses p j
  linarith

end

structure SourceOrderedTorusSampling (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) : Prop where
  weak : ∀ (I : Finset SourceCoordinate) (f : C(SourceSamplingTorus,ℝ)),
    Tendsto (fun s => ∫ p, f p ∂(sourceSamplingTrimmedTorus I s θ : Measure SourceSamplingTorus))
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ p, f p ∂(sourceSamplingLambdaTorus I : Measure SourceSamplingTorus)))
  support : ∀ (I : Finset SourceCoordinate) (s : ℕ),
    ∀ᵐ p ∂(sourceSamplingTrimmedTorus I s θ : Measure SourceSamplingTorus),
      (∀ i, sourceTorusRepresentative p.1 i ≤ sourceTorusRepresentative p.2 i) ∧
      ∃ n ∈ sourceSamplingPowers s, 0 < n ∧ p.2 = sourceTorusRotate θ n p.1
  marginals : ∀ (I : Finset SourceCoordinate) (r : Bool), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ s,
    ∃ g : SourceTorus → ℝ, Measurable g ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ g z) ∧
      (sourceSamplingTrimmedTorus I s θ : Measure SourceSamplingTorus).map (sourceTorusEndpoint r) =
        sourceTorusHaar.withDensity (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (g z)) ∧
      MemLp g 2 sourceTorusHaar ∧ (∫ z, g z^2 ∂sourceTorusHaar) ≤ C
  positive : ∀ I : Finset SourceCoordinate, ∀ᶠ s in atTop,
    0 < ((sourceSamplingTrimmedTorus I s θ : Measure SourceSamplingTorus) Set.univ).toReal

OAI.Analysis.FiniteFactor.CrossedProduct.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.sourceProjectionEvent_mass_upper
OAI.Analysis.FiniteFactor.CrossedProduct.text:
theorem sourceProjectionEvent_mass_upper (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ)
    (hs : SourceOrderedTorusSampling θ)
    {p : SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate →L[ℂ] SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate}
    (hp : p ∈ sourceAlgebra θ) (hproj : IsStarProjection p)
    (hinv : (1-p)*sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg*p = 0)
    (j : ℕ) (hphase : SourceSecondPhasesFrom θ j) :
    (sourceBiasedLaw j).real (sourceProjectionEvent p j) ≤ 1/((j : ℝ)+1) := by
  let K := (sourceStageState j).K
  let A := fun ω => sourceProjectionLeftCoefficient θ p (sourceBiasedEndpoint (fun _ => false) ω)
  let B := fun ω => sourceProjectionRightCoefficient θ p (sourceBiasedEndpoint (fun _ => true) ω)
  let Mass := fun ω => coefficientMass K (A ω) (B ω)
  have hi : Integrable Mass (sourceBiasedLaw j) := by
    dsimp only [Mass,coefficientMass]
    exact integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range (2*K+1)) (fun n _ =>
      (sourceTruncatedCoefficient_integrable θ hθ hs hp hproj hinv j n).norm)
  have hlow : (sourceStage j).ε * (sourceBiasedLaw j).real (sourceProjectionEvent p j) ≤
      ∫ ω in sourceProjectionEvent p j, Mass ω ∂sourceBiasedLaw j := by
    have hh := setIntegral_mono_on_ae (integrable_const (sourceStage j).ε) hi.integrableOn
      (sourceProjectionEvent_measurable p j) (sourceProjectionEvent_polynomial_lower θ hθ hp hproj j)
    simpa only [setIntegral_const,smul_eq_mul,mul_comm] using hh
  have hu := coefficientMass_integral_upper K A B (E := sourceProjectionEvent p j)
    (μ := sourceBiasedLaw j)
    (a := Real.exp (-(sourceStage j).L)+2*Real.exp (-(sourceStage j).L/800))
    (fun n _ => (sourceTruncatedCoefficient_integrable θ hθ hs hp hproj hinv j n).norm.integrableOn)
    (fun n _ => sourceProjectionEvent_coefficient_expectation θ hθ hs hp hproj hinv j hphase n)
  have hupper := hu.trans (sourceStage_error_budget j)
  have hh : (sourceStage j).ε * (sourceBiasedLaw j).real (sourceProjectionEvent p j) ≤
      (sourceStage j).ε * (1/((j : ℝ)+1)) := by
    calc
      (sourceStage j).ε * (sourceBiasedLaw j).real (sourceProjectionEvent p j) ≤
          (sourceStage j).ε/((j : ℝ)+1) := hlow.trans hupper
      _ = (sourceStage j).ε * (1/((j : ℝ)+1)) := by ring
  nlinarith [(sourceStage j).ε_pos]

end
end FiniteFactor

  toStarSubalgebra := StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ (StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ S)

      StarSubalgebra.coe_centralizer_centralizer ℂ S

    simp

theorem exists_source_prepared_ergodic : ∃ θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ,
    SourceRationalIndependent θ ∧
    (∃ j : ℕ, SourceSecondPhasesFrom θ j) ∧
    SourceOrderedTorusSampling θ ∧
    Ergodic (coordinateRotate θ 1) sourceBaseMeasure ∧
    HasScalarCenter (sourceAlgebra θ) ∧
    IsFiniteAlgebra (sourceAlgebra θ) ∧
    HasSeparablePredual (sourceAlgebra θ) ∧
    ∃ hθ : SourceAngles θ,
      let T := sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg
      T ∈ sourceAlgebra θ ∧ T ≠ 0 ∧ Function.Injective T ∧ ‖T‖ ≤ 1 ∧
        Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖T^n‖^(1/(n : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨θ,hr,hphase,hs,_hm,_hfree,hfinite,_htrace,hT⟩ := exists_source_prepared_finite
  exact ⟨θ,hr,hphase,hs,coordinateRotate_ergodic θ hr,sourceAlgebra_hasScalarCenter θ hr,
    hfinite,sourceAlgebra_hasSeparablePredual θ,hT⟩

end

theorem sourceAlgebra_hasNoMinimalProjection (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) :
    HasNoMinimalProjection (sourceAlgebra θ) := by
  intro p hp hproj hp0
  let p' : (sourceAlgebra θ).toStarSubalgebra := ⟨p,hp⟩
  obtain ⟨q,hqs,hqi,hq0,hqne,hqp⟩ :=
    Nonhyperlinear.Diffuseness.no_minimal_projection_of_small_partitions
      (sourceAlgebra θ) sourceVacuum
      (fun A B => sourceVacuumFunctional_tracial θ A.property B.property)
      (fun A hz => Subtype.ext (sourceVacuum_separating θ A.property hz))
      (sourceAlgebra_small_trace_partitions θ)
      p' (Subtype.ext hproj.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq) (Subtype.ext hproj.isIdempotentElem)
      (fun hz => hp0 (congrArg Subtype.val hz))
  refine ⟨q,q.property,⟨congrArg Subtype.val hqi,congrArg Subtype.val hqs⟩,?_,?_,congrArg Subtype.val hqp⟩
  · exact fun hz => hq0 (Subtype.ext hz)
  · exact fun hz => hqne (Subtype.ext hz)

end

OAI.Analysis.FiniteFactor.CrossedProduct.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.SourceAngles
OAI.FiniteFactor.sourceInvariantProjection_trivial
OAI.Analysis.FiniteFactor.CrossedProduct.text:
theorem sourceInvariantProjection_trivial
    (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ) (hr : SourceRationalIndependent θ)
    (hs : SourceOrderedTorusSampling θ) (hphase : ∃ J, SourceSecondPhasesFrom θ J)
    {p : SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate →L[ℂ] SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate}
    (hp : p ∈ sourceAlgebra θ) (hproj : IsStarProjection p)
    (hinv : (1-p)*sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg*p = 0) :
    p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · exact Or.inl hp0
  by_cases hp1 : p = 1
  · exact Or.inr hp1
  exfalso
  have hlow := sourceProjectionEvent_eventually_positive θ hθ hr hp hproj hp0 hp1 hinv
  obtain ⟨J,hJ⟩ := hphase
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, Real.exp (-82)/2 ≤ 1/((j : ℝ)+1) := by
    filter_upwards [hlow,eventually_ge_atTop J] with j hj hJj
    have hphasej : SourceSecondPhasesFrom θ j := fun s hjs => hJ s (hJj.trans hjs)
    exact hj.trans (sourceProjectionEvent_mass_upper θ hθ hs hp hproj hinv j hphasej)
  have hzero : Real.exp (-82)/2 ≤ 0 :=
    ge_of_tendsto (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)) hbound
  exact (not_le_of_gt (half_pos (Real.exp_pos (-82)))) hzero

end
end FiniteFactor

theorem littleFinitisticDimension_eq_top_of_two_mul_bounds
    (h : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} A, Module.Finite A M ∧
      projectiveDimension M < ⊤ ∧ ((2*m-2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ projectiveDimension M) :

  apply littleFinitisticDimension_eq_top_of_unbounded
  intro n
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hfinite,hm⟩ := h (n+1) (by omega)
  refine ⟨M,hM,hfinite,le_trans ?_ hm⟩
  exact_mod_cast (show n ≤ 2*(n+1)-2 by omega)

  let Λ := AsymmetryConstruction.Lambda SelectedBasic.augmentationC

OAI.Algebra.FinitisticAsymmetry.Triangul.name: OAI.LittleFinitistic.CummingsConstruction.injectivesGenerate
OAI.Algebra.FinitisticAsymmetry.Triangul.text:
lemma injectivesGenerate [Fintype ι] (hχ : Function.Surjective χ)
    (hnil : ∃ n : ℕ, (RingHom.ker χ.toRingHom)^n = ⊥) :
    InjectivesGenerate (T χ) := by
  classical
  let := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (T χ))
  intro P hP hT hcop hI X
  let := hP
  let := hT
  let (I : Type u) := hcop I
  let : P.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) :=
    ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape.of_equivalence
      (Discrete.equivalence (Equiv.ulift : ULift.{u} ℕ ≃ ℕ))
  apply DerivedSupport.localizing_eq_top_of_all_modules P
  · intro M
    apply DerivedSupport.prop_all_of_product_augmentation P hcop
      (augmentation χ).toRingHom (augmentation_surjective χ hχ)
      (augmentation_ker_nilpotent χ hnil) _ M
    intro j
    cases j with
    | inl i => exact oldSimple_mem χ i P hI
    | inr i => exact newSimple_mem χ i P hI

end LittleFinitistic.CummingsConstruction

end

OAI.Algebra.FinitisticAsymmetry.Asymmetr.name: OAI.LittleFinitistic.AsymmetryConstruction.all_clauses
OAI.Algebra.FinitisticAsymmetry.Asymmetr.text:
lemma all_clauses
    (hχ : Function.Surjective χ)
    (hnil : ∃ n : ℕ, (RingHom.ker χ.toRingHom)^n = ⊥)
    (hA : littleFinitisticDimension A = ⊤) :
    FiniteDimensional k (Lambda χ) ∧
      littleFinitisticDimension (Lambda χ) = ⊤ ∧
      bigFinitisticDimension (Lambda χ) = ⊤ ∧
      littleFinitisticDimension (Lambda χ)ᵐᵒᵖ = 0 ∧
      bigFinitisticDimension (Lambda χ)ᵐᵒᵖ = 0 ∧
      ¬ InjectivesGenerate (Lambda χ) ∧ InjectivesGenerate (Lambda χ)ᵐᵒᵖ := by
  classical
  let eA := ModuleCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.opOp A)
  have hinf : littleFinitisticDimension (Lambda χ) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hA, ← littleFinitisticDimension_equivalence eA]
    exact TriangularConstruction.right_little_lower_bound _ _ _
  have hbig : bigFinitisticDimension (Lambda χ) = ⊤ :=
    top_unique (hinf ▸ littleFinitisticDimension_le_big (Lambda χ))
  let eT := ModuleCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv
    (RingEquiv.opOp (CummingsConstruction.T χ))
  obtain ⟨hlz, hbz⟩ := CummingsConstruction.left_dimensions_zero χ hχ hnil
  have hlz' : littleFinitisticDimension (Lambda χ)ᵐᵒᵖ = 0 :=
    (littleFinitisticDimension_equivalence eT).trans hlz
  have hbz' : bigFinitisticDimension (Lambda χ)ᵐᵒᵖ = 0 :=
    (bigFinitisticDimension_equivalence eT).trans hbz
  refine ⟨inferInstance, hinf, hbig, hlz', hbz', ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Rickard.not_injectivesGenerate_of_little_eq_top k hinf
  · exact (injectivesGenerate_equivalence eT).mpr
      (CummingsConstruction.injectivesGenerate χ hχ hnil)
end LittleFinitistic.AsymmetryConstruction

end

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:37.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.limitingCenter_bounds
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:37.text:
theorem limitingCenter_bounds (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    lowerCenterBound ≤ limitingCenter k ∧ limitingCenter k ≤ (2 : ℝ)^k + 1 := by
  have ht := center_tendsto k hk
  have hb := center_bounds_eventually k hk
  exact ⟨ge_of_tendsto ht (hb.mono (fun _ h => h.1)), le_of_tendsto ht (hb.mono (fun _ h => h.2))⟩

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.CenterComparis.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.densityWindow
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.CenterComparis.text: def densityWindow (n k : ℕ) : ℝ := (n : ℝ)^(-delta k)

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Concentration:.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.concentrationError
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Concentration:.text: def concentrationError (n k : ℕ) : ℝ := varianceConstant k * (n : ℝ) ^ (-eta k)

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:60.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.subcritical_limit
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:60.text:
theorem subcritical_limit (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : c < limitingCenter k) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => properSATProbability n k ⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
  have hcL : c ≤ capMultiplier k := (hc.trans (limitingCenter_lt_cap k hk)).le
  have hcenter : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => center n k - densityWindow n k)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (limitingCenter k)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using (center_tendsto k hk).sub (densityWindow_tendsto k hk)
  have hmargin := hcenter.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hc)
  have hlower : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      1 - concentrationError n k ≤ properSATProbability n k ⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊ := by
    filter_upwards [hmargin, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (k + 1)] with n hmargin hn
    apply properSATProbability_center_lower hk hn (floor_density_le_cap hc0 hcL)
    have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
    have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn0
    rw [fluctuationWindow_eq_mul hn0]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmargin.le hn'.le
    have hf := Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hc0 hn'.le)
    nlinarith
  have hlowT : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 - concentrationError n k) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using (concentrationError_tendsto k hk).const_sub 1
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hlowT tendsto_const_nhds hlower
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => properSATProbability_le_one n k _)

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Concentration:.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.properSATProbability_center_lower
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Concentration:.text:
theorem properSATProbability_center_lower {n k m : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hn : k + 1 ≤ n)
    (hm : m ≤ mainCap n k)
    (hgap : (m : ℝ) + fluctuationWindow n k ≤ (n : ℝ) * center n k) :
    1 - concentrationError n k ≤ properSATProbability n k m := by
  let : Nonempty (ProperClause n k) := nonempty_properClause (by omega)
  rw [properSATProbability_eq_lifetime_tail (by omega) hm]
  have h := uniformProbability_mono (p := fun F : Formula n k (mainCap n k) =>
    ¬ (m : ℝ) ≤ lifetime k (mainCap n k) Finset.univ F)
    (q := fun F => fluctuationWindow n k ≤
      |lifetime k (mainCap n k) Finset.univ F - (n : ℝ) * center n k|) (fun F hF => by
        have hh : lifetime k (mainCap n k) Finset.univ F < m := lt_of_not_ge hF
        exact le_trans (by linarith) (neg_le_abs _))
  rw [uniformProbability_not] at h
  linarith [concentration_capped hk hn]

end


end FixedClauseThreshold

end OAI

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:43.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.limitingCenter_pos
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:43.text:
theorem limitingCenter_pos (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) : 0 < limitingCenter k :=
  lowerCenterBound_pos.trans_le (limitingCenter_bounds k hk).1

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:53.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.floor_density_le_cap
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:53.text:
theorem floor_density_le_cap {n k : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hcL : c ≤ capMultiplier k) :
    ⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊ ≤ mainCap n k := by
  have h := (Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hc0 (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n))).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcL (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n))
  exact_mod_cast (show (⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (mainCap n k : ℝ) by
    simpa only [mainCap, Nat.cast_mul] using h)

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.CenterComparis.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.concentrationError_tendsto
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.CenterComparis.text:
theorem concentrationError_tendsto (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => concentrationError n k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  have hη : 0 < eta k := by rw [eta_eq_twice_delta]; positivity [delta_pos hk]
  have ht := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hη).comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  simpa only [concentrationError, Function.comp_apply, mul_zero] using ht.const_mul (varianceConstant k)

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:19.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.limitingCenter
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:19.text: def limitingCenter (k : ℕ) : ℝ := Filter.limsup (fun n : ℕ => center n k) Filter.atTop

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.CenterComparis.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.densityWindow_tendsto
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.CenterComparis.text:
theorem densityWindow_tendsto (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => densityWindow n k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
  (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (delta_pos hk)).comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:46.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.limitingCenter_lt_cap
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:46.text:
theorem limitingCenter_lt_cap (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) : limitingCenter k < capMultiplier k := by
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) < 2^k := one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  have he : (capMultiplier k : ℝ) = 2^k * 2 := by simp [capMultiplier, pow_succ]
  rw [he]
  have h := (limitingCenter_bounds k hk).2
  linarith

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:122.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.main
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:122.text:
theorem main (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) : HasLimitingThreshold k := by
  refine ⟨limitingCenter k, limitingCenter_pos k hk, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c hc0 hc
    exact subcritical_limit k hk c hc0 hc
  · intro c hc
    exact supercritical_limit k hk c hc

end


end FixedClauseThreshold

end OAI

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:21.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.center_tendsto
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:21.text:
theorem center_tendsto (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => center n k) Filter.atTop (nhds (limitingCenter k)) := by
  have hb := center_bounds_eventually k hk
  have hUpper : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ => center n k) :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le (hb.mono (fun _ h => h.2))
  have hLower : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ => center n k) :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_ge (hb.mono (fun _ h => h.1))
  apply summable_min_convergence (fun n => center n k) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)
    (delta_pos hk) hUpper hLower
  obtain ⟨N, hadd, hnext⟩ := center_comparisons k hk
  refine ⟨N, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r hr s hs
    simpa only [densityWindow, Nat.cast_min] using hadd r hr s hs
  · intro s hs
    exact hnext s hs

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.CenterComparis.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.fluctuationWindow_eq_mul
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.CenterComparis.text:
theorem fluctuationWindow_eq_mul {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    fluctuationWindow n k = (n : ℝ) * densityWindow n k := by
  unfold fluctuationWindow densityWindow
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.rpow_add (by exact_mod_cast hn), Real.rpow_one]

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:109.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.supercritical_limit
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:109.text:
theorem supercritical_limit (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : limitingCenter k < c) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => properSATProbability n k ⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  let d := min c (capMultiplier k : ℝ)
  have hd : limitingCenter k < d := lt_min hc (limitingCenter_lt_cap k hk)
  have hdL : d ≤ capMultiplier k := min_le_right _ _
  have ht := supercritical_limit_below_cap k hk d hd hdL
  apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => properSATProbability_nonneg n k _) _ ht
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop k] with n hn
  apply properSATProbability_antitone hn
  exact Nat.floor_mono (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left c (capMultiplier k : ℝ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg n))

OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:84.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.supercritical_limit_below_cap
OAI.Probability.RandomSAT.Main:84.text:
theorem supercritical_limit_below_cap (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : limitingCenter k < c) (hcL : c ≤ capMultiplier k) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => properSATProbability n k ⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := ((limitingCenter_pos k hk).trans hc).le
  have hd : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * densityWindow n k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using (densityWindow_tendsto k hk).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
  have hcenter : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => center n k + 2 * densityWindow n k)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (limitingCenter k)) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using (center_tendsto k hk).add hd
  have hmargin := hcenter.eventually_lt_const hc
  have hupper : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      properSATProbability n k ⌊c * (n : ℝ)⌋₊ ≤ concentrationError n k := by
    filter_upwards [hmargin, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (k + 1)] with n hmargin hn
    apply properSATProbability_center_upper hk hn (floor_density_le_cap hc0 hcL)
    have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
    have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn0
    have hw := fluctuationWindow_one_le (n := n) hk hn0
    have he := fluctuationWindow_eq_mul (k := k) hn0
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmargin.le hn'.le
    have hf := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (c * (n : ℝ))
    nlinarith
  exact squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => properSATProbability_nonneg n k _)
    hupper (concentrationError_tendsto k hk)

OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.Main:16.name: OAI.ForestSpace.main_theorem
OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.Main:16.text:
theorem main_theorem :
    (¬FiniteDimensional ℝ (FullDual Vertex)) ∧
    TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (FullDual Vertex) ∧
    Reflexive (FullDual Vertex) ∧
    (∀ (α β : ℝ) (R : EquivalentNorm (FullDual Vertex) α β), ¬IsAUC R.N) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      Real.sqrt (1+t^2/12)-1 ≤ averageModulus (FullDual Vertex) norm t) ∧
    (∀ (k : ℕ) (f : (Diamond.diamond k).V → FullDual Vertex) (C : ℝ),
      Diamond.EmbeddingBound k f C → Real.sqrt (1+(k:ℝ)/12) ≤ C) := by
  exact ⟨infiniteDimensional_main_fullDual, separable_main_fullDual,
    reflexive_main_fullDual, fun _ _ R => main_no_equivalent_AUC R,
    main_average_modulus, main_diamond_distortion⟩

OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.Distortion:139.name: OAI.ForestSpace.Diamond.EmbeddingBound

OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.FullDual:132.name: OAI.ForestSpace.main_average_modulus
OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.FullDual:132.text:
theorem main_average_modulus (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Real.sqrt (1+t^2/12)-1 ≤ averageModulus (FullDual Vertex) norm t := by
  apply averageModulus_lower_of_subspaces infiniteDimensional_main_fullDual ht.le
  intro x hx ε hε
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hclose⟩ := exists_main_head_approx x (ε/4) (by positivity)
  let F : Cofinite (FullDual Vertex) := ⟨(mainFiniteCoordinates H).toLinearMap.ker,
    (mainFiniteCoordinates H).isClosed_ker, mainFiniteCoordinates_kernel_finite H⟩
  refine ⟨F,?_⟩
  intro y hy hyn
  have he : Q (H : Set Vertex) hH y = y := by
    rw [Q_eq_sub,main_P_eq_zero_of_mem_ker H hH hy,sub_zero]
  have hy' : Annihilates y (H : Set Vertex) := by
    rw [← he]
    exact annihilates_Q _ _ _
  have hpair := paired_estimate Vertex.forestOrder Vertex.finiteAncestors (H : Set Vertex) hH
    (P (H : Set Vertex) hH x) (t • y) (annihilates_P _ _ _) (hy'.smul t)
  rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.le,hyn,mul_one] at hpair
  have hh := pair_perturbation x (P (H : Set Vertex) hH x) (t • y)
    (t^2/12) (by positivity) hx hpair
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.FullDual:122.name: OAI.ForestSpace.main_P_eq_zero_of_mem_ker
OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.FullDual:122.text:
theorem main_P_eq_zero_of_mem_ker (H : Finset Vertex) (hH : IsLowerSet (H : Set Vertex))
    {y : FullDual Vertex} (hy : y ∈ (mainFiniteCoordinates H).toLinearMap.ker) :
    P (H : Set Vertex) hH y = 0 := by
  have hh : mainFiniteCoordinates H y = 0 := hy
  rw [P_finite_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro v hv
  have hz : y (e v) = 0 := congrFun hh ⟨v,hv⟩
  rw [hz,zero_smul]

OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.Distortion:143.name: OAI.ForestSpace.Diamond.distortion_lower
OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.Distortion:143.text:
theorem distortion_lower (hLens : LensProperty E) (k : ℕ)
    (f : (diamond k).V → E) (C : ℝ) (hf : EmbeddingBound k f C) :
    Real.sqrt (1+(k:ℝ)/12) ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hf⟩ := hf
  let g : (diamond k).V → E := fun v => s⁻¹ • f v
  have hgn : ∀ u v, ‖g u-g v‖ = ‖f u-f v‖/s := by
    intro u v
    dsimp [g]
    rw [← smul_sub,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hs.le)]
    ring
  have hl : ∀ u v, ((base.iterate k).graph.dist u v : ℝ) ≤ ‖g u-g v‖ := by
    intro u v
    rw [hgn]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hs).mpr (by simpa only [distance,mul_comm] using (hf u v).1)
  have hu : ∀ u v, ‖g u-g v‖ ≤ C*((base.iterate k).graph.dist u v : ℝ) := by
    intro u v
    rw [hgn]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hs).mpr (by simpa only [distance,mul_assoc,mul_comm,mul_left_comm] using (hf u v).2)
  let a := base.old k (base.left ())
  let b := base.old k (base.right ())
  have hd : ((base.iterate k).graph.dist a b : ℝ) = (2:ℝ)^k := by
    exact_mod_cast (base.old_edge_dist base_connected k ())
  have hc : 1 ≤ C := by
    have hlo := hl a b
    have hup := hu a b
    rw [hd] at hlo hup
    have hpow : 0 < (2:ℝ)^k := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
    nlinarith
  have hbound := edge_sq_loss hLens base base_connected k g C (by linarith) hl hu ()
  have hlo : 1 ≤ ‖g b-g a‖/(2:ℝ)^k := by
    have hh := hl a b
    rw [hd,norm_sub_rev] at hh
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) k)).mpr (by simpa using hh)
  change (‖g b-g a‖/(2:ℝ)^k)^2+(k:ℝ)/12 ≤ C^2 at hbound
  apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
  exact ⟨by linarith,by nlinarith⟩

end Distortion

end
end Diamond

OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.FullDual:153.name: OAI.ForestSpace.main_auc_modulus_zero
OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.FullDual:153.text:
theorem main_auc_modulus_zero {α β : ℝ} (R : EquivalentNorm (FullDual Vertex) α β) :
    aucModulus (FullDual Vertex) R.N (α/(2*β)) = 0 := by
  apply R.bounded_trees_auc_zero infiniteDimensional_main_fullDual
    (fun h s => (Vertex.treePath h s : FullDual Vertex))
  · exact Vertex.norm_treePath
  · intro h hh s hs j
    change 1 ≤ ‖((Vertex.treePath h (s++[j])-Vertex.treePath h s : X Vertex) : FullDual Vertex)‖
    rw [Vertex.treePath_child h hh s hs j,eX_val,norm_eStar]
  · intro h hh s hs
    have hd := weakNull_coordinates _
      (Vertex.child_injective (Vertex.node h hh s (Nat.le_of_lt hs)) hs)
    intro φ
    have hh' := hd (φ.comp (coordinateSubspace Vertex).subtypeL)
    convert hh' using 1
    ext j
    change φ (((Vertex.treePath h (s++[j])-Vertex.treePath h s : X Vertex) : FullDual Vertex)) = _
    rw [Vertex.treePath_child h hh s hs j]
    rfl

OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.Lens:136.name: OAI.ForestSpace.main_lens
OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.Lens:136.text:
theorem main_lens (R ε : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (x : FullDual Vertex) (y : ℕ → FullDual Vertex)
    (hp : ∀ j, ‖x+y j‖ ≤ R) (hm : ∀ j, ‖x-y j‖ ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ε ≤ ‖y i-y j‖) :
    ε^2/48 ≤ R^2-‖x‖^2 := by
  have hh : ‖x‖^2+ε^2/48 ≤ R^2 := by
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro δ hδ
    let η := min 1 (δ/(8*(R+1)))
    have hc : 0 < 8*(R+1) := by positivity
    have hη : 0 < η := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hδ hc)
    have hb := main_lens_aprox R ε hR hε x y hp hm hs η hη (min_le_left _ _)
    have he : 8*(R+1)*η ≤ δ := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hc).mp (min_le_right _ _)
    linarith
  linarith

end Lens

OAI.Analysis.ForestSpace.FullDual:173.name: OAI.ForestSpace.main_no_equivalent_AUC

theorem exists_main_head_approx (x : FullDual Vertex) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :

      ‖x-P (H : Set Vertex) hH x‖ < ε := by

  refine ⟨H,hH,?_⟩

  simpa only [hz] using hh

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Pro.name: OAI.Problem346.vanishing_on_products_aux
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Pro.text:
theorem vanishing_on_products_aux (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V]
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hab : a*(a-1) ≤ b)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T)
    (hdiag : ∀ y : Fin b → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial b V y) = 0) : T = 0 := by
  refine vanishing_on_products_of_second_transfer (V := V) ?_ a b ha hb hab T hT hdiag
  intro r m _ _ hbound S _ hrest
  exact SecondTransfer.second_transfer r m (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hbound) S hrest

end Problem346

end

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Sur.name: OAI.Problem346.canonical_surjective_unique_of_vanishing
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Sur.text:
theorem canonical_surjective_unique_of_vanishing (a b : ℕ) (V : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (hvan : ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T →
      (∀ u : Fin b → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial b V u) = 0) → T = 0) :
    ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V),
      IsFoulkesMap a b V μ ∧ Function.Surjective μ ∧
      ∀ ν : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V),
        IsFoulkesMap a b V ν → ν = μ := by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := exists_foulkesMap_from_spanning a b V
  exact ⟨μ, hμ, IsFoulkesMap.surjective_of_vanishing a b V μ hμ hvan,
    fun ν hν => IsFoulkesMap.unique a b V hν hμ⟩

end Problem346

end

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.name: OAI.Problem346.foulkesFormula
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.text:
def foulkesFormula (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (v : Fin b → Fin a → V) : SymPow a (SymPow b V) := by
  classical
  exact
    ((a.factorial : ℂ) ^ b)⁻¹ •
      ∑ σ : Fin b → Equiv.Perm (Fin a),
        symMonomial a (SymPow b V)
          (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun j => v j ((σ j) i)))

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.name: OAI.Problem346.IsFoulkesMap
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.text:
def IsFoulkesMap (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V)) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Fin b → Fin a → V,
    μ (symMonomial b (SymPow a V) (fun j => symMonomial a V (v j))) =
      foulkesFormula a b V v

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.name: OAI.Problem346.IsSymmetricMultilinearForm
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.text:
def IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V) : Prop :=
  ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (x : Fin a → SymPow b V),
    T (fun i => x (σ i)) = T x

end Problem346

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomial

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Sec.name: OAI.Problem346.SecondTransfer.second_transfer
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Sec.text:
theorem second_transfer [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (r m : ℕ)
    (hb : r * (r+1) ≤ r+m)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)
    (h : ∀ x t : V, ∀ Q : Fin r → SymPow m V,
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
        (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (Q i))) = 0) :
    ∀ v : Fin (r+1) → V,
      T (fun i => symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => v i)) = 0 := by
  classical
  let e := Module.finBasis ℂ V
  let P (k : Fin r → ℕ) :=
    multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e (label k)
  have hend : P (fun _ => r) = 0 := terminal_polynomial_zero r m T e h
  have hzero : P (fun _ => 0) = 0 := by
    apply zero_of_upward_grid r P hend
    · intro k hk i hi hnext
      exact polynomial_step T e hb k hk i hi hnext
    · intro i
      exact Nat.zero_le r
  exact independent_powers_zero_of_initial_polynomial_zero T e hzero

end Problem346.SecondTransfer

end

end OAI

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Ann.name: OAI.Problem346.IsFoulkesMap.surjective_of_vanishing
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Ann.text:
theorem IsFoulkesMap.surjective_of_vanishing (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V))
    (hμ : IsFoulkesMap a b V μ)
    (hvan : ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T →
      (∀ u : Fin b → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial b V u) = 0) → T = 0) :
    Function.Surjective μ := by
  apply LinearMap.dualMap_injective_iff.mp
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro φ hφ
  change φ = 0
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hφ
  apply (monomialFunctional_eq_zero_iff a b V φ).mp
  apply hvan _ (monomialFunctional_symmetric a b V φ)
  intro u
  rw [monomialFunctional_apply, ← hμ.map_diagonal a b V μ u]
  have h := congrArg (fun L : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ =>
    L (symMonomial b (SymPow a V) (fun j => symMonomial a V (fun _ => u j)))) hφ
  exact h

end Problem346

end

end OAI

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Spa.name: OAI.Problem346.IsFoulkesMap.unique
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Spa.text:
theorem IsFoulkesMap.unique (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    {f g : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V)}
    (hf : IsFoulkesMap a b V f) (hg : IsFoulkesMap a b V g) : f = g := by
  apply plethysm_linearMap_ext a b V
  intro x
  exact (hf x).trans (hg x).symm

end Problem346

end

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.name: OAI.Problem346.SymmetricMultilinearForm
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Mod.text:
abbrev SymmetricMultilinearForm (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] :=
  MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin a => SymPow b V) ℂ

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Sta.name: OAI.Problem346.canonical_foulkes_howe_surjective
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Sta.text:
theorem canonical_foulkes_howe_surjective :
    ∀ (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (a b : ℕ), 2 ≤ a → a * (a - 1) ≤ b → ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V), IsFoulkesMap a b V μ ∧ Function.Surjective μ ∧ ∀ ν : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V), IsFoulkesMap a b V ν → ν = μ := by
  intro V _ _ _ a b ha hab
  apply canonical_surjective_unique_of_vanishing a b V
  have hb : 1 ≤ b := by
    have hpred : 1 ≤ a - 1 := by omega
    have hprod := Nat.mul_le_mul ha hpred
    omega
  exact vanishing_on_products_aux V a b (by omega) hb hab

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Van.name: OAI.Problem346.vanishing_on_products_of_second_transfer
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Van.text:
theorem vanishing_on_products_of_second_transfer
    (secondTransfer : ∀ r m : ℕ, 0 < r → 0 < m → (r+1)*r ≤ r+m →
      ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V T →
      (∀ x t : V, ∀ Q : Fin r → SymPow m V, lowerProductForm r m T x t Q = 0) →
      ∀ v : Fin (r+1) → V,
        T (fun i => symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => v i)) = 0) :
    ∀ a b : ℕ, 1 ≤ a → 1 ≤ b → a*(a-1) ≤ b →
      ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T →
      (∀ y : Fin b → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial b V y) = 0) → T = 0 := by
  apply vanishing_induction_from_transfer_steps
  · intro r m hr _ _ T hT hdiag
    exact lowerProductForm_diagonal_zero r m hr T hT hdiag
  · exact secondTransfer
  · intro a b T hT
    exact symmetricMultilinearForm_eq_zero_of_pure_powers a b V T hT

end Problem346

end

end OAI

OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Can.name: OAI.Problem346.exists_foulkesMap_from_spanning
OAI.RepresentationTheory.FoulkesHowe.Can.text:
theorem exists_foulkesMap_from_spanning (a b : ℕ) (V : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] :
    ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V),
      IsFoulkesMap a b V μ := by
  classical
  apply exists_symPow_lift_on_spanning (symMonomial a V) (span_symMonomial a V)
    (foulkesFormula a b V)
  · intro v j
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_symPow_lift (foulkesRowFormSpanning a b V v j)
      (foulkesRowFormSpanning_symmetric a b V v j)
    exact ⟨L, fun u => (hL u).trans (foulkesRowFormSpanning_apply a b V v j u)⟩
  · intro σ v
    exact foulkesFormula_outer_permute a b V v σ

end Problem346

end

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:56.name: OAI.FourRow.robust_permanent_explicit
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:56.text:
theorem robust_permanent_explicit (ν : Law) (hp : IsProbability ν)
    (htv : totalVariation ν < robustRadius) (hm : UniformMarginals ν)
    (f : Functions) (hf : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ f i j) :
    permanentExpectation ν f ≤ ∏ i, lpNorm strictExponent (f i) := by
  by_cases hz : ∃ i, rowSq (f i) = 0
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hz
    have hf0 := rowSq_zero_entries (f i) hi
    have hprod (π : Perm) : ∏ k, f k (π k) = 0 := by
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (hf0 (π i))
    have hexp : permanentExpectation ν f = 0 := by
      simp only [permanentExpectation, hprod, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    rw [hexp]
    exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun k _ => lpNorm_nonneg _ _ (hf k))
  · have hspos (i : Site) : 0 < rowSq (f i) := by
      have := rowSq_nonneg (f i)
      have : rowSq (f i) ≠ 0 := fun hi => hz ⟨i, hi⟩
      positivity
    let c : Site → ℝ := fun i => Real.sqrt (rowSq (f i) / 4)
    have hcpos (i : Site) : 0 < c i := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos (hspos i) (by norm_num))
    have hc0 (i : Site) : 0 ≤ c i := le_of_lt (hcpos i)
    have hcne (i : Site) : c i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hcpos i)
    have hcsq (i : Site) : c i ^ 2 = rowSq (f i) / 4 :=
      Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg (le_of_lt (hspos i)) (by norm_num))
    let g : Functions := fun i j => f i j / c i
    have hg0 (i j : Site) : 0 ≤ g i j := div_nonneg (hf i j) (hc0 i)
    have hgn (i : Site) : rowSq (g i) = 4 := by
      dsimp [rowSq, g]
      simp_rw [div_pow, ← Finset.sum_div]
      change rowSq (f i) / c i ^ 2 = 4
      rw [hcsq]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt (hspos i)]
    have heq : f = fun i j => c i * g i j := by
      funext i j
      dsimp [g]
      field_simp [hcne i]
    have h := normalized_robust_permanent ν hp hm htv g hg0 hgn
    have hcprod : 0 ≤ ∏ i, c i := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hc0 i)
    have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hcprod
    rw [heq, expectation_scale]
    simp_rw [lpNorm_scale strictExponent (by norm_num [strictExponent]) _ (hc0 _) _ (hg0 _)]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    exact hscaled

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Norm:48.name: OAI.FourRow.lpNorm_nonneg
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Norm:48.text:
theorem lpNorm_nonneg (p : ℝ) (a : Site → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) :
    0 ≤ lpNorm p a :=
  Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg
    (ha j) _) (by norm_num)) _

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Stability:26.name: OAI.FourRow.rowSq_nonneg
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Stability:26.text:
theorem rowSq_nonneg (a : Site → ℝ) : 0 ≤ rowSq a :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Model:25.name: OAI.FourRow.UniformMarginals
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Model:25.text:
def UniformMarginals (ν : Law) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Site, ∑ π, (if π i = j then ν π else 0) = 1 / 4

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:13.name: OAI.FourRow.normalized_robust_permanent
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:13.text:
theorem normalized_robust_permanent (ν : Law) (hp : IsProbability ν)
    (hm : UniformMarginals ν) (htv : totalVariation ν < robustRadius)
    (f : Functions) (hf : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ f i j) (hn : ∀ i, rowSq (f i) = 4) :
    permanentExpectation ν f ≤ ∏ i, lpNorm strictExponent (f i) := by
  have h1 := normalized_uniform_stability f hf hn
  have h2 := normalized_perturbation ν hp hm f hf hn
  have h3 := normalized_product_norm_lower strictExponent (by norm_num [strictExponent])
    (by norm_num [strictExponent]) f hf hn
  have hd := totalDist_nonneg f
  have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt htv) hd
  dsimp [robustRadius] at ht
  dsimp [strictExponent] at h3 ⊢
  linarith

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:100.name: OAI.FourRow.robust_permanent
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:100.text:
theorem robust_permanent :
  ∃ p₀ : ℝ, 4 / 3 < p₀ ∧ p₀ < 2 ∧
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ ν : Law,
      IsProbability ν → totalVariation ν < ε → UniformMarginals ν →
      ∀ f : Functions, (∀ i j, 0 ≤ f i j) →
        permanentExpectation ν f ≤ ∏ i, lpNorm p₀ (f i) := by
  refine ⟨strictExponent, ?_, ?_, robustRadius, ?_, ?_⟩
  · norm_num [strictExponent]
  · norm_num [strictExponent]
  · norm_num [robustRadius]
  · intro ν hp htv hm f hf
    exact robust_permanent_explicit ν hp htv hm f hf

end FourRow
end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:39.name: OAI.FourRow.expectation_scale
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:39.text:
theorem expectation_scale (ν : Law) (c : Site → ℝ) (f : Functions) :
    permanentExpectation ν (fun i j => c i * f i j) =
      (∏ i, c i) * permanentExpectation ν f := by
  unfold permanentExpectation
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro π _
  ring

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:29.name: OAI.FourRow.lpNorm_scale
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:29.text:
theorem lpNorm_scale (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (a : Site → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) :
    lpNorm p (fun j => c * a j) = c * lpNorm p a := by
  unfold lpNorm
  simp_rw [Real.mul_rpow hc (ha _)]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, mul_div_assoc]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hc p)
    (div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (ha j) p)) (by norm_num))]
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul hc, one_div, mul_inv_cancel₀ hp, Real.rpow_one]

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Model:22.name: OAI.FourRow.IsProbability
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Model:22.text:
def IsProbability (ν : Law) : Prop :=
  (∀ π, 0 ≤ ν π) ∧ ∑ π, ν π = 1

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:49.name: OAI.FourRow.rowSq_zero_entries
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Main:49.text:
theorem rowSq_zero_entries (a : Site → ℝ) (h : rowSq a = 0) : ∀ j, a j = 0 := by
  intro j
  have hs : a j ^ 2 ≤ rowSq a :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg (a k)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  rw [h] at hs
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a j)]

OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Model:28.name: OAI.FourRow.totalVariation
OAI.Combinatorics.Permanent.Model:28.text:
def totalVariation (ν : Law) : ℝ :=
  (∑ π, |ν π - 1 / 24|) / 2

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Main:21.name: OAI.Problem367.free_ising_factor_iff_threshold
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Main:21.text:
theorem free_ising_factor_iff_threshold :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (beta : ℝ), 3 ≤ d → 0 ≤ beta → (IsFactorOfIID d (Real.tanh beta) ↔ Real.tanh beta ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) - 1)) := by
  intro d beta hd hbeta

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Main:13.name: OAI.Problem367.free_ising_factor_below_threshold
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Main:13.text:
theorem free_ising_factor_below_threshold :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (beta : ℝ), 3 ≤ d → 0 ≤ beta → Real.tanh beta ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) - 1) → IsFactorOfIID d (Real.tanh beta) := by
  apply free_ising_factor_below_threshold_of_actual_variance_identity
  intro d beta hd hb hcrit T
  exact IsingObservationFactor.actual_variance_analysis hd
    (freeIsingMeasure_hasFreeIsingLaw d (Real.neg_one_lt_tanh beta).le
      (Real.tanh_lt_one beta).le) hb.le hcrit T

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Estimates.Free.name: OAI.Problem367.freeIsingMeasure_hasFreeIsingLaw
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Estimates.Free.text:
theorem freeIsingMeasure_hasFreeIsingLaw (d : ℕ) {theta : ℝ}
    (h0 : -1 ≤ theta) (h1 : theta ≤ 1) :

  RootedBroadcast.hasFreeIsingLaw_of_root_nonroot_joint h0 h1
    (RootedBroadcast.map_factor_rest d theta)

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Estimates.Thre.name: OAI.Problem367.tanh_nonneg_of_beta_nonneg
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Estimates.Thre.text:
lemma tanh_nonneg_of_beta_nonneg {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta) :
    0 ≤ Real.tanh beta := by
  rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
  exact div_nonneg (Real.sinh_nonneg_iff.mpr hbeta) (Real.cosh_pos beta).le

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Ising.ActualVa.name: OAI.Problem367.IsingObservationFactor.actual_variance_analysis
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Ising.ActualVa.text:
theorem actual_variance_analysis
    (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hμ : HasFreeIsingLaw (Real.tanh beta) μ) (hb : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hcrit : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.tanh beta ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    (T : ℝ≥0) :
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (fun t : ℝ => ∫ z,
      (field beta (ConnectedHull.root d) t.toNNReal z.2.1 -
        field beta (ConnectedHull.root d) t.toNNReal z.2.2) ^ 2 ∂copies beta μ) 0 T ∧
    (∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T),
      deriv (fun s : ℝ => ∫ z,
        (field beta (ConnectedHull.root d) s.toNNReal z.2.1 -
          field beta (ConnectedHull.root d) s.toNNReal z.2.2) ^ 2 ∂copies beta μ) t =
        ∫ z, density beta (ConnectedHull.root d) t z ∂copies beta μ) := by
  obtain ⟨I, Y, hI2, hY2, hI, hIlim, _hYp, hYM, hYc, _hY0,
      _hYiso, hYsum, _hYmax, _hQ, _hAint, _hAc⟩ :=
    exists_canonical_root_response_integrals hd hμ hb hcrit
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := IsingJoinedResponseIntegrals.exists_integrals hd hμ hb hcrit
  have hfield := canonical_field_eq_normalized_integral hd hμ hb hcrit
    (fun a => (hI a).2.1) hYM hI2 hY2 (fun a => (hI a).2.2) hYc hYsum hIlim
  have hcopy := rootResponse_sum_eq_copy_all_times hμ hb
    hI2 hY2 S.channel_memLp S.total_memLp hYc S.total_continuous
    hIlim S.channel_limit hYsum S.total_sum
  have hrep := copied_difference_decomposition hμ hb (ConnectedHull.root d)
    hfield (fun j => hcopy.mono (fun z hz => hz j))
  exact variance_analysis_of_joined_decomposition hd hμ hb hcrit S hrep T

end Problem367.IsingObservationFactor

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Model:11.name: OAI.Problem367.TreeVertex
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Model:11.text:
abbrev TreeVertex (d : ℕ) :=

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Ising.SharpVar.name: OAI.Problem367.free_ising_factor_below_threshold_of_actual_variance_identity
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Ising.SharpVar.text:
theorem free_ising_factor_below_threshold_of_actual_variance_identity
    (hvariance : ∀ (d : ℕ) (beta : ℝ), 3 ≤ d → 0 < beta →
      ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.tanh beta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
      ActualRootVarianceIdentity beta (freeIsingMeasure d (Real.tanh beta))) :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (beta : ℝ), 3 ≤ d → 0 ≤ beta →
      Real.tanh beta ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) - 1) →
      IsFactorOfIID d (Real.tanh beta) := by
  intro d beta hd hb hthreshold
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hb with hzero | hpos
  · subst beta
    exact free_ising_factor_beta_zero d
  · have hsharp : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.tanh beta ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ d), Nat.cast_one] using
        (tanh_threshold_iff_branching_sq hd hpos.le).mp hthreshold
    exact isFactorOfIID_of_sharp_actual_variance_identity
      (freeIsingMeasure_hasFreeIsingLaw d (Real.neg_one_lt_tanh beta).le
        (Real.tanh_lt_one beta).le) hd hpos.le hsharp
      (hvariance d beta hd hpos hsharp)

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Model:80.name: OAI.Problem367.IsFactorOfIID
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Model:80.text:
def IsFactorOfIID (d : ℕ) (theta : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ Phi : (TreeVertex d → ℝ) → (TreeVertex d → IsingSpin),
    Measurable Phi ∧
    HasFreeIsingLaw theta (Measure.map Phi (labelMeasure d)) ∧
    ∀ g : TreeAut d,
      ∀ᵐ U ∂labelMeasure d, Phi (relabel g U) = relabel g (Phi U)

end Problem367

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Model:74.name: OAI.Problem367.HasFreeIsingLaw
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Model:74.text:
def HasFreeIsingLaw {d : ℕ} (theta : ℝ)
    (mu : Measure (TreeVertex d → IsingSpin)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : Finset (TreeVertex d)), ConnectedFinset D →
    ∀ eta : TreeVertex d → IsingSpin,
      mu {x | ∀ v ∈ D, x v = eta v} = freeCylinderWeight theta D eta

OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Factors.Necess.name: OAI.Problem367.free_ising_factor_only_if_threshold
OAI.Probability.FreeIsing.Factors.Necess.text:
theorem free_ising_factor_only_if_threshold (d : ℕ) (beta : ℝ)
    (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hfactor : IsFactorOfIID d (Real.tanh beta)) :
    Real.tanh beta ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) - 1) := by
  apply hfactor.le_threshold hd
  · exact le_trans (by norm_num) (tanh_nonneg_of_beta_nonneg hbeta)
  · exact (Real.tanh_lt_one beta).le

end Problem367

end

OAI.Probability.SpanningForest.Definitio.name: OAI.Problem336.relabelGraph
OAI.Probability.SpanningForest.Definitio.text:

  ⟨fun u v => G.1 (σ.symm u) (σ.symm v), by
    constructor
    · intro u
      exact G.2.1 (σ.symm u)
    · intro u v
      exact G.2.2 (σ.symm u) (σ.symm v)⟩

OAI.Probability.SpanningForest.Definitio.name: OAI.Problem336.HasFUSFLaw
OAI.Probability.SpanningForest.Definitio.text:
def HasFUSFLaw {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (G : GraphCode) (P : Measure Ω)
    (X : Ω → EdgeConfiguration) : Prop :=
  (∀ e, Measurable (fun ω => X ω e)) ∧
  ∀ (H : ℕ → FiniteSubgraphCode), IsConnectedExhaustion G H →
    ∀ (A B : Finset EdgeCode),
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => ustCylinder (H n) A B)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhds (P {ω |
          (∀ e ∈ A, X ω e = true) ∧
          (∀ e ∈ B, X ω e = false)}))

  exact FactorAssembly.canonical_hasFUSFLaw_of_sampler_hasLaw

OAI.Probability.SpanningForest.Definitio.name: OAI.Problem336.IsVertexIID

def IsVertexIID {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) (U : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) : Prop :=

  ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (A : ℕ → Set ℝ),

    P {ω | ∀ i ∈ s, U i ω ∈ A i} =
      Finset.prod s (fun i => uniform01 (A i))

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.Target:21.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.TimeConstantNorm
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.Target:21.text:
structure TimeConstantNorm (μ : Plane → ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ v, 0 ≤ μ v
  zero_iff : ∀ v, μ v = 0 ↔ v = 0
  triangle : ∀ v w, μ (v + w) ≤ μ v + μ w
  homogeneous : ∀ (a : ℝ) v, μ (a • v) = |a| * μ v

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.NoCornerCon.name: OAI.GammaFPP.CrossingBridge.long_paths_contradict_directional_limit
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.NoCornerCon.text:
theorem long_paths_contradict_directional_limit (w : Edge → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e)
    (b m₀ a η : ℝ) (hb : |b| ≤ 1) (hη : 0 < η) (k m : ℕ)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => passageTime w 0 ((n : ℤ),⌊b*(n : ℝ)⌋)/(n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 m₀))
    (hlong : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ blocks : List (List Step), ∀ rest : List Step,
      blocks.length=N → (∀ q ∈ blocks, FullSpatialChunk b k m q) →
      (∀ i ≤ rest.length, chunkInterior b k m (displacement (rest.take i))) →
      ((trace 0 (blocks.flatten++rest)).map traversalEdge).Nodup →
      N*η*(2 : ℝ)^k/2 ≤ defect w b m₀ a 0 (blocks.flatten++rest)) : False := by
  obtain ⟨N₀,hN₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hlong
  let A := η*(2 : ℝ)^k
  let L := (2 : ℝ)^m
  let δ := A/(8*L)
  have hA : 0 < A := by dsimp [A]; positivity
  have hL : 0 < L := by dsimp [L]; positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hδeq : 8*L*δ=A := by dsimp [δ]; field_simp
  have hup := hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show m₀ < m₀+δ by linarith))
  have hnat : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hnlarge := hnat.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop (((N₀ : ℝ)+1)*2*L))
  have hnC := hnat.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop ((A/2+|a|+1)/δ))
  have hnpos := hnat.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ))
  obtain ⟨n,hnup,hnlarge,hnC,hnpos⟩ := (hup.and (hnlarge.and (hnC.and hnpos))).exists
  obtain ⟨ds,hend,hsimple,_hmin,hcost⟩ := GammaFPP.LoopErase.exists_near_optimal_simple_path w hw 0 ((n : ℤ),⌊b*(n : ℝ)⌋) 1 (by norm_num)
  have hdisp : displacement ds=((n : ℤ),⌊b*(n : ℝ)⌋) := by simpa using hend
  obtain ⟨blocks,rest,heq,hfull,hrest⟩ := spatial_chunk_decomposition b k m ds
  have hcut := spatial_chunk_displacement_bound b hb k m blocks rest hfull hrest
  rw [← heq,hdisp] at hcut
  have hcutR : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2*L*((blocks.length : ℝ)+1) := by
    have hh : (n : ℤ) ≤ 2*(2 : ℤ)^m*((blocks.length : ℤ)+1) := by simpa using hcut
    dsimp [L]
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hN : N₀ ≤ blocks.length := by
    by_contra hh
    have hl : ((blocks.length : ℝ)+1) ≤ N₀ := by exact_mod_cast (show blocks.length+1 ≤ N₀ by omega)
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (show 0 ≤ 2*L by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hlow := hN₀ blocks.length hN blocks rest rfl hfull hrest (by rw [← heq]; exact hsimple)
  have hloA : (blocks.length : ℝ)*A/2 ≤ defect w b m₀ a 0 ds := by
    rw [← heq] at hlow
    simpa only [A,mul_assoc] using hlow
  have hr : |(⌊b*(n : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ)-b*n| ≤ 1 := by
    apply abs_le.mpr
    have hl := Int.floor_le (b*(n : ℝ))
    have hu := Int.lt_floor_add_one (b*(n : ℝ))
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hab : |a*((⌊b*(n : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ)-b*n)| ≤ |a| := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (abs_nonneg a)
  have hsupport : m₀*n-|a| ≤ support b m₀ a (displacement ds) := by
    rw [hdisp]
    simp only [support,transverse,Int.cast_natCast]
    linarith [(abs_le.mp hab).1]
  have hpass : passageTime w 0 ((n : ℤ),⌊b*(n : ℝ)⌋) < (m₀+δ)*n := (div_lt_iff₀ hnpos).mp hnup
  have hupper : defect w b m₀ a 0 ds < δ*n+|a|+1 := by
    unfold defect
    nlinarith
  have hcutδ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcutR hδ.le
  have hδN := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x*((blocks.length : ℝ)+1)) hδeq
  have hC : A/2+|a|+1 < δ*n := by
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp hnC
    nlinarith
  nlinarith

end GammaFPP.CrossingBridge

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.MeanNorm:74.name: OAI.GammaFPP.gammaMeanNorm_laws
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.MeanNorm:74.text:
theorem gammaMeanNorm_laws
    (h : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ) (hs : 0 < shape) (hr : 0 < rate) :
    TimeConstantNorm (gammaMeanNorm h hs hr) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v
    exact apply_nonneg (gammaMeanPairSeminorm h hs hr) (v 0, v 1)
  · intro v
    constructor
    · intro hv
      have hb := gammaMeanNorm_lower h hs hr v
      have hc := cheapSlope_pos hs hr
      rw [hv] at hb
      have h₀ : v 0 = 0 := abs_eq_zero.mp (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (v 0), abs_nonneg (v 1)])
      have h₁ : v 1 = 0 := abs_eq_zero.mp (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (v 0), abs_nonneg (v 1)])
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h₀
      · exact h₁
    · rintro rfl
      change gammaMeanPairSeminorm h hs hr 0 = 0
      exact map_zero _
  · intro v w
    change gammaMeanPairSeminorm h hs hr ((v 0, v 1) + (w 0, w 1)) ≤ _
    exact map_add_le_add (gammaMeanPairSeminorm h hs hr) _ _
  · intro a v
    change gammaMeanPairSeminorm h hs hr (a • (v 0, v 1)) = _
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, gammaMeanNorm] using map_smul_eq_mul (gammaMeanPairSeminorm h hs hr) a (v 0, v 1)

end GammaFPP

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.Target:12.name: OAI.GammaFPP.HasC1CurveChart
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.Target:12.text:
def HasC1CurveChart (S : Set Plane) (v : Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ U : Set Plane, IsOpen U ∧ v ∈ U ∧ v ∈ S ∧ ∃ γ : ℝ → Plane, ∃ θ : Plane → ℝ,
    ContDiff ℝ 1 γ ∧ ContinuousOn θ U ∧
    (∀ t, γ t ∈ S ∩ U) ∧ (∀ t, θ (γ t)=t) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ S ∩ U, γ (θ z)=z) ∧
    (∀ t, ∃ d : Plane, HasDerivAt γ d t ∧ d ≠ 0)

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.PlaneGeomet.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.direction
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.PlaneGeomet.text: noncomputable def direction (b : ℝ) : Plane := WithLp.toLp 2 ![1, b]

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.AnalyticSpe.name: OAI.GammaFPP.Analytic.gammaMeanNorm_analytic_of_noCorner
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.AnalyticSpe.text:
theorem gammaMeanNorm_analytic_of_noCorner
    (h : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ) (hs : 0 < shape) (hr : 0 < rate)
    (hnc : NoCornerWedge (gammaMeanNorm h hs hr)) :
    DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin (gammaMeanNorm h hs hr) ∧
      ∀ v ∈ frontier {z | gammaMeanNorm h hs hr z ≤ 1},
        GammaFPP.HasC1CurveChart (frontier {z | gammaMeanNorm h hs hr z ≤ 1}) v := by
  have hn := gammaMeanNorm_laws h hs hr
  have hd := differentiable_away_of_noCornerWedge _ hn (gammaMeanNorm_swap h hs hr) hnc
  exact ⟨hd, norm_boundary_curve_chart _ hn hd⟩

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.Target:40.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.Target:40.text:
def DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin (μ : Plane → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Plane, v ≠ 0 → ∃ ℓ : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ, HasFDerivAt μ ℓ v

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.Differentia.name: OAI.GammaFPP.gamma_differentiability
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.Differentia.text:
theorem gamma_differentiability : GammaDifferentiabilityTarget := by
  intro shape rate hs hr Ω _ P τ h
  have hnc : Analytic.NoCornerWedge (gammaMeanNorm h hs hr) := by
    intro b hb
    simpa [PlanarFPP.extremeSlope] using
      CrossingBridge.gamma_no_corner h hs hr b hb
  exact Analytic.gammaMeanNorm_target_conjunction_of_inputs h hs hr
    (h.isTimeConstant hs hr) hnc

end GammaFPP
