OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.Target:34.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.IsTimeConstant
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.Target:34.text:
def IsTimeConstant {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (P : Measure Ω) (τ : Edge → Ω → ℝ) (μ : Plane → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Plane, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P,
    Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => passageTime (fun e => τ e ω) (0, 0)
      (latticeFloor (t • v)) / t) atTop (𝓝 (μ v))

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.ActualNoCor.name: OAI.GammaFPP.CrossingBridge.gamma_no_corner
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.ActualNoCor.text:
theorem gamma_no_corner (henv : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ)
    (hshape : 0 < shape) (hrate : 0 < rate) (b : ℝ) (hb : |b| ≤ 1) :
    extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b false=extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b true := by
  let _ := henv.probability
  let μ := (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate)
  let am := extremeSlope μ b false
  let ap := extremeSlope μ b true
  have horder : am ≤ ap := by
    exact extreme_slopes_ordered _ (convex_transverse_profile μ (direction b) transverseUnit
      (gammaMeanNorm_laws henv hshape hrate).triangle (norm_positive_homogeneous μ (gammaMeanNorm_laws henv hshape hrate)))
  change am=ap
  by_contra hneq
  have hgap0 : 0 < (ap-am)/8 := by have hh := lt_of_le_of_ne horder hneq; linarith
  let η := min 1 ((ap-am)/8)
  have hη : 0 < η := lt_min (by norm_num) hgap0
  have hη1 : η ≤ 1 := min_le_left ..
  have hgap : 4*η ≤ (ap-am)/2 := by have hh := min_le_right (1 : ℝ) ((ap-am)/8); nlinarith
  obtain ⟨k,m,hs,hstep,hscale₁,hscale₂,hBK⟩ := gamma_witness_scale henv hshape hrate b η hb hη hη1
  have hlong := ae_eventually_spatial_long_paths henv hshape hrate b (μ (direction b)) am ap (sourceCrossingK shape rate μ b) η
    ((1 : ℝ)/1024) hb horder hη (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    hgap k m hs hstep hscale₁ hscale₂ hBK
  obtain ⟨ω,hp,hl,hh⟩ := (henv.ae_positive.and ((gamma_direction_nat_limit henv hshape hrate b).and hlong)).exists
  exact long_paths_contradict_directional_limit (fun e => τ e ω) (fun e => (hp e).le)
    b (μ (direction b)) ((am+ap)/2) η hb hη k m hl hh

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.AnalyticSpe.name: OAI.GammaFPP.Analytic.NoCornerWedge
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.AnalyticSpe.text:
def NoCornerWedge (μ : Plane → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : ℝ, |b| ≤ 1 →
    leftSlope (fun t : ℝ => μ (direction b + t • transverseUnit)) =
      rightSlope (fun t : ℝ => μ (direction b + t • transverseUnit))

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.PlaneGeomet.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.norm_positive_homogeneous
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.PlaneGeomet.text:
theorem norm_positive_homogeneous (μ : Plane → ℝ) (hμ : TimeConstantNorm μ) :
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ z, μ (t • z) = t * μ z := by
  intro t ht z
  rw [hμ.homogeneous, abs_of_nonneg ht]

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.ExtremeSlop.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.rightSlope
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.ExtremeSlop.text: noncomputable def rightSlope (φ : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ := derivWithin φ (Ioi 0) 0

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.Target:23.name: OAI.GammaFPP.GammaDifferentiabilityTarget
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.Target:23.text:
def GammaDifferentiabilityTarget : Prop :=
  ∀ (shape rate : ℝ), 0 < shape → 0 < rate →
    ∀ (Ω : Type) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
      (τ : PlanarFPP.Edge → Ω → ℝ),
      GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ →
        ∃ μ : Plane → ℝ,
          TimeConstantNorm μ ∧ IsTimeConstant P τ μ ∧
          DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin μ ∧
          ∀ v ∈ frontier {z : Plane | μ z ≤ 1},
            HasC1CurveChart (frontier {z : Plane | μ z ≤ 1}) v

end GammaFPP

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.ExtremeSlop.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.extreme_slopes_ordered
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.ExtremeSlop.text:
theorem extreme_slopes_ordered (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ConvexOn ℝ univ φ) :
    leftSlope φ ≤ rightSlope φ :=
  hφ.leftDeriv_le_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior (by simp)

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.WitnessBore.name: OAI.GammaFPP.CrossingBridge.ae_eventually_spatial_long_paths
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.WitnessBore.text:
theorem ae_eventually_spatial_long_paths (henv : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ)
    (hshape : 0 < shape) (hrate : 0 < rate)
    (b m₀ am ap K η r : ℝ) (hb : |b| ≤ 1) (ha : am ≤ ap) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) (hsmall : 196*r < 1)
    (hgap : 4*η ≤ (ap-am)/2) (k m : ℕ) (hs : 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ)^k)
    (hstep : max |m₀-((am+ap)/2)*b| |(am+ap)/2| ≤ η*(2 : ℝ)^k)
    (hscale₁ : η*(2 : ℝ)^k < 2*m₀*(2 : ℝ)^m-|((am+ap)/2)| *((2 : ℝ)^k+1))
    (hscale₂ : 3*η*(2 : ℝ)^k+2*|((am+ap)/2)| *((2 : ℝ)^k+1) < K*(2 : ℝ)^k)
    (hBK : ∀ is : List (ℤ×ℤ), P.real {ω | StrictDisjointPaths (spatialListSupport b k m is)
      (is.map (spatialWitnessFamily b m₀ am ap K η k m)) (fun e => τ e ω)} ≤ (r^16)^is.length) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ blocks : List (List Step), ∀ rest : List Step,
      blocks.length=N → (∀ q ∈ blocks, FullSpatialChunk b k m q) →
      (∀ i ≤ rest.length, chunkInterior b k m (displacement (rest.take i))) →
      ((trace 0 (blocks.flatten++rest)).map traversalEdge).Nodup →
      N*η*(2 : ℝ)^k/2 ≤ defect (fun e => τ e ω) b m₀ ((am+ap)/2) 0 (blocks.flatten++rest) := by
  let _ := henv.probability
  let B (N : ℕ) : Set Ω := {ω | SpatialBadPath (fun e => τ e ω) b m₀ ((am+ap)/2) η k m N}
  have hbound (N : ℕ) (hN : 4 ≤ N) : P.real (B N) ≤ (196 : ℝ)^N*(r^16)^(N/16) :=
    spatial_bad_path_probability henv hshape hrate b m₀ am ap K η (r^16) hb ha hη (by positivity)
      hgap k m hs hstep hscale₁ hscale₂ hBK N hN
  have hsum : Summable (fun N => P.real (B N)) := by
    rw [← summable_nat_add_iff 4]
    have hh := (summable_nat_add_iff 4).mpr (summable_witness_entropy r hr hr1 hsmall)
    exact hh.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => measureReal_nonneg) (fun n => hbound (n+4) (by omega))
  have ht : (∑' N, P (B N)) ≠ ⊤ := by
    simpa only [measureReal_def,ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top _ _)] using hsum.tsum_ofReal_ne_top
  filter_upwards [ae_eventually_notMem ht] with ω hω
  filter_upwards [hω] with N hN
  intro blocks rest hlen hfull hrest hsimple
  by_contra hc
  exact hN ⟨blocks,rest,hlen,hfull,hrest,hsimple,lt_of_not_ge hc⟩

end GammaFPP.CrossingBridge

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.AnalyticSpe.name: OAI.GammaFPP.Analytic.gammaMeanNorm_target_conjunction_of_inputs
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.AnalyticSpe.text:
theorem gammaMeanNorm_target_conjunction_of_inputs
    (h : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ) (hs : 0 < shape) (hr : 0 < rate)
    (ht : IsTimeConstant P τ (gammaMeanNorm h hs hr))
    (hnc : NoCornerWedge (gammaMeanNorm h hs hr)) :
    ∃ μ : Plane → ℝ, TimeConstantNorm μ ∧ IsTimeConstant P τ μ ∧
      DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin μ ∧
      ∀ v ∈ frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1},
        GammaFPP.HasC1CurveChart (frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1}) v := by
  obtain ⟨hd,hcharts⟩ := gammaMeanNorm_analytic_of_noCorner h hs hr hnc
  exact ⟨gammaMeanNorm h hs hr,gammaMeanNorm_laws h hs hr,ht,hd,hcharts⟩

end GammaFPP.Analytic

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.MeanPairSem.name: OAI.GammaFPP.gammaMeanPairSeminorm
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.MeanPairSem.text:
noncomputable def gammaMeanPairSeminorm
    (h : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ) (hs : 0 < shape) (hr : 0 < rate) :
    Seminorm ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) := by
  let m : Vertex → ℝ := directionalMeanConstant h hs hr
  have hn : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : Vertex), m (k • x) = (k : ℝ)*m x :=
    fun k x => h.directionalMeanConstant_nsmul hs hr x k
  have hz : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : Vertex), m (k • x) = (k.natAbs : ℝ)*m x :=
    fun k x => h.directionalMeanConstant_zsmul hs hr x k
  exact realMeanSeminorm (rationalMean m) ⟨shape/rate, (div_pos hs hr).le⟩
    (rationalMean_l1 m hn (shape/rate) (h.directionalMeanConstant_l1_lipschitz hs hr))
    (rationalMean_zero m hn (h.directionalMeanConstant_zero hs hr))
    (rationalMean_add_le m hn (h.directionalMeanConstant_add_le hs hr))
    (rationalMean_neg m hn (h.directionalMeanConstant_neg hs hr))
    (rationalMean_smul m hn hz)

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.ExtremeSlop.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.leftSlope
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.ExtremeSlop.text: noncomputable def leftSlope (φ : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ := derivWithin φ (Iio 0) 0

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.MeanNorm:64.name: OAI.GammaFPP.gammaMeanNorm
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.MeanNorm:64.text:
noncomputable def gammaMeanNorm
    (h : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ) (hs : 0 < shape) (hr : 0 < rate)
    (v : Plane) : ℝ := gammaMeanPairSeminorm h hs hr (v 0, v 1)

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.ExtremeSlop.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.convex_transverse_profile
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.ExtremeSlop.text:
theorem convex_transverse_profile {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (μ : E → ℝ) (u e : E)
    (hadd : ∀ z w, μ (z + w) ≤ μ z + μ w)
    (hhom : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ z, μ (t • z) = t * μ z) :
    ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun t : ℝ => μ (u + t • e)) := by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro v _ w _ a b ha hb hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  have heq : u + (a * v + b * w) • e = a • (u + v • e) + b • (u + w • e) := by
    rw [smul_add, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, add_add_add_comm,
      ← add_smul, hab, one_smul, ← add_smul]
  rw [heq]
  exact (hadd _ _).trans_eq (by rw [hhom a ha, hhom b hb])

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.ActualNoCor.name: OAI.GammaFPP.CrossingBridge.gamma_direction_nat_limit
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.ActualNoCor.text:
lemma gamma_direction_nat_limit (henv : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ)
    (hshape : 0 < shape) (hrate : 0 < rate) (b : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => passageTime (fun e => τ e ω) 0 ((n : ℤ),⌊b*(n : ℝ)⌋)/(n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 ((gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) (direction b))) := by
  filter_upwards [henv.isTimeConstant hshape hrate (direction b)] with ω hω
  have hh := hω.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  have he (n : ℕ) : latticeFloor ((n : ℝ) • direction b)=((n : ℤ),⌊b*(n : ℝ)⌋) := by
    simp [latticeFloor,direction,PiLp.smul_apply,mul_comm]
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,he,show (0 : Vertex)=(0,0) from rfl] using hh

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.Environment.name: OAI.GammaFPP.GammaEnvironment
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.Environment.text:
abbrev GammaEnvironment {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (shape rate : ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) (τ : PlanarFPP.Edge → Ω → ℝ) :=
  IidEnvironment (gammaMeasure shape rate) P τ

OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.ActualWitne.name: OAI.GammaFPP.CrossingBridge.gamma_witness_scale
OAI.Probability.GammaPassage.ActualWitne.text:
theorem gamma_witness_scale (henv : GammaEnvironment shape rate P τ)
    (hshape : 0 < shape) (hrate : 0 < rate) (b η : ℝ)
    (hb : |b| ≤ 1) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1) :
    ∃ k m : ℕ, 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ)^k ∧
      max |(gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) (direction b)-
        ((extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b false+extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b true)/2)*b|
        |(extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b false+extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b true)/2| ≤ η*(2 : ℝ)^k ∧
      η*(2 : ℝ)^k < 2*(gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) (direction b)*(2 : ℝ)^m-
        |(extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b false+extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b true)/2| *((2 : ℝ)^k+1) ∧
      3*η*(2 : ℝ)^k+2*|(extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b false+extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b true)/2| *((2 : ℝ)^k+1)
        < sourceCrossingK shape rate (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b*(2 : ℝ)^k ∧
      ∀ is : List (ℤ×ℤ), P.real {ω | StrictDisjointPaths (spatialListSupport b k m is)
        (is.map (spatialWitnessFamily b ((gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) (direction b))
          (extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b false) (extremeSlope (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b true)
          (sourceCrossingK shape rate (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate) b) η k m)) (fun e => τ e ω)} ≤
        (((1 : ℝ)/1024)^16)^is.length := by
  let μ := (gammaMeanNorm henv hshape hrate)
  let am := extremeSlope μ b false
  let ap := extremeSlope μ b true
  let a := (am+ap)/2
  let m₀ := μ (direction b)
  let q₀ : ℝ := ((1/1024)^16)/2
  have hq : 0 < q₀ := by dsimp [q₀]; positivity
  have hq1 : q₀ < 1 := by dsimp [q₀]; norm_num
  let S := max 2 (max |m₀-a*b| |a| / η)
  let D := (η+2*|a|+1)/m₀
  obtain ⟨k,hk,hs,hd,hBK⟩ := gamma_spatial_witness_BK_scales henv hshape hrate b q₀ η hb hq hq1 hη 0 S D
  let m := characteristicExponent P τ shape rate μ b q₀ k
  have hpow : (characteristicLength P τ shape rate μ b q₀ k : ℝ)=(2 : ℝ)^m := by
    simp [characteristicLength,m]
  rw [hpow] at hd
  have hs2 : 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ)^k := (le_max_left _ _).trans hs
  have hsC : max |m₀-a*b| |a| / η ≤ (2 : ℝ)^k := (le_max_right _ _).trans hs
  obtain ⟨hstep,hscale₁,hscale₂⟩ := witness_scale_inequalities b m₀ am ap η ((2 : ℝ)^k) ((2 : ℝ)^m)
    (norm_direction_pos μ (gammaMeanNorm_laws henv hshape hrate) b) hη hη1 hs2 hsC hd
  have hK : 100*(1+|am|+|ap|) ≤ sourceCrossingK shape rate μ b := by
    dsimp [am,ap]
    unfold sourceCrossingK
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (coordinateAllowance shape rate)]
  have hscale₂Gamma := hscale₂.trans_le
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2^k))
  refine ⟨k,m,hs2,hstep,hscale₁,hscale₂Gamma,?_⟩
  intro is
  have hh := hBK is
  have he : 2*q₀=((1 : ℝ)/1024)^16 := by dsimp [q₀]; ring
  rw [he] at hh
  exact hh

end GammaFPP.CrossingBridge

end OAI

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.exists_fiber_good
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma exists_fiber_good {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (P : Measure α) (L : α → ι)
    (Good : α → Prop) (hgood : ∀ᵐ z ∂P,Good z) (i : ι) (hp : P {z | L z = i} ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z,L z = i ∧ Good z := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  have ha : ∀ᵐ z ∂P,L z ≠ i := hgood.mono (fun z hz he => h ⟨z,he,hz⟩)
  exact hp (by simpa only [not_not] using (ae_iff.mp ha))

OAI.Probability.Localization.EntropyBudg.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.entropySlope_pos
OAI.Probability.Localization.EntropyBudg.text:
lemma entropySlope_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : 0 < entropySlope n := by
  unfold entropySlope
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))) (by norm_num)

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.ae_fiber_positive
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma ae_fiber_positive {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [Countable ι] (P : Measure α) (L : α → ι) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂P,P {w | L w = L z} ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  have h (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ z ∂P,L z = i → P {w | L w = i} ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases hp : P {w | L w = i} = 0
    · have ha : ∀ᵐ z ∂P,L z ≠ i := ae_iff.mpr (by simpa only [not_not] using hp)
      exact ha.mono (fun z hz he => (hz he).elim)
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun _ _ => hp)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr h] with z hz
  exact hz (L z) rfl

OAI.Probability.Localization.EntropyBudg.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.truncated_depth_integrable
OAI.Probability.Localization.EntropyBudg.text:
lemma truncated_depth_integrable {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) (N : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z => (truncatedDepth P Q N z : ℝ)) P := by
  have hc := (truncated_cost_bound hn P Q hac hK N).1
  have hm : Measurable (fun z => (truncatedDepth P Q N z : ℝ)) :=
    (measurable_of_countable (fun h : Log n => (((state P Q h).cell.1-Q.1:ℕ):ℝ))).comp (measurable_run hn P Q N)
  apply Integrable.mono' (hc.div_const (entropySlope n)) hm.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with z
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _),le_div_iff₀ (entropySlope_pos hn)]
  change _ ≤ (historyKL P Q (run P Q N z)).toReal + entropySlope n * (truncatedDepth P Q N z:ℝ)
  nlinarith [ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := historyKL P Q (run P Q N z))]

OAI.Probability.Localization.Rewards:38.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.truncatedAttempts
OAI.Probability.Localization.Rewards:38.text:
noncomputable def truncatedAttempts {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n) (N : ℕ) (z : Coordinate n) : ℕ :=
  (run P Q N z).length

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.run_eventually_terminal
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma run_eventually_terminal {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n)
    {z : Coordinate n} (ht : Terminates P Q z) :
    ∀ M,attempts P Q z ≤ M → run P Q M z = terminalLog P Q z := by
  intro M hM
  exact run_of_stopped_le P Q z hM (attempts_spec P Q ht)

OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.terminalKL
OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.text:
noncomputable def terminalKL {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n) (z : Coordinate n) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  InformationTheory.klDiv (terminalLaw P Q (terminalLog P Q z))
    (uniformCell (terminalCell P Q (terminalLog P Q z)))

OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.terminal_depth_integrable
OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.text:
lemma terminal_depth_integrable {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) :
    Integrable (fun z => (depth P Q z:ℝ)) P := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hc := (terminal_cost_budget hn P Q hac hK).1
  apply Integrable.mono' (hc.div_const (entropySlope n/2)) (measurable_depth_real hn0 P Q).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with z
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _),le_div_iff₀ (div_pos (entropySlope_pos hn0) (by norm_num))]
  nlinarith [ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := terminalKL P Q z)]

OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.terminal_attempts_budget
OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.text:
lemma terminal_attempts_budget {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) :
    Integrable (fun z => (attempts P Q z:ℝ)) P ∧
      (∫ z,(attempts P Q z:ℝ) ∂P) ≤ 2*(1+∫ z,(depth P Q z:ℝ) ∂P) := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hroot := ae_mem_cell_of_ac hac
  have hterm := almost_sure_termination hn P Q hac hK
  have hd := terminal_depth_integrable hn P Q hac hK
  apply frozen_nonnegative_bound P (fun N z => (truncatedAttempts P Q N z:ℝ)) _ _
  · positivity
  · exact integrable_truncatedAttempts hn0 P Q
  · intro N z
    exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  · exact ((measurable_of_countable (fun a : ℕ => (a:ℝ))).comp (measurable_attempts hn0 P Q)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · intro z
    exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  · filter_upwards [hterm] with z ht
    refine ⟨attempts P Q z,fun M hM => ?_⟩
    simp only [truncatedAttempts,run_eventually_terminal P Q ht M hM,terminalLog_length P Q ht]
  · intro N
    have he : ∀ᵐ z ∂P,(truncatedDepth P Q N z:ℝ) ≤ (depth P Q z:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hroot,hterm] with z hz ht
      have hm := truncatedDepth_mono hn0 P Q hz (Nat.le_max_left N (attempts P Q z))
      have hf := run_eventually_terminal P Q ht (max N (attempts P Q z)) (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
      simp only [truncatedDepth,hf] at hm
      exact_mod_cast hm
    have hi := integral_mono_ae (truncated_depth_integrable hn0 P Q hac hK N) hd he
    exact (truncated_attempts_integral hn0 P Q hac hK N).trans (by linarith)

OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.terminal_cost_budget
OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.text:
lemma terminal_cost_budget {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) :
    Integrable (fun z => (terminalKL P Q z).toReal + entropySlope n/2*(depth P Q z:ℝ)) P ∧
      (∫ z,(terminalKL P Q z).toReal + entropySlope n/2*(depth P Q z:ℝ) ∂P) ≤
        (InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q)).toReal + 2/Real.exp 1 := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hs : 0 ≤ entropySlope n/2 := le_of_lt (div_pos (entropySlope_pos hn0) (by norm_num))
  apply frozen_nonnegative_bound P
    (fun N z => (historyKL P Q (run P Q N z)).toReal + entropySlope n/2*(truncatedDepth P Q N z:ℝ))
    _ _ (budget_nonneg P Q)
  · intro N
    exact (truncated_KL_integrable hn0 P Q hac hK N).add
      ((truncated_depth_integrable hn0 P Q hac hK N).const_mul _)
  · intro N z
    exact add_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  · exact ((measurable_terminalKL hn0 P Q).ennreal_toReal.add
      ((measurable_depth_real hn0 P Q).const_mul _)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · intro z
    exact add_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  · have hroot := ae_mem_cell_of_ac hac
    filter_upwards [hroot,almost_sure_termination hn P Q hac hK] with z hz ht
    refine ⟨attempts P Q z,fun M hM => ?_⟩
    have he := run_eventually_terminal P Q ht M hM
    simp only [truncatedDepth,he,← terminal_historyKL hn0 P Q hroot hz ht,depth,terminalCell]
  · exact truncated_final_budget hn P Q hac hK

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.frozen_nonnegative_bound
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma frozen_nonnegative_bound {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (P : Measure α)
    (f : ℕ → α → ℝ) (F : α → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ N,Integrable (f N) P) (hf0 : ∀ N z,0 ≤ f N z)
    (hF : AEStronglyMeasurable F P) (hF0 : ∀ z,0 ≤ F z)
    (hfreeze : ∀ᵐ z ∂P,∃ N,∀ M,N ≤ M → f M z = F z)
    (hbound : ∀ N,(∫ z,f N z ∂P) ≤ B) :
    Integrable F P ∧ (∫ z,F z ∂P) ≤ B := by
  have he : (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (F z)) =ᵐ[P]
      (fun z => liminf (fun N => ENNReal.ofReal (f N z)) atTop) := by
    filter_upwards [hfreeze] with z hz
    obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := hz
    have ht : Tendsto (fun M => ENNReal.ofReal (f M z)) atTop (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal (F z))) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N,fun M hM => congrArg ENNReal.ofReal (hN M hM).symm⟩)
    exact ht.liminf_eq.symm
  have hb : (∫⁻ z,ENNReal.ofReal (F z) ∂P) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B := by
    rw [lintegral_congr_ae he]
    apply (lintegral_liminf_le' (fun N => (hf N).aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal)).trans
    apply liminf_le_of_frequently_le'
    apply Filter.Eventually.frequently
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun N => by
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hf N) (ae_of_all _ (hf0 N))]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hbound N))
  have hi : Integrable F P := ⟨hF,(hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (ae_of_all _ hF0)).mpr
    (hb.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)⟩
  refine ⟨hi,?_⟩
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (ae_of_all _ hF0)] at hb
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hB).mp hb

OAI.Probability.Localization.Rewards:103.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.positive_event_descendant
OAI.Probability.Localization.Rewards:103.text:
lemma positive_event_descendant {n : ℕ} (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n) (h : Log n)
    (hp : P (state P Q h).event ≠ 0) : Descendant Q (state P Q h).cell := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := nonempty_of_measure_ne_zero hp
  exact state_descendant_of_mem P Q h hz

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.almost_sure_termination
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma almost_sure_termination {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂P,Terminates P Q z := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  let E := {z | ¬Terminates P Q z}
  have hE : MeasurableSet E := (measurableSet_terminates hn0 P Q).compl
  apply ae_iff.mpr
  change P E = 0
  by_contra hp
  have hp0 : 0 < (P E).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hp (measure_ne_top _ _)
  let B := 2*(1+((InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q)).toReal + 2/Real.exp 1)/(entropySlope n/2))
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (B/(P E).toReal)
  have hconst : ∀ z ∈ E,(truncatedAttempts P Q N z:ℝ) = N := by
    intro z hz
    have ha : (state P Q (run P Q N z)).stopped = false := by
      apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
      intro hs
      exact hz ⟨N,hs⟩
    exact congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (k:ℝ)) (run_length_of_active P Q N z ha)
  have hi := setIntegral_le_integral (s := E) (integrable_truncatedAttempts hn0 P Q N)
    (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun hE hconst,integral_const] at hi
  simp only [Measure.real,Measure.restrict_apply_univ,smul_eq_mul] at hi
  have hb := truncated_uniform_attempts hn P Q hac hK N
  change _ ≤ B at hb
  have hN' := (div_lt_iff₀ hp0).mp hN
  nlinarith

OAI.Probability.Localization.EntropyBudg.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.truncated_attempts_integral
OAI.Probability.Localization.EntropyBudg.text:
lemma truncated_attempts_integral {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ z,(truncatedAttempts P Q N z:ℝ) ∂P) ≤ 2*(1+∫ z,(truncatedDepth P Q N z:ℝ) ∂P) := by
  have hroot := ae_mem_cell_of_ac hac
  have hC := (truncated_reward_bounds hn P Q hroot N).2
  have hD := truncated_depth_integrable hn P Q hac hK N
  have hp : ∀ᵐ z ∂P,(truncatedAttempts P Q N z:ℝ) ≤
      (truncatedDepth P Q N z:ℝ) + continuingTotal P Q N z + 1 := by
    filter_upwards [hroot] with z hz
    have hb := truncated_attempts_path hn P Q N hz
    have hs : (if (state P Q (run P Q N z)).stopped then (1:ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by split <;> norm_num
    linarith
  have hi := integral_mono_ae (integrable_truncatedAttempts hn P Q N)
    ((hD.add hC.1).add (integrable_const 1)) hp
  have had := integral_add (hD.add hC.1) (integrable_const (1:ℝ))
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi had
  rw [had,integral_add hD hC.1] at hi
  simp only [integral_const,Measure.real,measure_univ,ENNReal.toReal_one,one_smul] at hi
  linarith [hC.2.2]

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.truncated_uniform_attempts
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma truncated_uniform_attempts {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ z,(truncatedAttempts P Q N z:ℝ) ∂P) ≤
      2*(1+((InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q)).toReal + 2/Real.exp 1)/(entropySlope n/2)) := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hB := truncated_final_budget hn P Q hac hK N
  rw [integral_add (truncated_KL_integrable hn0 P Q hac hK N)
    ((truncated_depth_integrable hn0 P Q hac hK N).const_mul _),integral_const_mul] at hB
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ ∫ z,(historyKL P Q (run P Q N z)).toReal ∂P := integral_nonneg (fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
  have hd : (∫ z,(truncatedDepth P Q N z:ℝ) ∂P) ≤
      ((InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q)).toReal + 2/Real.exp 1)/(entropySlope n/2) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (div_pos (entropySlope_pos hn0) (by norm_num))]
    nlinarith
  exact (truncated_attempts_integral hn0 P Q hac hK N).trans (by linarith)

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.truncatedDepth_mono
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma truncatedDepth_mono {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n)
    {z : Coordinate n} (hz : z ∈ cellSet Q) : Monotone (fun N => truncatedDepth P Q N z) := by
  classical
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro N
  by_cases hs : (state P Q (run P Q N z)).stopped = true
  · simp only [truncatedDepth,run,hs,ite_true,le_refl]
  let s := state P Q (run P Q N z)
  let a := attemptLetter (ProbabilityTheory.cond P s.event) s.cell z
  have erun : run P Q (N+1) z = run P Q N z ++ [a] := by simp only [run,hs,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]; rfl
  simp only [truncatedDepth,erun,state_append,update,hs,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
  cases ha : a with
  | none => simp only [Option.getD_none,le_refl]
  | some R =>
    have hcell := state_event_subset_cell P Q _ (run_mem_event P Q N hz)
    have hbranch : z ∈ branch (ProbabilityTheory.cond P s.event) s.cell (some R) :=
      (attemptLetter_eq_iff hn _ _ hcell (some R)).mp ha
    have hR : FirstHeavy (ProbabilityTheory.cond P s.event) s.cell R := by
      by_contra hR
      simp only [branch,ite_eq_right hR,Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at hbranch
    exact Nat.sub_le_sub_right hR.1.1.1 Q.1

OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.measurable_depth_real
OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.text:
lemma measurable_depth_real {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) (Q : Cell n) :
    Measurable (fun z => (depth P Q z:ℝ)) :=
  (measurable_of_countable (fun h : Log n => (((terminalCell P Q h).1-Q.1:ℕ):ℝ))).comp
    (measurable_terminalLog hn P Q)

OAI.Probability.Localization.Main:12.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.finite_expected_regularization
OAI.Probability.Localization.Main:12.text:
theorem finite_expected_regularization : FiniteEntropyStatement := by
  refine ⟨32,fun n hn Q P hP hac hK => ?_⟩
  let := hP
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  refine ⟨almost_sure_termination hn P Q hac hK,measurable_terminalLog hn0 P Q,?_,
    terminal_depth_integrable hn P Q hac hK,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro h hp
    exact ⟨(terminal_regular hn P Q hac hK h hp).1,(terminal_regular hn P Q hac hK h hp).2.1⟩
  · exact (terminal_attempts_budget hn P Q hac hK).1
  · exact (terminal_attempts_budget hn P Q hac hK).2
  · exact terminal_ennreal_budget hn P Q hac hK

end FiniteEntropy

end RepeatedLocalization

end OAI

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.terminal_regular
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma terminal_regular {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞)
    (h : Log n) (hp : P {z | terminalLog P Q z = h} ≠ 0) :
    Descendant Q (terminalCell P Q h) ∧ Regular (terminalLaw P Q h) (terminalCell P Q h) ∧
      InformationTheory.klDiv (terminalLaw P Q h) (uniformCell (terminalCell P Q h)) ≠ ∞ := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hroot := ae_mem_cell_of_ac hac
  have hterm := almost_sure_termination hn P Q hac hK
  obtain ⟨z,hzh,hz,ht⟩ := exists_fiber_good P (terminalLog P Q)
    (fun z => z ∈ cellSet Q ∧ Terminates P Q z) (hroot.and hterm) h hp
  have he : {w | terminalLog P Q w = h} =ᵐ[P] (state P Q h).event := by
    simpa only [hzh] using terminal_fiber_ae_event hn0 P Q hroot hz ht
  have hp' : P (state P Q h).event ≠ 0 := by rwa [← measure_congr he]
  have hstop : (state P Q h).stopped = true := by
    rw [← hzh]
    exact attempts_spec P Q ht
  have hLaw : terminalLaw P Q h = ProbabilityTheory.cond P (state P Q h).event := cond_congr_ae P he
  refine ⟨positive_event_descendant P Q h hp',?_,?_⟩
  · rw [hLaw]
    exact history_regular_of_stopped hn0 P Q h hp' hstop
  · rw [hLaw]
    exact (historyKL_ne_top_budget hn0 P Q hac hK h hp').1

end FiniteEntropy

end RepeatedLocalization

end OAI

OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.terminal_ennreal_budget
OAI.Probability.Localization.TerminalBud.text:
lemma terminal_ennreal_budget {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) :
    (∫⁻ z,terminalKL P Q z ∂P) + ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.log 2/4)*n*(∫ z,(depth P Q z:ℝ) ∂P)) ≤
      InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) + ENNReal.ofReal (2/Real.exp 1) := by
  have hd := terminal_depth_integrable hn P Q hac hK
  have hk := terminal_KL_integrable hn P Q hac hK
  have hc := (terminal_cost_budget hn P Q hac hK).2
  rw [integral_add hk (hd.const_mul _),integral_const_mul] at hc
  have hfin : ∀ᵐ z ∂P,terminalKL P Q z ≠ ∞ := by
    filter_upwards [ae_fiber_positive P (terminalLog P Q)] with z hz
    exact (terminal_regular hn P Q hac hK (terminalLog P Q z) hz).2.2
  have he : (∫⁻ z,terminalKL P Q z ∂P) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z,(terminalKL P Q z).toReal ∂P) := by
    rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hk (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg))]
    exact lintegral_congr_ae (hfin.mono (fun z hz => (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hz).symm))
  have hs : (Real.log 2/4)*(n:ℝ) = entropySlope n/2 := by unfold entropySlope; ring
  rw [he,hs,← ENNReal.ofReal_add (integral_nonneg (fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg))]
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q)).toReal+2/Real.exp 1) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hc
    _ = _ := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add ENNReal.toReal_nonneg,ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hK]
      positivity
  · exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (div_pos (entropySlope_pos (by omega)) (by norm_num)))
      (integral_nonneg (fun _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _))

end FiniteEntropy

end RepeatedLocalization

end OAI

OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.history_regular_of_stopped
OAI.Probability.Localization.Termination.text:
lemma history_regular_of_stopped {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsFiniteMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (h : Log n) (hp : P (state P Q h).event ≠ 0) (hs : (state P Q h).stopped = true) :
    Regular (ProbabilityTheory.cond P (state P Q h).event) (state P Q h).cell := by
  induction h using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp only [state_nil,Bool.false_eq_true] at hs
  | append_singleton h a ih =>
    have hp0 : P (state P Q h).event ≠ 0 := by
      intro he
      exact hp (measure_mono_null (state_event_append_subset P Q h a) he)
    by_cases hs0 : (state P Q h).stopped = true
    · simp only [state_append,update,hs0,ite_true] at hs ⊢
      exact ih hp0 hs0
    let := ProbabilityTheory.cond_isProbabilityMeasure (μ := P) hp0
    cases a with
    | some R => simp [state_append,update,hs0] at hs
    | none =>
      have hq : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ ((ProbabilityTheory.cond P (state P Q h).event)
          (residual (ProbabilityTheory.cond P (state P Q h).event) (state P Q h).cell)).toReal := by
        simpa [state_append,update,hs0,branch] using hs
      have hr := stopped_regular hn (ProbabilityTheory.cond P (state P Q h).event) (state P Q h).cell hq
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.cond_cond_eq_cond_inter' (state_event_measurable P Q h)
        (measurableSet_residual _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)] at hr
      simpa [state_append,update,hs0,branch] using hr

lemma terminal_KL_integrable {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞) :
    Integrable (fun z => (terminalKL P Q z).toReal) P := by
  have hc := (terminal_cost_budget hn P Q hac hK).1

OAI.Probability.Localization.EntropyBudg.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.FiniteEntropy.historyKL_ne_top_budget
OAI.Probability.Localization.EntropyBudg.text:
lemma historyKL_ne_top_budget {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (P : Measure (Coordinate n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Q : Cell n) (hac : P ≪ uniformCell Q) (hK : InformationTheory.klDiv P (uniformCell Q) ≠ ∞)
    (h : Log n) (hp : P (state P Q h).event ≠ 0) :
    historyKL P Q h ≠ ∞ ∧
    (P (state P Q h).event).toReal * historyCost P Q h ≤
      (∫ z in (state P Q h).event,llr P (uniformCell Q) z ∂P) +
        (P (state P Q h).event).toReal * rewardLog P Q (complementReward P) h := by
  let := uniformCell_probability hn Q
  have hd := positive_event_descendant P Q h hp
  have hk := klDiv_cond_cond P (uniformCell Q) hac hK (state_event_measurable P Q h)
    (measurableSet_cellSet _) (state_event_subset_cell P Q h) hp (uniformCell_descendant_pos hn hd)
  rw [uniformCell_cond hd,uniformCell_log_mass hn hd] at hk
  refine ⟨hk.1,?_⟩
  have hroot : P (cellSet Q) = 1 := (mem_ae_iff_prob_eq_one (measurableSet_cellSet Q)).mp (ae_mem_cell_of_ac hac)
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (path_label_surprisal P Q hroot h hp) (ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := P (state P Q h).event))
  have he := hk.2
  change (P (state P Q h).event).toReal * ((historyKL P Q h).toReal + entropySlope n * _) ≤ _
  change (P (state P Q h).event).toReal * (historyKL P Q h).toReal = _ at he
  unfold entropySlope
  nlinarith

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.lintegral_greedy_raw_le
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.text:
lemma lintegral_greedy_raw_le {d k : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hα : 10*(k:ℝ) ≤ ((d:ℝ)-1)/2) (ν : Measure (Ambient d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : BallBound ν) (u : Ambient d) :
    (∫⁻ z,(GreedyEvent u).indicator (rawInverse u) z ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (baseExponent d k))*3^k := by
  let F : ℕ → (Fin k → Ambient d) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun L =>
    (GreedyEvent u).indicator (fun z => clippedInverse ((1/2:ℝ)^L) (translated u z))
  have hF : ∀ L,Measurable (F L) := fun L =>
    ((measurable_clippedInverse _).comp (measurable_translated u)).indicator (measurableSet_greedyEvent u)
  have hlim : ∀ z,Filter.Tendsto (fun L => F L z) Filter.atTop
      (nhds ((GreedyEvent u).indicator (rawInverse u) z)) := by
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z∈GreedyEvent u
    · simpa only [F,indicator_of_mem hz] using tendsto_clippedInverse u z
    · simp only [F,indicator_of_notMem hz]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ z,Filter.liminf (fun L => F L z) Filter.atTop ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν) :=
      lintegral_congr (fun z => (hlim z).liminf_eq.symm)
    _ ≤ Filter.liminf (fun L => ∫⁻ z,F L z ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)) Filter.atTop :=
      lintegral_liminf_le hF
    _ ≤ _ := Filter.liminf_le_of_frequently_le (Filter.Eventually.frequently (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      (fun L => lintegral_greedy_clipped_le hd hk hα ν hν (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2) L) u)))

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.extendRealization
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.text:
noncomputable def extendRealization {n N t : ℕ} {s s' : AnalysisState n}
    {f : s.Index → History N t} {q : s.Index → FiniteChannel (Coordinate n) (Fin N)}
    {g : s'.Index → s.Index × Fin N} (R : Realization s f) (E : ExtensionWitness s q s' g) :
    Realization s' (fun j => Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin (t+1) => Fin N) (f (g j).1) (g j).2) := by
  classical
  let rd := fun (z : Coordinate n) (w : History N (t+1)) => E.choose (R.read z (Fin.init w),w (Fin.last t)) z
  have hrd : Measurable (fun zw : Coordinate n × History N (t+1) => rd zw.1 zw.2) := by
    apply E.choose_meas.comp (f := fun zw : Coordinate n × History N (t+1) => ((R.read zw.1 (Fin.init zw.2),zw.2 (Fin.last t)),zw.1))
    exact ((R.read_meas.comp (measurable_fst.prodMk ((measurable_of_countable (fun w : History N (t+1) => Fin.init w)).comp measurable_snd))).prodMk
      ((measurable_of_countable (fun w : History N (t+1) => w (Fin.last t))).comp measurable_snd)).prodMk measurable_fst
  have herase (z : Coordinate n) (w : History N (t+1)) :
      g (rd z w) = (R.read z (Fin.init w),w (Fin.last t)) := E.erase_choose _ _
  let Q : Disclosure n N (t+1) := Fin.lastCases (fun z w => s'.cell (rd z w)) R.Q
  let tr : s'.Index → Fin (t+1) → Cell n := fun j => Fin.snoc (R.trace (g j).1) (s'.cell j)
  refine {
    Q := Q
    Qmeas := ?_
    Qfinite := ?_
    read := rd
    read_meas := hrd
    erase_read := ?_
    chosen := ?_
    trace := tr
    trace_read := ?_
    trace_cube := ?_
    trace_below := ?_
    trace_nested := ?_
    cell_cube := fun j => (E.subset j).trans (R.cell_cube (g j).1)
    read_mem := ?_
    depth_read := ?_ }
  · intro i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp only [Q,Fin.lastCases_last]
      change Measurable (fun zw : Coordinate n × History N (t+1) => s'.cell (rd zw.1 zw.2))
      exact (measurable_of_countable s'.cell).comp hrd
    · simp only [Q,Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
      change Measurable (fun zw : Coordinate n × History N (j.val+1) => R.Q j zw.1 zw.2)
      exact R.Qmeas j
  · intro i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp only [Q,Fin.lastCases_last]
      change (Set.range (fun zw : Coordinate n × History N (t+1) => s'.cell (rd zw.1 zw.2))).Finite
      apply (Set.finite_range s'.cell).subset
      rintro c ⟨zw,rfl⟩
      exact ⟨rd zw.1 zw.2,rfl⟩
    · simp only [Q,Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
      change (Set.range (fun zh : Coordinate n × History N (j.val+1) => R.Q j zh.1 zh.2)).Finite
      exact R.Qfinite j
  · intro z w
    rw [herase,R.erase_read]
    exact Fin.snoc_init_self w
  · intro j z hz
    dsimp only [rd]
    rw [Fin.init_snoc,Fin.snoc_last,R.chosen (g j).1 z (E.positive_parent j z hz)]
    exact E.chosen j z hz
  · intro z w i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [tr,Q,through_last]
    · simp only [tr,Q,Fin.snoc_castSucc,Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
      rw [herase]
      simpa only [through_init] using R.trace_read z (Fin.init w) j
  · intro j i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
    · simp only [tr,Fin.snoc_last]
      exact (E.subset j).trans (R.cell_cube _)
    · simp only [tr,Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact R.trace_cube _ k
  · intro j i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
    · simp only [tr,Fin.snoc_last]
      exact Subset.rfl
    · simp only [tr,Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (E.subset j).trans (R.trace_below _ k)
  · intro k i j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun a => ?_) i
    · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun b => ?_) j
      · intro _; exact Subset.rfl
      · intro h; exact False.elim (by have := b.isLt; change t ≤ b.val at h; omega)
    · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun b => ?_) j
      · intro _
        simp only [tr,Fin.snoc_last,Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        exact (E.subset k).trans (R.trace_below _ a)
      · intro h
        simpa only [tr,Fin.snoc_castSucc] using R.trace_nested (g k).1 a b h
  · intro z hz w
    exact E.contains _ z (R.read_mem z hz (Fin.init w))
  · intro z w
    simp only [finalLevel,show 0 < t+1 by omega,dite_eq_left]
    change (Q (Fin.last t) z (through w (Fin.last t))).1 = (s'.cell (rd z w)).1
    rw [through_last]
    simp only [Q,Fin.lastCases_last]

end RepeatedLocalization

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Kern.name: OAI.KernelPotential.FiniteMessage.actual_row_drift_bound
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Kern.text:
lemma actual_row_drift_bound {d N : ℕ} (hd : 16 ≤ d) (hN : 0 < N)
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d × Fin N)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : μ.map Prod.fst=sphereProbability d) (rule : BlockRule d N) :
    averagePhi (outgoingLaw μ rule) ≤ averagePhi μ+95*(d:ℝ)+6*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+
      2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ) := by
  have (v : Fin N) := component_finite μ v
  let ρ := fun v w => (component μ v).withDensity (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal ((localRule rule v).response w s))
  have hρf (v w) : IsFiniteMeasure (ρ v w) := density_finite _ _ (fun s => ((localRule rule v).response_bounds w s).2)
  have hρ (v w) : ρ v w ≤ sphereProbability d :=
    (density_le _ _ (fun s => ((localRule rule v).response_bounds w s).2)).trans (component_le_sphere μ hμ v)
  have hforget : averagePhi (outgoingLaw μ rule) ≤ ∑ w : Fin N,∑ v : Fin N,energy (ρ v w) := by
    rw [averagePhi_energy]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro w _
    rw [component_outgoing,rowSlice_eq]
    exact energy_mixture hd (fun v => ρ v w) (fun v => hρf v w) (fun v => hρ v w)
  have hlocal := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun v _ =>
    local_energy_bound hd hN (component μ v) (component_le_sphere μ hμ v) (localRule rule v))
  have hcharge := entropy_charge (d := d) (by omega) hN (fun v => (component μ v univ).toReal)
    (fun v => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) (component_masses_sum μ hμ)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm] at hforget
  have hsum := hforget.trans hlocal
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← averagePhi_energy] at hsum
  linarith
end KernelPotential.FiniteMessage

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.history_analysis_realized
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.text:
lemma history_analysis_realized {n N t : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (rules : Rules n N t)
    (L : ℝ) (hcost : UniformBlockCost n N L) :
    ∃ s : AnalysisState n, ∃ f : s.Index → History N t,
      s.channel.coarsen f = historyChannel rules ∧
      s.potential ≤ (t:ℝ)*(L+2*Real.log 2+1) ∧ Nonempty (Realization s f) := by
  classical
  have := cubePrior_isProbabilityMeasure hn
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨initialState hn,(fun _ => Fin.elim0),?_,?_,⟨initialRealization hn⟩⟩
    · apply FiniteChannel.ext_prob
      funext w z
      have hw : (Fin.elim0 : History N 0) = w := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [initialState,FiniteChannel.coarsen,historyChannel,historyLikelihood,hw,
        Finset.prod_empty,Finset.univ_eq_empty,Finset.sum_const]
      norm_num [Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_unique]
      change @Fintype.card Unit _ = 1
      exact Fintype.card_unique
    · rw [initialState_potential]; simp
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨s,f,hf,hs,⟨R⟩⟩ := ih (initRules rules)
    let r := fun w : History N t => blockChannel (rules (Fin.last t) w)
    let q := fun i : s.Index => r (f i)
    have H (i : s.Index) (hi : 0 < scoreMass (cubePrior n) (s.channel.prob i)) :
        finiteInformation (scorePosterior (cubePrior n) (s.channel.prob i)) (q i).prob ≤
          L+Real.log (s.B i) := by
      have hp := scorePosterior_probability (cubePrior n) _ (s.channel.measurable i)
        (s.channel.nonneg i) (s.channel.le_one i) hi
      exact hcost _ hp _ _ (s.support i hi) (s.B_one i) (s.spread i hi) (rules (Fin.last t) (f i))
    obtain ⟨s',g,hg,hs',⟨E⟩⟩ := analysis_extension_realized hn s q L H
    let F : s.Index × Fin N → History N t × Fin N := fun i => (f i.1,i.2)
    let f' := appendHistoryEquiv N t ∘ F ∘ g
    refine ⟨s',f',?_,?_,⟨extendRealization R E⟩⟩
    · apply FiniteChannel.ext_prob
      have hg' := FiniteChannel.ext_prob hg
      have hmap : (s.channel.bind q).coarsen F = (s.channel.coarsen f).bind r :=
        FiniteChannel.ext_prob (s.channel.coarsen_bind_map f r)
      calc
        (s'.channel.coarsen f').prob =
            (((s'.channel.coarsen g).coarsen F).coarsen (appendHistoryEquiv N t)).prob := by
          rw [FiniteChannel.coarsen_comp,FiniteChannel.coarsen_comp]
          rfl
        _ = (((historyChannel (initRules rules)).bind r).coarsen (appendHistoryEquiv N t)).prob := by
          rw [hg',hmap,hf]
        _ = (historyChannel rules).prob := historyChannel_succ rules
    · rw [Nat.cast_succ]
      linarith

end RepeatedLocalization

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.Realization
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.text:
structure Realization {n N t : ℕ} (s : AnalysisState n) (f : s.Index → History N t) where
  Q : Disclosure n N t
  Qmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (fun zh : Coordinate n × History N (i.val+1) => Q i zh.1 zh.2)
  Qfinite : ∀ i, (Set.range (fun zh : Coordinate n × History N (i.val+1) => Q i zh.1 zh.2)).Finite
  read : Coordinate n → History N t → s.Index
  read_meas : Measurable (fun zw : Coordinate n × History N t => read zw.1 zw.2)
  erase_read : ∀ z w, f (read z w) = w
  chosen : ∀ j z, 0 < s.channel.prob j z → read z (f j) = j
  trace : s.Index → Fin t → Cell n
  trace_read : ∀ z w i, trace (read z w) i = Q i z (through w i)
  trace_cube : ∀ j i, cellSet (trace j i) ⊆ initialCube n
  trace_below : ∀ j i, cellSet (s.cell j) ⊆ cellSet (trace j i)
  trace_nested : ∀ k (i j : Fin t), i ≤ j → cellSet (trace k j) ⊆ cellSet (trace k i)
  cell_cube : ∀ j, cellSet (s.cell j) ⊆ initialCube n
  read_mem : ∀ z ∈ initialCube n, ∀ w, z ∈ cellSet (s.cell (read z w))
  depth_read : ∀ z w, finalLevel Q (z,w) = (s.cell (read z w)).1

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.lintegral_raw_le
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.text:
lemma lintegral_raw_le {d k : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hα : 10*(k:ℝ) ≤ ((d:ℝ)-1)/2) (ν : Measure (Ambient d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hν : BallBound ν) (u : Ambient d) :
    (∫⁻ z,rawInverse u z ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)) ≤
      (k.factorial:ℝ≥0∞)*(ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (baseExponent d k))*3^k) := by
  classical
  let F : (Fin k → Ambient d) → ℝ≥0∞ := (GreedyEvent u).indicator (rawInverse u)
  have hF : Measurable F := (measurable_rawInverse u).indicator (measurableSet_greedyEvent u)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ z,∑ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),F (z ∘ π) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν) := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro z
      obtain ⟨π,hπ⟩ := exists_greedy_gram_order (translated u z)
      have hz : z ∘ π ∈ GreedyEvent u := hπ
      have he : F (z ∘ π)=rawInverse u z := by
        dsimp only [F]
        rw [indicator_of_mem hz,rawInverse_perm]
      rw [← he]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) => F (z ∘ π)) (fun _ _ => bot_le) (Finset.mem_univ π)
    _ = ∑ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),∫⁻ z,F (z ∘ π) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν) :=
      lintegral_finsetSum _ (fun π _ => (hF.comp (measurePreserving_permutation ν π).measurable))
    _ = ∑ _π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),∫⁻ z,F z ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro π _
      exact (measurePreserving_permutation ν π).lintegral_comp hF
    _ ≤ ∑ _π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (baseExponent d k))*3^k :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun _ _ => lintegral_greedy_raw_le hd hk hα ν hν u)
    _ = _ := by simp [Fintype.card_perm,nsmul_eq_mul]

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.inverse_volume_without_support
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.text:
theorem inverse_volume_without_support : InverseVolumeStatement := by
  refine ⟨20,by norm_num,300,?_⟩
  intro d hd ν hprob hν u
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hprob
  have hd1 : 1 ≤ d := by omega
  have hk3 : 3 ≤ d/100 := by omega
  have hk : d/100 ≤ d := Nat.div_le_self _ _
  have hk100 : 100*(d/100) ≤ d := by omega
  have hα : 10*(d/100:ℕ) ≤ ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 := by
    have hh : 100*(d/100:ℕ) ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk100
    have hd' : (300:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    nlinarith
  change (∫⁻ z,rawInverse u z ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (d/100) => ν)) ≤ _
  exact (lintegral_raw_le hd1 hk3 hα ν hν u).trans (inverse_constants hd1 hk)

end AllScaleInverseVolume

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.rawInverse_perm
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.text:
lemma rawInverse_perm {d k : ℕ} (u : Ambient d) (z : Fin k → Ambient d)
    (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) : rawInverse u (z ∘ π)=rawInverse u z := by
  have hg : Matrix.gram ℝ (translated u (z ∘ π))=
      (Matrix.gram ℝ (translated u z)).submatrix π π := rfl
  unfold rawInverse
  rw [hg,Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self]

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.rawInverse
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.text:
noncomputable def rawInverse {d k : ℕ} (u : Ambient d) (z : Fin k → Ambient d) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ((ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.gram ℝ (translated u z)).det))⁻¹)^k

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.measurePreserving_permutation
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.text:
lemma measurePreserving_permutation {d k : ℕ} (ν : Measure (Ambient d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun z : Fin k → Ambient d => z ∘ π)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)) (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)) := by
  have hh := MeasurePreserving.symm (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin k => Ambient d) π)
    (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin k => ν) π)
  have he : ((MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ : Fin k => Ambient d) π).symm :
      (Fin k → Ambient d) → (Fin k → Ambient d))=(fun z => z ∘ π) := by
    funext z i
    rfl
  simpa only [he] using hh

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.name: OAI.AllScaleInverseVolume.inverse_constants
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Inve.text:
lemma inverse_constants {d k : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hk : k ≤ d) :
    (k.factorial:ℝ≥0∞)*(ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (baseExponent d k))*3^k) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (20*d*k)) := by
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ d := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hk0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hkd : (k:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hfact : (k.factorial:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((d:ℝ)*k) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (k:ℝ)^k := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow k
      _ ≤ (Real.exp (d:ℝ))^k := pow_le_pow_left₀ hk0 (hkd.trans (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (d:ℝ)])) _
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
  have h3 : (3:ℝ)^k ≤ Real.exp ((2:ℝ)*k) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 2)^k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (2:ℝ)]) _
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
  have hexp : (d:ℝ)*k+baseExponent d k+2*k ≤ 20*d*k := by
    have hlog5 : Real.log 5 ≤ 5 := (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num)).trans (by norm_num)
    have hlog3 : Real.log 3 ≤ 3 := (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num)).trans (by norm_num)
    have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 2 := (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num)).trans (by norm_num)
    have ht5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog5 hk0
    have ht3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog3 (show 0 ≤ ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 by linarith)
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add ht5 ht3) hk0
    have ht2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlog2 (sq_nonneg (k:ℝ))
    have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkd hk0
    have hs1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd1 hk0
    unfold baseExponent
    nlinarith
  have hr : (k.factorial:ℝ)*(Real.exp (baseExponent d k)*3^k) ≤ Real.exp (20*d*k) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((d:ℝ)*k)*(Real.exp (baseExponent d k)*Real.exp (2*k)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul hfact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (Real.exp_pos _).le) (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp ((d:ℝ)*k+baseExponent d k+2*k) := by rw [Real.exp_add,Real.exp_add]; ring
      _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp
  have hh := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hr
  simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _),ENNReal.ofReal_natCast,
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_pos _).le, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat] using hh

end AllScaleInverseVolume

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Kern.name: OAI.KernelPotential.MassPotential.local_energy_bound
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Kern.text:
lemma local_energy_bound {d N : ℕ} (hd : 16 ≤ d) (hN : 0 < N)
    (ρ : Measure (Ambient d)) [IsFiniteMeasure ρ] (hρ : ρ ≤ sphereProbability d)
    (rule : LocalRule (d/16) d N) :
    (∑ w,energy (ρ.withDensity (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (rule.response w s)))) ≤
      energy ρ+(ρ univ).toReal*(95*(d:ℝ)+6*Real.log (1/(ρ univ).toReal)/(d:ℝ)+
        2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ)) := by
  by_cases hz : ρ univ=0
  · have he := Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero.mp hz
    simp [he,energy_zero]
  · let a := (ρ univ).toReal
    have ha : 0 < a := ENNReal.toReal_pos hz (measure_ne_top _ _)
    have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by
      have hh := hρ univ
      rw [measure_univ (μ := sphereProbability d)] at hh
      simpa [a] using ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top hh
    let ν := proper ρ
    have : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := proper_probability ρ
    have hH : 1 ≤ 1/a := (le_div_iff₀ ha).mpr (by simpa using ha1)
    have hν : ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1/a) • sphereProbability d := by
      have he : ENNReal.ofReal (1/a)=(ρ univ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [one_div,ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos ha,ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top _ _)]
      rw [he]
      change proper ρ ≤ _
      rw [proper,ite_eq_right hz]
      exact smul_le_smul_left _ hρ
    have he (w : Fin N) : energy (ρ.withDensity (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (rule.response w s)))=
        a*(mass ν (rule.response w)*Phi (post ν (rule.response w))) := by
      have := density_finite ν (rule.response w) (fun s => (rule.response_bounds w s).2)
      calc _ = energy (ENNReal.ofReal a • ν.withDensity (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (rule.response w s))) := by
                 congr 1
                 rw [← withDensity_smul_measure]
                 congr 1
                 exact (mass_smul_proper ρ).symm
           _ = a*energy (ν.withDensity (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (rule.response w s))) := energy_smul _ a ha.le
           _ = _ := by rw [energy_density ν _ (rule.measurable_response w)
                       (fun s => (rule.response_bounds w s).1) (fun s => (rule.response_bounds w s).2)]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (borel_bound hd hN ν hH hν rule) ha.le
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [energy_proper]
    change _ ≤ a*Phi ν+a*(95*(d:ℝ)+6*Real.log (1/a)/(d:ℝ)+2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ))
    calc _ ≤ a*(Phi ν+95*(d:ℝ)+6*Real.log (1/a)/(d:ℝ)+2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ)) := hh
         _ = _ := by ring
end KernelPotential.MassPotential

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Kern.name: OAI.KernelPotential.numeric_drift_charge
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Kern.text:
lemma numeric_drift_charge {d N : ℕ} (hd : 32 ≤ d) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hlog : Real.log N ≤ (d:ℝ)^2) :
    95*(d:ℝ)+6*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ) ≤ 135*(d:ℝ) := by
  have hdR : 0 < (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
  have hk : 0 < d/16 := by omega
  have hkR : (0:ℝ) < (d/16:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hdk : d ≤ 32*(d/16) := by omega
  have hdkR : (d:ℝ) ≤ 32*(d/16:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hdk
  have h6 : 6*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ) ≤ 6*(d:ℝ) := (div_le_iff₀ hdR).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have h2 : 2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ) ≤ 2*(d:ℝ) := (div_le_iff₀ hdR).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have h32 : Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ) ≤ 32*(d:ℝ) := by
    calc
      Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ) ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ)/((d:ℝ)/32) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hN))
          (by positivity) ((div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hdkR))
      _ ≤ 32*(d:ℝ) := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by nlinarith)
  linarith

lemma measurable_rawInverse {d k : ℕ} (u : Ambient d) : Measurable (rawInverse (k := k) u) := by
  have hm : Measurable (fun z : Fin k → Ambient d => ∏ i,‖gramSchmidt ℝ (translated u z) i‖) :=
    Finset.measurable_prod _ (fun i _ => ((measurable_gramSchmidt i).comp (measurable_translated u)).norm)

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.analysis_extension_realized
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.text:
lemma analysis_extension_realized {n N : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (s : AnalysisState n)
    (q : s.Index → FiniteChannel (Coordinate n) (Fin N)) (L : ℝ)
    (hcost : ∀ i,0 < scoreMass (cubePrior n) (s.channel.prob i) →
      finiteInformation (scorePosterior (cubePrior n) (s.channel.prob i)) (q i).prob ≤ L+Real.log (s.B i)) :
    ∃ s' : AnalysisState n, ∃ f : s'.Index → (s.Index × Fin N),
      (s'.channel.coarsen f).prob = (s.channel.bind q).prob ∧
      s'.potential ≤ s.potential+L+2*Real.log 2+1 ∧ Nonempty (ExtensionWitness s q s' f) := by
  classical
  let μ := cubePrior n
  have := cubePrior_isProbabilityMeasure hn
  let r := s.channel.bind q
  have hparentsupport (i : s.Index × Fin N) (hi : 0 < scoreMass μ (r.prob i)) :
      scorePosterior μ (r.prob i) (cellSet (s.cell i.1)) = 1 := by
    have hP := s.channel.bind_positive_parent q μ i hi
    have := scorePosterior_probability μ _ (r.measurable i) (r.nonneg i) (r.le_one i) hi
    have := scorePosterior_probability μ _ (s.channel.measurable i.1) (s.channel.nonneg i.1) (s.channel.le_one i.1) hP
    have hz := (scorePosterior_null_iff μ _ (s.channel.measurable i.1) (s.channel.nonneg i.1) hP
      _ (measurableSet_cellSet (s.cell i.1)).compl).mp
        ((prob_compl_eq_zero_iff (measurableSet_cellSet (s.cell i.1))).mpr (s.support i.1 hP))
    apply (prob_compl_eq_zero_iff (measurableSet_cellSet (s.cell i.1))).mp
    apply (scorePosterior_null_iff μ _ (r.measurable i) (r.nonneg i) hi _
      (measurableSet_cellSet (s.cell i.1)).compl).mpr
    filter_upwards [hz] with x hx
    intro hnot
    change s.channel.prob i.1 x*(q i.1).prob i.2 x = 0
    rw [hx hnot,zero_mul]
  have hex (i : s.Index × Fin N) : Nonempty (HeavyRefinement n (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (s.cell i.1)) := by
    by_cases h : 0 < scoreMass μ (r.prob i)
    · have := scorePosterior_probability μ _ (r.measurable i) (r.nonneg i) (r.le_one i) h
      exact exists_heavy_refinement hn (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (s.cell i.1) (hparentsupport i h)
        (div_nonneg zero_le_one h.le) (posterior_cube_domination hn r i h)
    · have hz : scoreMass μ (r.prob i) = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt h) (scoreMass_nonneg μ _ (r.nonneg i))
      rw [scorePosterior_of_mass_zero μ _ hz]
      exact zero_heavy_refinement n (s.cell i.1)
  let R := fun i => Classical.choice (hex i)
  let a := r.dbind (fun i => (R i).channel)
  have hpost (i : Sigma (fun i => (R i).Index)) (hi : 0 < scoreMass μ (a.prob i)) :
      scorePosterior μ (a.prob i) = scorePosterior (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i.1)) ((R i.1).channel.prob i.2) :=
    (scorePosterior_assoc μ _ _ (r.measurable i.1) ((R i.1).channel.measurable i.2)
      (r.nonneg i.1) ((R i.1).channel.nonneg i.2)
      (r.dbind_positive_parent _ μ i hi) (r.dbind_positive_conditional _ μ i hi)).symm
  let s' : AnalysisState n := {
    Index := Sigma (fun i => (R i).Index)
    channel := a
    cell := fun i => (R i.1).cell i.2
    B := fun i => (R i.1).B i.2
    B_one := fun i => (R i.1).B_one i.2
    support := fun i hi => by
      rw [hpost i hi]
      exact (R i.1).support i.2 (r.dbind_positive_conditional _ μ i hi)
    spread := fun i hi => by
      rw [hpost i hi]
      exact (R i.1).spread i.2 (r.dbind_positive_conditional _ μ i hi) }
  refine ⟨s',Sigma.fst,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact r.coarsen_dbind_fst (fun i => (R i).channel)
  ·
    let δ := fun i j => (((R i).cell j).1-(s.cell i.1).1:ℕ)
    let D := r.expectation μ (fun i => (R i).channel.expectation (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (fun j => δ i j))
    have hdepth : s'.depth = s.depth+D := by
      have he : (fun i : Sigma (fun i => (R i).Index) => (((R i.1).cell i.2).1:ℝ)) =
          fun i => ((s.cell i.1.1).1:ℝ)+(δ i.1 i.2:ℝ) := by
        funext i
        dsimp only [δ]
        rw [Nat.cast_sub ((R i.1).level_ge i.2)]
        ring
      change a.expectation μ _ = s.depth+D
      rw [he,FiniteChannel.expectation_add]
      change (r.dbind (fun i => (R i).channel)).expectation μ _ +
        (r.dbind (fun i => (R i).channel)).expectation μ _ = _
      rw [r.expectation_dbind_fst (fun i => (R i).channel) μ (fun i => ((s.cell i.1).1:ℝ)),
        r.expectation_dbind (fun i => (R i).channel) μ]
      change r.expectation μ (fun i => ((s.cell i.1).1:ℝ))+D = s.depth+D
      change (s.channel.bind q).expectation μ (fun i => ((s.cell i.1).1:ℝ))+D = s.depth+D
      rw [s.channel.expectation_bind_fst q μ (fun i => ((s.cell i).1:ℝ))]
      rfl
    have href (i : s.Index × Fin N) :
        finiteInformation (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (R i).channel.prob+
          (R i).channel.expectation (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (fun j => Real.log ((R i).B j)) ≤
        ((n:ℝ)/2+2)*Real.log 2*((R i).channel.expectation (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (fun j => δ i j))+2*Real.log 2+1 := by
      have h1 := (R i).entropy_bound
      have h2 := (R i).concentration_bound
      change _ ≤ _ at h1
      change _ ≤ _ at h2
      dsimp only [FiniteChannel.expectation,δ]
      linarith
    have hrefsum := r.expectation_mono μ href
    rw [r.expectation_add μ] at hrefsum
    have hright : r.expectation μ (fun i =>
        ((n:ℝ)/2+2)*Real.log 2*((R i).channel.expectation (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (fun j => δ i j))+2*Real.log 2+1) =
        ((n:ℝ)/2+2)*Real.log 2*D+2*Real.log 2+1 := by
      rw [r.expectation_add μ,r.expectation_add μ,r.expectation_const_mul μ,r.expectation_const μ,r.expectation_const μ]
    rw [hright] at hrefsum
    have hinfo : s'.information = finiteInformation μ r.prob+
        r.expectation μ (fun i => finiteInformation (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (R i).channel.prob) :=
      r.information_dbind (fun i => (R i).channel) μ
    have hconc : s'.concentration = r.expectation μ (fun i =>
        (R i).channel.expectation (scorePosterior μ (r.prob i)) (fun j => Real.log ((R i).B j))) := r.expectation_dbind (fun i => (R i).channel) μ (fun i => Real.log ((R i.1).B i.2))
    have hblock : finiteInformation μ r.prob ≤ s.information+s.concentration+L := by
      rw [s.channel.information_bind q μ]
      have hs : (∑ i,scoreMass μ (s.channel.prob i)*finiteInformation (scorePosterior μ (s.channel.prob i)) (q i).prob) ≤
          s.channel.expectation μ (fun i => L+Real.log (s.B i)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        by_cases h : scoreMass μ (s.channel.prob i) = 0
        · simp [h]
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcost i
            (lt_of_le_of_ne (scoreMass_nonneg μ _ (s.channel.nonneg i)) (Ne.symm h)))
            (scoreMass_nonneg μ _ (s.channel.nonneg i))
      rw [s.channel.expectation_add μ,s.channel.expectation_const μ] at hs
      change _ ≤ L+s.concentration at hs
      change s.information+_ ≤ _
      linarith
    unfold AnalysisState.potential
    rw [hinfo,hconc,hdepth]
    linarith
  · refine ⟨{
      choose := fun i z => ⟨i,(R i).select z⟩
      choose_fiber := ?_
      erase_choose := fun _ _ => rfl
      chosen := ?_
      positive_parent := ?_
      contains := fun i z hz => (R i).select_mem z hz
      subset := fun j => (R j.1).cell_subset j.2 }⟩
    · intro i j
      obtain ⟨k,j⟩ := j
      by_cases h : i = k
      · subst i
        change MeasurableSet {z | (⟨k,(R k).select z⟩ : Sigma (fun i => (R i).Index)) = ⟨k,j⟩}
        simpa only [Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, true_and] using (R k).select_fiber j
      · have he : {z | (⟨i,(R i).select z⟩ : Sigma (fun i => (R i).Index)) = ⟨k,j⟩} = ∅ := by
          ext z
          simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq,Set.mem_empty_iff_false,iff_false]
          intro h'
          exact h (congrArg Sigma.fst h')
        rw [he]
        exact MeasurableSet.empty
    · intro j z hz
      change 0 < r.prob j.1 z*(R j.1).channel.prob j.2 z at hz
      have hpos : 0 < (R j.1).channel.prob j.2 z :=
        pos_of_mul_pos_right hz (r.nonneg j.1 z)
      exact congrArg (Sigma.mk j.1) ((R j.1).chosen j.2 z hpos)
    · intro j z hz
      change 0 < (s.channel.prob j.1.1 z*(q j.1.1).prob j.1.2 z)*(R j.1).channel.prob j.2 z at hz
      have hr : 0 < s.channel.prob j.1.1 z*(q j.1.1).prob j.1.2 z :=
        pos_of_mul_pos_left hz ((R j.1).channel.nonneg j.2 z)
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_left hr ((q j.1.1).nonneg j.1.2 z)
end RepeatedLocalization

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Kern.name: OAI.KernelPotential.FiniteMessage.entropy_charge
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Kern.text:
lemma entropy_charge {d N : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hN : 0 < N) (a : Fin N → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ v,0 ≤ a v) (h1 : ∑ v,a v=1) :
    (∑ v,a v*(95*(d:ℝ)+6*Real.log (1/a v)/(d:ℝ)+2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ))) ≤
      95*(d:ℝ)+6*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ) := by
  have he : (∑ v,a v*Real.log (1/a v))=∑ v,-a v*Real.log (a v) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _
    rw [one_div,Real.log_inv]
    ring
  have hh := finite_entropy_bound hN a ha h1
  have hdR : 0 < (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (show 0 ≤ 6/(d:ℝ) by positivity)
  have hid : (∑ v,a v*(95*(d:ℝ)+6*Real.log (1/a v)/(d:ℝ)+2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ))) =
      95*(d:ℝ)+(6/(d:ℝ))*(∑ v,a v*Real.log (1/a v))+2*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)+Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ) := by
    simp only [mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_mul,h1,one_mul]
    congr 3
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _
    ring
  rw [hid,he]
  have he6 : 6/(d:ℝ)*Real.log (N:ℝ)=6*Real.log (N:ℝ)/(d:ℝ) := by ring
  rw [he6] at hb
  linarith

OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.name: OAI.RepeatedLocalization.repeated_localization
OAI.Probability.GaussianInformation.Dyad.text:
theorem repeated_localization : MainStatement := by
  refine ⟨1/2,by norm_num,32,?_⟩
  intro C₀ hC₀
  let A := blockInformationConstant+C₀
  let K := 2*Real.log 2+1
  let D := A+K
  let C := 16*D
  have hA : 0 < A := add_pos blockInformationConstant_pos hC₀
  have hK : 0 < K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
  have hD : 0 < D := add_pos hA hK
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro n N t hn hN rules halphabet
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hnR : (1:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ n by omega)
  let L := A*(n+1)
  have hc : UniformBlockCost n N L := actual_uniform_blockCost hn hN halphabet
  obtain ⟨s,f,hf,hs,⟨R⟩⟩ := history_analysis_realized hn0 rules L hc
  have hi := s.information_of_potential (show 8 ≤ n by omega) hs
  have hLK : L+2*Real.log 2+1 ≤ D*(n+1) := by
    dsimp [L,D,K]
    have hnnonneg : (0:ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hK.le hnnonneg]
  have hinfo : s.information ≤ 4*(t:ℝ)*D*(n+1) := by
    have H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLK (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4*(t:ℝ))
    nlinarith
  have hDt : 0 ≤ D*(t:ℝ) := mul_nonneg hD.le (Nat.cast_nonneg t)
  have hfinal : s.information ≤ C*(n+1)*t := by
    apply hinfo.trans
    dsimp [C]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hDt (show 0 ≤ (n:ℝ)+1 by positivity)]
  refine ⟨R.Q,R.valid,?_,?_⟩
  · exact (R.information_le hn0 rules hf).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hfinal)
  · rw [R.level_eq hn0 rules hf]
    have hhalf : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
      have H := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
      norm_num at H ⊢
      exact H
    have hd := s.depth_nonneg
    have hl := s.information_lower hn0
    have hsmall : (n:ℝ)/2*s.depth ≤ s.information := by
      have H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhalf (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hd)
      nlinarith
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left (a := (n:ℝ)/2) (a0 := by positivity)
    calc
      (n:ℝ)/2*s.depth ≤ s.information := hsmall
      _ ≤ 4*(t:ℝ)*D*(n+1) := hinfo
      _ ≤ (n:ℝ)/2*(C*t) := by
        dsimp [C]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hDt (sub_nonneg.mpr hnR)]
end RepeatedLocalization

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.GaussianMoat.Main:9.text:
theorem exists_sieveCertificate (D : ℝ) (hD : 1≤D) : Nonempty (SieveCertificate D) := by
  obtain ⟨a,δ,t,K,ha,ha1,haδ,ht,hK,hgap,hcost,hdensity⟩ := exists_separated_parameters
  let c := topCoefficient a/4
  have hc : 0<c := div_pos (topCoefficient_pos ha) (by norm_num)
  let rate := c*t/10500000
  have hrate : 0<rate := by dsimp only [rate]; positivity
  obtain ⟨W,hW⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 0 ((Real.log (latticeBall D).card+1)/rate))
  have hW0 : 0<W := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hW)
  have hWrate : Real.log (latticeBall D).card+1<(W:ℝ)*rate :=
    (div_lt_iff₀ hrate).mp ((le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hW)
  have hbatch : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop, ∀ w∈Finset.range W, ∀ J : ℕ → Finset ℕ,
      (∀ i<W, ∀ j∈J i, ((100:ℝ)^i*Real.exp m)≤j*Real.log 2 ∧
        j*Real.log 2≤21/20*((100:ℝ)^i*Real.exp m) ∧
        δ*(2:ℝ)^j/Real.log ((2:ℝ)^(j+1))≤(PrimeLogMass.dyadicBatch j).card) →
      (∀ i∈J w, ∀ j∈J w, i<j → i+K≤j) →
      ∀ j∈J w, ∀ E : ℝ, E≤c*(2:ℝ)^j/10000 →
        Nonempty (BatchCertificate D (commonBlocks a m W J) (windowSmoothing W m)
          (dyadicSieve j) (batchWordLength j) E (c/(10000000*Real.log ((2:ℝ)^j)))) := by
    apply (Finset.eventually_all (Finset.range W)).mpr
    intro w hw
    exact eventually_window_batch hD ha ha1 haδ hgap W w (Finset.mem_range.mp hw)
  obtain ⟨X0,hX0⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hdensity
  have hexp : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => Real.exp (m:ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  obtain ⟨m,hbatch,hsmooth,hm⟩ :=
    (hbatch.and ((eventually_allBins_smoothing D W).and
      (hexp.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop (max X0 (K*Real.log 2)))))).exists
  have hmX : X0≤Real.exp (m:ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans hm
  have hmK : K*Real.log 2≤Real.exp (m:ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans hm
  have hbexists : ∀ w : ℕ, ∃ J : Finset ℕ,
      t*((100:ℝ)^w*Real.exp m)≤J.card ∧
      (∀ i∈J, ∀ j∈J, i<j → i+K≤j) ∧
      ∀ j∈J, (100:ℝ)^w*Real.exp m≤j*Real.log 2 ∧
        j*Real.log 2≤21/20*((100:ℝ)^w*Real.exp m) ∧
        δ*(2:ℝ)^j/Real.log ((2:ℝ)^(j+1))≤(PrimeLogMass.dyadicBatch j).card := by
    intro w
    apply hX0 _ (hmX.trans _)
    have := window_power_one w
    nlinarith only [this,Real.exp_pos (m:ℝ)]
  choose J hdense hsep hbounds using hbexists
  let U := allBins W J
  have hJ : ∀ w<W, ∀ j∈J w, (100:ℝ)^w*Real.exp m≤j*Real.log 2 ∧
      j*Real.log 2≤21/20*((100:ℝ)^w*Real.exp m) := by
    intro w _ j hj; exact ⟨(hbounds w j hj).1,(hbounds w j hj).2.1⟩
  have hU : U.Nonempty := by
    have hCard0 : 0<(J 0).card := by
      have hpos : 0<t*((100:ℝ)^0*Real.exp m) := by positivity
      exact_mod_cast hpos.trans_le (hdense 0)
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hCard0
    exact ⟨j,Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨0,Finset.mem_range.mpr hW0,hj⟩⟩
  have hUcard : 0<U.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hU
  have hUlast : U.card-1+1=U.card := by omega
  have hUsep := allBins_separated J (Real.exp_pos (m:ℝ)) hmK hJ (fun w _ => hsep w)
  obtain ⟨hsmooth,htotal⟩ := hsmooth J (fun w hw j hj => (hJ w hw j hj).2)
  refine ⟨{
    schedule := commonBlocks a m W J
    smoothing := windowSmoothing W m
    batches := binEnum U
    last := U.card-1
    lengths := fun n => batchWordLength (binEnum U n)
    rates := fun n => c/(10000000*Real.log ((2:ℝ)^(binEnum U n)))
    error := Real.exp (-Real.exp m)
    batch := ?_
    divides := ?_
    nonneg := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    smooth := ?_
    excess := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro n hn
    apply Classical.choice
    have hn' : n<U.card := by omega
    have hmem := binEnum_mem U hn'
    obtain ⟨w,hw,hjw⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hmem
    apply (hbatch w hw J (fun w _ => hbounds w) (hsep w) _ hjw _)
    have hh := precedingFactors_enum_cost U hK hn' hUsep
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcost (show (0:ℝ)≤2^(binEnum U n) by positivity)
    exact hh.trans (by convert hm using 1; ring)
  · intro n hn
    exact batchWordLength_dvd (binEnum_strictMono U (Nat.lt_succ_self n) (by omega)).le
  · intro n hn a ha'
    rw [hUlast,precedingFactors_enum_all]
    exact hsmooth _ (binEnum_mem U (by omega)) _ (binEnum_mem U (by omega)) a ha'
  · rw [hUlast,binEnum_sum U (fun j => c/(10000000*Real.log ((2:ℝ)^j)))]
    have hsum := allBins_rate J (Real.exp_pos (m:ℝ)) hc hJ (fun w _ => hdense w)
    have hcost' : ((U.card-1:ℕ):ℝ)*Real.exp (-Real.exp m)≤1 :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le U.card 1 : ((U.card-1:ℕ):ℝ)≤U.card)
        (Real.exp_nonneg _)).trans htotal
    have hh := hWrate.trans_le hsum
    linarith only [hcost',hh]

OAI.Probability.GaussianPropeller.Config.name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.exists_configuration
OAI.Probability.GaussianPropeller.Config.text:
lemma exists_configuration (hk:2≤k) {A:Fin k→Set (Space d)} (hA:MinimalOptimal A)
    (hC:9/(8*Real.pi)<value A) (hall:∀ j,gaussian d (A j)≠0) :
    Nonempty (Configuration d k) := by
  classical
  have hCp:0<value A := (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<9/(8*Real.pi)).trans hC
  have hs:0<(Real.sqrt (value A))⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hCp)
  let v:Fin k→Space d := fun j=>(Real.sqrt (value A))⁻¹•centroid (A j)
  let σ:=_root_.Tuple.sort (fun j=> -‖v j‖)
  let z:Fin k→Space d := fun j=>v (σ j)
  let P:Fin k→ℝ := fun j=>(gaussian d).real (A (σ j))
  have hr:∀ j,‖v j‖=‖centroid (A j)‖/Real.sqrt (value A) := by
    intro j
    dsimp [v]
    rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hs]
    ring
  have hz:∀ j,‖z j‖=‖centroid (A (σ j))‖/Real.sqrt (value A) := fun j=>hr (σ j)
  refine ⟨{z:=z,P:=P,zero:=?_,norm:=?_,pos:=?_,order:=?_,obtuse:=?_,cap:=?_,
            probability:=?_,half:=?_,quadratic:=?_,linear:=?_,pair:=?_,cap3:=?_,loss4:=?_}⟩
  · dsimp [z]
    rw [Equiv.sum_comp σ]
    simp only [v,←Finset.smul_sum,sum_centroid_eq_zero hA.1.1,smul_zero]
  · dsimp [z]
    rw [Equiv.sum_comp σ (fun j => ‖v j‖^2)]
    simp_rw [hr,div_pow,Real.sq_sqrt hCp.le]
    rw [←Finset.sum_div]
    change value A/value A=1
    exact div_self hCp.ne'
  · intro j
    exact smul_ne_zero hs.ne' (active_centroid_ne_zero hA hCp (hall (σ j)))
  · intro i j hij
    have hh:=_root_.Tuple.monotone_sort (fun j=> -‖v j‖) hij
    exact neg_le_neg_iff.mp hh
  · intro i j hij
    change ⟪(Real.sqrt (value A))⁻¹•centroid (A (σ i)),(Real.sqrt (value A))⁻¹•centroid (A (σ j))⟫<0
    rw [real_inner_smul_left,real_inner_smul_right]
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hs (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hs
      (negative_inner_of_minimal hA (σ.injective.ne hij) (hall _) (hall _)))
  · intro j
    rw [hz]
    exact (normalized_centroid_lt_two_thirds (hA.1.1.1 _) hC).le
  · dsimp [P]
    rw [Equiv.sum_comp σ (fun j => (gaussian d).real (A j))]
    exact sum_cell_probability hA.1.1
  · intro j
    exact (active_probability_mem hk hA hCp (hall (σ j))).2
  · intro j
    rw [hz]
    by_cases hk5:k=5
    · subst k
      convert minimal_cap_four hA hC hall (σ j) using 1
      norm_num [P]
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hk5]
      convert normalized_cell_probability (hA.1.1.1 (σ j)) hC using 1 <;>
        norm_num [P,centroid,gaussian]
  · intro j
    rw [hz]
    exact (minimal_linear_quadratic hk hA hC hall (σ j)).le
  · intro i j l hij hil
    exact normalized_tuple_pair hA hC hall (σ.injective.ne hij) (σ.injective.ne hil)
  · intro hk4 j
    subst k
    rw [hz]
    exact minimal_cap_three hA hC hall (σ j)
  · intro hk4 j
    subst k
    rw [hz]
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hpx,hl⟩:=minimal_loss_constraint (by norm_num) hA hC hall (σ j)
    refine ⟨x,hx,hpx,le_trans ?_ hl⟩
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hl ⊢
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC.le (sq_nonneg _)) (by positivity)

end GaussianPropeller.Reduction

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GaussianPropeller.Main:3.name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.all_partition_bound
OAI.Probability.GaussianPropeller.Main:3.text:
theorem all_partition_bound (d:ℕ) (hd:0<d) :
    ∀ k (A:Fin k→Set (Space d)), IsPartition A → value A≤9/(8*Real.pi) := by
  classical
  let : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro A hA
    by_cases hk:k≤3
    · exact partition_bound_small hk hA
    let : NeZero k := ⟨by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨B,hB⟩:=exists_minimal_optimal (d:=d) (k:=k)
    suffices hb:value B≤9/(8*Real.pi) from (hB.1.2 _ hA).trans hb
    by_contra hn
    have hC:9/(8*Real.pi)<value B := lt_of_not_ge hn
    by_cases hall:∀ j,gaussian d (B j)≠0
    · obtain ⟨D⟩:=exists_configuration (by omega) hB hC hall
      by_cases hk4:k=4
      · subst k
        exact D.impossible_four
      · exact D.impossible_five_or_more (by omega)
    · push Not at hall
      obtain ⟨i,hi⟩:=hall
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
        have hp:=remove_null_partition hB.1.1 i hi
        have hv:=ih m (by omega) (fun j=>B (i.succAbove j)) hp
        rw [remove_null_value i hi] at hv
        exact (not_le_of_gt hC) hv

end GaussianPropeller.Reduction

OAI.Probability.GaussianPropeller.Elimin.name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.partition_bound_small
OAI.Probability.GaussianPropeller.Elimin.text:
lemma partition_bound_small {A:Fin k→Set (Space d)} (hk:k≤3) (hA:IsPartition A) :
    value A≤9/(8*Real.pi) := by
  have he:∃ B:Fin 3→Set (Space d), IsPartition B ∧ value B=value A := by
    have hc:∀ m, k ≤ m → ∃ B:Fin m→Set (Space d), IsPartition B ∧ value B=value A := by
      intro m hm
      induction m,hm using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩
      | succ m hm ih =>
        obtain ⟨B,hB,hv⟩:=ih
        let B' : Fin (m+1) → Set (Space d) := Fin.lastCases ∅ B
        have hp : IsPartition B' := append_empty_partition (A := B) hB
        have he : value B' = value B := append_empty_value B
        exact ⟨B',hp,he.trans hv⟩
    exact hc 3 hk
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hv⟩:=he
  rw [←hv]
  exact three_partition_bound hB

end GaussianPropeller.Reduction
