OAI.Probability.GaussianPropeller.Elimin.name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.remove_null_partition
OAI.Probability.GaussianPropeller.Elimin.text:
lemma remove_null_partition {A:Fin (k+1)→Set (Space d)} (hA:IsPartition A)
    (i:Fin (k+1)) (hi:gaussian d (A i)=0) :
    IsPartition (fun j:Fin k=>A (i.succAbove j)) := by
  constructor
  · intro j; exact hA.1 _
  have hn:∀ᵐ x∂gaussian d,x∉A i := by
    exact (ae_iff.mpr (by simpa using hi))
  filter_upwards [hA.2,hn] with x hx hxi
  obtain ⟨j,hj,huniq⟩:=hx

  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩:=Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hji
  refine ⟨a,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [ha] using hj
  · intro b hb
    apply Fin.succAbove_right_injective
    exact (huniq _ hb).trans ha.symm

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Hybr.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.hybrid_block_bound
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Hybr.text:
lemma hybrid_block_bound {d m : ℕ} (hd : 256 ≤ d) (hm : m ≤ d/8)
    {U V : Type*} [Fintype U] [Fintype V]
    [MeasurableSpace U] [MeasurableSpace V]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass U] [MeasurableSingletonClass V]
    (P : Measure (Sphere d×U)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hS : P.fst = uniformSphere d)
    (κ : Kernel (U×(Rows m d×(Fin m→ℝ))) V) [IsMarkovKernel κ]
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hH : shannonEntropy (endingSignalLaw P κ).snd ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B) :
    averagedFreshInformation (endingSignalLaw P κ)-averagedFreshInformation P ≤
      hybridRowConstant*m+(m:ℝ)/hybridCount d*(16*hybridBaselineConstant+B/(d/8:ℕ))+B/(d/32:ℕ) := by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d) := uniformSphere_probability_of_pos (by omega)
  let : Nonempty (Sphere d) := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d)
  let : Nonempty U := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure P.snd
  let : Nonempty V := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (endingSignalLaw P κ).snd
  have hi : ((endingRowLaw P κ).map swapLast).fst = (uniformSphere d).prod (gaussianRows m d) := by
    rw [endingRowLaw_independence,hS]
  have hh : shannonEntropy (endingRowLaw P κ).fst.snd ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B := by
    rwa [endingRowLaw_fst]
  have h := hybrid_average_ending (endingRowLaw P κ) hd hm hi hB hh
  simp_rw [exposedInformation_prefix_zero,endingRowLaw_fst] at h
  have hle : (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (hybridFirst d) (hybridLast d),
      (exposedInformation (alignedExperiment (r:=k-m) (endingRowLaw P κ))).toReal) / hybridCount d ≤
      averagedFreshInformation P := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k hk
    have hkm : m ≤ k := by
      obtain ⟨hk,_⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
      unfold hybridFirst at hk
      omega
    have hl := block_exposed_le_fresh (r:=k-m) P κ
    have hfresh : freshInformation P (m+(k-m)) = freshInformation P k :=
      congrArg (freshInformation P) (Nat.add_sub_of_le hkm)
    rw [hfresh] at hl
    exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (freshInformation_finite P) hl
  change averagedFreshInformation (endingSignalLaw P κ) - _ ≤ _ at h
  linarith

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiberTwoPointRight
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.text:
def fiberTwoPointRight (d k : ℕ) : Measure (Rows k d×(Sphere d×Sphere d)) :=
  letI : IsScalarTower ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞ := Semigroup.isScalarTower
  fiberTwoPointConstant k •
    Measure.map (Prod.swap : (Sphere d×Sphere d)×Rows k d → Rows k d×(Sphere d×Sphere d))
      (Measure.compProd
        (Measure.withDensity (Measure.prod (uniformSphere d) (uniformSphere d))
          (fiberDistanceWeight k))
        (perpendicularRowsKernel d k))

lemma fiberRight_finite {d k : ℕ} (hk : 1≤k) (hkd : k<d-1) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (fiberTwoPointRight d k) := by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (((uniformSphere d).prod (uniformSphere d)).withDensity (fiberDistanceWeight k)) := by
    apply isFiniteMeasure_withDensity
    rw [lintegral_congr_ae (fiberDistanceWeight_ae (k:=k) (by omega))]
    exact spherical_pair_inverse_finite hk hkd
  unfold fiberTwoPointRight

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiberTwoPointMain
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.text:
theorem fiberTwoPointMain : FiberTwoPointMain := by
  intro d k hk hkd
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d) :=
    uniformSphere_probability_of_pos (by omega)
  let : Nonempty (Sphere d) := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d)
  have := fiberLeft_finite hk hkd
  have := fiberRight_finite hk hkd
  refine ⟨inferInstance,inferInstance,?_⟩
  apply Measure.ext_prod
  intro A E hA hE
  have heq : ((fiberTwoPointLeft d k).restrict (A ×ˢ Set.univ)).map Prod.snd =
      ((fiberTwoPointRight d k).restrict (A ×ˢ Set.univ)).map Prod.snd := by
    apply Measure.ext_prod
    intro B D hB hD
    rw [snd_restrict_sphere_rectangle _ (hB.prod hD),snd_restrict_sphere_rectangle _ (hB.prod hD)]
    exact fiber_three_rectangle_eq hk hkd hA hB hD
  have h := congrArg (fun μ : Measure (Sphere d×Sphere d) => μ E) heq
  simpa only [snd_restrict_sphere_rectangle _ hE] using h

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiberDistanceWeight_ae

lemma fiberDistanceWeight_ae {d k : ℕ} (hd : 2≤d) :
    fiberDistanceWeight (d:=d) k =ᵐ[(uniformSphere d).prod (uniformSphere d)] fiberPairInverse k := by
  have hne := weightedSphere_pair_ne hd (fun _ => 1)
  have hne' : ∀ᵐ z ∂(uniformSphere d).prod (uniformSphere d), z.1 ≠ z.2 := by
    simpa only [withDensity_const,one_smul] using hne
  exact hne'.mono (fun z hz => fiberDistanceWeight_eq hz)

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiberTwoPointConstant

def fiberTwoPointConstant (k : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  letI : OfNat ℝ 2 := @instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 2 Real.instNatCast inferInstance
  letI : Mul ℝ := Real.instMul
  letI : Inv ℝ := Real.instInv
  letI : Pow ℝ ℕ := @NPow.toPow ℝ Real.instMonoid.toNPow
  ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹ ^ k)

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Hybr.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.hybridBlockMain
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Hybr.text:
theorem hybridBlockMain : HybridBlockMain := by
  let C := 1+|hybridRowConstant|+16*hybridBaselineConstant
  have hbase := hybridBaselineConstant_pos
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  refine ⟨C,100*C+100,256,hC,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro d hd m hm1 hm U V _ _ _ _ _ _ P _ hS κ _ B hB hH
  have h := hybrid_block_bound hd hm P hS κ hB hH
  have hrow : hybridRowConstant ≤ C := by
    have h := le_abs_self hybridRowConstant
    dsimp [C]
    linarith
  have hbaseline : 16*hybridBaselineConstant ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    linarith [abs_nonneg hybridRowConstant]
  have hbound : averagedFreshInformation (endingSignalLaw P κ)-averagedFreshInformation P ≤
    C*m+(m:ℝ)/hybridCount d*(C+B/(d/8:ℕ))+B/(d/32:ℕ) := by
    apply h.trans
    apply add_le_add _ le_rfl
    apply add_le_add
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrow (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hbaseline le_rfl) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨hbound,fun hBd => hbound.trans (hybrid_block_numeric hd hm hB hBd hC.le)⟩



end CurrentProjection

end

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Slab.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.spherical_pair_inverse_finite
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Slab.text:
lemma spherical_pair_inverse_finite {d k : ℕ} (hk : 1≤k) (hkd : k<d-1) :
    (∫⁻ z, fiberPairInverse k z ∂(uniformSphere d).prod (uniformSphere d)) ≠ ∞ := by
  apply ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (fiberEnergyBound_ne_top d) (measure_ne_top (uniformSphere d) Set.univ))
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ s : Sphere d, ∫⁻ t : Sphere d, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(t:Vector d)-(s:Vector d)‖⁻¹ ^ k)
        ∂uniformSphere d ∂uniformSphere d := lintegral_prod _ measurable_fiberPairInverse.aemeasurable
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ s : Sphere d, fiberEnergyBound d ∂uniformSphere d :=
      lintegral_mono (spherical_inverse_bound hk hkd)
    _ = _ := lintegral_const _

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiber_quadratic_eq

lemma fiber_quadratic_eq {d k : ℕ} [Nonempty (Sphere d)] (hk : 1≤k) (hkd : k<d-1)
    (H : BoundedContinuousFunction (Rows k d) ℝ≥0)
    (b : Sphere d→ℝ≥0∞) (hb : Measurable b) (M : ℝ≥0∞) (hM : M ≠ ∞) (hbM : ∀ s, b s≤M) :
    (∫⁻ z, fiberBilinearTest H b b z ∂fiberTwoPointLeft d k) =
      ∫⁻ z, fiberBilinearTest H b b z ∂fiberTwoPointRight d k := by
  have := finite_bounded_withDensity (uniformSphere d) b M hM hbM
  rw [fiberLeft_quadratic H b hb (spherical_projection_ac hk hkd),fiberRight_quadratic (by omega) H b hb]
  exact spherical_energy_identity _ H (weightedSphere_projection_ac hk hkd b)
    (weightedSphere_pair_ne (by omega) b) (weightedSphere_pair_inverse_finite hk hkd b hb M hM hbM)



end CurrentProjection

lemma shannonEntropy_finite {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [MeasurableSpace W]

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Hybr.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.hybrid_block_numeric
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Hybr.text:
lemma hybrid_block_numeric {d m : ℕ} {B C : ℝ}
    (hd : 256 ≤ d) (hm : m ≤ d/8) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hBd : B ≤ (d:ℝ)^2)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    C*m+(m:ℝ)/hybridCount d*(C+B/(d/8:ℕ))+B/(d/32:ℕ) ≤ (100*C+100)*d := by
  have hh0 : (0:ℝ)<(d/8:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<d/8 by omega)
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ)<(d/32:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<d/32 by omega)
  have hN0 : (0:ℝ)<hybridCount d := by unfold hybridCount; positivity
  have hm0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ d := Nat.cast_nonneg d
  have hmd : (m:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast (show m≤d by omega)
  have hdh : (d:ℝ) ≤ 16*(d/8:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show d≤16*(d/8) by omega)
  have hdq : (d:ℝ) ≤ 64*(d/32:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show d≤64*(d/32) by omega)
  have hmN : (m:ℝ) ≤ hybridCount d := by
    exact_mod_cast (show m≤hybridCount d by unfold hybridCount hybridFirst hybridLast; omega)
  have hmN' : (m:ℝ)/hybridCount d ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hN0).mpr hmN
  have hBh : B/(d/8:ℕ) ≤ 16*d := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hh0).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hBq : B/(d/32:ℕ) ≤ 64*d := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hq0).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hmul : (m:ℝ)/hybridCount d*(C+B/(d/8:ℕ)) ≤ C+16*d := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 1*(C+B/(d/8:ℕ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmN' (add_nonneg hC (div_nonneg hB hh0.le))
      _ ≤ C+16*d := by linarith
  have hCm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmd hC
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ)≤d := by exact_mod_cast (show 1≤d by omega)
  nlinarith

def fiberTwoPointLeft (d k : ℕ) [Nonempty (Sphere d)] : Measure (Rows k d×(Sphere d×Sphere d)) :=
  ((((gaussianRows k d).prod (uniformSphere d)).withDensity
    (fun z => exactDensity (uniformSphere d) z.1 (label z.1 (z.2:Vector d)))) ⊗ₘ
    ((sphericalFiberKernel d k).comap (fun z => (z.1,label z.1 (z.2:Vector d)))
      (measurable_fst.prodMk measurable_own_label))).map
    (fun z => (z.1.1,(z.1.2,z.2)))

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiber_bilinear_eq
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.text:
lemma fiber_bilinear_eq {d k : ℕ} [Nonempty (Sphere d)] (hk : 1≤k) (hkd : k<d-1)
    (H : BoundedContinuousFunction (Rows k d) ℝ≥0)
    (b a : Sphere d→ℝ≥0∞) (hb : Measurable b) (ha : Measurable a)
    {M N : ℝ≥0∞} (hM : M≠∞) (hN : N≠∞) (hbM : ∀ s, b s≤M) (haN : ∀ s, a s≤N) :
    (∫⁻ z, fiberBilinearTest H b a z ∂fiberTwoPointLeft d k) =
      ∫⁻ z, fiberBilinearTest H b a z ∂fiberTwoPointRight d k := by
  have := fiberRight_finite hk hkd
  have hbb := fiber_quadratic_eq hk hkd H b hb M hM hbM
  have haa := fiber_quadratic_eq hk hkd H a ha N hN haN
  have hsum := fiber_quadratic_eq hk hkd H (b+a) (hb.add ha) (M+N)
    (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨hM,hN⟩) (fun s => add_le_add (hbM s) (haN s))
  rw [fiberBilinear_add_left _ H b a (b+a) hb (hb.add ha),
    fiberBilinear_add_right _ H b b a hb hb,
    fiberBilinear_add_right _ H a b a ha hb,
    fiberBilinear_add_left _ H b a (b+a) hb (hb.add ha),
    fiberBilinear_add_right _ H b b a hb hb,
    fiberBilinear_add_right _ H a b a ha hb,
    fiberLeft_bilinear_comm H a b ha hb,fiberRight_bilinear_comm (by omega) H a b ha hb,
    hbb,haa] at hsum
  have hbbfin := fiberBilinear_integral_ne_top (fiberTwoPointRight d k) H b b hM hM hbM hbM
  have haafin := fiberBilinear_integral_ne_top (fiberTwoPointRight d k) H a a hN hN haN haN
  simp only [add_assoc] at hsum
  have h := (ENNReal.add_right_inj hbbfin).mp hsum
  rw [←add_assoc,←add_assoc] at h
  have h' := (ENNReal.add_left_inj haafin).mp h
  rw [←mul_two,←mul_two] at h'
  exact (ENNReal.mul_left_inj (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞)≠0) (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0∞)≠∞)).mp h'

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.FiberTwoPointMain
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.text:
def FiberTwoPointMain : Prop :=
  ∀ (d k : ℕ) (_hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkd : k < d-1),
    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d) :=
      uniformSphere_probability_of_pos (by omega)
    letI : Nonempty (Sphere d) := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d)
    IsFiniteMeasure (fiberTwoPointLeft d k) ∧ IsFiniteMeasure (fiberTwoPointRight d k) ∧
      fiberTwoPointLeft d k = fiberTwoPointRight d k



end CurrentProjection

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiber_comparison
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.text:
lemma fiber_comparison {d : ℕ} (hd : 100 ≤ d) {W : Type*} [Fintype W]
    [MeasurableSpace W] [MeasurableSingletonClass W]
    (P : Measure ((Sphere d×W)×Rows (d/10) d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hInd : (P.map swapLast).fst = (uniformSphere d).prod (gaussianRows (d/10) d))
    (hH : shannonEntropy P.fst.snd ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((d:ℝ)^2)) :
    freshInformation P.fst (d/3) ≤ exposedInformation (alignedExperiment (r:=d/3-d/10) P) +
      ENNReal.ofReal (1000*d) := by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d) := uniformSphere_probability_of_pos (by omega)
  let : Nonempty (Sphere d) := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d)
  let : Nonempty W := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure P.fst.snd
  have hHfin : shannonEntropy P.fst.snd ≠ ∞ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hH
  have hHr : (shannonEntropy P.fst.snd).toReal ≤ (d:ℝ)^2 :=
    ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (sq_nonneg _) hH
  have hdim : AdmissibleDimensions d (d/10) (d/3-d/10) (d/10) := by
    unfold AdmissibleDimensions
    omega
  obtain ⟨hJ0,hJ1,hcomp⟩ := critical_unrefined_comparison hdim P hInd hHfin
  have hσ := signal_marginal_of_independence P (uniformSphere d) (gaussianRows (d/10) d) hInd
  obtain ⟨hE,hEb,hF,hFb⟩ := criticalSignal_entropy P.fst hσ hdim.2.2.2.1 hHfin
  obtain ⟨he,hl⟩ := critical_entropy_scalars (show 1 ≤ d by omega) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hHr
    hEb ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hFb
  obtain ⟨hRow,hRowB⟩ := rowInformation_le_entropy P (uniformSphere d) (gaussianRows (d/10) d)
    hInd (by rwa [swapLast_snd])
  rw [swapLast_snd] at hRowB
  have hqr : (0:ℝ) < (d/10:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<d/10 by omega)
  have hqrB : (d:ℝ) ≤ 20*(d/10:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show d≤20*(d/10) by omega)
  have hℓr : ((d/10+(d/3-d/10):ℕ):ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast (show d/10+(d/3-d/10)≤d by omega)
  simp only [Nat.cast_add] at hℓr
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast (show 1≤d by omega)
  have hRowr : (rowInformation P (gaussianRows (d/10) d)).toReal/(d/10:ℕ) ≤ 20*(d:ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hqr).mpr
    nlinarith [hRowB.trans hHr]
  have hbound : exposedInformation (P.fst.prod (gaussianRows (d/10+(d/3-d/10)) d)) ≤
      exposedInformation (alignedExperiment (r:=d/3-d/10) P) + ENNReal.ofReal (1000*d) := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hJ0 (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨hJ1,ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top⟩)).mp
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_add hJ1 ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hdimEq : d/10+(d/3-d/10) = d/3 := by omega
  change freshInformation P.fst (d/10+(d/3-d/10)) ≤ _ at hbound
  have hfresh : freshInformation P.fst (d/10+(d/3-d/10)) = freshInformation P.fst (d/3) :=
    congrArg (freshInformation P.fst) hdimEq
  rwa [hfresh] at hbound

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Hybr.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.freshInformation_finite
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Hybr.text:
lemma freshInformation_finite {d k : ℕ} {W : Type*}
    [Fintype W] [MeasurableSpace W] [MeasurableSingletonClass W]
    [Nonempty W] [Nonempty (Sphere d)]
    (P : Measure (Sphere d×W)) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] : freshInformation P k ≠ ∞ := by
  apply exposedInformation_finite
  rw [Measure.fst_prod]
  exact shannonEntropy_finite P.snd

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiberBlockMain
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.text:
theorem fiberBlockMain : FiberBlockMain := by
  refine ⟨1000,100,by norm_num,?_⟩
  intro d hd U V _ _ _ _ _ _ P _ hS κ _ N hN hcard hNlog
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d) := uniformSphere_probability_of_pos (by omega)
  let : Nonempty (Sphere d) := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (uniformSphere d)
  let : Nonempty U := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure P.snd
  let : Nonempty V := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (endingSignalLaw P κ).snd
  have hEnt : shannonEntropy (endingSignalLaw P κ).snd ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((d:ℝ)^2) := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (shannonEntropy_finite _) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sq_nonneg _)]
    apply (shannonEntropy_le_log_card _).trans
    exact (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos) (by exact_mod_cast hcard)).trans hNlog
  have hInd : ((endingRowLaw P κ).map swapLast).fst = (uniformSphere d).prod (gaussianRows (d/10) d) := by
    rw [endingRowLaw_independence,hS]
  have h := fiber_comparison hd (endingRowLaw P κ) hInd (by rwa [endingRowLaw_fst])
  simp only [endingRowLaw_fst] at h
  have hproc := block_exposed_le_fresh (r:=d/3-d/10) P κ
  have he : freshInformation P (d/10+(d/3-d/10)) = freshInformation P (d/3) :=
    congrArg (freshInformation P) (by omega)
  rw [he] at hproc
  exact h.trans (add_le_add hproc le_rfl)



end CurrentProjection

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.perpendicularRowsKernel
OAI.CurrentProjection.fiber_indicator_lintegral

lemma fiber_indicator_lintegral {d k : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (Rows k d×(Sphere d×Sphere d)))
    (H : BoundedContinuousFunction (Rows k d) ℝ≥0)
    {B D : Set (Sphere d)} (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hD : MeasurableSet D) :
    (∫⁻ C, (H C : ℝ≥0∞) ∂(μ.restrict (Set.univ ×ˢ (B ×ˢ D))).map Prod.fst) =
      ∫⁻ z, fiberBilinearTest H (B.indicator (fun _ => 1)) (D.indicator (fun _ => 1)) z ∂μ := by
  have hH : Measurable (fun C => (H C : ℝ≥0∞)) := ENNReal.continuous_coe.measurable.comp H.continuous.measurable
  rw [lintegral_map hH measurable_fst,←lintegral_indicator (MeasurableSet.univ.prod (hB.prod hD))]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro z
  by_cases hb : z.2.1∈B <;> by_cases hd : z.2.2∈D <;>
    simp [fiberBilinearTest,Set.indicator,hb,hd]

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.fiber_three_rectangle_eq
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.text:
lemma fiber_three_rectangle_eq {d k : ℕ} [Nonempty (Sphere d)] (hk : 1≤k) (hkd : k<d-1)
    {A : Set (Rows k d)} {B D : Set (Sphere d)}
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hD : MeasurableSet D) :
    fiberTwoPointLeft d k (A ×ˢ (B ×ˢ D)) = fiberTwoPointRight d k (A ×ˢ (B ×ˢ D)) := by
  have := fiberLeft_finite hk hkd
  have heq : ((fiberTwoPointLeft d k).restrict (Set.univ ×ˢ (B ×ˢ D))).map Prod.fst =
      ((fiberTwoPointRight d k).restrict (Set.univ ×ˢ (B ×ˢ D))).map Prod.fst := by
    apply ext_of_forall_lintegral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
    intro H
    rw [fiber_indicator_lintegral _ H hB hD,fiber_indicator_lintegral _ H hB hD]
    apply fiber_bilinear_eq hk hkd H _ _ (measurable_const.indicator hB) (measurable_const.indicator hD)
      (M:=1) (N:=1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    · intro s
      by_cases hs : s∈B <;> simp [hs]
    · intro s
      by_cases hs : s∈D <;> simp [hs]
  have h := congrArg (fun μ : Measure (Rows k d) => μ A) heq
  simpa only [fst_restrict_sphere_rectangle _ hA] using h

OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.name: OAI.CurrentProjection.shannonEntropy_le_log_card
OAI.Probability.GaussianReplacement.Fibe.text:
lemma shannonEntropy_le_log_card {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [MeasurableSpace W]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass W] (π : Measure W) [IsProbabilityMeasure π] :
    (shannonEntropy π).toReal ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card W) := by
  let : Nonempty W := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure π
  let Q := (PMF.uniformOfFintype W).toMeasure
  have hQ : ∀ w, Q {w} = (Fintype.card W:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    intro w
    change (PMF.uniformOfFintype W).toMeasure {w} = _
    rw [PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _ (measurableSet_singleton w),PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply]
  have hq0 : (Fintype.card W:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)
  have hPQ : π ≪ Q := countable_ac_of_atom π Q (by intro w hw; exact (hq0 ((hQ w).symm.trans hw)).elim)
  obtain ⟨_,hb⟩ := countable_entropy_le_crossEntropy π Q hPQ (Integrable.of_finite)
  have he : (fun w => -Real.log (Q {w}).toReal) = fun _ : W => Real.log (Fintype.card W) := by
    funext w
    rw [hQ w,ENNReal.toReal_inv,ENNReal.toReal_natCast,Real.log_inv,neg_neg]
  simpa [he] using hb

OAI.Geometry.Convex.GeneralMahler.Theore.name: OAI.GeneralMahler.volumeProduct
OAI.GeneralMahler.general_mahler
OAI.Geometry.Convex.GeneralMahler.Theore.text:
theorem general_mahler {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (hcompact : IsCompact K) (hconvex : Convex ℝ K)
    (hinterior : (interior K).Nonempty) :
    ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) / (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ volumeProduct K ∧
      (volumeProduct K = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) / (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) ^ 2 ↔
        ∃ vertices : Fin (n + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
          AffineIndependent ℝ vertices ∧ K = convexHull ℝ (range vertices)) := by
  let D := ofSet K hcompact hconvex hinterior
  have h := (general_geometric hn K hcompact hconvex hinterior).2.2.2.2
  change ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) / (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ D.P ∧
    (D.P = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) / (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) ^ 2 ↔
      ∃ vertices : Fin (n + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
        AffineIndependent ℝ vertices ∧ K = convexHull ℝ (range vertices)) at h
  have hInf : D.P = volumeProduct K := D.product_inf
  rw [hInf] at h
  exact h

end GeneralMahler

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.Convex.GeneralMahler.Main:4.name: OAI.GeneralMahler.general_geometric
OAI.Geometry.Convex.GeneralMahler.Main:4.text:
theorem general_geometric {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (K : Set (Rn n))
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hc : Convex ℝ K) (hi : (interior K).Nonempty) :
    let D := ofSet K hK hc hi
    (∃! x, x ∈ interior K ∧ IsMinOn D.polarVol (interior K) x) ∧
    (D.santalo ∈ interior K ∧ IsMinOn D.polarVol (interior K) D.santalo) ∧
    (D.P = (volume K).toReal * (volume (polarAt K D.santalo)).toReal) ∧
    D.P = sInf (D.productAt '' interior K) ∧
    ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) / (n.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ D.P ∧
      (D.P = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) / (n.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 ↔ IsSimplex K) := by
  intro D
  exact ⟨D.santalo_exists, D.santalo_spec, rfl, D.product_inf, (mahal D).1, (mahal D).2⟩

end GeneralMahler

end OAI

OAI.Computability.StarHeight.Main:9.text:
theorem main {Alphabet : Type u} [Finite Alphabet] (L : Language Alphabet) (hL : L.IsRegular) :
    HasHeightAtMost L 3 := by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty Alphabet with h|h
  · let : IsEmpty Alphabet := h
    apply HasHeightAtMost.finite L _ 3
    apply (Set.finite_singleton ([] : List Alphabet)).subset
    intro w _
    cases w with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a w => exact isEmptyElim a
  · let : Nonempty Alphabet := h
    obtain ⟨M,hM,hfin,T,F,hTF⟩ := FiniteRecognition.of_regular hL
    let : Monoid M := hM
    let : Fintype M := hfin
    have heq : L=({w | T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)∈F} : Language Alphabet) := by
      ext w
      exact hTF w
    rw [heq]
    exact FiniteRecognition.recognized_height_three T F

end GeneralizedStarHeight

lemma graph_fiber (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M) (E : Language Alphabet) (d : M) :
    graph E (fun w => action M (T (FreeMonoid.ofList w))) (basis M 1) (basis M d) =
      ({w | w∈E∗ ∧ T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)=d} : Language Alphabet) := by
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨es,hes,rfl,h⟩
    refine ⟨Language.join_mem_kstar hes,?_⟩
    rw [updateWord_product] at h
    exact (value_recovery M _ _).mp h
  · rintro ⟨hw,hd⟩
    obtain ⟨es,rfl,hes⟩ := Language.mem_kstar.mp hw
    refine ⟨es,hes,rfl,?_⟩
    rw [updateWord_product]
    exact (value_recovery M _ _).mpr hd

OAI.Computability.StarHeight.Recognition.name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.FiniteRecognition.recognized_height_three
OAI.Computability.StarHeight.Recognition.text:
theorem recognized_height_three {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet2} {M : Type uM2} [Finite Alphabet] [Nonempty Alphabet]
    [Monoid M] [Fintype M] (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M) (F : Set M) :
    HasHeightAtMost ({w | T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)∈F} : Language Alphabet) 3 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E,hE,hB,hG⟩ := SourceSchedule.episode_linear_graphs T (RightRegular.action M)
  let A : M → Language Alphabet := fun d => {w | w∈E∗ ∧ T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)=d}
  let B : M → Language Alphabet := fun f => {w | w∈remainder E ∧ T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)=f}
  have hA : ∀ d, HasHeightAtMost (A d) 3 := by
    intro d
    change HasHeightAtMost ({w | w∈E∗ ∧ T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)=d} : Language Alphabet) 3
    rw [←RightRegular.graph_fiber T E d]
    exact hG (RightRegular.basis M 1) (RightRegular.basis M d)
  let I := {p : M × M // p.1*p.2∈F}
  have hU : HasHeightAtMost (⨆ p : I, A p.1.1 * B p.1.2) 3 :=
    HasHeightAtMost.iSup _ (fun p => (hA p.1.1).concat ((hB p.1.2).mono (by decide)))
  have heq : ({w | T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)∈F} : Language Alphabet)=
      ⨆ p : I, A p.1.1 * B p.1.2 := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · intro hw
      obtain ⟨es,r,hes,hr,hwr⟩ := factor_remainder hE.1 w
      let d := T (FreeMonoid.ofList es.flatten)
      let f := T (FreeMonoid.ofList r)
      have hdf : d*f∈F := by
        change T (FreeMonoid.ofList es.flatten)*T (FreeMonoid.ofList r)∈F
        rw [←map_mul]
        change T (FreeMonoid.ofList (es.flatten++r))∈F
        rw [←hwr]
        exact hw
      apply Language.mem_iSup.mpr
      refine ⟨⟨(d,f),hdf⟩,Language.mem_mul.mpr ⟨es.flatten,?_,r,?_,hwr.symm⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨Language.join_mem_kstar hes,rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨hr,rfl⟩
    · intro hw
      obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := Language.mem_iSup.mp hw
      obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,rfl⟩ := Language.mem_mul.mp hp
      change T (FreeMonoid.ofList a * FreeMonoid.ofList b)∈F
      rw [map_mul,ha.2,hb.2]
      exact p.2
  exact heq.symm ▸ hU

end FiniteRecognition

end GeneralizedStarHeight

OAI.Computability.StarHeight.EpisodeHeig.name: OAI.GeneralizedStarHeight.SourceSchedule.episode_linear_graphs
OAI.Computability.StarHeight.EpisodeHeig.text:
theorem episode_linear_graphs {Alphabet : Type uAlphabet4} {M : Type uM3} {V : Type uV2} {K : Type uK2}
    [Finite Alphabet] [Nonempty Alphabet] [Monoid M] [Fintype M]
    [Field K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype V]
    (T : FreeMonoid Alphabet →* M) (ρ : M → (V →ₗ[K] V)) :
    ∃ E : Language Alphabet, PrefixCode E ∧
      (∀ d : M, HasHeightAtMost ({w | w∈remainder E ∧ T (FreeMonoid.ofList w)=d} : Language Alphabet) 1) ∧
      ∀ x y : V, HasHeightAtMost (graph E (fun w => ρ (T (FreeMonoid.ofList w))) x y) 3 := by
  classical
  let : Fintype Alphabet := Fintype.ofFinite Alphabet
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hs₁⟩ := exists_shift_table (A := M) (K := K) (S := V)
  let β : M → M → (Fin g → M) → V := fun a c => (hs₁ (ClockAffine.productTable ρ a c)).choose
  have hβ : ∀ a c, ShiftTableProperty g (ClockAffine.productTable ρ a c) (β a c) :=
    fun a c => (hs₁ (ClockAffine.productTable ρ a c)).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨g',hg',hs₂⟩ := exists_shift_table (A := M) (K := K) (S := V × K)
  let γ : (M → (V × K →ₗ[K] V × K)) → (Fin g' → M) → V × K :=
    fun ψ => (hs₂ (ObservedInner.table ψ)).choose
  have hγ : ∀ ψ, ShiftTableProperty g' (ObservedInner.table ψ) (γ ψ) :=
    fun ψ => (hs₂ (ObservedInner.table ψ)).choose_spec
  let κ := Fintype.card (Kind M (V × K) K g')
  obtain ⟨μ,hμpos,hμ⟩ := exists_copies (M := M) (S := V) g κ (by omega)
  let P := Roster M (V × K) K g' μ
  let B := SlotResidues.slotModulus P
  have hB : 0<B := SlotResidues.slotModulus_pos P
  have hμ' : 20*(10000000*Real.log (2*Fintype.card (Tag M V g B))+4*(g+1))+10<μ := by
    simpa only [B,SlotResidues.slotModulus,P,Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin,κ] using hμ
  let : Nonempty (Tag M V g B) := ⟨Sum.inr ⟨0,⟨0,hB⟩,1,0,0⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨clock⟩ := RobustClock.exists_clock (Tag M V g B) P
  have honto : Function.Surjective (fun i : P => i.1.j) := by
    intro j
    exact ⟨(⟨j,0,0,fun _ => 1,fun _ => 0⟩,⟨0,hμpos⟩),rfl⟩
  let reference : P := (⟨⟨0,by omega⟩,0,0,fun _ => 1,fun _ => 0⟩,⟨0,hμpos⟩)
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_early (Alphabet := Alphabet) clock B (Fintype.card M) hB
    (fun i : P => i.1.j) honto (SlotResidues.reserved P)
  obtain ⟨L⟩ := S.exists_full_late hB g
  let A := S.parameters g L hB
  let j : Fin g := ⟨0,by omega⟩
  have hr : (S.cuts g).main j∈(S.cuts g).offsets := by
    simpa only [OuterStream.Cuts.base,Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] using
      (S.cuts g).offset_mem (.inl j) 0 S.R_pos
  have hG := S.outer_graph_height L hB T ρ β γ
    (SlotResidues.reserved_distinct P) hμ' hβ hγ reference ((S.cuts g).main j) hr
  have hlin := AffineRecovery.recovery_height (L.endRule.prefix_code L.lag) le_rfl
    (fun w => (ρ (T w)).toAddMonoidHom) (OuterStream.wordShift A clock T ρ β L.lag) 3
    (fun x y => by
      rw [←OuterStream.wordUpdate_affine A clock T ρ β L.lag]
      exact hG x y)
  refine ⟨L.endRule.complete L.lag,L.endRule.prefix_code L.lag,?_,hlin⟩
  intro d
  exact L.endRule.remainder_fiber_height T d L.lag
    (fun f b he => (S.episode_visible g L hB he).base)

end SourceSchedule

end GeneralizedStarHeight

OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.Main:95.name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.polynomialThreshold_averageSensitivity_le_of_nonzero
OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.Main:95.text:
theorem polynomialThreshold_averageSensitivity_le_of_nonzero {n d : ℕ}
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (hp : IsMultilinear p) (hd : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (hnz : ∀ x : Cube n, polynomialValue p x ≠ 0) :
    averageSensitivity (polynomialThreshold p) ≤ 8 * (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) := by
  let w : Cube n → ℝ := fun x => |polynomialValue p x|
  have hw (x : Cube n) : 0 < w x := abs_pos.mpr (hnz x)
  apply sensitivity_bound_of_cube_grading (polynomialThreshold p)
    (fun x => thresholdSign_cases (polynomialValue p x))
    (weightedProjectionMatrix w hw)
    (weightedProjectionMatrix_family w hw)
    (weightedProjectionMatrix_trace_re w hw)
  · intro i
    exact weightedProjectionMatrix_tridiagonal w hw i
  · intro r s hrs
    exact weightedProjectionMatrix_block_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree p hp hd hnz r s hrs

OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.Main:114.name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.polynomialThreshold_averageSensitivity_le
OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.Main:114.text:
theorem polynomialThreshold_averageSensitivity_le {n d : ℕ}
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (hp : IsMultilinear p) (hd : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    averageSensitivity (polynomialThreshold p) ≤ 8 * (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqd, hqnz, hqf⟩ := exists_nonzero_polynomial_same_threshold hp hd
  rw [← hqf]
  exact polynomialThreshold_averageSensitivity_le_of_nonzero q hq hqd hqnz

OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.SignPari.name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.exists_nonzero_polynomial_same_threshold
OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.SignPari.text:
theorem exists_nonzero_polynomial_same_threshold {n d : ℕ}
    {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} (hp : IsMultilinear p) (hd : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    ∃ q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      IsMultilinear q ∧ q.totalDegree ≤ d ∧
        (∀ x : Cube n, polynomialValue q x ≠ 0) ∧
        polynomialThreshold q = polynomialThreshold p := by
  obtain ⟨ε, _hε, hnonzero, hsign⟩ :=
    exists_pos_shift_nonzero_preserves_sign (polynomialValue p)
  refine ⟨p + MvPolynomial.C ε, hp.add_C ε, totalDegree_add_C_le hd ε, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    simpa only [polynomialValue_add_C] using hnonzero x
  · funext x
    simpa only [polynomialThreshold, polynomialValue_add_C] using hsign x

end LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial

OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.Model:54.name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.IsMultilinear
OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.Model:54.text:
def IsMultilinear {n : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i : Fin n, m i ≤ 1

OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.Model:68.name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.GotsmanLinialStatement
OAI.Combinatorics.GotsmanLinial.Model:68.text:
def GotsmanLinialStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n d : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ d → d ≤ n →
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ,
      IsMultilinear p → p.totalDegree ≤ d →
        averageSensitivity (polynomialThreshold p) ≤ 8 * (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

OAI.Combinatorics.SphericalRamsey.RealDe.name: OAI.GrahamSpherical.exists_real_derivation
OAI.Combinatorics.SphericalRamsey.RealDe.text:
theorem exists_real_derivation (a c : ℝ) (ha : Transcendental ℚ a) :
    ∃ D : Derivation ℤ ℝ ℝ, D a = c := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, haB, hB⟩ := exists_real_transcendenceBasis_containing a ha
  let b : B → ℝ := fun x => (x : ℝ)
  let i : B := ⟨a, haB⟩
  let F := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range b)
  let : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F ℝ := hB.isAlgebraic_field
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := exists_derivation_adjoin_coordinate b hB.1 i
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := AlgebraicExtension.exists_extension (K := ℝ) δ
  let x : F := ⟨b i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ (Set.range b) ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  have hδx : δ x = 1 := by
    exact hδ
  have hDa : D a = 1 := by
    have h := hD x
    rw [hδx, map_one] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨c • D, ?_⟩
  simp [Derivation.smul_apply, hDa]

end GrahamSpherical

end

theorem vertex_injective : Function.Injective vertex := by
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨c, d⟩ h
  have h0 := congrArg (fun x : Point 2 => x 0) h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun x : Point 2 => x 1) h
  have hp := v_pos
  have hpu := u_pos
  have hlt := v_lt_u
  have hu := u_lt_one
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> fin_cases c <;> fin_cases d
  all_goals norm_num [vertex, coordinates, squareCoordinate, Fin.ext_iff] at h0
  all_goals norm_num [vertex, coordinates, squareCoordinate, Fin.ext_iff] at h1
  all_goals first | rfl | linarith

OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.ReflectedCyl.name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderPathData
OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.ReflectedCyl.text:
noncomputable def cylinderPathData (Y : CutoffModels C q) : CutoffPathData hC q n Y where
  P := reflectedCylinder hC q n hnq H Y
  p₀ := reflectedCylinderEndpoint hC q n hnq H Y false
  p₁ := reflectedCylinderEndpoint hC q n hnq H Y true
  lifts₀ := reflectedCylinderEndpoint_lifts hC q n hnq H Y false
  lifts₁ := reflectedCylinderEndpoint_lifts hC q n hnq H Y true
  joint k hk t u₀ u₁ h₀ h₁ := by
    let R := reflectedCylinder hC q n hnq H Y
    let u : Bool → Y.obj.underlying.Cell (k+1) := fun ε =>
      if ε then cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y (k+1) u₁ else cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y (k+1) u₀
    have hu ε : (underlyingMap (reflectedCylinderEndpoint hC q n hnq H Y ε).hom).app k
        (cutoffCellEquiv hC q R k t) = Y.obj.underlying.source k (u ε) := by
      cases ε
      · have h := congrArg (cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y k) h₀
        erw [cutoffCellEquiv_comp, ← cutoffDiskFrame_source, cutoffCellEquiv_source] at h
        exact h
      · have h := congrArg (cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y k) h₁
        erw [cutoffCellEquiv_comp, ← cutoffDiskFrame_source, cutoffCellEquiv_source] at h
        exact h
    obtain ⟨l,hl,he⟩ := reflectedCylinder_joint_cells hC q n hnq H Y k hk
      (cutoffCellEquiv hC q R k t) u hu
    refine ⟨(cutoffCellEquiv hC q R (k+1)).symm l, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply (cutoffCellEquiv hC q R k).injective
      erw [← cutoffDiskFrame_source,cutoffCellEquiv_source, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hl
    · apply (cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y (k+1)).injective
      erw [cutoffCellEquiv_comp, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact he false
    · apply (cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y (k+1)).injective
      erw [cutoffCellEquiv_comp, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact he true

end GlobularTheory.Model
end Grothendieck

OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.ElementaryEx.name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.exactBoundaryTest_at_of_low_square
OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.ElementaryEx.text:
theorem exactBoundaryTest_at_of_low_square.{v} {X Y R S : GlobularSet.{v}}
    (i : Hom X Y) (j : Hom R S) (a : Hom X R) (b : Hom Y S)
    (sq : i.comp b = a.comp j) (hj : ExactBoundaryTest j) (d : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ k, k ≤ d → Function.Bijective (a.app k))
    (hb : Function.Injective (b.app d)) (hb₁ : Function.Surjective (b.app (d+1)))
    (bd : X.Boundary d) (y : Y.Cell d) (hy : Y.boundary d y = i.boundaryMap d bd) :
    ∃ x : X.Cell d, X.boundary d x = bd ∧ Y.Joined d (i.app d x) y := by
  have hy' : S.boundary d (b.app d y) = j.boundaryMap d (a.boundaryMap d bd) := by
    rw [← b.boundary_app,hy, ← Hom.boundaryMap_comp, sq, Hom.boundaryMap_comp]
  obtain ⟨r,hr,z,zs,zt⟩ := hj d (a.boundaryMap d bd) (b.app d y) hy'
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := (ha d le_rfl).surjective r
  have hxbd : X.boundary d x = bd := by
    apply (Hom.boundaryMap_bijective_of_low a d (fun k hk => ha k (by omega))).injective
    rw [a.boundary_app,hx,hr]
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := hb₁ z
  have hsquare : b.app d (i.app d x) = j.app d (a.app d x) :=
    congrFun (congrArg (fun f => f.app d) sq) x
  refine ⟨x,hxbd,c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply hb
    rw [b.source_app,hc,zs,hsquare,hx]
  · apply hb
    rw [b.target_app,hc,zt]

end GlobularSet

OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.CutoffExpans.name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.expansionContraction_all
OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.CutoffExpans.text:
theorem expansionContraction_all {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q r : ℕ) : ExpansionContraction hC q r := by
  let := cutoff_hasColimits hC q
  let := cutoff_hasLimits hC q
  have hall : ∀ m r, q-r = m → ExpansionContraction hC q r := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      intro r hr
      by_cases hqr : q ≤ r
      · exact expansionContraction_mono hC q hqr (expansionContraction_top hC q)
      · have Hnext : ExpansionContraction hC q (r+1) := @ih (q-(r+1)) (by omega) (r+1) rfl
        exact expansionContraction_of_paths hC q r
          (fun Y => ⟨cylinderPathData hC q r (by omega) Hnext Y⟩)
  exact @hall (q-r) r rfl

OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.CutoffExpans.name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.exactBoundaryTest_of_cutoff_path
OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.CutoffExpans.text:
theorem exactBoundaryTest_of_cutoff_path {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q r : ℕ) {X Y : CutoffModels C q} (i : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : (sourceClass hC q r).rlp.llp i) (hX : Cofibrant hC q X)
    (z : Y ⟶ X) (hz : i ≫ z = 𝟙 X) (P : CutoffPathData hC q r Y) :
    GlobularSet.ExactBoundaryTest (underlyingMap i.hom) := by
  let := cutoff_hasLimits hC q
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hX P.p₀ P.lifts₀ i
  let u : X ⟶ Y := a ≫ P.p₁
  let := hi (prod.lift P.p₀ P.p₁) P.joint_rlp
  have sq : CommSq a i (prod.lift P.p₀ P.p₁) (prod.lift (𝟙 Y) (z ≫ u)) := by
    constructor
    apply prod.hom_ext
    · simpa only [Category.assoc, prod.lift_fst, Category.comp_id] using ha
    · simp only [Category.assoc, prod.lift_snd]
      rw [← Category.assoc i, hz, Category.id_comp]
  have hf₀ : sq.lift ≫ P.p₀ = 𝟙 Y := by
    have e := congrArg (· ≫ prod.fst) sq.fac_right
    simpa only [Category.assoc, prod.lift_fst] using e
  have hf₁ : sq.lift ≫ P.p₁ = z ≫ u := by
    have e := congrArg (· ≫ prod.snd) sq.fac_right
    simpa only [Category.assoc, prod.lift_snd] using e
  have hp₀ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap P.p₀.hom) := by
    intro k
    exact (hasLiftingProperty_I_iff k P.p₀.hom).1
      ((boundaryClass_rlp_iff hC q 0 P.p₀).1 P.lifts₀ k (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hp₁ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap P.p₁.hom) := by
    intro k
    exact (hasLiftingProperty_I_iff k P.p₁.hom).1
      ((boundaryClass_rlp_iff hC q 0 P.p₁).1 P.lifts₁ k (Nat.zero_le k))
  apply GlobularSet.ExactBoundaryTest.of_retract_factor
    (underlyingMap i.hom) (underlyingMap z.hom) (underlyingMap u.hom)
    (congrArg (fun t : X ⟶ X => underlyingMap t.hom) hz) _ (Y.obj.joined_refl hC)
  have hv := GlobularSet.exactBoundaryTest_endpoint_section
    (underlyingMap P.p₀.hom) (underlyingMap P.p₁.hom) (underlyingMap sq.lift.hom)
    hp₀ hp₁
    (fun k x => congrFun (congrArg (fun t => (underlyingMap t.hom).app k) hf₀) x)
    (Y.obj.joined_refl hC)
  have e := congrArg (fun t : Y ⟶ Y => underlyingMap t.hom) hf₁
  change GlobularSet.ExactBoundaryTest (underlyingMap (sq.lift ≫ P.p₁).hom) at hv
  rw [e] at hv
  exact hv

OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.CutoffExpans.name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_elementary_exactBoundaryTest
OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.CutoffExpans.text:
theorem cutoff_elementary_exactBoundaryTest {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (hnq : n ≤ q) {X Y : C.Model} (hX : X.IsCellular)
    (a : disk C n ⟶ X) (i : X ⟶ Y) (b : disk C (n+1) ⟶ Y)
    (sq : IsPushout a (J C n) i b) :
    GlobularSet.ExactBoundaryTest (underlyingMap ((cutoffFunctor hC q).map i).hom) := by
  let := cutoff_hasColimits hC q
  let := cutoff_hasLimits hC q
  let F := cutoffFunctor hC q
  let : F.IsLeftAdjoint := (cutoffAdjunction hC q).isLeftAdjoint
  have hi : (sourceClass hC q n).rlp.llp (F.map i) := by
    apply MorphismProperty.of_isPushout (sq.map F)
    intro P Q p hp
    exact hp _ (MorphismProperty.ofHoms.mk (⟨n,le_rfl⟩ : {k : ℕ // n ≤ k}))
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := elementary_pushout_retraction hC n a i b sq
  apply exactBoundaryTest_of_cutoff_path hC q n (F.map i) hi
    (isCellular_cutoff_cofibrant hC q hX) (F.map z)
  · exact (F.map_comp i z).symm.trans ((congrArg F.map hz).trans (F.map_id X))
  · exact cylinderPathData hC q n hnq (expansionContraction_all hC q (n+1)) (F.obj Y)

end Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model

end OAI

OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.ElementaryEx.name: OAI.Grothendieck.elementary_expansion
OAI.CategoryTheory.Globular.ElementaryEx.text:
theorem elementary_expansion.{v} (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (X : C.Model) (hX : X.IsCellular) (n : ℕ)
    (a : GlobularTheory.Model.disk C n ⟶ X)
    (Y : C.Model) (i : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : GlobularTheory.Model.disk C (n + 1) ⟶ Y)
    (square : IsPushout a (GlobularTheory.Model.J C n) i b) :
    GlobularTheory.Model.WeakEquivalence hC i := by
  apply GlobularTheory.Model.weakEquivalence_of_exactBoundaryTest hC
  intro d bd y hy
  let q := max (n+1) (d+1)
  have hnq : n ≤ q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hdq : d ≤ q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hd₁q : d+1 ≤ q := Nat.le_max_right _ _
  let F := GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffFunctor hC q
  let ηX := GlobularTheory.Model.underlyingMap
    (GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffUnit hC q X)
  let ηY := GlobularTheory.Model.underlyingMap
    (GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffUnit hC q Y)
  have hs : (GlobularTheory.Model.underlyingMap i).comp ηY =
      ηX.comp (GlobularTheory.Model.underlyingMap (F.map i).hom) :=
    congrArg GlobularTheory.Model.underlyingMap
      ((GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffAdjunction hC q).unit.naturality i)
  exact GlobularSet.exactBoundaryTest_at_of_low_square
    (GlobularTheory.Model.underlyingMap i)
    (GlobularTheory.Model.underlyingMap (F.map i).hom) ηX ηY hs
    (GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_elementary_exactBoundaryTest hC q n hnq hX a i b square)
    d (fun k hk => GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffUnit_low_bijective hC q X k (hk.trans hdq))
    (GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffUnit_low_bijective hC q Y d hdq).injective
    (GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffUnit_low_bijective hC q Y (d+1) hd₁q).surjective bd y hy

end Grothendieck

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.GroupDeterminants.Projectio.name: OAI.GroupRingDeterminant.projection_criterion
OAI.Analysis.GroupDeterminants.Projectio.text:
theorem projection_criterion (D : ℕ) (hodd : Odd D)
    (P : Matrix m m (MonoidAlgebra ℚ G)) (hP : P * P = P ∧ IsSelfAdjoint P)
    (htrace : (Fintype.card r : ℚ) < ∑ i, (P i i).coeff 1)
    (Z : Matrix m m (MonoidAlgebra ℤ G)) (hZ : Z.map toRat = (D : ℚ) • P)
    (u : Matrix m r (MonoidAlgebra (ZMod 2) G))
    (v : Matrix r m (MonoidAlgebra (ZMod 2) G)) (huv : u * v = Z.map (toMod 2)) :
    MainStatement := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hq, hqD⟩ := exists_binary_modulus D hodd.pos hodd
  obtain ⟨U, V, A, hA, hAu⟩ := integral_transfer_of_congruence D hodd P hP.1 Z hZ u v huv k hk hqD
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (r ⊕ m)
  let A' := Matrix.reindex e e A
  have hAu' : IsUnit (rationalMatrix A') := reindexed_rational_isUnit A hAu
  have hqR : (1 : ℝ) < (2 ^ k : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hPC : P.map rationalComplexMap * P.map rationalComplexMap = P.map rationalComplexMap := by
    rw [← Matrix.map_mul, hP.1]
  have hOp : regularOperator A' = indexedComplexRepresentation
      (transferMatrix (((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ) (P.map rationalComplexMap)
        ((U.map toRat).map rationalComplexMap) ((V.map toRat).map rationalComplexMap)) := by
    rw [← rationalIndexed_integer A, hA, transferMatrix_map_complex]
  have hlog := transfer_trace_log (((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ)
    (lt_trans zero_lt_one hqR) (P.map rationalComplexMap) hPC
      ((U.map toRat).map rationalComplexMap) ((V.map toRat).map rationalComplexMap)
  dsimp only at hlog
  rw [← hOp, rationalComplexMap_trace] at hlog
  have htraceR : (Fintype.card r : ℝ) < ((∑ i, (P i i).coeff 1 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast htrace
  have hn : 2 * ((Fintype.card r : ℝ) - ((∑ i, (P i i).coeff 1 : ℚ) : ℝ)) *
      Real.log (((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℚ) : ℝ) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by norm_num) (sub_neg.mpr htraceR))
      (Real.log_pos (by simpa using hqR))
  refine ⟨G, inferInstance, inferInstance, Fintype.card (r ⊕ m),
    Fintype.card_pos, A', regularOperator A', hAu', regularOperator_spec A',
    regularOperator_isUnit hAu', fkDet_pos _, ?_⟩
  unfold fkDet
  apply Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr
  rw [hlog, Complex.ofReal_re]
  exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hn (by norm_num)

end ProjectionCriterion
end GroupRingDeterminant

end

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:72.name: OAI.HadamardSix.ratio_cubeFiber_sum_zero
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:72.text:
lemma ratio_cubeFiber_sum_zero (v : Index → ℂ) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ = 1)
    (h1 : ∑ i, v i = 0) (h2 : ∑ i, v i ^ 2 = 0)
    (a b : ℂ) (hne : a ≠ b) (hab : ∀ i, v i ^ 3 = a ∨ v i ^ 3 = b) :
    ∑ i ∈ cubeFiber v a, v i = 0 := by
  classical
  have hf : (∑ i ∈ cubeFiber v a, v i ^ 4) = a * ∑ i ∈ cubeFiber v a, v i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [← (mem_cubeFiber v a i).mp hi]
    ring
  have hl : (∑ i ∈ (cubeFiber v a)ᶜ, v i ^ 4) = b * ∑ i ∈ (cubeFiber v a)ᶜ, v i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [← (hab i).resolve_left (by simpa using hi)]
    ring
  have h4 := fourth_power_sum_zero v hv h1 h2
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl (cubeFiber v a), hf, hl] at h4
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl (cubeFiber v a)] at h1
  have he : (a - b) * ∑ i ∈ cubeFiber v a, v i = 0 := by
    linear_combination h4 - b * h1
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp he).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.Polynomials:1.name: OAI.HadamardSix.fourth_power_sum_zero
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.Polynomials:1.text:
lemma fourth_power_sum_zero (v : Index → ℂ) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ = 1)
    (h1 : ∑ i, v i = 0) (h2 : ∑ i, v i ^ 2 = 0) : ∑ i, v i ^ 4 = 0 := by
  have ha : (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal 4 : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) =
      {(0, 4), (1, 3), (2, 2), (3, 1), (4, 0)} := by decide
  have he4 : elementary v 4 = 0 := by
    simpa only [elementary_two_of_power_sums v h1 h2, star_zero, mul_zero]
      using elementary_complement v hv 2 (by decide)
  have hnpoly := MvPolynomial.mul_esymm_eq_sum Index ℂ 4
  rw [ha] at hnpoly
  norm_num [Finset.sum_filter] at hnpoly
  have hn := congrArg (MvPolynomial.aeval v : MvPolynomial Index ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ) hnpoly
  simp only [map_mul, map_ofNat, map_neg, map_add, map_sum,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_esymm_eq_multiset_esymm] at hn
  have hn' : 4 * elementary v 4 = -(∑ i, v i ^ 4) := by
    simpa [elementary, MvPolynomial.psum, h1, h2] using hn
  rw [he4] at hn'
  simpa using hn'.symm

end HadamardSix

end OAI

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:99.name: OAI.HadamardSix.rowRatio_norm
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:99.text:
lemma rowRatio_norm {H : Matrix6} (hu : Unimodular H) (i j k : Index) :
    ‖rowRatio H i j k‖ = 1 := by simp [rowRatio, hu i k, hu j k]

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:17.name: OAI.HadamardSix.rowRatio_cubeFiber_sum_zero
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:17.text:
lemma rowRatio_cubeFiber_sum_zero {H : Matrix6} (hH : IsComplexHadamard H)
    (hs : IsComplexHadamard (entrywiseSquare H)) {i j : Index} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (a b : ℂ) (hne : a ≠ b)
    (hab : ∀ k, rowRatio H i j k ^ 3 = a ∨ rowRatio H i j k ^ 3 = b) :
    ∑ k ∈ cubeFiber (rowRatio H i j) a, H i k * star (H j k) = 0 :=
  ratio_cubeFiber_sum_zero (rowRatio H i j) (rowRatio_norm hH.1 i j)
    (rowRatio_first_sum hH hij) (rowRatio_second_sum hs hij) a b hne hab

end HadamardSix

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:96.name: OAI.HadamardSix.rowRatio
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:96.text:
noncomputable def rowRatio (H : Matrix6) (i j : Index) : Index → ℂ :=
  fun k => H i k * star (H j k)

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:15.name: OAI.HadamardSix.mem_cubeFiber
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:15.text:
@[simp] lemma mem_cubeFiber (v : Index → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (i : Index) :
    i ∈ cubeFiber v z ↔ v i ^ 3 = z := by
  classical
  simp [cubeFiber]

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.Basic:15.name: OAI.HadamardSix.Unimodular
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.Basic:15.text: def Unimodular (H : Matrix6) : Prop := ∀ i j, ‖H i j‖ = 1

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:10.name: OAI.HadamardSix.rowRatio_first_sum
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.CubeFibers:10.text:
lemma rowRatio_first_sum {H : Matrix6} (hH : IsComplexHadamard H)
    {i j : Index} (hij : i ≠ j) : ∑ k, rowRatio H i j k = 0 := by
  simpa only [rowRatio, ite_eq_right hij] using hH.row_orthogonality i j

OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.Basic:17.name: OAI.HadamardSix.IsComplexHadamard
OAI.LinearAlgebra.Hadamard.Basic:17.text:
def IsComplexHadamard (H : Matrix6) : Prop :=
  Unimodular H ∧ H.conjTranspose * H = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix6)

OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Recurrenc.name: OAI.PlanarHalving.Sweep.packing_scale
OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Recurrenc.text:
lemma packing_scale : ∃ q : ℕ, 4≤q ∧ ∀ {n k : ℕ} (P : Fin n → Point)
    (hP : Generic P) (hk : k≤n) (_hn : 4*q≤n),
    let b := n/q-1
    ∀ hb : 0<b, (((states P hP hk).activityGreedy 0 b hb).count:ℝ)+1≤(q:ℝ)^((4:ℝ)/3)/2 := by
  obtain ⟨Q,_,hpack⟩ := activity_saving_cubic (δ := (1:ℝ)/(524288*1024)) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (4:ℝ) Q)
  have hq4 : 4≤q := by exact_mod_cast (le_max_left (4:ℝ) Q).trans hq.le
  have hqQ : Q≤q := (le_max_right (4:ℝ) Q).trans hq.le
  refine ⟨q,hq4,?_⟩
  intro n k P hP hk hn b hb
  let S := states P hP hk
  let G := S.activityGreedy 0 b hb
  have hscale := division_scale hq4 hn
  change 0<b ∧ b+1=n/q ∧ (b+1:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)/q ∧ n≤2*q*b ∧ b+1<n at hscale
  have hqb : q*b≤n := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left q (Nat.sub_le (n/q) 1)).trans (Nat.mul_div_le n q)
  have hratio : Q≤(n:ℝ)/b := hqQ.trans ((le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hb)).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hqb))
  have hdata := G.intervals_data S
  have hh := hpack P hP hk hb hratio (G.intervals S) hdata.1
    (fun p hp => (hdata.2 p hp).1) (fun p hp => by
      rw [← S.activitySize_eq]
      exact (hdata.2 p hp).2)
  rw [G.intervals_card S] at hh
  apply greedy_count_bound hq4 hb hscale.2.2.2.1
  norm_num at hh
  nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Main:27.name: OAI.PlanarHalving.power_bounds
OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Main:27.text:
theorem power_bounds :
    (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ n₀ : ℕ,
      ∀ n : ℕ, Even n → n₀ ≤ n → ∀ P : Fin n → Point,
        GeneralPosition P → (halvingCount P : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ ((4 : ℝ) / 3 - ε)) ∧
    (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ C : ℝ,
      ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ P : Fin n → Point, Generic P →
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n → (switchCount P k : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ ((4 : ℝ) / 3 - ε)) :=
  ⟨halving_power, all_ranks_power⟩

end PlanarHalving

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Decomposi.name: OAI.PlanarHalving.Sweep.recurrence_exponent
OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Decomposi.text:
lemma recurrence_exponent {q : ℕ} (hq : 4≤q) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0<ε ∧ 0<(4:ℝ)/3-ε ∧
      (q:ℝ)^((4:ℝ)/3)/2≤(q:ℝ)^((4:ℝ)/3-ε) := by
  have hq2 : (2:ℝ)≤q := by exact_mod_cast (show 2≤q by omega)
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ)<q := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hq2
  have hl2 : 0<Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlq : 0<Real.log (q:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlog : Real.log 2≤Real.log (q:ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hq2
  let ε : ℝ := Real.log 2/(2*Real.log (q:ℝ))
  have he : 0<ε := div_pos hl2 (by positivity)
  have hehalf : ε≤1/2 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<2*Real.log (q:ℝ))).mpr
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨ε,he,by linarith,?_⟩
  rw [Real.rpow_sub hq0]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 ε)
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hq0]
  calc
    Real.exp (Real.log (q:ℝ)*ε) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log 2) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      dsimp [ε]
      have hl0 := ne_of_gt hlq
      field_simp
      nlinarith
    _ = 2 := Real.exp_log (by norm_num)

end PlanarHalving.Sweep

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Recurrenc.name: OAI.PlanarHalving.all_ranks_power
OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Recurrenc.text:
theorem all_ranks_power :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ C : ℝ,
      ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ P : Fin n → Point, Generic P →
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n → (switchCount P k : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ ((4 : ℝ) / 3 - ε) := by
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hpack⟩ := Sweep.packing_scale
  obtain ⟨ε,he,hβ,hpow⟩ := Sweep.recurrence_exponent hq
  refine ⟨ε,he,(4*(q:ℝ))^2,?_⟩
  intro n _ P hP k hk
  apply Sweep.count_bound_induction hq hβ _ n P hP k hk
  intro n k P hP hk hn b hb
  exact (hpack P hP hk hn hb).trans hpow
end PlanarHalving

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Perturbat.name: OAI.PlanarHalving.Perturbation.generic_same_halvingCount
OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Perturbat.text:
lemma generic_same_halvingCount {n : ℕ} {P : Fin n → Point} (hP : GeneralPosition P) :
    ∃ Q : Fin n → Point, Generic Q ∧ halvingCount P=halvingCount Q := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hsides⟩ := generic_same_sides hP
  have hcount (i j : Fin n) : sideCount P i j=sideCount Q i j := by
    unfold sideCount
    apply congrArg Finset.card
    exact Finset.filter_congr (fun l _ => hsides i j l)
  refine ⟨Q,hQ,?_⟩
  unfold halvingCount
  apply congrArg Finset.card
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro ij _
  rw [hcount,hcount]

end PlanarHalving.Perturbation

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Main:9.name: OAI.PlanarHalving.halving_power
OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Main:9.text:
theorem halving_power :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ n₀ : ℕ,
      ∀ n : ℕ, Even n → n₀ ≤ n → ∀ P : Fin n → Point,
        GeneralPosition P → (halvingCount P : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ ((4 : ℝ) / 3 - ε) := by
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,C,hbound⟩ := all_ranks_power
  refine ⟨ε,hε,C,2,?_⟩
  intro n heven hn P hP
  obtain ⟨m,hm⟩ := heven
  have hn' : n=2*m := by omega
  clear hm
  subst n
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hcount⟩ := Perturbation.generic_same_halvingCount hP
  rw [hcount,halvingCount_eq_middle_switchCount (by omega : 0 < m) Q hQ]
  exact hbound (2*m) (by omega) Q hQ m (by omega)
end PlanarHalving

namespace PlanarHalving

OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Recurrenc.name: OAI.PlanarHalving.Sweep.count_bound_induction
OAI.Combinatorics.HalvingLines.Recurrenc.text:
lemma count_bound_induction {q : ℕ} (hq : 4≤q) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0<β)
    (hpacking : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (P : Fin n → Point) (hP : Generic P) (hk : k≤n)
      (_hn : 4*q≤n), let b := n/q-1
      ∀ hb : 0<b, (((states P hP hk).activityGreedy 0 b hb).count:ℝ)+1≤(q:ℝ)^β) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ P : Fin n → Point, Generic P → ∀ k : ℕ, k≤n →
      (switchCount P k:ℝ)≤(4*(q:ℝ))^2*(n:ℝ)^β := by
  let C : ℝ := (4*(q:ℝ))^2
  have hC : 0≤C := sq_nonneg _
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ)<q := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<q by omega)
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro P hP k hk
    by_cases hn : 4*q≤n
    · let b := n/q-1
      have hscale := division_scale hq hn
      change 0<b ∧ b+1=n/q ∧ (b+1:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)/q ∧ n≤2*q*b ∧ b+1<n at hscale
      let hb := hscale.1
      let G := (states P hP hk).activityGreedy 0 b hb
      obtain ⟨A,r,hA,hr,hcount⟩ := activity_decomposition hP hk hb
      have hg : (G.count:ℝ)+1≤(q:ℝ)^β := hpacking P hP hk hn hb
      have hAreal (j : Fin (G.count+1)) : ((A j).card:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)/q :=
        (by exact_mod_cast hA j : ((A j).card:ℝ)≤b+1).trans hscale.2.2.1
      have hind (j : Fin (G.count+1)) :
          (switchCount (subsetPoints P (A j)) (r j):ℝ)≤C*((A j).card:ℝ)^β :=
        ih (A j).card ((hA j).trans_lt hscale.2.2.2.2) (subsetPoints P (A j))
          (subsetPoints_generic hP (A j)) (r j) (hr j)
      change (switchCount P k:ℝ)≤C*(n:ℝ)^β
      calc
        (switchCount P k:ℝ) ≤ ∑ j : Fin (G.count+1), (switchCount (subsetPoints P (A j)) (r j):ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcount
        _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin (G.count+1), C*((A j).card:ℝ)^β := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hind j)
        _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (G.count+1), C*((n:ℝ)/q)^β := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ =>
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (hAreal j) hβ.le) hC)
        _ = C*((n:ℝ)/q)^β*((G.count:ℝ)+1) := by simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one];ring
        _ ≤ C*((n:ℝ)/q)^β*(q:ℝ)^β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (mul_nonneg hC (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _))
        _ = C*(n:ℝ)^β := by rw [Real.div_rpow (by positivity) hq0.le];field_simp
    · have hs : (switchCount P k:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)^2 := by exact_mod_cast (by simpa only [pow_two] using switchCount_le_sq P k : switchCount P k≤n^2)
      by_cases hz : n=0
      · subst n
        simpa only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_pow (by decide : (2:ℕ)≠0),Real.zero_rpow hβ.ne',mul_zero] using hs
      · have hn1 : (1:ℝ)≤n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1≤n by omega)
        have hnr : (n:ℝ)≤4*(q:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hn))
        have hpow : 1≤(n:ℝ)^β := by
          simpa only [Real.one_rpow] using Real.rpow_le_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1) hn1 hβ.le
        exact (hs.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hnr 2)).trans (le_mul_of_one_le_right hC hpow)

end PlanarHalving.Sweep

namespace PlanarHalving

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Orbitals.Orbital.name: OAI.HardSphere.Orbital.map_norm_le

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.CondensationDefi.name: OAI.HardSphere.GroundSupported

    (T : Density.Operator (ScalarL2 N L)) : Prop :=

    ∃u : Jet N L,u.1=ψ ∧ IsGroundVector N L a u

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.M.name: OAI.HardSphere.condensation_with_mixed
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.M.text:
theorem condensation_with_mixed :
    ∃ε₀ c₀ : ℝ,0<ε₀ ∧ 0<c₀ ∧
    ∀a ρ : ℝ,0<a → 0<ρ → ρ*a^3<ε₀ →
    ∀(N : ℕ→ℕ) (L : ℕ→Length) (hN : ∀k,0<N k),
      Tendsto N atTop atTop → Tendsto (fun k ↦ (L k).val) atTop atTop →
      Tendsto (fun k ↦ (N k:ℝ)/(L k).val^3) atTop (𝓝 ρ) →
      (∀Ψ : (k : ℕ)→Jet (N k) (L k),
        (∀k,IsGroundVector (N k) (L k) a (Ψ k)) →
        c₀≤liminf (fun k ↦ occupation (hN k) (Ψ k).1) atTop) ∧
      (∀T : (k : ℕ)→Density.Operator (ScalarL2 (N k) (L k)),
        (∀k,GroundSupported a (T k)) →
        c₀≤liminf (fun k ↦ mixedOccupation (hN k) (T k)) atTop) := by
  obtain ⟨ε,c,hε,hc,hevent⟩ := eventually_all_ground_occupation
  refine ⟨ε,c,hε,hc,?_⟩
  intro a ρ ha hρ hd N L hN hNtop hLtop hdensity
  have he := hevent a ρ ha hρ hd N L hN hNtop hLtop hdensity
  constructor
  · intro Ψ hΨ
    have hbounded : ∀ index, occupation (hN index) (Ψ index).1 ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro index
      simpa only [(hΨ index).2.2.1,one_pow] using
        occupation_le_norm_sq (hN index) (Ψ index).1
    apply le_liminf_of_le (isCoboundedUnder_ge_of_le atTop hbounded)
    filter_upwards [he] with index hindex
    exact hindex (Ψ index) (hΨ index)
  · intro T hT
    apply le_liminf_of_le (isCoboundedUnder_ge_of_le atTop (x:=1) (fun k ↦ mixedOccupation_le_one (hN k) (T k)))
    filter_upwards [he] with k hk
    exact mixedOccupation_lower (hN k) (T k) (hT k) hk

end HardSphere
end
end

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.P.name: OAI.HardSphere.physical_scaled_occupation
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.P.text:
theorem physical_scaled_occupation :
    ∃A c D₀ : ℝ,2≤A ∧ 0<c ∧ 1≤D₀ ∧ ∃K₀ : ℕ,400≤K₀ ∧
    ∀{N K : ℕ} [NeZero K] {L : Length},∀hN : 2≤N,∀hL : L.val=(K:ℝ),K₀≤K →
    ∀D α : ℝ,D=(N:ℝ)/L.val^3 → D₀≤D → A/2≤α → α≤2*A →
    ∀ψ : Jet N L,IsGroundVector N L (α/D) ψ →
      c≤occupation (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0<2) hN) ψ.1 := by
  obtain ⟨A,c,Dm,hA,hc,hDm,Km,hKm,hmod⟩ := Groups.physical_uniform_modulus
  obtain ⟨Dp,hDp,Kp,hKp,hphase⟩ := physical_uniform_phase_error hA hc
  refine ⟨A,c/2,max Dm Dp,hA,by positivity,hDm.trans (le_max_left _ _),
    max Km Kp,hKm.trans (le_max_left _ _),?_⟩
  intro N K instK L hN hL hK D α hDeq hD hlo hhi ψ hψ
  cases N with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
    have hn : 0<n := by omega
    have : Nontrivial (Fin (n+1)) := Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hN
    have hm := hmod hL ((le_max_left Km Kp).trans hK) D α
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using hDeq)
      ((le_max_left Dm Dp).trans hD) hlo hhi ψ hψ
    have hp := hphase hL ((le_max_right Km Kp).trans hK) D α
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using hDeq)
      ((le_max_right Dm Dp).trans hD) hlo hhi ψ hψ
    rw [occupation_eq_phase]
    linarith

end HardSphere
end
end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.P.name: OAI.HardSphere.Rescaling.jet_ground
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.P.text:
theorem jet_ground {N : ℕ} {L J : Length} {a : ℝ} {u : Jet N J}
    (hu : IsGroundVector N J a u) : IsGroundVector N L ((L.val/J.val)*a) (jet N L J u) := by
  have hLp := L.property
  have hJp := J.property
  refine ⟨jet_domain hu.1,pull_bosonic hu.2.1,?_,?_⟩
  · change ‖unitary N L J u.1‖=1
    exact ((unitary N L J).norm_map u.1).trans hu.2.2.1
  · intro v hv hb hn
    have hd := jet_domain (L:=J) hv
    have he : (J.val/L.val)*((L.val/J.val)*a)=a := by field_simp
    rw [he] at hd
    have h := hu.2.2.2 (jet N J L v) hd (pull_bosonic hb) (by rw [jet_fst,pull_norm,hn])
    rw [jet_energy] at h ⊢
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (sq_nonneg (J.val/L.val))
    have hid : (J.val/L.val)^2*((L.val/J.val)^2*energy v)=energy v := by field_simp
    exact ht.trans_eq hid

end HardSphere.Rescaling
end

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.T.name: OAI.HardSphere.Calibration.densityLimit_above_threshold
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.T.text:
lemma densityLimit_above_threshold {a α ρ T : ℝ}
    (ha : 0<a) (hα : 0<α) (hρ : 0<ρ) (hT : 0<T)
    (hdilute : ρ*a^3 < α^3/(4*T^2)) : 2*T < densityLimit a α ρ := by
  have hn : 0<ρ*a^3 := by positivity
  have hden : 0<4*T^2 := by positivity
  have hh := (lt_div_iff₀ hden).mp hdilute
  have hs : (2*T)^2 < α^3/(ρ*a^3) := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hn).2
    nlinarith
  rw [← densityLimit_sq ha hα hρ] at hs
  have hp := densityLimit_pos ha hα hρ
  nlinarith

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.O.name: OAI.HardSphere.occupation_le_norm_sq
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.O.text:
lemma occupation_le_norm_sq {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} (ψ : ScalarL2 N L) :
    occupation hN ψ≤‖ψ‖^2 := by
  have hLp := L.property
  let f := fun p : Configuration (N-1) L×Torus L ↦ ψ (insertFirst hN p.2 p.1)
  have hf : MemLp f 2 (volume.prod volume) := ground_slice_memLp hN ψ
  have ha := Phase.memLp_integral_norm hf
  have hc : MemLp (fun Y ↦ ‖∫x,f (Y,x)‖) 2 volume := by
    refine ha.mono' hf.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'.norm ?_
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun Y ↦ by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
      exact norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
  have hi := (hf.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)).integral_prod_left
  have hbound : (∫Y,‖∫x,f (Y,x)‖^2)≤(volume : Measure (Torus L)).real univ * ∫p,‖f p‖^2 ∂volume.prod volume := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫Y,(volume : Measure (Torus L)).real univ * ∫x,‖f (Y,x)‖^2 := by
        apply integral_mono_ae hc.integrable_sq (hi.const_mul _)
        filter_upwards [Phase.memLp_slices hf] with Y hY
        exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) 2).trans
          (Phase.integral_norm_sq_le hY)
      _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul,←integral_prod _ (hf.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0))]
  have hm : (∫p,‖f p‖^2 ∂volume.prod volume)=‖ψ‖^2 := by
    rw [scalar_norm_sq_integral]
    exact (bathFirst_preserving hN L).integral_comp
      (by
        cases N with
        | zero => omega
        | succ n =>
          convert (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) ↦ Torus L) 0).symm.measurableEmbedding.comp
            (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm (α:=Configuration n L) (β:=Torus L)).measurableEmbedding using 1 <;> try rfl
          funext p i
          simp [insertFirst,MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove,MeasurableEquiv.prodComm])
      (fun X ↦ ‖ψ X‖^2)
  rw [hm,Measure.real,BathSlice.volume_torus,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0≤L.val^3)] at hbound
  unfold occupation
  change (L.val^3)⁻¹*(∫Y,‖∫x,f (Y,x)‖^2)≤‖ψ‖^2
  calc
    _ ≤ (L.val^3)⁻¹*(L.val^3*‖ψ‖^2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [←mul_assoc,inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ L.property.ne'),one_mul]

end HardSphere
end

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Conditioning.Pha.text:
lemma memLp_integral_norm {f : Y × X → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
    MemLp (fun y ↦ ∫ x, ‖f (y,x)‖ ∂ν) 2 μ := by
  have hm := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.norm.integral_prod_right'
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hm).2
  have hi := (hf.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).integral_prod_left
  apply (hi.const_mul (ν.real univ)).mono' (hm.pow 2)
  filter_upwards [memLp_slices hf] with y hy
  change ‖(∫ x, ‖f (y,x)‖ ∂ν)^2‖ ≤ _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  exact integral_norm_sq_le hy

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.T.name: OAI.HardSphere.Calibration.eventually_scaled_window
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.T.text:
theorem eventually_scaled_window {a α ρ T : ℝ}
    (ha : 0<a) (hα : 0<α) (hρ : 0<ρ) (hT : 0<T)
    (hdilute : ρ*a^3 < α^3/(4*T^2))
    (N : ℕ → ℕ) (L : ℕ → ℝ) (hN : ∀ k, 0<N k) (hL : ∀ k, 0<L k)
    (hLtop : Tendsto L atTop atTop)
    (hdensity : Tendsto (fun k ↦ (N k:ℝ)/L k^3) atTop (𝓝 ρ)) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      α/2 < ((N k:ℝ)/(scaleK a α (N k) (L k):ℝ)^3) *
        (a*(scaleK a α (N k) (L k):ℝ)/L k) ∧
      ((N k:ℝ)/(scaleK a α (N k) (L k):ℝ)^3) *
        (a*(scaleK a α (N k) (L k):ℝ)/L k) < 2*α ∧
      (T+densityLimit a α ρ)/2 < (N k:ℝ)/(scaleK a α (N k) (L k):ℝ)^3 ∧
      (N k:ℝ)/(scaleK a α (N k) (L k):ℝ)^3 < 2*densityLimit a α ρ := by
  obtain ⟨hd, halpha⟩ := scaled_parameters_limits ha hα hρ N L hN hL hLtop hdensity
  have hp := densityLimit_pos ha hα hρ
  have habove := densityLimit_above_threshold ha hα hρ hT hdilute
  have hlow : (T+densityLimit a α ρ)/2 < densityLimit a α ρ := by linarith
  have hupp : densityLimit a α ρ < 2*densityLimit a α ρ := by linarith
  have hwa := halpha.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds (show α/2<α by linarith)
    (show α<2*α by linarith))
  have hwd := hd.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds hlow hupp)
  filter_upwards [hwa, hwd] with k ha' hd'
  exact ⟨ha'.1, ha'.2, hd'.1, hd'.2⟩

end HardSphere.Calibration

end
end

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Conditioning.Pha.name: OAI.HardSphere.Phase.integral_norm_sq_le
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Conditioning.Pha.text:
lemma integral_norm_sq_le [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {f : X → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f 2 ν) :
    (∫ x, ‖f x‖ ∂ν)^2 ≤ ν.real univ * ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂ν := by
  have h := integral_mul_le_sqrt (fun _ : X ↦ 1) (fun x ↦ ‖f x‖)
    (memLp_const 1) hf.norm (Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ zero_le_one)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
  simp only [one_mul, one_pow, integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
  have ha : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ∂ν := integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _
  have hm : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x‖^2 ∂ν := integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ ha (by positivity)).2 h
  simpa only [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (measureReal_nonneg), Real.sq_sqrt hm] using hs

end HardSphere.Phase

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.O.name: OAI.HardSphere.eventually_all_ground_occupation
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.O.text:
theorem eventually_all_ground_occupation :
    ∃ε₀ c₀ : ℝ,0<ε₀ ∧ 0<c₀ ∧
    ∀a ρ : ℝ,0<a → 0<ρ → ρ*a^3<ε₀ →
    ∀(N : ℕ→ℕ) (L : ℕ→Length) (hN : ∀k,0<N k),
      Tendsto N atTop atTop → Tendsto (fun k ↦ (L k).val) atTop atTop →
      Tendsto (fun k ↦ (N k:ℝ)/(L k).val^3) atTop (𝓝 ρ) →
      ∀ᶠ k in atTop,∀ψ : Jet (N k) (L k),IsGroundVector (N k) (L k) a ψ →
        c₀≤occupation (hN k) ψ.1 := by
  obtain ⟨A,c,D₀,hA,hc,hD₀,K₀,hK₀,hscaled⟩ := physical_scaled_occupation
  have hAp : 0<A := by linarith
  have hDp : 0<D₀ := by linarith
  refine ⟨A^3/(4*D₀^2),c,by positivity,hc,?_⟩
  intro a ρ ha hρ hd N L hN hNtop hLtop hdensity
  let K := fun k ↦ Calibration.scaleK a A (N k) (L k).val
  have hKtop : Tendsto K atTop atTop :=
    (Calibration.scale_limits ha hAp hρ N (fun k ↦ (L k).val) hN
      (fun k ↦ (L k).property) hLtop hdensity).1
  have hw := Calibration.eventually_scaled_window ha hAp hρ hDp hd N
    (fun k ↦ (L k).val) hN (fun k ↦ (L k).property) hLtop hdensity
  have hlim := Calibration.densityLimit_above_threshold ha hAp hρ hDp hd
  filter_upwards [hw,hKtop.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop K₀),hNtop.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 2)] with k hk hK hNk
  have hKpos : 0<K k := by omega
  let : NeZero (K k) := ⟨hKpos.ne'⟩
  let J : Length := ⟨(K k:ℝ),by exact_mod_cast hKpos⟩
  let D : ℝ := (N k:ℝ)/J.val^3
  let α : ℝ := D*(a*J.val/(L k).val)
  have hD : D₀≤D := by
    have hh : (D₀+Calibration.densityLimit a A ρ)/2<D := hk.2.2.1
    linarith
  have hαlo : A/2≤α := hk.1.le
  have hαhi : α≤2*A := hk.2.1.le
  have hDpos : 0<D := hDp.trans_le hD
  have hradius : J.val/(L k).val*a=α/D := by
    dsimp only [α]
    field_simp
  intro ψ hψ
  have hg := Rescaling.jet_ground (L:=J) hψ
  rw [hradius] at hg
  have hh := hscaled hNk (show J.val=(K k:ℝ) from rfl) hK D α rfl hD hαlo hαhi
    (Rescaling.jet (N k) J (L k) ψ) hg
  rw [Rescaling.jet_fst,Rescaling.pull_occupation] at hh
  exact hh

OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.CondensationDefi.name: OAI.HardSphere.Orbital.continuous
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.CondensationDefi.text:
def continuous {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} : ScalarL2 N L →L[ℂ] ScalarL2 (N-1) L := by
  have scalar_norm_sq_integral {N : ℕ} {L : Length} (u : ScalarL2 N L) :
      ‖u‖^2 = ∫ X, ‖u X‖^2 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq (F := ScalarL2 N L), L2.inner_def]
    simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

  have volume_torus (L : Length) : (volume : Measure (Torus L)) Set.univ = ENNReal.ofReal (L.val^3) := by
    rw [volume_pi,Measure.pi_univ]
    simp only [AddCircle.measure_univ,Finset.prod_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,
      ENNReal.ofReal_pow L.property.le]

  have integral_mul_le_sqrt {X : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] {ν : Measure X} (f g : X → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 ν) (hg : MemLp g 2 ν)
      (hf0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] f) (hg0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] g) :
      ∫ x, f x * g x ∂ν ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂ν) *
        Real.sqrt (∫ x, g x ^ 2 ∂ν) := by
    have h := integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg
      Real.HolderConjugate.two_two hf0 hg0 (by simpa using hf) (by simpa using hg)
    simpa only [Real.rpow_two, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] using h

  have integral_norm_sq_le {X : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] {ν : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {f : X → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f 2 ν) :
      (∫ x, ‖f x‖ ∂ν)^2 ≤ ν.real univ * ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 ∂ν := by
    have h := integral_mul_le_sqrt (fun _ : X ↦ 1) (fun x ↦ ‖f x‖)
      (memLp_const (1 : ℝ)) hf.norm (Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ zero_le_one)
      (Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
    simp only [one_mul, one_pow, integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
    have ha : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ∂ν := integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _
    have hm : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x‖^2 ∂ν := integral_nonneg fun _ ↦ sq_nonneg _
    have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ ha (by positivity)).2 h
    simpa only [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (measureReal_nonneg), Real.sq_sqrt hm] using hs

  have memLp_slices {X Y : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] {ν : Measure X} {μ : Measure Y} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : Y × X → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
      ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, MemLp (fun x ↦ f (y,x)) 2 ν := by
    filter_upwards [hf.aestronglyMeasurable.prodMk_left,
      (hf.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).prod_right_ae] with y hm hi
    exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hm).2 hi

  have memLp_integral_norm {X Y : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] {ν : Measure X} {μ : Measure Y} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : Y × X → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f 2 (μ.prod ν)) :
      MemLp (fun y ↦ ∫ x, ‖f (y,x)‖ ∂ν) 2 μ := by
    have hm := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.norm.integral_prod_right'
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hm).2
    have hi := (hf.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).integral_prod_left
    apply (hi.const_mul (ν.real univ)).mono' (hm.pow 2)
    filter_upwards [memLp_slices hf] with y hy
    change ‖(∫ x, ‖f (y,x)‖ ∂ν)^2‖ ≤ _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact integral_norm_sq_le hy

  have cons_preserving {n : ℕ} (L : Length) :
      MeasurePreserving (fun p : Configuration n L × Torus L ↦ Fin.cons (α:=fun _ ↦ Torus L) p.2 p.1)
        (volume.prod volume) volume := by
    have h := (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) ↦ Torus L) 0).symm
    have hh := h.comp (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ:= (volume : Measure (Configuration n L))) (ν:=volume))
    convert hh using 1; try rfl
    funext p i
    simp [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove]

  have insertFirst_preserving {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) (L : Length) :
      MeasurePreserving (fun p : Torus L×Configuration (N-1) L ↦ insertFirst hN p.1 p.2)
        ((volume : Measure (Torus L)).prod volume) volume := by
    cases N with
    | zero => omega
    | succ n =>
      unfold insertFirst
      have h := (cons_preserving (n:=n) L).comp
        (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ:=(volume : Measure (Torus L))) (ν:=volume))
      convert h using 1 <;> simp [Function.comp_def]

  have bathFirst_preserving {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) (L : Length) :
      MeasurePreserving (fun p : Configuration (N-1) L×Torus L ↦ insertFirst hN p.2 p.1)
        ((volume : Measure (Configuration (N-1) L)).prod volume) volume :=
    (insertFirst_preserving hN L).comp (Measure.measurePreserving_swap)

  have ground_slice_memLp {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} (ψ : ScalarL2 N L) :
      MemLp (fun p : Configuration (N-1) L×Torus L ↦ ψ (insertFirst hN p.2 p.1)) 2
        ((volume : Measure (Configuration (N-1) L)).prod volume) :=
    (Lp.memLp ψ).comp_measurePreserving (bathFirst_preserving hN L)

  have occupation_le_norm_sq {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} (ψ : ScalarL2 N L) :
      occupation hN ψ≤‖ψ‖^2 := by
    have hLp := L.property
    let f := fun p : Configuration (N-1) L×Torus L ↦ ψ (insertFirst hN p.2 p.1)
    have hf : MemLp f 2 (volume.prod volume) := ground_slice_memLp hN ψ
    have ha := memLp_integral_norm hf
    have hc : MemLp (fun Y ↦ ‖∫x,f (Y,x)‖) 2 volume := by
      refine ha.mono' hf.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'.norm ?_
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun Y ↦ by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
        exact norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    have hi := (hf.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)).integral_prod_left
    have hbound : (∫Y,‖∫x,f (Y,x)‖^2)≤(volume : Measure (Torus L)).real univ * ∫p,‖f p‖^2 ∂volume.prod volume := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫Y,(volume : Measure (Torus L)).real univ * ∫x,‖f (Y,x)‖^2 := by
          apply integral_mono_ae hc.integrable_sq (hi.const_mul _)
          filter_upwards [memLp_slices hf] with Y hY
          exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) 2).trans
            (integral_norm_sq_le hY)
        _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul,←integral_prod _ (hf.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0))]
    have hm : (∫p,‖f p‖^2 ∂volume.prod volume)=‖ψ‖^2 := by
      rw [scalar_norm_sq_integral]
      exact (bathFirst_preserving hN L).integral_comp
        (by
          cases N with
          | zero => omega
          | succ n =>
            convert (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) ↦ Torus L) 0).symm.measurableEmbedding.comp
              (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm (α:=Configuration n L) (β:=Torus L)).measurableEmbedding using 1 <;> try rfl
            funext p i
            simp [insertFirst,MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove,MeasurableEquiv.prodComm])
        (fun X ↦ ‖ψ X‖^2)
    rw [hm,Measure.real,volume_torus,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0≤L.val^3)] at hbound
    unfold occupation
    change (L.val^3)⁻¹*(∫Y,‖∫x,f (Y,x)‖^2)≤‖ψ‖^2
    calc
      _ ≤ (L.val^3)⁻¹*(L.val^3*‖ψ‖^2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [←mul_assoc,inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ L.property.ne'),one_mul]

  have map_ae {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} (ψ : ScalarL2 N L) : (map hN ψ : Configuration (N-1) L→ℂ)=ᵐ[volume] sliceIntegral hN ψ := by
    unfold map
    exact MemLp.coeFn_toLp _

  have map_add {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} (f g : ScalarL2 N L) : map hN (f+g)=map hN f+map hN g := by
    apply Lp.ext
    have hp := (bathFirst_preserving hN L).quasiMeasurePreserving.tendsto_ae.eventually (Lp.coeFn_add f g)
    have hs := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hp
    filter_upwards [map_ae hN (f+g),map_ae hN f,map_ae hN g,Lp.coeFn_add (map hN f) (map hN g),hs,
      memLp_slices (ground_slice_memLp hN f),memLp_slices (ground_slice_memLp hN g)] with Y hh hf hg hsum hY hfi hgi
    rw [hh,hsum]
    change sliceIntegral hN (f+g) Y=(map hN f) Y+(map hN g) Y
    rw [hf,hg]
    unfold sliceIntegral
    rw [←smul_add,←integral_add (hfi.integrable (by norm_num)) (hgi.integrable (by norm_num))]
    congr 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact hY

  have map_smul {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} (c : ℂ) (f : ScalarL2 N L) : map hN (c • f)=c • map hN f := by
    apply Lp.ext
    have hp := (bathFirst_preserving hN L).quasiMeasurePreserving.tendsto_ae.eventually (Lp.coeFn_smul c f)
    have hs := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hp
    filter_upwards [map_ae hN (c•f),map_ae hN f,Lp.coeFn_smul c (map hN f),hs] with Y hh hf hc hY
    rw [hh,hc]
    change sliceIntegral hN (c•f) Y=c • (map hN f) Y
    rw [hf]
    change (Real.sqrt (L.val^3))⁻¹ • (∫x : Torus L,(c•f) (insertFirst hN x Y))=
      c • ((Real.sqrt (L.val^3))⁻¹ • ∫x : Torus L,f (insertFirst hN x Y))
    rw [integral_congr_ae hY]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
    rw [integral_smul]
    exact smul_comm _ _ _

  have map_norm_sq {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} (ψ : ScalarL2 N L) : ‖map hN ψ‖^2=occupation hN ψ := by
    have hLp := L.property
    rw [scalar_norm_sq_integral]
    have hsi := integral_congr_ae ((map_ae hN ψ).fun_comp fun x ↦ ‖x‖^2)
    simp only [Function.comp_def] at hsi
    rw [hsi]
    unfold sliceIntegral occupation
    simp only [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,mul_pow,sq_abs,inv_pow,
      integral_const_mul,Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0≤L.val^3)]

  have map_norm_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) {L : Length} (ψ : ScalarL2 N L) : ‖map hN ψ‖≤‖ψ‖ := by
    have hh := (map_norm_sq hN ψ).trans_le (occupation_le_norm_sq hN ψ)
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (map hN ψ),norm_nonneg ψ]

  exact ({ toFun := map hN, map_add' := map_add hN, map_smul' := map_smul hN } : ScalarL2 N L →ₗ[ℂ] ScalarL2 (N-1) L).mkContinuous 1 (fun ψ ↦ by
    change ‖map hN ψ‖ ≤ 1 * ‖ψ‖
    simpa only [one_mul] using map_norm_le hN ψ)

end Orbital
