OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.T.name: OAI.HardSphere.Calibration.scale_limits
OAI.Analysis.HardSphere.Thermodynamics.T.text:
theorem scale_limits {a α ρ : ℝ} (ha : 0<a) (hα : 0<α) (hρ : 0<ρ)
    (N : ℕ → ℕ) (L : ℕ → ℝ) (hN : ∀ k, 0<N k) (hL : ∀ k, 0<L k)
    (hLtop : Tendsto L atTop atTop)
    (hdensity : Tendsto (fun k ↦ (N k:ℝ)/L k^3) atTop (𝓝 ρ)) :
    Tendsto (fun k ↦ scaleK a α (N k) (L k)) atTop atTop ∧
    Tendsto (fun k ↦ (scaleK a α (N k) (L k):ℝ) / scaleQ a α (N k) (L k))
      atTop (𝓝 1) ∧
    Tendsto (fun k ↦ (scaleK a α (N k) (L k):ℝ) / L k)
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt ((a/α)*ρ))) := by
  have hc : 0<Real.sqrt ((a/α)*ρ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hq : Tendsto (fun k ↦ scaleQ a α (N k) (L k)/L k)
      atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt ((a/α)*ρ))) := by
    convert (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hdensity).sqrt using 1
    ext k
    exact scaleQ_div ha hα (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hL k)
  have hqtop : Tendsto (fun k ↦ scaleQ a α (N k) (L k)) atTop atTop := by
    simpa only [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hL _).ne'] using hq.pos_mul_atTop hc hLtop
  have hkq := tendsto_nat_floor_div_atTop.comp hqtop
  refine ⟨tendsto_nat_floor_atTop.comp hqtop, hkq, ?_⟩
  have hqp (k) : scaleQ a α (N k) (L k) ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
    have hn : (0:ℝ)<N k := by exact_mod_cast hN k
    exact div_pos (mul_pos ha hn) (mul_pos hα (hL k))
  convert hkq.mul hq using 1
  · ext k
    dsimp only [Function.comp_def, scaleK]
    field_simp [hqp k]
  · simp

OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.Realizations.We.name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.weightMap
OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.Realizations.We.text:
noncomputable def weightMap (f:P→oQ) (w:OrderWeights P) : OrderWeights Q where
  weights:=w.weights.mapDomain f
  nonneg q:=by
    unfold Finsupp.mapDomain
    rw [Finsupp.sum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun p _=>by
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs; exacts [w.nonneg p,le_rfl])
  total:=by
    rw [Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (by intros;rfl) (by intros;rfl)]
    exact w.total
  chain:=by
    intro p hp q hq
    obtain ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩:=Finset.mem_image.mp (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hp)
    obtain ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩:=Finset.mem_image.mp (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hq)
    exact (w.chain a ha b hb).imp (fun h=>f.monotone h) (fun h=>f.monotone h)

OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.Harmonic.Spheri.name: OAI.HarmonicArtin.liftedFace_reindex_iff
OAI.Topology.ArtinGroups.Harmonic.Spheri.text:
lemma liftedFace_reindex_iff (a b : LiftedCell M) :
    LiftedFace (M.reindex e) (liftedReindexEquiv M e a) (liftedReindexEquiv M e b) ↔
      LiftedFace M a b := by
  change ((e '' a.2.val ⊆ e '' b.2.val) ∧ ∃ w : List T,
    (∀ s ∈ w, s ∈ e '' b.2.val) ∧
    (M.reindex e).toCoxeterSystem.length (wordCoxeter (M.reindex e) w) = w.length ∧
    (∀ v : coxeterParabolic (M.reindex e) (e '' a.2.val),
      (M.reindex e).toCoxeterSystem.length (wordCoxeter (M.reindex e) w) ≤
      (M.reindex e).toCoxeterSystem.length (wordCoxeter (M.reindex e) w * v.val)) ∧
    artinReindex M e a.1 = artinReindex M e b.1 * wordArtin (M.reindex e) w) ↔ _
  rw [Set.image_subset_image_iff e.injective]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ht,w,hw,hr,hm,he⟩
    let q := w.map e.symm
    have hq : q.map e = w := by simp [q,List.map_map]
    rw [←hq,reindex_letters] at hw
    rw [←hq,wordCoxeter_reindex,coxeter_length_reindex,List.length_map] at hr
    rw [←hq,wordCoxeter_reindex,minimal_reindex] at hm
    rw [←hq,wordArtin_reindex,←map_mul] at he
    exact ⟨ht,q,hw,hr,hm,(artinReindex M e).injective he⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht,w,hw,hr,hm,he⟩
    refine ⟨ht,w.map e,(reindex_letters e b.2.val w).mpr hw,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · simpa only [wordCoxeter_reindex,coxeter_length_reindex,List.length_map] using hr
    · rw [wordCoxeter_reindex,minimal_reindex]
      exact hm
    · simpa only [wordArtin_reindex,←map_mul] using congrArg (artinReindex M e) he

noncomputable def weightHomeomorph (e:P≃oQ) : OrderWeights P≃ₜOrderWeights Q where
  toFun:=weightMap (e : P→oQ)
  invFun:=weightMap (e.symm : Q→oP)
  left_inv w:=by
    rw [weightMap_comp]
    have he:(e.symm : Q→oP).comp (e : P→oQ)=OrderHom.id:=by ext p;exact e.symm_apply_apply p
    rw [he,weightMap_id]
  right_inv w:=by
    rw [weightMap_comp]
    have he:(e : P→oQ).comp (e.symm : Q→oP)=OrderHom.id:=by ext p;exact e.apply_symm_apply p
    rw [he,weightMap_id]
  continuous_toFun:=weightMap_continuous _
  continuous_invFun:=weightMap_continuous _

lemma exists_stream (target:∀l:Fin L,Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Index l.val) ℝ) :
    Nonempty (Stream L target) := by
  obtain ⟨w,N,ht⟩ := global_actual_transmission (system L) (geometry L)
    (fun l=>d0 l.val) (fun l=>by convert Dround_diagonal l.val using 1; simp only [system,geometry]) (generator_trace L)
    (generator_full L) target
  let : NeZero w.n := ⟨w.n_ne⟩
  obtain ⟨N',hN'⟩ := scalar_all_curvatures w mu_pos mu_le profile_limit
  let j0 := max N N'
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hzero,hpacket,htrans⟩ := ht j0 (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hdlocal⟩ := exists_unit_round_gap_selector w.n
  obtain ⟨hqb,hcurv⟩ := hN' j0 (le_max_right _ _) s hs
  refine ⟨⟨w,j0,s,hs,hzero,hpacket,d,(fun t i hi=>(hd t i hi).1),hdlocal,?_,hcurv,?_⟩⟩
  · intro t
    exact ⟨(hqb t).1,(hqb t).2.trans (by norm_num [qstar])⟩
  · intro j hj l
    obtain ⟨D,hD,hDp,z,hz,he⟩ := htrans j hj l
    refine ⟨z,hz,?_⟩
    rw [hD] at he
    exact he

OAI.NumberTheory.DirichletL.Hecke.Condit.name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeFamily.LFunction_ne_zero_of_certified_bands
OAI.NumberTheory.DirichletL.Hecke.Condit.text:
theorem LFunction_ne_zero_of_certified_bands
    (h : ProbeFinalAssemblyCertifiedBands.DetectorCertifiedBands)
    (χ : Character) {s : ℂ} (hs : (7 / 8 : ℝ) < s.re)
    (hpole : ¬ (χ.residue = 1 ∧ s = 1)) : LFunction χ s ≠ 0 := by
  apply ProbeFinalAssembly.hecke_of_chosen_moments
    (ProbeFinalAssemblyCertifiedBands.chosen_moments_of_certified h) χ s hs
  by_cases hs1 : s = 1

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.PowerGap:.name: OAI.Problem355.eventually_mul_rpow_lt_rpow
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.PowerGap:.text:
theorem eventually_mul_rpow_lt_rpow {n : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hn : Filter.Tendsto n Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ j in Filter.atTop,
      C * Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) a < Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) b := by
  simp only [Real.rpow_eq_pow]
  have hnR : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => (n j : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp hn
  have hp := (tendsto_rpow_atTop (sub_pos.mpr hab)).comp hnR
  filter_upwards [hp.eventually (Filter.eventually_gt_atTop C),
    hn.eventually (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1)] with j hj hjn
  have hpos : 0 < (n j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n j by omega)
  have hpowpos : 0 < Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) a := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hpos a
  calc
    C * Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) a <
        Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) (b - a) * Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) a :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hj hpowpos
    _ = Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) b := by
      simpa only [Real.rpow_eq_pow, sub_add_cancel] using (Real.rpow_add hpos (b - a) a).symm

end Problem355

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Auxiliary.name: OAI.Problem355.AuxiliarySampling.Law
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Auxiliary.text:
structure Law (q H : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] where
  Outcome : Type
  outcomeFintype : Fintype Outcome
  weight : Outcome → ℝ
  sets : Outcome → Finset (Fin 3 → ZMod q)
  size : ℕ
  size_pos : 0 < size
  weight_nonneg : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ weight ω
  weight_sum : @Finset.sum Outcome ℝ _ (@Finset.univ Outcome outcomeFintype) weight = 1
  sets_card : ∀ ω, (sets ω).card = size
  size_lower : q ^ 2 ≤ 2000 ^ 3 * H ^ 6 * size
  zero_not_mem : ∀ ω, (0 : Fin 3 → ZMod q) ∉ sets ω
  isCap : ∀ ω, AuxiliaryCap.IsCap (sets ω : Set (Fin 3 → ZMod q))
  short_relation : ∀ ω (p : Fin 3 → (Fin 3 → ZMod q)),
    (∀ i, p i ∈ sets ω) → Function.Injective p →
    ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℤ, (∀ i, |x i| ≤ (H : ℤ)) → x ≠ 0 →
      (∑ i, (x i : ZMod q) • p i) ≠ 0
  weight_le_eight : ∀ p : Fin 3 → (Fin 3 → ZMod q),
    AffineIndependent (ZMod q) p →
    @LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight Outcome (Fin 3 → ZMod q) outcomeFintype
      q size weight sets p ≤ 8
  weight_le_four : ∀ (p : Fin 3 → (Fin 3 → ZMod q)) (i j : Fin 3), p i ≠ p j →
    @LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight Outcome (Fin 3 → ZMod q) outcomeFintype
      q size weight sets p ≤ 4 * ((q : ℝ) ^ 3 / size)
  weight_le_two : ∀ p : Fin 3 → (Fin 3 → ZMod q),
    @LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight Outcome (Fin 3 → ZMod q) outcomeFintype
      q size weight sets p ≤ 2 * ((q : ℝ) ^ 3 / size) ^ 2

attribute [instance] Law.outcomeFintype

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Auxiliary.name: OAI.Problem355.AuxiliaryZeroCount.weighted_count_le_log
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Auxiliary.text:
theorem weighted_count_le_log
    (D : RowData) (q N : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime]
    (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hEq : IsUnit (D.E : ZMod q))
    (hparam : D.h ^ 26 ≤ (q : ℝ))
    (L : AuxiliarySampling.Law q ((D.B ^ D.k) ^ 2))
    (S : Finset (Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℤ))
    (hdet : ∀ A ∈ S, A.det = 0)
    (hrows : ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ i, A i ∈ D.L)
    (hheight : ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ i, A 2 i ≠ 0)
    (hproj : ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ i j : Fin 3, i ≠ j →
      ((A 0 i : ℝ) / A 2 i, (A 1 i : ℝ) / A 2 i) ≠
      ((A 0 j : ℝ) / A 2 j, (A 1 j : ℝ) / A 2 j))
    (hbound : ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ (2 * N : ℕ)) :
    (∑ A ∈ S, auxiliaryWeight q L.size L.weight L.sets
      (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col) ≤
      countConstant * (N : ℝ) ^ 6 / (D.I : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        (Real.log (4 * (N : ℝ)) / Real.log 2) := by
  apply ZeroGlobalCount.weighted_count_le_log D q N hN hEq hparam S
    (fun A => auxiliaryWeight q L.size L.weight L.sets
      (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col)
    8 (2 * 2000 ^ 6) (4 * 2000 ^ 3)
    (by norm_num) (by positivity) (by positivity)
    (fun A _ => auxiliaryWeight_nonneg q L.size L.weight L.sets L.weight_nonneg _)
    hdet hrows hheight hproj hbound
  · intro A hA hpositive
    obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := L.exists_outcome_of_weight_pos
      (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col hpositive
    exact ⟨L.sets ω, L.isCap ω, hω⟩
  · intro A hA hAI
    exact L.weight_le_eight _ hAI
  · intro A hA
    simpa only [RowData.h, Nat.cast_pow] using
      L.weight_le_two_main_square (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col
  · intro A hA hne
    simpa only [RowData.h, Nat.cast_pow] using
      L.weight_le_four_main_square (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col hne
  · intro A hA x hx hkernel hAI hpositive
    simpa only [RowData.h, Nat.cast_pow] using
      L.kernel_norm_gt_main_square A hpositive hAI hx.ne_zero hkernel

end Problem355.AuxiliaryZeroCount

end

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.UniformFi.name: OAI.Problem355.UniformFixedFiberCount.matrix_fiber_le
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.UniformFi.text:
theorem matrix_fiber_le
    {B k q : ℕ} (hB : B.Prime) [Fact q.Prime]
    (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (ZMod (B ^ k))) (d : PrimePowerData B k C)
    (L : AuxiliarySampling.Law q ((B ^ k) ^ 2))
    (hcop : (B ^ k).Coprime q) (hparam : ((B : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 26 ≤ (q : ℝ))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (S : Finset NonzeroWeightedCount.IntMatrix)
    (horbit : ∀ A ∈ S, A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod (B ^ k))) ∈
      Section04Orbit.slOrbit C)
    (hbox : ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ j, Homogeneous.InBox (N : ℝ) (fun i => (A i j : ℝ)))
    (hproj : ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ i j : Fin 3, i ≠ j →
      PlaneRowTransport.projectedColumn A i ≠ PlaneRowTransport.projectedColumn A j)
    (t : ℤ) (htq : |t| < (q : ℤ)) :
    (∑ A ∈ S.filter (fun A => A.det = t),
      LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight q L.size L.weight L.sets
        (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col) ≤
      countConstant * Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 6 /
        ((B : ℝ) ^ d.b * (B : ℝ) ^ d.e) ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have hz := AuxiliaryZeroCount.weighted_count_le_log (d.toZeroRowData hB) q N hN
    (d.toZeroRowData_E_isUnit hB hcop)
    (by simpa only [PrimePowerData.toZeroRowData_h] using hparam) L
    (S.filter (fun A => A.det = 0))
    (fun A hA => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2)
    (fun A hA i => d.orbit_rows_mem_toZeroRowData hB A
      (horbit A (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1) i)
    (fun A hA => box_height_ne_zero hN A (hbox A (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1))
    (fun A hA => hproj A (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1)
    (fun A hA => box_abs_le_two_mul A (hbox A (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1))
  have hzero : (∑ A ∈ S.filter (fun A => A.det = 0),
      LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight q L.size L.weight L.sets
        (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col) ≤
      AuxiliaryZeroCount.countConstant * (Real.log (4 * (N : ℝ)) / Real.log 2) *
        (N : ℝ) ^ 6 / ((B : ℝ) ^ d.b * (B : ℝ) ^ d.e) ^ 2 := by
    rw [d.toZeroRowData_index_real hB] at hz
    convert hz using 1
    ring
  exact matrix_fiber_le_of_zero_count hB.pos C d (N : ℝ)
    (by exact_mod_cast hN) S horbit hbox
    (fun A => LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight q L.size L.weight L.sets
      (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col)
    8 AuxiliaryZeroCount.countConstant (by norm_num)
    AuxiliaryZeroCount.countConstant_nonneg
    (fun A _ hAI => L.weight_le_eight _ hAI) hzero t htq

end Problem355.UniformFixedFiberCount

end

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Auxiliary.name: OAI.Problem355.AuxiliarySampling.nonempty_law
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Auxiliary.text:
theorem nonempty_law {q H : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime]
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hq : 2000 * H ^ 2 ≤ q) : Nonempty (Law q H) := by
  classical
  let w := q / (1000 * H ^ 2)
  have hd : 0 < 1000 * H ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hdq : 1000 * H ^ 2 ≤ q := by omega
  have hwq : w ≤ q := Nat.div_le_self _ _
  have hq2 : q ≠ 2 := by
    have hHsq : 1 ≤ H ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    omega
  obtain ⟨S, hbox, hsize, hcap⟩ := AuxiliaryCap.exists_cap_in_residueBox hq2 hwq
  have hfloor : q ≤ 2000 * H ^ 2 * w := by
    calc
      q ≤ 2 * (1000 * H ^ 2) * w := AuxiliarySet.le_twice_mul_div hd hdq
      _ = 2000 * H ^ 2 * w := by ring
  have hc : q ^ 2 ≤ 2000 ^ 3 * H ^ 6 * S.card := by
    have hcube : q ^ 3 ≤ (2000 * H ^ 2 * w) ^ 3 := by gcongr
    have hm : q * q ^ 2 ≤ q * (2000 ^ 3 * H ^ 6 * S.card) := by
      calc
        q * q ^ 2 = q ^ 3 := by ring
        _ ≤ (2000 * H ^ 2 * w) ^ 3 := hcube
        _ = (2000 ^ 3 * H ^ 6) * w ^ 3 := by ring
        _ ≤ (2000 ^ 3 * H ^ 6) * (q * S.card) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hsize
        _ = q * (2000 ^ 3 * H ^ 6 * S.card) := by ring
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hm (Fact.out : q.Prime).pos
  have hS : S.Nonempty := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mp
    by_contra hn
    have hz : S.card = 0 := by omega
    have hp : 0 < q ^ 2 := pow_pos (Fact.out : q.Prime).pos 2
    simp only [hz, mul_zero] at hc
    omega
  let A := Auxiliary.vectorShifts (Auxiliary.allowedShifts
    (Auxiliary.positiveMultipliers q H) (Auxiliary.integerWindow q (3 * H * w)))
  have hw : 1000 * H ^ 2 * w ≤ q := Nat.mul_div_le _ _
  have hA : q ^ 3 ≤ 2 * A.card :=
    (Auxiliary.auxiliary_allowed_vector_card_gt_half q H w hH hq hw).le
  have hmult : 3 * H < q := Auxiliary.auxiliary_multiplier_range q H hH hq
  apply nonempty_law_of_cap hH (by omega) S hS hcap (fun v hv => hbox v hv 0) hc A hA
  intro a ha n hn hnH
  have ha' := (Auxiliary.mem_vectorShifts_iff _ a).mp ha
  have ha'' := (Auxiliary.mem_allowedShifts_iff _ _
    (Auxiliary.positiveMultipliers_ne_zero q H hmult) (a 0)).mp ha'
  apply ha''
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨n, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hn, hnH⟩, rfl⟩

end Problem355.AuxiliarySampling

end

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Main:15.text:
theorem heilbronn_power_lower_bound :
    0 < heilbronnExponent ∧ ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ P : ℕ → Finset Point, Filter.Tendsto n Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, 3 ≤ n j ∧ (P j).card = n j ∧ pointsInUnitSquare (P j) ∧ triangleAreasAtLeast (P j) (Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) (-2 + heilbronnExponent)) := by
  let Ct : ℝ := (128 / 7 : ℝ) * UniformFixedFiberCount.countConstant
  have hCt : 0 ≤ Ct :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) UniformFixedFiberCount.countConstant_nonneg
  apply ParameterSampling.heilbronn_power_lower_bound_of_point_laws
    8 Ct (by norm_num) hCt
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro r _ hr _ D
  let : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  let : Fact D.q.Prime := ⟨D.auxiliary_prime⟩
  refine ⟨ActualPointLaw.pointLaw D, ActualPointLaw.pairProbability_le D, ?_⟩
  exact ActualPointLaw.tripleProbability_le_of_count D
    UniformFixedFiberCount.countConstant_nonneg
    (fun A => ActualPointLaw.weightedFiberBound_of_matrix_count
      UniformFixedFiberCount.countConstant
      @UniformFixedFiberCount.matrix_fiber_le D A)

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.UniformFi.name: OAI.Problem355.UniformFixedFiberCount.box_abs_le_two_mul
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.UniformFi.text:
lemma box_abs_le_two_mul {N : ℕ} (A : NonzeroWeightedCount.IntMatrix)
    (hbox : ∀ j, Homogeneous.InBox (N : ℝ) (fun i => (A i j : ℝ)))
    (i j : Fin 3) : |A i j| ≤ (2 * N : ℕ) := by
  have hr : |(A i j : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) := by
    have hj := hbox j
    fin_cases i
    · change |(A 0 j : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hj.1]
      linarith [hj.2.1, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) N]
    · change |(A 1 j : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hj.2.2.1]
      linarith [hj.2.2.2.1, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) N]
    · change |(A 2 j : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg ((Nat.cast_nonneg N).trans hj.2.2.2.2.1)]
      exact hj.2.2.2.2.2.le
  exact_mod_cast hr

def orbitEvent (N h : ℕ) [NeZero h]
    (C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ZMod h) : Finset IntMatrix :=
  (matrices N (samplingShift N)).filter (fun A =>
    Homogeneous.projectedDistinct (Homogeneous.integerColumn A 0)
      (Homogeneous.integerColumn A 1) (Homogeneous.integerColumn A 2) ∧
    (fun j i => (A i j : ZMod h)) ∈ orbitFinset (MainGroup h) C)

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.PrimePowe.name: OAI.Problem355.PrimePowerData
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.PrimePowe.text:
structure PrimePowerData (p k : ℕ) (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (ZMod (p ^ k))) where
  b : ℕ
  e : ℕ
  b_le_e : b ≤ e
  e_le_k : e ≤ k
  left : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 3) (ZMod (p ^ k))
  right : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 3) (ZMod (p ^ k))
  diagonalization : C = (left : Matrix _ _ _) *
    Matrix.diagonal ![1, ((p ^ b : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ k)),
      ((p ^ e : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ k))] * (right : Matrix _ _ _)

namespace PrimePowerData

variable {p k : ℕ} {C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (ZMod (p ^ k))}

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Parameter.name: OAI.Problem355.ParameterSampling.heilbronn_power_lower_bound_of_point_laws
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Parameter.text:
theorem heilbronn_power_lower_bound_of_point_laws
    (Cp Ct : ℝ) (hCp : 0 ≤ Cp) (hCt : 0 ≤ Ct)
    (hconstruction : ∃ r0 : ℕ, ∀ r : ℕ, r0 ≤ r → r.Prime → Odd r →
      ∀ D : PrimeParameterData heilbronnK r, ∃ L : PointLaw,
        L.pairProbability ≤ Cp * (D.M : ℝ) ^ 6 / (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3 ∧
        L.tripleProbability (D.tau / (16 * (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3)) ≤
          Ct * (Real.log (2 * (D.N : ℝ))) ^ 2 * D.h /
            ((D.N : ℝ) ^ 3 * (r : ℝ) ^ 41)) :
    0 < heilbronnExponent ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ P : ℕ → Finset Point,
        Filter.Tendsto n Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
        ∀ j : ℕ, 3 ≤ n j ∧ (P j).card = n j ∧ pointsInUnitSquare (P j) ∧
          triangleAreasAtLeast (P j)
            (Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) (-2 + heilbronnExponent)) := by
  obtain ⟨r0, hc⟩ := hconstruction
  obtain ⟨r1, hr1⟩ := exists_nat_gt
    (4 * Cp + 24 * Ct * (31620 * (heilbronnK : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)
  apply heilbronn_power_lower_bound_of_large_prime_configurations
  refine ⟨max r0 r1, ?_⟩
  intro r hr hp ho D
  obtain ⟨L, hpair, htriple⟩ := hc r ((le_max_left _ _).trans hr) hp ho D
  have hlarge : 4 * Cp + 24 * Ct * (31620 * (heilbronnK : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 < r :=
    hr1.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (le_max_right r0 r1).trans hr)
  exact configuration_of_law D L hCp hCt hlarge hpair htriple

end Problem355.ParameterSampling

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.TypedFixe.name: OAI.Problem355.TypedFixedFiberCount.orbitEvent_projections
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.TypedFixe.text:
theorem orbitEvent_projections {N h : ℕ} [NeZero h]
    {C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ZMod h} {A : IntMatrix}
    (hA : A ∈ orbitEvent N h C) (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Homogeneous.project (Homogeneous.integerColumn A i) ≠
      Homogeneous.project (Homogeneous.integerColumn A j) := by
  apply fixedDetEvent_projections (t := A.det) (h := h) (C := C) (N := N) _ i j hij
  rw [← orbitEvent_filter_det]
  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hA, rfl⟩

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Parameter.name: OAI.Problem355.ParameterSampling.configuration_of_law
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Parameter.text:
theorem configuration_of_law {k r : ℕ} (D : PrimeParameterData k r)
    (L : PointLaw) {Cp Ct : ℝ} (hCp : 0 ≤ Cp) (hCt : 0 ≤ Ct)
    (hlarge : 4 * Cp + 24 * Ct * (31620 * k + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 < r)
    (hpair : L.pairProbability ≤ Cp * (D.M : ℝ) ^ 6 / (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3)
    (htriple : L.tripleProbability (D.tau / (16 * (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3)) ≤
      Ct * (Real.log (2 * (D.N : ℝ))) ^ 2 * D.h / ((D.N : ℝ) ^ 3 * (r : ℝ) ^ 41)) :
    ∃ P : Finset Point, P.card = D.sampleCard ∧ pointsInUnitSquare P ∧
      triangleAreasAtLeast P (D.tau / (16 * (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3)) := by
  have hn : 0 < D.sampleCard := D.r_pos.trans_le (r_le_sampleCard D)
  have hbudget := FinalSampling.deletion_margin hn
    (show 0 ≤ Cp * (D.M : ℝ) ^ 6 / (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3 by positivity)
    (show 0 ≤ Ct * (Real.log (2 * (D.N : ℝ))) ^ 2 * D.h /
      ((D.N : ℝ) ^ 3 * (r : ℝ) ^ 41) by positivity)
    (relative_error_lt_one D hCp hCt hlarge)
  exact SharedGeometricAlteration.exists_configuration (2 * D.sampleCard) D.sampleCard
    (by omega) _ _ _ L.rho L.mu L.point L.rho_nonneg L.rho_sum L.mu_nonneg L.mu_sum
    L.in_square hpair htriple hbudget

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.ActualPoi.name: OAI.Problem355.ActualPointLaw.WeightedFiberBound
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.ActualPoi.text:
def WeightedFiberBound (D : PrimeParameterData heilbronnK r)
    [Fact D.q.Prime] (A : AuxiliarySampling.Law D.q (D.h ^ 2)) (K : ℝ) : Prop := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (D.B ^ heilbronnK) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ D.base_prime.ne_zero⟩
  exact ∀ z : Fin 3 → MainDigitLaw.Latent r, ∀ t : ℤ, |t| ≤ (D.tau : ℤ) →
    (∑ x ∈ ((IntegerPointLaw.projectedDistinctTriples D.N).filter
      (fun x => (fun i => residue (D.B ^ heilbronnK) (x i)) ∈
        orbitFinset (MainGroup (D.B ^ heilbronnK))
          (fun j => MainDigitLaw.column D (z j)))).filter
      (fun x => (integralMatrix x).det = t),
      LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight D.q A.size A.weight A.sets
        (fun i => residue D.q (x i))) ≤
      K * (Real.log (2 * (D.N : ℝ))) ^ 2 * (D.N : ℝ) ^ 6 /
        (((D.B ^ (latentSmith D z).b : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ((D.B ^ (latentSmith D z).e : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.LiftingPr.name: OAI.Problem355.LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.LiftingPr.text:
def auxiliaryWeight {Ω B : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (q s : ℕ) (w : Ω → ℝ) (V : Ω → Finset B) (b : Fin 3 → B) : ℝ :=
  (((q : ℝ) ^ 3) / (s : ℝ)) ^ 3 * inclusionMass w V b

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.ActualPoi.name: OAI.Problem355.ActualPointLaw.withAuxiliary_tripleProbability_le_of_count
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.ActualPoi.text:
theorem withAuxiliary_tripleProbability_le_of_count
    [Fintype (Label r)] (D : PrimeParameterData heilbronnK r)
    [Fact D.q.Prime] (A : AuxiliarySampling.Law D.q (D.h ^ 2))
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hcount : WeightedFiberBound D A K) :
    (withAuxiliary D A).tripleProbability
      (D.tau / (16 * (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3)) ≤
      ((128 / 7 : ℝ) * K) * (Real.log (2 * (D.N : ℝ))) ^ 2 * D.h /
        ((D.N : ℝ) ^ 3 * (r : ℝ) ^ 41) := by
  classical
  let : NeZero (D.B ^ heilbronnK) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ D.base_prime.ne_zero⟩
  let : NeZero (r ^ 9) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ D.r_pos.ne'⟩
  let : NeZero D.q := ⟨D.auxiliary_prime.ne_zero⟩
  have hN : D.liftMultiplicity * (D.B ^ heilbronnK * D.q) = D.N :=
    D.liftMultiplicity_mul_moduli
  have hwidth : 2 * (D.tau : ℤ) < (D.B ^ heilbronnK : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast D.twice_tau_lt_h
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Label r) = r ^ 41 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, FiniteFieldLabels.card_label]
    rfl
  have hb := IntegerPointLaw.ofSpecialLinear_tripleProbability_le
    (R := Real.log (2 * (D.N : ℝ)))
    D.base_prime heilbronnK_pos D.q D.liftMultiplicity A.size
    D.coprime D.auxiliary_prime.pos D.liftMultiplicity_pos A.size_pos
    (MainDigitLaw.column D) (latentSmith D) A.weight A.sets
    A.weight_nonneg A.weight_sum A.sets_card
    (show (0 : ℤ) ≤ D.tau by positivity) hwidth hK
    (latentSmith_moment D)
    (fun z h01 h02 h12 x _ hx => latent_separation D z h01 h02 h12 x hx)
    (by
      unfold WeightedFiberBound at hcount
      rw [hN]
      exact hcount)
  have hcardreal : (Fintype.card (Label r) : ℝ) = (r : ℝ) ^ 41 := by
    rw [hcard, Nat.cast_pow]
  rw [hN, hcardreal, Int.cast_natCast] at hb
  change (withAuxiliary D A).tripleProbability
    (D.tau / (16 * (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3)) ≤
    6 * (K / (21 / 64)) * (Real.log (2 * (D.N : ℝ))) ^ 2 * D.h /
      ((D.N : ℝ) ^ 3 * (r : ℝ) ^ 41) at hb
  convert hb using 1; ring

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.ActualPoi.name: OAI.Problem355.ActualPointLaw.tripleProbability_le_of_count
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.ActualPoi.text:
theorem tripleProbability_le_of_count
    (D : PrimeParameterData heilbronnK r) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hcount : ∀ A : @AuxiliarySampling.Law D.q (D.h ^ 2) ⟨D.auxiliary_prime⟩,
      @WeightedFiberBound r _ D ⟨D.auxiliary_prime⟩ A K) :
    (pointLaw D).tripleProbability (D.tau / (16 * (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3)) ≤
      ((128 / 7 : ℝ) * K) * (Real.log (2 * (D.N : ℝ))) ^ 2 * D.h /
        ((D.N : ℝ) ^ 3 * (r : ℝ) ^ 41) := by
  let : Fintype (Label r) := Fintype.ofFinite (Label r)
  let : Fact D.q.Prime := ⟨D.auxiliary_prime⟩
  unfold pointLaw
  exact withAuxiliary_tripleProbability_le_of_count D _ hK (hcount _)

end Problem355.ActualPointLaw

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.TypedFixe.name: OAI.Problem355.TypedFixedFiberCount.orbitEvent_filter_det
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.TypedFixe.text:
theorem orbitEvent_filter_det (N h : ℕ) [NeZero h]
    (C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ZMod h) (t : ℤ) :
    (orbitEvent N h C).filter (fun A => A.det = t) = fixedDetEvent N h C t := by
  ext A
  simp only [orbitEvent, fixedDetEvent, fixedDetProperty, Finset.mem_filter]
  tauto

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Refutatio.name: OAI.Problem355.not_eventualAlmostUpperBound_of_sequence
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Refutatio.text:
theorem not_eventualAlmostUpperBound_of_sequence
    {c epsilon : ℝ} (he : epsilon < c)
    {n : ℕ → ℕ} {P : ℕ → Finset Point}
    (hn : Filter.Tendsto n Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (hP : ∀ j : ℕ, 3 ≤ n j ∧ (P j).card = n j ∧ pointsInUnitSquare (P j) ∧
      triangleAreasAtLeast (P j) (Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) (-2 + c))) :
    ¬ eventualAlmostUpperBound epsilon := by
  rintro ⟨C, hC, n0, hupper⟩
  have hgap := eventually_mul_rpow_lt_rpow hn
    (show (-2 + epsilon : ℝ) < -2 + c by linarith) C
  obtain ⟨j, hjgap, hjn⟩ :=
    (hgap.and (hn.eventually (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop n0))).exists
  obtain ⟨hn3, hcard, hsquare, hlower⟩ := hP j
  obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, r, hr, hpq, hpr, hqr, harea⟩ :=
    hupper (n j) hjn hn3 (P j) hcard hsquare
  exact (not_lt_of_ge ((hlower p hp q hq r hr hpq hpr hqr).trans harea)) hjgap

end Problem355

end OAI

theorem orbitEvent_reduction {N h : ℕ} [NeZero h]

    A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod h)) ∈ Section04Orbit.slOrbit (transpose C) := by

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Parameter.text:
structure PointLaw where
  Environment : Type
  Column : Type
  environmentFintype : Fintype Environment
  columnFintype : Fintype Column
  rho : Environment → ℝ
  mu : Environment → Column → ℝ
  point : Environment → Column → Point
  rho_nonneg : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ rho θ
  rho_sum : @Finset.sum Environment ℝ _ Finset.univ rho = 1
  mu_nonneg : ∀ θ x, 0 ≤ mu θ x
  mu_sum : ∀ θ, @Finset.sum Column ℝ _ Finset.univ (mu θ) = 1

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.ActualWei.name: OAI.Problem355.ActualPointLaw.weightedFiberBound_of_matrix_count
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.ActualWei.text:
theorem weightedFiberBound_of_matrix_count (K : ℝ)
    (hraw : ∀ {B k q : ℕ} (_ : B.Prime) [Fact q.Prime],
      ∀ (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (ZMod (B ^ k)))
        (d : PrimePowerData B k C)
        (L : AuxiliarySampling.Law q ((B ^ k) ^ 2)),
      (B ^ k).Coprime q → ((B : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 26 ≤ (q : ℝ) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ), 1 ≤ N → ∀ (S : Finset IntMatrix),
      (∀ A ∈ S, A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod (B ^ k))) ∈
        Section04Orbit.slOrbit C) →
      (∀ A ∈ S, ∀ j, Homogeneous.InBox (N : ℝ) (fun i => (A i j : ℝ))) →
      (∀ A ∈ S, ∀ i j : Fin 3, i ≠ j →
        PlaneRowTransport.projectedColumn A i ≠ PlaneRowTransport.projectedColumn A j) →
      ∀ t : ℤ, |t| < (q : ℤ) →
      (∑ A ∈ S.filter (fun A => A.det = t),
        LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight q L.size L.weight L.sets
          (A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod q))).col) ≤
        K * Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 6 /
          ((B : ℝ) ^ d.b * (B : ℝ) ^ d.e) ^ 2)
    {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime] (D : PrimeParameterData heilbronnK r)
    [Fact D.q.Prime] (aux : AuxiliarySampling.Law D.q (D.h ^ 2)) :
    WeightedFiberBound D aux K := by
  classical
  let : NeZero D.B := ⟨D.base_prime.ne_zero⟩
  let : NeZero (D.B ^ heilbronnK) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ D.base_prime.ne_zero⟩
  unfold WeightedFiberBound
  intro z t ht
  have hparam : ((D.B : ℝ) ^ heilbronnK) ^ 26 ≤ (D.q : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (pow_pos D.base_prime.pos heilbronnK)
      (by norm_num : 26 ≤ 100)).trans D.auxiliary_lower.le
  have htq : |t| < (D.q : ℤ) :=
    ht.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast D.tau_lt_q)
  have hb := hraw D.base_prime
    (transpose (fun j => MainDigitLaw.column D (z j))) (latentSmith D z) aux
    D.coprime hparam D.N D.N_pos
    (orbitEvent D.N (D.B ^ heilbronnK) (fun j => MainDigitLaw.column D (z j)))
    (fun A hA => orbitEvent_reduction hA)
    (fun A hA j => orbitEvent_box hA j)
    (fun A hA i j hij => orbitEvent_projections hA i j hij) t htq
  change (∑ A ∈ (orbitEvent D.N (D.B ^ heilbronnK)
      (fun j => MainDigitLaw.column D (z j))).filter (fun A => A.det = t),
      matrixWeight D.q aux.size aux.weight aux.sets A) ≤ _ at hb
  rw [orbitEvent_filter_det, ← sum_fixedDet_nested_event] at hb
  have hden : ((D.B : ℝ) ^ (latentSmith D z).b *
      (D.B : ℝ) ^ (latentSmith D z).e) ^ 2 =
      (((D.B ^ (latentSmith D z).b : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ((D.B ^ (latentSmith D z).e : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow, mul_pow]
  rw [hden] at hb
  exact hb

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.TypedFixe.name: OAI.Problem355.TypedFixedFiberCount.orbitEvent_box
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.TypedFixe.text:
theorem orbitEvent_box {N h : ℕ} [NeZero h]
    {C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ZMod h} {A : IntMatrix}
    (hA : A ∈ orbitEvent N h C) (j : Fin 3) :
    Homogeneous.InBox (N : ℝ) (fun i => (A i j : ℝ)) := by
  have hAm := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1
  obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hAm
  exact IntegerPointLaw.column_inBox (x j)

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Parameter.name: OAI.Problem355.Parameters.heilbronn_power_lower_bound_of_large_prime_configurations
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.Parameter.text:
theorem heilbronn_power_lower_bound_of_large_prime_configurations
    (hconstruction : ∃ r0 : ℕ, ∀ r : ℕ, r0 ≤ r → r.Prime → Odd r →
      ∀ D : PrimeParameterData heilbronnK r, ∃ P : Finset Point,
        P.card = D.sampleCard ∧ pointsInUnitSquare P ∧
        triangleAreasAtLeast P (D.tau / (16 * (D.N : ℝ) ^ 3))) :
    0 < heilbronnExponent ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ P : ℕ → Finset Point,
        Filter.Tendsto n Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
        ∀ j : ℕ, 3 ≤ n j ∧ (P j).card = n j ∧ pointsInUnitSquare (P j) ∧
          triangleAreasAtLeast (P j)
            (Real.rpow (n j : ℝ) (-2 + heilbronnExponent)) := by
  obtain ⟨r0, hconstruction⟩ := hconstruction
  obtain ⟨r, D, hr, hprime⟩ := exists_heilbronn_parameter_sequence
  apply heilbronn_power_lower_bound_of_parameter_configurations D hr
  filter_upwards [hr.eventually_ge_atTop r0] with j hj
  exact hconstruction (r j) hj (hprime j).1 (hprime j).2.1 (D j)

end Problem355.Parameters

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.UniformFi.name: OAI.Problem355.UniformFixedFiberCount.matrix_fiber_le_of_zero_count
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.UniformFi.text:
theorem matrix_fiber_le_of_zero_count
    {B k q : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) [Fact q.Prime]
    (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (ZMod (B ^ k))) (d : PrimePowerData B k C)
    (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (S : Finset NonzeroWeightedCount.IntMatrix)
    (horbit : ∀ A ∈ S, A.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod (B ^ k))) ∈
      Section04Orbit.slOrbit C)
    (hbox : ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ j, Homogeneous.InBox N (fun i => (A i j : ℝ)))
    (W : NonzeroWeightedCount.IntMatrix → ℝ) (w Czero : ℝ)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hCzero : 0 ≤ Czero)
    (hW : ∀ A ∈ S,
      AffineIndependent (ZMod q) (fun j i => (A i j : ZMod q)) → W A ≤ w)
    (hzero : (∑ A ∈ S.filter (fun A => A.det = 0), W A) ≤
      Czero * (Real.log (4 * N) / Real.log 2) * N ^ 6 /
        ((B : ℝ) ^ d.b * (B : ℝ) ^ d.e) ^ 2)
    (t : ℤ) (htq : |t| < (q : ℤ)) :
    (∑ A ∈ S.filter (fun A => A.det = t), W A) ≤
      commonConstant Czero (w * NonzeroWeightedCount.boxConstant) *
        Real.log (2 * N) ^ 2 * N ^ 6 /
          ((B : ℝ) ^ d.b * (B : ℝ) ^ d.e) ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have hz : (∑ A ∈ S.filter (fun A => A.det = 0), W A) ≤
      Czero * (Real.log (4 * N) / Real.log 2) *
        (N ^ 6 / ((B : ℝ) ^ d.b * (B : ℝ) ^ d.e) ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using hzero
  have hdiag : C = (d.left : Matrix _ _ _) *
      DiagonalStabilizer.diagonal3 (R := ZMod (B ^ k)) (B ^ d.b) (B ^ d.e) *
        (d.right : Matrix _ _ _) := by
    simpa only [DiagonalStabilizer.diagonal3, Nat.cast_pow] using d.diagonalization
  have hb := sum_fiber_le S Matrix.det W hN
    (show 0 ≤ N ^ 6 / ((B : ℝ) ^ d.b * (B : ℝ) ^ d.e) ^ 2 by positivity)
    hCzero (mul_nonneg hw NonzeroWeightedCount.boxConstant_pos.le) hz t (by
      intro ht
      have hc := NonzeroWeightedCount.weighted_orbit_count B k d.b d.e hB
        d.b_le_k d.e_le_k d.b_le_e C d.left d.right hdiag N hN
        (S.filter (fun A => A.det = t))
        (fun A hA => horbit A (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1)
        (fun A hA => hbox A (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).1)
        t ht (fun A hA => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2) W w hw (by
          intro A hA
          obtain ⟨hAS, hAt⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hA
          exact hW A hAS (SmallDeterminantWeight.affineIndependent_columns A
            (by simpa only [hAt] using ht) (by simpa only [hAt] using htq)))
      simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using hc)
  simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using hb

OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.IntegerMa.name: OAI.Problem355.IntegerMatrixEvents.sum_fixedDet_nested_event
OAI.Geometry.HeilbronnTriangle.IntegerMa.text:
theorem sum_fixedDet_nested_event {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (N h q s : ℕ) [NeZero h]
    (C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ZMod h) (t : ℤ)
    (w : Ω → ℝ) (V : Ω → Finset (Fin 3 → ZMod q)) :
    (∑ x ∈ (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3 → Box N 3 (samplingShift N))).filter
      (fun x => project (x 0) ≠ project (x 1) ∧
        project (x 0) ≠ project (x 2) ∧ project (x 1) ≠ project (x 2))).filter
      (fun x => (fun j => residue h (x j)) ∈ orbitFinset (MainGroup h) C)).filter
      (fun x => (integralMatrix x).det = t),
      LiftingProbability.auxiliaryWeight q s w V (fun j => residue q (x j))) =
      ∑ A ∈ fixedDetEvent N h C t, matrixWeight q s w V A := by
  rw [← sum_fixedDet_event N h q s C t w V]
  apply Finset.sum_congr
  · ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      fixedDetProperty_integralMatrix, Homogeneous.projectedDistinct,
      integralMatrix_project]
    tauto
  · intro x hx
    rfl

end Problem355.IntegerMatrixEvents

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.Main:.name: OAI.Heisenberg.ordered_state_exists
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.Main:.text:
theorem ordered_state_exists (d ℓ : ℕ) (hd : 2≤d) [NeZero ℓ] :
    ∃ β₀ : ℝ,0<β₀ ∧ ∀ β : ℝ,β₀≤β →
      ∃ ω : State (d+1) ℓ,TranslationInvariant ω ∧ IsKMS β ω ∧
        (ω.functional (spinZ (d+1) ℓ 0)).im=0 ∧
        (ℓ:ℝ)/8≤(ω.functional (spinZ (d+1) ℓ 0)).re := by
  obtain ⟨τ,hτ⟩:=exists_tracial_state (d+1) ℓ
  obtain ⟨β₀,hβ₀,horder⟩:=Selection.field_ordered_cubes d ℓ hd τ hτ
  refine ⟨β₀,hβ₀,?_⟩
  intro β hβ
  let h : ℕ → ℝ:=fun n=>(n+1:ℝ)⁻¹
  have hhpos (n : ℕ) : 0<h n := by dsimp [h]; positivity
  have hh : Tendsto h atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    exact tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  have hex (n : ℕ) : ∃ m : ℕ,n ≤ m ∧
      ((box (d+1) (m+1)).card:ℝ)*ℓ/8≤
        ((gibbsState τ (shiftedField (box (d+1) (m+1)) (h n)) β).functional (totalZ (box (d+1) (m+1)))).re := by
    exact ((eventually_ge_atTop n).and (horder β hβ (h n) (hhpos n))).exists
  choose m hm hmag using hex
  let N : ℕ → ℕ:=fun n=>m n+1
  have hN : Tendsto N atTop atTop := tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n=>by exact (hm n).trans (Nat.le_succ _)) tendsto_id
  let η : ℕ → State (d+1) ℓ:=fun n=>gibbsState τ (shiftedField (box (d+1) (N n)) (h n)) β
  let ρ : ℕ → State (d+1) ℓ:=fun n=>cubeAverage (box (d+1) (N n)) (box_nonempty (d+1) (N n)) (η n)
  have hρ (n : ℕ) : (ℓ:ℝ)/8≤((ρ n).functional (spinZ (d+1) ℓ 0)).re :=
    cubeAverage_order _ _ (η n) (hmag n)
  obtain ⟨ω,κ,hκ,hω⟩:=state_subsequence ρ
  refine ⟨ω,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact cubeAverage_limit_TI (N∘κ) (hN.comp hκ.tendsto_atTop) (η∘κ) ω hω
  · exact cubeAverage_limit_KMS τ hτ (lt_of_lt_of_le hβ₀ hβ) (N∘κ) (hN.comp hκ.tendsto_atTop)
      (h∘κ) (hh.comp hκ.tendsto_atTop) ω hω
  · exact state_selfAdjoint_im ω (star_spinZ (d+1) ℓ 0)
  · exact ge_of_tendsto (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _ |>.comp (hω (spinZ (d+1) ℓ 0)))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n=>hρ (κ n)))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.Main:.name: OAI.Heisenberg.spontaneous_magnetization
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.Main:.text:
theorem spontaneous_magnetization (d ℓ : ℕ) (hd : 3≤d) (hℓ : 1≤ℓ) :
    DynamicsConverges d ℓ ∧
      ∃ β₀ : ℝ,0<β₀ ∧ ∀ β : ℝ,β₀≤β →
        ∃ ω : State d ℓ,TranslationInvariant ω ∧ IsKMS β ω ∧
          (ω.functional (spinZ d ℓ 0)).im=0 ∧
          (ℓ:ℝ)/8≤(ω.functional (spinZ d ℓ 0)).re := by
  have : NeZero ℓ:=⟨by omega⟩
  refine ⟨dynamics_converges d ℓ,?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k,rfl⟩:=Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : d≠0)
  exact ordered_state_exists k ℓ (by omega)

end Heisenberg
end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.Main:.name: OAI.Heisenberg.cubeAverage_order
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.Main:.text:
lemma cubeAverage_order {d ℓ : ℕ} (Λ : Finset (Site d)) (hΛ : Λ.Nonempty)
    (ω : State d ℓ) (hmag : (Λ.card : ℝ) * ℓ / 8 ≤ (ω.functional (totalZ Λ)).re) :
    (ℓ : ℝ) / 8 ≤ ((cubeAverage Λ hΛ ω).functional (spinZ d ℓ 0)).re := by
  have hr := congrArg Complex.re (cubeAverage_spinZ Λ hΛ ω)
  rw [complex_nat_inv_mul_re] at hr
  rw [hr]
  have hp : 0 < (Λ.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hΛ.card_pos
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr (by nlinarith)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.SpinC.name: OAI.Heisenberg.state_selfAdjoint_im
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.SpinC.text:
lemma state_selfAdjoint_im (ω : State d ℓ) {A : QuasiLocal d ℓ} (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    (ω.functional A).im=0 := by
  classical
  have h1:=(ω.positive (A+1)).1
  have h2:=(ω.positive A).1
  simp only [star_add,hA.star_eq,star_one,add_mul,mul_add,mul_one,one_mul,map_add,Complex.add_im,ω.normalized,Complex.one_im] at h1 h2
  linarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.SpinC.name: OAI.Heisenberg.cubeAverage_limit_TI
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.SpinC.text:
lemma cubeAverage_limit_TI (N : ℕ → ℕ) (hN : Tendsto N atTop atTop) (η : ℕ → State d ℓ)
    (ω : State d ℓ) (hω : ∀ A,Tendsto (fun n=>(cubeAverage (box d (N n)) (box_nonempty d (N n)) (η n)).functional A) atTop (𝓝 (ω.functional A))) : TranslationInvariant ω := by
  classical
  intro x A
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩:=(eventually_mem_box x).exists
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n=>(cubeAverage (box d (N n)) (box_nonempty d (N n)) (η n)).functional (translation d ℓ x A)-
      (cubeAverage (box d (N n)) (box_nonempty d (N n)) (η n)).functional A) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    classical
    apply squeeze_zero_norm' (a:=fun n=>(((box d (N n)\box d (N n-r)).card:ℝ)/(box d (N n)).card)*(8*‖A‖))
    · filter_upwards [hN.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop r)] with n hn
      exact cubeAverage_translation_bound (N n) r hn x hr (η n) A
    · simpa only [Function.comp_def,zero_mul] using ((box_boundary_inner_tendsto d r).comp hN).mul_const (8*‖A‖)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (tendsto_nhds_unique ((hω _).sub (hω A)) hlim)

end Heisenberg
end
end

end OAI

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.SpinC.name: OAI.Heisenberg.cubeAverage
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.SpinC.text:
def cubeAverage (Λ : Finset (Site d)) (hΛ : Λ.Nonempty) (ω : State d ℓ) : State d ℓ :=
  averageState (fun _ : Λ=>(Λ.card:ℝ)⁻¹) (fun _=>by positivity)
    (by simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_coe,nsmul_eq_mul]; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (show (Λ.card:ℝ)≠0 by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hΛ))
    (fun x=>translatedState ω x.val)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.SpinA.name: OAI.Heisenberg.cubeAverage_limit_KMS
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.Heisenberg.SpinA.text:
theorem cubeAverage_limit_KMS (τ : State d ℓ)
    (hτ : ∀ A B,τ.functional (A*B)=τ.functional (B*A))
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0<β) (N : ℕ → ℕ) (hN : Tendsto N atTop atTop)
    (h : ℕ → ℝ) (hh : Tendsto h atTop (𝓝 0)) (ω : State d ℓ)
    (hω : ∀ A,Tendsto (fun n=>(cubeAverage (box d (N n)) (box_nonempty d (N n))
      (gibbsState τ (shiftedField (box d (N n)) (h n)) β)).functional A) atTop (𝓝 (ω.functional A))) : IsKMS β ω := by
  refine ⟨hβ,fun A B=>?_⟩
  choose F hd hb hzero htop using fun n=>finite_cube_gibbs_strip (box d (N n)) (box_nonempty d (N n)) (h n) τ hτ hβ A B
  let η : ℕ → State d ℓ:=fun n=>gibbsState τ (shiftedField (box d (N n)) (h n)) β
  have hl:=cubeBoundary_locallyUniform N hN h hh η ω hω (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ (QuasiLocal d ℓ) A) B
  have hu:=cubeBoundary_locallyUniform N hN h hh η ω hω ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ (QuasiLocal d ℓ)).flip A) B
  have hf0 : TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun n (t : ℝ)=>F n t) (fun t=>ω.functional (A*dynamics d ℓ t B)) atTop := by
    simpa only [hzero,ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply',η] using hl
  have hf1 : TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun n (t : ℝ)=>F n ((t:ℂ)+Complex.I*β)) (fun t=>ω.functional (dynamics d ℓ t B*A)) atTop := by
    simpa only [htop,ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply',η] using hu
  obtain ⟨f,_,hfd,hfb,hfzero,hftop⟩:=HeisenbergStrip.bounded_strip_limit hβ
    (show 0≤4*‖A‖*‖B‖ by positivity) hd (fun n=>⟨4*‖A‖*‖B‖,hb n⟩)
    (fun n t=>hb n t (by constructor <;> simp [hβ.le]))
    (fun n t=>hb n ((t:ℂ)+Complex.I*β) (by constructor <;> simp [hβ.le])) hf0 hf1
  refine ⟨f,?_,hfd.1,⟨4*‖A‖*‖B‖,fun z hz0 hz1=>hfb z ⟨hz0,hz1⟩⟩,hfzero,hftop⟩
  simpa only [HeisenbergStrip.closure_openStrip hβ, HeisenbergStrip.closedStrip, Set.preimage, Set.mem_Icc] using hfd.2

end Heisenberg
end
end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.HenonEmden.UniformEnergy:13.name: OAI.HenonLaneEmden.weighted_uniform_energy
OAI.Analysis.HenonEmden.UniformEnergy:13.text:
lemma weighted_uniform_energy {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {p q A B : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsub : Subcritical n p q A B) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ u v : Space n → ℝ, IsSolution n p q A B u v →
        weightedEnergy (eta n) u q B+weightedEnergy (eta n) v p A ≤ C := by
  let c₁ := ((n:ℝ)+B)/(q+1)-((n:ℝ)-2)
  let c₂ := ((n:ℝ)+A)/(p+1)
  let γ := c₁+c₂
  have hγ : 0 < γ := by dsimp [γ,c₁,c₂]; unfold Subcritical at hsub; linarith
  have hn2 : 0 ≤ (n:ℝ)-2 := by
    have hn' : (3:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    linarith
  let K := (n:ℝ)-2+|(c₁-c₂)/2|
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := add_nonneg hn2 (abs_nonneg _)
  let ε := γ/(4*(1+K))
  have hε : 0 < ε := div_pos hγ (by positivity)
  have hεeq : (1+K)*ε=γ/4 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    field_simp
  obtain ⟨CP,hCP,hP⟩ := pressure_relative hn hp hq hε
  obtain ⟨CL,hCL,hL⟩ := localization_relative (by omega : 2 ≤ n) hp hq hε
  refine ⟨4*(CP+K*CL)/γ,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro u v h
  let Ef := weightedEnergy (eta n) u q B
  let Eg := weightedEnergy (eta n) v p A
  let Q := localQ (source u q B) (source v p A)
  let T := (q+1)⁻¹*weightedEnergy (w n) u q B+(p+1)⁻¹*weightedEnergy (w n) v p A-
      radialPressure (source u q B) (source v p A)
  have hEid : c₁*Ef+c₂*Eg=T+((n:ℝ)-2)*Q := h.closing_identity (by omega) hp hq
  have hT : T ≤ ε*(Ef+Eg)+CP := hP u v h
  have hQ : |Q|+|Ef-Eg| ≤ ε*(Ef+Eg)+CL := hL u v h
  have hcomb : γ/2*(Ef+Eg)=T+((n:ℝ)-2)*Q-((c₁-c₂)/2)*(Ef-Eg) := by
    dsimp only [γ]
    nlinarith [hEid]
  have hneg : -((c₁-c₂)/2)*(Ef-Eg) ≤ |(c₁-c₂)/2| *|Ef-Eg| := by
    simpa only [abs_mul,neg_mul] using neg_le_abs (((c₁-c₂)/2)*(Ef-Eg))
  have herror : ((n:ℝ)-2)*Q-((c₁-c₂)/2)*(Ef-Eg) ≤ K*(|Q|+|Ef-Eg|) := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self Q) hn2
    have h2 := mul_nonneg hn2 (abs_nonneg (Ef-Eg))
    have h3 := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg ((c₁-c₂)/2)) (abs_nonneg Q)
    dsimp only [K]
    nlinarith [h1,hneg,h2,h3]
  have hclose : γ/2*(Ef+Eg) ≤ (1+K)*ε*(Ef+Eg)+CP+K*CL := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ hK
    nlinarith [hcomb,herror,hT,hmul]
  rw [hεeq] at hclose
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hγ).mpr
  change (Ef+Eg)*γ ≤ 4*(CP+K*CL)
  nlinarith [hclose]

OAI.Analysis.HenonEmden.Main:9.name: OAI.HenonLaneEmden.main_nonexistence
OAI.Analysis.HenonEmden.Main:9.text:
theorem main_nonexistence (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (p q A B : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (hsub : Subcritical n p q A B) :
    ¬ ∃ u v : Space n → ℝ, IsSolution n p q A B u v := by
  rintro ⟨u,v,h⟩
  have hn3 := h.dimension_ge_three hn
  obtain ⟨C,_hC,hbound⟩ := uniform_unit_energy hn3 hp hq hsub
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRC⟩ := h.scaled_energy_unbounded hn hp hq hsub C
  have hscale := h.dilate (h.product_gt_one hn hp hq) (show 0 < R by linarith)
  exact not_lt_of_ge (hbound _ _ hscale) hRC

OAI.Analysis.HenonEmden.UniformEnergy:78.name: OAI.HenonLaneEmden.uniform_unit_energy
OAI.Analysis.HenonEmden.UniformEnergy:78.text:
lemma uniform_unit_energy {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {p q A B : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsub : Subcritical n p q A B) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ u v : Space n → ℝ, IsSolution n p q A B u v →
        (∫⁻ x in ball (0:Space n) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (energyDensity u q B x)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := weighted_uniform_energy hn hp hq hsub
  refine ⟨C,hC,fun u v h => (h.unit_energy_le_weighted (by omega)).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)⟩
  have hEg : 0 ≤ weightedEnergy (eta n) v p A :=
    weightedEnergyN_nonneg (eta_nonneg n) (fun x => (h.positive_v x).le)
  linarith [hbound u v h]

end HenonLaneEmden
end
end UniformEnergy

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Spectrum:90.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.numericalClosure_geometry
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Spectrum:90.text:
theorem numericalClosure_geometry (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    IsCompact (numericalClosure A) ∧ Convex ℝ (numericalClosure A) ∧
      spectrum ℂ A ⊆ numericalClosure A :=
  ⟨isCompact_numericalClosure A, convex_numericalClosure A, spectrum_subset_numericalClosure A⟩
