OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.CoeffSpace
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
abbrev CoeffSpace (m : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin m)

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.pow_mem_iterateSpace
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
theorem pow_mem_iterateSpace {q : ℕ} (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (d : ℕ) (x : Fin q → H)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ d) (j : Fin q) : (A ^ k) (x j) ∈ iterateSpace A d x := by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  exact ⟨(⟨k, by omega⟩, j), rfl⟩

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.Amplification
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
abbrev Amplification (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (m : ℕ) := UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] CoeffSpace m)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.tensorInclusion

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.holomorphicEval
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
def holomorphicEval {m : ℕ} (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (U : Set ℂ) (F : ℂ → Coeff m) :
    Amplification H m →L[ℂ] Amplification H m :=
  ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin m,
    tensorOp (holomorphicCalculus A U (fun z => F z i j)) (matrixUnit i j)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.RationalMatrix
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text: abbrev RationalMatrix (m : ℕ) := Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (RatFunc ℂ)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.NumericalRa.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.convex_numericalRange
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.NumericalRa.text:
theorem convex_numericalRange (A : H →L[ℂ] H) : Convex ℝ (numericalRange A) := by
  intro z hz w hw a b ha hb hab
  by_cases hzw : z = w
  · subst w
    simpa only [← add_smul, hab, one_smul] using hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyw⟩ := hw
  let δ : ℂ := w - z
  let z₀ : ℂ := a • z + b • w
  let T : H →L[ℂ] H := conj δ • (A - z₀ • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H))
  have hq (v : H) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) :
      inner ℂ v (T v) = conj δ * (inner ℂ v (A v) - z₀) := by
    simp only [T, smul_apply, sub_apply, inner_smul_right,
      inner_sub_right, one_apply_eq_self, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hv,
      RCLike.ofReal_one, one_pow, mul_one]
  have hxq : inner ℂ x (T x) = ((-b * normSq δ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [hq x hx, hxz]
    calc
      conj δ * (z - z₀) = (-b : ℂ) * (conj δ * δ) := by
        have ha' : a = 1 - b := by linarith
        simp only [z₀, δ, ha', Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_one]
        ring
      _ = ((-b * normSq δ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
        push_cast
        rfl
  have hyq : inner ℂ y (T y) = ((a * normSq δ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [hq y hy, hyw]
    calc
      conj δ * (w - z₀) = (a : ℂ) * (conj δ * δ) := by
        have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
        simp only [z₀, δ, hb', Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_one]
        ring
      _ = ((a * normSq δ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
        push_cast
        rfl
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hTv⟩ := zero_mem_numericalRange_of_opposite T x y hx hy
    (by simp [hxq]) (by simp [hyq])
    (by simpa only [hxq, Complex.ofReal_re] using
      mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hb) (normSq_nonneg δ))
    (by simpa only [hyq, Complex.ofReal_re] using mul_nonneg ha (normSq_nonneg δ))
  have hδ : conj δ ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero (starRingEnd ℂ)).mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hzw))
  rw [hq v hv] at hTv
  exact ⟨v, hv, sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hTv).resolve_left hδ)⟩

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.rationalEval
OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.numericalRange
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
def numericalRange (A : H →L[ℂ] H) : Set ℂ :=
  {z | ∃ x : H, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℂ x (A x) = z}

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:84.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.zeroConclusion
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:84.text:
theorem zeroConclusion [Subsingleton H] (A : H →L[ℂ] H) : ZeroConclusion A := by
  have hW := numericalRange_eq_empty A
  refine ⟨hW, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m F
    simp [hW]
  · intro m hm
    refine ⟨amplifiedOperator_eq_zero m, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d B
      have hP := amplifiedOperator_eq_zero m (polynomialEval A B)
      exact ⟨hP, by simp only [hP, hW, normSup_empty, mul_zero]; exact le_of_eq ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_zero⟩
    · intro U F
      have hF := amplifiedOperator_eq_zero m (holomorphicEval A U F)
      exact ⟨hF, by simp only [hF, hW, normSup_empty, mul_zero]; exact le_of_eq ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_zero⟩
    · intro R
      have hR := amplifiedOperator_eq_zero m (rationalEval A R)
      exact ⟨hR, by simp only [hR, hW, normSup_empty, mul_zero]; exact le_of_eq ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_zero⟩


end HilbertCrouzeix

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.tensorOp

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:69.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.amplification_eq_zero
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:69.text:
theorem amplification_eq_zero [Subsingleton H] (m : ℕ) (x : Amplification H m) :
    x = 0 := by
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x (isClosed_eq continuous_id continuous_const) ?_
  intro a
  have ha : a = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp only [ha, UniformSpace.Completion.coe_zero]

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.poleFreeSet
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
def poleFreeSet {m : ℕ} (R : RationalMatrix m) : Set ℂ :=
  {z | ∀ i j, (R i j).denom.eval z ≠ 0}

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.NumericalRa.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.normSup_empty
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.NumericalRa.text:
@[simp] theorem normSup_empty {E : Type*} [Norm E] (f : ℂ → E) :
    normSup ∅ f = 0 := by simp [normSup]

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.NumericalRa.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.isCompact_numericalClosure
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.NumericalRa.text:
theorem isCompact_numericalClosure (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    IsCompact (numericalClosure A) :=
  (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) ‖A‖).of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure
    (numericalClosure_subset_closedBall A)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.holomorphicCalculus
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
def holomorphicCalculus (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (U : Set ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  dunfordIntegral A (chosenContour (numericalClosure A) U) f

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.rationalFunction
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
def rationalFunction {m : ℕ} (R : RationalMatrix m) (z : ℂ) : Coeff m :=
  fun i j => RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℂ) z (R i j)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.numericalClosure
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text: def numericalClosure (A : H →L[ℂ] H) : Set ℂ := closure (numericalRange A)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.completion_coe_sum
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
@[simp] theorem completion_coe_sum {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V]
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → V) :
    (↑(∑ i ∈ s, f i) : UniformSpace.Completion V) = ∑ i ∈ s, (↑(f i) : UniformSpace.Completion V) :=
  map_sum (UniformSpace.Completion.toCompl : V →+ UniformSpace.Completion V) f s

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.iterateSpace
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
def iterateSpace {q : ℕ} (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (d : ℕ) (x : Fin q → H) : Submodule ℂ H :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun t : Fin (d + 1) × Fin q => (A ^ t.1.val) (x t.2))

instance iterateSpace_finiteDimensional {q : ℕ} (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (d : ℕ)
    (x : Fin q → H) : FiniteDimensional ℂ (iterateSpace A d x) :=
  FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite ℂ (Set.finite_range _)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.NumericalRa.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.numericalClosure_subset_closedBall
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.NumericalRa.text:
theorem numericalClosure_subset_closedBall (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    numericalClosure A ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 ‖A‖ :=
  closure_minimal (numericalRange_subset_closedBall A) Metric.isClosed_closedBall

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.mem_iterateSpace
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
theorem mem_iterateSpace {q : ℕ} (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (d : ℕ) (x : Fin q → H)
    (j : Fin q) : x j ∈ iterateSpace A d x := by
  simpa using pow_mem_iterateSpace A d x (Nat.zero_le d) j

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:51.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.rational_denominator_isUnit
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:51.text:
theorem rational_denominator_isUnit [Nontrivial H] (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
    {m : ℕ} (R : RationalMatrix m) (hR : numericalClosure A ⊆ poleFreeSet R)
    (i j : Fin m) : IsUnit (Polynomial.aeval A (R i j).denom) := by
  apply (spectrum.zero_notMem_iff ℂ).mp
  rw [spectrum.map_polynomial_aeval]
  rintro ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩
  exact hR (spectrum_subset_numericalClosure A hz) i j hz0

section TrivialSpace
omit [CompleteSpace H]

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.completedIsometry

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.rationalCalculus
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
def rationalCalculus (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : RatFunc ℂ) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  Polynomial.aeval A r.num * Ring.inverse (Polynomial.aeval A r.denom)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.polynomialEval

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.tensorOp_tmul
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
@[simp] theorem tensorOp_tmul {m : ℕ} (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (B : Coeff m)
    (x : H) (v : CoeffSpace m) :
    tensorOp A B (↑(x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)) =
      (↑(A x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) B) v) : Amplification H m) := by
  simp only [tensorOp, ContinuousLinearMap.completion_apply_coe, TensorProduct.mapL_tmul]

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.exists_finite_compression
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
theorem exists_finite_compression {m d : ℕ} (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (B : Fin (d + 1) → Coeff m) (ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] CoeffSpace m) :
    ∃ (E : Submodule ℂ H) (hE : FiniteDimensional ℂ E),
      letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E := hE
      ∃ η : Amplification E m,
        tensorInclusion E m η = (↑ξ : Amplification H m) ∧
        tensorInclusion E m (polynomialEval (compression A E) B η) =
          polynomialEval A B (↑ξ) := by
  obtain ⟨q, x, v, rfl⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_sum_tmul_eq ξ
  let E := iterateSpace A d x
  let xE (j : Fin q) : E := ⟨x j, mem_iterateSpace A d x j⟩
  let η : Amplification E m := ∑ j : Fin q, (↑(xE j ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v j) : Amplification E m)
  refine ⟨E, inferInstance, η, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [η, map_sum, tensorInclusion_tmul, completion_coe_sum]
    rfl
  · simp only [η, map_sum, completion_coe_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact polynomialEval_compression_tmul A E B (xE j) (v j)
      (fun k hk => pow_mem_iterateSpace A d x hk j)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.compression_pow
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
theorem compression_pow (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (E : Submodule ℂ H)
    [E.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : E) {d : ℕ}
    (hmem : ∀ k ≤ d, (A ^ k) (x : H) ∈ E) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ d) :
    (((compression A E) ^ k) x : H) = (A ^ k) (x : H) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk' : k ≤ d := by omega
    have hn : A ((A ^ k) (x : H)) ∈ E := by
      simpa only [pow_succ', mul_apply_eq_comp] using hmem (k + 1) hk
    rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', mul_apply_eq_comp, mul_apply_eq_comp]
    change E.starProjection (A (((compression A E) ^ k) x : H)) = _
    rw [ih hk']
    exact Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mpr hn

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Spectrum:50.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.isUnit_of_unit_inner
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Spectrum:50.text:
theorem isUnit_of_unit_inner (T : H →L[ℂ] H) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (h : ∀ x : H, ‖x‖ = 1 → δ ≤ ‖inner ℂ x (T x)‖) : IsUnit T := by
  have hl := antilipschitz_of_lowerBound T hδ (lowerBound_of_unit_inner T h)
  have hadj : ∀ x : H, ‖x‖ = 1 → δ ≤ ‖inner ℂ x (T.adjoint x)‖ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right, norm_inner_symm]
    exact h x hx
  have hla := antilipschitz_of_lowerBound T.adjoint hδ
    (lowerBound_of_unit_inner T.adjoint hadj)
  have hc : IsClosed (T.toLinearMap.range : Set H) := hl.isClosed_range T.uniformContinuous
  have hbot : T.toLinearMap.rangeᗮ = ⊥ := by
    rw [T.orthogonal_range]
    exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hla.injective
  have htop : T.toLinearMap.range = ⊤ := by
    rw [← hc.submodule_topologicalClosure_eq]
    exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_eq_top_iff.mpr hbot
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_bijective.mpr
    ⟨hl.injective, LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp htop⟩

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.matrixUnit
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text: def matrixUnit {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) : Coeff m := Matrix.single i j 1

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.matrixPolynomial
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
def matrixPolynomial {m d : ℕ} (B : Fin (d + 1) → Coeff m) (z : ℂ) : Coeff m :=
  ∑ k : Fin (d + 1), z ^ k.val • B k

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.ZeroConclusion
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Definitions.text:
def ZeroConclusion (A : H →L[ℂ] H) : Prop :=
  numericalRange A = ∅ ∧
  (∀ (m : ℕ) (F : ℂ → Coeff m), normSup (numericalRange A) F = 0) ∧
  ∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m →
    (∀ T : Amplification H m →L[ℂ] Amplification H m, T = 0) ∧
    (∀ (d : ℕ) (B : Fin (d + 1) → Coeff m), polynomialEval A B = 0 ∧
      ‖polynomialEval A B‖ ≤ 2 * normSup (numericalRange A) (matrixPolynomial B)) ∧
    (∀ (U : Set ℂ) (F : ℂ → Coeff m), holomorphicEval A U F = 0 ∧
      ‖holomorphicEval A U F‖ ≤ 2 * normSup (numericalRange A) F) ∧
    (∀ (R : RationalMatrix m), rationalEval A R = 0 ∧
      ‖rationalEval A R‖ ≤ 2 * normSup (numericalRange A) (rationalFunction R))

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:76.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.amplifiedOperator_eq_zero
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:76.text:
theorem amplifiedOperator_eq_zero [Subsingleton H] (m : ℕ)
    (T : Amplification H m →L[ℂ] Amplification H m) : T = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  exact amplification_eq_zero m (T x)

end TrivialSpace

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Spectrum:69.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.spectrum_subset_numericalClosure
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Spectrum:69.text:
theorem spectrum_subset_numericalClosure (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    spectrum ℂ A ⊆ numericalClosure A := by
  intro z hz
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hb⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp
    (isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl) z hnot
  have hdist : ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A, δ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := by
    intro w hw
    by_contra! hlt
    have hw' : w ∈ Metric.ball z δ := by
      simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hlt
    exact hb hw' (subset_closure hw)
  have hu : IsUnit ((algebraMap ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) z - A) := by
    apply isUnit_of_unit_inner _ hδ
    intro x hx
    simpa only [sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.algebraMap_apply,
      inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hx,
      RCLike.ofReal_one, one_pow, mul_one] using
      hdist (inner ℂ x (A x)) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact spectrum.mem_iff.mp hz hu

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.polynomialEval_compression_tmul
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
theorem polynomialEval_compression_tmul (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (E : Submodule ℂ H)
    [E.HasOrthogonalProjection] {m d : ℕ} (B : Fin (d + 1) → Coeff m)
    (x : E) (v : CoeffSpace m) (hmem : ∀ k ≤ d, (A ^ k) (x : H) ∈ E) :
    tensorInclusion E m (polynomialEval (compression A E) B (↑(x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v))) =
      polynomialEval A B (↑((x : H) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)) := by
  simp only [polynomialEval, sum_apply, map_sum, tensorOp_tmul,
    tensorInclusion_tmul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [compression_pow A E x hmem (Nat.le_of_lt_succ k.isLt)]

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.tensorInclusion_tmul
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
@[simp] theorem tensorInclusion_tmul (E : Submodule ℂ H) {m : ℕ}
    (x : E) (v : CoeffSpace m) :
    tensorInclusion E m (↑(x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)) = (↑((x : H) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v) : Amplification H m) := by
  change (TensorProduct.mapIsometry E.subtypeₗᵢ (.id : CoeffSpace m →ₗᵢ[ℂ] CoeffSpace m)
    ).toContinuousLinearMap.completion (↑(x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] v)) = _
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.completion_apply_coe]
  rfl

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.compression
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Compression.text:
def compression (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (E : Submodule ℂ H) [E.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
    E →L[ℂ] E := E.orthogonalProjectionOnto.comp (A.comp E.subtypeL)

OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:62.name: OAI.HilbertCrouzeix.numericalRange_eq_empty
OAI.Analysis.HilbertCrouzeix.Calculus:62.text:
theorem numericalRange_eq_empty [Subsingleton H] (A : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    numericalRange A = ∅ := by
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  rintro z ⟨x, hx, h⟩
  have hx0 : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  simp [hx0] at hx

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.FiniteBridgeSums
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
def FiniteBridgeSums : Prop :=
  ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h →
    Summable (weight (h := h)) ∧ Summable (firstLengthWeight (h := h)) ∧
    Summable (fun p : BridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p / bridgeMass h) ∧
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => weight p.val) ∧
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val) ∧
    Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val / confinedMass h)

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.bridgeMass
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text: noncomputable def bridgeMass (h : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑' p : BridgePath h, weight p

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.bridge_weight_finite_sum_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
theorem bridge_weight_finite_sum_bound (h : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (S : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    (∑ p ∈ S, weight p) ≤ (Real.cos (3*Real.pi/8))⁻¹ := by
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := bridge_finite_sum_word_bound h hh S (fun w => criticalActivity^w.length)
    (fun w => pow_nonneg criticalActivity_pos.le _)
  simp only [bridgeWord_length] at hM
  apply hM.trans
  exact boundary_source_weight_bound _ bottomSource (vertexWindow_convex h M)
    (bottomSource_mem_window h M hh)
    (bottomSource_outside_of_strip h _ (vertexWindow_strip h M))

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.bridge_length_finite_sum_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
theorem bridge_length_finite_sum_bound (h : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (S : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    (∑ p ∈ S, firstLengthWeight p) ≤ tailConstant*spatialConstant*((h : ℝ)+1)^2 := by
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := bridge_finite_sum_word_bound h hh S
    (fun w => (w.length : ℝ)*criticalActivity^w.length)
    (fun w => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg criticalActivity_pos.le _))
  simp only [bridgeWord_length] at hM
  rw [← lateralLengthMass_zero _ (bottomSource_mem_window h M hh)] at hM
  apply hM.trans
  have ht := lateralLengthMass_exp h hh _ (vertexWindow_convex h M)
    (bottomSource_mem_window h M hh) (vertexWindow_strip h M) 0 le_rfl
  simpa only [mul_zero,zero_div,Real.exp_zero,mul_one] using ht

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.BridgePath
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
structure BridgePath (h : ℕ) where
  vertices : List Vertex
  distinct : vertices.Nodup
  connected : vertices.IsChain adjacent
  source : vertices.head? = some (.up 0 0)
  terminal : ∃ i : ℤ, vertices.getLast? = some (.down i ((h : ℤ) - 1))
  inStrip : ∀ v ∈ vertices, 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ)

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Spat.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.spatialConstant
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Spat.text:
noncomputable def spatialConstant : ℝ :=
  20 * (1 + ∑' n : ℕ, ((n : ℝ)+1)*shellRatio^n)

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.firstLengthWeight
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
noncomputable def firstLengthWeight {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : ℝ :=
  (p.vertices.length : ℝ) * weight p

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.finite_bridge_sums
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
theorem finite_bridge_sums : FiniteBridgeSums := by
  intro h hh
  have hm := bridge_weight_summable h hh
  have hl := bridge_length_summable h hh
  have hmc : Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => weight p.val) := hm.subtype InLogCorridor
  have hlc : Summable (fun p : ConfinedBridgePath h => firstLengthWeight p.val) := hl.subtype InLogCorridor
  exact ⟨hm,hl,hl.div_const _,hmc,hlc,hlc.div_const _⟩

end PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.confinedMass
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
noncomputable def confinedMass (h : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' p : ConfinedBridgePath h, weight p.val

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Late.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.tailConstant
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Late.text:
noncomputable def tailConstant : ℝ :=
  2 * (Real.cos (3*Real.pi/8))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-Real.log rayContraction)

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.bridge_weight_summable
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
theorem bridge_weight_summable (h : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) : Summable (weight (h := h)) := by
  refine summable_of_sum_le (f := weight (h := h))
    (c := (Real.cos (3*Real.pi/8))⁻¹) ?_ (bridge_weight_finite_sum_bound h hh)
  intro p
  exact pow_nonneg criticalActivity_pos.le p.vertices.length

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.ConfinedBridgePath
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text: def ConfinedBridgePath (h : ℕ) := {p : BridgePath h // InLogCorridor p}

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.InLogCorridor
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
noncomputable def InLogCorridor {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, |(position v).1| ≤ (h : ℝ) * (Real.log (h : ℝ)) ^ 2

OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.name: OAI.PolynomialVacuumBridge.Corridor.bridge_length_summable
OAI.Combinatorics.HoneycombCorridor.Brid.text:
theorem bridge_length_summable (h : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) : Summable (firstLengthWeight (h := h)) := by
  refine summable_of_sum_le (f := firstLengthWeight (h := h))
    (c := tailConstant*spatialConstant*((h : ℝ)+1)^2) ?_
    (bridge_length_finite_sum_bound h hh)
  intro p
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p.vertices.length)
    (pow_nonneg criticalActivity_pos.le p.vertices.length)

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:221.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.shiftVertex_injective
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:221.text:
theorem shiftVertex_injective (i j : ℤ) : Function.Injective (shiftVertex i j) := by
  intro v w h
  have hc := congrArg Vertex.col h
  have hr := congrArg Vertex.row h
  have hu := congrArg Vertex.up h
  cases v; cases w
  simp only [shiftVertex, Vertex.mk.injEq] at hc hr hu ⊢
  exact ⟨add_right_cancel hc, add_right_cancel hr, hu⟩

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:32.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.position
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:32.text:
def position (v : Vertex) : ℂ :=
  if v.up then
    ⟨(v.col : ℝ) + (v.row : ℝ) / 2 + 1/2,
      rowSpacing * ((v.row : ℝ) + 1/3)⟩
  else
    ⟨(v.col : ℝ) + (v.row : ℝ) / 2 + 1,
      rowSpacing * ((v.row : ℝ) + 2/3)⟩

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:587.name: OAI.partition_succ_opposite
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:587.text:
theorem partition_succ_opposite (u : Bool) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    partition (baseVertex u) e s (n+1) ≤
      partition (baseVertex u) e s 1 * partition (baseVertex (!u)) e s n := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm n 1]
  apply (partition_split (baseVertex u) e s 1 n).trans_eq
  conv_rhs => rw [partition, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro γ hγ
  rw [partition_eq_base (endpoint _ _), endpoint_one_type hγ]
  rfl

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:153.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.mem_saws_iff
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:153.text:
theorem mem_saws_iff (o : Vertex) (n : ℕ) (γ : List Vertex) :
    γ ∈ saws o n ↔ γ.head? = some o ∧ γ.length = n + 1 ∧
      γ.IsChain Adj ∧ γ.Nodup := by
  simp only [saws, Finset.mem_filter, mem_walkLists_iff]
  tauto

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:613.name: OAI.endpoint_rayPath
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:613.text:
@[simp] theorem endpoint_rayPath (o : Vertex) (n : ℕ) :
    endpoint o (rayPath o n) = ray o n := by
  have hne : rayPath o n ≠ [] := by simp [rayPath]
  rw [endpoint, List.getLastD_eq_getLast?, List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast hne]
  simp only [Option.getD_some, rayPath, List.getLast_ofFn, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:86.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.partition
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:86.text:
def partition (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ γ ∈ saws o n, rho ^ n * Real.exp (s * projection e (displacement o γ))

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:249.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.rowVertex_adj
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:249.text:
theorem rowVertex_adj (k : ℕ) : Adj (rowVertex k) (rowVertex (k+1)) := by
  by_cases hk : k % 2 = 0
  · have hk' : (k+1) % 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    have he : (k+1) / 2 = k / 2 := by omega
    simp [rowVertex, hk, hk', Adj, UpDownAdj, up, down, he]
  · have hk' : (k+1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
    have he : (k+1) / 2 = k / 2 + 1 := by omega
    simp [rowVertex, hk, hk', Adj, UpDownAdj, up, down, he]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:773.name: freeEnergy_ge_of_mass_lt
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:773.text:
theorem freeEnergy_ge_of_mass_lt (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) {t s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hm : directionalMass o e t < ENNReal.ofReal s) :
    t ≤ freeEnergy o e s := by
  by_contra h
  have hfin := directionalSum_finite_of_freeEnergy_lt o e s (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have hle : ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ directionalMass o e t :=
    le_sSup ⟨s, hs, rfl, hfin⟩
  exact not_le_of_gt hm hle

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:180.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.projection_le_norm
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:180.text:
theorem projection_le_norm {e : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (v : ℂ) :
    projection e v ≤ ‖v‖ := by
  calc
    projection e v ≤ ‖star e * v‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
    _ = ‖v‖ := by simp [he]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:619.name: position_rowVertex
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:619.text:
theorem position_rowVertex (n : ℕ) :
    position (rowVertex n) - position (baseVertex true) =
      (⟨(n : ℝ) / 2, if n % 2 = 0 then 0 else rowSpacing / 3⟩ : ℂ) := by
  by_cases hn : n % 2 = 0
  · have hn' : (n / 2 : ℕ) * 2 = n := by omega
    have hr : ((n / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 = n := by exact_mod_cast hn'
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rowVertex, hn, position, up, baseVertex, -Int.natCast_ediv]
    linarith
  · have hn' : (n / 2 : ℕ) * 2 + 1 = n := by omega
    have hr : ((n / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 + 1 = n := by exact_mod_cast hn'
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rowVertex, hn, position, down, baseVertex, -Int.natCast_ediv] <;> linarith

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:865.name: norm_adj_le_one
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:865.text:
theorem norm_adj_le_one {v w : Vertex} (h : Adj v w) :
    ‖position w - position v‖ ≤ 1 := by
  rcases h with h | h
  · have := upDownAdj_sq_norm h
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (position w-position v)]
  · rw [norm_sub_rev]
    have := upDownAdj_sq_norm h
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (position v-position w)]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:493.name: OAI.displacement_split
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:493.text:
theorem displacement_split {o : Vertex} {n m : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (hγ : γ ∈ saws o (n+m)) :
    displacement o γ = displacement o (γ.take (n+1)) +
      displacement (endpoint o (γ.take (n+1))) (γ.drop n) := by
  have hn : n < γ.length := by
    have hl := ((mem_saws_iff _ _ _).mp hγ).2.1
    omega
  unfold displacement
  rw [endpoint_drop hn]
  abel

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:728.name: directionalSum_le_susceptibility_add
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:728.text:
theorem directionalSum_le_susceptibility_add (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (t : ℝ)
    {s u : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsu : s ≤ u) :
    directionalSum o e t s ≤ susceptibility o t + directionalSum o e t u := by
  unfold directionalSum susceptibility
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_add]
  apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
  intro b
  let q := projection e (position b - position o)
  have hexp : Real.exp (s*q) ≤ 1 + Real.exp (u*q) := by
    by_cases hq : 0 ≤ q
    · exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsu hq)).trans
        (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)
    · have hsq : s*q ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hs (le_of_not_ge hq)
      exact (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr hsq).trans
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have h := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hexp
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos _).le, ENNReal.ofReal_one] at h
  change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (s*q)) * green o b t ≤
    green o b t + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (u*q)) * green o b t
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (u*q))) * green o b t := mul_le_mul_left h _
    _ = _ := by rw [add_mul, one_mul]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:176.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.partition_zero
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:176.text:
@[simp] theorem partition_zero (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ) :
    partition o e s 0 = 1 := by
  simp [partition, endpoint, displacement, projection]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:891.name: norm_displacement_le_length
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:891.text:
theorem norm_displacement_le_length {o : Vertex} {n : ℕ} {γ : List Vertex}
    (h : γ ∈ saws o n) : ‖displacement o γ‖ ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
  induction n generalizing o γ with
  | zero =>
    simp only [saws_zero, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
    subst γ
    simp [displacement, endpoint]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hh : γ ∈ saws o (1+n) := by simpa [Nat.add_comm] using h
    have hp := splitWalk_mem hh
    simp only [splitWalk, Finset.mem_sigma] at hp
    rw [displacement_split hh]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖displacement o (γ.take (1+1))‖ +
        ‖displacement (endpoint o (γ.take (1+1))) (γ.drop 1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + (n : ℝ) := add_le_add (norm_displacement_one hp.1) (ih hp.2)
      _ = (n+1 : ℕ) := by simp [add_comm]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:42.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.neighbors

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:794.name: force_power_of_mass_powers
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:794.text:
theorem force_power_of_mass_powers (o : Vertex)
    (hm : UniformMassPowerAtZero (directionalMass o) (3/4 : ℝ))
    (hr : PowerAtZero (radialMass o) (3/4 : ℝ)) :
    UniformRealPowerAtZero (freeEnergy o) (4/3 : ℝ) := by
  intro ε hε
  let κ : ℝ := min ε (1/3)
  have hk : 0 < κ := lt_min hε (by norm_num)
  have hkε : κ ≤ ε := min_le_left _ _
  have hk1 : κ ≤ 1/3 := min_le_right _ _
  have hk2 : κ^2 ≤ κ/3 := by
    have := mul_nonneg hk.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hk1)
    nlinarith
  have hsmall : (4/3-κ) * (3/4+κ/16) < (1:ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg κ]
  have hlarge : (1:ℝ) < (4/3+κ) * (3/4-κ/16) := by
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨δm, hδm, Hm⟩ := hm (κ/16) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨δr, hδr, Hr⟩ := hr 1 zero_lt_one
  have Hχ : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < δr → susceptibility o t < ⊤ := by
    intro t ht htδ
    apply susceptibility_finite_of_radialMass_pos
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ht _))
      (Hr t ht htδ).1
  refine ⟨min 1 (min δr δm), lt_min zero_lt_one (lt_min hδr hδm), ?_⟩
  intro e he s hs hsδ
  have hs1 : s < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hsδ (min_le_left _ _)
  have hsr : s < δr := lt_of_lt_of_le hsδ
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hsm : s < δm := lt_of_lt_of_le hsδ
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
  have hqminus : s ^ ((4/3:ℝ)-κ) ≤ s := by
    simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hs hs1.le
      (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 4/3-κ by linarith)
  have hqplus : s ^ ((4/3:ℝ)+κ) ≤ s := by
    simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hs hs1.le
      (show (1:ℝ) ≤ 4/3+κ by linarith)
  have hs_lt : ENNReal.ofReal s <
      directionalMass o e (s ^ ((4/3:ℝ)-κ)) := by
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le _
      (Hm e he _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs _) (hqminus.trans_lt hsm)).1
    apply (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hs.le).mpr
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hs.le]
    simpa using Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt hs hs1 hsmall
  have hm_lt : directionalMass o e (s ^ ((4/3:ℝ)+κ)) < ENNReal.ofReal s := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt
      (Hm e he _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs _) (hqplus.trans_lt hsm)).2
    apply (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hs).mpr
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hs.le]
    simpa using Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_gt hs hs1 hlarge
  constructor
  · exact (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hs hs1.le
      (show (4/3:ℝ)+κ ≤ 4/3+ε by linarith)).trans
        (freeEnergy_ge_of_mass_lt o e hs.le hm_lt)
  · exact (freeEnergy_le_of_lt_mass o e
      (Hχ _ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs _) (hqminus.trans_lt hsr)) hs.le hs_lt).trans
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hs hs1.le
        (show (4/3:ℝ)-ε ≤ 4/3-κ by linarith))

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:307.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.weighted_green_eq
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:307.text:
theorem weighted_green_eq (o : Vertex) (t : ℝ) (R : Vertex → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' b : Vertex, R b * green o b t) =
      ∑' n : ℕ, ∑ γ ∈ saws o n, R (endpoint o γ) * ENNReal.ofReal (z t ^ n) := by
  simp only [green, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, Finset.mul_sum, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  rw [ennreal_tsum_finsetSum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro γ _
  rw [tsum_eq_single (endpoint o γ)]
  · simp
  · intro b hb
    simp [Ne.symm hb]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:210.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.radialSum_mono
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:210.text:
theorem radialSum_mono (o : Vertex) (t : ℝ) : Monotone (radialSum o t) := by
  intro s u hsu
  apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
  intro b
  apply mul_le_mul_left
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsu (norm_nonneg _))

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:852.name: upDownAdj_sq_norm
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:852.text:
theorem upDownAdj_sq_norm {v w : Vertex} (h : UpDownAdj v w) :
    ‖position w - position v‖ ^ 2 = (1/3 : ℝ) := by
  rcases v with ⟨i, j, u⟩
  rcases w with ⟨k, l, t⟩
  obtain ⟨hu, ht, h⟩ := h
  dsimp at hu ht h
  subst u; subst t
  rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
    simp only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, position, Bool.false_eq_true,
      ite_false, ite_true, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
      Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, rowSpacing] <;>
    ring_nf <;> norm_num [Real.sq_sqrt]

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:60.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.projection
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:60.text: def projection (e z : ℂ) : ℝ := (star e * z).re

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:764.name: freeEnergy_le_of_lt_mass
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:764.text:
theorem freeEnergy_le_of_lt_mass (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) {t s : ℝ}
    (hχ : susceptibility o t < ⊤) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hm : ENNReal.ofReal s < directionalMass o e t) : freeEnergy o e s ≤ t := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsr⟩ := lt_sSup_iff.mp hm
  obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl, hfin⟩ := hr
  have hsu : s < u := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hs).mp hsr
  exact freeEnergy_le_of_directionalSum_finite o e s
    (directionalSum_finite_of_le o e hχ hfin hs hsu.le)

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:720.name: directionalSum_finite_of_freeEnergy_lt
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:720.text:
theorem directionalSum_finite_of_freeEnergy_lt (o : Vertex) (e : ℂ) (s : ℝ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : freeEnergy o e s < t) : directionalSum o e t s < ⊤ :=
  directionalSum_finite_of_logPartition_limit o e s (logPartition_tendsto o e s) ht

OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:289.name: OAI.HoneycombForce.saws_nonempty
OAI.Probability.Honeycomb.FreeEnergy:289.text:
theorem saws_nonempty (o : Vertex) (n : ℕ) : (saws o n).Nonempty :=
  ⟨rayPath o n, rayPath_mem o n⟩
