OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Product..text:
theorem hasOnlyTrivialInvariantProjections_of_sampling_and_phases
    {p : ProductScaleData} (hp : ProductScaleLaws p)
    (e : ℕ ≃ Σ s, Fin (p.m s))
    (he : ∀ a : Σ s, Fin (p.m s),
      e.symm a = (∑ r ∈ Finset.range a.1, p.m r) + a.2.val)
    (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hadm : AdmissibleAnglesAndCosts θ (fun i => p.C (e i).1))
    (hb : ∀ j, ∀ i ∈ ProductPhases.consecutiveBlock p.m j,
      θ i ∈ Set.Icc (1 / p.N j) (2 / p.N j))
    (hsmall : ∀ s, ProductPhases.smallPhaseCondition
      (ProductPhases.consecutiveBlock p.m s) (p.K s) (p.G s) θ)
    (hlarge : ∀ᶠ s in atTop, ProductPhases.largePhaseCondition
      (ProductPhases.consecutiveBlock p.m s) (p.N s) θ)
    (hsampling : HasAllFiniteCoordinateSampling θ) :
    HasOnlyTrivialInvariantProjections (factor θ)
      (weightedOperator θ (fun i => p.C (e i).1)) := by
  intro A hAm hA hinv
  by_cases hA0 : A = 0
  · exact Or.inl hA0
  by_cases hA1 : A = 1
  · exact Or.inr hA1
  exfalso
  have hθ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i := fun i => (hadm.1 i).1.le
  have hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p.C (e i).1 := fun i => (hp.C_pos (e i).1).le
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hproj, htri⟩ := exists_covariantProjectionField_pairIdentity
    θ (fun i => p.C (e i).1) hθ0 hadm.2.1 hc hsampling A hAm hA hinv
  have hnorm : ‖A‖ = 1 := by
    have heq : ‖A‖ * ‖A‖ = ‖A‖ := by
      rw [← CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self, hA.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq,
        hA.isIdempotentElem.eq]
    have hpos : 0 < ‖A‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hA0
    nlinarith
  have hdiag := ae_strict_diagonal_of_invariant_projection hadm A hAm hA hA0 hA1
    hinv F (fun x => by simpa only [hnorm] using hF.2.1 x) hF.2.2.1 hF.2.2.2.1
  have hdiag' : ∀ᵐ x ∂baseMeasure,
      0 < BlockedProductCoupling.projectionDiagonal F x ∧
      BlockedProductCoupling.projectionDiagonal F x < 1 := by
    simpa only [BlockedProductCoupling.projectionDiagonal,
      BlockedProductCoupling.sourceBasisZero, PositiveDiagonalModel.e0,
      lp.inner_single_left, RCLike.inner_apply, map_one, mul_one] using hdiag
  have hpair := OrderedProductCoupling.source_circlePairLaw_pairIdentity_of_triangular
    p.m p.a p.b hp.m_ge_100
    (fun s => (hp.a_bounds s).1) (fun s => (hp.a_bounds s).2)
    (fun s => (hp.b_bounds s).1) (fun s => (hp.b_bounds s).2)
    e θ (fun i => p.C (e i).1) hθ0 hadm.2.1 hc F hproj
    (fun i => (hF.2.2.1 (lp.single 2 i 1)).measurable) htri
  have htail := hp.eventually_source_product_tail_estimate e he θ hθ0 hadm.2.1
    hb hsmall hlarge
  exact actualSource_projection_contradiction hp e he θ hθ0 hadm.2.1
    (fun i => hb (e i).1 i (ProductPhases.mem_consecutiveBlock_enumeration p.m e he i))
    A F hF hproj hinv hdiag' hpair htail

end Invariant233.ProductModel

end

OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Sampling.name: OAI.Invariant233.ProductModel.exists_admissible_phase_block_weight_and
OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Sampling.text:
theorem exists_admissible_phase_block_weight_and
    (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hgrowth : ∀ j, 2 ^ j ≤ m j)
    (K G C : ℕ → ℝ) (hK : ∀ j, 1 ≤ K j) (hG : ∀ j, 0 < G j)
    (hC : ∀ j, (K j) ^ 2 ≤ C j)
    (hscale : ∀ j, 2 < (m j : ℝ) * K j)
    (hsum : Summable (fun j => 1 / K j))
    (e : ℕ ≃ Σ j, Fin (m j))
    (he : ∀ a : Σ j, Fin (m j),
      e.symm a = (∑ r ∈ Finset.range a.1, m r) + a.2.val)
    {P : (ℕ → ℝ) → Prop}
    (hP : ∀ᵐ θ ∂Measure.infinitePi (fun i => ProbabilityTheory.cond volume
      (Icc (1 / ((m (e i).1 : ℝ) * K (e i).1))
        (2 / ((m (e i).1 : ℝ) * K (e i).1)))), P θ) :
    ∃ θ : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ j, ∀ i ∈ consecutiveBlock m j,
        θ i ∈ Icc (1 / ((m j : ℝ) * K j)) (2 / ((m j : ℝ) * K j))) ∧
      (∑' i, θ i) ≤ 2 * (∑' j, 1 / K j) ∧
      AdmissibleAnglesAndCosts θ (fun i => C (e i).1) ∧
      HasNegInfiniteLogIntegral baseMeasure (weight θ (fun i => C (e i).1)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂baseMeasure,
        0 < weight θ (fun i => C (e i).1) x ∧ weight θ (fun i => C (e i).1) x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ j, smallPhaseCondition (consecutiveBlock m j) (K j) (G j) θ) ∧
      (∀ᶠ j in atTop,
        largePhaseCondition (consecutiveBlock m j) ((m j : ℝ) * K j) θ) ∧ P θ := by
  have hm : ∀ j, 0 < m j := fun j =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < 2 ^ j) (hgrowth j)
  have hKpos (j : ℕ) : 0 < K j := zero_lt_one.trans_le (hK j)
  have hCpos (j : ℕ) : 0 < C j := (sq_pos_of_pos (hKpos j)).trans_le (hC j)
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hpos, hsθ, htθ, hind, hsmall, hlarge, hp⟩ :=
    exists_consecutive_phase_angles_and m hgrowth K G hKpos hG hsum e he hP
  have hbounds (i : ℕ) : θ i ∈
      Icc (1 / ((m (e i).1 : ℝ) * K (e i).1))
        (2 / ((m (e i).1 : ℝ) * K (e i).1)) :=
    hθ (e i).1 i (mem_consecutiveBlock_enumeration m e he i)
  have hunit (i : ℕ) : θ i < 1 :=
    (hbounds i).2.trans_lt ((div_lt_one
      (mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (hm _)) (hKpos _))).mpr (hscale _))
  refine ⟨θ, hθ, htθ, ?_, ?_, ?_, hsmall, hlarge, hp⟩
  · exact ⟨fun i => ⟨hpos i, hunit i, hCpos _⟩, hsθ, hind⟩
  · exact hasNegInfiniteLogIntegral_of_block_bounds m hm K C hK hC e θ
      (fun i => ⟨(hpos i).le, hunit i⟩) (fun i => (hbounds i).1)
  · filter_upwards [ae_weight_pos θ (fun i => C (e i).1)
      (fun i => (hpos i).le) (fun i => (hCpos _).le) hsθ] with x hx
    exact ⟨hx, (weight_mem_Icc θ _ x).2⟩

OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Product..name: OAI.Invariant233.ProductModel.product_realization_of_ae_sampling
OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Product..text:
theorem product_realization_of_ae_sampling
    (hsampling : ∀ (p : ProductScaleData) (_hp : ProductScaleLaws p)
      (S : ℕ → ℝ) (_hS : ∀ i, 0 < S i)
      (_hblock : ∀ j, ∀ i ∈ ProductPhases.consecutiveBlock p.m j,
        S i = (p.m j : ℝ) * p.K j),
      ∀ᵐ θ ∂Measure.infinitePi (fun i =>
        ProbabilityTheory.cond volume (Set.Icc (1 / S i) (2 / S i))),
        HasAllFiniteCoordinateSampling θ) :
    ∃ θ c : ℕ → ℝ, AdmissibleAnglesAndCosts θ c ∧
      HasAllFiniteCoordinateSampling θ ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂baseMeasure, 0 < weight θ c x) ∧
      HasNegInfiniteLogIntegral baseMeasure (weight θ c) ∧
      IsTypeII1FactorWithVector (factor θ) traceVector ∧
      HasSeparablePredual (factor θ) ∧
      weightedOperator θ c ∈ factor θ ∧ weightedOperator θ c ≠ 0 ∧
      NormQuasinilpotent (weightedOperator θ c) ∧
      vectorFugledeKadisonDeterminant traceVector (weightedOperator θ c) = 0 ∧
      spectrum ℂ (weightedOperator θ c) = {0} ∧
      IsVectorBrownMeasure traceVector (weightedOperator θ c) (Measure.dirac 0) ∧
      HasOnlyTrivialInvariantProjections (factor θ) (weightedOperator θ c) ∧
      ProductPolarStructure shiftOperator (weightedOperator θ c) := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ProductScaleConstruction.exists_product_scales
  have hm (j : ℕ) : 0 < p.m j := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hp.m_ge_100 j)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := InvariantProjection.IndependentAngles.exists_consecutiveBlocks_equiv p.m hm
  have hK (j : ℕ) : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p.K j := by exact_mod_cast hp.K_pos j
  have hG (j : ℕ) : (0 : ℝ) < p.G j := by exact_mod_cast hp.G_pos j
  have hC (j : ℕ) : (p.K j : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ p.C j := by
    rw [hp.C_eq j]
    exact le_max_right _ _
  have hscale (j : ℕ) : (2 : ℝ) < (p.m j : ℝ) * p.K j := by
    have hm100 : (100 : ℝ) ≤ p.m j := by exact_mod_cast hp.m_ge_100 j
    have hk := hK j
    nlinarith
  have hS (i : ℕ) : 0 < (p.m (e i).1 : ℝ) * p.K (e i).1 :=
    mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (hm _)) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (hp.K_pos _))
  have hsamp := hsampling p hp
    (fun i => (p.m (e i).1 : ℝ) * p.K (e i).1) hS
    (by
      intro j i hi
      rw [ProductPhases.enumeration_block_of_mem p.m e he hi])
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, _hsum, hadm, hlog, hpos, hsmall, hlarge, hs⟩ :=
    exists_admissible_phase_block_weight_and p.m hp.m_ge_pow_self
      (fun j => (p.K j : ℝ)) (fun j => (p.G j : ℝ)) p.C
      hK hG hC hscale hp.summable_reciprocal e he hsamp
  have hθ0 (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ θ i := (hadm.1 i).1.le
  have hθ01 (i : ℕ) : θ i ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hθ0 i, (hadm.1 i).2.1⟩
  have hc (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ p.C (e i).1 := (hadm.1 i).2.2.le
  have hdiv := (hasNegInfiniteLogIntegral_iff_tsum θ _ hθ01 hc).mp hlog
  obtain ⟨hfactor, hpredual, _hfields, _htrace⟩ := factor_complete θ hadm.2.2
  refine ⟨θ, (fun i => p.C (e i).1), hadm, hs,
    hpos.mono (fun _ hx => hx.1), hlog, hfactor, hpredual,
    weightedOperator_mem_factor θ _,
    weightedOperator_ne_zero θ _ hθ0 hc hadm.2.1,
    weightedOperator_normQuasinilpotent θ _ hθ0 hc hadm.2.1 hdiv,
    weightedOperator_vectorDeterminant_zero θ _ hθ0 hc hadm.2.1 hlog,
    weightedOperator_spectrum_eq_singleton_zero θ _ hθ0 hc hadm.2.1 hdiv,
    weightedOperator_isVectorBrownMeasure_dirac_zero_of_logIntegral
      θ _ hθ01 hc hadm.2.1 hlog,
    ?_, productPolarStructure_of_admissible θ _ hadm⟩
  exact hasOnlyTrivialInvariantProjections_of_sampling_and_phases hp e he θ hadm
    hθ hsmall hlarge hs

end Invariant233.ProductModel

OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Spectral.name: OAI.Invariant233.ProductModel.weightedOperator_normQuasinilpotent
OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Spectral.text:
theorem weightedOperator_normQuasinilpotent
    (θ c : ℕ → ℝ) (hθ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hθ : Summable θ)
    (hdiv : (∑' i, ENNReal.ofReal (c i * θ i)) = ∞) :
    NormQuasinilpotent (weightedOperator θ c) := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ q : ℕ, ∃ I : Finset ℕ, (q : ℝ) < ∑ i ∈ I, c i * θ i := by
    intro q
    exact ProductNorm.exists_finite_sum_gt_of_tsum_eq_top (fun i => c i * θ i)
      (fun i => mul_nonneg (hc i) (hθ0 i)) hdiv q
  choose I hI using hex
  apply ProductNorm.tendsto_root_zero_of_exponential_bounds
    (fun n => ‖weightedOperator θ c ^ n‖)
    (fun q => ∑ i ∈ I q, c i) (fun q => ∑ i ∈ I q, c i * θ i)
    (fun n => norm_nonneg _)
  · intro q n _hn
    exact norm_weightedOperator_pow_le_finite_cost θ c hθ0 hc hθ (I q) n
  · intro b
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_nat_gt b
    exact ⟨q, hq.trans (hI q)⟩

OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Sampling.name: OAI.Invariant233.ProductModel.SamplingWeights.ae_hasAllFiniteCoordinateSampling
OAI.Analysis.IrrationalRotation.Sampling.text:
theorem ae_hasAllFiniteCoordinateSampling
    {p : ProductScaleData} (hp : ProductScaleLaws p)
    (S : ℕ → ℝ) (hS : ∀ i, 0 < S i)
    (hblock : ∀ j, ∀ i ∈ ProductPhases.consecutiveBlock p.m j,
      S i = (p.m j : ℝ) * p.K j) :
    ∀ᵐ θ ∂Measure.infinitePi (fun i => ProbabilityTheory.cond volume
      (Icc (1 / S i) (2 / S i))),
      HasAllFiniteCoordinateSampling θ := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hp.exists_sampling_sequence
  filter_upwards [hp.ae_source_angles S hS hblock,
    ae_all_sourceCylinder_energy_tendsto_zero hp N hN S hS hblock,
    ae_all_source_univ_energy_tendsto_zero hp N hN S hS hblock] with θ hθ hC hU
  intro I
  apply orderedOrbitSampling_of_source_limits hp N hN θ I
    (fun i => (hθ.2.1 i).1.le) hθ.2.2.1
    (fun j i hi => (hθ.1 j i hi).2)
  · exact source_hasUniformL2Marginals_of_energy_convergence hp N θ I (hU I)
  · exact source_orbitAverage_weaklyConverges_of_cylinder_energy hp N θ I (hC I)

end Invariant233.ProductModel.SamplingWeights

theorem factor_complete (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hθ : ProductModel.JointlyRationallyIndependent θ) :
    IsTypeII1FactorWithVector (ProductModel.factor θ) ProductModel.traceVector ∧
      HasSeparablePredual (ProductModel.factor θ) ∧
      (∀ A : ProductModel.Hilbert →L[ℂ] ProductModel.Hilbert,
        A ∈ ProductModel.factor θ ↔
          ∃ (F : ProductModel.Base → ProductModel.Fiber →L[ℂ] ProductModel.Fiber)
            (B : ℝ), ProductModel.IsCovariantFieldRepresentation θ A F B) ∧
      (∀ (A : ProductModel.Hilbert →L[ℂ] ProductModel.Hilbert)
        (F : ProductModel.Base → ProductModel.Fiber →L[ℂ] ProductModel.Fiber) (B : ℝ),
        ProductModel.IsCovariantFieldRepresentation θ A F B →
          vectorTrace ProductModel.traceVector A = ProductModel.centralDiagonalIntegral F) := by
  refine ⟨factor_isTypeII1FactorWithVector θ hθ,
    factor_hasSeparablePredual θ,
    mem_factor_iff_covariantFieldRepresentation θ, ?_⟩
  intro A F B h
  exact h.vectorTrace_eq

      IsAtomicVonNeumannAlgebra (finitePolarAlgebra U (operatorModulus T) F)) ∧

OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:357.name: OAI.TriangularBilliards.bounded_billiard_invariant_constant
OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:357.text:
theorem bounded_billiard_invariant_constant (Q : Triangle) (hQ : Q.HasIrrationalAngle)
    {f : Phase → ℂ} (hfm : StronglyMeasurable f) (hf : MemLp f 2 (phaseMeasure Q))
    {H : ℝ} (hb : ∀ z, ‖f z‖ ≤ H)
    (hinv : ∀ t : ℝ, (fun z => f (billiardFlow Q t z)) =ᵐ[phaseMeasure Q] f) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, f =ᵐ[phaseMeasure Q] fun _ => c := by
  let F : DoublePhase → ℂ := fun z => f z.1
  have hFm : StronglyMeasurable F := hfm.comp_measurable measurable_fst
  have mp : MeasurePreserving (Prod.fst : DoublePhase → Phase) (doubleMeasure Q) (phaseMeasure Q) :=
    measurePreserving_fst
  have hF : MemLp F 2 (doubleMeasure Q) := hf.comp_measurePreserving mp
  have hFi : (geodesicHilbertFlow Q).HasGenerator (hF.toLp F) 0 := by
    apply ((geodesicHilbertFlow Q).hasGenerator_zero_iff _).mpr
    intro t
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [geodesic_koopman_ae Q t (hF.toLp F),hF.coeFn_toLp,
      (measurePreserving_doubleFlow Q t).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hF.coeFn_toLp,
      mp.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hinv t)] with z hz hfz hftz hiz
    rw [hz,hftz,hfz]
    exact hiz
  let g : Circle → ℂ := fun v => spatialMean Q F (v,0)
  have hgm : StronglyMeasurable g := (spatialMean_stronglyMeasurable Q hFm).comp_measurable
    (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
  have hgmean (c : DirectionParity) : spatialMean Q F c = g c.1 := rfl
  have hgi (i : Fin 3) : g ∘ reflectedDirection Q i =ᵐ[angularMeasure] g := by
    apply ae_fst_of_ae_prod (ν := parityMeasure)
    have hh := spatialMean_reflection_invariant Q hFm hF (fun z => hb z.1) hFi i
    filter_upwards [hh] with z hz
    exact hz
  obtain ⟨c,hgc⟩ := angular_reflections_constant Q hQ hgm hgi
  have hs := bounded_invariant_spatial_constancy Q hFm hF (fun z => hb z.1) hFi
  have hs' : ∀ᵐ v ∂angularMeasure,
      (fun x => f (x,v)) =ᵐ[(volume Q.table)⁻¹ • volume.restrict Q.table] fun _ => g v := by
    apply ae_fst_of_ae_prod (ν := parityMeasure)
    exact hs
  have hh : ∀ᵐ v ∂angularMeasure, ∀ᵐ x ∂((volume Q.table)⁻¹ • volume.restrict Q.table), f (x,v)=c := by
    filter_upwards [hs',hgc] with v hv hvc
    filter_upwards [hv] with x hx
    exact hx.trans hvc
  refine ⟨c,?_⟩
  have hm : MeasurableSet {z : ℂ × Circle | f z=c} := measurableSet_eq_fun hfm.measurable measurable_const
  apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae hm).mpr
  exact (Measure.ae_ae_comm (p := fun x v => f (x,v)=c) hm).mpr hh

OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:313.name: OAI.measure_zero_or_one_of_indicator_constant
OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:313.text:
lemma measure_zero_or_one_of_indicator_constant {α : Type uAlpha} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {A : Set α} {c : ℂ}
    (h : A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => c) :
    μ A=0 ∨ μ A=1 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := h.exists
  by_cases hxA : x∈A
  · have hc : c=1 := by simpa only [indicator_of_mem hxA] using hx.symm
    right
    have he : A =ᵐ[μ] univ := by
      filter_upwards [h] with y hy
      apply propext
      simp only [mem_univ,iff_true]
      by_contra hn
      rw [indicator_of_notMem hn,hc] at hy
      exact zero_ne_one hy
    rw [measure_congr he,measure_univ]
  · have hc : c=0 := by simpa only [indicator_of_notMem hxA] using hx.symm
    left
    apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
    filter_upwards [h] with y hy
    intro hym
    rw [indicator_of_mem hym,hc] at hy
    exact one_ne_zero hy

OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:402.name: OAI.TriangularBilliards.irrational_triangle_invariant_set
OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:402.text:
theorem irrational_triangle_invariant_set (Q : Triangle) (hQ : Q.HasIrrationalAngle)
    (A : Set Phase) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    (hAi : ∀ t : ℝ, phaseMeasure Q (((billiardFlow Q t) ⁻¹' A) ∆ A)=0) :
    phaseMeasure Q A=0 ∨ phaseMeasure Q A=1 := by
  classical
  let f : Phase → ℂ := A.indicator (fun _ => 1)
  have hfm : StronglyMeasurable f := stronglyMeasurable_const.indicator hA
  have hf : MemLp f 2 (phaseMeasure Q) := (memLp_const (1:ℂ)).indicator hA
  have hb (z : Phase) : ‖f z‖ ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hz : z∈A <;> simp [f,hz]
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := bounded_billiard_invariant_constant Q hQ hfm hf hb
    (fun t => invariant_indicator _ _ _ (hAi t))
  exact measure_zero_or_one_of_indicator_constant hc

OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:418.name: OAI.TriangularBilliards.irrational_triangle_billiard

    billiardFlow_cocycle Q,irrational_triangle_invariant_set Q hQ⟩

OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:338.name: OAI.invariant_indicator
OAI.Dynamics.TriangleBilliards.Main:338.text:
lemma invariant_indicator {α : Type uAlpha} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) (T : α → α) (A : Set α) (h : μ ((T ⁻¹' A) ∆ A)=0) :
    (fun x => A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℂ)) (T x)) =ᵐ[μ] A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℂ)) := by
  classical
  filter_upwards [measure_symmDiff_eq_zero_iff.mp h] with x hx
  change (T x∈A) = (x∈A) at hx
  by_cases hm : x∈A
  · have ht : T x∈A := by rwa [hx]
    simp only [indicator_of_mem hm,indicator_of_mem ht]
  · have ht : T x∉A := by rwa [hx]
    simp only [indicator_of_notMem hm,indicator_of_notMem ht]

OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.name: OAI.IsingPerceptron.patternFunctional_abs_bound
OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.text:
lemma patternFunctional_abs_bound {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ K) (q : OverlapPath) :
    |patternFunctional f q| ≤ K := by
  exact le_of_tendsto (uniformPattern_tendsto q hf hK).abs
    (Eventually.of_forall (uniformPattern_abs_bound hf.measurable hK q))

OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.name: OAI.IsingPerceptron.variationalValue_real_of_continuous
OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.text:
theorem variationalValue_real_of_continuous {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hbounded : ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x, |f x| ≤ K) :
    ∃ p : ℝ, variationalValue α f = (p : EReal) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hbounded
  have hb := variationalValue_finite_of_continuous hα hf hK
  have hl : ⊥ < variationalValue α f := lt_of_lt_of_le (EReal.bot_lt_coe _) hb.1
  have hu : variationalValue α f < ⊤ := lt_of_le_of_lt hb.2 (EReal.coe_lt_top _)
  exact ⟨(variationalValue α f).toReal, (EReal.coe_toReal hu.ne hl.ne').symm⟩

end IsingPerceptron

OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.name: OAI.IsingPerceptron.OverlapPath
OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.text:
structure OverlapPath where
  val : ℝ →ₘ[pathMeasure] ℝ
  admissible : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ,
    (q =ᵐ[pathMeasure] val) ∧ MonotoneOn q (Set.Ioo 0 1) ∧
    ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, q u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.name: OAI.IsingPerceptron.patternFunctional
OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.text:
def patternFunctional (f : ℝ → ℝ) (q : OverlapPath) : ℝ :=
  Filter.limUnder atTop (uniformPattern f q)

OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.name: OAI.IsingPerceptron.variationalValue_finite_of_continuous
OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.text:
theorem variationalValue_finite_of_continuous {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) {K : ℝ} (hK : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ K) :
    (-(α*K) : EReal) ≤ variationalValue α f ∧
      variationalValue α f ≤ (α*K : ℝ) := by
  constructor
  · apply le_iInf
    intro q
    have hv : -(α*K) ≤ α*patternFunctional f q := by
      have hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_le.mp (patternFunctional_abs_bound hf hK q)).1 hα
      nlinarith
    calc
      (-(α*K) : EReal) ≤ (α*patternFunctional f q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hv
      _ ≤ (α*patternFunctional f q : ℝ)+isingEntropy q := le_add_of_nonneg_right (isingEntropy_nonneg q)
  · calc
      variationalValue α f ≤ (α*patternFunctional f zeroOverlapPath : ℝ) + isingEntropy zeroOverlapPath :=
        iInf_le _ zeroOverlapPath
      _ = (α*patternFunctional f zeroOverlapPath : ℝ) := by rw [isingEntropy_zero, add_zero]
      _ ≤ (α*K : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_le.mp (patternFunctional_abs_bound hf hK _)).2 hα

OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.name: OAI.IsingPerceptron.isingEntropy
OAI.IsingPerceptron.isingEntropy_zero
OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.text:
lemma isingEntropy_zero : isingEntropy zeroOverlapPath = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm _ (isingEntropy_nonneg _)
  apply iSup_le
  intro h
  have hi : (∫ u, stepFunction h u * zeroOverlapPath.val u ∂pathMeasure) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ _u : ℝ, (0 : ℝ) ∂pathMeasure := integral_congr_ae (by
        filter_upwards [zeroOverlapPath_ae] with u hu
        rw [← hu, mul_zero])
      _ = 0 := integral_zero _ _
  simpa only [hi, zero_div, add_zero, EReal.coe_zero] using
    EReal.coe_le_coe (fieldRecursion_nonpos h)

OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.name: OAI.IsingPerceptron.isingEntropy_nonneg
OAI.Probability.IsingPerceptron.Variatio.text:
lemma isingEntropy_nonneg (q : OverlapPath) : 0 ≤ isingEntropy q := by
  have h := le_iSup (fun h : FieldStep =>
    ((fieldRecursion h + (∫ u, stepFunction h u*q.val u ∂pathMeasure)/2 : ℝ) : EReal))
      zeroFieldStep
  simpa only [isingEntropy, fieldRecursion_zeroFieldStep, stepFunction_zeroFieldStep, zero_mul,
    integral_zero, zero_div, add_zero, EReal.coe_zero] using h

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.JacobsthalBudgetSeparation.terminal_budget_separation
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem terminal_budget_separation (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      x*deletionBudget (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x) <
        c*((terminalY x:ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x)⌋₊/
          (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceB (terminalTop x))^2) := by
  let c0 : ℝ := Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant)/2
  have hc0 : 0 < c0 := by dsimp [c0]; positivity
  have hWT := terminal_w_tendsto
  have hLog := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hWT
  filter_upwards [eventual_terminal_numerics,eventual_terminal_logs,
    hWT.eventually ErdosInverseEuler.smallEuler_log_bounds,
    hLog.eventually_gt_atTop ((1276*32)/(c*c0))] with x hn hl he hloglarge
  obtain ⟨hx,hlog,hlogs,hTop,hYlo,_hYhi,_hTcut,hT,hTL⟩ := hn
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hl0 : 0 < Real.log x := by linarith
  have hw : 1 < ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x) := by linarith [he.1]
  have hV : c0/Real.log (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x)) ≤
      SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x)⌋₊ := by
    convert he.2.2.1 using 1
    dsimp [c0]
    ring
  have hscale := normalized_scale_lower hx0 hl0 hl.2.2.2.2.1 hl.2.2.2.2.2 hw hc0 hYlo hV
  have hsep : 1275 < c*c0*Real.log (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x))/32 := by
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos hc hc0)).mp hloglarge
    dsimp only [Function.comp_def] at hh
    nlinarith
  have hden : 0 < x^2/(Real.log x)^2 := div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hx0) (sq_pos_of_pos hl0)
  have hbudget := source_deletion_budget hx0 hl0 hlogs (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x) hT hTL
  calc
    _ ≤ 1275*x^2/(Real.log x)^2 := hbudget
    _ = 1275*(x^2/(Real.log x)^2) := by ring
    _ < (c*c0*Real.log (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x))/32)*(x^2/(Real.log x)^2) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsep hden
    _ = c*(c0*x^2*Real.log (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x))/(32*(Real.log x)^2)) := by ring
    _ ≤ c*((terminalY x:ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x)⌋₊/
        (Real.log (terminalTop x)/Real.log (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x)))^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale hc.le
    _ = _ := rfl
end NumberTheoryLean.JacobsthalBudgetSeparation


end Erdos970

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.JacobsthalTerminalScales.eventual_terminal_numerics
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem eventual_terminal_numerics : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
    4 ≤ x ∧ 2 ≤ Real.log x ∧ (Real.log x)^2 ≤ x ∧ 1 < terminalTop x ∧
    x^2/8 ≤ (terminalY x:ℝ) ∧ (terminalY x:ℝ) ≤ x^2 ∧
    progressionLength (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x) ≤ terminalCutoff x ∧
    (progressionLength (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x):ℝ) ≤ 2*x/Real.log x ∧
    Real.log x/2 ≤ Real.log (progressionLength (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x):ℝ) := by
  filter_upwards [eventual_terminal_logs] with x hx
  obtain ⟨hx,hlog,hs,h16,hlo,hhi⟩ := hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hl0 : 0 < Real.log x := by linarith
  have htop : 2 ≤ terminalTop x := by unfold terminalTop; nlinarith
  have hY : x^2/8 ≤ (terminalY x:ℝ) ∧ (terminalY x:ℝ) ≤ x^2 := by
    simpa only [terminalY,ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceY,terminalTop] using floor_length_bounds hx hl0 hlo hhi
  have hZ := floor_cutoff_bounds htop
  have hT := source_progression_bounds hx hlog hs (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x) hY.1 hY.2 hZ.1
    (by simpa only [terminalCutoff,terminalTop,mul_assoc] using hZ.2.2.2) hZ.2.2.1
  exact ⟨hx,hlog,hs,by linarith,hY.1,hY.2,hT.2.2,hT.2.1,
    progression_log_lower hx0 hl0 h16 _ _ hT.1⟩
end NumberTheoryLean.JacobsthalTerminalScales


end Erdos970

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.JacobsthalFromRootLower.terminal_w_le_top
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem terminal_w_le_top : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,

  filter_upwards [(Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp terminal_top_tendsto).eventually
    JacobsthalSourceScale.sourceW_bounds_eventually,terminal_top_tendsto.eventually_gt_atTop 1]
    with x hw ht
  have hW : ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x) ≤ Real.log (terminalTop x) := hw.2.2
  have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (zero_lt_one.trans ht)
  linarith

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.JacobsthalFinite.quadratic_of_eventually_quadratic
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem quadratic_of_eventually_quadratic
    (hlarge : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → 0 < k →
      ∃ m : ℕ, Targets.IsJacobsthalBound k m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ C * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    Targets.JacobsthalQuadratic := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, K, hK⟩ := hlarge
  let D : ℝ := max C (((K + 1) * (K + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hCD : C ≤ D := le_max_left _ _
  have hD : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le hC hCD
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  by_cases hKk : K ≤ k
  · obtain ⟨m, hm, hbound⟩ := hK k hKk hk
    exact ⟨m, hm, hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCD (sq_nonneg _))⟩
  · refine ⟨(k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial, factorial_isJacobsthalBound k, ?_⟩
    have hsmall : k + 1 ≤ K + 1 := by omega
    have hfac : (k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial ≤ (K + 1) * (K + 1).factorial :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hsmall (Nat.factorial_le hsmall)
    have hfacR : (((k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        (((K + 1) * (K + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hfac
    have hkR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hk2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc
      (((k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          (((K + 1) * (K + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) := hfacR
      _ ≤ D := le_max_right _ _
      _ ≤ D * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.JacobsthalFromRootLower.jacobsthal_of_source_root_lower
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem jacobsthal_of_source_root_lower (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (z : ℝ → PrimeHistories.Node)
    (hLower : ∀ᶠ top : ℝ in atTop,∀ a : ℕ → ℕ,
      c*((ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceY top:ℝ)*
        SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW top⌋₊/(ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceB top)^2) ≤
      countSurvivors (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceY top)
        (LargePrimeDeletion.cutoffPrimes ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW top⌋₊) a
        (rootVertex (z top) ∅ (sourcePrimeSet (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW top) top)
          ((ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceY top:ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW top⌋₊))) :
    Targets.JacobsthalQuadratic := by
  have hData : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      (terminalY x:ℝ) ≤ x^2 ∧
      progressionLength (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x) ≤ terminalCutoff x ∧
      ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x) ≤ terminalTop x ∧
      x*deletionBudget (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x) <
        c*((terminalY x:ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x)⌋₊/
          (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceB (terminalTop x))^2) ∧
      ∀ a : ℕ → ℕ,c*((terminalY x:ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop x)⌋₊/
          (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceB (terminalTop x))^2) ≤
        ((LargePrimeDeletion.cutoffSurvivors (terminalY x) (terminalCutoff x) a).card:ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [eventual_terminal_numerics,terminal_w_le_top,terminal_budget_separation c hc,
      terminal_top_tendsto.eventually hLower] with x hn hw hb hl
    refine ⟨hn.2.2.2.2.2.1,hn.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,hw,hb,?_⟩
    exact cutoff_lower_of_root_lower (terminalY x) hw (z (terminalTop x)) hl
  have hNat : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ m : ℕ,Targets.IsJacobsthalBound k m ∧ (m:ℝ) ≤ (1:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)^2 := by
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k:ℝ)) atTop atTop).eventually hData] with k hk
    refine ⟨terminalY (k:ℝ),?_,by simpa only [one_mul] using hk.1⟩
    exact isJacobsthalBound_of_cutoff_lower _ _ k hk.2.1 hk.2.2.2.2 hk.2.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨K,hK⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hNat
  exact JacobsthalFinite.quadratic_of_eventually_quadratic ⟨1,by norm_num,K,fun k hk _hpos => hK k hk⟩
end NumberTheoryLean.JacobsthalFromRootLower

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.Erdos970Final.source_root_survivor_lower
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem source_root_survivor_lower : ∃ c : ℝ,0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ top : ℝ in atTop,
    ∀ a : ℕ → ℕ,
    c*((sourceY top : ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊sourceW top⌋₊/(sourceB top)^2) ≤
      countSurvivors (sourceY top) (cutoffPrimes ⌊sourceW top⌋₊) a
        (rootVertex (sourceRootNode (1/100) top) ∅ (sourcePrimeSet (sourceW top) top)
          ((sourceY top : ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊sourceW top⌋₊)) := by
  obtain ⟨eta0,heta0,heta01,hCorrection⟩ := source_stopped_correction
  obtain ⟨c,Clen,Cs,xi0,hc,hClen,hCs,_hCsMin,hxi0,hxi01,hError⟩ :=
    source_root_lower_with_stopped_correction 1
  have hClenPos : 0 < Clen := by linarith
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hCorrection⟩ := hCorrection Cs hCs.le
  let eta : ℝ := eta0/2
  let xi : ℝ := min (xi0/2) (1/(40*Clen))
  have heta : 0 < eta := by dsimp [eta];positivity
  have hetaU : eta ≤ eta0 := by dsimp [eta];linarith
  have hetaHalf : eta < 1/2 := by dsimp [eta];linarith
  have hxi : 0 < xi := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hxiU : xi ≤ xi0 := (min_le_left _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hxi1 : xi ≤ 1 := hxiU.trans hxi01
  obtain ⟨rho,hrho,hError⟩ := hError eta heta hetaHalf xi hxi hxiU
  have hKstop : 0 < 2*K := by positivity
  have hCorrection := hCorrection Clen hClenPos.le eta heta.le hetaU xi hxi hxi1 rho (by linarith)
  refine ⟨c,hc,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hError (2*K) hKstop,hCorrection] with top hError hCorrection
  obtain ⟨_hw,_htop,hError⟩ := hError
  obtain ⟨_hwC,_htopC,hCorrection⟩ := hCorrection
  intro a
  have hLower := hError a
  have hSign := hCorrection a
  dsimp only at hLower hSign
  linarith

end Erdos970Final

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Paths.Source.name: OAI.Erdos970.Erdos970Final.source_stopped_correction
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Paths.Source.text:
theorem source_stopped_correction :
    ∃ eta0 : ℝ,0 < eta0 ∧ eta0 ≤ 1/4 ∧ ∀ Cs : ℝ,0 ≤ Cs →
      ∃ K : ℝ,0 < K ∧ ∀ Clen : ℝ,0 ≤ Clen → ∀ eta : ℝ,0 ≤ eta → eta ≤ eta0 →
      ∀ xi : ℝ,∀ hxi : 0 < xi,xi ≤ 1 → ∀ rho : ℝ,1 < rho →
      ∀ᶠ top : ℝ in atTop,∃ hw : 1 < sourceW top,∃ htop : sourceW top < top,
      ∀ a : ℕ → ℕ,
      let w := sourceW top
      let B := sourceB top
      let Y := sourceY top
      let mu := (Y : ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊w⌋₊
      let z := sourceRootNode (1/100) top
      let P := sourcePrimeSet w top
      let v := rootVertex z ∅ P mu
      let stop := stopCandidate Y w Cs eta Clen B xi ((2*K)*(Real.log w)^2)
        (rho*(2*K)*(Real.log w)^2) (lower w top xi) (width w top xi)
        (label (zero_lt_one.trans hw) htop hxi) a z
      0 ≤ ∑ ps ∈ stopped w stop P.card v,
        (countSurvivors Y (cutoffPrimes ⌊w⌋₊) a (after w v ps)-referenceValue w (after w v ps)) := by
  obtain ⟨eta0,heta0,heta01,P0,_hP0,hArithmetic⟩ := canonical_key_correction_nonnegative
  refine ⟨eta0,heta0,heta01,?_⟩
  intro Cs hCs
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hArithmetic⟩ := hArithmetic Cs hCs
  refine ⟨K,hK,?_⟩
  intro Clen hClen eta heta hetaU xi hxi hxi1 rho hrho
  have hKstop : 0 < 2*K := by positivity
  obtain ⟨W,_hW,hArithmetic⟩ := hArithmetic (2*rho) xi (by linarith) hxi
  have hGeometry := source_key_geometry hClen hxi hxi1 hKstop (by linarith : 0 < rho) P0
  filter_upwards [hGeometry,rootW_tendsto.eventually_ge_atTop W] with top hGeometry hW
  dsimp only at hGeometry
  obtain ⟨hY,hw,htop,hGeometry⟩ := hGeometry
  refine ⟨hw,htop,?_⟩
  intro a
  dsimp only
  apply stopped_correction_of_key_signs (sourceY top) (sourceW top) top Cs eta Clen
    (sourceB top) xi ((2*K)*(Real.log (sourceW top))^2) (rho*(2*K)*(Real.log (sourceW top))^2)
    ((sourceY top : ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊sourceW top⌋₊) hw htop hxi hClen a
    (sourceRootNode (1/100) top)
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨⟨d⟩,hPsize,hPl,hPu,hWidthLo,hWidthHi,hBand,hRef⟩ := hGeometry Cs eta a k hk
  have hPl' : Real.exp (K*(Real.log (sourceW top))^3) ≤ (k.tail.getLastD 0 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [show (2*K)/2=K by ring] using hPl
  have hPu' : (k.tail.getLastD 0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((2*rho)*K*(Real.log (sourceW top))^3) := by
    convert hPu using 1
    congr 1
    ring
  apply hArithmetic (sourceW top) hW top hw htop (sourceY top) hY eta Clen (sourceB top)
    ((2*K)*(Real.log (sourceW top))^2) (rho*(2*K)*(Real.log (sourceW top))^2)
    ((sourceY top : ℝ)*SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊sourceW top⌋₊) heta hetaU a
    (sourceRootNode (1/100) top) k d hPsize hPl' hPu' hWidthLo hWidthHi
  · simpa only [ErdosCommonMInterval.lengthExponent,ErdosCommonMInterval.referenceLength] using hBand
  · exact hRef

end Erdos970Final

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Estimates.So.name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.SourceRootErrorLower.source_root_lower_with_stopped_correction
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Estimates.So.text:
theorem source_root_lower_with_stopped_correction (Cmin : ℝ) :
    ∃ c Clen Cs xi₀ : ℝ,0 < c ∧ 1 ≤ Clen ∧ 0 < Cs ∧ Cmin ≤ Cs ∧ 0 < xi₀ ∧ xi₀ ≤ 1 ∧
    ∀ eta : ℝ,0 < eta → eta < 1/2 → ∀ xi : ℝ,∀ hxi : 0 < xi,xi ≤ xi₀ →
    ∃ rho : ℝ,10 < rho ∧ ∀ Kstop : ℝ,0 < Kstop →
    ∀ᶠ top : ℝ in atTop,∃ hw : 1 < sourceW top,∃ htop : sourceW top < top,
      ∀ a : ℕ → ℕ,
      let w := sourceW top
      let B := sourceB top
      let Y := sourceY top
      let small := LargePrimeDeletion.cutoffPrimes ⌊w⌋₊
      let V0 := SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊w⌋₊
      let z := sourceRootNode (1/100) top
      let P := sourcePrimeSet w top
      let v := rootVertex z ∅ P ((Y:ℝ)*V0)
      let stop := stopCandidate Y w Cs eta Clen B xi (Kstop*(Real.log w)^2) (rho*Kstop*(Real.log w)^2)
        (lower w top xi) (width w top xi) (label (zero_lt_one.trans hw) htop hxi) a z
      c*((Y:ℝ)*V0/B^2)+
        (∑ ps∈stopped w stop P.card v,(countSurvivors Y small a (after w v ps)-referenceValue w (after w v ps))) ≤
        countSurvivors Y small a v := by
  obtain ⟨c_L,hc_L,hRef⟩ := source_root_polynomial_margin
  have heighth : 0 < c_L/8 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨Cbad,K,hCbad,hK,hError⟩ := stopped_error_reduction (1/100) 2 (c_L/8) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) heighth
  obtain ⟨Csmall,B₀,W,hCsmall,hB₀,hW,hError⟩ := hError K (le_refl _)
  let eps := c_L/(8*Csmall)
  let budget := c_L/(8*Cbad)
  have heps : 0 < eps := by dsimp [eps]; positivity
  have hbudget : 0 < budget := by dsimp [budget]; positivity
  obtain ⟨Clen,Cs,xi₀,hClen,hCs,hCsMin,hxi₀,hxi₀1,hCompact⟩ :=
    source_compact_error_mass K eps budget (1/100) Cmin hK heps hbudget (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨c_L/2,Clen,Cs,xi₀,by positivity,hClen,hCs,hCsMin,hxi₀,hxi₀1,?_⟩
  intro eta heta0 heta xi hxi hx
  obtain ⟨rho,hrho,hCompact⟩ := hCompact eta heta0 heta xi hxi hx
  refine ⟨rho,hrho,?_⟩
  intro Kstop hKstop
  filter_upwards [hCompact Kstop hKstop,source_root_eventually_data,hRef,
    rootB_tendsto.eventually_ge_atTop B₀,rootW_tendsto.eventually_ge_atTop (max W 2)]
    with top hCompact hData hRef hB hwBound
  obtain ⟨hw,htop,hCompact⟩ := hCompact
  obtain ⟨hY,_hB3,_hw,_hwt,hcomp,h199,h23,hcons,hpower⟩ := hData
  refine ⟨hw,htop,?_⟩
  intro a
  dsimp only
  let w := sourceW top
  let B := sourceB top
  let Y := sourceY top
  let small := LargePrimeDeletion.cutoffPrimes ⌊w⌋₊
  let V0 := SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊w⌋₊
  let z := sourceRootNode (1/100) top
  let P := sourcePrimeSet w top
  let mu := (Y:ℝ)*V0
  let v := rootVertex z ∅ P mu
  let stop := stopCandidate Y w Cs eta Clen B xi (Kstop*(Real.log w)^2) (rho*Kstop*(Real.log w)^2)
    (lower w top xi) (width w top xi) (label (zero_lt_one.trans hw) htop hxi) a z
  have hw2 : 2 ≤ w := (le_max_right _ _).trans hwBound
  have hV0 : 0 < V0 := (inv_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans hw)).trans_le (SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler_floor_ge_inv w hw2)
  have hmu : 0 < mu := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hY) hV0
  have hBpos : 0 < B := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<3) (hB₀.trans hB)
  have hRoot : z.gap=Real.log (Y:ℝ)/Real.log w-(1:ℝ)/100+2 := rfl
  have hErr := hError B w top hB ((le_max_left _ _).trans hwBound) htop hcomp Y hY z hRoot
    rfl h199 h23 hcons rfl rfl hpower a eps heps.le stop
  have hBad := hCompact z a rfl h199 h23 hcons rfl rfl hRoot
  dsimp only at hErr hBad
  have hSmallPay : Csmall*eps=c_L/8 := by dsimp [eps]; field_simp [hCsmall.ne']
  have hBadPay : Cbad*budget=c_L/8 := by dsimp [budget]; field_simp [hCbad.ne']
  have hBadScaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBad hCbad.le
  rw [hBadPay] at hBadScaled
  rw [hSmallPay] at hErr
  let correction := ∑ ps∈stopped w stop P.card v,(countSurvivors Y small a (after w v ps)-referenceValue w (after w v ps))
  have hScaled : c_L/2+(B^2/mu)*correction ≤ (B^2/mu)*countSurvivors Y small a v := by
    dsimp only [correction,mu,v,P,small,V0,z,Y,w,B,stop] at *
    nlinarith
  have hf : 0 < B^2/mu := div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hBpos) hmu
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hf).mp
  calc
    _ = c_L/2+(B^2/mu)*correction := by
      change (B^2/mu)*(c_L/2*(mu/B^2)+correction)=_
      field_simp [hmu.ne',hBpos.ne']
    _ ≤ _ := hScaled
end NumberTheoryLean.SourceRootErrorLower


end Erdos970

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.IteratedLogBudget.separation
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem separation (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 3 ≤ A ∧ ∀ᶠ k : ℝ in atTop,
      k * deletionBudget (terminalY (rescale A k)) (terminalCutoff (rescale A k)) <
        c * ((terminalY (rescale A k) : ℝ) *
          SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW
            (terminalTop (rescale A k))⌋₊ /
          (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceB (terminalTop (rescale A k))) ^ 2) := by
  let c0 : ℝ := Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / 2
  have hc0 : 0 < c0 := by dsimp [c0]; positivity
  let A : ℝ := max 3 ((4 * 1276 * 32) / (c * c0))
  have hA : 3 ≤ A := le_max_left _ _
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hAb : 4 * 1276 * 32 ≤ A * (c * c0) :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hc hc0)).mp (le_max_right _ _)
  have hcoef : 4 * 1275 / A < c * c0 / 32 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hA0).mpr
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
  have hu := rescale_tendsto A hA
  have hWT := JacobsthalBudgetSeparation.terminal_w_tendsto.comp hu
  filter_upwards [hu.eventually eventual_terminal_numerics,
    hu.eventually eventual_terminal_logs,
    hWT.eventually ErdosInverseEuler.smallEuler_log_bounds,
    eventual_loglog_bounds, eventual_loglog_le_logW A hA] with k hn hl he hk hll
  let u := rescale A k
  let w := ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW (terminalTop u)
  obtain ⟨hx, hlog, hlogs, _hTop, hYlo, _hYhi, _hTcut, hT, hTL⟩ := hn
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hlog0 : 0 < Real.log u := by linarith
  have hw2 : 2 ≤ w := he.1
  have hw : 1 < w := by linarith
  have hlogw : 0 < Real.log w := Real.log_pos hw
  have hV : c0 / Real.log w ≤
      SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊w⌋₊ := by
    calc
      _ = Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / (2 * Real.log w) := by
        dsimp [c0]
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := he.2.2.1
  have hscale := normalized_scale_lower hu0 hlog0 hl.2.2.2.2.1 hl.2.2.2.2.2
    hw hc0 hYlo hV
  have hbudget := source_deletion_budget hu0 hlog0 hlogs
    (terminalY u) (terminalCutoff u) hT hTL
  have hf : 1275 * loglog k / A < c * c0 * Real.log w / 32 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 1275 * (4 * Real.log w) / A :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hll (by norm_num)) hA0.le
      _ = (4 * 1275 / A) * Real.log w := by ring
      _ < (c * c0 / 32) * Real.log w := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcoef hlogw
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hden : 0 < u ^ 2 / (Real.log u) ^ 2 :=
    div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hu0) (sq_pos_of_pos hlog0)
  calc
    k * deletionBudget (terminalY u) (terminalCutoff u) =
        (loglog k / A) * (u * deletionBudget (terminalY u) (terminalCutoff u)) := by
      dsimp [u, rescale]
      field_simp [hA0.ne', hk.2.1.ne']
    _ ≤ (loglog k / A) * (1275 * u ^ 2 / (Real.log u) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbudget (div_pos hk.2.1 hA0).le
    _ = (1275 * loglog k / A) * (u ^ 2 / (Real.log u) ^ 2) := by ring
    _ < (c * c0 * Real.log w / 32) * (u ^ 2 / (Real.log u) ^ 2) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hf hden
    _ = c * (c0 * u ^ 2 * Real.log w / (32 * (Real.log u) ^ 2)) := by ring
    _ ≤ c * ((terminalY u : ℝ) * SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊w⌋₊ /
        (Real.log (terminalTop u) / Real.log w) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale hc.le
    _ = _ := rfl

end Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.IteratedLogBudget

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.IteratedLogScales.rescale_tendsto
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem rescale_tendsto (A : ℝ) (hA : 3 ≤ A) : Tendsto (rescale A) atTop atTop := by

  exact Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.IteratedLogBound.of_source_root_lower
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem of_source_root_lower (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (z : ℝ → PrimeHistories.Node)
    (hLower : ∀ᶠ top : ℝ in atTop, ∀ a : ℕ → ℕ,
      c * ((ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceY top : ℝ) *
        SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW top⌋₊ /
        (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceB top) ^ 2) ≤
      countSurvivors (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceY top)
        (LargePrimeDeletion.cutoffPrimes ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW top⌋₊) a
        (rootVertex (z top) ∅ (sourcePrimeSet (ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW top) top)
          ((ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceY top : ℝ) *
            SmallSieveFinite.smallEuler ⌊ErdosInverseBoxHeight.sourceW top⌋₊))) :
    Targets.JacobsthalIteratedLog := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hbudget⟩ := IteratedLogBudget.separation c hc
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hu := rescale_tendsto A hA
  have hData : ∀ᶠ k : ℝ in atTop,
      ∃ m : ℕ, (∀ k' : ℕ, (k' : ℝ) = k → Targets.IsJacobsthalBound k' m) ∧
        (m : ℝ) ≤ A ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / (loglog k) ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hu.eventually eventual_terminal_numerics,
      hu.eventually JacobsthalFromRootLower.terminal_w_le_top,
      hbudget, (terminal_top_tendsto.comp hu).eventually hLower] with k hn hw hb hl
    refine ⟨terminalY (rescale A k), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k' hk'
      apply isJacobsthalBound_of_cutoff_lower _ _ k' hn.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      · exact cutoff_lower_of_root_lower _ hw (z (terminalTop (rescale A k))) hl
      · simpa only [hk', Function.comp_def, terminalY] using hb
    · calc
        _ ≤ (rescale A k) ^ 2 := hn.2.2.2.2.2.1
        _ = A ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / (loglog k) ^ 2 := by
          simp only [rescale, div_pow, mul_pow]
  apply IteratedLogFinite.of_eventually
  refine ⟨A ^ 2, sq_pos_of_pos hA0, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ))
    atTop atTop).eventually hData] with k hk
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hb⟩ := hk
  exact ⟨m, hm k rfl, hb⟩

end Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.IteratedLogBound

OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..name: OAI.Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.IteratedLogFinite.of_eventually
OAI.NumberTheory.Jacobsthal.Conclusions..text:
theorem of_eventually
    (hlarge : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop,
      ∃ m : ℕ, Targets.IsJacobsthalBound k m ∧
        (m : ℝ) ≤ C * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 / (loglog k) ^ 2) :
    Targets.JacobsthalIteratedLog := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hlarge⟩ := hlarge
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hlarge
  let weight : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
    (((k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) * (loglog k) ^ 2
  let D : ℝ := C + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, weight k
  have hw (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ weight k := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hCD : C ≤ D := le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => hw k)
  have hD : 0 < D := hC.trans_le hCD
  refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hkR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hden : 0 < (loglog k) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (loglog_pos hkR)
  by_cases hKk : K ≤ k
  · obtain ⟨m, hm, hb⟩ := hK k hKk
    refine ⟨m, hm, hb.trans ?_⟩
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCD (sq_nonneg _)) hden.le
  · refine ⟨(k + 1) * (k + 1).factorial,
      JacobsthalFinite.factorial_isJacobsthalBound k, ?_⟩
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).mpr
    have hsum : weight k ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, weight i :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hw i) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have hweight : weight k ≤ D := hsum.trans (by dsimp [D]; linarith)
    have hk2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact hweight.trans (by nlinarith)

end Erdos970.NumberTheoryLean.IteratedLogFinite

OAI.NumberTheory.JointDickman.Amplificat.name: OAI.JointDickman.jointDickmanLaw_of_rational_fixedScale
OAI.NumberTheory.JointDickman.Amplificat.text:
theorem jointDickmanLaw_of_rational_fixedScale (hfixed : RationalFixedScaleLaw) :
    JointDickmanLaw := by
  intro a b ha ha1 hb hb1
  obtain ⟨cl, _, hcl, hcllim⟩ := Rat.denseRange_cast.exists_seq_strictMono_tendsto_of_lt
    Rat.cast_strictMono.monotone ha
  obtain ⟨dl, _, hdl, hdllim⟩ := Rat.denseRange_cast.exists_seq_strictMono_tendsto_of_lt
    Rat.cast_strictMono.monotone hb
  obtain ⟨cu, _, hcu, hculim⟩ := Rat.denseRange_cast.exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto_of_lt
    Rat.cast_strictMono.monotone ha1
  obtain ⟨du, _, hdu, hdulim⟩ := Rat.denseRange_cast.exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto_of_lt
    Rat.cast_strictMono.monotone hb1
  let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
  have hδ : Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds)
  have hgl : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun N => fixedDensity (cl k) (dl k) N - δ k)
      atTop (𝓝 (dickmanCDF (cl k) * dickmanCDF (dl k) - δ k)) := by
    intro k
    apply Filter.Tendsto.sub _ tendsto_const_nhds
    apply hfixed
    · exact_mod_cast (hcl k).1
    · exact_mod_cast ((hcl k).2.trans ha1)
    · exact_mod_cast (hdl k).1
    · exact_mod_cast ((hdl k).2.trans hb1)
  have hhu : ∀ k, Tendsto (fixedDensity (cu k) (du k)) atTop
      (𝓝 (dickmanCDF (cu k) * dickmanCDF (du k))) := by
    intro k
    apply hfixed
    · exact_mod_cast (ha.trans (hcu k).1)
    · exact_mod_cast (hcu k).2
    · exact_mod_cast (hb.trans (hdu k).1)
    · exact_mod_cast (hdu k).2
  have hl := ((dickmanCDF_continuous.tendsto a).comp hcllim).mul
    ((dickmanCDF_continuous.tendsto b).comp hdllim)
  have hu := ((dickmanCDF_continuous.tendsto a).comp hculim).mul
    ((dickmanCDF_continuous.tendsto b).comp hdulim)
  have hnat : Tendsto (empiricalDensity (movingEvent a b)) atTop
      (𝓝 (dickmanCDF a * dickmanCDF b)) := by
    apply tendsto_of_approximating_bounds hgl hhu (by simpa using hl.sub hδ) hu
    · intro k
      exact fixedDensity_le_moving_add (by positivity) ha.le hb.le (hcl k).2 (hdl k).2
    · intro k
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (movingDensity_le_fixed ha.le hb.le (hcu k).1.le (hdu k).1.le)
  have hreal := realDensity_tendsto_of_nat hnat
  simpa [dickmanCDF, not_le.mpr ha, not_le.mpr hb] using hreal

end JointDickman

OAI.NumberTheory.JointDickman.Amplificat.name: OAI.JointDickman.increasingOrderLaw_of_jointDickmanLaw
OAI.NumberTheory.JointDickman.Amplificat.text:
theorem increasingOrderLaw_of_jointDickmanLaw (h : JointDickmanLaw) :
    IncreasingOrderLaw := by
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ((tendsto_order.mp orderingGridMass_tendsto).1 a ha).exists
    obtain ⟨f, g, hf, hg, hfI, hgD⟩ := exists_ordering_lower_approximants h m
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp hf).1 a hm, eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)]
      with X haX hX
    exact haX.trans_le (hfI X hX)
  · intro b hb
    have htarget : 1 - b < (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by linarith
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ :=
      ((tendsto_order.mp orderingGridMass_tendsto).1 (1 - b) htarget).exists
    obtain ⟨f, g, hf, hg, hfI, hgD⟩ := exists_ordering_lower_approximants h m
    have hgap : 1 < b + orderingGridMass m := by linarith
    let c : ℝ := (1 + b + orderingGridMass m) / 2
    have hc : 1 < c := by dsimp [c]; linarith
    have hcb : c - b < orderingGridMass m := by dsimp [c]; linarith
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp ordering_density_sum_tendsto).2 c hc,
      (tendsto_order.mp hg).1 (c - b) hcb, eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)]
      with X hsum hgX hX
    have hD := hgD X hX
    linarith

OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..name: OAI.KLInvariance.BruhatGraph.bottom_eq_of_comparisons
OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..text:
theorem bottom_eq_of_comparisons (hne : u ≠ b)
    (hupper : ∀ y : Interval cs u b, y.val ≠ u →
      klPolynomial cs y.val b=klPolynomial cs' (φ y).val b')
    (hforward : ∀ t : ℝ, 0<t → t<1 →
      scaledKL cs t u b ≤ dispatch (source cs u b) (target cs u b) (t⁻¹-t)
        (fun y => scaledKL cs t⁻¹ y.val b) (transportedSchedule φ) (intervalBottom cs hub))
    (hbackward : ∀ t : ℝ, 0<t → t<1 →
      scaledKL cs' t u' b' ≤ dispatch (source cs' u' b') (target cs' u' b') (t⁻¹-t)
        (fun y => scaledKL cs' t⁻¹ y.val b') (transportedSchedule φ.symm)
          (intervalBottom cs' hub')) : klPolynomial cs u b=klPolynomial cs' u' b' := by
  have hr := intervalIso_full_rankDifference cs cs' hub hub' φ
  have hne' : u' ≠ b' := by
    intro h
    have hp := length_lt_of_bruhat_ne cs hub hne
    unfold rankDifference at hr
    simp only [h,Nat.sub_self] at hr
    omega
  apply Comparison.eq_of_scaled_difference_reciprocal
    (klPolynomial cs u b) (klPolynomial cs' u' b') (rankDifference cs u b)
    ((klFamilies_spec cs).P_degree u b hub hne)
  · rw [hr]
    exact (klFamilies_spec cs').P_degree u' b' hub' hne'
  intro t ht ht1
  have hf := comparison_difference_le hub φ hub' (intervalBottom cs hub)
    (fun y hy => hupper y (fun he => hy (Subtype.ext he))) ht.ne' (hforward t ht ht1)
  have hb := comparison_difference_le hub' φ.symm hub (intervalBottom cs' hub')
    (fun y hy => by
      have hyy : (φ.symm y).val ≠ u := by
        intro he
        have he' : φ.symm y=intervalBottom cs hub := Subtype.ext he
        apply hy
        have hh := congrArg φ he'
        rw [φ.apply_symm_apply,intervalIso_bottom cs cs' hub hub' φ] at hh
        exact hh
      simpa only [φ.apply_symm_apply] using (hupper (φ.symm y) hyy).symm)
    ht.ne' (hbackward t ht ht1)
  rw [intervalIso_bottom cs cs' hub hub' φ] at hf
  rw [intervalIso_bottom cs' cs hub' hub φ.symm] at hb
  change scaledKL cs t u b-scaledKL cs' t u' b' ≤
    scaledKL cs t⁻¹ u b-scaledKL cs' t⁻¹ u' b' at hf
  change scaledKL cs' t u' b'-scaledKL cs t u b ≤
    scaledKL cs' t⁻¹ u' b'-scaledKL cs t⁻¹ u b at hb
  have he : scaledKL cs t u b-scaledKL cs' t u' b' =
      scaledKL cs t⁻¹ u b-scaledKL cs' t⁻¹ u' b' := by linarith
  simpa only [scaledKL_eq_scaledPolynomial cs _ hub,
    scaledKL_eq_scaledPolynomial cs' _ hub',hr] using he

end

OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..name: OAI.KLInvariance.BruhatGraph.upperIntervalIso
OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..text:
def upperIntervalIso (x : Interval cs u b) :
    Interval cs x.val b ≃o Interval cs' (φ x).val b' where
  toFun z :=
    let zI : Interval cs u b := ⟨z.val,x.property.1.trans z.property.1,z.property.2⟩
    ⟨(φ zI).val,φ.monotone z.property.1,(φ zI).property.2⟩
  invFun z :=
    let zI : Interval cs' u' b' := ⟨z.val,(φ x).property.1.trans z.property.1,z.property.2⟩
    ⟨(φ.symm zI).val,by
      change x ≤ φ.symm zI
      simpa only [φ.symm_apply_apply] using φ.symm.monotone
        (show φ x ≤ zI from z.property.1),(φ.symm zI).property.2⟩
  left_inv z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (φ.symm (φ ⟨z.val,x.property.1.trans z.property.1,z.property.2⟩)).val=z.val
    exact congrArg (fun a : Interval cs u b => a.val) (φ.symm_apply_apply _)
  right_inv z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (φ (φ.symm ⟨z.val,(φ x).property.1.trans z.property.1,z.property.2⟩)).val=z.val
    exact congrArg (fun a : Interval cs' u' b' => a.val) (φ.apply_symm_apply _)
  map_rel_iff' := by
    intro x y
    exact φ.map_rel_iff

OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..name: OAI.KLInvariance.exists_finiteIntervalModel

OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..name: OAI.KLInvariance.rankDifference_subinterval_lt
OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..text:
theorem rankDifference_subinterval_lt (x z : Interval cs a b) (hxz : x≤z)
    (hne : x.val≠a ∨ z.val≠b) :
    rankDifference cs x.val z.val<rankDifference cs a b := by
  have ha := length_le_of_bruhat cs x.property.1
  have hb := length_le_of_bruhat cs z.property.2
  have hm := length_le_of_bruhat cs hxz
  dsimp only [rankDifference]
  rcases hne with h|h

OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..name: OAI.KLInvariance.BruhatGraph.klPolynomial_invariance_finite
OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..text:
theorem klPolynomial_invariance_finite (a b : W) (a' b' : W')
    (hab : BruhatLE cs a b) (hab' : BruhatLE cs' a' b')
    (φ : Interval cs a b ≃o Interval cs' a' b') :
    klPolynomial cs a b=klPolynomial cs' a' b' := by
  have hp : ∀ n, ∀ (c : W) (c' : W')
      (hcb : BruhatLE cs c b) (hcb' : BruhatLE cs' c' b')
      (ψ : Interval cs c b ≃o Interval cs' c' b'), rankDifference cs c b=n →
      klPolynomial cs c b=klPolynomial cs' c' b' := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro c c' hcb hcb' ψ hn
      by_cases hne : c=b
      · have hne' : c'=b' := by
          by_contra h
          have hp := length_lt_of_bruhat_ne cs' hcb' h
          have hr := intervalIso_full_rankDifference cs cs' hcb hcb' ψ
          unfold rankDifference at hr
          rw [hne,Nat.sub_self] at hr
          omega
        simp only [hne,hne',klPolynomial,(klFamilies_spec cs).P_diagonal,(klFamilies_spec cs').P_diagonal]
      · apply bottom_eq_of_comparisons hcb hcb' ψ hne
        · intro y hy
          apply ih (rankDifference cs y.val b)
            (hn ▸ rankDifference_subinterval_lt y (intervalTop cs hcb) y.property.2 (Or.inl hy))
            y.val (ψ y).val y.property.2 (ψ y).property.2 (upperIntervalIso ψ y) rfl
        · intro t ht _ht1
          exact (scaledKL_eq_transported basis basis' ψ t ht.ne' (intervalBottom cs hcb)).le
        · intro t ht _ht1
          exact (scaledKL_eq_transported basis' basis ψ.symm t ht.ne' (intervalBottom cs' hcb')).le
  exact hp _ a a' hab hab' φ rfl

end
end KLInvariance.BruhatGraph

OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..name: OAI.KLInvariance.combinatorial_invariance
OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..text:
theorem combinatorial_invariance
    {B' : Type u'} {W' : Type v'} [Group W'] {M' : CoxeterMatrix B'}
    (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (cs' : CoxeterSystem M' W')
    {u b : W} {u' b' : W'}
    (hub : BruhatLE cs u b) (hub' : BruhatLE cs' u' b')
    (ι : Interval cs u b ≃o Interval cs' u' b') :
    klPolynomial cs u b = klPolynomial cs' u' b' := by
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := exists_finiteIntervalModel cs u b hub
  obtain ⟨F'⟩ := exists_finiteIntervalModel cs' u' b' hub'
  let : Fintype F.indices := F.finite.fintype
  let : Fintype F'.indices := F'.finite.fintype
  let basis := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ (Extended (StandardParabolic.matrix (M := M) F.indices))
  let basis' := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℝ (Extended (StandardParabolic.matrix (M := M') F'.indices))
  rw [←F.kl_eq,←F'.kl_eq]
  exact klPolynomial_invariance_finite basis basis' F.lower F.upper F'.lower F'.upper
    (F.bruhat hub) (F'.bruhat hub') ((F.orderIso.trans ι).trans F'.orderIso.symm)

end
end KLInvariance

OAI.RepresentationTheory.KazhdanLusztig..text:
theorem scaledKL_eq_transported {a b : W} {a' b' : W'}
    (φ : Interval cs a b ≃o Interval cs' a' b')
    {C : Type*} [Field C] (t : C) (ht : t≠0) (x : Interval cs a b) :
    scaledKL cs t x.val b =
      dispatch (source cs a b) (target cs a b) (t⁻¹-t)
        (fun y => scaledKL cs t⁻¹ y.val b) (transportedSchedule φ) x := by
  rw [transported_dispatch_matrix φ _ (Int.castRingHom C),
    scaledKL_reciprocity_upper cs t ht a b x]
  apply finsum_congr
  intro z
  rw [rTilde_invariance_all_entries basis basis' φ x z]

  facilities : Finset (Fin pointCount)

  facilities_nonempty : facilities.Nonempty
  budget_pos : 0 < budget
  covered : clients ∪ facilities = Finset.univ
  distance_nonneg : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ distance x y
  distance_self : ∀ x, distance x x = 0
  distance_symm : ∀ x y, distance x y = distance y x

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Algori.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.BitMachine.BinaryGlobalOuter.algorithm_guarantee
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Algori.text:
theorem algorithm_guarantee : globalApplicationClaim := by
  refine ⟨gamma/4,div_pos gamma_pos (by norm_num),?_⟩
  intro a _ha
  obtain ⟨v,C,Q,d,h⟩:=finite_program ⌈a⌉₊
  refine ⟨algorithm v C Q d,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro I seed
    rw [algorithm_output]
    have hh:=output_feasible v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed)
    exact ⟨hh.1,hh.2.2,fun _=>hh.2.1⟩
  · intro I
    rw [probability_eq]
    simp only [algorithm_output]
    have hp0 : 0≤(I.optimum:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast I.optimum_nonneg
    have hf:=FailureBudget.failure_le_power (g:=gamma) (a:=a) gamma_lt_one.le I.size
    apply (sub_le_sub_left hf 1).trans
    apply (h I).2.trans
    exact probability_mono (fun seed hs=>hs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [gamma_pos]) hp0))
  · intro I
    rw [expected_eq]
    simp only [algorithm_output]
    have hp0 : 0≤(I.optimum:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast I.optimum_nonneg
    have hb0 : 0≤(2-gamma/2)*(I.optimum:ℝ) := mul_nonneg (by linarith [gamma_lt_one]) hp0
    let K := (budget Q).eval I.bits.length
    let X (seed:Fin K→Bool) : ℝ := (I.cost (output v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed)):ℝ)
    have hFail : probability (fun seed:Fin K→Bool=>(2-gamma/2)*(I.optimum:ℝ)<X seed)≤FailureBudget.failure gamma ⌈a⌉₊ I.size := by
      have he : probability (fun seed:Fin K→Bool=>(2-gamma/2)*(I.optimum:ℝ)<X seed)=
          1-probability (fun seed:Fin K→Bool=>X seed≤(2-gamma/2)*(I.optimum:ℝ)) := by
        rw [←probability_compl];exact probability_congr (fun _=>not_le.symm)
      rw [he];have hh:=(h I).2;linarith
    have hAve:=average_le_threshold_add_failure X hb0 (h I).1
    have hζ:=FailureBudget.failure_le_margin gamma_pos.le ⌈a⌉₊ I.size
    have hmargin:=FailureBudget.expectation_margin hp0 hζ
    change average X≤_
    exact hAve.trans (le_trans (by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hFail (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤6) hp0)]) hmargin)
end MetricKMedianRecovery.BitMachine.BinaryGlobalOuter

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FailureBudget.failure_le_power
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.text:
lemma failure_le_power {g a : ℝ} (hg1 : g ≤ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    failure g ⌈a⌉₊ N ≤ Real.rpow ((N:ℝ)+2) (-a) := by
  have hb : (0:ℝ) < (N:ℝ)+2 := by positivity
  have hb1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)+2 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) N]
  have he : Real.rpow ((N:ℝ)+2) a ≤ ((N:ℝ)+2)^⌈a⌉₊ := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_eq_pow,Real.rpow_natCast] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hb1 (Nat.le_ceil a)
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < ((N:ℝ)+2)^⌈a⌉₊ := pow_pos hb _
  calc
    failure g ⌈a⌉₊ N ≤ 1 / (((N:ℝ)+2)^⌈a⌉₊) := by
      unfold failure
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hp) hp).mpr
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ 1 / Real.rpow ((N:ℝ)+2) a :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hb _) he
    _ = _ := by simpa only [Real.rpow_eq_pow,one_div] using (Real.rpow_neg hb.le a).symm

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FailureBudget.expectation_margin

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FailureBudget.failure

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FiniteSampling.probability_mono
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.text:
lemma probability_mono {P Q : Ω → Prop} (h : ∀ ω, P ω → Q ω) :
    probability P ≤ probability Q := by
  classical
  apply average_mono
  intro ω
  split_ifs with hp hq hq <;> try norm_num
  exact absurd (h ω hp) hq

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FiniteSampling.average_le_threshold_add_failure
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.text:
lemma average_le_threshold_add_failure (X : Ω → ℝ) {B M : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hX : ∀ s, X s ≤ M) :
    average X ≤ B + probability (fun s => B < X s)*M := by
  classical
  unfold probability
  rw [← average_mul_const, ← average_const (Ω := Ω) B, ← average_add]
  apply average_mono
  intro s
  simp only [average_const]
  by_cases hs : B < X s
  · simpa [hs] using (hX s).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hB)
  · simp only [hs,ite_false,zero_mul,add_zero]
    exact le_of_not_gt hs

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FiniteSampling.probability_compl
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.text:
lemma probability_compl [Nonempty Ω] (P : Ω → Prop) :
    probability (fun ω => ¬P ω) = 1 - probability P := by
  classical
  unfold probability
  rw [average_congr (Y := fun ω => 1 - if P ω then 1 else 0) (by
    intro ω
    by_cases hp : P ω <;> simp [hp]), average_sub, average_const]

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Algori.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.BitMachine.BinaryGlobalOuter.expected_eq

lemma expected_eq (A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm) (I : RationalMetricInput) :
    A.expectedCost I=average (fun seed:A.Seed I=>(I.cost (A.output I seed):ℝ)) := by
  rw [BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm.expectedCost,average,Fintype.expect_eq_sum_div_card]
  simp only [BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm.Seed,Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_bool,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FailureBudget.failure_le_margin
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.text:
lemma failure_le_margin {g : ℝ} (hg : 0 ≤ g) (e N : ℕ) : failure g e N ≤ g/24 := by
  have hp : (1:ℝ) ≤ ((N:ℝ)+2)^e := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) N])
  unfold failure
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hg (by norm_num)
  nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Model:.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.globalApplicationClaim
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Model:.text:
def globalApplicationClaim : Prop :=
  ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → ∃ A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm,
    (∀ (I : RationalMetricInput) (s : A.Seed I), I.Feasible (A.output I s)) ∧
    (∀ I : RationalMetricInput,
      1 - Real.rpow ((I.size : ℝ) + 2) (-a) ≤
        A.successProbability I ((2 - σ) * (I.optimum : ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ I : RationalMetricInput, A.expectedCost I ≤ (2 - σ) * (I.optimum : ℝ))

end MetricKMedianRecovery

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FiniteSampling.probability_congr

lemma probability_congr {P Q : Ω → Prop} (h : ∀ ω, P ω ↔ Q ω) :
    probability P = probability Q := by
  classical
  apply average_congr
  intro ω
  simp only [h ω]

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Recove.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.FiniteSampling.probability

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Algori.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.BitMachine.BinaryGlobalOuter.probability_eq

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Algori.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.BitMachine.BinaryGlobalOuter.algorithm_output
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Algori.text:
lemma algorithm_output (v : ℚ) (C : ℕ) (Q : Polynomial ℕ) (d : ℕ) (I : RationalMetricInput)
    (seed : (algorithm v C Q d).Seed I) :
    (algorithm v C Q d).output I seed=output v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed) := by
  change I.decodeOutput (run v C Q d (pairBits (I.bits,List.ofFn seed)))=_
  rw [run_bits,I.decode_outputBits _ (output_feasible v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed)).1]

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Algori.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.BitMachine.BinaryGlobalOuter.finite_program
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Algori.text:
theorem finite_program (e : ℕ) : ∃ v : ℚ, ∃ C : ℕ, ∃ Q : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ d : ℕ,
    ∀ I : RationalMetricInput,
      let K := (budget Q).eval I.bits.length
      (∀ seed:Fin K→Bool,(I.cost (output v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed)):ℝ)≤6*(I.optimum:ℝ)) ∧
      1-FailureBudget.failure gamma e I.size≤probability
        (fun seed:Fin K→Bool=>(I.cost (output v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed)):ℝ)≤(2-gamma/2)*(I.optimum:ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨v,C,Q,d,hR⟩:=BinaryGlobalRounding.rounded_program e
  refine ⟨v,C,Q,d,?_⟩
  intro I
  dsimp only
  let := I.metric
  let K := (budget Q).eval I.bits.length
  have hp0 : 0≤(I.optimum:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast I.optimum_nonneg
  have hf0 : 0≤FailureBudget.failure gamma e I.size := (FailureBudget.failure_pos gamma_pos _ _).le
  have hfactor : 0≤2-gamma/2 := by linarith [gamma_lt_one]
  by_cases hD : I.clients.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨O,hOF,hO,hOk,hOC⟩:=optimum_attained I.facilities I.clients I.facilities_nonempty I.budget I.budget_pos
    rw [I.metric_cost,I.metric_optimum] at hOC
    by_cases hz : (I.optimum:ℝ)=0
    · let Z:=BinaryGlobalZero.output I.distance I.clients I.facilities I.facilities_nonempty
      have hZ:=@BinaryGlobalZero.optimum_zero_spec _ I.metric I.distance (fun _ _=>rfl) I.clients I.facilities
        I.facilities_nonempty I.budget I.budget_pos (by rw [I.metric_optimum,hz])
      have hZF : Z⊆I.facilities := BinaryGlobalZero.output_subset _ _ _ _
      have hZN : Z.Nonempty := BinaryGlobalZero.output_nonempty _ _ _ _ hD
      have hZcost : (I.cost Z:ℝ)=0 := by rw [I.metric_cost] at hZ;exact hZ.2
      have hall (seed:Fin K→Bool) : (I.cost (output v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed)):ℝ)≤0 := by
        apply (cost_le_word v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed) Z hZF hZN hZ.1 ?_).trans_eq hZcost
        rw [words,zero_bits];exact List.mem_cons_self
      constructor
      · intro seed;rw [hz,mul_zero];exact hall seed
      · have he : probability (fun seed:Fin K→Bool=>(I.cost (output v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed)):ℝ)≤(2-gamma/2)*(I.optimum:ℝ))=1 :=
          probability_all _ (fun seed=>by rw [hz,mul_zero];exact hall seed)
        rw [he];linarith
    · have hp : 0<(I.optimum:ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne hp0 (Ne.symm hz)
      have hcp : 0<cost I.clients O := by rw [I.metric_cost,hOC];exact hp
      obtain ⟨p,_,f,_,hm,hmP,hPm⟩:=Rounding.largest_guess I.clients O I.facilities hD hO hOF hcp
      let M:=I.distance p f
      have hM : 0<M := by
        have hm' : (0:ℝ)<(M:ℝ) := hm
        exact_mod_cast hm'
      obtain ⟨U,hRun,hFeas,hBounds⟩:=hR I hD M hM
      have hMP : (M:ℝ)≤(I.cost O:ℝ) := by
        rw [I.metric_cost] at hmP
        exact hmP
      have hPM : (I.cost O:ℝ)≤I.clients.card*(M:ℝ) := by
        rw [I.metric_cost] at hPm
        exact hPm
      obtain ⟨hAll,hProb⟩:=hBounds O hOF hO hOk hMP hPM
      let k:=(BinaryGlobalCall.A.budget Q).eval (BinaryGlobalCall.integralPack I M []).length
      have hk : k≤K := demand_bound Q I M (flat_mem I p f)
      let sub (seed:Fin K→Bool) : Fin k→Bool := fun i=>seed (Fin.castLE hk i)
      have hCall (seed:Fin K→Bool) : BinaryGlobalCall.run v C Q d (BinaryGlobalCall.pack I M (List.ofFn seed))=BinaryFinSet.encode (U (sub seed)) := by
        have hh:=run_take v C Q d I M (List.ofFn seed)
        rw [take_ofFn_cast hk] at hh
        exact hh.trans (hRun (sub seed))
      have hle (seed:Fin K→Bool) : (I.cost (output v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed)):ℝ)≤(I.cost (U (sub seed)):ℝ) := by
        have h:=hFeas (sub seed)
        apply cost_le_word v C Q d I (List.ofFn seed) (U (sub seed)) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2
        rw [words]
        apply List.mem_cons_of_mem
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨M,flat_mem I p f,hCall seed⟩
      constructor
      · intro seed;exact (hle seed).trans (by rw [←hOC];exact hAll (sub seed))
      · rw [hOC] at hProb
        apply hProb.trans
        rw [←probability_prefix hk (fun seed:Fin k→Bool=>(I.cost (U seed):ℝ)≤(2-gamma/2)*(I.optimum:ℝ))]
        exact probability_mono (fun seed hs=>(hle seed).trans hs)
  · have hd : I.clients=∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hD
    have hc (S : Finset (Fin I.pointCount)) : (I.cost S:ℝ)=0 := by
      simp only [RationalMetricInput.cost,hd,Finset.sum_empty,dite_eq_ite,ite_self,Rat.cast_zero]
    constructor
    · intro seed;rw [hc];positivity
    · rw [probability_all _ (fun seed=>by rw [hc];exact mul_nonneg hfactor hp0)]
      linarith
end MetricKMedianRecovery.BitMachine.BinaryGlobalOuter

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Main:26.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.exists_internal_program
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Main:26.text:
theorem exists_internal_program (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∃ algorithm : Instance → List Bool,
      Nonempty (Binary.PolyProgram InstanceProgram.encode id algorithm) ∧
      ∀ I, Correct ε I (algorithm I) := by
  obtain ⟨s,r,hs,hs1,hr,hα,hfactor⟩ := exists_approximation_slack ε hε
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := exists_rational_all_parameters hs hs
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (0:ℝ) (1+3*(p.round.g:ℝ)+(p.round.allowance:ℝ)))
  have hCap : 1+3*(p.round.g:ℝ)+(p.round.allowance:ℝ)≤(C:ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans hC.le
  have hCp : 0<C := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hC
  let α := ((1+2/Real.exp 1+s)/(1-s))*(1+s)*(1+3/(r:ℝ))
  have hPseudo : ∀ I : Instance, I.computedPseudo r hr p C⊆I.facilities ∧ (I.computedPseudo r hr p C).Nonempty ∧
      (I.computedPseudo r hr p C).card≤I.k+C ∧ cost I (I.computedPseudo r hr p C)≤α*optimum I :=
    fun I => I.computedPseudo_spec r hr p hs.le hs hs1 C hCap
  obtain ⟨δ,a,b,hδ,hsδ,hf,ha,hb⟩ := Reduction.reduction_parameters α (ε/2) hα (by positivity) C hCp
  refine ⟨Reduction.Program.algorithm r hr p C a b δ,
    ⟨(Reduction.Program.ordinaryProgram r hr p C a b δ).comp Binary.BooleanLists.unpackProgram⟩,?_⟩
  intro I
  obtain ⟨hOF,hOn,hOk,hCost⟩ := Reduction.Program.ordinarySet_spec r hr p C a b δ α (ε/2) hCp hδ hsδ
    (by positivity) hf ha hb hPseudo I
  refine ⟨Reduction.Program.ordinarySet r hr p C a b δ I,hOF,hOn,hOk,rfl,hCost.trans ?_⟩
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfactor I.optimum_nonneg
