  A.randomBits.eval (queryBits I ζ).length

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.refinedRecoveryClaim
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
def refinedRecoveryClaim : Prop :=
  ∀ (bound : Polynomial ℕ) (ε L₀ : ℝ) (μ : ℚ),
    0 < ε → 0 < L₀ → 0 < μ → μ ≤ 1/4 → (μ : ℝ) ≤ ε/12 →
    ∃ A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm,
      PolynomialWork A bound ∧
      ∀ I : Input, I.Bounded bound → ∀ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ζ → ζ < 1 →
        (∀ s : Seed A I ζ, I.metric.Feasible (output A I ζ s)) ∧
        (∀ C : Certificate I μ L₀,
          1 - ζ ≤ successProbability A I ζ
            ((1 + 2 / Real.exp 1 + ε) * (I.metric.cost C.centers : ℝ)))

end MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.Certificate
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
structure Certificate (I : Input) (μ : ℚ) (L₀ : ℝ) where
  centers : Finset I.Point
  centers_subset : centers ⊆ I.metric.facilities
  same_card : centers.card = I.anchor.card
  positive_cost : 0 < (I.metric.cost centers : ℝ)
  good : Finset I.Point
  good_subset : good ⊆ centers
  proxy : I.Point → I.Point
  proxy_mem : ∀ i ∈ good, proxy i ∈ I.anchor
  proxy_inj : Set.InjOn proxy (↑good)
  proxy_cost : (∑ i ∈ good, ∑ p ∈ I.cluster centers i,
      (I.metric.distance p (proxy i) : ℝ)) ≤
    (∑ i ∈ good, I.clusterCost centers i) + (μ : ℝ) * (I.metric.cost centers : ℝ)
  few_bad : (((centers \ good).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ L₀ * Real.log (I.size : ℝ)

namespace Certificate
variable {I : Input} {μ : ℚ} {L₀ : ℝ}

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.refined_recovery_conditional
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
theorem refined_recovery_conditional (H : CompanionThresholdInput) : refinedRecoveryClaim := by
  intro bound ε L₀ μ hε _ _ _ _
  obtain ⟨f, ⟨P⟩, hf⟩ := H ε hε
  refine ⟨algorithm P, zero_random_polynomialWork _ rfl bound, ?_⟩
  intro I _ ζ hζ _
  have houtput (s : Seed (algorithm P) I ζ) :
      ∃ S : Finset I.Point, I.metric.Feasible S ∧ output (algorithm P) I ζ s = S ∧
        (I.metric.cost S : ℝ) ≤ (1+2/Real.exp 1+ε)*MetricKMedian.optimum I.asInstance := by
    obtain ⟨S, hSF, hS, hk, hout, hcost⟩ := hf I.asInstance
    refine ⟨S, ⟨hSF, hk, fun _ => hS⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [output, algorithm_run, hout, I.decode_mask S hSF]
    · rwa [I.asInstance_cost] at hcost
  refine ⟨fun s => by obtain ⟨S, hS, he, _⟩ := houtput s; exact he.symm ▸ hS, ?_⟩
  intro C
  have hall (s : Seed (algorithm P) I ζ) :
      (I.metric.cost (output (algorithm P) I ζ s) : ℝ) ≤
        (1+2/Real.exp 1+ε)*(I.metric.cost C.centers : ℝ) := by
    obtain ⟨S, _, he, hc⟩ := houtput s
    rw [he]
    exact hc.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (I.optimum_le_comparison C) (by positivity))
  have hprob : successProbability (algorithm P) I ζ
      ((1+2/Real.exp 1+ε)*(I.metric.cost C.centers : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    classical
    simp only [successProbability, hall, Finset.filter_true, Finset.card_univ,
      Seed, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow,
      Nat.cast_ofNat]
    exact div_self (show (2 : ℝ) ^ seedLength (algorithm P) I ζ ≠ 0 by positivity)
  rw [hprob]
  linarith

end MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Model:49.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.optimum
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Model:49.text:
noncomputable def optimum (I : Instance) : ℝ :=
  if h : (feasibleSets I).Nonempty then
    ((feasibleSets I).image (cost I)).min' (h.image _)
  else 0

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.PolynomialWork
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
def PolynomialWork (A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm) (bound : Polynomial ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d : ℕ,
    ∀ I : Input, I.Bounded bound → ∀ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ζ → ζ < 1 →
      (workBound A I ζ : ℝ) ≤
        c * ((I.size : ℝ) + 1) ^ d * (1 + Real.log (1 / ζ)) ^ d

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.workBound
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
noncomputable def workBound (A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm) (I : Input) (ζ : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  (queryBits I ζ).length + seedLength A I ζ +
    A.computation.time.eval (pairBits
      (queryBits I ζ, List.replicate (seedLength A I ζ) false)).length

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.refined_recovery
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
theorem refined_recovery :
    ∀ (bound : Polynomial ℕ) (ε L₀ : ℝ) (μ : ℚ),
      0 < ε → 0 < L₀ → 0 < μ → μ ≤ 1/4 → (μ : ℝ) ≤ ε/12 →
      ∃ A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm,
        PolynomialWork A bound ∧
        ∀ I : Input, I.Bounded bound → ∀ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ζ → ζ < 1 →
          (∀ s : Seed A I ζ, I.metric.Feasible (output A I ζ s)) ∧
          (∀ C : Certificate I μ L₀,
            1 - ζ ≤ successProbability A I ζ
              ((1 + 2 / Real.exp 1 + ε) * (I.metric.cost C.centers : ℝ))) :=
  refined_recovery_conditional companion_threshold_input

end MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.CompanionThresholdInput
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
def CompanionThresholdInput : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ f : MetricKMedian.Instance → List Bool,
    Nonempty (PolyProgram MetricKMedian.InstanceProgram.encode id f) ∧
    ∀ I, MetricKMedian.Correct ε I (f I)

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.algorithm
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
private noncomputable def algorithm {f : MetricKMedian.Instance → List Bool}
    (P : PolyProgram MetricKMedian.InstanceProgram.encode id f) : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm where
  randomBits := 0
  run p := f (CheckedInput.checked (MetricKMedian.InputParser.raw (first (first (pairBits p)))))
  computation := ((totalProgram P).recode pairBits (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)).stock
  finiteWorkAlphabet := ((totalProgram P).recode pairBits (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)).finite_work

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.algorithm_run
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
private lemma algorithm_run {f : MetricKMedian.Instance → List Bool}
    (P : PolyProgram MetricKMedian.InstanceProgram.encode id f) (I : Input) (ζ : ℝ)
    (s : Seed (algorithm P) I ζ) :
    (algorithm P).run (queryBits I ζ, List.ofFn s) = f I.asInstance := by
  simp only [algorithm, queryBits, first_pair, ← I.asInstance_bits,
    MetricKMedian.InputParser.raw_encoded, CheckedInput.checked_view]

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Model:.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.pairBits
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Model:.text:
def pairBits (p : List Bool × List Bool) : List Bool :=
  p.1.flatMap (fun b => [true, b]) ++ [false] ++ p.2

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.name: OAI.MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery.zero_random_polynomialWork
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedianRecovery.Refine.text:
lemma zero_random_polynomialWork (A : BinaryRandomizedAlgorithm)
    (hA : A.randomBits = 0) (b : Polynomial ℕ) : PolynomialWork A b := by
  let p := metricLengthPolynomial b
  let q := 2*p + 2*Polynomial.X + 2
  let w := Polynomial.X + A.computation.time.comp (2*Polynomial.X+1)
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hpow⟩ := polynomial_power_bound (w.comp q)
  let K : ℝ := 3 + 1/Real.log 2
  have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hK : 0 < K := by dsimp [K]; positivity
  refine ⟨c*K^d, by positivity, d, ?_⟩
  intro I hI ζ hζ hζ1
  let t := I.size + precision ζ + 1
  have hseed : seedLength A I ζ = 0 := by simp [seedLength, hA]
  have hlen : (queryBits I ζ).length ≤ q.eval t := by
    have hM := (metric_length_bound I b hI).trans
      (MetricKMedian.Binary.polynomial_eval_mono p (show I.size ≤ t by dsimp [t]; omega))
    have hn : I.metric.pointCount ≤ I.size := by
      calc
        _ = (I.metric.clients ∪ I.metric.facilities).card := by rw [I.metric.covered]; simp
        _ ≤ I.size := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    simp only [queryBits, BitMachine.pairBits_length, Input.anchorBits,
      List.length_append, List.length_ofFn, List.length_replicate]
    simp only [q, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_ofNat,
      Polynomial.eval_X]
    omega
  have hw : workBound A I ζ ≤ c*t^d := by
    have hb : workBound A I ζ = w.eval (queryBits I ζ).length := by
      simp [workBound, hseed, w, BitMachine.pairBits_length]
    rw [hb]
    exact (MetricKMedian.Binary.polynomial_eval_mono w hlen).trans
      (by simpa only [Polynomial.eval_comp] using hpow t (by dsimp [t]; omega))
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1/ζ) := Real.log_nonneg (by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hζ]
    linarith)
  have hprec : (precision ζ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (1/ζ)/Real.log 2 + 1 := by
    exact (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg hlog hlog2.le)).le
  have ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ K*((I.size : ℝ)+1)*(1+Real.log (1/ζ)) := by
    have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ I.size := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hi : 0 ≤ 1/Real.log 2 := by positivity
    have hprec' : (precision ζ : ℝ)+1 ≤ K*(1+Real.log (1/ζ)) := by
      change (precision ζ : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (1/ζ)*(Real.log 2)⁻¹+1 at hprec
      rw [one_div] at hi
      dsimp only [K]
      rw [one_div]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hi hlog]
    calc
      (t : ℝ) ≤ ((I.size : ℝ)+1)*((precision ζ : ℝ)+1) := by
        dsimp [t]
        push_cast
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hN (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (precision ζ))]
      _ ≤ ((I.size : ℝ)+1)*(K*(1+Real.log (1/ζ))) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hwR : (workBound A I ζ : ℝ) ≤ (c : ℝ)*(t : ℝ)^d := by exact_mod_cast hw
  apply hwR.trans
  calc
    _ ≤ (c : ℝ)*(K*((I.size : ℝ)+1)*(1+Real.log (1/ζ)))^d := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by simp only [mul_pow]; ring

end MetricKMedianRecovery.RefinedRecovery

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Model.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.approximationFactors
OAI.MetricKMedian.FactorCorrect
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Model.text:
def FactorCorrect (α : ℝ) (I : Instance) (output : List Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ S : Finset (Fin I.n), S ⊆ I.facilities ∧ S.Nonempty ∧ S.card ≤ I.k ∧
    output = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin I.n => decide (i ∈ S)) ∧
    cost I S ≤ α * optimum I

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Analy.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.infimum_le_threshold
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Analy.text:
theorem infimum_le_threshold :
    sInf approximationFactors ≤ 1 + 2 / Real.exp 1 := by
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  exact csInf_le approximationFactors_bddBelow (factor_above_threshold ε hε)

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Model.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.Complexity.PNeNP
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Model.text:
def PNeNP : Prop := P ≠ NP

end Complexity

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Model:31.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.encodeInstance
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Model:31.text:
def encodeInstance (I : Instance) : List Bool :=
  encodeNat I.n ++ encodeNat I.k ++
    List.ofFn (fun i : Fin I.n => decide (i ∈ I.clients)) ++
    List.ofFn (fun i : Fin I.n => decide (i ∈ I.facilities)) ++
    (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin I.n =>
      (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin I.n => encodeRat (I.distance i j))).flatten)).flatten

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Model.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.Complexity.FinitePolyTime
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Model.text:
def FinitePolyTime {α β : Type} (ea : α → List Bool) (eb : β → List Bool)
    (f : α → β) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime ea eb f,
    ∀ k : p.tm.K, Finite (p.tm.Γ k)

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Analy.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.approximationFactors_nonempty
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Analy.text:
theorem approximationFactors_nonempty : approximationFactors.Nonempty :=
  ⟨1 + 2 / Real.exp 1 + 1, factor_above_threshold 1 zero_lt_one⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Threshold:25.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.threshold
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Threshold:25.text:
theorem threshold (h : Complexity.PNeNP) :
    sInf approximationFactors=1+2/Real.exp 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm infimum_le_threshold
  exact le_csInf approximationFactors_nonempty (below_threshold_impossible h)
end MetricKMedian

end Inline_PCPThreshold

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Threshold:18.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.below_threshold_impossible
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Threshold:18.text:
theorem below_threshold_impossible (h : Complexity.PNeNP) :
    ∀ α ∈ approximationFactors, 1+2/Real.exp 1≤α := by
  intro α hα
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,L,hL,hno⟩ := Coverage.remaining_projection_obstruction h hα (lt_of_not_ge hn)
  exact hno (Coverage.projection_gap_np_reductions ε hε L hL)

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Analy.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.factor_above_threshold
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Analy.text:
theorem factor_above_threshold (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    1 + 2 / Real.exp 1 + ε ∈ approximationFactors := by
  obtain ⟨algorithm, p, hp, hcorrect⟩ := main_finite_work ε hε
  exact ⟨algorithm, ⟨p, hp⟩, hcorrect⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.PCP.UniformPro.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.Coverage.projection_gap_np_reductions
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.PCP.UniformPro.text:
theorem projection_gap_np_reductions : ProjectionGapNPReductions := by
  intro ε hε L hL
  obtain ⟨verify,p,⟨P,hfinite⟩,hverify⟩ := hL
  let (k : P.tm.K) : Finite (P.tm.Γ k) := hfinite k
  let (k : P.tm.K) : Fintype (P.tm.Γ k) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have he : (0:ℝ)<(ε:ℝ) := Rat.cast_pos.mpr hε
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := ProjectionSeed.repetition_exists (ε:ℝ) he
  refine ⟨SeedProgram.Width n,SeedProgram.LeftSize n,SeedProgram.RightSize n,
    CookProgram.projection P p n,CookProgram.projection_poly P p n,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact CookProgram.projection_complete P p n x ((hverify x).mp hx)
  · intro x hx
    apply CookProgram.projection_sound P p n x _ (ε:ℝ) he.le hn
    intro hc
    exact hx ((hverify x).mpr hc)
end MetricKMedian.Coverage

end Inline_PCPUniformProjection

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Model:12.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.Instance
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Model:12.text:
structure Instance where
  n : ℕ
  distance : Fin n → Fin n → ℚ
  clients : Finset (Fin n)
  facilities : Finset (Fin n)
  k : ℕ
  distance_nonneg : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ distance i j
  distance_eq_zero : ∀ i j, distance i j = 0 ↔ i = j
  distance_symm : ∀ i j, distance i j = distance j i
  distance_triangle : ∀ i j h, distance i h ≤ distance i j + distance j h
  k_pos : 1 ≤ k
  k_le : k ≤ facilities.card

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Analy.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.approximationFactors_bddBelow
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Analy.text:
theorem approximationFactors_bddBelow : BddBelow approximationFactors :=
  ⟨1, fun _ h => factor_ge_one h⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Proje.name: OAI.MetricKMedian.Coverage.remaining_projection_obstruction
OAI.Combinatorics.KMedian.Hardness.Proje.text:
theorem remaining_projection_obstruction (hPNP : PNeNP) {α : ℝ}
    (hα : α ∈ approximationFactors) (hsmall : α < 1+2/Real.exp 1) :
    ∃ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ L : Language, L ∈ NP ∧ ¬ ProjectionReduction ε L := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,L,hL,hno⟩ := remaining_gap_obstruction hPNP hα hsmall
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := partition_parameters_exist hδ
  exact ⟨P.ε,P.ε_pos,L,hL,fun h => hno (reduction_from_projections P h)⟩

end MetricKMedian.Coverage

end Inline_PCPInherited

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.KServer.Main:133.name: OAI.KServer.fully_quantified_main
OAI.Combinatorics.KServer.Main:133.text:
theorem fully_quantified_main : MainStatement.{u}:=by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩:=finite_law_suffices_for_main finite_law.{u}
  refine ⟨max C 1,lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1) (le_max_right C 1),?_⟩
  intro k hk X mX hX s
  have : NeZero k:=⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨A,B,hB,hzero,hcost⟩:=hC k hk X mX hX s
  refine ⟨A,B,hB,hzero,?_⟩
  intro σ
  have hnp:0≤(Real.log ((k:ℝ)+1))^2*optimalCost s σ:=
    mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (optimalCost_nonneg s σ)
  have hm:=mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left C 1) hnp
  have hh:=hcost σ
  nlinarith only [hh,hm]
end KServer

end


namespace KServer
universe u

OAI.Combinatorics.KServer.Main:123.name: OAI.KServer.MainStatement
OAI.Combinatorics.KServer.Main:123.text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ), 2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (X : Type u) (_ : MetricSpace X),
      (∃ e : Fin (k + 1) → X, Function.Injective e) →
      ∀ s : Configuration k X,
        ∃ A : Policy k X, ∃ B : ℝ,
          0 ≤ B ∧ (Function.Injective s → B = 0) ∧
          ∀ σ : List X,
            expectedCost A s σ ≤ C * (Real.log (k + 1)) ^ 2 * optimalCost s σ + B

OAI.Combinatorics.KServer.Main:155.name: OAI.KServer.main_theorem
OAI.Combinatorics.KServer.Main:155.text:
theorem main_theorem : MainStatement.{u} := fully_quantified_main
end KServer

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.middleCoboundary_apply
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.text:
@[simp] lemma middleCoboundary_apply {n : ℕ} (f : Cochain M (n+1)) (j : Fin (n+1))
    (v : Fin (n+2) → M) : middleCoboundary f j v = f (mergeInputs v j) := by
  change f (j.insertNth (v j.castSucc * v (j.castSucc.succAbove j))
    (fun i => v (j.castSucc.succAbove (j.succAbove i)))) = _
  congr 1
  apply (Fin.insertNth_eq_iff).mpr
  constructor
  · simp [mergeInputs, Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc]
  · funext i
    change v (j.castSucc.succAbove (j.succAbove i)) = mergeInputs v j (j.succAbove i)
    by_cases h : i.castSucc < j
    · rw [Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h]
      have h' : i.castSucc.castSucc < j.castSucc := by simpa using h
      rw [Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h']
      simp [mergeInputs, h]
    · have hj : j ≤ i.castSucc := le_of_not_gt h
      rw [Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ hj]
      have h' : j.castSucc ≤ i.succ.castSucc := by
        simp only [Fin.le_def, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at *
        omega
      rw [Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ h']
      have hh : ¬i.succ < j := by
        simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_succ, Fin.le_def, Fin.val_castSucc] at *
        omega
      have hn : i.succ ≠ j := by
        intro he; have he' := congrArg Fin.val he
        simp only [Fin.val_succ] at he'
        have := j.isLt
        simp only [Fin.le_def, Fin.val_castSucc] at hj
        omega
      simp [mergeInputs, hh, hn]

OAI.Analysis.TracialCohomology.Vanishing.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.differential_eq_zero_iff
OAI.Analysis.TracialCohomology.Vanishing.text:
lemma differential_eq_zero_iff {M : Type*} [CStarAlgebra M] {n : ℕ}
    (f : Cochain M n) :
    differential f = 0 ↔ ∀ x, differentialValue f x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    simpa only [differential_apply, zero_apply] using
      congrArg (fun F : Cochain M (n+1) => F x) h
  · intro h
    ext x
    simpa only [differential_apply, zero_apply] using h x

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.rightCoboundary
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.text:
def rightCoboundary {n : ℕ} (f : Cochain M n) : Cochain M (n+1) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M).compContinuousMultilinearMap f).uncurryRight

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.Cochains:.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.mergeInputs
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.Cochains:.text:
def mergeInputs {M : Type*} [Mul M] {n : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → M) (j : Fin n) : Fin n → M :=
  fun i => if i < j then v i.castSucc
    else if i = j then v i.castSucc * v i.succ else v i.succ

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.MainResul.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.KadisonRingrose.main_result
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.MainResul.text:
theorem main_result
    {M : Type u} [CStarAlgebra M] [PartialOrder M] [StarOrderedRing M] [WStarAlgebra M]
    (n : ℕ) (f : Cochain M (n + 2))
    (hf : ∀ x : Fin (n + 3) → M, differentialValue f x = 0) :
    ∃ g : Cochain M (n + 1), ∀ x : Fin (n + 2) → M,
      differentialValue g x = f x := by
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hXS, hXC, ⟨e⟩⟩ := WStarAlgebra.exists_predual (M := M)
  let := hX
  let := hXS
  let := hXC
  have hf' : differential f = 0 := by
    ext x
    simpa only [differential_apply, zero_apply] using hf x
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := bounded_primitive e f hf'
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have h := congrArg (fun h : Cochain M (n + 2) => h x) hg
  simpa only [differential_apply] using h

end BoundedHochschild.KadisonRingrose

end

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.ProperlyI.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.KadisonRingrose.properlyInfiniteVanishingInput
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.ProperlyI.text:
theorem properlyInfiniteVanishingInput : ProperlyInfiniteVanishingInput.{u} := by
  intro N hN hPO hSO hW hno n f hf
  let := hW
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hYS, hYC, ⟨e⟩⟩ := WStarAlgebra.exists_predual (M := N)
  let := hY
  let := hYS
  let := hYC
  exact properlyInfinite_primitive e hno f hf

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.leftCoboundary_apply
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.text:
@[simp] lemma leftCoboundary_apply {n : ℕ} (f : Cochain M n) (v : Fin (n+1) → M) :
    leftCoboundary f v = v 0 * f (fun i => v i.succ) := rfl

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.differential
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.text:
def differential : {n : ℕ} → Cochain M n → Cochain M (n+1)
  | 0, f => leftCoboundary f - rightCoboundary f
  | n+1, f => leftCoboundary f + ∑ j : Fin (n+1), ((-1:ℂ)^(j.val+1)) • middleCoboundary f j +
      ((-1:ℂ)^(n+1+1)) • rightCoboundary f

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.differential_apply
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.text:
@[simp] theorem differential_apply {n : ℕ} (f : Cochain M n) (v : Fin (n+1) → M) :
    differential f v = differentialValue f v := by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [differential, differentialValue, sub_eq_add_neg]
  | succ n => simp only [differential, differentialValue, add_apply, sum_apply, smul_apply,
      leftCoboundary_apply, rightCoboundary_apply, middleCoboundary_apply]

end BoundedHochschild

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.Cochains:.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.differentialValue
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.Cochains:.text:
noncomputable def differentialValue {M : Type*} [NormedRing M] [NormedAlgebra ℂ M]
    {n : ℕ} (f : Cochain M n) (v : Fin (n + 1) → M) : M :=
  v 0 * f (fun i => v i.succ) +
    ∑ j : Fin n, ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (j.val + 1)) • f (mergeInputs v j) +
    ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (n + 1)) • (f (fun i => v i.castSucc) * v (Fin.last n))

OAI.BoundedHochschild.rightCoboundary_apply

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.Main:79.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.KadisonRingrose.bounded_primitive
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.Main:79.text:
theorem bounded_primitive
    {M X : Type u} [CStarAlgebra M] [PartialOrder M] [StarOrderedRing M]
    [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X] [CompleteSpace X]
    (e : StrongDual ℂ X ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] M) {n : ℕ} (f : Cochain M (n + 2))
    (hf : differential f = 0) :
    ∃ g : Cochain M (n + 1), differential g = f := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := primitive_of_properlyInfinite_input e properlyInfiniteVanishingInput f
    ((differential_eq_zero_iff f).mp hf)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simpa only [differential_apply] using hg x

OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.name: OAI.BoundedHochschild.middleCoboundary
OAI.Analysis.BoundedHochschild.CentralHo.text:
def middleCoboundary {n : ℕ} (f : Cochain M (n+1)) (j : Fin (n+1)) : Cochain M (n+2) :=
  (((ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryMidEquiv ℂ (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => M) M j).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap).comp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M M (Cochain M n) (f.curryMid j)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M))).uncurryMid j.castSucc

theorem hyperreflexivity_of_spectralSteps_and_arveson (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)

OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Represent.name: OAI.KadisonSimilarity.exists_publishedSeparableModel
OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Represent.text:
theorem exists_publishedSeparableModel (P : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    Nonempty (PublishedSeparableModel P) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hAclosed, hAsep, hAcomm, _hA, hcentral⟩ := exists_separable_central_source P
  let : IsClosed (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := hAclosed
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace A := hAsep
  let : IsMulCommutative A := hAcomm
  let π := A.subtype
  let D := cyclicDecompositionData π.range
  let : MeasurableSpace (WeakDual.characterSpace ℂ A) := commonCyclicMeasurable
  let : BorelSpace (WeakDual.characterSpace ℂ A) := commonCyclicBorel
  let := commonCyclicCountable π D
  have hcentral' : starSubalgebraCommutant π.range = (vonNeumannCenter P).commutant := by
    simpa only [π, subtype_star_range] using hcentral
  obtain ⟨B, C, hBclosed, hCclosed, hBsep, hCsep, hB, hC, hBgen, _hCgen, hSgen⟩ :=
    exists_separable_joint_cstar_source P
  let : IsClosed (B : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := hBclosed
  let : IsClosed (C : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := hCclosed
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace B := hBsep
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace C := hCsep
  have hSgen' : representationVonNeumannAlgebra (jointCStarSource B C).subtype =
      starSubalgebraCommutant π.range := by
    rw [representationVonNeumannAlgebra, subtype_star_range, hSgen, hcentral']
  have hcomm (b : jointCStarSource B C) (a : A) :
      (b : H →L[ℂ] H) * π a = π a * b := by
    have hb : (b : H →L[ℂ] H) ∈ starSubalgebraCommutant π.range := by
      rw [← hSgen']
      exact mem_representationVonNeumannAlgebra (jointCStarSource B C).subtype b
    exact commutant_commutes_representation π ⟨b.val, hb⟩ a
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hnull, ρ, hρ⟩ := exists_conull_common_representations π D
    (jointCStarSource B C).subtype hcomm
  let φ := StarSubalgebra.inclusion (le_jointCStarSource_left B C)
  let ρB := fun x => unitizationRestrict φ (ρ x)
  have hρB (b : B) (f : CommonCyclicHilbert π D) :
      ∀ᵐ x : s ∂Measure.comap ((↑) : s → WeakDual.characterSpace ℂ A)
        (cyclicCommonBaseMeasure π D),
        isometricExtension (cyclicCommonEmbedding π D) (b : H →L[ℂ] H) f x =
          ρB x (Unitization.inr b) (f x) := by
    have h := hρ (φ b) f
    change ∀ᵐ x : s ∂Measure.comap ((↑) : s → WeakDual.characterSpace ℂ A)
      (cyclicCommonBaseMeasure π D),
      isometricExtension (cyclicCommonEmbedding π D) (b : H →L[ℂ] H) f x =
        ρ x (Unitization.inr (φ b)) (f x) at h
    simpa only [ρB, unitizationRestrict_inr] using h
  have hBgen' : representationVonNeumannAlgebra B.subtype = P := by
    rw [representationVonNeumannAlgebra, subtype_star_range]
    exact hBgen
  let DC := commonProjectionCentralData π D P B hB hBgen' hcentral' s hs hnull ρB hρB
  have hBC (b : B) (c : C) :
      (b : H →L[ℂ] H) * (c : H →L[ℂ] H) =
        (c : H →L[ℂ] H) * (b : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    (VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp (hC c.property)) b (hB b.property)
  have hfactor := ae_common_fiber_scalar_center π D B C hBC hSgen' s hs hnull ρ hρ
  exact ⟨publishedSeparableModel_of_central_factors P (cyclicCommonBaseMeasure π D)
    (conullProjectionFiber s ρB) DC hfactor⟩

OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Similarit.name: OAI.KadisonSimilarity.similarity_of_uniformCommutator
OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Similarit.text:
theorem similarity_of_uniformCommutator {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (estimate : UniformCommutatorEstimate.{v} C) (π : BoundedUnitalHom A H) :
    SimilarToStar A H π := by
  let f : A →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := ⟨π.1.toLinearMap, π.2⟩
  have hb : ∀ a, ‖π.1 a‖ ≤ (‖f‖ + 1) * ‖a‖ := by
    intro a
    exact (f.le_opNorm a).trans (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg a])
  obtain ⟨S, _, hS⟩ := paulsenSimilarityInput π (Real.exp (C * ((‖f‖ + 1) + 1)))
    (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
    (completeBound_of_uniformCommutator hC estimate π (by positivity) hb)
  exact ⟨S, hS⟩

end KadisonSimilarity

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Similarit.name: OAI.KadisonSimilarity.paulsenSimilarityInput
OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Similarit.text:
theorem paulsenSimilarityInput (π : BoundedUnitalHom A H) : PaulsenSimilarityInput π := by
  intro C hC hπ
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial H with hH | hH
  · let := hH
    refine ⟨1, ?_, fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
    have hnorm : ‖(1 : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ = 0 := by
      rw [Subsingleton.elim (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) 0, norm_zero]
    simpa only [inv_one, Units.val_one, hnorm, zero_mul] using hC
  · let := hH
    have h01 : (0 : A) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      have he := congrArg π.1 h
      have hz : (0 : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 := by
        simpa only [map_zero, map_one] using he
      exact zero_ne_one hz
    let : Nontrivial A := ⟨⟨0, 1, h01⟩⟩
    have hm : (1 : CStarMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) A).map π.1.toLinearMap = 1 := by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i
      fin_cases j
      simp
    have hc := completeBound_entrywise π hπ 1 1
    rw [hm, CStarRing.norm_one, CStarRing.norm_one, mul_one] at hc
    have hCpos : 0 < C := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hc
    obtain ⟨F⟩ := BoundedHochschild.KadisonRingrose.factorization_of_complete_bound
      π.1.toLinearMap hCpos (completeBound_entrywise π hπ)
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hs⟩ := quantitative_similarity_of_factorization
      π F.representation F.rightMap F.leftMap.adjoint (fun a => (F.factorization a).symm)
    refine ⟨S, hS.trans ?_, hs⟩
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.norm_map, mul_comm] using F.bound

end KadisonSimilarity

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Represent.name: OAI.KadisonSimilarity.spectralStepApproximation
OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Represent.text:
theorem spectralStepApproximation (P : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : SpectralStepApproximation P := by
  intro A hAP hA δ hδ
  have hself : IsSelfAdjoint A := hA
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ((binarySpectralRadius_tendsto_zero A).eventually
    (gt_mem_nhds hδ)).exists
  refine ⟨n, -(∑ i : Fin n, binarySpectralRadius A i / 2),
    (fun i : Fin n => binarySpectralRadius A i),
    (fun i : Fin n => rangeSupport (binarySpectralResidual A i)⁺), ?_,
    sum_binarySpectralRadius_le A n, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact ⟨positive_rangeSupport_mem P _ (binarySpectralResidual_mem P A hAP i),
      (rangeSupport_isStarProjection _).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq,
      (rangeSupport_isStarProjection _).isIdempotentElem.eq⟩
  · rw [spectralStep_binary_eq_sum, ← binarySpectralResidual_eq_sub_sum]
    exact (binarySpectralResidual_norm_le A hself n).trans hn.le

end KadisonSimilarity

end

OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.OperatorA.name: OAI.KadisonSimilarity.SimilarToStar
OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.OperatorA.text:
def SimilarToStar (π : BoundedUnitalHom A H) : Prop :=

    (S : H →L[ℂ] H) * π.1 (star a) * (↑S⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      star ((S : H →L[ℂ] H) * π.1 a * (↑S⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H))

OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Similarit.name: OAI.KadisonSimilarity.arvesonDistanceFormula
OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Similarit.text:
theorem arvesonDistanceFormula (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ArvesonDistanceFormula M T := by
  let b := completeCommutatorNorm M.commutant T
  have hb : b ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    (completeCommutatorNorm_le_twice_distance M T)
  let r := b.toReal
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have happrox (n : ℕ) : 2 * Metric.infDist T (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ≤
      r + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    apply twice_distance_le_of_complete_bound M T (by positivity)
    change b ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (r + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
    calc
      b = ENNReal.ofReal r := (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hb).symm
      _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity))
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 r) := by
    have hc : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => r) atTop (𝓝 r) := tendsto_const_nhds
    have h := hc.add
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
        (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1))
    simpa only [add_zero] using h
  have hd : 2 * Metric.infDist T (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ≤ r :=
    ge_of_tendsto hlim (Eventually.of_forall happrox)
  apply (arvesonDistanceFormula_iff_reverse_bound M T).mpr
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hd
    _ = b := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hb

end KadisonSimilarity

end

OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Similarit.name: OAI.KadisonSimilarity.completeBound_of_uniformCommutator
OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Similarit.text:
theorem completeBound_of_uniformCommutator {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (estimate : UniformCommutatorEstimate.{v} C) (π : BoundedUnitalHom A H)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hπ : ∀ a, ‖π.1 a‖ ≤ M * ‖a‖) :
    CompleteBound π.1 (Real.exp (C * (M + 1))) := by
  intro n X
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
  intro ξ
  by_cases hn : 0 < n
  · let E := finiteOrbitSubspace π (fun i => ξ i)
    let ρ := restrictBoundedHom π E (finiteOrbitSubspace_invariant π (fun i => ξ i))
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := finiteOrbitSubspace_similar π hn (fun i => ξ i)
    have hcb : IsCompletelyBounded ρ.1 :=
      ⟨_, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), completeBound_of_similarity ρ S hS⟩
    have hb := kirchberg_uniform_completeBound hC estimate ρ hM
      (restrictBoundedHom_bound π E (finiteOrbitSubspace_invariant π (fun i => ξ i))
        (le_of_lt hM) hπ) hcb n X
    let η : HilbertCopies E n := WithLp.toLp 2 (finiteOrbitGenerators π (fun i => ξ i))
    have hη : ‖η‖ = ‖ξ‖ := by
      have he : ‖η‖ ^ 2 = ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp only [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, η, finiteOrbitGenerators]
        rfl
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg η, norm_nonneg ξ]
    have he (i : Fin n) :
        ((matrixOperator (X.map ρ.1) η i : E) : H) =
          matrixOperator (X.map π.1) ξ i := by
      simp [matrixOperator_apply, ρ, η, finiteOrbitGenerators, restrictBoundedHom_apply]
    have hnorm : ‖matrixOperator (X.map ρ.1) η‖ = ‖matrixOperator (X.map π.1) ξ‖ := by
      have hs : ‖matrixOperator (X.map ρ.1) η‖ ^ 2 =
          ‖matrixOperator (X.map π.1) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp only [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [← he i]
        rfl
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (matrixOperator (X.map ρ.1) η),
        norm_nonneg (matrixOperator (X.map π.1) ξ)]
    calc
      ‖matrixOperator (X.map π.1) ξ‖ = ‖matrixOperator (X.map ρ.1) η‖ := hnorm.symm
      _ ≤ ‖matrixOperator (X.map ρ.1)‖ * ‖η‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ (Real.exp (C * (M + 1)) * ‖CStarMatrix.ofMatrix X‖) * ‖ξ‖ := by
        rw [hη]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (norm_nonneg _)
  · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
    subst n
    have hξ : ξ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp [hξ]

OAI.Geometry.KahlerSplitting.ProductRetr.name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.exists_productRetracts
OAI.Geometry.KahlerSplitting.ProductRetr.text:
lemma exists_productRetracts [CompactSpace X.Carrier] (g : KahlerMetric X)
    (h₁ : Integrable S.projection) (h₂ : Integrable (complementaryProjection S))
    (π : OrdinaryUniversalCover X Z) (o : Z.Carrier) :
    Nonempty (ProductRetracts π o h₁ h₂) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q⟩ := FirstGerm.exists_globalProjection g h₁ h₂ π o
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := FirstGerm.exists_globalProjection g h₂ (integrable_swap_complement h₁) π o
  have hc (x : RetractChart.Fixed Q.toFun) := Q.exists_retractChart g x.property
  have hd (x : RetractChart.Fixed R.toFun) := R.exists_retractChart g x.property
  choose c hc₁ hc₂ using hc
  choose d hd₁ hd₂ using hd
  exact ⟨⟨Q,R,c,hc₁,d,hd₁⟩⟩

namespace ProductRetracts
variable (P : ProductRetracts π o h₁ h₂)

OAI.Geometry.KahlerSplitting.Main:14.name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.main
OAI.Geometry.KahlerSplitting.Main:14.text:
theorem main (X : ComplexManifold.{u} n) [CompactSpace X.Carrier]
    [ConnectedSpace X.Carrier] (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hr₂ : 0 < r₂)
    (g : KahlerMetric X) (S : HolomorphicSplitting X r₁ r₂)
    (h₁ : Integrable S.projection) (h₂ : Integrable (complementaryProjection S))
    (Z : ComplexManifold.{v} n) (π : OrdinaryUniversalCover X Z) :
    ∃ (Y₁ : ComplexManifold.{v} r₁) (Y₂ : ComplexManifold.{v} r₂),
      ConnectedSpace Y₁.Carrier ∧ ConnectedSpace Y₂.Carrier ∧
      SimplyConnectedSpace Y₁.Carrier ∧ SimplyConnectedSpace Y₂.Carrier ∧
      CompatibleProduct S π Y₁ Y₂ := by
  have _ := hn
  have _ := hr₁
  have _ := hr₂
  let := π.connected
  let o : Z.Carrier := Classical.choice inferInstance
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := exists_productRetracts g h₁ h₂ π o
  let := P.simplyConnected_first g
  let := P.simplyConnected_second g
  refine ⟨P.Y₁,P.Y₂,inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Φ,hΦ,hd,hdi⟩ := P.pair_biholomorph g
  refine ⟨Φ,hd,hdi,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [hΦ]
    exact P.first_tangent g
  · rw [hΦ]
    exact P.second_tangent g

end UniversalCoverSplitting
end
end

structure OneQuasitrace (A : Type*) [CStarAlgebra A] where
  toFun : A → ℂ
  square_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ toFun (star x * x)
  square_swap : ∀ x, toFun (star x * x) = toFun (x * star x)
  real_imag : ∀ h k, IsSelfAdjoint h → IsSelfAdjoint k →
    toFun (h + Complex.I • k) = toFun h + Complex.I * toFun k
  abelian_linear : ∀ S : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A,
    IsClosed (S : Set A) → (∀ x y : S, x * y = y * x) →
    ∃ f : S →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ, ∀ x : S, f x = toFun x

  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := matrixMap_surjective (quotientHom d) (quotientHom_surjective d) n v

  have hzero' := (matrixMap_quotient_eq_zero d _).2 hnull'

OAI.Analysis.Quasitrace.Infiniteness:21.text:
theorem not_properlyInfinite (τ : OneQuasitrace A) (hτ : τ.Normalized) :
    ¬ ProperlyInfinite A := by
  rintro ⟨s,t,hs,ht,hst⟩
  change τ 1 = 1 at hτ
  let p := s * star s
  let q := t * star t
  have hp : IsSelfAdjoint p := IsSelfAdjoint.mul_star_self s
  have hq : IsSelfAdjoint q := IsSelfAdjoint.mul_star_self t
  have hpp : p*p = p := by
    dsimp [p]
    calc
      (s*star s)*(s*star s) = s*(star s*s)*star s := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = s*star s := by rw [hs]; simp
  have hqq : q*q = q := by
    dsimp [q]
    calc
      (t*star t)*(t*star t) = t*(star t*t)*star t := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = t*star t := by rw [ht]; simp
  have hpq : p*q = 0 := by
    dsimp [p,q]
    calc
      (s*star s)*(t*star t) = s*(star s*t)*star t := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hst]; simp
  have hqp : q*p = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg star hpq
    simpa only [star_mul, hp.star_eq, hq.star_eq, star_zero] using h
  have hcomm : Commute p q := hpq.trans hqp.symm
  have hpqSq : (p+q)*(p+q) = p+q := by
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, hpp, hqq, hpq, hqp, add_zero, zero_add]
  have he : star (1-(p+q))*(1-(p+q)) = 1-(p+q) := by
    rw [(IsSelfAdjoint.one A |>.sub (hp.add hq)).star_eq]
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, one_mul, mul_one, hpqSq, sub_self, sub_zero]
  have hle : p+q ≤ 1 := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mp
    rw [← he]
    exact star_mul_self_nonneg _
  have hvp : τ p = 1 := by
    have h := τ.square_swap s
    simpa only [hs, hτ] using h.symm
  have hvq : τ q = 1 := by
    have h := τ.square_swap t
    simpa only [ht, hτ] using h.symm
  have hv : τ (p+q) = 2 := by rw [τ.map_add hp hq hcomm, hvp, hvq]; norm_num
  have h := τ.scalar_upper_bound 1
    (add_nonneg (mul_star_self_nonneg s) (mul_star_self_nonneg t))
    (by simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one, one_smul] using hle)
  rw [hv, hτ] at h
  norm_num at h

  ∃ (B : Type) (instB : CStarAlgebra B),

lemma unit_syllables_every (w : FreeProd A) :

  obtain ⟨g,l,hl,rfl⟩ := normalized_every w

    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact Or.inr rfl

OAI.GroupTheory.Kervaire.WordNormalizati.name: OAI.KervaireRibbon.circle_formPerm
OAI.GroupTheory.Kervaire.WordNormalizati.text:
lemma circle_formPerm (i : I) (l : List I) (hn : (i::l).Nodup) :
    Circle (i::l).formPerm i l := by
  change ((i::l)++[i]).IsChain (fun x y ↦ (i::l).formPerm x=y)
  rw [List.isChain_iff_getElem]
  intro n hn'
  have hh : n < (i::l).length := by simp only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton] at hn'; omega
  rw [List.getElem_append_left hh]
  by_cases hs : n+1 < (i::l).length
  · rw [List.getElem_append_left hs]
    exact List.formPerm_apply_lt_getElem _ hn n hs
  · have he : n = l.length := by simp only [List.length_cons] at hh hs; omega
    subst n
    simp only [List.getElem_append_right (by simp : (i::l).length ≤ l.length+1),
      List.length_cons,Nat.sub_self,List.getElem_cons_zero]
    exact List.formPerm_apply_getElem_length i l

OAI.GroupTheory.Kervaire.Main:21.name: OAI.KervaireRibbon.relator_normalClosure_coefficient_eq_one
OAI.GroupTheory.Kervaire.Main:21.text:
lemma relator_normalClosure_coefficient_eq_one (ρ : Perm I) (hρ : ∀ i j, ρ.SameCycle i j)
    (a : I → A) (s : I → ℤ) (hs : ∀ i, s i=1 ∨ s i = -1)
    (hsum : (∑ i, s i)=1 ∨ (∑ i, s i) = -1) (i : I) (l : List I)
    (hc : Circle ρ i l) (hn : (i::l).Nodup) (hcover : ∀ j, j ∈ i::l)
    (g : A) (hg : Coprod.inl g ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure ({dartEval s a (i::l)} : Set (FreeProd A))) :
    g=1 := by
  have hle : Subgroup.normalClosure ({dartEval s a (i::l)} : Set (FreeProd A)) ≤ realizedSubgroup ρ a s := by
    apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    intro w hw
    have he : w = dartEval s a (i::l) := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hw
    subst w
    exact relator_ribbon_realized ρ hρ a s hs i l hc hn hcover
  exact (hle hg).coefficient_eq_one hρ hs hsum
end KervaireRibbon

OAI.GroupTheory.Kervaire.Main:43.name: OAI.Kervaire.normalClosure_coefficient_eq_one
OAI.GroupTheory.Kervaire.Main:43.text:
lemma normalClosure_coefficient_eq_one {A : Type*} [Group A] (w : WordGroup A)
    (hw : Unimodular w) (g : A) (hg : Coprod.inl g ∈ relatorClosure w) : g=1 := by
  obtain ⟨l,hlen,hunit,heval⟩ := unit_syllables_every w
  let I := Fin l.length
  let s : I → ℤ := fun i ↦ (l.get i).1
  let a : I → A := fun i ↦ (l.get i).2
  let e : List I := List.finRange l.length
  have hne : e ≠ [] := by
    intro he
    have hpos : 0 < l.length := by omega
    have hm : (⟨0,hpos⟩ : I) ∈ e := List.mem_finRange _
    rw [he] at hm
    exact List.not_mem_nil hm
  obtain ⟨i,is,he⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hne
  have : Nonempty I := ⟨i⟩
  let ρ : Perm I := e.formPerm
  have hn : (i::is).Nodup := by rw [← he]; exact List.nodup_finRange _
  have hcover : ∀ j : I, j ∈ i::is := by intro j; rw [← he]; exact List.mem_finRange j
  have hc : Circle ρ i is := by change Circle e.formPerm i is; rw [he]; exact circle_formPerm i is hn
  have hρ : ∀ j k : I, ρ.SameCycle j k := by
    change ∀ j k, e.formPerm.SameCycle j k
    rw [he]
    exact formPerm_sameCycle_all i is hn hcover
  have hs : ∀ j : I, s j=1 ∨ s j = -1 := fun j ↦ hunit _ (List.get_mem l j)
  have heval' : dartEval s a (i::is) = w := by
    rw [← he]
    change (List.map (fun j : I ↦ Coprod.inr (ofAdd (l.get j).1)*Coprod.inl (l.get j).2) e).prod = w
    change (List.map ((fun x : ℤ×A ↦ Coprod.inr (ofAdd x.1)*Coprod.inl x.2) ∘ l.get) e).prod = w
    rw [← List.map_map (f := l.get) (g := fun x : ℤ×A ↦ Coprod.inr (ofAdd x.1)*Coprod.inl x.2)]
    rw [← List.ofFn_eq_map,List.ofFn_get]
    exact heval
  have hsumEq : (∑ i : I, s i) = exponentSum w := by
    rw [← List.sum_ofFn]
    change (List.ofFn (Prod.fst ∘ l.get)).sum = _
    rw [← List.map_ofFn,List.ofFn_get]
    exact (syllableEval_exponent l).symm.trans (congrArg (fun z : FreeProd A ↦ toAdd (Coprod.snd z)) heval)
  have hsum : (∑ i : I, s i)=1 ∨ (∑ i : I, s i) = -1 := by rw [hsumEq]; exact hw
  apply relator_normalClosure_coefficient_eq_one ρ hρ a s hs hsum i is hc hn hcover g
  rw [heval']
  exact hg

universe u

lemma polishProbabilityLaws (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] : PolishProbabilityLaws X := by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with
  | inl hX => exact ⟨compact_probability_polish X, compact_probability_borel X⟩
  | inr hX =>
    let : MetricSpace X := metrizableSpaceMetric X
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Metric.PiNatEmbed.exists_embedding_to_hilbert_cube (X := X)
    have hfm : MeasurableEmbedding f := hf.continuous.measurableEmbedding hf.injective
    let : BorelSpace (ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → unitInterval)) := compact_probability_borel _
    let : PolishSpace (ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → unitInterval)) := compact_probability_polish _
    have hF : IsEmbedding (fun μ : ProbabilityMeasure X => μ.map f) :=
      isEmbedding_probability_map hf hfm
    have hr : IsGδ (range (fun μ : ProbabilityMeasure X => μ.map f)) := by
      rw [range_probability_map hfm]
      exact isGDelta_supported_probabilities (isGDelta_range_embedding hf)
    let : PolishSpace (range (fun μ : ProbabilityMeasure X => μ.map f)) :=
      polishSpace_of_isGDelta hr
    have hp : PolishSpace (ProbabilityMeasure X) := hF.toHomeomorph.isClosedEmbedding.polishSpace
    refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
    have hlo : (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ProbabilityMeasure X)) ≤
        borel (ProbabilityMeasure X) := by
      have h : @Measurable (ProbabilityMeasure X) (Measure X)
          (borel (ProbabilityMeasure X)) inferInstance (fun μ => (μ : Measure X)) := by
        let : MeasurableSpace (ProbabilityMeasure X) := borel (ProbabilityMeasure X)
        let : BorelSpace (ProbabilityMeasure X) := ⟨rfl⟩
        exact measurable_measure_of_continuous_probability continuous_id
      exact h.comap_le
    have hup : borel (ProbabilityMeasure X) ≤
        (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ProbabilityMeasure X)) := by
      rw [hF.eq_induced, borel_comap, ← BorelSpace.measurable_eq]
      exact (measurable_probability_map hfm.measurable).comap_le
    exact ⟨le_antisymm hlo hup⟩

end CircleDomainRigidity

  intro μ R hR hfull
  have ha : AnalyticSet R := hR.analyticSet

  rcases ha with hempty | ⟨q,hq,hqR⟩
  · obtain ⟨α,hα⟩ := hfull (ContinuousMap.const PathTime OnePoint.infty)
    rw [hempty] at hα

  · let g : (ℕ → ℕ) → C(PathTime, Sphere) := fun b => (q b).1
    have hsurj : Surjective g := by
      intro γ
      obtain ⟨α,hα⟩ := hfull γ

      obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hα

    obtain ⟨b,hb,hinv⟩ := exists_nullMeasurable_baire_rightInverse

    refine ⟨fun γ => (q (b γ)).2,hq.snd.measurable.comp_nullMeasurable hb,?_⟩
    intro γ
    have hmem : q (b γ) ∈ R := hqR ▸ mem_range_self (b γ)
    have he : q (b γ) = (γ,(q (b γ)).2) := Prod.ext (hinv γ) rfl

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Topology.Cros.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitDiskCrosscutSeparation
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Topology.Cros.text:
theorem unitDiskCrosscutSeparation (hsch : PlanarSchoenflies) :
    UnitDiskCrosscutSeparation := by
  intro p hi ha hb hp
  have hb0 : p 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h,norm_zero] at hb
    exact zero_ne_one hb
  let R := Homeomorph.mulLeft₀ (p 1) hb0
  let q : Path ((p 1)⁻¹ * p 0) 1 := {
    toFun := fun t => (p 1)⁻¹ * p t
    continuous_toFun := continuous_const.mul p.continuous
    source' := rfl
    target' := inv_mul_cancel₀ hb0 }
  have hqp (t : PathTime) : R (q t) = p t := by
    change p 1 * ((p 1)⁻¹ * p t) = p t
    rw [← mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ hb0,one_mul]
  have hqnorm (t : PathTime) : ‖q t‖ = ‖p t‖ := by
    change ‖(p 1)⁻¹ * p t‖ = ‖p t‖
    rw [norm_mul,norm_inv,hb,inv_one,one_mul]
  have hqa : ‖(p 1)⁻¹ * p 0‖ = 1 := (hqnorm 0).trans ha
  have hqa1 : (p 1)⁻¹ * p 0 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have he : p 0 = p 1 := by
      rw [← hqp 0]
      change p 1 * ((p 1)⁻¹ * p 0) = p 1
      rw [h,mul_one]
    have hh : (0 : PathTime) = 1 := hi he
    exact zero_ne_one (congrArg (fun t : PathTime => (t : ℝ)) hh)
  have hqi : Injective q := fun s t he => hi (by rw [← hqp s,← hqp t,he])
  have hqpint : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : PathTime) 1, ‖q t‖ < 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hqnorm]
    exact hp t ht
  obtain ⟨U,V,hU,hV,hUc,hVc,hd,hu,hfu,hfv⟩ :=
    disk_crosscut_sides_at_one hsch q hqi hqpint hqa hqa1
  have hRnorm (z : ℂ) : ‖R z‖ = ‖z‖ := by
    change ‖p 1 * z‖ = ‖z‖
    rw [norm_mul,hb,one_mul]
  have hRb : R '' ball (0 : ℂ) 1 = ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩
      simpa only [mem_ball_zero_iff,hRnorm] using hw
    · intro hz
      refine ⟨R.symm z,?_,R.apply_symm_apply z⟩
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff,← hRnorm, R.apply_symm_apply]
      exact mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz
  have hRrange : R '' range q = range p := by
    rw [← range_comp]
    exact congrArg range (funext hqp)
  refine ⟨R '' U,R '' V,R.isOpenMap U hU,R.isOpenMap V hV,
    hUc.image R R.continuous.continuousOn,hVc.image R R.continuous.continuousOn,
    ?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty,← image_inter R.injective,hd.inter_eq,image_empty]
  · rw [← image_union,hu,image_sdiff R.injective,hRb,hRrange]
  · rw [← R.image_frontier,← hRb,← image_inter R.injective,hfu,
      image_inter R.injective,hRrange,hRb]
  · rw [← R.image_frontier,← hRb,← image_inter R.injective,hfv,
      image_inter R.injective,hRrange,hRb]

end CircleDomainRigidity

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Selection.Con.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.koebeCircleDomainConjecture_of_constructed_quotient
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Selection.Con.text:
theorem koebeCircleDomainConjecture_of_constructed_quotient
    (hcross : UnitDiskAlternatingContinua)
    (hplane : PlanarLipschitzFiberCoarea)
    (hcoarea : WeightedPlanarScalarCoarea) (hLusin : FiniteTorusAnalyticMeasurability)
    (hsard : SmoothPlanarSard) (hsch : PlanarSchoenflies) (hsep : UnitDiskCrosscutSeparation)
    (hcollar : SmoothRegularJordanCollars) (hselect : BorelPathRelationSelection)
    (hgreen : UnorientedFiniteCircleGreenFormula) (harea : ExteriorCoefficientAreaTheorem)
    (hcompact : SmoothCompactMetricSphereUniformization) (hfinite : FiniteJordanModelUniformization)
    (hmontel : MontelExhaustion) (hhurwitz : HurwitzUnivalentLimit) (hzero : HurwitzZeroFreeLimit)
    (harcs : ∀ C : Set Sphere, IsCompact C → LocallyConnectedSpace C →
      HasSimpleArcsInConnectedOpens C)
    (hstandard : ∀ e : PathCodeData Sphere Sphere, [StandardBorelSpace (BasePathCode e)] →
      StandardBorelProbabilityLaws (BasePathCode e))
    (hpath : PolishProbabilityLaws C(PathTime, Sphere))
    (hdual : ∀ (e : PathCodeData Sphere Sphere)
      (I : Set ℕ) [PolishSpace I] (b : I → Sphere) (c : I → ℝ≥0∞)
      (ν : Measure Sphere) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
      [StandardBorelSpace (ConstrainedCostCode e b c ν)],
      MeasureImageDuality (ConstrainedCostCode e b c ν) (PathCostSpace Sphere I))
    (hlift : ∀ (e : PathCodeData Sphere Sphere)
      (I : Set ℕ) [PolishSpace I] (b : I → Sphere) (c : I → ℝ≥0∞)
      (ν : Measure Sphere) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
      [StandardBorelSpace (ConstrainedCostCode e b c ν)],
      MeasurePlanLifting (ConstrainedCostCode e b c ν) (PathCostSpace Sphere I))
    : KoebeCircleDomainConjecture := by
  intro U hU hconn
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hconn.nonempty
  let N := pointToInfinity x
  have hG : IsOpen (N '' U) := N.isOpenMap U hU
  have hGconn : IsConnected (N '' U) := hconn.image _ N.continuous.continuousOn
  have hinf : OnePoint.infty ∈ N '' U := ⟨x, hx, pointToInfinity_apply_self x⟩
  have hN := isConformalEquivalence_pointToInfinity x U
  by_cases hwhole : N '' U = univ
  · exact ⟨N '' U, N, hwhole ▸ isCircleDomain_univ, hN⟩
  · obtain ⟨V, f, hV, hf⟩ := circle_uniformization_of_infty_mem_of_shrinking hcross hplane
      hcoarea hLusin hsard hsch hsep hcollar hselect hgreen harea hcompact hfinite
      hmontel hhurwitz hzero harcs hstandard hpath hdual hlift hG hGconn hinf hwhole
    exact ⟨V, f ∘ N, hV, hN.trans hf⟩

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Uniformizatio.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.hurwitzZeroFreeLimit
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Uniformizatio.text:
theorem hurwitzZeroFreeLimit : HurwitzZeroFreeLimit := by
  intro D F f hD hconn hF hlim
  have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f D := hlim.differentiableOn (hF.mono (fun _ h => h.1)) hD
  have ha := hd.analyticOnNhd hD
  by_cases hzall : ∀ z ∈ D, f z = 0
  · exact Or.inl hzall
  right
  intro c hc hz
  have hn : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] c, f z ≠ 0 := by
    rcases (ha c hc).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with he | hn
    · exact (hzall (ha.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hconn.isPreconnected hc he)).elim
    · exact hn
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hεn⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hn
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδD⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hD c hc
  let r := min ε δ / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := half_pos (lt_min hε hδ)
  have hrε : r < ε := by dsimp [r]; have := min_le_left ε δ; linarith
  have hrδ : r < δ := by dsimp [r]; have := min_le_right ε δ; linarith
  have hbD : closedBall c r ⊆ D := fun z hz => hδD (closedBall_subset_ball hrδ hz)
  have hnz : ∀ z ∈ sphere c r, f z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz
    apply hεn
    refine ⟨closedBall_subset_ball hrε (sphere_subset_closedBall hz),?_⟩
    change z ≠ c
    intro he
    have hh := mem_sphere.mp hz
    rw [he,dist_self] at hh
    exact hr.ne' hh.symm
  have hfseq : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, DiffContOnCl ℂ (F n) (ball c r) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ closedBall c r, F n z ≠ 0 := hF.mono (fun n hn =>
    ⟨DiffContOnCl.mk_ball (hn.1.mono (ball_subset_closedBall.trans hbD))
      (hn.1.continuousOn.mono hbD),fun z hz => hn.2 z (hbD hz)⟩)
  have hU : TendstoUniformlyOn F f atTop (sphere c r) :=
    (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformlyOn_of_compact (isCompact_sphere c r)).mp
      (hlim.mono (sphere_subset_closedBall.trans hbD))
  exact nonzero_limit_center_of_nonzero_circle hr
    (hd.continuousOn.mono (sphere_subset_closedBall.trans hbD)) hfseq hU (hlim.tendsto_at hc) hnz hz

end CircleDomainRigidity

end

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Probability.M.text:
lemma measureImageDuality
    (A Z : Type*) [MeasurableSpace A] [StandardBorelSpace A]
    [TopologicalSpace Z] [PolishSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z] :
    MeasureImageDuality A Z := by
  classical
  intro K hK σ hσ c hc hmod
  let : IsFiniteMeasure σ := hσ
  let : MeasurableSingletonClass (FiniteMeasure Z) :=
    ⟨fun v => compact_finiteMeasure_measurableSet isCompact_singleton⟩
  by_cases hz : (0 : FiniteMeasure Z) ∈ range K
  · let η : ProbabilityMeasure (FiniteMeasure Z) := ⟨Measure.dirac 0,inferInstance⟩
    refine ⟨η,fun _ => 0,measurable_const,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · change ∀ᵐ v ∂Measure.dirac (0 : FiniteMeasure Z), v ∈ range K
      filter_upwards [ae_eq_dirac (fun v : FiniteMeasure Z => v)] with v hv
      rw [hv]
      exact hz
    · intro E hE
      change (∫⁻ v : FiniteMeasure Z, (v : Measure Z) E ∂Measure.dirac 0) = σ.withDensity (fun _ => 0) E
      simp
    · simp
  · have hnonzero : ∀ a, K a ≠ 0 := by
      intro a ha
      exact hz ⟨a,ha⟩
    obtain ⟨S,hS,hSK,hSm⟩ := exists_compact_subfamily_of_borel_image σ K hK hnonzero hmod
    have hSn : S.Nonempty := by
      by_contra hn
      let : IsEmpty S := ⟨fun x => hn ⟨x.val,x.property⟩⟩
      rw [measureFamilyModulus_zero_of_isEmpty] at hSm
      exact (not_lt_of_ge bot_le) hSm
    have hSz : (0 : FiniteMeasure Z) ∉ S := fun h => hz (hSK h)
    obtain ⟨η,q,hq,hsupp,hbar,he⟩ := compact_measure_image_duality σ hS hSn hSz c hc hSm
    exact ⟨η,q,hq,hsupp.mono (fun v hv => hSK hv),hbar,he⟩

end CircleDomainRigidity

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Sobolev.Exter.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.exteriorCoefficientAreaTheorem
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Sobolev.Exter.text:
lemma exteriorCoefficientAreaTheorem (hsch : PlanarSchoenflies)
    (hgreen : UnorientedFiniteCircleGreenFormula) : ExteriorCoefficientAreaTheorem := by
  intro F hF hi hn
  let c := principalLaurentCoefficient F
  have hb (N : ℕ) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ((n : ℝ)+1)*‖c n‖^2) ≤ 1 := by
    have hs : ContinuousAt (fun a : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        ((n : ℝ)+1)*‖c n‖^2*(a⁻¹)^(2*(n+1))) 1 := by
      apply tendsto_finsetSum
      intro n _
      exact continuousAt_const.mul (((continuousAt_id : ContinuousAt (fun a : ℝ => a) 1).inv₀
        (by norm_num)).pow (2*(n+1)))
    have ht : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        ((n : ℝ)+1)*‖c n‖^2*(a⁻¹)^(2*(n+1))) (𝓝[>] 1)
        (𝓝 (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ((n : ℝ)+1)*‖c n‖^2)) := by
      simpa using hs.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have ha : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => a^2) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 1) := by
      have h : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => a^2) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 ((1 : ℝ)^2)) :=
        ((continuousAt_id : ContinuousAt (fun a : ℝ => a) 1).pow 2).tendsto.mono_left
          nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      simpa only [one_pow] using h
    apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto ht ha
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with a ha
    exact finite_principal_coefficient_sum_le hsch hgreen hF hi hn ha N
  have hnonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ((n : ℝ)+1)*‖c n‖^2 := by positivity
  refine ⟨c, summable_of_sum_range_le hnonneg hb, Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le hnonneg hb, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hu : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (invertedPrincipalRemainder F) (ball 0 1) := by
    simpa using invertedPrincipalRemainder_analyticOnNhd (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      hF (principal_remainder_tendsto_zero hn)
  exact principal_laurent_hasSum hu hz

end CircleDomainRigidity

end

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Sobolev.Weigh.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.weightedPlanarScalarCoarea
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Sobolev.Weigh.text:
theorem weightedPlanarScalarCoarea : WeightedPlanarScalarCoarea := by
  intro D hD f hf q hq
  let R := D ∩ {z | fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0}
  let C := D ∩ {z | fderiv ℝ f z = 0}
  have hR : WeightedScalarCoareaIdentity R f q := regular_weighted_coarea hD hf hq
  have hCm : MeasurableSet C := measurableSet_planar_critical hD hf
  have hCD : C ⊆ D := inter_subset_left
  have hRC : Disjoint R C := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hzR hzC
    exact hzR.2 hzC.2
  have hDC : D = R ∪ C := by
    ext z
    simp only [R, C, mem_union, mem_inter_iff, mem_ofPred_eq]
    tauto
  have hCzero : ∀ᵐ t, weightedScalarLevelLength C f q t = 0 :=
    ae_zero_weighted_planar_critical_fiber hD hf q
  have hsplit (t : ℝ) : weightedScalarLevelLength D f q t =
      weightedScalarLevelLength R f q t + weightedScalarLevelLength C f q t := by
    unfold weightedScalarLevelLength
    rw [hDC, union_inter_distrib_right]
    exact lintegral_union (measurableSet_restricted_scalar_level hD hf.continuousOn hCm hCD t)
      (hRC.mono inter_subset_left inter_subset_left)
  have heq : weightedScalarLevelLength D f q =ᵐ[volume] weightedScalarLevelLength R f q := by
    filter_upwards [hCzero] with t ht
    rw [hsplit t, ht, add_zero]
  have hCE : (∫⁻ z in C, q z * ENNReal.ofReal ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖) = 0 := by
    apply setLIntegral_eq_zero hCm
    intro z hz
    change q z * ENNReal.ofReal ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ = 0
    have hz0 : fderiv ℝ f z = 0 := hz.2
    rw [hz0, norm_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨hR.1.congr heq.symm, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫⁻ t, weightedScalarLevelLength D f q t) = ∫⁻ t, weightedScalarLevelLength R f q t :=
      lintegral_congr_ae heq
    _ = ∫⁻ z in R, q z * ENNReal.ofReal ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ := hR.2
    _ = ∫⁻ z in D, q z * ENNReal.ofReal ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ := by
      conv_rhs => rw [hDC, lintegral_union hCm hRC, hCE, add_zero]

end CircleDomainRigidity

end

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Topology.Plan.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.planarSchoenflies
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Topology.Plan.text:
lemma planarSchoenflies : PlanarSchoenflies := by
  intro γ hγ hinj
  let e : ℂ ≃ₜ Schoenflies.Plane := complexPlaneCoordinates.toHomeomorph.symm
  let c0 : Circle → Schoenflies.Plane := fun z => e (z : ℂ)
  let c1 : Circle → Schoenflies.Plane := fun z => e (γ z)
  have hc0 : Continuous c0 := e.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hi0 : Injective c0 := e.injective.comp Subtype.val_injective
  have hc1 : Continuous c1 := e.continuous.comp hγ
  have hi1 : Injective c1 := e.injective.comp hinj
  let e0 : Circle ≃ₜ range c0 := (hc0.isClosedEmbedding hi0).isEmbedding.toHomeomorph
  let e1 : Circle ≃ₜ range c1 := (hc1.isClosedEmbedding hi1).isEmbedding.toHomeomorph
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := Schoenflies.jordan_schoenflies_of_homeomorph
    (circle_embedding_range_isJordanCurve c0 hc0 hi0)
    (circle_embedding_range_isJordanCurve c1 hc1 hi1) (e0.symm.trans e1)
  refine ⟨e.trans (F.trans e.symm), ?_⟩
  intro z
  have hh : F (e (z : ℂ)) = e (γ z) := by
    simpa only [Homeomorph.trans_apply, Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply,
      e0, e1, Topology.IsEmbedding.toHomeomorph_apply_coe, c0, c1] using hF (e0 z)
  change e.symm (F (e (z : ℂ))) = γ z
  rw [hh, e.symm_apply_apply]

end CircleDomainRigidity

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Uniformizatio.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.smoothCompactMetricSphereUniformization
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Uniformizatio.text:
lemma smoothCompactMetricSphereUniformization : SmoothCompactMetricSphereUniformization := by
  intro g hg hPD hfar
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFi, hlim, hmetric⟩ := smooth_metric_plane_model g hg hPD hfar
  have hhol := metric_plane_model_exterior_holomorphic hmetric hfar
  have hlim' : Tendsto (fun z => F z - z) (Bornology.cobounded ℂ) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Metric.cobounded_eq_cocompact] using hlim
  obtain ⟨ha, hd⟩ := principalInversionGerm_analytic_deriv hhol hlim'
  have halocal : AnalyticAt ℂ (sphereLocalMap F.onePointCongr ∞) 0 := by
    rwa [sphereLocalMap_onePointCongr_infty]
  have hdlocal : HasDerivAt (sphereLocalMap F.onePointCongr ∞) 1 0 := by
    rwa [sphereLocalMap_onePointCongr_infty]
  have hfix : F.onePointCongr ∞ = (∞ : Sphere) := rfl
  have hai := analyticAt_inverse_sphereLocalMap_infty F.onePointCongr hfix halocal
    (by rw [hdlocal.deriv]; exact one_ne_zero)
  refine ⟨F.onePointCongr, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p
    cases p using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty =>
      have hconf : IsConformalAt F.onePointCongr OnePoint.infty :=
        ⟨F.onePointCongr.continuous.continuousAt, 1, one_ne_zero,
          by
            convert hdlocal using 1 <;> first | rfl | exact chart_infty_self⟩
      exact hconf.isMetricConformalAt_of_scalar (c := 4)
        (by norm_num) (by simp [sphereChartMetric])
    | coe z => exact hmetric z
  · intro p
    cases p using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty => exact ⟨F.onePointCongr.continuous.continuousAt,
        by simpa only [chart_infty_self] using halocal.contDiffAt.restrict_scalars ℝ⟩
    | coe z =>
      refine ⟨F.onePointCongr.continuous.continuousAt, ?_⟩
      rw [sphereLocalMap_onePointCongr_coe, chart_coe_self]
      exact hF.contDiffAt
  · intro p
    cases p using OnePoint.rec with
    | infty => exact ⟨F.onePointCongr.symm.continuous.continuousAt,
        by simpa only [chart_infty_self] using hai.contDiffAt.restrict_scalars ℝ⟩
    | coe z =>
      refine ⟨F.onePointCongr.symm.continuous.continuousAt, ?_⟩
      change ContDiffAt ℝ (↑(⊤ : ENat)) (sphereLocalMap F.symm.onePointCongr (z : Sphere))
        (chart (z : Sphere) (z : Sphere))
      rw [sphereLocalMap_onePointCongr_coe, chart_coe_self]
      exact hFi.contDiffAt

end CircleDomainRigidity

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Uniformizatio.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.montelExhaustion
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Uniformizatio.text:
theorem montelExhaustion : MontelExhaustion := by
  classical
  intro D F hD hmono hF hbound
  obtain ⟨s,hs,G,heq,he,hb⟩ := exists_montel_continuous_family D F hD hmono hF hbound
  let U := ⋃ n, D n
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_iUnion hD
  let H : ℕ → C(U, ℂ) := fun n => (G n).comp ⟨Subtype.val,continuous_subtype_val⟩
  obtain ⟨v,t,ht,hv⟩ := locally_uniform_complex_subsequence hU H he hb
  let f : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => if hz : z ∈ U then v ⟨z,hz⟩ else 0
  have hf : (f ∘ ((↑) : U → ℂ)) = v := by
    funext z
    simp only [Function.comp_apply,f,dite_eq_left z.property]
  have hlim : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n => G (t n)) f atTop U := by
    apply tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoLocallyUniformly_comp_coe.mpr
    rw [hf]
    exact hv
  refine ⟨s ∘ t,f,hs.comp ht,?_⟩
  apply (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact hU).mpr
  intro K hKU hK
  have hKlim := (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact hU).mp hlim K hKU hK
  exact hKlim.congr (ht.tendsto_atTop.eventually (heq K hK hKU))

end CircleDomainRigidity

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Uniformizatio.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.hurwitzUnivalentLimit
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Uniformizatio.text:
theorem hurwitzUnivalentLimit : HurwitzUnivalentLimit := by
  intro D F f hD hconn hF hlim hnonconstant
  have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f D := hlim.differentiableOn (hF.mono (fun _ h => h.1)) hD
  have ha := hd.analyticOnNhd hD
  intro x hx y hy heq
  by_contra hxy
  have hop : IsOpen (D ∩ {y}ᶜ) := hD.inter isClosed_singleton.isOpen_compl
  have hx' : x ∈ D ∩ {y}ᶜ := ⟨hx,hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hrD⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hop x hx'
  have hbD : ball x r ⊆ D := fun z hz => (hrD hz).1
  have hseq : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => F n z-F n y) (ball x r) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ ball x r, F n z-F n y ≠ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hF] with n hn
    refine ⟨(hn.1.mono hbD).sub_const (F n y),?_⟩
    intro z hz he
    have hh : z = y := hn.2 (hbD hz) hy (sub_eq_zero.mp he)
    exact (hrD hz).2 hh
  have hconst : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n (_ : ℂ) => F n y)
      (fun _ => f y) atTop (ball x r) :=
    ((hlim.tendsto_at hy).tendstoUniformlyOn_const (ball x r)).tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
  have hsub : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n z => F n z-F n y)
      (fun z => f z-f y) atTop (ball x r) := (hlim.mono hbD).sub hconst
  rcases hurwitzZeroFreeLimit (ball x r) (fun n z => F n z-F n y)
    (fun z => f z-f y) isOpen_ball (Metric.isConnected_ball hr) hseq hsub with hz | hn
  · have hzero : (fun z => f z-f y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [ball_mem_nhds x hr] with z hzr
      exact hz z hzr
    have hall := (ha.sub analyticOnNhd_const).eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      hconn.isPreconnected hx hzero
    exact hnonconstant ⟨f y,fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mp (hall hz)⟩
  · exact hn x (mem_ball_self hr) (sub_eq_zero.mpr heq)

end CircleDomainRigidity

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Topology.Fini.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unorientedFiniteCircleGreenFormula
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Topology.Fini.text:
lemma unorientedFiniteCircleGreenFormula : UnorientedFiniteCircleGreenFormula := by
  intro H γ hγ
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hgreen⟩ := regular_jordan_green hγ
  refine ⟨ε,hε,?_⟩
  intro n c r hr hd hin O hO hsub P Q hP hQ
  let K := closure (jordanInterior H) \ ⋃ i, ball (c i) (r i)
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hep,_⟩ := exists_smooth_collar_extension hO
    (finite_hole_core_closed H c r) hsub hP 0
  obtain ⟨q,hq,heq,_⟩ := exists_smooth_collar_extension hO
    (finite_hole_core_closed H c r) hsub hQ 0
  have houter : planarFormIntegral p q γ = planarFormIntegral P Q γ := by
    unfold planarFormIntegral
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t _
    have ht := jordan_boundary_mem_finite_hole_core hγ c r hin t
    dsimp only
    rw [hep.self_of_nhdsSet ht,heq.self_of_nhdsSet ht]
  have hcircle (i : Fin n) :
      planarFormIntegral p q (unitCircleParam (c i) (r i)) =
        planarFormIntegral P Q (unitCircleParam (c i) (r i)) := by
    unfold planarFormIntegral
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t _
    have ht := circle_mem_finite_hole_core H c r hr hd hin i t
    dsimp only
    rw [hep.self_of_nhdsSet ht,heq.self_of_nhdsSet ht]
  have hsum : (∑ i, planarFormIntegral p q (unitCircleParam (c i) (r i))) =
      ∑ i, planarFormIntegral P Q (unitCircleParam (c i) (r i)) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hcircle i)
  have hcurl : Continuous (fun z => (fderiv ℝ q z) 1 - (fderiv ℝ p z) Complex.I) :=
    ((hq.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const).sub
      ((hp.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const)
  calc
    ε * planarFormIntegral P Q γ - ∑ i, planarFormIntegral P Q (unitCircleParam (c i) (r i)) =
        ε * planarFormIntegral p q γ - ∑ i, planarFormIntegral p q (unitCircleParam (c i) (r i)) := by
      rw [houter,hsum]
    _ = ∫ z in jordanInterior H \ ⋃ i, closedBall (c i) (r i),
        (fderiv ℝ q z) 1 - (fderiv ℝ p z) Complex.I := by
      rw [hgreen p q hp hq]
      simp_rw [translated_disk_green hp hq _ (hr _)]
      exact integral_finite_round_holes H c r hd hin hcurl
    _ = _ := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun ((jordanInterior_isOpen H).measurableSet.diff
        (MeasurableSet.iUnion fun _ => isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet))
      intro z hz
      have hzK : z ∈ K := by
        refine ⟨subset_closure hz.1,?_⟩
        intro hm
        obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hm
        exact hz.2 (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i,ball_subset_closedBall hi⟩)
      have hpz := hep.filter_mono (nhds_le_nhdsSet hzK)
      have hqz := heq.filter_mono (nhds_le_nhdsSet hzK)
      dsimp only
      rw [hpz.fderiv_eq,hqz.fderiv_eq]

end CircleDomainRigidity

end

OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Topology.Disk.name: OAI.CircleDomainRigidity.unitDiskAlternatingContinua
OAI.Analysis.CircleDomains.Topology.Disk.text:
theorem unitDiskAlternatingContinua (hsch : PlanarSchoenflies) : UnitDiskAlternatingContinua := by
  intro A B hAc hA hBc hB hAd hBd θ hθ h0 h2 h1 h3
  by_contra hn
  have hAB : Disjoint A B := Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun z hzA hzB => hn ⟨z,hzA,hzB⟩)
  let z : Fin 4 → ℂ := fun i => standardCirclePoint (θ i)
  have hz0 : z 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he := Circle.norm_coe ((AddCircle.homeomorphCircle (T := (1 : ℝ)) one_ne_zero) (θ 0))
    change ‖z 0‖ = 1 at he
    rw [h,norm_zero] at he
    exact zero_ne_one he
  have h20 : z 2 ≠ z 0 := by
    intro h
    have he := congrArg unitCircleCut (standardCirclePoint_injective h)
    exact (ne_of_gt (hθ (by decide : (0 : Fin 4) < 2))) he
  obtain ⟨p,hpi,hpint,hpB⟩ := exists_disk_crosscut_avoiding hAc hA hAd hBc.isClosed hAB
    h2 h0 (Circle.norm_coe _) (Circle.norm_coe _) h20
  let R := Homeomorph.mulLeft₀ (z 0) hz0
  let q : Path ((z 0)⁻¹ * z 2) 1 := {
    toFun := fun t => (z 0)⁻¹ * p t
    continuous_toFun := continuous_const.mul p.continuous
    source' := by rw [p.source]
    target' := by rw [p.target,inv_mul_cancel₀ hz0] }
  have hqp (t : PathTime) : R (q t) = p t := by
    change z 0 * ((z 0)⁻¹ * p t) = p t
    rw [← mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ hz0,one_mul]
  have hRnorm (w : ℂ) : ‖R.symm w‖ = ‖w‖ := by
    change ‖(z 0)⁻¹ * w‖ = ‖w‖
    rw [norm_mul,norm_inv,show ‖z 0‖ = 1 from Circle.norm_coe _,inv_one,one_mul]
  have hqi : Injective q := fun s t he => hpi (by rw [← hqp s,← hqp t,he])
  have hqint : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : PathTime) 1, ‖q t‖ < 1 := by
    intro t ht
    change ‖R.symm (p t)‖ < 1
    rw [hRnorm]
    exact hpint t ht
  obtain ⟨ha,ha1,hx,hy⟩ := alternating_boundary_rotated_arcs θ hθ
  obtain ⟨H,hf,_,hinside⟩ := exists_disk_crosscut_jordan hsch q hqi hqint ha ha1
  let C := R.symm '' B
  have hC : IsPreconnected C := hB.isPreconnected.image R.symm R.symm.continuous.continuousOn
  have hCd : C ⊆ closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    rintro _ ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff,hRnorm]
    exact mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp (hBd hw)
  have hCq : Disjoint C (range q) := by
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro w ⟨b,hb,he⟩ ⟨t,ht⟩
    have hpt : p t = b := by
      rw [← hqp t,ht,← he,R.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hpB ⟨t,hpt⟩ hb
  have hxC : (z 0)⁻¹ * z 1 ∈ C := ⟨z 1,h1,rfl⟩
  have hyC : (z 0)⁻¹ * z 3 ∈ C := ⟨z 3,h3,rfl⟩
  have hxcl : (z 0)⁻¹ * z 1 ∈ closure (jordanInterior H) :=
    frontier_subset_closure (hf ▸ Or.inr hx)
  have hynot : (z 0)⁻¹ * z 3 ∉ closure (jordanInterior H) := by
    have he := disk_crosscut_exterior_circle q ha hqint H hf hinside
    have hh := he.symm ▸ hy
    exact hh.1
  rcases connected_avoiding_crosscut_one_side q ha H hf hinside hC hCd hCq with h | h
  · exact hynot (h hyC)
  · exact h hxC hxcl

end CircleDomainRigidity

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Operators.Spectral.name: OAI.Laughlin.spectral_kernel_distance
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Operators.Spectral.text:
theorem spectral_kernel_distance {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℂ E]
    (T : Module.End ℂ E) (hT : T.IsSymmetric) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hgap : ∀ v : E, v≠0 → ∀ a : ℝ, T v=(a : ℂ) • v → a=0 ∨ c≤a)
    (x : E) : ∃ y : E, T y=0 ∧ c*‖x-y‖^2 ≤ (inner ℂ (T x) x).re := by
  classical
  let d := Module.finrank ℂ E
  let b := hT.eigenvectorBasis (n := d) rfl
  let a := hT.eigenvalues (n := d) rfl
  let z : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => if a i=0 then b.repr x i else 0)
  let y := b.repr.symm z
  have hyrepr (i : Fin d) : b.repr y i = if a i=0 then b.repr x i else 0 := by
    simp [y,z]
  have hdiag (v : E) (i : Fin d) : b.repr (T v) i = (a i : ℂ)*b.repr v i :=
    hT.eigenvectorBasis_apply_self_apply rfl v i
  have hy : T y=0 := by
    apply b.repr.injective
    ext i
    rw [hdiag,hyrepr]
    by_cases hi : a i=0 <;> simp [hi]
  have hnorm : ‖x-y‖^2 = ∑ i : Fin d, if a i=0 then 0 else ‖b.repr x i‖^2 := by
    rw [← b.repr.norm_map,EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp only [map_sub,PiLp.sub_apply,hyrepr]
    by_cases ha : a i=0 <;> simp [ha]
  have he : (inner ℂ (T x) x).re = ∑ i : Fin d, a i*‖b.repr x i‖^2 := by
    rw [← b.repr.inner_map_map,PiLp.inner_apply,Complex.re_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hdiag]
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply,map_mul,Complex.conj_ofReal]
    have hn : (star (b.repr x i)*b.repr x i).re = ‖b.repr x i‖^2 := by
      change (((starRingEnd ℂ) (b.repr x i))*b.repr x i).re = _
      rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    have hh : b.repr x i * ((a i : ℂ) * star (b.repr x i)) =
        (a i : ℂ)*(star (b.repr x i)*b.repr x i) := by ring
    change (b.repr x i * ((a i : ℂ) * star (b.repr x i))).re = _
    rw [hh,Complex.mul_re,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,sub_zero,hn]
  refine ⟨y,hy,?_⟩
  rw [hnorm,he,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i hi
  have hb : b i ≠ 0 := b.orthonormal.ne_zero i
  have hgi := hgap (b i) hb (a i) (hT.apply_eigenvectorBasis rfl i)
  by_cases ha : a i=0
  · simp [ha]
  · rw [ite_eq_right ha]
    exact mul_le_mul (hgi.resolve_left ha) le_rfl (sq_nonneg _)
      (hc.trans (hgi.resolve_left ha))

end Laughlin

end OAI
