OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.FockEnergy:.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.tensorExterior_energy
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.FockEnergy:.text:
theorem tensorExterior_energy (n Q : ℕ) (ψ : State (n+2) Q) (hψ : Antisymmetric ψ) :
    sourceFockEnergy Q (tensorExterior (n+2) Q ψ) = ((n+2).factorial : ℝ)*energy ψ := by
  have hn : ‖((n+2 : ℂ)*(n+1))/(Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ)‖^2 =
      ((n+2 : ℝ)*(n+1))^2/2 := by
    rw [norm_div,norm_mul,div_pow,mul_pow]
    have h2 : ‖(Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ)‖^2 = (2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
        Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
    rw [h2]
    have hn2 : (n+2 : ℂ) = ((n+2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
    have hn1 : (n+1 : ℂ) = ((n+1 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [hn2,hn1,Complex.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity),Complex.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    ring
  simp only [sourceFockEnergy,sourcePairEnd_tensorExterior n Q ψ hψ,
    occupationNormSq_smul,hn,tensorExterior_norm n Q _ (headPairAmplitude_antisymmetric ψ hψ _)]
  rw [energy_head_pair n Q ψ hψ]
  simp only [Nat.factorial_succ,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Polynomial.Physica.name: OAI.Laughlin.physical_Laughlin_kernel
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Polynomial.Physica.text:
theorem physical_Laughlin_kernel {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (ψ : State N (3*(N-1))) (hψ : Antisymmetric ψ) :
    energy ψ = 0 ↔ ∃ c : ℂ, ψ = fun a => c * laughlinVector N (3*(N-1)) a := by
  constructor
  · exact zero_energy_state_eq_laughlin hN ψ hψ
  · rintro ⟨c,hc⟩
    apply (energy_eq_zero_iff_global_pair_cubes (by omega) ψ hψ).mpr
    intro i j hij
    rw [hc, spinPolynomial_scalar, spinPolynomial_laughlinVector]
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (bracket_cube_dvd_laughlin hij) _

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SpectralDista.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.euclideanFockHamiltonian_symmetric
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SpectralDista.text:
theorem euclideanFockHamiltonian_symmetric (Q : ℕ) :
    (euclideanFockHamiltonian Q).IsSymmetric := by
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := (occupationEuclidean Q).surjective x
  obtain ⟨v,rfl⟩ := (occupationEuclidean Q).surjective y
  simp only [euclideanFockHamiltonian_apply,occupationEuclidean_inner]
  exact sourceFockHamiltonian_symmetric Q u v

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.Hamiltonian:2.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.sourceFockHamiltonian
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.Hamiltonian:2.text:
noncomputable def sourceFockHamiltonian (Q : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ (Space Q) :=
  ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (2*Q-1), sourcePairCreateEnd Q p * sourcePairEnd Q p

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.EigenvalueGap.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.sourceFockHamiltonian_kernel
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.EigenvalueGap.text:
theorem sourceFockHamiltonian_kernel (Q : ℕ) (x : Space Q) :
    sourceFockHamiltonian Q x=0 ↔ sourceFockEnergy Q x=0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := sourceFockHamiltonian_quadratic Q x
    rw [h] at he
    have hz : occupationInner Q 0 x=0 := by simp [occupationInner]
    rw [hz] at he
    exact Complex.ofReal_injective he.symm
  · intro h
    have he := (sourceFockEnergy_eq_zero Q x).mp h
    simp only [sourceFockHamiltonian,LinearMap.sum_apply,Module.End.mul_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    rw [he p hp,map_zero]

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Operators.Physical.name: OAI.Laughlin.energy_head_pair
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Operators.Physical.text:
theorem energy_head_pair (n Q : ℕ) (ψ : State (n+2) Q) (hψ : Antisymmetric ψ) :
    energy ψ = ((n+2 : ℝ)*(n+1)/2) *
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (2*Q-1), ∑ b : Configuration n Q, ‖headPairAmplitude ψ p b‖^2 := by
  have he (i j : Fin (n+2)) (hij : i < j) (p : ℕ) :
      (∑ a : Configuration (n+2) Q,
        if a i = 0 ∧ a j = 0 then ‖pairAmplitude ψ i j p a‖^2 else 0) =
        ∑ b : Configuration n Q, ‖headPairAmplitude ψ p b‖^2 := by
    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := (Fin.exists_succAbove_eq (ne_of_lt hij).symm)
    subst j
    exact anchored_pair_sum ψ hψ i k p
  unfold energy
  have hs : (∑ i : Fin (n+2), ∑ j : Fin (n+2), if i < j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      (n+2 : ℝ)*(n+1)/2 := by
    rw [unordered_position_count]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [← hs,Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  by_cases hij : i < j
  · simp only [ite_eq_left hij,one_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p hp => he i j hij p)
  · simp [hij]

end Laughlin

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.KernelReado.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.headPairAmplitude_readout
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.KernelReado.text:
theorem headPairAmplitude_readout (n Q : ℕ) (x : Space Q) (p : ℕ)
    (b : Configuration n Q) :
    headPairAmplitude (normalizedTensorReadout (n+2) Q x) p b =
      (((Real.sqrt ((n+2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ : ℂ)*(Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ)) *
        occupationInner Q (orderedWedge b) (sourcePairEnd Q p x) := by
  have he (i j : Fin (Q+1)) :
      occupationInner Q (orderedWedge (Fin.cons i (Fin.cons j b))) x =
        occupationInner Q (orderedWedge b) (annihilate j (annihilate i x)) := by
    rw [orderedWedge_cons,orderedWedge_cons,create_annihilate_adjoint,create_annihilate_adjoint]
  simp only [headPairAmplitude,normalizedTensorReadout,he,sourcePairEnd,pairEnd,
    LinearMap.sum_apply,LinearMap.smul_apply,Module.End.mul_apply,
    occupationInner_sum_right,occupationInner_smul_right,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have h2 : (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity)
  push_cast
  field_simp

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.tensorExterior_single
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.text:
theorem tensorExterior_single (n Q : ℕ) (a : Configuration n Q) :
    tensorExterior n Q (Pi.single a 1) = orderedWedge a := by
  simp [tensorExterior,Pi.single_apply,orderedWedge]

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Polynomial.Laughli.name: OAI.Laughlin.spinPolynomial_laughlinVector
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Polynomial.Laughli.text:
theorem spinPolynomial_laughlinVector (N : ℕ) :
    spinPolynomial (laughlinVector N (3*(N-1)))=laughlinPolynomial N := by
  exact spinPolynomial_reconstruct _ (laughlinPolynomial_particle_degree N)

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Exterior.Occupatio.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.occupationNormSq_nonneg
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Exterior.Occupatio.text:
theorem occupationNormSq_nonneg (Q : ℕ) (x : Space Q) : 0 ≤ occupationNormSq Q x := by
  unfold occupationNormSq
  positivity

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.PairContrac.name: OAI.Laughlin.headPairAmplitude
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.PairContrac.text:
noncomputable def headPairAmplitude {n Q : ℕ} (ψ : State (n+2) Q)
    (p : ℕ) (b : Configuration n Q) : ℂ :=
  ∑ x, ∑ y, (pairCoefficient Q p x y : ℂ) * ψ (Fin.cons x (Fin.cons y b))

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Model:48.name: OAI.Laughlin.laughlinVector
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Model:48.text:
noncomputable def laughlinVector (N Q : ℕ) : State N Q := fun a =>
  (laughlinPolynomial N).coeff (monomialExponent a) /
    ((∏ i : Fin N, Real.sqrt (Nat.choose Q (a i).val : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.normalizedTensorReadout
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.text:
noncomputable def normalizedTensorReadout (n Q : ℕ) (x : Space Q) : State n Q :=
  fun a => ((Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ : ℂ) * occupationInner Q (orderedWedge a) x

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Pair.EnergyReturn:.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.occupationNormSq_smul
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Pair.EnergyReturn:.text:
theorem occupationNormSq_smul (Q : ℕ) (c : ℂ) (x : Space Q) :
    occupationNormSq Q (c • x) = ‖c‖^2 * occupationNormSq Q x := by
  simp [occupationNormSq,mul_pow,Finset.mul_sum]

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SpectralDista.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.occupationEuclidean
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SpectralDista.text:
noncomputable def occupationEuclidean (Q : ℕ) :
    Space Q ≃ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Finset (Fin (Q+1))) :=
  (occupationBasis Q).equivFun.trans (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℂ (Finset (Fin (Q+1)) → ℂ)).symm

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.normalizedTensorReadout_antisymmetric
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.text:
theorem normalizedTensorReadout_antisymmetric (n Q : ℕ) (x : Space Q) :
    Antisymmetric (normalizedTensorReadout n Q x) := by
  intro i j hij a
  simp [normalizedTensorReadout,orderedWedge_swap a i j hij,occupationInner]

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Main:19.name: OAI.Laughlin.mainTarget_proved
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Main:19.text:
theorem mainTarget_proved : MainTarget := by
  obtain ⟨Q₀,h25,hgap⟩ := physical_fock_kernel_distance_uniform
  refine ⟨Q₀+2,by omega,fun N hN ψ hψ => ?_⟩
  have hN2 : 2 ≤ N := by omega
  obtain ⟨n,rfl⟩ : ∃ n, N=n+2 := ⟨N-2,by omega⟩
  have hQ : Q₀ ≤ 3*(n+2-1) := by omega
  let Q := 3*(n+2-1)
  let x := normalizedTensorExterior (n+2) Q ψ
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hb⟩ := hgap Q hQ x
  have hyE : sourceFockEnergy Q y=0 := (sourceFockHamiltonian_kernel Q y).mp hy
  have hrE : energy (normalizedTensorReadout (n+2) Q y)=0 :=
    normalizedTensorReadout_zero_energy n Q y hyE
  have hrA := normalizedTensorReadout_antisymmetric (n+2) Q y
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := (physical_Laughlin_kernel (show 2 ≤ n+2 by omega)
    (normalizedTensorReadout (n+2) Q y) hrA).mp hrE
  have hread : normalizedTensorReadout (n+2) Q (x-y) =
      fun a => ψ a-c*laughlinVector (n+2) Q a := by
    rw [normalizedTensorReadout_sub,normalizedTensorReadout_left_inverse (n+2) Q ψ hψ,hc]
  have hnorm := normalizedTensorReadout_norm_le (n+2) Q (x-y)
  rw [hread] at hnorm
  have hdist := distanceToLaughlinSq_le ψ c
  have hE : sourceFockEnergy Q x=energy ψ := normalizedTensorExterior_energy n Q ψ hψ
  rw [hE] at hb
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdist.trans hnorm) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/100)).trans hb

end Laughlin

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.EigenvalueGap.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.physical_fock_eigenvalue_gap_uniform
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.EigenvalueGap.text:
theorem physical_fock_eigenvalue_gap_uniform :
    ∃ Q₀ : ℕ, 25 ≤ Q₀ ∧ ∀ Q : ℕ, Q₀ ≤ Q → ∀ x : Space Q, x≠0 → ∀ a : ℝ,
      sourceFockHamiltonian Q x=(a : ℂ) • x → a=0 ∨ (1/100 : ℝ) ≤ a := by
  obtain ⟨Q₀,h25,h⟩ := physical_fock_square_uniform
  refine ⟨Q₀,h25,fun Q hQ x hx a he => ?_⟩
  have hn : 0 < occupationNormSq Q x :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (occupationNormSq_nonneg Q x) (Ne.symm (mt (occupationNormSq_eq_zero Q x).mp hx))
  have ha := sourceFock_eigen_nonneg Q x hx a he
  have hs := h Q hQ x
  rw [sourceFock_eigen_energy Q x a he,he,occupationNormSq_smul] at hs
  have hnorm : ‖(a : ℂ)‖^2=a^2 := by simp
  rw [hnorm] at hs
  have hs' : (1/100 : ℝ)*a ≤ a^2 := by nlinarith
  by_cases hz : a=0
  · exact Or.inl hz
  · right
    have hp : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm hz)
    nlinarith

end Laughlin.Fock

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Polynomial.Physica.name: OAI.Laughlin.spinPolynomial_scalar
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Polynomial.Physica.text:
theorem spinPolynomial_scalar {N Q : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (ψ : State N Q) :
    spinPolynomial (fun a => c * ψ a) = C c * spinPolynomial ψ := by
  unfold spinPolynomial
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  rw [C_mul_monomial]
  congr 1
  ring

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.FockEnergy:.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.normalizedTensorExterior_energy
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.FockEnergy:.text:
theorem normalizedTensorExterior_energy (n Q : ℕ) (ψ : State (n+2) Q)
    (hψ : Antisymmetric ψ) :
    sourceFockEnergy Q (normalizedTensorExterior (n+2) Q ψ) = energy ψ := by
  have hp : 0 < ((n+2).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos (n+2)
  have hs : (Real.sqrt ((n+2).factorial : ℝ))^2 = ((n+2).factorial : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hp)
  have he (c : ℂ) (x : Space Q) : sourceFockEnergy Q (c • x) = ‖c‖^2*sourceFockEnergy Q x := by
    simp only [sourceFockEnergy,map_smul,occupationNormSq_smul,Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [normalizedTensorExterior,he,tensorExterior_energy n Q ψ hψ]
  have hn : ‖((Real.sqrt ((n+2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖^2 =
      (((n+2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
    rw [norm_inv,inv_pow]
    congr 1
    simpa only [Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs] using hs
  rw [hn]
  field_simp

end Laughlin.Fock

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SpectralDista.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.physical_fock_kernel_distance_uniform
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SpectralDista.text:
theorem physical_fock_kernel_distance_uniform :
    ∃ Q₀ : ℕ, 25 ≤ Q₀ ∧ ∀ Q : ℕ, Q₀ ≤ Q → ∀ x : Space Q,
      ∃ y : Space Q, sourceFockHamiltonian Q y=0 ∧
        (1/100 : ℝ)*occupationNormSq Q (x-y) ≤ sourceFockEnergy Q x := by
  obtain ⟨Q₀,h25,hgap⟩ := physical_fock_eigenvalue_gap_uniform
  refine ⟨Q₀,h25,fun Q hQ x => ?_⟩
  have hg : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Finset (Fin (Q+1))), v≠0 → ∀ a : ℝ,
      euclideanFockHamiltonian Q v=(a : ℂ) • v → a=0 ∨ (1/100 : ℝ)≤a := by
    intro v hv a he
    obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := (occupationEuclidean Q).surjective v
    apply hgap Q hQ u (by intro hu; simp [hu] at hv) a
    apply (occupationEuclidean Q).injective
    simpa only [euclideanFockHamiltonian_apply,map_smul] using he
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hb⟩ := spectral_kernel_distance (euclideanFockHamiltonian Q)
    (euclideanFockHamiltonian_symmetric Q) (1/100) (by norm_num) hg (occupationEuclidean Q x)
  obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := (occupationEuclidean Q).surjective z
  refine ⟨y,?_,?_⟩
  · apply (occupationEuclidean Q).injective
    simpa only [euclideanFockHamiltonian_apply,map_zero] using hz
  · rw [← map_sub,occupationEuclidean_norm,euclideanFockHamiltonian_apply,
      occupationEuclidean_inner,sourceFockHamiltonian_quadratic,Complex.ofReal_re] at hb
    exact hb

end Laughlin.Fock

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Polynomial.Polynom.name: OAI.Laughlin.bracket_cube_dvd_laughlin
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Polynomial.Polynom.text:
theorem bracket_cube_dvd_laughlin {N : ℕ} {i j : Fin N} (hij : i < j) :
    bracket i j ^ 3 ∣ laughlinPolynomial N := by
  classical
  unfold laughlinPolynomial
  have h₁ : bracket i j ^ 3 ∣ ∏ k : Fin N, if i < k then bracket i k ^ 3 else 1 := by
    simpa [hij] using
    (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun j => if i < j then bracket i j ^ 3 else 1)
      (Finset.mem_univ j))
  exact h₁.trans
    (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i => ∏ j : Fin N, if i < j then bracket i j ^ 3 else 1)
      (Finset.mem_univ i))

end Laughlin

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Model:8.name: OAI.Laughlin.Configuration
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Model:8.text: abbrev Configuration (N Q : ℕ) := Fin N → Fin (Q+1)

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Model:43.name: OAI.Laughlin.monomialExponent
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Model:43.text:
noncomputable def monomialExponent {N Q : ℕ} (a : Configuration N Q) : SpinorVariables N →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.onFinset Finset.univ
    (fun ib => if ib.2 then (a ib.1).val else Q - (a ib.1).val)
    (by intro; simp)

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.orderedWedge_swap
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.text:
theorem orderedWedge_swap {n Q : ℕ} (a : Configuration n Q) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i≠j) :
    orderedWedge (a ∘ Equiv.swap i j) = -orderedWedge a := by
  exact (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti ℂ n).map_swap (fun k => mode (a k)) hij

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Spin.PairDecomposi.name: OAI.Laughlin.zero_energy_state_eq_laughlin
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Spin.PairDecomposi.text:
theorem zero_energy_state_eq_laughlin {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (ψ : State N (3*(N-1))) (hψ : Antisymmetric ψ) (hE : energy ψ = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, ψ = fun a => c * laughlinVector N (3*(N-1)) a := by
  exact state_eq_laughlin_of_pair_cubes ψ
    (energy_zero_global_pair_cubes (by omega) ψ hψ hE)

end Laughlin

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Model:56.name: OAI.Laughlin.MainTarget
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Model:56.text:
def MainTarget : Prop :=
  ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N →
    ∀ ψ : State N (3*(N-1)), Antisymmetric ψ →
      (1/100 : ℝ) * distanceToLaughlinSq ψ ≤ energy ψ

end Laughlin

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorIso.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.normalizedTensorExterior_norm
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorIso.text:
theorem normalizedTensorExterior_norm (n Q : ℕ) (ψ : State n Q)
    (hψ : Antisymmetric ψ) :
    occupationNormSq Q (normalizedTensorExterior n Q ψ) = ∑ a, ‖ψ a‖^2 := by
  have h := normalizedTensorExterior_inner n Q ψ ψ hψ
  rw [occupationInner_self] at h
  have he (a : Configuration n Q) : star (ψ a)*ψ a = ((‖ψ a‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
    rfl
  simp only [he,← Complex.ofReal_sum] at h
  exact Complex.ofReal_injective h

end Laughlin.Fock

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SpectralDista.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.euclideanFockHamiltonian_apply
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SpectralDista.text:
theorem euclideanFockHamiltonian_apply (Q : ℕ) (x : Space Q) :
    euclideanFockHamiltonian Q (occupationEuclidean Q x) =
      occupationEuclidean Q (sourceFockHamiltonian Q x) := by
  simp [euclideanFockHamiltonian]

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.Adjoint:8.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.occupationInner
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.Adjoint:8.text:
noncomputable def occupationInner (Q : ℕ) (x y : Space Q) : ℂ :=
  ∑ A : Finset (Fin (Q+1)), star ((occupationBasis Q).repr x A) * (occupationBasis Q).repr y A

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.name: OAI.Laughlin.Fock.normalizedTensorReadout_norm_le
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Tensor.ExteriorAdj.text:
theorem normalizedTensorReadout_norm_le (n Q : ℕ) (x : Space Q) :
    (∑ a, ‖normalizedTensorReadout n Q x a‖^2) ≤ occupationNormSq Q x := by
  let ψ := normalizedTensorReadout n Q x
  let z := normalizedTensorExterior n Q ψ
  let S : ℝ := ∑ a, ‖ψ a‖^2
  have he (a : Configuration n Q) : star (ψ a)*ψ a = ((‖ψ a‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
    rfl
  have hzx : occupationInner Q z x = (S : ℂ) := by
    rw [normalizedTensorExterior_adjoint]
    change (∑ a, star (ψ a)*ψ a) = (S : ℂ)
    simp only [he,← Complex.ofReal_sum]
    rfl
  have hzz : occupationInner Q z z = (S : ℂ) := by
    rw [occupationInner_self,normalizedTensorExterior_norm n Q ψ
      (normalizedTensorReadout_antisymmetric n Q x)]
  have hxz : occupationInner Q x z = (S : ℂ) := by
    rw [← occupationInner_star,hzx]
    simp
  have hs : occupationNormSq Q (x-z) = occupationNormSq Q x-S := by
    apply Complex.ofReal_injective
    rw [← occupationInner_self]
    have hsub : occupationInner Q (x-z) (x-z) =
        occupationInner Q x x - occupationInner Q x z -
          occupationInner Q z x + occupationInner Q z z := by
      simp [occupationInner,sub_mul,mul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      ring
    rw [hsub,occupationInner_self,hzx,hxz,hzz]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hp := occupationNormSq_nonneg Q (x-z)
  rw [hs] at hp
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hp

end Laughlin.Fock

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Main:11.name: OAI.Laughlin.distanceToLaughlinSq_le
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Main:11.text:
theorem distanceToLaughlinSq_le {N Q : ℕ} (ψ : State N Q) (c : ℂ) :
    distanceToLaughlinSq ψ ≤ ∑ a, ‖ψ a-c*laughlinVector N Q a‖^2 := by
  apply csInf_le
  · refine ⟨0,?_⟩
    rintro t ⟨d,rfl⟩
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a ha => sq_nonneg _)
  · exact ⟨c,rfl⟩

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Operators.GlobalPa.name: OAI.Laughlin.energy_eq_zero_iff_global_pair_cubes
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Operators.GlobalPa.text:
theorem energy_eq_zero_iff_global_pair_cubes {N Q : ℕ} (hQ : 2 ≤ Q)
    (ψ : State N Q) (hψ : Antisymmetric ψ) :
    energy ψ = 0 ↔ ∀ i j : Fin N, i < j → bracket i j^3 ∣ spinPolynomial ψ := by
  rw [energy_eq_zero_iff_affine_pair_cubes hQ ψ hψ]
  constructor
  · intro h i j hij
    exact (affine_pair_cubes_iff_bracket_dvd ψ i j (ne_of_lt hij)).mp (h i j hij)
  · intro h i j hij
    exact (affine_pair_cubes_iff_bracket_dvd ψ i j (ne_of_lt hij)).mpr (h i j hij)

end Laughlin

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.Inner:8.text:

  funext a

  have hr : star (((Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ : ℂ)) =

  rw [hr] at h

theorem normalizedTensorExterior_inner (n Q : ℕ) (ψ φ : State n Q)
    (hφ : Antisymmetric φ) :
    occupationInner Q (normalizedTensorExterior n Q ψ) (normalizedTensorExterior n Q φ) =
      ∑ a, star (ψ a)*φ a := by
  have hp : 0 < (n.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos n
  have hs : Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hp)
  have he : ((Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℂ))^2 = (n.factorial : ℂ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hp)
  simp only [normalizedTensorExterior,occupationInner_smul_left,occupationInner_smul_right,
    tensorExterior_inner n Q ψ φ hφ]
  simp only [Complex.star_def, map_inv₀, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hsc : (Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hs
  rw [← he]
  field_simp

  rw [energy_head_pair n Q _ (normalizedTensorReadout_antisymmetric (n+2) Q x)]
  have hp := (sourceFockEnergy_eq_zero Q x).mp hx
  have hs : (∑ p ∈ Finset.range (2*Q-1), ∑ b : Configuration n Q,
      ‖headPairAmplitude (normalizedTensorReadout (n+2) Q x) p b‖^2) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero

  rw [hs,mul_zero]

theorem fockInequality_eventual_of_certificates {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (rows : ι → ComparisonRow) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hThree : ∀ z : ComparedThreeBlock,
      planarRowsThreeTrace rows z.val.val <
        (3/2 : ℝ)*(3*(z.val.val : ℝ)-1)*(-1/2)^z.val.val)
    (hFour : ∀ D, 1 ≤ D → D ≤ 23 →
      (planarFourGram D * planarFourComparison rows ε D * planarFourGram D).PosSemidef) :
    ∃ e : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ Q, 0 ≤ e Q) ∧ Tendsto e atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ Q in atTop, FockInequality Q (1-rowsEta rows-tailCoefficient Q-1222*ε-e Q) := by
  obtain ⟨e, hepos, helim, he⟩ := averagedRowsFour_eventual_bound rows ε hε hFour
  refine ⟨e, hepos, helim, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [threeTraceForm_eventual_bound rows hThree, eventually_ge_atTop 24] with Q h3 hQ
  have htail : (tailThreeTarget Q + tailCoefficient Q • hamiltonian Q).PosSemidef := by
    rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K:=ℂ), RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal]
    exact tailThreeTarget_relative_bound (Q:=Q) (by omega)
  have hf := fockInequality_of_finite_comparisons rows (by omega : 16 ≤ Q)
    (averagedRowsFour (by omega : 8 ≤ Q) rows) (tailCoefficient Q) (1222*ε+e Q)
    (averagedRows_positive rows (by omega)) h3 (he Q hQ) htail
  convert hf using 1
  ring

theorem tailCoefficient_tendsto :
    Tendsto tailCoefficient atTop (𝓝 (61/4096 : ℝ)) := by
  have h := tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence tailBound_summable tailTerm_tendsto
    (show ∀ᶠ Q in atTop, ∀ m, ‖tailTerm Q m‖ ≤
      6 * ((17+2*m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((17+2*m : ℕ)+1) * (2/3 : ℝ)^(17+2*m) from
      (eventually_ge_atTop 4).mono (fun _ hQ m => tailTerm_bound hQ m))
  rw [limit_tail_hasSum.tsum_eq] at h
  exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun Q => (tailCoefficient_eq_tsum Q).symm))

theorem integer_threshold_of_certificates_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (rows : ι → ComparisonRow)
    (hEta : rowsEta rows ≤ 93527408868499 / 10^14)
    (hThree : ∀ z : ComparedThreeBlock,
      planarRowsThreeTrace rows z.val.val <
        (3/2 : ℝ)*(3*(z.val.val : ℝ)-1)*(-1/2)^z.val.val)
    (hFour : ∀ D, 1 ≤ D → D ≤ 23 →
      (planarFourGram D * planarFourComparison rows (3/10^6) D * planarFourGram D).PosSemidef)
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ < gammaStar) :
    ∃ Qγ : ℤ, 1 ≤ Qγ ∧ ∀ Q : ℤ, Qγ ≤ Q → FockInequality Q.toNat γ := by
  obtain ⟨e, _, helim, hb⟩ :=
    fockInequality_eventual_of_certificates rows (3/10^6) (by norm_num) hThree hFour
  have hl : Tendsto (fun Q => 1-(93527408868499 / 10^14 : ℝ)-
      tailCoefficient Q-1222*(3/10^6)-e Q) atTop (𝓝 gammaStar) := by
    have h := (((tendsto_const_nhds (x := 1-(93527408868499 / 10^14 : ℝ))).sub
      tailCoefficient_tendsto).sub_const (1222*(3/10^6))).sub helim
    simpa only [sub_zero, final_margin_arithmetic] using h
  apply uniform_integer_threshold_of_eventual_bound _ hl _ γ hγ
  filter_upwards [hb] with Q hQ
  exact hQ.mono (by linarith only [hEta])

OAI.Analysis.LaughlinFock.IntegerCompres.name: OAI.LaughlinFock.planar_certificate_of_integer
OAI.Analysis.LaughlinFock.IntegerCompres.text:
theorem planar_certificate_of_integer (D : ℕ)
    (h : ((integerCompression D).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).PosSemidef) :
    (planarFourGram D * planarFourComparison certificateRows (3/10^6) D *
      planarFourGram D).PosSemidef := by
  classical
  let d : Matrix (CopyLabel D) (CopyLabel D) ℂ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun r => (Real.sqrt (rationalCopyDiagonal D r.val.val : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let G := (integerFourGram D).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)
  let Y := (integerRowsFourTrace D).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)
  let u : CopyLabel D → ℂ := fun r => (rationalCopyDiagonal D r.val.val : ℂ)
  let c : CopyLabel D → ℂ := fun r => (if r.val.val=1 then 2 else 0)+3/10^6
  have hd : dᴴ = d := by
    ext r s
    by_cases hrs : r=s <;> simp [d, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hrs, eq_comm]
  have hDD : d*d=Matrix.diagonal u := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext r
    have hu : 0 ≤ (rationalCopyDiagonal D r.val.val : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (rationalCopyDiagonal_pos D r.val.val).le
    change (Real.sqrt (rationalCopyDiagonal D r.val.val : ℝ) : ℂ)*
      (Real.sqrt (rationalCopyDiagonal D r.val.val : ℝ) : ℂ) = _
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt hu]
    simp [u]
  have hc : d*Matrix.diagonal c*d = Matrix.diagonal (fun r => c r*u r) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    funext r
    have hv := congrFun (congrFun hDD r) r
    simp only [d, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq] at hv
    rw [mul_right_comm, hv]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  have hG : planarFourGram D = d*G*d := by
    ext r s
    rw [planarFourGram_rational, rationalFourGram_integer]
    simp [d,G,Matrix.diagonal_mul,Matrix.mul_diagonal, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  have hE : (Matrix.of (fun r s => ((∑ t : Fin 8,
      planarRowFourTrace D (certificateRows t).t.val (certificateRows t).alpha r s : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
      d*Y*d := by
    ext r s
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal, d,Y,
      Matrix.map_apply, integerRowsFourTrace, Matrix.sum_apply, map_sum, Complex.ofReal_sum,
      Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    change ((planarRowFourTrace D t.val (rationalComparisonRow t (certificateEll t)
      (certificateAlpha t)).alpha r s : ℝ) : ℂ) = _
    rw [planarRowFourTrace_rational D t (certificateEll t) (certificateAlpha t),
      rationalFourTrace_integer]
    simp
  have hC : planarFourComparison certificateRows (3/10^6) D = Matrix.diagonal c - d*Y*d := by
    rw [planarFourComparison, hE]
    have hct : (2:ℂ) • targetCopy D + ((3/10^6:ℝ):ℂ) • (1:Matrix (CopyLabel D) (CopyLabel D) ℂ) =
        Matrix.diagonal c := by
      ext r s
      by_cases he : r=s
      · subst s
        simp [targetCopy, c, Matrix.smul_apply]
      · have hf : ¬ (r.val.val=1 ∧ s.val.val=1) := by
          intro hh
          apply he
          apply Subtype.ext
          apply Fin.ext
          omega
        simp [targetCopy, c, Matrix.smul_apply, he, hf]
    rw [← hct]
    abel
  have hM : (integerFourMiddle D).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun r => c r*u r) - Matrix.diagonal u*Y*Matrix.diagonal u := by
    ext r s
    simp only [integerFourMiddle, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
      Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    by_cases hrs : r=s
    · subst s
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
      dsimp [c,u,Y]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    · simp [hrs, c,u,Y]
  have hfull : planarFourGram D * planarFourComparison certificateRows (3/10^6) D *
      planarFourGram D = d*((integerCompression D).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ))*d := by
    rw [hG, hC, integerCompression, Matrix.map_mul, Matrix.map_mul, hM]
    calc
      _ = d*(G*(d*Matrix.diagonal c*d-(d*d)*Y*(d*d))*G)*d := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hDD, hc]
  rw [hfull]
  simpa only [hd] using h.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same d

end LaughlinFock
end

theorem uniform_integer_threshold_of_eventual_bound (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 gammaStar))
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ Q in atTop, FockInequality Q (a Q))
    (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ < gammaStar) :
    ∃ Qγ : ℤ, 1 ≤ Qγ ∧ ∀ Q : ℤ, Qγ ≤ Q → FockInequality Q.toNat γ := by
  have he : ∀ᶠ Q in atTop, γ < a Q := ha.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hγ)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hbound.and he)
  refine ⟨(max 1 q : ℕ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact_mod_cast (le_max_left 1 q)
  · intro Q hQ
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := le_trans (by positivity) hQ
    have hqn : max 1 q ≤ Q.toNat := by exact_mod_cast (show (max 1 q : ℤ) ≤ (Q.toNat : ℤ) by simpa [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hQ0] using hQ)
    exact (hq Q.toNat (le_trans (le_max_right 1 q) hqn)).1.mono
      (hq Q.toNat (le_trans (le_max_right 1 q) hqn)).2.le

OAI.Analysis.LaughlinGap.GlobalBound:36.text:
lemma occupation_square_of_real_square {Q : ℕ} (γ : ℝ)
    (h : γ • physicalHamiltonian Q ≤ physicalHamiltonian Q * physicalHamiltonian Q) :
    ∀ x : Occupation.Hilbert (Q+1), γ * Occupation.localPairEnergy (Q+1) (2*Q-1) Q x ≤
      ‖Occupation.physicalOccupationHamiltonian Q x‖^2 := by
  have hp := complexify_positive (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (sub_nonneg.mpr h))
  intro x
  have hx := hp.re_inner_nonneg_right x
  simp only [map_sub,map_mul,map_smul,complexify_physicalHamiltonian,
    LinearMap.sub_apply,LinearMap.smul_apply,Module.End.mul_apply,inner_sub_right,
    inner_smul_right_eq_smul] at hx
  rw [← (Occupation.physicalOccupationHamiltonian_positive Q).isSymmetric x
    (Occupation.physicalOccupationHamiltonian Q x),inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K] at hx
  change 0 ≤ ((‖Occupation.physicalOccupationHamiltonian Q x‖:ℂ)^2).re -
    (γ • inner ℂ x (Occupation.physicalOccupationHamiltonian Q x)).re at hx
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.real_smul,Complex.mul_re,
    Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,sub_zero,
    Occupation.physicalOccupationHamiltonian_inner] at hx
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hx

        ‖physicalOccupationHamiltonian Q x‖ ^ 2) : MainTarget := by

theorem finite_degree_endpoint (L : ℕ) (x : Space L) (hx : DegreeAtMost L L x) :

      squareNorm L (planarHamiltonian L) (fun A => (occupationBasis L).repr x A) := by

    (lt_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1/25) one_twenty_fifth_lt_gammaStar)

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Fock.SharpGap:16.name: OAI.Laughlin.one_twenty_fifth_lt_gammaStar

OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Planar.Forms:28.name: OAI.Laughlin.Planar.full_planar_endpoint
OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Planar.Forms:28.text:
theorem full_planar_endpoint {N : ℕ} (ψ : HomogeneousState N) :
    ENNReal.ofReal gammaStar * fullEnergy ψ ≤ fullSquareNorm ψ := by
  unfold fullEnergy fullSquareNorm
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
  apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
  intro L
  have hd : DegreeAtMost L L (ψ.block L) := by
    intro A hA
    exact ψ.homogeneous L A (Or.inr (ne_of_gt hA))
  have h := finite_degree_endpoint L (ψ.block L) hd
  have hγ : 0 ≤ gammaStar :=
    le_of_lt (lt_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1/25) one_twenty_fifth_lt_gammaStar)
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hγ]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h

end Laughlin.Planar

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.ExtremizerMass.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.ExtremizerProof.sharp_times_extremizer_integral
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.ExtremizerMass.text:
lemma sharp_times_extremizer_integral {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 1/2 < γ) :
    sharpConstant γ * (∫ x, (equalityPotential γ x)^(γ+1/2)) = 1 := by
  have hσ : 0 < γ-1/2 := by linarith
  have hr : 0 < (γ-1/2)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hσ
  have hpow : γ+1/2 = 1+(γ-1/2) := by ring
  change sharpConstant γ * (∫ x, (potential ((γ-1/2)⁻¹) x)^(γ+1/2)) = 1
  rw [hpow,potential_power_integral hr]
  have hc := action_constant_eq_sharp hσ
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at hc
  rw [← hc]
  calc
    _ = actionYoungConstant (γ-1/2)*(((γ-1/2)⁻¹+1)^(1+(γ-1/2))/(γ-1/2)⁻¹) := by
      rw [mul_comm _ (betaAction (γ-1/2)),← mul_assoc,div_mul_cancel₀ _ (betaAction_pos hσ).ne']
    _ = 1 := young_times_extremizer_factor hσ

end SharpLiebThirring.ExtremizerProof

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main:10.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.sharp_times_extremizer_mass
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main:10.text:
lemma sharp_times_extremizer_mass {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 1/2 < γ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ)*potentialMass γ (equalityPotential γ) = 1 := by
  rw [(equalityPotential_admissible hγ).mass_eq_ofReal hγ,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sharpConstant_pos hγ).le,
    sharp_times_extremizer_integral hγ,ENNReal.ofReal_one]

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main:16.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.optimalConstant_le_sharp
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main:16.text:
lemma optimalConstant_le_sharp {γ : ℝ} (hγ₀ : 1/2 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 3/2) :
    optimalConstant γ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ) := by
  unfold optimalConstant
  refine iSup_le (fun W ↦ iSup_le (fun hW ↦ iSup_le (fun _ ↦ ?_)))
  exact ENNReal.div_le_of_le_mul (negativeMoment_bound hγ₀ hγ₁ hW)

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main:38.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.sharp_lieb_thirring
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main:38.text:
theorem sharp_lieb_thirring : MainClaim := by
  intro γ hγ₀ hγ₁
  have hupper := optimalConstant_le_sharp hγ₀ hγ₁
  have hlower := sharp_le_oneStateConstant hγ₀
  have hone := oneStateConstant_le_optimalConstant γ
  have hr : 0 < (γ-1/2)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hW := equalityPotential_admissible hγ₀
  refine ⟨fun _ hW ↦ negativeMoment_bound hγ₀ hγ₁ hW,
    le_antisymm hupper (hlower.trans hone),le_antisymm (hone.trans hupper) hlower,
    hW,potential_mass_pos hr,?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm (negativeMoment_bound hγ₀ hγ₁ hW)
  rw [sharp_times_extremizer_mass hγ₀]
  exact one_le_negativeMoment hr γ

end SharpLiebThirring

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.MomentBound:72.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.negativeMoment_bound
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.MomentBound:72.text:
lemma negativeMoment_bound {γ : ℝ} (hγ₀ : 1/2 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 3/2)
    {W : ℝ → ℝ} (hW : Admissible γ W) :
    negativeMoment γ W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ)*potentialMass γ W := by
  unfold negativeMoment
  refine iSup_le (fun N ↦ iSup_le (fun u ↦ iSup_le (fun k ↦ iSup_le (fun ho ↦ iSup_le (fun he ↦ ?_)))))
  have hh := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (finite_complex_eigenfamily_bound hγ₀ hγ₁ hW u k ho he)
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ Real.rpow_nonneg (he i).1.le _),
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sharpConstant_pos hγ₀).le,← hW.mass_eq_ofReal hγ₀] at hh
  simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (he _).1.le (show 0 ≤ 2*γ by linarith)] using hh

end SharpLiebThirring

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main:22.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.sharp_le_oneStateConstant
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main:22.text:
lemma sharp_le_oneStateConstant {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 1/2 < γ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ) ≤ oneStateConstant γ := by
  have hr : 0 < (γ-1/2)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hW := equalityPotential_admissible hγ
  have hpos : 0 < potentialMass γ (equalityPotential γ) := potential_mass_pos hr
  have hle : ENNReal.ofReal (sharpConstant γ) ≤
      oneStateMoment γ (equalityPotential γ) / potentialMass γ (equalityPotential γ) := by
    apply (ENNReal.le_div_iff_mul_le (Or.inl hpos.ne') (Or.inl (hW.mass_ne_top hγ))).mpr
    rw [sharp_times_extremizer_mass hγ]
    exact one_le_oneStateMoment hr γ
  unfold oneStateConstant
  exact hle.trans (le_iSup_of_le (equalityPotential γ)
    (le_iSup_of_le hW (le_iSup_of_le hpos le_rfl)))

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.MomentBound:51.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.finite_complex_eigenfamily_bound
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.MomentBound:51.text:
lemma finite_complex_eigenfamily_bound {N : ℕ} {γ : ℝ}
    (hγ₀ : 1/2 < γ) (hγ₁ : γ < 3/2) {W : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hW : Admissible γ W) (u : Fin N → H1) (k : Fin N → ℝ)
    (ho : IsOrthonormalFamily u) (he : ∀ i, IsNegativeEigenfunction W (k i) (u i)) :
    (∑ i, k i^(2*γ)) ≤ sharpConstant γ*∫ x, W x^(γ+1/2) := by
  have hWl := hW.locallyIntegrable hγ₀
  choose a ha har using (fun i ↦ eigen_C1_representative hWl (he i) Complex.reCLM)
  choose b hb hbi using (fun i ↦ eigen_C1_representative hWl (he i) Complex.imCLM)
  have hr (i j : Fin N) : inner ℝ (a i) (a j)+inner ℝ (b i) (b j) = if i=j then 1 else 0 := by
    have hh := congrArg Complex.re (ho i j)
    rw [re_l2Pairing (har i) (hbi i) (har j) (hbi j)] at hh
    simpa only [apply_ite,Complex.one_re,Complex.zero_re] using hh
  have hi (i j : Fin N) : inner ℝ (a i) (b j)-inner ℝ (b i) (a j) = 0 := by
    have hh := congrArg Complex.im (ho i j)
    rw [im_l2Pairing (har i) (hbi i) (har j) (hbi j)] at hh
    simpa only [apply_ite,Complex.one_im,Complex.zero_im,ite_self] using hh
  obtain ⟨J,hJ,v,l,hvo,hve,hl,hs⟩ := realify_finite_family hWl k (fun i ↦ (he i).1) a b ha hb hr hi (2*γ)
  let := hJ
  exact hs.trans (real_family_bound hγ₀ hγ₁ hWl hW.1 (hW.integrable_rpow hγ₀) v l hvo hve hl)

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.MomentBound:42.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.sharpConstant_pos
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.MomentBound:42.text:
lemma sharpConstant_pos {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 1/2 < γ) : 0 < sharpConstant γ := by
  have hσ : 0 < γ-1/2 := by linarith
  have he := action_constant_eq_sharp hσ
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at he
  rw [← he]
  apply div_pos _ (betaAction_pos hσ)
  unfold actionYoungConstant
  positivity

OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.MomentBound:27.name: OAI.SharpLiebThirring.Admissible.mass_eq_ofReal
OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.MomentBound:27.text:
lemma Admissible.mass_eq_ofReal {γ : ℝ} {W : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hW : Admissible γ W) (hγ : 1/2 < γ) :
    potentialMass γ W = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, W x^(γ+1/2)) := by
  rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hW.integrable_rpow hγ)]
  · apply lintegral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hW.1] with x hx
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hx (by linarith)
  · filter_upwards [hW.1] with x hx
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg hx _

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzEquivalence.Compac.name: OAI.LipschitzCounterexample.CompactWSC.compact_supported_wsc
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzEquivalence.Compac.text:
theorem compact_supported_wsc (K : Set H) (hK : IsCompact K) (h0 : (0:H) ∈ K) :
    WeakSequences.WeakSequentiallyComplete (supported K) := by
  intro u hu
  by_contra hno
  let : CompleteSpace (supported K) := (supported_isClosed K).completeSpace_coe
  obtain ⟨φ,d,hd,hφ,hfar⟩ := WeakSequences.nonconvergent_biddual_gap hu hno
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := hu.bounded
  let C := max B 1
  have hC : 0 < C := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1) (le_max_right _ _)
  have huC (n : ℕ) : ‖u n‖ ≤ C := (hB n).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  let α := d/32
  let ρ := α/16
  have hα : 0 < α := div_pos hd (by norm_num)
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := div_pos hα (by norm_num)
  have hρα : ρ ≤ α/4 := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith
  have hαd : 32*α ≤ d := by dsimp [α]; linarith
  have hRich := triangularRows_rich h0 u φ hφ hd hC hρ hα hρα hαd huC hfar
  let Q := closure (convexHull ℝ K)
  have hQ : IsCompact Q := (hK.totallyBounded.convexHull.closure).isCompact_of_isClosed isClosed_closure
  have hQc : Convex ℝ Q := (convex_convexHull ℝ K).closure
  have hKQ : K ⊆ Q := (subset_convexHull ℝ K).trans subset_closure
  obtain ⟨T,a,hT,hdiag,hWUC⟩ := exists_wuc_duals h0 hQ hQc hKQ hC.le hα hRich
  let S : ℕ → supported K →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun i => (T i).comp (supported K).subtypeL
  have hS : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ i, |c i| ≤ 1) → ∀ x : supported K,
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i*S i x| ≤ 2*‖x‖ :=
    fun n c hc x => hWUC n c hc x.val x.property
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := WeakSequences.uniform_small_of_wuc S hS hu (show 0<α/4 by positivity)
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := (a N).close
  have hclose : |T N (u k)-T N (a N).a.vector| < 2*ρ := by
    rw [← map_sub,← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact ((T N).le_opNorm _).trans_lt (by nlinarith [hT N,norm_nonneg (T N),norm_nonneg ((u k : Space H)-(a N).a.vector)])
  have hsmall : |T N (u k)| < α/4 := hN N le_rfl k
  have hlarge := hdiag N
  have hl := (abs_lt.mp hclose).1
  have hs := (abs_lt.mp hsmall).2
  dsimp [ρ] at hl
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Geometry.S.name: OAI.LipschitzHilbert.selected_counting_energy
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Geometry.S.text:
theorem selected_counting_energy {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {n : ℕ}
    (D : Fin n → Rectangle)
    (hD : ∀ T : Rectangle, ∃ i, dist ((D i).axes 0) (T.axes 1) < 1/4)
    (R : ι → Rectangle) (stock : Finset ι) (selected : List ι)
    (hrun : RectangleCoverRun R
      (maximalBlocked (fun i => (D i).orthogonalCoordinates) R
        selectionDilation (by norm_num) selectionThreshold) ∅ stock selected)
    {v : Plane → Plane} {K δ : ℝ≥0} (hv : LipschitzWith K v) (hu : ∀ x, ‖v x‖ = 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hR : ∀ j ∈ stock, (R j).Admissible v K δ) :
    (δ : ℝ≥0∞)*(∫⁻ x, (rectangleCount R selected.toFinset x)^2) ≤
      1923*(∑ j ∈ selected.toFinset, volume (R j).carrier) := by
  let A := ∑ j ∈ selected.toFinset, volume (R j).carrier
  have hn := selected_near_energy D hD R hrun (by simp) (by simp)
  have hn' : orderedPairSum (nearPair R) selected ≤ A := by
    simpa only [previousPairSum,Finset.sum_empty,Finset.sum_const_zero,zero_add] using hn
  have hf := selected_far_energy D hD R hrun hv hu hδ hR
  have hd : (δ : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hδ1.le
  have hdn : (δ : ℝ≥0∞)*orderedPairSum (nearPair R) selected ≤ A := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 1*A := mul_le_mul' hd hn'
      _ = A := one_mul _
  have hda : (δ : ℝ≥0∞)*A ≤ A := by simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul' hd (le_refl A)
  have hsplit : orderedPairSum (overlapPair R) selected =
      orderedPairSum (nearPair R) selected+orderedPairSum (farPair R) selected := by
    have he : overlapPair R = fun i j => nearPair R i j+farPair R i j := by
      funext i j
      exact overlapPair_split R i j
    rw [he,orderedPairSum_split]
  rw [rectangleCount_second_moment]
  change (δ : ℝ≥0∞)*(∑ i ∈ selected.toFinset, ∑ j ∈ selected.toFinset, overlapPair R i j) ≤ 1923*A
  rw [list_overlap_energy R selected hrun.selected_nodup,hsplit]
  calc
    _ = (δ : ℝ≥0∞)*A+2*((δ : ℝ≥0∞)*orderedPairSum (nearPair R) selected)+
        2*((δ : ℝ≥0∞)*orderedPairSum (farPair R) selected) := by ring
    _ ≤ A+2*A+2*(960*A) := add_le_add (add_le_add hda (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hdn))
      (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hf)
    _ = _ := by ring

end LipschitzHilbert

end

def rectangleMaximum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (R : ι → Rectangle)
    (h : Plane → ℝ) (x : Plane) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  by
    classical
    exact Finset.univ.sup fun i => if x ∈ (R i).carrier then (R i).average h else 0

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Estimates..name: OAI.LipschitzHilbert.LaceyLiInput
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Estimates..text:
def LaceyLiInput : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ≥0, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (v : Plane → Plane) (K δ : ℝ≥0),
      LipschitzWith K v → (∀ x, ‖v x‖ = 1) → 0 < δ → δ < 1 →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : Fin n → Rectangle),
        (∀ i, (R i).Admissible v K δ) →
        ∀ (h : Plane → ℝ), MemLp h 2 volume → ∀ t : ℝ≥0, 0 < t →
          (t : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 * volume {x | (t : ℝ≥0∞) < rectangleMaximum R h x} ≤
            (C : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 / (δ : ℝ≥0∞) * squareIntegral volume h

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Geometry.L.name: OAI.LipschitzHilbert.laceyLiInput_proved
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Geometry.L.text:
theorem laceyLiInput_proved : LaceyLiInput := by
  obtain ⟨m,D,hD⟩ := Rectangle.exists_finite_transverse_directions
  let B : ℝ≥0∞ := 1+(9+3*(m:ℝ≥0∞))*selectionThreshold⁻¹*ENNReal.ofReal (selectionDilation^2)
  have hη0 : selectionThreshold ≠ 0 := by
    exact ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by norm_num))
  have hηtop : selectionThreshold ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hBtop : B ≠ ∞ := by
    dsimp [B]
    exact ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨by simp,
      ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.mul_ne_top
        (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨by norm_num,ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by norm_num) (by simp)⟩)
        (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr hη0))
        ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top⟩
  have hBCtop : B*1923 ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.mul_ne_top hBtop (by norm_num)
  let C : ℝ≥0 := max 1 (B*1923).toNNReal
  have hC1 : 1 ≤ C := le_max_left _ _
  have hCpos : 0 < C := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC1
  have hBC : B*1923 ≤ (C:ℝ≥0∞) := by
    rw [←ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hBCtop]
    exact_mod_cast (le_max_right (1:ℝ≥0) (B*1923).toNNReal)
  have hCsq : B*1923 ≤ (C:ℝ≥0∞)^2 := by
    refine hBC.trans ?_
    have h1 : (1:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ C := by exact_mod_cast hC1
    simpa only [one_mul,pow_two] using mul_le_mul' h1 (le_refl (C:ℝ≥0∞))
  refine ⟨C,hCpos,?_⟩
  intro v K δ hv hu hδ hδ1 n R hR h hh t ht
  let stock : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (t:ℝ≥0∞) < (R i).average h)
  obtain ⟨selected,hrun⟩ := rectangle_cover_run_maximal_exists
    (fun i => (D i).orthogonalCoordinates) R selectionDilation (by norm_num) selectionThreshold stock
  have henergy := selected_counting_energy D hD R stock selected hrun hv hu hδ hδ1
    (fun i _ => hR i)
  have hδ0 : (δ:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hδ.ne'
  have hoverlap : (∫⁻ x, (rectangleCount R selected.toFinset x)^2) ≤
      (1923/(δ:ℝ≥0∞))*(∑ i ∈ selected.toFinset, volume (R i).carrier) := by
    calc
      _ = (δ:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹*((δ:ℝ≥0∞)*(∫⁻ x, (rectangleCount R selected.toFinset x)^2)) := by
        rw [←mul_assoc,ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hδ0 ENNReal.coe_ne_top,one_mul]
      _ ≤ (δ:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹*(1923*(∑ i ∈ selected.toFinset, volume (R i).carrier)) :=
        mul_le_mul' le_rfl henergy
      _ = _ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
  have hcover := maximal_selection_cover_bound (fun i => (D i).orthogonalCoordinates)
    (fun i => (D i).orthogonalCoordinates_measurePreserving) R selectionDilation (by norm_num)
    selectionThreshold hη0 hηtop stock selected hrun
  have hlevel : {x | (t:ℝ≥0∞) < rectangleMaximum R h x} ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ stock, (R i).carrier := by
    intro x hx
    change (t:ℝ≥0∞) < Finset.univ.sup (fun i => if x ∈ (R i).carrier then (R i).average h else 0) at hx
    obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := Finset.lt_sup_iff.mp hx
    by_cases hxi : x ∈ (R i).carrier
    · rw [ite_eq_left hxi] at hi
      exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨i,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i,hi⟩,hxi⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right hxi] at hi
      exact (not_lt_zero hi).elim
  have hcover' : volume {x | (t:ℝ≥0∞) < rectangleMaximum R h x} ≤
      B*(∑ i ∈ selected.toFinset, volume (R i).carrier) := by
    refine (measure_mono hlevel).trans ?_
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hcover
  have hhigh : ∀ i ∈ selected.toFinset, (t:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (R i).average h := by
    intro i hi
    have his := hrun.selected_subset i (List.mem_toFinset.mp hi)
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp his).2.le
  have hweak := covering_weak_bound R selected.toFinset
    {x | (t:ℝ≥0∞) < rectangleMaximum R h x} h hh.aestronglyMeasurable
    (t:ℝ≥0∞) B (1923/(δ:ℝ≥0∞)) hhigh hcover' hoverlap
  refine hweak.trans (mul_le_mul' ?_ le_rfl)
  calc
    B*(1923/(δ:ℝ≥0∞)) = (B*1923)*(δ:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
    _ ≤ (C:ℝ≥0∞)^2*(δ:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := mul_le_mul' hCsq le_rfl
    _ = _ := rfl

end LipschitzHilbert

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Geometry.L.name: OAI.LipschitzHilbert.covering_weak_bound
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Geometry.L.text:
theorem covering_weak_bound (R : ι → Rectangle) (s : Finset ι) (U : Set Plane)
    (h : Plane → ℝ) (hh : AEStronglyMeasurable h volume) (t B D : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hhigh : ∀ i∈s, t≤(R i).average h)
    (hcover : volume U≤B*(∑ i∈s,volume (R i).carrier))
    (hoverlap : (∫⁻ x, rectangleCount R s x^2)≤D*(∑ i∈s,volume (R i).carrier)) :
    t^2*volume U≤B*D*squareIntegral volume h := by
  calc
    _ ≤ t^2*(B*(∑ i∈s,volume (R i).carrier)) := mul_le_mul' le_rfl hcover
    _ = B*(t^2*(∑ i∈s,volume (R i).carrier)) := by ring
    _ ≤ B*(D*squareIntegral volume h) :=
      mul_le_mul' le_rfl (selected_area_from_overlap R s h hh t D hhigh hoverlap)
    _ = _ := by ring

end LipschitzHilbert

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Conditiona.name: OAI.LipschitzHilbert.ShortHilbertConclusion
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzHilbert.Conditiona.text:
def ShortHilbertConclusion (a : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : Plane → Plane, LipschitzWith 1 v → (∀ x, ‖v x‖=1) →
    (∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0<epsilon → epsilon<a → ∀ f : SchwartzMap Plane ℂ,
      eLpNorm (twoSidedTruncation v epsilon a f) 2 volume≤C*eLpNorm f 2 volume) ∧
    (∀ f : SchwartzMap Plane ℂ,
      eLpNorm (smoothPrincipalValue v a f) 2 volume≤C*eLpNorm f 2 volume) ∧
    (∀ f : SchwartzMap Plane ℂ, ∀ level : ℝ≥0∞, level≠0 → level≠∞ →
      volume {x | level<‖smoothPrincipalValue v a f x‖ₑ}≤
        level⁻¹^2*((C:ℝ≥0∞)*eLpNorm f 2 volume)^2) ∧
    (∀ epsilon : ℝ, 0<epsilon → epsilon<a →
      ∃ T : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure Plane) →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 volume,
        ‖T‖≤C ∧ ∀ f : SchwartzMap Plane ℂ,
          (T (f.toLp 2 volume) : Plane → ℂ)=ᵐ[volume] twoSidedTruncation v epsilon a f) ∧
    (∃ T : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure Plane) →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 volume,
      ‖T‖≤C ∧ ∀ f : SchwartzMap Plane ℂ,
        (T (f.toLp 2 volume) : Plane → ℂ)=ᵐ[volume] smoothPrincipalValue v a f)

OAI.Combinatorics.ListHadwiger.Recursive.name: OAI.LinearListHadwiger.Recursion.recursive_woven_or_obstruction
OAI.Combinatorics.ListHadwiger.Recursive.text:
theorem recursive_woven_or_obstruction : ∃ K Q : ℕ, 100≤K ∧ 1≤Q ∧
    ∀ a : ℕ, 1≤a → ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
      KConnectedOn G univ (K*a) → Q*a≤listChromaticNumber G →
      Woven G a (3*a) ∨ FractionalObstruction G := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,T₁,hT₁,houter⟩ := outer_region
  obtain ⟨S,hS,T₂,hT₂,hfresh⟩ := fresh_model
  let K := A+100
  let a₀ := max 24 (max T₁ T₂)
  let B := ⌊(200000000:ℝ)*(64*a₀:ℕ)*Real.log (2*(64*a₀:ℕ))⌋₊+1
  let c : ℕ := 4*32768+42+5+6*K₀
  let Q := B+A+18*K+512*S+40+256*c+1
  have hK : 100≤K := by dsimp [K]; omega
  have hQ : 1≤Q := by dsimp [Q]; omega
  have hQA : A+7<Q := by dsimp [Q]; omega
  have hQbig : 18*K+512*S+40+256*c<Q := by dsimp [Q]; omega
  have hQB : B<Q := by dsimp [Q]; omega
  refine ⟨K,Q,hK,hQ,?_⟩
  intro a
  induction a using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h a ih =>
    intro ha V _ _ G hc hl
    classical
    have hka : 100*a≤K*a := Nat.mul_le_mul_right a hK
    by_cases hminor : 64*a≤hadwigerNumber G
    · exact Or.inl (large_minor_woven G ha (Knitting.kConnected_mono hc hka) hminor)
    have hm : hadwigerNumber G<64*a := by omega
    have ha₀ : a₀<a := by
      by_contra hn
      have hma : hadwigerNumber G<64*a₀ := hm.trans_le (by omega)
      have hb := CoarseDensity.coarse_list_bound G (show 2≤64*a₀ by dsimp [a₀]; omega) hma
      change listChromaticNumber G≤B at hb
      nlinarith only [ha,hl,hQB,hb]
    have hac : 24<a := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt ha₀
    obtain ⟨hcpos,hclt,hcshrink⟩ := child_shrink hac
    have ht₁ : T₁≤64*a := by have := (le_max_left T₁ T₂).trans (le_max_right 24 _); omega
    have ht₂ : T₂≤64*a := by have := (le_max_right T₁ T₂).trans (le_max_right 24 _); omega
    by_cases hbad : FractionalObstruction G
    · exact Or.inr hbad
    left
    intro roots hr _ p hp x y _ hxy
    let O := Fin a ⊕ (Fin p × Bool)
    let port : O → V := Sum.elim roots (fun z => if z.2 then y z.1 else x z.1)
    let Z := univ.image port
    have hO : Fintype.card O=a+2*p := by simp [O]; omega
    have hZ : Z.card≤7*a := by
      have hh := card_image_le (s:=univ) (f:=port)
      rw [card_univ,hO] at hh
      calc Z.card≤a+2*p := hh
           _≤7*a := by omega
    obtain ⟨proxy,hproxy,hadj⟩ := distinct_proxies G port Z hc
      (show Fintype.card O+Z.card≤K*a by rw [hO]; omega)
    let R := univ\Z
    let P := G.induce (↑R:Set V)
    let proxy' (o : O) : (↑R:Set V) := ⟨proxy o,mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,(hadj o).1⟩⟩
    have hproxy' : Function.Injective proxy' := fun i j he => hproxy (congrArg Subtype.val he)
    let e : (Fin p × Bool) ≃ Fin (2*p) := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simp; omega)
    let r (i : Fin a) := proxy' (.inl i)
    let n (j : Fin (2*p)) := proxy' (.inr (e.symm j))
    have hr' : Function.Injective r := hproxy'.comp Sum.inl_injective
    have hn' : Function.Injective n := hproxy'.comp (Sum.inr_injective.comp e.symm.injective)
    have hrn (i j) : r i≠n j := by intro he; cases hproxy' he
    have hcR : KConnectedOn G R (30*a) := by
      apply Knitting.kConnected_mono (Knitting.delete_connected G hc (subset_univ Z) (by omega))
      omega
    have hcP : KConnectedOn P univ (30*a) := connected_induce_univ G R hcR
    have hmP : hadwigerNumber P<64*a := (Knitting.model_induce G R).hadwiger_le.trans_lt hm
    have hdel := ell_delete G univ Z
    rw [ell_univ] at hdel
    change listChromaticNumber G≤listChromaticNumber P+Z.card at hdel
    have hQAa := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hQA (show 0<a by omega)
    have hPA : A*a<listChromaticNumber P := by nlinarith only [hQAa,hdel,hl,hZ]
    have noP : ¬FractionalObstruction P := fun hb => hbad (obstruction_induce G R hb)
    obtain ⟨H,D,U,⟨routing⟩,hHD,hHc,hDc,hHl⟩ :=
      (houter a ha ht₁ p hp (↑R:Set V) P r n hr' hn' hrn hcP hmP hPA).resolve_right noP
    have hcall (W : Type) [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (L : SimpleGraph W)
        (hconn : KConnectedOn L univ (K*child a)) (hlist : Q*child a≤listChromaticNumber L) :
        Woven L (child a) (3*child a) ∨ FractionalObstruction L :=
      ih (child a) hclt hcpos W L hconn hlist
    have hsep : 3*S*(64*a)+3*a≤ell P H := by
      change listChromaticNumber P≤ell P H+c*(64*a) at hHl
      have hb : 192*S+10+64*c<Q := by omega
      have hh := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb (show 0<a by omega)
      nlinarith only [hh,hHl,hdel,hl,hZ]
    have hstep : Q*child a+6*(K*child a)+2*S*(64*a)+3*a<ell P H := by
      change listChromaticNumber P≤ell P H+c*(64*a) at hHl
      have hq := Nat.mul_le_mul_left Q hcshrink
      have hk := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (6*K) hcshrink
      have hh := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hQbig (show 0<a by omega)
      nlinarith only [hh,hq,hk,hHl,hdel,hl,hZ]
    obtain ⟨M,hMH⟩ := (hfresh a K Q ha (by omega) ht₂ hcall (↑R:Set V) P H routing.fresh
      routing.fresh_injective routing.fresh_mem hmP hHc hsep hstep).resolve_right noP
    have hgroup : KConnectedOn P D (65536*Fintype.card (Roles a (2*p))) := by
      apply Knitting.kConnected_mono hDc
      simp only [Roles,Fintype.card_sum,Fintype.card_fin]
      dsimp [K₀]
      omega
    obtain ⟨C₀,hC₀,hCC₀,hE₀,hrC₀,hnC₀⟩ := junction_groups P ha r n e H D _ U hHD routing M hMH hgroup
    let lift := Knitting.model_induce G R
    let C (i : Fin a ⊕ Fin p) := lift.expand (C₀ i)
    have hC (i) : (G.induce (C i)).Connected := lift.expand_connected (hC₀ i)
    have hCC (i j) (hij : i≠j) : Disjoint (C i) (C j) := lift.expand_disjoint (hCC₀ i j hij)
    have hCZ (i v) (hv : v∈C i) : v∉Z := by
      obtain ⟨w,_,hw⟩ := hv
      have he : v=w.val := hw
      exact he ▸ (mem_sdiff.mp w.property).2
    have hpZ (o : O) : port o∈Z := mem_image.mpr ⟨o,mem_univ _,rfl⟩
    apply weaving_from_proxy_groups G roots x y hr hxy C hC hCC
      (fun i j hv => hCZ i _ hv (hpZ (.inl j)))
      (fun i j hv => hCZ i _ hv (hpZ (.inr (j,false))))
      (fun i j hv => hCZ i _ hv (hpZ (.inr (j,true))))
    · intro i j hij
      obtain ⟨v,hv,w,hw,he⟩ := hE₀ i j hij
      exact ⟨v.val,⟨v,hv,rfl⟩,w.val,⟨w,hw,rfl⟩,he⟩
    · intro i
      exact ⟨proxy (.inl i),⟨r i,hrC₀ i,rfl⟩,(hadj (.inl i)).2⟩
    · intro i
      have hh := hnC₀ (i,false)
      have he : n (e (i,false))=proxy' (.inr (i,false)) := by simp [n]
      rw [he] at hh
      exact ⟨proxy (.inr (i,false)),⟨proxy' (.inr (i,false)),hh,rfl⟩,(hadj (.inr (i,false))).2⟩
    · intro i
      have hh := hnC₀ (i,true)
      have he : n (e (i,true))=proxy' (.inr (i,true)) := by simp [n]
      rw [he] at hh
      exact ⟨proxy (.inr (i,true)),⟨proxy' (.inr (i,true)),hh,rfl⟩,(hadj (.inr (i,true))).2⟩

end LinearListHadwiger.Recursion

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ListHadwiger.Main:52.name: OAI.LinearListHadwiger.SmallList.no_fractionalObstruction
OAI.Combinatorics.ListHadwiger.Main:52.text:
lemma no_fractionalObstruction {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) : ¬ FractionalObstruction G := by
  rintro ⟨S,hS⟩
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (Fractional.number_le_four_hadwiger (G.induce (↑S : Set V)))) hS
end SmallList

OAI.Combinatorics.ListHadwiger.Reduction.name: OAI.LinearListHadwiger.Recursion.final_bound_or_obstruction
OAI.Combinatorics.ListHadwiger.Reduction.text:
theorem final_bound_or_obstruction : ∃ C : ℕ, 1≤C ∧
    ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V),
      listChromaticNumber G≤C*hadwigerNumber G ∨
        FractionalObstruction G := by
  obtain ⟨K,Q,hK,hQ,hs⟩ := recursive_woven_or_obstruction
  refine ⟨2*(Q+6*K),by omega,?_⟩
  intro V _ _ G
  classical
  by_cases hb : FractionalObstruction G
  · exact Or.inr hb
  left
  have hminorfree (t : ℕ) (ht : 2≤t) (hm : hadwigerNumber G<t) :
      listChromaticNumber G≤(Q+6*K)*t := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hl : (Q+6*K)*t<listChromaticNumber G := by omega
    have hk : 1≤K*t := by nlinarith
    obtain ⟨P,hPc,hPl⟩ := list_connectivity_extraction G hk (by nlinarith)
    have hlist : Q*t≤listChromaticNumber (G.induce (↑P:Set V)) := by
      change listChromaticNumber G-6*(K*t)≤ell G P at hPl
      change Q*t≤ell G P
      have he : (Q+6*K)*t=Q*t+6*(K*t) := by ring
      rw [he] at hl
      omega
    rcases hs t (by omega) (↑P:Set V) (G.induce (↑P:Set V))
      (connected_induce_univ G P hPc) hlist with hw|hbad
    swap
    · exact hb (obstruction_induce G P hbad)
    obtain ⟨r,hr,hrP⟩ := choose_vertices (show t≤P.card by have hh:=hPc.1; nlinarith)
    have h0 (i : Fin 0) : V := Fin.elim0 i
    obtain ⟨A⟩ := woven_induce G P hw r hr hrP 0 (by omega) h0 h0
      (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
    have hm' : HasCliqueMinor G t := ⟨A.model.branch,A.model.connected,A.model.disjoint,A.model.adjacent⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (cliqueMinor_le_hadwigerNumber hm')) hm
  have hpos := one_le_hadwigerNumber G
  have hfinal := hminorfree (hadwigerNumber G+1) (by omega) (by omega)
  nlinarith

end LinearListHadwiger.Recursion

end OAI

OAI.Algebra.Finitistic.Main:44.name: OAI.LittleFinitistic.Main.exists_counterexample
OAI.Algebra.Finitistic.Main:44.text:
theorem exists_counterexample :
    ∃ (A : Type) (_ : Ring A) (_ : Algebra ℂ A),
      FiniteDimensional ℂ A ∧ littleFinitisticDimension A = ⊤ ∧
        ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ N : ModuleCat.{0} A, Module.Finite A N ∧
          ((2*m-2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ projectiveDimension N ∧
            projectiveDimension N < ⊤ := by
  exact ⟨SelectedOrdinaryAlgebra.A, inferInstance, inferInstance, counterexample⟩

end LittleFinitistic.Main

end

end OAI

OAI.Algebra.Finitistic.Main:36.name: OAI.LittleFinitistic.Main.counterexample
OAI.Algebra.Finitistic.Main:36.text:
theorem counterexample : FiniteDimensional ℂ A ∧ littleFinitisticDimension A = ⊤ ∧
    ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ N : ModuleCat.{0} A, Module.Finite A N ∧
      ((2*m-2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ projectiveDimension N ∧ projectiveDimension N < ⊤ := by
  refine ⟨inferInstance, infinite_littleFinitisticDimension, ?_⟩
  intro m hm
  let : NeZero m := ⟨by omega⟩
  exact ⟨testModule m, inferInstance, projective_dimension_bounds m⟩

OAI.MeasureTheory.Integral.BoundedMoment.name: OAI.LittlewoodFiniteFlatness.tendsto_integral_rpow_of_bounded_moment
OAI.MeasureTheory.Integral.BoundedMoment.text:
theorem tendsto_integral_rpow_of_bounded_moment
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : ℕ → α → ℝ) (hg : ∀ n, Measurable (g n))
    (hb : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x, 0 ≤ g n x ∧ g n x ≤ 1)
    (k : ℕ) (_hk : 0 < k)
    (hmoment : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, g n x ^ k ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, g n x ^ p ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply tendsto_order.2
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    filter_upwards [hb] with n hn
    exact ha.trans_le (integral_nonneg fun x => Real.rpow_nonneg (hn x).1 p)
  · intro ε hε
    let δ : ℝ := (ε / 2) ^ (1 / p)
    have hδ : 0 < δ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _
    have hδp : δ ^ p = ε / 2 := by
      dsimp [δ]
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hp), Real.rpow_one]
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n => (∫ x, g n x ^ k ∂μ) / δ ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using hmoment.div_const (δ ^ k)
    have he : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (∫ x, g n x ^ k ∂μ) / δ ^ k < ε / 2 :=
      (tendsto_order.1 ht).2 (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    filter_upwards [hb, he] with n hn he
    have hi : Integrable (fun x => g n x ^ p) μ := by
      apply (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono'
        (((Real.continuous_rpow_const hp.le).measurable.comp (hg n)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      exact ae_of_all μ fun x => by
        change ‖g n x ^ p‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (hn x).1 p)]
        exact Real.rpow_le_one (hn x).1 (hn x).2 hp.le
    have hik : Integrable (fun x => g n x ^ k) μ := by
      apply (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' ((hg n).pow_const k).aestronglyMeasurable
      exact ae_of_all μ fun x => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (hn x).1 k)]
        simpa using pow_le_pow_left₀ (hn x).1 (hn x).2 k
    have hbound : (∫ x, g n x ^ p ∂μ) ≤ δ ^ p + (∫ x, g n x ^ k ∂μ) / δ ^ k := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫ x, (δ ^ p + g n x ^ k / δ ^ k) ∂μ :=
          integral_mono hi ((integrable_const _).add (hik.div_const _))
            (fun x => bounded_rpow_threshold (hn x).1 (hn x).2 hδ hp)
        _ = _ := by rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) (hik.div_const _), integral_div]; simp
    rw [hδp] at hbound
    linarith

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.circlePolynomial
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
def circlePolynomial {N : ℕ} (ε : Fin N → ℝ) : C(UnitAddCircle, ℂ) :=
  ∑ k : Fin N, (ε k : ℂ) • fourier (k : ℤ)

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.normalized_error_sq_tendsto
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma normalized_error_sq_tendsto :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∫ t : UnitAddCircle, (normalized N t - 1) ^ 2 ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.2
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [normalized_eventually_bound hmain (η := ε / 4) (by positivity),
    eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with N hb hN
  have hlo : 0 ≤ ∫ t : UnitAddCircle, (normalized N t - 1) ^ 2 ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg (fun t => sq_nonneg _)
  have hhi := normalized_error_sq_bound hN (η := ε / 4) (by positivity) hb
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hlo]
  linarith

end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.normalized_continuous
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma normalized_continuous (N : ℕ) : Continuous (normalized N) :=
  (circlePolynomial (chosenSigns N)).continuous.norm.div_const _

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.minimizingBits
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text: def minimizingBits (N : ℕ) : Fin N → Bool := Classical.choose (exists_minimizing_signing N)

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.normalized_nonneg
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma normalized_nonneg (N : ℕ) (t : UnitAddCircle) : 0 ≤ normalized N t :=
  div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.normalized_error_sq_bound
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma normalized_error_sq_bound {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hb : ∀ t, normalized N t ≤ 1 + η) :
    (∫ t : UnitAddCircle, (normalized N t - 1) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  let f := normalized N
  have hf : Continuous f := normalized_continuous N
  have hi := continuous_integrable f hf
  have hi2 := continuous_integrable (fun t => f t ^ 2) (hf.pow 2)
  have hE : (∫ t, f t ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1 := normalized_energy hN
  have hmul : (∫ t, f t ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ (1 + η) * ∫ t, f t ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono hi2 (hi.const_mul _)
    intro t
    have hp := normalized_nonneg N t
    have ht := hb t
    change f t ≤ 1 + η at ht
    change 0 ≤ f t at hp
    nlinarith
  rw [hE] at hmul
  have hmean : 1 / (1 + η) ≤ ∫ t, f t ∂μ :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1 + η)).2 (by nlinarith [hmul])
  have hrec : 1 - η ≤ 1 / (1 + η) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1 + η)).2 (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg η])
  have hid : (∫ t, (f t - 1) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 2 - 2 * ∫ t, f t ∂μ := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ t, (f t ^ 2 - 2 * f t) + 1 ∂μ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [] with t
        ring
      _ = 2 - 2 * ∫ t, f t ∂μ := by
        rw [integral_add (f := fun t => f t ^ 2 - 2 * f t) (g := fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
          (hi2.sub (hi.const_mul 2)) (integrable_const 1),
          integral_sub (f := fun t => f t ^ 2) (g := fun t => 2 * f t)
            hi2 (hi.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul, hE]
        simp
        ring
  change (∫ t, (f t - 1) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 2 * η
  rw [hid]
  linarith

include hmain in

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.FlatnessModel:16.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.IsRealSigning
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.FlatnessModel:16.text:
def IsRealSigning {N : ℕ} (ε : Fin N → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, ε k = -1 ∨ ε k = 1

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.FlatnessModel:12.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.littlewoodValue
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.FlatnessModel:12.text:
def littlewoodValue {N : ℕ} (ε : Fin N → ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ k : Fin N, (ε k : ℂ) * z ^ (k : ℕ)

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.normalized_measurable
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma normalized_measurable (N : ℕ) : Measurable (normalized N) :=
  (normalized_continuous N).measurable

include hmain in

OAI.MeasureTheory.Integral.BoundedMoment.name: OAI.LittlewoodFiniteFlatness.tendsto_integral_abs_sub_one_rpow
OAI.MeasureTheory.Integral.BoundedMoment.text:
theorem tendsto_integral_abs_sub_one_rpow
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : ℕ → α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n, Measurable (f n))
    (h0 : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ f n x)
    (h2 : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ x, f n x ≤ 2)
    (hmoment : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (f n x - 1) ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, |f n x - 1| ^ p ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply tendsto_integral_rpow_of_bounded_moment μ (fun n x => |f n x - 1|)
    (fun n => continuous_abs.measurable.comp ((hf n).sub measurable_const)) ?_ 2 (by decide) ?_ p hp
  · filter_upwards [h2] with n hn
    intro x
    exact ⟨abs_nonneg _, abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h0 n x], by linarith [hn x]⟩⟩
  · simpa only [sq_abs] using hmoment

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.FlatnessModel:19.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.MainStatement
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.FlatnessModel:19.text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ ε : (N : ℕ) → Fin N → ℝ,
    (∀ N : ℕ, IsRealSigning (ε N)) ∧
    ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N : ℕ =>
          ∫ t : UnitAddCircle,
            Real.rpow
              |‖littlewoodValue (ε N) (fourier (1 : ℤ) t)‖ /
                  Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) - 1|
              p
            ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
        Filter.atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ))

end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.signVector_signing
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma signVector_signing {N : ℕ} (b : Fin N → Bool) : IsRealSigning (signVector b) := by
  intro k
  cases h : b k <;> simp [signVector, boolSign, h]

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.FiniteFlatness:1.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.main
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.FiniteFlatness:1.text:
theorem main : MainStatement := by
  have hmain : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N →
      ∃ ε : Fin N → ℝ, IsRealSigning ε ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖littlewoodValue ε z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * Real.sqrt N := by
    change AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.MainStatement
    exact AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewood.main
  refine ⟨chosenSigns, chosenSigns_signing, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have h := LittlewoodFiniteFlatness.tendsto_integral_abs_sub_one_rpow
    μ normalized normalized_measurable normalized_nonneg
    (normalized_eventually_le_two hmain) (normalized_error_sq_tendsto hmain) p hp
  simpa only [normalized, circlePolynomial_apply, μ, Real.rpow_eq_pow] using h

end AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.chosenSigns
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text: def chosenSigns (N : ℕ) : Fin N → ℝ := signVector (minimizingBits N)

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.fourier_nat
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma fourier_nat (n : ℕ) (t : UnitAddCircle) :
    fourier (n : ℤ) t = (fourier (1 : ℤ) t) ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, fourier_add, ih, pow_succ]

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.normalized_eventually_bound
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma normalized_eventually_bound {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ t, normalized N t ≤ 1 + η := by
  filter_upwards [chosenSigns_eventually_bound hmain hη, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with N hb hN
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  intro t
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNr)).2 (hb t)

include hmain in

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.signVector
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text: def signVector {N : ℕ} (b : Fin N → Bool) : Fin N → ℝ := fun k => boolSign (b k)

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.normalized
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
def normalized (N : ℕ) (t : UnitAddCircle) : ℝ :=

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.normalized_eventually_le_two
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma normalized_eventually_le_two :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ t, normalized N t ≤ 2 := by
  simpa only [show (1 : ℝ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num] using
    normalized_eventually_bound hmain (η := 1) (by norm_num)

OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.name: OAI.AsymptoticallyMinimalLittlewoodFiniteFlatness.circlePolynomial_apply
OAI.Analysis.Littlewood.MinimizingFamily.text:
lemma circlePolynomial_apply {N : ℕ} (ε : Fin N → ℝ) (t : UnitAddCircle) :
    circlePolynomial ε t = littlewoodValue ε (fourier (1 : ℤ) t) := by
  simp only [circlePolynomial, littlewoodValue, ContinuousMap.sum_apply,
    ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [fourier_nat]

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:20.text:
lemma finiteSlabs_volume_of_variance {n : ℕ} (D : Finset (Space n))
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin n, EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ i ∈ D)
    (f₀ f₁ : Space n → ℝ) (h₀ : ∀ u ∈ D, 0 < f₀ u)
    (h₁ : ∀ u ∈ D, 0 < f₁ u) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hvar : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ s : ℝ,
      SlabPartition.variance ε
        (SlabReduction.features (fun u : D => u.val.ofLp) (fun u : D => f₀ u.val) (2*k+2))
        (SlabReduction.rates (fun u : D => f₀ u.val) (fun u : D => f₁ u.val) (2*k+2)) s
        (SlabPartition.variation
          (SlabReduction.features (fun u : D => u.val.ofLp) (fun u : D => f₀ u.val) (2*k+2))
          (SlabReduction.rates (fun u : D => f₀ u.val) (fun u : D => f₁ u.val) (2*k+2)) 1 s) ≤
      SlabPartition.mean ε
        (SlabReduction.features (fun u : D => u.val.ofLp) (fun u : D => f₀ u.val) (2*k+2))
        (SlabReduction.rates (fun u : D => f₀ u.val) (fun u : D => f₁ u.val) (2*k+2)) s
        (SlabPartition.variation
          (SlabReduction.features (fun u : D => u.val.ofLp) (fun u : D => f₀ u.val) (2*k+2))
          (SlabReduction.rates (fun u : D => f₀ u.val) (fun u : D => f₁ u.val) (2*k+2)) 2 s)) :
    volume (finiteSlabs D f₀) ^ (1-t) * volume (finiteSlabs D f₁) ^ t ≤
      volume (finiteSlabs D (fun u => f₀ u ^ (1-t) * f₁ u ^ t)) := by
  apply finiteSlabs_volume_of_body_inequality D hD f₀ f₁ h₀ h₁ ht
  exact SlabReduction.finite_slabs_of_variance (fun u : D => u.val.ofLp)
    (fun u => h₀ u.val u.property) (fun u => h₁ u.val u.property) ht
    (volume_body_finiteSlabs_ne_top D hD f₀ h₀)
    (volume_body_finiteSlabs_ne_top D hD f₁ h₁)
    (volume_body_finiteSlabs_ne_top D hD (fun u => f₀ u^(1-t)*f₁ u^t)
      (fun u hu => SlabReduction.width_pos (h₀ u hu) (h₁ u hu) t)) hvar

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.name: OAI.ActualMoment.covariance_rhs
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.text:
lemma covariance_rhs {q:ℕ} (hq:Even q) {ε:ℝ} (hε:0<ε)
    (p:κ→ι→ℝ) (h:κ→ℝ) (b:κ→ℝ) :
    SlabPartition.mean ε (SlabReduction.features p h q) (fun _=>0) 0
      (fun x=>∑i,b i^2*MvPolynomial.eval x (SlabReduction.features p h q i))=
      ∑i,b i^2*(∫x,summand (p i) (h i) q x ∂law ε p h q) := by
  rw [mean_eq hq hε p h]
  simp only [SlabReduction.features,feature_eval]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _=>(integrable_summand hq hε p h (p i) (h i) q).const_mul _)]
  simp only [integral_const_mul]
end ActualMoment

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:19.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.main_dimension_one
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:19.text:
lemma main_dimension_one {K L : Set (Space 1)}
    (hK : IsConvexBody K) (hL : IsConvexBody L)
    (hsK : OriginSymmetric K) (hsL : OriginSymmetric L)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    volume (logCombination K L t) = volume K ^ (1 - t) * volume L ^ t := by
  have ha := positive_support hK hsK oneDirection_norm
  have hb := positive_support hL hsL oneDirection_norm
  have hvK : volume K = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * support K oneDirection) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← wulff_support hK]
    exact volume_wulff_one (support_neg hK hsK)
  have hvL : volume L = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * support L oneDirection) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← wulff_support hL]
    exact volume_wulff_one (support_neg hL hsL)
  have hreal :
      (2 * support K oneDirection) ^ (1 - t) * (2 * support L oneDirection) ^ t =
        2 * (support K oneDirection ^ (1 - t) * support L oneDirection ^ t) := by
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) ha.le, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hb.le]
    calc
      _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - t) * 2 ^ t) *
          (support K oneDirection ^ (1 - t) * support L oneDirection ^ t) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), sub_add_cancel,
        Real.rpow_one]
  change volume (wulff (interpolatedSupport K L t)) = _
  rw [volume_wulff_one (interpolatedSupport_even hK hL hsK hsL t), hvK, hvL,
    ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1),
    ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (by positivity) ht0,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), hreal]
  rfl

end LogBrunnMinkowski

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:20.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.source_variance_at_parameter
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:20.text:
lemma source_variance_at_parameter (hv : SoftVarianceStatement)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] [Nonempty κ]
    (p : κ → Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) {h₀ h₁ : κ → ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 < h₀ i) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < h₁ i) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    SlabPartition.variance ε (SlabReduction.features p h₀ (2*k+2))
      (SlabReduction.rates h₀ h₁ (2*k+2)) s
      (SlabPartition.variation (SlabReduction.features p h₀ (2*k+2))
        (SlabReduction.rates h₀ h₁ (2*k+2)) 1 s) ≤
    SlabPartition.mean ε (SlabReduction.features p h₀ (2*k+2))
      (SlabReduction.rates h₀ h₁ (2*k+2)) s
      (SlabPartition.variation (SlabReduction.features p h₀ (2*k+2))
        (SlabReduction.rates h₀ h₁ (2*k+2)) 2 s) := by
  have h := hv n hn κ inferInstance inferInstance (2*k+2) ⟨k+1, by omega⟩ (by omega)
    ε hε p hp (SlabReduction.widths h₀ h₁ s)
    (fun i => SlabReduction.width_pos (ha i) (hb i) s) (SlabReduction.rates h₀ h₁ (2*k+2))
  rw [varying_variation_eq p ha hb, varying_variation_eq p ha hb]
  simp only [pow_one]
  simpa only [SlabPartition.variance, SlabPartition.mean, SlabPartition.partition,
    varying_density_eq p ha hb] using h

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:20.text:

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:18.name: OAI.MomentSlab.variance_from_moment
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:18.text:
theorem variance_from_moment {q : ℕ} (hq : Even q) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (p : κ → ι → ℝ) (h : κ → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (hh : ∀ i, 0 < h i)
    {φ : Space ι → ℝ} (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hpos : ∀ z, (hess φ z).PosDef)
    (hupper : ∀ z, ((4/ε) • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)-hess φ z).PosSemidef)
    (heq : ∀ z, Real.log (hess φ z).det = potential ε p h (q+2) (grad φ z)+
      Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (-potential ε p h (q+2) x))-φ z)
    (Φ : Space ι ≃ₜ Space ι) (hΦ : (Φ : Space ι → Space ι) = grad φ)
    (hInv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Φ.symm : Space ι → Space ι))
    (hmap : Measure.map (grad φ) (sourceMeasure volume φ) = law ε p h (q+2)) (b : κ → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, (∑ i, b i*summand (p i) (h i) (q+2) x)^2 ∂law ε p h (q+2))-
      (∫ x, ∑ i, b i*summand (p i) (h i) (q+2) x ∂law ε p h (q+2))^2 ≤
      ∑ i, b i^2*(∫ x, summand (p i) (h i) (q+2) x ∂law ε p h (q+2)) := by
  let V := potential ε p h (q+2)
  let Z := ∫ x, Real.exp (-V x)
  let μ := law ε p h (q+2)
  let ψ (i : κ) := summand (p i) (h i) (q+2)
  have hqe := hq.add even_two
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := potential_probability hqe hε p h
  let : Measure.IsOpenPosMeasure μ := law_openPos hqe hε p h
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (targetMeasure volume V Z) := potential_probability hqe hε p h
  let : Measure.IsOpenPosMeasure (targetMeasure volume V Z) := law_openPos hqe hε p h
  have hψ (i : κ) : MemLp (ψ i) 2 μ := summand_memLp hqe hε p h (p i) (h i) (q+2)
  let F := LpVariance.centered μ (LpVariance.sumPotential ψ b)
  have hF : MemLp F 2 μ := LpVariance.centered_memLp μ (LpVariance.sum_memLp μ ψ hψ b)
  have hFe : ∀ x, F (-x)=F x := by
    intro x
    change (∑ i, b i*ψ i (-x)) - _ = (∑ i, b i*ψ i x) - _
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [show ψ i (-x)=ψ i x from summand_even hqe (p i) (h i) x]
  have hFc : (∫ x, F x ∂μ)=0 :=
    LpVariance.centered_integral μ (MemLp.integrable (by norm_num) (LpVariance.sum_memLp μ ψ hψ b))
  have hclosure := MomentKernel.centered_even_mem_closure (ι:=ι) (φ:=φ) (V:=V) (Z:=Z)
    (Λ:=4/ε) (m:=0) hφ (smooth_potential ε p h (q+2)) (potential_even hqe ε p h)
    hpos (potential_partition_pos hqe hε p h) (potential_nonneg hqe hε.le p h)
    (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hε.le) hupper heq Φ hΦ hInv hmap hF hFe hFc
  apply LpVariance.variance_of_centered_dual μ (fun i => ∫ x, ψ i x ∂μ)
    (fun i => mean_summand_pos hqe hε p h (hp i) (ne_of_gt (hh i)) hqe) ψ hψ b
  apply LpVariance.integral_dual_extend μ (fun i => ∫ x, ψ i x ∂μ) ψ hψ
    ((RealSmoothOperator.squareRange (E:=Space ι) μ (MatrixOperator.principal (MomentOperator.tau Φ φ)
      (MomentKernel.smooth_tau hφ Φ hInv)++MatrixOperator.drift)) : Set (Lp ℝ 2 μ))
    (fun u hu => range_dual_bound hq hε p h hp hh hφ hpos hupper heq Φ hΦ hInv hmap u hu) hF
  exact hclosure

end MomentSlab
end
