OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.name: OAI.ActualMoment.coordinates
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.text:
theorem coordinates {q:ℕ} (hq:Even q) {ε:ℝ} (hε:0<ε)
    (p:κ→ι→ℝ) (h:κ→ℝ) :
    ∃φ:P→ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ (∀x,(hess φ x).PosDef) ∧
      (∀x,((4/ε) • (1:Matrix ι ι ℝ)-hess φ x).PosSemidef) ∧
      (∀x, Real.log (hess φ x).det=SoftSlab.potential ε p h q (grad φ x)+
        Real.log (∫x:P,Real.exp (-SoftSlab.potential ε p h q x))-φ x) ∧
      ∃Φ:P≃ₜP,(Φ:P→P)=grad φ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Φ.symm:P→P) ∧
        Measure.map (grad φ) (sourceMeasure volume φ)=SoftSlab.law ε p h q := by
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,hpos,hcap,heq,Φ,hΦ,hInv,hm⟩:=euclidean hq hε p h
  let ψ:P→ℝ:=fun x=>φ ((C).symm x)
  have hψ:ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ:=hφ.comp (C).symm.contDiff
  let Ψ:P≃ₜP:=((C).symm.toHomeomorph.trans Φ).trans (C).toHomeomorph
  have hg:∀x,grad ψ x=C (gradient φ ((C).symm x)):=grad_pull (hφ.differentiable (by simp))
  have hh:∀x,hess ψ x=MomentLinearization.hessian ob φ ((C).symm x):=hess_pull hφ
  have hΨ:(Ψ:P→P)=grad ψ := by
    funext x
    rw [hg]
    change C (Φ ((C).symm x))=_
    rw [hΦ]
  have hΨi:ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Ψ.symm:P→P):=(C).contDiff.comp (hInv.comp (C).symm.contDiff)
  have hZ:=coord_integral (ι:=ι) (fun x:P=>Real.exp (-SoftSlab.potential ε p h q x))
  have hsrc:Measure.map C (volume.withDensity (fun x:E=>ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-φ x))))=
      sourceMeasure volume ψ := coord_source hφ
  have htar:Measure.map C (CompactMomentVariational.normalizedSource volume
      (fun x:E=>SoftSlab.potential ε p h q (C x)))=SoftSlab.law ε p h q :=
    coord_normalized (SoftSlab.smooth_potential ε p h q)
  have hmap:Measure.map (grad ψ) (sourceMeasure volume ψ)=SoftSlab.law ε p h q := by
    rw [←hsrc,Measure.map_map (smooth_grad hψ).continuous.measurable (C).continuous.measurable]
    have hgC:(grad ψ) ∘ C=C ∘ (gradient φ) := by
      funext x
      simp only [Function.comp_apply,hg,(C).symm_apply_apply]
    rw [hgC,←Measure.map_map (C).continuous.measurable]
    · rw [hm,htar]
    · exact ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.contDiff.comp
        (hφ.fderiv_right (m:=∞) (by simp))).continuous.measurable
  refine ⟨ψ,hψ,(fun x=>by rw [hh];exact hpos _),
    (fun x=>by rw [hh];exact hcap _),?_,Ψ,hΨ,hΨi,hmap⟩
  intro x
  rw [hh,hg]
  simpa only [hZ] using heq ((C).symm x)
end

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:19.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.main_of_finite_slabs
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:19.text:
lemma main_of_finite_slabs {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {K L : Set (Space n)} (hK : IsConvexBody K) (hL : IsConvexBody L)
    (hsK : OriginSymmetric K) (hsL : OriginSymmetric L)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (hslabs : ∀ D : Finset (Space n),
      (∀ i : Fin n, EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ i ∈ D) →
      (∀ u ∈ D, ‖u‖ = 1) →
      volume (finiteSlabs D (support K)) ^ (1 - t) *
        volume (finiteSlabs D (support L)) ^ t ≤
          volume (finiteSlabs D (interpolatedSupport K L t))) :
    volume K ^ (1 - t) * volume L ^ t ≤ volume (logCombination K L t) := by
  let : Nonempty (UnitSphere n) := unitSphere_nonempty hn
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_dense_seq (UnitSphere n)
  have hKlim := tendsto_volume_finiteSlabs hd
    ((support_continuous hK).comp continuous_subtype_val) (support_neg hK hsK)
  have hLlim := tendsto_volume_finiteSlabs hd
    ((support_continuous hL).comp continuous_subtype_val) (support_neg hL hsL)
  rw [wulff_support hK] at hKlim
  rw [wulff_support hL] at hLlim
  have hTlim := tendsto_volume_finiteSlabs hd
    (interpolatedSupport_sphere_continuous hK hL hsK hsL t)
    (interpolatedSupport_even hK hL hsK hsL t)
  have hprod := ENNReal.Tendsto.mul (hKlim.ennrpow_const (1 - t))
    (Or.inr (ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg ht0 (body_volume_ne_top hL)))
    (hLlim.ennrpow_const t)
    (Or.inr (ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) (body_volume_ne_top hK)))
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hprod hTlim
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun m => hslabs _ (basis_mem_directions d m)
      (fun _ hu => directions_unit d m hu)))

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.main
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.text:
theorem main (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (K L : Set (Space n))
    (hK : IsConvexBody K) (hL : IsConvexBody L)
    (hsK : OriginSymmetric K) (hsL : OriginSymmetric L)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (volume K) ^ (1 - t) * (volume L) ^ t ≤ volume (logCombination K L t) := by
  exact main_of_softVariance softVariance n hn K L hK hL hsK hsL t ht0 ht1
end LogBrunnMinkowski
end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:20.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.SoftVarianceStatement
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:20.text:
def SoftVarianceStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → ∀ (κ : Type) (_ : Fintype κ) (_ : Nonempty κ),
  ∀ (q : ℕ), Even q → 2 ≤ q → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
  ∀ (p : κ → Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, p i ≠ 0) → ∀ (h : κ → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < h i) →
  ∀ (b : κ → ℝ),
    SlabPartition.variance ε (SlabReduction.features p h q) (fun _ => 0) 0
      (fun x => ∑ i, b i * MvPolynomial.eval x (SlabReduction.features p h q i)) ≤
    SlabPartition.mean ε (SlabReduction.features p h q) (fun _ => 0) 0
      (fun x => ∑ i, b i^2 * MvPolynomial.eval x (SlabReduction.features p h q i))

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:29.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.logCombination
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:29.text:
noncomputable def logCombination {n : ℕ} (K L : Set (Space n)) (t : ℝ) :
    Set (Space n) :=
  wulff (fun u => (support K u) ^ (1 - t) * (support L u) ^ t)

end LogBrunnMinkowski

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:20.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.main_of_softVariance
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:20.text:
lemma main_of_softVariance (hv : SoftVarianceStatement) : MainStatement := by
  intro n hn K L hK hL hsK hsL t ht₀ ht₁
  by_cases hn₁ : n = 1
  · subst n
    exact (main_dimension_one hK hL hsK hsL ht₀ ht₁).ge
  have hn₂ : 2 ≤ n := by omega
  apply main_of_finite_slabs hn hK hL hsK hsL ht₀ ht₁
  intro D hD hunit
  have ha : ∀ u ∈ D, 0 < support K u := fun u hu => positive_support hK hsK (hunit u hu)
  have hb : ∀ u ∈ D, 0 < support L u := fun u hu => positive_support hL hsL (hunit u hu)
  apply finiteSlabs_volume_of_variance D hD (support K) (support L) ha hb ⟨ht₀, ht₁⟩
  intro ε hε k s
  let : Nonempty D := ⟨⟨EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ ⟨0, by omega⟩, hD _⟩⟩
  apply source_variance_at_parameter hv hn₂ (fun u : D => u.val.ofLp) _
    (fun u => ha u.val u.property) (fun u => hb u.val u.property) hε k s
  intro u hu
  have hzero : u.val = 0 := by
    apply WithLp.ofLp_injective
    exact hu
  have hnorm := hunit u.val u.property
  rw [hzero, norm_zero] at hnorm
  norm_num at hnorm

end LogBrunnMinkowski
end


end

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:19.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.MainStatement
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:19.text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (K L : Set (Space n)),
    IsConvexBody K → IsConvexBody L → OriginSymmetric K → OriginSymmetric L →
    ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
      (volume K) ^ (1 - t) * (volume L) ^ t ≤ volume (logCombination K L t)

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.softVariance
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.text:
theorem softVariance : SoftVarianceStatement := by
  intro n hn κ _ _ q hq hq2 ε hε p hp h hh b
  classical
  let : Nonempty (Fin n):=Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (by omega)
  have hqm:Even (q-2):=(Nat.even_sub hq2).mpr (iff_of_true hq even_two)
  have hqq:q-2+2=q:=Nat.sub_add_cancel hq2
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,hpos,hcap,heq,Φ,hΦ,hInv,hm⟩:=
    ActualMoment.coordinates (hqm.add even_two) hε p h
  have hv:=MomentSlab.variance_from_moment hqm hε p h hp hh hφ hpos hcap heq Φ hΦ hInv hm b
  simp only [hqq] at hv
  rw [ActualMoment.variance_eq hq hε p h b,ActualMoment.covariance_rhs hq hε p h b]
  exact hv

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:17.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.IsConvexBody
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:17.text:
def IsConvexBody {n : ℕ} (K : Set (Space n)) : Prop :=
  IsCompact K ∧ Convex ℝ K ∧ (interior K).Nonempty

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:19.name: OAI.LogBrunnMinkowski.positive_support
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:19.text:
lemma positive_support {n : ℕ} {K : Set (Space n)} (hK : IsConvexBody K)
    (hsK : OriginSymmetric K) {u : Space n} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) : 0 < support K u := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_interior 0 (zero_mem_interior hK hsK)
  have hru : (r / 2) • u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Space n) r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hu, mul_one,
      abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < r / 2)]
    linarith
  have h := inner_le_support hK (interior_subset (hball hru)) u
  have huu : ⟪u,u⟫_ℝ = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]; norm_num
  rw [inner_smul_left, huu] at h
  norm_num at h
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < r / 2) h

OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.name: OAI.ActualMoment.variance_eq
OAI.Geometry.LogVolume.BrunnMinkowski:24.text:
lemma variance_eq {q:ℕ} (hq:Even q) {ε:ℝ} (hε:0<ε)
    (p:κ→ι→ℝ) (h:κ→ℝ) (b:κ→ℝ) :
    SlabPartition.variance ε (SlabReduction.features p h q) (fun _=>0) 0
      (fun x=>∑i,b i*MvPolynomial.eval x (SlabReduction.features p h q i))=
    (∫x,(∑i,b i*summand (p i) (h i) q x)^2 ∂law ε p h q)-
      (∫x,∑i,b i*summand (p i) (h i) q x ∂law ε p h q)^2 := by
  classical
  let P:MvPolynomial ι ℝ:=∑i,MvPolynomial.C (b i)*SlabReduction.features p h q i
  have hP: (fun x=>MvPolynomial.eval x P)=
      (fun x=>∑i,b i*MvPolynomial.eval x (SlabReduction.features p h q i)) := by
    funext x
    simp [P]
  rw [←hP,SlabPartition.variance_eq hε (SlabReduction.features_nonneg p h hq)]
  simp only [mean_eq hq hε p h,P,map_sum,map_mul,MvPolynomial.eval_C,
    SlabReduction.features,feature_eval]

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Main:63.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.source_gammaStar_zero
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Main:63.text:
theorem source_gammaStar_zero : gammaStar=0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact csInf_le ⟨0,fun _ h => h.1⟩ source_exponent_zero
  · exact le_csInf ⟨0,source_exponent_zero⟩ (fun _ h => h.1)

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Model:75.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.queryComplexity
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Model:75.text:
def queryComplexity (d : ℕ) : ℕ∞ :=
  sInf ((fun q : ℕ => (q : ℕ∞)) '' {q | CanSample d q})

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.LowerBounds.H.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.LowerBound.not_canSample_exponential
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.LowerBounds.H.text:
theorem not_canSample_exponential {d q : ℕ} (hd : 2^(64*(q+1)) ≤ d) : ¬ CanSample d q := by
  intro h
  have hb := exponential_dimension_bounds hd
  have h₁ := canSample_target_separation_bound hb.2.2.1 hb.2.2.2 (exponential_tolerance hd) h
  have h₂ := target_event_large hd
  linarith

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Main:54.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.source_exponent_zero
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Main:54.text:
theorem source_exponent_zero : ExponentBound 0 := by
  refine ⟨le_rfl,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨d₀,hd₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (eventually_subpolynomial_sampler hε)
  refine ⟨d₀,?_⟩
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqbound⟩ := hd₀ d hd
  simpa only [zero_add] using hq.queryComplexity_le.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hqbound)

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Model:68.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.CanSample
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Model:68.text:
def CanSample (d q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (Ω : Type) (_ : MeasurableSpace Ω) (μ : Measure Ω)
    (_ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) (A : OracleAlgorithm Ω d q),
    ∀ V : Point d → ℝ, Admissible V →
      Measurable (A.run V) ∧ TVAtMost (μ.map (A.run V)) (gibbs V) (1 / 10)

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.LowerBounds.H.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.LowerBound.source_logarithmic_lower
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.LowerBounds.H.text:
theorem source_logarithmic_lower :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ d₀ ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
      ENNReal.ofReal (c * Real.log (d : ℝ)) ≤ (queryComplexity d).toENNReal := by
  refine ⟨(128 * Real.log 2)⁻¹, by positivity, 2^128, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro d hd
  have hfeasible : ∀ q : ℕ, CanSample d q → (128 * Real.log 2)⁻¹ * Real.log d ≤ q := by
    intro q hq
    by_contra hh
    exact not_canSample_exponential (exponential_of_small_log hd (lt_of_not_ge hh)) hq
  unfold queryComplexity
  rw [sInf_image]
  simp only [ENat.toENNReal_iInf]
  apply le_iInf
  intro q
  apply le_iInf
  intro hq
  simpa only [ENat.toENNReal_coe,ENNReal.ofReal_natCast] using
    ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hfeasible q hq)

end LogConcaveSampling.LowerBound

end LowerProof

end

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Sampling.Mixi.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.eventually_subpolynomial_sampler
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Sampling.Mixi.text:
theorem eventually_subpolynomial_sampler {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop,∃q : ℕ,CanSample d q ∧ (q:ℝ)≤(d:ℝ)^ε := by
  let κ := ε/4
  let P := 10*(1+κ)/κ
  have hκ : 0<κ := by dsimp [κ]; positivity
  have hPeq : κ*P=10*(1+κ) := by dsimp [P]; field_simp
  have hP : 1≤P := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hκ).2
    linarith
  have hPerr : κ+3<κ*P := by rw [hPeq]; linarith
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hts,_,K,_,e,her,hep,hproducer⟩ := exists_primitive_producer hκ hP
  have herr := top_asymptotic_errors hκ hPerr her (hep.mono (fun _ h => h.le))
  have hcostRate := (LogPowerRate.power (-(κ*t))).mul
    ((proximalRounds_rate hκ.le).add (descentRounds_rate.mono (by linarith)))
  have hcost := hcostRate.eventually_small (b:= -ε) (by dsimp [κ] at *; nlinarith)
  simp only [neg_neg] at hcost
  filter_upwards [hproducer,herr,hcost,hep,eventually_ge_atTop (2:ℕ)] with d hprod herr hcost hep hd
  obtain ⟨S,B,hB,hbud,hcorr⟩ := hprod
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ)<d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0<d)
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ)≤d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1≤d)
  have hd2 : (1:ℝ)<d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1<d)
  have hqpos : 0<(d:ℝ)^(-κ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd0 _
  have hq1 : (d:ℝ)^(-κ)<1 := Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg hd2 (by linarith)
  have hh : 0<topScale κ d := topScale_pos (by omega)
  have hη : (d:ℝ)^(-(κ*t))≤1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hd1 (by nlinarith)
  let T := S 1 1
  let N := proximalRounds κ d
  let J := descentRounds d
  let q := T.full.calls*N+T.full.calls*J
  refine ⟨q,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨_,inferInstance,topSeedLaw T N J,inferInstance,(topProgram T (topScale κ d) N J).algorithm,?_⟩
    intro V hV
    refine ⟨(topProgram T (topScale κ d) N J).algorithm.measurable_run hV,?_⟩
    rw [show (topProgram T (topScale κ d) N J).algorithm.run V =
      (topProgram T (topScale κ d) N J).run V from funext (Program.algorithm_run _ V)]
    have ha := topProgram_accuracy S hh (show 2*topScale κ d≤(d:ℝ)^(-κ) by unfold topScale; linarith)
      hq1 hep.le hη (hbud 1).reserve hcorr
      ⌈40*(1+κ)*dimensionLog d/topScale κ d⌉₊ J hV
    exact ha.mono (by simpa only [proximalRounds,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using herr)
  · have hc : (T.calls:ℝ)≤(d:ℝ)^(κ*t) := (by exact_mod_cast (hbud 1).calls : (T.calls:ℝ)≤B).trans hB
    calc
      (q:ℝ) = (T.calls:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)+J) := by change ((T.calls*N+T.calls*J:ℕ):ℝ)=_; push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ (d:ℝ)^(κ*t)*((N:ℝ)+J) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (by positivity)
      _ ≤ |(d:ℝ)^(κ*t)*((N:ℝ)+J)| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ _ := hcost

end LogConcaveSampling

end

end

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.LowerBounds.H.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.LowerBound.exponential_of_small_log
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.LowerBounds.H.text:
lemma exponential_of_small_log {d q : ℕ} (hd : 2^128 ≤ d)
    (hq : (q : ℝ) < (128 * Real.log 2)⁻¹ * Real.log d) : 2^(64*(q+1)) ≤ d := by
  have hl : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hdp : 0 < d := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hd
  have hdr : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hdp
  have hd' : (2 : ℝ)^128 ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlog : 128 * Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log d := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hd'
    simpa only [Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh
  have hq' : 128 * Real.log (2 : ℝ) * q < Real.log d := by
    have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hq (show 0 < 128 * Real.log (2 : ℝ) by positivity)
    rwa [← mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity),one_mul] at hh
  have hx : Real.log ((2 : ℝ)^(64*(q+1))) ≤ Real.log d := by
    rw [Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    nlinarith only [hlog,hq']
  have hexp := (Real.log_le_log_iff (by positivity) hdr).mp hx
  exact_mod_cast hexp

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Main:68.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.exact_source_main
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Main:68.text:
theorem exact_source_main :
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ d : ℕ, 2 ≤ d →
      (queryComplexity d).toENNReal ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (d : ℝ) ^ ε)) ∧
    (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ d₀ ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
      ENNReal.ofReal (c * Real.log (d : ℝ)) ≤ (queryComplexity d).toENNReal) ∧
    gammaStar = 0 := by
  exact ⟨source_subpolynomial_upper,LowerBound.source_logarithmic_lower,source_gammaStar_zero⟩

end LogConcaveSampling

end

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Model:83.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.gammaStar
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Model:83.text:
def gammaStar : ℝ := sInf {γ : ℝ | ExponentBound γ}

end LogConcaveSampling

end

OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Main:33.name: OAI.LogConcaveSampling.source_subpolynomial_upper
OAI.Probability.LogConcave.Main:33.text:
theorem source_subpolynomial_upper :
    ∀ ε : ℝ,0<ε → ∃ C : ℝ,∀ d : ℕ,2≤d →
      (queryComplexity d).toENNReal≤ENNReal.ofReal (C*(d:ℝ)^ε) := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨d₀,hd₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (eventually_subpolynomial_sampler hε)
  let C : ℝ := (10*2^d₀:ℕ)+1
  have hC : 1≤C := by dsimp [C]; have := (Nat.cast_nonneg (10*2^d₀) : (0:ℝ)≤_); linarith
  refine ⟨C,?_⟩
  intro d hd
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ)≤d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1≤d)
  have hp : 1≤(d:ℝ)^ε := Real.one_le_rpow hd1 hε.le
  by_cases hlarge : d₀≤d
  · obtain ⟨q,hq,hqbound⟩ := hd₀ d hlarge
    exact hq.queryComplexity_le.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      (hqbound.trans (by nlinarith)))
  · have hsmall : d≤d₀ := by omega
    have hpow : (10*2^d:ℕ)≤10*2^d₀ := by gcongr
    have hq : ((10*2^d:ℕ):ℝ)≤C := by dsimp [C]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 10*2^d≤10*2^d₀+1)
    exact (finite_dimension_sampler d).queryComplexity_le.trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hq.trans (by nlinarith)))

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:3.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:3.text:
structure SmoothProjectiveVariety where
  scheme : Scheme
  structural : scheme ⟶ complexBase
  dimension : ℕ
  integral : IsIntegral scheme
  smooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension dimension structural
  projective : ∃ (N : ℕ) (i : scheme ⟶ complexProjectiveSpace N),
    IsClosedImmersion i ∧ i ≫ complexProjectiveStructure N = structural

attribute [instance] SmoothProjectiveVariety.integral SmoothProjectiveVariety.smooth

namespace SmoothProjectiveVariety

instance (X : SmoothProjectiveVariety) : Smooth X.structural :=
  SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth X.dimension X.structural

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:3.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety.BoundaryFibration
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:3.text:
structure BoundaryFibration (X Y : SmoothProjectiveVariety)
    (E : X.ReducedSNCBoundary) (D : Y.ReducedSNCBoundary) where
  hom : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme
  over_base : hom ≫ Y.structural = X.structural
  surjective : Surjective hom
  connected : ∀ y : Y.ComplexPoint, ConnectedSpace ↥(CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback hom y.hom)
  support : hom ⁻¹' D.support ⊆ E.support

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:3.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.complexProjectiveStructure
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:3.text:
def complexProjectiveStructure (N : ℕ) : complexProjectiveSpace N ⟶ complexBase :=
  Proj.toSpecZero (projectiveGrading N) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (projectiveConstants N))

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.FiberNe.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety.veryGenerally_of_nonempty_open
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.FiberNe.text:
lemma veryGenerally_of_nonempty_open
    {Y : SmoothProjectiveVariety} {P : Y.ComplexPoint → Prop}
    {U : Y.scheme.Opens} (hne : U ≠ ⊥)
    (hP : ∀ y : Y.ComplexPoint, y.point ∈ U → P y) : VeryGenerally Y P := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun _ => U.compl, fun _ => ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro htop
    change U.compl = ⊤ at htop
    apply hne
    apply le_bot_iff.mp
    intro x hx
    have hc : x ∈ U.compl := by rw [htop]; trivial
    exact (hc hx).elim
  · intro y hy
    apply hP y
    exact Classical.not_not.mp (hy 0)

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:4.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety.VeryGenerally
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:4.text:
def VeryGenerally (Y : SmoothProjectiveVariety) (P : Y.ComplexPoint → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ Z : ℕ → TopologicalSpace.Closeds Y.scheme,
    (∀ n, Z n ≠ ⊤) ∧ ∀ y : Y.ComplexPoint, (∀ n, y.point ∉ Z n) → P y

end SmoothProjectiveVariety

open SmoothProjectiveVariety

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:4.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety.FiberModel
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:4.text:
structure FiberModel {X Y : SmoothProjectiveVariety} {E : X.ReducedSNCBoundary}
    {D : Y.ReducedSNCBoundary} (f : BoundaryFibration X Y E D) (y : Y.ComplexPoint) where
  variety : SmoothProjectiveVariety
  inclusion : variety.scheme ⟶ X.scheme
  square : IsPullback inclusion variety.structural f.hom y.hom
  boundary : variety.ReducedSNCBoundary
  boundary_pullback : boundary.ideal = E.ideal.comap inclusion

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:3.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety.StratumSmoothFibration
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:3.text:
structure StratumSmoothFibration (X Y : SmoothProjectiveVariety)
    (E : X.ReducedSNCBoundary) (D : Y.ReducedSNCBoundary)
    extends BoundaryFibration X Y E D where
  smooth : Smooth (hom.resLE D.complement (hom ⁻¹ᵁ D.complement) le_rfl)
  strata : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin E.count)), S.Nonempty →
    Smooth (((S.sup E.components).subschemeι ≫ hom).resLE D.complement
      (((S.sup E.components).subschemeι ≫ hom) ⁻¹ᵁ D.complement) le_rfl)

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:2.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.complexProjectiveSpace
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Basic:2.text: abbrev complexProjectiveSpace (N : ℕ) : Scheme := Proj (projectiveGrading N)

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Nonzero.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety.exists_open_nonzero_fiber_pluriform
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.Nonzero.text:
theorem exists_open_nonzero_fiber_pluriform
    {X Y : SmoothProjectiveVariety} {E : X.ReducedSNCBoundary} {D : Y.ReducedSNCBoundary}
    (f : StratumSmoothFibration X Y E D) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (s : X.RationalPluriform m) (hs : s ∈ E.sections m) (hn : s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U : Y.scheme.Opens, U ≠ ⊥ ∧ U ≤ D.complement ∧
      ∀ (y : Y.ComplexPoint), y.point ∈ U →
        ∀ F : FiberModel f.toBoundaryFibration y,
          ∃ σ : F.variety.RationalPluriform m, σ ∈ F.boundary.sections m ∧ σ ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hm0 : m = 0
  · exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hm hm0).elim
  · have hgen := D.generic_mem_complement
    obtain ⟨U, hgenU, hU, ⟨b⟩⟩ := Y.exists_cotangent_chart D.complement
      (genericPoint Y.scheme) hgen
    let := f.surjective
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := f.hom.surjective (genericPoint Y.scheme)
    have hfx : f.hom x ∈ U.1 := hx ▸ hgenU
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, _, e, hsm, t, ht, hI⟩ :=
      exists_relative_log_chart f U hU ⊤ x (by trivial) hfx
    let : Nonempty V.1 := ⟨⟨x, hxV⟩⟩
    let A := Γ(Y.scheme, U.1)
    let B := Γ(X.scheme, V.1)
    let r := X.dimension - Y.dimension
    let : Algebra A B := (f.hom.appLE U.1 V.1 e).hom.toAlgebra
    let : IsScalarTower ℂ A B := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a =>
      (appLE_constants f.hom f.over_base U.1 V.1 e a).symm
    let : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension r A B := hsm.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth A B :=
      Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth r
    have hle := base_dimension_le_of_smooth_point f x (hU hfx)
    have hdim : X.dimension = Y.dimension + r := by omega
    have hrank : Module.finrank B (KaehlerDifferential A B) = r := by
      simp only [Module.finrank,
        Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential r,
        Cardinal.toNat_natCast]
    let c := Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq B (KaehlerDifferential A B) hrank
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := local_logarithmic_numerator E m s hs V t ht hI
    have hq₀n : q₀ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hq
      apply hn
      rw [← hq₀, hq, map_zero]
    let q := degreeTransport ℂ B hdim m q₀
    let a := pluricanonicalCoordinate ℂ A B Y.dimension r m b c q
    have han : a ≠ 0 := by
      have hqn : q ≠ 0 := by
        simpa only [map_zero] using (degreeTransport ℂ B hdim m).injective.ne hq₀n
      simpa only [map_zero] using
        (pluricanonicalCoordinate ℂ A B Y.dimension r m b c).injective.ne hqn
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hWU, hmeet⟩ := exists_open_meeting_coefficient f U.1 hU V e a han
    refine ⟨W, hW, hWU.trans hU, ?_⟩
    intro y hy F
    have hyU := hWU hy
    have hdimF := fiber_dimension_eq f y (hU hyU) F
    have hr : r = F.variety.dimension := by omega
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hmeet y hy F
    have hzV : F.inclusion z ∈ V.1 := X.scheme.basicOpen_le a hz
    let : Nonempty (F.inclusion ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) := ⟨⟨z, hzV⟩⟩
    let cF := basisDegreeTransport hr c
    let qF := degreeTransport ℂ B (congrArg (Y.dimension + ·) hr) m q
    let P : NumeratorChart f.toBoundaryFibration y F U hdimF m s :=
      ⟨V, e, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, cF, t, ht, hI, qF, by
        dsimp only [qF, q]
        rw [degreeTransport_trans, logarithmicPullback_degreeTransport, hq₀]⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, heq⟩ := exists_global_specialization f U hU y hyU F hdimF m s hs b
    refine ⟨σ, hσ, ?_⟩
    rw [← heq P]
    change logarithmicNumerator f.toBoundaryFibration y F U hyU V e
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FormallySmooth A B) Y.dimension F.variety.dimension m b cF t qF ≠ 0
    apply logarithmicNumerator_ne_zero_of_coefficient f.toBoundaryFibration y F U hyU V e
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FormallySmooth A B) Y.dimension m b cF t
      (fiber_boundary_equation_ne_zero f.toBoundaryFibration y F V t hI) qF
    dsimp only [cF, qF]
    rw [pluricanonicalCoordinate_degreeTransport]
    exact chartToFunctionField_ne_zero_of_mem_basicOpen F.inclusion V.1 a z hz

end ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety

end

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.FiberNe.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety.exists_open_fiber_kodaira_ne_bot
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.FiberNe.text:
theorem exists_open_fiber_kodaira_ne_bot
    {X Y : SmoothProjectiveVariety} {E : X.ReducedSNCBoundary} {D : Y.ReducedSNCBoundary}
    (f : StratumSmoothFibration X Y E D) (hE : E.kodaira ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ U : Y.scheme.Opens, U ≠ ⊥ ∧ U ≤ D.complement ∧
      ∀ (y : Y.ComplexPoint), y.point ∈ U →
        ∀ F : FiberModel f.toBoundaryFibration y, F.boundary.kodaira ≠ ⊥ := by
  classical
  have hs : ∃ (m : ℕ), 0 < m ∧ ∃ s : X.RationalPluriform m,
      s ∈ E.sections m ∧ s ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hE (E.kodaira_eq_bot_iff.mpr h)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, s, hs, hn⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨U, hne, hU, hf⟩ := exists_open_nonzero_fiber_pluriform f m hm s hs hn
  refine ⟨U, hne, hU, ?_⟩
  intro y hy F hF
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hnσ⟩ := hf y hy F
  exact hnσ (F.boundary.kodaira_eq_bot_iff.mp hF m hm σ hσ)

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.FiberNe.name: OAI.ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety.veryGenerally_fiber_negative_branch
OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.LogKodaira.FiberNe.text:
theorem veryGenerally_fiber_negative_branch
    {X Y : SmoothProjectiveVariety} {E : X.ReducedSNCBoundary} {D : Y.ReducedSNCBoundary}
    (f : StratumSmoothFibration X Y E D) :
    VeryGenerally Y fun y => y.point ∈ D.complement ∧
      ∀ F : FiberModel f.toBoundaryFibration y, F.boundary.kodaira = ⊥ →
        E.kodaira = D.kodaira + F.boundary.kodaira ∧
        ∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m → ∀ s : X.RationalPluriform m, s ∈ E.sections m → s = 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hE : E.kodaira = ⊥
  · have hne : D.complement ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro hD
      have hg := D.generic_mem_complement
      rw [hD] at hg
      exact hg
    apply veryGenerally_of_nonempty_open hne
    intro y hy
    refine ⟨hy, fun F hF => ⟨?_, E.kodaira_eq_bot_iff.mp hE⟩⟩
    simpa only [hF, WithBot.add_bot] using hE
  · obtain ⟨U, hne, hU, hf⟩ := exists_open_fiber_kodaira_ne_bot f hE
    apply veryGenerally_of_nonempty_open hne
    intro y hy
    exact ⟨hU hy, fun F hF => ((hf y hy F) hF).elim⟩

end ReverseLogKodaira.SmoothProjectiveVariety

end

OAI.Analysis.MutuallyUnbiased.Fourier.Fo.name: OAI.MUB6.fourier_vanishing_of_pair_certificates

theorem fourier_vanishing_of_pair_certificates {H : CMatrix} (hH : IsHadamard H)
    (hcross : PairCertificateIdentity H qCross) (hsame : PairCertificateIdentity H qSame)
    (hTao : ¬Equivalent H tao) (π : Equiv.Perm Coord) :

  rcases dichotomy_of_pair_certificates hH hcross hsame with hz | hs
  · exact hz.permuted_charge π
  · exact (hTao (hadamard_square_equivalent_tao hH hs)).elim

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.HomogeneousMassAssem.text:
theorem symmetric_mahler_from_special_homogeneous_values (n : ℕ)
    (hvalue : ∀ N (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ),
      Function.Injective (measurement A) → ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m →
      Mahler.homogeneousSphereFlux n N (specialLeadingPolynomial A m) =
        (Real.pi*(m:ℝ))^(n+1))
    {K : Set (Fin (n+1) → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ K, -x ∈ K) (hint : (interior K).Nonempty) :
    (4:ℝ)^(n+1)/(Nat.factorial (n+1):ℝ) ≤
      (volume K).toReal*(volume (coordinatePolar K)).toReal := by
  apply symmetric_mahler_from_special_source_flux_limits n _ hK hconv hsym hint
  intro N A hA m hm
  have h := euclideanSpecial_massHypotheses A (by omega) hA hm
  simpa only [hvalue N A hA m hm] using h.sourceCoordinateFlux_limit

end SymmetricMahler

theorem symmetric_mahler_from_special_source_flux_limits (n : ℕ)
    (hlimit : ∀ N (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ),
      Function.Injective (measurement A) → ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → Tendsto
      (fun r => MahlerStokes.sphereFlux r
        (Mahler.sourceCoordinateForm (Mahler.sourceCoordinates n)
          (Mahler.logTau (euclideanSpecialMap A m)) n))
      (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (𝓝 ((Real.pi*(m:ℝ))^(n+1))))
    {K : Set (Fin (n+1) → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ K, -x ∈ K) (hint : (interior K).Nonempty) :
    (4:ℝ)^(n+1)/(Nat.factorial (n+1):ℝ) ≤
      (volume K).toReal*(volume (coordinatePolar K)).toReal := by
  apply symmetric_mahler_from_regular_special_mass (by omega) _ hK hconv hsym hint
  intro N A hA m hm k
  exact special_regular_mass_of_source_flux_limit A hA hm k (hlimit N A hA m hm)

end SymmetricMahler

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.SpecialLeadingTerm:5.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.specialLeadingPolynomial_homogeneous

lemma specialLeadingPolynomial_homogeneous (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) (m : ℕ) (j : Fin N) :
    (specialLeadingPolynomial A m j).IsHomogeneous m := by
  have h : (∑ i : Fin n, MvPolynomial.C (inverseLinearCoefficient*(A j i : ℂ))*MvPolynomial.X i).IsHomogeneous 1 := by
    exact MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.sum _ _ _ (fun i _ => MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C_mul_X _ _)
  simpa only [specialLeadingPolynomial,one_mul] using h.pow m

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.EuclideanSpecialMap:.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.euclideanSpecial_massHypotheses
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.EuclideanSpecialMap:.text:
theorem euclideanSpecial_massHypotheses (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hA : Function.Injective (measurement A)) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    Mahler.MassHypotheses n N m (euclideanStripDomain A)
      (euclideanSpecialMap A m) (specialLeadingPolynomial A m) := by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  refine ⟨hn,by omega,?_,?_,differentiableOn_euclideanSpecialMap A m,?_,
    specialLeadingPolynomial_homogeneous A m,?_,euclideanSpecial_remainder A m,?_⟩
  · exact (isOpen_complexStripDomain A).preimage euclideanCoordinates.continuous
  · change euclideanCoordinates 0 ∈ complexStripDomain A
    simpa only [map_zero] using zero_mem_complexStripDomain A
  · intro z hz
    have h := specialMap_eq_zero_iff A hA hm0 hz
    constructor
    · intro hf
      have he := h.mp (funext hf)
      exact euclideanCoordinates.injective (he.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    · intro hz0 j
      have he := h.mpr (by simp only [hz0,map_zero])
      exact congrFun he j
  · intro z hz
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have he : specialLeadingMap A m (euclideanCoordinates z) = 0 := by
      funext j
      simpa only [specialLeadingPolynomial_eval,euclideanCoordinates,PiLp.coe_continuousLinearEquiv,Pi.zero_apply] using! h j
    have hz0 := (specialLeadingMap_eq_zero_iff A hA hm0 _).mp he
    exact hz (euclideanCoordinates.injective (hz0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  · intro R hR hR1
    exact euclideanSpecial_compact_closure A hA hm0 hR hR1

end SymmetricMahler

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.EuclideanSpecialMap:.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.differentiableOn_euclideanSpecialMap
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.EuclideanSpecialMap:.text:
lemma differentiableOn_euclideanSpecialMap (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (j : Fin N) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (euclideanSpecialMap A m j) (euclideanStripDomain A) := by
  have h := differentiableOn_pi.mp (differentiableOn_specialMap A m) j
  exact h.comp euclideanCoordinates.differentiable.differentiableOn (fun z hz => hz)

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.MassTarget:16.name: OAI.Mahler.MassHypotheses
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.MassTarget:16.text:
structure MassHypotheses (n N m : ℕ) (U : Set (ComplexEuclidean n))
    (f : Fin N → ComplexEuclidean n → ℂ)
    (G : Fin N → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℂ) : Prop where
  dimension_pos : 1 ≤ n
  degree_pos : 1 ≤ m
  open_domain : IsOpen U
  zero_mem : (0 : ComplexEuclidean n) ∈ U
  holomorphic : ∀ j, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f j) U
  isolated_zero : ∀ z ∈ U, (∀ j, f j z = 0) ↔ z = 0
  homogeneous : ∀ j, (G j).IsHomogeneous m
  leading_nonzero : ∀ z : ComplexEuclidean n, z ≠ 0 →
    ∃ j, MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => z i) (G j) ≠ 0
  taylor_remainder : Asymptotics.IsBigO (𝓝[≠] (0 : ComplexEuclidean n))
    (fun z => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => f j z - MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => z i) (G j)) :
      ComplexEuclidean N)) (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ (m + 1))
  compact_sublevels : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R < 1 →
    IsCompact (closure (U ∩ {z | tau f z < R})) ∧
      closure (U ∩ {z | tau f z < R}) ⊆ U

theorem MassHypotheses.homogeneousSphereFlux_value {k N m : ℕ}
    {U : Set (ComplexEuclidean (k+1))} {f : Fin N → ComplexEuclidean (k+1) → ℂ}
    {G : Fin N → MvPolynomial (Fin (k+1)) ℂ} (h : MassHypotheses (k+1) N m U f G) :
    homogeneousSphereFlux k N G = (Real.pi*(m:ℝ))^(k+1) := by
  cases k with
  | zero => simpa only [Nat.zero_add, pow_one] using h.homogeneousCircle_flux
  | succ k => exact h.homogeneous_flux_endpoints.1

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.SpecialLeadingTerm:5.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.specialLeadingPolynomial_eval

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.EuclideanSpecialMap:.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.euclideanSpecial_compact_closure
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.EuclideanSpecialMap:.text:
lemma euclideanSpecial_compact_closure (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : Function.Injective (measurement A)) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hR1 : R < 1) :
    IsCompact (closure (euclideanStripDomain A ∩ {z | Mahler.tau (euclideanSpecialMap A m) z < R})) ∧
      closure (euclideanStripDomain A ∩ {z | Mahler.tau (euclideanSpecialMap A m) z < R}) ⊆
        euclideanStripDomain A := by
  have h := specialTau_compact_closure A hA hm hR hR1
  let S := {z | z ∈ complexStripDomain A ∧ specialTau A m z < R}
  let K := (euclideanCoordinates (n := n)) ⁻¹' closure S
  have hK : IsCompact K := euclideanCoordinates.toHomeomorph.isCompact_preimage.mpr h.1
  have hs : euclideanStripDomain A ∩ {z | Mahler.tau (euclideanSpecialMap A m) z < R} ⊆ K := by
    intro z hz
    apply subset_closure
    exact ⟨hz.1,by simpa only [euclideanSpecialTau,mem_ofPred_eq] using hz.2⟩
  have hclosure := closure_minimal hs hK.isClosed
  exact ⟨hK.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hclosure,fun z hz => h.2 (hclosure hz)⟩

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.SpecialLeadingTerm:4.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.specialLeadingMap
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.SpecialLeadingTerm:4.text:
noncomputable def specialLeadingMap (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (z : Fin n → ℂ) : Fin N → ℂ := fun j => (inverseLinearCoefficient*complexRow A j z)^m

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.HomogeneousSphereInt.name: OAI.Mahler.homogeneousSphereFlux
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.HomogeneousSphereInt.text:
noncomputable def homogeneousSphereFlux (k N : ℕ)
    (G : Fin N → MvPolynomial (Fin (k+1)) ℂ) : ℝ :=
  sphereFlux k (boundaryFormFin (dcLinear (logTau (polynomialMap G))))

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.SpecialLeadingTerm:6.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.specialLeadingMap_eq_zero_iff
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.SpecialLeadingTerm:6.text:
theorem specialLeadingMap_eq_zero_iff (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : Function.Injective (measurement A)) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (z : Fin n → ℂ) : specialLeadingMap A m z = 0 ↔ z = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply complexRow_injective A hA
    funext j
    have hp : (inverseLinearCoefficient*complexRow A j z)^m = 0 := congrFun h j
    have hr : complexRow A j z = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      exact (pow_ne_zero m (mul_ne_zero inverseLinearCoefficient_ne_zero hn)) hp
    simpa using hr
  · rintro rfl
    funext j
    simp [specialLeadingMap,hm.ne']

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.MainTheorem:12.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.symmetric_mahler
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.MainTheorem:12.text:
theorem symmetric_mahler {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ K, -x ∈ K) (hint : (interior K).Nonempty) :
    (4:ℝ)^n/(Nat.factorial n:ℝ) ≤
      (volume K).toReal*(volume (coordinatePolar K)).toReal := by
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k =>
    apply symmetric_mahler_from_special_homogeneous_values k _ hK hconv hsym hint
    intro N A hA m hm
    exact (euclideanSpecial_massHypotheses A (by omega) hA hm).homogeneousSphereFlux_value

end SymmetricMahler

end

OAI.Analysis.Mahler.EuclideanSpecialMap:.name: OAI.SymmetricMahler.euclideanSpecial_remainder
OAI.Analysis.Mahler.EuclideanSpecialMap:.text:
lemma euclideanSpecial_remainder (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    IsBigO (𝓝[≠] (0 : Mahler.ComplexEuclidean n))
      (fun z => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => euclideanSpecialMap A m j z -
        MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => z i) (specialLeadingPolynomial A m j)) :
          Mahler.ComplexEuclidean N)) (fun z => ‖z‖ ^ (m + 1)) := by
  have ht : Tendsto (euclideanCoordinates (n := n)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      ((euclideanCoordinates (n := n)).continuousAt (x := 0)).tendsto.mono_left
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := {0}ᶜ))
  have hcomp := (specialMap_leading_remainder A m).comp_tendsto ht
  have hnorm := (euclideanCoordinates.toContinuousLinearMap.isBigO_id
    (𝓝[≠] (0 : Mahler.ComplexEuclidean n))).norm_norm.pow (m+1)
  have hout := (euclideanCoordinates (n := N)).symm.isBigO_comp
    (fun z : Mahler.ComplexEuclidean n => specialMap A m (euclideanCoordinates z) -
      specialLeadingMap A m (euclideanCoordinates z)) (𝓝[≠] 0)
  have h := hout.trans (hcomp.trans hnorm)
  simpa only [euclideanSpecialMap,specialLeadingPolynomial_eval,euclideanCoordinates,
    PiLp.coe_continuousLinearEquiv,PiLp.coe_symm_continuousLinearEquiv,Pi.sub_apply] using! h

  (∑ i, MvPolynomial.C (inverseLinearCoefficient*(A j i : ℂ))*MvPolynomial.X i)^m

OAI.Analysis.MarkovType.RenormingBasic:4.name: OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.UniformConvex
OAI.Analysis.MarkovType.RenormingBasic:4.text:
def UniformConvex (p : Seminorm ℝ X) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 2 → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
    ∀ x y : X, p x ≤ 1 → p y ≤ 1 → ε ≤ p (x - y) →
      p ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + y)) ≤ 1 - δ

OAI.Analysis.MarkovType.PisierPowerRenor.name: OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.exists_power_smooth_equivalentNorm
OAI.Analysis.MarkovType.PisierPowerRenor.text:
theorem exists_power_smooth_equivalentNorm [CompleteSpace X] (hUC : HasEquivalentUCNorm X) :
    ∃ N : EquivalentNorm X, ∃ q : ℝ, 1 < q ∧ q ≤ 2 ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ SymmetricPowerSmooth N.p q C ∧ PowerSmooth N.p q C ∧
        (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → smoothnessModulus N.p t ≤ C * t ^ q) ∧
        UniformSmooth N.p := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr₂, χ, hχ, hUpper⟩ := finiteUpperL2_of_hasEquivalentUCNorm hUC
  have hUpper' : FiniteUpperL2 X r (max 1 χ) := by
    intro m μ F M N B hB hM hdiff
    refine (hUpper m μ F M N B hB hM hdiff).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right 1 χ)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)) hB
  let q : ℝ := (1 + r) / 2
  have hq : 1 < q := by dsimp [q]; linarith only [hr]
  have hqr : q < r := by dsimp [q]; linarith only [hr]
  have hq₂ : q ≤ 2 := by dsimp [q]; linarith only [hr₂]
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hDyadic⟩ := finiteUpperL2_extrapolate_dyadic
    hr hr₂ (le_max_left 1 χ) hUpper' hq hqr
  obtain ⟨N, _, _, hC, hSym, hPower, hModulus, hUniform⟩ :=
    exists_powerSmooth_equivalentNorm_of_finiteDyadicType hq hT hDyadic
  exact ⟨N, q, hq, hq₂, T ^ q, hC, hSym, hPower, hModulus, hUniform⟩

end MarkovSuperreflexivity

end OAI

  upper_bound : ∀ x, p x ≤ upper * ‖x‖

    (N : EquivalentNorm X) {q D : ℝ}

theorem global_bounded_persistent_solution :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (N : ReactionNetwork d) (κ : Reaction N → ℝ),
      0 < d → WeaklyReversible N → (∀ e, 0 < κ e) →
      ∀ x0 : Fin d → ℝ, PositiveState x0 →
      ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧
        (∃ x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ), IsGlobalForwardSolution N κ x0 x) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ), IsGlobalForwardSolution N κ x0 x →
        ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i : Fin d, ε ≤ x t i ∧ x t i ≤ ε⁻¹ := by
  intro d N κ hd hweak hκ x0 hx0
  obtain ⟨K, hK, _, _, hxK, hpos, hinv⟩ :=
    compact_convex_invariant_polytope d N κ hd hweak hκ x0 hx0
  exact global_bounds_of_compact_invariant N κ x0 hK hxK hpos hinv

end Problem326

OAI.Analysis.MassAction.BarrierInvarianc.text:
theorem compact_convex_invariant_polytope_of_uniform {d : ℕ}
    (happroximation : UniformAffineApproximation d)
    (N : ReactionNetwork d) (κ : Reaction N → ℝ)
    (hweak : WeaklyReversible N) (hκ : ∀ e, 0 < κ e)
    (x₀ : Fin d → ℝ) (hx₀ : PositiveState x₀) :
    ∃ K : Set (Fin d → ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ Convex ℝ K ∧ IsFinitePolyhedron K ∧
      x₀ ∈ K ∧ K ⊆ {x | PositiveState x} ∧ IsForwardInvariant N κ K := by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := exists_affineBarrierData happroximation N κ hweak hκ x₀ hx₀
  obtain ⟨hc, hv, hp, hx, hpos⟩ := A.geometric_properties
  exact ⟨A.plateau, hc, hv, hp, hx, hpos, A.isForwardInvariant⟩

def IsForwardInvariant {d : ℕ} (N : ReactionNetwork d)
    (κ : Reaction N → ℝ) (K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ z, z ∈ K →
    (∃ x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ), IsGlobalForwardSolution N κ z x) ∧
    ∀ (T : ℝ) (x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ)), 0 ≤ T →
      IsForwardSolutionOn N κ z T x →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, x t ∈ K) ∧
      ∃ xg : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ),
        IsGlobalForwardSolution N κ z xg ∧
        Set.EqOn xg x (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T)

end Problem326

theorem compact_convex_invariant_polytope :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (N : ReactionNetwork d) (κ : Reaction N → ℝ),
      0 < d → WeaklyReversible N → (∀ e, 0 < κ e) →
      ∀ x0 : Fin d → ℝ, PositiveState x0 →
      ∃ K : Set (Fin d → ℝ),
        IsCompact K ∧ Convex ℝ K ∧ IsFinitePolyhedron K ∧
        x0 ∈ K ∧ K ⊆ {x | PositiveState x} ∧ IsForwardInvariant N κ K := by
  intro d N κ _ hweak hκ x0 hx0
  apply BarrierConstruction.compact_convex_invariant_polytope_of_uniform ?_
    N κ hweak hκ x0 hx0
  exact Affine.uniform_affine_data_of_full_certificates
    (fun E hE => Affine.exists_fullCertificate d (-1) 1 E (by norm_num)
      (fun r _ => hE r))

theorem exists_fullCertificate :
    ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ a b : ℝ, ∀ E : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ,
      a < b → (∀ r, Cube a b r → 0 < E r) →
      Nonempty (FullCertificate d a b E) := by
  apply fullCertificate_of_local_and_glue
  · intro d hd ih a b E hab hE t hat htb
    by_cases heq : t = b
    · subst t
      exact ⟨localCertificate_upper hd a b E (hE _ (fun _ => ⟨hab.le, le_rfl⟩))⟩
    · apply localCertificate_of_layers hd (lt_of_le_of_ne htb heq) E
        (hE _ (fun _ => ⟨hat, htb⟩))
      intro k hk hkd β htβ hβb
      obtain ⟨F, _, hF⟩ := exists_typeFamily_layerCertificate hk hkd htβ hβb E
        (fun r hr => hE r (fun i => ⟨hat.trans (hr i).1, (hr i).2⟩))
        (fun E' hE' => ih k hkd β b E' hβb hE')
      exact ⟨F, hF⟩
  · intro d hd a b E hab _ hlocal
    exact glue_localCertificates hd hab.le E hlocal

end Problem326.Affine

OAI.Analysis.MassAction.CompactInvarianc.name: OAI.Problem326.global_bounds_of_compact_invariant
OAI.Analysis.MassAction.CompactInvarianc.text:
theorem global_bounds_of_compact_invariant {d : ℕ}
    (N : ReactionNetwork d) (κ : Reaction N → ℝ) (x0 : Fin d → ℝ)
    {K : Set (Fin d → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hx0 : x0 ∈ K)
    (hpos : K ⊆ {x | PositiveState x}) (hinv : IsForwardInvariant N κ K) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧
      (∃ x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ), IsGlobalForwardSolution N κ x0 x) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ → (Fin d → ℝ), IsGlobalForwardSolution N κ x0 x →
        ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i : Fin d, ε ≤ x t i ∧ x t i ≤ ε⁻¹ := by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεone, hbound⟩ := compact_positive_uniform_bounds hK
    (fun x hx => hpos hx)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, hεone, (hinv x0 hx0).1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx t ht i
  have hfinite : IsForwardSolutionOn N κ x0 t x := by
    refine ⟨hx.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro s hs
      exact (hx.2 s hs.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro s hs
      exact hx.2 s hs.1.le
  have hmem := ((hinv x0 hx0).2 t x ht hfinite).1 t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩
  exact hbound (x t) hmem i

end Problem326

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.MassAction.CompactBounds:13.name: OAI.Problem326.compact_positive_uniform_bounds
OAI.Analysis.MassAction.CompactBounds:13.text:
theorem compact_positive_uniform_bounds {ι : Type uIota} [Finite ι]
    {K : Set (ι → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i, 0 < x i) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i, ε ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ ε⁻¹ := by
  let S : Set ℝ := ⋃ i : ι, (fun x : ι → ℝ => x i) '' K
  have hS : IsCompact S :=
    isCompact_iUnion (fun i => hK.image (continuous_apply i))
  have hSpos : ∀ y ∈ S, 0 < y := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, x, hx, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    exact hpos x hx i
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haS⟩ := hS.exists_forall_le' continuous_id.continuousOn hSpos
  have hinv : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) S :=
    continuousOn_id.inv₀ (fun y hy => ne_of_gt (hSpos y hy))
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbS⟩ := hS.exists_forall_le' hinv
    (fun y hy => inv_pos.mpr (hSpos y hy))
  let ε : ℝ := min (1 / 2) (min a b)
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min ha hb)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  intro x hx i
  have hmem : x i ∈ S := Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hεa : ε ≤ a := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hεb : ε ≤ b := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  refine ⟨hεa.trans (haS _ hmem), ?_⟩
  have hle : ε ≤ (x i)⁻¹ := hεb.trans (hbS _ hmem)
  exact (le_inv_comm₀ hε (hpos x hx i)).mp hle

end Problem326

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.MassAction.UniformAffineDat.name: OAI.Problem326.Affine.uniform_affine_data_of_full_certificates
OAI.Analysis.MassAction.UniformAffineDat.text:
theorem uniform_affine_data_of_full_certificates {d : ℕ}
    (hfull : ∀ E : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ r, 0 < E r) →
      Nonempty (FullCertificate d (-1) 1 E)) :
    ∀ E : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ r, 0 < E r) →
      ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ (r : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
        (c : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (h₀ : ℝ), 0 < h₀ ∧
        ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < h₀ → ∀ p : Fin d → ℝ,
          (∀ i, |p i| ≤ 1) → ∀ j : Fin n,
            (∀ k : Fin n,
              dot (r j) (fun i => h ^ p i) + c j h ≤
                dot (r k) (fun i => h ^ p i) + c k h) →
            ∀ i, |p i - r j i| < E (r j) := by
  intro E hE
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := hfull E hE
  exact C.uniform_affine_data hE

end Problem326.Affine

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineFact.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.affineLift_hasFactorization
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineFact.text:
theorem affineLift_hasFactorization {n r : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (he : Even n)
    (h : HasAffineLift n r) : HasFactorization n r := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨L, T, hT⟩ := h
  have hvertex (M : PerfectMatching n) : ∃ X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ,
      X ∈ L ∧ X.PosSemidef ∧ T X = matchingPoint M := by
    have hm : matchingPoint M ∈ matchingPolytope n :=
      subset_convexHull ℝ _ (Set.mem_range_self M)
    rw [← hT] at hm
    obtain ⟨X, hX, heq⟩ := hm
    exact ⟨X, hX.1, hX.2, heq⟩
  choose B hBL hB hBT using hvertex
  have hrow (i : Row n) : ∃ A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ,
      A.PosSemidef ∧ ∀ M, (A * B M).trace = slack i M := by
    obtain ⟨M₀, hzero⟩ := row_has_tight_matching hn he i
    have hnonneg (X : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) (hXL : X ∈ L)
        (hXP : X.PosSemidef) : 0 ≤ ((slackAffine i).comp T) X := by
      apply slackAffine_nonneg
      rw [← hT]
      exact ⟨X, ⟨hXL, hXP⟩, rfl⟩
    have hz : ((slackAffine i).comp T) (B M₀) = 0 := by
      simpa only [AffineMap.comp_apply, hBT, slackAffine_vertex] using hzero
    obtain ⟨A, hA, hAB⟩ := AffinePSD.affine_slack_certificate L B hB hBL
      ((slackAffine i).comp T) hnonneg M₀ hz
    refine ⟨A, hA, fun M => ?_⟩
    simpa only [AffineMap.comp_apply, hBT, slackAffine_vertex] using hAB M
  choose A hA hAB using hrow
  exact ⟨A, B, hA, hB, fun i M => (hAB i M).symm⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.FiniteFact.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.psdRank_le

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.TightMatch.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.row_has_tight_matching
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.TightMatch.text:
lemma row_has_tight_matching {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (he : Even n) (i : Row n) :
    ∃ M : PerfectMatching n, slack i M = 0 := by
  cases i with
  | inl e => exact edge_has_tight_matching hn he e
  | inr U => exact oddCut_has_tight_matching he U

end PerfectMatchingPSD

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineSlac.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.slackAffine_vertex
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineSlac.text:
lemma slackAffine_vertex {n : ℕ} (i : Row n) (M : PerfectMatching n) :
    slackAffine i (matchingPoint M) = slack i M := by
  classical
  cases i with
  | inl e => rfl
  | inr U =>
    simp only [slackAffine, AffineMap.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, AffineMap.const_apply,
      LinearMap.coe_toAffineMap, slack]
    congr 1
    rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
    calc
      _ = ∑ e : Edge n, if Crosses U.1 e ∧ e ∈ M.1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro e _
        by_cases h : Crosses U.1 e <;> simp [h, matchingPoint]
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_boole, crossingCount]
        apply congrArg (fun s : Finset (Edge n) => (s.card : ℝ))
        ext e
        simp [and_comm]

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineFact.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.factorization_order_pos
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineFact.text:
lemma factorization_order_pos {n r : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (he : Even n)
    (h : HasFactorization n r) : 0 < r := by
  classical
  by_contra hr
  have hr0 : r = 0 := by omega
  subst r
  obtain ⟨M⟩ := perfectMatching_nonempty he
  let v : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hc := M.2 v
  obtain ⟨e, heq⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc
  have heM : e ∈ M.1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (heq.symm ▸ Finset.mem_singleton_self e)).1
  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hf⟩ := h
  have hz := hf (Sum.inl e) M
  simp [slack, heM, Matrix.trace] at hz

end PerfectMatchingPSD

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineMode.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.HasAffineLift
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineMode.text:
def HasAffineLift (n r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (L : AffineSubspace ℝ (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ))
    (T : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ →ᵃ[ℝ] (Edge n → ℝ)),
    T '' {X | X ∈ L ∧ X.PosSemidef} = matchingPolytope n

end PerfectMatchingPSD

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Model:12.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.PerfectMatching
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Model:12.text:
abbrev PerfectMatching (n : ℕ) :=
  {M : Finset (Edge n) // IsPerfectMatching M}

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineSlac.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.slackAffine_nonneg
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineSlac.text:
lemma slackAffine_nonneg {n : ℕ} (i : Row n) {x : Edge n → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ matchingPolytope n) : 0 ≤ slackAffine i x := by
  have hc : Convex ℝ {x : Edge n → ℝ | 0 ≤ slackAffine i x} := by
    exact (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ)).affine_preimage (slackAffine i)
  apply convexHull_min _ hc hx
  rintro _ ⟨M, rfl⟩
  rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, slackAffine_vertex]
  exact slack_nonneg i M

end PerfectMatchingPSD

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineSlac.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.slackAffine
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineSlac.text:
noncomputable def slackAffine {n : ℕ} (i : Row n) : (Edge n → ℝ) →ᵃ[ℝ] ℝ := by
  classical
  cases i with
  | inl e => exact (LinearMap.proj e).toAffineMap
  | inr U =>
    exact (∑ e : Edge n, if Crosses U.1 e then LinearMap.proj e else 0).toAffineMap -
      AffineMap.const ℝ (Edge n → ℝ) 1

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Normalized.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.perfectMatching_nonempty
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Normalized.text:
lemma perfectMatching_nonempty {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) : Nonempty (PerfectMatching n) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hn
  let e : (Fin k × Bool) ≃ Fin n := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by
    simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool]
    omega)
  exact ⟨fromPairing (Pairing.transport e standardPairing)⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineMode.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.matchingPolytope
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineMode.text:
noncomputable def matchingPolytope (n : ℕ) : Set (Edge n → ℝ) :=
  convexHull ℝ (Set.range (matchingPoint (n := n)))

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Model:34.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.HasFactorization
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Model:34.text:
def HasFactorization (n r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : Row n → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (B : PerfectMatching n → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ),
    (∀ i, (A i).PosSemidef) ∧ (∀ M, (B M).PosSemidef) ∧
    ∀ i M, slack i M = Matrix.trace (A i * B M)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineCert.name: OAI.AffinePSD.affine_slack_certificate
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineCert.text:
lemma affine_slack_certificate (L : AffineSubspace ℝ (Matrix R R ℝ))
    (B : I → Matrix R R ℝ) (hB : ∀ i, (B i).PosSemidef) (hBL : ∀ i, B i ∈ L)
    (f : Matrix R R ℝ →ᵃ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hn : ∀ X ∈ L, X.PosSemidef → 0 ≤ f X)
    (i₀ : I) (hz : f (B i₀) = 0) :
    ∃ A : Matrix R R ℝ, A.PosSemidef ∧ ∀ i, (A * B i).trace = f (B i) := by
  classical
  suffices ∃ A : Matrix R R ℝ, A.PosSemidef ∧ evaluation B A = fun i => f (B i) by
    obtain ⟨A, hA, he⟩ := this
    exact ⟨A, hA, fun i => congrFun he i⟩
  apply exists_psd_evaluation B hB
  intro c hc
  let s : ℝ := ∑ i, c i
  let t : ℝ := |s| + 1
  let q : ℝ := s + t
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q, t]; linarith [neg_abs_le s]
  let w : I → ℝ := fun i => (c i + if i = i₀ then t else 0) / q
  have hw : ∑ i, w i = 1 := by
    simp only [w, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simpa only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, q, s] using div_self hq.ne'
  have hmatrix : ∑ i, w i • B i = q⁻¹ • ((∑ i, c i • B i) + t • B i₀) := by
    simp only [w, div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← Finset.smul_sum, add_smul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hpos : (∑ i, w i • B i).PosSemidef := by
    rw [hmatrix]
    exact (hc.add ((hB i₀).smul ht)).smul (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
  have hnonneg := hn _ (affine_sum_mem L B hBL w hw) hpos
  rw [affine_sum_apply f B w hw] at hnonneg
  have hvalue : ∑ i, w i • f (B i) = (∑ i, c i * f (B i)) / q := by
    simp only [w, smul_eq_mul, add_div, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Finset.sum_div]
    simp [hz]
  rw [hvalue] at hnonneg
  have hh := (le_div_iff₀ hq).mp hnonneg
  simpa using hh

end AffinePSD

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineLift.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.affine_lift_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineLift.text:
theorem affine_lift_lower_bound :
    ∀ C : ℝ, 0 < C → ∃ n₀ : ℕ, 4 ≤ n₀ ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → Even n → ∀ r : ℕ,
        HasAffineLift n r → (n : ℝ) ^ C < (r : ℝ) := by
  intro C hC
  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀, hmain⟩ := main C hC
  refine ⟨n₀, hn₀, ?_⟩
  intro n hn he r h
  have hn4 : 4 ≤ n := hn₀.trans hn
  have hf := affineLift_hasFactorization hn4 he h
  have hr := factorization_order_pos (by omega) he hf
  exact (hmain n hn he).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast psdRank_le hr hf)

end PerfectMatchingPSD

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineMode.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.matchingPoint
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.AffineMode.text:
noncomputable def matchingPoint {n : ℕ} (M : PerfectMatching n) : Edge n → ℝ := by

  exact fun e => if e ∈ M.1 then 1 else 0

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Dualit.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.linearScore_expectation
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Dualit.text:
theorem linearScore_expectation (G : LooplessGraph V E) (p : G.Matching → ℝ)
    (u : E → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ M, p M * linearScore G u c M) =
      (∑ e, u e * G.mean p e) - c * ∑ M, p M := by
  simp only [linearScore, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [sum_mean_assoc]
  ring

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Main:2.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_barrier_ge_id
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Main:2.text:
theorem entropy_barrier_ge_id {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (h8 : t ≤ Real.log 8) :
    t ≤ 8 * (1-Real.exp (-t)) := by
  have he : 1 ≤ Real.exp t := Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr ht
  have he8 : Real.exp t ≤ 8 := by
    have hh := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h8
    rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 8)] at hh
    exact hh
  have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (Real.exp_pos t)
  rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog
  have hin := Real.exp_neg t
  rw [hin]
  have hp := Real.exp_pos t
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hp).mp
  have hmain : t * Real.exp t ≤ 8 * (Real.exp t - 1) := by
    have : t ≤ Real.exp t - 1 := hlog
    nlinarith
  have hprod : Real.exp t * (8*(1-(Real.exp t)⁻¹)) = 8*(Real.exp t-1) := by
    field_simp [hp.ne']
  calc
    Real.exp t * t = t * Real.exp t := mul_comm _ _
    _ ≤ 8 * (Real.exp t-1) := hmain
    _ = _ := hprod.symm

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.sum_positive_support
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.text:
theorem sum_positive_support (x f : E → ℝ) (hf : ∀ e, ¬ 0 < x e → f e=0) :
    (∑ e, f e) = ∑ e : {e // 0 < x e}, f e.val := by
  classical
  have hz : (∑ e : {e // ¬ 0 < x e}, f e.val)=0 :=
    Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => hf e.val e.property
  have hh := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype (fun e => 0 < x e) f
  rw [hz,add_zero] at hh
  exact hh.symm

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Basic:.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.indicator
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Basic:.text:
def indicator (G : LooplessGraph V E) (M : G.Matching) (e : E) : ℝ :=
  if e ∈ M.val then 1 else 0

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.matching_covariance_trace
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.text:
theorem matching_covariance_trace (G : LooplessGraph V E) {x : E → ℝ}
    {p : G.Matching → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ G.feasibleLaws x) {m : ℕ}
    (hV : Fintype.card V=2*m) :
    (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x)).trace = Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e}-(m:ℝ) := by
  have hx : x ∈ G.polytope := (G.mem_polytope_iff x).mpr ⟨p,hp⟩
  have hsum : (∑ e : {e // 0 < x e}, x e.val)=(m:ℝ) := by
    rw [← G.marginal_sum hV hx]
    exact (sum_positive_support x x (fun e he => le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt he) (G.coordinate_mem_Icc hx e).1)).symm
  unfold matchingNormalized
  rw [normalized_covariance_trace hp.1 _ ?_ _ ?_ (fun e => e.property),hsum]
  · intro M e
    simp only [LooplessGraph.indicator]
    split <;> norm_num
  · intro e
    exact congrFun hp.2 e.val

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_nonneg
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.text:
theorem entropy_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex ι) : 0 ≤ entropy p := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  exact Real.negMulLog_nonneg (hp.1 i)
    (probabilitySimplex_le_one hp i)

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Contin.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.maxMatchingEntropy_lowerSemicontinuousOn
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Contin.text:
theorem maxMatchingEntropy_lowerSemicontinuousOn (G : LooplessGraph V E)
    (heven : Even (Fintype.card V)) :
    LowerSemicontinuousOn (maxMatchingEntropy G) G.polytope := by
  intro x hx r hr
  have hn := maxMatchingEntropy_nonneg G hx
  have hden : 0 < maxMatchingEntropy G x+1 := by linarith
  have ha : 0 < min (1:ℝ) ((maxMatchingEntropy G x-r)/(maxMatchingEntropy G x+1)) :=
    lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hr) hden)
  obtain ⟨t,ht0,htt⟩ := exists_between ha
  have ht1 : t<1 := htt.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have htb : t*(maxMatchingEntropy G x+1) < maxMatchingEntropy G x-r :=
    (lt_div_iff₀ hden).mp (htt.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  filter_upwards [G.polytope_eventually_expand heven hx ht0] with y hy
  have hh := maxMatchingEntropy_mix_ge G hx hy ⟨ht0.le,ht1.le⟩
  have he : (1-t) • x+t • (x+t⁻¹ • (y-x))=y := by
    ext e
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,Pi.sub_apply,smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he] at hh
  have hz := mul_nonneg ht0.le (maxMatchingEntropy_nonneg G hy)
  nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Model:.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Model:.text:
structure LooplessGraph (V : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) where
  left : E → V
  right : E → V
  loopless : ∀ e, left e ≠ right e
namespace LooplessGraph
variable {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq E]

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_rank_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.text:
theorem covariance_rank_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {C : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hC : C.PosSemidef) {a : ℝ}
    (hsecond : ∀ u : ι → ℝ,
      (a - 1) * ((C *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ u)) + u ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ u) ≤ 0) :
    (C.rank : ℝ) ≤ (1-a) * C.trace := by
  let eig := hC.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  have heig : ∀ i, 0 ≤ eig i := hC.eigenvalues_nonneg
  have hone : ∀ i, eig i ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ (1-a) * eig i := by
    intro i hi
    let v : ι → ℝ := hC.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i
    have hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
      have hn := hC.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i
      have hi : inner ℝ (hC.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i)
          (hC.isHermitian.eigenvectorBasis i) = 1 := by
        rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn]
        norm_num
      simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, star_trivial] using hi
    have he : C *ᵥ v = eig i • v := hC.isHermitian.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
    have hs := hsecond v
    rw [he] at hs
    simp only [smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hv, mul_one] at hs
    have hp : 0 < eig i := lt_of_le_of_ne (heig i) (Ne.symm hi)
    nlinarith
  rw [hC.isHermitian.rank_eq_card_non_zero_eigs,
    hC.isHermitian.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
  change (Fintype.card {i // eig i ≠ 0} : ℝ) ≤ (1-a) * ∑ i, eig i
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : {i // eig i ≠ 0}, (1 : ℝ) := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ i : {i // eig i ≠ 0}, (1-a) * eig i := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hone i i.property
    _ = ∑ i, (1-a) * eig i := by
      have hz : (∑ i : {i // ¬ eig i ≠ 0}, (1-a) * eig i) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i _
        rw [not_ne_iff.mp i.property, mul_zero]
      simpa only [hz, add_zero] using
        (Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype (fun i => eig i ≠ 0)
          (fun i => (1-a) * eig i))

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.maxMatchingEntropy_nonneg
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.text:
theorem maxMatchingEntropy_nonneg (G : LooplessGraph V E) {y : E → ℝ}
    (hy : y ∈ G.polytope) : 0 ≤ maxMatchingEntropy G y := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := maxMatchingEntropy_attained G hy

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Main:8.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_main
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Main:8.text:
theorem entropy_main (G : LooplessGraph V E) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hV : Fintype.card V = 2 * m)
    (hPM : Nonempty G.Matching) (y : E → ℝ) (hy : y ∈ G.polytope) :
    marginalEntropy y - maxMatchingEntropy G y ≤
      8 * (m : ℝ) * (1 - Real.exp (-marginalEntropy y / (m : ℝ))) := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have heven : Even (Fintype.card V) := by rw [hV]; exact even_two_mul m
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hmax⟩ := entropyDefect_attains_max G heven hPM (m:ℝ)
  by_contra htarget
  have hypos : 0 < entropyDefect G (m:ℝ) y := by
    dsimp [entropyDefect,entropyBarrier,marginalEntropy] at *
    linarith
  have hpos : 0 < entropyDefect G (m:ℝ) x := hypos.trans_le (hmax y hy)
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hopt⟩ := maxMatchingEntropy_attained G hx
  obtain ⟨hxnon,hspos,hentropy⟩ := marginal_entropy_support_bound G hm hV hx
  have hH := maxMatchingEntropy_nonneg G hx
  let s : ℝ := Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e}
  have hsR : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; exact_mod_cast hspos
  have hrpos : 0 < s/(m:ℝ) := div_pos hsR hmR
  have hu : entropy x/(m:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (s/(m:ℝ)) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hmR).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hentropy
  have hlo : Real.log 8 < entropy x/(m:ℝ) := by
    by_contra hle
    have hb := entropy_barrier_ge_id (div_nonneg hxnon hmR.le) (le_of_not_gt hle)
    have hb' := (div_le_iff₀ hmR).mp hb
    dsimp only [entropyDefect,entropyBarrier] at hpos
    rw [neg_div] at hpos
    nlinarith
  have hs8 : 8*(m:ℝ) < s := by
    have hh := (Real.log_lt_log_iff (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<8) hrpos).mp (hlo.trans_le hu)
    exact (lt_div_iff₀ hmR).mp hh
  have ha : 8*(m:ℝ)/s ≤ 8*Real.exp (-entropy x/(m:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hu)
    rw [Real.exp_neg,Real.exp_log hrpos,inv_div] at hh
    rw [neg_div,mul_div_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (by norm_num)
  have hrankNat := matching_covariance_rank G heven hp hopt
  rw [hV] at hrankNat
  have hrankR : s ≤ 2*(2*(m:ℝ))+(covariance p (matchingNormalized G x)).rank := by
    dsimp only [s]
    exact_mod_cast hrankNat
  have hrank : s-4*(m:ℝ) ≤ (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x)).rank := by linarith
  exact covariance_contradiction (covariance_posSemidef p (matchingNormalized G x)) hmR hs8
    hrank (matching_covariance_trace G hp hV) ha
    (matching_covariance_second_variation G hp hopt hmR hmax)

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.normalized_covariance_trace
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.text:
theorem normalized_covariance_trace {p : A → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex A)
    (v : A → I → ℝ) (hv : ∀ a i, (v a i)^2=v a i) (x : I → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, ∑ a, p a*v a i = x i) (hxp : ∀ i, 0 < x i) :
    (covariance p (normalizedCentered v x)).trace = Fintype.card I - ∑ i, x i := by
  unfold Matrix.trace Matrix.diag
  simp_rw [covariance_entry hp.1]
  have heq : ∀ i, (∑ a, p a*normalizedCentered v x a i*normalizedCentered v x a i) = 1-x i := by
    intro i
    simpa only [pow_two, mul_assoc] using
      normalizedCentered_variance hp.2 v hv x hx hxp i
  simp_rw [heq]
  simp

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.normalizeLinear
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.text:
def normalizeLinear (x : E → ℝ) :
    ({e // 0 < x e} → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ({e // 0 < x e} → ℝ) where
  toFun := fun u e => u e/Real.sqrt (x e.val)
  map_add' := by intro u v; ext e; exact add_div _ _ _
  map_smul' := by intro a u; ext e; exact mul_div_assoc _ _ _

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.maxMatchingEntropy_attained
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.text:
theorem maxMatchingEntropy_attained (G : LooplessGraph V E) {y : E → ℝ}
    (hy : y ∈ G.polytope) :
    ∃ p ∈ G.feasibleLaws y, entropy p = maxMatchingEntropy G y := by
  have hc := (G.compact_feasibleLaws y).image continuous_entropy
  have hn := ((G.mem_polytope_iff y).mp hy).image entropy
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := hc.sSup_mem hn
  exact ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.matchingNormalized_score
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.text:
theorem matchingNormalized_score (G : LooplessGraph V E) (x : E → ℝ)
    (u : {e // 0 < x e} → ℝ) (M : G.Matching) :
    linearScore G (matchingScoreWeights x u) (∑ e, matchingScoreWeights x u e*x e) M =
      matchingNormalized G x M ⬝ᵥ u := by
  classical
  unfold linearScore
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [sum_positive_support x _ (fun e he => by simp [matchingScoreWeights,LooplessGraph.positiveExtension,he])]
  rw [dotProduct]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  simp only [matchingScoreWeights,LooplessGraph.positiveExtension_pos,matchingNormalized,normalizedCentered]
  ring
