OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.normalized_face_mem
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.text:
theorem normalized_face_mem (G : LooplessGraph V E) {x : E → ℝ}
    (heven : Even (Fintype.card V)) {p : G.Matching → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ G.feasibleLaws x) (hopt : entropy p=maxMatchingEntropy G x)
    {u : {e // 0 < x e} → ℝ} (hu : u ∈ G.faceSpace x) :
    (fun e => u e/Real.sqrt (x e.val)) ∈ weightedDirectionSpace p (matchingNormalized G x) := by
  have hx : x ∈ G.polytope := (G.mem_polytope_iff x).mpr ⟨p,hp⟩
  have hev := G.faceSpace_eventually_line (G.polytope_subset_constraintPolytope hx) hu
  have hneg : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, x+(-t) • LooplessGraph.positiveExtension x u ∈ G.constraintPolytope := by
    have hc : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => -t) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by simpa using continuous_neg.tendsto (0:ℝ)
    exact hc.eventually hev
  have hh : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      (x+t • LooplessGraph.positiveExtension x u ∈ G.constraintPolytope ∧
      x+(-t) • LooplessGraph.positiveExtension x u ∈ G.constraintPolytope) ∧ 0 < t :=
    ((hev.and hneg).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds).and eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
  obtain ⟨a,⟨ha,hna⟩,ha0⟩ := hh.exists
  rw [← G.polytope_eq_constraints heven] at ha hna
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := (G.mem_polytope_iff _).mp ha
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := (G.mem_polytope_iff _).mp hna
  have hsupp := midpoint_law_support G hp hopt hq hr
  have hsum : (∑ M, q M • matchingNormalized G x M) ∈
      weightedDirectionSpace p (matchingNormalized G x) := by
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro M _
    by_cases hM : 0 < p M
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨M,hM⟩,rfl⟩)
    · have hq0 : q M=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt fun hqM => hM (hsupp M hqM)) (hq.1.1 M)
      simp only [hq0,zero_smul]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  have hin := Submodule.smul_mem _ a⁻¹ hsum
  have he : a⁻¹ • (∑ M, q M • matchingNormalized G x M) =
      (fun e => u e/Real.sqrt (x e.val)) := by
    ext e
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply,Finset.sum_apply,smul_eq_mul]
    rw [matchingNormalized_average G hq]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,LooplessGraph.positiveExtension_pos]
    field_simp
    ring
  rwa [he] at hin

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_rank
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.text:
theorem covariance_rank {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (b : A → I → ℝ) :
    (covariance p b).rank = Module.finrank ℝ (weightedDirectionSpace p b) := by
  rw [covariance, rank_self_mul_transpose, rank_eq_finrank_span_cols, weightedColumns_span hp]

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Calcul.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropyLineD
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Calcul.text:
def entropyLineD {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x v : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -∑ i, v i * Real.log (x i+t*v i) - ∑ i, v i

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_quadratic
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.text:
theorem covariance_quadratic {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (b : A → I → ℝ)
    (u : I → ℝ) : u ⬝ᵥ (covariance p b *ᵥ u) = ∑ a, p a*(b a ⬝ᵥ u)^2 := by
  rw [dotProduct]
  simp_rw [covariance_mulVec hp, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  calc
    (∑ i, u i*(p a*b a i*(b a ⬝ᵥ u))) =
      (∑ i, b a i*u i)*(p a*(b a ⬝ᵥ u)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    _ = p a*(b a ⬝ᵥ u)^2 := by rw [← dotProduct]; ring

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.matchingNormalized_mulVec
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.text:
theorem matchingNormalized_mulVec (G : LooplessGraph V E) {x : E → ℝ}
    {p : G.Matching → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ G.feasibleLaws x)
    (u : {e // 0 < x e} → ℝ) (e : {e // 0 < x e}) :
    (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x) *ᵥ u) e =
      G.mean (fun M => p M * linearScore G (matchingScoreWeights x u)
        (∑ e, matchingScoreWeights x u e*x e) M) e.val / Real.sqrt (x e.val) := by
  let a := linearScore G (matchingScoreWeights x u) (∑ e, matchingScoreWeights x u e*x e)
  have hcenter : ∑ M, p M*a M=0 := by
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [linearScore_expectation,hp.2,hp.1.2,mul_one,sub_self]
  calc
    _ = ∑ M, (p M*a M*G.indicator M e.val-x e.val*(p M*a M))/Real.sqrt (x e.val) := by
      rw [covariance_mulVec hp.1.1]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro M _
      rw [← matchingNormalized_score G x u M]
      change p M*((G.indicator M e.val-x e.val)/Real.sqrt (x e.val))*a M = _
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,hcenter,mul_zero,sub_zero]
      rfl

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Main:5.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.marginal_entropy_support_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Main:5.text:
theorem marginal_entropy_support_bound (G : LooplessGraph V E) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hV : Fintype.card V=2*m) {x : E → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ G.polytope) :
    0 ≤ entropy x ∧ 0 < Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e} ∧
      entropy x ≤ (m:ℝ)*Real.log ((Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e}:ℝ)/(m:ℝ)) := by
  have hmR : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmass := G.marginal_sum hV hx
  have hn : ∀ e, 0 ≤ x e := fun e => (G.coordinate_mem_Icc hx e).1
  have hz : ∀ e, ¬ 0 < x e → x e=0 := fun e he => le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt he) (hn e)
  have hsum : (∑ e : {e // 0 < x e}, x e.val)=(m:ℝ) :=
    (sum_positive_support x x hz).symm.trans hmass
  have hent : entropy (fun e : {e // 0 < x e} => x e.val)=entropy x := by
    unfold entropy
    exact (sum_positive_support x (fun e => Real.negMulLog (x e))
      (fun e he => by rw [hz e he,Real.negMulLog_zero])).symm
  have hpossum : 0 < ∑ e, x e := by rw [hmass]; exact hmR
  obtain ⟨e,_,he⟩ := (Finset.sum_pos_iff_of_nonneg (fun e _ => hn e)).mp hpossum
  have hs : 0 < Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e} := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨⟨e,he⟩⟩
  have hsR : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e} := by exact_mod_cast hs
  refine ⟨Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => Real.negMulLog_nonneg (hn e) (G.coordinate_mem_Icc hx e).2),hs,?_⟩
  let c : ℝ := (Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e}:ℝ)/(m:ℝ)
  have hc : 0 < c := div_pos hsR hmR
  have hcm : c*(m:ℝ)=Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e} := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hmR.ne'
  have hb := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun e : {e // 0 < x e} => fun _ =>
    Real.negMulLog_le_one_sub_self (mul_nonneg hc.le e.property.le))
  simp_rw [Real.negMulLog_mul] at hb
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_mul,← Finset.mul_sum,hsum,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,hsum] at hb
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one] at hb
  change (m:ℝ)*Real.negMulLog c+c*entropy (fun e : {e // 0 < x e} => x e.val) ≤
    (Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e}:ℝ)-c*(m:ℝ) at hb
  rw [hent,Real.negMulLog,hcm,sub_self] at hb
  change entropy x ≤ (m:ℝ)*Real.log c
  nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Second.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropyDefect
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Second.text:
def entropyDefect (G : LooplessGraph V E) (m : ℝ) (y : E → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  entropyBarrier m (entropy y)-maxMatchingEntropy G y

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_contradiction
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.text:
theorem covariance_contradiction {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {C : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hC : C.PosSemidef) {a m s : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 8*m < s) (hrank : s-4*m ≤ C.rank)
    (htrace : C.trace = s-m) (ha : 8*m/s ≤ a)
    (hsecond : ∀ u : ι → ℝ,
      (a-1) * ((C *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ u)) + u ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ u) ≤ 0) : False := by
  have hb := covariance_rank_bound hC hsecond
  rw [htrace] at hb
  have hsp : 0 < s := by linarith
  have hsmp : 0 < s-m := by linarith
  have hau : a ≤ 3*m/(s-m) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hsmp).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hcross := (div_le_div_iff₀ hsp hsmp).mp (ha.trans hau)
  nlinarith [mul_pos hm (show 0 < 5*s-8*m by linarith)]

end MatchingEntropy

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Second.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.matching_defect_second_variation
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Second.text:
theorem matching_defect_second_variation (G : LooplessGraph V E) {x : E → ℝ}
    {p : G.Matching → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ G.feasibleLaws x)
    (hopt : entropy p = maxMatchingEntropy G x) {m : ℝ} (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (hmax : ∀ y ∈ G.polytope, entropyDefect G m y ≤ entropyDefect G m x)
    (u : E → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hcenter : ∑ M, p M*linearScore G u c M = 0) :
    (8*Real.exp (-entropy x/m)-1)*
        (∑ e, (G.mean (fun M => p M*linearScore G u c M) e)^2/x e) +
      (8*Real.exp (-entropy x/m)/m)*
        (entropyLineD x (G.mean (fun M => p M*linearScore G u c M)) 0)^2 +
      (∑ M, p M*(linearScore G u c M)^2) ≤ 0 := by
  let a := linearScore G u c
  let v := G.mean (fun M => p M*a M)
  let c₀ := ∑ M, p M*Real.log (p M)
  let c₁ := ∑ M, (p M*a M)*Real.log (p M)
  have hsupp : ∀ e, x e = 0 → v e = 0 := by
    rw [← hp.2]
    exact mean_score_support G hp.1 a
  apply entropy_second_variation x v hsupp hp.1 a hcenter hm c₀ c₁
  filter_upwards [score_law_eventually_simplex hp.1 a hcenter] with t ht
  let r := fun M => p M+t*(p M*a M)
  have hr : r ∈ probabilitySimplex G.Matching := ht
  have hrmean : G.mean r = fun e => x e+t*v e := by
    change G.meanLinear (p+t • (fun M => p M*a M)) = _
    rw [map_add, map_smul]
    change G.mean p+t • v = _
    rw [hp.2]
    rfl
  have hdual := matching_entropy_dual_bound G hp hopt hr
    (fun M hM => by dsimp [r]; simp [hM]) u c t
  have hscore : (∑ M, r M*a M) = t*(∑ M, p M*(a M)^2) := by
    dsimp [r]
    simp_rw [add_mul, mul_assoc t, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [hcenter, zero_add]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro M _
    ring
  have hlog : (∑ M, r M*Real.log (p M)) = c₀+t*c₁ := by
    dsimp [r, c₀, c₁]
    simp_rw [add_mul, mul_assoc t, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  change maxMatchingEntropy G (G.mean r) ≤
    Real.log (partition p a t) - (∑ M, r M*Real.log (p M)) - t*(∑ M, r M*a M) at hdual
  rw [hlog, hscore] at hdual
  have hmaxr := hmax (G.mean r) (G.mean_mem_polytope hr)
  dsimp only [entropyDefect] at hmaxr
  have hzero := partition_zero hp.1 a
  simp only [zero_mul, zero_pow (by omega : 2 ≠ 0), add_zero, hzero,
    Real.log_one, sub_zero]
  rw [← hopt] at hmaxr
  rw [entropy_eq p] at hmaxr
  rw [← hrmean]
  dsimp only [c₀] at *
  nlinarith

end MatchingEntropy

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.matching_covariance_rank
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.text:
theorem matching_covariance_rank (G : LooplessGraph V E) {x : E → ℝ}
    (heven : Even (Fintype.card V)) {p : G.Matching → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ G.feasibleLaws x) (hopt : entropy p=maxMatchingEntropy G x) :
    Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e} ≤ 2*Fintype.card V+
      (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x)).rank := by
  let W := weightedDirectionSpace p (matchingNormalized G x)
  let L : G.faceSpace x →ₗ[ℝ] W :=
    ((normalizeLinear x).comp (G.faceSpace x).subtype).codRestrict W
      (fun u => normalized_face_mem G heven hp hopt u.property)
  have hi : Function.Injective L := by
    intro u v huv
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext e
    have hh := congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val huv) e
    change u.val e/Real.sqrt (x e.val)=v.val e/Real.sqrt (x e.val) at hh
    exact (div_left_inj' (ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr e.property))).mp hh
  have hdim := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hi
  have hq := (G.faceSpace x).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have hc := G.faceCodimension_bound heven ((G.mem_polytope_iff x).mpr ⟨p,hp⟩)
  rw [covariance_rank hp.1.1]
  have hq' : G.faceCodimension x+Module.finrank ℝ (G.faceSpace x)=Fintype.card {e // 0 < x e} := by
    simpa only [LooplessGraph.faceCodimension,Module.finrank_pi,Module.finrank_self,Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ,smul_eq_mul,mul_one] using hq
  change Module.finrank ℝ (G.faceSpace x) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ W at hdim
  dsimp only [W] at hdim
  omega

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_posSemidef
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Covari.text:
theorem covariance_posSemidef (p : A → ℝ) (b : A → I → ℝ) :
    (covariance p b).PosSemidef := by
  simpa only [covariance, conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
    posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose (weightedColumns p b)

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.maxMatchingEntropy
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Entrop.text:
def maxMatchingEntropy (G : LooplessGraph V E) (y : E → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (entropy '' G.feasibleLaws y)

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.matching_covariance_second_variation
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Matchi.text:
theorem matching_covariance_second_variation (G : LooplessGraph V E) {x : E → ℝ}
    {p : G.Matching → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ G.feasibleLaws x)
    (hopt : entropy p=maxMatchingEntropy G x) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hmax : ∀ y ∈ G.polytope, entropyDefect G m y ≤ entropyDefect G m x)
    (u : {e // 0 < x e} → ℝ) :
    (8*Real.exp (-entropy x/m)-1)*
        ((covariance p (matchingNormalized G x) *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ
          (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x) *ᵥ u)) +
      u ⬝ᵥ (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x) *ᵥ u) ≤ 0 := by
  let w := matchingScoreWeights x u
  let c := ∑ e, w e*x e
  let a := linearScore G w c
  have hcenter : ∑ M, p M*a M=0 := by
    dsimp only [a,c]
    rw [linearScore_expectation,hp.2,hp.1.2,mul_one,sub_self]
  have hh := matching_defect_second_variation G hp hopt hm.ne' hmax w c hcenter
  have hnorm : (∑ e, (G.mean (fun M => p M*a M) e)^2/x e) =
      (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x) *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ
        (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x) *ᵥ u) := by
    have hx : x ∈ G.polytope := (G.mem_polytope_iff x).mpr ⟨p,hp⟩
    rw [sum_positive_support x _ (fun e he => by
      have hz : x e=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt he) (G.coordinate_mem_Icc hx e).1
      simp [hz])]
    rw [dotProduct]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    rw [matchingNormalized_mulVec G hp,← sq,div_pow,Real.sq_sqrt e.property.le]
  have hquad : (∑ M, p M*(a M)^2) = u ⬝ᵥ (covariance p (matchingNormalized G x) *ᵥ u) := by
    rw [covariance_quadratic hp.1.1]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro M _
    rw [← matchingNormalized_score G x u M]
  change (8*Real.exp (-entropy x/m)-1)*(∑ e, (G.mean (fun M => p M*a M) e)^2/x e)+
    (8*Real.exp (-entropy x/m)/m)*(entropyLineD x (G.mean (fun M => p M*a M)) 0)^2+
    (∑ M, p M*(a M)^2) ≤ 0 at hh
  rw [hnorm,hquad] at hh
  have hpterm : 0 ≤ (8*Real.exp (-entropy x/m)/m)*
      (entropyLineD x (G.mean (fun M => p M*a M)) 0)^2 := by positivity
  linarith

end MatchingEntropy

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Contin.name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropyDefect_attains_max
OAI.Combinatorics.PerfectMatching.Contin.text:
theorem entropyDefect_attains_max (G : LooplessGraph V E)
    (heven : Even (Fintype.card V)) (hPM : Nonempty G.Matching) (m : ℝ) :
    ∃ x ∈ G.polytope, ∀ y ∈ G.polytope, entropyDefect G m y ≤ entropyDefect G m x := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun y : E → ℝ => entropyBarrier m (entropy y)) := by
    have hb : Continuous (entropyBarrier m) := by unfold entropyBarrier; fun_prop
    exact hb.comp continuous_entropy
  have hs : UpperSemicontinuousOn (entropyDefect G m) G.polytope := by
    change UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun y => entropyBarrier m (entropy y)-maxMatchingEntropy G y) G.polytope
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, Pi.neg_apply] using
      hc.continuousOn.upperSemicontinuousOn.add
        (maxMatchingEntropy_lowerSemicontinuousOn G heven).neg
  have hn : G.polytope.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨M⟩ := hPM
    exact ⟨G.indicator M,subset_convexHull ℝ _ (Set.mem_range_self M)⟩
  exact UpperSemicontinuousOn.exists_isMaxOn hn G.compact_polytope hs

end MatchingEntropy

end

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralAlgorithm.algorithm_success
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.text:
lemma algorithm_success (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ) (he : 0<ε) (he1 : ε<1) (hd : 0<δ) :
    1-δ≤(algorithm (encodeInput G ε δ)).mean (fun as=>if AccurateWord G ε as then 1 else 0) := by
  classical
  by_cases hz:Z G=0
  · rw [Experiment.mean_indicator_eq_one _ _ ((algorithm_proper G ε δ he he1 hd.le).mono
      (proper_accurate_zero G ε hz))]
    linarith
  have hZ:0<Z G:=Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz
  cases hE:empty (parseInput (encodeInput G ε δ)) with
  | true =>
    have hn : G.n=0 := of_decide_eq_true (by rwa [empty_source] at hE)
    have hz:=count_empty_graph hn
    have hq : AccurateWord G ε (LiteralCodec.ratWord (1,1)) := by
      refine ⟨1,LiteralCodec.ratWord_repr 1 (by norm_num),?_,?_⟩ <;> rw [hz] <;> norm_num <;> linarith
    simp only [algorithm,Experiment.mean_map,count,hE,ite_true,Experiment.mean,ite_eq_left hq]
    linarith
  | false =>
    have hI:invalid (parseInput (encodeInput G ε δ))=false := by
      cases hi:invalid (parseInput (encodeInput G ε δ)) with
      | false => rfl
      | true => exact False.elim (hz (invalid_zero G ε δ hi))
    have hn:=valid_two G ε δ hE hI
    have hev:=valid_even G ε δ hI
    let : Nontrivial (Fin G.n):=Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hn
    let p:=FiniteTrial.parameters G hn hev ε he he1
    have hs:=FiniteTrial.guardedAmplifiedBitOutput_success p hZ δ hd
    have hb : qaverage (fun b=>if FiniteTrial.Accurate p (FiniteTrial.guardedAmplifiedBitOutput p δ b) then 1 else 0)≥1-δ := by
      rw [qaverage_indicator]
      simpa only [FiniteTrial.guardedAccurateBits,Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_bool,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hs
    simp only [algorithm,Experiment.mean_map,count,hE,hI,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
    rw [compute_mean hn hev ε δ he he1 hd.le]
    apply hb.trans (qaverage_mono _ _ (fun b=>?_))
    split_ifs with ha hword hword
    · rfl
    · exfalso
      apply hword
      exact ⟨_,LiteralCodec.ratWord_repr _ (FiniteTrial.guardedAmplifiedBitOutput_nonneg p δ b),ha⟩
    · norm_num
    · rfl
end MatchingFPRAS.LiteralAlgorithm

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.OnlineTree.physicalCost
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.postTime_mono

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:45.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.mainTime_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.text:
lemma mainTime_bound : ∃ C d : ℕ,0<C ∧ ∀ (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ),
    0<ε→ε<1→0≤δ→wrapTime LiteralAlgorithm.algorithmRealizer (encodeInput G ε δ)≤timeBound C d G ε δ := by
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩:=LiteralAlgorithm.algorithm_bound
  let F:=LiteralAlgorithm.algorithmRealizer
  let bound:=fun x=>packTime x+q.eval x*OnlineStack.Executes.factor F.program.code (18*x+1) (q.eval x)+postTime (q.eval x)
  have hb : PolynomiallyBounded bound :=
    ((polynomial_packTime PolynomiallyBounded.id).add ((polynomial_eval q).mul
      (polynomial_factor F (((PolynomiallyBounded.const 18).mul PolynomiallyBounded.id).add
        (PolynomiallyBounded.const 1)) (polynomial_eval q)))).add (polynomial_postTime (polynomial_eval q))
  obtain ⟨C,d,hb⟩:=hb
  refine ⟨C+1,d,by omega,?_⟩
  intro G ε δ he he1 hd
  let as:=encodeInput G ε δ
  let x:=as.length+⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊+Nat.clog 2 ⌈δ⁻¹⌉₊+1
  have hx : 1≤x := by dsimp only [x];omega
  have hl : as.length≤x := by dsimp only [x];omega
  have hc := hq G ε δ he he1 hd x hx hl (by dsimp only [x];omega) (by dsimp only [x];omega)
  have hcost : F.cost as≤q.eval x := by dsimp only [F,as];omega
  have hout : (LiteralAlgorithm.algorithm as).worst weight≤q.eval x := by dsimp only [as];omega
  have hword : (LiteralAlgorithm.algorithm as).worst List.length≤q.eval x :=
    Experiment.worst_le _ _ _ ((Experiment.all_worst _ weight).mono (fun bs hbs=>
      (list_length_le_weight bs).trans (hbs.trans hout)))
  have hweight : weight as≤18*x+1 := by rw [LiteralCodec.weight_word];omega
  have hwrap : wrapTime F as≤bound x := by
    unfold wrapTime OnlineTree.physicalCost
    exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add (packTime_mono hl)
      (Nat.mul_le_mul hcost (OnlineStack.Executes.factor_mono _ _ _ _ hweight hcost))) (postTime_mono hword)
  apply hwrap.trans ((hb x hx).trans ?_)
  change C*x^d≤(C+1)*x^d
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
end MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:81.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.timeBound
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:81.text:
def timeBound (C d : ℕ) (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  C * ((encodeInput G ε δ).length + ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊ + Nat.clog 2 ⌈δ⁻¹⌉₊ + 1) ^ d

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralAlgorithm.algorithm
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.text:
def algorithm (as : List Symbol) : Experiment (List Symbol) :=
  (count (parseInput as)).map LiteralCodec.ratWord

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:38.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.encodeInput
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:38.text:
def encodeInput (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ) : List Symbol :=
  encodeNat G.n ++ encodeNat G.edges.card ++
    (((G.edges.map toLex.toEmbedding).sort (· ≤ ·)).flatMap fun e =>
      encodeNat (ofLex e).1.val ++ encodeNat (ofLex e).2.val) ++
    encodeRat ε ++ encodeRat δ

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:8.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.GraphInput
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:8.text:
structure GraphInput where
  n : ℕ
  edges : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)
  increasing : ∀ e ∈ edges, e.1 < e.2

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.polynomial_packTime
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.text:
lemma polynomial_packTime {f : ℕ→ℕ} (hf : PolynomiallyBounded f) :
    PolynomiallyBounded (fun x=>packTime (f x)) :=
  ((PolynomiallyBounded.const 1).add (polynomial_budget 1 (18*width) hf (PolynomiallyBounded.const 0))).mul
    (PolynomiallyBounded.const (MachineCost.programCost packCode))

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Tapes.On.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.OnlineStack.Executes.factor_mono
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Tapes.On.text:
lemma factor_mono [Inhabited Λ] [Inhabited σ] [Fintype σ]
    (H H' n n' : ℕ) (hH : H≤H') (hn : n≤n') :
    factor M H n ≤ factor M H' n' := by unfold factor; gcongr
omit [Inhabited Λ] [Inhabited σ] [Fintype σ] in

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.postTime
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.text: noncomputable def postTime (n : ℕ) : ℕ := eraseTime+unpackTime n

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Tapes.Co.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralCodec.weight_word
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Tapes.Co.text:
lemma weight_word (as : List Symbol) : weight as=18*as.length+1 := by
  induction as with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a as ih => rw [weight_cons,weight_symbol,ih,List.length_cons]; omega

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.polynomial_eval
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.text:
lemma polynomial_eval (p : Polynomial ℕ) : PolynomiallyBounded (fun x=>p.eval x) := by
  refine Polynomial.induction_on' p ?_ ?_
  · intro p q hp hq
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_add] using hp.add hq
  · intro n a
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_monomial] using (PolynomiallyBounded.const a).mul (PolynomiallyBounded.id.pow n)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Graphs.E.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.PhysicalStream.Experiment.worst_le
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Graphs.E.text:
lemma worst_le (p : Experiment α) (f : α → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (h : All p (fun a=>f a≤N)) : p.worst f≤N := by
  induction p with
  | done a => exact h
  | read p ih => exact max_le (ih false h.1) (ih true h.2)
  | delay n p ih => exact ih h
end MatchingFPRAS.PhysicalStream.Experiment

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.AccurateTape
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.text:
def AccurateTape (G : GraphInput) (ε : ℚ) (T : Tape Symbol) : Prop :=
  ∃ q : ℚ,T.right₀=ListBlank.mk (encodeRat q) ∧ (1-ε)*(Z G:ℚ)≤q ∧ q≤(1+ε)*(Z G:ℚ)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.wrapTime
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.text:
noncomputable def wrapTime {f : List Symbol→Experiment (List Symbol)} (F : OnlineTree.Realizer f)
    (as : List Symbol) : ℕ := packTime as.length+OnlineTree.physicalCost F as+postTime ((f as).worst List.length)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.polynomial_factor
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.text:
lemma polynomial_factor {A B : Type} [Codec A] [Codec B] {f : A→Experiment B}
    (F : OnlineTree.Realizer f) {H n : ℕ→ℕ}
    (hH : PolynomiallyBounded H) (hn : PolynomiallyBounded n) :
    PolynomiallyBounded (fun x=>OnlineStack.Executes.factor F.program.code (H x) (n x)) := by
  let a:=OnlineStack.accesses F.program.code
  let o:=OnlineStack.overhead F.program.code
  exact ((PolynomiallyBounded.const o).mul ((PolynomiallyBounded.const 1).add
    ((PolynomiallyBounded.const (2*a)).mul ((hH.add (hn.mul (PolynomiallyBounded.const a))).add
      (PolynomiallyBounded.const 1))))).add (PolynomiallyBounded.const 1)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Graphs.E.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.PhysicalStream.Experiment.all_true
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Graphs.E.text:
lemma all_true (p : Experiment α) : All p (fun _=>True) := by
  induction p with
  | done a => trivial
  | read p ih => exact ⟨ih false,ih true⟩
  | delay n p ih => exact ih

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:84.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.goodTapes
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:84.text:
noncomputable def goodTapes (A : RandomMachine) (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin t → Bool) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter fun bits => ∃ q : ℚ,
    Outputs A (encodeInput G ε δ) bits q ∧
    (1 - ε) * (Z G : ℚ) ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (1 + ε) * (Z G : ℚ)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralAlgorithm.AccurateWord
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.text:
def AccurateWord (G : GraphInput) (ε : ℚ) (as : List Symbol) : Prop :=
  ∃ q : ℚ,as=encodeRat q ∧ (1-ε)*(Z G:ℚ)≤q ∧ q≤(1+ε)*(Z G:ℚ)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Tapes.On.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.OnlineStack.Executes.factor
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Tapes.On.text:
noncomputable def factor (M : Λ → TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (H n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  overhead M*(1+2*accesses M*(H+n*accesses M+1))+1
omit [Inhabited Λ] [Inhabited σ] [Fintype σ] in

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.BitComplexity.PolynomiallyBounded.const
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.text:
lemma PolynomiallyBounded.const (c : ℕ) : PolynomiallyBounded (fun _=>c) := by
  exact ⟨c,0,fun _ _=>by simp⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.average_good
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.text:
lemma average_good (A : RandomMachine) (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ) (n : ℕ)
    (hh : ∀ b : Bits n,(MatchingFPRAS.run A (encodeInput G ε δ) b).state=none) :
    average (fun b : Bits n=>if AccurateTape G ε (MatchingFPRAS.run A (encodeInput G ε δ) b).tape then 1 else 0)=
      ((goodTapes A G ε δ n).card:ℚ)/(2:ℚ)^n := by
  have he (b : Bits n) : AccurateTape G ε (MatchingFPRAS.run A (encodeInput G ε δ) b).tape ↔
      ∃ q : ℚ,Outputs A (encodeInput G ε δ) b q ∧ (1-ε)*(Z G:ℚ)≤q ∧ q≤(1+ε)*(Z G:ℚ) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q,ht,hq⟩;exact ⟨q,⟨hh b,ht⟩,hq⟩
    · rintro ⟨q,⟨_,ht⟩,hq⟩;exact ⟨q,ht,hq⟩
  simp_rw [he]
  simp only [average,goodTapes,Finset.sum_boole]

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.mainProgram_outputs
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.text:
lemma mainProgram_outputs (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ) (he : 0<ε) (he1 : ε<1) (hd : 0≤δ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : wrapTime algorithmRealizer (encodeInput G ε δ)≤n) :
    (∀ b : Bits n,∃ q : ℚ,0≤q ∧ Outputs mainProgram.machine (encodeInput G ε δ) b q) ∧
    (Z G=0→∀ b : Bits n,Outputs mainProgram.machine (encodeInput G ε δ) b 0) := by
  constructor
  · intro b
    obtain ⟨hh,q,hq,ht,_⟩:=mainProgram_all G ε δ he he1 hd n hn b
    exact ⟨q,hq,hh,ht⟩
  · intro hz b
    obtain ⟨hh,q,_hq,ht,hzq⟩:=mainProgram_all G ε δ he he1 hd n hn b
    rw [hzq hz] at ht
    exact ⟨hh,ht⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.accurateTape_of_word
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.text:
lemma accurateTape_of_word (G : GraphInput) (ε : ℚ) (as : List Symbol) (h : AccurateWord G ε as) :
    AccurateTape G ε (Tape.mk₁ as) := by
  obtain ⟨q,rfl,hq⟩:=h
  exact ⟨q,by simp [Tape.mk₁,Tape.mk₂],hq⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.packTime
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.text:
noncomputable def packTime (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (1+LiteralBlockMap.budget 1 (18*width) n 0)*MachineCost.programCost packCode

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Main:21.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.thm_main
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Main:21.text:
theorem thm_main : MainStatement := by
  obtain ⟨C,d,hC,hbound⟩:=LiteralPhysical.mainTime_bound
  refine ⟨LiteralPhysical.mainProgram.machine,C,d,hC,?_⟩
  intro G ε δ he he1 hd _hd1
  dsimp only
  have hn:=hbound G ε δ he he1 hd.le
  obtain ⟨hp,hz⟩:=LiteralPhysical.mainProgram_outputs G ε δ he he1 hd.le
    (timeBound C d G ε δ) hn
  exact ⟨hp,hz,LiteralPhysical.mainProgram_success G ε δ he he1 hd
    (timeBound C d G ε δ) hn⟩
end MatchingFPRAS

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralAlgorithm.algorithmRealizer
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.text:
noncomputable def algorithmRealizer : OnlineTree.Realizer algorithm :=
  (OnlineTree.composition (OnlineTree.composition (OnlineTree.deterministic parseInputRealizer) countRealizer)
    (OnlineTree.deterministic LiteralCodec.ratWordRealizer)).congr (by
      intro as h;simp only [algorithm,Experiment.mean_bind,Experiment.mean,Experiment.mean_map])

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:94.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.MainStatement
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Model:94.text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : RandomMachine) (C d : ℕ), 0 < C ∧
    ∀ (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 →
      let t := timeBound C d G ε δ
      (∀ bits : Fin t → Bool, ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ q ∧ Outputs A (encodeInput G ε δ) bits q) ∧
      (Z G = 0 → ∀ bits : Fin t → Bool, Outputs A (encodeInput G ε δ) bits 0) ∧
      ((goodTapes A G ε δ t).card : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ t ≥ 1 - δ

end MatchingFPRAS

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.mainProgram_realizes
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Machines.text:
lemma mainProgram_realizes (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    mainProgram.Realizes (Tape.mk₁ (encodeInput G ε δ))
      ((LiteralAlgorithm.algorithm (encodeInput G ε δ)).map Tape.mk₁)
      (wrapTime LiteralAlgorithm.algorithmRealizer (encodeInput G ε δ)) :=
  wrap_realizes _ _ (input_nonzero G ε δ) (algorithm_alphabet _)
end MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.mainProgram_all
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.text:
lemma mainProgram_all (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ) (he : 0<ε) (he1 : ε<1) (hd : 0≤δ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : wrapTime algorithmRealizer (encodeInput G ε δ)≤n) (b : Bits n) :
    (MatchingFPRAS.run mainProgram.machine (encodeInput G ε δ) b).state=none ∧
      ProperTape G (MatchingFPRAS.run mainProgram.machine (encodeInput G ε δ) b).tape := by
  apply (mainProgram_realizes G ε δ).run_all _ _ n hn b
  rw [Experiment.all_map]
  exact (algorithm_proper G ε δ he he1 hd).mono (properTape_of_word G)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical.mainProgram_success
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Probabil.text:
lemma mainProgram_success (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ) (he : 0<ε) (he1 : ε<1) (hd : 0<δ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : wrapTime algorithmRealizer (encodeInput G ε δ)≤n) :
    1-δ≤((goodTapes mainProgram.machine G ε δ n).card:ℚ)/(2:ℚ)^n := by
  have hs : 1-δ≤(algorithm (encodeInput G ε δ)).mean
      (fun as=>if AccurateTape G ε (Tape.mk₁ as) then 1 else 0) := by
    apply (algorithm_success G ε δ he he1 hd).trans (Experiment.mean_mono _ _ _ ?_)
    exact (Experiment.all_true _).mono (by
      intro as _
      by_cases h : AccurateWord G ε as
      · simp only [ite_eq_left h,ite_eq_left (accurateTape_of_word G ε as h),le_refl]
      · simp only [ite_eq_right h];split_ifs <;> norm_num)
  have hm:=(mainProgram_realizes G ε δ).run_mean (fun T=>if AccurateTape G ε T then 1 else 0) n hn
  rw [Experiment.mean_map] at hm
  rw [←hm,average_good mainProgram.machine G ε δ n
    (fun b=>(mainProgram_all G ε δ he he1 hd.le n hn b).1)] at hs
  exact hs
end MatchingFPRAS.LiteralPhysical

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.PhysicalStream.Experiment.mean_mono
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Algorith.text:
lemma mean_mono {A : Type} (p : Experiment A) (f g : A→ℚ) (h : p.All (fun a=>f a≤g a)) : p.mean f≤p.mean g := by
  induction p with
  | done a => exact h
  | delay n p ih => exact ih h
  | read p ih => exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add (ih false h.1) (ih true h.2)) (by norm_num)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.LiteralAlgorithm.algorithm_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Complexi.text:
lemma algorithm_bound : ∃ q : Polynomial ℕ,∀ (G : GraphInput) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (_he : 0<ε) (_he1 : ε<1) (_hd : 0≤δ) (x : ℕ),1≤x→
    (encodeInput G ε δ).length≤x→⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊≤x→Nat.clog 2 ⌈δ⁻¹⌉₊≤x→
    algorithmRealizer.cost (encodeInput G ε δ)+(algorithm (encodeInput G ε δ)).worst weight≤q.eval x := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩:=polynomial_parseInput
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩:=polynomial_pair polynomial_empty polynomial_identity
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩:=polynomial_pair polynomial_invalid polynomial_identity
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩:=polynomial_constant ((1,1) : Fraction) (A:=Parsed)
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩:=polynomial_constant ((0,1) : Fraction) (A:=Parsed)
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩:=compute_bound
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩:=LiteralCodec.polynomial_ratWord
  let P:=p.comp (18*X+1)
  let B:Polynomial ℕ:=2*X+P+1
  let Q:=e.comp P+j.comp P+c.comp P+d.comp P+k.comp B+60
  refine ⟨P+Q+2*(v.comp Q),?_⟩
  intro G ε δ hε hε1 hδ x hx hl hεx hδx
  let as:=encodeInput G ε δ
  let a:=parseInput as
  have hparse : parseInputRealizer.cost as+weight a≤P.eval x := by
    apply (hp as).trans
    rw [LiteralCodec.weight_word]
    simpa only [P,Polynomial.eval_comp,Polynomial.eval_add,Polynomial.eval_mul,Polynomial.eval_ofNat,Polynomial.eval_X,Polynomial.eval_one] using
      polynomial_eval_monotone p (show 18*as.length+1≤18*x+1 by dsimp only [as];omega)
  have hwa : weight a≤P.eval x := by omega
  have hep : (pair emptyRealizer identity).cost a≤e.eval (P.eval x) :=
    (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans ((he a).trans (polynomial_eval_monotone e hwa))
  have hjp : (pair invalidRealizer identity).cost a≤j.eval (P.eval x) :=
    (Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans ((hj a).trans (polynomial_eval_monotone j hwa))
  have hcp : (constant ((1,1) : Fraction)).cost a+weight ((1,1) : Fraction)≤c.eval (P.eval x) :=
    (hc a).trans (polynomial_eval_monotone c hwa)
  have hdp : (constant ((0,1) : Fraction)).cost a+weight ((0,1) : Fraction)≤d.eval (P.eval x) :=
    (hd a).trans (polynomial_eval_monotone d hwa)
  have hb : x≤B.eval x ∧ 2*x≤B.eval x ∧ P.eval x≤B.eval x := by
    simp only [B,Polynomial.eval_add,Polynomial.eval_mul,Polynomial.eval_ofNat,Polynomial.eval_X,Polynomial.eval_one]
    omega
  have hcount : countRealizer.cost a+(count a).worst weight≤Q.eval x := by
    cases hE:empty a with
    | true =>
      rw [count_cost]
      simp only [count,hE,ite_true,Experiment.worst,Q,Polynomial.eval_add,Polynomial.eval_comp,Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
      omega
    | false =>
      cases hI:invalid a with
      | true =>
        rw [count_cost]
        simp only [count,hE,hI,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,ite_true,Experiment.worst,Q,Polynomial.eval_add,Polynomial.eval_comp,Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
        omega
      | false =>
        have hn:=valid_two G ε δ hE hI
        have hev:=valid_even G ε δ hI
        let : Nontrivial (Fin G.n):=Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hn
        have hnx : G.n≤B.eval x := (valid_size G ε δ hI).trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hl).trans hb.2.1)
        have hcompute:=hk G hn hev ε δ hε hε1 hδ (B.eval x) (hx.trans hb.1) hnx (hεx.trans hb.1) (hδx.trans hb.1) (hwa.trans hb.2.2)
        rw [count_cost]
        simp only [count,hE,hI,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,Q,Polynomial.eval_add,Polynomial.eval_comp,Polynomial.eval_ofNat]
        dsimp only [as,a] at *
        omega
  have hout : (count a).All (fun z=>LiteralCodec.ratWordRealizer.cost z+weight (LiteralCodec.ratWord z)≤v.eval (Q.eval x)) :=
    (Experiment.all_worst (count a) weight).mono (fun z hz=>(hv z).trans
      (polynomial_eval_monotone v (hz.trans (by omega))))
  have htail : (count a).worst LiteralCodec.ratWordRealizer.cost≤v.eval (Q.eval x) :=
    Experiment.worst_le _ _ _ (hout.mono (fun z hz=>(Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans hz))
  have hword : (count a).worst (weight ∘ LiteralCodec.ratWord)≤v.eval (Q.eval x) :=
    Experiment.worst_le _ _ _ (hout.mono (fun z hz=>(Nat.le_add_left _ _).trans hz))
  rw [algorithm_cost]
  unfold algorithm
  rw [Experiment.worst_map]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add,Polynomial.eval_mul,Polynomial.eval_ofNat,Polynomial.eval_comp]
  dsimp only [a,as] at *
  omega
end MatchingFPRAS.LiteralAlgorithm

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Graphs.E.name: OAI.MatchingFPRAS.PhysicalStream.Experiment.all_worst
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingCount.Graphs.E.text:
lemma all_worst (p : Experiment α) (f : α → ℕ) : All p (fun a=>f a≤p.worst f) := by
  induction p with
  | done a => exact le_rfl
  | read p ih => exact ⟨(ih false).mono (fun a ha=>ha.trans (le_max_left _ _)),
      (ih true).mono (fun a ha=>ha.trans (le_max_right _ _))⟩
  | delay n p ih => exact ih

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.NumericalB.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.blockSize_grid
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.NumericalB.text:
lemma blockSize_grid (d t : ℕ) : 2*t^4*d ≤ blockSize d t := by
  dsimp [blockSize]
  calc
    2*t^4*d = (2*d)*t^4 := by ring
    _ ≤ 4*(d+1)*t^4 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Padding:59.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.global_factors_of_factorization
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Padding:59.text:
lemma global_factors_of_factorization {n r s q : ℕ} (hn : Even n) (hnpos : 1 ≤ n)
    (hfac : HasFactorization n r) {W : Type} [Fintype W]
    (e : (GlobalVertices s q ⊕ W) ≃ Fin n) (MW : Pairing W) :
    ∃ (Q : Equiv.Perm (GlobalVertices s q) → (Fin q → Bool) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
      (B : Pairing (GlobalVertices s q) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ),
      (∀ a y, (Q a y).PosSemidef) ∧ (∀ M, (B M).PosSemidef) ∧
      (∀ a y, (Q a y).trace ≤ (n:ℝ)+1) ∧ (∀ M, (B M).trace ≤ (r:ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ a y M, (Q a y * B (Pairing.relabel a M)).trace =
        tableCoordinate (globalCutColor y) (true,false) M - 1 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A,B,hA,hB,hpair,htrA,htrB⟩ := normalized_factorization hn hnpos hfac
  let z (a : Equiv.Perm (GlobalVertices s q)) (y : Fin q → Bool) : GlobalVertices s q ⊕ W → Bool :=
    Sum.elim (globalCutColor y ∘ a.symm) (fun _ => false)
  have hz (a : Equiv.Perm (GlobalVertices s q)) (y : Fin q → Bool) :
      Odd (Fintype.card {v // z a y v = true}) := by
    rw [true_card_sum_false]
    change Odd (Fintype.card {v // globalCutColor y (a.symm v) = true})
    rw [true_card_comp_equiv]
    exact globalCutColor_odd s q y
  let U (a : Equiv.Perm (GlobalVertices s q)) (y : Fin q → Bool) := colorCut e (z a y) (hz a y)
  refine ⟨fun a y => A (Sum.inr (U a y)),
    fun M => B (fromPairing (Pairing.transport e (Pairing.sum M MW))),
    fun a y => hA _, fun M => hB _, fun a y => htrA _, fun M => htrB _, ?_⟩
  intro a y M
  rw [hpair, colorCut_slack, tableCoordinate_sum, tableCoordinate_false, add_zero]
  congr 1
  rw [← Pairing.transport_perm, tableCoordinate_transport]
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp

end PerfectMatchingPSD

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Parameters.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.exists_padded_global_equiv
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Parameters.text:
lemma exists_padded_global_equiv {n s q : ℕ} (hn : Even n) (hle : 2*s*(q+2)+2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, Nonempty ((GlobalVertices s q ⊕ (Fin k × Bool)) ≃ Fin n) := by
  have hg : Even (2*s*(q+2)+2) := ⟨s*(q+2)+1, by ring⟩
  have hd : Even (n-(2*s*(q+2)+2)) := (Nat.even_sub hle).mpr ⟨fun _ => hg, fun _ => hn⟩
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨k, ⟨Fintype.equivOfCardEq ?_⟩⟩
  rw [Fintype.card_sum, globalVertices_card]
  simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool]
  omega

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Main:9.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.main_nat
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Main:9.text:
lemma main_nat (p : ℕ) : ∃ n₀ : ℕ, 4 ≤ n₀ ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → Even n → (n:ℝ)^p < (psdRank n:ℝ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d,H,hd,D,hD,hdecode⟩ := conditional_cell_lower_bound (10*(p+1))
  obtain ⟨Te,hTe⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (eventually_pow_lt_half_exp (6*p))
  let T := 2+H+1024*(d+1)+Fintype.card (SampleIndex d)+⌈8*(D+1)⌉₊+Te
  refine ⟨vertexSize d T+4, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hneven
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hleft,hright⟩ := bracket_vertexSize d T n (by omega)
  dsimp only [T] at ht
  have ht2 : 2 ≤ t := by omega
  have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := by omega
  have hHt : H ≤ t := by omega
  have hdt : 1024*(d+1) ≤ t := by omega
  have hTt : Fintype.card (SampleIndex d) ≤ t := by omega
  have hDt : 8*(D+1) ≤ (t:ℝ) :=
    (Nat.le_ceil (8*(D+1))).trans (by exact_mod_cast (show ⌈8*(D+1)⌉₊ ≤ t by omega))
  have htet : Te ≤ t := by omega
  have hn6 : n ≤ t^6 := hright.le.trans (vertexSize_succ_le_pow6 d t ht1 hdt)
  have hl : 1 ≤ t^4 := one_le_pow₀ ht1
  have hs : 1 ≤ blockSize d t := hl.trans (blockSize_ge d t)
  have hH : H ≤ 3*blockSize d t+1 := by
    have hts : t ≤ blockSize d t := (Nat.le_pow (by decide : 0 < 4)).trans (blockSize_ge d t)
    omega
  by_contra hnot
  have hrn : (psdRank n:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)^p := le_of_not_gt hnot
  obtain ⟨k,⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_padded_global_equiv hneven hleft
  obtain ⟨Q,B,hQ,hB,htrQ,htrB,hpair⟩ := global_factors_of_factorization
    hneven (by omega : 1 ≤ n) (hasFactorization_psdRank n) e (standardPairing (H := Fin k))
  have hsel : (t:ℝ)*(psdRank n)^4*(Fintype.card (SampleIndex d))*
      ((2*(3*(blockSize d t:ℝ)+1))^(2*(10*(p+1))))⁻¹ ≤
      (1/((psdRank n:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)+1)*(2*(t^4:ℕ))))^2 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using numerical_selection p d t (psdRank n) n
      (Fintype.card (SampleIndex d)) ht2 (psdRank_pos n) hn6 hTt hrn
  have hsmall : 16*(t:ℝ)^2*((t:ℝ)*D+1) ≤ 2*(t^4:ℕ) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using numerical_smallness D t ht1 hDt
  have hlower : (2:ℝ)^t/2 ≤ (psdRank n:ℝ) :=
    hdecode (blockSize d t) t (t^4) (psdRank n) hH hs ht1 (blockSize_grid d t) hl
      (psdRank_pos n) ((n:ℝ)+1) (by positivity) Q B hQ hB htrQ htrB hpair hsel hsmall
  have hn6r : (n:ℝ) ≤ (t:ℝ)^6 := by exact_mod_cast hn6
  have hpow : (n:ℝ)^p ≤ (t:ℝ)^(6*p) := by
    simpa only [pow_mul] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hn6r p
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hlower) ((hrn.trans hpow).trans_lt (hTe t htet))

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.FiniteFact.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.hasFactorization_psdRank
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.FiniteFact.text:
lemma hasFactorization_psdRank (n : ℕ) : HasFactorization n (psdRank n) :=
  (Nat.sInf_mem (factor_orders_nonempty n)).2

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.CellLowerB.name: OAI.MatchingInterpolation.conditional_cell_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.CellLowerB.text:
lemma conditional_cell_lower_bound (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ d H : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧
    ∀ s q l r : ℕ, H ≤ 3*s+1 → 1 ≤ s → 1 ≤ q → 2*l*d ≤ s → 1 ≤ l → 0 < r →
    ∀ m : ℝ, 0 < m →
    ∀ (Q : Equiv.Perm (GlobalVertices s q) → (Fin q → Bool) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
      (B : Pairing (GlobalVertices s q) → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ),
      (∀ a y, (Q a y).PosSemidef) → (∀ M, (B M).PosSemidef) →
      (∀ a y, (Q a y).trace ≤ m) → (∀ M, (B M).trace ≤ (r:ℝ)) →
      (∀ a y M, (Q a y*B (Pairing.relabel a M)).trace =
        tableCoordinate (globalCutColor y) (true,false) M-1) →
      (q:ℝ)*r^4*(Fintype.card (SampleIndex d))*((2*(3*s+1):ℝ)^(2*K))⁻¹ ≤
        (1/((r:ℝ)*m*(2*l)))^2 →
      16*(q:ℝ)^2*((q:ℝ)*D+1) ≤ 2*l →
      (2:ℝ)^q/2 ≤ r := by
  obtain ⟨d,H,hd,hgood⟩ := good_cell_polynomials K
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hw⟩ := weightMass_bound d
  let D := (2*(d:ℝ)+1)*c+6
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  refine ⟨d,H,hd,D,hD,?_⟩
  intro s q l r hH hs hq hsl hl hr m hm Q B hQ hB htrQ htrB hpair hnum hn
  let L : ℝ := 2*l
  have hL : 1 ≤ L := by dsimp [L]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ 2*l)
  have hLp : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hrp : 0 < (r:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
  let η := 1/((r:ℝ)*m*L)
  let δ := 1/(L*m)
  have hη : 0 ≤ η := by dsimp [η]; positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  obtain ⟨a,P,hP,happrox⟩ := hgood s q l r hH hs hsl B hB htrB η hη hnum
  let e := weightMass d L*(2*(d:ℝ)*L)+(r:ℝ)*(6+weightMass d L)*η*m
  have hw0 := weightMass_nonneg d L
  have he0 : 0 ≤ e := by dsimp [e]; positivity
  have he : e ≤ D/L := interpolation_trace_error_bound d hc.le hL
    (hw L hL) (le_of_eq (normalized_eta hrp hm hLp))
  have hδm : δ*m=1/L := by dsimp [δ]; field_simp [hLp.ne', hm.ne']
  have hε : 0 ≤ (q:ℝ)*e+δ*m := by positivity
  have heps : (q:ℝ)*e+δ*m ≤ ((q:ℝ)*D+1)/L := by
    have heq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (Nat.cast_nonneg q)
    rw [hδm]
    calc
      _ ≤ (q:ℝ)*(D/L)+1/L := add_le_add heq (le_refl (1/L))
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hsmall := sqrt_error_small (Nat.cast_nonneg q) hLp hε heps hn
  exact cell_decoder hs hq hsl (Q a) (fun M => B (Pairing.relabel a M))
    (hQ a) (fun M => hB _) (hpair a) P hP hη hδ (by omega)
      (htrQ a) happrox hε hsmall

end MatchingInterpolation

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Main:53.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.main
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Main:53.text:
theorem main : MainClaim := by
  intro C _hC
  obtain ⟨n₀,hn₀,hmain⟩ := main_nat ⌈C⌉₊
  refine ⟨n₀,hn₀,?_⟩
  intro n hn heven
  have hn1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ n by omega)
  have hpow := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hn1 (Nat.le_ceil C)
  rw [Real.rpow_natCast] at hpow
  exact hpow.trans_lt (hmain n hn heven)

end PerfectMatchingPSD

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Parameters.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.vertexSize_succ_le_pow6
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Parameters.text:
lemma vertexSize_succ_le_pow6 (d t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hd : 1024*(d+1) ≤ t) :
    vertexSize d (t+1) ≤ t^6 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ 1024*(d+1)*t^5 := vertexSize_succ_bound d t ht
    _ ≤ t*t^5 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hd
    _ = _ := by ring

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.GoodCells:.name: OAI.MatchingInterpolation.SampleIndex
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.GoodCells:.text: abbrev SampleIndex (d : ℕ) := Fin 5 ⊕ GridIndex d

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.NumericalB.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.numerical_selection
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.NumericalB.text:
lemma numerical_selection (p d t r n T : ℕ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hn : n ≤ t^6) (hT : T ≤ t) (hrn : (r:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)^p) :
    (t:ℝ)*r^4*T*((2*(3*(blockSize d t:ℝ)+1))^(2*(10*(p+1))))⁻¹ ≤
      (1/((r:ℝ)*((n:ℝ)+1)*(2*(t:ℝ)^4)))^2 := by
  have ht2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast ht
  have ht1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ t := by linarith
  have ht0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ t := Nat.cast_nonneg t
  have hr0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ r := Nat.cast_nonneg r
  have hn6 : (n:ℝ) ≤ (t:ℝ)^6 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hrp : (r:ℝ) ≤ (t:ℝ)^(6*p) := by
    simpa only [pow_mul] using hrn.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hn6 p)
  have hm : (n:ℝ)+1 ≤ (t:ℝ)^7 := by
    have h6 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (t:ℝ)^6 := one_le_pow₀ ht1
    calc
      _ ≤ (t:ℝ)^6+(t:ℝ)^6 := add_le_add hn6 h6
      _ = 2*(t:ℝ)^6 := by ring
      _ ≤ (t:ℝ)*(t:ℝ)^6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht2 (pow_nonneg ht0 _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hL : 2*(t:ℝ)^4 ≤ (t:ℝ)^5 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (t:ℝ)*(t:ℝ)^4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht2 (pow_nonneg ht0 _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hTr : (T:ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hbase : (t:ℝ)^4 ≤ 2*(3*(blockSize d t:ℝ)+1) := by
    have hs : (t:ℝ)^4 ≤ (blockSize d t:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast blockSize_ge d t
    have hs0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (blockSize d t:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    linarith
  have hb : 0 < (2*(3*(blockSize d t:ℝ)+1))^(2*(10*(p+1))) := by positivity
  apply selection_of_cleared hb (by positivity)
  calc
    _ ≤ (t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)^(6*p))^6*(t:ℝ)*((t:ℝ)^7)^2*((t:ℝ)^5)^2 := by gcongr
    _ = (t:ℝ)^(36*p+26) := by
      have he : 36*p+26 = 1+(6*p)*6+1+7*2+5*2 := by omega
      rw [he]
      simp only [pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one]
    _ ≤ (t:ℝ)^(8*(10*(p+1))) := pow_le_pow_right₀ ht1 (by omega)
    _ = ((t:ℝ)^4)^(2*(10*(p+1))) := by rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; omega
    _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (pow_nonneg ht0 _) hbase _

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.FiniteFact.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.psdRank_pos
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.FiniteFact.text:
lemma psdRank_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < psdRank n :=
  (Nat.sInf_mem (factor_orders_nonempty n)).1

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Parameters.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.bracket_vertexSize
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Parameters.text:
lemma bracket_vertexSize (d T n : ℕ) (hn : vertexSize d T ≤ n) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, T ≤ t ∧ vertexSize d t ≤ n ∧ n < vertexSize d (t+1) := by
  classical
  let P := fun t => vertexSize d t ≤ n
  let t := Nat.findGreatest P n
  have hT : T ≤ n := (index_le_vertexSize d T).trans hn
  refine ⟨t, Nat.le_findGreatest (P := P) hT hn, Nat.findGreatest_spec (P := P) hT hn, ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  have hnext : P (t+1) := le_of_not_gt h
  have htn : t+1 ≤ n := (index_le_vertexSize d (t+1)).trans hnext
  exact (Nat.findGreatest_eq_iff.mp (show Nat.findGreatest P n=t from rfl)).2.2
    (Nat.lt_succ_self t) htn hnext

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.NumericalB.name: OAI.PerfectMatchingPSD.numerical_smallness
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.NumericalB.text:
lemma numerical_smallness (D : ℝ) (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hD : 8*(D+1) ≤ (t:ℝ)) :
    16*(t:ℝ)^2*((t:ℝ)*D+1) ≤ 2*(t:ℝ)^4 := by
  have ht1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast ht
  have ht0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ t := Nat.cast_nonneg t
  calc
    _ ≤ 16*(t:ℝ)^2*((t:ℝ)*(D+1)) := by gcongr; linarith
    _ = 2*(t:ℝ)^3*(8*(D+1)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2*(t:ℝ)^3*(t:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

end PerfectMatchingPSD

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingPSD.Parameters.text:
lemma eventually_pow_lt_half_exp (p : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, (t:ℝ)^p < (2:ℝ)^t/2 := by
  have ho := isLittleO_pow_const_const_pow_of_one_lt (R := ℝ) p (by norm_num : 1 < (2:ℝ))
  have hb := ho.bound (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/4)
  filter_upwards [hb] with t ht
  have ht' : (t:ℝ)^p ≤ (1/4)*(2:ℝ)^t := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ (t:ℝ)^p by positivity),
      abs_of_pos (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) _)] using ht
  calc
    _ ≤ (1/4)*(2:ℝ)^t := ht'
    _ < _ := by nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) t]

end PerfectMatchingPSD

theorem omega_lt_target_of_nearby_balanced_family
    (W : ℕ → ComplexWitness.FiniteRectangularWitness)
    (scale : ℕ → ℝ) (g h H : ℝ)
    (g_lower : (27961 : ℝ) / 25000 < g)
    (h_lower : (31519 : ℝ) / 10000 < h)
    (h_upper : h < (15761 : ℝ) / 5000)
    (scale_positive : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0 < scale n)
    (outer_rate : Tendsto
      (fun n => Real.log ((W n).outer : ℝ) / scale n) atTop
      (𝓝 h))
    (inner_rate : Tendsto
      (fun n => Real.log ((W n).inner : ℝ) / scale n) atTop
      (𝓝 (2 * g)))
    (multiplicity_rate : Tendsto
      (fun n => Real.log ((W n).multiplicity : ℝ) / scale n) atTop (𝓝 (2 * H)))
    (rank_rate : Tendsto
      (fun n => Real.log ((W n).rank : ℝ) / scale n) atTop
      (𝓝 (6 * Real.log 3 + 2 * H))) :
    Arithmetic.rectangularOmega ℂ ((709 : ℝ) / 1000) < (523 : ℝ) / 250 := by
  have hh₀ : 0 < h := by linarith
  have hgap : (709 : ℝ) / 1000 * h < 2 * g :=
    (lt_div_iff₀ hh₀).1 (target_aspect_lt g_lower hh₀ h_upper)
  apply omega_lt_of_balanced_family W scale (709 / 1000) (523 / 250) g h H
    (by norm_num) hh₀ hgap _ scale_positive outer_rate inner_rate multiplicity_rate rank_rate
  exact (div_lt_iff₀ hh₀).1
    (exponent_lt_target ComplexCertificates.log_three_upper h_lower)

theorem rectangularOmega_lt_target :
    Arithmetic.rectangularOmega ℂ ((709 : ℝ) / 1000) < (523 : ℝ) / 250 := by
  obtain ⟨counts, hD, h_lower, h_upper, g_lower, _g_upper⟩ :=
    CurveLaws.exists_count_rate_bounds
  let p := normalizedCountLaw counts hD
  have mass : ∀ a, p.mass a = (counts a : ℝ) / (∑ b, counts b : ℕ) := fun _ => rfl
  exact RectangularWitness.omega_lt_target_of_nearby_balanced_family
    (witness counts) (fun t => (t : ℝ) * (∑ a, counts a : ℕ))
    (lawPairingRate p curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .yz)
    (lawPairingRate p curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .xy +
      lawPairingRate p curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .xz)
    (finiteEntropy p.mass) g_lower h_lower h_upper
    (scale_eventually_pos counts hD)
    (tendsto_log_witness_outer counts hD p mass)
    (tendsto_log_witness_inner counts hD p mass)
    (tendsto_log_witness_multiplicity counts hD p mass)
    (tendsto_log_witness_rank counts hD p mass)

OAI.LinearAlgebra.MatrixMultiplication.E.text:
theorem exists_count_rate_bounds :
    ∃ counts : CurveLeaf → ℕ, ∃ hD : 0 < ∑ a, counts a,
      (31519 : ℝ) / 10000 <
        lawPairingRate (normalizedCountLaw counts hD) curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .xy +
          lawPairingRate (normalizedCountLaw counts hD) curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .xz ∧
      lawPairingRate (normalizedCountLaw counts hD) curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .xy +
          lawPairingRate (normalizedCountLaw counts hD) curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .xz <
        (15761 : ℝ) / 5000 ∧
      (27961 : ℝ) / 25000 <
        lawPairingRate (normalizedCountLaw counts hD) curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .yz ∧
      lawPairingRate (normalizedCountLaw counts hD) curveLabels 5 curveReaderPair .yz <
        (6991 : ℝ) / 6250 := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_rational_rate_bounds
  obtain ⟨counts, hD, hmass⟩ := q.exists_type_representation
  have law_eq (p r : FiniteLaw CurveLeaf) (h : p.mass = r.mass) : p = r := by
    cases p
    cases r
    cases h
    rfl
  have heq : normalizedCountLaw counts hD = q.toFiniteLaw :=
    law_eq _ _ (funext hmass)
  refine ⟨counts, hD, ?_⟩
  simpa only [heq] using hq

end MatrixMultiplication.CurveLaws

OAI.Combinatorics.MatrixRemoval.Asymptot.name: OAI.Problem348.exists_depth_polynomial_decay
OAI.Combinatorics.MatrixRemoval.Asymptot.text:
theorem exists_depth_polynomial_decay (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h ∧
      (1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) * (1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ h)) <
        c * Real.rpow (1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) C := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_ge C
  have ht := (tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt (2 * k)
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).const_mul ((388 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k))
  have hev : ∀ᶠ h : ℕ in atTop,
      (388 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) * ((h : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h) < c := by
    exact ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by simpa using hc))
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hsmall⟩ := (eventually_ge_atTop 1 |>.and hev).exists
  refine ⟨h, hh, ?_⟩
  have hhR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast hh
  have hd : 0 < 386 * (h : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
  have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) < 386 * (h : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith
  have htwo : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by positivity
  have hpoly : (386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ (2 * k) ≤
      (388 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) * (h : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hd.le (by linarith) _
  have hratio : (386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ (2 * k) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < c := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ((388 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) * (h : ℝ) ^ (2 * k)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hpoly htwo.le
      _ = (388 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) * ((h : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) / (2 : ℝ) ^ h) := by ring
      _ < c := hsmall
  have hepspos : 0 < 1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hepsle : 1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one (by positivity)).2
    nlinarith
  have hexponent : (1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) ^ k ≤
      Real.rpow (1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) C := by
    simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hepspos hepsle hk
  have hsmall' : 1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ h) <
      c * (1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) ^ k := by
    rw [div_pow, one_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_one_div]
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hd (2 * k))).2
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hratio
  calc
    _ ≤ 1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ h) := by
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) hepsle
    _ < c * (1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) ^ k := hsmall'
    _ ≤ c * Real.rpow (1 / ((386 * (h : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) C :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexponent hc.le

end Problem348

end

OAI.Combinatorics.MatrixRemoval.Conseque.name: OAI.Problem348.no_polynomial_removal_bound_of_sequence
OAI.Combinatorics.MatrixRemoval.Conseque.text:
theorem no_polynomial_removal_bound_of_sequence
    (hseq : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h →
      let d : ℕ := 386 * h + 2
      let n : ℕ := d * 2 ^ h
      ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n,
        fixedDistance A ≥ 1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧
        (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) ^ 132) ≤
          (1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ h))) :
    ∀ c C : ℝ, 0 < c → 0 < C →
      ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
        ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧
          ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n,
            fixedDistance A ≥ ε ∧
            (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) <
              c * Real.rpow ε C * ((n : ℝ) ^ 132) := by
  intro c C hc _hC
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hdecay⟩ := exists_depth_polynomial_decay c C hc
  let d : ℕ := 386 * h + 2
  let n : ℕ := d * 2 ^ h
  have hd : 1 < d := by dsimp [d]; omega
  have hdR : (1 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d := by linarith
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (pow_pos (by decide) _)
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  obtain ⟨A, hdist, hcopies⟩ := hseq h hh
  refine ⟨n, hn, 1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2), by positivity, ?_, A, hdist, ?_⟩
  · apply (div_lt_one (by positivity)).2
    nlinarith
  · have hdecay' : (1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ h)) <
        c * Real.rpow (1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2)) C := by
      simpa [d] using hdecay
    exact (div_lt_iff₀ (pow_pos hnR 132)).mp (hcopies.trans_lt hdecay')

end Problem348

end

OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Main:33.name: OAI.MatroidProphet.complete_hidden_guarantee
OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Main:33.text:
theorem complete_hidden_guarantee {n : ℕ} (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (hE : M.E = Set.univ)
    (w : Weights n) (hw : ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ 293)⁻¹ * optimum M w ≤
      ∫ r, hiddenWorstReward (completeHiddenRule M hE) w r ∂sourceSeedLaw n := by
  let W := optimum M (fun e => roundedWeight weightBase (w e))
  have hb := branch_mixture_lower W (maximumRounded M w) (mainPayoff M hE w) (maximumPayoff M w)
    (optimum_nonneg M _) (maximumRounded_nonneg M w) (mainPayoff_nonneg M hE w)
    (maximum_branch_guarantee M w hw) (main_branch_guarantee_small M hE w)
  have hi := integrated_branch_lower M hE w hw
  have hr := optimum_rounding_bound M weightBase (by norm_num [weightBase]) w hw
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ thinningRate * retainedFraction / (32 * densityThreshold * weightBase) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg constants_positive.2.2.1.le constants_positive.2.2.2.2.le)
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) constants_positive.2.1.le) constants_positive.1.le)
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr hc0
  have hcancel : thinningRate * retainedFraction / (32 * densityThreshold * weightBase) *
      (weightBase * W) = thinningRate * retainedFraction / (32 * densityThreshold) * W := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt constants_positive.1, ne_of_gt constants_positive.2.1]
  rw [hcancel] at hscaled
  rw [hidden_fraction_exact] at hscaled
  exact hscaled.trans (hb.trans hi)

OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Reduction.name: OAI.MatroidProphet.hiddenVectorChallenge_implies_oneSampleChallenge
OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Reduction.text:
theorem hiddenVectorChallenge_implies_oneSampleChallenge.{u}
    (hh : HiddenVectorChallenge) : OneSampleChallenge.{u} := by
  intro n M hM
  obtain ⟨bits, ν, hν, A, hA, hbound⟩ := hh n M hM
  let := hν
  refine ⟨bits, ν, hν, sampleSimulation A, sampleSimulation_feasible M A hA, ?_⟩
  intro Ω mΩ μ hμ S V R hS hV hR hSN hVN hi hlaw hseed hRlaw hopt π hπ
  obtain ⟨hri, hpay⟩ := oneSample_of_hidden M A ν (((2 : ℝ) ^ 293)⁻¹) hA hbound
    μ S V R hS hV hR hSN hVN hi hlaw hseed hRlaw hopt π hπ
  refine ⟨hri, le_trans ?_ hpay⟩
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
  · exact inv_anti₀ (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) 293)
      (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by decide : 293 ≤ 310))
  · exact integral_nonneg fun ω => optimum_nonneg M (V ω)

end MatroidProphet

OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Simulatio.name: OAI.MatroidProphet.sampleSimulation
OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Simulatio.text:
noncomputable def sampleSimulation {n bits : ℕ} (A : HiddenRule n bits) : OnlineRule n bits where
  decide k r s h := if currentLabel h ∈ A.mask r then false
    else A.core.decide k r (observed A r s) (simulationHistory A r s h)
  measurable_decide k := by
    classical
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro r
    have hc : Measurable (fun x : Weights n × History n k => currentLabel x.2) :=
      measurable_fst.comp ((measurable_pi_apply (⟨k.val, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩ : Fin (k.val + 1))).comp measurable_snd)
    have hm : MeasurableSet {x : Weights n × History n k | currentLabel x.2 ∈ A.mask r} :=
      hc (by trivial)
    exact Measurable.ite hm measurable_const
      ((A.core.measurable_decide k).comp (measurable_const.prodMk
        (((measurable_observed A r).comp measurable_fst).prodMk
          (measurable_simulationHistory A r k))))

OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Gluing:63.name: OAI.MatroidProphet.oneSample_of_hidden
OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Gluing:63.text:
theorem oneSample_of_hidden {n bits : ℕ} (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (A : HiddenRule n bits)
    (ν : Measure (Seed bits)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (c : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ (w : Weights n), (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) →
      ∀ (r : Seed bits) (π : ArrivalOrder n) (t : ℕ),
        M.Indep (hiddenAcceptedThrough A r w π t : Set (Fin n)))
    (hbound : ∀ (w : Weights n), (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) →
      c * optimum M w ≤ ∫ r, hiddenWorstReward A w r ∂ν)
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (S V : Ω → Weights n) (R : Ω → Seed bits)
    (hS : Measurable S) (hV : Measurable V) (hR : Measurable R)
    (hSN : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ e, 0 ≤ S ω e) (hVN : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ e, 0 ≤ V ω e)
    (hi : iIndepFun (pairedCoordinates S V) μ)
    (hlaw : ∀ e, μ.map (fun ω => S ω e) = μ.map (fun ω => V ω e))
    (hseed : IndepFun (fun ω => (S ω, V ω)) R μ)
    (hRlaw : μ.map R = ν)
    (hopt : Integrable (fun ω => optimum M (V ω)) μ)
    (π : Ω → ArrivalOrder n) (hπ : Measurable π) :
    Integrable (fun ω => reward (sampleSimulation A) (R ω) (S ω) (V ω) (π ω)) μ ∧
      c * (∫ ω, optimum M (V ω) ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, reward (sampleSimulation A) (R ω) (S ω) (V ω) (π ω) ∂μ := by
  have hj := glue_seed_joint_law μ ν S V R hS hV hR hi hlaw hseed hRlaw A.mask
  have hoptLaw : Integrable (optimum M) (μ.map V) :=
    (integrable_map_measure (measurable_optimum M).aestronglyMeasurable hV.aemeasurable).2 hopt
  have hNNLaw : ∀ᵐ w ∂μ.map V, ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e :=
    (ae_map_iff hV.aemeasurable (measurableSet_nonnegative n)).2 hVN
  have hip := integrable_hidden_product M A ν (μ.map V) hA hNNLaw hoptLaw
  have him := hj.integrable_comp_of_integrable hip
  have hri := integrable_feasible_reward M (sampleSimulation A)
    (sampleSimulation_feasible M A hA) μ S V R π hS hV hR hπ hSN hVN hopt
  have hb := hidden_product_integral_bound M A ν (μ.map V) c hA hNNLaw hoptLaw hbound
  have hoptEq := integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable (μ := μ) hV
    (measurable_optimum M).stronglyMeasurable
  have hminEq := integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable (μ := μ) hj.measurable
    (measurable_hiddenWorstReward A).stronglyMeasurable
  rw [hj.map_eq] at hminEq
  rw [hoptEq, hminEq] at hb
  refine ⟨hri, hb.trans (integral_mono_ae him hri (ae_of_all _ ?_))⟩
  intro ω
  change hiddenWorstReward A (glue (A.mask (R ω)) (S ω) (V ω)) (R ω) ≤
    reward (sampleSimulation A) (R ω) (S ω) (V ω) (π ω)
  rw [sampleSimulation_reward]
  exact hiddenWorstReward_le A _ (R ω) (π ω)

end MatroidProphet

OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Simulatio.name: OAI.MatroidProphet.sampleSimulation_feasible
OAI.Probability.MatroidProphet.Simulatio.text:
theorem sampleSimulation_feasible {n bits : ℕ} (M : Matroid (Fin n))
    (A : HiddenRule n bits)
    (hA : ∀ (w : Weights n), (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) →
      ∀ (r : Seed bits) (π : ArrivalOrder n) (t : ℕ),
        M.Indep (hiddenAcceptedThrough A r w π t : Set (Fin n))) :
    Feasible M (sampleSimulation A) := by
  intro r s v π t hs hv
  rw [sampleSimulation_acceptedThrough]
  apply hA
  intro e
  classical
  by_cases he : e ∈ A.mask r
  · simpa [glue, he, Function.comp_def] using hs e
  · simpa [glue, he, Function.comp_def] using hv e

    ∃ (A : HiddenRule n bits),

        ∀ (r : Seed bits) (π : ArrivalOrder n) (t : ℕ),
          M.Indep (hiddenAcceptedThrough A r w π t : Set (Fin n))) ∧
      ∀ (w : Weights n), (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) →
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ 293)⁻¹ * optimum M w ≤
          ∫ r, hiddenWorstReward A w r ∂ν

theorem reconstructed_source_witness.{u} {n : ℕ} {Q : Type*}
    [Fintype Q] [MeasurableSpace Q] [MeasurableSingletonClass Q]
    (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (hE : M.E = Set.univ)
    (K : Q → Fin (n + 1))
    (decode : Q → Finset (Fin n) → Seed (mainSeedBits n))
    (νQ : Measure Q) [IsProbabilityMeasure νQ]
    (hproductLaw : (νQ.prod (Secretary.uniformArrivalLaw n)).map
      (fun z => decode z.1 (orderPrefix z.2 (K z.1).val)) = sourceSeedLaw n)
    (hproductMask : ∀ᵐ z ∂νQ.prod (Secretary.uniformArrivalLaw n),
      (completeHiddenRule M hE).mask (decode z.1 (orderPrefix z.2 (K z.1).val)) =
        orderPrefix z.2 (K z.1).val) :
    ∃ (q : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Fin q)), IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
      ∃ (A : SecretaryRule n (Fin q)), SecretaryFeasible M A ∧
        SecretaryGuarantee.{u} M A ν (((2 : ℝ) ^ 293)⁻¹) := by
  exact secretaryFinSeed_witness (reconstructedRule (completeHiddenRule M hE) K decode)
    M νQ (((2 : ℝ) ^ 293)⁻¹)
    (reconstructed_feasible M (completeHiddenRule M hE) K decode
      (completeHiddenRule_feasible M hE))
    (reconstructed_source_guarantee M hE K decode νQ hproductLaw hproductMask)

end MatroidProphet.SecretaryReplay

theorem maximalSeshadriConstants (S : Surface) (L : LineBundle S.scheme)
    (hL : LineBundle.IsAmple S.scheme L) : EventualMaximalSeshadri S L := by
  obtain ⟨r₀,hr₀,h⟩ := S.eventual_very_general_curve_lower L hL
  refine ⟨r₀,hr₀,fun r hr => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Z,hZ,hne,hC⟩ := h r hr
  refine ⟨Z,hZ,hne,fun p hp => ?_⟩
  have hrpos : 0 < r := hr₀.trans_le hr
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := S.pointBlowup_exists L hL r p
  exact ⟨⟨B,B.boundaryNef_of_curve_bound S L hL hrpos (hC p hp)⟩,
    S.seshadri_eq_of_curve_lower L hL hrpos p (hC p hp)⟩

def EventualMaximalSeshadri (S : Surface) (L : LineBundle S.scheme) : Prop :=
  ∃ r₀ : ℕ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, r₀ ≤ r →
    ∃ Z : ℕ → Set (Configuration S r),
      (∀ n, IsClosed (Z n) ∧ Z n ≠ Set.univ) ∧
      (∃ p : Configuration S r, ∀ n, p ∉ Z n) ∧
      ∀ p : Configuration S r, (∀ n, p ∉ Z n) →
        (∃ B : PointBlowup S r p, B.BoundaryNef L) ∧
        seshadriConstant S L r p = Real.sqrt ((selfIntersection S L : ℝ) / r)

end

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.KernelEl.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.Kernel.chord_half_ambient_bound
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.KernelEl.text:
lemma chord_half_ambient_bound {d M T : ℕ} {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (L : Ω → Policy d M T) (ρ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (hL : Admissible L ρ (UniformSphere d)) (hd : 16 ≤ d) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ChordSuccess L ρ (UniformSphere d) ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
      (12^d * ε^((d:ℝ)/2-1) *
        (SuccessConstant^d * (((2*(d/8)+4)*2^M:ℕ):ℝ)^(1/((d/8:ℕ):ℝ)))^BlockCount T (d/8)) := by
  have hb := chord_real_coefficient L ρ hL hd hε (by linarith : ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 ≤ (d:ℝ)/2) le_rfl
  have he : (d:ℝ)-1-(d:ℝ)/2 = (d:ℝ)/2-1 := by ring
  rw [he] at hb
  apply hb.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
  have hN : 1 ≤ 2^M := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hNK : 2^M ≤ (2*(d/8)+4)*2^M := by
    simp
  have hR := realStep_pos d hN
  have hs := stopping_step_bound hd hN hNK T
  have hSp := stepConstant_pos
  have hK : 2*StepConstant ≤ SuccessConstant := by dsimp [SuccessConstant]; linarith
  have hroot : 0 ≤ (((2*(d/8)+4)*2^M:ℕ):ℝ)^(1/((d/8:ℕ):ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hbase := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*StepConstant) hK d) hroot
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ (2*StepConstant)^d *
    (((2*(d/8)+4)*2^M:ℕ):ℝ)^(1/((d/8:ℕ):ℝ))) hbase (BlockCount T (d/8))
  calc
    _ = ((3*4^d:ℝ)*ε^((d:ℝ)/2-1))*((T+1:ℝ)*RealStep d (2^M)^BlockCount T (d/8)) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (cap_constant_le (by omega : 1 ≤ d)) (by positivity))
      (hs.trans hpow) (by positivity) (by positivity)

end MemoryPrecision.Kernel

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.JointL1:.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.JointL1Statement
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.JointL1:.text:
def JointL1Statement : Prop :=
  let two : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 2 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 2 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  ∀ d m p : ℕ,
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Space d) := WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)
  2 ≤ d → 1 ≤ m → m < d → 2 ≤ p →
  ∀ β H R : ℝ, (m : ℝ)+(p : ℝ)-two < β → 0 < H → 0 < R →
  ∀ z : Space d, ∀ μ : Measure (Space d), IsFiniteMeasure μ →
    @Measure.support (Space d)
      (PiLp.topologicalSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      (WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)) μ ⊆
      @Metric.closedBall (Space d)
        (PiLp.instPseudoMetricSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)) z R →
    AmbientBallBound μ H β →
    μ ≪ UniformSphere d →
  ∀ F : ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ,
    Measurable F → (∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) →
    (MatrixLabelReference d m).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =
      ProjectionLaw μ m →
    Tendsto (fun δ => eLpNorm (fun Ay => GaussianRegularization μ m δ Ay - F Ay)
      1 (MatrixLabelReference d m)) (𝓝[Set.Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧
    eLpNorm F (p : ℝ≥0∞) (MatrixLabelReference d m) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (ProjectionNormScale m p H β R)

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeBloc.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.cube_block
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeBloc.text:
theorem cube_block : CubeBlockStatement := by
  refine ⟨CubeBlockConstant, cubeBlockConstant_one, ?_⟩
  intro d k N hd hk hkp hN L hL f hf hf1 hloc g hg hgs z r hr
  by_cases hL0 : L = 0
  · simp only [hL0, mul_zero, zero_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ u in CubeBall d z r, ∑ w, f w u ∂CubeLaw d :=
        lintegral_mono (weightedBlock_le_sum _ _ hgs)
      _ = ∑ w, ∫⁻ u in CubeBall d z r, f w u ∂CubeLaw d :=
        lintegral_finsetSum _ (fun w _ => hf w)
      _ ≤ ∑ _w : Fin N, ENNReal.ofReal (L*r^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun w _ => hloc w z r hr)
      _ = 0 := by simp [hL0]
  have hLpos : 0 < L := lt_of_le_of_ne hL (Ne.symm hL0)
  by_cases hempty : CubeBall d z r = ∅
  · simp [hempty]
  obtain ⟨u₀,hu₀⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
  let ν (w : Fin N) := ((CubeLaw d).withDensity (f w)).map (CubeEmbedding d)
  let (w : Fin N) : IsFiniteMeasure (ν w) := weighted_image_finite (CubeLaw d) (CubeEmbedding d) (f w) (hf1 w)
  have hν w : AmbientBallBound (ν w) L (3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) := cube_weighted_ambient (by omega) (hloc w)
  have hp : 2 ≤ (d/2)/4 := by omega
  have hkd : k ≤ d := by omega
  have hgap : (k:ℝ)+(((d/2)/4:ℕ):ℝ)-2 < (3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) := by
    have hp' : (((d/2)/4:ℕ):ℝ)*4 ≤ (d/2:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_le_self (d/2) 4
    have hk' : (k:ℝ) ≤ ((d/2)/4:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hkp
    have hn' : (8:ℝ) ≤ (d/2:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 8 ≤ d/2 by omega)
    linarith
  have hsel := localized_weighted_selection ν hp hk hkd (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 7)
    hLpos hgap (cube_J_bound hd hkp) hν g hg hgs (CubeEmbedding d u₀) (by positivity : 0 < 4*r)
  have he := weightedBlock_mass_identity (CubeLaw d) (cubeEmbedding_measurable d) hf hf1 hg
    (show MeasurableSet (Metric.closedBall (CubeEmbedding d u₀) (4*r)) from Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet)
  apply (lintegral_mono_set (cubeBall_embedding_subset (by omega) z u₀ hu₀)).trans
  rw [he]
  apply hsel.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
  have hscale := cube_constant_scale (d := d) (by omega) hr
  norm_num only [show (7:ℝ)*192=1344 by norm_num]
  calc
    _ = ((1344:ℝ)^d*(4*r)^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ))*((N:ℝ)^(1/(((d/2)/4:ℕ):ℝ))*L) := by ring
    _ ≤ (CubeBlockConstant^(d/2)*r^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ))*((N:ℝ)^(1/(((d/2)/4:ℕ):ℝ))*L) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscale (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring
end MemoryPrecision


end

def GaussianRegularization {d : ℕ}
    (μ : @Measure (Space d)
      (WithLp.measurableSpace
        (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
          (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))) (Fin d → ℝ)))
    (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ)
    (Ay : (Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) : ℝ :=
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Space d) := WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)
  ∫ signal, ∏ index, gaussianPDFReal 0 ⟨δ^2, sq_nonneg δ⟩
    (Ay.2 index - @inner ℝ (Space d)
      (@InnerProductSpace.toInner ℝ (Space d) _
        (PiLp.seminormedAddCommGroup exponent (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
        (PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)))
      signal (Ay.1 index)) ∂μ

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.ambient_tube
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.text:
lemma ambient_tube {μ : Measure E} {H β R : ℝ} {z : E}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R)
    (hball : ∀ x : E, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      μ (Metric.closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (H*r^β))
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (htR : t ≤ R) :
    μ {x | Metric.infDist x L ≤ t} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
      ((3:ℝ)^Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (2:ℝ)^β * H *
        R^Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * t^(β-(Module.finrank ℝ L.direction:ℝ))) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hcover⟩ := affine_tube_cover_radius L z hR ht htR
  let c : L.direction → E := fun y => R • (y:E) + (orthogonalProjection L z : E)
  have hsub : {x | Metric.infDist x L ≤ t} ≤ᵐ[μ]
      ⋃ y ∈ s, Metric.closedBall (c y) (2*t) := by
    filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
    intro hxL
    have hxR : dist x z ≤ R := hsupport hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hcover x hxR hxL
    exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ μ (⋃ y ∈ s, Metric.closedBall (c y) (2*t)) := measure_mono_ae hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ s, μ (Metric.closedBall (c y) (2*t)) := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _y ∈ s, ENNReal.ofReal (H*(2*t)^β) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => hball (c y) _ (by positivity)
    _ = (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (H*(2*t)^β) := by simp
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((3*R/t)^Module.finrank ℝ L.direction) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (H*(2*t)^β) := by
      gcongr
      exact_mod_cast ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hcard
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
      congr 1
      calc
        _ = H * ((3*R/t)^Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (2*t)^β) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [ambient_tube_radius_factors _ _ ht]; ring

omit [BorelSpace E] in

lemma success_le_one {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (L : Ω → Policy d M T)
    (ρ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] (π : Measure (Sphere d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure π]
    (ε : ℝ) : Success L ρ π ε ≤ 1 := by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (RowLaw d T) := by unfold RowLaw; infer_instance
  unfold Success experiment
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _z : Sphere d × (Ω × Rows d T), (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂π.prod (ρ.prod (RowLaw d T)) :=
      lintegral_mono (fun z => (L z.2.1).pathValue_le_one _
        ((L z.2.1).outputTest_le_one (angleTest_le_one ε)) z.1 (records z.1 z.2.2))
    _ = 1 := by simp
