OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.text:
def FiniteDensityStatement : Prop :=
  let two : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 2 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 2 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  ∀ d m p : ℕ,
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Space d) := WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)
  1 ≤ d → 1 ≤ m → 2 ≤ p →
  ∀ β H R : ℝ, (m : ℝ)+(p : ℝ)-two < β → 0 < H → 0 < R →
  ∀ z : Space d, ∀ μ : Measure (Space d), IsFiniteMeasure μ →
    @Measure.support (Space d)
      (PiLp.topologicalSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      (WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)) μ ⊆
      @Metric.closedBall (Space d)
        (PiLp.instPseudoMetricSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)) z R →
    AmbientBallBound μ H β →
    ∃ F : ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ,
      Measurable F ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) ∧
      (MatrixLabelReference d m).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =
        ProjectionLaw μ m ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂MatrixLabelReference d m, x ∉ ProjectedEllipsoid z R → F x = 0) ∧
      eLpNorm F (p : ℝ≥0∞) (MatrixLabelReference d m) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ProjectionNormScale m p H β R)

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeBloc.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.cube_constant_scale
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeBloc.text:
lemma cube_constant_scale {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (1344:ℝ)^d * (4*r)^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) ≤ CubeBlockConstant^(d/2) * r^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) := by
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hr.le]
  have hp : (1344:ℝ)^d ≤ (1344^3:ℝ)^(d/2) := by
    rw [← pow_mul]
    apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num)
    omega
  have h4 : (4:ℝ)^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) ≤ (4:ℝ)^(d/2) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (d/2)
    linarith
  calc
    _ = ((1344:ℝ)^d*(4:ℝ)^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ))*r^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) := by ring
    _ ≤ ((1344^3:ℝ)^(d/2)*(4:ℝ)^(d/2))*r^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow]; congr 2; norm_num [CubeBlockConstant]

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.KernelSt.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.Kernel.source_stream_explicit
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.KernelSt.text:
lemma source_stream_explicit :
  ∀ d M T : ℕ, 32 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
  ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
  ∀ L : Ω → Policy d M T, Admissible L ρ (UniformSphere d) →
    Success L ρ (UniformSphere d) ε ≤ min 1 (ENNReal.ofReal
      ((2*ε*Real.exp (StreamConstant*(1+(M:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)^2)*(BlockCount T ((d-1)/8):ℝ)))^(((d:ℝ)-1)/2))) := by
  intro d M T hd ε hε hε1 Ω _ ρ hρ L hL
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  let : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  refine le_min (Policy.success_le_one L ρ (UniformSphere d) ε) ?_
  apply (Policy.success_le_chord L ρ (UniformSphere d) ε).trans
  by_cases hT : T = 0
  · subst T
    simp only [BlockCount, Nat.ceil_zero, zero_div, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    exact (Policy.chord_zero_bound L ρ hL (by omega) hε).trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (zero_cap_precise hd hε hε1))
  · apply (chord_half_sphere_bound L ρ hL (by omega) hε hε1).trans
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    let a := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
    let X := StreamConstant*(1+(M:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)^2)*(BlockCount T ((d-1)/8):ℝ)
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := by
      dsimp [a]
      have : (32:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
      linarith
    have he : Real.exp (a*X) = (Real.exp X)^a := by rw [← Real.exp_mul, mul_comm]
    have h2 : ε^a ≤ (2*ε)^a := Real.rpow_le_rpow hε.le (by linarith) ha
    calc
      _ = ε^a * ((4:ℝ)^d * (SuccessConstant^d *
        (((d/8+2)*2^M:ℕ):ℝ)^(1/((d/8:ℕ):ℝ)))^BlockCount T (d/8)) := by dsimp [a, BlockCount, MemoryPrecision.BlockCount]; ring
      _ ≤ ε^a * Real.exp (a*X) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        simpa only [a, X, BlockCount, MemoryPrecision.BlockCount, mul_assoc] using stream_full_factor hd (by omega : 0 < T)
      _ ≤ (2*ε)^a * Real.exp (a*X) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity)
      _ = (2*ε*Real.exp X)^a := by
        rw [he]
        exact (Real.mul_rpow (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2*ε) (Real.exp_pos X).le).symm

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Main:59.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.main
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Main:59.text:
theorem main :
  AmbientGramStatement ∧
  FiniteDensityStatement ∧
  MeasurableTestStatement ∧
  JointL1Statement ∧
  PointwiseDensityStatement ∧
  CoefficientStepStatement ∧
  Kernel.SourceEllipsoidStatement.{u} ∧
  CubeBlockStatement ∧
  (∃ D : ℝ, Real.exp 1 ≤ D ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∃ hd₀ : 16 ≤ d₀, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
    ∀ d M T : ℕ, ∀ hd : d₀ ≤ d, M ≤ d^2 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ K : Ω → MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy d M T,
      MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy.ModelAdmissible.{u} K ρ →
      MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy.Success K ρ
        (MemoryPrecision.Kernel.CubePrior (MemoryPrecision.Kernel.cubePrior_dimension hd₀ hd)) ε ≤
          min 1 (ENNReal.ofReal
            (D^((d/2)*(MemoryPrecision.Kernel.BlockCount T ((d/2)/4)+1)) * ε^((d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ))) ∧
      ((∀ signal : MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Sphere d,
        (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
          (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast inferInstance)) /
        (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 3
          (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 3 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast inferInstance)) ≤
          (∫⁻ observation,
            MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy.experiment K
              (MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy.angleTest ε) (signal, observation)
            ∂ρ.prod (MemoryPrecision.Kernel.RowLaw d T))) →
        c*(d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε) ≤ (T:ℝ))) ∧
  (∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, 0 < d₀ ∧
    ∀ d M T : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
    ∀ L : Ω → MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy d M T,
      MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy.Admissible L ρ (MemoryPrecision.Kernel.UniformSphere d) →
      MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy.Success L ρ (MemoryPrecision.Kernel.UniformSphere d) ε ≤ min 1 (ENNReal.ofReal
        ((2*ε*Real.exp (C*(1+(M:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)^2)*(MemoryPrecision.Kernel.BlockCount T ((d-1)/8):ℝ)))^(((d:ℝ)-1)/2)))) :=
  ⟨ambient_gram, finite_density, measurable_test, joint_l1, pointwise_density, coefficient_step, Kernel.source_ellipsoid_success, cube_block, Kernel.source_cube_success, Kernel.source_stream_success⟩

end MemoryPrecision

lemma density_set_bound (ν : Measure X) (F : X → ℝ) (hF : Measurable F)
    (hF0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) (p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (B : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hnorm : eLpNorm F (p:ℝ≥0∞) ν ≤ B) (E : Set X) (hE : MeasurableSet E) :
    ν.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) E ≤ B * (ν E)^(1-1/(p:ℝ)) := by
  have h := density_test_bound ν F hF hF0 p hp B hnorm Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
    (by simp) (E.indicator 1) (measurable_one.indicator hE).aemeasurable
    (fun x => (Set.indicator_le (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ≥0∞)) (fun _ _ => le_rfl)) x)
  simpa only [lintegral_indicator hE, Measure.restrict_apply_univ,
    setLIntegral_const, Pi.one_apply, one_mul, Measure.restrict_univ] using h

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeBloc.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.cubeBall_embedding_subset
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeBloc.text:
lemma cubeBall_embedding_subset {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (z : Space (d/2)) {r : ℝ}
    (u₀ : Cube d) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ CubeBall d z r) :
    CubeBall d z r ⊆ CubeEmbedding d ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (CubeEmbedding d u₀) (4*r) := by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (d/2:ℕ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d/2 by omega))
  intro u hu
  have hu' : dist u.val z ≤ Real.sqrt (d/2:ℕ)*r := hu
  have hu₀' : dist u₀.val z ≤ Real.sqrt (d/2:ℕ)*r := hu₀
  have hab : dist u.val u₀.val ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (d/2:ℕ)*r := by
    have := dist_triangle u.val z u₀.val
    rw [dist_comm z u₀.val] at this
    linarith
  apply (cubeEmbedding_dist hd u u₀).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ 2/Real.sqrt (d/2:ℕ)*(2*Real.sqrt (d/2:ℕ)*r) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (by positivity)
    _ = 4*r := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hs]; ring

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.LabelTra.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.tendsto_eLpNorm_averageTranslate_sub
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.LabelTra.text:
lemma tendsto_eLpNorm_averageTranslate_sub (κ : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure κ]
    {F : Ω × Y → ℝ} (hFm : Measurable F) (hF : MemLp F 1 (γ.prod τ)) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => eLpNorm (fun x => averageTranslate κ δ F x - F x)
      1 (γ.prod τ)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => ∫⁻ u, eLpNorm
      (fun x => F (x.1,x.2 + δ • u) - F x) 1 (γ.prod τ) ∂κ)
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_lintegral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
      (μ := κ) (l := 𝓝 (0:ℝ)) (f := fun _ => 0)
      (fun _ => eLpNorm F 1 (γ.prod τ) + eLpNorm F 1 (γ.prod τ))
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun δ => ?_))
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun δ => Eventually.of_forall (fun u =>
        eLpNorm_labelTranslate_sub_le γ τ hF (δ • u))))
      (by simpa using ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨hF.eLpNorm_lt_top.ne, hF.eLpNorm_lt_top.ne⟩)
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun u => ?_))
    · simpa using h
    · have hnorm (translation : Y) :
          eLpNorm (fun point => F (point.1, point.2 + δ • translation) - F point)
            1 (γ.prod τ) =
          ∫⁻ point, ‖F (point.1, point.2 + δ • translation) - F point‖ₑ ∂γ.prod τ :=
        eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm (by fun_prop)
      simp_rw [hnorm]
      exact Measurable.lintegral_prod_right (by fun_prop)
    · exact (tendsto_eLpNorm_labelTranslate_sub γ τ hF).comp
        (by
          have hc : Continuous (fun δ : ℝ => δ • u) := by fun_prop
          simpa using hc.tendsto (0:ℝ))
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds ht
    (fun _ => bot_le) (eLpNorm_averageTranslate_sub_le γ τ κ hFm hF)
end Translation
end MemoryPrecision

def PointwiseDensityStatement : Prop :=
  let two : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 2 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 2 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  ∀ d m p : ℕ, 2 ≤ d → 1 ≤ m → m < d → 2 ≤ p →
  ∀ β H R : ℝ, (m : ℝ)+(p : ℝ)-two < β → 0 < H → 0 < R →
  ∀ z : Space d,
  ∀ μ : @Measure (Space d) (WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)),
    IsFiniteMeasure μ →
    @Measure.support (Space d)
      (PiLp.topologicalSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      (WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)) μ ⊆
      @Metric.closedBall (Space d)
        (PiLp.instPseudoMetricSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)) z R →
    AmbientBallBound μ H β →
    μ ≪ UniformSphere d → PointwiseDensityProperties μ m p H β R

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Coeffici.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.coefficient_step
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Coeffici.text:
theorem coefficient_step : CoefficientStepStatement := by
  refine ⟨1344, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro d m N hd hm hmp hN α H hαlo hαhi hH h hh hh1 hb g hg hgsum z r hr
  have : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (SpherePrior d) :=
    (show IsProbabilityMeasure (NoiselessRegression.sphereLaw (E := Space d)) from inferInstance)
  let ν (w : Fin N) := ((SpherePrior d).withDensity (h w)).map Subtype.val
  let (w : Fin N) : IsFiniteMeasure (ν w) :=
    weighted_image_finite (SpherePrior d) Subtype.val (h w) (hh1 w)
  have hν (w) : AmbientBallBound (ν w) H α := by
    intro x ρ hρ
    rw [show ν w = ((SpherePrior d).withDensity (h w)).map Subtype.val from rfl,
      weighted_image_ball _ measurable_subtype_coe]
    exact hb w x ρ hρ
  have hp : 2 ≤ d/8 := by omega
  have hmd : m ≤ d := hmp.trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _)
  have hgap : (m:ℝ)+((d/8:ℕ):ℝ)-2 < α := by
    have hm' : (m:ℝ) ≤ (d/8:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hmp
    have hp' : ((d/8:ℕ):ℝ)*8 ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_le_self d 8
    have hd' : (16:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    linarith
  have hJ := fun j hj => (specialized_J_bound d m (d/8) hd rfl hm hmp α hαlo hαhi j hj).2.2
  have hsel := localized_weighted_selection ν hp hm hmd (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 7)
    hH hgap hJ hν g hg hgsum z hr
  have he := weightedBlock_mass_identity (SpherePrior d) measurable_subtype_coe hh hh1 hg
    (show MeasurableSet (Metric.closedBall z r) from Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet)
  change (∫⁻ s in Subtype.val ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall z r,
    WeightedBlock Subtype.val h g s ∂SpherePrior d) ≤ _
  rw [he]
  convert hsel using 1
  norm_num [ν, mul_assoc]

end MemoryPrecision


end

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeBloc.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.cube_J_bound
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeBloc.text:
lemma cube_J_bound {d k : ℕ} (hd : 16 ≤ d) (hk : k ≤ (d/2)/4) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ (d/2)/4-2 → J (3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) k j ≤ (7:ℝ)^d := by
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ (d/2)/4 := by omega
  have hn4 : (((d/2)/4:ℕ):ℝ)*4 ≤ (d/2:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_le_self (d/2) 4
  have hn : ((d/2:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast Nat.div_le_self d 2
  have hm : (k:ℝ) ≤ ((d/2)/4:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  intro j hj
  have hj' : (j:ℝ)+2 ≤ ((d/2)/4:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show j+2 ≤ (d/2)/4 by omega)
  have hgap : 0 < (3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ)-(j:ℝ)-(k:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hquot : (k:ℝ)/((3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ)-(j:ℝ)-(k:ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hgap]
    linarith
  have h3 : (3:ℝ)^j ≤ (3:ℝ)^d := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have h2 : (2:ℝ)^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ)^d := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    linarith
  calc
    J (3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) k j = 1+(3:ℝ)^j*(2:ℝ)^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ)*
      ((k:ℝ)/((3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ)-(j:ℝ)-(k:ℝ))) := by unfold J; ring
    _ ≤ 1+(3:ℝ)^j*(2:ℝ)^(3*(d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ)*1 := by gcongr
    _ ≤ 1+(3:ℝ)^d*(2:ℝ)^d := by rw [mul_one]; gcongr
    _ = 1+(6:ℝ)^d := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    _ ≤ (7:ℝ)^d := by
      simpa only [one_pow, show (1:ℝ)+6=7 by norm_num] using
        pow_add_pow_le (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 by norm_num) (show d ≠ 0 by omega)

      apply lintegral_mono

      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro w _

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Weighted.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.WeightedBlock
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Weighted.text:
def WeightedBlock (ι : X → Space d) (h : Fin N → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (g : Fin N → ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ≥0∞) (x : X) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let euclideanMeasurable := @WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ) inferInstance
  let rowMeasurable := @MeasurableSpace.pi (Fin m) (fun _ => Space d)
    (fun _ => euclideanMeasurable)
  @MeasureTheory.lintegral (Fin m → Space d) rowMeasurable
    (@Measure.pi (Fin m) (fun _ => Space d) inferInstance (fun _ => euclideanMeasurable)
      (fun _ => @stdGaussian (Space d)
        (PiLp.normedAddCommGroup exponent (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
        (PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
        (space_finiteDimensional d) euclideanMeasurable))
    (fun rows => ∑ state, g state (rows, fun index => @inner ℝ (Space d)
      (@InnerProductSpace.toInner ℝ (Space d) _
        (PiLp.seminormedAddCommGroup exponent (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
        (PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)))
      (ι x) (rows index)) * h state x)

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.ProjectionNormScale

def ProjectionNormScale (m p : ℕ) (H β R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let two : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 2 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 2 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  (two * Real.pi) ^ (-(m : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ)-1) / (two*(p : ℝ))) * H *
    R ^ (β - (m : ℝ)*(1-1/(p : ℝ))) *
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range (p-1), J β m j) ^ (1/(p : ℝ))

def UniformSphere (d : ℕ) : Measure (Sphere d) :=

    PiLp.normedAddCommGroup

        (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast inferInstance))
      (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)
  let euclideanInner := PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)
  let σ := @Measure.toSphere (Vector d) euclideanGroup
    (@InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace ℝ (Vector d) _
      euclideanGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup euclideanInner) inferInstance
    (@volume (Vector d) (@measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace (Vector d)
      euclideanGroup euclideanInner inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance))
  (σ Set.univ)⁻¹ • σ

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Precisio.text:
lemma source_precision {d M T : ℕ} {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (L : Ω → Policy d M T) (ρ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (hd : 32 ≤ d) (hL : Admissible L ρ (UniformSphere d)) {ε A : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 < A) (hM : (M:ℝ) ≤ A*(d:ℝ)^2) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1/10)
    (hs : (2/3:ℝ≥0∞) ≤ Success L ρ (UniformSphere d) ε) :
    (1/(8+20*StreamConstant*(1+A)))*(d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε) ≤ (T:ℝ) := by
  have hT : d ≤ 4*T := by
    by_contra hn
    have hb := hs.trans (source_linear_success_bound L ρ (by omega) (by omega) hε1 hL)
    have hb' : ENNReal.ofReal (2/3:ℝ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (21/32:ℝ) := by
      simpa [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos] using hb
    have hh := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 21/32)).mp hb'
    norm_num at hh
  have hb := hs.trans (source_stream_explicit d M T hd ε hε hε1 Ω ρ inferInstance L hL)
  have hb' : (2/3:ℝ) ≤
      (2*ε*Real.exp (StreamConstant*(1+(M:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)^2)*(BlockCount T ((d-1)/8):ℝ)))^(((d:ℝ)-1)/2) := by
    apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity)).mp
    simpa [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos] using hb.trans (min_le_right _ _)
  exact precision_from_exact_bound hd hT streamConstant_pos hA hM hε hb'
end Policy

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.CubeSucc.text:
lemma source_cube_bound {d M T : ℕ} {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (L : Ω → Policy d M T) (ρ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (hd : 16 ≤ d) (hL : Admissible L ρ (CubePrior (by omega)))
    (hM : M ≤ d^2) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Success L ρ (CubePrior (by omega)) ε ≤ min 1 (ENNReal.ofReal
      (CubeSuccessConstant^((d/2)*(BlockCount T ((d/2)/4)+1)) * ε^((d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ))) := by
  refine le_min (Policy.success_le_one L ρ (CubePrior (by omega)) ε) ?_
  have hb := (Policy.success_le_chord L ρ (CubePrior (by omega)) ε).trans
    (Policy.source_cube_chord_bound L ρ hd hL hε)
  have he : (T+1:ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal
      ((12:ℝ)^(d/2)*ε^((d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) * CubeStep d (2^M)^MemoryPrecision.BlockCount T ((d/2)/4)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((T+1:ℝ) *
        ((12:ℝ)^(d/2)*ε^((d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) * CubeStep d (2^M)^MemoryPrecision.BlockCount T ((d/2)/4))) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ T+1)]
    congr 1
    simp [ENNReal.ofReal_add]
  rw [he] at hb
  apply hb.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
  calc
    _ = ((T+1:ℝ) * ((12:ℝ)^(d/2) * CubeStep d (2^M)^MemoryPrecision.BlockCount T ((d/2)/4))) *
        ε^((d/2:ℕ)/4:ℝ) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (cube_whole_factor hd hM T) (by positivity)

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.specialized_gram_product_bound
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.text:
lemma specialized_gram_product_bound (d m p : ℕ) (hd : 16 ≤ d) (hp : p=d/8)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmp : m ≤ p) (β : ℝ)
    (hβlo : ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 ≤ β) (hβhi : β ≤ (d:ℝ)/2)
    (H R : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 0 < R) :
    H^p * R^(β*(p:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)*(p-1:ℕ)) * (∏ j : Fin (p-1), J β m j) ≤
      (7:ℝ)^(d*(p-1)) * H^p * R^(β*(p:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)*(p-1:ℕ)) := by
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := by omega
  have hs := specialized_J_bound d m p hd hp hm hmp β hβlo hβhi
  have hprod : (∏ j : Fin (p-1), J β m j) ≤ (7:ℝ)^(d*(p-1)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∏ _j : Fin (p-1), (7:ℝ)^d := by
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod₀
        · intro j _
          apply (J_pos ?_).le
          have hh := hs j (by have := j.isLt; omega)
          have hd' : (16:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
          linarith [hh.1, hh.2.1]
        · intro j _
          exact (hs j (by have := j.isLt; omega)).2.2
      _ = _ := by simp [← pow_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ H^p * R^(β*(p:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)*(p-1:ℕ)) * (7:ℝ)^(d*(p-1)) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Measurab.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.eLpNorm_completion
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Measurab.text:
lemma eLpNorm_completion (ν : Measure X) (F : X → ℝ) (hF : Measurable F) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) : eLpNorm F (p:ℝ≥0∞) ν.completion = eLpNorm F (p:ℝ≥0∞) ν := by
  have hFc : @Measurable (NullMeasurableSpace X ν) ℝ _ _ F :=
    hF.mono (original_le_completion ν) le_rfl
  erw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by exact_mod_cast hp) (by finiteness)
      hFc.aestronglyMeasurable,
    eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by exact_mod_cast hp) (by finiteness)
      hF.aestronglyMeasurable,
    lintegral_completion ν (by fun_prop)]

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.specialized_J_bound
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.text:
lemma specialized_J_bound (d m p : ℕ) (hd : 16 ≤ d) (hp : p=d/8)
    (_ : 1 ≤ m) (hmp : m ≤ p) (β : ℝ)
    (hβlo : ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 ≤ β) (hβhi : β ≤ (d:ℝ)/2) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p-2 →
      ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 - 2*(p:ℝ) + 2 ≤ β-(j:ℝ)-(m:ℝ) ∧
      (d:ℝ)/4 + 3/2 ≤ ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 - 2*(p:ℝ) + 2 ∧
      J β m j ≤ (7:ℝ)^d := by
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := by omega
  have hp8 : p*8 ≤ d := by rw [hp]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self d 8
  have hp8' : (p:ℝ)*8 ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hp8
  have hd' : (16:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hm' : (m:ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hmp
  intro j hj
  have hj' : (j:ℝ)+2 ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (show j+2 ≤ p by omega)
  have hmargin : ((d:ℝ)-1)/2-2*(p:ℝ)+2 ≤ β-(j:ℝ)-(m:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hdim : (d:ℝ)/4+3/2 ≤ ((d:ℝ)-1)/2-2*(p:ℝ)+2 := by linarith
  refine ⟨hmargin, hdim, ?_⟩
  have hgap : 0 < β-(j:ℝ)-(m:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hquot : (m:ℝ)/(β-(j:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one hgap]
    linarith
  have h3 : (3:ℝ)^j ≤ (3:ℝ)^d := by
    apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num)
    omega
  have h2 : (2:ℝ)^β ≤ (2:ℝ)^d := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    linarith
  calc
    J β m j = 1 + (3:ℝ)^j * (2:ℝ)^β * ((m:ℝ)/(β-(j:ℝ)-(m:ℝ))) := by unfold J; ring
    _ ≤ 1 + (3:ℝ)^j * (2:ℝ)^β * 1 := by gcongr
    _ ≤ 1 + (3:ℝ)^d * (2:ℝ)^d := by rw [mul_one]; gcongr
    _ = 1 + (6:ℝ)^d := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    _ ≤ (7:ℝ)^d := by
      simpa only [one_pow, show (1:ℝ)+6=7 by norm_num] using pow_add_pow_le (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
        (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 6 by norm_num) (show d ≠ 0 by omega)

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.JointL1:.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.joint_l1
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.JointL1:.text:
theorem joint_l1 : JointL1Statement := by
  intro d m p hd hm hmd hp β H R hgap hH hR z μ hμ hs hb hac F hFm hF0 hden
  have : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (ProjectionLaw μ m) := by unfold ProjectionLaw; infer_instance
  have : SigmaFinite (MatrixLabelReference d m) := by unfold MatrixLabelReference; infer_instance
  have hF := memLp_density_of_finite (MatrixLabelReference d m) (ProjectionLaw μ m) hFm hF0 hden
  constructor
  · have ht := tendsto_eLpNorm_averageTranslate_sub
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => stdGaussian (Space d)))
      (volume : Measure (Fin m → ℝ))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => gaussianReal 0 1)) hFm hF
    apply (ht.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with δ hδ
    apply eLpNorm_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [GaussianRegularization_ae_eq_average μ m F hFm hF0 hden δ
      (ne_of_gt hδ)] with x hx
    exact congrArg (fun t => t - F x) hx.symm
  · obtain ⟨G,hGm,hG0,hGden,hGs,hGnorm⟩ :=
      exact_finite_density d m p hp hm β H R hgap hH hR z μ hs hb
    have he := density_ae_unique_real (MatrixLabelReference d m) hFm hF0 hGm hG0
      (hden.trans hGden.symm)
    exact (eLpNorm_congr_ae he).symm ▸ hGnorm
end MemoryPrecision


end

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Measurab.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.MeasurableTestStatement
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Measurab.text:
def MeasurableTestStatement : Prop :=
  let two : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 2 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 2 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  ∀ d m p : ℕ,
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Space d) := WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)
  1 ≤ d → 1 ≤ m → 2 ≤ p →
  ∀ β H R : ℝ, (m : ℝ)+(p : ℝ)-two < β → 0 < H → 0 < R →
  ∀ z : Space d, ∀ μ : Measure (Space d), IsFiniteMeasure μ →
    @Measure.support (Space d)
      (PiLp.topologicalSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      (WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)) μ ⊆
      @Metric.closedBall (Space d)
        (PiLp.instPseudoMetricSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)) z R →
    AmbientBallBound μ H β →
    let ν := MatrixLabelReference d m
    let η := ProjectionLaw μ m
    let B := ENNReal.ofReal (ProjectionNormScale m p H β R)
    let α := 1-1/(p:ℝ)
    (∀ E, MeasurableSet E → ν E ≠ ∞ → η E ≤ B * (ν E)^α) ∧
    η ≪ ν ∧
    ∃ ηc : Measure (NullMeasurableSpace ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) ν),
      (∀ E, NullMeasurableSet E ν → ηc E = η E) ∧
      (∀ E, NullMeasurableSet E ν → ν.completion E ≠ ∞ →
        ηc E ≤ B * (ν.completion E)^α) ∧
      (∀ φ : NullMeasurableSpace ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) ν → ℝ≥0∞,
        Measurable φ → (∀ x, φ x ≤ 1) →
        (∫⁻ x, φ x ∂ηc) ≤ B * (∫⁻ x in ProjectedEllipsoid z R, φ x ∂ν.completion)^α)

    (fun _ => @stdGaussian (Vector d)
    (PiLp.normedAddCommGroup

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Pointwis.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.measurable_PointwiseDensity
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Pointwis.text:
lemma measurable_PointwiseDensity {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Space d)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (m : ℕ) : Measurable (PointwiseDensity μ m) := by
  classical
  let S := {x : (Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ) | ∃ l : ℝ,
    Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => GaussianRegularization μ m (1/(i:ℝ)) x) atTop (𝓝 l)}
  have hS : MeasurableSet S :=
    measurableSet_exists_tendsto (fun i => measurable_GaussianRegularization μ m _)
  apply measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable
    (f := fun i => S.indicator (GaussianRegularization μ m (1/(i:ℝ))))
    (fun i => (measurable_GaussianRegularization μ m _).indicator hS)
  apply tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ S
  · rcases hx with ⟨l,hl⟩
    rw [PointwiseDensity_eq_of_tendsto μ x hl]
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_mem (show x ∈ S from ⟨l,hl⟩)] using hl
  · have he : PointwiseDensity μ m x = 0 := by
      unfold PointwiseDensity
      exact dite_eq_right hx
    rw [he]
    simpa only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (0:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0))

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.ambient_inverse_moment
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.text:
lemma ambient_inverse_moment {μ : Measure E} {H β R : ℝ} {z : E}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 0 < R) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R)
    (hball : ∀ x : E, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      μ (Metric.closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (H*r^β))
    (L : AffineSubspace ℝ E) [Nonempty L] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hgap : (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction:ℝ) + (m:ℝ) < β) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < Metric.infDist x L) ∧
    (∫⁻ x, (ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.infDist x L)) ^ (-(m:ℝ)) ∂μ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (J β m (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction) * H * R^(β-(m:ℝ))) := by
  have hm' : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hi := sharp_inverse_scaled μ (fun x => Metric.infDist x L)
    (Metric.continuous_infDist_pt _).measurable (fun _ => Metric.infDist_nonneg)
    hm' (show (m:ℝ) < β-(Module.finrank ℝ L.direction:ℝ) by linarith)
    (show 0 ≤ H*R^β by positivity)
    (show 0 ≤ (3:ℝ)^Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (2:ℝ)^β * H * R^β by positivity)
    hR (ambient_mass_bound hR hsupport hball)
    (fun t ht ht1 => ambient_tube_scaled hR hsupport hball L ht ht1)
  refine ⟨hi.1, hi.2.trans_eq ?_⟩
  congr 1
  have heq : H*R^β + ((3:ℝ)^Module.finrank ℝ L.direction * (2:ℝ)^β * H * R^β) *
      (m:ℝ)/(β-(Module.finrank ℝ L.direction:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)) =
      J β m (Module.finrank ℝ L.direction) * H * R^β := by
    unfold J
    ring
  rw [heq, mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hR]
  congr 2

end AmbientMoments

lemma density_ae_unique_real {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (ν₀ : Measure X) [SigmaFinite ν₀] {F G : X → ℝ}
    (hFm : Measurable F) (hF0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x)
    (hGm : Measurable G) (hG0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ G x)
    (hden : ν₀.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =
      ν₀.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (G x))) : F =ᵐ[ν₀] G := by
  have he := (withDensity_eq_iff_of_sigmaFinite hFm.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable
    hGm.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable).mp hden
  filter_upwards [he] with x hx
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_eq_ofReal_iff (hF0 x) (hG0 x)).mp hx

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Measurab.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.measurable_test
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Measurab.text:
theorem measurable_test : MeasurableTestStatement := by
  intro d m p hd hm hp β H R hgap hH hR z μ hμ hs hb
  let := hμ
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hF0, hden, hsupp, hnorm⟩ :=
    exact_finite_density d m p hp hm β H R hgap hH hR z μ hs hb
  dsimp only
  let ν := MatrixLabelReference d m
  let B := ENNReal.ofReal (ProjectionNormScale m p H β R)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro E hE _
    rw [← hden]
    exact density_set_bound ν F hF hF0 p hp B hnorm E hE
  · rw [← hden]
    exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _
  · let ηc := ν.completion.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x))
    refine ⟨ηc, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro E hE
      calc
        ηc E = ν.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) E :=
          withDensity_completion_apply ν F hF E hE
        _ = ProjectionLaw μ m E := congrArg (fun q => q E) hden
    · intro E hE _
      have hFc : @Measurable (NullMeasurableSpace _ ν) ℝ _ _ F :=
        hF.mono (original_le_completion ν) le_rfl
      have hnormc : eLpNorm F (p:ℝ≥0∞) ν.completion ≤ B := by
        erw [eLpNorm_completion ν F hF p (by omega)]
        exact hnorm
      exact density_set_bound ν.completion F hFc hF0 p hp B hnormc E hE
    · intro φ hφ hφ1
      have hFc : @Measurable (NullMeasurableSpace _ ν) ℝ _ _ F :=
        hF.mono (original_le_completion ν) le_rfl
      have hnormc : eLpNorm F (p:ℝ≥0∞) ν.completion ≤ B := by
        erw [eLpNorm_completion ν F hF p (by omega)]
        exact hnorm
      exact density_test_bound ν.completion F hFc hF0 p hp B hnormc
        (ProjectedEllipsoid z R) (isClosed_projectedEllipsoid z R).measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet
        hsupp φ hφ.aemeasurable hφ1
end MemoryPrecision

def SourceStreamStatement : Prop :=

  ∀ L : Ω → MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy d M T,
    MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy.Admissible L ρ (MemoryPrecision.Kernel.UniformSphere d) →
    MemoryPrecision.Kernel.Policy.Success L ρ (MemoryPrecision.Kernel.UniformSphere d) ε ≤ min 1 (ENNReal.ofReal
      ((2*ε*Real.exp (C*(1+(M:ℝ)/(d:ℝ)^2)*(MemoryPrecision.Kernel.BlockCount T ((d-1)/8):ℝ)))^(((d:ℝ)-1)/2)))

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.isClosed_projectedEllipsoid
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.text:
lemma isClosed_projectedEllipsoid {d m : ℕ} (z : Space d) (R : ℝ) :
    IsClosed (ProjectedEllipsoid (m := m) z R) := by
  let K := Metric.closedBall (0 : Space d) R
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  let : CompactSpace K := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hK
  let D : Set (((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) × K) :=
    {w | w.1.2 = fun j => ⟪z, w.1.1 j⟫ + ⟪(w.2 : Space d), w.1.1 j⟫}
  have hD : IsClosed D := isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have he : ProjectedEllipsoid (m := m) z R = Prod.fst '' D := by
    ext Ay
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, he⟩

theorem ambient_gram : AmbientGramStatement := by

  · intro d m p _hd hm hp β R H hβ hR hH μ hfin z hsupport hball
    let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hfin
    have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
    have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
    have hgap : ((p-1:ℕ):ℝ)+(m:ℝ)-1<β := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hp1]
      push_cast

    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj L hnonempty hdim
      let : Nonempty L := hnonempty

      · have hi := (ambient_inverse_moment hH hR hsupport hball L hm0
          (by rw [hdim]; linarith)).2

    · exact ae_joint_replica_independent hH hR hsupport hball hm0 (p-1) hgap
    · have hi := joint_replica_integral_exact hH hR hsupport hball hm0 (p-1) hgap
      simpa only [NoiselessRegression.replicaWeight_eq_det, InverseGram,
        Nat.sub_add_cancel hp1] using hi
  · refine ⟨7, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    intro d m p hd hp hm hmp β hβlo hβhi
    exact ⟨specialized_J_bound d m p hd hp hm hmp β hβlo hβhi,

def SourceEllipsoidStatement : Prop :=
  let two : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 2 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 2 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let four : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 4 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 4 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 2)))
  let ten : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 10 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 10 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 8)))
  ∃ C C₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ 1 ≤ C₀ ∧
  ∀ d M T : ℕ, 16 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/ten →
  ∀ (Ω : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (ρ : Measure Ω), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
  ∀ K : Ω → Policy d M T, Policy.Admissible K ρ (UniformSphere d) →
    Policy.Success K ρ (UniformSphere d) ε ≤ min 1 (ENNReal.ofReal
      (four^d * ε^(((d:ℝ)-1)/two) *
        (C^d * (((d/8+2)*2^M : ℕ):ℝ)^(1/((d/8:ℕ):ℝ)))^(BlockCount T (d/8)))) ∧
    Policy.ChordSuccess K ρ (UniformSphere d) ε ≤ min 1 (ENNReal.ofReal

        (C^d * (((2*(d/8)+4)*2^M : ℕ):ℝ)^(1/((d/8:ℕ):ℝ)))^(BlockCount T (d/8)))) ∧
    {x : Sphere d × Sphere d | Real.arccos (@inner ℝ (Vector d)
      (@InnerProductSpace.toInner ℝ (Vector d) _
        (PiLp.seminormedAddCommGroup
          (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
            (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0))))
          (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
        (PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)))
      x.2.val x.1.val) ≤ ε} ⊆
    {x | @Dist.dist (Vector d)
      (PiLp.instDist (p := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
        (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0))))
        (α := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)) x.2.val x.1.val ≤ ε}

theorem pointwise_density : PointwiseDensityStatement := by
  intro d m p hd hm hmd hp β H R hgap hH hR z μ hμ hs hb hac
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ
  obtain ⟨F,hFm,hF0,hden,hFs,hFnorm⟩ :=
    exact_finite_density d m p hp hm β H R hgap hH hR z μ hs hb
  have he := pointwiseDensity_ae_eq hm μ F hFm hF0 hden
  refine ⟨?_, PointwiseDensity_nonneg μ m, measurable_PointwiseDensity μ m,
    ?_, ?_, pointwiseDensity_ae_eq hm μ, ?_⟩
  · intro δ hδ
    exact ⟨fun r hr => radialMixture_nonneg m δ hr, radialMixture_measurable m δ,
      radialMixture_integral m hm hδ, radialMixture_tail m hm hδ⟩
  · intro A hA
    exact pointwiseDensity_fullRank hd hm hmd μ hac A hA
  · exact (withDensity_congr_ae (he.fun_comp ENNReal.ofReal)).trans hden
  · have hp0 : (p:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0)
    have hpE : (p:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0)
    have hpow := ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hFnorm (show 0 ≤ (p:ℝ) by positivity)
    rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hpE (by finiteness)
      hFm.aestronglyMeasurable] at hpow
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast] at hpow
    rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul, one_div_mul_cancel hp0, ENNReal.rpow_one] at hpow
    simp only [ENNReal.rpow_natCast] at hpow
    have hi : (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (PointwiseDensity μ m x)^p) =ᵐ[MatrixLabelReference d m]
        (fun x => ‖F x‖ₑ^p) := by
      filter_upwards [he] with x hx
      rw [hx, Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (hF0 x)]
    rw [lintegral_congr_ae hi]
    exact hpow
end MemoryPrecision

lemma ae_joint_replica_independent {μ : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {H β R : ℝ} {z : E}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 0 < R) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R)
    (hball : ∀ x : E, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      μ (Metric.closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (H*r^β))
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (n : ℕ)
    (hgap : (n:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)-1<β) :
    ∀ᵐ v : E × (Fin n → E) ∂μ.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)),
      LinearIndependent ℝ (fun j => v.2 j-v.1) := by
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet {v : E × (Fin n → E) |
      ∀ i, gramSchmidt ℝ (fun j => v.2 j-v.1) i ≠ 0} := by
    rw [Set.ofPred_forall]
    apply MeasurableSet.iInter
    intro i
    have h := (measurable_gramSchmidt i).comp
      (show Measurable (fun v : E × (Fin n → E) => fun j => v.2 j-v.1) by fun_prop)
    exact (measurableSet_eq_fun h measurable_const).compl
  have ha : ∀ᵐ v : E × (Fin n → E) ∂μ.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ)),
      ∀ i, gramSchmidt ℝ (fun j => v.2 j-v.1) i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae hmeas]
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p =>
      ae_replica_nondegenerate_exact hH hR hsupport hball hm p n hgap
  filter_upwards [ha] with v hv
  apply Matrix.linearIndependent_of_det_gram_ne_zero
  rw [det_gram_eq_prod_gramSchmidt]
  exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => pow_ne_zero _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hv i))

lemma chord_half_sphere_bound {d M T : ℕ} {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (L : Ω → Policy d M T) (ρ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (hL : Admissible L ρ (UniformSphere d)) (hd : 16 ≤ d) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1/10) :
    ChordSuccess L ρ (UniformSphere d) ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
      (4^d * ε^(((d:ℝ)-1)/2) *
        (SuccessConstant^d * (((d/8+2)*2^M:ℕ):ℝ)^(1/((d/8:ℕ):ℝ)))^BlockCount T (d/8)) := by
  by_cases hT : T = 0
  · subst T
    simp only [blockCount_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
    exact (Policy.chord_zero_bound L ρ hL (by omega) hε).trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (terminal_angular_zero_bound hd hε hε1))
  · have hb := chord_real_coefficient L ρ hL hd hε (le_refl (((d:ℝ)-1)/2)) (by linarith)
    have he : (d:ℝ)-1-((d:ℝ)-1)/2 = ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 := by ring
    rw [he] at hb
    apply hb.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
    have hN : 1 ≤ 2^M := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hNK : 2^M ≤ (d/8+2)*2^M := by
      simp
    have hs := stopping_step_bound_three hd hN hNK (by omega : 0 < T)
    calc
      _ = (4^d * ε^(((d:ℝ)-1)/2)) * (3*((T+1:ℝ)*RealStep d (2^M)^BlockCount T (d/8))) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by positivity)

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Weighted.text:
lemma weightedBlock_mass_identity (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {ι : X → Space d} (hι : Measurable ι)
    {h : Fin N → X → ℝ≥0∞} (hh : ∀ w, Measurable (h w)) (hh1 : ∀ w x, h w x ≤ 1)
    {g : Fin N → ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hg : ∀ w, Measurable (g w)) {B : Set (Space d)} (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    (∫⁻ x in ι ⁻¹' B, WeightedBlock ι h g x ∂μ) =
      ∑ w, ∫⁻ x, g w x ∂projectionLaw (((μ.withDensity (h w)).map ι).restrict B) m := by
  classical
  let (w : Fin N) : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.withDensity (h w)) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_withDensity (ne_of_lt ((lintegral_mono (hh1 w)).trans_lt (by simp)))
  let G (w : Fin N) (x : X) (A : Fin m → Space d) := g w (A, fun j => ⟪ι x,A j⟫) * h w x
  have hG (w) : Measurable (Function.uncurry (G w)) :=
    ((hg w).comp (by fun_prop)).mul ((hh w).comp measurable_fst)
  have he (w) : (∫⁻ u, g w u ∂projectionLaw (((μ.withDensity (h w)).map ι).restrict B) m) =
      ∫⁻ x in ι ⁻¹' B, ∫⁻ A, G w x A
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => stdGaussian (Space d)) ∂μ := by
    have hobs : Measurable (fun x : (Fin m → Space d) × Space d =>
        g w (x.1,fun j => ⟪x.2,x.1 j⟫)) := (hg w).comp (by fun_prop)
    have htech : Measurable (fun x : (Fin m → Space d) × X =>
        g w (x.1,fun j => ⟪ι x.2,x.1 j⟫)) := (hg w).comp (by fun_prop)
    rw [projectionLaw_lintegral _ _ (hg w), Measure.restrict_map hι hB,
      lintegral_map hobs.lintegral_prod_left hι,
      restrict_withDensity (hι hB), lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (hh w)
        htech.lintegral_prod_left]
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro x
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
    rw [← lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (ne_of_lt ((hh1 w x).trans_lt (by simp)))]
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro A
    exact mul_comm _ _
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [← lintegral_finsetSum _ (fun w _ => (hG w).lintegral_prod_right)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro x
  unfold WeightedBlock
  exact lintegral_finsetSum _ (fun w _ => (hG w).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id))
end WeightedImage

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.JointL1:.text:
lemma GaussianRegularization_ae_eq_average {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Space d))
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (m : ℕ)
    (F : ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ)
    (hF : Measurable F) (hF0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x)
    (hden : (MatrixLabelReference d m).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =
      ProjectionLaw μ m) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    GaussianRegularization μ m δ =ᵐ[MatrixLabelReference d m]
      averageTranslate (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => gaussianReal 0 1)) δ F := by
  have he := projectionSmoothing_ae_eq_fiberSmoothing μ m
    (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) hF.ennreal_ofReal hden
    (gaussianPDF 0 ⟨δ^2,sq_nonneg δ⟩) (measurable_gaussianPDF _ _)
  filter_upwards [he] with x hx
  rw [GaussianRegularization_eq_toReal, hx]
  unfold averageTranslate
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (Eventually.of_forall (fun u => hF0 _))
    ((hF.comp (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable)]
  congr 1
  change fiberSmoothing volume (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x))
    (fun y : Fin m → ℝ => ∏ j, gaussianPDF 0 _ (y j)) x =
      ∫⁻ u : Fin m → ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (F (x.1,fun j => x.2 j + δ * u j))
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)
  rw [lintegral_gaussian_shift_scale m δ hδ x.2 (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (F (x.1,y)))
    (by fun_prop)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro y
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact gaussianPDF_zero_sub_comm _ _ _

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.joint_replica_integral_exact
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.text:
lemma joint_replica_integral_exact {μ : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {H β R : ℝ} {z : E}
    (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 0 < R) (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R)
    (hball : ∀ x : E, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      μ (Metric.closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (H*r^β))
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (n : ℕ)
    (hgap : (n:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)-1<β) :
    (∫⁻ v : E × (Fin n → E), replicaWeight m v.1 v.2
      ∂μ.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ => μ))) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (H^(n+1) * R^(β*(n+1:ℕ)-(m:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)) *
        ∏ j : Fin n, J β m j) := by
  have hJ (j : Fin n) : 0 < J β m j := by
    apply J_pos
    have hj : (j:ℝ)+1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt j.isLt
    linarith
  have hfac (j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ J β m j * H * R^(β-(m:ℝ)) := by
    exact le_of_lt (mul_pos (mul_pos (hJ j) hH) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hR _))
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ p, ∫⁻ v : Fin n → E, replicaWeight m p v
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ) ∂μ :=
      lintegral_prod _ (measurable_joint_replicaWeight m n).aemeasurable
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _p, ∏ j : Fin n, ENNReal.ofReal (J β m j * H * R^(β-(m:ℝ))) ∂μ :=
      lintegral_mono fun p => replica_integral_exact hH hR hsupport hball hm p n hgap
    _ = (∏ j : Fin n, ENNReal.ofReal (J β m j * H * R^(β-(m:ℝ)))) * μ univ :=
      lintegral_const _
    _ ≤ (∏ j : Fin n, ENNReal.ofReal (J β m j * H * R^(β-(m:ℝ)))) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (H*R^β) := mul_le_mul' le_rfl (ambient_mass_bound hR hsupport hball)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun j _ => hfac j),
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hfac j)]
      congr 1
      simp only [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hR.le]
      have heq : R^((β-(m:ℝ))*(n:ℝ)) * R^β =
          R^(β*(n+1:ℕ)-(m:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hR]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      calc
        _ = (H^n*H) * (R^((β-(m:ℝ))*(n:ℝ)) * R^β) * ∏ j : Fin n, J β m j := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [← pow_succ, heq]

end ReplicaExact

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Pointwis.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.PointwiseDensityProperties
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Pointwis.text:
def PointwiseDensityProperties {d : ℕ}
    (μ : @Measure (Space d)
      (WithLp.measurableSpace
        (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
          (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))) (Fin d → ℝ)))
    (m p : ℕ) (H β R : ℝ) : Prop :=
  letI : MeasurableSpace (Space d) := WithLp.measurableSpace
    (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
      (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
        (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))) (Fin d → ℝ)
  let reference : Measure ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) := MatrixLabelReference d m
  RadialMixtureRepresentation m ∧
  (∀ x, 0 ≤ PointwiseDensity μ m x) ∧
  Measurable (PointwiseDensity μ m) ∧
  FullRankDensityFormula μ m ∧
  reference.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (PointwiseDensity μ m x)) =
    ProjectionLaw μ m ∧
  (∀ F : ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ,
    Measurable F → (∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) →
    reference.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =
      ProjectionLaw μ m → PointwiseDensity μ m =ᵐ[reference] F) ∧
  (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (PointwiseDensity μ m x)^p ∂reference) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (ProjectionNormScale m p H β R)^p

OAI.Probability.GaussianRegression.Spher.text:
lemma chord_le_arccos (s t : Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    dist s.val t.val ≤ Real.arccos ⟪s.val,t.val⟫ := by
  have hs : ‖s.val‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp s.property
  have ht : ‖t.val‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp t.property
  have habs : |⟪s.val,t.val⟫| ≤ 1 := by
    simpa [hs, ht] using abs_real_inner_le_norm s.val t.val
  have hcos := Real.one_sub_sq_div_two_le_cos (x := Real.arccos ⟪s.val,t.val⟫)
  rw [Real.cos_arccos (abs_le.mp habs).1 (abs_le.mp habs).2] at hcos
  have hd : (dist s.val t.val)^2 = 2 - 2*⟪s.val,t.val⟫ := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_sq_real, hs, ht]
    ring
  nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := s.val) (y := t.val), Real.arccos_nonneg ⟪s.val,t.val⟫]

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Measurab.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.density_test_bound
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Measurab.text:
lemma density_test_bound (ν : Measure X) (F : X → ℝ) (hF : Measurable F)
    (hF0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) (p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (B : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hnorm : eLpNorm F (p:ℝ≥0∞) ν ≤ B) (S : Set X) (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hsupp : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∉ S → F x = 0)
    (φ : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hφ : AEMeasurable φ ν) (hφ1 : ∀ x, φ x ≤ 1) :
    (∫⁻ x, φ x ∂ν.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x))) ≤
      B * (∫⁻ x in S, φ x ∂ν)^(1-1/(p:ℝ)) := by
  have hp' : 1 < (p:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < p)
  have hpq := Real.HolderConjugate.conjExponent hp'
  have hq : 1 / Real.conjExponent (p:ℝ) = 1-1/(p:ℝ) := by
    simpa only [one_div] using (eq_sub_of_add_eq' hpq.inv_add_inv_eq_one)
  let K := S.indicator φ
  have hK : AEMeasurable K ν := hφ.indicator hS
  have hK1 : ∀ x, K x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    exact (Set.indicator_le (g := fun _ => 1) (fun _ _ => hφ1 _)) x
  rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul₀ (hF.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable) hφ]
  have he : (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x) * φ x) =ᵐ[ν]
      (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x) * K x) := by
    filter_upwards [hsupp] with x hx
    by_cases hxS : x ∈ S
    · simp [K, Set.indicator_of_mem hxS]
    · simp [K, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxS, hx hxS]
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [lintegral_congr_ae he]
  have hholder := ENNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq ν hpq hF.ennreal_ofReal.aemeasurable hK
  have hnormeq : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (F x) ^ (p:ℝ) ∂ν) ^ (1/(p:ℝ)) =
      eLpNorm F (p:ℝ≥0∞) ν := by
    rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0))
      (by finiteness) hF.aestronglyMeasurable]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast, Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (hF0 _)]
  rw [hnormeq, hq] at hholder
  refine hholder.trans (mul_le_mul' hnorm ?_)
  apply ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow _ (by rw [← hq]; exact hpq.symm.one_div_nonneg)
  calc
    (∫⁻ x, K x ^ Real.conjExponent (p:ℝ) ∂ν) ≤ ∫⁻ x, K x ∂ν :=
      lintegral_mono (fun x => ENNReal.rpow_le_self_of_le_one (hK1 x) hpq.symm.lt.le)
    _ = _ := lintegral_indicator hS _

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.exact_finite_density
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.text:
lemma exact_finite_density (d m p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (β H R : ℝ) (hgap : (m:ℝ)+(p:ℝ)-2 < β) (hH : 0 < H) (hR : 0 < R)
    (z : Space d) (μ : Measure (Space d)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hsupport : μ.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R) (hball : AmbientBallBound μ H β) :
    ∃ F : ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ,
      Measurable F ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) ∧
      (MatrixLabelReference d m).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =
        ProjectionLaw μ m ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂MatrixLabelReference d m, x ∉ ProjectedEllipsoid z R → F x = 0) ∧
      eLpNorm F (p : ℝ≥0∞) (MatrixLabelReference d m) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ProjectionNormScale m p H β R) := by
  let C := gaussianPeak ^ ((p-1)*m) * ENNReal.ofReal
    (H^p * R^(β*(p:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)*((p-1:ℕ):ℝ)) * ∏ j : Fin (p-1), J β m j)
  have hC : C ≠ ∞ := by unfold C gaussianPeak; finiteness
  have hp1 : p-1+1 = p := by omega
  have hmom : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → (∫⁻ x, φ x = 1) →
      (∫⁻ Ay, projectionSmoothing μ φ m Ay ^ (p-1+1) ∂matrixLabelReference m) ≤ C := by
    intro φ hφ hφ1
    have hg : ((p-1:ℕ):ℝ)+(m:ℝ)-1 < β := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
      push_cast
      linarith
    simpa only [hp1] using sharp_projectionSmoothing_moment hH hR hsupport hball φ hφ hφ1 hm (p-1) hg
  have hac := projectionLaw_ac_of_moment μ m (p-1) (by omega) C hC hmom
  let G := (projectionLaw μ m).rnDeriv (matrixLabelReference m)
  have hG : Measurable G := Measure.measurable_rnDeriv _ _
  have hden : (matrixLabelReference m).withDensity G = projectionLaw μ m :=
    Measure.withDensity_rnDeriv_eq _ _ hac
  have hGtop : ∀ᵐ x ∂matrixLabelReference m, G x ≠ ∞ := Measure.rnDeriv_ne_top _ _
  have hGmom : (∫⁻ x, G x^p ∂matrixLabelReference m) ≤ C := by
    simpa only [hp1] using projectionLaw_rnDeriv_moment μ m (p-1) (by omega) C hC hmom
  let F := fun x => (G x).toReal
  have hFG : (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =ᵐ[matrixLabelReference m] G := by
    filter_upwards [hGtop] with x hx
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hx
  refine ⟨F, hG.ennreal_toReal, fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (matrixLabelReference m).withDensity _ = projectionLaw μ m
    rw [withDensity_congr_ae hFG, hden]
  · have hnull := projectionLaw_ellipsoid_compl μ hsupport (m := m)
    rw [← hden, withDensity_apply _ (isClosed_projectedEllipsoid z R).measurableSet.compl] at hnull
    have hz := (lintegral_eq_zero_iff' hG.aemeasurable).mp hnull
    change ∀ᵐ x ∂(matrixLabelReference m).restrict (ProjectedEllipsoid z R)ᶜ, G x = 0 at hz
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' (isClosed_projectedEllipsoid z R).measurableSet.compl] at hz
    filter_upwards [hz] with x hx hnot
    dsimp [F]
    rw [hx hnot]
    rfl
  · change eLpNorm F (p:ℝ≥0∞) (matrixLabelReference m) ≤ _
    rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0))
      (by finiteness) hG.ennreal_toReal.aestronglyMeasurable]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast]
    have he : (fun x => ‖F x‖ₑ ^ (p:ℝ)) =ᵐ[matrixLabelReference m] (fun x => G x^p) := by
      filter_upwards [hFG] with x hx
      rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, hx, ENNReal.rpow_natCast]
    rw [lintegral_congr_ae he]
    exact (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hGmom (by positivity)).trans_eq
      (moment_root_eq_scale hp hH hR hgap)

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.DensityU.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.pointwiseDensity_ae_eq
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.DensityU.text:
lemma pointwiseDensity_ae_eq {d m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (μ : Measure (Space d))
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (F : ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ)
    (hFm : Measurable F) (hF0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x)
    (hden : (MatrixLabelReference d m).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) =
      ProjectionLaw μ m) :
    PointwiseDensity μ m =ᵐ[MatrixLabelReference d m] F := by
  have hfin : (∫⁻ z, ENNReal.ofReal (F z) ∂MatrixLabelReference d m) ≠ ∞ := by
    have he := congrArg (fun ν => ν Set.univ) hden
    rw [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.restrict_univ] at he
    rw [he]
    let : IsFiniteMeasure (ProjectionLaw μ m) := by unfold ProjectionLaw; infer_instance
    exact measure_ne_top _ _
  have ht := ae_tendsto_fiberGaussian
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m => stdGaussian (Space d))) hm
    (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) hFm.ennreal_ofReal hfin
  have he (i : ℕ) := projectionSmoothing_ae_eq_fiberSmoothing μ m
    (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (F x)) hFm.ennreal_ofReal hden
    (gaussianPDF 0 ⟨(1/(i:ℝ))^2,sq_nonneg _⟩) (measurable_gaussianPDF _ _)
  filter_upwards [ht, ae_all_iff.mpr he] with x hx hxe
  apply PointwiseDensity_eq_of_tendsto
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hF0 x)] at hx
  convert hx using 1
  ext i
  rw [GaussianRegularization_eq_toReal μ m _, hxe i]
end MemoryPrecision


end

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Weighted.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.localized_weighted_selection
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.Weighted.text:
lemma localized_weighted_selection {d m p N : ℕ} (ν : Fin N → Measure (Space d))
    [∀ w, IsFiniteMeasure (ν w)] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmd : m ≤ d)
    {β K H : ℝ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hH : 0 < H) (hgap : (m:ℝ)+(p:ℝ)-2 < β)
    (hJ : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p-2 → J β m j ≤ K^d)
    (hball : ∀ w, AmbientBallBound (ν w) H β)
    (g : Fin N → ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hg : ∀ w, Measurable (g w)) (hgsum : ∀ x, ∑ w, g w x ≤ 1)
    (z : Space d) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ w, ∫⁻ x, g w x ∂projectionLaw ((ν w).restrict (Metric.closedBall z r)) m) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((K*192)^d * (N:ℝ)^(1/(p:ℝ)) * H * r^β) := by
  let τ w := realNormalize (ν w) β H z r
  let (w : Fin N) : IsFiniteMeasure (τ w) := realNormalize_finite (ν w) hH z hr
  let F : ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) → ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) :=
    fun x => (x.1, fun i => ⟪z,x.1 i⟫ + r*x.2 i)
  have hF : Measurable F := by fun_prop
  have hb := normalized_weighted_selection τ hp hm hmd hK hgap hJ
    (fun w => realNormalize_local (hball w) hH z hr)
    (fun w => realNormalize_support (ν w) β H z hr)
    (fun w => g w ∘ F) (fun w => (hg w).comp hF) (fun x => hgsum (F x))
  have he (w) : (∫⁻ x, g w x ∂projectionLaw ((ν w).restrict (Metric.closedBall z r)) m) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (H*r^β) * ∫⁻ x, g w (F x) ∂projectionLaw (τ w) m := by
    rw [← realNormalize_reconstruct (ν w) (β := β) hH z hr, projectionLaw_smul,
      projectionLaw_affine, lintegral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul, lintegral_map (hg w) hF]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  refine (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hb).trans_eq ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast N, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity : 0 ≤ K*192),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ (K*192)^d),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ H*r^β)]
  congr 1
  ring

end MemoryPrecision


end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.ProjectionLaw
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.text:
def ProjectionLaw {d : ℕ}
    (μ : @Measure (Space d)
      (WithLp.measurableSpace
        (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
          (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))) (Fin d → ℝ)))
    (m : ℕ) : @Measure ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ))
      (@MeasurableSpace.prod (Fin m → Space d) (Fin m → ℝ)
        (@MeasurableSpace.pi (Fin m) (fun _ => Space d)
          (fun _ => WithLp.measurableSpace
            (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
              (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))) (Fin d → ℝ)))
        inferInstance) :=
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let euclideanMeasurable := WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)
  let rowMeasurable := @MeasurableSpace.pi (Fin m) (fun _ => Space d)
    (fun _ => euclideanMeasurable)
  let rowLaw := @Measure.pi (Fin m) (fun _ => Space d) inferInstance
    (fun _ => euclideanMeasurable)
    (fun _ => @stdGaussian (Space d)
      (PiLp.normedAddCommGroup exponent (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      (PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      inferInstance euclideanMeasurable)
  @Measure.map ((Fin m → Space d) × Space d) ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ))
    (@MeasurableSpace.prod _ _ rowMeasurable euclideanMeasurable)
    (@MeasurableSpace.prod _ _ rowMeasurable inferInstance)
    (fun pair => (pair.1, fun index => @inner ℝ (Space d)
      (@InnerProductSpace.toInner ℝ (Space d) _
        (PiLp.seminormedAddCommGroup exponent (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
        (PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)))
      pair.2 (pair.1 index)))
    (@Measure.prod _ _ rowMeasurable euclideanMeasurable rowLaw μ)

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.ProjectedEllipsoid
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.text:
def ProjectedEllipsoid {d m : ℕ} (z : Space d) (R : ℝ) :
    Set ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ)) :=
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let euclideanInner := @InnerProductSpace.toInner ℝ (Space d) _
    (PiLp.seminormedAddCommGroup exponent (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
    (PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
  {pair | ∃ displacement ∈ @Metric.closedBall (Space d)
      (PiLp.instPseudoMetricSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      (WithLp.toLp exponent (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) R,
    pair.2 = fun index => @inner ℝ (Space d) euclideanInner z (pair.1 index) +
      @inner ℝ (Space d) euclideanInner displacement (pair.1 index)}

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.AmbientGramStatement
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.AmbientG.text:
def AmbientGramStatement : Prop :=
  let two : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 2 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 2 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let three : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 3 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 3 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 1)))
  let four : ℝ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ 4 (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ 4 Real.commRing.toNatCast
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 2)))
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  (∀ (d m p : ℕ),
    letI : MeasurableSpace (Space d) := WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)
    letI : PseudoMetricSpace (Space d) :=
      PiLp.instPseudoMetricSpace (p := exponent) (β := fun _ : Fin d => ℝ)
    letI : AddCommGroup (Space d) := WithLp.instAddCommGroup exponent (Fin d → ℝ)
    letI : Module ℝ (Space d) := WithLp.instModule (p := exponent) (K := ℝ) (V := Fin d → ℝ)
    1 ≤ d → 1 ≤ m → 2 ≤ p →
    ∀ β R H : ℝ, (m : ℝ) + (p : ℝ) - two < β → 0 < R → 0 < H →
    ∀ (μ : Measure (Space d)), IsFiniteMeasure μ →
    ∀ z : Space d, μ.support ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R →
    AmbientBallBound μ H β →
    (∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ p-2 → ∀ L : AffineSubspace ℝ (Space d),
      Nonempty L → Module.finrank ℝ L.direction = j →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ R →
        μ {s | Metric.infDist s L ≤ t} ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (three^j * two^β * H * R^j * t^(β-(j:ℝ)))) ∧
      (∫⁻ s, (ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.infDist s L)) ^ (-(m:ℝ)) ∂μ) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (J β m j * H * R^(β-(m:ℝ)))) ∧
    (∀ᵐ v : Space d × (Fin (p-1) → Space d)
      ∂μ.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (p-1) => μ)),
      LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i => v.2 i - v.1)) ∧
    (∫⁻ v : Space d × (Fin (p-1) → Space d), InverseGram m v
      ∂μ.prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (p-1) => μ))) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (H^p * R^(β*(p:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)*(p-1:ℕ)) *
        ∏ j : Fin (p-1), J β m j)) ∧
  (∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (d m p : ℕ), 16 ≤ d → p = d/8 →
    1 ≤ m → m ≤ p → ∀ β : ℝ, ((d:ℝ)-1)/two ≤ β → β ≤ (d:ℝ)/two →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p-2 →
      ((d:ℝ)-1)/two - two*(p:ℝ) + two ≤ β-(j:ℝ)-(m:ℝ) ∧
      (d:ℝ)/four + three/two ≤ ((d:ℝ)-1)/two - two*(p:ℝ) + two ∧
      J β m j ≤ C^d) ∧
    (∀ H R : ℝ, 0 < H → 0 < R →
      H^p * R^(β*(p:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)*(p-1:ℕ)) * (∏ j : Fin (p-1), J β m j) ≤
        C^(d*(p-1)) * H^p * R^(β*(p:ℝ)-(m:ℝ)*(p-1:ℕ))))

OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.name: OAI.MemoryPrecision.MatrixLabelReference
OAI.Probability.MemoryPrecision.FiniteDe.text:
def MatrixLabelReference (d m : ℕ) : @Measure ((Fin m → Space d) × (Fin m → ℝ))
    (@MeasurableSpace.prod (Fin m → Space d) (Fin m → ℝ)
      (@MeasurableSpace.pi (Fin m) (fun _ => Space d)
        (fun _ => WithLp.measurableSpace
          (@OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
            (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))) (Fin d → ℝ)))
      inferInstance) :=
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := @OfNat.ofNat ℝ≥0∞ 2
    (@instOfNatAtLeastTwo ℝ≥0∞ 2 ENNReal.instAddCommMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.instAtLeastTwo (nat_lit 0)))
  let euclideanMeasurable := WithLp.measurableSpace exponent (Fin d → ℝ)
  let rowMeasurable := @MeasurableSpace.pi (Fin m) (fun _ => Space d)
    (fun _ => euclideanMeasurable)
  let rowLaw := @Measure.pi (Fin m) (fun _ => Space d) inferInstance
    (fun _ => euclideanMeasurable)
    (fun _ => @stdGaussian (Space d)
      (PiLp.normedAddCommGroup exponent (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      (PiLp.innerProductSpace (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun _ : Fin d => ℝ))
      inferInstance euclideanMeasurable)
  @Measure.prod _ _ rowMeasurable inferInstance rowLaw volume

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Parameters:79.name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionRadius_log_le
OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Parameters:79.text:
theorem compressionRadius_log_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
    Real.log 3 / Real.log ((compressionRadius a : ℝ) + 1) ≤ accuracy a := by
  have hθ := accuracy_pos ha
  have hceil := Nat.le_ceil (Real.exp (Real.log 3 / accuracy a))
  have hbound : Real.exp (Real.log 3 / accuracy a) < (compressionRadius a : ℝ) + 1 := by
    simp only [compressionRadius, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    linarith
  have hlog := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos (Real.log 3 / accuracy a)) hbound
  rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (compressionRadius_log_pos a)).mpr
  have hmul := (div_lt_iff₀ hθ).mp hlog
  nlinarith

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Parameters:39.name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.accuracy_pos

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Main:48.name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_entropy_duality_counterexample_with_covers
OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Main:48.text:
theorem exists_entropy_duality_counterexample_with_covers
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ K : Set (RealSpace (Fin n)),
      IsSymmetricConvexBody K ∧
      Coverable K (cube (Fin n)) ∧
      Coverable (polar (cube (Fin n))) (a⁻¹ • polar K) ∧
      b * Real.log (coveringNumber (polar (cube (Fin n))) (a⁻¹ • polar K) : ℝ) <
        Real.log (coveringNumber K (cube (Fin n)) : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrank⟩ := exists_rank b (accuracy a) (compressionRadius_pos a)
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith only [hb]
  let P : EntropyPair a r (8 * b) := Classical.choice
    (exists_entropy_pair_with_budget a ha r (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hr)
      (8 * b) (by positivity))
  refine ⟨P.dimension, P.dimension_pos, P.body, P.body_isSymmetricConvexBody,
    P.primal_coverable, P.dual_coverable, ?_⟩
  have hratio : entropyRatio a P.body < 1 / (2 * b) :=
    P.ratio_lt.trans (entropyBudget_lt_of_rank hb hrank)
  have hcross := (div_lt_div_iff₀ P.primal_log_pos
    (by positivity : 0 < 2 * b)).mp hratio
  nlinarith only [hcross, P.primal_log_pos]

theorem exists_rank (b θ : ℝ) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, 0 < r ∧
      8 * b * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) + h - 1 := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 0 (8 * b * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (pivotSlots θ : ℝ)))
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hr
  have hrbound := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hr
  have hh1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ h := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hh)
  refine ⟨r, Nat.cast_pos.mp hr0, ?_⟩
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Compression:1.name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.uniform_compression
OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Compression:1.text:
theorem uniform_compression
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i)
    (hlabels : ∀ i, Nat.card (Set.range (L i)) ≤ q)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset (Fin u)))
    (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ T ∈ 𝒯, ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) :
    ∃ A : Finset (X → ℝ), A.Nonempty ∧
      (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (u : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (h * s) *
        (1 + (s : ℝ) * 2 ^ u / θ) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u) ∧
      SignedCompression.PositiveApproximation (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) θ A := by
  let E := FixedLabels.ofCardBound L hlabels
  refine ⟨compressionList L E h s θ,
    compressionList_nonempty L E h s θ hu hq,
    compressionList_card_le L E h s θ hθ hs, ?_⟩
  intro μ hμ hmass
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ := compressionList_bounds L E 𝒯 hu hh hs θ hθ hsθ
    hprofile hcomp μ hμ hmass
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hx := hb x
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Main:27.name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.entropyBudget_lt_of_rank
OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Main:27.text:
private theorem entropyBudget_lt_of_rank {a b : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hrank : 8 * b * (compressionRadius a : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      (pivotSlots (accuracy a) : ℝ) <
        (r : ℝ) + (compressionRadius a : ℝ) - 1) :
    entropyBudget a r (8 * b) < 1 / (2 * b) := by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith only [hb]
  have hden : 0 < (r : ℝ) + (compressionRadius a : ℝ) - 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hrank
  have hfirst : 2 * (compressionRadius a : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      (pivotSlots (accuracy a) : ℝ) /
        ((r : ℝ) + (compressionRadius a : ℝ) - 1) < 1 / (4 * b) := by
    apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ hden (by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith only [hrank]
  calc
    entropyBudget a r (8 * b) < 1 / (4 * b) + 2 / (8 * b) :=
      add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hfirst (le_refl _)
    _ = 1 / (2 * b) := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hb0]; ring

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.MatrixEntropy.name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.entropyPair_of_matrix
OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.MatrixEntropy.text:
theorem entropyPair_of_matrix {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hprime : Real.exp (B * encodingCost (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)
      (directionCount r (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)) /
        (formDimension r (compressionRadius a) : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ))
    (g : Y → X → ℝ)
    (hrows : Fintype.card X = p ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a))
    (hcolumns : Fintype.card X ≤ Fintype.card Y)
    (hsep : ∀ x x', x ≠ x' → ∃ y, 1 ≤ |g y x - g y x'|)
    (A : Finset (RealSpace X))
    (hA : UniformApproximation g (6 * accuracy a) A)
    (Q : ℕ) (hAQ : A.card ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hQ : Real.log (Q : ℝ) ≤
      (compressionRadius a : ℝ) * (pivotSlots (accuracy a) : ℝ) *
        Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a - 1)) +
          encodingCost (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)
            (directionCount r (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a))) :
    Nonempty (EntropyPair a r B) := by
  have hθ := accuracy_pos ha
  have hh := compressionRadius_pos a
  have hD := formDimension_pos (j := compressionRadius a) hr
  obtain ⟨hn, K, hK, hcube, hfin, hdualfin, hlo, hhi⟩ :=
    matrix_to_body_fin g (by positivity : 0 ≤ 6 * accuracy a) hθ hsep A hA
  have hscale : 6 * (6 * accuracy a) + 2 * accuracy a = 38 * accuracy a := by ring
  rw [hscale] at hdualfin hhi
  obtain ⟨hdualfin', hmono⟩ := polar_cover_enlarge K
    (by positivity : 0 < 38 * accuracy a) (accuracy_cover_scale ha).le hdualfin
  have hdualpos : 0 < coveringNumber (polar (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y))))
      (a⁻¹ • polar K) := by
    apply coveringNumber_pos _ hdualfin'
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    simp
  have hN : p ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a) ≤
      coveringNumber K (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y))) := by
    simpa only [hrows] using hlo
  have hm : 1 < p ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a) :=
    Nat.one_lt_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hD) hp.one_lt
  have hNpos := hm.trans_le hN
  have hdualQ := hmono.trans (hhi.trans hAQ)
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a) := by
    exact_mod_cast hm
  have hNR : (p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a) ≤
      (coveringNumber K (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y))) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hN
  have hdualR : (1 : ℝ) ≤
      (coveringNumber (polar (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y)))) (a⁻¹ • polar K) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hdualpos)
  have hdualQR :
      (coveringNumber (polar (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y)))) (a⁻¹ • polar K) : ℝ) ≤
        (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hdualQ
  have hratios := entropy_ratio_bounds hmR hNR hdualR hdualQR
  have hcompression := form_entropy_ratio_le hr hh hp.one_lt hQ
  have hencoding := prime_choice_encoding_ratio_lt hp hD hB hprime
  have hratiosmall : entropyRatio a K < entropyBudget a r B := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt hratios.2
    exact hcompression.trans_lt (add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (le_refl _) hencoding)
  have hrn : r ≤ Fintype.card Y :=
    rank_le_ambientDimension hr hh hp.two_le (by simpa only [hrows] using hcolumns)
  exact ⟨{
    dimension := Fintype.card Y
    dimension_pos := hn
    rank_le_dimension := hrn
    body := K
    body_isSymmetricConvexBody := hK
    cube_isSymmetricConvexBody := hcube
    primal_coverable := hfin
    dual_coverable := hdualfin'
    primal_one_lt := hNpos
    dual_pos := hdualpos
    primal_log_pos := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hNpos)
    ratio_nonneg := hratios.1
    ratio_lt := hratiosmall
  }⟩

end MetricEntropyDuality

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Model:38.text:

    (K : Set (RealSpace ι)) : Prop where
  isCompact : IsCompact K

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.EntropyPair:3.name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.EntropyPair
OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.EntropyPair:3.text:
structure EntropyPair (a : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (B : ℝ) where
  dimension : ℕ
  dimension_pos : 0 < dimension
  rank_le_dimension : r ≤ dimension
  body : Set (RealSpace (Fin dimension))
  body_isSymmetricConvexBody : IsSymmetricConvexBody body
  cube_isSymmetricConvexBody : IsSymmetricConvexBody (cube (Fin dimension))
  primal_coverable : Coverable body (cube (Fin dimension))
  dual_coverable : Coverable (polar (cube (Fin dimension))) (a⁻¹ • polar body)
  primal_one_lt : 1 < coveringNumber body (cube (Fin dimension))
  dual_pos : 0 < coveringNumber (polar (cube (Fin dimension))) (a⁻¹ • polar body)
  primal_log_pos : 0 < Real.log (coveringNumber body (cube (Fin dimension)) : ℝ)
  ratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ entropyRatio a body
  ratio_lt : entropyRatio a body < entropyBudget a r B

end MetricEntropyDuality

end

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Construction:.name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_entropy_pair_with_budget
OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.Construction:.text:
theorem exists_entropy_pair_with_budget (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) :
    Nonempty (EntropyPair a r B) := by
  classical
  have hr₀ : 0 < r := hr
  let θ := accuracy a
  let h := compressionRadius a
  let j := h - 1
  have hh : 0 < h := compressionRadius_pos a
  have hj : j + 1 = h := Nat.sub_add_cancel hh
  have hθ : 0 < θ := accuracy_pos ha
  have hθ₁ : θ < 1 := accuracy_lt_one ha
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _, hp_h, hp_size, hp_entropy, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
    exists_prime_for_rank ha hr₀ B 0 hB
  let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let u := directionCount r (j + 1) θ
  have hu : 0 < u := directionCount_pos hr₀ (Nat.succ_pos j) hθ
  have hp_h' : j + 1 < p := by simpa only [hj] using hp_h
  have hp_size' : (j + 1) ^ 2 * u ^ (2 * (j + 1)) < p := by
    simpa only [u, hj] using hp_size
  obtain ⟨t, hrobust⟩ := exists_robust_directions
    hr₀ (Nat.succ_pos j) hθ hθ₁ hp_h' hp_size'
  let X := FiniteFieldRows.RowIndex p r (j + 1)
  let Y := FiniteFieldRows.ColumnIndex θ p r (j + 1) u
  let : Nonempty X := ⟨0⟩
  let : Nonempty Y := FiniteFieldRows.columnIndex_nonempty hθ.le p r (j + 1) u
  let L := FiniteFieldRows.labels (j := j) t
  let 𝒯 := FiniteFieldRows.admissibleSets θ u
  let g : Y → X → ℝ := FiniteFieldRows.column (j := j) θ t
  let q := p ^ formDimension r j
  have hq : 0 < q := pow_pos hp.pos _
  have hlabels : ∀ i, Nat.card (Set.range (L i)) ≤ q := by
    intro i
    calc
      Nat.card (Set.range (L i)) ≤ Nat.card (SymmetricForm (ZMod p) r j) :=
        Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (fun z : Set.range (L i) => z.val)
          Subtype.val_injective
      _ = q := by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, card_form_coefficients]
  have hcomp : ∀ T ∈ 𝒯, ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ) := by
    intro T hT
    exact FiniteFieldRows.mem_admissibleSets.mp hT
  have hsθ : 1 ≤ (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) * θ := by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using one_le_mul_pivotSlots hθ
  have hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ := by
    simpa only [hj] using compressionRadius_log_le ha
  obtain ⟨A, hAne, hcount, hpositive⟩ := uniform_compression
    (L := L) (hlabels := hlabels) (𝒯 := 𝒯) (hu := hu) (hq := hq)
    (hh := Nat.succ_pos j) (hs := pivotSlots_pos hθ) (θ := θ) (hθ := hθ)
    (hsθ := hsθ) (hprofile := hprofile) (hcomp := hcomp)
  have hsigned : UniformApproximation g (6 * θ)
      (SignedCompression.differenceList A) :=
    SignedCompression.uniformApproximation g θ A hpositive
  have hlog := log_card_le_encodingCost hu hq hθ hAne hcount
  have hlog' : Real.log (A.card : ℝ) ≤
      (compressionRadius a : ℝ) * (pivotSlots (accuracy a) : ℝ) *
        Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a - 1)) +
          encodingCost (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)
            (directionCount r (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)) := by
    change Real.log (A.card : ℝ) ≤
      (h : ℝ) * (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) * Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r j) +
        encodingCost h θ (directionCount r h θ)
    simpa only [q, Nat.cast_pow, u, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, hj] using hlog
  have hrows : Fintype.card X = p ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a) := by
    change Fintype.card (FiniteFieldRows.RowIndex p r (j + 1)) =
      p ^ formDimension r h
    simpa only [hj] using FiniteFieldRows.card_rowIndex p r (j + 1)
  have hcolumns : Fintype.card X ≤ Fintype.card Y :=
    FiniteFieldRows.card_rowIndex_le_columns hθ.le p r (j + 1) u
  have hsep : ∀ x x' : X, x ≠ x' → ∃ y : Y, 1 ≤ |g y x - g y x'| := by
    intro x x' hxx'
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := FiniteFieldRows.exists_column_abs_eq_one t hrobust x x' hxx'
    exact ⟨y, hy.ge⟩
  exact entropyPair_of_matrix a ha r hr₀ B hB p hp hp_entropy g
    hrows hcolumns hsep (SignedCompression.differenceList A) hsigned
    A.card (SignedCompression.differenceList_card_le A) hlog'

end MetricEntropyDuality

end

end OAI

theorem exists_robust_directions
    {p r h : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hr : 0 < r) (hh : 0 < h)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1)
    (hp_h : h < p)
    (hp_size : h ^ 2 * (directionCount r h θ) ^ (2 * h) < p) :
    ∃ t : Fin (directionCount r h θ) → Fin r → ZMod p,
      ∀ F : SymmetricForm (ZMod p) r h, F ≠ 0 →
        ∃ T : Finset (Fin (directionCount r h θ)),
          ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (directionCount r h θ : ℝ) ∧
            T.Nonempty ∧
          ∀ a : Fin h → Fin (directionCount r h θ), (∀ j, a j ∈ T) →
            SymmetricForm.eval F (fun j => t (a j)) ≠ 0 :=
  exists_robust_directions_of_budget hr hh (directionCount_pos hr hh hθ0)
    hθ1 (directionCount_budget hθ0) hp_h hp_size

OAI.Analysis.MetricEntropy.PrimeChoice:7.text:
theorem exists_prime_for_rank {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B bound : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) :
    let h := compressionRadius a
    let D := formDimension r h
    let u := directionCount r h (accuracy a)
    let C := encodingCost h (accuracy a) u
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ bound < (p : ℝ) ∧ h < p ∧
      h ^ 2 * u ^ (2 * h) < p ∧ Real.exp (B * C / (D : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ) ∧
      0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧ B * C < (D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧
      2 * C / ((D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ)) < 2 / B ∧ 0 < C := by
  let h := compressionRadius a
  let D := formDimension r h
  let u := directionCount r h (accuracy a)
  let C := encodingCost h (accuracy a) u
  have hh : 0 < h := compressionRadius_pos a
  have hθ := accuracy_pos ha
  have hD : 0 < D := formDimension_pos (j := h) hr
  have hu : 0 < u := directionCount_pos hr hh hθ
  have hC : 0 < C := encodingCost_pos hh hθ hu
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hbound, hhp, hsize, hexp, hlog, hbudget, hratio⟩ :=
    exists_prime_with_entropy_budget h u D C B bound hD hB
  exact ⟨p, hp, hbound, hhp, hsize, hexp, hlog, hbudget, hratio, hC⟩

end MetricEntropyDuality

end

OAI.Analysis.SegmentLenses.Completed:87.name: OAI.SegmentLenses.completed_main_tail
OAI.Analysis.SegmentLenses.Completed:87.text:
theorem completed_main_tail {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    (x y : FullDual V) (hx : head H x = x)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hp : ‖x + y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x - y‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖tail H y‖ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
  apply dual_norm_le _ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  intro u
  let K := ancestralHull (H ∪ u.coeff.support)
  have hK : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) K := ancestralHull_ancestral _
  have hHK : H ⊆ K := Finset.subset_union_left.trans (subset_ancestralHull _)
  have huK : u.coeff.support ⊆ K := Finset.subset_union_right.trans (subset_ancestralHull _)
  have hxK := head_eq_of_subset hHK x hx
  have hpK : ‖x + head K y‖ ≤ R := by
    have he : x + head K y = head K (x + y) := by
      change x + headLinear K y = headLinear K (x + y)
      simp only [map_add, headLinear_apply, hxK]
    rw [he]
    exact (norm_head_le hK (x + y)).trans hp
  have hmK : ‖x - head K y‖ ≤ R := by
    have he : x - head K y = head K (x - y) := by
      change x - headLinear K y = headLinear K (x - y)
      simp only [map_sub, headLinear_apply, hxK]
    rw [he]
    exact (norm_head_le hK (x - y)).trans hm
  have hb := finite_main_tail hH hK hHK x (head K y) hx (head_head K y) R hR hpK hmK
  rw [← tail_head_pairing H K y u huK]
  have hop := (tail H (head K y)).le_opNorm (u : Primal V)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe] at hop
  exact hop.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (norm_nonneg u))

end CompletedMain
