OAI.Computability.MinUncut.Main:38.name: OAI.MinUncut.Uniform.full_outputs
OAI.Computability.MinUncut.Main:38.text:
def full_outputs (K : ℕ) (F : BinaryFormula.Formula) :
    TM2OutputsInTime fullMachine
      ((inputBits (K,F)).map frontendMachine.inputAlphabet.symm)
      (some (output K F).bits) ((fullTime K).eval (formulaBits F).length) := by
  let v:=formulaBits F
  let w:=MinUncutGames.Foundations.Complexity.formulaBits (frontend F).val
  let mid:=(nameBits K++w).map frontendMachine.outputAlphabet.symm
  let h1:=Framed.execute frontendMachine.tm frontendMachine.inputAlphabet frontendMachine.outputAlphabet
    K v w _ (frontendMachine.outputsFun F)
  have handoff:mid.map frontendMachine.outputAlphabet=nameBits K++w:=by
    simp only [mid,List.map_map,Function.comp_def,Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact List.map_id _
  let h2: TM2OutputsInTime coreMachine (mid.map frontendMachine.outputAlphabet)
      (some (output K F).bits) ((coreTime K).eval w.length):=by
    erw [handoff]
    exact core_outputs K F
  let hh:=MachineSequential.execute framedFrontend coreMachine frontendMachine.outputAlphabet false
    _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2
  have hs:=frontSize_bound F
  have hc:=evalNat_mono (coreTime K) hs
  refine ⟨hh.toEvalsTo,hh.steps_le_m.trans ?_⟩
  change frontendMachine.time.eval v.length+2*(nameBits K).length+1+
    2*(mid.length+1)+(coreTime K).eval w.length≤(fullTime K).eval v.length
  simp only [mid,List.length_map,List.length_append,fullTime,eval_add,eval_C,eval_mul,eval_comp]
  dsimp only [v,w] at *

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.PlaneCurves.FullTa.text:
theorem fullNagata_of_genuine_source_construction
    (hconstruction : ∀ r : ℕ, 10 ≤ r → ¬ IsSquare r → ∀ d m : ℕ,
      0 < d → 0 < m → 3 < (d : ℝ) / m → (d : ℝ) / m < Real.sqrt r →
      UniversalSupport r d (fun _ => m) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (delta : ℝ) (x : Fin 9 → ℝ),
      0 < n → 0 < delta → delta < 1 / 2 → Function.Injective x →
      (∀ i, 0 < x i ∧ x i < 1 / 2) →
      (∑ i : Fin 9, sourceOffsets x i) = delta →
      (∀ j : ℤ, 0 ≤ j → j ≤ ((n * m : ℕ) : ℤ) →
        firstLower ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ) ((n * m : ℕ) : ℤ) j
          (3 * (Real.sqrt r - 3)) delta ∉ Set.range (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)) →
      (∀ j : ℤ, ((n * m : ℕ) : ℤ) < j → j ≤ ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ) / 3 →
        0 < ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ) - 3 * j →
        secondLower ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ) j
          (3 * (Real.sqrt r - 3)) delta ∉ Set.range (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)) →
      (exponentSet ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ) ((n * m : ℕ) : ℤ)
        (3 * (Real.sqrt r - 3)) delta).Nonempty →
      ∀ᶠ τ : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
        ∃ (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτone : τ < 1) (U : Set ℂ),
          IsOpen U ∧ (0 : ℂ) ∈ U ∧
          (∀ p : Fin (r - 9) → ℂ, Function.Injective p → (∀ i, p i ∈ U) →
            ∃ F : genuineSourceSections hτ hτone x (3 * (Real.sqrt r - 3))
                ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ) (n * m),
              F ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, Nagata.Workers.W28.HasAnalyticOrderAtLeast (𝕜 := ℂ)
                (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => localScalar F (tauPower τ (1 / 2)) z.1 z.2)
                (p i, 0) (n * m))) : Nagata.FullNagata := by
  apply fullNagata_of_nonsquare_interior_exclusion
  intro r hr hns d m hd hm hlow hupp hU
  exact Workers.W12.genuine_source_geometric_contradiction r d m hr hm hlow hupp
    (hconstruction r hr hns d m hd hm hlow hupp hU)

end Nagata.W13

OAI.AlgebraicGeometry.PlaneCurves.FixedC.text:
theorem source_fixed_scaled_construction {r d m : ℕ} (hr : 9 ≤ r)
    (hUniversal : Nagata.W13.UniversalSupport r d (fun _ => m))
    (n : ℕ) (marks : Fin 9 → ℝ) (hmarks : Function.Injective marks)
    (hmbounds : ∀ i, 0 < marks i ∧ marks i < 1 / 2) (a : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ τ : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
      ∃ (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτone : τ < 1) (U : Set ℂ),
        IsOpen U ∧ (0 : ℂ) ∈ U ∧
        ∀ ξ : Fin (r - 9) → ℂ, Function.Injective ξ → (∀ i, ξ i ∈ U) →
          ∃ F : genuineSourceSections hτ hτone marks a ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ) (n * m),
            F ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, HasAnalyticOrderAtLeast (𝕜 := ℂ)
              (fun x : ℂ × ℂ => localScalar F (tauPower τ (1 / 2)) x.1 x.2)
              (ξ i, 0) (n * m) := by
  have hrEq : r = 9 + (r - 9) := by omega
  have hscaled : Nagata.W13.UniversalSupport (9 + (r - 9)) (n * d) (fun _ => n * m) := by
    have hu : Nagata.W13.UniversalSupport r (n * d) (fun _ => n * m) := by
      simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using Nagata.W13.universalSupport_pow hUniversal n
    exact Eq.mp (congrArg (fun R : ℕ =>
      Nagata.W13.UniversalSupport R (n * d) (fun _ => n * m)) hrEq) hu
  have hone : ∀ᶠ τ : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), τ < 1 :=
    mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hone] with τ hτ hτone
  obtain ⟨U,hU,h0,hEvery⟩ := source_fixed_necessary_W hτ hτone marks hmarks hmbounds
    a (n * d) (n * m) (r - 9) hscaled
  exact ⟨hτ,hτone,U,hU,h0,hEvery⟩

end Nagata.CoefficientSpaces

end

theorem compacts_representation_map_one {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A]
    {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hrange : ∀ T : H →L[ℂ] H, IsCompactOperator T → ∃ a : A, φ a = T) :
    φ 1 = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H := by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hrange _ (rankOne_isCompact x x)
    have hmul : φ 1 * InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x x =
        InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x x := by
      rw [← ha, ← map_mul, one_mul]
    have hv := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T x) hmul
    simp only [mul_apply_eq_comp, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply,
      map_smul] at hv
    exact smul_right_injective H (inner_self_ne_zero.mpr hx) hv

theorem all_irreducibles_equivalent_of_pure_states
    (hall : ∀ (f g : A →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f) (hg : IsPureState g),
      UnitarilyEquivalent (pureGNS f hf) (pureGNS g hg))
    (π : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (hπ : IsIrreducible π)
    (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (K →L[ℂ] K)) (hρ : IsIrreducible ρ) :
    UnitarilyEquivalent π ρ := by
  let := irreducible_nontrivial_space π hπ
  let := irreducible_nontrivial_space ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨ξ,hξ⟩ := exists_norm_eq H (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨η,hη⟩ := exists_norm_eq K (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hf,hfπ⟩ := irreducible_vector_pure_equivalent π hπ ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨hg,hgρ⟩ := irreducible_vector_pure_equivalent ρ hρ η hη
  exact hfπ.symm.trans ((hall _ _ hf hg).trans hgρ)

theorem fullTower_pure_reference_unconditional (hi : Function.Injective σ)
    (f : limitStage (fullTower_unconditional σ hσ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f) :
    PureStateEquivalent f hf (limitStage (fullTower_unconditional σ hσ)).reference
      (limitStage (fullTower_unconditional σ hσ)).reference_spec.1 := by
  let F := fullTower_unconditional σ hσ
  let X := limitStage F
  let into := fun j => (limitEmbedding F j).map
  let incl := fun {i j : ConstructionIndex} (h : i ≤ j) => (F.map (homOfLE h)).embedding.map
  have hcomp : ∀ {i j} (h : i ≤ j), (into j).comp (incl h) = into i := by
    intro i j h

  have hfp : ∀ j, IsPureState (restrictState (into j) X.reference) := by
    intro j
    rw [(limitEmbedding F j).reference_map]

  apply scheduled_pure_equivalent_to_reference (fun j => (F.obj j).stage)
    into (fun j => (limitEmbedding F j).injective) incl hcomp
    (fun j => (limitEmbedding F j).uep) X.reference X.reference_spec.1 hfp
    (fun j => pureList ConstructionIndex constructionIndex_cardinal (F.obj j))
    (fun j => pureList_pure ConstructionIndex constructionIndex_cardinal (F.obj j))
    (fun j g hg => pureList_covers ConstructionIndex constructionIndex_cardinal (F.obj j)
      (fullTower_count_unconditional σ hσ j) g hg)
    σ hσ Order.succ Order.le_succ ?_ f hf (limit_eventual_pure F f hf)
  intro j η
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hr,he⟩ := recursiveTower_treated_unconditional ConstructionIndex constructionIndex_cardinal
    σ hσ hi (j,η) (not_isMax _)
  refine ⟨G,hG,hr,?_⟩

  simp only [TracialStage.Hom.reference_map]

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.HNN:1789.text:
theorem pure_lifts_equivalent (φ : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] C)
    (f g : A →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f) (hg : IsPureState g)
    (he : UnitarilyEquivalent (pureGNS f hf) (pureGNS g hg))
    (hu : StateExtensionUnique φ g)
    (F G : C →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hF : IsPureState F) (hG : IsPureState G)
    (hrF : restrictState φ F = f) (hrG : restrictState φ G = g) :
    UnitarilyEquivalent (pureGNS F hF) (pureGNS G hG) := by
  obtain ⟨u,huconj⟩ := pureState_equivalent_conjugate f g hf hg he
  let v : unitary C := ⟨φ (u:A),by
    constructor
    · rw [← map_star,← map_mul,u.property.1,map_one]
    · rw [← map_star,← map_mul,u.property.2,map_one]⟩
  let H := restrictState (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ C v).symm.toStarAlgHom F
  have hH : IsState H := isState_restrict _ _ hF.1
  have hrH : restrictState φ H = g := by
    ext a
    change F (star (φ (u:A))*φ a*φ (u:A)) = g a
    rw [← map_star,← map_mul,← map_mul]
    change restrictState φ F (star (u:A)*a*(u:A)) = g a
    rw [hrF]
    exact (congrArg (fun k : A →L[ℂ] ℂ => k a) huconj).symm
  have hh := hu H G hH hG.1 hrH hrG
  apply pureState_equivalent_of_conjugate F G hF hG v
  intro a
  exact (congrArg (fun k : C →L[ℂ] ℂ => k a) hh).symm

end

    (π : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (hπ : IsIrreducible π)
    (ξ : H) (hξ : ‖ξ‖ = 1) :
    ∃ hf : IsPureState (vectorFunctional π ξ),
      UnitarilyEquivalent (pureGNS (vectorFunctional π ξ) hf) π := by
  have hs := irreducible_vector_state π hπ ξ hξ
  have hn : ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hz : (0:ℝ) = 1 := by simpa only [h,norm_zero] using hξ
    exact zero_ne_one hz
  have he := cyclic_representation_equivalent (positiveOfSquares (vectorFunctional π ξ) hs.2)
    π ξ (fun _ => rfl) (irreducible_vector_cyclic π hπ ξ hn)
  have hp := isPureState_of_gns_irreducible (vectorFunctional π ξ) hs
    (he.symm.isIrreducible hπ)
  exact ⟨hp,he⟩

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Tracial:243.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.main
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Tracial:243.text:
theorem main :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : CStarAlgebra A),
      IsSimpleCStar A ∧ ¬ FiniteDimensional ℂ A ∧
      (∃ τ : A →L[ℂ] ℂ, IsFaithfulTracialState τ) ∧
      HasUniqueIrreducibleRepresentation.{u, v, w} A ∧
      ∀ (H : Type v) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H],
        ¬ IsIsomorphicToCompacts A H := by
  obtain ⟨σ,hi,hσ⟩ := exists_pair_schedule constructionCardinal.{0} constructionCardinal_regular
  let X := ChronologicalStage.limitStage (ChronologicalStage.fullTower_unconditional σ hσ)
  have hall : ∀ (f g : X →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f) (hg : IsPureState g),
      PureStateEquivalent f hf g hg := by
    intro f g hf hg
    exact (ChronologicalStage.fullTower_pure_reference_unconditional σ hσ hi f hf).trans
      (ChronologicalStage.fullTower_pure_reference_unconditional σ hσ hi g hg).symm
  let A := ULift.{u} X
  let e : X ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A := liftStarAlgEquiv X
  let : PartialOrder A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder A
  let : StarOrderedRing A := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing A
  have hinf : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℂ A := by
    intro h
    exact X.infinite (FiniteDimensional.of_injective e.toAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap e.injective)
  refine ⟨A,inferInstance,X.simple.of_equiv e,hinf,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨restrictState e.symm.toStarAlgHom X.trace,
      isState_restrict _ _ X.traceState,?_,?_⟩
    · intro a b
      change X.trace (e.symm (a*b)) = X.trace (e.symm (b*a))
      rw [map_mul e.symm a b, map_mul e.symm b a]
      exact X.tracial _ _
    · intro a ha
      change 0 < (X.trace (e.symm (star a*a))).re
      rw [map_mul e.symm (star a) a, map_star e.symm a]
      exact X.traceFaithful _ (fun h => ha (e.symm.injective (h.trans (map_zero e.symm).symm)))
  · intro H _ _ _ K _ _ _ π ρ hπ hρ
    exact all_irreducibles_equivalent_of_pure_states (pureHomogeneity_of_equiv e hall) π hπ ρ hρ
  · intro H _ _ _
    exact not_isIsomorphicToCompacts hinf H

end NaimarkZFC

end

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.HNN:2106.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.isPureState_restrict_equiv
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.HNN:2106.text:
theorem isPureState_restrict_equiv (e : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] B)
    (f : B →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f) :
    IsPureState (restrictState e.toStarAlgHom f) := by
  have hr : restrictState e.symm.toStarAlgHom (restrictState e.toStarAlgHom f) = f := by
    ext b
    exact congrArg f (e.apply_symm_apply b)
  exact unique_lift_pure e.symm.toStarAlgHom f hf _
    (isState_restrict e.toStarAlgHom f hf.1) hr (fun g hg hgr =>
      StateExtensionUnique.of_surjective e.symm.toStarAlgHom e.symm.surjective f
        g _ hg (isState_restrict _ _ hf.1) hgr hr)

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Dependencies:489.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.scheduled_pure_equivalent_to_reference
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Dependencies:489.text:
theorem scheduled_pure_equivalent_to_reference
    (into : ∀ j, D j →⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) (hinj : ∀ j, Function.Injective (into j))
    (incl : ∀ {i j}, i ≤ j → D i →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D j)
    (hcomp : ∀ {i j} (h : i ≤ j), (into j).comp (incl h) = into i)
    (hu : ∀ j, PureUEP (into j))
    (f : A →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f)
    (hfp : ∀ j, IsPureState (restrictState (into j) f))
    (list : ∀ j, K → D j →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hlp : ∀ j η, IsPureState (list j η))
    (hex : ∀ j (g : D j →L[ℂ] ℂ), IsPureState g → ∃ η, list j η = g)
    (σ : J × K → J) (hσ : ∀ p, p.1 ≤ σ p)
    (next : J → J) (hn : ∀ j, j ≤ next j)
    (treated : ∀ j η, ∃ (G : D (next (σ (j,η))) →L[ℂ] ℂ)
      (hG : IsPureState G),
      restrictState (incl ((hσ (j,η)).trans (hn (σ (j,η))))) G = list j η ∧
      PureStateEquivalent G hG (restrictState (into (next (σ (j,η)))) f)
        (hfp (next (σ (j,η)))))
    (H : A →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hH : IsPureState H)
    (hearly : ∃ j, IsPureState (restrictState (into j) H)) :
    PureStateEquivalent H hH f hf := by
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hearly
  obtain ⟨η,hη⟩ := hex j _ hj
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hrG,heG⟩ := treated j η
  let k := next (σ (j,η))
  have hjk : j ≤ k := (hσ (j,η)).trans (hn (σ (j,η)))
  have hup : StateExtensionUnique ((into k).comp (incl hjk)) (list j η) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hu j _ (hlp j η)
  have hsH : IsState (restrictState (into k) H) := isState_restrict (into k) H hH.1
  have hrH : restrictState (incl hjk) (restrictState (into k) H) = list j η := by
    rw [restrictState_comp,hcomp,hη]
  have hHG : restrictState (into k) H = G :=
    hup.of_comp (hinj k) _ _ hsH hG.1 hrH hrG
  exact pure_lifts_equivalent (into k) G (restrictState (into k) f) hG (hfp k)
    heG (hu k _ (hfp k)) H f hH hf hHG rfl

end

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Recursion:2037.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.not_isIsomorphicToCompacts
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Recursion:2037.text:
theorem not_isIsomorphicToCompacts {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A]
    (hA : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℂ A)
    (H : Type v) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] :
    ¬ IsIsomorphicToCompacts A H := by
  rintro ⟨φ, hinj, hrange⟩
  have hone : φ 1 = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H :=
    compacts_representation_map_one φ (fun T hT => (hrange T).mpr hT)
  have hcompact : IsCompactOperator (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H) := by
    rw [← hone]
    exact (hrange (φ 1)).mp ⟨1, rfl⟩
  have : FiniteDimensional ℂ H :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_isCompactOperator_id (𝕜 := ℂ) hcompact
  let F : A →ₗ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    { toFun := φ
      map_add' := map_add φ
      map_smul' := fun c a => map_smul φ c a }
  exact hA (FiniteDimensional.of_injective F hinj)

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Recursion:2055.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.pureHomogeneity_of_equiv
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Recursion:2055.text:
lemma pureHomogeneity_of_equiv {A B : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] [CStarAlgebra B]
    [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B]
    (e : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] B)
    (h : ∀ (f g : A →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f) (hg : IsPureState g),
      PureStateEquivalent f hf g hg)
    (f g : B →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f) (hg : IsPureState g) :
    PureStateEquivalent f hf g hg := by
  have hrf := isPureState_restrict_equiv e f hf
  have hrg := isPureState_restrict_equiv e g hg
  exact pure_lifts_equivalent e.toStarAlgHom _ _ hrf hrg (h _ _ hrf hrg)
    (StateExtensionUnique.of_surjective _ e.surjective _) f g hf hg rfl rfl

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Dependencies:920.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.exists_injective_above
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Dependencies:920.text:
theorem exists_injective_above (c : Cardinal.{u}) (hc : c.IsRegular)
    (f : c.ord.ToType → c.ord.ToType) :
    ∃ s : c.ord.ToType → c.ord.ToType, Function.Injective s ∧ ∀ x, f x ≤ s x := by
  classical
  let F (o : Ordinal.{u}) : Ordinal.{u} :=
    if h : o < c.ord then (f (Ordinal.ToType.mk ⟨o,h⟩) : Ordinal) else 0
  have hF (o : Ordinal.{u}) (ho : o < c.ord) : F o < c.ord := by
    simp only [F,dite_eq_left ho]
    exact (f (Ordinal.ToType.mk ⟨o,ho⟩)).toOrd.property
  let s (x : c.ord.ToType) : c.ord.ToType := Ordinal.ToType.mk
    ⟨ordinalMajorant F (x : Ordinal),ordinalMajorant_lt c hc F hF x.toOrd.property⟩
  refine ⟨s,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg (fun z : c.ord.ToType => (z : Ordinal)) hxy
    have h' : ordinalMajorant F (x : Ordinal) = ordinalMajorant F (y : Ordinal) := by
      simpa only [s,Ordinal.ToType.toOrd,OrderIso.symm_apply_apply] using h
    have he := (ordinalMajorant_strictMono F).injective h'
    exact Ordinal.ToType.mk.symm.injective (Subtype.ext he)
  · intro x
    apply Ordinal.ToType.mk.symm.le_iff_le.mp
    change (f x).toOrd.val ≤ (s x).toOrd.val
    simp only [s,Ordinal.ToType.toOrd,OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]
    have h := le_ordinalMajorant F (x : Ordinal)
    have hFx : F (x : Ordinal) = (f x : Ordinal) := by
      simp only [F, dite_eq_left (show (x : Ordinal) < c.ord from x.toOrd.property)]
      exact congrArg (fun z : c.ord.ToType => (f z : Ordinal))
        (OrderIso.apply_symm_apply Ordinal.ToType.mk x)
    rw [hFx] at h
    exact h

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Recursion:1996.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.liftStarAlgEquiv
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Recursion:1996.text:
def liftStarAlgEquiv : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] ULift.{v} A where
  toFun := ULift.up
  invFun := ULift.down
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  map_star' _ := rfl

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Dependencies:950.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.exists_pair_schedule
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Dependencies:950.text:
theorem exists_pair_schedule (c : Cardinal.{u}) (hc : c.IsRegular) :
    ∃ σ : c.ord.ToType × c.ord.ToType → c.ord.ToType,
      Function.Injective σ ∧ ∀ p, p.1 ≤ σ p := by
  have he : Cardinal.mk (c.ord.ToType × c.ord.ToType) = Cardinal.mk c.ord.ToType := by
    rw [Cardinal.mk_prod,Cardinal.mk_ord_toType,Cardinal.lift_id,Cardinal.mul_eq_self hc.aleph0_le]
  let e : (c.ord.ToType × c.ord.ToType) ≃ c.ord.ToType :=
    Classical.choice (Cardinal.eq.mp he)
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hbound⟩ := exists_injective_above c hc (fun x => (e.symm x).1)
  exact ⟨s ∘ e,hs.comp e.injective,fun p => by simpa using hbound (e p)⟩

end

OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Recursion:1893.name: OAI.NaimarkZFC.ChronologicalStage.limit_eventual_pure
OAI.Analysis.Naimark.Recursion:1893.text:
theorem limit_eventual_pure (f : (limitStage F) →L[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : IsPureState f) :
    ∃ j : constructionCardinal.{0}.ord.ToType,
      IsPureState (restrictState (limitEmbedding F j).map f) := by
  obtain ⟨S,hSc,hS,_,_,_,hp,hu⟩ := (limitHistory F).countable_determination f hf
  obtain ⟨j,hSj⟩ := limit_countable_support_bounded F S hSc hS
  let φ := (limitEmbedding F j).map
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := (limitEmbedding F j).injective
  let : IsClosed (φ.range : Set (limitStage F)) :=
    (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry φ hφ).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
  have hr := pure_restrict_intermediate_subalgebra
    ((limitHistory F).algebra S) φ.range (limit_support_le_range F S j hSj)
    f hf.1 hp hu
  let e : (F.obj j).stage ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] φ.range :=
    StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective (φ.codRestrict φ.range (fun a => ⟨a,rfl⟩))
      ⟨fun a b h => hφ (congrArg Subtype.val h),by
        rintro ⟨a,⟨b,rfl⟩⟩; exact ⟨b,rfl⟩⟩
  exact ⟨j,isPureState_restrict_equiv e (restrictState φ.range.subtype f) hr⟩

theorem alternating_analytic (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ)
    (hM : M.WellFormed) (hw : M.ValidInput w) :
    IsCompact Spatial.box ∧
    Smooth (force ν M w) ∧ Smooth (velocity M w) ∧
    SupportedIn (force ν M w) Spatial.box ∧ SupportedIn (velocity M w) Spatial.box ∧
    Rapid (force ν M w) ∧ Rapid (velocity M w) ∧
    force ν M w = residual ν (velocity M w) ∧
    NavierStokes ν (force ν M w) (velocity M w) (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
    EnergyClass (velocity M w) (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
    (∀ (v : Velocity) (p : Pressure),
      NavierStokes ν (force ν M w) v p → CompetitorEnergyClass v p →
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, v t x = velocity M w t x ∧ p t x = 0) ∧
    ∃ X : Space → ℝ → Space,
      (∀ a, IsTrajectory (velocity M w) a (X a)) ∧
      (∀ a γ, IsTrajectory (velocity M w) a γ → ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → γ t = X a t) ∧
      ((∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ 0 < X observedParticle t 0) ↔ M.Halts w) := by
  obtain ⟨hf, hU, hfs, hUs, hNS, hX⟩ := smooth_forced_simulation ν M hM w hw
  exact ⟨Spatial.box_compact, hf, hU, hfs, hUs, Bounds.force_rapid ν M w,
    Bounds.velocity_rapid M w, rfl, hNS, velocity_energyClass M w,
    velocity_unique ν hν M w, hX⟩

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.rationalVector_error
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma rationalVector_error (q : RationalVector) (v : Space) (k : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, |v i - rationalVector q i| ≤ (tolerance (k+2) : ℝ)) :
    ‖rationalVector q - v‖ ≤ dyadicError k := by
  apply (space_norm_le_sum _).trans
  have hi (i : Fin 3) : |(rationalVector q-v) i| ≤ (tolerance (k+2) : ℝ) := by
    change |rationalVector q i-v i| ≤ _
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact h i
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin 3, |(rationalVector q-v) i|) ≤ 3 * (tolerance (k+2) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, (tolerance (k+2) : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hi i)
      _ = _ := by simp
  apply hsum.trans
  simp only [tolerance_cast, dyadicError, pow_add]
  nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2) k]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
def ProgramFor (c : FieldProgram) (F : Velocity) : Prop :=
  (∀ (l : ℕ) (α : IndexCode) (q : RationalPoint) (k : ℕ),
    ∃ v : RationalVector, Returns c.1 (l, α, q, k) v ∧
      (0 ≤ q.1 →
        ‖rationalVector v - mixed l (index α) F (rationalPoint q).1 (rationalPoint q).2‖
          ≤ dyadicError k)) ∧
  (∀ (l : ℕ) (α : IndexCode) (R k : ℕ),
    ∃ m : ℕ, Returns c.2.1 (l, α, R, k) m ∧
      ∀ z z' : ℝ × Space,
        0 ≤ z.1 → 0 ≤ z'.1 → ‖z‖ ≤ R → ‖z'‖ ≤ R →
        ‖z - z'‖ ≤ dyadicError m →
        ‖mixed l (index α) F z.1 z.2 - mixed l (index α) F z'.1 z'.2‖ ≤ dyadicError k) ∧
  (∀ (J l : ℕ) (α : IndexCode),
    ∃ B : ℕ, Returns c.2.2 (J, l, α) B ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
        (1 + t + ‖x‖) ^ J * ‖mixed l (index α) F t x‖ ≤ B)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Spatial.box_compact
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma box_compact : IsCompact box := by
  apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Space) 9).of_isClosed_subset isClosed_box
  intro x hx
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sqrt_le_iff]
  refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
  calc
    ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖x i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, (3 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hx i) 2
    _ ≤ 9 ^ 2 := by norm_num

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.ComputableReal
OAI.AlternatingNS.residual
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
def residual (ν : ℝ) (u : Velocity) : Velocity :=
  fun t x => dt u t x + advection u t x - ν • laplacian u t x

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.NavierStokes
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
def NavierStokes (ν : ℝ) (f u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  ClassicalRegularity u p ∧
  (∀ x, u 0 x = 0) ∧
  ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x,
    div u t x = 0 ∧
    dt u t x + advection u t x = -grad p t x + ν • laplacian u t x + f t x

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.CompetitorEnergyClass
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
def CompetitorEnergyClass (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  ∀ T, 0 ≤ T →
    ContinuousInH 2 u T ∧ C1InL2 u T ∧ ContinuousInH 1 p T ∧
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ x, ‖u t x‖ ≤ C

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Bounds.HalfEq
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text: def HalfEq (f g : Field F) : Prop := ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, f t x = g t x

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Analytic.dt_eq_full
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma dt_eq_full {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (F : Field E) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F)) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (x : Space) :
    dt F t x = fullDt F t x := by
  unfold dt fullDt
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => F s x) t :=
    ((hF.comp (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const)).differentiable (by simp) t)
  rw [fderivWithin_eq_fderiv (uniqueDiffOn_Ici _ _ ht) hd]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Bounds.force_rapid
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
theorem force_rapid (ν : ℝ) (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ) : Rapid (Construction.force ν M w) := by
  have hf := velocity_rapidJets M w
  have hR : Rapid (fun t x => Analytic.fullDt (Construction.velocity M w) t x +
      advection (Construction.velocity M w) t x - ν • laplacian (Construction.velocity M w) t x) :=
    RapidJets.rapid (f := fun t x => Analytic.fullDt (Construction.velocity M w) t x +
      advection (Construction.velocity M w) t x - ν • laplacian (Construction.velocity M w) t x)
      (hf.fullResidual ν)
  apply Rapid.congr_half hR
  intro t ht x
  simp only [Construction.force, residual]
  rw [Analytic.dt_eq_full _ hf.1 t ht x]

end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.AlternatingConclusion
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
def AlternatingConclusion (ν : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (compileForce compileVelocity : Machine × List ℕ → FieldProgram),
    Computable compileForce ∧ Computable compileVelocity ∧
    ∃ K : Set Space, IsCompact K ∧
      ∀ (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ), M.WellFormed → M.ValidInput w →
        ∃ (f U : Velocity) (X : Space → ℝ → Space),
          ProgramFor (compileForce (M, w)) f ∧
          ProgramFor (compileVelocity (M, w)) U ∧
          Smooth f ∧ Smooth U ∧
          SupportedIn f K ∧ SupportedIn U K ∧ Rapid f ∧ Rapid U ∧
          f = residual ν U ∧
          NavierStokes ν f U (fun _ _ => 0) ∧ EnergyClass U (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
          (∀ (v : Velocity) (p : Pressure),
            NavierStokes ν f v p → CompetitorEnergyClass v p →
            ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, v t x = U t x ∧ p t x = 0) ∧
          (∀ a, IsTrajectory U a (X a)) ∧
          (∀ a γ, IsTrajectory U a γ → ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → γ t = X a t) ∧
          ((∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ 0 < X observedParticle t 0) ↔ M.Halts w)

end
end AlternatingNS

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.alternating
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
theorem alternating (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hc : ComputableReal ν) :
    AlternatingConclusion ν := by
  obtain ⟨cf,hcf,hf⟩ := Effective.Certified.programs
    (Effective.force_certified ν) (Effective.force_named ν hc)
  obtain ⟨cu,hcu,hu⟩ := Effective.Certified.programs
    Effective.velocity_certified Effective.velocity_named
  refine ⟨cf,cu,hcf,hcu,Spatial.box,Spatial.box_compact,?_⟩
  intro M w hM hw
  obtain ⟨_,hfs,hUs,hfk,hUk,hfr,hUr,hr,hNS,hE,huniq,X,hX,hXuniq,hhalt⟩ :=
    Construction.alternating_analytic ν hν M w hM hw
  exact ⟨Construction.force ν M w,Construction.velocity M w,X,
    (hf (M,w)).congr_half (Effective.fullForce_half ν M w),hu (M,w),
    hfs,hUs,hfk,hUk,hfr,hUr,hr,hNS,hE,huniq,hX,hXuniq,hhalt⟩

end AlternatingNS

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.TimeGlue.eq_sum
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma eq_sum {A E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ t, t ≤ 0 → g t = 0) (W : ℕ → A → E)
    (t : ℝ) (x : A) (a : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ a) :
    glue g W t x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range a, g (t - k) • W k x := by
  apply tsum_eq_sum
  intro k hk
  have hk' : a ≤ k := by simpa using hk
  have hka : (a : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk'
  rw [hg _ (by linarith), zero_smul]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.dyadicError

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.SupportedIn

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.modulus_computable
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma modulus_computable (B : A × ℕ × ℕ → ℕ) (hB : Computable B) : Computable₂ (modulus B) := by
  have hl : Computable (fun z : A × ModInput => z.2.1) := Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd
  have hα : Computable (fun z : A × ModInput => z.2.2.1) := Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  have hk : Computable (fun z : A × ModInput => z.2.2.2.2) := Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd))
  exact Primrec.nat_add.to_comp.comp hk (hB.comp (Computable.fst.pair
    ((Computable.const 0).pair (Computable.succ.comp (Computable.list_length.comp
      (mixedWord_computable.comp hl hα))))))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.fullForce_half
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma fullForce_half (ν : ℝ) (M : Machine) (w : List ℕ) :

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.EnergyClass
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
def EnergyClass (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop :=
  CompetitorEnergyClass u p ∧
  ∀ T, 0 ≤ T → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ x,
    ‖u t x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ (u t) x‖ ≤ C

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.IsTrajectory
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
def IsTrajectory (u : Velocity) (a : Space) (γ : ℝ → Space) : Prop :=
  γ 0 = a ∧ ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivWithinAt γ (u t (γ t)) (Set.Ici 0) t

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Construction.smooth_forced_simulation
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
theorem smooth_forced_simulation (ν : ℝ) (M : Machine) (hM : M.WellFormed)
    (w : List ℕ) (hw : M.ValidInput w) :
    Smooth (force ν M w) ∧ Smooth (velocity M w) ∧
    SupportedIn (force ν M w) Spatial.box ∧ SupportedIn (velocity M w) Spatial.box ∧
    NavierStokes ν (force ν M w) (velocity M w) (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
    ∃ X : Space → ℝ → Space,
      (∀ a, IsTrajectory (velocity M w) a (X a)) ∧
      (∀ a γ, IsTrajectory (velocity M w) a γ → ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → γ t = X a t) ∧
      ((∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ 0 < X observedParticle t 0) ↔ M.Halts w) := by
  have hU := velocity_smooth M w
  have hK := Spatial.box_compact
  have hs := velocity_supported M w
  refine ⟨Analytic.residual_smooth ν _ hU, hU.contDiffOn,
    fun t _ => Analytic.residual_supported ν _ _ hK.isClosed hs t,
    fun t _ => hs t,
    Analytic.residual_navierStokes ν _ hU (velocity_rest M w) (velocity_div M w), ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hu⟩ := Analytic.global_material_flow _ hU _ hK hs
  refine ⟨X, hX, hu, ?_⟩
  have he : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → path M w t = X observedParticle t :=
    hu _ _ (path_isTrajectory M hM w hw)
  rw [← path_reachability M w]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ => ⟨t, ht, by rw [he t ht]; exact hp⟩,
    fun ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ => ⟨t, ht, by rw [← he t ht]; exact hp⟩⟩

end Construction

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.Named.computableReal_const
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma Named.computableReal_const {r : ℝ} (hr : ComputableReal r) : Named (fun _ : A => r) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,h⟩ := hr
  have ha' : Computable a := (Arithmetic.rat_mk.to_comp.comp
    (Computable.fst.comp ha) (Computable.snd.comp ha)).of_eq (fun n => by
      simp [Rat.mkRat_eq_div, Rat.num_div_den])
  refine ⟨fun z => a z.2, ha'.comp Computable.snd, fun _ n => ?_⟩
  simpa only [tolerance_cast] using h n

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.values_computable
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma values_computable (b : (((A × Fin 3) × List (Fin 4)) × RationalPoint) × ℕ → ℚ)
    (hb : Computable b) : Computable₂ (values b) :=
  (sample_computable b hb 0).pair ((sample_computable b hb 1).pair (sample_computable b hb 2))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.Certified.programs
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma Certified.programs {f : A → Velocity}
    (hf : Certified (fun a => Function.uncurry (f a)))
    (hn : Named (fun z : (A × Fin 3) × RationalPoint =>
      f z.1.1 (rationalPoint z.2).1 (rationalPoint z.2).2 z.1.2)) :
    ∃ compile : A → FieldProgram, Computable compile ∧ ∀ a, ProgramFor (compile a) (f a) := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbError⟩ := hf.jetBound.named_component_words hn
  obtain ⟨sf,B,hB,hBound⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨ce,hce,he⟩ := compiler_of_computable (values b) (values_computable b hb)
  obtain ⟨cm,hcm,hm⟩ := compiler_of_computable (modulus B) (modulus_computable B hB)
  obtain ⟨cb,hcb,hc⟩ := compiler_of_computable (bound B) (bound_computable B hB)
  refine ⟨fun a => (ce a,cm a,cb a), hce.pair (hcm.pair hcb), fun a => ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩⟩
  · intro l α q k
    refine ⟨values b a (l,α,q,k),?_,fun ht => ?_⟩
    · have hh := he a (l,α,q,k)
      rcases q with ⟨t,x,y,z⟩
      simpa only [Returns, values, Encodable.encode_prod_val, Arithmetic.rationalCoding_encode] using hh
    · rw [mixed_eq_wordJet (f a) (sf a) l α _ (by change 0 ≤ (q.1 : ℝ); exact_mod_cast ht)]
      apply rationalVector_error
      intro i
      have hh := hbError (((a,i),mixedWord l α),q) (k+2)
      have heq : rationalVector (values b a (l,α,q,k)) i = (sample b a (l,α,q,k) i : ℝ) := by
        fin_cases i <;> rfl
      rw [heq]
      exact hh
  · intro l α R k
    refine ⟨modulus B a (l,α,R,k),hm a (l,α,R,k),fun z z' ht ht' _ _ hd => ?_⟩
    rw [mixed_eq_wordJet (f a) (sf a) l α z.1 ht z.2,
      mixed_eq_wordJet (f a) (sf a) l α z'.1 ht' z'.2]
    let C := B (a,0,(mixedWord l α).length+1)
    have hC (y : ℝ × Space) : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (wordJet (Function.uncurry (f a)) (mixedWord l α)) y‖ ≤ C := by
      have hC' : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (1+(mixedWord l α).length) (Function.uncurry (f a)) y‖ ≤ C := by
        rw [Nat.add_comm 1 (mixedWord l α).length]
        simpa only [C, pow_zero, one_mul] using hBound a 0 ((mixedWord l α).length+1) y
      exact (wordJet_bound (sf a) (mixedWord l α) 1 y).trans hC'
    have hLip := jet_lipschitz (wordJet_smooth (sf a) (mixedWord l α)) C hC z z'
    exact hLip.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (Nat.cast_nonneg C)).trans (by
      simpa only [modulus, C, tolerance_cast] using mul_precision C k))
  · intro J l α
    refine ⟨bound B a (J,l,α),hc a (J,l,α),fun t ht x => ?_⟩
    rw [mixed_eq_wordJet (f a) (sf a) l α t ht x]
    have hnorm : ‖wordJet (Function.uncurry (f a)) (mixedWord l α) (t,x)‖ ≤
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (mixedWord l α).length (Function.uncurry (f a)) (t,x)‖ := by
      have hh := wordJet_bound (sf a) (mixedWord l α) 0 (t,x)
      rw [Nat.zero_add] at hh
      simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] using hh
    apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1+t+‖x‖)^J)).trans
    simpa only [bound, weight, abs_of_nonneg ht] using hBound a J (mixedWord l α).length (t,x)

end AlternatingNS.Effective

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.TimeGlue.glue

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.mul_precision
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma mul_precision (C k : ℕ) : (C : ℝ) * (tolerance (k+C) : ℝ) ≤ tolerance k := by
  rw [tolerance_add, mul_left_comm]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (tolerance_pos _).le (nat_mul_tolerance C)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.force_certified
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma force_certified (ν : ℝ) : Certified (fun z : Machine × List ℕ => Function.uncurry (fullForce ν z.1 z.2)) := by
  obtain ⟨D,hD⟩ := exists_nat_ge |ν|
  exact (velocity_certified.fullDt.add velocity_certified.advection).sub (velocity_certified.laplacian.csmul ν D hD)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.velocity_named
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma velocity_named : Named (fun z : ((Machine × List ℕ) × Fin 3) × RationalPoint =>
    Construction.velocity z.1.1.1 z.1.1.2 (rationalPoint z.2).1 (rationalPoint z.2).2 z.1.2) := by
  let P := ((Machine × List ℕ) × Fin 3) × RationalPoint
  have hq : Computable (fun z : P => z.2.1) := Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd
  let N : P → ℕ := fun z => z.2.1.num.natAbs+1
  have hN : Computable N := Computable.succ.comp (Arithmetic.int_abs.to_comp.comp (Arithmetic.rat_num.to_comp.comp hq))
  have hterm : Named (fun z : P × ℕ => Profiles.pulse ((rationalPoint z.1.2).1 - z.2) *
      Construction.piece z.1.1.1.1 z.1.1.1.2 z.2 (rationalPoint z.1.2).2 z.1.1.2) := by
    have hh := pulse_rational_named.comp (Arithmetic.rat_sub.to_comp.comp
      (hq.comp Computable.fst) (Arithmetic.rat_natCast.to_comp.comp Computable.snd))
    have hp := piece_named.comp
      ((((Computable.fst.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst)).pair Computable.snd).pair
        (Computable.snd.comp (Computable.fst.comp Computable.fst))).pair
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.fst))
    exact (hh.mul hp).congr (by intro z; simp [rationalPoint])
  apply (hterm.sum_range N hN).congr
  intro z
  have ht : (rationalPoint z.2).1 ≤ (N z : ℝ) := by
    have hr := le_trans (le_abs_self (z.2.1 : ℝ)) (abs_rat_cast_le_num z.2.1)
    dsimp [N, rationalPoint]; push_cast; linarith
  rw [Construction.velocity, TimeGlue.eq_sum _ Profiles.pulse_zero_left _ _ _ (N z) ht]
  simp [WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.observedParticle
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text: def observedParticle : Space := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![-1, 0, 0]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..name: OAI.AlternatingNS.Effective.bound_computable
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.AlternatingFlow..text:
lemma bound_computable (B : A × ℕ × ℕ → ℕ) (hB : Computable B) : Computable₂ (bound B) := by
  have hJ : Computable (fun z : A × BoundInput => z.2.1) := Computable.fst.comp Computable.snd
  have hl : Computable (fun z : A × BoundInput => z.2.2.1) := Computable.fst.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  have hα : Computable (fun z : A × BoundInput => z.2.2.2) := Computable.snd.comp (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)
  exact hB.comp (Computable.fst.pair (hJ.pair
    (Computable.list_length.comp (mixedWord_computable.comp hl hα))))

    mixed l (index α) f t x = wordJet (Function.uncurry f) (mixedWord l α) (t,x) := by
  have h := wordJet_dt (spatial (index α) f) (Analytic.spatial_smooth f hf _) l t ht x

  simpa only [mixedWord, wordJet_append, mixed] using h

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.name: OAI.VelocityDetection.TorusClass.ComparisonClass
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.text:
structure ComparisonClass (u : VectorField 3) (p : ScalarField 3) : Prop where
  velocity_slices : ∀ t ≥ 0, ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x => u t x i)
  pressure_slices : ∀ t ≥ 0, ContDiff ℝ 1 (p t)
  velocity_periodic : ∀ t ≥ 0, FactorsThrough (u t) PeriodicSpace.cover
  pressure_periodic : ∀ t ≥ 0, periodic (p t)
  pressure_mean : ∀ t ≥ 0, (∫ x, p t x ∂measure) = 0
  time_derivative : ∀ t ≥ 0, ∀ x i,
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => u s x i) (dt u t x i) (Ici 0) t
  velocity_continuous : ∀ T > 0, ∀ i,
    ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ × Space => u y.1 y.2 i) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)
  time_continuous : ∀ T > 0, ∀ i,
    ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ × Space => dt u y.1 y.2 i) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)
  gradient_continuous : ∀ T > 0, ∀ i k,
    ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ × Space => D k (fun x => u y.1 x i) y.2) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)
  second_continuous : ∀ T > 0, ∀ i k l,
    ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ × Space => D l (D k (fun x => u y.1 x i)) y.2) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)
  pressure_continuous : ∀ T > 0,
    ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ × Space => p y.1 y.2) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)
  pressure_gradient_continuous : ∀ T > 0, ∀ i,
    ContinuousOn (fun y : ℝ × Space => D i (p y.1) y.2) (Icc 0 T ×ˢ univ)

    FactorsThrough (total F t) PeriodicSpace.cover := by
  intro X Y hXY
  exact tsum_congr (fun k => hp k t hXY)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.name: OAI.VelocityDetection.NavierStokes
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.text:
def NavierStokes (ν : ℝ) (u : VectorField 3) (p : ScalarField 3)
    (f : VectorField 3) : Prop :=
  (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x : Coord 3, ∀ i : Fin 3,
    timeD (fun s y => u s y i) t x + advection u (fun s y => u s y i) t x =
      -spatialD i p t x + ν * laplacian (fun s y => u s y i) t x + f t x i) ∧
  (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → ∀ x, divergence u t x = 0) ∧
  (∀ x, u 0 x = 0)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.name: OAI.VelocityDetection.MachineCylinder.analytic_result
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.text:
theorem analytic_result (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (M : TM0.Machine (Fin b) (Fin N)) (w : List (Fin b)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (uncurry (force ν M w)) ∧
    UniformDerivatives.Bounded (fun _ : Unit => uncurry (force ν M w)) ∧
    (∀ t X z, force ν M w t (update X 2 z) = force ν M w t X) ∧
    (∀ T : ℝ, ∃ K : Set (Coord 2), IsCompact K ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      ∀ X : Coord 3, horizontal X ∉ K → force ν M w t X = 0) ∧
    ∃ u : VectorField 3,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (uncurry u) ∧
      Cylinder.ComparisonClass (fun t x => u t (Cylinder.join x)) (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
      NavierStokes ν u (fun _ _ => 0) (force ν M w) ∧
      (∀ t ≥ 0, (∀ x, 0 ≤ u t (Cylinder.join x) 2) ∧
        Integrable (fun x => u t (Cylinder.join x) 2) Cylinder.measure) ∧
      (Observation.planeEvent u ↔ (TM0.eval M w).Dom) ∧
      (∀ (v : VectorField 3) (q : ScalarField 3),
        Cylinder.ComparisonClass (fun t x => v t (Cylinder.join x))
          (fun t x => q t (Cylinder.join x)) →
        NavierStokes ν v q (force ν M w) →
        ∀ t ≥ 0, (∀ x, v t x = u t x) ∧ (∀ x, q t x = 0)) :=
  ⟨contDiff_force ν hν M w, bounded_force ν hν M w, force_vertical_independent ν M w,
    force_support ν hν M w, velocity ν hν M w, contDiff_velocity ν hν M w,
    comparisonClass ν hν M w, navierStokes ν hν M w, third_component ν hν M w,
    detection ν hν M w, fun _ _ => unique ν hν M w⟩

end VelocityDetection.MachineCylinder

    1 / ((32 : ℕ) : ℝ) < x 1 ∧ x 1 < 1 / ((8 : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ (1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) < u t x 2

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.name: OAI.VelocityDetection.main_result
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.text:
theorem main_result :
    ∃ B : ℕ, 0 < B ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, |deriv (deriv SmoothBump.profile) s| ≤ (B:ℝ)) ∧
    ∀ (ν : ℝ), 0 < ν → ComputableReal ν →
    ∀ (b N : ℕ) [NeZero b] [NeZero N]
      (M : TM0.Machine (Fin b) (Fin N)) (w : List (Fin b)),
    ∃ (Ftor Fcyl : ℝ → VectorField 3),
      (compile B M w).Represents .torus Ftor ∧
      (compile B M w).Represents .cylinder Fcyl ∧
      (ContDiff ℝ ∞ (uncurry (Ftor ν)) ∧
        (∀ t, FactorsThrough (Ftor ν t) PeriodicSpace.cover) ∧
        (∃ K : Set (Coord 2), IsCompact K ∧ (∀ X ∈ K, ∀ i, X i ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
          ∀ t X, PeriodicSpace.cover (horizontal X) ∉ PeriodicSpace.cover '' K → Ftor ν t X = 0) ∧
        (∀ T d, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ X,
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ d (uncurry (Ftor ν)) (t,X)‖ ≤ C) ∧
        ∃ u : VectorField 3,
          ContDiff ℝ ∞ (uncurry u) ∧ TorusClass.ComparisonClass u (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
          NavierStokes ν u (fun _ _ => 0) (Ftor ν) ∧
          (Observation.torusEvent u ↔ (TM0.eval M w).Dom) ∧
          ∀ (v : VectorField 3) (p : ScalarField 3), TorusClass.ComparisonClass v p →
            NavierStokes ν v p (Ftor ν) →
            ∀ t ≥ 0, (∀ X, v t X = u t X) ∧ (∀ X, p t X = 0)) ∧
      (ContDiff ℝ ∞ (uncurry (Fcyl ν)) ∧
        UniformDerivatives.Bounded (fun _ : Unit => uncurry (Fcyl ν)) ∧
        (∀ t X z, Fcyl ν t (update X 2 z) = Fcyl ν t X) ∧
        (∀ T : ℝ, ∃ K : Set (Coord 2), IsCompact K ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) T,
          ∀ X : Coord 3, horizontal X ∉ K → Fcyl ν t X = 0) ∧
        ∃ u : VectorField 3,
          ContDiff ℝ ∞ (uncurry u) ∧
          Cylinder.ComparisonClass (fun t x => u t (Cylinder.join x)) (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
          NavierStokes ν u (fun _ _ => 0) (Fcyl ν) ∧
          (∀ t ≥ 0, (∀ x, 0 ≤ u t (Cylinder.join x) 2) ∧
            Integrable (fun x => u t (Cylinder.join x) 2) Cylinder.measure) ∧
          (Observation.planeEvent u ↔ (TM0.eval M w).Dom) ∧
          ∀ (v : VectorField 3) (p : ScalarField 3),
            Cylinder.ComparisonClass (fun t x => v t (Cylinder.join x))
              (fun t x => p t (Cylinder.join x)) →
            NavierStokes ν v p (Fcyl ν) →
            ∀ t ≥ 0, (∀ X, v t X = u t X) ∧ (∀ X, p t X = 0)) := by
  refine ⟨SmoothBump.bound,SmoothBump.bound_pos,SmoothBump.second_bound,?_⟩
  intro ν hν _hcomputable b N _ _ M w
  exact ⟨(fun μ => MachineTorus.force μ M w), (fun μ => MachineCylinder.force μ M w),
    Program.compile_represents .torus M w, Program.compile_represents .cylinder M w,
    MachineTorus.analytic_result ν hν M w, MachineCylinder.analytic_result ν hν M w⟩

end VelocityDetection
end

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.name: OAI.VelocityDetection.Effective.MachineRecipe.Program.compile_represents
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.text:
theorem compile_represents (d : Domain) (M : TM0.Machine (Fin b) (Fin N))
    (w : List (Fin b)) :
    (compile SmoothBump.bound M w).Represents d (fun ν => analyticForce d ν M w) := by
  constructor
  · intro i is q x hq hν ε hε
    constructor
    · apply Nat.rfindOpt_dom.mpr
      obtain ⟨k,r,hr⟩ := runTrial_terminates d M w i is hq hν hε
      exact ⟨k,r,hr⟩
    · intro r hr
      obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := Nat.rfindOpt_spec hr
      exact runTrial_correct d M w i is hq hν ε k hk
  · intro i is Q hQ
    constructor
    · apply Nat.rfindOpt_dom.mpr
      obtain ⟨k,C,hC⟩ := runBoundTrial_terminates d M w i is Q hQ
      exact ⟨k,C,hC⟩
    · intro C hC
      obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := Nat.rfindOpt_spec hC
      exact runBoundTrial_correct d M w i is Q hQ k hk

end VelocityDetection.Effective.MachineRecipe.Program
end

def Represents (P : Program b N) (d : Domain) (F : ℝ → VectorField 3) : Prop :=
  letI := neZeroFive
  (∀ (i : Fin 3) (is : List (Fin 5)) (q : Fin 5 → ℕ → ℚ) (x : Fin 5 → ℝ),
    Names q x → 0 < x 0 → ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε →
      (P.evaluate d i is q ε).Dom ∧
      ∀ r ∈ P.evaluate d i is q ε,
        |mixedD is (forceFunction F i) x-(r:ℝ)| ≤ (ε:ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ (i : Fin 3) (is : List (Fin 5)) (Q : RationalBox 5), 0 < Q.lower 0 →
    (P.derivativeBounds d i is Q).Dom ∧
    ∀ C ∈ P.derivativeBounds d i is Q, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Q.carrier, |mixedD is (forceFunction F i) x| ≤ (C:ℝ))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.name: OAI.VelocityDetection.Effective.MachineRecipe.runTrial_correct

theorem runTrial_correct (d : Domain) (M : TM0.Machine (Fin b) (Fin N))
    (w : List (Fin b)) (i : Fin 3) (is : List (Fin 5))
    {q : Fin 5 → ℕ → ℚ} {x : Fin 5 → ℝ} (hq : Names q x) (hν : 0 < x 0)
    (ε : ℚ) (k : ℕ) {r : ℚ} (hr : runTrial d SmoothBump.bound M w i is q ε k = some r) :
    |mixedD is (forceFunction (fun ν => analyticForce d ν M w) i) x-(r:ℝ)| ≤ (ε:ℝ) := by
  have hg := cutoffs_good d hq hν
  rw [← mixedD_congr (force_germ d _ _ M w hg i) is]
  exact trial_correct _ is hq (valid_force d _ _ M w hν i) ε k hr

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.name: OAI.VelocityDetection.Effective.MachineRecipe.runBoundTrial_correct
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.text:
theorem runBoundTrial_correct (d : Domain) (M : TM0.Machine (Fin b) (Fin N))
    (w : List (Fin b)) (i : Fin 3) (is : List (Fin 5)) (Q : RationalBox 5) (hQ : 0 < Q.lower 0)
    (k : ℕ) {C : ℚ} (h : runBoundTrial d SmoothBump.bound M w i is Q k = some C) :
    0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q.carrier,
      |mixedD is (forceFunction (fun ν => analyticForce d ν M w) i) x| ≤ (C:ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨hC,hbound⟩ := Q.boundTrial_correct _ is k h
  refine ⟨hC,fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hg := box_good d Q hQ hx
  rw [← mixedD_congr (force_germ d _ _ M w hg i) is]
  exact hbound x hx (valid_force d _ _ M w hg.1 i)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.name: OAI.VelocityDetection.MachineTorus.analytic_result
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.NavierStokes.Vel.text:
theorem analytic_result (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (M : TM0.Machine (Fin b) (Fin N)) (w : List (Fin b)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (uncurry (force ν M w)) ∧
    (∀ t, FactorsThrough (force ν M w t) PeriodicSpace.cover) ∧
    (∃ K : Set (Coord 2), IsCompact K ∧ (∀ X ∈ K, ∀ i, X i ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
      ∀ t X, PeriodicSpace.cover (horizontal X) ∉ PeriodicSpace.cover '' K → force ν M w t X = 0) ∧
    (∀ T d, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) T, ∀ X,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ d (uncurry (force ν M w)) (t,X)‖ ≤ C) ∧
    ∃ u : VectorField 3,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (uncurry u) ∧ TorusClass.ComparisonClass u (fun _ _ => 0) ∧
      NavierStokes ν u (fun _ _ => 0) (force ν M w) ∧
      (Observation.torusEvent u ↔ (TM0.eval M w).Dom) ∧
      ∀ (v : VectorField 3) (p : ScalarField 3), TorusClass.ComparisonClass v p →
        NavierStokes ν v p (force ν M w) →
        ∀ t ≥ 0, (∀ X, v t X = u t X) ∧ (∀ X, p t X = 0) :=
  ⟨contDiff_force ν hν M w, force_periodic ν hν M w,
    ⟨chartSet,compact_chartSet,fun _ h => chartSet_interior h,force_support ν M w⟩,
    bounded_force ν hν M w, velocity ν hν M w, contDiff_velocity ν hν M w,
    comparisonClass ν hν M w,navierStokes ν hν M w,detection ν hν M w,
    fun _ _ => unique ν hν M w⟩

end VelocityDetection.MachineTorus

OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.Eigenfunctions:.name: OAI.SharpNodal.Geometry.exists_normalized_eigen
OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.Eigenfunctions:.text:
lemma exists_normalized_eigen [CompactSpace M] {u : M → ℝ}
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ,Plane) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ u) (hne : u≠0) {K : ℝ}
    (heq : ∀x,-laplaceBeltrami u x=K^2*u x) :
    ∃v : M → ℝ,NormalizedEigen K v ∧ nodalSet v=nodalSet u := by
  have hsome : ∃x,u x≠0:=by
    by_contra hn; push Not at hn; apply hne; funext x; exact hn x
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩:=hsome
  let : Nonempty M:=⟨z⟩
  obtain ⟨x,-,hmax⟩:=isCompact_univ.exists_isMaxOn (Set.univ_nonempty) hu.continuous.abs.continuousOn
  let m:=|u x|
  have hm : 0 < m :=(abs_pos.mpr hz).trans_le (hmax (mem_univ z))
  let v:=fun y=>m⁻¹*u y
  have hv : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ,Plane) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ v:=contMDiff_const.mul hu
  refine ⟨v,⟨hv,?_,?_,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · intro y
    rw [laplaceBeltrami_const_mul hu]
    dsimp [v]
    rw [←mul_neg,heq y]
    ring
  · intro y
    dsimp [v]
    rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hm)]
    exact (inv_mul_le_iff₀ hm).mpr (by simpa only [mul_one] using (show |u y| ≤ m from hmax (mem_univ y)))
  · refine ⟨x,?_⟩
    dsimp [v]
    rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hm)]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hm.ne'
  · ext y
    simp only [nodalSet,mem_ofPred_eq,v,mul_eq_zero,inv_eq_zero,hm.ne',false_or]
end SharpNodal.Geometry

open scoped Topology ContDiff
open Set Filter Metric MeasureTheory

OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.Eigenfunctions:.name: OAI.SharpNodal.Geometry.laplaceBeltrami_const_mul
OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.Eigenfunctions:.text:
lemma laplaceBeltrami_const_mul {u : M → ℝ}
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ,Plane) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ u) (c : ℝ) (x : M) :
    laplaceBeltrami (fun z=>c*u z) x=c*laplaceBeltrami u x := by
  obtain ⟨e,hx,he⟩:=exists_isothermal_chart x
  have ht:=e.map_source hx
  have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u∘e.symm) e.target:=(hu.comp_contMDiffOn he.1.2).contDiffOn
  obtain ⟨f,r,hf,hr,-,heq⟩:=smooth_extension_near e.open_target ht hs
  have hg : f=ᶠ[𝓝 (e x)]u∘e.symm:=Eventually.mono (ball_mem_nhds _ hr) (fun z hz=>heq z hz)
  have hcg : (fun z=>c*f z)=ᶠ[𝓝 (e x)](fun z=>c*u (e.symm z)):=by filter_upwards [hg] with z hz; rw [hz]; rfl
  have hc : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ,Plane) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ (fun z=>c*u z) := contMDiff_const.mul hu
  rw [←e.left_inv hx,he.laplace hc ht,he.laplace hu ht]
  change euclideanLaplacian (fun z=>c*u (e.symm z)) (e x)/conformalFactor e (e x)=_
  rw [←laplacian_germ hcg,laplacian_const_mul hf]
  dsimp only
  rw [laplacian_germ hg]
  ring

OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.Eigenfunctions:.name: OAI.SharpNodal.Geometry.NormalizedEigen
OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.Eigenfunctions:.text:
structure NormalizedEigen (K : ℝ) (u : M → ℝ) : Prop where
  smooth : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ,Plane) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ u
  equation : ∀x,-laplaceBeltrami u x=K^2*u x
  bound : ∀x,|u x|≤1
  maximum : ∃x,|u x|=1

variable [CompactSpace M] [ConnectedSpace M]

OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.CompactCover:44.name: OAI.SharpNodal.Geometry.exists_normalized_global_length
OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.CompactCover:44.text:
lemma exists_normalized_global_length : ∃C : ℝ,0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀K : ℝ,0 < K → ∀u : M → ℝ,NormalizedEigen K u →
      Measure.hausdorffMeasure 1 (nodalSet u) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*K) := by
  choose G hG hx B hB hb using (exists_normalized_local_length (M:=M))
  have hcover : (univ : Set M)⊆⋃x,G x:=fun x _=>mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x,hx x⟩
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩:=isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover G hG hcover
  refine ⟨∑x∈t,B x,Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _=>hB x),?_⟩
  intro K hK u hu
  have hz : nodalSet u⊆⋃x∈t,{z | z∈G x ∧ u z=0} := by
    intro z hzu
    obtain ⟨x,hxt,hzx⟩:=mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (mem_univ z))
    exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨x,hxt,hzx,hzu⟩
  apply (measure_mono hz).trans ((measure_biUnion_finset_le t _).trans ((Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _=>hb x K hK u hu)).trans _))
  rw [←ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun x _=>mul_nonneg (hB x) hK.le),Finset.sum_mul]
end SharpNodal.Geometry

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.Main:377.name: OAI.SharpNodal.Main
OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.Main:377.text:
theorem Main [CompactSpace M] [ConnectedSpace M]
    [IsContMDiffRiemannianBundle 𝓘(ℝ,Plane) ∞ Plane
      (fun x:M=>TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ,Plane) x)]
    [IsRiemannianManifold 𝓘(ℝ,Plane) M] : MainStatement M := by
  let : MeasurableSpace M:=borel M
  let : BorelSpace M:=⟨rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩:=Geometry.exists_normalized_global_length (M:=M)
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam u hu hne heq
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hZ⟩:=Geometry.exists_normalized_eigen (K:=Real.sqrt lam) hu hne
    (fun x=>by simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt hlam.le] using heq x)
  change Measure.hausdorffMeasure 1 (nodalSet u) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*Real.sqrt lam)
  rw [←hZ]
  exact hbound (Real.sqrt lam) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hlam) v hv
end SharpNodal

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.CompactCover:37.name: OAI.SharpNodal.Geometry.exists_normalized_local_length
OAI.Analysis.NodalLength.CompactCover:37.text:
lemma exists_normalized_local_length (x : M) :
    ∃G : Set M,IsOpen G ∧ x∈G ∧ ∃B : ℝ,0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀K : ℝ,0 < K → ∀u : M → ℝ,NormalizedEigen K u →
        Measure.hausdorffMeasure 1 {z | z∈G ∧ u z=0} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (B*K) := by
  obtain ⟨e,hxe,he⟩:=exists_isothermal_chart x
  let y:=e x
  obtain ⟨R,Cp,hR,hCp,hclose,hvol,hp,hpd⟩:=he.exists_profile_ball (e.map_source hxe)
  have hball : ball y R⊆e.target:=ball_subset_closedBall.trans hclose
  let s:=min (R/2000) (1/2)
  have hs : 0 < s:=lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1:=(min_le_right _ _).trans (by norm_num)
  have hsR : 1000*s < R:=by
    have hh:=min_le_left (R/2000) (1/2)
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨k₀,hk₀,hkgap⟩:=normalized_frequency_gap (M:=M)
  obtain ⟨Cinit,hCinit⟩:=he.uniform_chart_wave hCp hs hs1 hsR hk₀ hball hvol hp hpd
  obtain ⟨a₀,B,ha₀,haT,hB,hBlen⟩:=uniform_plane_length hCp (mul_pos hs hk₀) Cinit
  let G:=e.source∩e ⁻¹' ball y (s/4)
  let C:=2*(Cp+1)*s*B*s
  refine ⟨G,e.isOpen_inter_preimage isOpen_ball,⟨hxe,mem_ball_self (by positivity)⟩,C,by dsimp [C]; positivity,?_⟩
  intro K hK u hu
  obtain ⟨D,hDU,hDK,hDinit,hDnonzero⟩:=hCinit K (hkgap K hK u hu) u hu a₀
    (haT.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hkgap K hK u hu) hs.le))
  have hlen:=hBlen D hDinit hDnonzero
  rw [hDK] at hlen
  let F:=rescaleMap y s
  let Z:={z : Plane | z∈ball (0:Plane) (1/4) ∧ D.U z=0}
  have hF : MapsTo F (ball (0:Plane) (1/4)) (ball y R) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball,dist_eq_norm]
    change ‖y+s • z-y‖ < R
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hs]
    have hh:=mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz
    nlinarith
  have hpre : {z | z∈G ∧ u z=0}⊆((e.symm : Plane → M)∘F) '' Z := by
    intro a ha
    let z:=s⁻¹ • (e a-y)
    have hz : z∈ball (0:Plane) (1/4) := by
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
      dsimp [z]
      rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs)]
      have hh:=ha.1.2
      rw [mem_preimage,mem_ball,dist_eq_norm] at hh
      exact (inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hs).mpr (by nlinarith)
    have hFz : F z=e a:=by simp [F,z,rescaleMap,smul_smul,hs.ne']
    have hez : e.symm (F z)=a:=by rw [hFz,e.left_inv ha.1.1]
    refine ⟨z,⟨hz,?_⟩,hez⟩
    rw [hDU]
    change u (e.symm (F z))=0
    simpa only [hez] using ha.2
  have hLip:=(he.lipschitzOn_symm hball hCp hp).comp
    (rescaleMap_lipschitz y hs.le).lipschitzOnWith hF
  have hLZ:=hLip.mono (show Z⊆ball (0:Plane) (1/4) from fun z hz=>hz.1)
  have himage:=hLZ.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (d:=1) (by norm_num)
  rw [ENNReal.rpow_one] at himage
  let L : ℝ≥0 := ⟨2*(Cp+1),by positivity⟩
  have hconst : ((L*s.toNNReal : ℝ≥0):ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal (2*(Cp+1)*s) := by
    rw [ENNReal.coe_mul,ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_eq_coe_nnreal (by positivity)).symm
  rw [hconst] at himage
  apply (measure_mono hpre).trans (himage.trans ((mul_le_mul' le_rfl hlen).trans _))
  rw [←ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  exact le_of_eq (by dsimp [C]; ring)

theorem subquadratic_memory : SubquadraticMemory.{u} := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, d₁, hfixed⟩ := fixed_quadratic_memory (1 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  intro M hM
  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hM.eventuallyLE
  refine ⟨max d₁ (max d₂ 1), ?_⟩
  intro d hd T ε hε hε10 Ω _ ρ hρ L hL hs
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  have hmem : (M d : ℝ) ≤ 1 * (d : ℝ)^2 := by
    have hm := hd₂ d (by omega)
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (M d) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M d),
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (d : ℝ)), one_mul] using hm
  apply hfixed d (by omega) (M d) T hmem ε hε hε10 Ω ρ hρ L hL
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · exact hs
  · exact L.uniformSuccess_of_pointwise ρ hL (by omega) ε hs

OAI.Probability.GaussianRegression.Main:.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.fixed_quadratic_memory
OAI.Probability.GaussianRegression.Main:.text:
theorem fixed_quadratic_memory : FixedQuadraticMemory.{u} := by
  intro A hA
  refine ⟨1/(4*(400000+100*A)), by positivity, 32, ?_⟩
  intro d hd M T hM ε hε hε10 Ω _ ρ hρ L hL hs
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  have hT : d ≤ 4*T := by
    by_contra h
    have hb := hs.trans (L.linear_success_bound ρ (by omega) (by omega) hε10 hL)
    have hr := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hb
    norm_num [ENNReal.toReal_div] at hr
  let q := (d-1)/4
  let a := 2*q
  have hq : 2 ≤ q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hqa : 2*q ≤ a := le_rfl
  have ha : 2*a ≤ d-1 := by dsimp [a, q]; omega
  have hdq : d ≤ 8*q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hda : d ≤ 4*a := by dsimp [a]; omega
  exact precision_from_stream_bound hd hT (by omega) hdq hda hM hA hε (by linarith)
    (L.streaming_success_bound_real ρ hL (by omega) hε ha hq hqa hs)

OAI.Probability.GaussianRegression.Preci.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.precision_from_stream_bound
OAI.Probability.GaussianRegression.Preci.text:
lemma precision_from_stream_bound {d M T a q : ℕ} {ε A : ℝ}
    (hd : 32 ≤ d) (hT : d ≤ 4*T) (hq : 0 < q) (hdq : d ≤ 8*q)
    (ha : d ≤ 4*a) (hM : (M : ℝ) ≤ A * (d : ℝ)^2) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hbound : (2/3 : ℝ) ≤ ((T : ℝ)+1) * ((3 : ℝ)*4^d * ε^a) *
      ((32768 : ℝ)^d * ((2 : ℝ)^M)^(1/(q : ℝ)))^(T/q+1)) :
    (1 / (4*(400000+100*A))) * (d : ℝ) * Real.log (1/ε) ≤ (T : ℝ) := by
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < d)
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hT0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T := Nat.cast_nonneg T
  have hdp : (d : ℝ) ≤ 4*T := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hdqp : (d : ℝ) ≤ 8*q := by exact_mod_cast hdq
  have hap : (d : ℝ) ≤ 4*a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hB : ((T/q+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * d ≤ 12*T := by
    have hbd : (T/q+1)*d ≤ 12*T := by
      have hmul := Nat.div_mul_le_self T q
      calc
        (T/q+1)*d = (T/q)*d+d := by ring
        _ ≤ (T/q)*(8*q)+d := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hdq) _
        _ = 8*((T/q)*q)+d := by ring
        _ ≤ 8*T+d := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 8 hmul) _
        _ ≤ 12*T := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hbd
  have hMq : (M : ℝ) / q ≤ 8*A*d := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hq0).2
    calc
      (M : ℝ) ≤ A*d^2 := hM
      _ ≤ A*d*(8*q) := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdqp (by positivity : 0 ≤ A*d)]
      _ = 8*A*d*q := by ring
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2/3) hbound
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
    Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
    Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
    Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
    Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow,
    Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow,
    Real.log_rpow (by positivity), Real.log_pow] at hlog
  have hlogε : Real.log (1/ε) = -Real.log ε := by simp
  have hlogε0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1/ε) := Real.log_nonneg ((le_div_iff₀ hε).2 (by simpa using hε1))
  have heq : (1/(q : ℝ)) * ((M : ℝ)*Real.log 2) = ((M : ℝ)/q)*Real.log 2 := by ring
  rw [heq] at hlog
  have hlT : Real.log ((T : ℝ)+1) ≤ T := by
    simpa using Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < T+1)
  have hl3 : Real.log (3 : ℝ) ≤ 3 := Real.log_le_self (by norm_num)
  have hl4 : Real.log (4 : ℝ) ≤ 4 := Real.log_le_self (by norm_num)
  have hl32 : Real.log (32768 : ℝ) ≤ 32768 := Real.log_le_self (by norm_num)
  have hl2 : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    convert Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) using 1; norm_num
  have hl23 : -(1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (2/3 : ℝ) := by
    have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2/3)
    norm_num at h
    linarith
  have hinside : (d : ℝ)*Real.log 32768 + ((M : ℝ)/q)*Real.log 2 ≤
      (32768+8*A)*d := by
    have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ)/q := by positivity
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl32 hd0.le
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl2 hm0
    nlinarith
  have hfull : ((T/q+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      ((d : ℝ)*Real.log 32768 + ((M : ℝ)/q)*Real.log 2) ≤
      12*T*(32768+8*A) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ((T/q+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((32768+8*A)*d) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinside (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = (32768+8*A)*(((T/q+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*d) := by ring
      _ ≤ (32768+8*A)*(12*T) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hd4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 4 ≤ d)
  have hlogbound : (a : ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε) ≤ (400000+100*A)*T := by
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl4 hd0.le
    rw [hlogε]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hA.le hT0]
  have hmain : (d : ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε) ≤ 4*(400000+100*A)*T := by
    have ham := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hap hlogε0
    linarith
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 4*(400000+100*A) := by positivity
  calc
    _ = ((d : ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε))/(4*(400000+100*A)) := by ring
    _ ≤ T := (div_le_iff₀ hden).2 (by nlinarith [hmain])

end NoiselessRegression

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.Kazhdan:3.text:
theorem exists_aperiodic_integral_rep :
    ∃ π : FiniteUnitaryRep.{0,0} IntegralGroup, π.Irreducible ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → ¬ π.Equivalent (π.pull (integralTheta ^ j))) := by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, T, hT⟩ := FiniteUnitaryRep.exists_irreducible augmentationRep
  refine ⟨π, hπ, fun j hj he => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := he
  have hkill (v : IntegralVector3) (x : π) :
      π.action ((integralTheta ^ j) (integralTranslation v)) x = x := by
    apply T.injective
    rw [hT, augmentation_pull_translation j hj]
    rfl
  have hfix (x : π) (v : IntegralVector3) : π.action (integralTranslation v) x = x := by
    apply U.injective
    rw [hU]
    change π.action ((integralTheta ^ j) (integralTranslation v)) (U x) = U x
    exact hkill v (U x)
  have hall (x : π) : x = 0 := by
    apply T.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    apply augmentation_no_translation_invariants
    intro v
    rw [← hT, hfix]
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : π)
  exact hx (hall x)

end NuclearUltrapower.Elementary

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.GroupObst.name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.fullGroup_no_nuclear_ultrapower
OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.GroupObst.text:
theorem fullGroup_no_nuclear_ultrapower (hB : IsNuclear.{0,0} B)
    (ω : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : IsFree ω) :
    ¬ ∃ φ : FullGroupModel.Full Δ →⋆ₐ[ℂ] NormUltrapower B ω,
      Function.Injective φ := by
  classical
  rintro ⟨φ,hφ⟩
  let ρ := universalGNS (A := B)
  have hρ : Function.Injective ρ := universalGNS_injective
  let : Nontrivial (UniversalGNS B) := faithful_hilbert_nontrivial ρ hρ
  let ι := FullGroupModel.inclusion Δ
  let φu : FullGroupModel.Full Δ →⋆* NormUltrapower B ω :=
    { φ.toMonoidHom with map_star' := map_star φ }
  let r : Δ →* unitary (NormUltrapower B ω) :=
    (Unitary.map φu).toMonoidHom.comp ι
  obtain ⟨u,hu1,hu,hmul⟩ := exists_unitary_lifts ω r
  have hmul' (g h : Δ) : Tendsto
      (fun n => ‖(u (g*h) n : B) - (u g n : B)*(u h n : B)‖)
        (ω : Filter ℕ) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [norm_sub_rev, norm_zero] using (hmul g h).norm
  let φ' := (normUltraToCStar B ω).comp φ
  have hφ' : Function.Injective φ' := (normUltraToCStar_injective B ω).comp hφ
  let σ := injectiveInduced f hf π
  let ψ := FullGroupModel.modelMap Δ
    (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom.comp σ)
  have hψ (g : Γ) : ψ (ι (f g)) = (σ (f g) : InjectiveInducedSpace f π →L[ℂ] _) := by
    exact FullGroupModel.modelMap_generator Δ _ (f g)
  have hu' (g : Γ) : φ' (ι (f g)) = VariableUltra.mk (fun _ : ℕ => B) ω
      (VariableUltra.unitarySequence (fun _ : ℕ => B) (u (f g))) := by
    have h := congrArg (normUltraToCStar B ω) (hu (f g))
    have hr (d : Δ) : (r d : NormUltrapower B ω) = φ (ι d) := rfl
    rw [hr] at h
    simpa only [normUltraToCStar_mk, boundedSeqToLp_unitary, φ',
      StarAlgHom.comp_apply] using h.symm
  obtain ⟨z,hz0,hz⟩ := injectiveInduced_invariant_tensor f hf π
  let a : ℝ := min (κ/2) (κ^2 / (8 * (S.card : ℝ)))
  have hcard : 0 < (S.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hSne
  have ha0 : 0 < a := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have ha : a < κ := (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
  have ha' : a < κ^2 / (4 * (S.card : ℝ)) := by
    have hk2 : 0 < κ^2 := sq_pos_of_pos hκ0
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by
      apply div_lt_div_of_pos_left hk2 (by positivity)
      linarith)
  have hm := initial_match ρ hρ S ω φ' hφ' (fun g => (ι (f g) : FullGroupModel.Full Δ))
    (fun g => u (f g)) hu' ψ (fun g => σ (f g)) hψ π.dual a ha0
    (ha.le.trans hκ) z hz0 (fun s _ => hz s)
  exact contradiction_of_initial_match ρ f θ hθ t S u ω κ a hB hSne hκ0 hκ hgap hS
    ha ha0 ha' ht (fun n => by simpa only [Finset.coe_singleton] using hω {n}) hu1 hmul'
    π.dual hirr.dual (FiniteUnitaryRep.dual_aperiodic θ haper) hm
end Obstruction
end NuclearUltrapower

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.Kazhdan:6.name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.Elementary.kazhdanSet_generates
OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.Kazhdan:6.text:
theorem kazhdanSet_generates : Subgroup.closure (kazhdanSet : Set IntegralGroup) = ⊤ := by
  classical
  let K := Subgroup.closure (kazhdanSet : Set IntegralGroup)
  have hlin : ∀ M : E, linearInclusion M ∈ K := by
    have he : (eGenSet : Set E) ⊆ K.comap linearInclusion := by
      intro M hM
      exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Finset.mem_union_left _
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨M,hM,rfl⟩))
    have hc := (Subgroup.closure_le (K.comap linearInclusion)).mpr he
    rw [eSet_generates] at hc
    exact fun M => hc (Subgroup.mem_top M)
  have hb (i : Fin 3) : integralTranslation (basisVector i) ∈ K :=
    Subgroup.subset_closure (Finset.mem_union_right _
      (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ _,rfl⟩))
  have ht : ∀ v, integralTranslation v ∈ K := by
    intro v
    rw [translation_three]
    exact K.mul_mem (K.mul_mem (by rw [translation_zsmul]; exact K.zpow_mem (hb 0) _)
      (by rw [translation_zsmul]; exact K.zpow_mem (hb 1) _))
      (by rw [translation_zsmul]; exact K.zpow_mem (hb 2) _)
  apply top_unique
  intro g _
  rw [normal_form g]
  exact K.mul_mem (ht _) (hlin _)

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.Obstructi.name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.main_statement
OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.Obstructi.text:
theorem main_statement : MainStatement.{0} := by
  let A : UnitalCStar := ⟨FullGroupModel.Full G⟩
  refine ⟨A, FullGroupModel.inclusion G, ?_, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨FullGroupModel.dense_span G, ?_⟩
    intro D ρ
    refine ⟨FullGroupModel.modelMap G ρ, FullGroupModel.modelMap_generator G ρ, ?_⟩
    intro φ hφ
    exact FullGroupModel.modelMap_unique G ρ φ hφ
  · intro B hB ω hω
    obtain ⟨π,hπ,haπ⟩ := Elementary.exists_aperiodic_integral_rep
    apply fullGroup_no_nuclear_ultrapower Elementary.integralInclusion
      Elementary.integralInclusion_injective Elementary.integralTheta
      Elementary.integralTheta_injective Elementary.stableLetter ?_
      Elementary.kazhdanSet Elementary.kazhdanSet_nonempty Elementary.kazhdanSet_generates
      (1/4000) (by norm_num) ?_ Elementary.hasKazhdanGap π hπ haπ hB ω hω
    · intro g
      have h := Elementary.stableLetter_conjugation g
      calc
        _ = (Elementary.stableLetter * Elementary.integralInclusion g *
          Elementary.stableLetter⁻¹) * Elementary.stableLetter := congrArg (· * _) h.symm
        _ = _ := by group
    · have hc : 1 ≤ (Elementary.kazhdanSet.card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr Elementary.kazhdanSet_nonempty
      linarith

end NuclearUltrapower
end

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.CuntzNucl.name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.CuntzAveraging.commutingEval_norm_le_min
OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.CuntzNucl.text:
theorem commutingEval_norm_le_min (hRS : ∀ a c, Commute (R a) (S c)) (x : Algebra ⊗[ℂ] C) :
    ‖commutingEval H R S x‖ ≤ minTensorNorm.{0,0,0} x := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (minTensorNorm_nonneg x)
  intro v
  have hs : R 1 (commutingEval H R S x v) = commutingEval H R S x v :=
    congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T v) (commutingEval_support H R S x)
  have hb (n : ℕ) : ‖commutingEval H R S x v‖ ≤
      ‖jointDefect H R S n x‖ * ‖v‖ + minTensorNorm.{0,0,0} x * ‖v‖ := by
    calc
      _ = ‖averaged R n (commutingEval H R S x v)‖ := by rw [averaged_norm,hs]
      _ = ‖jointDefect H R S n x v + completedEval H S x (averaged R n v)‖ := by
        rw [jointDefect,sub_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,sub_add_cancel]
      _ ≤ ‖jointDefect H R S n x v‖ + ‖completedEval H S x (averaged R n v)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖jointDefect H R S n x‖ * ‖v‖ + minTensorNorm.{0,0,0} x * ‖v‖ := by
        apply add_le_add (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _)
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul (completedEval_norm_le H S x)
            ((averaged R n).le_of_opNorm_le (averaged_norm_le R n) v |>.trans_eq (one_mul _))
            (norm_nonneg _) (minTensorNorm_nonneg x))
  have ht := ((jointDefect_tendsto H R S hRS x).norm.mul_const ‖v‖).add_const
    (minTensorNorm.{0,0,0} x * ‖v‖)
  simpa only [norm_zero,zero_mul,zero_add] using
    ge_of_tendsto ht (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb)

end CuntzAveraging

  map_one' := by ext <;> simp
  map_mul' g h := by
    apply SemidirectProduct.ext
    · apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
      funext i
      change ((g.left.toAdd i + (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin' g.right) h.left.toAdd i : ℤ) : Dyadic) =
        (g.left.toAdd i : Dyadic) + (dilationAction (g.right, 1)) (fun j => (h.left.toAdd j : Dyadic)) i
      simp [dilationAction, matrixAction, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin'_apply,
        Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, LinearEquiv.smulOfUnit]
    · rfl

    funext i

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.CuntzAlge.name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.CuntzUniversal.modelMap_unique
OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.CuntzAlge.text:
theorem modelMap_unique {D : Type} [CStarAlgebra D] (r : Fin 2 → D)
    (hr : CuntzTwoRelations r) (φ : Algebra →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D)
    (hφ : ∀ i, φ (generator i) = r i) : φ = modelMap r hr := by
  have hletter (a : Letter) : φ (inclusion (MonoidAlgebra.of ℂ Word (FreeMonoid.of a))) =
      evalLetter r a := by
    rcases a with ⟨i,b⟩
    cases b
    · exact hφ i
    · change φ (inclusion (MonoidAlgebra.single (FreeMonoid.of (i,true)) 1)) = star (r i)
      have hg : (MonoidAlgebra.single (FreeMonoid.of (i,true)) 1 : Poly) =
          star (CuntzPolynomial.generator i) := by
        rw [CuntzPolynomial.generator,star_single,star_word_of,star_one]
        rfl
      rw [hg,map_star,map_star]
      exact congrArg star (hφ i)
  have hw (w : Word) : φ (inclusion (MonoidAlgebra.of ℂ Word w)) = evalWord r w := by
    induction w using FreeMonoid.recOn with
    | one =>
      change φ (inclusion 1) = evalWord r 1
      simp only [map_one]
    | of_mul a w ih => simp only [map_mul,hletter,ih,evalWord_of]
  have he (x : Poly) : φ (inclusion x) = modelMap r hr (inclusion x) := by
    rw [modelMap_coe]
    induction x using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
    | of w => simpa only [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply,evaluate_single,one_smul] using hw w
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add,hx,hy]
    | smul c x hx => simp only [map_smul,hx]
  have hc (f : Algebra →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D) : Continuous f :=
    AddMonoidHomClass.continuous_of_bound f 1 (fun x => by
      simpa only [one_mul] using NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le f x)
  apply DFunLike.ext'
  exact Completion.denseRange_coe.equalizer (hc φ) (hc (modelMap r hr)) (funext he)

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.FullGroup.text:
def inclusion : Γ →* unitary (Full Γ) where
  toFun := generator Γ
  map_one' := by

    change algebraicInclusion Γ (MonoidAlgebra.single 1 1) = 1
    exact map_one _
  map_mul' g h := by

    change algebraicInclusion Γ (MonoidAlgebra.single (g*h) 1) =
      algebraicInclusion Γ (MonoidAlgebra.single g 1) * algebraicInclusion Γ (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1)
    rw [← map_mul, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.Kazhdan:1.name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.Elementary.stableLetter_conjugation
OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.Kazhdan:1.text:
theorem stableLetter_conjugation (g : IntegralGroup) :
    stableLetter * integralInclusion g * stableLetter⁻¹ = integralInclusion (integralTheta g) := by
  apply (mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul).mpr
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext
  · apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    funext i
    change 0 + ((dilationAction (1, Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)))
      (fun j => (g.left.toAdd j : Dyadic))) i =
      ((2 * g.left.toAdd i : ℤ) : Dyadic) +
      (dilationAction (g.right, 1) (0 : Vector3)) i
    simp [dilationAction, matrixAction, LinearEquiv.smulOfUnit, Units.smul_def]
  · change (1, Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)) * ((g.right : SL3Z), 1) =
      ((g.right : SL3Z), 1) * (1, Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ))
    simp

OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.FullGroup.name: OAI.NuclearUltrapower.FullGroupModel.modelMap_unique
OAI.Analysis.NuclearUltrapower.FullGroup.text:
theorem modelMap_unique {D : Type} [CStarAlgebra D] (ρ : Γ →* unitary D)
    (φ : Full Γ →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D) (hφ : ∀ g, φ (inclusion Γ g) = (ρ g : D)) :
    φ = modelMap Γ ρ := by
  have he (x : ℂ[Γ]) : φ (algebraicInclusion Γ x) = modelMap Γ ρ (algebraicInclusion Γ x) := by
    induction x using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
    | of g => exact (hφ g).trans (modelMap_generator Γ ρ g).symm
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
    | smul c x hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]
  have hc : Continuous (φ : Full Γ → D) :=
    AddMonoidHomClass.continuous_of_bound φ 1 (by
      intro x
      simpa only [one_mul] using NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le φ x)
  have hd : Continuous (modelMap Γ ρ : Full Γ → D) :=
    AddMonoidHomClass.continuous_of_bound (modelMap Γ ρ) 1 (by
      intro x
      simpa only [one_mul] using NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le (modelMap Γ ρ) x)
  apply DFunLike.ext'
  exact Completion.denseRange_coe.equalizer hc hd (funext he)

                                                                         
instance [Countable Γ] : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (Full Γ) := by
  have hs : TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable (Set.range (fun g => (inclusion Γ g : Full Γ))) :=
    (Set.countable_range _).isSeparable
  have ht := hs.span (R := ℂ)
  have hc := ht.closure
  rw [(dense_span Γ).closure_eq] at hc
  exact TopologicalSpace.isSeparable_univ_iff.mp hc

end NuclearUltrapower.FullGroupModel

lemma oddPerm_mul (g h : Equiv.Perm S) (w : Words (S := S) odd k) :

  intro i

    ((relabelOddEquiv (g * h) w.1) ((oddFrame w).symm i)) =
    oddFrame (actWord g (actWord h w))

OAI.RepresentationTheory.RowColumn.Occup.text:
theorem occupied_dimension_ratio (m n : ℕ) (Ω : Finset (Board m n)) [Nonempty Ω]
    (a : YoungDiagram) (e : Ω ≃ Cell a) (h : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (H : InHook a h)
    (r c u v : ℕ)
    (ρ : Representation ℂ (rowGroup Ω) (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin r)))
    (τ : Representation ℂ (columnGroup Ω) (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin c)))
    (hρ : IsUnitary ρ) (hτ : IsUnitary τ)
    (I : Fin u → EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin r) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] hilbertSpace a)
    (J : Fin v → EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin c) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] hilbertSpace a)
    (hI : ∀ i, Intertwines (V := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin r)) (W := hilbertSpace a)
      ρ ((relabelledUnitary a e).comp (rowGroup Ω).subtype) (I i).toLinearMap)
    (hJ : ∀ i, Intertwines (V := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin c)) (W := hilbertSpace a)
      τ ((relabelledUnitary a e).comp (columnGroup Ω).subtype) (J i).toLinearMap)
    (hu : u ≤ (Ω.card+1)^(4*m*h^2)) (hv : v ≤ (Ω.card+1)^(4*n*h^2)) :
    allCopyOverlap (V := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin r)) (W := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin c))
      (X := hilbertSpace a) I J ≤
      (16 * ((Ω.card : ℝ)+1)^((16*(m+n)+8)*h^2) * Real.exp ((m*n-Ω.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ((r : ℝ)*c / Module.finrank ℂ (space a)) := by
  let board : Ω ↪ Fin m × Fin n := ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩
  let c₀ : HookModel.Color h := Sum.inl ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have ha := actual_copy_overlap_bound (V := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin r))
    (W := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin c)) board a e h H c₀ ρ τ hρ hτ I J hI hJ
  have hc : Fintype.card (Cell a) = Ω.card := (Fintype.card_congr e).symm.trans (Fintype.card_coe Ω)
  have hD := hook_sectorAlgebra_bound (S := Cell a) h (HookModel.oddCount a h H)
  rw [hc] at hD
  let D := Module.finrank ℂ (sectorAlgebra (S := Cell a) (HookModel.IsOdd (h := h)) (HookModel.oddCount a h H))
  have hp := occupied_factor_bound Ω.card m n h u v D ((m*n-Ω.card : ℕ) : ℝ) hu hv hD
  have hratio : 0 ≤ (r : ℝ)*c / (Module.finrank ℂ (space a) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp hratio
  simp only [hook_lineCost, hc, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_coe, finrank_euclideanSpace,
    Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, ← pow_mul] at ha
  apply ha.trans
  convert hmul using 1; dsimp [D]; ring

end RowColumn

end

theorem factorial_le_dimension_row_column (μ : YoungDiagram) :
    μ.card.factorial ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (space μ)*Fintype.card (rowGroup μ)*Fintype.card (colGroup μ) := by
  rw [←card_tabloid_mul_row]
  nlinarith [dimension_times_column_ge_tabloids μ]
