OAI.Geometry.PinnedDistances.ArithmeticS.name: OAI.WeakPinned.graph_card_tendsto

OAI.Geometry.PinnedDistances.Main:12.name: OAI.WeakPinned.mainStatement
OAI.Geometry.PinnedDistances.Main:12.text:
theorem mainStatement : MainStatement := by
  classical
  by_contra hfail
  obtain ⟨c,s,γ,hc,hcγ,hγs,hs,hθ,P,C,hcard,hG,hmodels⟩ := sequence_arithmetic_model hfail
  choose L hL ii Z₁ Z₂ t hii h₁ h₂ ht0 ht using hmodels
  let K := fun j => L j
  let (j : ℕ) : NumberField (K j) := hL j
  have hn : Tendsto (fun j => (Fintype.card (C j):ℝ)) atTop atTop := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe, Function.comp_def] using tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp (graph_card_tendsto hcard)
  apply arithmetic_sequence_impossible (fun j => coreGraph (P j) s (C j)) (Theta s) γ c
    (fun j => Theta s/((j:ℝ)+2)) Z₁ Z₂ h₁ h₂ hθ (hc.trans hcγ) (hγs.trans hs) hc hcγ hn
    (graph_error_tendsto (Theta s)) (fun j => by positivity) _ hG t ht
  intro j
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hθ.le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)
  have : 0 ≤ (j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg j
  linarith

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.hopping_selfAdjoint
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem hopping_selfAdjoint : IsSelfAdjoint hopping := by
   apply ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mpr
   intro u w
   change inner ℂ (hopping u) w = inner ℂ u (hopping w)
   simp only [hopping, add_apply, inner_add_left, inner_add_right,
     LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, inner_permute, translation_symm]
   simp only [Prod.neg_mk, neg_neg, neg_zero]
   ring

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.anderson_formula
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem anderson_formula (v : Configuration) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h) : IsAndersonOperator v (anderson v hh hv) := by
   intro u x
   simp [anderson]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.spectralInterval
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
def spectralInterval (h : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  {z | z.im = 0 ∧ -4 - h ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ 4 + h}

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.anderson_selfAdjoint
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem anderson_selfAdjoint (v : Configuration) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h) : IsSelfAdjoint (anderson v hh hv) := by
   change IsSelfAdjoint (hopping + potential v hh hv)
   exact IsSelfAdjoint.add (R := Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)
     hopping_selfAdjoint (potential_selfAdjoint v hh hv)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.bounded_ae
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem bounded_ae {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∀ᵐ v ∂disorderLaw h, ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h := by
  let := uniform_probability hh
  rw [ae_all_iff]
  intro x
  have he := (measurePreserving_eval_infinitePi
    (fun _ : Site => ProbabilityTheory.cond volume (Set.Icc (-h) h)) x).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ProbabilityTheory.ae_cond_mem measurableSet_Icc)
  filter_upwards [he] with v hv
  exact abs_le.mpr hv

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.potential_selfAdjoint
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem potential_selfAdjoint (v : Configuration) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h) : IsSelfAdjoint (potential v hh hv) := by
   apply ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mpr
   intro u w
   change inner ℂ (potential v hh hv u) w = inner ℂ u (potential v hh hv w)
   rw [lp.inner_eq_tsum, lp.inner_eq_tsum]
   congr 1
   funext x
   simp [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.anderson_spectrum_ae
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem anderson_spectrum_ae {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∀ᵐ v ∂disorderLaw h, ∃ H : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert,
      IsAndersonOperator v H ∧ IsSelfAdjoint H ∧ spectrum ℂ H = spectralInterval h := by
  filter_upwards [bounded_ae hh, constant_boxes_ae hh] with v hv hbox
  exact ⟨anderson v hh.le hv, anderson_formula v hh.le hv,
    anderson_selfAdjoint v hh.le hv, spectrum_eq_interval v hh hv hbox⟩

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.constant_boxes_ae
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem constant_boxes_ae {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∀ᵐ v ∂disorderLaw h, HasConstantBoxes v h := by
  have he : ∀ᵐ v ∂disorderLaw h, ∀ (q : ℚ) (l n : ℕ),
      (q : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h → ∃ k : ℕ,
        ∀ p : Patch n, |v (trialSite n k p) - (q : ℝ)| < 1 / ((l : ℝ) + 1) := by
    simp only [ae_all_iff]
    intro q l n
    by_cases hq : (q : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h
    · intro _
      exact constant_trial_ae hh hq (by positivity) n
    · simp [hq]
  filter_upwards [he] with v hv
  intro w hw ε hε n
  let δ := min (ε / 2) (min (w + h) (h - w))
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; exact lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min (by linarith [hw.1]) (by linarith [hw.2]))
  obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show w - δ < w + δ by linarith)
  have hd1 : δ ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hd2 : δ ≤ w + h := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hd3 : δ ≤ h - w := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hq : (q : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hwq : |(q : ℝ) - w| < ε / 2 := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (show 0 < ε / 2 by linarith)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hv q l n hq
  refine ⟨(((k * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ), 0), fun p => ?_⟩
  have hsite : patchSite n p + (((k * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ), 0) = trialSite n k p := by
    ext <;> simp [patchSite, trialSite, Nat.cast_add, add_comm]
  rw [hsite]
  calc
    |v (trialSite n k p) - w| =
      |(v (trialSite n k p) - (q : ℝ)) + ((q : ℝ) - w)| := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ |v (trialSite n k p) - (q : ℝ)| + |(q : ℝ) - w| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ < ε := by linarith [hk p]

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.anderson
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
def anderson (v : Configuration) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h) :
    Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert := hopping + potential v hh hv

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.disorderLaw
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
def disorderLaw (h : ℝ) : Measure Configuration :=
  Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : Site => ProbabilityTheory.cond volume (Set.Icc (-h) h))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.spectrum_eq_interval
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem spectrum_eq_interval (v : Configuration) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h) (hbox : HasConstantBoxes v h) :
    spectrum ℂ (anderson v hh.le hv) = spectralInterval h := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm (spectrum_subset v hh.le hv)
  have hi : Set.Ioo (-4-h) (4+h) ⊆ Complex.ofReal ⁻¹' spectrum ℂ (anderson v hh.le hv) := by
    intro e he
    exact spectrum_contains_interior v hh hv hbox he
  have hc := closure_minimal hi ((spectrum.isClosed (𝕜 := ℂ) (anderson v hh.le hv)).preimage
    Complex.continuous_ofReal)
  rw [closure_Ioo (by linarith : -4-h ≠ 4+h)] at hc
  intro z hz
  have hm := hc ⟨hz.2.1, hz.2.2⟩
  have hez : (z.re:ℂ) = z := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hz.1]
  simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, hez] using hm

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.Configuration
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text: abbrev Configuration := Site → ℝ

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.trialSite
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
def trialSite (n : ℕ) (k : ℕ) (p : Patch n) : Site :=
  (((k * (n + 1) + p.1.val : ℕ) : ℤ), (p.2.val : ℤ))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.potential
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
def potential (v : Configuration) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h) :
    Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert :=
   lp.mapCLM 2 (fun x => (v x : ℂ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) hh
     (fun x => by simpa only [norm_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id, mul_one,
       Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hv x)

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.constant_trial_ae
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem constant_trial_ae {h w ε : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hw : w ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h) (hε : 0 < ε) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ v ∂disorderLaw h, ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ p : Patch n,
      |v (trialSite n k p) - w| < ε := by
  let := uniform_probability hh
  let μ := ProbabilityTheory.cond volume (Set.Icc (-h) h)
  let s : Set (Patch n → ℝ) := Set.univ.pi (fun _ => Set.Ioo (w - ε) (w + ε))
  have hs : MeasurableSet s := MeasurableSet.pi (Set.to_countable _) (by measurability)
  have hp : (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : Patch n => μ)) s ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [Measure.infinitePi_pi_univ _ (fun _ => measurableSet_Ioo), tprod_fintype]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun _ _ => ne_of_gt (uniform_interval_pos hw hε))
  have he := iid_exists_ae (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : Patch n => μ)) hs hp
  have hm : MeasurePreserving (fun v k p => v (trialSite n k p))
      (disorderLaw h) (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ =>
        Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : Patch n => μ))) :=
    ⟨by fun_prop, trial_law hh n⟩
  filter_upwards [hm.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae he] with v hv
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨k, fun p => ?_⟩
  have hp := hk p (Set.mem_univ p)
  exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [hp.1], by linarith [hp.2]⟩

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.IsAndersonOperator
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
def IsAndersonOperator (v : Configuration) (H : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : Hilbert) (x : Site),
    (H u) x = u (x.1 + 1, x.2) + u (x.1 - 1, x.2) +
      u (x.1, x.2 + 1) + u (x.1, x.2 - 1) + (v x : ℂ) * u x

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.spectrum_contains_interior
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem spectrum_contains_interior (v : Configuration) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h) (hbox : HasConstantBoxes v h) {e : ℝ}
    (he : e ∈ Set.Ioo (-4-h) (4+h)) :
    (e:ℂ) ∈ spectrum ℂ (anderson v hh.le hv) := by
  let a := e/(4+h)
  have hp : 0 < 4+h := by linarith
  have hlo : -1 < a := by change -1 < e/(4+h); apply (lt_div_iff₀ hp).mpr; linarith [he.1]
  have hhi : a < 1 := by change e/(4+h) < 1; apply (div_lt_iff₀ hp).mpr; linarith [he.2]
  have hw : h*a ∈ Set.Ioo (-h) h := by
    constructor
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  have hf : 4*a ∈ Set.Icc (-4:ℝ) 4 := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩ := freeEnergy_surjective hf
  have hm := spectrum_contains_shifted_free v hh.le hv hbox hw hq
  have hea : (4+h)*a = e := by dsimp [a]; field_simp
  have hec : freeEnergy q + ((h*a:ℝ):ℂ) = (e:ℂ) := by
    rw [hqe, ← Complex.ofReal_add]
    congr 1
    nlinarith
  rwa [hec] at hm

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.uniform_probability
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem uniform_probability {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.cond volume (Set.Icc (-h) h)) := by
  apply ProbabilityTheory.cond_isProbabilityMeasure_of_finite
  · rw [Real.volume_Icc]
    exact ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith))
  · rw [Real.volume_Icc]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.patchSite
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text: def patchSite (n : ℕ) (p : Patch n) : Site := ((p.1.val : ℤ), (p.2.val : ℤ))

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.spectrum_subset
OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.text:
theorem spectrum_subset (v : Configuration) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hv : ∀ x, |v x| ≤ h) : spectrum ℂ (anderson v hh hv) ⊆ spectralInterval h := by
   intro z hz
   have hr := (anderson_selfAdjoint v hh hv).im_eq_zero_of_mem_spectrum hz
   have hn := (spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem hz).trans (norm_anderson_le v hh hv)
   refine ⟨hr, ?_, ?_⟩
   · have : -z.re ≤ ‖z‖ := by simpa using Complex.re_le_norm (-z)
     linarith
   · exact (Complex.re_le_norm z).trans hn

OAI.MathematicalPhysics.PlanarAnderson.S.name: OAI.PlanarAnderson.HasConstantBoxes

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Measures.Root.name: OAI.PlanarFalconer.distanceSet_positive_of_dilate
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Measures.Root.text:
theorem distanceSet_positive_of_dilate (E : Set Plane) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hpos : 0 < volume (distanceSet ((fun x : Plane => s • x) '' E))) :
    0 < volume (distanceSet E) := by
  rw [distanceSet_dilate E hs] at hpos
  have he : (fun r : ℝ => s*r) '' distanceSet E = (fun r : ℝ => s⁻¹*r) ⁻¹' distanceSet E := by
    ext r
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
      simpa only [mem_preimage,inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hs.ne'] using ht
    · intro hr
      exact ⟨s⁻¹*r,hr,mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hs.ne' r⟩
  rw [he,Real.volume_preimage_mul_left (inv_ne_zero hs.ne')] at hpos
  exact (ENNReal.mul_pos_iff.mp hpos).2

end PlanarFalconer

end OAI

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Main:12.name: OAI.PlanarFalconer.manuscript_main
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Main:12.text:
theorem manuscript_main (E : Set Plane) (hE : IsCompact E) (hd : 1 < dimH E) :
    0 < volume (distanceSet E) := by
  obtain ⟨δ,s,hδ,hδ1,hs,Q,hQ,hcent,μ,ν,_,_,hμE,hνE,_,_,hμQ,hνQ,
    C,hC,hball₀,hball₁,K,hK,hμrad,hνrad⟩ := exists_normalized_root_setup E hE hd
  obtain ⟨β,lam,sig,kap,hβ,hlam,hlamδ,hsig,hkap,hkapβ,hgap,hratio⟩ :=
    exists_source_assembly_parameters hδ hδ1
  obtain ⟨Ψ,hΨ,hpos,hsupp,hone⟩ := exists_assembly_shell_cutoff
  have hp1 : 1 < 1+δ/8 := by linarith
  have hpq : (1+δ/8).HolderConjugate ((1+δ/8)/((1+δ/8)-1)) :=
    (Real.holderConjugate_iff_eq_conjExponent hp1).mpr rfl
  have hμrad' : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ:Measure Plane),
      sourceDensityNorm (1+δ/8) ((ν:Measure Plane).map (sourceRadialUnit x)) ≤ K := by
    filter_upwards [(μ:Measure Plane).support_mem_ae] with x hx
    exact hμrad x hx
  have hνrad' : ∀ᵐ y ∂(ν:Measure Plane),
      sourceDensityNorm (1+δ/8) ((μ:Measure Plane).map (sourceRadialUnit y)) ≤ K := by
    filter_upwards [(ν:Measure Plane).support_mem_ae] with y hy
    exact hνrad y hy
  have hlo : 100 ≤ dist (Q 0).center (Q 1).center := by rw [hcent]; norm_num
  have hhi : dist (Q 0).center (Q 1).center ≤ 2000 := by rw [hcent]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨hτ,happrox⟩ := two_root_has_shell_approximations Q hQ hlo hhi μ ν hμQ hνQ
    hδ hδ1 hβ hlam hlamδ hsig hkap hkapβ hgap hratio hC.le hC.le hball₀ hball₁
    hpq hK hμrad' hνrad' hΨ hpos hsupp hone
  have hac := shell_criterion ⟨weightedDistance ((μ:Measure Plane).prod ν),hτ⟩ happrox
  have hsep : ∀ᵐ z ∂(μ:Measure Plane).prod (ν:Measure Plane),
      90 ≤ dist z.1 z.2 ∧ dist z.1 z.2 ≤ 2010 := by
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hμQ,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hνQ] with z hx hy
    exact separated_unit_roots_distance Q hQ hlo hhi z.1 z.2 hx hy
  have hcompact : IsCompact ((fun x : Plane => s • x) '' E) := hE.image (by fun_prop)
  have hcarry₀ : (μ:Measure Plane) ((fun x : Plane => s • x) '' E)ᶜ = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null (compl_subset_compl.mpr hμE) (μ:Measure Plane).support_mem_ae
  have hcarry₁ : (ν:Measure Plane) ((fun x : Plane => s • x) '' E)ᶜ = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null (compl_subset_compl.mpr hνE) (ν:Measure Plane).support_mem_ae
  apply distanceSet_positive_of_dilate E hs
  exact positive_distance_volume_of_weighted_ac (μ:Measure Plane) (ν:Measure Plane)
    hcompact hcarry₀ hcarry₁ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 90) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2010) hsep hac

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Shells.ShellR.name: OAI.PlanarFalconer.shell_criterion
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Shells.ShellR.text:
theorem shell_criterion (τ : FiniteMeasure ℝ) (hτ : HasShellApproximations τ) :
    (τ : Measure ℝ) ≪ volume := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf,ht⟩ := shell_reconstruction_locallyIntegrable τ hτ
  exact absolutelyContinuous_of_smooth_test_density τ f hf ht

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Shells.TwoRoo.name: OAI.PlanarFalconer.two_root_has_shell_approximations
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Shells.TwoRoo.text:
theorem two_root_has_shell_approximations (Q : Fin 2 → DyadicSquare)
    (hQ : ∀ l, (Q l).side = 1)
    (hlo : 100 ≤ dist (Q 0).center (Q 1).center) (hhi : dist (Q 0).center (Q 1).center ≤ 2000)
    (μ ν : ProbabilityMeasure Plane) (hμQ : (μ:Measure Plane) (Q 0).carrierᶜ = 0)
    (hνQ : (ν:Measure Plane) (Q 1).carrierᶜ = 0)
    {δ β lam sig kap C₀ C₁ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hβ : β = δ/10)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hlamδ : lam < δ/1000) (hsig : 0 < sig)
    (hkap : 0 < kap) (hkapβ : 1000000*kap < β) (hgap : sig < kap/1000)
    (hratio : 10000000*(lam+sig)/kap < β/100)
    (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (hball₀ : ∀ x : Plane, ∀ r > 0, (μ:Measure Plane) (ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₀*r^(1+δ)))
    (hball₁ : ∀ x : Plane, ∀ r > 0, (ν:Measure Plane) (ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₁*r^(1+δ)))
    {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) {K : ENNReal} (hK : K ≠ ⊤)
    (hμrad : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ:Measure Plane), sourceDensityNorm p ((ν:Measure Plane).map (sourceRadialUnit x)) ≤ K)
    (hνrad : ∀ᵐ y ∂(ν:Measure Plane), sourceDensityNorm p ((μ:Measure Plane).map (sourceRadialUnit y)) ≤ K)
    {Ψ : ℝ → ℝ} (hΨ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Ψ x)
    (hs : ∀ x, Ψ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ Ioo (1/4:ℝ) 4)
    (hone : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) 2, 1 ≤ Ψ x) :
    ∃ hτ : IsFiniteMeasure (weightedDistance ((μ:Measure Plane).prod ν)),
      HasShellApproximations ⟨weightedDistance ((μ:Measure Plane).prod ν),hτ⟩ := by
  have hQ₀ : 0 < (Q 0).side := by rw [hQ 0]; norm_num
  have hQ₁ : 0 < (Q 1).side := by rw [hQ 1]; norm_num
  have hsep : ∀ᵐ z ∂(μ:Measure Plane).prod (ν:Measure Plane), 90 ≤ dist z.1 z.2 := by
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hμQ,
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae hνQ] with z hx hy
    exact (separated_unit_roots_distance Q hQ hlo hhi z.1 z.2 hx hy).1
  let := weightedProductInput_finite (μ:Measure Plane) (ν:Measure Plane) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 90) hsep
  let τ : FiniteMeasure ℝ := ⟨weightedDistance ((μ:Measure Plane).prod ν),inferInstance⟩
  refine ⟨inferInstance,?_⟩
  change HasShellApproximations τ
  obtain ⟨H₀,N₀,hH₀,_,hf₀⟩ := actual_class_family (Q 0) (hQ 0) (μ:Measure Plane) hμQ hC₀ hlam hsig hball₀
  obtain ⟨H₁,N₁,hH₁,_,hf₁⟩ := actual_class_family (Q 1) (hQ 1) (ν:Measure Plane) hνQ hC₁ hlam hsig hball₁
  obtain ⟨NS,hNS,hshell⟩ := uniform_two_root_shell_decay hδ hδ1 hβ hlam hlamδ hsig
    hkap hkapβ hgap hratio hΨ hpos hs hone
  obtain ⟨eta,heta,NR,hrate⟩ := restoration_power_rate H₀ H₁ hlam hsig hpq
  let D := ENNReal.ofReal ((90:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ))*(4+2*K)
  have hD : D ≠ ⊤ := by dsimp only [D]; finiteness
  have hDbound : D ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (D.toReal+1) := by
    calc
      D = ENNReal.ofReal D.toReal := (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hD).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (D.toReal+1) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith)
  apply hasShellApproximations_of_eventual τ heta (show 0 < β/2 by rw [hβ]; positivity)
    (show 0 < D.toReal+1 by positivity) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)
    (max (max NS NR) (max (max N₀ N₁) (max H₀ H₁)))
  intro N hN
  obtain ⟨m₀,hm₀⟩ := hf₀ N (by omega)
  obtain ⟨m₁,hm₁⟩ := hf₁ N (by omega)
  have hfinite := restoredTwoRootCandidate_finite (Q 0) (Q 1) hQ₀ hQ₁ (μ:Measure Plane) (ν:Measure Plane)
    m₀ m₁ N (N/H₀) (N/H₁) lam sig kap β
  let := hfinite.1
  let := hfinite.2
  let σ : FiniteMeasure ℝ := ⟨restoredTwoRootCandidate (Q 0) (Q 1) μ ν m₀ m₁ N (N/H₀) (N/H₁) lam sig kap β,inferInstance⟩
  refine ⟨σ,?_,?_⟩
  · have hweight : ∀ᵐ z ∂(μ:Measure Plane).prod (ν:Measure Plane), distanceWeight z ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((90:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hsep] with z hz
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) hz (by norm_num))
    have hremoved := two_root_restored_removed_mass_bound (Q 0) (Q 1) hQ₀ hQ₁ μ ν m₀ m₁
      (by omega : 0 < N) δ lam sig hkap β hm₀ hm₁ hpq hK hμrad hνrad hweight
    have hrate' := hrate N (by omega) (ENNReal.ofReal ((90:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ))) K
    change ((weightedDistance ((μ:Measure Plane).prod ν)).toSignedMeasure -
      (restoredTwoRootCandidate (Q 0) (Q 1) μ ν m₀ m₁ N (N/H₀) (N/H₁) lam sig kap β).toSignedMeasure).totalVariation univ ≤ _
    rw [restoredTwoRootCandidate_totalVariation (Q 0) (Q 1) hQ₀ hQ₁]
    apply (hremoved.trans hrate').trans
    change D*ENNReal.ofReal (((2:ℝ)^N)^(-eta)) ≤ _
    rw [dyadic_negative_power,ENNReal.ofReal_mul (show 0 ≤ D.toReal+1 by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_left hDbound _
  · have hb := hshell N (by omega) Q hQ hlo hhi (μ:Measure Plane) (ν:Measure Plane)
      H₀ H₁ hH₀ hH₁ (by omega) (by omega) m₀ m₁ hm₀ hm₁
    change shellEnergy (restoredTwoRootCandidate (Q 0) (Q 1) μ ν m₀ m₁ N (N/H₀) (N/H₁) lam sig kap β) N ≤ _
    convert hb using 1
    congr 1
    simpa only [neg_div] using (dyadic_negative_power (β/2) N).symm

end PlanarFalconer

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Estimates.Sou.name: OAI.PlanarFalconer.exists_source_assembly_parameters
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Estimates.Sou.text:
theorem exists_source_assembly_parameters {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    ∃ β lam sig kap : ℝ, β = δ/10 ∧ 0 < lam ∧ lam < δ/1000 ∧ 0 < sig ∧
      0 < kap ∧ 1000000*kap < β ∧ sig < kap/1000 ∧
      10000000*(lam+sig)/kap < β/100 := by
  let kap := δ/1000000000
  let lam := δ^2/1000000000000000000000000
  have hd2 : 0 < δ^2 := sq_pos_of_pos hδ
  have hd2δ : δ^2 < δ := by nlinarith
  have hkap : 0 < kap := by dsimp only [kap]; positivity
  refine ⟨δ/10,lam,lam,kap,rfl,?_,?_,?_,hkap,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · dsimp only [lam]; positivity
  · dsimp only [lam]; nlinarith
  · dsimp only [lam]; positivity
  · dsimp only [kap]; linarith
  · dsimp only [lam,kap]; nlinarith
  · apply (div_lt_iff₀ hkap).mpr
    dsimp only [lam,kap]
    nlinarith

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Estimates.Sou.name: OAI.PlanarFalconer.exists_assembly_shell_cutoff
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Estimates.Sou.text:
theorem exists_assembly_shell_cutoff :
    ∃ Ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ Ψ x) ∧
      (∀ x, Ψ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ Ioo (1/4:ℝ) 4) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) 2, 1 ≤ Ψ x) := by
  refine ⟨assemblyShellBump,assemblyShellBump.contDiff,fun _ => assemblyShellBump.nonneg,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hh : dist x (5/4:ℝ) < 1 := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hx (assemblyShellBump.zero_of_le_dist (not_lt.mp hn))
    rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_lt] at hh
    constructor <;> linarith
  · intro x hx
    have hh : x ∈ closedBall (5/4:ℝ) assemblyShellBump.rIn := by
      change dist x (5/4:ℝ) ≤ 3/4
      rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2]
    rw [assemblyShellBump.one_of_mem_closedBall hh]

end PlanarFalconer

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Shells.Normal.name: OAI.PlanarFalconer.separated_unit_roots_distance
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Shells.Normal.text:
theorem separated_unit_roots_distance (Q : Fin 2 → DyadicSquare)
    (hQ : ∀ l, (Q l).side = 1)
    (hlo : 100 ≤ dist (Q 0).center (Q 1).center)
    (hhi : dist (Q 0).center (Q 1).center ≤ 2000)
    (x y : Plane) (hx : x ∈ (Q 0).carrier) (hy : y ∈ (Q 1).carrier) :
    90 ≤ dist x y ∧ dist x y ≤ 2010 := by
  have hx' := (Q 0).dist_center_le_three_quarters (by rw [hQ 0]; norm_num) hx
  have hy' := (Q 1).dist_center_le_three_quarters (by rw [hQ 1]; norm_num) hy
  rw [hQ 0] at hx'
  rw [hQ 1] at hy'
  have hl := dist_triangle4 (Q 0).center x y (Q 1).center
  have hu := dist_triangle4 x (Q 0).center (Q 1).center y
  rw [dist_comm (Q 0).center x] at hl
  rw [dist_comm (Q 1).center y] at hu
  constructor <;> linarith

OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Frostman.Norm.name: OAI.PlanarFalconer.exists_normalized_root_setup
OAI.MeasureTheory.Falconer.Frostman.Norm.text:
theorem exists_normalized_root_setup (E : Set Plane) (hE : IsCompact E) (hd : 1 < dimH E) :
    ∃ δ s : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ 0 < s ∧
      ∃ Q : Fin 2 → DyadicSquare, (∀ l, (Q l).side = 1) ∧
        dist (Q 0).center (Q 1).center = 250 ∧
      ∃ μ ν : ProbabilityMeasure Plane,
        IsCompact (μ : Measure Plane).support ∧ IsCompact (ν : Measure Plane).support ∧
        (μ : Measure Plane).support ⊆ (fun x : Plane => s • x) '' E ∧
        (ν : Measure Plane).support ⊆ (fun x : Plane => s • x) '' E ∧
        (μ : Measure Plane).support ⊆ (Q 0).carrier ∧
        (ν : Measure Plane).support ⊆ (Q 1).carrier ∧
        (μ : Measure Plane) (Q 0).carrierᶜ = 0 ∧ (ν : Measure Plane) (Q 1).carrierᶜ = 0 ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ BallBound μ (1+δ) C ∧ BallBound ν (1+δ) C ∧
      ∃ K : ℝ≥0∞, K ≠ ⊤ ∧
        (∀ x ∈ (μ : Measure Plane).support,
          sourceDensityNorm (1+δ/8) ((ν : Measure Plane).map (sourceRadialUnit x)) ≤ K) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ (ν : Measure Plane).support,
          sourceDensityNorm (1+δ/8) ((μ : Measure Plane).map (sourceRadialUnit y)) ≤ K) := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδ1,ζ,hζ,hna,C,hC,hball,_⟩ := exists_frostman_above_one E hE hd
  let := hna
  obtain ⟨x,hx,y,hy,hxy⟩ := exists_distinct_support_points ζ
  let r := dist x y/1000
  let s := 250/dist x y
  have hdist : 0 < dist x y := dist_pos.mpr hxy
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp only [r]; positivity
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  obtain ⟨μ₀,hμ₀,Cμ,hCμ,hbμ⟩ := compact_neighborhood_probability E hE ζ hζ hC hball x hx hr
  obtain ⟨ν₀,hν₀,Cν,hCν,hbν⟩ := compact_neighborhood_probability E hE ζ hζ hC hball y hy hr
  let f : Plane → Plane := fun z => s • z
  have hfc : Continuous f := by dsimp only [f]; fun_prop
  let μ₁ := μ₀.map f
  let ν₁ := ν₀.map f
  let Q : Fin 2 → DyadicSquare := ![(rootPatchEnvelope x r).dilate s,(rootPatchEnvelope y r).dilate s]
  have hgeo := normalized_root_patch_geometry x y hxy
  have hQ (l : Fin 2) : (Q l).side = 1 := by
    fin_cases l
    · exact hgeo.2.1
    · exact hgeo.2.2.1
  have hcent : dist (Q 0).center (Q 1).center = 250 := hgeo.2.2.2.1
  have hAK : IsCompact (f '' (E ∩ closedBall x r)) := (hE.inter_right isClosed_closedBall).image hfc
  have hBK : IsCompact (f '' (E ∩ closedBall y r)) := (hE.inter_right isClosed_closedBall).image hfc
  have hμA : (μ₁ : Measure Plane).support ⊆ f '' (E ∩ closedBall x r) :=
    support_subset_carrier μ₁ hAK.isClosed (dilate_carried_compact μ₀ _
      (hE.inter_right isClosed_closedBall) hμ₀ s)
  have hνB : (ν₁ : Measure Plane).support ⊆ f '' (E ∩ closedBall y r) :=
    support_subset_carrier ν₁ hBK.isClosed (dilate_carried_compact ν₀ _
      (hE.inter_right isClosed_closedBall) hν₀ s)
  have hμK := hAK.of_isClosed_subset Measure.isClosed_support hμA
  have hνK := hBK.of_isClosed_subset Measure.isClosed_support hνB
  have hμQ : (μ₁ : Measure Plane).support ⊆ (Q 0).carrier :=
    hμA.trans ((image_mono inter_subset_right).trans hgeo.2.2.2.2.1)
  have hνQ : (ν₁ : Measure Plane).support ⊆ (Q 1).carrier :=
    hνB.trans ((image_mono inter_subset_right).trans hgeo.2.2.2.2.2)
  have hsep : Disjoint (μ₁ : Measure Plane).support (ν₁ : Measure Plane).support := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hz hz'
    have hh := separated_unit_roots_distance Q hQ (by rw [hcent]; norm_num)
      (by rw [hcent]; norm_num) z z (hμQ hz) (hνQ hz')
    have hh' := hh.1
    norm_num at hh'
  let D := max (Cμ/s^(1+δ)) (Cν/s^(1+δ))
  have hD : 0 < D := (by positivity : 0 < Cμ/s^(1+δ)).trans_le (le_max_left _ _)
  have hbμ₁ : BallBound μ₁ (1+δ) D := by
    intro z a ha
    exact ((hbμ.dilate hs) z a ha).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (by positivity)))
  have hbν₁ : BallBound ν₁ (1+δ) D := by
    intro z a ha
    exact ((hbν.dilate hs) z a ha).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (by positivity)))
  obtain ⟨μ,ν,hμK',hνK',hμsub,hνsub,D',hD',hbμ',hbν',K,hK,hU,hV⟩ :=
    source_uniform_radial_restrictions μ₁ ν₁ hμK hνK hsep hδ hδ1 hD hbμ₁ hbν₁
  have hμQ' := hμsub.trans hμQ
  have hνQ' := hνsub.trans hνQ
  refine ⟨δ,s,hδ,hδ1,hs,Q,hQ,hcent,μ,ν,hμK',hνK',
    hμsub.trans (hμA.trans (image_mono inter_subset_left)),
    hνsub.trans (hνB.trans (image_mono inter_subset_left)),hμQ',hνQ',?_,?_,
    D',hD',hbμ',hbν',K,hK,hU,hV⟩
  · exact measure_mono_null (compl_subset_compl.mpr hμQ') (μ : Measure Plane).support_mem_ae
  · exact measure_mono_null (compl_subset_compl.mpr hνQ') (ν : Measure Plane).support_mem_ae

end PlanarFalconer

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UniqueSuppo.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.unique_supports_of_differentiable
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UniqueSuppo.text:
theorem unique_supports_of_differentiable (μ : Plane → ℝ) (hμ : TimeConstantNorm μ)
    (hd : DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin μ) : UniqueNormalizedSupports μ := by
  intro v hv
  have hne : v ≠ 0 := by intro he; have hh := (hμ.zero_iff v).mpr he; linarith
  obtain ⟨ℓ,hℓ⟩ := hd v hne
  obtain ⟨he,hl⟩ := norm_derivative_support μ hμ v ℓ hℓ
  refine ⟨ℓ,⟨by rw [he,hv],hl⟩,?_⟩
  intro g hg
  exact norm_support_unique μ v ℓ g hℓ (by rw [hg.1,hv]) hg.2

end PlanarFPP

    ContDiff ℝ 1 γ ∧ ContinuousOn θ U ∧
    (∀ t, γ t ∈ S ∩ U) ∧ (∀ t, θ (γ t)=t) ∧

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UnitSphereC.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.actual_C1_unit_sphere
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UnitSphereC.text:
theorem actual_C1_unit_sphere (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ) : C1UnitSphere actualSourceTimeConstant := by
  let μ := actualSourceTimeConstant
  let U : Set Plane := {0}ᶜ
  have hU : IsOpen U := isClosed_singleton.isOpen_compl
  have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 μ U := by
    intro v hv
    exact (actual_contDiffAt_away henv v hv).contDiffWithinAt
  intro v hv
  have hne : v ≠ 0 := by intro he; have hz := (actualSourceTimeConstant_norm.zero_iff v).mpr he; linarith
  refine ⟨U,hU,hne,fun w => μ w-1,hc.sub contDiffOn_const,?_,?_⟩
  · intro w _
    exact sub_eq_zero.symm
  · intro w hw hzero
    have hw1 : μ w=1 := sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
    obtain ⟨ℓ,hℓ⟩ := actual_differentiable_away henv w hw
    have hEuler := (norm_derivative_support μ actualSourceTimeConstant_norm w ℓ hℓ).1
    refine ⟨ℓ,by simpa using hℓ.sub_const 1,?_⟩
    intro hz
    simp [hz,hw1] at hEuler

end PlanarFPP

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.NormBoundar.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.ball_support_contact_pos
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.NormBoundar.text:
lemma ball_support_contact_pos (μ : Plane → ℝ) (hμ : TimeConstantNorm μ)
    (v : Plane) (g : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ z, μ z ≤ 1 → g z ≤ g v) : 0 < g v := by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ : ∃ u : Plane, g u ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hh
    apply hg
    ext u
    simpa using not_exists.mp hh u
  let w := g u • u
  have hwg : 0 < g w := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_self_pos.mpr hu
  have hw : w ≠ 0 := by intro hz; rw [hz,map_zero] at hwg; exact lt_irrefl _ hwg
  have hμw : 0 < μ w := lt_of_le_of_ne (hμ.nonneg w) (fun h => hw ((hμ.zero_iff w).mp h.symm))
  have hunit : μ ((μ w)⁻¹ • w)=1 := by
    rw [hμ.homogeneous,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμw),inv_mul_cancel₀ hμw.ne']
  have hh := hs ((μ w)⁻¹ • w) hunit.le
  rw [map_smul,smul_eq_mul] at hh
  exact (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμw) hwg).trans_le hh

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UniqueSuppo.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.norm_derivative_support
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UniqueSuppo.text:
lemma norm_derivative_support (μ : Plane → ℝ) (hμ : TimeConstantNorm μ)
    (v : Plane) (ℓ : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : HasFDerivAt μ ℓ v) :
    ℓ v=μ v ∧ ∀ w, ℓ w ≤ μ w := by
  have h0 := norm_derivative_subgradient μ hμ v ℓ hd 0
  have h2 := norm_derivative_subgradient μ hμ v ℓ hd ((2 : ℝ) • v)
  have hzero : μ 0=0 := (hμ.zero_iff 0).mpr rfl
  have htwo : μ ((2 : ℝ) • v)=2*μ v := by rw [hμ.homogeneous]; norm_num
  have he : (2 : ℝ) • v-v=v := by module
  simp only [zero_sub,map_neg,hzero] at h0
  rw [htwo,he] at h2
  have hv : ℓ v=μ v := by linarith
  refine ⟨hv,?_⟩
  intro w
  have hh := norm_derivative_subgradient μ hμ v ℓ hd w
  rw [map_sub,hv] at hh
  linarith

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.NormBoundar.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.norm_supporting_line_unique
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.NormBoundar.text:
theorem norm_supporting_line_unique (μ : Plane → ℝ) (hμ : TimeConstantNorm μ)
    (hd : DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin μ) (v : Plane) (hv : v ∈ frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1}) :
    ∃! L : Set Plane, ∃ g : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ, g ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ z, μ z ≤ 1 → g z ≤ g v) ∧ L={z | g z=g v} := by
  have hv1 : μ v=1 := by rw [norm_ball_frontier μ hμ] at hv; exact hv
  obtain ⟨ℓ,hℓ,hunique⟩ := unique_supports_of_differentiable μ hμ hd v hv1
  have hℓne : ℓ ≠ 0 := by intro he; simp [he] at hℓ
  refine ⟨{z | ℓ z=1},⟨ℓ,hℓne,fun z hz => (hℓ.2 z).trans (by rw [hℓ.1]; exact hz),by rw [hℓ.1]⟩,?_⟩
  rintro L ⟨g,hg,hs,rfl⟩
  have hc := ball_support_contact_pos μ hμ v g hg hs
  have he := hunique ((g v)⁻¹ • g) (ball_support_normalized μ hμ v hv1 g hg hs)
  ext z
  rw [← he]
  change g z=g v ↔ (g v)⁻¹*g z=1
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [hz,inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne']
  · intro hz
    have hh := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => g v*x) hz
    simpa only [← mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne',one_mul,mul_one] using hh

end PlanarFPP

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.BoundaryCur.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.manuscriptMain
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.BoundaryCur.text:
theorem manuscriptMain (Ω : Type) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) (τ : Edge → Ω → ℝ)
    (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ) :
    ∃ μ : Plane → ℝ, TimeConstantNorm μ ∧ IsTimeConstant P τ μ ∧
      DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin μ ∧ UniqueNormalizedSupports μ ∧ C1UnitSphere μ ∧
      (∀ v ∈ frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1}, ∃! L : Set Plane,
        ∃ g : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ, g ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ z, μ z ≤ 1 → g z ≤ g v) ∧ L={z | g z=g v}) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1}, HasC1CurveChart (frontier {z | μ z ≤ 1}) v) := by
  exact ⟨actualSourceTimeConstant,actualSourceTimeConstant_norm,actualSourceTimeConstant_isTimeConstant henv,
    actual_differentiable_away henv,
    unique_supports_of_differentiable _ actualSourceTimeConstant_norm (actual_differentiable_away henv),
    actual_C1_unit_sphere henv,
    norm_supporting_line_unique _ actualSourceTimeConstant_norm (actual_differentiable_away henv),
    actual_boundary_curve henv⟩

end PlanarFPP

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.GlobalDiffe.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.actual_differentiable_horizontal
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.GlobalDiffe.text:
lemma actual_differentiable_horizontal (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ)
    (v : Plane) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hdom : |v 1| ≤ |v 0|) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ actualSourceTimeConstant v := by
  have hx : v 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hy : v 1=0 := by simpa [hx] using hdom
    apply hv
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hx,hy]
  have hb : |v 1/v 0| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_div]; exact (div_le_one (abs_pos.mpr hx)).mpr hdom
  have he : v 0 • direction (v 1/v 0)=v := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [direction,PiLp.smul_apply]
    field_simp
  rw [← he]
  exact norm_differentiable_smul _ actualSourceTimeConstant_norm _ _ hx
    (actual_direction_differentiable henv _ hb)

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.LatticeSwap.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.actualSourceTimeConstant_swap
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.LatticeSwap.text:
theorem actualSourceTimeConstant_swap (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ) (v : Plane) :
    actualSourceTimeConstant (swapPlane v)=actualSourceTimeConstant v := by
  have ht : IsTimeConstant P (fun e => τ (swapEdge e)) (fun z => actualSourceTimeConstant (swapPlane z)) := by
    intro z
    filter_upwards [actualSourceTimeConstant_isTimeConstant henv (swapPlane z)] with ω hω
    have he (t : ℝ) : passageTime (fun e => τ (swapEdge e) ω) 0 (latticeFloor (t • z)) =
        passageTime (fun e => τ e ω) 0 (latticeFloor (t • swapPlane z)) := by
      rw [← passageTime_swap (fun e => τ e ω) (0 : Vertex) (latticeFloor (t • z)),← latticeFloor_swap,map_smul]
      rfl
    simpa only [show ((0,0) : Vertex)=0 from rfl,he] using hω
  have hh := actualSourceTimeConstant_unique henv.swap ht
  exact congrFun hh v

end PlanarFPP

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.GlobalDiffe.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.actual_differentiable_away
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.GlobalDiffe.text:
theorem actual_differentiable_away (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ) :
    DifferentiableAwayFromOrigin actualSourceTimeConstant := by
  intro v hv
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ actualSourceTimeConstant v := by
    by_cases hh : |v 1| ≤ |v 0|
    · exact actual_differentiable_horizontal henv v hv hh
    · have hsv : swapPlane v ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hv; exact swapPlane.injective (by simpa using h)
      have hdom : |swapPlane v 1| ≤ |swapPlane v 0| := by simpa using (le_of_not_ge hh)
      have hs := actual_differentiable_horizontal henv (swapPlane v) hsv hdom
      have hc := hs.comp v swapPlane.toContinuousLinearEquiv.differentiableAt
      have he : (fun z => actualSourceTimeConstant (swapPlane z))=actualSourceTimeConstant :=
        funext (actualSourceTimeConstant_swap henv)
      simpa only [Function.comp_def,he] using hc
  exact ⟨fderiv ℝ actualSourceTimeConstant v,hd.hasFDerivAt⟩

end PlanarFPP

end OAI

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.BoundaryCur.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.actual_sphere_curve_chart
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.BoundaryCur.text:
theorem actual_sphere_curve_chart (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ) (v : Plane)
    (hv : actualSourceTimeConstant v=1) : HasC1CurveChart {z | actualSourceTimeConstant z=1} v := by
  let μ := actualSourceTimeConstant
  have horizontal (z : Plane) (hz : μ z=1) (hx : z 0 ≠ 0) : HasC1CurveChart {w | μ w=1} z := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with hneg | hpos
    · exact sphere_horizontal_chart μ actualSourceTimeConstant_norm (actual_profile_contDiff henv) (-1)
        (by norm_num) z hz (by linarith)
    · exact sphere_horizontal_chart μ actualSourceTimeConstant_norm (actual_profile_contDiff henv) 1
        (by norm_num) z hz (by simpa using hpos)
  by_cases hx : v 0 ≠ 0
  · exact horizontal v hv hx
  · have hvne : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro he
      have hz := (actualSourceTimeConstant_norm.zero_iff v).mpr he
      linarith
    have hy : v 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hy
      apply hvne
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp_all
    have hsv : μ (swapPlane v)=1 := by dsimp [μ]; rw [actualSourceTimeConstant_swap henv,hv]
    have hs := horizontal (swapPlane v) hsv (by simpa using hy)
    have hh := HasC1CurveChart.preimage_isometry {z | μ z=1} v swapPlane hs
    have he : swapPlane ⁻¹' {z | μ z=1}={z | μ z=1} := by
      ext z
      simp only [mem_preimage,mem_ofPred_eq,μ,actualSourceTimeConstant_swap henv]
    rwa [he] at hh

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UniqueSuppo.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.norm_support_unique
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UniqueSuppo.text:
lemma norm_support_unique (μ : Plane → ℝ) (v : Plane) (ℓ g : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hd : HasFDerivAt μ ℓ v) (hg : g v=μ v) (hlower : ∀ w, g w ≤ μ w) : g=ℓ := by
  have hmin : IsLocalMin (fun w => μ w-g w) v := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro w
    have hv : μ v-g v=0 := by rw [hg]; ring
    change μ v-g v ≤ μ w-g w
    rw [hv]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hlower w)
  have he := hmin.hasFDerivAt_eq_zero (hd.sub g.hasFDerivAt)
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp he).symm

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.NormBoundar.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.ball_support_normalized
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.NormBoundar.text:
lemma ball_support_normalized (μ : Plane → ℝ) (hμ : TimeConstantNorm μ)
    (v : Plane) (_hv : μ v=1) (g : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ z, μ z ≤ 1 → g z ≤ g v) :
    ((g v)⁻¹ • g) v=1 ∧ ∀ z, ((g v)⁻¹ • g) z ≤ μ z := by
  have hc := ball_support_contact_pos μ hμ v g hg hs
  constructor
  · simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne']
  · intro z
    by_cases hz : z=0
    · subst z
      simp [(hμ.zero_iff 0).mpr rfl]
    · have hμz : 0 < μ z := lt_of_le_of_ne (hμ.nonneg z) (fun h => hz ((hμ.zero_iff z).mp h.symm))
      have hn : μ ((μ z)⁻¹ • z)=1 := by
        rw [hμ.homogeneous,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hμz),inv_mul_cancel₀ hμz.ne']
      have hh := hs ((μ z)⁻¹ • z) hn.le
      simp only [map_smul,smul_eq_mul] at hh
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh hμz.le
      rw [← mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ hμz.ne',one_mul] at hmul
      change (g v)⁻¹*g z ≤ μ z
      exact (inv_mul_le_iff₀ hc).mpr (by nlinarith)

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.NormBoundar.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.norm_ball_frontier
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.NormBoundar.text:
theorem norm_ball_frontier (μ : Plane → ℝ) (hμ : TimeConstantNorm μ) :
    frontier {v | μ v ≤ 1}={v | μ v=1} := by
  apply Subset.antisymm (frontier_le_subset_eq (timeConstantNorm_continuous μ hμ) continuous_const)
  intro v hv
  change μ v=1 at hv
  rw [frontier_eq_closure_inter_closure]
  refine ⟨subset_closure (show μ v ≤ 1 by exact hv.le),?_⟩
  have ht : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • v) (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 v) := by
    have hh : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => t • v) 1 := continuous_id.smul continuous_const |>.continuousAt
    simpa only [one_smul] using hh.mono_left (show 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝 (1 : ℝ) from nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
  apply mem_closure_of_tendsto ht
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
  change 1<t at ht
  change ¬μ (t • v) ≤ 1
  rw [hμ.homogeneous,hv,abs_of_pos (show 0<t by linarith)]
  linarith

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.BoundaryCur.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.actual_boundary_curve
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.BoundaryCur.text:
theorem actual_boundary_curve (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ) (v : Plane)
    (hv : v ∈ frontier {z | actualSourceTimeConstant z ≤ 1}) :
    HasC1CurveChart (frontier {z | actualSourceTimeConstant z ≤ 1}) v := by
  rw [norm_ball_frontier _ actualSourceTimeConstant_norm] at hv ⊢
  exact actual_sphere_curve_chart henv v hv

OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UnitSphereC.name: OAI.PlanarFPP.actual_contDiffAt_away
OAI.Probability.FirstPassage.UnitSphereC.text:
theorem actual_contDiffAt_away (henv : ExponentialEnvironment P τ) (v : Plane) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 actualSourceTimeConstant v := by
  by_cases hx : v 0 ≠ 0
  · exact actual_contDiffAt_horizontal henv v hx
  · have hy : v 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hy
      apply hv
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp_all
    have hswap : swapPlane v 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa using hy
    have hs := actual_contDiffAt_horizontal henv (swapPlane v) hswap
    have hh := hs.comp v swapPlane.toContinuousLinearEquiv.contDiff.contDiffAt
    have he : (fun z => actualSourceTimeConstant (swapPlane z))=actualSourceTimeConstant :=
      funext (actualSourceTimeConstant_swap henv)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,he] using hh

OAI.Combinatorics.PlanarL1.StepSuccess:1.name: OAI.PlanarL1.Parameters.successGain_pos
OAI.Combinatorics.PlanarL1.StepSuccess:1.text:
lemma successGain_pos : 0 < successGain := by
  unfold successGain
  refine lt_min Columns.Model.VertexTests.cutoffGain_pos ?_
  norm_num [kappaA,a₁,j,EA,epsilon,kappaB,a₂,R,lambda]

OAI.Combinatorics.PlanarL1.Schedule:50.name: OAI.PlanarL1.Parameters.exists_goodSpacing
OAI.Combinatorics.PlanarL1.Schedule:50.text:
lemma exists_goodSpacing : ∃ q : ℕ, GoodSpacing q := by
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 2 (max (2000/R) (max (20/persistenceRadius+1)
    (max (80*persistenceSlope+1) (6/successGain+1)))))
  have h2 : (2:ℝ)<q := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hq
  have hg : 2000/R<(q:ℝ) := (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)).trans_lt hq
  have hr : 20/persistenceRadius+1<(q:ℝ) := (le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
    (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))).trans_lt hq
  have hs : 80*persistenceSlope+1<(q:ℝ) := (le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
    (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))).trans_lt hq
  have hb : 6/successGain+1<(q:ℝ) := (le_trans (le_max_right _ _)
    (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))).trans_lt hq
  have hp : (0:ℝ)<q := by linarith
  have hp' : (0:ℝ)<q-1 := by linarith
  refine ⟨q,h2.le,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ (show (0:ℝ)<R by norm_num [R])).mp hg
    nlinarith
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ persistenceRadius_pos).mp (show 20/persistenceRadius<(q:ℝ) by linarith)
    linarith
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hp').mpr
    linarith
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hp').mpr
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ successGain_pos).mp (show 6/successGain<(q:ℝ)-1 by linarith)
    nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.PlanarL1.Embedding:96.name: OAI.PlanarL1.planar_graph_metrics_embed_L1
OAI.Combinatorics.PlanarL1.Embedding:96.text:
theorem planar_graph_metrics_embed_L1 : MainStatement := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q,g⟩ := exists_goodSpacing
  refine ⟨max 1 (2/(scheduleGain/(q:ℝ))),le_max_left _ _,?_⟩
  intro n G length hc hp hs hl
  let o : Fin n := Classical.choice hc.nonempty
  obtain ⟨s,L,hL,hd⟩ := Weighted.EnlargedTree.column_model_of_planar hc hs hl o hp
  cases s with
  | zero => exact (Fin.elim0 (L.column (Weighted.EnlargedTree.tree hc hs hl o).root))
  | succ k =>
    let A := L.ambient
    obtain ⟨Ω,measurable,μ,f,hf⟩ := A.exists_L1_embedding g (fun v => L.point (.inl v))
    refine ⟨Ω,measurable,μ,f,?_⟩
    intro x y
    have he : dist (L.point (.inl x)) (L.point (.inl y))=graphDistance G length x y := hd x y
    have hh := hf x y
    change (L.point (.inl x)).distance (L.point (.inl y)) ≤ ‖f x-f y‖ ∧
      ‖f x-f y‖ ≤ (2/(scheduleGain/(q:ℝ)))*(L.point (.inl x)).distance (L.point (.inl y)) at hh
    rw [hd x y] at hh
    refine ⟨hh.1,hh.2.trans ?_⟩
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _)
    rw [← he]
    exact dist_nonneg
end PlanarL1


end

end OAI

lemma column_model_of_planar (hp : IsPlanar G) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ L : (tree hc hs hl o).Layout n, ExactPairs L ∧
      ∀ u v : V, (L.point (.inl u)).distance (L.point (.inl v))=graphDistance G l u v := by
  obtain ⟨n,L,hL⟩ := exact_layout_of_planar hc hs hl o hp

OAI.Combinatorics.PlanarL1.PlanarMetric:.name: OAI.PlanarL1.Weighted.EnlargedTree.exact_layout_of_planar
OAI.Combinatorics.PlanarL1.PlanarMetric:.text:
lemma exact_layout_of_planar (hp : IsPlanar G) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ L : (tree hc hs hl o).Layout n, ExactPairs L := by
  classical
  let : LinearOrder V := LinearOrder.lift' (Fintype.equivFin V) (Fintype.equivFin V).injective
  by_cases hr : (tree hc hs hl o).IsLeaf (tree hc hs hl o).root
  · refine ⟨1,(tree hc hs hl o).rootLeafLayout hr,?_⟩
    intro i j
    constructor
    · intro h; exact h.elim
    · rintro ⟨d,_,_⟩
      have he := hr.ancestor_eq ((tree hc hs hl o).root_ancestor (.inr d))
      exact False.elim (Sum.inl_ne_inr he)
  · exact layout_of_planar hc hs hl o hp hr

OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.Basic:30.name: OAI.SharpPlanar.SharpCertificate
OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.Basic:30.text:
def SharpCertificate (f : SchwartzMap Plane ℝ) : Prop :=
  Radial f ∧ fourier f 0 = 1 ∧ f 0 = 2 / Real.sqrt 3 ∧
    (∀ ξ, (fourier f ξ).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (fourier f ξ).re) ∧
    (∀ x, 1 ≤ ‖x‖ → f x ≤ 0)

end SharpPlanar

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.text:
lemma normalizedCandidate_radial : Radial normalizedCandidate := by
  intro x y hxy
  simp only [normalizedCandidate_apply]
  rw [exactLeft_radial (scaleFactor • x) (scaleFactor • y) (by simp only [norm_smul,hxy])]

    fun ξ => ⟨normalizedCandidate_fourier_real ξ,normalizedCandidate_fourier_nonneg ξ⟩,

OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.name: OAI.SharpPlanar.normalizedCandidate_origin
OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.text:
lemma normalizedCandidate_origin : normalizedCandidate 0=2/Real.sqrt 3 := by
  rw [normalizedCandidate_apply,smul_zero]
  unfold normalizationConstant
  have hb := b_pos.ne'
  have he := exactLeft_origin_positive.ne'
  simp only [b]
  field_simp

OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.name: OAI.SharpPlanar.normalizedCandidate_fourier_real
OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.text:
lemma normalizedCandidate_fourier_real (ξ : Plane) : (fourier normalizedCandidate ξ).im=0 := by
  rw [normalizedCandidate_fourier]; rfl
end SharpPlanar

OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.Main:16.name: OAI.SharpPlanar.normalizedCandidate_fourier_nonneg
OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.Main:16.text:
lemma normalizedCandidate_fourier_nonneg (ξ : Plane) : 0≤(fourier normalizedCandidate ξ).re := by
  rw [normalizedCandidate_fourier]
  change 0≤exactRight (scaleFactor⁻¹ • ξ)/exactLeft 0
  apply div_nonneg _ exactLeft_origin_positive.le
  rw [exactRight_apply]
  apply mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hh:=global_sign_true (mul_nonneg b_pos.le (sq_nonneg ‖scaleFactor⁻¹ • ξ‖))
  rw [exactJet_zero_H₂] at hh
  simpa only [ite_true,one_mul] using hh

OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.Main:7.name: OAI.SharpPlanar.normalizedCandidate_nonpos
OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.Main:7.text:
lemma normalizedCandidate_nonpos {x : Plane} (hx : 1≤‖x‖) : normalizedCandidate x≤0 := by
  rw [normalizedCandidate_apply,exactLeft_apply,scaled_radius]
  apply mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos normalizationConstant_pos.le
  apply mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hs : (1:ℝ)≤‖x‖^2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hh:=global_sign_false hs
  rw [exactJet_zero_H₁] at hh
  norm_num at hh
  exact hh

OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.name: OAI.SharpPlanar.normalizedCandidate
OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.text:
noncomputable def normalizedCandidate : SchwartzMap Plane ℝ :=
  normalizationConstant • dilateSchwartz exactLeft scaleFactor scaleFactor_pos.ne'

OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.name: OAI.SharpPlanar.normalizedCandidate_fourier_origin
OAI.Analysis.PlanarPacking.NormalizedCan.text:
lemma normalizedCandidate_fourier_origin : fourier normalizedCandidate 0=1 := by
  rw [normalizedCandidate_fourier,smul_zero,← exact_origin_identity,div_self exactLeft_origin_positive.ne']
  norm_num

OAI.Geometry.UnitDistances.Obstruction:7.name: OAI.PlanarUnitDistances.AlgebraicObstruction.no_rectangles
OAI.Geometry.UnitDistances.Obstruction:7.text:
theorem no_rectangles (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hU : (U : Filter ℕ)≤atTop)
    (t J : ℕ → ℝ) (ht : Tendsto t (U : Filter ℕ) atTop)
    (hJ : Tendsto J (U : Filter ℕ) atTop) (P : ℕ → Finset ℂ)
    (hP : Upper (U : Filter ℕ) t (fun n => (P n).card) 1)
    (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ → Prop)
    (he : Lower (U : Filter ℕ) t
      (fun n => (GenericGrid.edges (fun n (a : P n) (b : P n) => E n a b) n).card) 2)
    (K : ℕ → Type) [∀ n,Field (K n)] [∀ n,NumberField (K n)] [∀ n,IsGalois ℚ (K n)]
    (e : ∀ n,K n →+* ℂ) (ell : ∀ n,ℂ → ℂ → K n)
    (H : Hypotheses U t J P E K e ell) : False := by
  classical
  have heP : Lower (U : Filter ℕ) t
      (fun n => mass (indicator (E n)) (P n) (P n)) 2 :=
    he.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (mass_indicator (P n) (P n) (E n)).symm)
  have hn n p r : 0 ≤ indicator (E n) p r := by unfold indicator; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hl n p r : indicator (E n) p r ≤ 1 := by unfold indicator; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  obtain ⟨A,B,d,hsub,heAB,hd,hlA,hlB,hca,hcb⟩ := DenseLoci.controlled_subsets U t ht
    P P (fun n => indicator (E n)) id star id star (fun n p _ r _ => hn n p r) hP hP heP
  have hA := DenseLoci.upper_card_subset U t hP (fun n => (hsub n).1)
  have hB := DenseLoci.upper_card_subset U t hP (fun n => (hsub n).2)
  have hAf := DenseLoci.lower_card_of_dense U t ht A B (fun n => indicator (E n))
    (fun n p _ r _ => hl n p r) hB heAB
  have hBf := DenseLoci.lower_card_of_dense U t ht B A (fun n r p => indicator (E n) p r)
    (fun n r _ p _ => hl n p r) hA
    (heAB.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun n => by unfold mass; exact Finset.sum_comm.symm))
  have heG : Lower (U : Filter ℕ) t
      (fun n => (GenericGrid.edges (fun n (a : A n) (b : B n) => E n a b) n).card) 2 :=
    heAB.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun n => mass_indicator (A n) (B n) (E n))
  rcases hca with hplane|hcurve
  · exact plane U hU t J ht hJ P A B E hsub hA hB heG K e ell H hplane
  · rcases hcb with hplane|hcurveB
    · exact curve_plane U hU t J ht hJ P A B E hsub hA hB hAf heG K e ell H hcurve hplane
    · exact curve_curve U hU t J ht hJ P A B E hsub hA hB hAf hBf heG K e ell H hcurve hcurveB
end PlanarUnitDistances.AlgebraicObstruction

theorem impossible (s : Sequence) : False := by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_data s
  let U := Filter.hyperfilter ℕ
  have hU : (U:Filter ℕ)≤atTop := Nat.hyperfilter_le_atTop
  exact AlgebraicObstruction.no_rectangles U hU D.t D.J (D.t_limit.mono_left hU)
    (D.J_limit.mono_left hU) D.P (fun ε hε => hU (D.card_power ε hε))
    D.E (fun ε hε => hU (D.edge_power ε hε)) D.K D.e D.ell (D.hypotheses U hU)

theorem exists_data (s : Sequence) : Nonempty (Data s) := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,h⟩ := IncidenceSelected.choose s
  choose a b hb h using fun n => h (delta n) (delta_pos n) (delta_le n)
  have hh (n : ℕ) : ∀ᶠi in atTop,∃R : Realization s (a n) i,∃J : ℝ,
      0<J ∧ (n:ℝ)+1≤J ∧
      s.t i^(2-1/((n:ℝ)+1))≤(IncidenceSelected.pairs R J (delta n)).card ∧
      2≤IncidencePopular.k s i := by
    filter_upwards [h n,(s.wedge_power.const_mul s.tendsto (hb n)) (1/((n:ℝ)+1)) (by positivity),
      (scale_limit s).eventually_ge_atTop (2*((n:ℝ)+1)/c),IncidencePopular.k_large s] with i hi hpow hscale hk
    obtain ⟨R,J,hJ,hJ',hcount⟩ := hi
    have hc' := (div_le_iff₀ hc).mp hscale
    exact ⟨R,J,hJ,by nlinarith,hpow.trans hcount,hk⟩
  obtain ⟨f,hf,h⟩ := PowerGrowth.diagonal hh
  choose R J hJ hj hd hk using h
  exact ⟨⟨f,hf,a,R,J,hJ,hj,hd,hk⟩⟩

theorem properColoring_seven_of_normalized_cover
    (hcover : ∀ x y : ℝ, ∃ a b : ℤ,
      (x - ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 +
        (y - Real.sqrt 3 * b / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) :
    ProperColoring 7 := by
  apply exists_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
    (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => triangularLattice p.1 p.2)
    (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => SevenLattice.colorFin p.1 p.2) (7 / 15 : ℝ)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hcover ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 0) ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 1)
    exact ⟨(a, b), dist_triangularLattice_le_of_coordinates x a b hab⟩
  · norm_num
  · intro i j hij hc
    have hq := SevenLattice.same_color_separation
      (SevenLattice.colorFin_injective_value hc) hij
    have hsep := triangularLattice_dist_gt_two i.1 i.2 j.1 j.2 hq
    linarith

theorem triangularLattice_dist_gt_two (a b c d : ℤ)

  have hr : (7 : ℝ) ≤ ((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 +
      ((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)*(b-d : ℤ) + ((b-d : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 := by
    exact_mod_cast h

  have hd := dist_nonneg (x := triangularLattice a b) (y := triangularLattice c d)

OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Covering:21.name: OAI.Problem160.triangular_rectangle_cover
OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Covering:21.text:
private theorem triangular_rectangle_cover (s x y : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hsq : s ^ 2 = 3)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1)
    (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ s / 2) :
    x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 ∨
    (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 ∨
    (x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 + (y - s / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  by_cases hx : x ≤ 1 / 2
  · by_cases hxy : s * y ≤ 1 - x
    · exact Or.inl (triangular_wedge_bound s x y hs hsq hx0 hx hy0 hxy)
    · right; right
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (1 / 2 - x) (s / 2 - y) hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith
  · by_cases hxy : s * y ≤ x
    · right; left
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (1 - x) y hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) hy0 (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    · right; right
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (x - 1 / 2) (s / 2 - y) hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith

OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Covering:47.name: OAI.Problem160.triangular_lattice_cover
OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Covering:47.text:
theorem triangular_lattice_cover (x y : ℝ) :
    ∃ m n : ℤ,
      (x - ((m : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 +
        (y - Real.sqrt 3 * (n : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt 3
  have hs : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)
  have hsq : s ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  let n : ℤ := ⌊2 * y / s⌋
  let m : ℤ := ⌊x - (n : ℝ) / 2⌋
  let u : ℝ := x - ((m : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) / 2)
  let v : ℝ := y - s * (n : ℝ) / 2
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y / s := Int.floor_le _
  have hn1 : 2 * y / s < (n : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≤ x - (n : ℝ) / 2 := Int.floor_le _
  have hm1 : x - (n : ℝ) / 2 < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hu1 : u ≤ 1 := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp hn0
    dsimp [v]
    nlinarith
  have hv1 : v ≤ s / 2 := by
    have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp hn1
    dsimp [v]
    nlinarith
  rcases triangular_rectangle_cover s u v hs hsq hu0 hu1 hv0 hv1 with h | h | h
  · exact ⟨m, n, h⟩
  · refine ⟨m + 1, n, ?_⟩
    have hu : x - (((m + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) / 2) = u - 1 := by
      dsimp [u]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hu]
    exact h
  · refine ⟨m, n + 1, ?_⟩
    have hu : x - ((m : ℝ) + ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2) = u - 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [u]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hv : y - Real.sqrt 3 * ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2 = v - s / 2 := by
      dsimp [v, s]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hu, hv]
    exact h

end Problem160

end

OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Assembly:12.name: OAI.Problem160.exists_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Assembly:12.text:
theorem exists_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
    {X I : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] {k : ℕ}
    (center : I → X) (color : I → Fin k) (r : ℝ)
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i : I, dist x (center i) ≤ r)
    (hdiam : 2 * r < 1)
    (hsep : ∀ i j : I, i ≠ j → color i = color j →
      1 + 2 * r < dist (center i) (center j)) :
    ∃ c : X → Fin k, ∀ x y : X, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y := by
  classical
  choose cell hcell using hcover
  refine ⟨fun x => color (cell x), ?_⟩
  intro x y hdist hcolor
  by_cases hsame : cell x = cell y
  · have htriangle := dist_triangle x (center (cell x)) y
    have hx := hcell x
    have hy := hcell y
    rw [← hsame] at hy
    rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) y] at htriangle
    linarith
  · have hfar := hsep (cell x) (cell y) hsame hcolor
    have htriangle₁ := dist_triangle (center (cell x)) x (center (cell y))
    have htriangle₂ := dist_triangle x y (center (cell y))
    have hx := hcell x
    have hy := hcell y
    rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) x] at htriangle₁
    linarith

end Problem160

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Metric:60.name: OAI.Problem160.dist_triangularLattice_le_of_coordinates
OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Metric:60.text:
theorem dist_triangularLattice_le_of_coordinates (x : Plane) (a b : ℤ)
    (h : ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 0 - ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)/2))^2 +
         ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 1 - Real.sqrt 3 * b / 2)^2 ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) :
    dist x (triangularLattice a b) ≤ (7 / 15 : ℝ) := by
  have heq := dist_triangularLattice_sq x a b
  have hd := dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := triangularLattice a b)
  nlinarith

end Problem160

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Al.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.templateSymmetryGroup
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Al.text:
def templateSymmetryGroup (D : SupportDatum W I B) : Subgroup (W ≃ₗ[ℝ] W) where
  carrier := {A | ∀ E : Set W, IsCompact E → E.Nonempty → Convex ℝ E →
    D.templateSupport (A '' E) = D.templateSupport E}
  one_mem' := by
    intro E _ _ _
    simp
  mul_mem' := by
    intro A C hA hC E hc hn hv
    have hh := hA (C '' E) (hc.image C.continuous_of_finiteDimensional)
      (hn.image C) (hv.linear_image C.toLinearMap)
    change D.templateSupport ((fun x => A (C x)) '' E) = _
    simpa only [Set.image_image, Function.comp_def] using hh.trans (hC E hc hn hv)
  inv_mem' := by
    intro A hA E hc hn hv
    have hh := hA (A.symm '' E) (hc.image A.symm.continuous_of_finiteDimensional)
      (hn.image A.symm) (hv.linear_image A.symm.toLinearMap)
    change D.templateSupport (A.symm '' E) = _
    simpa only [Set.image_image, Function.comp_def, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      Set.image_id'] using hh.symm

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.exists_bounded_leftInvariant_metric
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.text:
theorem exists_bounded_leftInvariant_metric
    {H : Type*} [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalGroup H]
    [FirstCountableTopology H] [T2Space H] :
    ∃ m : MetricSpace H,
      m.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace = ‹TopologicalSpace H› ∧
      (letI := m; IsIsometricSMul H H) ∧
      (letI := m; ∀ x y : H, dist x y ≤ 1) := by
  let u : UniformSpace H := IsTopologicalGroup.leftUniformSpace H
  let : UniformSpace H := u
  let : IsCountablyGenerated (𝓤 H) := by
    change IsCountablyGenerated (Filter.comap (fun p : H × H => p.1⁻¹ * p.2) (𝓝 1))
    infer_instance
  let : MetricSpace H := UniformSpace.metricSpace H
  let : IsLeftUniformGroup H :=
    { uniformity_eq := rfl }
  refine ⟨leftInvariantMetric (G := H), rfl, leftInvariantMetric_isometric, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  exact leftInvariantDistance_le_one x y

end PolycyclicRecognition

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.exists_additive_complex_adjoint_weights
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.text:
theorem exists_additive_complex_adjoint_weights
    [SimplyConnectedSpace G] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace G]
    (b : Basis (Fin m) ℝ (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G))
    (T : ComplexTriangularAdjoint (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G) n)
    {Exp : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G → G} (hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp) :
    ∃ π : G →* Multiplicative (Fin n → ℂ), Continuous (fun g => (π g).toAdd) ∧
      ∀ x, (π (Exp x)).toAdd = T.weightMap x := by
  apply exists_lifted_complex_matrix_weights (complexAdjointMatrixHom b T.basis)
    (continuous_complexAdjointMatrixHom b T.basis)
    (complexAdjointMatrixHom_upper b T hExp) T.weightMap Exp hExp.map_zero
    (fun x => (hExp.contMDiff_curve x).continuous)
  intro x i
  rw [complexAdjointMatrixHom_exp b T.basis hExp]
  simp only [complexifiedAdjointMatrix_apply]
  rw [complex_matrix_exp_diagonal _ (T.upper _)]
  rfl

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.LinearMetricChains
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.text:
structure LinearMetricChains (X : Type*) [PseudoMetricSpace X] where
  step : ℝ
  step_pos : 0 < step
  slope : ℝ
  slope_nonneg : 0 ≤ slope
  error : ℝ
  error_nonneg : 0 ≤ error
  chain : ∀ x y : X, ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → X),
    p 0 = x ∧ p n = y ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ slope * dist x y + error ∧
      ∀ i < n, dist (p i) (p (i + 1)) ≤ step

variable {X Y : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y]

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Al.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.isPolycyclic_finitelyGenerated_discrete_of_linear_nilpotent_kernel
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Al.text:
theorem isPolycyclic_finitelyGenerated_discrete_of_linear_nilpotent_kernel
    (I : LieIdeal ℝ (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G)) (hI : LieRing.IsNilpotent I)
    (d : E →ₗ[ℝ] W) (hd : Function.Surjective d)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker d = I.toSubmodule)
    (Exp : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G → G) (hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp)
    (π : G →* Multiplicative W) (hπ : Continuous π)
    (he : ∀ x, (π (Exp x)).toAdd = d x)
    (Γ : Subgroup G) [DiscreteTopology Γ] [Group.FG Γ] : IsPolycyclic Γ := by
  let f := π.comp Γ.subtype
  let K := f.ker.map Γ.subtype
  have hKΓ : (K : Set G) ⊆ (Γ : Set G) := by
    rintro g ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
    exact x.property
  let : DiscreteTopology K := DiscreteTopology.of_subset (inferInstance : DiscreteTopology Γ) hKΓ
  have hKker : K ≤ π.ker := by
    rintro g ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hx
  have hK := isPolycyclic_discrete_linear_nilpotent_kernel
    I hI d hd hker Exp hExp π hπ he K hKker
  let e := f.ker.equivMapOfInjective Γ.subtype Subtype.val_injective
  have hF : IsPolycyclic f.ker := hK.of_surjective e.symm.toMonoidHom e.symm.surjective
  have hQ : IsPolycyclic (Γ ⧸ f.ker) :=
    (isPolycyclic_equiv (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange f)).mpr
      (isPolycyclic_of_finitelyGenerated_commGroup f.range)
  exact isPolycyclic_of_normal_subgroup f.ker hF hQ

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.WordMetric.leftInvariant
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.text:
theorem leftInvariant : letI := P.normedGroup; IsIsometricSMul G G := by
  let := P.normedGroup
  refine ⟨fun g => Isometry.of_dist_eq (fun x y => ?_)⟩
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, dist_eq, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left]

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Al.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.lieRiemannianMetricInput
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Al.text:
theorem lieRiemannianMetricInput : LieRiemannianMetricInput := by
  intro S
  let groupTopology : IsTopologicalGroup S.carrier :=
    topologicalGroup_of_lieGroup (𝓘(ℝ, S.modelSpace)) ∞
  let localCompact : LocallyCompactSpace S.carrier :=
    Manifold.locallyCompact_of_finiteDimensional (𝓘(ℝ, S.modelSpace))
  let e : S.modelSpace ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ S.modelSpace)) :=
    (Module.finBasis ℝ S.modelSpace).equivFun.toContinuousLinearEquiv.trans
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ S.modelSpace)) ℝ).symm
  refine ⟨leftRiemannianMinimizingMetric e, ?_⟩
  rw [ProperChainMetric.compatibleMetric_eq]
  change letI := leftRiemannianMetric (G := S.carrier) e
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ₜ S.carrier),
      ContMDiff (𝓘(ℝ, Fin n → ℝ)) (𝓘(ℝ, S.modelSpace)) ∞ φ →
      ContMDiff (𝓘(ℝ, S.modelSpace)) (𝓘(ℝ, Fin n → ℝ)) ∞ φ.symm →
      LocallyLipschitz φ ∧ LocallyLipschitz φ.symm
  let metric := leftRiemannianMetric (G := S.carrier) e
  intro n φ hφ hφinv
  exact ⟨smooth_into_leftRiemannian_locallyLipschitz e hφ,
    smooth_from_leftRiemannian_locallyLipschitz e hφinv⟩

end PolycyclicRecognition

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Co.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.uniform_bounded_height
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Co.text:
theorem uniform_bounded_height
    (R : SimplyConnectedSolvableLieModel) (d : ProperChainMetric R.carrier)
    {a : ℕ} (T : TriangularAdjoint (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) R.carrier) a)
    (huni : ModelIsUnimodular R)
    {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] [FiniteDimensional ℝ W]
    (q : HeightSpace T.character ≃ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (Exp : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) R.carrier → R.carrier)
    (hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp) (π : R.carrier →* Multiplicative W)
    (hπExp : ∀ x, (π (Exp x)).toAdd = q (heightProjection T.character x)) :
    letI := d.compatibleMetric
    ∃ A : Subgroup (W ≃ₗ[ℝ] W), Set.Finite (A : Set (W ≃ₗ[ℝ] W)) ∧
      ∀ K C : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → 0 ≤ C → ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
        ∀ F : SelfQuasiIsometry R.carrier K C, ∃ AF : A, ∀ g,
          ‖(π (F.toFun g)).toAdd - ((π (F.toFun 1)).toAdd + AF.val (π g).toAdd)‖ ≤ B := by
  classical
  let : IsTopologicalGroup R.carrier :=
    topologicalGroup_of_lieGroup (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) ⊤
  let : LocallyCompactSpace R.carrier :=
    Manifold.locallyCompact_of_finiteDimensional (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace))
  let : MeasurableSpace R.carrier := borel _
  let : BorelSpace R.carrier := ⟨rfl⟩
  let m : Measure R.carrier := Measure.haar
  let : m.IsMulRightInvariant := huni
  obtain ⟨d₀, hcompat⟩ := lieRiemannianMetricInput R
  let := d₀.toProperChainMetric.compatibleMetric
  let := d₀.toProperChainMetric.proper_compatibleMetric
  let := d₀.toProperChainMetric.isometric_compatibleMetric
  let V := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (finrank ℝ (HeightSpace T.character)))
  let q₀ : HeightSpace T.character ≃ₗ[ℝ] V :=
    LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ (by simp [V])
  obtain ⟨π₀, hπ₀Exp, _, _, L, hL, hπ₀Lip⟩ :=
    exists_lipschitz_intrinsic_canonical_height T q₀ d₀.toProperChainMetric.chains_compatibleMetric hExp
  let e : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] W := q₀.symm.trans q
  have hπe (g : R.carrier) : (π g).toAdd = e (π₀ g).toAdd := by
    apply height_eq_of_exponential_linear hExp π π₀ e.toLinearMap
    intro x
    rw [hπExp, hπ₀Exp]
    simp [e]
  have hπ₀ : LipschitzWith (⟨L, hL⟩ : ℝ≥0) (fun g => (π₀ g).toAdd) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x y
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    exact hπ₀Lip x y
  obtain ⟨n, φ, hφ0, hf, hb⟩ :=
    exists_intrinsic_smooth_coordinates T q₀ Exp hExp π₀ hπ₀.continuous hπ₀Exp
  obtain ⟨hfLip, hbLip⟩ := hcompat n φ hf hb
  let c := ControlledContraction.ofChart φ hφ0 hfLip hbLip
  have hunimod (x : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) R.carrier) :
      LinearMap.trace ℝ _ (ad ℝ _ x) = 0 :=
    trace_ad_eq_zero_of_intrinsic_kernel_haar T q₀ Exp hExp π₀ hπ₀.continuous hπ₀Exp m x
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := LieAlgebra.exists_isCartanSubalgebra_engel ℝ
    (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) R.carrier)
  let H := LieSubalgebra.engel ℝ x
  let : H.IsCartanSubalgebra := hx
  obtain ⟨M⟩ := nonempty_cartanWordModel H T
  let D := M.supportIn T hunimod q₀
  have hheight := M.exists_uniform_height_intrinsic T hunimod q₀ Exp hExp
    m π₀ hπ₀Exp hπ₀
    d₀.minimizing_compatibleMetric remezPolynomialInput geodesicMetricExistenceInput
  let A := (templateSymmetryGroup D).map (heightConjugation e)
  refine ⟨A, finite_heightConjugation e (templateSymmetryGroup D), ?_⟩
  intro K C hK hC
  let Q := @SelfQuasiIsometry R.carrier d.compatibleMetric.toPseudoMetricSpace K C
  let f : Q → R.carrier → R.carrier := by
    let := d.compatibleMetric
    exact fun F => F.toFun
  let g : Q → R.carrier → R.carrier := by
    let := d.compatibleMetric
    exact fun F => F.inverse
  have hK₀ : 0 ≤ K := le_trans zero_le_one hK
  have hf : letI := d.compatibleMetric
      ∀ F x y, dist (f F x) (f F y) ≤ K * dist x y + (C + 3 * K * C) := by
    let := d.compatibleMetric
    intro F x y
    exact (F.upper x y).trans (by nlinarith)
  have hg : letI := d.compatibleMetric
      ∀ F x y, dist (g F x) (g F y) ≤ K * dist x y + (C + 3 * K * C) := by
    let := d.compatibleMetric
    intro F x y
    exact (F.inverse_upper hK₀ x y).trans (by linarith)
  have hgf : letI := d.compatibleMetric
      ∀ F x, dist (g F (f F x)) x ≤ C + 2 * K * C := by
    let := d.compatibleMetric
    intro F x
    exact (F.left_inverse_close hK₀ x).trans (by linarith)
  have hfg : letI := d.compatibleMetric
      ∀ F x, dist (f F (g F x)) x ≤ C + 2 * K * C := by
    let := d.compatibleMetric
    intro F x
    exact ((dist_comm _ _).trans_le (F.inverse_close x)).trans (by nlinarith)
  obtain ⟨κ, ξ, ε, hκ, hξ, _, hf', hg', hgf', hfg'⟩ :=
    coarse_pair_metric_change d d₀.toProperChainMetric hK₀
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ C + 3 * K * C) (by positivity : 0 ≤ C + 2 * K * C)
      f g hf hg hgf hfg
  obtain ⟨label, B, hB, hbound⟩ := uniform_affine_height_of_coarse_inverse_pairs
    c d₀.minimizing_compatibleMetric D π₀ hL hπ₀Lip hheight
    hκ hξ f g hf' hg' hgf' hfg'
  refine ⟨‖e.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * B,
    mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hB, ?_⟩
  intro F
  refine ⟨⟨heightConjugation e (label F).val, ?_⟩, fun y => ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨(label F).val, (label F).property, rfl⟩
  · simp only [hπe]
    exact norm_height_difference_le e _ _ _ (label F).val (hbound F y)

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.groupExponential_isGroupExponential
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.text:
theorem groupExponential_isGroupExponential :
    IsGroupExponential (groupExponential (E := E) (G := G)) where
  map_zero := by
    have h := groupExponential_smul (0 : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G) 0
    simpa only [zero_smul, invariantCurve_zero] using h
  map_add_smul v s t := by
    simp only [groupExponential_smul, invariantCurve_add]
  hasMFDerivAt_zero v := by
    have hv : mulInvariantVectorField v (1 : G) = v := by
      unfold mulInvariantVectorField
      rw [show (fun x : G => 1 * x) = id from funext one_mul, mfderiv_id]
      rfl
    have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => groupExponential (t • v)) = invariantCurve v :=
      funext (groupExponential_smul v)
    rw [hfun]
    apply (invariantCurve_isMIntegralCurve v 0).congr_mfderiv
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro r
    let s : ℝ := r
    change s • mulInvariantVectorField v (invariantCurve v 0) = s • v
    congr 1
    have heq : (mulInvariantVectorField v (invariantCurve v 0) : E) =
        (mulInvariantVectorField v 1 : E) := by
      congr 1
      exact invariantCurve_zero v
    exact heq.trans hv

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.text:
theorem exists_intrinsic_smooth_coordinates
    {a : ℕ} (T : TriangularAdjoint (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G) a)
    (q : HeightSpace T.character ≃ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (Exp : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G → G) (hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp)
    (π : G →* Multiplicative W) (hπ : Continuous π)
    (he : ∀ x, (π (Exp x)).toAdd = q (heightProjection T.character x)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (φ : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ₜ G), φ 0 = 1 ∧
      ContMDiff (𝓘(ℝ, Fin n → ℝ)) (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ φ ∧
      ContMDiff (𝓘(ℝ, E)) (𝓘(ℝ, Fin n → ℝ)) ∞ φ.symm := by
  obtain ⟨φ, h0, hf, hb⟩ := exists_intrinsic_smooth_product_coordinates T q Exp hExp π hπ he
  let V := (Fin (finrank ℝ T.kernelIdeal) → ℝ) × W
  let e := (finBasis ℝ V).equivFun.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
  refine ⟨finrank ℝ V, e.toHomeomorph.trans φ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change φ (e 0) = 1
    rw [map_zero, h0]
  · exact hf.comp e.contDiff.contMDiff
  · exact e.symm.contDiff.contMDiff.comp hb

end PolycyclicRecognition

    Exp ((s + t) • v) = Exp (s • v) * Exp (t • v)
  hasMFDerivAt_zero : ∀ v : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G,
    HasMFDerivAt (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)) (𝓘(ℝ, E)) (fun t : ℝ => Exp (t • v)) 0
      (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) v)

theorem isPolycyclic_finitelyGenerated_discrete_solvableLieGroup
    {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [MetricSpace G] [ChartedSpace E G] [Group G] [LieGroup (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ⊤ G]
    [SimplyConnectedSpace G] [Group.IsSolvable G]
    (Γ : Subgroup G) [DiscreteTopology Γ] [Group.FG Γ] : IsPolycyclic Γ := by
  let L := GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G
  let : IsTopologicalGroup G := topologicalGroup_of_lieGroup (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ⊤
  let : LocallyPathConnectedSpace G := ChartedSpace.locallyPathConnectedSpace E G
  let : LieAlgebra.IsSolvable L := groupLieAlgebra_isSolvable (E := E) (G := G)
  obtain ⟨n, b, hb⟩ := exists_complex_triangular_adjoint_basis L
  let T : ComplexTriangularAdjoint L n := ⟨b, hb⟩
  let Exp := groupExponential (E := E) (G := G)
  have hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp := groupExponential_isGroupExponential
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, he⟩ := exists_additive_complex_adjoint_weights (Module.finBasis ℝ L) T hExp
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩ := exists_range_restricted_complex_weights hExp T.weightMap π hπ he
  exact isPolycyclic_finitelyGenerated_discrete_of_linear_nilpotent_kernel
    T.kernelIdeal T.kernelIdeal_nilpotent T.weightMap.rangeRestrict
    T.weightMap.surjective_rangeRestrict (LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict T.weightMap)
    Exp hExp q hq hqe Γ

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Re.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.recognition_and_lattice_of_gromov
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Re.text:
theorem recognition_and_lattice_of_gromov
    (gromov : ∀ (K : Type) [Group K] [DecidableEq K], GromovPolynomialGrowthInput K)
    {P J : Type} [Group P] [Group J] [MetricSpace P] [MetricSpace J]
    [IsIsometricSMul P P] [IsIsometricSMul J J] [Group.FG P] [Group.FG J]
    [DiscreteTopology J] [ProperSpace J]
    [MeasurableSpace J] [BorelSpace J] [MeasurableMul J]
    (e : MetricQuasiEquivalence P J) (hP : IsVirtuallyPolycyclic P)
    (CP : LinearMetricChains P)
    (hPfinite : ∀ r : ℝ, (Metric.closedBall (1 : P) r).Finite) :
    IsVirtuallyPolycyclic J ∧
      ∃ Γ : Subgroup J, Γ.FiniteIndex ∧
        ∃ (S : SimplyConnectedSolvableLieModel) (Λ : Subgroup S.carrier),
          IsUniformLattice Λ ∧ Nonempty (Γ ≃* Λ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ, S, Λ, hΛ, ⟨iso⟩⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_solvable_lattice_of_virtuallyPolycyclic dekimpeLatticeRealizationInput P hP
  obtain ⟨R, a, T, dS, dR, hmodel⟩ :=
    exists_intrinsic_height_model_with_controlled_contraction cornulierTesseraModelInput
      geodesicMetricExistenceInput lieRiemannianMetricInput matrixLieDifferentialInput S
  let := dS.compatibleMetric
  let := dR.toProperChainMetric.compatibleMetric
  let := dS.proper_compatibleMetric
  let := dS.isometric_compatibleMetric
  let := dR.toProperChainMetric.proper_compatibleMetric
  let := dR.toProperChainMetric.isometric_compatibleMetric
  let : IsTopologicalGroup S.carrier :=
    topologicalGroup_of_lieGroup (𝓘(ℝ, S.modelSpace)) ⊤
  let : IsTopologicalGroup R.carrier :=
    topologicalGroup_of_lieGroup (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) ⊤
  let : MeasurableSpace R.carrier := borel _
  let : BorelSpace R.carrier := ⟨rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨eSR⟩, ⟨c⟩, q, Exp, π, hExp, hπExp, _, _, K, hK, hπLip⟩ := hmodel
  obtain ⟨ePS⟩ := nonempty_original_lattice_comparison CP hPfinite Γ hΓ S Λ hΛ iso dS
  let u := e.symm.trans (ePS.trans eSR)
  let m : Measure R.carrier := Measure.haar
  let : m.IsMulRightInvariant :=
    SimplyConnectedSolvableLieModel.isMulRightInvariant_of_lattice_comparison
      isPolycyclic_uniformLattice_solvableLieGroup S R Λ hΛ
      dS dR.toProperChainMetric eSR m
  have hπ : LipschitzWith (⟨K, hK⟩ : ℝ≥0) (fun g => (π g).toAdd) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x y
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    exact hπLip x y
  have hunimod (x : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) R.carrier) :
      LinearMap.trace ℝ _ (ad ℝ _ x) = 0 :=
    trace_ad_eq_zero_of_intrinsic_kernel_haar T q Exp hExp π hπ.continuous hπExp m x
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := LieAlgebra.exists_isCartanSubalgebra_engel ℝ
    (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) R.carrier)
  let H := LieSubalgebra.engel ℝ x
  let : H.IsCartanSubalgebra := hx
  obtain ⟨M⟩ := nonempty_cartanWordModel H T
  have hheight := M.exists_uniform_height_intrinsic T hunimod q Exp hExp
    m π hπExp hπ
    dR.minimizing_compatibleMetric remezPolynomialInput geodesicMetricExistenceInput
  exact recognition_and_lattice_of_uniform_normalized_height_proved dekimpeLatticeRealizationInput
    e hP hPfinite T _ q π Exp hExp hπExp u gromov (M.supportIn T hunimod q)
    hπ c dR.minimizing_compatibleMetric hheight

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.ControlledContraction.ofChart
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.text:
def ofChart (φ : E ≃ₜ G) (hφ : φ 0 = 1)
    (hf : LocallyLipschitz φ) (hb : LocallyLipschitz φ.symm) : ControlledContraction G where
  contract p s z := p * chartContraction φ s (p⁻¹ * z)
  zero p z := by simp [hφ]
  one p z := by simp
  bounds R hR := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC, htime, hspace⟩ := chartContraction_bounds φ hφ hf hb hR
    refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
    intro p z w hz hw s hs t ht
    have hzp : p⁻¹ * z ∈ closedBall (1 : G) R := by
      change dist (p⁻¹ * z) 1 ≤ R
      calc
        _ = dist z p := by simpa using dist_mul_left p⁻¹ z p
        _ ≤ R := hz
    have hwp : p⁻¹ * w ∈ closedBall (1 : G) R := by
      change dist (p⁻¹ * w) 1 ≤ R
      calc
        _ = dist w p := by simpa using dist_mul_left p⁻¹ w p
        _ ≤ R := hw
    rw [dist_mul_left]
    rcases le_total s t with hst | hts
    · have h₁ := hspace s hs _ hzp _ hwp
      have h₂ := htime s hs t ht _ hwp
      rw [dist_mul_left] at h₁
      have h := dist_triangle (chartContraction φ s (p⁻¹ * z))
        (chartContraction φ s (p⁻¹ * w)) (chartContraction φ t (p⁻¹ * w))
      rw [min_eq_left hst]
      linarith
    · have h₁ := htime s hs t ht _ hzp
      have h₂ := hspace t ht _ hzp _ hwp
      rw [dist_mul_left] at h₂
      have h := dist_triangle (chartContraction φ s (p⁻¹ * z))
        (chartContraction φ t (p⁻¹ * z)) (chartContraction φ t (p⁻¹ * w))
      rw [min_eq_right hts]
      linarith

end ControlledContraction
end PolycyclicRecognition

end
