OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.exists_compact_symmetric_generating_neighborhood
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.text:
theorem exists_compact_symmetric_generating_neighborhood
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [LocallyCompactSpace G] {L : Set G} (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure L = ⊤) :
    ∃ K : Set G, IsCompact K ∧ K ∈ 𝓝 (1 : G) ∧
      Subgroup.closure K = ⊤ ∧ ∀ g : G, g⁻¹ ∈ K ↔ g ∈ K := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUn⟩ := exists_compact_mem_nhds (1 : G)
  let Q := L ∪ U
  let K := Q ∪ Q⁻¹
  have hQ : IsCompact Q := hL.union hU
  refine ⟨K, hQ.union hQ.inv, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact mem_of_superset hUn (by intro x hx; exact Or.inl (Or.inr hx))
  · apply top_unique
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Subgroup.closure_mono (by intro x hx; exact Or.inl (Or.inl hx))
  · intro g
    simp only [K, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inv, inv_inv]
    exact or_comm

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.coarse_pair_metric_change
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.text:
theorem coarse_pair_metric_change
    {G P : Type} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
    (d₁ d₂ : ProperChainMetric G) {κ ξ ε : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (f g : P → G → G)
    (hf : letI := d₁.compatibleMetric
      ∀ p x y, dist (f p x) (f p y) ≤ κ * dist x y + ξ)
    (hg : letI := d₁.compatibleMetric
      ∀ p x y, dist (g p x) (g p y) ≤ κ * dist x y + ξ)
    (hgf : letI := d₁.compatibleMetric; ∀ p x, dist (g p (f p x)) x ≤ ε)
    (hfg : letI := d₁.compatibleMetric; ∀ p x, dist (f p (g p x)) x ≤ ε) :
    letI := d₂.compatibleMetric
    ∃ κ' ξ' ε' : ℝ, 0 ≤ κ' ∧ 0 ≤ ξ' ∧ 0 ≤ ε' ∧
      (∀ p x y, dist (f p x) (f p y) ≤ κ' * dist x y + ξ') ∧
      (∀ p x y, dist (g p x) (g p y) ≤ κ' * dist x y + ξ') ∧
      (∀ p x, dist (g p (f p x)) x ≤ ε') ∧
      (∀ p x, dist (f p (g p x)) x ≤ ε') := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, h₁₂⟩ := d₁.compare d₂
  obtain ⟨a', b', ha', hb', h₂₁⟩ := d₂.compare d₁
  let := d₂.compatibleMetric
  let oldDist := @dist G d₁.compatibleMetric.toPseudoMetricSpace.toDist
  have hcontrol (F : P → G → G)
      (hF : ∀ p x y, oldDist (F p x) (F p y) ≤ κ * oldDist x y + ξ) :
      ∀ p x y, dist (F p x) (F p y) ≤
        (a * κ * a') * dist x y + (a * κ * b' + a * ξ + b) := by
    intro p x y
    calc
      _ ≤ a * oldDist (F p x) (F p y) + b := h₁₂ _ _
      _ ≤ a * (κ * oldDist x y + ξ) + b := by gcongr; exact hF p x y
      _ ≤ a * (κ * (a' * dist x y + b') + ξ) + b := by gcongr; exact h₂₁ x y
      _ = _ := by ring
  refine ⟨a * κ * a', a * κ * b' + a * ξ + b, a * ε + b,
    by positivity, by positivity, by positivity, hcontrol f hf, hcontrol g hg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p x
    exact (h₁₂ _ _).trans (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgf p x) ha) le_rfl)
  · intro p x
    exact (h₁₂ _ _).trans (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfg p x) ha) le_rfl)

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

end OAI

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.exists_range_restricted_complex_weights
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.text:
theorem exists_range_restricted_complex_weights
    {Exp : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G → G} (hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp)
    (d : E →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℂ)) (π : G →* Multiplicative (Fin n → ℂ))
    (hπ : Continuous (fun g => (π g).toAdd))
    (he : ∀ x, (π (Exp x)).toAdd = d x) :
    ∃ q : G →* Multiplicative d.range, Continuous (fun g => (q g).toAdd) ∧
      ∀ x, (q (Exp x)).toAdd = d.rangeRestrict x := by
  let S : Subgroup G :=
    { carrier := {g | (π g).toAdd ∈ d.range}
      one_mem' := by
        change (π 1).toAdd ∈ d.range
        rw [map_one]
        exact d.range.zero_mem
      mul_mem' := by
        intro g h hg hh
        change (π (g * h)).toAdd ∈ d.range
        rw [map_mul]
        exact d.range.add_mem hg hh
      inv_mem' := by
        intro g hg
        change (π g⁻¹).toAdd ∈ d.range
        rw [map_inv]
        exact d.range.neg_mem hg }
  have hex (x : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G) : (π (Exp x)).toAdd ∈ d.range := by
    rw [he]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self d _
  have hS : S = ⊤ := by
    apply subgroup_eq_top_of_exponential_basis hExp (Module.finBasis ℝ E)
    intro i t
    exact hex _
  have hmem (g : G) : (π g).toAdd ∈ d.range := by
    change g ∈ S
    rw [hS]
    trivial
  let q : G →* Multiplicative d.range :=
    { toFun := fun g => Multiplicative.ofAdd ⟨(π g).toAdd, hmem g⟩
      map_one' := by apply Multiplicative.ext; apply Subtype.ext; exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd π.map_one
      map_mul' := by
        intro g h
        apply Multiplicative.ext
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (π.map_mul g h) }
  refine ⟨q, hπ.subtype_mk hmem, fun x => ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact he x

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Al.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.hasPolynomialGrowth_of_wordBall
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Al.text:
theorem hasPolynomialGrowth_of_wordBall (T : Finset J)
    (hT : ∀ t ∈ T, t⁻¹ ∈ T)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (T : Set J) = ⊤)
    (hgrowth : ∃ C b : ℕ, ∀ n, (wordBall T n).card ≤ C * (1 + n) ^ b) :
    FormalConjecturesCheck.HasPolynomialGrowth J := by
  obtain ⟨C, b, h⟩ := hgrowth
  refine ⟨(T : Set J), T.finite_toSet, hgen, ((C : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ b, b,
    mul_pos (by positivity) (by positivity), ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  rw [growthFunction_eq_card_wordBall T hT]
  have hcard : ((wordBall T n).card : ℝ) ≤ (C : ℝ) * (1 + (n : ℝ)) ^ b := by
    exact_mod_cast h n
  have hshift : (1 : ℝ) + n ≤ 2 * n := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    linarith
  calc
    ((wordBall T n).card : ℝ) ≤ (C : ℝ) * (1 + (n : ℝ)) ^ b := hcard
    _ ≤ ((C : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * (n : ℝ)) ^ b := by gcongr; linarith
    _ = (((C : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ b) * (n : ℝ) ^ b := by rw [mul_pow]; ring

end PolycyclicRecognition

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.geodesicMetricExistenceInput
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.text:
theorem geodesicMetricExistenceInput : GeodesicMetricExistenceInput := by
  intro G _ _ _ _ _ _ hgen
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hiso, hbound⟩ := exists_bounded_leftInvariant_metric (H := G)
  let mc : MetricSpace G := m.replaceTopology hm.symm
  have hmc : mc = m := m.replaceTopology_eq hm.symm
  let := mc
  have hi : IsIsometricSMul G G :=
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun d : MetricSpace G => letI := d; IsIsometricSMul G G) hmc.symm) hiso
  let := hi
  have hb : ∀ x y : G, dist x y ≤ 1 :=
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun d : MetricSpace G => letI := d; ∀ x y : G, dist x y ≤ 1) hmc.symm) hbound
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hLgen⟩ := hgen
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hKn, hKgen, hKsymm⟩ :=
    exists_compact_symmetric_generating_neighborhood hL hLgen
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεK⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hKn
  let δ := min 1 (ε / 2)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min zero_lt_one (half_pos hε)
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hball : ∀ g : G, dist 1 g ≤ δ → g ∈ K := by
    intro g hg
    apply hεK
    change dist g 1 < ε
    rw [dist_comm]
    exact hg.trans_lt ((min_le_right 1 (ε / 2)).trans_lt (half_lt_self hε))
  exact ⟨weightedProperChainMetric K hKgen hKsymm hb δ hδ hδ1 hball hK⟩

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.text:
theorem groupLieAlgebra_isSolvable :
    LieAlgebra.IsSolvable (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G) := by
  let L := GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G
  let A := E →L[ℝ] E
  let ρ : G →* Aˣ := (conjugationDifferentialHom (E := E) (G := G)).toHomUnits
  let R := algebraGroupTangentLie ρ.range
  let : Group.IsSolvable ρ.range :=
    Group.isSolvable_of_surjective (f := ρ.rangeRestrict) ρ.rangeRestrict_surjective
  let : LieAlgebra.IsSolvable R := algebraGroupTangentLie_isSolvable ρ.range
  let j₀ : L →ₗ⁅ℝ⁆ A :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := groupAdjointOperator
          map_add' := by
            intro x y
            ext z
            exact congrArg (fun w : L => (w : E)) (add_lie x y (show L from z))
          map_smul' := by
            intro r x
            ext z
            exact congrArg (fun w : L => (w : E)) (smul_lie r x (show L from z)) }
      map_lie' := by
        intro x y
        ext z
        exact congrArg (fun w : L => (w : E)) (lie_lie x y (show L from z)) }
  have hmem (v : L) : j₀ v ∈ R := by
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    let Exp := groupExponential (E := E) (G := G)
    have hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp := groupExponential_isGroupExponential
    refine ⟨fun t => ρ (Exp (t • v)), fun t => ⟨Exp (t • v), rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change ρ (Exp (0 • v)) = 1
      rw [zero_smul, hExp.map_zero, map_one]
    · have h := hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const (j₀ v) (0 : ℝ)
      simp only [zero_smul, NormedSpace.exp_zero, one_mul] at h
      convert h using 1
      funext t
      exact adjointLinearMap_exponential hExp v t
  let j : L →ₗ⁅ℝ⁆ R :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨j₀ x, hmem x⟩
      map_add' := fun x y => Subtype.ext (j₀.map_add x y)
      map_smul' := fun r x => Subtype.ext (j₀.map_smul r x)
      map_lie' := fun {x y} => Subtype.ext (j₀.map_lie x y) }
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := LieAlgebra.IsSolvable.solvable ℝ R
  have hjzero (x : L) (hx : x ∈ LieAlgebra.derivedSeries ℝ L n) : j x = 0 := by
    have hm := LieIdeal.derivedSeries_map_le (f := j) n (LieIdeal.mem_map hx)
    rwa [hn] at hm
  apply (LieAlgebra.isSolvable_iff ℝ L).mpr
  refine ⟨n + 1, le_antisymm ?_ bot_le⟩
  have hz : (LieAlgebra.derivedSeries ℝ L (n + 1)).toSubmodule ≤ ⊥ := by
    rw [LieAlgebra.derivedSeries_def, LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ,
      LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span']
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, _, rfl⟩
    change ⁅x, y⁆ = 0
    have hzero : j₀ x = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val (hjzero x hx)
    exact congrArg (fun f : A => f y) hzero
  exact hz

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

theorem height_eq_of_exponential_linear
    {W W' : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℝ W] [AddCommGroup W'] [Module ℝ W']
    {Exp : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G → G} (hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp)
    (π : G →* Multiplicative W) (ψ : G →* Multiplicative W') (e : W' →ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (he : ∀ x, (π (Exp x)).toAdd = e (ψ (Exp x)).toAdd) :
    ∀ g, (π g).toAdd = e (ψ g).toAdd := by
  let τ : G →* Multiplicative W :=
    { toFun := fun g => Multiplicative.ofAdd (e (ψ g).toAdd)
      map_one' := by simp
      map_mul' := by intro g h; simp only [map_mul, toAdd_mul, map_add]; rfl }
  have h : π = τ := monoidHom_ext_exponential hExp π τ
    (fun x => Multiplicative.ext (he x))
  intro g
  exact congrArg (fun f : G →* Multiplicative W => (f g).toAdd) h

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.ProperChainMetric
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.text:
structure ProperChainMetric (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] where
  metric : MetricSpace G
  topology_eq : metric.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace = ‹TopologicalSpace G›
  proper : letI := metric; ProperSpace G
  leftInvariant : letI := metric; IsIsometricSMul G G
  chains : letI := metric; LinearMetricChains G

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.trace_ad_eq_zero_of_intrinsic_kernel_haar
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.An.text:
theorem trace_ad_eq_zero_of_intrinsic_kernel_haar
    {a : ℕ} (T : TriangularAdjoint (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G) a)
    (q : HeightSpace T.character ≃ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (Exp : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G → G) (hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp)
    (π : G →* Multiplicative W) (hπ : Continuous π)
    (hπExp : ∀ v, (π (Exp v)).toAdd = q (heightProjection T.character v))
    (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.IsMulRightInvariant]
    (x : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, E)) G) : LinearMap.trace ℝ _ (ad ℝ _ x) = 0 := by
  let d := q.toLinearMap.comp (heightProjection T.character)
  have hd : Function.Surjective d := q.surjective.comp (heightProjection_surjective T.character)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, _, hsright⟩ :=
    exists_continuous_section_of_exponential_linear_quotient hExp d hd π hπExp
  let sC : C(Multiplicative W, G) := ⟨fun w => s w.toAdd, hs⟩
  have hsC (w : Multiplicative W) : π (sC w) = w := Multiplicative.ext (hsright w.toAdd)
  obtain ⟨N, ExpN, hExpN, ι, hι, _, hιExp, hrange⟩ :=
    exists_closed_intrinsic_height_kernel T q Exp hExp π hπ hπExp
  let b := finBasis ℝ T.kernelIdeal
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hhaar, hright⟩ := exists_height_kernel_coordinates T Exp hExp π N
    (nilpotentPublishedInputs.haar T.kernelIdeal N) ExpN hExpN ι hι hιExp hrange b
  have hdet := abs_det_conjugationDifferential_eq_one_of_height_coordinates
    T q Exp hExp π hπ hπExp sC hsC b c hc hhaar hright μ (Exp x)
  obtain ⟨m, _, j, ρ, _, _, _, _, hρ, he⟩ :=
    exists_intrinsic_faithful_triangular_representation T Exp hExp
  rw [det_conjugationDifferential_exp T hExp j ρ hρ he,
    abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] at hdet
  exact (Real.exp_eq_one_iff _).mp hdet

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

end OAI

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Re.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.group_recognition_of_gromov
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Re.text:
theorem group_recognition_of_gromov
    (gromov : ∀ (K : Type) [Group K] [DecidableEq K], GromovPolynomialGrowthInput K)
    {P J : Type} [Group P] [Group J] [Group.FG P] [Group.FG J]
    (e : GroupCoarseEquivalence P J) (hP : IsVirtuallyPolycyclic P) :
    IsVirtuallyPolycyclic J ∧
      ∃ Γ : Subgroup J, Γ.FiniteIndex ∧
        ∃ (S : SimplyConnectedSolvableLieModel) (Λ : Subgroup S.carrier),
          IsUniformLattice Λ ∧ Nonempty (Γ ≃* Λ) := by
  obtain ⟨dP, hPd, hPi, hPp, ⟨CP⟩⟩ := exists_finite_word_metric P
  let := dP
  let := hPd
  let := hPi
  let := hPp
  obtain ⟨dJ, hJd, hJi, hJp, ⟨CJ⟩⟩ := exists_finite_word_metric J
  let := dJ
  let := hJd
  let := hJi
  let := hJp
  let : MeasurableSpace J := borel _
  let : BorelSpace J := ⟨rfl⟩
  have hPfinite (r : ℝ) : (Metric.closedBall (1 : P) r).Finite :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (1 : P) r).finite_of_discrete
  have hJfinite (r : ℝ) : (Metric.closedBall (1 : J) r).Finite :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (1 : J) r).finite_of_discrete
  exact recognition_and_lattice_of_gromov gromov
    (e.metric CP CJ hPfinite hJfinite) hP CP hPfinite

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.uniform_affine_height_of_coarse_inverse_pairs
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Ge.text:
theorem uniform_affine_height_of_coarse_inverse_pairs
    (c : ControlledContraction G)
    (hpath : ∀ g : G, ∃ γ : ℝ → G, γ 0 = 1 ∧ γ 1 = g ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        dist (γ t) (γ s) ≤ dist 1 g * |t - s|)
    (D : SupportDatum W I B₀) (π : G →* Multiplicative W)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hπ : ∀ x y, ‖(π x).toAdd - (π y).toAdd‖ ≤ L * dist x y)
    (hheight : ∀ Λ : ℝ≥0, 2 ≤ (Λ : ℝ) →
      ∃ label : NormalizedPair G Λ → templateSymmetryGroup D,
        ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
          ∀ p x, ‖(π (p.val.1 x)).toAdd - (label p).val (π x).toAdd‖ ≤ B)
    {K C A : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (f g : P → G → G)
    (hf : ∀ p x y, dist (f p x) (f p y) ≤ K * dist x y + C)
    (hg : ∀ p x y, dist (g p x) (g p y) ≤ K * dist x y + C)
    (hgf : ∀ p x, dist (g p (f p x)) x ≤ A)
    (hfg : ∀ p x, dist (f p (g p x)) x ≤ A) :
    ∃ (label : P → templateSymmetryGroup D) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ p x,
      ‖(π (f p x)).toAdd - ((π (f p 1)).toAdd + (label p).val (π x).toAdd)‖ ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, E, hE, hreplace⟩ := exists_lipschitz_pair_replacement_constants c hpath hK hC
  have hex (p : P) : ∃ q : C(G, G) × C(G, G), LipschitzPairBounds G Λ q ∧
      (∀ x, dist (q.1 x) (f p x) ≤ E) ∧ (∀ x, dist (q.2 x) (g p x) ≤ E) :=
    hreplace (f p) (g p) (hf p) (hg p) (hgf p) (hfg p)
  choose rep hrep hclose _ using hex
  obtain ⟨label, B, hB, hbound⟩ := hheight Λ hΛ
  exact uniform_affine_height_of_bounded_pair_representatives D π hL hπ
    label hB hbound f rep hrep hE hclose

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

end OAI

OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Re.name: OAI.PolycyclicRecognition.main_uniform_bounded_height
OAI.GroupTheory.PolycyclicRecognition.Re.text:
theorem main_uniform_bounded_height
    (R : SimplyConnectedSolvableLieModel) (d : ProperChainMetric R.carrier)
    {a : ℕ} (T : TriangularAdjoint (GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) R.carrier) a)
    (huni : ModelIsUnimodular R)
    {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] [FiniteDimensional ℝ W]
    (q : HeightSpace T.character ≃ₗ[ℝ] W)
    (Exp : GroupLieAlgebra (𝓘(ℝ, R.modelSpace)) R.carrier → R.carrier)
    (hExp : IsGroupExponential Exp) (π : R.carrier →* Multiplicative W)
    (hπExp : ∀ x, (π (Exp x)).toAdd = q (heightProjection T.character x)) :
    letI := d.compatibleMetric
    ∃ A : Subgroup (W ≃ₗ[ℝ] W), Set.Finite (A : Set (W ≃ₗ[ℝ] W)) ∧
      ∀ K C : ℝ, 1 ≤ K → 0 ≤ C → ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
        ∀ F : SelfQuasiIsometry R.carrier K C, ∃ AF : A, ∀ g,
          ‖(π (F.toFun g)).toAdd - ((π (F.toFun 1)).toAdd + AF.val (π g).toAdd)‖ ≤ B :=
  uniform_bounded_height R d T huni q Exp hExp π hπExp

end PolycyclicRecognition

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Learne.name: OAI.PosteriorRegression.kernel_subquadratic_memory
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Learne.text:
theorem kernel_subquadratic_memory : KernelSubquadraticMemory.{u} := by
  refine ⟨1/(4*(400000+100*(1:ℝ))),by positivity,?_⟩
  intro M hM
  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hM.eventuallyLE
  refine ⟨max 32 d₂, ?_⟩
  intro d hd T ε hε hε10 Ω _ ρ hρ E hs
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  have hmem : (M d : ℝ) ≤ 1 * (d : ℝ)^2 := by
    have hm := hd₂ d (by omega)
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (M d) : (0:ℝ)≤M d),
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (d : ℝ)),one_mul] using hm
  exact E.fixed_quadratic_memory (by norm_num) (by omega) hmem hε hε10 hs

end PosteriorRegression
end

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.stateHaarSideLaw
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def stateHaarSideLaw {d V W : ℕ} (ℓ : ℕ)
    (q : Measure ((Vec d × Fin V) × Fin W)) :
    Measure ((Fin V × Data d ℓ) × (Vec d × Fin W)) :=
  ((haarRows d ℓ).prod q).map
    (fun z => ((z.2.1.2, (z.1, labels z.1 z.2.1.1)), (z.2.1.1, z.2.2)))

instance {d V W : ℕ} (ℓ : ℕ)
    (q : Measure ((Vec d × Fin V) × Fin W)) [IsFiniteMeasure q] :
    IsFiniteMeasure (stateHaarSideLaw ℓ q) := by
  unfold stateHaarSideLaw haarRows
  infer_instance

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.DistanceReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def DistanceReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    ∀ (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
      (f : Vec d → ℝ) (b : ℝ),
      0 ≤ b → Measurable f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ Real.exp b) →
      p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (κ : Kernel (Data d (d / 16)) (Fin N)) [IsMarkovKernel κ],
        conditionalInformation (sideLaw (d / 2) (signalMessageLaw p κ)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (messageEntropy (signalMessageLaw p κ) / ((d / 8 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            C * ((d : ℝ) + b / (d : ℝ)))

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.IncidenceReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def IncidenceReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    ∀ (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
      (f : Vec d → ℝ) (F : ℝ),
      1 ≤ F → Measurable f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ F) →
      p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (κ : Kernel (Data d (d / 16)) (Fin N)) [IsMarkovKernel κ],
        conditionalInformation (sideLaw (d / 4) (signalMessageLaw p κ)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (N : ℝ) / ((d / 16 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            C * (d : ℝ) + C * Real.log (1 + Real.log F))

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.priorLog_le_dimension_add_div
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
lemma priorLog_le_dimension_add_div {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.log (1+(d:ℝ)+b) ≤ 2*(d:ℝ)+b/(d:ℝ) := by
  have hdr : (1:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdp : (0:ℝ)<d := by linarith
  have hh := log_le_tangent (by positivity : 0<1+(d:ℝ)+b) hdp
  have he : (1+(d:ℝ)+b)/(d:ℝ)-1 = 1/(d:ℝ)+b/(d:ℝ) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hi : (1:ℝ)/(d:ℝ) ≤ d := (div_le_iff₀ hdp).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hl := Real.log_le_self hdp.le
  linarith

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.HaarReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def HaarReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 64 ≤ d →
    ∀ (V W : ℕ) [NeZero V] [NeZero W]
      (q : Measure (Vec d × Fin V)) [IsProbabilityMeasure q],
      q.fst = sphereLaw d →
      ∀ (κ : Kernel (Fin V × Data d (d / 16)) (Fin W)) [IsMarkovKernel κ],
        cmi (stateHaarSideLaw (d / 4) (stateMessageLaw q κ)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (terminalConditionalEntropy (stateMessageLaw q κ) /
            ((d / 16 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + C * (d : ℝ) +
            Real.log (1 + C * (d : ℝ) + finiteEntropy q.snd) +
            C * (finiteEntropy q.snd + Real.log (d : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ)^2)

end PosteriorReplicas
end

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.EqualLabelVersions
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def EqualLabelVersions : Prop :=
  ∀ (d k m : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ m → k + m ≤ d - 2 →
    ∀ (base : BaseLaw) (f : Vec d → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable f →
      (∃ L : ℝ≥0∞, L ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ x, f x ≤ L) →
      let ν := (base.measure d).withDensity f
      (Measurable (fun z : Rows d k × Labels k => projectedDensity base f z.1 z.2)) ∧
      (Measurable (fun z : Rows d k × Labels k => ballDensityVersion ν z.1 z.2)) ∧
      (Measurable (fun z : Rows d k × Labels k => gaussianDensityVersion ν z.1 z.2)) ∧
      (∀ A : Rows d k, LinearIndependent ℝ A →
        ν.map (labels A) = volume.withDensity (projectedDensity base f A) ∧
        projectedDensity base f A =ᵐ[volume] ballDensityVersion ν A ∧
        projectedDensity base f A =ᵐ[volume] gaussianDensityVersion ν A) ∧
      (∀ᵐ u ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => ν),
        LinearIndependent ℝ (differences u) ∧
        ∀ᵐ A ∂constrainedRows k u,
          LinearIndependent ℝ A ∧
          (∀ i, labels A (u i) = labels A (u 0)) ∧
          (base = .spherical → ‖liftLabel A (labels A (u 0))‖ < 1) ∧
          0 < projectedDensity base f A (labels A (u 0)) ∧
          projectedDensity base f A (labels A (u 0)) ≠ ∞ ∧
          projectedDensity base f A (labels A (u 0)) =
            ballDensityVersion ν A (labels A (u 0)) ∧
          projectedDensity base f A (labels A (u 0)) =
            gaussianDensityVersion ν A (labels A (u 0)))

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.differences
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def differences {d m : ℕ} (u : Tuple d m) : Fin m → Vec d :=
  fun i => u i.succ - u 0

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.finiteEntropy
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def finiteEntropy {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [MeasurableSpace J] (μ : Measure J) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, - μ.real {j} * Real.log (μ.real {j})

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.haarReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
theorem haarReplicaBlock : HaarReplicaBlock := by
  refine ⟨200+Real.pi,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro d hd V W hV hW q hp hq κ hκ
  have hi := haar_state_information_bound (m := d/16) (ℓ := d/4)
    (by omega : 4*(d/16)+d/16+2≤d) (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega : d/16+d/16≤d/4) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) q hq κ
  apply hi.trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hE := finiteEntropy_nonneg q.snd
  have hdp : (1:ℝ)≤d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1≤d)
  have hl := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : 0<1+(d:ℝ)+finiteEntropy q.snd)
    (show 1+(d:ℝ)+finiteEntropy q.snd ≤ 1+(200+Real.pi)*(d:ℝ)+finiteEntropy q.snd by
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hrem : 0 ≤ (200+Real.pi)*(finiteEntropy q.snd+Real.log (d:ℝ))/(d:ℝ)^2 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (add_nonneg hE (Real.log_nonneg hdp))) (sq_nonneg _)
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]

end PosteriorReplicas
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.ballDensityVersion
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def ballDensityVersion {d k : ℕ} (ν : Measure (Vec d))
    (A : Rows d k) (y : Labels k) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  Filter.liminf (fun n : ℕ =>
    ((volume : Measure (Labels k)) {v | labelNorm v < (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹})⁻¹ *
      ν {x | labelNorm (labels A x - y) < (n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹}) Filter.atTop

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.incidenceReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
theorem incidenceReplicaBlock : IncidenceReplicaBlock := by
  refine ⟨200+Real.pi,by positivity,64,?_⟩
  intro d hd p hp f F hF hf hfF hpf N hN κ hκ
  have hi := gaussian_replica_information_real (m := d/16-1) (ℓ := d/4)
    (by omega : 4*(d/16)+(d/16-1)+2≤d) (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega : d/16+(d/16-1)≤d/4) (by omega) (by omega)
    p hf hF hfF hpf κ
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1≤d/16)] at hi
  apply hi.trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hH : messageEntropy (signalMessageLaw p κ) ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ) := by
    simpa only [messageEntropy_eq_finiteEntropy,Fintype.card_fin] using
      finiteEntropy_le_log_card (signalMessageLaw p κ).snd
  have hH' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hH (show 0 ≤ ((d/16:ℕ):ℝ) by positivity)
  have hlog := priorLog_le_dimension_add_log (d:=d) (Real.log_nonneg hF)
  have hpos := Real.log_nonneg (show 1≤1+Real.log F by linarith [Real.log_nonneg hF])
  have hdp : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ) := by positivity
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos,mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hpos]

end PosteriorReplicas
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.gaussian_replica_information_real
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
lemma gaussian_replica_information_real {d ℓ k m N : ℕ} [NeZero N]
    (hd : 4*k+m+2 ≤ d) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hkm : k+m≤ℓ)
    (hdk : d ≤ 32*k) (hℓk : ℓ ≤ 16*k)
    (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
    {f : Vec d → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) {L : ℝ} (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hfL : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ L)
    (hp : p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)))
    (κ : Kernel (Data d k) (Fin N)) [IsMarkovKernel κ] :
    conditionalInformation (sideLaw ℓ (signalMessageLaw p κ)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (messageEntropy (signalMessageLaw p κ) / ((m+1:ℕ):ℝ) +
        (100+Real.pi)*(d:ℝ) + Real.log (1+(d:ℝ)+Real.log L)) := by
  subst p
  exact gaussian_replica_information hd hk hm hkm hdk hℓk hf.ennreal_ofReal hL
    (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hfL x).2) κ

end PosteriorReplicas

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.gaussianReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
theorem gaussianReplicaBlock : GaussianReplicaBlock := by
  refine ⟨200+Real.pi,by positivity,64,?_⟩
  intro d hd
  dsimp only
  intro p hp f L hf hfL hpf N hN κ hκ
  have hL : 1 ≤ L := by
    have : IsProbabilityMeasure ((sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x))) := hpf ▸ hp
    exact spherical_density_bound_one_le (by omega) (fun x => (hfL x).2)
  have hi := gaussian_replica_information_real (m := 2*(d/16))
    (by omega : 4*(2*(d/16))+2*(d/16)+2≤d) (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega : 2*(d/16)+2*(d/16)≤4*(2*(d/16))) (by omega) (by omega)
    p hf hL hfL hpf κ
  apply hi.trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hlog := priorLog_le_dimension_add_log (d:=d) (Real.log_nonneg hL)
  have hmono := Real.log_le_log (by linarith [Real.log_nonneg hL] : 0<1+Real.log L)
    (show 1+Real.log L ≤ 2+Real.log L by linarith)
  have hpos := Real.log_nonneg (show 1≤2+Real.log L by linarith [Real.log_nonneg hL])
  have hdp : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ) := by positivity
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos,mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hpos]

OAI.PosteriorReplicas.EqualLabelMeasureIdentity
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def EqualLabelMeasureIdentity : Prop :=
  ∀ (d k m : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ m → k + m ≤ d - 2 →
    ∀ (base : BaseLaw) (f : Vec d → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable f →
      (∃ L : ℝ≥0∞, L ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ x, f x ≤ L) →
      equalLabelLeft (k := k) (m := m) base f (fun _ => 1) < ∞ ∧
      ∀ H : Rows d k × Labels k × Tuple d m → ℝ≥0∞,
        Measurable H → equalLabelLeft base f H = equalLabelRight base f H

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.GaussianReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def GaussianReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    let k := 2 * (d / 16)
    let t := k + 1
    let ℓ := 4 * k
    ∀ (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
      (f : Vec d → ℝ) (L : ℝ),
      Measurable f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ L) →
      p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (κ : Kernel (Data d k) (Fin N)) [IsMarkovKernel κ],
        conditionalInformation (sideLaw ℓ (signalMessageLaw p κ)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (messageEntropy (signalMessageLaw p κ) / (t : ℝ) +
            C * (d : ℝ) + C * Real.log (2 + Real.log L))

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.finiteEntropy_le_log_card
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
lemma finiteEntropy_le_log_card {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [Nonempty W] [MeasurableSpace W]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass W] (q : Measure W) [IsProbabilityMeasure q] :
    finiteEntropy q ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card W : ℝ) := by
  have hn : 0 < (Fintype.card W : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun w _ =>
    neg_mul_log_le_tangent (measureReal_nonneg (μ := q) (s := {w})) (inv_pos.mpr hn))
  simp only [Real.log_inv, neg_mul_neg, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_probability_atoms q, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    nsmul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn.ne', one_mul, add_sub_cancel_right] at h
  exact h

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Main:1.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.source_main

theorem source_main : EqualLabelMeasureIdentity ∧ EqualLabelVersions ∧
    GaussianReplicaBlock ∧ DistanceReplicaBlock ∧ HaarReplicaBlock ∧
    SyntheticReplicaBlock ∧ IncidenceReplicaBlock ∧
    PosteriorRegression.KernelSubquadraticMemory.{u} :=
  ⟨equalLabelMeasureIdentity, equalLabelVersions, gaussianReplicaBlock,
    distanceReplicaBlock, haarReplicaBlock, syntheticReplicaBlock,
    incidenceReplicaBlock, PosteriorRegression.kernel_subquadratic_memory⟩

def SyntheticReplicaBlock : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 16 ≤ d →
    ∀ (p : Measure (Vec d)) [IsProbabilityMeasure p]
      (f : Vec d → ℝ) (L : ℝ),
      1 ≤ L → Measurable f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ L) →
      p = (sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) →
      ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (z : Data d (d / 8) → Fin N) (hz : Measurable z),
        conditionalInformation
          (sideLaw (d / 2) (signalMessageLaw p (Kernel.deterministic z hz))) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (N : ℝ) / ((d / 8 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
            C * ((d : ℝ) + Real.log (1 + Real.log L)))

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.haar_state_information_bound
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
lemma haar_state_information_bound {d ℓ k m V W : ℕ} [NeZero W]
    (hd : 4*k+m+2 ≤ d) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hkm : k+m≤ℓ)
    (hdk : d ≤ 32*k) (hℓk : ℓ ≤ 16*k) (hℓ : ℓ≤d)
    (q : Measure (Vec d × Fin V)) [IsProbabilityMeasure q]
    (hq : q.fst = sphereLaw d)
    (κ : Kernel (Fin V × Data d k) (Fin W)) [IsMarkovKernel κ] :
    cmi (stateHaarSideLaw ℓ (stateMessageLaw q κ)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (terminalConditionalEntropy (stateMessageLaw q κ) / ((m+1:ℕ):ℝ) +
        (100+Real.pi)*(d:ℝ) + Real.log (1+(d:ℝ)+finiteEntropy q.snd)) := by
  let R : Fin V → ℝ := fun v =>
    finiteEntropy (stateOutputKernel q κ v).snd / ((m+1:ℕ):ℝ) +
      (100+Real.pi)*(d:ℝ) + Real.log (1+(d:ℝ)-Real.log (q.snd.real {v}))
  have hR (v : Fin V) : 0 ≤ R v := by
    have hE := finiteEntropy_nonneg (stateOutputKernel q κ v).snd
    have hlog : Real.log (q.snd.real {v}) ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos measureReal_nonneg measureReal_le_one
    have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log (1+(d:ℝ)-Real.log (q.snd.real {v})) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) d] : 1≤1+(d:ℝ)-Real.log (q.snd.real {v}))
    dsimp [R]
    positivity
  rw [stateHaarInformation_average hℓ q κ]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ v, q.snd {v} * ENNReal.ofReal (R v) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v _
      by_cases hv : q.snd {v} = 0
      · simp [hv]
      · exact mul_le_mul le_rfl (state_gaussian_information_bound hd hk hm hkm hdk hℓk q hq κ v hv) (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ v, q.snd.real {v} * R v) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun v _ => mul_nonneg measureReal_nonneg (hR v))]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro v _
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul measureReal_nonneg,measureReal_def,ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top _ _)]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      have havg := finiteEntropy_log_average q.snd (a := 1+(d:ℝ)) (by positivity)
      have heq : ∑ v, q.snd.real {v} * R v =
          terminalConditionalEntropy (stateMessageLaw q κ) / ((m+1:ℕ):ℝ) +
            (100+Real.pi)*(d:ℝ) +
              ∑ v, q.snd.real {v} * Real.log (1+(d:ℝ)-Real.log (q.snd.real {v})) := by
        simp only [R,mul_add,← mul_div_assoc,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_div,
          ← Finset.sum_mul,sum_probability_atoms q.snd,one_mul,
          terminalConditionalEntropy_average]
      rw [heq]
      linarith

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.syntheticReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
theorem syntheticReplicaBlock : SyntheticReplicaBlock := by
  refine ⟨200+Real.pi,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro d hd p hp f L hL hf hfL hpf N hN z hz
  have hi := gaussian_replica_information_real (m := d/8-1) (ℓ := d/2)
    (by omega : 4*(d/8)+(d/8-1)+2≤d) (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega : d/8+(d/8-1)≤d/2) (by omega) (by omega)
    p hf hL hfL hpf (Kernel.deterministic z hz)
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1≤d/8)] at hi
  apply hi.trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hH : messageEntropy (signalMessageLaw p (Kernel.deterministic z hz)) ≤ Real.log (N:ℝ) := by
    simpa only [messageEntropy_eq_finiteEntropy,Fintype.card_fin] using
      finiteEntropy_le_log_card (signalMessageLaw p (Kernel.deterministic z hz)).snd
  have hH' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hH (show 0 ≤ ((d/8:ℕ):ℝ) by positivity)
  have hlog := priorLog_le_dimension_add_log (d:=d) (Real.log_nonneg hL)
  have hpos := Real.log_nonneg (show 1≤1+Real.log L by linarith [Real.log_nonneg hL])
  have hdp : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ) := by positivity
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos,mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hpos]

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.priorLog_le_dimension_add_log
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
lemma priorLog_le_dimension_add_log {d : ℕ} {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    Real.log (1+(d:ℝ)+u) ≤ (d:ℝ)+Real.log (1+u) := by
  have hd : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ) := by positivity
  have hh := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : 0<1+(d:ℝ)+u)
    (show 1+(d:ℝ)+u ≤ (1+(d:ℝ))*(1+u) by nlinarith)
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)] at hh
  have hl := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : 0<1+(d:ℝ))
  linarith

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.equalLabelRight
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def equalLabelRight {d k m : ℕ} (base : BaseLaw) (f : Vec d → ℝ≥0∞)
    (H : Rows d k × Labels k × Tuple d m → ℝ≥0∞) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi) ^ (-(k * m : ℝ) / 2)) *
    ∫⁻ u, (ENNReal.ofReal (affineVolume u))⁻¹ ^ k *
      ∫⁻ A, H (A, labels A (u 0), u) ∂constrainedRows k u
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => (base.measure d).withDensity f)

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.equalLabelLeft
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Model:.text:
def equalLabelLeft {d k m : ℕ} (base : BaseLaw) (f : Vec d → ℝ≥0∞)
    (H : Rows d k × Labels k × Tuple d m → ℝ≥0∞) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∫⁻ A, ∫⁻ y, (projectedDensity base f A y) ^ (m + 1) *
    ∫⁻ u, H (A, y, u) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => tiltedFiber base f A y)
      ∂volume ∂gaussianRows d k

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.finiteEntropy_nonneg
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
lemma finiteEntropy_nonneg {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [MeasurableSpace W] [MeasurableSingletonClass W]
    (q : Measure W) [IsProbabilityMeasure q] : 0 ≤ finiteEntropy q := by
  simpa only [finiteEntropy, neg_mul, mul_neg] using finite_crossEntropy_nonneg q q

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.spherical_density_bound_one_le
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
lemma spherical_density_bound_one_le {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    {f : Vec d → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hfL : ∀ x, f x ≤ L)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ((sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)))] : 1 ≤ L := by
  let : NeZero d := ⟨hd.ne'⟩
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (sphereLaw d) := by
    change IsProbabilityMeasure (BaseLaw.spherical.measure d); infer_instance
  apply ENNReal.one_le_ofReal.mp
  calc
    (1:ℝ≥0∞) = ((sphereLaw d).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x))) univ := (measure_univ).symm
    _ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂sphereLaw d := by rw [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,Measure.restrict_univ]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _x, ENNReal.ofReal L ∂sphereLaw d := lintegral_mono (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hfL x))
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal L := by simp

OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.name: OAI.PosteriorReplicas.distanceReplicaBlock
OAI.Probability.PosteriorReplicas.Inform.text:
theorem distanceReplicaBlock : DistanceReplicaBlock := by
  refine ⟨200+Real.pi,by positivity,64,?_⟩
  intro d hd p hp f b hb hf hfL hpf N hN κ hκ
  have hL : 1 ≤ Real.exp b := Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr hb
  have hi := gaussian_replica_information_real (m := d/8-1) (ℓ := d/2)
    (by omega : 4*(d/16)+(d/8-1)+2≤d) (by omega) (by omega)
    (by omega : d/16+(d/8-1)≤d/2) (by omega) (by omega)
    p hf hL hfL hpf κ
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1≤d/8),Real.log_exp] at hi
  apply hi.trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have hlog := priorLog_le_dimension_add_div (by omega : 1≤d) hb
  have hdp : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ) := by positivity
  have hbdiv : 0 ≤ b/(d:ℝ) := div_nonneg hb hdp
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos,mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hbdiv]

OAI.NumberTheory.PowerFree.Main:144.name: OAI.QuarticPowerFree.allDegrees
OAI.NumberTheory.PowerFree.Main:144.text:
theorem allDegrees (f : Polynomial ℤ)

OAI.NumberTheory.PowerFree.Main:20.name: OAI.QuarticPowerFree.quartic_dyadic_tail
OAI.NumberTheory.PowerFree.Main:20.text:
theorem quartic_dyadic_tail (f : Polynomial ℤ) (hf : f.IsPrimitive)
    (hirr : Irreducible (f.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))) (hc : 0 < f.leadingCoeff)
    (hd : f.natDegree=4) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (dyadicTailCount f (f.natDegree-2) N:ℝ) ≤ C*(N:ℝ)^(1-3/1000:ℝ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M,μ,Q,C,Xcut,hμ,hC,_hXcut,hQ,hfactor⟩ :=
    balanced_arithmetic f hirr (by omega) hc (f.natDegree-2) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨F,hF,heval⟩ := polynomial_dyadic_eval_bound f
  have hK : Module.finrank ℚ M.Carrier=4 := M.degree_eq.trans hd
  let T := integralEmbeddingChart M.Carrier 4 hK
  have hθ : Function.Injective (fun i => T.σ i M.root) := by
    intro i j hij
    apply T.σ.injective
    apply (RingHom.equivRatAlgHom M.Carrier ℂ).injective
    apply M.powerBasis.algHom_ext
    change T.σ i M.powerBasis.gen = T.σ j M.powerBasis.gen
    rw [M.powerBasis_gen,M.integralRoot_eq]
    simp only [map_mul,map_intCast,hij]
  have hboxes (j : Fin 100) := balanced_coordinates_quarticbox j T μ hμ C F hC (by linarith)
  choose Cbox hCbox hbox using hboxes
  have hcounts (j : Fin 100) := quartic_indexed_count f hf hd j hK T M.root hθ μ hμ Q hQ (Cbox j) (hCbox j)
  choose D Xcount hD hcount using hcounts
  let Dall : ℝ := ∑ j : Fin 100, D j
  have hDall : 0 < Dall := Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => hD j) Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨Dall,hDall,?_⟩
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N:ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hall : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ j : Fin 100, Xcount j < (N:ℝ) :=
    Filter.eventually_all.mpr (fun j => hlim.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop (Xcount j)))
  filter_upwards [hlim.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop (max 1 Xcut)),hall] with N hN hNcount
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ (N:ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans hN.le
  have hNcut : Xcut ≤ (N:ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans hN.le
  let S := (Finset.Ioc N (2*N)).filter fun n : ℕ =>
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ N < p ∧ (p:ℤ)^(f.natDegree-2) ∣ f.eval (n:ℤ)
  have hS (n : S) : ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ N < p ∧
      (p:ℤ)^(f.natDegree-2) ∣ f.eval (n.val:ℤ) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp n.property).2
  choose P hP hNP hdiv using hS
  have hrange (n : S) : (N:ℝ) < (n.val:ℝ) ∧ (n.val:ℝ) ≤ 2*(N:ℝ) := by
    have hn := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp n.property).1
    constructor
    · exact_mod_cast hn.1
    · exact_mod_cast hn.2
  have hNP' (n : S) : (N:ℝ) < P n := by exact_mod_cast hNP n
  have hfac (n : S) := (hfactor N hNcut (n.val:ℤ) (P n)
    (by exact_mod_cast (hrange n).1) (by exact_mod_cast (hrange n).2)
    (hP n) (hNP' n) (hdiv n)).2
  choose J hJ A hA B hAB hnorm harch using hfac
  have hprime (n : S) : (P n).Prime ∧ (N:ℝ) < P n ∧ (P n:ℤ) ∣ f.eval (n.val:ℤ) := by
    refine ⟨hP n,hNP' n,?_⟩
    exact dvd_trans (dvd_pow_self _ (by omega : f.natDegree-2 ≠ 0)) (hdiv n)
  have hupper (n : S) : (P n:ℝ) ≤ F*(N:ℝ)^2 := by
    have hp2 := large_prime_power_upper f hirr (by omega) F N (n.val:ℤ) (P n) (f.natDegree-2)
      (heval N hN1 (n.val:ℤ) (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast (hrange n).2)) (hdiv n)
    rw [hd] at hp2
    simp only [Nat.reduceSub,Real.rpow_natCast] at hp2
    change (P n:ℝ)^2 ≤ F*(N:ℝ)^(4:ℕ) at hp2
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ P n) (by positivity : 0 ≤ F*(N:ℝ)^2)).mp
    have hFF : F ≤ F^2 := by nlinarith
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hFF (sq_nonneg ((N:ℝ)^2))
    nlinarith only [hp2,hh]
  have hbins (n : S) := quartic_prime_bin N F (P n) hN1 (by linarith) (hNP' n) (hupper n)
  choose bin hbinlo hbinhi using hbins
  let R (j : Fin 100) := Finset.univ.filter (fun n : S => bin n=j)
  have hR (j : Fin 100) : ((R j).card:ℝ) ≤ D j*(N:ℝ)^(997/1000:ℝ) := by
    let a : R j → ℤ := fun n => (n.val.val:ℤ)
    have hainj : Function.Injective a := by
      intro n m he
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Int.natCast_inj.mp he
    have hbe (n : R j) : bin n.val=j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp n.property).2
    have hcoords (n : R j) (i) : |(T.coord (A n.val) i:ℝ)| ≤ Cbox j*(N:ℝ)^(quarticU j) ∧
        |(T.coord (B n.val) i:ℝ)| ≤ Cbox j*(N:ℝ)^(quarticV j) := by
      have hlo : (N:ℝ)^(quarticLowerEta j) < P n.val := by simpa only [hbe n] using hbinlo n.val
      have hhi : (P n.val:ℝ) ≤ F*(N:ℝ)^(quarticUpperEta j) := by simpa only [hbe n] using hbinhi n.val
      apply hbox j N hN1 (P n.val) hlo hhi (A n.val) (B n.val) ?_ i
      intro w
      have hh := And.intro (harch n.val w).1.2 (harch n.val w).2.2
      simpa only [hd,Nat.reduceSub,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh
    have hh := hcount j N (hNcount j) (R j) a (fun n => P n.val) (fun n => J n.val)
      (fun n => A n.val) (fun n => B n.val) hainj
      (fun n => by simpa only [a,Int.cast_natCast] using hrange n.val)
      (fun n => hJ n.val) (fun n => hprime n.val) (fun n => hA n.val)
      (fun n => by simpa only [hd,Nat.reduceSub] using hAB n.val)
      (fun n => hnorm n.val) hcoords
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using hh
  have hcard : (S.card:ℝ) ≤ ∑ j : Fin 100, ((R j).card:ℝ) := by
    have hh := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).mpr (indexed_card_le_sum_fibres bin)
    simp only [Fintype.card_coe,Nat.cast_sum] at hh
    convert hh using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    congr 2
    ext n
    simp only [R,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
  calc
    (dyadicTailCount f (f.natDegree-2) N:ℝ) = (S.card:ℝ) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 100, ((R j).card:ℝ) := hcard
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 100, D j*(N:ℝ)^(997/1000:ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hR j)
    _ = Dall*(N:ℝ)^(1-3/1000:ℝ) := by rw [←Finset.sum_mul]; norm_num only [show (1-3/1000:ℝ)=997/1000 by norm_num]; rfl

end

OAI.NumberTheory.PowerFree.Main:123.name: OAI.QuarticPowerFree.density_ge_four
OAI.NumberTheory.PowerFree.Main:123.text:
theorem density_ge_four (f : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hirr : Irreducible (f.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))) (hd : 4 ≤ f.natDegree)
    (hlocal : LocallyAdmissible f (f.natDegree-2)) :
    DensityStatement f (f.natDegree-2) := by
  by_cases hd5 : 5 ≤ f.natDegree
  · exact density_ge_five f hirr hd5 hlocal
  obtain ⟨a,g,ha,hfg,hgprim,hgpos,hgdeg,hgirr⟩ := exists_primitive_positive_normalization f hirr
  obtain ⟨C,_hC,hbound⟩ := quartic_dyadic_tail g hgprim hgirr hgpos (by omega)
  have ht := dyadic_tail_limit_of_power_saving g (g.natDegree-2) (3/1000) C (by norm_num) hbound
  rw [hgdeg] at ht
  exact densityStatement_from_normalized_dyadic_tail f g hirr (by omega)
    (by omega) hlocal a ha hfg ht

  classical
  unfold initialCount LargePrimeGaps.largeGapIndices

    (hgap : ∀ C : ℝ, 0 < C → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N →
        c * (N : ℝ) ≤ (initialCount (largeGapIndices C) N : ℝ)) :
    0 < lowerAsymptoticDensity ratioIncreaseIndices := by

OAI.NumberTheory.PrimeGaps.RatioCorollar.name: OAI.Problem344.positive_lower_density_prime_ratio_increases

  refine ⟨c, hc, N0, ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  rw [largeGap_count_eq]

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Determinant:45.text:
lemma sourceDeterminant_trace_logCutoff (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ) (n : ℕ) :
    (sourceVacuumFunctional (cfc (logarithmCutoff n)
      (CFC.abs (sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg)))).re =
      -(∫ x,min (n:ℝ) (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x) ∂sourceBaseMeasure) := by
  rw [sourceOperator_abs θ hθ,sourceWeight_cfc θ hθ]
  change (sourceVacuumFunctional (sourcePi θ (sourceContinuousWeightBase θ ((logarithmCutoff n).restrict WeightInterval)))).re=_
  rw [sourcePi_trace]
  have he : (fun x=>(sourceContinuousWeightBase θ ((logarithmCutoff n).restrict WeightInterval)).toFun x)=ᵐ[sourceBaseMeasure]
      fun x=>(-min (n:ℝ) (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x):ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [sourceSamplingHaar_cube] with x hx
    change (logarithmCutoff n (sourceWeightPoint θ x):ℂ)=((-min (n:ℝ) (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x):ℝ):ℂ)
    rw [sourceWeightPoint_val θ hθ hx]
    exact congrArg Complex.ofReal (logarithmCutoff_exp_neg n (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x))
  rw [integral_congr_ae he,integral_complex_ofReal,Complex.ofReal_re,integral_neg]

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.UnitDeterminan.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.FugledeKadisonDeterminant_of_isUnit
OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.UnitDeterminan.text:
lemma FugledeKadisonDeterminant_of_isUnit (T : ProductOp) (hu : IsUnit T) :
    FugledeKadisonDeterminant sourceVacuumFunctional T=
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (sourceVacuumFunctional (CFC.log (CFC.abs T))).re) := by
  have hp : ∀y∈spectrum ℝ (CFC.abs T),0<y := fun y hy=>product_abs_spectrum_pos hu hy
  have hc : ContinuousOn Real.log (spectrum ℝ (CFC.abs T)) := by
    apply Real.continuousOn_log.mono
    intro y hy
    exact (hp y hy).ne'
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := logarithmCutoff_cfc_eq_log (CFC.abs_nonneg T) (product_abs_isUnit hu)
    exact (iInf_le _ n).trans_eq
      (congrArg (fun operator : ProductOp =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (sourceVacuumFunctional operator).re)) hn)
  · apply le_iInf
    intro n
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    apply sourceVacuumFunctional_mono
    apply cfc_mono (hf:=hc) (hg:=(logarithmCutoff n).continuous.continuousOn)
    intro y hy
    exact Real.log_le_log (hp y hy) (le_max_right _ _)
end FiniteFactor

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Determinant:89.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.sourceOperator_determinant_zero
OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Determinant:89.text:
theorem sourceOperator_determinant_zero (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ) :
    FugledeKadisonDeterminant sourceVacuumFunctional
      (sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg)=0 := by
  let Δ := FugledeKadisonDeterminant sourceVacuumFunctional
    (sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg)
  have hb (k : ℕ) : Δ≤ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(k:ℝ))) := by
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := sourceLog_trunc_antibounded θ hθ (k:ℝ)
    apply (iInf_le _ n).trans
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    exact (sourceDeterminant_trace_logCutoff θ hθ n).trans_le (neg_le_neg hn)
  have ht : Tendsto (fun k:ℕ=>ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(k:ℝ)))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have he := Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp he
  exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto ht (Eventually.of_forall hb)) bot_le
end FiniteFactor

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Dirac:10.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.expLogPotential_dirac_zero
OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Dirac:10.text:
lemma expLogPotential_dirac_zero (z : ℂ) :
    expLogPotential (Measure.dirac (0:ℂ)) z=ENNReal.ofReal ‖z‖ := by
  have he (n : ℕ) : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (∫ w,logarithmCutoff n ‖z-w‖ ∂Measure.dirac (0:ℂ)))=
      ENNReal.ofReal (max (Real.exp (-(n:ℝ))) ‖z‖) := by
    rw [integral_dirac]
    simp only [sub_zero]
    change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Real.log (max (Real.exp (-(n:ℝ))) ‖z‖)))=_
    rw [Real.exp_log ((Real.exp_pos _).trans_le (le_max_left _ _))]
  unfold expLogPotential
  simp_rw [he]
  apply le_antisymm
  · have ht : Tendsto (fun n:ℕ=>ENNReal.ofReal (max (Real.exp (-(n:ℝ))) ‖z‖)) atTop (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal ‖z‖)) := by
      have hmax : Tendsto (fun index : ℕ => max (Real.exp (-(index : ℝ))) ‖z‖)
          atTop (𝓝 (max 0 ‖z‖)) :=
        (Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).max
          (tendsto_const_nhds (x := ‖z‖))
      simpa only [max_eq_right (norm_nonneg z)] using ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal hmax
    exact ge_of_tendsto ht (Eventually.of_forall (iInf_le _))
  · exact le_iInf (fun n=>ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_max_right _ _))

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Model:93.text:
def FugledeKadisonDeterminant (τ : ProductOp → ℂ) (T : ProductOp) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  let determinant := fun (Hilbert : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup Hilbert]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ Hilbert] [CompleteSpace Hilbert] [Nontrivial Hilbert]
    (trace : (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) → ℂ) (operator : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) =>
      letI : Module ℝ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) := Module.complexToReal _
      letI : IsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)
          IsSelfAdjoint := IsSelfAdjoint.instIsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus
      ⨅ n : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal
        (Real.exp ((trace (cfc (logarithmCutoff n) (CFC.abs operator))).re))
  let domain := (SourceCoordinate → ℝ) × ℤ
  let measurable : MeasurableSpace domain := productMeasurable
  let exponent : ℝ≥0∞ := productExponent
  let measure : @Measure domain measurable := sourceMeasure SourceCoordinate
  let complete := @MeasureTheory.Lp.instCompleteSpace domain measurable exponent measure ℂ
    Complex.instNormedAddCommGroup Complex.instCompleteSpace fact_one_le_two_ennreal
  @determinant (SourceHilbert SourceCoordinate) productHilbertGroup productHilbertInner
    complete productHilbertNontrivial τ T

end

def IsBrownMeasure (τ : ProductOp → ℂ) (T : ProductOp) (μ : Measure ℂ) : Prop :=
  let translate := fun (Hilbert : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup Hilbert]

      operator - algebraMap ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) scalar

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Determinant:60.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.sourceLog_trunc_antibounded
OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Determinant:60.text:
lemma sourceLog_trunc_antibounded (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ) (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,a≤∫ x,min (n:ℝ) (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x) ∂sourceBaseMeasure := by
  let f : ℕ → (SourceCoordinate → ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun n x=> ENNReal.ofReal (min (n:ℝ) (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x))
  have hmeas (n) : Measurable (f n) := ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_const.min (sourceLog_measurable _ _ _))
  have hmono : Monotone f := by
    intro n m hnm x
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    exact min_le_min_right _ (by exact_mod_cast hnm)
  have hs : (⨆ n,∫⁻ x,f n x ∂sourceBaseMeasure)=∞ := by
    rw [← lintegral_iSup hmeas hmono]
    have he (x) : (⨆ n,f n x)=ENNReal.ofReal (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact iSup_le (fun n=>ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (min_le_right _ _))
      · obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x)
        exact le_iSup_of_le n (by dsimp [f]; rw [min_eq_right hn])
    simp_rw [he]
    exact sourceLog_lintegral_top θ hθ
  by_contra hn
  have hb : ∀ n,∫⁻ x,f n x ∂sourceBaseMeasure≤ENNReal.ofReal a := by
    intro n
    have hnn : ∀ᵐ x ∂sourceBaseMeasure,0 ≤ min (n:ℝ) (sourceLog θ sourceLogWeight 1 x) := by
      filter_upwards [sourceSamplingHaar_cube] with x hx
      exact le_min (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (sourceLog_nonneg θ hθ hx)
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (sourceLog_trunc_integrable θ hθ n) hnn]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_of_lt (not_le.mp (fun h=>hn ⟨n,h⟩)))
  have := iSup_le hb
  rw [hs] at this
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (top_le_iff.mp this)

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Resolvent:72.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.sourceResolvent_determinant
OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Resolvent:72.text:
theorem sourceResolvent_determinant (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z≠0) :
    FugledeKadisonDeterminant sourceVacuumFunctional
      (sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg-algebraMap ℂ ProductOp z)=ENNReal.ofReal ‖z‖ := by
  rw [FugledeKadisonDeterminant_of_isUnit _ (sourceResolvent_isUnit θ hθ hz),
    sourceResolvent_trace_log_abs θ hθ hz,Real.exp_log (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz)]
end FiniteFactor
end

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Resolvent:59.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.sourceResolvent_trace_log_abs
OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Resolvent:59.text:
lemma sourceResolvent_trace_log_abs (θ : SourceCoordinate → ℝ) (hθ : SourceAngles θ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z≠0) :
    (sourceVacuumFunctional (CFC.log (CFC.abs (sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg-algebraMap ℂ ProductOp z)))).re=Real.log ‖z‖ := by
  let T := sourceOperator θ sourceLogWeight hθ.nonneg sourceLogWeight_nonneg-algebraMap ℂ ProductOp z
  have hu : IsUnit T := sourceResolvent_isUnit θ hθ hz
  have hn : ∀y∈spectrum ℝ (CFC.abs T),y≠0 := fun y hy=>(product_abs_spectrum_pos hu hy).ne'
  have hh := CFC.log_pow 2 (CFC.abs T) hn (CFC.abs_nonneg T).isSelfAdjoint
  rw [pow_two, CFC.abs_mul_abs] at hh
  have he := congrArg (fun a:ProductOp=>(sourceVacuumFunctional a).re) hh
  rw [sourceResolvent_trace_log_square θ hθ hz] at he
  simp only [two_nsmul,sourceVacuumFunctional_add,Complex.add_re] at he
  change _=_ at he
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Main:14.name: OAI.FiniteFactor.productBrown
OAI.Analysis.BrownMeasure.Main:14.text:
theorem productBrown : ProductBrownClaim := by
  intro θ hθ
  refine ⟨inferInstance, dirac_zero_support_compact, ?_⟩
  intro z
  rw [expLogPotential_dirac_zero]
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    simp only [map_zero, sub_zero, norm_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
    exact sourceOperator_determinant_zero θ hθ
  · exact sourceResolvent_determinant θ hθ hz
end FiniteFactor

end

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.haar_success
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.text:
theorem haar_success :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ d M T : ℕ, 16 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      let k := d/4
      let Nstar : ℝ := ((k:ℝ)+2)*2^M
      seededSuccess K ρ ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (C^d*ε^k*(C^d*Nstar^(1/(k:ℝ)))^((T+k-1)/k)) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := Learner.haar_success.{0}
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro d M T hd ε hε hε10 Ξ _ ρ hρ K hK k Nstar
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  apply seed_average_bound
  filter_upwards [hK] with ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨ν,L,hν,hB,hL,he,_⟩ := (K ξ).exists_equivalent_tape hξ (by omega)
  rw [←he ε]
  exact h d M T hd ε hε hε10 (Tape M T) ν hν L hL

theorem riesz_success :

  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := Learner.riesz_success.{0}
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro d M T hd ε hε hε10 Ξ _ ρ hρ K hK q W
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  apply seed_average_bound
  filter_upwards [hK] with ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨ν,L,hν,hB,hL,he,_⟩ := (K ξ).exists_equivalent_tape hξ (by omega)
  rw [←he ε]
  exact h d M T hd ε hε hε10 (Tape M T) ν hν L hL

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.exists_successful_seed
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.text:
lemma exists_successful_seed {Ξ : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] {P : Ξ → Prop} (hP : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, P ξ)
    {f : Ξ → ℝ≥0∞} {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c ≠ ∞) (hs : c ≤ ∫⁻ ξ, f ξ ∂ρ) :
    ∃ ξ, P ξ ∧ c ≤ f ξ := by
  by_contra h
  have hlt : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, f ξ < c := by
    filter_upwards [hP] with ξ hξ
    exact lt_of_not_ge (fun hf => h ⟨ξ,hξ,hf⟩)
  have hbound : ∫⁻ ξ, f ξ ∂ρ ≤ c := seed_average_bound ρ (ae_le_of_ae_lt hlt)
  have hstrict := lintegral_strict_mono (show ρ ≠ 0 from by
    intro he; have hh := measure_univ (μ := ρ); rw [he] at hh; simp at hh)
    (aemeasurable_const (b := c)) (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hc hbound) hlt
  have hh : ∫⁻ ξ, f ξ ∂ρ < c := by simpa using hstrict
  exact not_lt_of_ge hs hh

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_fixed_stop
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.text:
theorem cap_fixed_stop :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d M T : ℕ, 32 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ T →
      let k := d/16
      let α : ℝ := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
      seededFixedSuccess K ρ ε t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (Real.exp (C*d)*(ε/2)^α*(Real.exp (C*d)*(2:ℝ)^((M:ℝ)/k))^((t+k-1)/k)) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := Learner.cap_fixed_stop.{0}
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro d M T hd ε hε hε10 Ξ _ ρ hρ K hK t ht k α
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  apply seed_average_bound
  filter_upwards [hK] with ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨ν,L,hν,hB,hL,_,he⟩ := (K ξ).exists_equivalent_tape hξ (by omega)
  rw [←he ε t]
  exact h d M T hd ε hε hε10 (Tape M T) ν hν L hL
    (L.measurable_terminal hB).fst.aemeasurable t ht

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.seededSuccess_of_pointwise
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.text:
lemma seededSuccess_of_pointwise [NeZero d]
    (K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T) (ρ : Measure Ξ) [SFinite ρ] (ε : ℝ)
    (hm : JointSuccessMeasurable K ρ ε)
    (hs : ∀ s, (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ seededPointwiseSuccess K ρ ε s) :
    (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ seededSuccess K ρ ε := by
  rw [seededSuccess_eq_integral_pointwise K ρ ε hm]
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ _ : UnitSphere d, (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂uniformSphere d := by simp
    _ ≤ _ := lintegral_mono hs

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Main:1.name: OAI.ProjectionMoments.main
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Main:1.text:
theorem main : MainStatement.{u} := by
  refine ⟨integrated_frame_moment, normalized_unitBall_moment, all_radii_sphere_moment,
    positive_family_cap_domination, riesz_deterministic_offsets, one_block_all_radii,
    NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.haar_success,
    NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.riesz_success,
    NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_fixed_stop,
    NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_total_success,
    NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_fixed_stop_asymptotic,
    NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_total_success_asymptotic, ?_,
    NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.subquadratic_memory_with_pointwise,
    NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.fixed_quadratic_memory⟩
  intro d M T hd K hK
  exact K.exists_equivalent_tape hK hd

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.fixed_quadratic_memory
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.text:
theorem fixed_quadratic_memory : FixedQuadraticMemory.{u} := by
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨c,hc,d₀,h⟩ := NoiselessRegression.fixed_quadratic_memory.{0} A hA
  refine ⟨c,hc,max d₀ 3,?_⟩
  intro d hd M T hM ε hε hε10 Ξ _ ρ hρ K hK hs
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  obtain ⟨ξ,hξ,hsξ⟩ := exists_successful_seed ρ hK (ENNReal.div_ne_top (by norm_num) (by norm_num) : (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞) hs
  obtain ⟨ν,L,hν,hB,hL,he,_⟩ := (K ξ).exists_equivalent_tape hξ (by omega)
  apply h d (by omega) M T hM ε hε hε10 (Tape M T) ν hν L hL
  rwa [he ε]

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.exists_equivalent_tape
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.text:
theorem exists_equivalent_tape (K : FiniteKernelLearner d M T) (hK : K.CompletedRules) (hd : 3 ≤ d) :
    ∃ (ρ : Measure (Tape M T)) (L : Learner d M T (Tape M T)),
      IsProbabilityMeasure ρ ∧ L.MeasurableRules ∧ L.Admissible ρ ∧
      (∀ ε, L.uniformSuccess ρ ε = K.uniformSuccess ε) ∧
      (∀ ε t, L.uniformFixedSuccess ρ ε t = K.uniformFixedSuccess ε t) := by
  let : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨K',hK',he⟩ := K.exists_borel_same_joint hK hd
  let R := Classical.choice (K'.exists_realizer hK')
  refine ⟨K'.tapeLaw,R.toLearner,inferInstance,R.measurableRules,
    R.toLearner.admissible_of_measurable R.measurableRules K'.tapeLaw,?_,?_⟩
  · intro ε
    rw [R.uniformSuccess_eq]
    apply lintegral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [he] with z hz
    rw [hz]
  · intro ε t
    rw [R.uniformFixedSuccess_eq]
    apply lintegral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [he] with z hz
    rw [hz]

end

universe u
variable {d M T : ℕ}

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.seed_average_bound
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Seeded.text:
lemma seed_average_bound {Ξ : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] {f : Ξ → ℝ≥0∞} {C : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, f ξ ≤ C) : ∫⁻ ξ, f ξ ∂ρ ≤ C := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _, C ∂ρ := lintegral_mono_ae h
    _ = C := by simp

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_finite_to_asymptotic
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.text:
lemma cap_finite_to_asymptotic (C : ℝ) {d M : ℕ} (hd : 32 ≤ d)
    (hM : (M:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ)^2) (ε α : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    Real.exp (C*d)*(ε/2)^α*(Real.exp (C*d)*(2:ℝ)^((M:ℝ)/(d/16:ℕ)))^n ≤
      Real.exp ((C+32)*d*(1+n))*(ε/2)^α := by
  have hbase := cap_memory_factor C hd hM
  have hfront : Real.exp (C*d) ≤ Real.exp ((C+32)*d) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) d]
  have ht := mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfront (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ ε/2) α))
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hbase n) (by positivity) (by positivity)
  apply ht.trans_eq
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  calc
    Real.exp ((C+32)*d)*(ε/2)^α*Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*((C+32)*d)) =
        (Real.exp ((C+32)*d)*Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*((C+32)*d)))*(ε/2)^α := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; ring

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_accuracy_cost
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.text:
lemma cap_accuracy_cost {d : ℕ} (hd : 3 ≤ d) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (ε/2)^(((d:ℝ)-1)/2) ≤ Real.exp (-(d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε)/3) := by
  have hdR : (3:ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have ha : 0 ≤ ((d:ℝ)-1)/2 := by linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ε^(((d:ℝ)-1)/2) := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (by linarith) ha
    _ ≤ ε^((d:ℝ)/3) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hε hε1 (by linarith)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hε,one_div,Real.log_inv]
      congr 1
      ring

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_fixed_stop_asymptotic
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.text:
theorem cap_fixed_stop_asymptotic :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
      Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d:ℝ)) (fun d => (d:ℝ)^2) →
      ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d (M d) T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ T →
      let k := d/16
      let α : ℝ := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
      seededFixedSuccess K ρ ε t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (Real.exp (C*d*(1+((t+k-1)/k:ℕ)))*(ε/2)^α) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := cap_fixed_stop.{u}
  refine ⟨C+32,by linarith,?_⟩
  intro M hM
  obtain ⟨d₀,hd₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hM.eventuallyLE
  refine ⟨max d₀ 32,?_⟩
  intro d hd T ε hε hε10 Ξ _ ρ hρ K hK t ht k α
  have hm : (M d:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ)^2 := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (M d)),
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (d:ℝ))] using hd₀ d (by omega)
  exact (h d (M d) T (by omega) ε hε hε10 Ξ ρ hρ K hK t ht).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (cap_finite_to_asymptotic C (by omega) hm ε α _ hε.le))

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_total_success_asymptotic
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.text:
theorem cap_total_success_asymptotic :
    ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < C₁ ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧ ∀ M : ℕ → ℕ,
      Asymptotics.IsLittleO atTop (fun d => (M d:ℝ)) (fun d => (d:ℝ)^2) →
      ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d (M d) T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      seededSuccess K ρ ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (((T:ℝ)+1)*Real.exp (C₁*d+C₂*T-(d:ℝ)*Real.log (1/ε)/3)) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := cap_total_success.{u}
  refine ⟨2*(C+32),32*(C+32),by positivity,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro M hM
  obtain ⟨d₀,hd₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hM.eventuallyLE
  refine ⟨max d₀ 32,?_⟩
  intro d hd T ε hε hε10 Ξ _ ρ hρ K hK
  have hm : (M d:ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ)^2 := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (M d)),
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (d:ℝ))] using hd₀ d (by omega)
  apply (h d (M d) T (by omega) ε hε hε10 Ξ ρ hρ K hK).trans
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  simp only [mul_assoc]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ)+1)
  have hfinite := cap_finite_to_asymptotic C (by omega) hm ε (((d:ℝ)-1)/2)
    ((T+d/16-1)/(d/16)) hε.le
  simp only [mul_assoc] at hfinite
  apply hfinite.trans
  have hcost := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cap_ceil_cost (T := T) (by omega : 32 ≤ d))
    (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ C+32)
  have he : Real.exp ((C+32)*d*(1+((T+d/16-1)/(d/16):ℕ))) ≤
      Real.exp (2*(C+32)*d+32*(C+32)*T) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    nlinarith
  simp only [mul_assoc] at he
  apply (mul_le_mul he (cap_accuracy_cost (d := d) (by omega) hε (by linarith)) (by positivity) (by positivity)).trans_eq
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

end FiniteKernelLearner
end NoiselessRegression

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_ceil_cost
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.text:
lemma cap_ceil_cost {d T : ℕ} (hd : 32 ≤ d) :
    (d:ℝ)*(1+((T+d/16-1)/(d/16):ℕ)) ≤ 2*d+32*T := by
  let k := d/16
  let n := (T+k-1)/k
  have hk : 0 < k := by dsimp [k]; omega
  have hkR : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hdiv : n*k ≤ T+k := (Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _).trans (by omega)
  have hdivR : (n:ℝ)*k ≤ (T:ℝ)+k := by exact_mod_cast hdiv
  have hdR : (d:ℝ) ≤ 32*k := by exact_mod_cast (show d ≤ 32*k by dsimp [k]; omega)
  have hn : (n:ℝ) ≤ (T:ℝ)/k+1 := by
    have he := div_mul_cancel₀ (T:ℝ) hkR.ne'
    nlinarith
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) d)
  have hdk : (d:ℝ)/(k:ℝ) ≤ 32 := (div_le_iff₀ hkR).mpr hdR
  have hT := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdk (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) T)
  change (d:ℝ)*(1+(n:ℝ)) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (d:ℝ)*((T:ℝ)/k+2) := by nlinarith
    _ = (d:ℝ)/k*T+2*d := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.cap_total_success
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.text:
theorem cap_total_success :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ d M T : ℕ, 32 ≤ d → ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ∀ (Ξ : Type u) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (ρ : Measure Ξ), IsProbabilityMeasure ρ →
      ∀ K : Ξ → FiniteKernelLearner d M T, (∀ᵐ ξ ∂ρ, (K ξ).CompletedRules) →
      let k := d/16
      let α : ℝ := ((d:ℝ)-1)/2
      seededSuccess K ρ ε ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (((T:ℝ)+1)*Real.exp (C*d)*(ε/2)^α*
          (Real.exp (C*d)*(2:ℝ)^((M:ℝ)/k))^((T+k-1)/k)) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := Learner.cap_fixed_stop.{0}
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro d M T hd ε hε hε10 Ξ _ ρ hρ K hK k α
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  apply seed_average_bound
  filter_upwards [hK] with ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨ν,L,hν,hB,hL,he,_⟩ := (K ξ).exists_equivalent_tape hξ (by omega)
  rw [←he ε]
  have hs := L.uniformSuccess_le_sum_fixed ν ε
  have hbase : 1 ≤ Real.exp (C*d)*(2:ℝ)^((M:ℝ)/k) :=
    one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (Real.one_le_exp (by positivity))
      (Real.one_le_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity))
  apply hs.trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _t : Fin (T+1), ENNReal.ofReal
        (Real.exp (C*d)*(ε/2)^α*(Real.exp (C*d)*(2:ℝ)^((M:ℝ)/k))^((T+k-1)/k)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro t _
      apply (h d M T hd ε hε hε10 (Tape M T) ν hν L hL
        (L.measurable_terminal hB).fst.aemeasurable t (by omega)).trans
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      exact pow_le_pow_right₀ hbase (Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega))
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin]
      rw [nsmul_eq_mul, ←ENNReal.ofReal_natCast,
        ←ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ ((T+1:ℕ):ℝ))]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring

end

universe u
variable {d M T : ℕ} {Ξ : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ξ]

OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.name: OAI.NoiselessRegression.FiniteKernelLearner.subquadratic_memory_with_pointwise
OAI.Probability.ProjectionMoments.Asympt.text:
theorem subquadratic_memory_with_pointwise : SubquadraticMemoryWithPointwise.{u} := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,h⟩ := subquadratic_memory.{u}
  refine ⟨c,hc,?_⟩
  intro M hM
  obtain ⟨d₀,hd₀⟩ := h M hM
  refine ⟨max d₀ 1,?_⟩
  intro d hd T ε hε hε10 Ξ _ ρ hρ K hK hs
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  let : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  apply hd₀ d (by omega) T ε hε hε10 Ξ ρ hρ K hK
  rcases hs with hs | ⟨hm,hs⟩
  · exact hs
  · exact seededSuccess_of_pointwise K ρ ε hm hs

end

OAI.Geometry.ProjectionVolume.ProductCou.name: OAI.Paper092.product_counterexample
OAI.Geometry.ProjectionVolume.ProductCou.text:
theorem product_counterexample :
    (IsCompact productWitness ∧ Convex ℝ productWitness ∧
      (interior productWitness).Nonempty) ∧
    normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 =
      (121 * (Nat.choose 20 10 : ℝ)) / (21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 20) ∧
    normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 =
      (22355476 : ℝ) / 22020096 ∧
    1 < normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 ∧
    (volume (projectionBody productWitness)).toReal >
      simplexConstant 20 * (volume productWitness).toReal ^ 19 := by
  have hratio : normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 =
      (22355476 : ℝ) / 22020096 := by
    rw [productWitness_normalizedProjectionVolume]
    exact dimension_twenty_ratio
  have hchoose : normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 =
      (121 * (Nat.choose 20 10 : ℝ)) / (21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 20) := by
    rw [hratio, Nat.choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial (by norm_num : 10 ≤ 20)]
    norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  have hgt : 1 < normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness / simplexConstant 20 := by
    rw [hratio]
    norm_num
  have hnorm : simplexConstant 20 < normalizedProjectionVolume productWitness := by
    rw [productWitness_normalizedProjectionVolume]
    exact dimension_twenty_strict
  change simplexConstant 20 <
    (volume (projectionBody productWitness)).toReal / (volume productWitness).toReal ^ 19 at hnorm
  have hvol := (lt_div_iff₀ (pow_pos productWitness_volume_pos 19)).mp hnorm
  exact ⟨productWitness_is_convex_body, hchoose, hratio, hgt, hvol⟩

end Paper092

theorem uniform_localization : ∀ d s t, 0 ≤ s → s < t → UniformLocalization d s t := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero => intro s t _ hst; exact uniform_zero hst
  | succ d ih =>
    apply finite_scale_induction (UniformLocalization (d+1))
    · intro s t _ _ ht; exact uniform_large (d+1) ht
    · intro s t a b u w hs hsa hau huw hwt htb hdegree hnext
      exact uniform_backward ih hs hsa hau huw hwt htb hdegree hnext

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Loc.name: OAI.QAC.localization

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.name: OAI.QAC.parity_trace_identity
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.text:
lemma parity_trace_identity {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) (B : Operator N) :
    (∑ x : Word n, (localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*B*localMatrix (inputHadamard n N))
      (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)) =
    ∑ x : Word n, (bitSign (parity x):ℂ)*B (inputWord x) (inputWord x) := by
  rw [← trace_flip_ancilla hnN]
  let H := localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)
  let T := inputFlip n N*ancillaProjection n N
  change Matrix.trace (T*(H*B*H)) = _
  calc
    Matrix.trace (T*(H*B*H)) = Matrix.trace ((T*(H*B))*H) :=
      congrArg Matrix.trace (mul_assoc T (H*B) H).symm
    _ = Matrix.trace (H*T*(H*B)) := Matrix.trace_mul_cycle _ _ _
    _ = Matrix.trace ((H*T*H)*B) := by rw [mul_assoc (H*T) H B]
    _ = Matrix.trace (inputPhase n N*ancillaProjection n N*B) := by
      rw [show H*T*H=inputPhase n N*ancillaProjection n N from inputHadamard_ancilla_flip n N]
    _ = _ := trace_phase_ancilla hnN B

end QAC

end

end OAI

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.name: OAI.QAC.eventually_exp_neg_power_lt
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.text:
lemma eventually_exp_neg_power_lt {s ε : ℝ} (hs : 0<s) (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Real.exp (-(N:ℝ)^s)<ε := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_power_le hs (-Real.log ε+1)] with N hN
  rw [Real.rpow_zero,mul_one] at hN
  rw [← Real.exp_log hε]
  exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith only [hN])

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Bas.name: OAI.QAC.IsCircuit
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Bas.text:
def IsCircuit {N : ℕ} : ℕ → Operator N → Prop
  | 0, U => ∃ L : LocalLayer N, U = localMatrix L
  | d + 1, U => ∃ (V : Operator N) (R : ReflectionLayer N) (L : LocalLayer N),
      IsCircuit d V ∧ U = V * reflectionMatrix R * localMatrix L

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Com.name: OAI.QAC.high_entry_bound
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Com.text:
lemma high_entry_bound {N : ℕ} (B : Operator N) (z : Word N) (F : Finset (Fin N))
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ (F.card:ℝ)) :
    ‖B (flipWord F z) z‖ ≤ ‖(computationalCount z).high r*B*(computationalCount z).zero‖ := by
  let y := flipWord F z
  have habs := (computationalCount z).high_mul_pattern F (Finset.subset_univ F) r
  rw [ite_eq_left hr,computationalCount_pattern] at habs
  have hleft : basisProjection y*(computationalCount z).high r = basisProjection y := by
    have h := congrArg star habs
    rw [star_mul, ((computationalCount z).high_projection r).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq] at h
    change star (basisProjection y)*(computationalCount z).high r = star (basisProjection y) at h
    simpa only [← computationalCount_zero,
      (computationalCount y).zero_projection.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq,
      ((computationalCount z).high_projection r).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq] using h
  have heq : ((computationalCount z).high r*B*basisProjection z) y z = B y z := by
    rw [← basisProjection_mul_entry y ((computationalCount z).high r*B*basisProjection z) z]
    rw [← mul_assoc,← mul_assoc,hleft,mul_basisProjection_entry,basisProjection_mul_entry]
  rw [computationalCount_zero]
  exact heq ▸ matrix_entry_norm_le ((computationalCount z).high r*B*basisProjection z) y z

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mod.name: OAI.QAC.ParityStatement
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mod.text:
def ParityStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : ℕ) (c ε : ℝ), 1 ≤ c → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 2 →
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, ∀ N : ℕ, n ≤ N → (N : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ c →
      ∀ layers : List (PhysicalLayer N), layers.length ≤ d →
        ∀ out : Fin N, ¬ (∀ x : Word n,
          1 / 2 + ε ≤ successProbability (physicalCircuitMatrix layers) out x)

end QAC

end

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Com.name: OAI.QAC.inputSet_card
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Com.text:
lemma inputSet_card {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n ≤ N) : (inputSet n N).card=n := by

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.name: OAI.QAC.parity_lower_bound
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.text:
theorem parity_lower_bound : ParityStatement := by
  intro d c ε hc hε _
  have hcpos : 0<c := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hc
  let t : ℝ := 1/(2*c)
  let s : ℝ := t/2
  have ht : 0<t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have hs : 0<s := by dsimp [s]; positivity
  have hst : s<t := by dsimp [s]; linarith only [ht]
  have hct : c*t≤1 := by
    have hceq : c*t=1/2 := by dsimp [t]; field_simp
    rw [hceq]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨N₀,hN₀⟩ := localization d s t hs.le hst
  obtain ⟨N₁,hN₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (eventually_exp_neg_power_lt hs hε)
  refine ⟨max 1 (max N₀ N₁),?_⟩
  intro n hn N hnN hsize layers hdepth out hsuccess
  have hn1 : 1≤n := (le_max_left 1 (max N₀ N₁)).trans hn
  have hn0 : 0<n := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn1
  have hNN₀ : N₀≤N := (le_trans (le_max_left N₀ N₁) (le_max_right 1 (max N₀ N₁))).trans (hn.trans hnN)
  have hNN₁ : N₁≤N := (le_trans (le_max_right N₀ N₁) (le_max_right 1 (max N₀ N₁))).trans (hn.trans hnN)
  let W := physicalCircuitMatrix layers
  let H := localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)
  have hW : IsCircuit d W := (physicalCircuit_isCircuit layers).mono hdepth
  have hU : IsCircuit d (H*star W) := hW.star_mem.local_mul (inputHadamard n N)
  have hthreshold : (N:ℝ)^t≤(n:ℝ) := polynomial_qubit_threshold hn1 ht.le hct hsize
  have hentry (x : Word n) :
      ‖(H*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W)*H)
        (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(N:ℝ)^s) := by
    exact (hadamard_high_entry_bound hnN W out x hthreshold).trans
      (hN₀ N hNN₀ (H*star W) hU (computationalCount (inputWord x)) (outputZeroCount out))
  have hadv := parity_advantage_from_entries hn0 hnN W hW.mem_unitary out hsuccess hentry
  exact (not_le_of_gt (hN₁ N hNN₁)) hadv

end QAC

end

end OAI

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.name: OAI.QAC.hadamard_high_entry_bound
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.text:
lemma hadamard_high_entry_bound {n N : ℕ} (hnN : n≤N) (W : Operator N)
    (out : Fin N) (x : Word n) {r : ℝ} (hr : r≤(n:ℝ)) :
    ‖(localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W)*
      localMatrix (inputHadamard n N))
      (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)‖ ≤
    ‖(computationalCount (inputWord x)).high r*(localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*star W)*
      (outputZeroCount out).zero*star (localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*star W)*
      (computationalCount (inputWord x)).zero‖ := by
  have hcard : r≤((inputSet n N).card:ℝ) := by simpa only [inputSet_card hnN] using hr
  have hh := high_entry_bound
    (localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W)*
      localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)) (inputWord x) (inputSet n N) hcard
  simpa only [star_mul,star_star,inputHadamard_star,mul_assoc] using hh
