OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mod.name: OAI.QAC.successProbability
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mod.text:
def successProbability {n N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (out : Fin N) (x : Word n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ y : Word N, if y out = parity x then Complex.normSq (W y (inputWord x)) else 0

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mea.name: OAI.QAC.success_character_lower
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mea.text:
lemma success_character_lower {n N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (out : Fin N) (x : Word n) {ε : ℝ} (hsuccess : 1/2+ε ≤ successProbability W out x) :
    ε+bitSign (parity x)/2 ≤
      ((bitSign (parity x):ℂ)*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W) (inputWord x) (inputWord x)).re := by
  rw [born_zero_diagonal,← Complex.ofReal_mul,Complex.ofReal_re]
  have htotal := outputProbability_complement W hW out (inputWord x)
  change 1/2+ε ≤ outputProbability W out (parity x) (inputWord x) at hsuccess
  generalize hp : parity x=b at hsuccess ⊢
  fin_cases b
  · norm_num [bitSign] at *
    linarith only [hsuccess]
  · norm_num [bitSign] at *
    linarith only [hsuccess,htotal]

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mea.name: OAI.QAC.parity_advantage_from_entries
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mea.text:
lemma parity_advantage_from_entries {n N : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) (hnN : n ≤ N)
    (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N)) (out : Fin N) {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hsuccess : ∀ x : Word n, 1/2+ε ≤ successProbability W out x)
    (hentry : ∀ x : Word n,
      ‖(localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W)*
        localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)) (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)‖ ≤ δ) :
    ε ≤ δ := by
  let B := star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W
  let H := localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)
  have hlow := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun (x : Word n) (_ : x∈Finset.univ) =>
    success_character_lower W hW out x (hsuccess x))
  have hzero := sum_bitSign_parity hn
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul,
    ← Finset.sum_div,hzero,zero_div,add_zero] at hlow
  have hupp := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun (x : Word n) (_ : x∈Finset.univ) =>
    (Complex.re_le_norm ((H*B*H) (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x))).trans (hentry x))
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul] at hupp
  have heq := congrArg Complex.re (parity_trace_identity hnN B)
  have hsumre (f : Word n → ℂ) : (∑ x, f x).re = ∑ x, (f x).re :=
    map_sum Complex.reAddGroupHom f Finset.univ
  rw [hsumre,hsumre] at heq
  change (∑ x : Word n, ((H*B*H) (flipWord (inputSet n N) (inputWord x)) (inputWord x)).re) =
    ∑ x : Word n, ((bitSign (parity x):ℂ)*B (inputWord x) (inputWord x)).re at heq
  rw [heq] at hupp
  have hc : 0 < (Fintype.card (Word n):ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hc).mp (hlow.trans hupp)

end QAC

end

end OAI

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Bas.name: OAI.QAC.LocalizationStatement
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Bas.text:
def LocalizationStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : ℕ) (s t : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → s < t →
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ N₀, ∀ U : Operator N, IsCircuit d U →
      ∀ M D : Count N,
        ‖M.high ((N : ℝ) ^ t) * U * D.zero * star U * M.zero‖ ≤
          Real.exp (-((N : ℝ) ^ s))

end QAC

end

end OAI

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.name: OAI.QAC.sum_bitSign_parity
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.text:
lemma sum_bitSign_parity {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) : (∑ x : Word n, bitSign (parity x))=0 := by
  simp only [bitSign_parity]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun (_ : Fin n) (b : Bit) => bitSign b)]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ (⟨0,hn⟩ : Fin n)) (by norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two,bitSign])

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Com.name: OAI.QAC.inputHadamard_star
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Com.text:
lemma inputHadamard_star (n N : ℕ) : star (localMatrix (inputHadamard n N)) =
    localMatrix (inputHadamard n N) := by
  rw [localMatrix_star]
  congr 1
  funext i
  apply Subtype.ext
  by_cases hi : i.val<n
  · simp only [inputHadamard,ite_eq_left hi,Unitary.coe_star,hadamardGate]
    exact bitH_star
  · simp [inputHadamard,hi]

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Asy.name: OAI.QAC.eventually_power_le
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Asy.text:
lemma eventually_power_le {s t : ℝ} (hst : s < t) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, C * (N : ℝ) ^ s ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ t := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ) ^ (t - s)) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop (sub_pos.2 hst)).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually_ge_atTop C, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN h1
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  calc
    C * (N : ℝ) ^ s ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (t - s) * (N : ℝ) ^ s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN (Real.rpow_nonneg hN0.le _)
    _ = (N : ℝ) ^ t := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hN0]; congr 1; ring

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Phy.name: OAI.QAC.physicalLayer_isCircuit
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Phy.text:
lemma physicalLayer_isCircuit {N : ℕ} (P : PhysicalLayer N) :
    IsCircuit 1 (physicalLayerMatrix P) := by
  let R : ReflectionLayer N := ⟨normalCounts P.gates,normalCounts_disjoint _ P.disjoint⟩
  refine ⟨1,R,normalLocal P.gates,?_,?_⟩
  · exact ⟨fun _ => 1,by simp [localMatrix]⟩
  · rw [one_mul,reflectionMatrix_eq]
    exact gateList_normal P.gates

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.name: OAI.QAC.polynomial_qubit_threshold
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Par.text:
lemma polynomial_qubit_threshold {n N : ℕ} {c t : ℝ} (hn : 1≤n)
    (ht : 0≤t) (hct : c*t≤1) (hN : (N:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)^c) : (N:ℝ)^t≤(n:ℝ) := by
  have hn1 : (1:ℝ)≤n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  calc
    (N:ℝ)^t ≤ ((n:ℝ)^c)^t := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg N) hN ht
    _ = (n:ℝ)^(c*t) := (Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg n) c t).symm
    _ ≤ (n:ℝ)^1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hn1 hct
    _ = (n:ℝ) := Real.rpow_one _

OAI.Geometry.QuadricBundles.Main:10.name: OAI.QuadricCounterexample.main_theorem
OAI.Geometry.QuadricBundles.Main:10.text:
theorem main_theorem : SourceMainTheorem := by
  let G := sourceGraphScalars.equalizerData.bundle
  let E : ℕ → AlgebraicRankTwoBundle := fun m ↦
    if hm : 0 < m then powerPullbackTwist G m hm else G
  refine ⟨G,E,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro m hm
    dsimp [E]
    rw [dite_eq_left hm]
    exact powerPullbackTwist_spec G m hm
  · intro m hm
    dsimp [E]
    rw [dite_eq_left hm]
    exact sourceGraphScalars.equalizerData.powerTwist_ample m hm
  · obtain ⟨m₀,h₀,h⟩ := source_eventually_no_positive_metric
    refine ⟨m₀,h₀,fun m hmi ↦ ?_⟩
    have hm : 0 < m := h₀.trans_le hmi
    dsimp [E]
    rw [dite_eq_left hm]
    exact h m hm hmi

end
end QuadricCounterexample

OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Ma.name: OAI.QuantitativeVanDerWaerden.uniform_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Ma.text:
theorem uniform_lower_bound :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, ∀ r ≥ 2,
      (k : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 100000 : ℝ) * k * (Nat.log 2 r : ℝ)) < (W r k : ℝ) := by

OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Di.name: OAI.QuantitativeVanDerWaerden.cyclic_binary_color_lower
OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Di.text:
theorem cyclic_binary_color_lower {N k r : ℕ} {C : ZMod N → Bool}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hC : CyclicAvoids C k) :
    N ^ Nat.log 2 r < W r k := by
  exact binary_digit_product_log_lt_W hN hk hr hC
    (finite_ramsey (by omega) (by omega))

end QuantitativeVanDerWaerden

OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Cy.name: OAI.QuantitativeVanDerWaerden.CyclicAvoids
OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Cy.text:
def CyclicAvoids {N : ℕ} {α : Type uAlpha} (C : ZMod N → α) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a d, d ≠ 0 → ¬ (∀ j < k, C (a + (j : ZMod N) * d) = C a)

end QuantitativeVanDerWaerden

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Un.name: OAI.QuantitativeVanDerWaerden.uniform_lower_of_cyclicLowerBound
OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Un.text:
theorem uniform_lower_of_cyclicLowerBound {c : ℝ} (hcyclic : CyclicLowerBound c) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, ∀ r ≥ 2,
      (k : ℝ) ^ (c * k * (Nat.log 2 r : ℝ)) < (W r k : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hcyclic
  refine ⟨max K 2, ?_⟩
  intro k hk r hr
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := (le_max_right K 2).trans hk
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hsize, C, hC⟩ := hK k ((le_max_left K 2).trans hk)
  have hprod := cyclic_binary_color_lower hN hk2 hr hC
  calc
    (k : ℝ) ^ (c * k * (Nat.log 2 r : ℝ)) =
        ((k : ℝ) ^ (c * k)) ^ Nat.log 2 r :=
      Real.rpow_mul_natCast (Nat.cast_nonneg k) _ _
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ Nat.log 2 r :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) _) hsize _
    _ < (W r k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hprod

OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Cy.name: OAI.QuantitativeVanDerWaerden.exists_cyclic_coloring
OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Cy.text:
theorem exists_cyclic_coloring :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, ∃ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N ∧
      (k : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 100000 : ℝ) * k) ≤ (N : ℝ) ∧
        ∃ C : ZMod N → Bool, CyclicAvoids C k :=
  eventually_atTop.1 eventually_cyclic_coloring

end QuantitativeVanDerWaerden

end

OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Cy.name: OAI.QuantitativeVanDerWaerden.eventually_cyclic_coloring
OAI.Combinatorics.ProgressionColoring.Cy.text:
theorem eventually_cyclic_coloring :
    ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, ∃ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N ∧
      (k : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 100000 : ℝ) * k) ≤ (N : ℝ) ∧
        ∃ C : ZMod N → Bool, CyclicAvoids C k := by
  filter_upwards [ConstructionModel.eventually_outerChoice, eventually_basicScales,
    eventually_geometryScales, ConstructionModel.eventually_outerChoice_sparse_budget]
    with k houter hbasic hgeom hbudget
  obtain ⟨hk, houter⟩ := houter
  let s : ConstructionModel.Data k := ConstructionModel.choose k hk
  let o : ConstructionModel.OuterChoice s hk := Classical.choice (houter s)
  let : NeZero (s.q ^ dimension k) := ConstructionModel.groupSize_neZero s
  let c₀ : ConstructionModel.Group s → Bool :=
    fun n => o.color (ConstructionModel.fullLabel s hk n)
  let key : ConstructionModel.Group s →
      (Fin (dimension k) → (ConstructionModel.mesh s hk).Label) × ℤ :=
    perturbationKey (ConstructionModel.mesh s hk) s.q (dimension k)
      (ConstructionModel.lambda k)
  let A := affineProgressions s.q (dimension k) (ConstructionModel.lambda k) k
  have hmult : ∀ ad ∈ nonzeroProgressions (s.q ^ dimension k), ∀ a,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin k => (cyclicSignature c₀ key ad j).2 = a)).card ≤ 4 := by
    intro ad had a
    exact construction_key_fiber_card_le_four s hk hbasic ad.1 ad.2
      ((mem_nonzeroProgressions ad).mp had) a
  have hcases : ∀ ad ∈ nonzeroProgressions (s.q ^ dimension k), ad ∈ A ∨ ∀ b,
      k ≤ 100 * (oppositePositions (cyclicSignature (k := k) c₀ key ad) b).card := by
    intro ad had
    rcases ConstructionModel.OuterChoice.rich_or_affine s hk o hgeom ad.1 ad.2 with hrich | haff
    · right
      intro b
      refine (hrich (!b)).trans_eq ?_
      apply congrArg (fun n : ℕ => 100 * n)
      apply congrArg (Finset.card : Finset (Fin k) → ℕ)
      apply Finset.ext
      intro j
      constructor
      · intro hj
        apply (@Finset.mem_filter _ _ _ _ _).mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        simpa only [cyclicSignature, c₀, ConstructionModel.fullLabelWord,
          Bool.eq_not_iff] using ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ _ _ _).mp hj).2
      · intro hj
        apply (@Finset.mem_filter _ _ _ _ _).mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        simpa only [cyclicSignature, c₀, ConstructionModel.fullLabelWord,
          Bool.eq_not_iff] using ((@Finset.mem_filter _ _ _ _ _).mp hj).2
    · left
      exact (mem_affineProgressions ad).mpr ⟨(mem_nonzeroProgressions ad).mp had, haff⟩
  have hbudget' : 2 * (((s.q ^ dimension k : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
      flipProbability k ^ ((k + 399) / 400) +
      2 * ((A.image (cyclicSignature (k := k) c₀ key)).card : ℝ) *
        (1 - flipProbability k) ^ ((k + 3) / 4) < 1 := by
    simpa only [A, c₀, key, ConstructionModel.groupSize] using hbudget hk s o
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_cyclicAvoids_of_ambient_keys c₀ key A
    (affineProgressions_subset _ _ _ _) (flipProbability_pos (by omega : 0 < k)).le
    hbasic.flip_small.le hmult hcases hbudget'
  refine ⟨ConstructionModel.groupSize s, ConstructionModel.groupSize_two_le s hk, ?_, C, hC⟩
  simpa only [Parameters.c] using ConstructionModel.groupSize_lower s hk

OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.SharpCycles:8.name: OAI.QuinticLienard.Sharpness.two_cycles
OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.SharpCycles:8.text:
lemma two_cycles : ∃ ε : ℝ, ∃ C D : Set Plane,IsLimitCycle (F ε) C ∧ IsLimitCycle (F ε) D ∧ C≠D := by
  have h1 : ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝 (0:ℝ),ε≠0 → ∃ (C : Set Plane) (b : ℝ),
      IsLimitCycle (F ε) C ∧ (0,b) ∈ C ∧ |b-1|<1/4 :=
    cycle_near_simple (s:=1) (d:=6*Real.pi) (by norm_num) (by norm_num [average])
      (by convert average_deriv 1 using 1; ring) (by positivity)
  have h2 : ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝 (0:ℝ),ε≠0 → ∃ (C : Set Plane) (b : ℝ),
      IsLimitCycle (F ε) C ∧ (0,b) ∈ C ∧ |b-2|<1/4 :=
    cycle_near_simple (s:=2) (d:=(-48)*Real.pi) (by norm_num) (by norm_num [average])
      (by convert average_deriv 2 using 1; ring) (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hp : ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ),0<ε ∧
      (ε≠0 → ∃ (C : Set Plane) (b : ℝ),IsLimitCycle (F ε) C ∧ (0,b) ∈ C ∧ |b-1|<1/4) ∧
      (ε≠0 → ∃ (C : Set Plane) (b : ℝ),IsLimitCycle (F ε) C ∧ (0,b) ∈ C ∧ |b-2|<1/4) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,(h1.and h2).filter_mono inf_le_left] with ε hε hh
    exact ⟨hε,hh⟩
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hC,hD⟩ := hp.exists
  obtain ⟨C,b,hC,hb,hb1⟩ := hC (ne_of_gt hε)
  obtain ⟨D,c,hD,hc,hc2⟩ := hD (ne_of_gt hε)
  refine ⟨ε,C,D,hC,hD,?_⟩
  intro heq
  have hbpos : (F ε).eval 0<b := by rw [F_zero];linarith [(abs_lt.mp hb1).1]
  have hcpos : (F ε).eval 0<c := by rw [F_zero];linarith [(abs_lt.mp hc2).1]
  have hpoint := hC.1.axis_unique (quintic_representation (F_degree ε)) hbpos hb (heq ▸ hc) rfl hcpos
  have he : c=b := congrArg Prod.snd hpoint
  linarith [(abs_lt.mp hb1).2,(abs_lt.mp hc2).1]

OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.CycleTransfor.name: OAI.QuinticLienard.limitCycle_encard_neg
OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.CycleTransfor.text:
lemma limitCycle_encard_neg (F : Polynomial ℝ) :
    {C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle F C}.encard={C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle (-F) C}.encard := by
  have h (G : Polynomial ℝ) : {C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle G C}.encard≤{C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle (-G) C}.encard := by
    apply encard_le_encard_of_injOn (f:=fun C=>flipY '' C) (fun _ h=>h.flipY)
    exact (Set.image_injective.mpr flipY.injective).injOn
  exact le_antisymm (h F) (by simpa only [neg_neg] using h (-F))
end QuinticLienard

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.UpperAssembly.name: OAI.QuinticLienard.quintic_representation
OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.UpperAssembly.text:
lemma quintic_representation {F : Polynomial ℝ} (hF : F.degree≤5) : ∀ x,F.eval x=poly (fun i : Fin 6=>F.coeff i) x := by
  have hd : F.natDegree≤5 := Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_degree_le hF
  intro x
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (show F.natDegree<6 by omega)]
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ,Finset.sum_range_zero,zero_add,pow_zero,mul_one,pow_one,poly]
  norm_num

OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.SharpCycles:1.name: OAI.QuinticLienard.Sharpness.sharpness
OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.SharpCycles:1.text:
lemma sharpness : ∃ G : Polynomial ℝ,G.degree≤5 ∧ {C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle G C}.encard=2 := by
  obtain ⟨ε,C,D,hC,hD,hne⟩ := two_cycles
  refine ⟨F ε,F_degree ε,le_antisymm (upper_bound (F ε) (F_degree ε)) ?_⟩
  rw [←Set.encard_pair hne]
  exact Set.encard_mono (pair_subset hC hD)
end QuinticLienard.Sharpness

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.UpperAssembly.name: OAI.QuinticLienard.upper_bound
OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.UpperAssembly.text:
lemma upper_bound (F : Polynomial ℝ) (hF : F.degree≤5) : {C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle F C}.encard≤2 := by
  by_cases h5 : 0≤F.coeff 5
  · exact upper_nonnegative (quintic_representation hF) h5
  · rw [limitCycle_encard_neg F]
    have hd : (-F).degree≤5 := by simpa only [Polynomial.degree_neg] using hF
    apply upper_nonnegative (quintic_representation hd)
    simpa using (neg_nonneg.mpr (le_of_not_ge h5))
end QuinticLienard

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.Main:20.name: OAI.QuinticLienard.main
OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.Main:20.text:
theorem main :
    (∀ F : Polynomial ℝ, F.degree ≤ 5 → {C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle F C}.encard ≤ 2) ∧
    (∃ F : Polynomial ℝ, F.degree ≤ 5 ∧ {C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle F C}.encard = 2) :=
  ⟨upper_bound,Sharpness.sharpness⟩
end QuinticLienard

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.UpperAssembly.name: OAI.QuinticLienard.upper_nonnegative
OAI.Analysis.LienardCycles.UpperAssembly.text:
lemma upper_nonnegative {F : Polynomial ℝ} {a : Fin 6 → ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ x,F.eval x=poly a x) (h5 : 0≤a 5) : {C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle F C}.encard≤2 := by
  by_cases h1 : 0≤a 1
  · by_cases h3 : 0≤a 3
    · by_cases hz : a 1=0 ∧ a 3=0 ∧ a 5=0
      · have H := limitCycle_encard_le_matching hF
        rw [no_isolated_matching_even hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2,encard_empty] at H
        exact H.trans (by norm_num)
      · have hne : a 1≠0 ∨ a 3≠0 ∨ a 5≠0 := by tauto
        have he : {C : Set Plane | IsLimitCycle F C}=∅ := by
          apply eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
          intro C hC
          exact no_periodic_case1 hF h1 h3 h5 hne hC.1
        rw [he,encard_empty]
        norm_num
    · exact (limitCycle_encard_le_matching hF).trans (matching_isolated_case2 h1 (lt_of_not_ge h3) h5)
  · by_cases h3 : 0≤a 3
    · exact (limitCycle_encard_le_matching hF).trans (matching_isolated_case3 (lt_of_not_ge h1) h3 h5)
    · exact (limitCycle_encard_le_matching hF).trans (matching_isolated_case4 (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h3) h5)

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Density.name: OAI.RadialTransition.densityInterval
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Density.text:
theorem densityInterval :
    ∃ (p : ℝ) (φ : Potential) (B C η βc : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      0 < p ∧ IsPackingDensity p ∧
      IsBoundedPotential φ ∧ Continuous φ ∧
      0 < B ∧ 0 < C ∧ StableWith φ B ∧ AlgebraicDecayWith φ C ∧
      0 < η ∧ Ioo (5*p/3 - η) (5*p/3 + η) ⊆ Ioi 0 ∧
      βc ∈ Icc (7/8:ℝ) (9/8) ∧
      ∀ ρ ∈ Ioo (5*p/3 - η) (5*p/3 + η),
        IsCanonicalFreeEnergy φ ρ (fun β => f β ρ) ∧
        StrictTemperatureCorner (fun β => f β ρ) βc := by
  obtain ⟨t,b,ht,hb,hrow,x,hx,hsupport⟩ := exists_family_pressure_ball
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have had := iteration_admissible hb t
  let φ := familyPotential t (iterationMass b) (scaleRange b)
  let ρ₀ := 5*packingDensity/3
  have hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀ := by dsimp [ρ₀]; have := packingDensity_pos; positivity
  let η := min (pressureRadius/2) (ρ₀/2)
  have hη : 0 < η := lt_min (by have := pressureRadius_pos; positivity) (by positivity)
  have hηγ : η ≤ pressureRadius/2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hηρ : η ≤ ρ₀/2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hI : Ioo (ρ₀-η) (ρ₀+η) ⊆ Ioi 0 := by
    intro ρ hρ
    change 0 < ρ
    linarith [hρ.1]
  have hφ : Continuous φ := continuous_familyPotential had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 t
  have hbd : IsBoundedPotential φ := bounded_familyPotential had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 t
  have hrow' := admissible_row ht0.le had hrow
  have hcoerc : 2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(∑' n, iterationMass b n)/2 ≤ t^2/16 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
  have hst : StableWith φ (t^2/2) :=
    stable_family_of_master ht0.le had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 had.2.2.1 (fun _ => le_rfl) hrow'
  have hc : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, 2 ≤ (r:ℝ) → φ r ≤ 0 := fun _ hr =>
    familyPotential_nonpos_outer had.1 had.2.1 ht hr
  have hlim (β d : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :=
    (familyCanonicalThermo_spec ht had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 hcoerc hβ hd).1
  let f := fun β ρ => t*canonicalThermo φ t β ρ/β
  have hβ : 0 < x 0 := phaseWindow_positive (by norm_num) hx
  have hβband : x 0 ∈ Icc (7/8:ℝ) (9/8) := by
    have hh := abs_le.mp (phaseWindow_coords hx).1
    constructor <;> linarith
  let C := t^2*(2:ℝ)^(3+1/32:ℝ)+
    t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(∑' n, iterationMass b n*(scaleRange b n)^(1/32:ℝ))
  have hC : 0 < C := by
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ ∑' n, iterationMass b n*(scaleRange b n)^(1/32:ℝ) := by
      apply tsum_nonneg
      intro n
      exact mul_nonneg (had.1 n) (Real.rpow_nonneg (scaleRange_pos (by linarith) n).le _)
    have hbi := bumpIntegral_pos
    dsimp [C]
    positivity
  refine ⟨packingDensity,φ,t^2/2,C,η,x 0,f,packingDensity_pos,packingDensity_limit,
    hbd,hφ,by positivity,hC,hst,
    decay_familyPotential ht had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 (iterationMass_weight_summable hb),
    hη,hI,hβband,?_⟩
  intro ρ hρI
  change ρ ∈ Ioo (ρ₀-η) (ρ₀+η) at hρI
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := hI hρI
  have hdensity : |ρ - 5*packingDensity/3| < pressureRadius/2 := by
    change |ρ - ρ₀| < pressureRadius/2
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [hρI.1], by linarith [hρI.2]⟩
  have hf : IsCanonicalFreeEnergy φ ρ (fun β => f β ρ) :=
    family_free_energy ht hρ.le had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 hcoerc
  have hdual (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) : canonicalThermo φ t β ρ =
      sSup (Set.range fun h : ℝ => h*ρ-grandPressure φ t β h) :=
    canonical_dual_sup hφ hbd hst ht0 hβ.le hρ hc (fun d hd => hlim β d hβ.le hd)
  have hconc : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ioi 0) (fun β => canonicalThermo φ t β ρ) :=
    canonicalThermo_concave hφ hbd ht0 hρ.le (fun β hβ => hlim β ρ hβ.le hρ.le)
  obtain ⟨hs₁,hs₂⟩ := support_ball_two_pressures_nearby hsupport hdensity
  exact ⟨hf, canonical_corner_of_pressure_supports hβ ht0
    (show 17*packingDensity/4-pressureRadius/2 <
      17*packingDensity/4+pressureRadius/2 by linarith [pressureRadius_pos])
    hdual hconc hs₁ hs₂⟩

end RadialTransition
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Main:39.name: OAI.RadialTransition.family_free_energy
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Main:39.text:
lemma family_free_energy {t ρ : ℝ} {a R : ℕ → ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hR : ∀ n, 1 ≤ R n) (hs : Summable a)
    (hcoerc : 2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(∑' n, a n)/2 ≤ t^2/16) :
    IsCanonicalFreeEnergy (familyPotential t a R) ρ
      (fun β => t*canonicalThermo (familyPotential t a R) t β ρ/β) := by
  intro β hβ
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hlim := ((familyCanonicalThermo_spec ht ha hR hs hcoerc hβ.le hρ).1.comp
    (floor_tendsto_thermodynamicFilter hρ)).const_mul t |>.div_const β
  convert hlim using 1
  ext L
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply,finiteCanonical]
  field_simp

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text: lemma iterationP_succ (t b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : iterationP t b (n+1)=idealAttraction (iterationQ t b n) (scaleTail b n) := rfl

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text:
lemma iterationMass_summable {b : ℝ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : Summable (iterationMass b) :=
  summable_prepend _ (summable_scaleTail hb)

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iterationMass_pos
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text:
lemma iterationMass_pos {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (n : ℕ) : 0 < iterationMass b n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact phaseMass_pos
  | succ n => exact scaleTail_pos hb n

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Density.name: OAI.RadialTransition.support_ball_two_pressures_nearby
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Density.text:
lemma support_ball_two_pressures_nearby {Q : Pressure} {x : Parameter} {ρ : ℝ}
    (hs : Metric.closedBall targetSlope pressureRadius ⊆
      supportSet (onParameters Q) positiveParameters x)
    (hρ : |ρ - 5*packingDensity/3| < pressureRadius/2) :
    pressureSupport Q (x 0) (x 1) (17*packingDensity/4-pressureRadius/2) ρ ∧
    pressureSupport Q (x 0) (x 1) (17*packingDensity/4+pressureRadius/2) ρ := by
  have hmem (z : ℝ) (hz : |z| ≤ pressureRadius/2) :
      parameter (17*packingDensity/4+z) ρ ∈
        Metric.closedBall targetSlope pressureRadius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, targetSlope, parameter_sub]
    have he : 17*packingDensity/4+z-17*packingDensity/4 = z := by ring
    rw [he]
    apply (parameter_norm_le _).trans
    simp only [parameter_zero, parameter_one]
    linarith
  have hpos := pressureRadius_pos
  have hs₁ := pressureSupport_iff.mpr
    (hs (hmem (-pressureRadius/2) (by rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; linarith)))
  have hs₂ := pressureSupport_iff.mpr
    (hs (hmem (pressureRadius/2) (by rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)])))
  simpa only [parameter_zero, parameter_one, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_div] using
    And.intro hs₁ hs₂

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Infinit.name: OAI.RadialTransition.exists_family_pressure_ball
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Infinit.text:
lemma exists_family_pressure_ball :
    ∃ t b : ℝ, 1 ≤ t ∧ 2 ≤ b ∧
      2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*iterationBudget ≤ (t^2/8)/8 ∧
      ∃ x ∈ phaseWindow (1/8), Metric.closedBall targetSlope pressureRadius ⊆
        supportSet (onParameters (grandPressure (familyPotential t (iterationMass b) (scaleRange b)) t)) positiveParameters x := by
  have hinitE := initial_separation phaseRadius_pos (show 0<pressureRadius/64 by have := pressureRadius_pos; positivity)
  obtain ⟨t,⟨⟨⟨hinit,ht⟩,htA⟩,htrow⟩⟩ := (hinitE.and (eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℝ)) |>.and
    (eventually_ge_atTop (6912*iterationBudget)) |>.and
    (eventually_ge_atTop (140608*bumpIntegral⁻¹*iterationBudget))).exists
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hrow : 2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*iterationBudget ≤ (t^2/8)/8 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htrow ht0.le
    nlinarith only [hh]
  obtain ⟨U,C,C₀,hU,hC,hC₀,hcontrol⟩ := family_controls ht iterationBudget_pos.le htA hrow
  obtain ⟨D,K,hD,hK,hkac⟩ := family_kac_uniform ht (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
    (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)≤3/2) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2) iterationBudget_pos.le htA
  obtain ⟨b,k,l,hb,hbK,hk,hl,hdom,hrad,hband,hpress⟩ :=
    scale_budgets (K := K) (by linarith : 0≤U) (by linarith : 0≤C) hC₀ (show 0<2*D by positivity)
  have had := iteration_admissible hb t
  have hpre (n : ℕ) := reversePrefix_admissible (t := t) had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 had.2.2.2 n
  have hmass (n : ℕ) : iterationMass b n ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) iterationBudget :=
    ⟨iterationMass_pos (by linarith) n,iterationMass_le hb n⟩
  have hctrl (n : ℕ) := hcontrol _ _ (hpre n) _ (hmass n)
  have hP (n : ℕ) : ConvexOn ℝ positiveParameters (onParameters (iterationP t b n)) :=
    convexOn_idealAttraction (admissible_pressure_convex ht (hpre n) hrow) (hctrl n).1
  have hQ (n : ℕ) : ConvexOn ℝ positiveParameters (onParameters (iterationQ t b n)) :=
    admissible_pressure_convex ht (hpre (n+1)) hrow
  have happ := iteration_kac ht hD hK hb hbK hrow hkac
  have hlip (n : ℕ) (x : Parameter) (hx : x ∈ phaseWindow (1/4))
      (y : Parameter) (hy : y ∈ phaseWindow (1/4)) :
      |onParameters (iterationP t b n) x-onParameters (iterationP t b n) y| ≤ C*dist x y :=
    (hctrl n).2.2.1 x hx y hy
  have hinc (n : ℕ) (x : Parameter) (hx : x ∈ phaseWindow (1/4)) :
      |onParameters (iterationP t b (n+1)) x-onParameters (iterationQ t b n) x| ≤ C₀*scaleTail b n := by
    have hh := (hctrl (n+1)).2.2.2 x hx
    change 0 ≤ onParameters (iterationP t b (n+1)) x-onParameters (iterationQ t b n) x ∧
      onParameters (iterationP t b (n+1)) x-onParameters (iterationQ t b n) x ≤ C₀*scaleTail b n at hh
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hh.1]
    exact hh.2
  have hball : ∀ n, ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball phaseCenter (1/8), Metric.closedBall targetSlope pressureRadius ⊆
      supportSet (onParameters (iterationP t b n)) positiveParameters x := by
    apply multiscale_pressure_balls (fun n => scaleTail_pos (by linarith) n)
      (fun n => show 0≤2*D*(scaleTail b n)^2 by positivity) (by linarith : 0≤U)
      (by linarith : 0≤C) hk hl hP hQ (iterationP_succ t b) happ hlip hinc
      (fun n => (hctrl (n+1)).1) (fun n => (hctrl (n+1)).2.1) ?_ hdom hrad hband hpress
    intro x hx
    rw [iterationP_zero]
    exact ⟨(hinit x hx).2,(hinit x hx).1⟩
  have hlim (x : Parameter) (hx : x ∈ phaseWindow (1/4)) :
      Tendsto (fun n => onParameters (iterationP t b n) x) atTop
        (nhds (onParameters (grandPressure (familyPotential t (iterationMass b) (scaleRange b)) t) x)) := by
    have hβ : 0 < x 0 := phaseWindow_positive (by norm_num) hx
    have hlimQ := (grandPressure_reversePrefix_tendsto (h := x 1) ht hβ had hrow).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    have hdiff : Tendsto (fun n => onParameters (iterationP t b n) x-onParameters (iterationQ t b n) x) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      apply squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun n => 2*D*(scaleTail b n)^2)
      · intro n
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_sub_comm] using happ n x hx
      · simpa using ((summable_scaleTail hb).tendsto_atTop_zero.pow 2).const_mul (2*D)
    have hsum := hdiff.add hlimQ
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply,onParameters,iterationQ,sub_add_cancel,zero_add] using hsum
  exact ⟨t,b,ht,hb,hrow,pressure_ball_limit (admissible_pressure_convex ht had hrow) hball hlip hlim⟩

end RadialTransition
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Uniform.name: OAI.RadialTransition.family_kac_uniform
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Uniform.text:
lemma family_kac_uniform {t βlo βhi H A : ℝ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hb : 0 < βlo) (hb' : βlo ≤ βhi) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (htA : 6912*A ≤ t) :
    ∃ C K : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 1 ≤ K ∧
    ∀ (b S : ℕ → ℝ) (a R₀ R β h : ℝ),
      (∀ n, 0 ≤ b n) → (∀ n, 1 ≤ S n) → Summable b →
      2 ≤ R₀ → (∀ n, S n ≤ R₀) → 0 ≤ a → a+∑' n, b n ≤ A →
      2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(a+∑' n, b n) ≤ (t^2/8)/8 →
      K*R₀ ≤ R → β ∈ Icc βlo βhi → h ∈ Icc (-H) H →
      |grandPressure (familyPotential t (prepend a b) (prepend R S)) t β h-
        idealAttraction (grandPressure (familyPotential t b S) t) a β h| ≤
        C*Real.sqrt (R₀/R) := by
  obtain ⟨κ, D, F, C, hκ, hD, hDF, hC0, hc⟩ := uniform_kac_parameters ht hb hb' hH hA htA
  let W := 10000*(bumpLip:ℝ)+bumpIntegral⁻¹
  have hW : 0 ≤ W := by dsimp [W]; have := bumpIntegral_pos; positivity
  let K := 16*(W+1)^2
  have hK : 1 ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg W]
  let E := 1+2*C+(F+5)/t+βhi*A/2*W*F^2
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hF0 : 0 ≤ F := by linarith
  have hb0 : 0 < βhi := hb.trans_le hb'
  have hE : 0 < E := by dsimp [E]; positivity
  refine ⟨6*E, K, by positivity, hK, ?_⟩
  intro b S a R₀ R β h hbn hS hs hR₀ hrange ha hmass hrow hRR hβ hh
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑' n, b n := tsum_nonneg hbn
  have haA : a ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) A := ⟨ha, by linarith⟩
  have hBA : (∑' n, b n) ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) A := ⟨hsum, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨hq, hqpos, hq1, hqR, hRq, hqfrac, hη⟩ := sqrt_grid_exists hR₀ hW hRR
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
  have heq : kernelRowError hq R = W*(hq:ℝ)/R := rfl
  have heta : kernelUpperError hq R ≤ 1 := (kernelUpperError_le_row hR0.le).trans (heq ▸ hη)
  obtain ⟨hcoerc, hcut, hF, hC⟩ := hc β hβ h hh a haA
  have hbound := family_kac_variational_grid hqpos ht (hb.trans_le hβ.1) ha hqR hq1
    hbn hS hs hR₀ hrange hrow hκ (hcoerc _ ⟨kernelUpperError_nonneg hq hR0.le, heta⟩)
    hD hcut hDF hF (hC _ hBA)
  apply hbound.trans
  have hlog := log_volume_error_le hF0 hq1 ht0
  have hbA : β*a/2 ≤ βhi*A/2 := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul hβ.2 haA.2 ha hb0.le) (by norm_num)
  have hs0 : 0 < (hq:ℝ)/4 := by linarith
  rw [heq]
  exact kac_grid_error_bound hC0 hF0 ht0 hb0.le hA hW hbA hs0 hR₀
    (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg hq) hR0.le) hRq hqfrac hlog

end RadialTransition
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iterationP_zero
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text:
lemma iterationP_zero (t b : ℝ) : iterationP t b 0=
    idealAttraction (grandPressure (corePotential t) t) phaseMass := by
  simp only [iterationP,reversePrefix_zero,iterationMass,prepend_zero,familyPotential_zero]

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iterationMass_tsum
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text:
lemma iterationMass_tsum {b : ℝ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : (∑' n, iterationMass b n) ≤ iterationBudget := by
  rw [iterationMass,tsum_prepend _ (summable_scaleTail hb)]
  have hh := tsum_scaleTail_le hb
  dsimp [iterationBudget]
  linarith [inv_fourth_le_half hb]

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iteration_kac
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text:
lemma iteration_kac {t C K b : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hC : 0 < C) (_hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbK : 2*K ≤ b)
    (hrow : 2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*iterationBudget ≤ (t^2/8)/8)
    (hkac : ∀ (a S : ℕ → ℝ) (m R₀ R β h : ℝ),
      (∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) → (∀ n, 1 ≤ S n) → Summable a →
      2 ≤ R₀ → (∀ n, S n ≤ R₀) → 0 ≤ m → m+∑' n, a n ≤ iterationBudget →
      2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(m+∑' n, a n) ≤ (t^2/8)/8 →
      K*R₀ ≤ R → β ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2) → h ∈ Icc (-2:ℝ) 2 →
      |grandPressure (familyPotential t (prepend m a) (prepend R S)) t β h-
        idealAttraction (grandPressure (familyPotential t a S) t) m β h| ≤ C*Real.sqrt (R₀/R)) :
    ∀ n x, x ∈ phaseWindow (1/4) →
      |onParameters (iterationQ t b n) x-onParameters (iterationP t b n) x| ≤ 2*C*(scaleTail b n)^2 := by
  have ha := iteration_admissible hb t
  have hbn : 1 ≤ b := by linarith
  intro n x hx
  have had := reversePrefix_admissible (t := t) ha.1 ha.2.1 ha.2.2.1 ha.2.2.2 n
  have hadnext := reversePrefix_admissible (t := t) ha.1 ha.2.1 ha.2.2.1 ha.2.2.2 (n+1)
  have hm : iterationMass b n+∑' j, reversePrefix 0 (iterationMass b) n j ≤ iterationBudget := by
    simpa only [reversePrefix_succ,tsum_prepend _ (summable_reversePrefix _ _)] using hadnext.2.2.2
  have hrow' : 2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(iterationMass b n+∑' j, reversePrefix 0 (iterationMass b) n j) ≤ (t^2/8)/8 := by
    apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm ?_) hrow
    have := bumpIntegral_pos
    positivity
  obtain ⟨hβ, hh⟩ := phaseWindow_quarter_bounds hx
  have hβ' : x 0 ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2) := ⟨by linarith [hβ.1],by linarith [hβ.2]⟩
  have hh' : x 1 ∈ Icc (-2:ℝ) 2 := abs_le.mp hh
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    have hh := hkac _ _ (iterationMass b 0) 2 (scaleRange b 0) (x 0) (x 1)
      had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 (by norm_num) (fun _ => by norm_num [reversePrefix_zero])
      (ha.1 0) hm hrow' (by nlinarith [scaleRange_base_le hbn 0]) hβ' hh'
    change |onParameters (iterationQ t b 0) x-onParameters (iterationP t b 0) x| ≤ C*Real.sqrt (2/scaleRange b 0) at hh
    apply hh.trans
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (scale_kac_zero hb) hC.le]
  | succ n =>
    have hR₂ : 2 ≤ scaleRange b n := hb.trans (scaleRange_base_le hbn n)
    have hrange : ∀ j, reversePrefix 1 (scaleRange b) (n+1) j ≤ scaleRange b n :=
      reversePrefix_range_le (by linarith) (fun j hj => scaleRange_mono hbn (by omega))
    have hstep : K*scaleRange b n ≤ scaleRange b (n+1) := by
      rw [scaleRange_succ]
      have hKR : K ≤ scaleRange b n := (show K≤b by linarith).trans (scaleRange_base_le hbn n)
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (scaleRange_pos (by linarith) n).le (sub_nonneg.mpr hKR)]
    have hh := hkac _ _ (iterationMass b (n+1)) (scaleRange b n) (scaleRange b (n+1)) (x 0) (x 1)
      had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 hR₂ hrange (ha.1 (n+1)) hm hrow' hstep hβ' hh'
    change |onParameters (iterationQ t b (n+1)) x-onParameters (iterationP t b (n+1)) x| ≤ C*Real.sqrt (scaleRange b n/scaleRange b (n+1)) at hh
    rw [scale_kac_succ hbn] at hh
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (scaleTail b (n+1))]

end RadialTransition
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iteration_admissible
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text:
lemma iteration_admissible {b : ℝ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (t : ℝ) :
    AdmissibleFamily t iterationBudget (iterationMass b) (scaleRange b) :=
  ⟨fun n => (iterationMass_pos (by linarith) n).le,scaleRange_one_le (by linarith),
    iterationMass_summable hb,iterationMass_tsum hb⟩

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Main:10.name: OAI.RadialTransition.canonical_dual_sup
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Main:10.text:
lemma canonical_dual_sup {φ : Potential} (hφ : Continuous φ) (hb : IsBoundedPotential φ)
    {B t β ρ : ℝ} (hstable : StableWith φ B) (ht : 0 < t) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hc : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, 2 ≤ (r:ℝ) → φ r ≤ 0)
    (hlim : ∀ d : ℝ, 0 ≤ d → Tendsto (fun z : ℝ × ℕ => finiteCanonical φ t z.1 z.2 β)
      (thermodynamicFilter d) (nhds (canonicalThermo φ t β d))) :
    canonicalThermo φ t β ρ = sSup (Set.range fun h : ℝ => h*ρ-grandPressure φ t β h) := by
  obtain ⟨h,he,hle⟩ := (canonical_grand_duality hφ hb hstable ht hβ hc hlim).2 ρ hρ
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [he]
    apply le_csSup
    · exact ⟨canonicalThermo φ t β ρ,fun v ⟨j,hj⟩ => hj ▸ hle j⟩
    · exact ⟨h,rfl⟩
  · exact csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _) (fun v ⟨j,hj⟩ => hj ▸ hle j)

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iterationMass_weight_summable
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text:
lemma iterationMass_weight_summable {b : ℝ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    Summable (fun n => iterationMass b n*(scaleRange b n)^(1/32:ℝ)) := by
  apply (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp
  simpa only [iterationMass,prepend_succ] using summable_scaleTail_weight hb

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iterationMass_le
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text:
lemma iterationMass_le {b : ℝ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (n : ℕ) : iterationMass b n ≤ iterationBudget := by
  exact ((iterationMass_summable hb).le_tsum n (fun j _ => (iterationMass_pos (by linarith) j).le)).trans (iterationMass_tsum hb)

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Initial.name: OAI.RadialTransition.initial_separation
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Initial.text:
lemma initial_separation {τ ε₀ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hε₀ : 0 < ε₀) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop, ∀ x ∈ phaseWindow (1/4),
      |onParameters (idealAttraction (grandPressure (corePotential t) t) phaseMass) x-
        onParameters threePlane x| ≤ ε₀ ∧
      HasPhaseGroups (idealAttraction (grandPressure (corePotential t) t) phaseMass) x (τ/2) := by
  obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀, hcut⟩ := uniform_ideal_cutoff (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)
    (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)≤3/2) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2) phaseMass_pos.le
  let U := max U₀ (4*packingDensity)
  have hUU : U₀ ≤ U := le_max_left _ _
  have hU : 1 ≤ U := hU₀.trans hUU
  have hUp : 4*packingDensity ≤ U := le_max_right _ _
  let K := 1+phaseMass/2*(U+4*packingDensity)
  have hK : 0 < K := by have := phaseMass_pos; have := packingDensity_pos; dsimp [K]; positivity
  let η := τ/(4*K)
  have hη : 0 < η := div_pos hτ (by positivity)
  let ε := min ε₀ (min (τ/32) (phaseMass*η^2/16))
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min hε₀ (lt_min (by positivity) (by have := phaseMass_pos; positivity))
  have he₀ : ε ≤ ε₀ := min_le_left _ _
  have heτ : ε ≤ τ/32 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have heη : ε ≤ phaseMass*η^2/16 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  let H := 2+2*phaseMass*U
  have hH : 0 ≤ H := by have := phaseMass_pos; dsimp [H]; positivity
  filter_upwards [corePressure_uniform_bare (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/4) hH hε,
    eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℝ), eventually_ge_atTop (6912*phaseMass)] with t happ ht htA
  let Q := grandPressure (corePotential t) t
  obtain ⟨hQ, hact⟩ := core_ideal_convex_active ht htA
  have hb : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (0:ℝ) := fun _ => le_rfl
  have hS : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ (1:ℝ) := fun _ => le_rfl
  have hs : Summable (fun _ : ℕ => (0:ℝ)) := summable_zero
  have hrow : 2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(∑' _ : ℕ, (0:ℝ)) ≤ (t^2/8)/8 := by simp; positivity
  have hactive (β h : ℝ) (hβ : β ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2)) (hh : |h| ≤ 2) :
      ∃ u ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) U, ActiveShift Q phaseMass β h u := by
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hc, hbound⟩ := hcut t ht htA β hβ h (abs_le.mp hh) phaseMass ⟨phaseMass_pos.le,le_rfl⟩
    have hbound' := hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hUU hκ.le)
    obtain ⟨u, hu, ha⟩ := family_ideal_exists_active ht (by linarith [hβ.1]) phaseMass_pos.le
      hb hS hs hrow hκ hc hU hbound'
    rw [familyPotential_zero] at ha
    exact ⟨u, hu, ha⟩
  have hshift (β h u : ℝ) (hβ : β ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2)) (hh : |h| ≤ 2)
      (hu : u ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) U) : |h+β*phaseMass*u| ≤ H := by
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ β := by linarith [hβ.1]
    have ha0 := phaseMass_pos.le
    have hu0 := hu.1
    have hmul : β*phaseMass*u ≤ 2*phaseMass*U :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show β ≤ 2 by linarith [hβ.2]) phaseMass_pos.le)
        hu.2 hu.1 (by have := phaseMass_pos; positivity)
    calc
      _ ≤ |h|+|β*phaseMass*u| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ H := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ β*phaseMass*u)]; dsimp [H]; linarith
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hβ, hh⟩ := phaseWindow_quarter_bounds hx
  have hβ' : x 0 ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2) := ⟨by linarith [hβ.1], by linarith [hβ.2]⟩
  have hβ0 : 0 < x 0 := by linarith [hβ.1]
  have happx : ∀ u ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) U, |Q (x 0) (x 1+x 0*phaseMass*u)-bareLimit (x 1+x 0*phaseMass*u)| ≤ ε := by
    intro u hu
    exact happ _ _ (by linarith [hβ.1]) (hshift _ _ _ hβ' hh hu)
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨u, hub, hu⟩ := hactive _ _ hβ' hh
    exact (ideal_approx_threePlane hβ0.le hUp hu hub happx).trans he₀
  · have hlocal : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x (1/16), ∃ u ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) U, ActiveShift Q phaseMass (y 0) (y 1) u := by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : y ∈ phaseWindow (1/2) := phaseWindow_mono (by norm_num : (1/4:ℝ)+1/16≤1/2) (phaseWindow_near hx hy)
      obtain ⟨hyβ, hyh⟩ := phaseWindow_half_bounds hy'
      exact hactive _ _ hyβ hyh
    have hgen := ideal_supportSet_generated hQ phaseMass_pos hact (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/16)
      (by linarith [hβ.1] : 2*(1/16:ℝ)<x 0) hlocal
    apply phase_groups_of_generators hgen
    rintro v ⟨u, hub, hu, e, hes, rfl⟩
    have happe : ∀ s ∈ ({-(1/4:ℝ),0,1/4} : Set ℝ),
        |Q (x 0+s) (x 1+x 0*phaseMass*u)-bareLimit (x 1+x 0*phaseMass*u)| ≤ ε := by
      intro s hs
      have hs' : -(1/4:ℝ) ≤ s := by
        simp only [mem_insert_iff,mem_singleton_iff] at hs
        rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
      exact happ _ _ (by linarith [hβ.1]) (hshift _ _ _ hβ' hh hub)
    have hsmall : 2*ε ≤ x 0*phaseMass/2*η^2 := by
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hβ.1 (mul_nonneg phaseMass_pos.le (sq_nonneg η))
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := phase_generator_distance hβ0 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/4)
      (by linarith [hβ.1]) hη.le hUp hu hub happx happe hsmall hes
    refine ⟨i, Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr ?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    apply hi.trans
    have heq : K*η=τ/4 := by dsimp [η]; field_simp
    change 2*ε/(1/4)+K*η ≤ τ/2
    rw [heq]
    linarith

end RadialTransition
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iterationMass
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.text: def iterationMass (b : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ := prepend phaseMass (scaleTail b)

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Physica.name: OAI.RadialTransition.iterationQ

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Main:24.name: OAI.RadialTransition.support_ball_two_pressures
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Main:24.text:
lemma support_ball_two_pressures {Q : Pressure} {x : Parameter}
    (hs : Metric.closedBall targetSlope pressureRadius ⊆ supportSet (onParameters Q) positiveParameters x) :
    pressureSupport Q (x 0) (x 1) (17*packingDensity/4-pressureRadius/2) (5*packingDensity/3) ∧
    pressureSupport Q (x 0) (x 1) (17*packingDensity/4+pressureRadius/2) (5*packingDensity/3) := by
  have hp := pressureRadius_pos
  have hmem (z : ℝ) (hz : |z|≤pressureRadius) : parameter (17*packingDensity/4+z) (5*packingDensity/3) ∈
      Metric.closedBall targetSlope pressureRadius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm,targetSlope,parameter_sub,sub_self]
    have he : 17*packingDensity/4+z-17*packingDensity/4=z := by ring
    rw [he,parameter_horizontal_norm]
    exact hz
  have hs₁ := pressureSupport_iff.mpr (hs (hmem (-pressureRadius/2) (by rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; linarith)))
  have hs₂ := pressureSupport_iff.mpr (hs (hmem (pressureRadius/2) (by rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]; linarith)))
  simpa only [parameter_zero,parameter_one,sub_eq_add_neg,neg_div] using And.intro hs₁ hs₂

OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Main:53.name: OAI.RadialTransition.main
OAI.Probability.RadialTransition.Main:53.text:
theorem main :
    ∃ (p : ℝ) (φ : Potential) (B C : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (βc : ℝ),
      0 < p ∧ IsPackingDensity p ∧
      IsBoundedPotential φ ∧ Continuous φ ∧
      0 < B ∧ 0 < C ∧ StableWith φ B ∧ AlgebraicDecayWith φ C ∧
      IsCanonicalFreeEnergy φ (5*p/3) f ∧
      βc ∈ Icc (7/8:ℝ) (9/8) ∧ StrictTemperatureCorner f βc := by
  obtain ⟨t,b,ht,hb,hrow,x,hx,hsupport⟩ := exists_family_pressure_ball
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have had := iteration_admissible hb t
  let φ := familyPotential t (iterationMass b) (scaleRange b)
  let ρ := 5*packingDensity/3
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; have := packingDensity_pos; positivity
  have hφ : Continuous φ := continuous_familyPotential had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 t
  have hbd : IsBoundedPotential φ := bounded_familyPotential had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 t
  have hrow' := admissible_row ht0.le had hrow
  have hcoerc : 2197*t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(∑' n, iterationMass b n)/2 ≤ t^2/16 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
  have hst : StableWith φ (t^2/2) := stable_family_of_master ht0.le had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 had.2.2.1 (fun _ => le_rfl) hrow'
  have hc : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, 2 ≤ (r:ℝ) → φ r ≤ 0 := fun _ hr => familyPotential_nonpos_outer had.1 had.2.1 ht hr
  have hlim (β d : ℝ) (hβ : 0≤β) (hd : 0≤d) := (familyCanonicalThermo_spec ht had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 hcoerc hβ hd).1
  let f := fun β => t*canonicalThermo φ t β ρ/β
  have hf : IsCanonicalFreeEnergy φ ρ f := family_free_energy ht hρ.le had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 hcoerc
  have hβ : 0 < x 0 := phaseWindow_positive (by norm_num) hx
  have hβband : x 0 ∈ Icc (7/8:ℝ) (9/8) := by
    have hh := abs_le.mp (phaseWindow_coords hx).1
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hdual (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) : canonicalThermo φ t β ρ =
      sSup (Set.range fun h : ℝ => h*ρ-grandPressure φ t β h) :=
    canonical_dual_sup hφ hbd hst ht0 hβ.le hρ hc (fun d hd => hlim β d hβ.le hd)
  have hconc : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ioi 0) (fun β => canonicalThermo φ t β ρ) :=
    canonicalThermo_concave hφ hbd ht0 hρ.le (fun β hβ => hlim β ρ hβ.le hρ.le)
  obtain ⟨hs₁,hs₂⟩ := support_ball_two_pressures hsupport
  have hcorner : StrictTemperatureCorner f (x 0) := canonical_corner_of_pressure_supports hβ ht0
    (show 17*packingDensity/4-pressureRadius/2 < 17*packingDensity/4+pressureRadius/2 by linarith [pressureRadius_pos]) hdual hconc hs₁ hs₂
  let C := t^2*(2:ℝ)^(3+1/32:ℝ)+t*bumpIntegral⁻¹*(∑' n, iterationMass b n*(scaleRange b n)^(1/32:ℝ))
  have hC : 0 < C := by
    have hw0 : 0≤∑' n, iterationMass b n*(scaleRange b n)^(1/32:ℝ) := by
      apply tsum_nonneg
      intro n
      exact mul_nonneg (had.1 n) (Real.rpow_nonneg (scaleRange_pos (by linarith) n).le _)
    have hbi := bumpIntegral_pos
    dsimp [C]
    positivity
  exact ⟨packingDensity,φ,t^2/2,C,f,x 0,packingDensity_pos,packingDensity_limit,hbd,hφ,
    by positivity,hC,hst,decay_familyPotential ht had.1 had.2.1 had.2.2.1 (iterationMass_weight_summable hb),
    hf,hβband,hcorner⟩

end RadialTransition
end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Model:14.name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.SharpBounds
OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Model:14.text:
def SharpBounds : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
    (t : ℝ) ^ 4 / Real.rpow (Real.log t) (3 + ε) ≤ (ramsey 5 t : ℝ) ∧
    (ramsey 5 t : ℝ) ≤ C * (t : ℝ) ^ 4 / (Real.log t) ^ 3

OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Main:27.name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.main
OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Main:27.text:
theorem main : SharpBounds ∧ SharpExponent :=
  ⟨sharpBounds, sharpExponent_of_sharpBounds sharpBounds⟩
end SharpRamseyFive

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Main:18.name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.sharpBounds
OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Main:18.text:
theorem sharpBounds : SharpBounds := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, n₀, hupper⟩ := upper_bound_eventually
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  have hlo := lower_arbitrary_slack (fun η hη hη' => primeConstruction hη hη') hε
  obtain ⟨m₀, hlower⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hlo
  exact ⟨max n₀ m₀, fun t ht =>
    ⟨hlower t ((le_max_right _ _).trans ht), hupper t ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht)⟩⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Bounds.Prim.name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.lower_arbitrary_slack
OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Bounds.Prim.text:
theorem lower_arbitrary_slack
    (hconstruction : ∀ η : ℝ, 0<η → η<1/10 → PrimeConstruction η)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, (t:ℝ)^4/Real.rpow (Real.log t) (3+ε) ≤ (ramsey 5 t:ℝ) := by
  let η := min (ε/8) (1/20)
  have hη : 0<η := lt_min (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  have hηhi : η<1/10 := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hdiff : 0<ε-4*η := by have hh := min_le_left (ε/8) (1/20); change η≤ε/8 at hh; linarith
  have hgrowth : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => (Real.log t)^(ε-4*η)) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop hdiff).comp (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  filter_upwards [lower_fixed_eta hη (hconstruction η hη hηhi),eventually_ge_atTop (2:ℕ),
    hgrowth.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop (512:ℝ))] with t ht ht2 h512
  have hl : 0<Real.log (t:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1<t by omega))
  have hden : 512*(Real.log t)^(3+4*η) ≤ Real.rpow (Real.log t) (3+ε) := by
    have heq : (3+ε) = (ε-4*η)+(3+4*η) := by ring
    change _ ≤ (Real.log t)^(3+ε)
    conv_rhs => rw [heq,Real.rpow_add hl]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h512 (Real.rpow_nonneg hl.le _)
  exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) hden).trans ht.le

end SharpRamseyFive

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Bounds.Prim.name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.primeConstruction
OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Bounds.Prim.text:
theorem primeConstruction {η : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) (hη' : η<1/10) : PrimeConstruction η := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun q : ℕ=>Real.log (q:ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hevent := hlog.eventually ((eventually_no_initial_polar hη hη' (1/2) 2 40
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).and (initial_floor_scales hη hη'))
  obtain ⟨q₀,hq₀⟩:=eventually_atTop.mp hevent
  refine ⟨max q₀ 3,?_⟩
  intro q hlarge hprime
  let : Fact q.Prime:=⟨hprime⟩
  let K:=ZMod q
  let V:=Space K
  let : Finite (Dual K V) := Module.finite_of_finite K
  let : Finite (Dual K (Dual K V)) := Module.finite_of_finite K
  let : Fintype (ℙ K V):=Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Fintype (ℙ K (Dual K V)):=Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Fintype (ℙ K (Dual K (Dual K V))):=Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Finite (Submodule K (Dual K V)):=Finite.of_injective
    (fun W : Submodule K (Dual K V)=>(W:Set (Dual K V))) SetLike.coe_injective
  let : Fintype (Submodule K (Dual K V)):=Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hd : finrank K V=5 := by simp [V,Space]
  let : Nonempty (RectangleGeometry.Flag (K:=K) (V:=V)):=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (RectangleGeometry.flags_nonempty hd)
  have hcard : Nat.card K=q := by simp [K,Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  let σ:=Real.log (q:ℝ)
  have hqp : (0:ℝ)<q := by exact_mod_cast hprime.pos
  have hqexp : Real.exp σ=Nat.card K := by rw [hcard];exact Real.exp_log hqp
  have hq3 : 3≤Nat.card K := by rw [hcard];exact (le_max_right _ _).trans hlarge
  obtain ⟨hforbid,hσ,hqexp3,hfloor,hlen⟩:=hq₀ q ((le_max_left _ _).trans hlarge)
  let N:=⌊(q:ℝ)^4*σ⌋₊
  let n:=⌊(q:ℝ)*σ^(1+η)⌋₊
  have heq : Real.exp σ=(q:ℝ) := Real.exp_log hqp
  change 1≤σ at hσ
  change ⌊Real.exp σ*σ^(1+η)⌋₊≤⌊(Real.exp σ)^4*σ⌋₊ at hfloor
  rw [heq] at hfloor
  have hN : (N:ℝ)≤(Nat.card K:ℝ)^4*σ := by
    rw [hcard]
    exact Nat.floor_le (by dsimp [σ];positivity)
  have hNexp : (N:ℝ)≤Real.exp (4*σ)*σ := by
    have he : Real.exp (4*σ)=(Nat.card K:ℝ)^4 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat,hqexp] using Real.exp_nat_mul σ 4
    rw [he]
    exact hN
  have hlen' : (1/2:ℝ)*(Nat.card K:ℝ)*σ^(1+η)≤(n:ℝ) := by
    simpa only [n,σ,Real.exp_log hqp,hcard] using hlen
  have hk : (n:ℝ)≤(Nat.card K:ℝ)*σ^(1+η) := by
    rw [hcard]
    exact Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  by_contra hnone
  have hno : ∀s : Fin N→RectangleGeometry.Flag (K:=K) (V:=V),¬(graph s)ᶜ.CliqueFree n := by
    intro s hs
    exact hnone ⟨graph s,cliqueFree_five s,hs⟩
  obtain ⟨adm,⟨S⟩⟩:=initial_polar_of_no_graph (K:=K) hfloor σ hσ hqexp hq3 hN hno
  exact hforbid q K (RectangleGeometry.Flag (K:=K) (V:=V)) N n adm (40*σ) (n:ℝ) S
    hq3 hcard hσ hqexp (incidentFlag_log_card hd σ hqexp) hNexp hlen' le_rfl hk
    (by linarith only [hlen']) (by positivity) le_rfl
end
end

OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Bounds.Rams.name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.upper_bound_eventually
OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Bounds.Rams.text:
theorem upper_bound_eventually :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
      (ramsey 5 t : ℝ) ≤ C * (t : ℝ)^4 / (Real.log t)^3 := by
  simpa only [ramsey_eq_related, show 5-1 = 4 from rfl, show 5-2 = 3 from rfl]
    using SharpLogRamsey.Upper.ramsey_upper (s := 5) (by decide)

OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Bounds.Prim.name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.sharpExponent_of_sharpBounds
OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Bounds.Prim.text:
theorem sharpExponent_of_sharpBounds (h : SharpBounds) : SharpExponent := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hb⟩ := h
  have ht : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => (t:ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hl := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp ht
  have hll := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hl
  have hlog : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, 0 < Real.log t ∧ 0 < Real.log (Real.log t) := by
    filter_upwards [hl.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop (1:ℝ))] with t hlt
    change 1 < Real.log (t:ℝ) at hlt
    exact ⟨by linarith,Real.log_pos hlt⟩
  have hnumeric (t : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (ht : 2 ≤ t)
      (hlog : 0 < Real.log t) (hllog : 0 < Real.log (Real.log t))
      (hlo : (t:ℝ)^4 / Real.rpow (Real.log t) (3+ε) ≤ (ramsey 5 t:ℝ))
      (hhi : (ramsey 5 t:ℝ) ≤ C*(t:ℝ)^4/(Real.log t)^3) :
      3 - Real.log C / Real.log (Real.log t) ≤
        (4*Real.log t-Real.log (ramsey 5 t:ℝ))/Real.log (Real.log t) ∧
      (4*Real.log t-Real.log (ramsey 5 t:ℝ))/Real.log (Real.log t) ≤ 3+ε := by
    have htpos : 0 < (t:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<t by omega)
    have hp : 0 < (t:ℝ)^4 / Real.rpow (Real.log t) (3+ε) :=
      div_pos (pow_pos htpos _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog _)
    have hrpos := hp.trans_le hlo
    have lower := Real.log_le_log hp hlo
    have upper := Real.log_le_log hrpos hhi
    rw [Real.log_div (x := (t:ℝ)^4) (y := Real.rpow (Real.log t) (3+ε)) (by positivity) (ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlog _)),
      Real.log_pow,show Real.log (Real.rpow (Real.log t) (3+ε)) = (3+ε)*Real.log (Real.log t) from Real.log_rpow hlog (3+ε)] at lower
    rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity),Real.log_mul (by positivity)
      (by positivity),Real.log_pow,Real.log_pow] at upper
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at lower upper
    constructor
    · apply (le_div_iff₀ hllog).mpr
      have heq : (3-Real.log C/Real.log (Real.log t))*Real.log (Real.log t) =
          3*Real.log (Real.log t)-Real.log C := by field_simp
      rw [heq]
      linarith
    · exact (div_le_iff₀ hllog).mpr (by linarith)
  unfold SharpExponent
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    have hconv : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => 3-Real.log C/Real.log (Real.log t)) atTop (nhds 3) := by
      simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.sub ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := Real.log C)).div_atTop hll)
    obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := hb 1 (by norm_num)
    filter_upwards [hconv.eventually (lt_mem_nhds ha),hlog,eventually_ge_atTop (max N 2)]
      with t hat hlt ht
    obtain ⟨hlo,hhi⟩ := hN t ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht)
    exact hat.trans_le (hnumeric t 1 ((le_max_right _ _).trans ht) hlt.1 hlt.2 hlo hhi).1
  · intro a ha
    let ε := (a-3)/2
    have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
    obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := hb ε hε
    filter_upwards [hlog,eventually_ge_atTop (max N 2)] with t hlt ht
    obtain ⟨hlo,hhi⟩ := hN t ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht)
    exact ((hnumeric t ε ((le_max_right _ _).trans ht) hlt.1 hlt.2 hlo hhi).2).trans_lt
      (by dsimp [ε]; linarith)

end SharpRamseyFive

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Model:19.name: OAI.SharpRamseyFive.SharpExponent
OAI.Combinatorics.RamseyFive.Model:19.text:
def SharpExponent : Prop :=

    (fun t : ℕ => (4 * Real.log (t : ℝ) - Real.log (ramsey 5 t : ℝ)) /

theorem post_polynomial : ∃ K e, ∀ z, postCost z≤K*(treeSize (encode z)+1)^e := by
  have hi := PolyBound.base (fun z : PostCode.Input => treeSize (encode z))
  have hc := polynomial_limit PostCode.run.polynomial _ (fun z : PostCode.Input => z) hi
  have ho := polynomial_output PostCode.run.device _ (fun z : PostCode.Input => z) hi hc
  have he := ((PolyBound.const _ 4).mul ho).add (PolyBound.const _ 2)
  have hb : PolyBound (fun z : PostCode.Input => treeSize (encode z)) (fun z => Emit.cost (PostCode.run z).bits) :=
    he.mono (fun z => (Emit.bound _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 (digits_length _)) 2))
  exact (hc.add hb).add (PolyBound.const _ 2)
end MeanPayoff.Realizer

theorem correct_count {K : ℕ} (P : Program K) (G : Game) (n : ℕ)
    (hh : (tree P n (RegisterBits.initial P (input G))).All (fun c => c.control=none))
    (hp : 7/8≤(tree P n (RegisterBits.initial P (input G))).probability
      (fun c => BinaryInput.CorrectList G c.output)) :
    7*2^(2*bound P (input G) n)≤8*(Finset.univ.filter
      (fun bits : Fin (2*bound P (input G) n)→Bool =>
        CorrectOutput G (result (machine P) G (2*bound P (input G) n) bits))).card := by
  classical
  have hq := correct_probability P G n hh
  have hl : (2:ℚ)^(2*bound P (input G) n)*(7/8)≤
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun bits : Fin (2*bound P (input G) n)→Bool =>
        CorrectOutput G (result (machine P) G (2*bound P (input G) n) bits))).card : ℚ) :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity)).trans hq
  have hr : (7:ℚ)*2^(2*bound P (input G) n)≤8*
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun bits : Fin (2*bound P (input G) n)→Bool =>
        CorrectOutput G (result (machine P) G (2*bound P (input G) n) bits))).card : ℚ) := by
    linarith only [hl]
  exact_mod_cast hr

OAI.Computability.RationalHitting.Main:1.text:
theorem stack_implementation : StackImplementation := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := Runtime.raw_feasible
  let f : p.Registers → Fin (Fintype.card p.Registers+1) :=
    fun a => (Fintype.equivFin p.Registers a).castSucc
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b h
    apply (Fintype.equivFin p.Registers).injective
    exact Fin.castSucc_inj.mp h
  obtain ⟨C,k,hC,hk,hbound⟩ := (p.bound.comp (TimeBound.variable+1)).growth
  refine ⟨Fintype.card p.Registers,p.program.rename f,f p.input,f p.output,C,k,hC,hk,?_⟩
  intro n s hn hs
  obtain ⟨t,ht,he⟩ := p.correct (n,s)
  refine ⟨t,?_,?_⟩
  · have hb := hbound (n+s+1) (by omega)
    simp only [TimeBound.eval_comp,TimeBound.eval_add,TimeBound.eval_variable,
      TimeBound.eval_numeral] at hb
    have hlen : (unaryWord n s).length+1=n+s+1+1 := by simp [unaryWord];omega
    have ht' : t≤p.bound.eval ((unaryWord n s).length+1) := ht
    rw [hlen] at ht'
    exact ht'.trans hb
  · have hh := he.rename_single f hf
    simpa only [single,Function.comp_apply,id_eq] using hh

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.RenormingMode.text:
def RealL1RenormingStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∃ N : AddGroupNorm RealL1,
    (∀ (r : ℝ) (c : RealL1), N (r • c) = |r| * N c) ∧
    (∀ c : RealL1, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖c‖ ≤ N c ∧ N c ≤ blockBound p * ‖c‖) ∧
    (let m : Module ℝ RealL1 := inferInstance
     letI : NormedAddCommGroup RealL1 := N.toNormedAddCommGroup
     ∃ s : NormedSpace ℝ RealL1, s.toModule = m ∧
       letI := s
       CompleteSpace RealL1 ∧
       HasBAP RealL1 (2 * blockBound p) ∧ ¬ HasBAP RealL1 (p : ℝ) ∧
         (p = 1 → ¬ HasBAP RealL1 1))

end DiscreteFree
end

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.CompactApprox.name: OAI.DiscreteFree.projection_compact
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.CompactApprox.text:
theorem projection_compact (C : Set (FreeSpace o)) (hC : IsCompact C) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ F : Finset M, ∀ G : Finset M, F ⊆ G → ∀ u ∈ C,
      ‖supportProjection o sep G u - u‖ < ε := by
  have hK : 0 < 2*B+1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨t, _, ht, hcover⟩ := hC.finite_cover_balls (e := ε/(2*(2*B+1))) (by positivity)
  choose F hF using (fun z : FreeSpace o => projection_pointwise o sep B hB hb z (ε/2) (by positivity))
  refine ⟨ht.toFinset.biUnion F, fun G hG u hu => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, huz⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcover hu)
  have hzF : F z ⊆ G := (Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem F (ht.mem_toFinset.mpr hz)).trans hG
  have hze := hF z G hzF
  have huz' : ‖u-z‖ < ε/(2*(2*B+1)) := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using huz
  have hsmall : (2*B+1)*‖u-z‖ < ε/2 := by
    have hh := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2*(2*B+1))).mp huz'
    nlinarith
  calc
    ‖supportProjection o sep G u - u‖ =
      ‖(supportProjection o sep G (u-z) - (u-z)) + (supportProjection o sep G z - z)‖ := by
        rw [map_sub]; congr 1; abel
    _ ≤ ‖supportProjection o sep G (u-z) - (u-z)‖ + ‖supportProjection o sep G z - z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (2*B+1)*‖u-z‖ + ‖supportProjection o sep G z - z‖ :=
      add_le_add (projection_error_bound o sep B hB hb G (u-z)) le_rfl
    _ < ε := by linarith

include sep hB hb in

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Coefficients:.name: OAI.DiscreteFree.Coefficients.synthesis_bound
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Coefficients:.text:
theorem synthesis_bound (c : L1 ι) :
    ‖synthesisLinear o e B hb c‖ ≤ B * ‖c‖ := by
  change ‖∑' i, c i • delta o (e i).val‖ ≤ B * ‖c‖
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' i, ‖c i • delta o (e i).val‖ :=
      norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (summable_term_norm o e B hb c)
    _ ≤ ∑' i, |c i| * B := Summable.tsum_le_tsum (term_bound o e B hb c)
      (summable_term_norm o e B hb c) ((summable_abs c).mul_right B)
    _ = B * ‖c‖ := by rw [tsum_mul_right, norm_eq_tsum, mul_comm]

theorem not_hasBAP_of_finite_obstruction {M : Type*} [MetricSpace M] (o : M)
    (A : Finset M) (p ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hobs : ∀ T : FreeSpace o →L[ℝ] FreeSpace o,
      Module.Finite ℝ (LinearMap.range T.toLinearMap) → ‖T‖ ≤ p →
        ∃ a ∈ A, ε ≤ ‖T (delta o a) - delta o a‖)
    (Λ : ℝ) (hΛ : Λ ≤ p) : ¬ HasBAP (FreeSpace o) Λ := by
  intro h
  let C := (delta o) '' (A : Set M)
  have hC : IsCompact C := (A.finite_toSet.image (delta o)).isCompact
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hTnorm,η,hη,he⟩ := h C hC ε hε
  obtain ⟨a,ha,herr⟩ := hobs T hT (hTnorm.trans hΛ)
  have herror := he (delta o a) ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
  linarith

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Coordinates:1.text:
theorem supportProjection_bound (F : Finset M) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hb : ∀ x, dist x o ≤ B) : ‖supportProjection o sep F‖ ≤ 2*B := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
  intro u
  rw [supportProjection_apply]
  calc
    ‖∑ j ∈ F, coordinate o sep j u • delta o j‖ ≤
        ∑ j ∈ F, ‖coordinate o sep j u • delta o j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ j ∈ F, |coordinate o sep j u| * dist j o := by simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, delta_norm]
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ F, |coordinate o sep j u| * B := by gcongr with j hj; exact hb j
    _ = (∑ j ∈ F, |coordinate o sep j u|) * B := (Finset.sum_mul ..).symm
    _ ≤ (2 * ‖u‖) * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sum_abs_coordinate_le o sep F u) hB
    _ = (2*B) * ‖u‖ := by ring

end DiscreteFree
end

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Coefficients:.name: OAI.DiscreteFree.Coefficients.synthesis_analysis
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Coefficients:.text:
@[simp] theorem synthesis_analysis (u : FreeSpace o) :
    synthesis o e B hb (analysis o sep e u) = u := by
  let A := (synthesis o e B hb).comp (analysis o sep e)
  change A u = u
  refine freeSpace_induction (fun v => A v = v)
    (isClosed_eq A.continuous continuous_id) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ u
  · exact map_zero A
  · intro v w hv hw
    simp only [map_add, hv, hw]
  · intro r v hv
    simp only [map_smul, hv]
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : x = o
    · subst x
      simp [A]
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := e.surjective ⟨x, hx⟩
      have hix : (e i).val = x := congrArg Subtype.val hi
      rw [← hix]
      change synthesis o e B hb (analysis o sep e (delta o (e i).val)) = _
      rw [analysis_delta, synthesis_single, one_smul]

theorem bounded_separated_hasBAP : HasBAP (FreeSpace o) (2*B) := by
  intro C hC ε hε
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := projection_compact o sep B hB hb C hC (ε/2) (by positivity)
  exact ⟨supportProjection o sep F, supportProjection_finiteRank o sep F,
    supportProjection_bound o sep F B hB hb, ε/2, by linarith,
    fun u hu => (hF F le_rfl u hu).le⟩

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Coefficients:.name: OAI.DiscreteFree.Coefficients.equiv_bounds
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Coefficients:.text:
theorem equiv_bounds (c : L1 ι) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖c‖ ≤ ‖equiv o sep e B hb c‖ ∧
    ‖equiv o sep e B hb c‖ ≤ B * ‖c‖ := by
  constructor
  · have h := analysis_bound o sep e (synthesis o e B hb c)
    change ‖analysis o sep e (synthesis o e B hb c)‖ ≤
      2 * ‖synthesis o e B hb c‖ at h
    rw [analysis_synthesis] at h
    change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖c‖ ≤ ‖synthesis o e B hb c‖
    linarith
  · exact synthesis_bound o e B hb c

end Coefficients

end DiscreteFree

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Renorming:41.name: OAI.DiscreteFree.real_l1_quantitative_renorming
OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Renorming:41.text:
theorem real_l1_quantitative_renorming : RealL1RenormingStatement := by
  intro p hp
  let : Fact (0 < BlockParameters.R p) := ⟨BlockParameters.R_pos hp⟩
  let o := BlockConstruction.base p
  let sep := BlockConstruction.separation p
  have hb (x : BlockConstruction.Block p) : dist x o ≤ blockBound p := by
    simpa only [BlockParameters.B_formula] using BlockConstruction.diameter p x o
  have hB : 0 ≤ blockBound p := by dsimp [blockBound]; positivity
  let α := {x : BlockConstruction.Block p // x ≠ o}
  let : Infinite α := (Set.finite_singleton o).infinite_compl.to_subtype
  let : Encodable α := Encodable.ofCountable α
  let : Denumerable α := Denumerable.ofEncodableOfInfinite α
  let e : ℕ ≃ α := (Denumerable.eqv α).symm
  let J : RealL1 ≃L[ℝ] FreeSpace o := Coefficients.equiv o sep e (blockBound p) hb
  let A : RealL1 ≃ₗ[ℝ] FreeSpace o := J.toLinearEquiv
  let m : Module ℝ RealL1 := inferInstance
  let N : AddGroupNorm RealL1 :=
    { toFun := fun c => ‖J c‖
      map_zero' := by simp
      add_le' := fun c d => by simpa only [map_add] using norm_add_le (J c) (J d)
      neg' := fun c => by simp
      eq_zero_of_map_eq_zero' := fun c hc => J.injective (by simpa using hc) }
  refine ⟨N, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r c
    change ‖J (r • c)‖ = |r| * ‖J c‖
    rw [map_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  · exact Coefficients.equiv_bounds o sep e (blockBound p) hb
  · let : NormedAddCommGroup RealL1 := N.toNormedAddCommGroup
    let s : NormedSpace ℝ RealL1 :=
      { toModule := m
        norm_smul_le := fun r c => by
          change ‖J (r • c)‖ ≤ ‖r‖ * ‖J c‖
          rw [map_smul, norm_smul] }
    refine ⟨s, rfl, ?_⟩
    let := s
    let I : RealL1 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] FreeSpace o :=
      { toLinearEquiv := A
        norm_map' := fun _ => rfl }
    have hgood : HasBAP (FreeSpace o) (2 * blockBound p) :=
      bounded_separated_hasBAP o sep (blockBound p) hB hb
    have hbad : ¬ HasBAP (FreeSpace o) (p : ℝ) :=
      BlockConstruction.noBAP p hp p le_rfl
    have hnewbad : ¬ HasBAP RealL1 (p : ℝ) := fun h =>
      hbad ((hasBAP_linearIsometryEquiv_iff I p).mp h)
    refine ⟨I.toIsometryEquiv.completeSpace,
      (hasBAP_linearIsometryEquiv_iff I _).mpr hgood, hnewbad, ?_⟩
    intro hp1
    simpa only [hp1, Nat.cast_one] using hnewbad

end DiscreteFree
end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LipschitzFree.Coefficients:.text:
@[simp] theorem analysis_synthesis (c : L1 ι) :
    analysis o sep e (synthesis o e B hb c) = c := by
  apply lp.ext
  funext i
  rw [analysis_apply, synthesis_apply,
    (coordinate o sep (e i).val).map_tsum (summable_term o e B hb c)]

    (∀ (H : Finset JoinedNode), joinedTree.Initial H → ∀ x : XZero,

    (∀ A : EquivalentNorm XZero, ¬A.AUC) ∧
    (∀ A : EquivalentNorm XJoined, ¬A.AUC) :=
  ⟨fun _ ht ht1 => ⟨XSigma_averaged_modulus ht ht1,XJoined_averaged_modulus ht ht1⟩,
    fun _ hH x hx z hz hz0 => XZero_cubic_of_support x hH hx z hz hz0,

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.JoinedG.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.separated_midpoint_families
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.JoinedG.text:
theorem separated_midpoint_families {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε2 : ε ≤ 2)
    (x : TreeSpace T) (z : ℕ → TreeSpace T)
    (hplus : ∀ n, ‖x+z n‖ ≤ 1) (hminus : ∀ n, ‖x-z n‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ε ≤ ‖z i - z j‖) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ 1 - min (1/2) (logarithmicGamma 2 (ε/16)) := by
  let g := logarithmicGamma 2 (ε/16)
  have hg : 0 < g := logarithmicGamma_pos (by positivity) (by linarith)
  let δ := min (1/4 : ℝ) (min (ε/8) (g/4))
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1/4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hδε : δ ≤ ε/8 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδg : δ ≤ g/4 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Completion.denseRange_coe.exists_dist_lt x hδ
  have hvx : ‖(v : TreeSpace T) - x‖ < δ := by simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hv
  let H := T.head (show ι →₀ ℝ from v)
  have hH : T.Initial H := T.head_initial v
  let f := headCoordinates T H
  let P : (H → ℝ) →L[ℝ] TreeSpace T :=
    (Completion.toComplL : TreeVector T →L[ℝ] TreeSpace T).comp (TreeVector.ofHead T H)
  have hP : ∀ w, P (f w) = projection T H hH w := fun w => (projection_reconstructs T H hH w).symm
  have hzb : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ ≤ 1 := fun j => norm_perturbation_le (hplus j) (hminus j)
  have hfb : ∀ j, ‖f (z j)‖ ≤ ‖f‖ := fun j =>
    (f.le_opNorm _).trans (by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hzb j) (norm_nonneg f))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hijP⟩ := finite_dimensional_image_close_pair P (fun j => f (z j)) hfb
    (by positivity : 0 < 2 * δ)
  rw [hP, hP] at hijP
  let u := (1/2 : ℝ) • (z i - z j)
  have hu : ε / 2 ≤ ‖u‖ := by
    dsimp [u]; rw [norm_smul]; norm_num
    linarith [hsep i j hij]
  have he := lens_half_difference (hplus i) (hminus i) (hplus j) (hminus j)
  have hup : ‖x+u‖ ≤ 1 := he.1
  have hum : ‖x-u‖ ≤ 1 := he.2
  have hPu : ‖projection T H hH u‖ < δ := by
    dsimp [u]; rw [map_smul, map_sub, norm_smul]; norm_num
    linarith
  let y := u - projection T H hH u
  have hyt : y ∈ tail T H hH := by
    change projection T H hH y = 0
    dsimp [y]; rw [map_sub, projection_idem, sub_self]
  have hY : ε/4 ≤ ‖y‖ := by
    have htri : ‖u‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖projection T H hH u‖ := by
      simpa [y] using norm_add_le y (projection T H hH u)
    linarith
  have hdist : ‖((v : TreeSpace T) - x) - projection T H hH u‖ < 2 * δ :=
    (norm_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
  have hdist' : ‖((v : TreeSpace T) - x) + projection T H hH u‖ < 2 * δ :=
    (norm_add_le _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
  have hvp : ‖(v : TreeSpace T) + y‖ ≤ 1 + 2 * δ := by
    have heq : (v : TreeSpace T) + y = (x+u) + (((v : TreeSpace T)-x)-projection T H hH u) := by dsimp [y]; abel
    rw [heq]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hvm : ‖(v : TreeSpace T) - y‖ ≤ 1 + 2 * δ := by
    have heq : (v : TreeSpace T) - y = (x-u) + (((v : TreeSpace T)-x)+projection T H hH u) := by dsimp [y]; abel
    rw [heq]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hgap := logarithmic_tail_gap T v hH (T.support_subset_head v) y hyt
    (by positivity : 0 < ε/4) (by linarith : ε/4 ≤ 2) hY
    (hvp.trans (by linarith)) (hvm.trans (by linarith))
  have hg' : logarithmicGamma 2 (ε/4/4) = g := by dsimp [g]; congr 1 ; ring
  rw [hg'] at hgap
  have hxv := norm_sub_norm_le x (v : TreeSpace T)
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hxv
  have hm : min (1/2 : ℝ) g ≤ g := min_le_right _ _
  change ‖x‖ ≤ 1 - min (1/2 : ℝ) g
  linarith

end

end TreeSpace

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:47.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.recursion_unique
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:47.text:
lemma recursion_unique (h : ℕ+) (v : ComponentNode h → ℝ)
    (f g : ComponentNode h → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ s, f s = leastPair (v s)
      (aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (f c).1))
      (aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (f c).2)))
    (hg : ∀ s, g s = leastPair (v s)
      (aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (g c).1))
      (aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (g c).2))) : f = g := by
  have he : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ComponentNode h, h.val-s.1.length = n → f s = g s := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro s hs
      have hcEqual (c : ComponentNode h)
          (hc : c ≠ (componentTree h).root ∧ (componentTree h).parent c = s) : f c = g c := by
        have hstep := component_step h c hc.1
        rw [hc.2] at hstep
        change c.1.length = s.1.length+1 at hstep
        have hcHeight := c.2
        exact ih (h.val-c.1.length) (by omega) c rfl
      rw [hf s,hg s]
      have ha : aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (f c).1) = aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (g c).1) := by
        unfold aggregateChildren
        congr 1
        apply tsum_congr
        intro c
        split_ifs with hc
        · exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1 ^ heightExponent h) (hcEqual c hc)
        · rfl
      have hb : aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (f c).2) = aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (g c).2) := by
        unfold aggregateChildren
        congr 1
        apply tsum_congr
        intro c
        split_ifs with hc
        · exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.2 ^ heightExponent h) (hcEqual c hc)
        · rfl
      rw [ha,hb]
  funext s
  exact he _ s rfl

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Variabl.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.outer_cubic_of_components
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Variabl.text:
theorem outer_cubic_of_components {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (x y : Outer E)
    (hc : ∀ i, C*‖y i‖^3 ≤ ((‖x i+y i‖+‖x i-y i‖)/2-‖x i‖)*max ‖x i+y i‖ ‖x i-y i‖^2)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hp : ‖x+y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x-y‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖x‖^2 + C/(2*Real.sqrt 2*R)*‖y‖^3 ≤ R^2 := by
  have hh := outer_cubic_squared E hC x y hc
  have hp2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp 2
  have hm2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hm 2
  have hD := midpoint_energy_nonneg x y
  have hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by have hx := (norm_midpoint_average x y).1; linarith
  have hx2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hx 2
  have he : (‖x+y‖^2+‖x-y‖^2-2*‖x‖^2)^2 ≤ (2*(R^2-‖x‖^2))^2 := by
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hD (by linarith) 2
  have hh' : C^2*‖y‖^6 ≤ (2*R^2)*(2*(R^2-‖x‖^2))^2 := hh.trans
    (mul_le_mul (by linarith) he (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity))
  have hq : 0 < 2*Real.sqrt 2*R := by positivity
  have hsq : (2*Real.sqrt 2*R*(R^2-‖x‖^2))^2 = (2*R^2)*(2*(R^2-‖x‖^2))^2 := by
    calc
      _ = 4*(Real.sqrt 2)^2*R^2*(R^2-‖x‖^2)^2 := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)]; ring
  have hfinal : C*‖y‖^3 ≤ 2*Real.sqrt 2*R*(R^2-‖x‖^2) := by
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (mul_nonneg hC (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) 3)) (mul_nonneg hq.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hx2))).mp
    rw [hsq]
    calc
      (C*‖y‖^3)^2 = C^2*‖y‖^6 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := hh'
  have hd : C*‖y‖^3/(2*Real.sqrt 2*R) ≤ R^2-‖x‖^2 := (div_le_iff₀ hq).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm (R^2-‖x‖^2)] using hfinal)
  have heq : C*‖y‖^3/(2*Real.sqrt 2*R) = C/(2*Real.sqrt 2*R)*‖y‖^3 := by ring
  rw [heq] at hd
  linarith

end Outer

theorem cubic_stability (x y : Xv) (_hx : FiniteTotalSupport x) (A : ∀ h, Finset (ComponentNode h))
    (hA : AdmissibleHeads x y A) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hp : ‖x+y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x-y‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖x‖^2+cubicConstant/(2*Real.sqrt 2*R)*‖y‖^3 ≤ R^2 :=

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Variabl.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.outer_sixth_of_components
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Variabl.text:
theorem outer_sixth_of_components {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (x y : Outer E)
    (hc : ∀ i, C*‖y i‖^6 ≤ (‖x i+y i‖^2+‖x i-y i‖^2-2*‖x i‖^2)*
      (‖x i+y i‖^2+‖x i-y i‖^2)^2) :
    C*‖y‖^6 ≤ (‖x+y‖^2+‖x-y‖^2-2*‖x‖^2)*(‖x+y‖^2+‖x-y‖^2)^2 := by
  have hp : HasSum (fun i => ‖x i+y i‖^2) (‖x+y‖^2) := outer_hasSum_square E (x+y)
  have hm : HasSum (fun i => ‖x i-y i‖^2) (‖x-y‖^2) := outer_hasSum_square E (x-y)
  have hx := outer_hasSum_square E x
  have hy := outer_hasSum_square E y
  have hS := hp.add hm
  have hD := hS.sub (hx.mul_left 2)
  have hh := cubic_transport_tsum hC (fun i => ‖y i‖^2)
    (fun i => ‖x i+y i‖^2+‖x i-y i‖^2-2*‖x i‖^2)
    (fun i => ‖x i+y i‖^2+‖x i-y i‖^2)
    (fun i => sq_nonneg _) (fun i => midpoint_energy_nonneg (x i) (y i)) (fun i => by positivity)
    hy.summable hD.summable hS.summable (fun i => by convert hc i using 1 ; ring)
  rw [hy.tsum_eq,hD.tsum_eq,hS.tsum_eq] at hh
  convert hh using 1 ; ring

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:52.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.lp_model_exact
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:52.text:
theorem lp_model_exact (h : ℕ+)
    (v : AggregationVector.CoordinateLp (ComponentNode h) (exponent h))
    (f : ComponentNode h → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ s, f s = leastPair (v s)
      (aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (f c).1))
      (aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (f c).2))) :
    f = lpPotentials h v ∧ nu h v = (f (componentTree h).root).1+(f (componentTree h).root).2 := by
  have he := recursion_unique h v f (lpPotentials h v) hf (lpPotentials_recursion h v)
  refine ⟨he,?_⟩
  rw [he]
  rfl

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Variabl.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.weak_null_cubic
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Variabl.text:
theorem weak_null_cubic (x : Xv) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (y : ℕ → Xv) (hy : WeaklyNull y) (hyε : ∀ j, ε ≤ ‖y j‖)
    (hp : ∀ j, ‖x+y j‖ ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ j, ‖x-y j‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖x‖^2+weakTailConstant*ε^3 ≤ 1 := by
  let K : Set Xv := {w | ‖w‖^2*(1+‖x-w‖)+weakTailConstant*ε^3 ≤ (1+‖x-w‖)^3}
  have hc : IsClosed K := isClosed_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have hi : {w : Xv | FiniteTotalSupport w} ⊆ K :=
    fun w hw => finite_center_weak_bound x hε y hy hyε hp hm w hw
  have hx : x ∈ K := closure_minimal hi hc (finite_support_dense x)
  simpa only [K,Set.mem_ofPred_eq,sub_self,norm_zero,add_zero,mul_one,one_pow] using hx

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Equival.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.bounded_trees_modulus_eq_zero
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Equival.text:
theorem bounded_trees_modulus_eq_zero {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (A : EquivalentNorm E) (u : ℕ → List ℕ → E)
    {m M c : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hu : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length ≤ h → m ≤ ‖u h s‖ ∧ ‖u h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      WeaklyNull (fun k => u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s))
    (hdc : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      ∀ k, c ≤ ‖u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s‖) :
    A.modulus (A.lower * c / (2 * A.upper * M)) = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm (bounded_trees_modulus_le_zero hE A u hm hM hc hu hd hdc)
  apply A.modulus_nonneg hE
  have := A.lower_pos
  have := A.upper_pos
  positivity

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Variabl.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.finite_support_dense

lemma finite_support_dense : Dense {x : Xv | FiniteTotalSupport x} := by

  rw [Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top]
  apply SquareSum.closedSubmodule_eq_top Component _ finiteSubmodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure
  intro h x

  | hp =>

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:35.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.rootSumCompletionStatement
