lemma rootSumCompletionStatement {ι : Type uIndex} [DecidableEq ι] [Infinite ι]
    (T : FiniteRootedTree ι) : RootSumCompletionStatement T where
  complete := inferInstance
  infinite_dimensional := TreeSpace.not_finite_dimensional T
  coordinate_continuous := fun s => (TreeSpace.coordinate T s).continuous
  coordinate_extends := TreeSpace.coordinate_coe T
  fields_continuous := fun s => ⟨TreeSpace.continuous_P T s,TreeSpace.continuous_Q T s⟩
  fields_extend := fun s v => ⟨TreeSpace.P_coe T s v,TreeSpace.Q_coe T s v⟩
  root_formula := TreeSpace.norm_eq T
  projections := fun H hH => ⟨TreeSpace.projection_contracts T H hH,TreeSpace.projection_idem T H hH,
    TreeSpace.coordinate_projection T H hH,TreeSpace.projection_finite_rank T H hH,
    TreeSpace.tail_closed T H hH,TreeSpace.tail_finite_codimension T H hH,
    fun x hx _ hε => TreeSpace.finite_tail_dense T H hH x hx hε⟩

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:19.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.one_sided_modulus_zero
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:19.text:
theorem one_sided_modulus_zero (A : EquivalentNorm Xv) : A.modulus (A.lower/A.upper) = 0 := by
  have he : A.lower*2/(2*A.upper*1) = A.lower/A.upper := by field_simp [A.upper_pos.ne']
  rw [←he]
  apply bounded_trees_modulus_eq_zero not_finite_dimensional A pathVector
    (m := 1) (M := 1) (c := 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  · intro h hh s hs; rw [pathVector_norm]; exact ⟨le_rfl,le_rfl⟩
  · intro h hh s hs; exact pathVector_increments h s hs
  · intro h hh s hs k; exact pathVector_increment_lower h s hs k

    (h.val+1:ℝ)^(-1/heightExponent h)*‖v‖ ≤ nu h v ∧
    nu h v ≤ 2*(h.val+1:ℝ)^(1-1/heightExponent h)*‖v‖ := by

    have he := ZeroTreeSpace.pathVector_step joinedTree (joinedNode h (s ++ [k]))
      (joinedNode_ne_root h (s ++ [k]))

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:46.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.lpPotentials_recursion
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:46.text:
lemma lpPotentials_recursion (h : ℕ+)
    (v : AggregationVector.CoordinateLp (ComponentNode h) (exponent h)) (s : ComponentNode h) :
    lpPotentials h v s = leastPair (v s)
      (aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (lpPotentials h v c).1))
      (aggregateChildren h s (fun c => (lpPotentials h v c).2)) := by
  have hc : componentCoordinate h s ((componentEquiv h).symm v) = v s := by
    rw [←componentEquiv_apply,(componentEquiv h).apply_symm_apply]
  simpa only [lpPotentials,aggregateChildren,hc] using
    component_recursion h ((componentEquiv h).symm v) s

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.JoinedG.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.XJoined_separated_families
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.JoinedG.text:
theorem XJoined_separated_families {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧
      (ε ≤ 2 → η = min (1/2) (logarithmicGamma 2 (ε/16))) ∧
      ∀ (x : XJoined) (z : ℕ → XJoined),
        (∀ n, ‖x+z n‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ n, ‖x-z n‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ε ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) → ‖x‖ ≤ 1-η := by
  by_cases hε2 : ε ≤ 2
  · refine ⟨min (1/2) (logarithmicGamma 2 (ε/16)), ?_, ?_, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
    · exact lt_min (by norm_num) (logarithmicGamma_pos (by positivity) (by linarith))
    · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
    · exact fun x z hp hm hs => TreeSpace.separated_midpoint_families joinedTree hε hε2 x z hp hm hs
  · refine ⟨1/2, by norm_num, by norm_num, fun h => (hε2 h).elim, ?_⟩
    intro x z hp hm hs
    have h0 := norm_perturbation_le (hp 0) (hm 0)
    have h1 := norm_perturbation_le (hp 1) (hm 1)
    have hsep := hs 0 1 (by norm_num)
    have htri := norm_sub_le (z 0) (z 1)
    exfalso; linarith

end RecursivePotentials

  · intro h hh s hs; exact XJoined_path_increments h s hs
  · intro h hh s hs k
    have he := TreeSpace.cutPathVector_step joinedTree (joinedNode h (s ++ [k]))
      (joinedNode_ne_root h (s ++ [k]))
    rw [joinedNode_parent h s hs k] at he
    rw [he, TreeSpace.basisVector_norm _ _ (joinedNode_ne_root h (s ++ [k]))]

OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:38.name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.rec_completion
OAI.Analysis.RecursivePotentials.Main:38.text:
theorem rec_completion : RootSumCompletionStatement sequenceTree ∧
    ZeroRootCompletionStatement joinedTree ∧ RootSumCompletionStatement joinedTree ∧

    (hp : ∀ j, ‖x+y j‖ ≤ 1) (hm : ∀ j, ‖x-y j‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ theta ε ∧ theta ε < 1 := by
  have hh := weak_null_cubic x hε y hy hyε hp hm
  have hr : 0 ≤ 1-weakTailConstant*ε^3 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖]

  · apply (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)).mpr
    have hpos : 0 < weakTailConstant*ε^3 := mul_pos weakTailConstant_pos (pow_pos hε 3)

theorem exists_normalizedMinimalData_of_counterexample
    (hX : CanonicallyReflexive X) {C : Set X}
    (hne : C.Nonempty) (hclosed : IsClosed C)
    (hbounded : Bornology.IsBounded C) (hconvex : Convex ℝ C)
    (F : C → C) (hF : LipschitzWith 1 F) (hno : ∀ x : C, F x ≠ x) :
    Nonempty (NormalizedMinimalData (X := X)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, _hDC⟩ := exists_minimalInvariantData_of_counterexample
    hX hne hclosed hbounded hconvex F hF hno
  let E := D.scaled hX (Metric.diam D.K)⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr D.diam_pos)
  let : Nonempty E.K := E.nonempty.to_subtype
  let : SeparableSpace E.K := E.separable.separableSpace
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_dense_seq E.K
  exact ⟨{
    toMinimalInvariantData := E
    diam_one := D.scaled_inv_diam hX
    z := z
    dense_z := hz
    weak_metrizable := weakCarrier_metrizable E.separable E.weak_compact
    weak_ball_compact := weaklyCompact_differenceBall hX E.K
  }⟩

end ReflexiveFixedPoints

OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mai.name: OAI.QAC.parity_lower_bound_polynomial_size
OAI.InformationTheory.QuantumCircuit.Mai.text:
theorem parity_lower_bound_polynomial_size (d k C : ℕ)
    (_hd : 0 < d) (_hk : 0 < k) (_hC : 0 < C) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, ∀ N : ℕ, n ≤ N → N ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ k →
      ∀ layers : List (PhysicalLayer N), layers.length ≤ d →
        ∀ out : Fin N, ∃ x : Word n,
          successProbability (physicalCircuitMatrix layers) out x < (2 : ℝ) / 3 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n₀, h₀⟩ := parity_lower_bound d ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (1 / 6)
    (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le k)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨max n₀ (max 1 (C * 2 ^ k)), ?_⟩
  intro n hn N hnN hN layers hdepth out
  rcases max_le_iff.mp hn with ⟨hn₀, hnrest⟩
  rcases max_le_iff.mp hnrest with ⟨hn1, hCn⟩
  have hpoly : N ≤ n ^ (k + 1) := by
    calc
      N ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ k := hN
      _ ≤ C * (2 * n) ^ k :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left C (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) k)
      _ = (C * 2 ^ k) * n ^ k := by rw [mul_pow, Nat.mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ n * n ^ k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n ^ k) hCn
      _ = n ^ (k + 1) := by rw [pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hsize : (N : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
    exact_mod_cast hpoly
  have hnot := h₀ n hn₀ N hnN hsize layers hdepth out
  push Not at hnot
  norm_num at hnot
  exact hnot

end QAC

end

      ∃ z : ℂ,c=z • (1 : M.toStarSubalgebra)) :

OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Topology.name: OAI.RelativeGeneration.traceUnitaryHomeomorph
OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Topology.text:
def traceUnitaryHomeomorph (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert))
    (trace : algebra →L[ℂ] ℂ) {UnitarySpace : Type*} [MetricSpace UnitarySpace]
    (unitaryEquiv : UnitarySpace ≃ unitary algebra)
    (distance_eq : ∀ first second, dist first second =
      traceDistance algebra trace (unitaryEquiv first) (unitaryEquiv second)) :
    @Homeomorph UnitarySpace (unitary algebra) inferInstance (traceTopology algebra trace) := by
  letI : TopologicalSpace (unitary algebra) := traceTopology algebra trace
  refine { unitaryEquiv with continuous_toFun := ?_, continuous_invFun := ?_ }
  · apply continuous_generateFrom_iff.mpr
    rintro ball ⟨center, radius, _, rfl⟩
    have preimage_ball : unitaryEquiv ⁻¹'
        {point | traceDistance algebra trace center point < radius} =
        Metric.ball (unitaryEquiv.symm center) radius := by
      ext point
      change traceDistance algebra trace center (unitaryEquiv point) < radius ↔
        dist point (unitaryEquiv.symm center) < radius
      rw [dist_comm, distance_eq, unitaryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change IsOpen (unitaryEquiv ⁻¹' {point | traceDistance algebra trace center point < radius})
    rw [preimage_ball]
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball
  · apply continuous_def.mpr
    intro openSet isOpenSet
    refine isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr ?_
    intro point point_mem
    obtain ⟨radius, radius_pos, ball_subset⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpenSet (unitaryEquiv.symm point) point_mem
    refine ⟨{candidate | traceDistance algebra trace point candidate < radius}, ?_,
      TopologicalSpace.isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem ⟨point, radius, radius_pos, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro candidate candidate_mem
      apply ball_subset
      change dist (unitaryEquiv.symm candidate) (unitaryEquiv.symm point) < radius
      rw [dist_comm, distance_eq, unitaryEquiv.apply_symm_apply, unitaryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact candidate_mem
    · change traceDistance algebra trace point point < radius
      calc
        traceDistance algebra trace point point =
            dist (unitaryEquiv.symm point) (unitaryEquiv.symm point) := by
          simpa only [unitaryEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using

structure IsNormalizedTrace (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert))
    (trace : algebra →L[ℂ] ℂ) : Prop where
  normalized : trace 1 = 1
  positive : ∀ element : algebra, 0 ≤ (trace (star element * element)).re
  star_preserving : ∀ element : algebra, trace (star element) = star (trace element)
  tracial : ∀ left right : algebra, trace (left * right) = trace (right * left)
  faithful : ∀ element : algebra, trace (star element * element) = 0 → element = 0
  normal : @Continuous algebra ℂ (algebraUltraweakTopology algebra) inferInstance trace

  have hc : @Continuous _ _ (UltrapowerBridge.ultraweakTopology H) inferInstance
      (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => ∑ i, inner ℂ (η i) (T (ξ i))) := by
    let : TopologicalSpace (H →L[ℂ] H) := UltrapowerBridge.ultraweakTopology H
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => UltrapowerBridge.vectorFunctional_ultraweak_continuous (η i) (ξ i))
  have he : (traceFreeTrace hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit : M.toStarSubalgebra → ℂ)=
      (fun x => ∑ i, inner ℂ (η i) (x.val (ξ i))) := funext h
  rw [he]
  exact @Continuous.comp _ _ _ (UltrapowerBridge.algebraUltraweakTopology M)
    (UltrapowerBridge.ultraweakTopology H) _ _ _ hc continuous_induced_dom

OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Main:21.text:
theorem relative_generation_of_II1_separable_predual
    (P S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (hP : IsII1Factor P) (hS : IsII1Factor S)
    (hPS : P ≤ S)
    (hirr : ∀ c : S,
      (∀ a : P,StarSubalgebra.inclusion hPS a*c=c*StarSubalgebra.inclusion hPS a) →
      ∃ z : ℂ,c=algebraMap ℂ S z)
    (hsep : HasSeparablePredual S) :
    IsGδ {u : FactorTraceUnitary S hS |
      wstar ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra S hS).val})=S} ∧
    Dense {u : FactorTraceUnitary S hS |
      wstar ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra S hS).val})=S} := by
  let hf := hS.factor_smul
  let hu := hS.one_ne_zero
  let K := TraceFreeHilbert hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu
  let R := traceFreeHilbertClosure hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu
  let σ := traceFreeHilbertClosureTrace hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu
  let N := traceFreeRelativeImage hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu P hP.weaklyClosed
  have hNR : N ≤ R := traceFreeRelativeImage_le hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu P hP.weaklyClosed
  have hN : IsII1Factor N.toStarSubalgebra :=
    traceFreeRelativeImage_isII1Factor hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu P hP.weaklyClosed hPS hP
  have hfN : ∀ c : N.toStarSubalgebra,
      (∀ a : N.toStarSubalgebra,a*c=c*a) → ∃ z : ℂ,c=z • (1 : N.toStarSubalgebra) := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hN.factor c hc
    exact ⟨z,hz.trans (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one z)⟩
  have hirr' : ∀ c : S,
      (∀ a : P,StarSubalgebra.inclusion hPS a*c=c*StarSubalgebra.inclusion hPS a) →
      ∃ z : ℂ,c=z • (1 : S) := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hirr c hc
    exact ⟨z,hz.trans (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one z)⟩
  have hi := traceFreeRelativeImage_irreducible hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu
    P hP.weaklyClosed hPS hirr'
  have hs := traceOrbit_isSeparable_of_separablePredual σ
    (traceFreeHilbertClosure_hasSeparablePredual hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu hsep)
  obtain ⟨hg,hd⟩ := represented_full_relative_generation σ hNR hfN hN.diffuse hi hs
  let f := FactorTraceUnitary.representedHomeomorph S hS
  have he : {u : FactorTraceUnitary S hS |
      wstar ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra S hS).val})=S} =
      f ⁻¹' {v : TraceUnitary σ |
        wstar ((N : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) ∪ {(v.algebra σ).val})=R.toStarSubalgebra} := by
    ext u
    exact traceFreeRelativeGeneration_iff hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu P hP.weaklyClosed hPS
      (u.algebra S hS)
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨IsGδ.preimage f.continuous hg, f.isOpenQuotientMap.dense_preimage_iff.mpr hd⟩

OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Represen.name: OAI.Generator.Tracial.represented_full_relative_generation
OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Represen.text:
theorem represented_full_relative_generation
    (hfactor : ∀ c : N.toStarSubalgebra,
      (∀ a : N.toStarSubalgebra, a*c=c*a) → ∃ z : ℂ,c=z • (1 : N.toStarSubalgebra))
    (hdiff : ∀ r : N.toStarSubalgebra, IsStarProjection r → r ≠ 0 →
      ∃ q : N.toStarSubalgebra, IsStarProjection q ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧ q ≠ r ∧ r*q=q ∧ q*r=q)
    (hirr : ∀ c : M.toStarSubalgebra,
      (∀ a : N.toStarSubalgebra, coordinateInclusion hNM a*c=c*coordinateInclusion hNM a) →
      ∃ z : ℂ,c=z • (1 : M.toStarSubalgebra))
    (hsep : TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable (Set.range (baseVector τ))) :
    IsGδ {u : TraceUnitary τ |
      wstar ((N : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra τ).val}) = M.toStarSubalgebra} ∧
    Dense {u : TraceUnitary τ |
      wstar ((N : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra τ).val}) = M.toStarSubalgebra} := by
  have he : {u : TraceUnitary τ |
      wstar ((N : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra τ).val}) = M.toStarSubalgebra} =
      {u : TraceUnitary τ | relativeGenerated (N := N) τ u = M} := by
    ext u
    change (relativeGenerated (N := N) τ u).toStarSubalgebra = M.toStarSubalgebra ↔ _
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply VonNeumannAlgebra.ext
      intro x
      change x ∈ (relativeGenerated (N := N) τ u).toStarSubalgebra ↔ x ∈ M.toStarSubalgebra
      rw [h]
    · exact fun h => congrArg _ h
  refine ⟨he.symm ▸ relativeGeneratingLocus_isGδ τ hNM hsep, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C,_,hC,hm⟩ := represented_relative_generation τ hNM hfactor hdiff hirr hsep
  exact hC.mono hm

end Generator.Tracial

    RelativeGeneration.IsNormalizedTrace S (normalizedFactorTrace S hS) := by
  let : CompleteSpace (factorVonNeumann hS).toStarSubalgebra :=
    baseCompleteSpace (factorVonNeumann hS)
  let : CStarAlgebra (factorVonNeumann hS).toStarSubalgebra := {}
  let : PartialOrder (factorVonNeumann hS).toStarSubalgebra :=
    CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing (factorVonNeumann hS).toStarSubalgebra :=

    { normalized := normalized

OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Inclusio.name: OAI.Generator.Tracial.traceFreeRelativeImage_le
OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Inclusio.text:
theorem traceFreeRelativeImage_le : N ≤ R := by
  rintro a ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩
  exact traceFreeHilbertAction_mem_closure hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit b

variable (hPM : P ≤ M.toStarSubalgebra)

OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Inclusio.name: OAI.Generator.Tracial.traceFreeRelativeGeneration_iff
OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.Inclusio.text:
theorem traceFreeRelativeGeneration_iff (u : M.toStarSubalgebra) :
    wstar ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {u.val}) = M.toStarSubalgebra ↔
      wstar ((N : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) ∪ {π u}) = (R).toStarSubalgebra := by
  constructor
  · intro hgen
    let Q := vonNeumannOfWOTClosed
      (wstar ((N : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) ∪ {π u})) (wstar_closed _)
    have hQR : Q ≤ R := wstar_le (vonNeumann_wotClosed R) (by
      rintro a (ha|ha)
      · exact traceFreeRelativeImage_le hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit P hP ha
      · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha
        exact traceFreeHilbertAction_mem_closure hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit u)
    have hpre : M.toStarSubalgebra ≤ concretePreimage (e).toStarAlgHom Q.toStarSubalgebra := by
      apply le_trans (le_of_eq hgen.symm)
      apply wstar_le (traceFreeHilbert_preimage_wotClosed hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit Q hQR)
      rintro a (ha|ha)
      · apply (mem_concretePreimage (e).toStarAlgHom Q.toStarSubalgebra ⟨a,hPM ha⟩).mpr
        exact subset_wstar _ (Or.inl ⟨⟨a,hPM ha⟩,ha,rfl⟩)
      · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha
        exact (mem_concretePreimage (e).toStarAlgHom Q.toStarSubalgebra u).mpr
          (subset_wstar _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton _)))
    apply le_antisymm (show Q.toStarSubalgebra ≤ (R).toStarSubalgebra from hQR)
    intro b hb
    let a := (e).symm ⟨b,hb⟩
    have ha := (mem_concretePreimage (e).toStarAlgHom Q.toStarSubalgebra a).mp (hpre a.property)
    change ((e) ((e).symm ⟨b,hb⟩)).val ∈ Q.toStarSubalgebra at ha
    simpa only [StarAlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using ha
  · intro hgen
    let A := wstar ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {u.val})
    have hAM : A ≤ M.toStarSubalgebra := wstar_le (vonNeumann_wotClosed M) (by
      rintro a (ha|ha)
      · exact hPM ha
      · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha
        exact u.property)
    let B := (A.comap M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype).map π
    have hRB : (R).toStarSubalgebra ≤ B := by
      apply le_trans (le_of_eq hgen.symm)
      apply wstar_le (traceFreeSubalgebraImage_wotClosed hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit A
        (wstar_closed _))
      rintro a (ha|ha)
      · obtain ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩ := ha
        exact ⟨b,subset_wstar _ (Or.inl hb),rfl⟩
      · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha
        exact ⟨u,subset_wstar _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton _)),rfl⟩
    apply le_antisymm hAM
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b,hb,he⟩ := hRB (traceFreeHilbertAction_mem_closure hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit ⟨a,ha⟩)
    have he' := traceFreeHilbertAction_injective hfactor hdiff hfinite hunit he
    change b.val ∈ A at hb
    rwa [he'] at hb

end Generator.Tracial

end

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Surface.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.exists_rescaled_ball_chart
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Surface.text:
theorem exists_rescaled_ball_chart {n d : ℕ}
    (r : ℝ) (a : Ambient n) (s : ℝ≥0) (hs : 0 < s)
    (f : ball (0 : Ambient n) r → Ambient d) (M : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith M f) :
    ∃ g : Ambient n → Ambient d,
      LipschitzOnWith (M * s) g (ball a (r / (s : ℝ))) ∧
      g '' ball a (r / (s : ℝ)) = Set.range f := by
  classical
  have hsr : 0 < (s : ℝ) := hs
  have hnorm (u : Ambient n) : ‖(s : ℝ) • (u - a)‖ = (s : ℝ) * dist u a := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg s.coe_nonneg, dist_eq_norm]
  have hmem (u : Ambient n) (hu : u ∈ ball a (r / (s : ℝ))) :
      (s : ℝ) • (u - a) ∈ ball (0 : Ambient n) r := by
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    rw [hnorm]
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ hsr).mp hu
    simpa only [mul_comm] using! h
  let T : ball a (r / (s : ℝ)) → ball (0 : Ambient n) r :=
    fun u => ⟨(s : ℝ) • (u.val - a), hmem u.val u.property⟩
  have hTdist (u v : ball a (r / (s : ℝ))) :
      dist (T u) (T v) = (s : ℝ) * dist u v := by
    change dist ((s : ℝ) • (u.val - a)) ((s : ℝ) • (v.val - a)) =
      (s : ℝ) * dist u.val v.val
    rw [dist_smul₀, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg s.coe_nonneg]
    congr 1
    simp only [dist_eq_norm]
    congr 1
    abel
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective T := by
    intro v
    let u : Ambient n := a + (s : ℝ)⁻¹ • v.val
    have hu : u ∈ ball a (r / (s : ℝ)) := by
      change dist (a + (s : ℝ)⁻¹ • v.val) a < r / (s : ℝ)
      rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hsr)]
      have hv : ‖v.val‖ < r := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp v.property
      have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv (inv_pos.mpr hsr)
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using! h
    refine ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (s : ℝ) • ((a + (s : ℝ)⁻¹ • v.val) - a) = v.val
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hsr.ne', one_smul]
  let g : Ambient n → Ambient d := fun u =>
    if hu : u ∈ ball a (r / (s : ℝ)) then f (T ⟨u, hu⟩) else 0
  have hg (u : Ambient n) (hu : u ∈ ball a (r / (s : ℝ))) : g u = f (T ⟨u, hu⟩) := by
    simp only [g, dite_eq_left hu]
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro u hu v hv
    rw [hg u hu, hg v hv]
    have h := hf.dist_le_mul (T ⟨u, hu⟩) (T ⟨v, hv⟩)
    rw [hTdist] at h
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, Subtype.dist_eq, mul_assoc] using! h
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨T ⟨u, hu⟩, (hg u hu).symm⟩
    · rintro y ⟨v, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurj v
      exact ⟨u.val, u.property, (hg u.val u.property).trans (congrArg f hu)⟩

end

end RieszRectifiability

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.quantitative_uniform_surface_ball_charts
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.text:
theorem quantitative_uniform_surface_ball_charts {n d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hnd : n ≤ d)
    (C G : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hG : 0 < G) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1 / 281474976710656 ∧ activeProjectionError d ε ≤ 1 / 128 ∧
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ M : ℝ≥0,
      ∀ (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) [μ.Regular], ADRegularWithConstant n C μ →
      GlobalUpperGrowth n G μ → ∀ (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ) (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points),
        AdmissibleRadius μ (latticeRadius R k / 8) →
        let Good := fun q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z =>
          bilateralBeta n μ q.center (1024 * q.radius) < ε
        ∃ (S : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z → AffineSubspace ℝ (Ambient d))
          (hS : ∀ i, IsAffineNPlane n (S i)),
          (∀ i, activeRegionCell Good i → bilateralPlaneError μ i.center (1024 * i.radius) (S i) < ε) ∧
          ∃ f : S (supportCellRoot μ R hR k z) → Ambient d,
            IsActiveRegionLimitModel μ R hR k z Good S hS ε f ∧
            ∃ g : ball (0 : Ambient n) (latticeRadius R k) → Ambient d,
              LipschitzWith M g ∧ Set.range g ⊆ closedBall (z : Ambient d) (3 * latticeRadius R k) ∧
              (ENNReal.ofReal G + activeRegionStopMassAreaConstant n G) *
                (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Ambient d))
                  ((Set.range f ∩ closedBall (z : Ambient d) (3 * latticeRadius R k)) \ Set.range g) ≤
                    ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z) := by
  obtain ⟨Ktop, hKtop, K, hK, hmodels⟩ := quantitative_matched_surface_models hn hnd C G hC hG
  have hKpos : 0 < K := zero_lt_one.trans_le hK
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hκquarter, σ, hσ, hwidth, hpair, hshadow⟩ := exists_projection_region_thresholds n K K hKpos hKpos
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεfine, hsmall, hprecision⟩ := exists_matched_surface_precision d σ hσ
  refine ⟨ε, hε, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  have hCpos : 0 < C := zero_lt_one.trans_le hC
  let W := ENNReal.ofReal G + activeRegionStopMassAreaConstant n G
  have hW : W < ⊤ := by
    have hstop := activeRegionStopMassAreaConstant_lt_top n G
    exact ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top, hstop⟩
  have hθ := nativeCoreAreaFraction_pos_le_half n K hKpos
  have hzero : 0 ≤ 1 - nativeCoreAreaFraction n K := by linarith [hθ.2]
  have hone : 1 - nativeCoreAreaFraction n K < 1 := by linarith [hθ.1]
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := exists_depth_for_weighted_geometric_loss
    (1 - nativeCoreAreaFraction n K) hzero hone W hW (K * C * (64 : ℝ) ^ n) (by positivity) δ hδ
  let M := finiteBallChartUnionConstant d (11 ^ d) (projectionRegionDepthConstant d (Real.toNNReal (2 / κ)) J)
  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
  intro μ _hreg hAD hg R hR k z hcore
  have hballs := hAD.2
  let Good := fun q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z =>
    bilateralBeta n μ q.center (1024 * q.radius) < ε
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hfit, f, hmodel, _, hreg, hs, _, hdiam, hgν, hlν, hplanes⟩ :=
    hmodels μ hAD hg ε hε hεfine hsmall R hR k z hcore
  let ν := nativeSurfaceArea n (Set.range f)
  have hgeometry : ∀ p ∈ ν.support, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient d), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧
        (∀ x ∈ ν.support ∩ closedBall p (1024 * r),
          infDist x (AffineSubspace.mk' p P : Set (Ambient d)) ≤ σ * r) ∧
        closedBall (P.orthogonalProjectionOnto p) (r / 32) ⊆
          P.orthogonalProjectionOnto '' (ν.support ∩ closedBall p (r / 16)) := by
    intro p hp r hr
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hheight, hcover⟩ := hplanes p hp r hr
    exact ⟨P, hP, fun x hx => (hheight x hx).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprecision hr.le), hcover⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hglip, hgrange, harea⟩ := exists_matched_surface_ball_depth_chart ν (Set.range f) rfl hs
    K K hKpos hKpos hgν (fun p hp r hr => hlν p hp r hr.1) σ κ hσ hκ (by linarith) hwidth hpair hshadow
    hgeometry hdiam hn J (latticeRadius R k) (latticeRadius_pos R hR k) z
  have hmass := radius_eight_growth_le_original_cell_mass μ C G hCpos hG hg
    (fun p hp r hr => (hballs p hp r hr).1) R hR k hcore z K hKpos.le
  refine ⟨S, hS, hfit, f, hmodel, g, hglip, hgrange, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ W * ((ENNReal.ofReal (1 - nativeCoreAreaFraction n K)) ^ J *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (K * C * (64 : ℝ) ^ n) * μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z))) :=
      mul_le_mul' le_rfl (harea.trans (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hmass))
    _ = (W * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - nativeCoreAreaFraction n K)) ^ J *
        ENNReal.ofReal (K * C * (64 : ℝ) ^ n)) * μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul' hJ le_rfl

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.quantitative_higher_codimension_riesz_rectifiability
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.text:
theorem quantitative_higher_codimension_riesz_rectifiability : QuantitativeFullStatement := by
  intro d n _hd hn hnd C hC D
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ p =>
    have hnd' : p + 1 ≤ d := by omega
    let G : ℝ := 9 ^ d * C
    have hG : 0 < G := mul_pos (by positivity) (zero_lt_one.trans_le hC)
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεfine, hsmall, hpieces⟩ :=
      quantitative_uniform_restart_surface_pieces (Nat.succ_pos p) hnd' C G hC hG
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, b, _hb, hcharts⟩ := quantitative_recursive_chart_from_surface_pieces
      hnd' C G D hC hG 1024 ε (by norm_num) hε hεfine hsmall (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨N, P, hdata⟩ := hpieces δ hδ
    let M := badBudgetChartConstant
      (fun M => restartChartStepConstant d N P (restartChartStepConstant d N P M)) b
    refine ⟨(1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) / (C * 32 ^ (p + 1)),
      div_pos (by norm_num) (mul_pos (zero_lt_one.trans_le hC) (by positivity)),
      M * (1 / 4), ?_⟩
    intro μ hreg hAD hRiesz
    let : μ.Regular := hreg
    by_cases hsupport : μ.support.Nontrivial
    · have hg : GlobalUpperGrowth (p + 1) G μ := quantitative_global_growth hnd' μ C hAD hsupport
      apply quantitative_ball_images_of_clean_cell_deficits μ C hAD G hG hg
        (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) M
      intro R hR k z hcore
      obtain ⟨E, data, hloss⟩ := hdata μ hAD hg R hR k z hcore
      obtain ⟨g, hglip, _, hdeficit⟩ := hcharts N P μ hAD hg hRiesz R hR k z hcore E data hloss
      exact ⟨g, hglip, hdeficit⟩
    · intro x _hx r hr
      have hdiam : ediam μ.support = 0 := ediam_eq_zero_iff.mpr (Set.not_nontrivial_iff.mp hsupport)
      have hz : ENNReal.ofReal r = 0 := le_antisymm (hdiam ▸ hr.2) zero_le
      exact ((ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hr.1).ne' hz).elim

end
end RieszRectifiability

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.SelectedRestartSurfaceData
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.text:
structure SelectedRestartSurfaceData (n : ℕ)
    (Bad : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z → Prop)
    (q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z) (E : Set (Ambient d))
    (ε : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (P : ℝ≥0) where
  planes : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR (k + q.depth) ⟨q.center, q.mem_net⟩ →
    AffineSubspace ℝ (Ambient d)
  isPlane : ∀ i, IsAffineNPlane n (planes i)
  fits : ∀ i, activeRegionCell (relativeRestartGood Bad q) i →
    bilateralPlaneError μ i.center (1024 * i.radius) (planes i) < ε
  model : planes (supportCellRoot μ R hR (k + q.depth) ⟨q.center, q.mem_net⟩) → Ambient d
  isModel : IsActiveRegionLimitModel μ R hR (k + q.depth) ⟨q.center, q.mem_net⟩
    (relativeRestartGood Bad q) planes isPlane ε model
  domains : Fin N → Set (Ambient n)
  domains_bounded : ∀ j, domains j ⊆ ball (0 : Ambient n) q.radius
  pieces : Fin N → Ambient n → Ambient d
  pieces_lipschitz : ∀ j, LipschitzOnWith P (pieces j) (domains j)
  pieces_bounded : ∀ j, pieces j '' domains j ⊆ closedBall q.center (3 * q.radius)
  pieces_cover : E = ⋃ j : Fin N, pieces j '' domains j

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.selectedRestartSurfaceDataOfBallChart

def selectedRestartSurfaceDataOfBallChart
    (Bad : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z → Prop)
    (q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z)
    (S : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR (k + q.depth) ⟨q.center, q.mem_net⟩ → AffineSubspace ℝ (Ambient d))
    (hS : ∀ i, IsAffineNPlane n (S i)) (ε : ℝ)
    (hfit : ∀ i, activeRegionCell (relativeRestartGood Bad q) i →
      bilateralPlaneError μ i.center (1024 * i.radius) (S i) < ε)
    (f : S (supportCellRoot μ R hR (k + q.depth) ⟨q.center, q.mem_net⟩) → Ambient d)
    (hmodel : IsActiveRegionLimitModel μ R hR (k + q.depth) ⟨q.center, q.mem_net⟩
      (relativeRestartGood Bad q) S hS ε f)
    (g : ball (0 : Ambient n) q.radius → Ambient d) (M : ℝ≥0) (hg : LipschitzWith M g)
    (himage : Set.range g ⊆ closedBall q.center (3 * q.radius)) :
    SelectedRestartSurfaceData n Bad q (Set.range g) ε 1 M where
  planes := S
  isPlane := hS
  fits := hfit
  model := f
  isModel := hmodel
  domains := fun _ => ball (0 : Ambient n) q.radius
  domains_bounded := fun _ => Subset.rfl
  pieces := fun _ => ballChartPartialMap q.radius g
  pieces_lipschitz := fun _ => ballChartPartialMap_lipschitzOn q.radius g M hg
  pieces_bounded := fun _ => by
    rw [ballChartPartialMap_image]
    exact himage
  pieces_cover := by simp only [ballChartPartialMap_image, iUnion_const]

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.quantitative_global_growth
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.text:
theorem quantitative_global_growth {d n : ℕ} (hnd : n ≤ d)
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (C : ℝ) (hAD : ADRegularWithConstant n C μ)
    (hpos : μ.support.Nontrivial) :
    GlobalUpperGrowth n ((9 : ℝ) ^ d * C) μ := by
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := zero_le_one.trans hAD.1
  have hG : 0 ≤ (9 : ℝ) ^ d * C := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hC
  refine ⟨hG, ?_⟩
  intro a r hr
  by_cases hz : μ (ball a r) = 0
  · rw [hz]
    exact zero_le
  obtain ⟨x, hxa, hx⟩ := μ.nonempty_inter_support_of_pos (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz)
  by_cases hsmall : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * r) ≤ ediam μ.support
  · have hsub : ball a r ⊆ ball x (2 * r) := by
      intro y hy
      change dist y x < 2 * r
      calc
        dist y x ≤ dist y a + dist a x := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < r + r := add_lt_add hy (by simpa only [mem_ball, dist_comm] using! hxa)
        _ = 2 * r := by ring
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ 9 ^ d :=
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 9) n).trans
        (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 9) hnd)
    calc
      μ (ball a r) ≤ μ (ball x (2 * r)) := measure_mono hsub
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (2 * r) ^ n) := (hAD.2 x hx _ ⟨by positivity, hsmall⟩).2
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (9 ^ d * C * r ^ n) := by
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        rw [mul_pow]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (mul_nonneg hC (pow_nonneg hr.le n))]
  · have hdiam : ediam μ.support < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * r) := lt_of_not_ge hsmall
    have hfin : ediam μ.support ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_lt hdiam
    have hdr : diam μ.support < 2 * r := by
      have h := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal hfin ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr hdiam
      simpa only [diam, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * r)] using! h
    calc
      μ (ball a r) ≤ μ Set.univ := measure_mono (subset_univ _)
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (9 ^ d * C * (diam μ.support / 2) ^ n) :=
        quantitative_total_mass_of_bounded_support μ C hAD hpos hfin
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (9 ^ d * C * r ^ n) := by
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ (div_nonneg diam_nonneg (by norm_num)) (by linarith) n) hG

end
end RieszRectifiability

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.has_selected_restart_assembly_of_surface_data
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.text:
theorem has_selected_restart_assembly_of_surface_data (hn : 0 < n)
    (G : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hg : GlobalUpperGrowth n G μ)
    (Bad : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z → Prop)
    (E : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q} → Set (Ambient d))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεfine : ε ≤ 1 / 281474976710656)
    (hsmall : activeProjectionError d ε ≤ 1 / 128) (N : ℕ) (P : ℝ≥0)
    (data : ∀ q : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q},
      ¬ Bad q.val → SelectedRestartSurfaceData n Bad q.val (E q) ε N P) :
    HasSelectedRestartAssembly n Bad E
      (fun M => restartChartStepConstant d N P (restartChartStepConstant d N P M)) := by
  classical
  intro q M child hchildLip hchildImage
  have hlocal (i : relativeSelectedRestartStops Bad q.val (E q))
      (j : supportImmediateChildren μ R hR (k + q.val.depth + i.val.depth)
        ⟨i.val.center, i.val.mem_net⟩) :
      ∃ f : ball (0 : Ambient n) j.val.radius → Ambient d,
        LipschitzWith M f ∧ Set.range f = Set.range (child (selectedRestartChildNode Bad q.val (E q) i j)) := by
    apply exists_chart_at_equal_radius _ _ _ _ M
      (hchildLip (selectedRestartChildNode Bad q.val (E q) i j))
    change (q.val.compose (i.val.compose j.val)).radius = j.val.radius
    simp only [SupportCellDescendant.compose_radius]
  choose localChart hlocalLip hlocalRange using hlocal
  have hlocalImage (i : relativeSelectedRestartStops Bad q.val (E q))
      (j : supportImmediateChildren μ R hR (k + q.val.depth + i.val.depth)
        ⟨i.val.center, i.val.mem_net⟩) :
      Set.range (localChart i j) ⊆ closedBall j.val.center (2 * j.val.radius) := by
    rw [hlocalRange i j]
    have h := hchildImage (selectedRestartChildNode Bad q.val (E q) i j)
    change Set.range _ ⊆ closedBall j.val.center (2 * (q.val.compose (i.val.compose j.val)).radius) at h
    simpa only [SupportCellDescendant.compose_radius] using! h
  have hassembled : ∃ g : ball (0 : Ambient n) q.val.radius → Ambient d,
      LipschitzWith (restartChartStepConstant d N P (restartChartStepConstant d N P M)) g ∧
      Set.range g ⊆ closedBall q.val.center (2 * q.val.radius) ∧
      selectedRestartParent Bad q.val (E q) ⊆ Set.range g ∧
      ∀ i j, j.val.cell ∩ Set.range (localChart i j) ⊆ Set.range g := by
    by_cases hbad : Bad q.val
    · let root := supportCellRoot μ R hR (k + q.val.depth) ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩
      have hroot : root ∈ relativeSelectedRestartStops Bad q.val (E q) := by
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inl rfl⟩
        · change ¬ ¬ Bad (q.val.compose root)
          rw [SupportCellDescendant.compose_root]
          exact not_not.mpr hbad
        · intro i hi _
          exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i.depth hi)
      let i0 : relativeSelectedRestartStops Bad q.val (E q) := ⟨root, hroot⟩
      obtain ⟨g, hgLip, hgRange, hgCover, _⟩ := exists_immediate_child_chart_assembly hn
        μ R hR (k + q.val.depth) ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩
        (localChart i0) M (hlocalLip i0) (hlocalImage i0)
      have hconstant := (restartChartStepConstant_bounds d N P M).2.2.1.trans
        (restartChartStepConstant_bounds d N P (restartChartStepConstant d N P M)).1
      refine ⟨g, hgLip.weaken hconstant, hgRange, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        have hr := hx.1.2 root hx.1.1
        change ¬ Bad (q.val.compose root) at hr
        rw [SupportCellDescendant.compose_root] at hr
        exact False.elim (hr hbad)
      · intro i
        have hi : i = i0 := Subtype.ext (relative_selected_stop_eq_root_of_bad Bad q.val hbad (E q) i)
        subst i
        exact hgCover
    · let a := data q hbad
      let root := supportCellRoot μ R hR (k + q.val.depth) ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩
      have heq := selected_restart_stops_of_good_root Bad q.val hbad (E q)
      let lift := fun i : activeCellSelectedStopSet μ R hR (k + q.val.depth)
        ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩ (relativeRestartGood Bad q.val) root (E q) =>
          (⟨i.val, heq.symm ▸ i.property⟩ : relativeSelectedRestartStops Bad q.val (E q))
      obtain ⟨g, hgLip, hgRange, hgParent, hgCover, _⟩ := exists_good_region_restart_chart hn
        μ G hG hg R hR (k + q.val.depth) ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩
        (relativeRestartGood Bad q.val) a.planes a.isPlane ε hε hεfine hsmall a.fits
        a.model a.isModel root (relative_restart_root_active Bad q.val hbad)
        N a.domains a.domains_bounded a.pieces P a.pieces_lipschitz a.pieces_bounded (E q) a.pieces_cover
        (fun i => localChart (lift i)) M (fun i => hlocalLip (lift i)) (fun i => hlocalImage (lift i))
      refine ⟨g, hgLip.weaken (goodRegionRestartAssemblyConstant_le_two_steps d N P M), hgRange, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [selected_restart_parent_eq]
        exact hgParent
      · intro i j
        exact hgCover ⟨i.val, heq ▸ i.property⟩ j
  obtain ⟨g, hgLip, hgRange, hgParent, hgCover⟩ := hassembled
  refine ⟨g, hgLip, hgRange, hgParent, ?_⟩
  intro w x hx
  obtain ⟨i, j, hw⟩ := w.property
  have heq : selectedRestartChildNode Bad q.val (E q) i j = w :=
    Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hw.symm)
  have hxcell : x ∈ j.val.cell := by
    have h := hx.1
    rw [hw, SupportCellDescendant.compose_cell, SupportCellDescendant.compose_cell] at h
    exact h
  have hxrange : x ∈ Set.range (localChart i j) := by
    rw [hlocalRange i j, heq]
    exact hx.2
  exact hgCover i j ⟨hxcell, hxrange⟩

end

end RieszRectifiability

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.quantitative_uniform_restart_surface_pieces
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.text:
theorem quantitative_uniform_restart_surface_pieces {n d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hnd : n ≤ d)
    (C G : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hG : 0 < G) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1 / 281474976710656 ∧ activeProjectionError d ε ≤ 1 / 128 ∧
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ (N : ℕ) (P : ℝ≥0),
    ∀ (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) [μ.Regular], ADRegularWithConstant n C μ →
    GlobalUpperGrowth n G μ → ∀ (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ) (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points),
      AdmissibleRadius μ (latticeRadius R k / 8) →
      let Bad := fun i : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z =>
        ε ≤ bilateralBeta n μ i.center (1024 * i.radius)
      ∃ (E : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q} → Set (Ambient d))
        (data : ∀ q : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q},
          ¬ Bad q.val → SelectedRestartSurfaceData n Bad q.val (E q) ε N P),
        ∀ q hq, (ENNReal.ofReal G + activeRegionStopMassAreaConstant n G) *
          (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Ambient d))
            ((Set.range (data q hq).model ∩ closedBall q.val.center (3 * q.val.radius)) \ E q) ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ q.val.cell := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεfine, hsmall, hcharts⟩ := quantitative_uniform_surface_ball_charts hn hnd C G hC hG
  refine ⟨ε, hε, hεfine, hsmall, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hcharts δ hδ
  refine ⟨1, M, ?_⟩
  intro μ _hreg hAD hg R hR k z hcore
  have hM := hM μ hAD hg
  let Bad := fun i : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z =>
    ε ≤ bilateralBeta n μ i.center (1024 * i.radius)
  let Q := {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q}
  have hlocal (q : Q) :
      ∃ (S : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR (k + q.val.depth) ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩ →
          AffineSubspace ℝ (Ambient d)) (hS : ∀ i, IsAffineNPlane n (S i)),
        (∀ i, activeRegionCell (relativeRestartGood Bad q.val) i →
          bilateralPlaneError μ i.center (1024 * i.radius) (S i) < ε) ∧
        ∃ f : S (supportCellRoot μ R hR (k + q.val.depth) ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩) → Ambient d,
          IsActiveRegionLimitModel μ R hR (k + q.val.depth) ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩
            (relativeRestartGood Bad q.val) S hS ε f ∧
          ∃ g : ball (0 : Ambient n) q.val.radius → Ambient d,
            LipschitzWith M g ∧ Set.range g ⊆ closedBall q.val.center (3 * q.val.radius) ∧
            (ENNReal.ofReal G + activeRegionStopMassAreaConstant n G) *
              (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Ambient d))
                ((Set.range f ∩ closedBall q.val.center (3 * q.val.radius)) \ Set.range g) ≤
                  ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ q.val.cell := by
    have hqcore : AdmissibleRadius μ (latticeRadius R (k + q.val.depth) / 8) := by
      simpa only [one_div, mul_comm, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] using! q.val.core_admissible hcore
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hfit, f, hmodel, g, hglip, hgrange, hloss⟩ :=
      hM R hR (k + q.val.depth) ⟨q.val.center, q.val.mem_net⟩ hqcore
    have hGood : relativeRestartGood Bad q.val =
        (fun i => bilateralBeta n μ i.center (1024 * i.radius) < ε) := relativeRestartGood_beta_eq ε q.val
    exact ⟨S, hS, by simpa only [hGood] using! hfit,
      f, by simpa only [hGood] using! hmodel, g, hglip, hgrange, hloss⟩
  choose S hS hfit f hmodel g hglip hgrange hloss using hlocal
  let E (q : Q) : Set (Ambient d) := Set.range (g q)
  let data (q : Q) : SelectedRestartSurfaceData n Bad q.val (E q) ε 1 M :=
    selectedRestartSurfaceDataOfBallChart Bad q.val (S q) (hS q) ε (hfit q)
      (f q) (hmodel q) (g q) M (hglip q) (hgrange q)
  refine ⟨E, (fun q _ => data q), ?_⟩
  intro q _hq
  change (ENNReal.ofReal G + activeRegionStopMassAreaConstant n G) *
    (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Ambient d))
      ((Set.range (f q) ∩ closedBall q.val.center (3 * q.val.radius)) \ Set.range (g q)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ q.val.cell
  exact hloss q

end
end RieszRectifiability

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.quantitative_selected_restart_uniform_deficit
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.text:
theorem quantitative_selected_restart_uniform_deficit {p d : ℕ} (hnd : p + 1 ≤ d)
    (C G : ℝ) (D : ℝ≥0) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hG : 0 < G) (H ε : ℝ) (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (ζ : ℝ) (hζ : 0 < ζ) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ b : ℕ, 0 < b ∧
      ∀ (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) [μ.Regular], ADRegularWithConstant (p + 1) C μ →
      GlobalUpperGrowth (p + 1) G μ → RieszL2BoundedWithConstant (p + 1) D μ → ∀ (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ) (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points),
        AdmissibleRadius μ (latticeRadius R k / 8) →
        let Bad := fun i : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z =>
          ε ≤ bilateralBeta (p + 1) μ i.center (H * i.radius)
        ∀ (E : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q} → Set (Ambient d))
          (step : ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0),
          HasSelectedRestartAssembly (p + 1) Bad E step →
          (∀ q, μ (selectedRestartRemainder Bad q.val (E q)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ q.val.cell) →
          ∃ g : ball (0 : Ambient (p + 1)) (latticeRadius R k) → Ambient d,
            LipschitzWith (badBudgetChartConstant step b) g ∧
            Set.range g ⊆ closedBall (z : Ambient d) (2 * latticeRadius R k) ∧
            μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z \ Set.range g) ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal ζ * μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z) := by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hregions⟩ := quantitative_restart_loss_budget hnd C G D hC hG H ε hH hε
    (ζ / 2) (half_pos hζ)
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hcounts⟩ := quantitative_cell_bad_count_budget hnd C G D hC hG H ε hH hε
    (ζ / 2) (half_pos hζ)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, b, hb, ?_⟩
  intro μ _hreg hAD hg hRiesz R hR k z hcore
  have hregions := hregions μ hAD hg hRiesz
  have hcounts := hcounts μ hAD hg hRiesz
  dsimp only
  intro E step hassemble hloss
  let Bad := fun i : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z =>
    ε ≤ bilateralBeta (p + 1) μ i.center (H * i.radius)
  let q : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q} :=
    ⟨supportCellRoot μ R hR k z, Or.inl rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A, _, _, hAmass, hAcount⟩ := hcounts R hR k z hcore
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgrange, _, hdeficit⟩ := exists_restart_chart_with_original_mass_deficit
    μ R hR k z Bad
    (fun r => selectedRestartRemainder Bad r.val (E r))
    (fun r => selectedRestartParent Bad r.val (E r))
    (fun r => selectedRestartNext Bad r.val (E r)) step
    (fun r w hw => selected_restart_next_consumes_bad_cell Bad r.val (E r) w hw)
    (fun r => selected_restart_partition Bad r.val (E r)) hassemble b q A
    (fun x hx => hAcount x hx.2 q.val)
  have hsum := hregions R hR k z hcore
    (fun r => μ (selectedRestartRemainder Bad r.val (E r))) hloss
  have hbound := hdeficit.trans (add_le_add hAmass hsum)
  have heq : ENNReal.ofReal (ζ / 2) + ENNReal.ofReal (ζ / 2) = ENNReal.ofReal ζ := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (half_pos hζ).le (half_pos hζ).le, add_halves]
  refine ⟨g, hg, hgrange, ?_⟩
  simpa only [← add_mul, heq] using! hbound

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Nets.La.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.SupportCellDescendant
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Nets.La.text:
structure SupportCellDescendant {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Ambient d))
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ) (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points) where
  depth : ℕ
  center : Ambient d
  mem_net : center ∈ (supportLatticeNets μ R hR (k + depth)).points
  ancestor : supportLatticeAncestor μ R hR k depth ⟨center, mem_net⟩ = z

variable {d : ℕ} {μ : Measure (Ambient d)} {R : ℝ} {hR : 0 < R}
  {k : ℕ} {z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points}

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Model:4.text:
def QuantitativeFullStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ d n : ℕ, 4 ≤ d → 2 ≤ n → n + 2 ≤ d →
    ∀ C_AD : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_AD → ∀ C_R : ℝ≥0,
      ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ ∃ M : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ μ : Measure (Ambient d), μ.Regular →
          ADRegularWithConstant n C_AD μ →
          RieszL2BoundedWithConstant n C_R μ →
          BallImageConclusion n μ θ M

end

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.quantitative_total_mass_of_bounded_support
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.text:
theorem quantitative_total_mass_of_bounded_support {d n : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (C : ℝ) (hAD : ADRegularWithConstant n C μ)
    (hpos : μ.support.Nontrivial) (hfin : ediam μ.support ≠ ⊤) :
    μ Set.univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((9 : ℝ) ^ d * C * (diam μ.support / 2) ^ n) := by
  classical
  let D := diam μ.support
  have hb : Bornology.IsBounded μ.support := isBounded_iff_ediam_ne_top.mpr hfin
  have hD : 0 < D := diam_pos hpos hb
  have hc : IsCompact μ.support := isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr ⟨μ.isClosed_support, hb⟩
  obtain ⟨N, _, hNE, hsep, hcover⟩ := exists_separated_cover_extension μ.support ∅
    (D / 4) (by positivity) (empty_subset _) (by simp)
  have hNfin : N.Finite := by
    have h := separated_set_finite_inter_compact N μ.support (D / 4)
      (by positivity) hsep hc
    simpa only [inter_eq_left.mpr hNE] using! h
  let s := hNfin.toFinset
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hpos.nonempty
  let t := s.image (fun x => x - a)
  have hcard : t.card = s.card := Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun x y h => sub_left_inj.mp h)
  have hball : ∀ x ∈ t, ‖x‖ ≤ D := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    exact dist_le_diam_of_mem hb (hNE (hNfin.mem_toFinset.mp hy)) ha
  have hsep' : ∀ x ∈ t, ∀ y ∈ t, x ≠ y → 2 * (D / 8) ≤ dist x y := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    rw [dist_sub_right]
    have hn : z ≠ w := by rintro rfl; exact hxy rfl
    have hh := hsep (hNfin.mem_toFinset.mp hz) (hNfin.mem_toFinset.mp hw) hn
    linarith
  have hs : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (9 : ℝ) ^ d := by
    have hp := euclidean_separated_card_le t D (D / 8) hD.le (by positivity) hball hsep'
    have heq : (D + D / 8) / (D / 8) = 9 := by field_simp; ring
    simpa only [hcard, heq] using! hp
  have hadmiss : AdmissibleRadius μ (D / 2) := by
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    calc
      ENNReal.ofReal (D / 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith)
      _ = ediam μ.support := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfin
  have hcov : μ.support ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ s, ball x (D / 2) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := hcover y hy
    exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨x, hNfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hx, lt_trans hyx (by linarith)⟩
  have heq : μ μ.support = μ Set.univ := by
    simpa only [univ_inter] using! (measure_inter_conull (μ := μ) (s := Set.univ) μ.measure_compl_support)
  calc
    μ Set.univ = μ μ.support := heq.symm
    _ ≤ μ (⋃ x ∈ s, ball x (D / 2)) := measure_mono hcov
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ s, μ (ball x (D / 2)) := measure_biUnion_finset_le s _
    _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ s, ENNReal.ofReal (C * (D / 2) ^ n) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro x hx
      exact (hAD.2 x (hNE (hNfin.mem_toFinset.mp hx)) _ hadmiss).2
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((s.card : ℝ) * (C * (D / 2) ^ n)) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ (s.card : ℝ)), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (9 ^ d * C * (D / 2) ^ n) := by
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      have hC : 0 ≤ C := zero_le_one.trans hAD.1
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs (mul_nonneg hC (pow_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ D / 2) n))]

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.relativeRestartGood

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Model:1.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.AdmissibleRadius
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Model:1.text:
def AdmissibleRadius {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (r : ℝ) : Prop :=

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.quantitative_ball_images_of_clean_cell_deficits
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.text:
theorem quantitative_ball_images_of_clean_cell_deficits {n d : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (C : ℝ) (hAD : ADRegularWithConstant n C μ)
    (G : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hg : GlobalUpperGrowth n G μ)
    (ζ : ℝ) (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ) (hζone : ζ < 1) (M : ℝ≥0)
    (hcharts : ∀ (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ)
      (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points),
      AdmissibleRadius μ (latticeRadius R k / 8) →
      ∃ f : ball (0 : Ambient n) (latticeRadius R k) → Ambient d,
        LipschitzWith M f ∧ μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z \ Set.range f) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ζ * μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z)) : BallImageConclusion n μ ((1 - ζ) / (C * 32 ^ n)) (M * (1 / 4)) := by
  obtain ⟨hC, hballs⟩ := hAD
  have hCpos : 0 < C := zero_lt_one.trans_le hC
  have hkeep : 0 < 1 - ζ := sub_pos.mpr hζone
  let θ := (1 - ζ) / (C * 32 ^ n)
  have hθ : 0 < θ := div_pos hkeep (mul_pos hCpos (by positivity))
  change BallImageConclusion n μ θ (M * (1 / 4))
  intro x hx r hr
  have hR : 0 < r / 4 := div_pos hr.1 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨zc, hzc, hnear⟩ := (supportLatticeNets μ (r / 4) hR 0).covers x hx
  let z : (supportLatticeNets μ (r / 4) hR 0).points := ⟨zc, hzc⟩
  have hrad : latticeRadius (r / 4) 0 = r / 4 := by simp only [latticeRadius, pow_zero, mul_one]
  have hcore : AdmissibleRadius μ (latticeRadius (r / 4) 0 / 8) := by
    refine ⟨div_pos (latticeRadius_pos _ hR 0) (by norm_num), ?_⟩
    apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_).trans hr.2
    rw [hrad]
    linarith [hr.1]
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hdeficit⟩ := hcharts (r / 4) hR 0 z hcore
  have hmass := cleanSupportCell_measure_bounds μ C G hCpos hG hg
    (fun y hy s hs => (hballs y hy s hs).1) (r / 4) hR 0 hcore z
  have hfinite : μ (cleanSupportCell μ (r / 4) hR 0 z) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hmass.2
  have hret := retained_mass_of_chart_deficit μ _ (Set.range f) hfinite ζ hζ hdeficit
  have hcoef : θ * r ^ n = (1 - ζ) * ((latticeRadius (r / 4) 0 / 8) ^ n / C) := by
    rw [hrad]
    change (1 - ζ) / (C * 32 ^ n) * r ^ n = (1 - ζ) * ((r / 4 / 8) ^ n / C)
    rw [div_div, show (4 : ℝ) * 8 = 32 by norm_num, div_pow]
    ring
  have hretained : ENNReal.ofReal (θ * r ^ n) ≤
      μ (cleanSupportCell μ (r / 4) hR 0 z ∩ Set.range f) := by
    rw [hcoef, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hkeep.le]
    exact (mul_le_mul_right hmass.1 (ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ζ))).trans hret
  have hcell : cleanSupportCell μ (r / 4) hR 0 z ⊆ ball x r := by
    intro y hy
    have hdist := (supportLatticeCell_bounds μ (r / 4) hR 0 z).2 hy.1
    change dist y zc ≤ 2 * latticeRadius (r / 4) 0 at hdist
    rw [hrad] at hdist hnear
    have htri := dist_triangle y zc x
    rw [dist_comm zc x] at htri
    change dist y x < r
    linarith [hr.1]
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFRange⟩ := exists_rescaled_ball_chart (latticeRadius (r / 4) 0)
    (0 : Ambient n) (1 / 4) (by norm_num) f M hf
  have hdomain : latticeRadius (r / 4) 0 / ((1 / 4 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = r := by
    rw [hrad]
    norm_num
    ring
  rw [hdomain] at hF hFRange
  let g := (ball (0 : Ambient n) r).domRestrict F
  have hcover : Set.range f ⊆ Set.range g := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hFu⟩ := hFRange.symm ▸ hy
    exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, hFu⟩
  refine ⟨g, hF.to_restrict, hretained.trans (measure_mono ?_)⟩
  exact fun y hy => ⟨hcell hy.1, hcover hy.2⟩

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.selected_restart_remainder_mass_le_surface_loss
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.text:
theorem selected_restart_remainder_mass_le_surface_loss {n d : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (G : ℝ) (hG : 0 < G) (hg : GlobalUpperGrowth n G μ)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ) (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points)
    (Bad : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z → Prop)
    (q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z) (hq : ¬ Bad q) (E : Set (Ambient d))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεfine : ε ≤ 1 / 281474976710656)
    (hsmall : activeProjectionError d ε ≤ 1 / 128) (N : ℕ) (P : ℝ≥0)
    (a : SelectedRestartSurfaceData n Bad q E ε N P) :
    μ (selectedRestartRemainder Bad q E) ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal G + activeRegionStopMassAreaConstant n G) *
        (μH[(n : ℝ)] : Measure (Ambient d))
          ((Set.range a.model ∩ closedBall q.center (3 * q.radius)) \ E) := by
  rw [selected_restart_remainder_of_good_root Bad q hq E]
  exact active_cell_remainder_mass_le_discarded_area μ G hG hg R hR (k + q.depth)
    ⟨q.center, q.mem_net⟩ (relativeRestartGood Bad q) a.planes a.isPlane
    ε hε hεfine hsmall a.fits a.model a.isModel
    (supportCellRoot μ R hR (k + q.depth) ⟨q.center, q.mem_net⟩)
    (relative_restart_root_active Bad q hq) E

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.retained_mass_of_chart_deficit
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.text:
theorem retained_mass_of_chart_deficit {d : ℕ} (μ : Measure (Ambient d))
    (Q T : Set (Ambient d)) (hfinite : μ Q ≠ ⊤) (ζ : ℝ) (hζ : 0 ≤ ζ)
    (hdeficit : μ (Q \ T) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ζ * μ Q) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ζ) * μ Q ≤ μ (Q ∩ T) := by
  have hsub : Q ⊆ (Q ∩ T) ∪ (Q \ T) := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases ht : x ∈ T
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, ht⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, ht⟩
  have hmass : μ Q ≤ μ (Q ∩ T) + μ (Q \ T) + 0 := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using! (measure_mono (μ := μ) hsub).trans (measure_union_le _ _)
  have h := mass_fraction_of_two_deficits _ _ _ 0 hfinite ζ 0 hζ le_rfl hmass hdeficit (by simp)
  simpa only [sub_zero] using! h

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Foundat.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.cleanSupportCell_measure_bounds
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Foundat.text:
theorem cleanSupportCell_measure_bounds {n d : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (C G : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G)
    (hg : GlobalUpperGrowth n G μ)
    (hlower : ∀ z ∈ μ.support, ∀ r : ℝ, AdmissibleRadius μ r →
      ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n / C) ≤ μ (ball z r))
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ) (hcore : AdmissibleRadius μ (latticeRadius R k / 8))
    (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((latticeRadius R k / 8) ^ n / C) ≤ μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z) ∧
      μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (G * (3 * latticeRadius R k) ^ n) := by
  rw [cleanSupportCell_measure_eq μ C G hC hG hg hlower R hR k z]
  exact supportLatticeCell_measure_bounds μ C G hg hlower R hR k hcore z

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.IsActiveRegionLimitModel
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.text:
def IsActiveRegionLimitModel {n d : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ)
    (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points)
    (Good : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z → Prop)
    (S : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z → AffineSubspace ℝ (Ambient d))
    (hS : ∀ i, IsAffineNPlane n (S i)) (ε : ℝ)
    (f : S (supportCellRoot μ R hR k z) → Ambient d) : Prop :=
  Continuous f ∧ IsProperMap f ∧
  TendstoUniformly (fun t (u : S (supportCellRoot μ R hR k z)) =>
    activeRegionParameterMap μ R hR k z Good S hS t u) f atTop ∧
  (∀ t (u : S (supportCellRoot μ R hR k z)),
    dist (activeRegionParameterMap μ R hR k z Good S hS t u) (f u) ≤
      ((17039360 * ε) / 63) * latticeRadius R (k + t)) ∧
  cellRegionZeroSet μ R hR k z Good ⊆ Set.range f ∧
  cellRegionLimit μ R hR k z Good ⊆ Set.range f ∧
  ∀ (K : Set (Ambient d)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ →
    (∀ x ∈ K, δ ≤ cellRegionStoppingScale μ R hR k z Good x) →
    ∃ N, ∀ t, N ≤ t → Set.range f ∩ K = activeRegionSurface μ R hR k z Good S hS t ∩ K

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.relativeRestartGood_beta_eq
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Restart.text:
theorem relativeRestartGood_beta_eq (ε : ℝ)
    (q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z) :
    relativeRestartGood (fun i => ε ≤ bilateralBeta n μ i.center (1024 * i.radius)) q =
      (fun i => bilateralBeta n μ i.center (1024 * i.radius) < ε) := by
  funext i
  apply propext
  change (¬ ε ≤ bilateralBeta n μ i.center (1024 * (q.compose i).radius)) ↔ _
  rw [q.compose_radius i]
  exact not_le

end

end RieszRectifiability

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.name: OAI.RieszRectifiability.quantitative_recursive_chart_from_surface_pieces
OAI.Analysis.RieszRectifiability.Uniform.text:
theorem quantitative_recursive_chart_from_surface_pieces {p d : ℕ} (hnd : p + 1 ≤ d)
    (C G : ℝ) (D : ℝ≥0) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hG : 0 < G) (H ε : ℝ) (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hεfine : ε ≤ 1 / 281474976710656) (hsmall : activeProjectionError d ε ≤ 1 / 128)
    (ζ : ℝ) (hζ : 0 < ζ) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ b : ℕ, 0 < b ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : ℝ≥0), ∀ (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) [μ.Regular], ADRegularWithConstant (p + 1) C μ →
      GlobalUpperGrowth (p + 1) G μ → RieszL2BoundedWithConstant (p + 1) D μ →
      ∀ (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (k : ℕ) (z : (supportLatticeNets μ R hR k).points),
      AdmissibleRadius μ (latticeRadius R k / 8) →
      let Bad := fun i : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z =>
        ε ≤ bilateralBeta (p + 1) μ i.center (H * i.radius)
      ∀ (E : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q} → Set (Ambient d))
        (data : ∀ q : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q},
          ¬ Bad q.val → SelectedRestartSurfaceData (p + 1) Bad q.val (E q) ε N P),
        (∀ q hq, (ENNReal.ofReal G + activeRegionStopMassAreaConstant (p + 1) G) *
          (μH[((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)] : Measure (Ambient d))
            ((Set.range (data q hq).model ∩ closedBall q.val.center (3 * q.val.radius)) \ E q) ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ q.val.cell) →
        ∃ g : ball (0 : Ambient (p + 1)) (latticeRadius R k) → Ambient d,
          LipschitzWith (badBudgetChartConstant
            (fun M => restartChartStepConstant d N P (restartChartStepConstant d N P M)) b) g ∧
          Set.range g ⊆ closedBall (z : Ambient d) (2 * latticeRadius R k) ∧
          μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z \ Set.range g) ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal ζ * μ (cleanSupportCell μ R hR k z) := by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, b, hb, hcharts⟩ := quantitative_selected_restart_uniform_deficit
    hnd C G D hC hG H ε hH hε ζ hζ
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, b, hb, ?_⟩
  intro N P μ _hreg hAD hg hRiesz R hR k z hcore
  have hcharts := hcharts μ hAD hg hRiesz
  dsimp only
  intro E data hloss
  let Bad := fun i : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z =>
    ε ≤ bilateralBeta (p + 1) μ i.center (H * i.radius)
  have hassemble := has_selected_restart_assembly_of_surface_data (Nat.succ_pos p)
    G hG hg Bad E ε hε hεfine hsmall N P data
  apply hcharts R hR k z hcore E _ hassemble
  intro q
  by_cases hq : Bad q.val
  · rw [selected_restart_remainder_of_bad_root Bad q.val hq (E q), measure_empty]
    exact zero_le
  · exact (selected_restart_remainder_mass_le_surface_loss μ G hG hg R hR k z
      Bad q.val hq (E q) ε hε hεfine hsmall N P (data q hq)).trans (hloss q hq)

end
end RieszRectifiability

def RieszL2BoundedWithConstant {d : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ≥0)
    (μ : Measure (Ambient d)) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ f : Ambient d → ℝ,
    MemLp f 2 μ → MemLp (truncated n μ ε f) 2 μ ∧
      eLpNorm (truncated n μ ε f) 2 μ ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * eLpNorm f 2 μ

variable (remainder parent : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q} → Set (Ambient d)) (next : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q} → Set {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q})
  (step : ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0)
  (hnext : ∀ q w, w ∈ next q → ∃ i : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z,
    q.val.depth ≤ i.depth ∧ i.cell ⊆ q.val.cell ∧ Bad i ∧
      i.depth < w.val.depth ∧ w.val.cell ⊆ i.cell)
  (hpartition : ∀ q, q.val.cell \ remainder q ⊆ parent q ∪
    ⋃ w : next q, w.val.val.cell)
  (hassemble : ∀ (q : {q : SupportCellDescendant μ R hR k z // cellRestartsAfter Bad q}) (M : ℝ≥0)
    (child : ∀ w : next q, ball (0 : Ambient n) w.val.val.radius → Ambient d),
    (∀ w, LipschitzWith M (child w)) →
    (∀ w, Set.range (child w) ⊆ closedBall w.val.val.center (2 * w.val.val.radius)) →
    ∃ g : ball (0 : Ambient n) q.val.radius → Ambient d,
      LipschitzWith (step M) g ∧ Set.range g ⊆ closedBall q.val.center (2 * q.val.radius) ∧
      parent q ⊆ Set.range g ∧
      ∀ w, w.val.val.cell ∩ Set.range (child w) ⊆ Set.range g)

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:135.name: OAI.Rokhlin.sequential_step
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:135.text:
lemma sequential_step (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (T : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ)
    (hmix : ∀ s t : Set Ω, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet t →
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => μ (s ∩ (T^[n]) ⁻¹' t)) atTop (𝓝 (μ s*μ t)))
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ih : ∀ n < k, SequentialMixing μ T n) : SequentialMixing μ T k := by
  classical
  intro d hd S hS
  let i : Fin k := ⟨k-1,by omega⟩
  have hremote r j (hj : j ≠ i) : d r j+r < d r i := by
    apply hd r j i
    have hne : j.val ≠ k-1 := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h)
    have := j.isLt
    change j.val < k-1
    omega
  let a : Ω → (Fin k → Bool) := fun x j => if x ∈ S j then true else false
  have ha : Measurable a := Measurable.of_eval fun j =>
    Measurable.ite (hS j) measurable_const measurable_const
  let f : Fin k → (Fin k → Bool) → ℝ := fun j z => if z j then 1 else 0
  have hf j z : f j z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by dsimp [f]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hfa j x : f j (a x) = setIndicator (S j) x := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S j <;> simp [f,a,setIndicator,hx]
  have hrect := proper_rectangles_of_induction μ T ih d hd
  have ht := last_centered_correlation_zero μ T hT hmix (by simpa using hk) d hrect i hremote a ha f hf
  simp_rw [hfa] at ht
  rw [integral_setIndicator μ (hS i)] at ht
  let J : Finset (Fin k) := Finset.univ.erase i
  have hJ : J ≠ Finset.univ := by
    intro h
    have : i ∈ J := h ▸ Finset.mem_univ i
    exact Finset.notMem_erase i Finset.univ this
  have hp := hrect J hJ (fun j => S j) (fun j => hS j)
  have hpR := (ENNReal.continuousAt_toReal (show (∏ j : J, μ (S j)) ≠ ∞ from ENNReal.prod_ne_top (fun _ _ => measure_ne_top μ _))).tendsto.comp hp
  let w r x := ∏ j ∈ J, setIndicator (S j) ((T^[d r j]) x)
  have hwmeas r : Measurable (w r) := Finset.measurable_prod _ fun j _ =>
    (setIndicator_measurable (hS j)).comp (T.measurable.iterate _)
  have hwb r x : |w r x| ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [Finset.abs_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    intro j hj
    have hh := setIndicator_bounds (S j) ((T^[d r j]) x)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hh.1]
    exact hh.2
  have hwi r : Integrable (w r) μ := real_integrable_bound μ (hwmeas r) 1 (hwb r)
  have hew r : (∫ x, w r x ∂μ) = (μ (⋂ j : J, (T^[d r j]) ⁻¹' S j)).toReal := by
    have he : w r = fun x => ∏ j : J, setIndicator (S j) ((T^[d r j]) x) := by
      funext x
      exact (Finset.prod_coe_sort J (fun j => setIndicator (S j) ((T^[d r j]) x))).symm
    rw [he]
    simp_rw [setIndicator_preimage]
    exact integral_prod_setIndicator μ _ (fun j => (hS j).preimage (T.measurable.iterate _))
  have hpR' : Tendsto (fun r => ∫ x, w r x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∏ j ∈ J, (μ (S j)).toReal)) := by
    change Tendsto (fun r => (μ (⋂ j : J, (T^[d r j]) ⁻¹' S j)).toReal) atTop
      (𝓝 ((∏ j : J, μ (S j)).toReal)) at hpR
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_prod,Finset.prod_coe_sort J (fun j => (μ (S j)).toReal)] at hpR
    simpa only [hew] using hpR
  have hwhole r : (∫ x, ∏ j, setIndicator (S j) ((T^[d r j]) x) ∂μ) =
      (μ (⋂ j, (T^[d r j]) ⁻¹' S j)).toReal := by
    simp_rw [setIndicator_preimage]
    exact integral_prod_setIndicator μ _ (fun j => (hS j).preimage (T.measurable.iterate _))
  have hsplit r : (∫ x, (setIndicator (S i) ((T^[d r i]) x)-(μ (S i)).toReal)*w r x ∂μ) =
      (μ (⋂ j, (T^[d r j]) ⁻¹' S j)).toReal - (μ (S i)).toReal*(∫ x, w r x ∂μ) := by
    have hi : Integrable (fun x => setIndicator (S i) ((T^[d r i]) x)*w r x) μ := by
      apply real_integrable_bound μ (((setIndicator_measurable (hS i)).comp (T.measurable.iterate _)).mul (hwmeas r)) 1
      intro x
      change |setIndicator (S i) ((T^[d r i]) x)*w r x| ≤ 1
      rw [abs_mul]
      apply (fun leftBound rightNonneg rightBound => (mul_le_of_le_one_left rightNonneg leftBound).trans rightBound) _ (abs_nonneg _) (hwb r x)
      have hh := setIndicator_bounds (S i) ((T^[d r i]) x)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hh.1]
      exact hh.2
    simp_rw [sub_mul]
    rw [integral_sub hi ((hwi r).const_mul _),integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [←hwhole]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with x
    exact Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => setIndicator (S j) ((T^[d r j]) x)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  change Tendsto (fun r => ∫ x, (setIndicator (S i) ((T^[d r i]) x)-(μ (S i)).toReal)*w r x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) at ht
  simp_rw [hsplit] at ht
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (μ (S i)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 ((μ (S i)).toReal)) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have hsum := ht.add (hconst.mul hpR')
  change Tendsto (fun r => ((μ (⋂ j, (T^[d r j]) ⁻¹' S j)).toReal -
    (μ (S i)).toReal*(∫ x, w r x ∂μ))+(μ (S i)).toReal*(∫ x, w r x ∂μ)) atTop
    (𝓝 (0+(μ (S i)).toReal*(∏ j ∈ J, (μ (S j)).toReal))) at hsum
  simp only [sub_add_cancel,zero_add] at hsum
  have hprod : (μ (S i)).toReal*(∏ j ∈ J, (μ (S j)).toReal) = (∏ j, μ (S j)).toReal := by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_prod]
    exact Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => (μ (S j)).toReal) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [hprod] at hsum
  exact (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal_iff (fun _ => measure_ne_top μ _) (ENNReal.prod_ne_top (fun _ _ => measure_ne_top μ _))).mp hsum

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:267.name: OAI.Rokhlin.mixing_nat_of_IsMixing
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:267.text:
lemma mixing_nat_of_IsMixing (μ : Measure Ω) (T : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (h : IsMixing μ T) :
    ∀ s t : Set Ω, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet t →
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => μ (s ∩ (T^[n]) ⁻¹' t)) atTop (𝓝 (μ s*μ t)) := by
  intro s t hs ht
  have hc : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℤ)) atTop (comap Int.natAbs atTop) := by
    rw [tendsto_comap_iff]
    change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Int.natAbs (n:ℤ)) atTop atTop
    exact tendsto_id
  have hh := (h s t hs ht).comp hc
  change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => μ (s ∩ timeMap T (n:ℤ) ⁻¹' t)) atTop (𝓝 (μ s*μ t)) at hh
  simpa only [timeMap_nat] using hh

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:67.name: OAI.Rokhlin.sequential_two
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:67.text:
lemma sequential_two (μ : Measure Ω) (T : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ)
    (hmix : ∀ s t : Set Ω, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet t →
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => μ (s ∩ (T^[n]) ⁻¹' t)) atTop (𝓝 (μ s*μ t))) :
    SequentialMixing μ T 2 := by
  intro d hd A hA
  have hb r : d r 0 ≤ d r 1 := by have := hd r 0 1 (by decide); omega
  have hc : Tendsto (fun r => d r 1-d r 0) atTop atTop := by
    apply tendsto_atTop_mono (fun r => Nat.le_of_lt ?_) tendsto_id
    have hh := hd r 0 1 (by decide)
    change r < d r 1-d r 0
    omega
  have ht := (hmix (A 0) (A 1) (hA 0) (hA 1)).comp hc
  change Tendsto (fun r => μ (A 0 ∩ (T^[d r 1-d r 0]) ⁻¹' A 1)) atTop (𝓝 (μ (A 0)*μ (A 1))) at ht
  have he r : (⋂ i : Fin 2, (T^[d r i]) ⁻¹' A i) =
      (T^[d r 0]) ⁻¹' A 0 ∩ (T^[d r 1]) ⁻¹' A 1 := by
    ext x
    simp [Fin.forall_fin_two]
  simpa only [he,Fin.prod_univ_two,shifted_pair μ T hT _ _ (hA 0) (hA 1) _ _ (hb _),Function.comp_apply] using ht
end

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:227.name: OAI.Rokhlin.sequential_mixing_all
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:227.text:
theorem sequential_mixing_all (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (T : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ)
    (hmix : ∀ s t : Set Ω, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet t →
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => μ (s ∩ (T^[n]) ⁻¹' t)) atTop (𝓝 (μ s*μ t))) :
    ∀ k, SequentialMixing μ T k := by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    by_cases hk : 3 ≤ k
    · exact sequential_step μ T hT hmix hk ih
    · interval_cases k
      · exact sequential_zero μ T
      · exact sequential_one μ T hT
      · exact sequential_two μ T hT hmix
end

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:248.name: OAI.Rokhlin.layoutTime_gap_bound
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:248.text:
lemma layoutTime_gap_bound {k : ℕ} (g : Fin (k-1) → ℕ+) (i j : Fin k) (hij : i<j) :
    ∃ q : Fin (k-1), layoutTime g i+(g q:ℕ) ≤ layoutTime g j := by
  classical
  let q : Fin (k-1) := ⟨i.val,by have := j.isLt; have := hij; omega⟩
  let s : Finset (Fin (k-1)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun t => t.val < i.val)
  let t : Finset (Fin (k-1)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun t => t.val < j.val)
  have hqs : q ∉ s := by simp [s,q]
  have hsub : insert q s ⊆ t := by
    intro l hl
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hl with h | h
    · subst l; simpa [t,q] using hij
    · have hl := (Finset.mem_filter.mp h).2
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,lt_trans hl hij⟩
  refine ⟨q,?_⟩
  have hei : layoutTime g i = ∑ l ∈ s, (g l:ℕ) := by simp [layoutTime,s,Finset.sum_filter]
  have hej : layoutTime g j = ∑ l ∈ t, (g l:ℕ) := by simp [layoutTime,t,Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [hei,hej,add_comm,←Finset.sum_insert (f := fun l => (g l:ℕ)) hqs]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hsub

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.HilbertCodes.name: OAI.Rokhlin.layoutTime
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.HilbertCodes.text:
def layoutTime {k : ℕ} (gaps : Fin (k - 1) → ℕ+) (i : Fin k) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin (k - 1), if j.val < i.val then (gaps j : ℕ) else 0

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.HilbertCodes.name: OAI.Rokhlin.IsMixing
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.HilbertCodes.text:
def IsMixing (μ : Measure Ω) (T : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) : Prop :=

    Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => μ (A ∩ timeMap T n ⁻¹' B))
      (comap Int.natAbs atTop) (𝓝 (μ A * μ B))

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:47.name: OAI.Rokhlin.sequential_one
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:47.text:
lemma sequential_one (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (T : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω)
    (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ) : SequentialMixing μ T 1 := by
  intro d hd A hA
  have he r : μ (⋂ i, (T^[d r i]) ⁻¹' A i) = μ (A 0) := by
    have he : (⋂ i : Fin 1, (T^[d r i]) ⁻¹' A i) = (T^[d r 0]) ⁻¹' A 0 := by
      ext x
      simp
    rw [he]
    exact (hT.iterate _).measure_preimage (hA 0).nullMeasurableSet
  simpa only [he,Fin.prod_univ_one] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := μ (A 0)))

OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:279.name: OAI.Rokhlin.mixingOfOrder_of_sequential
OAI.Dynamics.MultipleMixing.Main:279.text:
lemma mixingOfOrder_of_sequential (μ : Measure Ω) (T : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (hseq : SequentialMixing μ T k) : MixingOfOrder μ T k := by
  classical
  intro A hA
  by_contra hn
  have hbad : ∃ s : Set ENNReal, s ∈ 𝓝 (∏ i, μ (A i)) ∧
      ¬∀ᶠ g : Fin (k-1) → ℕ+ in atTop,
        μ (⋂ i, timeMap T (layoutTime g i : ℤ) ⁻¹' A i) ∈ s := by
    rw [Filter.tendsto_def] at hn
    push Not at hn
    obtain ⟨s,hs,hout⟩ := hn
    exact ⟨s,hs,hout⟩
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hbad⟩ := hbad
  have hex (r : ℕ) : ∃ g : Fin (k-1) → ℕ+, (∀ j, r < (g j:ℕ)) ∧
      μ (⋂ i, timeMap T (layoutTime g i : ℤ) ⁻¹' A i) ∉ s := by
    have hfreq : ∃ᶠ g : Fin (k-1) → ℕ+ in atTop,
        μ (⋂ i, timeMap T (layoutTime g i : ℤ) ⁻¹' A i) ∉ s := Filter.not_eventually.mp hbad
    obtain ⟨g,hg,hout⟩ := frequently_atTop.1 hfreq (fun _ => (⟨r+1,by omega⟩ : ℕ+))
    exact ⟨g,fun j => by have := hg j; change r+1 ≤ (g j:ℕ) at this; omega,hout⟩
  choose g hg hout using hex
  let d r i := layoutTime (g r) i
  have hd : Spaced d := by
    intro r i j hij
    obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := layoutTime_gap_bound (g r) i j hij
    have hh := hg r q
    dsimp [d]
    omega
  have ht := hseq d hd A hA
  have he := ht.eventually hs
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := he.exists
  apply hout r
  change μ (⋂ i, (T^[layoutTime (g r) i]) ⁻¹' A i) ∈ s at hr
  simpa only [timeMap_nat] using hr
end

open MeasureTheory Filter

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Singular:50.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singularUpper_image
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Singular:50.text:
lemma singularUpper_image (p gamma c : ℝ) :
    (fun z => vec3 0 0 (Real.sqrt 2)+z) ''
      (swapReflect '' physicalRuled (Real.sqrt 2) (singularDomain p gamma c)
        (fun z => -c • singularField p z) 1) = singularUpper p gamma c := by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,⟨_,⟨b,hb,s,hs,rfl⟩,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨b,hb,s,hs,?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [swapReflect,vec3] <;> ring
  · rintro ⟨b,hb,s,hs,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨swapReflect (vec3 s (b 0+s*(-c • singularField p b) 0)
      (Real.sqrt 2*(b 1+s*(-c • singularField p b) 1))),
      ⟨_,⟨b,hb,s,hs,rfl⟩,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [swapReflect,vec3] <;> ring

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.upperTipCylinder_triangle

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:194.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.SingularStatement
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:194.text:
def SingularStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ p gamma : ℝ, 1 < p → p < (Real.sqrt 51 - 5) / 2 →
    1 < gamma → gamma < 1 / (2 - p) →
    singularCoefficient p < 0 ∧
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (fun c => 2 * singularCost p gamma c + 8 * Real.sqrt 2 * (c ^ gamma) ^ 2 -
        (Real.sqrt 2 / 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * singularCoefficient p * c ^ 2))
      (fun c => c ^ 2) ∧
    ∀ᶠ c : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
      ∃ n m : ℕ, ∃ C : Fin n → Cylinder, ∃ D : Fin m → Cylinder,
      ∃ B₁ B₂ : Cylinder,
        (∀ i, (C i).parallelogram) ∧ (∀ j, (D j).parallelogram) ∧
        B₁.triangle ∧ B₂.triangle ∧
        singularLower p gamma c ⊆ familySet C ∧
        singularUpper p gamma c ⊆ familySet D ∧
        B₁.carrier = lowerTip (c ^ gamma) ∧ B₂.carrier = upperTip (c ^ gamma) ∧
        tetrahedron ⊆ familySet C ∪ familySet D ∪ B₁.carrier ∪ B₂.carrier ∧
        familyArea C + familyArea D + B₁.area + B₂.area < Real.sqrt 2 / 2

    orthogonalGrid, nilpotent, singular⟩

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:33.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.firstPhysicalMap_injective
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:33.text:
lemma firstPhysicalMap_injective {h : ℝ} (hh : h ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (firstPhysicalMap h) := by
  intro x y he
  have he0 := congrArg (fun z : Space => z 0) he
  have he1 := congrArg (fun z : Space => z 1) he
  have he2 := congrArg (fun z : Space => z 2) he
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact he0
  · exact he1
  · exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hh he2)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Projection:19.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.projectedCylinder_parallelogram
