OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.IsTriangle.translate
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.text:
lemma IsTriangle.translate {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {P : Set E} (hP : IsTriangle P) (a : E) :
    IsTriangle ((fun x => a+x) '' P) := by
  obtain ⟨c,u,v,hli,rfl⟩ := hP
  refine ⟨a+c,u,v,hli,?_⟩
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,⟨s,t,hs,ht,hst,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨s,t,hs,ht,hst,by abel_nf⟩
  · rintro ⟨s,t,hs,ht,hst,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c+s•u+t•v,⟨s,t,hs,ht,hst,rfl⟩,by abel_nf⟩

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Singular:69.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singular
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Singular:69.text:
theorem singular : SingularStatement := by
  intro p gamma hp hp' hg hg'
  obtain ⟨hp2,hpg,_,hk⟩ := singular_parameter_bounds hp hp' hg hg'
  refine ⟨hk,singular_asymptotic hp hp2.le hg,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,singular_geometric_cover hp hp2 hpg,
    singular_hyperbolic_eventually hp hp2 hpg,singular_totalCost_small hp hp2.le hg hk]
    with c hc hgeom hhyp hcost
  have hc : 0 < c := hc
  let eps : ℝ := (Real.sqrt 2/2-(2*singularCost p gamma c+8*Real.sqrt 2*(c^gamma)^2))/4
  have heps : 0 < eps := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hcost) (by norm_num)
  have hroot : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hD := singularDomain_isCompact p gamma c
  obtain ⟨n,C,hC,hcovC,hcostC⟩ := physical_hyperbolic_cover hroot (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)
    hD (singular_scaled_smoothNear p gamma c hc) (fun z hz => (hhyp z hz).1) heps
  have hneg := physical_hyperbolic_cover hroot (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)
    hD (singular_scaled_smoothNear p gamma (-c) hc) (fun z hz => (hhyp z hz).2) heps
  simp only [neg_smul,physicalWeight_neg] at hneg
  have hupper := (hneg.isometry swapReflect.toIsometryEquiv).isometry
    (IsometryEquiv.addLeft (vec3 0 0 (Real.sqrt 2)))
  simp only [← neg_smul] at hupper
  change HasFiniteCover Cylinder.parallelogram
    ((fun z => vec3 0 0 (Real.sqrt 2)+z) ''
      (swapReflect '' physicalRuled (Real.sqrt 2) (singularDomain p gamma c)
        (fun z => -c • singularField p z) 1)) (singularCost p gamma c+eps) at hupper
  rw [singularUpper_image] at hupper
  obtain ⟨m,D,hD,hcovD,hcostD⟩ := hupper
  refine ⟨n,m,C,D,lowerTipCylinder (c^gamma),upperTipCylinder (c^gamma),hC,hD,
    lowerTipCylinder_triangle (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc gamma),
    upperTipCylinder_triangle (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc gamma),hcovC,hcovD,
    lowerTipCylinder_carrier _,upperTipCylinder_carrier _,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [lowerTipCylinder_carrier,upperTipCylinder_carrier]
    exact hgeom.trans (union_subset_union (union_subset_union (union_subset_union hcovC hcovD) Subset.rfl) Subset.rfl)
  · rw [lowerTipCylinder_area (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le gamma),
      upperTipCylinder_area (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le gamma)]
    change familyArea C ≤ singularCost p gamma c+eps at hcostC
    dsimp only [eps] at hcostC hcostD
    linarith

end RuledApproximation

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:116.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.OrthogonalGridStatement
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:116.text:
def OrthogonalGridStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane) (kappa : ℝ),
    IsCompact D → volume (frontier D) = 0 → SmoothNear 1 D v → kappa < 1 →
    (∀ p ∈ D, LinearMap.trace ℝ Plane (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap = 0 ∧
      LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap < 0 ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ v p‖ ≤ kappa) →
    ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → HasFiniteCover Cylinder.parallelogram
      (physicalRuled (Real.sqrt 2) D v 1)
      (Real.sqrt 2 * (∫ p in D,
        1 / Real.sqrt (1 + v p 0 ^ 2 + 2 * v p 1 ^ 2)) + e)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SquareCover:1.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.nilpotent_physical_cover
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SquareCover:1.text:
theorem nilpotent_physical_cover {h : ℝ} {D : Set Plane} {v : Plane → Plane}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hD : IsCompact D) (hv : SmoothNear 1 D v)
    (hnil : ∀ p ∈ D, (fderiv ℝ v p).comp (fderiv ℝ v p) = 0)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    HasFiniteCover (squareProjected h) (physicalRuled h D v 1)
      (h * (∫ p in D, physicalWeight h (v p)) + eps) := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hDU, hv⟩ := hv
  have hF : IntegrableOn (fun p => physicalWeight h (v p)) D :=
    ((physicalWeight_continuous h).comp_continuousOn (hv.continuousOn.mono hDU)).integrableOn_compact hD
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbudget⟩ := exists_inflation_budget
    (h * ∫ p in D, physicalWeight h (v p)) (half_pos heps)
  have hc := globalize_local_covers h 1 v (fun p => physicalWeight h (v p)) (h*B) hD hF
    (fun p hp => nilpotent_local_patch hh hB hU hv (hDU hp) (hnil p hp)) (half_pos heps)
  apply hc.mono Subset.rfl
  nlinarith

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:213.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.FullMain
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:213.text:
def FullMain : Prop :=
  HyperbolicStatement ∧ PhysicalHyperbolicStatement ∧ LogarithmicStatement ∧
  ProductCellStatement ∧ OrthogonalGridStatement ∧ NilpotentStatement ∧ SingularStatement

end RuledApproximation

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Singular:14.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singular_hyperbolic_eventually
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Singular:14.text:
lemma singular_hyperbolic_eventually {p gamma : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hp2 : p < 2)
    (hpg : 0 < 1+gamma*(p-2)) :
    ∀ᶠ c : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ z ∈ singularDomain p gamma c,
      HyperbolicAt 1 (fun w => c • singularField p w) z ∧
      HyperbolicAt 1 (fun w => -c • singularField p w) z := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := singularField_homogeneous_bounds p
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => C*(c*(c^gamma)^(p-2))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using (singular_cutoff_small hpg).const_mul C
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))]
    with c hc hsmall
  have hc : 0 < c := hc
  intro z hz
  have hd : 0 < c^gamma := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc gamma
  have hz1 : 0 < z 1 := hd.trans_le hz.1
  have hb : |z 0| ≤ 2*z 1 := by linarith [hz.2.2.1]
  have hn := (hbound z hz1 hb).2
  have hr := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hd hz.1 (by linarith : p-2 ≤ 0)
  have hclt : c*‖fderiv ℝ (singularField p) z‖ < 1 := calc
    _ ≤ c*(C*(z 1)^(p-2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn hc.le
    _ ≤ c*(C*(c^gamma)^(p-2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (by linarith)) hc.le
    _ = C*(c*(c^gamma)^(p-2)) := by ring
    _ < 1 := hsmall
  exact ⟨singularField_scaled_hyperbolic hp hp2 hc.ne' hz1 hz.2.2.1
      (by simpa only [abs_of_pos hc] using hclt),
    singularField_scaled_hyperbolic hp hp2 (neg_ne_zero.mpr hc.ne') hz1 hz.2.2.1
      (by simpa only [abs_neg,abs_of_pos hc] using hclt)⟩

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:139.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.NilpotentStatement
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:139.text:
def NilpotentStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (D : Set Plane) (G : Plane → Plane), IsCompact D → SmoothNear ∞ D G →
    (∀ b ∈ D, (fderiv ℝ G b).comp (fderiv ℝ G b) = 0) →
    ∀ h eps : ℝ, 0 < h → 0 < eps →
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ T : Fin n → Set Plane, ∃ g : Fin n → Plane,
      (∀ i, IsSquareTile (T i)) ∧
      physicalRuled 1 D G 1 ⊆ ⋃ i, auxiliaryCylinder (T i) (g i) ∧
      (∑ i, volume.real (T i) * physicalWeight h (g i)) ≤
        (∫ b in D, physicalWeight h (G b)) + eps ∧
      ∀ a : ℝ, ∃ C₁ C₂ : Fin n → Cylinder,
        (∀ i, (C₁ i).parallelogram ∧ (C₂ i).parallelogram ∧
          (C₁ i).carrier = firstPhysicalMap h '' auxiliaryCylinder (T i) (g i) ∧
          (C₂ i).carrier = secondPhysicalMap h a '' auxiliaryCylinder (T i) (g i) ∧
          (C₁ i).area = h * volume.real (T i) * physicalWeight h (g i) ∧
          (C₂ i).area = h * volume.real (T i) * physicalWeight h (g i))

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularField.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singular_parameter_bounds
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularField.text:
lemma singular_parameter_bounds {p gamma : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (hp' : p < (Real.sqrt 51-5)/2) (hg : 1 < gamma) (hg' : gamma < 1/(2-p)) :
    p < 2 ∧ 0 < 1+gamma*(p-2) ∧ 0 < 2*gamma-2 ∧ singularCoefficient p < 0 := by
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 51)^2 = (51:ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hsn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (51:ℝ)
  have hs9 : Real.sqrt 51 < 9 := by nlinarith
  have hp2 : p < 2 := by linarith
  have hgam : gamma*(2-p) < 1 := (lt_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hp2)).mp hg'
  have hroot : 2*p+5 < Real.sqrt 51 := by linarith
  have hnum : 2*p^2+10*p-13 < 0 := by nlinarith
  refine ⟨hp2, by nlinarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
  exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by norm_num) hnum) (by linarith)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.upperTipCylinder
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.text:
def upperTipCylinder (d : ℝ) : Cylinder :=
  ((lowerTipCylinder d).rotate swapReflect).translate (vec3 0 0 (Real.sqrt 2))

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:45.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.firstPhysicalMap_ruled
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:45.text:
lemma firstPhysicalMap_ruled (h : ℝ) (D : Set Plane) (G : Plane → Plane) :
    firstPhysicalMap h '' physicalRuled 1 D G 1 = physicalRuled h D G 1 := by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,⟨p,hp,s,hs,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p,hp,s,hs,by simp [firstPhysicalMap]⟩
  · rintro ⟨p,hp,s,hs,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨vec3 s (p 0+s*G p 0) (p 1+s*G p 1),
      ⟨p,hp,s,hs,by simp⟩,rfl⟩

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:85.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.PhysicalHyperbolicStatement
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:85.text:
def PhysicalHyperbolicStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (h L : ℝ) (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane),
    0 < h → 0 < L → IsCompact D → SmoothNear 1 D v →
    (∀ p ∈ D, HyperbolicAt L v p) →
    ∀ (e : ℝ), 0 < e → ∀ F : Space ≃ᵢ Space,
    HasFiniteCover Cylinder.parallelogram (F '' physicalRuled h D v L)
      (h * (∫ p in D, physicalWeight h (v p)) + e)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.lowerTipCylinder_triangle
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.text:
lemma lowerTipCylinder_triangle {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) : (lowerTipCylinder d).triangle :=
  (coneTriangle_triangle (by positivity : 0 < 2*d)).linear_image _
    (perpendicularProjection_injective (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)) 0)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:13.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.swapReflect
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:13.text:
def swapReflect : Space ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space where
  toFun z := vec3 (z 1) (z 0) (-z 2)
  invFun z := vec3 (z 1) (z 0) (-z 2)
  left_inv z := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [vec3]
  right_inv z := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [vec3]
  map_add' z w := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [vec3]; abel
  map_smul' c z := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [vec3]
  norm_map' z := by
    change ‖vec3 (z 1) (z 0) (-z 2)‖ = ‖z‖
    have hz : z = vec3 (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
    have hs : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hz,norm_vec3_sq]
    have ht := norm_vec3_sq (z 1) (z 0) (-z 2)
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z,norm_nonneg (vec3 (z 1) (z 0) (-z 2))]

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Singular:42.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singular_scaled_smoothNear
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Singular:42.text:
lemma singular_scaled_smoothNear (p gamma k : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    SmoothNear 1 (singularDomain p gamma c) (fun z => k • singularField p z) := by
  obtain ⟨U,hU,hDU,hF⟩ := singularDomain_smoothNear p gamma hc
  exact ⟨U,hU,hDU,(hF.of_le (by norm_num : (1:WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞)).const_smul k⟩

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.lowerTipCylinder_area
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.text:
lemma lowerTipCylinder_area {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    (lowerTipCylinder d).area = 4*Real.sqrt 2*d^2 := by
  rw [lowerTipCylinder,projectedCylinder_area (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)),
    coneTriangle_volume (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*d)]
  simp only [physicalWeight,PiLp.zero_apply,zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0),add_zero,
    mul_zero,Real.sqrt_one,div_one,mul_one]
  ring

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularBound.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singularDomain_isCompact
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularBound.text:
lemma singularDomain_isCompact (p gamma c : ℝ) : IsCompact (singularDomain p gamma c) := by
  have hb : Continuous (fun z : Plane => z 0) := by fun_prop
  have hr : Continuous (fun z : Plane => z 1) := by fun_prop
  have hcap : Continuous (fun z : Plane => (1/2:ℝ)+c^2*ceilingPolynomial p (z 0)+c^(5/2:ℝ)) := by
    unfold ceilingPolynomial
    fun_prop
  have hclosed : IsClosed (singularDomain p gamma c) :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const hr).inter ((isClosed_le hr continuous_const).inter
      ((isClosed_le hb.abs hr).inter (isClosed_le hr hcap)))
  apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Plane) 4).of_isClosed_subset hclosed
  intro z hz
  have hz0 : |z 0| ≤ 2 := hz.2.2.1.trans hz.2.1
  have hz1 : |z 1| ≤ 2 := (abs_of_nonneg ((abs_nonneg _).trans hz.2.2.1)).le.trans hz.2.1
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right]
  exact (plane_norm_le_sum z).trans (by linarith)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:109.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.ProductCellStatement
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:109.text:
def ProductCellStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (h M : ℝ) (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane),
    0 < h → 0 < M → IsCompact D → volume (frontier D) = 0 →
    SmoothNear 1 D v → (∀ p ∈ D, HyperbolicAt M v p) →
    ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → HasFiniteCover Cylinder.openBounded (physicalRuled h D v M)
      (h * (∫ p in D, physicalWeight h (v p)) + e)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:168.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singularDomain

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularGeome.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singular_geometric_cover
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularGeome.text:
lemma singular_geometric_cover {p gamma : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hp2 : p < 2)
    (hpg : 0 < 1+gamma*(p-2)) :
    ∀ᶠ c : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      tetrahedron ⊆ singularLower p gamma c ∪ singularUpper p gamma c ∪
        lowerTip (c^gamma) ∪ upperTip (c^gamma) := by
  obtain ⟨C,_,hinv⟩ := singular_inverse_small hp2
  obtain ⟨K,_,hover⟩ := singular_overlap_small (by linarith : 0 ≤ p) hp2.le
  have h0 : Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => c) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hcut : Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => c*C*(c^gamma)^(p-2)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_assoc,mul_left_comm,mul_zero] using (singular_cutoff_small hpg).const_mul C
  have hKlim : Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => c*K) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by simpa using h0.mul_const K
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,h0.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)),
    hcut.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/8)),
    hKlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)),overlap_error_eventually K]
    with c hc hc1 hcut hcK herr
  have hc : 0 < c := hc
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨t,ht0,ht1,hx,hy,hz2⟩ := hz
  by_cases htip : t ≤ 2*c^gamma
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨t,ht0,htip,hy,hz2⟩)
  by_cases htip' : 1-t ≤ 2*c^gamma
  · exact Or.inr ⟨1-t,by linarith,htip',hx,by rw [hz2]; congr 1; ring⟩
  have hx1 : |z 0| ≤ 1 := hx.trans (by linarith)
  have hy1 : |z 1| ≤ 1 := hy.trans ht1
  have hkx : |c*z 0| ≤ c := by simpa only [abs_mul,abs_of_pos hc,mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx1 hc.le
  have hky : |-c*z 1| ≤ c := by simpa only [abs_mul,abs_neg,abs_of_pos hc,mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1 hc.le
  obtain ⟨zm,hm0,hm2,hmb,hem⟩ := hinv (c^gamma) c (z 1) t (c*z 0)
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc gamma) hc.le hcut.le (by linarith) ht1 hy hkx
  obtain ⟨zp,hp0,hp2',hpb,hep⟩ := hinv (c^gamma) c (z 0) (1-t) (-c*z 1)
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc gamma) hc.le hcut.le (by linarith) (by linarith) hx hky
  have hem0 := congrArg (fun w : Plane => w 0) hem
  have hem1 := congrArg (fun w : Plane => w 1) hem
  have hep0 := congrArg (fun w : Plane => w 0) hep
  have hep1 := congrArg (fun w : Plane => w 1) hep
  change z 1 = zm 0+(c*z 0)*singularField p zm 0 at hem0
  change t = zm 1+(c*z 0)*singularField p zm 1 at hem1
  change z 0 = zp 0+(-c*z 1)*singularField p zp 0 at hep0
  change 1-t = zp 1+(-c*z 1)*singularField p zp 1 at hep1
  have hceil := hover c (z 0) (z 1) zm zp hc.le hc1.le hcK.le herr hx1 hy1 hm2 hp2' hmb hpb
    (by linarith only [hem0]) (by linarith only [hep0]) (by nlinarith only [hem1,hep1])
  rcases hceil with hm | hp'
  · apply Or.inl ∘ Or.inl ∘ Or.inl
    refine ⟨zm,⟨hm0,hm2,hmb,hm⟩,z 0,hx1,?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · rfl
    · change z 1 = zm 0+z 0*(c*singularField p zm 0)
      nlinarith only [hem0]
    · change z 2 = Real.sqrt 2*(zm 1+z 0*(c*singularField p zm 1))
      rw [hz2]
      congr 1
      nlinarith only [hem1]
  · apply Or.inl ∘ Or.inl ∘ Or.inr
    refine ⟨zp,⟨hp0,hp2',hpb,hp'⟩,z 1,hy1,?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · change z 0 = zp 0-c*z 1*singularField p zp 0
      nlinarith only [hep0]
    · rfl
    · change z 2 = Real.sqrt 2*(1-(zp 1-c*z 1*singularField p zp 1))
      rw [hz2]
      congr 1
      nlinarith only [hep1]

end RuledApproximation

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Projection:18.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.projectedCylinder_area
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Projection:18.text:
lemma projectedCylinder_area {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (g : Plane) (P : Set Plane) :
    (projectedCylinder h g P).area = h * volume.real P * physicalWeight h g := by
  rw [Cylinder.area, projectedCylinder, perpendicularProjection_volume hh]
  ring

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:98.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.LogarithmicStatement
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Model:98.text:
def LogarithmicStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (X k : ℝ) (D : Set Plane) (v : Plane → Plane),
    0 < X → 0 < k → IsCompact D → volume (frontier D) = 0 →
    OpenRectangleC2 D v →
    (∀ p ∈ D, LinearMap.trace ℝ Plane (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap = 0 ∧
      LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap < 0 ∧
      k * X * Real.sqrt (-LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ v p).toLinearMap) < 1) →
    ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → HasFiniteCover Cylinder.openBounded
      (physicalRuled 1 D (fun p => k • v p) X)
      ((∫ p in D, 1 / Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2 * ‖v p‖ ^ 2)) + e)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.upperTipCylinder_area
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.text:
lemma upperTipCylinder_area {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    (upperTipCylinder d).area = 4*Real.sqrt 2*d^2 := by
  rw [upperTipCylinder,Cylinder.translate_area,Cylinder.rotate_area,lowerTipCylinder_area hd]

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:28.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.physicalMaps_relation
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:28.text:
lemma physicalMaps_relation (h a : ℝ) (z : Space) :
    secondPhysicalMap h a z = vec3 0 0 (h*a) + swapReflect (firstPhysicalMap h z) := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [secondPhysicalMap,firstPhysicalMap,swapReflect,vec3]; ring

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularAsymp.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singular_asymptotic
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularAsymp.text:
lemma singular_asymptotic {p gamma : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hp2 : p ≤ 2) (hg : 1 < gamma) :
    Asymptotics.IsLittleO (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ))
      (fun c => 2*singularCost p gamma c+8*Real.sqrt 2*(c^gamma)^2-
        (Real.sqrt 2/2+2*Real.sqrt 2*singularCoefficient p*c^2))
      (fun c => c^2) := by
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff_tendsto']
  · have ht := (singular_totalCost_quotient_tendsto hp hp2 hg).sub_const (2*Real.sqrt 2*singularCoefficient p)
    simp only [sub_self] at ht
    apply ht.congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with c hc
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
    field_simp
    ring
  · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with c hc
    exact fun h => False.elim ((pow_ne_zero 2 (ne_of_gt hc)) h)

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:57.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.nilpotent
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Nilpotent:57.text:
theorem nilpotent : NilpotentStatement := by
  intro D G hD hG hnil h eps hh heps
  obtain ⟨U,hU,hDU,hG⟩ := hG
  have hG1 : SmoothNear 1 D G := ⟨U,hU,hDU,hG.of_le (by norm_num)⟩
  obtain ⟨n,C,hC,hcov,hcost⟩ := nilpotent_physical_cover hh hD hG1 hnil (mul_pos hh heps)
  choose T g hT hCT using hC
  refine ⟨n,T,g,hT,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    have hz' : firstPhysicalMap h z ∈ physicalRuled h D G 1 := by
      rw [← firstPhysicalMap_ruled]
      exact mem_image_of_mem _ hz
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (hcov hz')
    rw [hCT i,projectedCylinder_carrier] at hi
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hx'⟩ := hi
    have he : x = z := firstPhysicalMap_injective hh.ne' hx'
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, he ▸ hx⟩
  · simp_rw [familyArea,hCT,projectedCylinder_area hh] at hcost
    have he : (∑ i, h * volume.real (T i) * physicalWeight h (g i)) =
        h * ∑ i, volume.real (T i) * physicalWeight h (g i) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    rw [he] at hcost
    nlinarith
  · intro a
    let C₁ : Fin n → Cylinder := fun i => projectedCylinder h (g i) (T i)
    let C₂ : Fin n → Cylinder := fun i =>
      ((C₁ i).rotate swapReflect).translate (vec3 0 0 (h*a))
    refine ⟨C₁,C₂,fun i => ?_⟩
    have hP : (C₁ i).parallelogram := projectedCylinder_parallelogram hh _ (hT i).parallelogram
    refine ⟨hP,Cylinder.translate_parallelogram (Cylinder.rotate_parallelogram hP swapReflect) _,
      projectedCylinder_carrier h _ _,?_,projectedCylinder_area hh _ _,?_⟩
    · dsimp only [C₂]
      rw [Cylinder.translate_carrier,Cylinder.rotate_carrier,projectedCylinder_carrier,
        ← image_comp,← image_comp]
      congr 1
      funext z
      exact (physicalMaps_relation h a z).symm
    · dsimp only [C₂]
      rw [Cylinder.translate_area,Cylinder.rotate_area]
      exact projectedCylinder_area hh _ _

end RuledApproximation

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Projection:22.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.projectedCylinder_carrier
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.Projection:22.text:
lemma projectedCylinder_carrier (h : ℝ) (g : Plane) (P : Set Plane) :
    (projectedCylinder h g P).carrier = firstPhysicalMap h '' auxiliaryCylinder P g := by
  ext x
  rw [projectedCylinder_mem_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, s, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨axial s (p + s • g), ⟨s, p, hp, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [firstPhysicalMap, axial, vec3, planeEmbedding, physicalDirection,
      mul_add, mul_left_comm]
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨s, p, hp, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨p, hp, s, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [firstPhysicalMap, axial, vec3, planeEmbedding, physicalDirection,
      mul_add, mul_left_comm]

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularAsymp.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.singular_totalCost_small
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.SingularAsymp.text:
lemma singular_totalCost_small {p gamma : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hp2 : p ≤ 2) (hg : 1 < gamma)
    (hk : singularCoefficient p < 0) :
    ∀ᶠ c : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      2*singularCost p gamma c+8*Real.sqrt 2*(c^gamma)^2 < Real.sqrt 2/2 := by
  have hk' : 2*Real.sqrt 2*singularCoefficient p < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg
    (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num))) hk
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
    (singular_totalCost_quotient_tendsto hp hp2 hg).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hk')] with c hc hcost
  exact sub_neg.mp (by simpa only [zero_mul] using (div_lt_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hc)).mp hcost)

end RuledApproximation

end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.name: OAI.RuledApproximation.lowerTipCylinder_carrier
OAI.Geometry.RuledCovering.TipCylinders:.text:
lemma lowerTipCylinder_carrier (d : ℝ) : (lowerTipCylinder d).carrier = lowerTip d := by
  ext z
  rw [lowerTipCylinder,projectedCylinder_mem_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b,hb,s,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b 1,hb.1,hb.2.1,by simpa [planeEmbedding,physicalDirection,vec3] using hb.2.2,
      by simp [planeEmbedding,physicalDirection,vec3]⟩
  · rintro ⟨t,ht0,htd,hy,hz⟩
    refine ⟨vec2 (z 1) t,⟨ht0,htd,hy⟩,z 0,?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [planeEmbedding,physicalDirection,vec3,hz]

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.SubfieldBo.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.subfield_natCard_cube_le_of_prime_degree
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.SubfieldBo.text:
theorem subfield_natCard_cube_le_of_prime_degree (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n.Prime)
    (hcard : Fintype.card F = p ^ n) (hn3 : 2 < n)
    (S : Subfield F) (hS : S ≠ ⊤) : Nat.card S ^ 3 ≤ Fintype.card F := by
  rw [subfield_natCard_eq_char_of_prime_degree hp hn hcard S hS, hcard]
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp.pos (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn3)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.exists_prime_goodGadget_above
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.text:
theorem exists_prime_goodGadget_above (B : ℕ) :
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), B < p ∧ 5 < p ∧ p % 3 = 2 ∧
      letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
      ∃ a : GadgetOutcome (ZMod p), GoodGadget a := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := LineCover.uniform_linecover_probability
    3 (1 / 4) (1 / 100) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (1 / 4) (by norm_num)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ q : ℕ in atTop,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(q : ℝ) / 2048) < 1 / 4 :=
    (tendsto_order.mp tendsto_originalDensity_failure_atTop).2 _ (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hsmall
  obtain ⟨p, hpbound, hp, hpmod⟩ :=
    exists_prime_gt_mod_three_eq_two (B + Q + N + 2048)
  have hpB : B < p := by omega
  have hp5 : 5 < p := by omega
  have hpQ : Q ≤ p := by omega
  have hpN : N ≤ p := by omega
  have hp2048 : 2048 ≤ p := by omega
  refine ⟨p, hp, hpB, hp5, hpmod, ?_⟩
  let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hcard : 3 < Fintype.card (ZMod p) := by simpa using (show 3 < p by omega)
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime 3 (Fintype.card (ZMod p) - 1) :=
    coprime_three_zmod_card_sub_one hpmod
  have hsub : Incidence.SmallProperSubfields (ZMod p) := by
    intro M hM
    exact (hM (primeField_subfield_eq_top p M)).elim
  have hline := hQ (ZMod p) (by simpa using hpQ) hsub
    (cubicDeletionProcess hcop hcard)
  change 1 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤
    (FiniteLaw.pi (gadgetTrials (k := ZMod p))).prob
      (LineCover.GoodLineCover (1 / 4) (1 / 100)) at hline
  rw [← gadgetLaw_map_config, FiniteLaw.prob_map] at hline
  have horiginal := prob_originalLineDensity_ge (k := ZMod p)
    (by simpa using hp2048)
  change 1 - (Fintype.card (ZMod p) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.exp (-(Fintype.card (ZMod p) : ℝ) / 2048) ≤
    (gadgetLaw (ZMod p)).prob OriginalLineDensity at horiginal
  have hfailure : (Fintype.card (ZMod p) : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.exp (-(Fintype.card (ZMod p) : ℝ) / 2048) < 1 / 4 := by
    simpa using hN p hpN
  have hex : ∃ a : GadgetOutcome (ZMod p), OriginalLineDensity a ∧
      LineCover.GoodLineCover (1 / 4) (1 / 100) (gadgetConfig a) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have himp : ∀ a : GadgetOutcome (ZMod p), OriginalLineDensity a →
        ¬ LineCover.GoodLineCover (1 / 4) (1 / 100) (gadgetConfig a) := by
      intro a ha hgood
      exact hnot ⟨a, ha, hgood⟩
    have hmono := (gadgetLaw (ZMod p)).prob_mono himp
    rw [FiniteLaw.prob_compl] at hmono
    linarith
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hgood⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨a, goodGadget_of_events hcop hcard ?_ a ha hgood⟩
  simpa using (show 200 < 19 * p by omega)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Mai.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.exists_prime_eventually_counterexampleRank
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Mai.text:
theorem exists_prime_eventually_counterexampleRank :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ 5 < p ∧ p % 3 = 2 ∧
      ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → n.Prime → 2 < n →
        CounterexampleRank (p ^ n + 1) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp5, hpmod, hgadget⟩ := exists_prime_goodGadget
  let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hgadget
  have hs : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (ZMod p) := by
    rw [ZMod.card]
    omega
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩ := exists_distinct_nonzero (k := ZMod p) (by
    rw [ZMod.card]
    omega)
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime 3 (Fintype.card (ZMod p) - 1) :=
    coprime_three_zmod_card_sub_one hpmod
  obtain ⟨K, Q, _hK, hpool⟩ :=
    exists_goodAmbientPool_uniform.{0, 0} u v huv a ha.1 hs
  refine ⟨p, hp, hp5, hpmod, Q, ?_⟩
  intro n hQn hn hn3
  have hsize : Q ≤ Fintype.card (ExtensionField p n) := by
    rw [extensionField_card p n hn.ne_zero]
    have hnpow : n < p ^ n := Nat.lt_pow_self (by omega : 1 < p)
    exact hQn.trans hnpow.le
  have hsub : Incidence.SmallProperSubfields (ExtensionField p n) := by
    intro S hS
    exact extensionField_properSubfield_cube_le p n hn hn3 S hS
  obtain ⟨hgap, pool, hgood⟩ :=
    hpool (ExtensionField p n) (primeEmbedding p n) hsize hsub
  have hr := counterexampleRank_of_goodAmbientPool
    (primeEmbedding p n) u v huv hu hv a ha hcop K pool hgood hgap
  simpa only [extensionField_card p n hn.ne_zero] using hr

    (σ : k →+* F) (u v : k) (huv : u ≠ v) (a : GadgetOutcome k)
    (K : ℕ) (b : AmbientPool σ K) (choice : ConfigurationGroup σ → Fin K) :
    RPartiteUniform (Fintype.card F + 1)
      (hypergraph (ambientSelectedConfiguration σ u v huv a K b choice)) :=

    (a : GadgetOutcome k) (K : ℕ) (b : AmbientPool σ K)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.mem_linePoints
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.text:
@[simp] theorem mem_linePoints (p : Point F) (l : AffineLine F) :
    p ∈ linePoints l ↔ Incidence p l := by simp only [linePoints, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gro.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.selectedShifts_deletionSeparated
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gro.text:
theorem selectedShifts_deletionSeparated
    (σ : k →+* F) (u v : k) (huv : u ≠ v) {K : ℕ}
    (pool : Selection.Pool F (Fintype.card (ConfigurationGroup σ)) K)
    (choice : Fin (Fintype.card (ConfigurationGroup σ)) → Fin K)
    (hchoice : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      ¬ Selection.Conflict (groupSelectionData σ u v huv) i j
        (pool (i, choice i)) (pool (j, choice j)))
    (a : GadgetOutcome k) :
    DeletionSeparated σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv) (selectedShifts σ pool choice) a := by
  classical
  intro i j hij p hp q hq d hd
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ :=
    (mem_placedSubplane_iff σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv i)
      (selectedShifts σ pool choice i) p).mp hp
  obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
  apply selectedShifts_projection_ne σ u v huv pool choice hchoice i j hij x y d
  exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (groupAltered_subset_conflict σ u v huv j hd)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.Extension:.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.ExtensionField
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.Extension:.text:
abbrev ExtensionField (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] := GaloisField p n

noncomputable instance extensionFieldFintype (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Fintype (ExtensionField p n) := Fintype.ofFinite _

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.GadgetOutcome
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.text: abbrev GadgetOutcome (k : Type*) [Zero k] := NonzeroSlope k → k

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.Extension:.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.extensionField_card
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.Extension:.text:
theorem extensionField_card (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Fintype.card (ExtensionField p n) = p ^ n := by
  simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using GaloisField.card p n hn

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.GoodGadget
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.text:
def GoodGadget (a : GadgetOutcome k) : Prop :=
  OriginalLineDensity a ∧
    (∀ ell : AffineLine k,
      Fintype.card k ≤ 8 * (transformedRetained a ∩ linePoints ell).card) ∧
    GadgetCoverProperty (transformedRetained a)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Del.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.DeletionSeparated
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Del.text:
def DeletionSeparated (σ : k →+* F) (M : G → PlaneLinearMap F)
    (b : G → Point F) (a : GadgetOutcome k) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : G, i ≠ j → ∀ p ∈ placedSubplane σ (M i) (b i),
    ∀ y ∈ (retainedPoints a).image (placedPoint σ (M j) (b j)),
      ∀ d ∈ alteredDirections σ (M j), projection d p ≠ projection d y

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.ProjectivePoint
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.text: abbrev ProjectivePoint (F : Type*) := Point F ⊕ Direction F

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.coprime_three_zmod_card_sub_one
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.text:
theorem coprime_three_zmod_card_sub_one {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hpmod : p % 3 = 2) :
    Nat.Coprime 3 (Fintype.card (ZMod p) - 1) := by
  rw [ZMod.card]
  apply Nat.prime_three.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
  intro hd
  have hz := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hd
  omega

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gro.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.exists_distinct_nonzero
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gro.text:
theorem exists_distinct_nonzero (hcard : 2 < Fintype.card k) :
    ∃ u v : k, u ≠ 0 ∧ v ≠ 0 ∧ u ≠ v := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ v : k, v ≠ 0 ∧ v ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hsub : (Finset.univ : Finset k) ⊆ {0, 1} := by
      intro x _
      by_cases hx : x = 0
      · simp [hx]
      · simp [h x hx]
    have hc := (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans Finset.card_le_two
    rw [Finset.card_univ] at hc
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, hv0, hv1⟩ := hex
  exact ⟨1, v, one_ne_zero, hv0, hv1.symm⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Det.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.not_isCover_actual_group_configuration
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Det.text:
theorem not_isCover_actual_group_configuration
    (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime 3 (Fintype.card k - 1)) (ha : GoodGadget a)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hgap : 1 + (δ / 10) * Fintype.card F < δ * Fintype.card F / 2)
    (hsep : DeletionSeparated σ M b a)
    (hthin : ∀ p : Point F, OffPencilThin data p)
    (hline : ∀ ell ∉ allDeletedLines σ M b a,
      δ * Fintype.card F / 2 ≤ ((X ∩ linePoints ell).card : ℝ))
    (hnear : ∀ L : Finset (AffineLine F), L.card ≤ Fintype.card F →
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∃ ell ∈ L, Incidence x ell) →
      ∃ p : ProjectivePoint F,
        (1 - δ / 10) * Fintype.card F ≤ ((L ∩ affinePencil p).card : ℝ))
    (C : Finset (Vertex (k := k) (data).altered))
    (hCcard : C.card ≤ Fintype.card F) : ¬ IsCover (hypergraph data) C := by
  let _ := hδ
  classical
  intro hC
  let B := allDeletedLines σ M b a
  have hY : GadgetCoverProperty ((retainedPoints a).image cubeMap) := ha.2.2
  have hordinary := ordinaryLines_cover_ordinaryPoints data C hC
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hnear (ordinaryLines data C)
    ((ordinaryLines_card_le data C).trans hCcard) hordinary
  have hforced : forcedPencilVertices data B p ⊆ C :=
    forcedPencilVertices_subset_of_near_pencil data C hC hCcard B p δ (δ / 10)
      hgap hline hp
  cases p with
  | inr d =>
      let I : Finset (ConfigurationGroup σ) :=
        Finset.univ.filter (fun i => d ∈ groupAltered σ u v huv i)
      have hIle : I.card ≤ 2 := groupAltered_multiplicity_le_two σ u v huv d
      have hdeleted : (B ∩ affinePencil (Sum.inr d)).card ≤
          I.card * (Fintype.card k - 1) :=
        card_allDeletedLines_inter_affinePencil_infinite_le σ M b a ha.1 d
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_groupAltered σ u v huv hu hv d
      have hiI : i ∈ I := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩
      by_cases hother : ∃ j ∈ I, j ≠ i
      · obtain ⟨j, hjI, hji⟩ := hother
        have hij : i ≠ j := hji.symm
        have hj : d ∈ groupAltered σ u v huv j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hjI).2
        have hItwo : I.card = 2 := by
          have hgt : 1 < I.card := Finset.one_lt_card.mpr ⟨i, hiI, j, hjI, hij⟩
          omega
        rw [hItwo] at hdeleted
        exact double_infinite_center_impossible σ M b (retainedPoints a) X hcop hY
          C hC hCcard B d i j hij hi hj
          (shared_groupAltered_axes_subset σ u v huv hu hv hij hi hj)
          (shared_groupAltered_axes_subset σ u v huv hu hv hji hj hi)
          hforced hdeleted
      · have hIone : I.card = 1 := by
          have hsub : I ⊆ {i} := by
            intro j hj
            have hji : j = i := by
              by_contra hji
              exact hother ⟨j, hj, hji⟩
            exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hji
          have hle : I.card ≤ 1 := by
            simpa only [Finset.card_singleton] using (Finset.card_le_card hsub)
          have hpos : 0 < I.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨i, hiI⟩
          omega
        rw [hIone, one_mul] at hdeleted
        exact single_infinite_center_impossible σ M b (retainedPoints a) X hcop hY
          C hC hCcard B d i hi hforced hdeleted
  | inl p =>
      by_cases hinside : ∃ i : ConfigurationGroup σ,
          p ∈ placedSubplane σ (M i) (b i)
      · obtain ⟨i, hpi⟩ := hinside
        have hdeleted := card_deletedPencil_le_of_mem_placedSubplane
          σ M b a hsep i p hpi
        have hpencil : deletedPencil σ M b a p = B ∩ affinePencil (Sum.inl p) := by
          ext ell
          simp only [mem_deletedPencil, Finset.mem_inter, mem_affinePencil,
            projectiveIncidence_finite_affine, B]
        rw [hpencil] at hdeleted
        obtain ⟨wp, rfl⟩ := (mem_placedSubplane_iff σ (M i) (b i) p).1 hpi
        exact finite_inside_center_impossible σ M b (retainedPoints a) X hcop hY
          i wp C hC hCcard B hforced hdeleted
      · have hout : ∀ i : ConfigurationGroup σ,
            p ∉ placedSubplane σ (M i) (b i) := by
          intro i hi
          exact hinside ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact not_isCover_of_finite_outside_placedSubplanes σ M b a ha.1 hsep data
          (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) rfl p hout (hthin p) C hforced hCcard hC

end RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gro.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.selectedShifts
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gro.text:
def selectedShifts (σ : k →+* F) {K : ℕ}
    (pool : Selection.Pool F (Fintype.card (ConfigurationGroup σ)) K)
    (choice : Fin (Fintype.card (ConfigurationGroup σ)) → Fin K)
    (i : ConfigurationGroup σ) : Point F :=
  pool ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)) i,
    choice ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)) i))

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.retainedPoints
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.text:
def retainedPoints (a : GadgetOutcome k) : Finset (Point k) :=
  Finset.univ \ Finset.univ.biUnion (fun d => linePoints (omittedLine a d))

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Poo.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.offPencilThin_of_groupPoolThin
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Poo.text:
theorem offPencilThin_of_groupPoolThin
    (σ : k →+* F) (u v : k) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (pool : ConfigurationGroup σ → Fin K → Point F)
    (choice : ConfigurationGroup σ → Fin K)
    (Y : Finset (Point k)) (X : Finset (Point F))
    (hthin : PoolThin (groupPoints σ u v huv) (groupAltered σ u v huv) pool)
    (p : Point F) :
    OffPencilThin
      (placedConfiguration σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv)
        (fun i => pool i (choice i)) Y X) p := by
  classical
  let data := placedConfiguration σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv)
    (fun i => pool i (choice i)) Y X
  intro ell hp
  apply (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans (hthin p ell hp)
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hinc, hdir⟩ := (mem_offPencilGroups data p ell i).mp hi
  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, choice i, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨(groupPlacement σ u v huv i).apply (mapPoint σ w), ?_,
    joinDirection p (data.base i w), hdir, hinc, ?_⟩
  · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨w, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  · exact incidence_joinLine_right p (data.base i w)

end RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.ExtensionS.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.extensionField_properSubfield_cube_le
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.ExtensionS.text:
theorem extensionField_properSubfield_cube_le (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hn : n.Prime) (hn3 : 2 < n) (S : Subfield (ExtensionField p n)) (hS : S ≠ ⊤) :
    Nat.card S ^ 3 ≤ Fintype.card (ExtensionField p n) :=
  subfield_natCard_cube_le_of_prime_degree (Fact.out : p.Prime) hn
    (extensionField_card p n hn.ne_zero) hn3 S hS

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.exists_prime_goodGadget
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Gad.text:
theorem exists_prime_goodGadget :
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), 5 < p ∧ p % 3 = 2 ∧
      letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
      ∃ a : GadgetOutcome (ZMod p), GoodGadget a := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _, hp5, hpmod, ha⟩ := exists_prime_goodGadget_above 0
  exact ⟨p, hp, hp5, hpmod, ha⟩

end RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Amb.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.ambientPool_goodLineCover_selected
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Amb.text:
theorem ambientPool_goodLineCover_selected (σ : k →+* F) (u v : k) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (a : GadgetOutcome k) (ha : OriginalLineDensity a) (K : ℕ) (b : AmbientPool σ K)
    (choice : ConfigurationGroup σ → Fin K) (δ ρ : ℝ)
    (hgood : LineCover.GoodLineCover δ ρ (ambientPoolConfig σ u v huv a ha K b)) :
    (∀ ell, ell ∉ ambientSelectedLines σ u v huv a K b choice →
      δ * Fintype.card F / 2 ≤
        ((ambientSelectedSurvivors σ u v huv a K b choice ∩ linePoints ell).card : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ L : Finset (AffineLine F), L.card ≤ Fintype.card F →
      ambientSelectedSurvivors σ u v huv a K b choice ⊆ L.biUnion linePoints →
      ∃ p : ProjectivePoint F,
        (1 - ρ) * Fintype.card F ≤ ((LineCover.coverPencil L p).card : ℝ)) := by
  constructor
  · intro ell hell
    apply (hgood.1 ell).trans
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (Finset.inter_subset_inter
      (ambientPool_ignored_survivors_subset_selected σ u v huv a ha K b choice ell hell)
      (Finset.Subset.refl _))
  · intro L hL hcover
    apply hgood.2 L hL
    have hsub := (ambientPool_survivors_subset_selected σ u v huv a ha K b choice).trans hcover
    rw [Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset.mpr hsub, Finset.card_empty]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

end RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.mem_affinePencil
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.text:
@[simp] theorem mem_affinePencil (p : ProjectivePoint F) (l : AffineLine F) :
    l ∈ affinePencil p ↔ ProjectiveIncidence p (some l) := by
  simp only [affinePencil, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Infin.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.counterexampleRank_of_no_small_cover
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Infin.text:
theorem counterexampleRank_of_no_small_cover {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {r : ℕ} {H : Hypergraph V} (hr : 0 < r) (hne : H.Nonempty)
    (hpart : RPartiteUniform r H) (hI : Intersecting H)
    (hsmall : ∀ C : Finset V, C.card ≤ r - 1 → ¬ IsCover H C) :
    CounterexampleRank r := by
  refine ⟨V, inferInstance, inferInstance, H, hr, hne, hpart, hI, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hpart.nonemptyEdges hr).exists_cover
  · exact matchingNumber_eq_one_of_nonempty_intersecting hne hI
  · exact coverNumber_eq_rank_of_no_small_cover hr hpart.uniform hne hI hsmall

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.AffineLine
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.text: abbrev AffineLine (F : Type*) := Direction F × F

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Sel.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.ambientSelectedConfiguration
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Sel.text:
def ambientSelectedConfiguration
    (σ : k →+* F) (u v : k) (huv : u ≠ v) (a : GadgetOutcome k)
    (K : ℕ) (b : AmbientPool σ K) (choice : ConfigurationGroup σ → Fin K) :
    ConfigurationData k F (ConfigurationGroup σ) :=
  placedConfiguration σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv) (fun i => b i (choice i))
    (retainedPoints a) (ambientSelectedSurvivors σ u v huv a K b choice)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Defin.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.matchingNumber
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Defin.text: def matchingNumber (H : Hypergraph V) : ℕ := (matchings H).sup Finset.card

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Hyp.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.hypergraph
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Hyp.text:
def hypergraph (data : ConfigurationData k F G) :
    Hypergraph (Vertex (k := k) data.altered) := by
  classical
  exact data.ordinaryPoints.image (ordinaryEdge data) ∪
    Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i => data.retained.image (exceptionalEdge data i))

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Amb.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.GoodAmbientPool
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Amb.text:
def GoodAmbientPool {F : Type uf} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    (σ : k →+* F) (u v : k) (huv : u ≠ v)
    (a : GadgetOutcome k) (ha : OriginalLineDensity a) (K : ℕ)
    (pool : AmbientPool σ K) : Prop :=
  Selection.HasCompatibleChoice (groupSelectionData σ u v huv)
      (ambientFlatPoolEquiv σ K pool) ∧
    LineCover.GoodLineCover (ambientDeletionDelta (Fintype.card k) K)
      (ambientDeletionDelta (Fintype.card k) K / 10)
      (ambientPoolConfig σ u v huv a ha K pool) ∧
    PoolThin (groupPoints σ u v huv) (groupAltered σ u v huv) pool

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Defin.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.coverNumber
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Defin.text: def coverNumber (H : Hypergraph V) : ℕ := sInf (coverCardinalities H)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Defin.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Intersecting
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Defin.text:
def Intersecting (H : Hypergraph V) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ H, ∀ f ∈ H, e ≠ f → (e ∩ f).Nonempty

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Sel.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.ambientSelectedHypergraph_intersecting
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Sel.text:
theorem ambientSelectedHypergraph_intersecting
    (σ : k →+* F) (u v : k) (huv : u ≠ v) (a : GadgetOutcome k)
    (K : ℕ) (b : AmbientPool σ K) (choice : ConfigurationGroup σ → Fin K)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime 3 (Fintype.card k - 1))
    (hsep : DeletionSeparated σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv)
      (fun i => b i (choice i)) a) :
    Intersecting (hypergraph (ambientSelectedConfiguration σ u v huv a K b choice)) := by
  apply placedHypergraph_intersecting σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv)
    (fun i => b i (choice i)) (retainedPoints a)
    (ambientSelectedSurvivors σ u v huv a K b choice) hcop
  · intro x hx i w hw d hd
    exact ambientSelectedSurvivors_projection_ne σ u v huv a K b choice x hx i w hw d hd
  · intro i j hij w hw z _ d hd
    exact DeletionSeparated.retained_projection_ne σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv)
      (fun i => b i (choice i)) a hsep i j hij w hw z d hd

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Incidence.Unifor.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Incidence.SmallProperSubfields
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Incidence.Unifor.text:
def SmallProperSubfields (F : Type*) [Field F] [Fintype F] : Prop :=
  ∀ M : Subfield F, M ≠ ⊤ → Nat.card M ^ 3 ≤ Fintype.card F

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Infin.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.CounterexampleRank
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Hypergraph.Infin.text:
def CounterexampleRank (r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (V : Type) (fin : Fintype V) (dec : DecidableEq V),
    letI : Fintype V := fin
    letI : DecidableEq V := dec
    ∃ H : Hypergraph V,
      0 < r ∧ H.Nonempty ∧ RPartiteUniform r H ∧ Intersecting H ∧
        (∃ C : Finset V, IsCover H C) ∧ matchingNumber H = 1 ∧ coverNumber H = r

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.affinePencil
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:1.text:
def affinePencil (p : ProjectivePoint F) : Finset (AffineLine F) :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun l => ProjectiveIncidence p (some l)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Fin.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.OffPencilThin

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:2.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Incidence
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Geometry.Basic:2.text:
def Incidence (p : Point F) (l : AffineLine F) : Prop :=
  projection l.1 p = l.2

instance [DecidableEq F] (p : Point F) (l : AffineLine F) :
    Decidable (Incidence p l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (projection l.1 p = l.2))

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.Extension:.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.primeEmbedding
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Field.Extension:.text:
noncomputable def primeEmbedding (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ZMod p →+* ExtensionField p n := algebraMap _ _

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Amb.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.ambientFlatPoolEquiv
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Amb.text:
def ambientFlatPoolEquiv (σ : k →+* F) (K : ℕ) :
    AmbientPool σ K ≃ Selection.Pool F (Fintype.card (ConfigurationGroup σ)) K where
  toFun b p := b ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)).symm p.1) p.2
  invFun b i j := b ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)) i, j)
  left_inv b := by
    funext i j
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  right_inv b := by
    funext p
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Prod.mk.eta]

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Act.name: OAI.RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction.counterexampleRank_of_goodAmbientPool
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.Construction.Act.text:
theorem counterexampleRank_of_goodAmbientPool
    (σ : k →+* F) (u v : k) (huv : u ≠ v) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (a : GadgetOutcome k) (ha : GoodGadget a)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime 3 (Fintype.card k - 1))
    (K : ℕ) (pool : AmbientPool σ K)
    (hpool : GoodAmbientPool σ u v huv a ha.1 K pool)
    (hgap : 1 + ambientDeletionDelta (Fintype.card k) K / 10 * Fintype.card F <
      ambientDeletionDelta (Fintype.card k) K * Fintype.card F / 2) :
    CounterexampleRank (Fintype.card F + 1) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨choiceFin, hchoice⟩, hrigid, hthin⟩ := hpool
  let choice : ConfigurationGroup σ → Fin K := fun i =>
    choiceFin ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)) i)
  let b : ConfigurationGroup σ → Point F := fun i => pool i (choice i)
  let X := ambientSelectedSurvivors σ u v huv a K pool choice
  let data := ambientSelectedConfiguration σ u v huv a K pool choice
  let δ := ambientDeletionDelta (Fintype.card k) K
  have hshift : selectedShifts σ (ambientFlatPoolEquiv σ K pool) choiceFin = b := by
    funext i
    change pool ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)).symm
      ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)) i))
        (choiceFin ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)) i)) =
      pool i (choiceFin ((Fintype.equivFin (ConfigurationGroup σ)) i))
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hsep : DeletionSeparated σ (groupPlacement σ u v huv) b a := by
    have h := selectedShifts_deletionSeparated σ u v huv
      (ambientFlatPoolEquiv σ K pool) choiceFin hchoice a
    rw [hshift] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨hline, hnear⟩ := ambientPool_goodLineCover_selected
    σ u v huv a ha.1 K pool choice δ (δ / 10) hrigid
  have hnear' : ∀ L : Finset (AffineLine F), L.card ≤ Fintype.card F →
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∃ ell ∈ L, Incidence x ell) →
      ∃ p : ProjectivePoint F,
        (1 - δ / 10) * Fintype.card F ≤ ((L ∩ affinePencil p).card : ℝ) := by
    intro L hL hcover
    have hsub : X ⊆ L.biUnion linePoints := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨ell, hell, hxell⟩ := hcover x hx
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨ell, hell, (mem_linePoints x ell).mpr hxell⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hnear L hL hsub
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    have heq : LineCover.coverPencil L p = L ∩ affinePencil p := by
      ext ell
      simp only [LineCover.mem_coverPencil, Finset.mem_inter, mem_affinePencil]
    rw [heq] at hp
    exact hp
  have hthin' : ∀ p : Point F, OffPencilThin data p := fun p =>
    offPencilThin_of_groupPoolThin σ u v huv pool choice (retainedPoints a) X hthin p
  have hne : (hypergraph data).Nonempty :=
    ambientSelectedHypergraph_nonempty σ u v huv a K pool choice ha
  have hI : Intersecting (hypergraph data) :=
    ambientSelectedHypergraph_intersecting σ u v huv a K pool choice hcop hsep
  have hpart : RPartiteUniform (Fintype.card F + 1) (hypergraph data) :=
    ambientSelectedHypergraph_rPartiteUniform σ u v huv a K pool choice
  apply counterexampleRank_of_no_small_cover (Nat.zero_lt_succ _) hne hpart hI
  intro C hCcard
  have hCq : C.card ≤ Fintype.card F := by omega
  have hnot := not_isCover_actual_group_configuration σ u v huv a b X hu hv hcop ha
    δ (ambientDeletionDelta_pos _ _) hgap hsep hthin' hline hnear' C hCq
  have hdec : instDecidableEqConfigurationGroup σ =
      (inferInstance : DecidableEq (ConfigurationGroup σ)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hdec] at hnot
  exact hnot

end RyserCoveringCounterexample.Construction

end

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:36.name: OAI.RyserOdd.Specification.ExplicitFailureAt
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:36.text:
def ExplicitFailureAt (r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (V : Type) (fin : Fintype V) (dec : DecidableEq V),
    letI : Fintype V := fin
    letI : DecidableEq V := dec
    ∃ H : Hypergraph V,
      0 < r ∧ H.Nonempty ∧ RPartiteUniform r H ∧ Uniform r H ∧
        Intersecting H ∧ (∃ C : Finset V, IsCover H C) ∧
        matchingNumber H = 1 ∧ coverNumber H = r ∧
        (r - 1) * matchingNumber H < coverNumber H

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:68.name: OAI.RyserOdd.eventualOddRanks
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:68.text:
theorem eventualOddRanks : Specification.EventualOddRanks := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_threshold_goodGadget
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  intro p hpP hp hpmod
  obtain ⟨hp5, hgadget⟩ := hP p hpP hp hpmod
  let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hgadget
  have hs : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (ZMod p) := by
    rw [ZMod.card]
    omega
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, huv⟩ := exists_distinct_nonzero (k := ZMod p) (by
    rw [ZMod.card]
    omega)
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime 3 (Fintype.card (ZMod p) - 1) :=
    coprime_three_zmod_card_sub_one hpmod
  obtain ⟨K, Q, _hK, hpool⟩ :=
    exists_goodAmbientPool_uniform.{0, 0} u v huv a ha.1 hs
  refine ⟨max 3 Q, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro n hn hnOdd
  have hn3 : 2 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 2 < 3)
    ((le_max_left 3 Q).trans hn)
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hQn : Q ≤ n := (le_max_right 3 Q).trans hn
  have hsize : Q ≤ Fintype.card (ExtensionField p n) := by
    rw [extensionField_card p n hn0]
    have hnpow : n < p ^ n := Nat.lt_pow_self hp.one_lt
    exact hQn.trans hnpow.le
  have hsub : Incidence.SmallProperSubfields (ExtensionField p n) := by
    intro S hS
    exact extensionField_properSubfield_cube_le_of_odd p n hnOdd hn3 S hS
  obtain ⟨hgap, pool, hgood⟩ :=
    hpool (ExtensionField p n) (primeEmbedding p n) hsize hsub
  have hr := counterexampleRank_of_goodAmbientPool
    (primeEmbedding p n) u v huv hu hv a ha hcop K pool hgood hgap
  simpa only [extensionField_card p n hn0] using hr

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:48.name: OAI.RyserOdd.Specification.explicitFailureAt_of_counterexampleRank
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:48.text:
theorem explicitFailureAt_of_counterexampleRank {r : ℕ}
    (hr : CounterexampleRank r) : ExplicitFailureAt r := by
  rcases hr with ⟨V, fin, dec, H, hpos, hne, hpart, hI, hcover, hmatch, hcard⟩
  let : Fintype V := fin
  let : DecidableEq V := dec
  refine ⟨V, fin, dec, H, hpos, hne, hpart, hpart.uniform, hI,
    hcover, hmatch, hcard, ?_⟩
  rw [hmatch, hcard, Nat.mul_one]
  exact Nat.sub_lt hpos (by decide)

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:13.name: OAI.RyserOdd.eventualOddFailures_and_infinite
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:13.text:
theorem eventualOddFailures_and_infinite :
    (∃ primeThreshold : ℕ, ∀ prime : ℕ, primeThreshold ≤ prime →
      prime.Prime → prime % 3 = 2 →
      ∃ degreeThreshold : ℕ, 3 ≤ degreeThreshold ∧
        ∀ degree : ℕ, degreeThreshold ≤ degree → Odd degree →
          Specification.ExplicitFailureAt (prime ^ degree + 1)) ∧
    Set.Infinite {rank : ℕ | Specification.ExplicitFailureAt rank} := by
  refine ⟨eventualExplicitFailures, ?_⟩
  exact infiniteRanks.mono fun _rank => Specification.explicitFailureAt_of_counterexampleRank

end RyserOdd

namespace RyserOddReference

OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:11.name: OAI.RyserOdd.eventualExplicitFailures
OAI.Combinatorics.Ryser.OddExtensions:11.text:
theorem eventualExplicitFailures :
    ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ p : ℕ, P ≤ p → p.Prime → p % 3 = 2 →
      ∃ N : ℕ, 3 ≤ N ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Odd n →
        Specification.ExplicitFailureAt (p ^ n + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := eventualOddRanks
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  intro p hpP hp hpmod
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hall⟩ := hP p hpP hp hpmod
  exact ⟨N, hN, fun n hn hnOdd =>
    Specification.explicitFailureAt_of_counterexampleRank (hall n hn hnOdd)⟩

OAI.Probability.SATComputability.Main:25.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.Computability.threshold_program
OAI.Probability.SATComputability.Main:25.text:
theorem threshold_program :
    ∃ (q : ℕ → ℚ) (c : Nat.Partrec.Code),
      Computable q ∧
      (∀ r, c.eval r = Part.some (Encodable.encode (q r))) ∧
      (∀ r, |(q r : ℝ)-limitingCenter 3| ≤ (2^r : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
  threshold_program_of_trial_separation satTrialSeparation

OAI.Probability.SATComputability.Main:32.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.Computability.MainStatement
OAI.Probability.SATComputability.Main:32.text:
def MainStatement : Prop :=
    ∃ (α : ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℚ) (c : Nat.Partrec.Code),
      0 < α ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a < α →
        Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => properSATProbability n 3 ⌊a*(n : ℝ)⌋₊) atTop (nhds 1)) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ, α < a →
        Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => properSATProbability n 3 ⌊a*(n : ℝ)⌋₊) atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
      Computable (fun r => Encodable.encode (q r)) ∧
      (∀ r, c.eval r = Part.some (Encodable.encode (q r))) ∧
      (∀ r, |(q r : ℝ)-α| ≤ (2^r : ℝ)⁻¹)

OAI.Probability.SATComputability.Main:43.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.Computability.main
OAI.Probability.SATComputability.Main:43.text:
theorem main : MainStatement := by
  obtain ⟨q,c,hq,hc,he⟩ := threshold_program
  exact ⟨limitingCenter 3,q,c,limitingCenter_pos 3 (by decide),
    subcritical_limit 3 (by decide),supercritical_limit 3 (by decide),
    Computable.encode_iff.mpr hq,hc,he⟩

end FixedClauseThreshold.Computability

end OAI

OAI.Probability.SATComputability.Main:13.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.Computability.satTrialSeparation
OAI.Probability.SATComputability.Main:13.text:
theorem satTrialSeparation : TrialSeparation satTrialEvaluation (limitingCenter 3) := by
  constructor
  · exact fun _ hj hn => satTrialEvaluation_sound hj hn
  · intro a ha
    have haR : (0 : ℝ) < a := (limitingCenter_pos 3 (by decide)).trans ha
    have haQ : 0 < a := by exact_mod_cast haR
    let aNN : ℝ≥0 := ⟨a,haR.le⟩
    have haNN : 0 < aNN := haR
    obtain ⟨ε,hε,hV⟩ := relaxedPoissonMinimum_supercritical (a := aNN) ha
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hnegative⟩ := negative_pressure_of_violation_density haNN hε hV
    exact satTrialEvaluation_negative_witness a haQ b hb hnegative

OAI.Probability.SATComputability.LowerPr.name: OAI.FixedClauseThreshold.Computability.threshold_program_of_trial_separation
OAI.Probability.SATComputability.LowerPr.text:
theorem threshold_program_of_trial_separation {T : TrialEvaluation}
    (hT : TrialSeparation T (limitingCenter 3)) :
    ∃ (q : ℕ → ℚ) (c : Nat.Partrec.Code),
      Computable q ∧
      (∀ r, c.eval r = Part.some (Encodable.encode (q r))) ∧
      (∀ r, |(q r : ℝ) - limitingCenter 3| ≤ (2 ^ r : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
  obtain ⟨lower, hl, hs, hd⟩ := exists_lowerProgram
  obtain ⟨q, hq, he⟩ := computable_of_trial_separation hT hl hs hd
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := rational_sequence_code hq
  exact ⟨q, c, hq, hc, he⟩

end FixedClauseThreshold.Computability

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.lifetime_parameters
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.text:
lemma lifetime_parameters {k N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    N^(2*k) ≤ N^(2*k+1) ∧ k ≤ N^(2*k) ∧ 0 < N^(2*k+1) := by
  refine ⟨Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega), ?_, by positivity⟩
  exact (Nat.le_of_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self).trans
    ((Nat.pow_le_pow_left hN k).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)))

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.ReplacementS.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.sharp_parameters
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.ReplacementS.text:
lemma sharp_parameters {k g : ℕ} (hg : 2 ≤ g) :
    g^(k+1) ≤ g^(k+2) ∧ k ≤ g^(k+1) ∧ 0 < g^(k+2) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, by positivity⟩
  · exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  · exact (Nat.le_of_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self).trans
      ((Nat.pow_le_pow_left hg k).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)))

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.lifetime_subcube_eventually
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.text:
lemma lifetime_subcube_eventually (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, (N : ℝ)^k / 2 ≤
      lifetime (N^(2*k+1)) k (subcube (N^(2*k+1)) (N^(2*k))) := by
  have hh := (killRatio_limit (by omega : 0 < 2*k) k).add
    (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat ((k : ℝ)^2))
  simp only [add_zero] at hh
  have hC : ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ < (1/2 : ℝ) := by
    have h8 : (8 : ℝ) ≤ 2^k := by
      have hh8 := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ)) hk
      norm_num at hh8 ⊢
      exact hh8
    rw [← one_div]
    apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)).mpr
    nlinarith
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2, hh.eventually_lt_const hC] with N hN hsmall
  obtain ⟨hbu, hkb, hu⟩ := lifetime_parameters (k := k) hN
  have hbound := subcube_block_upper hu hbu (hkb.trans hbu) (N^k)
  have he : (N^k : ℕ) * killRatio (N^(2*k+1)) (N^(2*k)) k +
      ((N^k : ℕ) : ℝ)^2 * (k : ℝ)^2 / (N^(2*k+1) : ℕ) =
      (N : ℝ)^k * killRatio (N^(2*k+1)) (N^(2*k)) k + (k : ℝ)^2/N := by
    have hN0 : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    push_cast
    rw [pow_succ, pow_mul]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he] at hbound
  have hhalf : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - blockKill (N^(2*k+1)) k (subcube (N^(2*k+1)) (N^(2*k))) (N^k) := by
    linarith
  have ht := lifetime_ge_survival (hkb.trans hbu) (subcube (N^(2*k+1)) (N^(2*k))) (N^k)
  push_cast at ht
  calc
    _ = (N : ℝ)^k * (1/2) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) k)).trans ht

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.Sharpness:7.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.sharpness
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.Sharpness:7.text:
theorem sharpness (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (∀ γ D A : ℝ, γ < (k : ℝ) / ((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) → 0 < D → 0 < A →
      ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ u : ℕ, N ≤ u ∧ k ≤ u ∧ ∃ S : Finset (Assignment u),
        S.Nonempty ∧ A * (u : ℝ) ^ (-((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ blockKill u (k-1) S 1 ∧
        D * (blockKill u (k-1) S 1) ^ (-γ) < lifetime u k S) ∧
    (∃ u : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ S : ∀ g, Finset (Assignment (u g)),
      (∀ g, 2 ≤ g → k ≤ u g ∧ (S g).Nonempty) ∧
      Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop
        (fun g => blockKill (u g) (k-1) (S g) 1 - blockKill (u g) k (S g) g)
        (fun g => ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ * (g : ℝ)^(-((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))) ∧
    (¬ ∃ e : ℕ → ℝ,
      Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop e (fun g => (g : ℝ)^(-((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ u, k ≤ u → ∀ S : Finset (Assignment u), S.Nonempty → ∀ g, 2 ≤ g →
        blockKill u (k-1) S 1 - e g ≤ blockKill u k S g) := by
  exact ⟨lifetime_sharp k hk, replacement_sharp k hk, no_uniform_littleO_error k hk⟩

end RandomKSAT

end OAI

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.lifetime_sharp
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.text:
theorem lifetime_sharp (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (γ D A : ℝ)
    (hγ : γ < (k : ℝ) / ((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) (_hD : 0 < D) (_hA : 0 < A) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ u : ℕ, N ≤ u ∧ k ≤ u ∧ ∃ S : Finset (Assignment u),
      S.Nonempty ∧ A * (u : ℝ) ^ (-((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ blockKill u (k-1) S 1 ∧
      D * (blockKill u (k-1) S 1) ^ (-γ) < lifetime u k S := by
  intro M
  have ha := (killing_above_scale (by omega : 0 < 2*k) (by omega : 0 < k-1)).eventually_gt_atTop A
  have hd := (lifetime_ratio_growth k hk γ hγ).eventually_gt_atTop D
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hMN, ha, hd, ht⟩ :=
    ((eventually_ge_atTop 2).and ((eventually_ge_atTop M).and
      (ha.and (hd.and (lifetime_subcube_eventually k hk))))).exists
  obtain ⟨hbu, hkb, hu⟩ := lifetime_parameters (k := k) hN
  have hku := hkb.trans hbu
  have hru : k-1 ≤ N^(2*k+1) := by omega
  refine ⟨N^(2*k+1), hMN.trans (Nat.le_pow (by omega)), hku,
    subcube (N^(2*k+1)) (N^(2*k)), subcube_nonempty _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [subcube_one hbu hru, Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), Real.rpow_natCast, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr ha.le
  · rw [subcube_one hbu hru]
    have hq : 0 < killRatio (N^(2*k+1)) (N^(2*k)) (k-1) := killRatio_pos (by omega) hru
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hq.le, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact ((div_lt_iff₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq γ)).mpr hd).trans_le ht

end RandomKSAT

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.ReplacementS.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.replacement_sharp
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.ReplacementS.text:
theorem replacement_sharp (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ S : ∀ g, Finset (Assignment (u g)),
      (∀ g, 2 ≤ g → k ≤ u g ∧ (S g).Nonempty) ∧
      Asymptotics.IsEquivalent Filter.atTop
        (fun g => blockKill (u g) (k-1) (S g) 1 - blockKill (u g) k (S g) g)
        (fun g => ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ * (g : ℝ)^(-((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
  refine ⟨fun g => g^(k+2), fun g => subcube (g^(k+2)) (g^(k+1)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g hg
    obtain ⟨hbu, hkb, hu⟩ := sharp_parameters (k := k) hg
    exact ⟨hkb.trans hbu, subcube_nonempty _ _⟩
  · have hc : ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by positivity
    apply (Asymptotics.isEquivalent_iff_tendsto_one (by
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2] with g hg
      exact mul_ne_zero hc (ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _)))).mpr
    have hh := (replacement_gap_scaled_limit k hk).div_const (((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹)
    rw [div_self hc] at hh
    apply hh.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2] with g hg
    simp only [Pi.div_apply]
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), Real.rpow_natCast]
    field_simp

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.lifetime_ratio_growth
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.text:
lemma lifetime_ratio_growth (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (γ : ℝ)
    (hγ : γ < (k : ℝ)/((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ)^k / 2 * (killRatio (N^(2*k+1)) (N^(2*k)) (k-1))^γ)
      atTop atTop := by
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) < ((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < k-1)
  have hδ : 0 < (k : ℝ) - ((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*γ := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ hr).mp hγ
    nlinarith
  have hh := (killRatio_limit (by omega : 0 < 2*k) (k-1)).rpow_const (p := γ) (Or.inl (by positivity))
  have hp := ((tendsto_rpow_atTop hδ).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).atTop_mul_pos
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) γ) hh
  have hp' := Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1/2) hp
  apply hp'.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2] with N hN
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [rpow_rescaling (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < N) (killRatio_nonneg _ _ _) k (k-1) γ]
  ring

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.Subcube:19.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.subcube_nonempty
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.Subcube:19.text:
lemma subcube_nonempty (u b : ℕ) : (subcube u b).Nonempty := by
  exact ⟨fun _ => false, mem_subcube.mpr (by simp)⟩

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.ReplacementS.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.no_uniform_littleO_error
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.ReplacementS.text:
theorem no_uniform_littleO_error (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ¬ ∃ e : ℕ → ℝ,
      Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop e (fun g => (g : ℝ)^(-((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ u, k ≤ u → ∀ S : Finset (Assignment u), S.Nonempty → ∀ g, 2 ≤ g →
        blockKill u (k-1) S 1 - e g ≤ blockKill u k S g := by
  rintro ⟨e, he, hbound⟩
  have hc : 0 < ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hp := (replacement_gap_scaled_limit k hk).eventually_const_lt (show
    ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ / 2 < ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ by linarith)
  have hsmall := he.tendsto_div_nhds_zero.eventually_lt_const (show
    (0 : ℝ) < ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ / 2 by positivity)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hp, he'⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop 2).and (hp.and hsmall)).exists
  obtain ⟨hbu, hkb, hu⟩ := sharp_parameters (k := k) hg
  have hb := hbound (g^(k+2)) (hkb.trans hbu)
    (subcube (g^(k+2)) (g^(k+1))) (subcube_nonempty _ _) g hg
  have hb' : blockKill (g^(k+2)) (k-1) (subcube (g^(k+2)) (g^(k+1))) 1 -
      blockKill (g^(k+2)) k (subcube (g^(k+2)) (g^(k+1))) g ≤ e g := by linarith
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb' (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) g) (k-1))
  rw [Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), Real.rpow_natCast, div_inv_eq_mul] at he'
  nlinarith

end RandomKSAT

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.Subcube:84.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.subcube_one
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.Subcube:84.text:
lemma subcube_one {u b s : ℕ} (hbu : b ≤ u) (hsu : s ≤ u) :
    blockKill u s (subcube u b) 1 = killRatio u b s := by
  rw [blockKill_one hsu (subcube_nonempty u b), frozen_subcube_card hbu]

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.killing_above_scale
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LifetimeShar.text:
lemma killing_above_scale {m r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => killRatio (N^(m+1)) (N^m) r * ((N^(m+1) : ℕ) : ℝ)^r)
      atTop atTop := by
  have hh := (tendsto_nat_pow_real (m*r) (by positivity)).atTop_mul_pos
    (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 : ℝ)^r)⁻¹) (killRatio_limit hm r)
  apply hh.congr'
  filter_upwards [] with N
  push_cast
  calc
    _ = (N : ℝ)^(m*r+r) * killRatio (N^(m+1)) (N^m) r := by rw [pow_add]; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [show m*r+r = (m+1)*r by ring, pow_mul]; ring

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.ReplacementS.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.replacement_gap_scaled_limit
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.ReplacementS.text:
lemma replacement_gap_scaled_limit (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    Tendsto (fun g : ℕ => (g : ℝ)^(k-1) *
      (blockKill (g^(k+2)) (k-1) (subcube (g^(k+2)) (g^(k+1))) 1 -
       blockKill (g^(k+2)) k (subcube (g^(k+2)) (g^(k+1))) g))
      atTop (𝓝 (((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹)) := by
  have hq := killRatio_limit (by omega : 0 < k+1) (k-1)
  have hr := replacement_scaled_limit k hk
  have hc : ((2 : ℝ)^(k-1))⁻¹ - ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ := by
    have he : k = (k-1)+1 := by omega
    conv_lhs => rhs; rw [he, pow_succ]
    conv_rhs => rw [he, pow_succ]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hh := hq.sub hr
  rw [hc] at hh
  apply hh.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2] with g hg
  obtain ⟨hbu, hkb, hu⟩ := sharp_parameters (k := k) hg
  rw [subcube_one hbu (by omega : k-1 ≤ g^(k+2))]
  ring

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LinearLower:.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.variance_linear_lower
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LinearLower:.text:
theorem variance_linear_lower (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      (∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → k ≤ n →
        c*n ≤ variance (H : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k)) ∧
      (∀ B : ℝ, U k < B → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → k ≤ n →
        c*n ≤ variance (T B : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k)) := by
  obtain ⟨B₀,hB₀,c₀,hc₀,N₀,hN₀⟩ := fixed_cap_variance_lower k hk
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hK := bridgeC_nonneg hk1
  obtain ⟨N₁,hN₁⟩ := positive_linear_absorb c₀ hc₀ (12*bridgeC k)
  refine ⟨c₀/8,by positivity,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨max N₀ N₁,fun n hn hkn => ?_⟩
    have hl := hN₀ n (by omega) hkn
    have ha := hN₁ n (by omega)
    have hv := cap_variance_le_H hk1 hkn hB₀
    have hn0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ n := by positivity
    nlinarith
  · intro B hB
    refine ⟨max N₀ N₁,fun n hn hkn => ?_⟩
    have hl := hN₀ n (by omega) hkn
    have ha := hN₁ n (by omega)
    have hv := cap_variance_le_H hk1 hkn hB₀
    have hv' := H_variance_le_cap hk1 hkn hB.le
    nlinarith

end RandomKSAT

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.CapBridge:15.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.H_variance_le_cap
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.CapBridge:15.text:
lemma H_variance_le_cap {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) {B : ℝ} (hB : U k ≤ B) :
    variance (H : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k) ≤
      2*variance (T B : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k)+2*bridgeC k := by
  let := streamLaw_probability n k hkn
  exact (variance_bridge (H_memLp_two hk hkn) (T_memLp hkn B 2)).trans
    (by linarith [cap_error_uniform hk hkn hB])

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.FailureWindo.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.positive_linear_absorb
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.FailureWindo.text:
lemma positive_linear_absorb (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (K : ℝ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → K ≤ d*n := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (K/d)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hN' : (N:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  nlinarith [(div_lt_iff₀ hd).mp (hN.trans_le hN')]

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.CapBridge:17.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.uncapped_variance_upper
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.CapBridge:17.text:
theorem uncapped_variance_upper (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, k ≤ n →
      variance (H : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k) ≤ C*n*ell k n := by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hv⟩ := capped_variance_upper k hk (U k) (U_pos hk1)
  refine ⟨2*C+2*bridgeC k, by positivity [bridgeC_nonneg hk1], fun n hkn => ?_⟩
  have hh := H_variance_le_cap hk1 hkn (le_refl (U k))
  have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (hk1.trans hkn)
  have he := ell_one_le k n (hk1.trans hkn)
  have hb := bridgeC_nonneg hk1
  have hm : 1 ≤ (n : ℝ)*ell k n := by nlinarith
  have hm' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm hb
  nlinarith [hv n hkn]

end RandomKSAT

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LinearLower:.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.fixed_cap_variance_lower
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.LinearLower:.text:
theorem fixed_cap_variance_lower (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, U k ≤ B ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N : ℕ,
      ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → k ≤ n →
        c*n ≤ variance (T B : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k) := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hRU,hRq⟩ := exists_lower_scale k (by omega)
  let β := Real.exp (-4*(R:ℝ)*k^2)
  have hβ : 0 < β := Real.exp_pos _
  have hβ1 : β ≤ 1 := by
    apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
    have : (0:ℝ) ≤ R := by positivity
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k:ℝ)]
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ha1,haHall,haβ⟩ := exists_lower_density hβ hβ1
  let d := (a/(16*((2*R:ℕ)+1:ℝ)^2))*a*β/16
  have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; positivity
  obtain ⟨Ng,hNg⟩ := eventual_geometric_small
    (by positivity [real_rate_pos (by omega : 1 ≤ k)] : 0 ≤ 2*(1-((2:ℝ)^k)⁻¹)^R)
    hRq (show 0 < β/4 by positivity)
  obtain ⟨Na,hNa⟩ := positive_linear_absorb a ha 8
  obtain ⟨Nd,hNd⟩ := positive_linear_absorb d hd 4
  refine ⟨2*(R:ℝ),hRU,d/4,by positivity,max (2*k^2) (max Ng (max Na Nd)),?_⟩
  intro n hn hkn
  have hn2 : 2*k^2 ≤ n := by omega
  have hng : Ng ≤ n := by omega
  have hna : Na ≤ n := by omega
  have hnd : Nd ≤ n := by omega
  let := clause_nonempty n k hkn
  have hs := sentinel_linear_lower (by omega : 2 ≤ k) hkn hR hn2 ha ha1 haHall haβ
    (hNa n hna) (hNg n hng)
  change d*n ≤ fvariance (fun w : Fin (2*R*n) → Clause n k => (listStop (List.ofFn w):ℝ)) at hs
  have hb := sentinel_variance_bridge (n := n) (k := k) (M := 2*R*n)
  have hcap : cap n (2*(R:ℝ)) = 2*R*n := by
    have he : 2*(R:ℝ)*n = ((2*R*n:ℕ):ℝ) := by
      simp only [Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat]
    simp only [cap,he,Nat.floor_natCast]
  have hv := cap_variance_finite hkn (2*(R:ℝ))
  rw [hcap] at hv
  rw [←hv] at hb
  have hdn := hNd n hnd
  nlinarith

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.CapBridge:11.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.bridgeC_nonneg
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.CapBridge:11.text:
lemma bridgeC_nonneg {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : 0 ≤ bridgeC k := by
  unfold bridgeC
  exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (tsum_nonneg (fun j => by positivity [real_rate_pos hk]))

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.Main:15.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.variance_main
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.Main:15.text:
theorem variance_main (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, k ≤ n →
      variance (H : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k) ≤ C * n * ell k n) ∧
    (∀ B : ℝ, 0 < B → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, k ≤ n →
      variance (T B : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k) ≤ C * n * ell k n) ∧
    (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧
      (∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → k ≤ n →
        c * n ≤ variance (H : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k)) ∧
      (∀ B : ℝ, U k < B → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → k ≤ n →
        c * n ≤ variance (T B : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k))) := by
  exact ⟨uncapped_variance_upper k hk, capped_variance_upper k hk, variance_linear_lower k hk⟩

end RandomKSAT

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.SATVariance.CapBridge:16.name: OAI.RandomKSAT.cap_variance_le_H
OAI.Probability.SATVariance.CapBridge:16.text:
lemma cap_variance_le_H {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) {B : ℝ} (hB : U k ≤ B) :
    variance (T B : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k) ≤
      2*variance (H : Stream n k → ℝ) (streamLaw n k)+2*bridgeC k := by
  let := streamLaw_probability n k hkn
  have hh := variance_bridge (T_memLp hkn B 2) (H_memLp_two hk hkn)
  have he : (∫ ω : Stream n k, (T B ω-H ω)^2 ∂streamLaw n k) =
      ∫ ω : Stream n k, (H ω-T B ω)^2 ∂streamLaw n k := by
    congr 1
    funext ω
    ring
  rw [he] at hh
  exact hh.trans (by linarith [cap_error_uniform hk hkn hB])

OAI.Probability.SKBarriers.Dynamics.Forb.name: OAI.SK.Analytic.forbiddenEndpointError_tendsto
OAI.Probability.SKBarriers.Dynamics.Forb.text:
theorem forbiddenEndpointError_tendsto : Tendsto forbiddenEndpointError atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have H := (stretched_exp_decay (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<3)).add ((stretched_exp_decay (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<8)).const_mul 48)
  change Tendsto (fun n => Real.exp (-3*levelLogScale n)+48*Real.exp (-8*levelLogScale n)) atTop (𝓝 0)
  simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero] using H

OAI.Probability.SKBarriers.Coverage.Ther.name: OAI.SK.Analytic.finiteParisiInf
