OAI.Combinatorics.GraphThreshold.Thresho.name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.expectationThreshold_pos_of_zero_constraint
OAI.Combinatorics.GraphThreshold.Thresho.text:
theorem expectationThreshold_pos_of_zero_constraint {V : Type*}
    (n : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph V)
    (hone : ∀ F : H.Subgraph, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ expectedCopies n 1 F.coe)
    (F : H.Subgraph) (hzero : expectedCopies n 0 F.coe = 0) :
    0 < expectationThreshold n H := by
  have hatt := expectationThreshold_attained_of_one n H hone
  have hne : expectationThreshold n H ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h := hatt.2 F
    rw [hz, hzero] at h
    norm_num at h
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hatt.1.1 (Ne.symm hne)

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Main:59.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.entropy_rate_dimension
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Main:59.text:
theorem entropy_rate_dimension {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (S : System ι) (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) :
    lowerHausdorffDimension μ = ENNReal.ofReal (min 1 (S.entropyRate / S.lyapunov)) := by
  rw [S.selfSimilar_dimension μ hμ]
  congr 1
  exact le_antisymm (le_min (S.exponent_le_one μ hμ) (S.exponent_le_rate μ hμ)) (S.exponent_lower_bound μ hμ)

end EntropyRateDimension

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.AttractorF.name: OAI.CorSetReference.cor_set
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.AttractorF.text:
theorem cor_set {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (r t : ι → ℝ) (hr0 : ∀ i, 0 < |r i|) (hr1 : ∀ i, |r i| < 1)
    (hno : ∀ u v : List ι, u ≠ [] → v ≠ [] →
      word r t u = word r t v → u = v) :
    IsCompact (attractor r t) ∧ (attractor r t).Nonempty ∧
    (∃! s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ ∑ i, |r i| ^ s = 1) ∧
    (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → (∑ i, |r i| ^ s = 1) →
      dimH (attractor r t) = ENNReal.ofReal (min 1 s)) := by
  have hword (w : List ι) :
      (uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1).wordAffine w = word r t w := by
    induction w with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons i w ih =>
      change (r i * ((uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1).wordAffine w).1,
        r i * ((uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1).wordAffine w).2 + t i) =
        (r i * (word r t w).1, r i * (word r t w).2 + t i)
      rw [ih]
  have hno' : ∀ u v : List ι, u ≠ [] → v ≠ [] →
      (uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1).wordAffine u =
        (uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1).wordAffine v → u = v := by
    intro u v hu hv he
    apply hno u v hu hv
    simpa only [hword] using he
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, unweighted_existsUnique_similarityDimension r t hr0 hr1, ?_⟩
  · exact unweightedAttractor_compact r t hr0 hr1
  · exact Set.range_nonempty _
  · intro a ha he
    exact unweighted_no_exact_overlaps_attractor_dimension_of_root r t hr0 hr1 a ha he hno'

end CorSetReference

end OAI

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.walkEntropy_eq_symbolEntropy
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.text:
theorem walkEntropy_eq_symbolEntropy [Nonempty ι] (S : System ι)
    (h : SameLengthNoExactOverlaps S) (n : ℕ) :
    S.walkEntropy n = (n : ℝ) * (symbolEntropy S / Real.log 2) := by
  classical
  have he := FiniteEntropy.observableEntropy_of_injective Finset.univ
    (S.wordWeight (n := n)) S.completeMap
    (fun w _ => (S.wordWeight_pos w).le) (h n)
  rw [S.map_entropy_as_observation, word_entropy] at he
  have h2 : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (eq_div_iff h2).mpr
  exact he

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.noExactOverlaps_iff_nonempty
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.text:
theorem noExactOverlaps_iff_nonempty (S : System ι) :
    NoExactOverlaps S ↔ ∀ u v : List ι, u ≠ [] → v ≠ [] →
      S.wordAffine u = S.wordAffine v → u = v := by
  constructor
  · intro h u v _ _ he
    exact h he
  · intro h u v he
    by_cases hu : u = []
    · subst u
      have hv := equal_map_prefix S [] v (by simpa using he)
      exact hv.symm
    by_cases hv : v = []
    · subst v
      exact equal_map_prefix S [] u (by simpa using he.symm)
    exact h u v hu hv he

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Main:11.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.exists_slightly_larger_depth
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Main:11.text:
theorem exists_slightly_larger_depth {d χ h : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hgap : d*χ < h) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, χ < a ∧ d*a < h := by
  let t := (h-d*χ)/(2*(d+1))
  have hp : 0 < 2*(d+1) := by linarith
  have ht : 0 < t := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgap) hp
  have he : t*(2*(d+1))=h-d*χ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp.ne'
  refine ⟨χ+t,by linarith,?_⟩
  nlinarith

namespace System
variable {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
local instance : MeasurableSpace ι := ⊤
local instance : MeasurableSingletonClass ι := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.unweightedAttractor_compact
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Unweighted.text:

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Homogeneou.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.homogeneous_exponent_lower_direct
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Homogeneou.text:
theorem homogeneous_exponent_lower_direct {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (S : System ι) {lam : ℝ} (hr : ∀ i, S.ratio i = lam)
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) :
    min 1 (S.entropyRate / S.lyapunov) ≤ Coding.exponent S := by
  classical
  by_contra! hstrict
  obtain ⟨d, hed, hdm⟩ := exists_between hstrict
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := (Coding.exponent_nonneg S).trans hed.le
  have hd1 : d < 1 := hdm.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hdr : d < S.entropyRate / S.lyapunov := hdm.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hdh : d * S.lyapunov < S.entropyRate := (lt_div_iff₀ S.lyapunov_pos).mp hdr
  obtain ⟨a, hχa, hda⟩ := exists_slightly_larger_depth hd hdh
  have hap : 0 < a := S.lyapunov_pos.trans hχa
  have hl : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := S.selfSimilar_entropy_bound μ hμ hed
  apply Typed.no_strict_entropy_gap S (fun _ : ι => ())
    (fun i j _ => (hr i).trans (hr j).symm) μ hμ hd hd1 hap
    (A' := (S.lyapunov + a) / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith) hC
  simpa using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hda hl

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.EntropyGap.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Typed.no_strict_entropy_gap
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.EntropyGap.text:
theorem no_strict_entropy_gap (S : System α) (tag : α → β)
    (hr : ∀ a v, tag a=tag v → S.ratio a=S.ratio v)
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ)
    {d C A A' : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d < 1) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hA' : S.lyapunov < A') (hAA : A' < A)
    (hb : ∀ s, 0 < s → s < 1 → averaged μ s ≤ d*Real.log (1/s)+C)
    (hgap : d*A*Real.log 2 < S.entropyRate*Real.log 2-Real.log (Fintype.card β)) : False := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hdef⟩ := S.uniform_nonsaturation_of_entropy_bound μ hμ hd1 hb
  obtain ⟨M,hM'⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 4 (10*Real.log 2/δ))
  have hM : 4 < M := by exact_mod_cast (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hM'
  have hMr : (0 : ℝ)<M := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < M by omega)
  have he : 5/(M : ℝ)*Real.log 2 ≤ δ/2 := by
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp ((le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hM')
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<2)).mpr
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hMr).mp
    have heq : (5/(M : ℝ)*Real.log 2*2)*(M : ℝ)=10*Real.log 2 := by field_simp; ring
    nlinarith [heq]
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,N,_,hloss⟩ := retained_loss_linear S tag hr μ hμ hd hA hA' hb hgap
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hbands⟩ := pair_bands_of_retained_loss S tag hr A A' hε hloss
  obtain ⟨dmax,_,hdmax⟩ := S.exists_depth_bound
  obtain ⟨D,hD'⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 1 dmax)
  have hD : 1 ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast ((le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hD').le
  have hdD : ∀ v, S.letterDepth v ≤ (D : ℝ) := fun v => (hdmax v).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hD').le
  have hcoef : 0 < δ/2*c := mul_pos (div_pos hδ (by norm_num)) hc
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((2*(D : ℝ)*Real.log ((M*M : ℕ) : ℝ))/(δ/2*c))
  obtain ⟨n,B,hn,ha,hbudget,hsep⟩ := select_separated_bands S tag hA hAA hbands q
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hdvd,hBH⟩ := exists_common_horizon n hn B
  let K : Fin q → ℕ := fun i => H/n i
  have hkn (i : Fin q) : K i*n i=H := Nat.div_mul_cancel (hdvd i)
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hcompact⟩ := S.selfSimilar_compact μ hμ
  have hcomp : CompactlyCarried μ := ⟨R,hR.le,hcompact⟩
  have hcount := count_pair_budget_le S tag hr μ hμ hcomp hdef hM he hD hdD n K
    (fun i => bandStart A (n i)) B A' hkn ha hBH hsep
  have hsum : (q : ℝ)*(c*H) ≤ ∑ i, (K i : ℝ)*pairBudget S tag A' (bandStart A (n i)) (B i) (n i) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ _i : Fin q, c*(H : ℝ) := by simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbudget i) (Nat.cast_nonneg (K i))
        have hnH : (K i : ℝ)*(n i : ℝ)=(H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkn i
        nlinarith
  have hlim : (δ/2*c)*(q : ℝ) ≤ 2*(D : ℝ)*Real.log ((M*M : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by exact_mod_cast hH : (0 : ℝ)<H)).mp
    calc
      _ = δ/2*((q : ℝ)*(c*H)) := by ring
      _ ≤ δ/2*(∑ i, (K i : ℝ)*pairBudget S tag A' (bandStart A (n i)) (B i) (n i)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)
      _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat,mul_assoc,mul_comm,mul_left_comm] using hcount
  have hq' := (div_lt_iff₀ hcoef).mp hq
  nlinarith

end EntropyRateDimension.Typed

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Unweighted.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.unweighted_existsUnique_similarityDimension
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Unweighted.text:
theorem unweighted_existsUnique_similarityDimension (r t : ι → ℝ)
    (hr0 : ∀ i, 0 < |r i|) (hr1 : ∀ i, |r i| < 1) :
    ∃! s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ ∑ i, |r i| ^ s = 1 := by
  simpa only [similaritySum, uniformSystem] using
    existsUnique_similarityDimension (uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1)

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Homogeneou.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.homogeneous_dimension_direct
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Homogeneou.text:
theorem homogeneous_dimension_direct {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (S : System ι)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (hr : ∀ i, S.ratio i = lam)
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ)
    (h : NoExactOverlaps S) :
    lowerHausdorffDimension μ =
      ENNReal.ofReal (min 1 (symbolEntropy S / Real.log (1/lam))) := by
  rw [← homogeneous_naturalLyapunov S hlam hr]
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hn : 0 < naturalLyapunov S := by
    have hp := S.lyapunov_pos
    rw [lyapunov_eq_naturalLyapunov] at hp
    exact (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hlog).mp hp
  have hu : Coding.exponent S ≤ symbolEntropy S / naturalLyapunov S := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hn).mpr
    have hb := Coding.exponent_symbol_entropy_bound S
    change Coding.exponent S * S.lyapunov * Real.log 2 ≤ symbolEntropy S at hb
    rw [lyapunov_eq_naturalLyapunov] at hb
    have hc : Coding.exponent S * (naturalLyapunov S / Real.log 2) * Real.log 2 =
        Coding.exponent S * naturalLyapunov S := by
      field_simp [hlog.ne']
    rwa [hc] at hb
  have hl := homogeneous_exponent_lower_direct S hr μ hμ
  rw [entropyRate_eq_symbolEntropy S (noExactOverlaps_sameLength S h),
    lyapunov_eq_naturalLyapunov, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hlog.ne'] at hl
  rw [S.selfSimilar_dimension μ hμ]
  exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal (le_antisymm (le_min (S.exponent_le_one μ hμ) hu) hl)

end EntropyRateDimension.Extensions

end OAI

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.naturalLyapunov
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.text:
noncomputable def naturalLyapunov (S : System ι) : ℝ :=
  -(∑ i, S.weight i * Real.log |S.ratio i|)

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.SameLengthNoExactOverlaps
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.text:
def SameLengthNoExactOverlaps (S : System ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Injective (S.completeMap (n := n))

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.entropyRate_eq_symbolEntropy
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.text:
theorem entropyRate_eq_symbolEntropy [Nonempty ι] (S : System ι)
    (h : SameLengthNoExactOverlaps S) :
    S.entropyRate = symbolEntropy S / Real.log 2 := by
  have hw (n : ℕ) : S.walkEntropy (n+1) / (n+1 : ℕ) =
      symbolEntropy S / Real.log 2 := by
    rw [walkEntropy_eq_symbolEntropy S h]
    have hn : (n+1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    push_cast
    field_simp [hn]
  unfold System.entropyRate
  simp only [hw, Set.range_const, csInf_singleton]

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.homogeneous_naturalLyapunov
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.text:
theorem homogeneous_naturalLyapunov (S : System ι) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hr : ∀ i, S.ratio i = lam) : naturalLyapunov S = Real.log (1/lam) := by
  simp only [naturalLyapunov, hr, abs_of_pos hlam, ← Finset.sum_mul,
    S.weight_sum, one_mul, one_div, Real.log_inv]

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.symbolEntropy
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.text:
noncomputable def symbolEntropy (S : System ι) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, Real.negMulLog (S.weight i)

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Attractor:.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.attractor_compact
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Attractor:.text:
theorem attractor_compact [Nonempty ι] (S : System ι) : IsCompact (attractor S) := by
  let : TopologicalSpace ι := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology ι := ⟨rfl⟩
  exact isCompact_range (point_continuous S)

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.AttractorD.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.no_exact_overlaps_attractor_dimension_of_root
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.AttractorD.text:
theorem no_exact_overlaps_attractor_dimension_of_root (S : System ι) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hroot : ∑ i, |S.ratio i| ^ s = 1) (h : NoExactOverlaps S) :
    dimH (attractor S) = ENNReal.ofReal (min 1 s) := by
  let : MeasurableSpace ι := ⊤
  let : MeasurableSingletonClass ι := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩
  let T := similaritySystem S hroot
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_min]
    exact le_min (by simpa using attractor_dim_le_one S) (attractor_dim_le_similarity S hs hroot)
  · have hd := no_exact_overlaps_dimension T (Coding.law T) (Coding.law_selfSimilar T)
      (similaritySystem_noExactOverlaps S hroot h)
    rw [similaritySystem_entropy S hroot,
      mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (naturalLyapunov_pos T).ne'] at hd
    rw [← hd]
    exact coding_law_dimension_le_attractor T

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.AttractorF.name: OAI.CorSetReference.attractor
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.AttractorF.text:

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.AttractorD.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.existsUnique_similarityDimension
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.AttractorD.text:
theorem existsUnique_similarityDimension (S : System ι) :
    ∃! s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ similaritySum S s = 1 := by
  have hcont : Continuous (similaritySum S) :=
    continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => Real.continuous_const_rpow (S.ratio_pos i).ne')
  have hlim : Tendsto (similaritySum S) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    change Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∑ i, |S.ratio i| ^ s) atTop (𝓝 0)
    have hh : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∑ i, |S.ratio i| ^ s) atTop
        (𝓝 (∑ _i : ι, (0 : ℝ))) :=
      tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
        tendsto_rpow_atTop_of_base_lt_one |S.ratio i|
          (lt_trans (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0) (S.ratio_pos i))
          (S.ratio_lt_one i))
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const_zero] using hh
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hb0⟩ :=
    ((hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num))).and
      (eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ))).exists
  have hzero : 1 ≤ similaritySum S 0 := by
    simpa [similaritySum] using (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card ι by
      exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := ι))
  obtain ⟨s, hs, he⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' hb0 hcont.continuousOn
    (show (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (similaritySum S b) (similaritySum S 0) from ⟨hb.le, hzero⟩)
  refine ⟨s, ⟨hs.1, he⟩, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  exact (similaritySum_strictAnti S).injective (ht.2.trans he.symm)

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.lyapunov_eq_naturalLyapunov
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.NoOverlaps.text:
theorem lyapunov_eq_naturalLyapunov (S : System ι) :
    S.lyapunov = naturalLyapunov S / Real.log 2 := by
  simp only [System.lyapunov, naturalLyapunov, ← mul_div_assoc,
    ← Finset.sum_div, neg_div]

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Unweighted.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.unweighted_no_exact_overlaps_attractor_dimension_of_root
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Unweighted.text:
theorem unweighted_no_exact_overlaps_attractor_dimension_of_root
    (r t : ι → ℝ) (hr0 : ∀ i, 0 < |r i|) (hr1 : ∀ i, |r i| < 1)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hroot : ∑ i, |r i| ^ s = 1)
    (hno : ∀ u v : List ι, u ≠ [] → v ≠ [] →
      (uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1).wordAffine u =
        (uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1).wordAffine v → u = v) :
    dimH (unweightedAttractor r t hr0 hr1) = ENNReal.ofReal (min 1 s) := by
  exact no_exact_overlaps_attractor_dimension_of_root (uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1)
    hs hroot ((noExactOverlaps_iff_nonempty (uniformSystem r t hr0 hr1)).mpr hno)

OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Unweighted.name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Extensions.uniformSystem
OAI.MeasureTheory.SelfSimilar.Unweighted.text:
noncomputable def uniformSystem (r t : ι → ℝ)
    (hr0 : ∀ i, 0 < |r i|) (hr1 : ∀ i, |r i| < 1) : System ι where
  ratio := r
  offset := t
  weight := fun _ => 1 / (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)
  ratio_pos := hr0
  ratio_lt_one := hr1
  weight_pos := fun _ => one_div_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := ι))
  weight_sum := by
    have hn : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos (α := ι)).ne'
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, one_div]
    exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hn

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Basic:168.name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivity_pos_of_nonconstant
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Basic:168.text:
theorem sensitivity_pos_of_nonconstant (f : (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (h : ∃ x y, f x ≠ f y) : 0 < sensitivity f := by
  by_contra hn
  have hz : sensitivity f = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
  have hi (x : I → Bool) (i : I) : f (flip x {i}) = f x := by
    apply (sensitivityAt_eq_zero_iff f x).mp _ i
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero ((sensitivityAt_le_sensitivity f x).trans_eq hz)
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := h
  exact hxy (eq_of_singleton_invariant f hi x y)

end Finite
end Paper320

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Labeling:5.name: OAI.Paper320.regular_goodLabeling_exists
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Labeling:5.text:
theorem regular_goodLabeling_exists {M : ℕ} (hM : 3 ≤ M) :
    Nonempty (GoodLabeling (regularCyclicTournament M).toTournament

  goodLabeling_exists hM (le_ceil_sqrt_sq M) _

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.ParameterB.name: OAI.Paper320.parameter_ge_eighty_one
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.ParameterB.text:
theorem parameter_ge_eighty_one {d M : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hM : 9 ^ (d + 1) ≤ M) :
    81 ≤ M := by
  have hp : (9 : ℕ) ^ 2 ≤ 9 ^ (d + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  norm_num at hp
  exact hp.trans hM

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructi.name: OAI.Paper320.constructionDimension
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructi.text:
def constructionDimension (d M r : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (d + 2) * M ^ 2 * ((2 * M ^ 2 + 1) * r) ^ d

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructe.name: OAI.Paper320.exists_constructed_seed
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructe.text:
theorem exists_constructed_seed (d M : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hM : 9 ^ (d + 1) ≤ M) :
    ∃ f : (Fin (constructionDimension d M (Nat.ceil (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)))) → Bool) → Bool,
      0 < constructionDimension d M (Nat.ceil (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ))) ∧
      f (fun _ => false) = false ∧ (∃ x y, f x ≠ f y) ∧
      sensitivity f ≤ 2 * (d + 2) * M ^ (d + 1) ∧
      M ^ 2 * (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) ^ d ≤ blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false) := by
  have h81 := parameter_ge_eighty_one hd hM
  have hMp : 0 < M := by omega
  have hr := construction_label_count_pos hMp
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := regular_goodLabeling_exists (show 3 ≤ M by omega)
  let f := finalWitness d (regularCyclicTournament M) A
  have hs := finalWitness_sensitivity d (regularCyclicTournament M) A hMp hr
    (parameter_epsilon_budget hd hM)
  have hb := finalWitness_blockSensitivity d (regularCyclicTournament M) A hr
  have hbp : 0 < M ^ 2 * (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) ^ d := by positivity
  have hnc := nonconstant_of_blockSensitivityAt_pos f (fun _ => false) (hbp.trans_le hb)
  exact ⟨f, constructionDimension_pos hMp hr,
    finalWitness_zero d (regularCyclicTournament M) A hr, hnc, hs, hb⟩

end Paper320

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructi.name: OAI.Paper320.finalWitness_sensitivity
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructi.text:
theorem finalWitness_sensitivity {M r : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (T : RegularTournament M)
    (A : GoodLabeling T.toTournament r) (hM : 0 < M) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hbudget : ((max r 16 : ℕ) : ℝ) / M * 3 ^ (d + 1) ≤ 2) :
    sensitivity (finalWitness d T A) ≤ 2 * (d + 2) * M ^ (d + 1) := by
  rw [finalWitness, sensitivity_reindex]
  exact finalBoolean_sensitivity d T A hM hr hbudget

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructi.name: OAI.Paper320.finalWitness

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.ParameterB.name: OAI.Paper320.parameter_epsilon_budget
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.ParameterB.text:
theorem parameter_epsilon_budget {d M : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hM : 9 ^ (d + 1) ≤ M) :
    ((max (Nat.ceil (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ))) 16 : ℕ) : ℝ) / M * 3 ^ (d + 1) ≤ 2 := by
  have h81 := parameter_ge_eighty_one hd hM
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < M by omega)
  have hm := ceil_sqrt_max_le_two_sqrt h81
  have hp := parameter_sqrt_lower hM
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)) / M * Real.sqrt (M : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hm hpos.le) hp (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 := by
      field_simp
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le]

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Model:23.name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivity
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Model:23.text:
def sensitivity {I : Type} [Fintype I] (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) : ℕ :=

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Model:36.name: OAI.Paper320.blockSensitivity
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Model:36.text:
def blockSensitivity {I : Type} [Fintype I] (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) : ℕ :=

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Separation.name: OAI.Paper320.seed_ratio_lower
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Separation.text:
theorem seed_ratio_lower (d : ℕ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ d / (4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) ≤
      (M ^ 2 * (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) ^ d) /
        (2 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) * M ^ (d + 1)) ^ 2 := by
  rw [seed_ratio_identity d (by positivity) (ne_of_gt hM)]
  have hk : 2 ≤ (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) / M ^ 2 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hM 2)).mpr
    linarith
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hk d) (by positivity)

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Tournament.name: OAI.Paper320.regularCyclicTournament
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Tournament.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Separation.name: OAI.Paper320.quantitative_separation
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Separation.text:
theorem quantitative_separation (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool),
      0 < n ∧ f (fun _ => false) = false ∧
      (∃ x y : Fin n → Bool, f x ≠ f y) ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ d / (4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) ≤
        (blockSensitivity f : ℝ) / (sensitivity f : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  let M : ℕ := 9 ^ (d + 1)
  have hM : 0 < M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
  obtain ⟨f, hn, hf, hnc, hs, hb⟩ := exists_constructed_seed d M hd (by rfl)
  exact ⟨_, f, hn, hf, hnc, quantitative_ratio_of_bounds f d M hM hnc hs hb⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Separation.name: OAI.Paper320.ratio_of_bounds
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Separation.text:
theorem ratio_of_bounds {I : Type} [Fintype I] (f : (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (s b : ℝ) (hpos : 0 < (sensitivity f : ℝ))
    (hs : (sensitivity f : ℝ) ≤ s) (hb : b ≤ (blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false) : ℝ))
    (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) :
    b / s ^ 2 ≤ (blockSensitivity f : ℝ) / (sensitivity f : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  have hsp : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hs
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hpos 2)).mpr
  calc
    _ ≤ (b / s ^ 2) * s ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hpos.le hs 2) (div_nonneg hb0 (sq_nonneg s))
    _ = b := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (pow_pos hsp 2))
    _ ≤ (blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false) : ℝ) := hb
    _ ≤ (blockSensitivity f : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast blockSensitivityAt_le_blockSensitivity f (fun _ => false)

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Iterates:1.name: OAI.Paper320.nonconstant_of_blockSensitivityAt_pos
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Iterates:1.text:
theorem nonconstant_of_blockSensitivityAt_pos (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool)
    (h : 0 < blockSensitivityAt f x) : ∃ y z, f y ≠ f z := by
  obtain ⟨blocks, hc, _, hb⟩ := exists_blockSensitivityAt_family f x
  have hn : blocks.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (hc.symm ▸ h)
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hn
  exact ⟨flip x B, x, (hb B hB).2⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Model:18.name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivityAt
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Model:18.text:
def sensitivityAt {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter fun i => f (flip x {i}) ≠ f x).card

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructi.name: OAI.Paper320.finalWitness_blockSensitivity
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructi.text:
theorem finalWitness_blockSensitivity {M r : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (T : RegularTournament M)
    (A : GoodLabeling T.toTournament r) (hr : 0 < r) :
    M ^ 2 * (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) ^ d ≤ blockSensitivityAt (finalWitness d T A) (fun _ => false) := by
  rw [finalWitness, blockSensitivityAt_reindex]
  exact finalBoolean_blockSensitivity d T A hr

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Model:28.name: OAI.Paper320.blockSensitivityAt
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Model:28.text:
def blockSensitivityAt {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool) : ℕ :=
  Finset.univ.sup fun blocks : Finset (Finset I) =>
    if (∀ A ∈ blocks, ∀ B ∈ blocks, A ≠ B → Disjoint A B) ∧
        (∀ B ∈ blocks, B.Nonempty ∧ f (flip x B) ≠ f x)
    then blocks.card else 0

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Separation.name: OAI.Paper320.quantitative_ratio_of_bounds
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Separation.text:
theorem quantitative_ratio_of_bounds {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (d M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hnc : ∃ x y, f x ≠ f y)
    (hs : sensitivity f ≤ 2 * (d + 2) * M ^ (d + 1))
    (hb : M ^ 2 * (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) ^ d ≤ blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false)) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ d / (4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) ≤
      (blockSensitivity f : ℝ) / (sensitivity f : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  have hMr : 0 < (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hM
  apply (seed_ratio_lower d hMr).trans
  apply ratio_of_bounds
  · exact_mod_cast sensitivity_pos_of_nonconstant f hnc
  · exact_mod_cast hs
  · exact_mod_cast hb
  · positivity

OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructe.name: OAI.Paper320.construction_label_count_pos
OAI.Combinatorics.Sensitivity.Constructe.text:
theorem construction_label_count_pos {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) :
    0 < Nat.ceil (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)) := by
  have h := le_ceil_sqrt_sq M
  by_contra hn
  have he : Nat.ceil (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)) = 0 := by omega
  rw [he] at h
  norm_num at h
  omega

OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.ChangedP.name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.ActualSpace.X_infinite
OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.ChangedP.text:
lemma X_infinite : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ (X hCH) := by
  intro hh
  let := hh
  have : FiniteDimensional ℝ (StrongDual ℝ (X hCH)) := inferInstance
  exact infiniteDimensional (FiniteDimensional.of_injective (twistedIso hCH).toLinearMap (twistedIso hCH).injective)

OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.ChangedP.name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.ActualSpace.X_restriction_nonseparable
OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.ChangedP.text:
lemma X_restriction_nonseparable (F : Submodule ℝ E) (hF : IsClosed (F : Set E))
    (hFi : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ F) [SeparableSpace F] :
    ¬ IsSeparable (restrict F '' (X hCH : Set (StrongDual ℝ E))) := by
  intro hsep
  let s := restrict F '' (X hCH : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)) ∪
    restrict F '' (X₀ : Set (StrongDual ℝ E))
  let Z := (Submodule.span ℝ s).topologicalClosure
  have hZ : IsSeparable (Z : Set (StrongDual ℝ F)) :=
    (hsep.union (predual_restriction_separable F)).span.closure
  have hin : X hCH ⊔ X₀ ≤ Z.comap (restrict F).toLinearMap := by
    apply sup_le
    · intro y hy
      exact Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩))
    · intro y hy
      exact Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩))
  have hc : IsClosed ((Z.comap (restrict F).toLinearMap) : Set (StrongDual ℝ E)) :=
    (Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).preimage (restrict F).continuous
  have hp {f : Family} (P : InfinitePath f) : restrict F (pathFunctional P) ∈ Z :=
    (Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hin hc) (path_mem_twisted_sum hCH P)
  let R : BranchReduction F := Classical.choice (exists_branchReduction F hF hFi)
  let ψ : (ℕ → Bool) → StrongDual ℝ F := fun b =>
    restrict F (pathFunctional (TreeNode.branchPath (BlockApprox.blocks R) b))
  have hsψ : IsSeparable (range ψ) := hZ.mono (by
    rintro _ ⟨b,rfl⟩
    exact hp _)
  apply boolSeq_uncountable
  apply countable_of_separated_range ψ hsψ (1/(2004*(‖R.U‖+1))) (by positivity)
  intro b c hbc
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  exact BlockApprox.restricted_separated R hbc

OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.Negative.name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.negative_real
OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.Negative.text:
theorem negative_real (hCH : CH) : ¬ SQ.{u} ℝ := by
  intro hSQ
  let X := ActualSpace.X hCH
  let : NormedAddCommGroup X := inferInstance
  let : NormedSpace ℝ X := inferInstance
  let : CompleteSpace X := ActualSpace.X_complete hCH
  let XU := ULift.{u} X
  let : NormedAddCommGroup XU := inferInstance
  let : NormedSpace ℝ XU := inferInstance
  let : CompleteSpace XU := inferInstance
  let d : XU ≃L[ℝ] X := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift
  have hI : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ XU := by
    intro hh
    let := hh
    exact ActualSpace.X_infinite hCH
      (FiniteDimensional.of_injective d.symm.toLinearMap d.symm.injective)
  have hsq := hSQ XU hI
  let R : ActualSpace.E ≃L[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ XU :=
    (ActualSpace.twistedIso hCH).trans (d.symm.arrowCongr (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ))
  let J : XU →L[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ ActualSpace.E :=
    (ActualSpace.X hCH).subtypeL.comp d.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hR (e : ActualSpace.E) (x : XU) : R e x = J x e := by
    exact ActualSpace.twistedIso_apply hCH e (d x)
  obtain ⟨F,hF,hFi,hFs,hsep⟩ := separable_restriction_of_quotient R J hR hsq
  let := hFs.separableSpace
  apply ActualSpace.X_restriction_nonseparable hCH F hF hFi
  apply hsep.mono
  rintro _ ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
  refine ⟨d.symm ⟨x,hx⟩,?_⟩
  change (J (d.symm ⟨x,hx⟩)).comp F.subtypeL = (ActualSpace.restrict F) x
  simp only [J,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,d.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

end SeparableQuotient

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.Separabl.name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.separable_restriction_of_quotient
OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.Separabl.text:
lemma separable_restriction_of_quotient
    (R : E ≃L[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ X) (J : X →L[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ E)
    (hR : ∀ e x, R e x = J x e) (hSQ : HasSeparableQuotient ℝ X) :
    ∃ F : Submodule ℝ E, IsClosed (F : Set E) ∧ ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ F ∧
      IsSeparable (F : Set E) ∧
      IsSeparable (range (fun x : X => (J x).comp F.subtypeL)) := by
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hHi,hHe⟩ := separable_evaluation_of_hasSeparableQuotient hSQ
  let hNg : NormedAddCommGroup H := inferInstance
  let hNs : NormedSpace ℝ H := inferInstance
  let : CompleteSpace H := hH.completeSpace_coe
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hGi,hGs⟩ := exists_separable_closed_ID (𝕜 := ℝ) (Y := H) hHi
  let gNg : NormedAddCommGroup G := inferInstance
  let gNs : NormedSpace ℝ G := inferInstance
  let : CompleteSpace G := hG.completeSpace_coe
  let : SeparableSpace G := hGs.separableSpace
  let T : G →L[ℝ] E := R.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (H.subtypeL.comp G.subtypeL)
  have hi : Isometry (H.subtypeL.comp G.subtypeL) := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hT : ∃ K, AntilipschitzWith K T := by
    refine ⟨_,R.symm.antilipschitz.comp hi.antilipschitzWith⟩
  obtain ⟨K,hK⟩ := hT
  let F := T.range
  let fNg : NormedAddCommGroup F := inferInstance
  let fNs : NormedSpace ℝ F := inferInstance
  have hFc : IsClosed (F : Set E) := hK.isClosed_range T.uniformContinuous
  let e : G ≃L[ℝ] F := T.equivRange hK.injective hFc
  have hFi : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ F := by
    intro hh
    let := hh
    exact hGi (FiniteDimensional.of_injective e.toLinearMap e.injective)
  have hFs : IsSeparable (F : Set E) := isSeparable_range T.continuous
  let U : F →L[ℝ] H := G.subtypeL.comp e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap
  let A : StrongDual ℝ H →L[ℝ] StrongDual ℝ F := ContinuousLinearMap.precomp ℝ U
  have he (x : X) : (J x).comp F.subtypeL = A (subspaceEvaluation H x) := by
    ext z
    obtain ⟨g,rfl⟩ := e.surjective z
    change J x (T g) = ((U (e g) : H) : StrongDual ℝ X) x
    have hu : U (e g) = (g : H) := by
      change G.subtypeL (e.symm (e g)) = _
      rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
      rfl
    rw [hu]
    change J x (R.symm ((g : H) : StrongDual ℝ X)) = ((g : H) : StrongDual ℝ X) x
    rw [← hR,R.apply_symm_apply]
  refine ⟨F,hFc,hFi,hFs,(hHe.image A.continuous).mono ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨subspaceEvaluation H x,mem_range_self x,(he x).symm⟩

end SeparableQuotient

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.Complexi.name: OAI.SeparableQuotient.Complexify.infinite
OAI.Analysis.SeparableQuotients.Complexi.text:
lemma infinite [CompleteSpace X] (hX : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℝ X) :
    ¬ FiniteDimensional ℂ (Complexify X) := by
  intro hh
  let := hh
  let : FiniteDimensional ℝ (Complexify X) := FiniteDimensional.trans ℝ ℂ _
  let : FiniteDimensional ℝ (X × X) := FiniteDimensional.of_injective (pairEquiv X).symm.toLinearMap (pairEquiv X).symm.injective
  exact hX (FiniteDimensional.of_injective (LinearMap.inl ℝ X X) (by intro x y h; exact Prod.mk.inj h |>.1))

end Complexify
end SeparableQuotient

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Red.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Counterexample

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.exists_maximizing_pair
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
theorem exists_maximizing_pair (r : V → V → Prop)
    (admissible : Finset (V × V) → Finset (V × V) → Prop)
    (hex : ∃ P Q, admissible P Q) :
    ∃ P Q, admissible P Q ∧ ∀ P' Q', admissible P' Q' →
      objective r P' Q' ≤ objective r P Q := by
  classical
  let candidates : Finset (Finset (V × V) × Finset (V × V)) :=
    Finset.univ.filter fun p => admissible p.1 p.2
  have hne : candidates.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨P, Q, h⟩ := hex
    exact ⟨(P, Q), Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmax⟩ := candidates.exists_max_image
    (fun p => objective r p.1 p.2) hne
  refine ⟨p.1, p.2, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2, ?_⟩
  intro P Q h
  exact hmax (P, Q) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩)

end

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.rightCandidate

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Pru.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.pruning
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Pru.text:
theorem pruning (r : X → X → Prop) : PruningStatement r := by
  intro R C
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hα, hβ⟩ := exists_augmented_maximum_matching r R C
  apply exists_pruning_of_augmented_matching_bound r R C M hM
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using
    augmented_matching_card_le_corners r R C M hM.1 hα hβ

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.objective_lt_of_pruning
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
theorem objective_lt_of_pruning {r : V → V → Prop}
    {P Q R C P' Q' : Finset (V × V)}
    (hpr : PruningResult r R C P' Q')
    (hH : (H r R C).card ≤ uncoveredCount r P Q)
    (hgain : P.card + Q.card + 2 * uncoveredCount r P Q < R.card + C.card) :
    objective r P Q < objective r P' Q' := by
  have hZ := uncoveredZ_card_le r R C P' Q'
  have hR := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hpr.subset_left
  have hC := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hpr.subset_right
  have hdel := hpr.deletion_bound
  unfold objective
  omega

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Cov.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.exists_pruning_of_augmented_matching_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Cov.text:
theorem exists_pruning_of_augmented_matching_bound
    (r : V → V → Prop) (R C : Finset (V × V))
    (M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C))
    (hM : IsMaximumMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M)
    (hbound : M.card ≤ (H r R C).card + (Z r R C).card) :
    ∃ R' C', PruningResult r R C R' C' := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A, B, hcover, hcard, hA, hB⟩ :=
    exists_vertexCover_card_eq_of_isMaximumMatching hM
  exact exists_pruning_of_augmented_cover r R C A B hcover hA hB
    (hcard.trans_le hbound)

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Red.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.counterexample_iff_not_conjecture

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Tra.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.blowup_strictSubsetGrowth
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Tra.text:
theorem blowup_strictSubsetGrowth {r : V → V → Prop} {m : ℕ}
    (_hr : IsOriented r) (hi : PositiveIndegree r) (hd : SubsetDeficit r)
    (hm : Fintype.card V < m) : StrictSubsetGrowth (blowup r m) := by
  classical
  intro U hU hUproper
  by_cases hS : U.image Prod.fst = Finset.univ
  · have hX := blowup_image_eq_univ_of_full_support hi U hS
    have hUcard : U.card < (Finset.univ : Finset (V × Fin m)).card := by
      apply Finset.card_lt_card
      exact Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hUproper⟩
    have hYcard : (image (blowup r m) (image (blowup r m) U)).card ≤
        (Finset.univ : Finset (V × Fin m)).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ _)
    simp only [hX] at hYcard ⊢
    omega
  · have hSne : (U.image Prod.fst).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hU
      exact ⟨p.1, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩⟩
    have hdef := hd (U.image Prod.fst) hSne hS
    have hgain :
        (image (blowup r m) (image (blowup r m) U) \ image (blowup r m) U).card ≤
          (image r (image r (U.image Prod.fst)) \ image r (U.image Prod.fst)).card * m := by
      simpa only [Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin] using
        (Finset.card_le_card (blowup_second_sdiff_subset (r := r) U))
    have hloss :
        (image r (U.image Prod.fst) \ U.image Prod.fst).card * m ≤
          (image (blowup r m) U \ U).card := by
      simpa only [Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin] using
        (Finset.card_le_card (blowup_boundary_product_subset (r := r) U))
    have hsource := blowup_source_sdiff_card_le (r := r) U
    have hamp :
        (image r (image r (U.image Prod.fst)) \ image r (U.image Prod.fst)).card * m + m ≤
          (image r (U.image Prod.fst) \ U.image Prod.fst).card * m := by
      have hstep :
          ((image r (image r (U.image Prod.fst)) \ image r (U.image Prod.fst)).card + 1) * m ≤
            (image r (U.image Prod.fst) \ U.image Prod.fst).card * m :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hdef)
      simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using hstep
    apply card_add_card_lt_twice_of_sdiff
    omega

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Sub.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.subsetDeficit_of_minimal
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Sub.text:
theorem subsetDeficit_of_minimal {r : V → V → Prop}
    (hr : IsOriented r) (hcounter : Counterexample r)
    (hminimal : ArcMinimal r) (hboundary : NonemptyBoundary r) :
    SubsetDeficit r := by
  classical
  intro S hS hproper
  have hE := hboundary S hS hproper
  have hg : deficitPotential r S (image r S \ S) < (image r S \ S).card := by
    apply strict_deficit_of_augmentation (image r S \ S) hE
      (deficitPotential r S)
    · simp [deficitPotential]
    · intro T hT hTproper
      exact deficitPotential_step r hr hcounter hminimal S T hT hTproper
  rw [deficitPotential_terminal] at hg
  exact hg

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mod.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.IsOriented
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mod.text:
structure IsOriented (r : V → V → Prop) : Prop where
  loopless : ∀ v, ¬ r v v
  asymmetric : ∀ {u v}, r u v → ¬ r v u

variable [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

noncomputable section

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Red.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.StrictSubsetGrowth
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Red.text:
def StrictSubsetGrowth (r : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ S : Finset V, S.Nonempty → S ≠ Finset.univ →
    S.card + (image r (image r S)).card < 2 * (image r S).card

omit [DecidableEq V] in

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.diagonal
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
def diagonal : Finset (V × V) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun z => z.1 = z.2)

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mod.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.GoodVertex
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mod.text:
def GoodVertex (r : V → V → Prop) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (firstNeighbors r v).card ≤ (secondNeighbors r v).card

end

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.H_candidates_card_le_uncovered
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
theorem H_candidates_card_le_uncovered (r : V → V → Prop) (P Q : Finset (V × V)) :
    (H r (leftCandidate r Q) (rightCandidate r P)).card ≤ (uncovered r P Q).card :=
  Finset.card_le_card (H_candidates_subset_uncovered r P Q)

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Pru.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.PruningStatement
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Pru.text:
def PruningStatement (r : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ R C : Finset (V × V), ∃ R' C', PruningResult r R C R' C'

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.no_strictSubsetGrowth_of_pruning
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
theorem no_strictSubsetGrowth_of_pruning {r : V → V → Prop}
    (hr : IsOriented r) (hpos : PositiveIndegree r)
    (hprune : PruningStatement r) : ¬ StrictSubsetGrowth r := by
  classical
  intro hgrowth
  obtain ⟨P, Q, h, hmax⟩ := exists_maximizing_pair r (Admissible r)
    ⟨diagonal, diagonal, diagonal_admissible hr⟩
  obtain ⟨P', Q', hp⟩ := hprune (leftCandidate r Q) (rightCandidate r P)
  have hnext : Admissible r P' Q' := pruning_preserves_diagonal h hp
  have hH : (H r (leftCandidate r Q) (rightCandidate r P)).card ≤
      uncoveredCount r P Q := by
    exact H_candidates_card_le_uncovered r P Q
  have hbetter := objective_lt_of_pruning hp hH (complement_gain h hpos hgrowth)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmax P' Q' hnext)) hbetter

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mod.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.firstNeighbors
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mod.text:
def firstNeighbors (r : V → V → Prop) (v : V) : Finset V := by

  exact Finset.univ.filter (r v)

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Aug.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.exists_augmented_maximum_matching
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Aug.text:
theorem exists_augmented_maximum_matching (r : V → V → Prop)
    (R C : Finset (V × V)) :
    ∃ M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C),
      IsMaximumMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M ∧
      IsMaximumMatching (AlphaRelation r R C) (alphaEdges M) ∧
      IsMaximumMatching (BetaRelation r R C) (betaEdges M) := by
  classical
  have hblock : ∀ a b, AugmentedEdge r R C a b → b.isRight → a.isLeft := by
    intro a b hab hb
    cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [AugmentedEdge]
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hα, hβ⟩ := exists_maximum_matching_with_maximum_blocks
    (fun a : LeftVertex r R C => a.isLeft)
    (fun b : RightVertex r R C => b.isRight) hblock
  exact ⟨M, hM, alphaEdges_isMaximumMatching hM.1 hα,
    betaEdges_isMaximumMatching hM.1 hβ⟩

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.Admissible
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
structure Admissible (r : V → V → Prop) (P Q : Finset (V × V)) : Prop where
  compatible : Compatible r P Q
  diagonal_left : diagonal ⊆ P
  diagonal_right : diagonal ⊆ Q

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Min.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.exists_minimal_counterexample
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Min.text:
theorem exists_minimal_counterexample [Nonempty V] {r : V → V → Prop}
    (hr : IsOriented r) (hbad : Counterexample r) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ s : Fin n → Fin n → Prop,
      IsOriented s ∧ Counterexample s ∧ ArcMinimal s ∧
        NonemptyBoundary s ∧ PositiveIndegree s := by
  classical
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n => 0 < n ∧ ∃ s : Fin n → Fin n → Prop,
    IsOriented s ∧ Counterexample s
  have hex : ∃ n, P n := by
    refine ⟨Fintype.card V, Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance,
      reindex (Fintype.equivFin V) r, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact isOriented_reindex (Fintype.equivFin V) hr
    · exact counterexample_reindex (Fintype.equivFin V) hbad
  let n := Nat.find hex
  obtain ⟨hn, t, ht, htb⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have harcs : ∃ a : ℕ, ∃ s : Fin n → Fin n → Prop,
      IsOriented s ∧ Counterexample s ∧ (arcSet s).card = a :=
    ⟨(arcSet t).card, t, ht, htb, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsb, hscard⟩ := Nat.find_spec harcs
  have hsmin : ArcMinimal s := by
    intro u hu hub
    rw [hscard]
    exact Nat.find_min' harcs ⟨u, hu, hub, rfl⟩
  have hsorder : OrderMinimal s := by
    intro k hk u hu hub
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using (Nat.find_min' hex ⟨hk, u, hu, hub⟩)
  have hboundary := hsorder.nonemptyBoundary hs hsb
  exact ⟨n, hn, s, hs, hsb, hsmin, hboundary,
    hboundary.positiveIndegree hs hsb⟩

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.pruning_preserves_diagonal
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
theorem pruning_preserves_diagonal {r : V → V → Prop}
    {P Q P' Q' : Finset (V × V)} (h : Admissible r P Q)
    (hp : PruningResult r (leftCandidate r Q) (rightCandidate r P) P' Q') :
    Admissible r P' Q' where
  compatible := hp.no_conflicts
  diagonal_left := by
    intro a ha
    exact hp.retain_left a
      (diagonal_subset_leftCandidate h.compatible h.diagonal_left ha)
      (diagonal_left_conflictFree h.diagonal_left ha)
  diagonal_right := by
    intro b hb
    exact hp.retain_right b
      (diagonal_subset_rightCandidate h.compatible h.diagonal_right hb)
      (diagonal_right_conflictFree h.diagonal_right hb)

end
end SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.uncoveredCount
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
def uncoveredCount (r : V → V → Prop) (P Q : Finset (V × V)) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ \ (leftImage r P ∪ rightImage r Q)).card

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Tra.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.blowup_isOriented
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Tra.text:
theorem blowup_isOriented {r : V → V → Prop} (hr : IsOriented r) (m : ℕ) :
    IsOriented (blowup r m) := by
  constructor
  · intro p hp
    rcases hp with hp | ⟨_, hp⟩
    · exact hr.loopless p.1 hp
    · exact (lt_irrefl p.2) hp
  · intro p q hpq hqp
    rcases hpq with hpq | ⟨heq, hlt⟩
    · rcases hqp with hqp | ⟨heq, _⟩
      · exact hr.asymmetric hpq hqp
      · apply hr.loopless p.1
        simpa only [heq] using hpq
    · rcases hqp with hqp | ⟨_, hgt⟩
      · apply hr.loopless q.1
        simpa only [heq] using hqp
      · exact (not_lt_of_gt hlt) hgt

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mod.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.secondNeighbors
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mod.text:
def secondNeighbors (r : V → V → Prop) (v : V) : Finset V := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun w =>
    w ≠ v ∧ ¬ r v w ∧ ∃ u, r v u ∧ r u w)

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Red.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.PositiveIndegree
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Red.text:
def PositiveIndegree (r : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, ∃ u, r u v

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Bas.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.SecondNeighborhoodConjecture

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Extremal.complement_gain
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Ext.text:
theorem complement_gain {r : V → V → Prop} {P Q : Finset (V × V)}
    (h : Admissible r P Q) (hpos : PositiveIndegree r)
    (hgrowth : StrictSubsetGrowth r) :
    P.card + Q.card + 2 * uncoveredCount r P Q <
      (leftCandidate r Q).card + (rightCandidate r P).card := by
  classical
  have hleft := h.strict_leftImage_growth hpos hgrowth
  have hright := h.strict_rightImage_growth hpos hgrowth
  have huncovered := uncoveredCount_add_images h.compatible
  have hR : (leftCandidate r Q).card +
      (rightImage r (rightImage r Q)).card = (Finset.univ : Finset (V × V)).card :=
    Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.subset_univ _)
  have hC : (rightCandidate r P).card +
      (leftImage r (leftImage r P)).card = (Finset.univ : Finset (V × V)).card :=
    Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.subset_univ _)
  omega

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Tra.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.blowup_positiveIndegree
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Tra.text:
theorem blowup_positiveIndegree {r : V → V → Prop}
    (hi : PositiveIndegree r) (m : ℕ) : PositiveIndegree (blowup r m) := by
  intro p
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hi p.1
  exact ⟨(v, p.2), Or.inl hv⟩

variable [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mai.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.exists_goodVertex
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Mai.text:
theorem exists_goodVertex (r : V → V → Prop) (hr : IsOriented r) :
    ∃ v, GoodVertex r v := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  have hcounter : Counterexample r := (counterexample_iff_not_conjecture r).mpr h
  obtain ⟨n, hn, g, hg, hpos, hgrowth⟩ := counterexample_reduction hr hcounter
  let : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
  exact Extremal.no_strictSubsetGrowth_of_pruning hg hpos (Pruning.pruning g) hgrowth

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Red.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.counterexample_reduction
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Red.text:
theorem counterexample_reduction {r : V → V → Prop}
    (hr : IsOriented r) (hcounter : Counterexample r) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧
      ∃ g : (Fin n × Fin (n + 1)) → (Fin n × Fin (n + 1)) → Prop,
        IsOriented g ∧ PositiveIndegree g ∧ StrictSubsetGrowth g := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, hn, s, hs, hbad, hminimal, hboundary, hindegree⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_counterexample hr hcounter
  refine ⟨n, hn, blowup s (n + 1), blowup_isOriented hs (n + 1),
    blowup_positiveIndegree hindegree (n + 1), ?_⟩
  apply blowup_strictSubsetGrowth hs hindegree
    (subsetDeficit_of_minimal hs hbad hminimal hboundary)
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Nat.lt_succ_self n

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Aug.name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.augmented_matching_card_le_corners
OAI.Combinatorics.SecondNeighborhood.Aug.text:
theorem augmented_matching_card_le_corners
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X))
    (M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C))
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M)
    (hα : IsMaximumMatching (AlphaRelation r R C) (alphaEdges M))
    (hβ : IsMaximumMatching (BetaRelation r R C) (betaEdges M)) :
    M.card ≤ (Z r R C).card + (H r R C).card := by
  classical
  have hαrelation : matrixLSupport r R C = AlphaRelation r R C := by
    funext z a
    exact propext (matrixLSupport_iff_leftCovers r R C z a)
  have hβrelation : matrixNTransposeSupport r R C = BetaRelation r R C := by
    funext z b
    exact propext (matrixNTransposeSupport_iff_rightCovers r R C z b)
  have hα' : IsMaximumMatching (matrixLSupport r R C) (alphaEdges M) := by
    rw [hαrelation]
    exact hα
  have hβ' : IsMaximumMatching (matrixNTransposeSupport r R C) (betaEdges M) := by
    rw [hβrelation]
    exact hβ
  have hOriginal := originalEdges_isMatching hM
  have hleft : Function.Injective (fun e : ↥(originalEdges M) => e.val.1) := by
    intro e f hef
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hOriginal.2.1 e.property f.property hef
  have hright : Function.Injective (fun e : ↥(originalEdges M) => e.val.2) := by
    intro e f hef
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hOriginal.2.2 e.property f.property hef
  have hbound := original_add_auxiliary_card_le_corners
    r R C (alphaEdges M) (betaEdges M) hα' hβ'
    (fun e : ↥(originalEdges M) => e.val.1)
    (fun e : ↥(originalEdges M) => e.val.2) hleft hright
    (fun e f => original_alpha_left_ne hM e.property f.property)
    (fun e f => original_beta_right_ne hM e.property f.property)
    (fun e => hOriginal.1 e.val e.property)
  rw [augmented_matching_card hM]
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using hbound

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Currents.Basic.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.integerRectifiable_zero

lemma integerRectifiable_zero (k : ℕ) :

  · intro i

  | succ k =>
    refine ⟨isMetricCurrent_zero _, integerRectifiable_zero _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [boundarySucc_zero]

    · rw [boundarySucc_zero]
      exact integerRectifiable_zero k

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Transport.Prop.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.integral_push_proper
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Transport.Prop.text:
lemma integral_push_proper [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X k} (hT : IsIntegral k T)
    {f : X → Y} (hf : LipschitzWith 1 f) : IsIntegral k (pushCurrent f T) := by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact ⟨pushCurrent_isMetricCurrent hT.1 hf,integerRectifiable_push_proper hT.2 hf⟩
  | succ k =>
    refine ⟨pushCurrent_isMetricCurrent hT.1 hf,integerRectifiable_push_proper hT.2.1 hf,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [pushCurrent_boundarySucc T hf]
      exact pushCurrent_isMetricCurrent hT.2.2.1 hf
    · rw [pushCurrent_boundarySucc T hf]
      exact integerRectifiable_push_proper hT.2.2.2 hf

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Transport.Prop.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.mass_push_one_general
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Transport.Prop.text:
lemma mass_push_one_general {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X k} (hT : IsMetricCurrent T)
    {f : X → Y} (hf : LipschitzWith 1 f) : mass (pushCurrent f T) ≤ mass T := by
  apply le_csInf
  · obtain ⟨μ,hμ,hc⟩ := hT.finiteMass
    exact ⟨μ.real univ,μ,hμ,hc,rfl⟩
  · rintro r ⟨μ,hμ,hc,rfl⟩
    let := hμ
    have hh := pushCurrent_controls hT hc hf
    simp only [one_pow,ENNReal.coe_one,one_smul] at hh
    have hl := mass_le_measure (T := pushCurrent f T) (μ := μ.map f) inferInstance hh
    simpa only [Measure.real,Measure.map_apply hf.continuous.measurable MeasurableSet.univ,
      preimage_univ] using hl

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Main:111.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.sharp_integral_filling
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Main:111.text:
theorem sharp_integral_filling
    (X : Type u) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [ProperSpace X]
    (hX : IsCAT0 X) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (T : IntegralCurrent X n)
    (hTc : CompactlySupported T.val) (hTz : IsCycle T.val) :
    ∃ S : IntegralCurrent X (n + 1), CompactlySupported S.val ∧
      boundarySucc S.val = T.val ∧
      mass S.val ≤ fillingCoefficient n * (mass T.val) ^ fillingPower n := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  have hnEq : n = k+2 := by omega
  clear hk
  subst n
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hE | hN
  · have hT0 : T.val = 0 := by
      funext b π
      by_cases hab : Admissible b π
      · have heq : b = fun _ => 0 := funext fun x => isEmptyElim x
        rw [heq]
        simpa using T.property.1.linearFirst (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) π 0 0
          (BoundedLip.const 0) (BoundedLip.const 0) hab.2
      · exact T.property.1.offDomain b π hab
    refine ⟨⟨0,isIntegral_zero _⟩,compactlySupported_zero _,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [hT0]; exact boundarySucc_zero _
    · rw [show mass (0 : Functional X (k+2+1)) = 0 from mass_zero _]
      exact mul_nonneg (fillingCoefficient_pos (by omega)).le (Real.rpow_nonneg (mass_nonneg _) _)
  · obtain ⟨S,hS,hSc,hSb,hSm⟩ := proper_filling_bound hX T.property hTc hTz
    exact ⟨⟨S,hS⟩,hSc,hSb,hSm⟩
end CAT0Fillings
end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Fillings.Compa.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.compact_filling_bound
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Fillings.Compa.text:
theorem compact_filling_bound : ∀ k : ℕ,
    ∀ (X : Type u) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X],
      IsCAT0 X → ∀ T : Functional X (k+2), IsIntegral (k+2) T → boundarySucc T = 0 →
        fillingVolume T ≤ fillingCoefficient (k+2)*(mass T)^(fillingPower (k+2)) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro X _ _ _ _ _ hX T hT hz
    exact fillingVolume_le_two hX hT hz
  | succ k ih =>
    intro X _ _ _ _ _ hX T hT hz
    apply fillingVolume_le_of_coefficient hX ?_ hT hz
    intro U hU hUz c hc hm hext
    exact extremal_coefficient_high (by omega) hX hU hUz hc hm ih hext
end CAT0Fillings
end

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Currents.Basic.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.mass_zero
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Currents.Basic.text:
@[simp] lemma mass_zero (k : ℕ) : mass (fun (_ : X → ℝ) (_ : Fin k → X → ℝ) => 0) = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h : Controls (fun (_ : X → ℝ) (_ : Fin k → X → ℝ) => 0) (0 : Measure X) := by
      intro b π hb hπ
      simp
    simpa using mass_le_measure (μ := (0 : Measure X)) inferInstance h
  · exact mass_nonneg _

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Currents.Pushf.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.CurrentOperations.pushCurrent_comp
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Currents.Pushf.text:
lemma pushCurrent_comp {Z : Type*} [MetricSpace Z] {k : ℕ} {T : Functional X k}
    {f : X → Y} {g : Y → Z} {L : ℝ≥0} (hg : LipschitzWith L g) :
    pushCurrent (g ∘ f) T = pushCurrent g (pushCurrent f T) := by
  funext b π
  by_cases h : Admissible b π
  · rw [pushCurrent_apply (g ∘ f) T h, pushCurrent_apply g (pushCurrent f T) h,
      pushCurrent_apply f T (admissible_comp h hg)]
    rfl
  · simp only [pushCurrent, ite_eq_right h]

end CurrentOperations

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Currents.Basic.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.mass_le_measure

  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩

  · exact ⟨μ, hμ, hT, rfl⟩

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Transport.Supp.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.pushCurrent_eq_of_ball_support
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Transport.Supp.text:
lemma pushCurrent_eq_of_ball_support [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {n : ℕ} {T : Functional X n} (hT : IsMetricCurrent T)
    {K : Set X} (hK : ∀ b π, Admissible b π → (∀ x ∈ K, b x = 0) → T b π = 0)
    (o : X) (R : ℝ) (hKR : K ⊆ closedBall o R) {P : X → X}
    (hP : LipschitzWith 1 P) (hfix : ∀ x, dist x o ≤ R+2 → P x = x) : pushCurrent P T = T := by
  funext b π
  by_cases hab : Admissible b π
  · rw [pushCurrent_apply P T hab]
    let c := fun x => ballCutoff o R x*b x
    have hc : BoundedLip c := (ballCutoff_boundedLip o R).mul hab.1
    have hπP : ∀ i, ∃ L, LipschitzWith L (π i ∘ P) := (admissible_comp hab hP).2
    calc
      T (b ∘ P) (fun i => π i ∘ P) = T c (fun i => π i ∘ P) := by
        apply hT.first_congr_support hK (boundedLip_comp hab.1 hP) hc hπP
        intro x hx
        have hxR := hKR hx
        have hfixx := hfix x (by have := hxR; change dist x o ≤ R at this; linarith)
        simp only [Function.comp_apply,hfixx,c,ballCutoff_one o R hxR,one_mul]
      _ = T c π := by
        apply hT.coord_congr_on hc hπP hab.2 (U := ball o (R+1)) isOpen_ball ?_ ?_
        · intro x hx
          apply ballCutoff_support o R
          intro hz
          exact hx (by simp only [c,hz,zero_mul])
        · intro i x hx
          rw [Function.comp_apply,hfix x (by change dist x o < R+1 at hx; linarith)]
      _ = T b π := by
        apply hT.first_congr_support hK hc hab.1 hab.2
        intro x hx
        simp only [c,ballCutoff_one o R (hKR hx),one_mul]
  · simp only [pushCurrent,ite_eq_right hab,hT.offDomain b π hab]
end CAT0Fillings
end

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Main:61.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.proper_filling_bound
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Main:61.text:
lemma proper_filling_bound [Nonempty X] (hX : IsCAT0 X) {k : ℕ}
    {T : Functional X (k+2)} (hT : IsIntegral (k+2) T) (hTc : CompactlySupported T)
    (hz : boundarySucc T = 0) :
    ∃ S : Functional X (k+3), IsIntegral (k+3) S ∧ CompactlySupported S ∧
      boundarySucc S = T ∧ mass S ≤ fillingCoefficient (k+2)*(mass T)^(fillingPower (k+2)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hTK⟩ := hTc
  let o : X := Classical.choice inferInstance
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hKR⟩ := hK.isBounded.subset_closedBall_lt 0 o
  obtain ⟨P,hP,hPr,hPf⟩ := hX.exists_ball_retraction o (R := R+2) (by linarith)
  let B := closedBall o (R+2)
  have : Nonempty B := ⟨o,by simp [B]; linarith⟩
  let p : X → B := fun x => ⟨P x,by simpa only [B,mem_closedBall,dist_comm] using hPr x⟩
  have hp : LipschitzWith 1 p := hP
  have hinc : LipschitzWith 1 (Subtype.val : B → X) := LipschitzWith.subtype_val B
  have hiA : AntilipschitzWith 1 (Subtype.val : B → X) := by
    intro x y
    change edist (x : X) (y : X) ≤ (1:ℝ≥0∞)*edist (x : X) (y : X)
    rw [one_mul]
  let U := pushCurrent p T
  have hU : IsIntegral (k+2) U := integral_push_proper hT hp
  have hUz : boundarySucc U = 0 := pushCurrent_cycle hz hp
  have hUm : mass U ≤ mass T := mass_push_one_general hT.1 hp
  have hB : IsCAT0 B := hX.closedBall o (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hVb,hVm⟩ := hB.exists_minimal_integral_filling hU hUz
  let S := pushCurrent (Subtype.val : B → X) V
  have hS : IsIntegral (k+3) S := integral_push_of_bilipschitz hV hinc hiA
  have hb : boundarySucc S = T := by
    rw [pushCurrent_boundarySucc V hinc,hVb,←pushCurrent_comp hinc]
    exact pushCurrent_eq_of_ball_support hT.1 hTK o R hKR hP
      (fun x hx => hPf x (by rwa [dist_comm]))
  refine ⟨S,hS,?_,hb,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨B,isCompact_closedBall o (R+2),?_⟩
    intro b π hab hbK
    change pushCurrent (Subtype.val : B → X) V b π = 0
    rw [pushCurrent_apply _ _ hab]
    have heq : b ∘ (Subtype.val : B → X) = fun _ => 0 := funext fun x => hbK x x.property
    rw [heq]
    have hπ := (admissible_comp hab hinc).2
    simpa using hV.1.linearFirst (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun i => π i ∘ Subtype.val)
      0 0 (BoundedLip.const 0) (BoundedLip.const 0) hπ
  · calc
      mass S ≤ mass V := mass_push_one_general hV.1 hinc
      _ = fillingVolume U := hVm
      _ ≤ fillingCoefficient (k+2)*(mass U)^(fillingPower (k+2)) := compact_filling_bound k B hB U hU hUz
      _ ≤ fillingCoefficient (k+2)*(mass T)^(fillingPower (k+2)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow (mass_nonneg U) hUm
          (le_of_lt (lt_trans zero_lt_one (fillingPower_gt_one (by omega)))))
          (fillingCoefficient_pos (by omega)).le

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Currents.PushB.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.CurrentOperations.pushCurrent_boundarySucc
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Currents.PushB.text:
lemma pushCurrent_boundarySucc {k : ℕ} (T : Functional X (k+1))
    {f : X → Y} {K : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith K f) :
    boundarySucc (pushCurrent f T) = pushCurrent f (boundarySucc T) := by
  funext b π
  by_cases h : Admissible b π
  · have hcons : Admissible (fun _ : Y => (1 : ℝ)) (Matrix.vecCons b π) := by
      refine ⟨BoundedLip.const 1, ?_⟩
      intro i
      refine Fin.cases h.1.1 (fun j => h.2 j) i
    rw [boundarySucc, ite_eq_left h, pushCurrent_apply f T hcons,
      pushCurrent_apply f (boundarySucc T) h, boundarySucc,
      ite_eq_left (admissible_comp h hf)]
    congr 1
    funext i x
    exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
  · simp only [boundarySucc, pushCurrent, ite_eq_right h]

abbrev Functional (X : Type u) (k : ℕ) := (X → ℝ) → (Fin k → X → ℝ) → ℝ

OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Geometry.Ball:.name: OAI.CAT0Fillings.IsCAT0.closedBall
OAI.Geometry.CAT0Fillings.Geometry.Ball:.text:
theorem IsCAT0.closedBall {X : Type u} [MetricSpace X] (hX : IsCAT0 X)
    (o : X) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) : IsCAT0 (Metric.closedBall o R) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hd, hc⟩ := hX
  have hconv (x y : Metric.closedBall o R) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      s x.val y.val t ∈ Metric.closedBall o R := by
    have hh := hc x.val y.val o t 1 ht (by simp)
    rw [(hs x.val o).2] at hh
    have he : (t * dist x.val y.val - 1 * dist x.val o) ^ 2 +
          t * 1 * (dist y.val o ^ 2 - (dist x.val y.val - dist x.val o) ^ 2) =
        (1 - t) * dist x.val o ^ 2 + t * dist y.val o ^ 2 -
          t * (1 - t) * dist x.val y.val ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [he] at hh
    have hx := (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg hR).mpr x.property
    have hy := (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg hR).mpr y.property
    have hx' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)
    have hy' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy ht.1
    have hh' : dist (s x.val y.val t) o ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2))
        (sq_nonneg (dist x.val y.val))]
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ dist_nonneg hR).mp hh'
  let clamp : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => max 0 (min 1 t)
  have hclamp (t : ℝ) : clamp t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    exact ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  have hclamp_eq (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : clamp t = t := by
    simp only [clamp, min_eq_right ht.2, max_eq_right ht.1]
  let sB : Metric.closedBall o R → Metric.closedBall o R → ℝ →
      Metric.closedBall o R := fun x y t => ⟨s x.val y.val (clamp t), hconv x y _ (hclamp t)⟩
  refine ⟨sB, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change s x.val y.val (clamp 0) = x.val
      rw [hclamp_eq _ (by simp), (hs x.val y.val).1]
    · change s x.val y.val (clamp 1) = y.val
      rw [hclamp_eq _ (by simp), (hs x.val y.val).2]
  · intro x y u v hu hv
    change dist (s x.val y.val (clamp u)) (s x.val y.val (clamp v)) = _
    rw [hclamp_eq _ hu, hclamp_eq _ hv]
    exact hd x.val y.val u v hu hv
  · intro p x y u v hu hv
    change dist (s p.val x.val (clamp u)) (s p.val y.val (clamp v)) ^ 2 ≤ _
    rw [hclamp_eq _ hu, hclamp_eq _ hv]
    exact hc p.val x.val y.val u v hu hv

end CAT0Fillings
end

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Constructi.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.LowerTransfer.actual_prime_construction
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Constructi.text:
theorem actual_prime_construction (i : ℕ) : PrimeConstruction (i+3) := by
  intro η hη hηu
  have hσ:=Marking.eventually_graph_witness i η hη (by linarith : η ≤ 1)
  have ht : Tendsto (fun q : ℕ=>log (q:ℝ)) atTop atTop:=
    tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually hσ,InitialExperiment.eventually_source_sizes i η hη.le]
    with q hgraph hsize
  intro hq
  have : Fact q.Prime:=⟨hq⟩
  have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < q:=by exact_mod_cast hq.pos
  exact hgraph q hsize.1 (exp_log hq0) _ _ hsize.2.2.1 hsize.2.2.2.1
    hsize.2.2.2.2.1 hsize.2.2.2.2.2.1 hsize.2.2.2.2.2.2

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Sam.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.Upper.ramsey_upper
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Sam.text:
theorem ramsey_upper {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
      (ramsey s t : ℝ) ≤ C*(t:ℝ)^(s-1)/(Real.log (t:ℝ))^(s-2) := by
  obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hs
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hCb⟩ := ramsey_upper_scaled j
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  have H : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      (ramsey (3+j) t : ℝ) ≤ C*(t:ℝ)^(3+j-1)/(Real.log (t:ℝ))^(3+j-2) := by
    filter_upwards [hCb, eventually_ge_atTop (2:ℕ)] with t ht ht2
    have hl : 0 < Real.log (t:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < t by omega))
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hl _)).mpr
    simpa [show 3+j = j+3 from by omega] using ht
  exact eventually_atTop.mp H

end SharpLogRamsey.Upper

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Constructi.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.LowerTransfer.prime_construction
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Constructi.text:
theorem prime_construction (d : ℕ) (hd : 5 ≤ d) : PrimeConstruction d := by
  have he : d-3+3=d:=by omega
  simpa only [he] using actual_prime_construction (d-3)
end
end SharpLogRamsey.LowerTransfer

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Fro.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.mainLimit_of_mainBounds
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Fro.text:
theorem mainLimit_of_mainBounds (s : ℕ) (h : MainBounds s) : MainLimit s := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := h
  have hlog : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => Real.log (t:ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hloglog : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => Real.log (Real.log (t:ℝ)))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hlog
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨t₀,ht₀⟩ := h (ε/2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨t₁,ht₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    (hloglog.eventually (Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (max 0 (2*|Real.log C|/ε))))
  refine ⟨max (max t₀ t₁) 2, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have htl : t₀≤t := (le_max_left t₀ t₁).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht)
  have htll : t₁≤t := (le_max_right t₀ t₁).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht)
  have ht2 : 2≤t := (le_max_right _ _).trans ht
  have htp : (0:ℝ)<t := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0<t)
  have hlt : 0<Real.log (t:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1<t))
  have hll0 : 0<Real.log (Real.log (t:ℝ)) := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt (ht₁ t htll)
  have hllbig : 2*|Real.log C|/ε<Real.log (Real.log (t:ℝ)) :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt (ht₁ t htll)
  obtain ⟨hl,hu⟩ := ht₀ t htl
  have hp : 0<(t:ℝ)^(s-1)/Real.rpow (Real.log (t:ℝ)) ((s-2:ℕ)+(ε/2)) :=
    div_pos (pow_pos htp _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlt _)
  have hr : 0<(ramsey s t:ℝ) := hp.trans_le hl
  have hl' := Real.log_le_log hp hl
  change Real.log ((t:ℝ)^(s-1)/(Real.log (t:ℝ))^(((s-2:ℕ):ℝ)+ε/2)) ≤ Real.log (ramsey s t:ℝ) at hl'
  rw [Real.log_div (pow_ne_zero (s-1) (ne_of_gt htp))
    (ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlt (((s-2:ℕ):ℝ)+(ε/2)))), Real.log_pow,Real.log_rpow hlt] at hl'
  have hu' := Real.log_le_log hr hu
  rw [Real.log_div (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hC) (pow_ne_zero (s-1) (ne_of_gt htp)))
    (pow_ne_zero (s-2) (ne_of_gt hlt)), Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hC)
      (pow_ne_zero (s-1) (ne_of_gt htp)),Real.log_pow,Real.log_pow] at hu'
  have herr : |Real.log C| < (ε/2)*Real.log (Real.log (t:ℝ)) := by
    have he := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp hllbig
    nlinarith
  have hlow : ((s-2:ℕ):ℝ)-ε/2 <
    (((s-1:ℕ):ℝ)*Real.log (t:ℝ)-Real.log (ramsey s t:ℝ))/
      Real.log (Real.log (t:ℝ)) := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hll0).mpr
    have habs := le_abs_self (Real.log C)
    nlinarith
  have hupp : (((s-1:ℕ):ℝ)*Real.log (t:ℝ)-Real.log (ramsey s t:ℝ))/
      Real.log (Real.log (t:ℝ)) ≤ ((s-2:ℕ):ℝ)+ε/2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hll0).mpr
    nlinarith
  rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith
end SharpLogRamsey

namespace SharpLogRamsey

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Model:16.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.MainBounds
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Model:16.text:
def MainBounds (s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
      (t : ℝ) ^ (s - 1) / Real.rpow (Real.log (t : ℝ)) ((s - 2 : ℕ) + ε)
        ≤ (ramsey s t : ℝ) ∧
      (ramsey s t : ℝ) ≤ C * (t : ℝ) ^ (s - 1) /
        (Real.log (t : ℝ)) ^ (s - 2)

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Fro.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.main_of_primeConstruction
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Fro.text:
theorem main_of_primeConstruction (s : ℕ) (hs : 6 ≤ s)
    (hprime : LowerTransfer.PrimeConstruction (s-1)) : MainBounds s ∧ MainLimit s := by
  have hb : MainBounds s := by
    obtain ⟨C,hC,t₀,ht₀⟩ := Upper.ramsey_upper (by omega : 3 ≤ s)
    refine ⟨C,hC,fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    have hl := LowerTransfer.all_epsilon_lower (s-1) (by omega) hprime ε hε
    have he : s-1+1=s := by omega
    have he' : s-1-1=s-2 := by omega
    rw [he,he'] at hl
    obtain ⟨t₁,ht₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hl
    exact ⟨max t₀ t₁,fun t ht => ⟨ht₁ t ((le_max_right _ _).trans ht),
      ht₀ t ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht)⟩⟩
  exact ⟨hb,mainLimit_of_mainBounds s hb⟩
end SharpLogRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Main:12.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.main
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Main:12.text:
theorem main (s : ℕ) (hs : 6 ≤ s) : MainBounds s ∧ MainLimit s :=
  main_of_primeConstruction s hs (LowerTransfer.prime_construction (s-1) (by omega))
end SharpLogRamsey

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Low.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.LowerTransfer.PrimeConstruction
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Low.text:
def PrimeConstruction (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η < 1/10 → ∀ᶠ q : ℕ in atTop,
    q.Prime → ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin ⌊(q:ℝ)^d * Real.log q⌋₊),
      G.CliqueFree (d+1) ∧ G.indepNum < ⌊(q:ℝ) * (Real.log q)^(1+η)⌋₊

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Model:24.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.MainLimit
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Model:24.text:
def MainLimit (s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun t : ℕ =>
      (((s - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (t : ℝ) - Real.log (ramsey s t : ℝ)) /
        Real.log (Real.log (t : ℝ)))
    Filter.atTop (nhds ((s - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ))

end SharpLogRamsey

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Low.name: OAI.SharpLogRamsey.LowerTransfer.all_epsilon_lower
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpRamsey.Bounds.Low.text:
theorem all_epsilon_lower (d : ℕ) (hd : 1≤d) (hprime : PrimeConstruction d)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop,
      (t:ℝ)^d/(Real.log t)^(((d-1:ℕ):ℝ)+ε) ≤ (ramsey (d+1) t :ℝ) := by
  let η := min (1/20:ℝ) (ε/(2*(d:ℝ)))
  have hd0 : 0<(d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<d by omega)
  have hη : 0<η := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hη' : η<1/10 := (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hηε : (d:ℝ)*η<ε := by

    have he : (d:ℝ)*(ε/(2*(d:ℝ)))=ε/2 := by field_simp
    rw [he] at h

  exact lower_from_prime_construction d hd hprime η ε hη hη' hηε

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpThreshold.SharpTh.name: OAI.Problem313.graphQuantile_width_of_variance_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.SharpThreshold.SharpTh.text:
theorem graphQuantile_width_of_variance_bound {n : ℕ} {f : GraphConfig n → Bool}
    {C ε : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hmono : IncreasingGraphProperty f) (hnt : NontrivialGraphProperty f)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (hvariance : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      graphVariance p f ≤ C * totalInfluence p f) :
    graphQuantile (1 - ε) f - graphQuantile ε f ≤
      (4 * C) * Real.log (1 / (2 * ε)) := by
  have hεone : ε < 1 := by linarith
  have hother0 : 0 < 1 - ε := by linarith
  have hother1 : 1 - ε < 1 := by linarith
  have ha := graphQuantile_mem_Ioo hmono hnt hε hεone
  have hb := graphQuantile_mem_Ioo hmono hnt hother0 hother1
  have hab : graphQuantile ε f ≤ graphQuantile (1 - ε) f := by
    exact (graphQuantile_strictMonoOn hmono hnt
      ⟨hε.le, hεone.le⟩ ⟨hother0.le, hother1.le⟩ (by linarith)).le
  have hrange : ∀ p ∈ Set.Icc (graphQuantile ε f) (graphQuantile (1 - ε) f),
      p ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨ha.1.trans_le hp.1, hp.2.trans_lt hb.2⟩
  have hlog : graphQuantile (1 - ε) f - graphQuantile ε f ≤
      2 * C * Real.log ((1 - ε) / ε) := by
    apply logistic_width_of_hasDerivAt
      (μ := fun p => graphMean p f) (μ' := fun p => totalInfluence p f)
      hab hε hεone (continuous_graphMean f).continuousOn
    · intro p hp
      exact graphMean_mem_Ioo (hrange p hp).1 (hrange p hp).2 hnt
    · intro p hp
      exact hasDerivAt_graphMean hmono p
    · intro p hp
      have hv := hvariance p (hrange p (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hp))
      simpa only [graphVariance_eq_mean_mul] using hv
    · exact graphMean_graphQuantile hmono hnt hε.le hεone.le
    · exact graphMean_graphQuantile hmono hnt hother0.le hother1.le
  exact threshold_log_conversion C ε
    (graphQuantile (1 - ε) f - graphQuantile ε f) hC hε hεhalf hlog

OAI.Combinatorics.SharpThreshold.SharpTh.text:
theorem sharp_threshold_width_of_variance_bound
    (hvariance : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : GraphConfig n → Bool) (p : ℝ),
      2 ≤ n → VertexInvariant f → 0 < p → p < 1 →
      graphVariance p f ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ 17 / (Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) *
        totalInfluence p f) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : GraphConfig n → Bool) (ε : ℝ),

          Real.log (1 / (2 * ε)) := by

  have h := graphQuantile_width_of_variance_bound
    (C := (2 : ℝ) ^ 17 / (Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 2)
    (by positivity) hmono hnt hε hεhalf
    (fun p hp => hvariance n f p hn hinvariant hp.1 hp.2)
  convert h using 1; ring

lemma exists_symmetric_kernel : Nonempty SymmetricCounterKernel := by
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := exists_oriented_kernel
  let Ω := W.X × W.Y
  let p := W.left.prod W.right
  let V := crossedKernel W.value
  let L : ℝ := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun xy : Ω × Ω => V xy.1 xy.2)
  have hL (x y : Ω) : V x y≤L := Finset.le_sup' (fun xy : Ω × Ω => V xy.1 xy.2) (Finset.mem_univ (x,y))
  have hmean : kernelMean p p V=1 := by rw [crossedKernel_mean,W.mean_one,one_pow]
  have hone : 1≤L := by
    rw [←hmean]
    exact p.mean_bound (fun x => p.mean_bound (fun y => hL x y))
  have hpos : 0<L := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hone
  refine ⟨{ Ω := Ω
            law := p
            value := fun x y => V x y/L
            nonneg := fun x y => div_nonneg (crossedKernel_nonneg _ W.nonneg x y) hpos.le
            le_one := fun x y => (div_le_one hpos).mpr (hL x y)
            symm := fun x y => congrArg (fun z => z/L) (crossedKernel_symm _ x y)
            mean_pos := ?_
            gap := ?_ }⟩
  · rw [kernelMean_div,hmean]; exact div_pos zero_lt_one hpos
  · rw [bipartiteMoment_div,kernelMean_div,hmean,div_pow,one_pow]
    apply (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (pow_pos hpos 66)).mpr
    rw [crossedKernel_moment]; exact W.gap
end SidorenkoCounterexample

OAI.NumberTheory.SiegelZeros.Structure.N.text:
theorem exists_fixed_parameters_not_eventually_uniform_bound (C : ℝ) :
    ∃ H : ℕ, 86713344 ≤ H ∧ ∃ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ ∧
      ∀ (q δ : ℕ → ℝ) (C_H : ℝ),
        Tendsto q atTop atTop → Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0) →
        let N : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦ (⌈q k ^ γ⌉₊ : ℝ)
        let U : ℕ → ℝ := fun k ↦ N k ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)
        let D : ℝ := (H : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) / (4 * 97 ^ 2)
        ¬ (∀ᶠ k in atTop,
          1 ≤ 13 / 16 + (C + 13 / 24) * (Real.log (q k) / Real.log (U k)) +
            C * δ k * (Real.log (U k) / Real.log (q k)) +
            (C_H + 13 / 12 * Real.log 8) / Real.log (U k) +
            C / (D * Real.log (U k)) + 3 / (2 * D * U k)) := by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hchoice⟩ := exists_gamma_second_term_bound C
  refine ⟨86713344, le_rfl, γ, hγ, ?_⟩
  intro q δ C_H hq hδ N U D hbound
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  have hU : Tendsto U atTop atTop := (tendsto_scale_natCeil_rpow_atTop hγ).comp hq
  have hlogU := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hU
  have hratio : Tendsto (fun k ↦ Real.log (U k) / Real.log (q k))
      atTop (𝓝 (4 * γ / 3)) := (tendsto_log_scale_natCeil_rpow_div_log hγ).comp hq
  have hδterm : Tendsto (fun k ↦ C * δ k * (Real.log (U k) / Real.log (q k)))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using (hδ.const_mul C).mul hratio
  have hfixed := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := C_H + 13 / 12 * Real.log 8)).div_atTop hlogU
  have hdet₁ := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := C)).div_atTop (hlogU.const_mul_atTop hD)
  have hdet₂ := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (3 : ℝ))).div_atTop
    (hU.const_mul_atTop (by positivity : 0 < 2 * D))
  have herror : Tendsto (fun k ↦ C * δ k * (Real.log (U k) / Real.log (q k)) +

theorem uniform_exclusion_of_actual_cutoff
    (hgeometry : ∀ (H N : ℕ), 2 ≤ H → H ≤ N → 18818 ≤ N →
      ∀ (d : ℤ) (a : ℂ), Squarefree d → d ≠ 1 → d ≠ 2 →
        ∀ ha : a ^ 2 = (d : ℂ), ActualCutoffSpanning H N d a ha) :
