  obtain ⟨C, hC, hC4, hmassAll⟩ := W63.exists_good_mass_for_actual_zeros_normalized
  let H : ℕ := 86713344
  have hH : 2 ≤ H := by norm_num [H]
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hallow⟩ := ParameterChoices.choose_exponent_quotient C hC.le
  obtain ⟨CH, hCH, hmass⟩ := hmassAll H hH
  obtain ⟨z, hindex, hsmall, hq, hgap, hne, hHN, hqR, hN, hU, hratio⟩ :=
    genuine_contrary_sequence_with_parameters failure γ hγ H
  apply false_of_eventual_exists_pivot_master H (by simp [H]) γ C CH
    hγ hCH hallow (fun i => ((z i).q : ℕ)) (fun i => (z i).gap) hq hgap
  filter_upwards [hne, hN.eventually_ge_atTop (max H 18818),
    hU.eventually_ge_atTop 3] with i hi8 hiN hiU
  let : NeZero ((z i).q : ℕ) := ⟨(z i).q.ne_zero⟩
  have hiHN : H ≤ auxiliaryN γ ((z i).q : ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans hiN
  have hiLarge : 18818 ≤ auxiliaryN γ ((z i).q : ℝ) :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans hiN
  have himass := hmass ((z i).q : ℕ) (z i).q_ge_three (z i).χ
    (z i).primitive (z i).nonprincipal (z i).real_character
    (z i).β (auxiliaryU γ ((z i).q : ℝ)) (z i).beta_pos (z i).beta_lt_one
    (z i).zero hiU
  apply exists_actual_character_pivot_master (z i).q_ge_three hi8 (z i).χ
    (z i).primitive (z i).real_character (z i).nonprincipal
    H hH hiHN hiLarge C CH (z i).gap hC4
    (hgeometry H (auxiliaryN γ ((z i).q : ℝ)) hH hiHN hiLarge)

theorem source_real_zero_uniform_master_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ H : ℕ, 86713344 ≤ H → ∃ CH : ℝ,
      ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q], 3 ≤ q → q ≠ 8 →
      ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
        (∀ x : ZMod q, (χ x).im = 0) → χ.IsPrimitive → χ ≠ 1 →
      ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ (β : ℂ) = 0 →
      ∀ N : ℕ, H ≤ N → 18818 ≤ N →
      let U : ℝ := (N : ℝ) ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)
      let D : ℝ := (H : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) / (4 * 97 ^ 2)
      1 ≤ 13 / 16 + (C + 13 / 24) * (Real.log (q : ℝ) / Real.log U) +
        C * ((1 - β) * Real.log (q : ℝ)) * (Real.log U / Real.log (q : ℝ)) +
        (CH + 13 / 12 * Real.log 8) / Real.log U +
        C / (D * Real.log U) + 3 / (2 * D * U) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC, _hC4, CH, hsource⟩ :=
    source_character_global_greedy_determinant_master_bounds
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro H hH
  have hHnat : 0 < H := by omega
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_global_weight_sorted_jet_equiv H hHnat
  refine ⟨CH H, ?_⟩
  intro q _ hq hq8 χ hreal hprim hne
  have hfield := characterField_ne_sourceSqrtTwoField_of_ne_eight q χ hprim
    (real_character_isQuadratic χ hreal) hne hq8
  obtain ⟨d, a, b, _hd, _hdsize, _hddiv, _hdns, _ha, _hb, _hfield, _hdisc,
    _hfund, _hformula, v, _hv, _hint, _hdegree, σ, τ, _hσa, _hσb, _hτa, _hτb,
    _hcard, _hall, _hcomm, hdata⟩ := hsource q χ hreal hprim hne hfield
  intro β hβ0 hβ1 hzero N hHN hN U D
  let n : Fin (N ^ 4) ≃ (Fin 4 → Fin N) :=
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (by simp : Fintype.card (Fin 4 → Fin N) = N ^ 4)).symm
  obtain ⟨g, α, _hg, _hα, hrange, _hmono, _hweight, _hstable,
    Δ, _hΔ, _hΔne, harch, _hdiv, _hraw, hfinite, hlarge⟩ := hdata N H hHnat hHN n e he
  obtain ⟨hpivot₁, hpivot₂, _hSpos, _hmaster⟩ := hlarge hN
  have hS₁eq := sum_embedding_eq_sum_finset_of_range α _ hrange (fun a => (a 0 : ℝ))
  have hS₂eq := sum_embedding_eq_sum_finset_of_range α _ hrange
    (fun a => ((a 1 : ℝ) + a 2))
  rw [← hS₁eq] at hpivot₁
  rw [← hS₂eq] at hpivot₂
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hHnat.trans_le hHN
  have hM : 0 < (N : ℝ) ^ 4 := pow_pos hNpos _
  have hUone : 1 < U := Real.one_lt_rpow
    (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega)) (by norm_num)
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp [D]; positivity
  have hS₁ : D * (N : ℝ) ^ 4 * U ≤ ∑ i, (α i 0 : ℝ) := by
    convert hpivot₁ using 1
    dsimp [D, U]
    ring
  have hratio : (∑ i, ((α i 1 : ℝ) + α i 2)) / (∑ i, (α i 0 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 12 :=
    pivot_ratio_le_one_twelfth (H := (H : ℝ)) (M := (N : ℝ) ^ 4) (U := U)
      (by exact_mod_cast hH) hM (zero_lt_one.trans hUone)
      (by simpa only [U] using hpivot₁)
      (by simpa only [U, neg_div] using hpivot₂)
  have hlower := hfinite β hβ0 hβ1 hzero U (zero_lt_one.trans hUone).le
  have hlogM : Real.log ((N : ℝ) ^ 4) = 3 * Real.log U :=
    log_degree_four_eq_three_log_scale hNpos
  have hlogN : Real.log (N : ℝ) = 3 / 4 * Real.log U :=
    log_eq_three_quarters_log_scale hNpos
  apply FinalComparison.uniform_master_bound hM hUone
    (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < q by omega))) hD hC.le hS₁ hratio hlogM
    ?_ hlower
  simpa only [hlogN] using harch

end WeightedTorusJets

theorem tendsto_natCeil_rpow_atTop {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 < γ) :

OAI.NumberTheory.SiegelZeros.Characters..name: OAI.SiegelZeros.WeightedTorusJets.dirichlet_real_zero_bound
OAI.NumberTheory.SiegelZeros.Characters..text:
theorem dirichlet_real_zero_bound :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q], 3 ≤ q →
      ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ.IsPrimitive → χ ≠ 1 →
        (∀ a : ZMod q, (χ a).im = 0) → ∀ β : ℝ,
          (0 < β ∧ β < 1 ∧ DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ (β : ℂ) = 0) →
            c ≤ (1 - β) * Real.log (q : ℝ) := by
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨q, hq, χ, β, hadm, hqtop, hgap⟩ := exists_contrary_sequence hnot
  obtain ⟨C, _hC, hsource⟩ := source_real_zero_uniform_master_bound
  obtain ⟨H, hH, γ, hγ, hno⟩ := exists_fixed_parameters_not_eventually_uniform_bound C
  obtain ⟨CH, hCH⟩ := hsource H hH
  have hqreal : Tendsto (fun n => (q n : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp hqtop
  apply hno (fun n => (q n : ℝ)) (fun n => (1 - β n) * Real.log (q n : ℝ)) CH hqreal hgap
  have hNtop : Tendsto (fun n => ⌈(q n : ℝ) ^ γ⌉₊) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_natCeil_rpow_atTop hγ).comp hqreal
  filter_upwards [hNtop.eventually_ge_atTop H, hNtop.eventually_ge_atTop 18818,
    hqtop.eventually_ne_atTop 8] with n hnH hnN hn8
  let := hq n
  exact hCH (q n) (hadm n).1 hn8 (χ n) (hadm n).2.2.2.1
    (hadm n).2.1 (hadm n).2.2.1 (β n) (hadm n).2.2.2.2.1
    (hadm n).2.2.2.2.2.1 (hadm n).2.2.2.2.2.2
    ⌈(q n : ℝ) ^ γ⌉₊ hnH hnN

end WeightedTorusJets

OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:35.text:
lemma smooth_average_lipschitz {f : ℂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hc : HasCompactSupport f)
    {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0<a) (hat : a≤t) :
    LipschitzWith (⟨(∫ y, ‖gradient f y‖)/(Real.pi*a^2),by positivity⟩ : ℝ≥0) (fun x => signedAverage f x t) := by
  obtain ⟨L,hL⟩ := hf.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hc one_ne_zero
  have hD := fun y => norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ hL (x₀ := y)
  have hi : Integrable (gradient f) := (continuous_gradient hf).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (gradient_hasCompactSupport hc)
  have ht := ha.trans_le hat
  apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le (fun x => (hasFDerivAt_signedAverage hf hD x ht).differentiableAt)
  intro x
  change ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => signedAverage f x t) x‖ ≤ _
  rw [← (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ ℂ).symm.norm_map]
  change ‖gradient (fun x => signedAverage f x t) x‖ ≤ _
  rw [gradient_signedAverage hf hD x ht,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0<(Real.pi*t^2)⁻¹)]
  have he : ‖∫ y in Metric.ball x t, gradient f y‖ ≤ ∫ y, ‖gradient f y‖ :=
    (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (setIntegral_le_integral hi.norm (ae_of_all _ (fun y => norm_nonneg _)))
  rw [← div_eq_inv_mul]
  exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right he (by positivity)).trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (integral_nonneg (fun y => norm_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sq_le_sq₀ ha.le ht.le |>.mpr hat) Real.pi_pos.le))

lemma smooth_band_self_bound {f : ℂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport f) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ x, ‖gradient (band f a a) x‖) ≤ ∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖ := by
  have hgi : Integrable (gradient f) :=
    (continuous_gradient hf).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (gradient_hasCompactSupport hc)
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hf.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hc one_ne_zero
  have he : gradient (band f a a) = diskKernel a ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] gradient f := by
    funext x
    rw [band_self, gradient_signedAverage hf
      (fun y => norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ hL (x₀ := y)) x ha,
      diskKernel_convolution]
  rw [he]
  have h := WeakSobolev.norm_convolution_le (diskKernel_integrable a) hgi
  simpa only [diskKernel_integral_abs ha, one_mul] using h

OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:113.name: OAI.SignedDisk.CenteredDiskEndpoint.hasGradient_iff_hasWeakGradient
OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:113.text:
lemma hasGradient_iff_hasWeakGradient {f : Plane → ℝ} {g : Plane → Plane}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f) (hg : Integrable g) :
    HasGradient (μ := volume) f g ↔ HasWeakGradient f g := by
  constructor
  · intro hw φ hφ hc i
    simpa only [testPartial,EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right,RCLike.conj_to_real,one_mul]
      using hw φ hφ hc (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
  · intro hw φ hφ hc v
    have hv : v=∑ i : Fin 2,v i • EuclideanSpace.single i 1 := by
      simpa only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr,EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply] using
        ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).sum_repr v).symm
    have hleft i : Integrable (fun x => f x*testPartial φ i x) :=
      hf.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport
        ((hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const) (hc.fderiv_apply ℝ _)
    have hright i : Integrable (fun x => g x i*φ x) :=
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).integrable_comp hg).locallyIntegrable.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ.continuous hc
    have hd x : f x*fderiv ℝ φ x v=∑ i : Fin 2,v i*(f x*testPartial φ i x) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [_root_.map_sum,map_smul,smul_eq_mul,Finset.mul_sum,testPartial]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    have hi x : ⟪g x,v⟫*φ x=∑ i : Fin 2,v i*(g x i*φ x) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [inner_sum,real_inner_smul_right,EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right,RCLike.conj_to_real,one_mul,Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    simp_rw [hd,hi]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hleft i).const_mul _),
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hright i).const_mul _)]
    simp only [integral_const_mul,hw φ hφ hc,Finset.sum_neg_distrib,mul_neg]

lemma signedBand_comp_complexPlane (f : Plane → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :

OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:284.name: OAI.SignedDisk.CenteredDiskEndpoint.gradient_comp_complexPlane
OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:284.text:
lemma gradient_comp_complexPlane {f : Plane → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (z : ℂ) :
    gradient (fun w => f (complexPlane w)) z = complexPlane.symm (gradient f (complexPlane z)) := by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ
  intro v
  rw [inner_gradient_left]
  change fderiv ℝ (f ∘ complexPlane) z v = _
  rw [fderiv_comp z (hf _) complexPlane.differentiableAt, complexPlane.fderiv]
  change fderiv ℝ f (complexPlane z) (complexPlane v) = _
  rw [← inner_gradient_left]
  simpa only [complexPlane.apply_symm_apply] using
    complexPlane.inner_map_map (complexPlane.symm (gradient f (complexPlane z))) v

OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:75.name: OAI.SignedDisk.SobolevBand.smooth_dyadic_bound

OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:296.text:
theorem main_signed_finite_band : SignedFiniteBandStatement := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := smooth_dyadic_bound_including_zero
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro f hf hc a ha m
  let f' : ℂ → ℝ := fun z => f (complexPlane z)
  have hf1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 f := hf.of_le (by simp)
  have hf' : ContDiff ℝ 1 f' := hf1.comp complexPlane.contDiff
  have hc' : HasCompactSupport f' := hc.comp_homeomorph complexPlane.toHomeomorph
  have hab : a ≤ (2 : ℝ)^m*a := by
    have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ)^m := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp ha.le
  have hL := smooth_band_lipschitz hf' hc' ha hab
  have hFi' := hL.continuous.locallyIntegrable (μ := volume)
  have hGi' := smooth_band_integrable_gradient hf' hc' ha hab
  have he : band f' a ((2 : ℝ)^m*a) =
      fun z => signedBand f a ((2 : ℝ)^m*a) (complexPlane z) :=
    signedBand_comp_complexPlane f a _
  have hFi : LocallyIntegrable (signedBand f a ((2 : ℝ)^m*a)) := by
    apply locallyIntegrable_comp_complexPlane.mp
    simpa only [he] using hFi'
  let G' := gradient (band f' a ((2 : ℝ)^m*a))
  let G := fun x => complexPlane (G' (complexPlane.symm x))
  have hG0 : Integrable (fun x => G' (complexPlane.symm x)) :=
    integrable_comp_complexPlane_symm.mpr hGi'
  have hGi : Integrable G :=
    complexPlane.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hG0
  have hw' : HasGradient (μ := volume) (band f' a ((2 : ℝ)^m*a)) G' :=
    lipschitz_hasGradient hL
  have hw0 := hw'.comp_isometry complexPlane.symm
  have hw : HasWeakGradient (signedBand f a ((2 : ℝ)^m*a)) G := by
    apply (hasGradient_iff_hasWeakGradient hFi hGi).mp
    simpa only [he, complexPlane.apply_symm_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm] using hw0
  refine ⟨hFi, G, hGi, hw, ?_⟩
  have hnorm : (∫ z, ‖gradient f' z‖) = gradientNorm (gradient f) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ z, ‖complexPlane.symm (gradient f (complexPlane z))‖ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ (fun z => congrArg norm
          (gradient_comp_complexPlane (hf1.differentiable one_ne_zero) z))
      _ = _ := gradientNorm_comp_complexPlane (gradient f)
  rw [show gradientNorm G = ∫ z, ‖G' z‖ from gradientNorm_comp_complexPlane_symm G']
  exact (hbound hf' hc' ha m).trans_eq (congrArg (fun v => C*v) hnorm)

end CenteredDiskEndpoint

OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:240.name: OAI.SignedDisk.SobolevBand.smooth_dyadic_bound_including_zero
OAI.Analysis.SignedDisk.Main:240.text:
theorem smooth_dyadic_bound_including_zero : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ {f : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 f → HasCompactSupport f →
    ∀ {a : ℝ}, 0 < a → ∀ m : ℕ,
      (∫ x, ‖gradient (band f a ((2 : ℝ)^m*a)) x‖) ≤ C*(∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := smooth_dyadic_bound
  refine ⟨max C 1, (le_max_right C 1).trans' zero_le_one, ?_⟩
  intro f hf hc a ha m
  have hv : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ‖gradient f x‖ := integral_nonneg (fun x => norm_nonneg _)
  cases m with
  | zero =>
      simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul] using
        (smooth_band_self_bound hf hc ha).trans
          (by simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right C 1) hv)
  | succ n =>
      have he : (2 : ℝ)^(n+1)*a = 2*((2 : ℝ)^n*a) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      rw [he]
      exact (hbound hf hc ha n).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left C 1) hv)

end SobolevBand

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.UniformMome.text:
theorem signed_occurrence_moment_bound :
    ∃ η₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η < η₀ →
        ∃ κ₀ : ℝ, 0 < κ₀ ∧ κ₀ < η / 256 ∧
          ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ < κ₀ →
            ∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧
              ∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d →
                ∀ lam : Partition (2 ^ d),
                  ∀ (u v l : ℕ) (h : u + v + l = 2 ^ d)
                    (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l),
                    SignedOccurrence h α β γ lam →
                      logMoment (weightedMoment lam r) ≤
                        ((coefficient η d * signedEntropy α β +
                            remainderBudget κ d l : ℝ) : EReal) := by
  refine ⟨1, zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
  intro η hη hη1
  refine ⟨η/512, by positivity, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ hκsmall
  exact signed_occurrence_moment_bound_fixed hη hη1 hκ (by linarith)

end SignedSweeps

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.sweepColors_le_size
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.text:
lemma sweepColors_le_size (d : ℕ) : sweepColors d ≤ 2^d := by
  apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
  have hn : (1:ℝ) ≤ (2^d : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_pow d 2 (by decide)
  simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hn (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/64 ≤ 1)

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.UniformMome.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.signed_occurrence_moment_bound_fixed
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.UniformMome.text:
theorem signed_occurrence_moment_bound_fixed {η κ : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hsmall : κ < η/256) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d →
      ∀ lam : Partition (2^d), ∀ (u v l : ℕ) (h : u+v+l=2^d)
        (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l),
        SignedOccurrence h α β γ lam →
        logMoment (weightedMoment lam r) ≤
          ((coefficient η d*signedEntropy α β+remainderBudget κ d l : ℝ) : EReal) := by
  let ξ : ℝ := min (1/64) (κ/16)
  let δ : ℝ := ξ/4
  have hξ : 0 < ξ := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hξ₁ : ξ < 1/10 := (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hξ₂ : ξ < κ/6 := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by nlinarith)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  have hδ1 : δ < 1 := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have hδξ : δ < ξ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  obtain ⟨D₁,hD₁,herr⟩ := balanced_recurrence_error_eventually hκ hξ₁ hξ₂
  obtain ⟨D₂,_hD₂,hclose⟩ := nonsparse_closing_budget hη hκ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 6) hδ1 hδξ
  obtain ⟨D₃,_hD₃,hcost⟩ := truncation_coefficient_eventually hη hκ.le
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/64) (by nlinarith : κ < η*((1:ℝ)/64)/2)
  let D := max D₁ (max D₂ D₃)
  obtain ⟨r₀,_hr₀,hbase⟩ := signed_occurrence_moment_bound_proved_ranges D hδ hη.le κ
  have hr : r₀ ≤ 2^r₀ := Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le
  refine ⟨2^r₀, Nat.one_le_pow r₀ 2 (by decide), ?_⟩
  intro d
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h d ih =>
    intro hd
    by_cases hdD : d ≤ D
    · intro lam u v l h α β γ ho
      exact hbase (2^r₀) hr d hd lam (Or.inl hdD) u v l h α β γ ho
    have hlarge : D ≤ d := le_of_not_ge hdD
    have hd10 : 10 ≤ d := hD₁.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans hlarge)
    have hd₁ : D₁ ≤ d := (le_max_left _ _).trans hlarge
    have hd₂ : D₂ ≤ d := (le_max_left D₂ D₃).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hlarge)
    have hd₃ : D₃ ≤ d := (le_max_right D₂ D₃).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hlarge)
    have hab : d/2+childDepth d=d := (balanced_depth_sizes hd10).1
    have ha1 : 1 ≤ d/2 := by omega
    have hb1 : 1 ≤ childDepth d := by unfold childDepth; omega
    have hab' : d/2 ≤ childDepth d := by unfold childDepth; omega
    have had : d/2 < d := by omega
    have hbd : childDepth d < d := by omega
    have hlocal (e : ℕ) (he1 : 1 ≤ e) (heb : e ≤ childDepth d) (hed : e < d) :
        ∀ (lam : Partition (2^e)) (u v l : ℕ) (h : u+v+l=2^e)
          (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l),
          SignedOccurrence h α β γ lam → weightedMoment lam (2^r₀) ≤
            Real.exp (coefficient η (childDepth d)*signedEntropy α β+
              clippedBudget (coefficient κ (childDepth d)) (2^e) l) := by
      intro lam u v l h α β γ ho
      have hi := (logMoment_le_iff (weightedMoment_nonneg lam (2^r₀))).mp
        (ih e hed he1 lam u v l h α β γ ho)
      rw [remainderBudget_eq_clippedBudget] at hi
      apply hi.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr _)
      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (coefficient_mono_depth hη.le he1 heb)
        (signedEntropy_nonneg α β))
        (clippedBudget_mono (coefficient_mono_depth hκ.le he1 heb) (Nat.one_le_pow e 2 (by decide)))
    have HA := hlocal (d/2) ha1 hab' had
    have HB := hlocal (childDepth d) hb1 le_rfl hbd
    have hηc : 0 ≤ coefficient η (childDepth d) :=
      (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ η/2).trans (coefficient_bounds hη.le hb1).1
    have hηc1 : coefficient η (childDepth d) ≤ 1 := (coefficient_bounds hη.le hb1).2.trans hη1.le
    have hκc : κ/2 ≤ coefficient κ (childDepth d) := (coefficient_bounds hκ.le hb1).1
    have hR : 2*max (2^(d/2)) (2^(childDepth d))+2*sweepColors d+1 ≤ 16*2^d := by
      have haN : 2^(d/2) ≤ 2^d := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) had.le
      have hbN : 2^(childDepth d) ≤ 2^d := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hbd.le
      have hqN := sweepColors_le_size d
      have hn : 1 ≤ 2^d := Nat.one_le_pow d 2 (by decide)
      have hmax : max (2^(d/2)) (2^(childDepth d)) ≤ 2^d := max_le haN hbN
      omega
    apply signed_moment_of_bounded_lengths hη.le hκ.le hd (sweepColors_pos d) (hcost d hd₃)
    intro lam u v l h α β γ hα hβ ho
    by_cases hk : ((2^d-lam.1.rowLen 0 : ℕ):ℝ) ≤ ((2^d:ℕ):ℝ)^(1-δ)
    · exact hbase (2^r₀) hr d hd lam (Or.inr (Or.inl hk)) u v l h α β γ ho
    by_cases hc : 2^d/2 < lam.1.colLen 0
    · exact hbase (2^r₀) hr d hd lam (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr hc))) u v l h α β γ ho
    have hcol : lam.1.colLen 0 ≤ 2^d/2 := le_of_not_gt hc
    have hlevel : ((2^d:ℕ):ℝ)^(1-δ) ≤ ((2^d-lam.1.rowLen 0 : ℕ):ℝ) := (lt_of_not_ge hk).le
    have hlengthα : α.1.colLen 0 ≤ sweepColors d := by simpa only [YoungDiagram.length_rowLens] using hα
    have hlengthβ : β.1.colLen 0 ≤ sweepColors d := by simpa only [YoungDiagram.length_rowLens] using hβ
    have hrec := signed_sweep_recurrence_depth_sum hab (sweepColors_pos d) hηc hηc1
      (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ κ/2) hκc HA HB hR lam u v l h α β γ hlengthα hlengthβ ho
    have he := herr d hd₁ l (by omega)
    have hb := hclose d hd₂ lam hcol hlevel u v l h α β γ ho
    apply (logMoment_le_iff (weightedMoment_nonneg lam (2^r₀))).mpr
    apply hrec.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr _)
    have hn : 0 ≤ ((2^d:ℕ):ℝ)^(1-ξ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    linarith

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.UniformMome.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.signed_sweep_recurrence_depth_sum
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.UniformMome.text:
lemma signed_sweep_recurrence_depth_sum {d a b j q R : ℕ} (hab : a+b=d) (hq : 0 < q)
    {η τ κ : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hκτ : κ ≤ τ)
    (HA : ∀ (lam : Partition (2^a)) (u v l : ℕ) (h : u+v+l=2^a)
      (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l),
      SignedOccurrence h α β γ lam → weightedMoment lam (2^j) ≤
        Real.exp (η*signedEntropy α β+clippedBudget τ (2^a) l))
    (HB : ∀ (lam : Partition (2^b)) (u v l : ℕ) (h : u+v+l=2^b)
      (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l),
      SignedOccurrence h α β γ lam → weightedMoment lam (2^j) ≤
        Real.exp (η*signedEntropy α β+clippedBudget τ (2^b) l))
    (hR : 2*max (2^a) (2^b)+2*q+1 ≤ R)
    (lam : Partition (2^d)) (u v l : ℕ) (h : u+v+l=2^d)
    (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l)
    (hα : α.1.colLen 0 ≤ q) (hβ : β.1.colLen 0 ≤ q)
    (ho : SignedOccurrence h α β γ lam) :
    weightedMoment lam (2^j) ≤ Real.exp (η*signedEntropy α β+
      τ*l*Real.log (2^d : ℕ)-(l:ℝ)*Real.log ((2^d : ℕ)/ (l:ℝ))+6*l+
      (2^b : ℕ)*typedLineError (2^a) q R+(2^a : ℕ)*typedLineError (2^b) q R+
      holeClippingError κ (2^a) (2^b)+((2^a : ℕ)+(2^b : ℕ) : ℝ)*Real.log (l+1)) := by
  subst d
  exact signed_sweep_recurrence hq hη hη' hκ hκτ HA HB hR lam u v l h α β γ hα hβ ho

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.balanced_recurrence_error_eventually
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.text:
theorem balanced_recurrence_error_eventually {κ ξ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hξ₁ : ξ < 1/10) (hξ₂ : ξ < κ/6) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, 10 ≤ D ∧ ∀ d ≥ D, ∀ (l : ℕ), l ≤ 2^d →
      ((2^(childDepth d):ℕ):ℝ)*typedLineError (2^(d/2)) (sweepColors d) (16*2^d)+
      ((2^(d/2):ℕ):ℝ)*typedLineError (2^(childDepth d)) (sweepColors d) (16*2^d)+
      holeClippingError (κ/2) (2^(d/2)) (2^(childDepth d))+
      (((2^(d/2):ℕ):ℝ)+((2^(childDepth d):ℕ):ℝ))*Real.log (l+1) ≤ ((2^d:ℕ):ℝ)^(1-ξ) := by
  have he₁ := depth_power_log_eventually (by linarith : (9:ℝ)/10 < 1-ξ) 322
  have he₂ := depth_power_log_eventually (by linarith : 1-κ/6 < 1-ξ) 2
  obtain ⟨D,hD⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (he₁.and he₂)
  refine ⟨max D 10, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro d hd l hl
  have hd10 : 10 ≤ d := (le_max_right _ _).trans hd
  obtain ⟨hadd,hsl,hml,hs,hm⟩ := balanced_depth_sizes hd10
  let N : ℝ := (2^d:ℕ)
  let L : ℝ := Real.log ((16*2^d:ℕ):ℝ)
  have hN : 1 ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_pow d 2 (by decide)
  have hN0 : 0 < N := zero_lt_one.trans_le hN
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]; change 1 ≤ 16*N; nlinarith [hN])
  have hterms (t m : ℕ) (ht : (t:ℝ) ≤ N^((3:ℝ)/5)) (hm : (m:ℝ) ≤ N^((3:ℝ)/5)) :
      (m:ℝ)*typedLineError t (sweepColors d) (16*2^d) ≤ 160*N^((9:ℝ)/10)*L := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (m:ℝ)*(160*N^((3:ℝ)/10)*L) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (typedLineError_bound ht) (Nat.cast_nonneg m)
      _ ≤ N^((3:ℝ)/5)*(160*N^((3:ℝ)/10)*L) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [show N^((3:ℝ)/5)*(160*N^((3:ℝ)/10)*L) =
          160*(N^((3:ℝ)/5)*N^((3:ℝ)/10))*L by ring, ← Real.rpow_add hN0]
        norm_num
  have hH := hterms (2^(d/2)) (2^(childDepth d)) hs hm
  have hK := hterms (2^(childDepth d)) (2^(d/2)) hm hs
  have hlog : Real.log ((l:ℝ)+1) ≤ L := by
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    have hl' : (l:ℝ) ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; exact_mod_cast hl
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    change (l:ℝ)+1 ≤ 16*N
    nlinarith
  have hsum : ((2^(d/2):ℕ):ℝ)+((2^(childDepth d):ℕ):ℝ) ≤ 2*N^((9:ℝ)/10) := by
    have hb := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN (by norm_num : (3:ℝ)/5 ≤ 9/10)
    linarith
  have hhist := mul_le_mul hsum hlog (Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [show (0:ℝ) ≤ l by positivity] : (1:ℝ) ≤ (l:ℝ)+1))
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*N^((9:ℝ)/10))
  have hclip := balanced_clipping_error hd10 hκ.le
  obtain ⟨he₁,he₂⟩ := hD d ((le_max_left _ _).trans hd)
  change _ ≤ N^(1-ξ)
  change _ ≤ 2*N^(1-κ/6)*L at hclip
  change 322*N^((9:ℝ)/10)*L ≤ N^(1-ξ)/2 at he₁
  change 2*N^(1-κ/6)*L ≤ N^(1-ξ)/2 at he₂
  linarith

end SignedSweeps
end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BudgetBound.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.clippedBudget_mono
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BudgetBound.text:
lemma clippedBudget_mono {τ τ' : ℝ} (hτ : τ ≤ τ') {a h : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
    clippedBudget τ a h ≤ clippedBudget τ' a h := by
  apply max_le_max le_rfl
  apply sub_le_sub_right
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ (by positivity))
    (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast ha))

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.sweepColors_pos
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.text:

  positivity

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.sweepColors
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.text: def sweepColors (d : ℕ) : ℕ := ⌈((2^d : ℕ) : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/64)⌉₊

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.UniformMome.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.coefficient_mono_depth
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.UniformMome.text:
lemma coefficient_mono_depth {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) {a b : ℕ}
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : coefficient η a ≤ coefficient η b := by
  have hroot : 0 < Real.sqrt a := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < a by omega))
  have hroots : Real.sqrt a ≤ Real.sqrt b := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast hab)
  have hi := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2*Real.sqrt a)
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hroots (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2))
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left hi 1) hη

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.balanced_depth_sizes
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BalancedErr.text:
lemma balanced_depth_sizes {d : ℕ} (hd : 10 ≤ d) :
    d/2+childDepth d=d ∧
    ((2^d:ℕ):ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ ((2^(d/2):ℕ):ℝ) ∧
    ((2^d:ℕ):ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ ((2^(childDepth d):ℕ):ℝ) ∧
    ((2^(d/2):ℕ):ℝ) ≤ ((2^d:ℕ):ℝ)^((3:ℝ)/5) ∧
    ((2^(childDepth d):ℕ):ℝ) ≤ ((2^d:ℕ):ℝ)^((3:ℝ)/5) := by
  have hb : d/2+childDepth d=d := by unfold childDepth; omega
  have h₁ : d ≤ 3*(d/2) := by omega
  have h₂ : d ≤ 3*childDepth d := by unfold childDepth; omega
  have h₃ : 5*(d/2) ≤ 3*d := by omega
  have h₄ : 5*childDepth d ≤ 3*d := by unfold childDepth; omega
  have h₁' : (d:ℝ) ≤ 3*(d/2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast h₁
  have h₂' : (d:ℝ) ≤ 3*(childDepth d : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast h₂
  have h₃' : 5*(d/2 : ℕ) ≤ 3*(d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h₃
  have h₄' : 5*(childDepth d : ℕ) ≤ 3*(d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h₄
  exact ⟨hb, depth_rpow_le_two_pow (by linarith), depth_rpow_le_two_pow (by linarith),
    two_pow_le_depth_rpow (by linarith), two_pow_le_depth_rpow (by linarith)⟩

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BudgetBound.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.remainderBudget_eq_clippedBudget
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BudgetBound.text:
lemma remainderBudget_eq_clippedBudget (κ : ℝ) (d l : ℕ) :
    remainderBudget κ d l = clippedBudget (coefficient κ d) (2 ^ d) l := by
  by_cases hl : l = 0 <;> simp [remainderBudget, clippedBudget, hl]

OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BudgetBound.name: OAI.SignedSweeps.clippedBudget
OAI.Probability.SignedSweeps.BudgetBound.text:
def clippedBudget (τ : ℝ) (a h : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  max 0 (τ * h * Real.log a - (h : ℝ) * Real.log ((a : ℝ) / h))

OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.PolygonGe.name: OAI.SimpleAmenable.polygonAlternatingGroup_perfect
OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.PolygonGe.text:
theorem polygonAlternatingGroup_perfect (a m : ℕ) (hm : 5 ≤ m) :
    Group.IsPerfect (polygonAlternatingGroup a m) := by
  apply Subgroup.isPerfect_iff.mpr
  apply le_antisymm (Subgroup.commutator_le_self _)
  change Subgroup.closure _ ≤ _
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨b,c,hb,hc,rfl⟩ := threeSlotCycle_is_commutator hm hg
  exact Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.subset_closure hb)
    (Subgroup.subset_closure hc)

OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.Configura.name: OAI.SimpleAmenable.polygonAlternatingGroup

noncomputable def polygonFullGroup (a m : ℕ) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (TrackPoint a m)) where

  one_mem' := identity_hasTable a m
  mul_mem' := comp_hasTable
  inv_mem' := fun {f} h => inverse_hasTable f h

lemma polygon_full_low_homology_finite (a m:ℕ) (ha:0<a) (hm : 34 ≤ m) :
    Module.Finite ℤ (groupHomology (Rep.trivial ℤ (polygonFullGroup a m) ℤ) 1) ∧
    Module.Finite ℤ (groupHomology (Rep.trivial ℤ (polygonFullGroup a m) ℤ) 2) := by
  have barH1Finite := polygon_bar_homology_finite a ha 1 (by omega)
  have barH2Finite := polygon_bar_homology_finite a ha 2 (by omega)
  have barH3Finite := polygon_bar_homology_finite a ha 3 (by omega)

OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.PolygonGe.name: OAI.SimpleAmenable.threeSlotCycle_is_commutator
OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.PolygonGe.text:
theorem threeSlotCycle_is_commutator {a m : ℕ} (hm : 5 ≤ m)
    {g : polygonFullGroup a m} (hg : IsThreeSlotCycle g) :
    ∃ b c : polygonFullGroup a m,
      IsThreeSlotCycle b ∧ IsThreeSlotCycle c ∧ ⁅b,c⁆ = g := by
  obtain ⟨U,s,hU,hs,hgact,hgfix⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨k,l,hkl,hk,hl⟩ := two_spare_tracks hm (fun i => (s i).1)
  let S := extendSlots s k l
  have hS := extendSlots_injective U s hs k l hkl hk hl
  let φ := slotHom U S hS
  refine ⟨φ (trackCycle leftThreeInFive), φ (trackCycle rightThreeInFive),
    slotHom_cycle_isThreeSlotCycle U hU S hS _,
    slotHom_cycle_isThreeSlotCycle U hU S hS _, ?_⟩
  rw [← map_commutatorElement, five_cycle_commutator]
  have he (i : Fin 3) (x : U.val) :
      SlotMap a m U S (threeInFive i,x) = SlotMap a m U s (i,x) := by
    simp only [SlotMap, S, extendSlots_three]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro p
  change slotPerm U S hS (trackCycle threeInFive) p = g.val p
  by_cases hp : p ∈ Set.range (SlotMap a m U s)
  · obtain ⟨⟨i,x⟩,rfl⟩ := hp
    rw [← he i x, slotPerm_apply, trackCycle_apply, he, he, hgact]
  · rw [hgfix p hp]
    by_cases hP : p ∈ Set.range (SlotMap a m U S)
    · obtain ⟨⟨j,x⟩,rfl⟩ := hP
      rw [slotPerm_apply]
      have hj : j ∉ Set.range threeInFive := by
        rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩
        exact hp ⟨(i,x),(he i x).symm⟩
      rw [trackCycle_apply_of_notMem threeInFive hj]
    · exact slotPerm_apply_of_notMem U S hS _ hP

OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.Homology..name: OAI.SimpleAmenable.PolygonTracks.finite_alternating_H2_of_full
OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.Homology..text:
lemma finite_alternating_H2_of_full (a m : ℕ) (hm : 205 < m)
    [Module.Finite ℤ (groupHomology (Rep.trivial ℤ (polygonFullGroup a m) ℤ) 1)]
    [Module.Finite ℤ (groupHomology (Rep.trivial ℤ (polygonFullGroup a m) ℤ) 2)] :
    Module.Finite ℤ (groupHomology.H2 (IntegralHomology.coefficients (polygonAlternatingGroup a m))) := by
  let f : polygonFullGroup a m →* Abelianization (polygonFullGroup a m) := Abelianization.of
  let e := abelianKernelEquiv a m (by omega)
  have : IsNoetherianRing (MonoidAlgebra ℤ (Abelianization (polygonFullGroup a m))) :=
    TrivialHomology.abelianization_ring_noetherian _
  have : Group.IsPerfect (polygonAlternatingGroup a m) := polygonAlternatingGroup_perfect a m (by omega)
  have : Group.IsPerfect f.ker := Group.IsPerfect.ofSurjective (f:=e.symm.toMonoidHom) e.symm.surjective
  have ha : ∀g : polygonFullGroup a m,
      TrivialHomology.map (QuotientRegular.conjugate f g).toMonoidHom 2 = 𝟙 _ := by
    intro g
    have := TrivialHomology.isIso_equiv e 2
    apply (cancel_mono (TrivialHomology.map e.toMonoidHom 2)).mp
    rw [Category.id_comp, ← TrivialHomology.map_comp]
    have he : e.toMonoidHom.comp (QuotientRegular.conjugate f g).toMonoidHom =
        (fullConjugation a m g).comp e.toMonoidHom := by
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    rw [he,TrivialHomology.map_comp]
    have hg : TrivialHomology.map (fullConjugation a m g) 2=𝟙 _ := by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      exact fullAction_trivial a m hm g
    rw [hg,Category.comp_id]
  have : Module.Finite ℤ (groupHomology (Rep.trivial ℤ f.ker ℤ) 2) :=
    QuotientRegular.finite_kernel_H2 f (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _)
      (TrivialHomology.H1_isZero_of_perfect) ha
  have := TrivialHomology.isIso_equiv e 2
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective (TrivialHomology.map e.toMonoidHom 2).hom
    ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp inferInstance)
end PolygonTracks
end SimpleAmenable

OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.Configura.name: OAI.SimpleAmenable.IsThreeSlotCycle
OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.Configura.text:
def IsThreeSlotCycle {a m : ℕ} (g : polygonFullGroup a m) : Prop :=
  ∃ (U : polygonAlgebra a) (slots : Fin 3 → Fin m × (CutRing × CutRing)),
    U.val.Nonempty ∧ Function.Injective (SlotMap a m U slots) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin 3) (x : U.val),
      g.val (SlotMap a m U slots (i,x)) = SlotMap a m U slots (i+1,x)) ∧
    (∀ p ∉ Set.range (SlotMap a m U slots), g.val p = p)

theorem main : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Group G),
    Infinite G ∧ Group.IsFinitelyPresented G ∧ IsSimpleGroup G ∧ FolnerAmenable G := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,h⟩:=fixed_track_polygon_progress
  obtain ⟨hinfinite,hsimple,hfolner,H,hH,q,hpres,hsur,hcentral⟩:=h 206 (by omega)
  let:=hH
  have:=hpres
  have:=polygonAlternatingGroup_perfect a 206 (by omega)
  have:=polygon_alternating_H2_finite a 206 ha (by omega)
  exact ⟨polygonAlternatingGroup a 206,inferInstance,hinfinite,
    finitelyPresented_of_central_cover_h2 q hsur hcentral,hsimple,hfolner⟩
end SimpleAmenable

OAI.GroupTheory.SimpleAmenable.Main:97.name: OAI.SimpleAmenable.polygon_alternating_H2_finite

lemma polygon_alternating_H2_finite (a m:ℕ) (ha:0<a) (hm : 205 < m) :

OAI.NumberTheory.SingleFold.RecursiveEnu.text:
theorem exists_counter {p : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop} (hp : REPred p) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (M : Counter.Machine Q (Macro.Reg (Reg n))),
      ∀a, p a ↔ Counter.Halts M (counterInput a) := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩:=exists_code hp
  let initial := trNormal c Cont'.halt
  let S := codeSupp c Cont'.halt
  have hS := tr_supports c Cont'.halt
  refine ⟨Macro.State (FiniteState n tr S),inferInstance,inferInstance,counterProgram tr initial S,fun a=>?_⟩
  rw [counter_halts tr initial S hS.1 hS.2]
  change p a ↔ (eval (TM2.step tr) (init c (List.ofFn a))).Dom
  rw [PartrecToTM2.tr_eval]
  exact (hc a).symm
end SingleFold.TM2Macro

end

lemma halts_sf : SF (fun d : J → ℕ=>Counter.Halts M d) := by
  have hh := (system_sf M).ex (fun d v u hv hu=>decode_injective (system_unique hv hu))
  refine hh.congr ?_
  intro d
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    exact ⟨_,hv.haltsAt⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩:=system_complete M d h
    refine ⟨encode v,?_⟩
    simpa only [inp,wit,Function.comp_def,Sum.elim_inl,Sum.elim_inr,decode_encode] using hv
end SingleFold.CounterCompilation

OAI.NumberTheory.SingleFold.Main:8.name: OAI.SingleFold.recursively_enumerable_sf
OAI.NumberTheory.SingleFold.Main:8.text:
theorem recursively_enumerable_sf {n : ℕ} {p : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop} (hp : REPred p) : SF p := by
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hD,M,hM⟩:=TM2Macro.exists_counter hp
  let := hQ
  let := hD
  have hc := CounterCompilation.halts_sf M
  have hi : MapSF (TM2Macro.counterInput (n:=n)) := by
    apply MapSF.vector
    intro j
    cases hs : TM2Macro.inputSlot j with
    | none => simpa only [TM2Macro.counterInput,hs,Option.elim_none] using (ScalarSF.const (α:=Fin n) 0)
    | some i => simpa only [TM2Macro.counterInput,hs,Option.elim_some] using ScalarSF.proj i
  exact (hi.pullback hc).congr (fun a=>(hM a).symm)

OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.GaussianPos.name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.GaussianNumerics.eventually_local_coordinate_position
OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.GaussianPos.text:
theorem eventually_local_coordinate_position : ∀ᶠ l : ℕ in atTop,
    ∀ m D : ℕ, D ≤ l → 0 < m+D →
      Real.exp ((l:ℝ)^30) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt ((m+D : ℕ):ℝ)) →
      ∀ K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ), IsCompact K → Convex ℝ K → (interior K).Nonempty →
        ∃ e : (Fin (m+D) → ℝ) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] (Fin (m+D) → ℝ),
          ∀ y : Fin D → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ≤ 6*(l:ℝ)^2 →
            (volume (e '' K)).toReal*Folded.gamma y/2 ≤
              (volume (coordinateFiber (e '' K) y)).toReal := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_local_position] with l hl
  intro m D hD hn hroot K hK hc hi
  let A : (Fin (m+D) → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] E (m+D) := (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)).symm
  have hAK : IsCompact (A '' K) := hK.image A.toContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous
  have hAc : Convex ℝ (A '' K) := hc.linear_image A.toLinearMap
  have hAi : (interior (A '' K)).Nonempty := by
    change (interior (A.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph '' K)).Nonempty
    rw [←A.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph.image_interior]
    exact hi.image _
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hl m D hD hn hroot (A '' K) hAK hAc hAi
  let J := g '' (A '' K)
  have hJ : IsCompact J := hAK.image g.toAffineMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
  let G : E (m+D) ≃ₜ ((Fin m → ℝ) × E D) :=
    { toEquiv := g.toEquiv
      continuous_toFun := g.toAffineMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
      continuous_invFun := g.symm.toAffineMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional }
  have hJi : (interior J).Nonempty := by
    change (interior (G '' (A '' K))).Nonempty
    rw [←G.image_interior]
    exact hAi.image G
  have hJ0 : 0 < (volume J).toReal := by
    apply ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt ?_) hJ.measure_ne_top
    exact (isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume hJi).trans_le (measure_mono interior_subset)
  let e := A.toAffineEquiv.trans (g.trans (flatten m D).toAffineEquiv)
  have he : e '' K=flatten m D '' J := by
    dsimp [e,J]
    rw [Set.image_image,Set.image_image]
    rfl
  refine ⟨e,fun y hy => ?_⟩
  rw [he,flatten_volume m D hJ]
  have hf : coordinateFiber (flatten m D '' J) y=Sections.fiber J (WithLp.toLp 2 y) := by
    have H := flatten_fiber (flatten m D '' J) (WithLp.toLp 2 y)
    have hc : (flatten m D).symm '' ((flatten m D) '' J)=J := by
      simp only [Set.image_image,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,Set.image_id']
    rw [hc] at H
    exact H.symm
  rw [hf]
  have H := hg (WithLp.toLp 2 y) hy
  rw [density_half_gaussian,gaussian_toLp] at H
  change Folded.gamma y/2 ≤ canonical J (WithLp.toLp 2 y) at H
  rw [canonical,ENNReal.toReal_inv] at H
  have HH := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H hJ0.le
  rw [←mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ hJ0.ne',one_mul] at HH
  simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using HH


end SingleLatticeCovering.GaussianNumerics




noncomputable section

end

OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.Assembly:19.name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Assembly.eventual_single_lattice_covering
OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.Assembly:19.text:
theorem eventual_single_lattice_covering :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ K : Set (Fin n → ℝ),
      IsCompact K → Convex ℝ K → (interior K).Nonempty →
      ∃ (Λ : Submodule ℤ (Fin n → ℝ)) (_ : DiscreteTopology Λ), IsZLattice ℝ Λ ∧
        K+(Λ : Set (Fin n → ℝ))=Set.univ ∧
        (volume K).toReal/ZLattice.covolume Λ volume ≤ C*(n : ℝ)*Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨cutoff,hcut,C,k,κ,hC,hk,hκ,hvertical⟩ := vertical_patterns_alphabets
  let CT : ℝ := 301
  have hCT : 0 ≤ CT := by norm_num [CT]
  have hCTeq : 1+CT=302 := by norm_num [CT]
  obtain ⟨Cstar,hstar,hconditions⟩ := FinalRates.final_conditions hC hk
    (show 0 < Real.exp (-1)/8 by positivity) (show 0 ≤ Real.exp 1/8 by positivity)
    hκ (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num) hCT
  refine ⟨Real.exp 1*Cstar,by positivity,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hconditions,FinalRates.eventually_marginal_scales hC (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)
      (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 0),
    FinalRates.firstSize_tendsto.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop cutoff),
    (FinalRates.localScale_tendsto hC).eventually GaussianNumerics.eventually_local_coordinate_position,
    FinalRates.eventually_localScale_root hC,
      FinalRates.eventually_dimension_small hC,eventually_ge_atTop (540 : ℕ)]
      with n hn hscale hfirst hgaussian hroot hdim hn540
  obtain ⟨B,c,hcb,hcs,hDim,hRad,hAlphabet,hPattern⟩ := hvertical (FinalRates.firstSize n) hfirst
  have hDdim : (c.fullDim : ℝ) ≤ C*((FinalRates.firstSize n : ℝ)+1) := by
    simpa [Chain.fullDim,Nat.cast_add] using hDim
  obtain ⟨hDn,hm,hcap,hload,hcrit,hcount⟩ := hn.2 c.fullDim hDdim
  have hm270 : 270 ≤ n-c.fullDim := by
    have hd := (hdim c.fullDim hDdim).2
    have hnR : (540 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn540
    have hh : (270 : ℝ) ≤ ((n-c.fullDim : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hDn]
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast hh
  rw [hCTeq] at hcrit
  obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,hSmall⟩ := hscale c.fullDim hDdim
  have hD : 0 < c.fullDim := by
    have hfirstdim := chain_first_le_dim c
    rw [hcb] at hfirstdim
    dsimp [Chain.fullDim]
    omega
  let m := n-c.fullDim
  have hmn : m+c.fullDim=n := Nat.sub_add_cancel hDn
  have hmnle : m ≤ n := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by omega)
  have hnlog : 0 < Real.log (n : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < n by omega))
  let ρ := Cstar*(n : ℝ)*Real.log (n : ℝ)
  let ε := Real.exp (-k*(FinalRates.firstSize n : ℝ)^(70/100 : ℝ))
  let R := FinalRates.sectionRadius C n
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; positivity
  have hrad : c.radiusSq+(B.terminalDim : ℝ) ≤ R^2 :=
    FinalRates.radius_sq_bound hC.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hRad
  have step : coversAtBound (m+c.fullDim) ((Real.exp 1*Cstar)*(n : ℝ)*Real.log (n : ℝ)) := by
    intro K hK hc hi
    obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := hgaussian m c.fullDim (FinalRates.dimension_le_localScale hC hDdim)
      (by omega : 0 < m+c.fullDim) (by simpa only [hmn] using hroot) K hK hc hi
    obtain ⟨heK,hec,hei⟩ := affine_body e hK hc hi
    have heV := body_volume_pos heK hei
    have hg : ∀ y : c.FullVec, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ≤ 6*(c.fullDim : ℝ)*R →
        (volume (e '' K)).toReal*gamma y/2 ≤ (volume (coordinateFiber (e '' K) y)).toReal := by
      intro y hy
      apply he y
      apply hy.trans
      calc
        6*(c.fullDim:ℝ)*R ≤ 6*(FinalRates.localScale C n:ℝ)*(FinalRates.localScale C n:ℝ) := by
          gcongr
          · exact (FinalRates.sectionRadius_pos hC n).le
          · exact_mod_cast FinalRates.dimension_le_localScale hC hDdim
          · exact FinalRates.sectionRadius_le_localScale C n
        _ = 6*(FinalRates.localScale C n:ℝ)^2 := by ring
    obtain ⟨Λ,hd,hfull,hcover,hbound⟩ := sections_and_circuits_cover c hm270 hD (e '' K) heK hec heV
      (FinalRates.sectionRadius_pos hC n) hrad hSmall hg κ ρ ε (Real.sqrt (m : ℝ))
      (8*(n : ℝ)*Real.log (n : ℝ)) hρ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      (by
        intro y
        obtain ⟨P,hPn,hPb,hPl,hPt,hPw⟩ := hPattern y
        exact ⟨P,hPn,hPb,hPl,hPw⟩)
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hload) hcap hcrit (by
        intro δ s hs
        have hs' : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (3*(n : ℝ)^2)^c.fullDim := hs.trans (by
          gcongr)
        have ha : ∀ j < c.fullDim, Real.log ((c.alphabetSeq j).card+1 : ℝ) ≤
            Real.log 8+(c.fullDim : ℝ)*Real.log ((c.fullDim : ℝ)+2)+(FinalRates.firstSize n : ℝ)^2 := by
          intro j hj
          simpa only [c.alphabetSeq_fin ⟨j,hj⟩] using hAlphabet ⟨j,hj⟩
        simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hDn] using hcount s c.alphabetSeq hs' ha)
    let := hd
    let := hfull
    have hb : (volume (e '' K)).toReal/ZLattice.covolume Λ volume ≤
        (Real.exp 1*Cstar)*(n : ℝ)*Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
      convert hbound using 1 ; dsimp [ρ] ; ring
    exact pull_back_cover e K Λ hcover hb
  change coversAtBound n ((Real.exp 1*Cstar)*(n : ℝ)*Real.log (n : ℝ))
  simpa only [hmn] using step


end SingleLatticeCovering.Assembly


end

end OAI

OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.GaussianPos.name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.FinalRates.eventually_localScale_root
OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.GaussianPos.text:
lemma eventually_localScale_root {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
    Real.exp ((localScale C n:ℝ)^30) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)) := by
  let H : ℝ := 3*(C+2)
  have hH : 0 < H := by dsimp [H]; positivity
  have hsmall : (fun n : ℕ => (Real.log (Real.log (n:ℝ)))^60) =o[atTop]
      (fun n => Real.log (n:ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,Real.rpow_natCast,Real.rpow_one] using
      (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop ((60:ℕ):ℝ) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)).comp_tendsto log_nat_atTop
  filter_upwards [hsmall.bound (by positivity : 0 < 1/(4*H^30)),
    loglog_nat_atTop.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℝ)),
    eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℕ)] with n hbound hs hn
  have hnp : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (n:ℝ)) := le_trans zero_le_one hs
  have hs2 : 1 ≤ (Real.log (Real.log (n:ℝ)))^2 := one_le_pow₀ hs
  have hceil := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (sq_nonneg (Real.log (Real.log (n:ℝ))))
  change (firstSize n:ℝ) < (Real.log (Real.log (n:ℝ)))^2+1 at hceil
  have hlceil := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (sectionRadius_pos hC n).le
  have hl : (localScale C n:ℝ) ≤ H*(Real.log (Real.log (n:ℝ)))^2 := by
    dsimp [localScale,sectionRadius]
    push_cast
    dsimp [sectionRadius] at hlceil
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hceil.le (show 0 ≤ C+1 by linarith)
    dsimp [H]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 2*C+5 by linarith) (sub_nonneg.mpr hs2)]
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg hs0 _),
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg n)] at hbound
  have hpow : (localScale C n:ℝ)^30 ≤ H^30*(Real.log (Real.log (n:ℝ)))^60 := by
    have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg (localScale C n)) hl 30
    simpa only [mul_pow,←pow_mul] using hh
  have hexp : 4*(localScale C n:ℝ)^30 ≤ Real.log (n:ℝ) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4*H^30)
    have he : (4*H^30)*(1/(4*H^30)*Real.log (n:ℝ))=Real.log (n:ℝ) := by field_simp
    rw [he] at hh
    nlinarith
  have hlog : Real.log (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)))=Real.log (n:ℝ)/4 := by
    rw [Real.log_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),Real.log_sqrt hnp.le]
    ring
  rw [←Real.exp_log (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hnp))]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  rw [hlog]
  linarith


end SingleLatticeCovering.FinalRates

theorem single_lattice_covering :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n →
      ∀ (K : Set (Space n)), IsConvexBody K →
        ∃ (L : Submodule ℤ (Space n)) (_ : DiscreteTopology L),
          IsZLattice ℝ L ∧ LatticeCovers K L ∧
            (volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume L ≤ C * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := Assembly.eventual_single_lattice_covering
  obtain ⟨C',hC',h'⟩ := FiniteDimensions.absorb_finitely_many_dimensions ⟨C,h⟩
  exact ⟨C',hC',fun n hn K hK => h' n hn K hK.1 hK.2.1 hK.2.2⟩


end SingleLatticeCovering

OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.GaussianPos.name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.FinalRates.localScale_tendsto
OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.GaussianPos.text:
lemma localScale_tendsto {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) : Tendsto (localScale C) atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop_mono _ firstSize_tendsto
  intro n
  have H := sectionRadius_le_localScale C n
  dsimp [sectionRadius] at H
  exact_mod_cast (show (firstSize n:ℝ) ≤ (localScale C n:ℝ) by
    nlinarith [show (0:ℝ) ≤ (firstSize n:ℝ) by positivity])

OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.GaussianPos.name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.FinalRates.dimension_le_localScale
OAI.Geometry.LatticeCovering.GaussianPos.text:
lemma dimension_le_localScale {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) {n D : ℕ}
    (hD : (D:ℝ) ≤ C*((firstSize n:ℝ)+1)) : D ≤ localScale C n := by
  have _ := hC
  have hc := sectionRadius_le_localScale C n
  have hh : (D:ℝ) ≤ (localScale C n:ℝ) := by
    dsimp [sectionRadius] at hc
    nlinarith [show (0:ℝ) ≤ (firstSize n:ℝ) by positivity]
  exact_mod_cast hh

OAI.Computability.LoopMatching.ExpandCou.name: OAI.LoopMatching.expanded_count
OAI.Computability.LoopMatching.ExpandCou.text:
theorem expanded_count (G : Input) (j : ℕ) :
    BinaryMatching.count (expand G j) = j.factorial * countWithLoops G j := by
  classical
  let w : (BinaryMatching.completeGraph (expand G j).n).Matching → ℕ :=
    fun N => ∏ e ∈ N.val, BinaryMatching.multiplicity (expand G j) e
  have hzero :
      (∑ N : {N : (BinaryMatching.completeGraph (expand G j).n).Matching //
        ¬ ∀ e ∈ N.val, e.val.1.val < G.n}, w N.val) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro N _
    exact expanded_weight_zero_of_not_supported G j N.val N.property
  have hs : BinaryMatching.count (expand G j) =
      ∑ N : SupportedMatching G j, w N.val := by
    have ht := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype
      (fun N : (BinaryMatching.completeGraph (expand G j).n).Matching =>
        ∀ e ∈ N.val, e.val.1.val < G.n) w
    rw [hzero, Nat.add_zero] at ht
    have hi :
        (Subtype.fintype (fun N :
          (BinaryMatching.completeGraph (expand G j).n).Matching =>
            ∀ e ∈ N.val, e.val.1.val < G.n) : Fintype (SupportedMatching G j)) =
          supportedMatchingFintype G j := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hi] at ht
    exact ht.symm
  rw [hs]
  calc
    _ = ∑ q : (M : PartialMatching G.n) × (Fin j ≃ ↥(loopVertices M)),
        weight G q.1 := by
      apply Fintype.sum_equiv (supportedMatchingEquiv G j)
      intro N
      rw [supportedMatchingEquiv_fst]
      exact supported_matching_weight G j N
    _ = ∑ M : PartialMatching G.n,
        Fintype.card (Fin j ≃ ↥(loopVertices M)) * weight G M := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro M _
      simp
    _ = j.factorial * countWithLoops G j := by
      unfold countWithLoops
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro M _
      rw [card_dummyAssignments]
      by_cases h : (loopVertices M).card = j <;> simp [h]

end LoopMatching

end

end OAI

theorem actual_algorithm_correct (G : Input) :

    (MachineMain.A G).1 ≤ (MachineMain.A G).2 * count G ∧
    (MachineMain.A G).2 * count G ≤ 2 ^ (18 * G.n) * (MachineMain.A G).1 ∧

  · have hz := count_eq_zero_of_sparse_bound G h
    simp [MachineMain.A, h, hz]
  · rw [MachineMain.A, ite_eq_right h]

      Approximation.output_bounds_of_expanded_count G
        (fun j _ => expanded_count G j)⟩

OAI.Computability.LoopMatching.Approxima.name: OAI.LoopMatching.Approximation.output_bounds_of_expanded_count
OAI.Computability.LoopMatching.Approxima.text:
theorem output_bounds_of_expanded_count (G : Input)
    (expanded_count : ∀ j ≤ G.n,
      BinaryMatching.count (expand G j) = j.factorial * countWithLoops G j) :
    (output G).1 ≤ (output G).2 * count G ∧
    (output G).2 * count G ≤ 2 ^ (18 * G.n) * (output G).1 ∧
    ((output G).1 = 0 ↔ count G = 0) := by
  have hlo : ∀ j ≤ G.n, term G j ≤ j.factorial * countWithLoops G j := by
    intro j hj
    rw [← expanded_count j hj]
    exact (term_bounds G j).1
  have hhi : ∀ j ≤ G.n,
      j.factorial * countWithLoops G j ≤ 2 ^ (18 * G.n) * term G j := by
    intro j hj
    rw [← expanded_count j hj]
    apply (term_bounds G j).2.1.trans
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
    apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 1 ≤ (2 : ℕ))
    omega
  obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := factorial_profile_bounds (term G) (countWithLoops G)
    (2 ^ (18 * G.n)) G.n hlo hhi
  rw [← count_eq_sum_countWithLoops G] at hl hu
  change (output G).1 ≤ (output G).2 * count G at hl
  change (output G).2 * count G ≤ 2 ^ (18 * G.n) * (output G).1 at hu
  refine ⟨hl, hu, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rw [hz, mul_zero] at hu
    have hprod : (output G).2 * count G = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hu
    exact (Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left (Nat.ne_of_gt (output_den_pos G))
  · intro hz
    rw [hz, mul_zero] at hl
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hl

OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.BorderPolars:3.name: OAI.PermanentBorder.Polar.smooth_count_numerical_bound
OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.BorderPolars:3.text:
theorem smooth_count_numerical_bound (n K r : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hcount : (r:ℝ) * ((r-1:ℕ):ℝ)^K ≤
      2^K * ((2*n-1).choose (K+1) : ℝ)) :
    ((r-1:ℕ):ℝ) * (K+1) / (4 * Real.exp 1) ≤ n := by
  have hr0 : (0:ℝ) < (r-1:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < r-1 by omega)
  have hrle : ((r-1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le r 1
  have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hK : (0:ℝ) < K+1 := by positivity
  have hchoose := choose_exp_bound (2*n-1) (K+1) (by omega)
  have htwo : ((2*n-1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ 2*n := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_le (2*n) 1)
  have hbase : Real.exp 1 * ((2*n-1:ℕ):ℝ) / ((K+1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤
      (2 * Real.exp 1 * n) / (K+1) := by
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (1:ℝ)]
  have hpow : (((r-1:ℕ):ℝ))^(K+1) ≤ (4 * Real.exp 1 * n / (K+1))^(K+1) := by
    calc
      (((r-1:ℕ):ℝ))^(K+1) ≤ (r:ℝ) * ((r-1:ℕ):ℝ)^K := by
        rw [pow_succ, mul_comm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrle (by positivity)
      _ ≤ 2^K * ((2*n-1).choose (K+1) : ℝ) := hcount
      _ ≤ 2^K * (Real.exp 1 * ((2*n-1:ℕ):ℝ) / ((K+1:ℕ):ℝ))^(K+1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hchoose (by positivity)
      _ ≤ 2^(K+1) * ((2 * Real.exp 1 * n) / (K+1))^(K+1) := by
        apply mul_le_mul
        · have : (2:ℝ)^K ≤ 2^(K+1) := by rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) K]
          exact this
        · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hbase _
        · positivity
        · positivity
      _ = (4 * Real.exp 1 * n / (K+1))^(K+1) := by
        rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; ring
  have hle : ((r-1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.exp 1 * n / (K+1) :=
    (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) (by omega : K+1 ≠ 0)).mp hpow
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
  have := (le_div_iff₀ hK).mp hle
  nlinarith

end PermanentBorder.Polar

OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.InitialForm:12.name: OAI.PermanentBorder.smooth_initial_form_lower_bound
OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.InitialForm:12.text:
theorem smooth_initial_form_lower_bound (d r : ℕ) (g : Poly (Fin d))
    (a : Fin d → ℂ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (_hG : homogeneousComponent r
      (affineSubstitution a (fun i j : Fin d => if i = j then 1 else 0) g) ≠ 0)
    (hlow : ∀ j < r, homogeneousComponent j
      (affineSubstitution a (fun i j : Fin d => if i = j then 1 else 0) g) = 0)
    (hs : ∀ y : Fin d → ℂ,
      eval y (homogeneousComponent r
        (affineSubstitution a (fun i j : Fin d => if i = j then 1 else 0) g)) = 0 →
      (∀ i, eval y (pderiv i (homogeneousComponent r
        (affineSubstitution a (fun i j : Fin d => if i = j then 1 else 0) g))) = 0) →
      y = 0) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      (HasBorderDeterminant n g →
        ((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((d-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (4*Real.exp 1) ≤ (n : ℝ)) ∧
      (HasExactDeterminant n g →
        ((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((d-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (4*Real.exp 1) ≤ (n : ℝ)) := by
  intro n
  have hb : HasBorderDeterminant n g →
      ((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((d-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (4*Real.exp 1) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    intro h
    have hq := h.affineSubstitution a
      (fun i j : Fin d => if i = j then (1 : ℂ) else 0)
    have hinit := hq.lowest_homogeneousComponent hlow
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Polar.HasBorderDeterminant.smooth_lower_bound hinit
      (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hd) hr
      (homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous r _) hs
  exact ⟨hb, fun h => hb h.hasBorderDeterminant⟩

end PermanentBorder

end OAI

OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.BorderPolars:2.name: OAI.PermanentBorder.Polar.HasBorderDeterminant.polar_count
OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.BorderPolars:2.text:
theorem HasBorderDeterminant.polar_count {n r : ℕ}
    {f : Poly (PolarVars τ)} (hb : HasBorderDeterminant n f)
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hh : f.IsHomogeneous r)
    (hs : ∀ y : PolarVars τ → ℂ, eval y f = 0 →
      (∀ j, eval y (pderiv j f) = 0) → y = 0) :
    r * (r-1)^Fintype.card τ ≤
      2^Fintype.card τ * (2*n-1).choose (Fintype.card τ+1) := by
  classical
  cases n with
  | zero => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hb.1)
  | succ n =>
    obtain ⟨w,e,A₀,A,x,hx,hxs⟩ := HasBorderDeterminant.simple_polar_approximant hb hr hh hs
    let P := affineMatrixPolynomial (n+1) A₀ A
    let Q := polynomialSystem (affinePolarOperators w e) P
    let b := e.symm (Pi.single none 1)
    let L := e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp optionInsert
    have hrel : polarPair (fun y => (affine A₀ A y).det)
        (fun z => b + L (optionProduct.symm z)) w =
          fun z => optionProduct (Q (optionProduct.symm z)) := by
      have heval : (fun y => (affine A₀ A y).det) = (fun y => eval y P) := by
        funext y
        exact (eval_matrix A₀ A y).symm
      have hψ : (fun z => b + L (optionProduct.symm z)) =
          (fun z => affineNormChart e (optionProduct.symm z)) := by
        funext z
        exact (affineNormChart_add e _).symm
      rw [heval,hψ]
      exact polarPair_polynomialSystem w e P
    have hQ (z : Option τ → ℂ) : DifferentiableAt ℂ Q z := by
      apply differentiableAt_pi.mpr
      intro j
      exact ((contDiff_mvPolynomial_eval ((affinePolarOperators w e j) P)).differentiable (by decide)).differentiableAt
    have hcount := affine_polar_count A₀ A b L w (fun j => optionProduct (x j))
      (optionProduct.injective.comp hx)
      (fun j => by
        rw [hrel]
        change optionProduct (Q (optionProduct.symm (optionProduct (x j)))) = 0
        rw [optionProduct.symm_apply_apply]
        have hz : Q (x j) = 0 := (hxs j).1
        rw [hz, map_zero])
      (fun j => by
        rw [hrel]
        exact simple_conjugate optionProduct (hQ (x j)) (hxs j).2)
    have hn : 2*(n+1)-1 = 2*n+1 := by omega
    simpa [hn] using hcount
end PermanentBorder.Polar

namespace PermanentBorder.Polar

OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.BorderPolars:3.name: OAI.PermanentBorder.Polar.HasBorderDeterminant.smooth_lower_bound
OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.BorderPolars:3.text:
theorem HasBorderDeterminant.smooth_lower_bound {σ : Type} [Fintype σ]
    {n r : ℕ} {f : Poly σ} (hb : HasBorderDeterminant n f)
    (hσ : 2 ≤ Fintype.card σ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hh : f.IsHomogeneous r)
    (hs : ∀ y : σ → ℂ, eval y f = 0 →
      (∀ j, eval y (pderiv j f) = 0) → y = 0) :
    ((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card σ-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (4*Real.exp 1) ≤ n := by
  classical
  let K := Fintype.card σ - 2
  have hc : Fintype.card σ = Fintype.card (PolarVars (Fin K)) := by
    simp only [PolarVars,Fintype.card_option,Fintype.card_fin]
    dsimp [K]
    omega
  let e := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hc
  have hb' := hb.rename e
  have hp := HasBorderDeterminant.polar_count hb' hr (hh.rename_isHomogeneous)
    (smooth_rename e f hs)
  have hcount : (r : ℝ) * ((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^K ≤
      2^K * ((2*n-1).choose (K+1) : ℝ) := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hp
    exact_mod_cast hp
  have h := smooth_count_numerical_bound n K r hb.1 hr hcount
  have hk : K+1 = Fintype.card σ-1 := by dsimp [K]; omega
  have hkR : (K : ℝ)+1 = ((Fintype.card σ-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  simpa only [hkR] using h
end Polar
end PermanentBorder

end OAI

OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.BorderPolars:3.name: OAI.PermanentBorder.Polar.smooth_rename
OAI.Algebra.Determinantal.BorderPolars:3.text:
lemma smooth_rename {σ τ : Type} [Fintype σ] [Fintype τ]
    (e : σ ≃ τ) (f : Poly σ)
    (hs : ∀ y : σ → ℂ, eval y f = 0 →
      (∀ j, eval y (pderiv j f) = 0) → y = 0) :
    ∀ y : τ → ℂ, eval y (rename e f) = 0 →
      (∀ j, eval y (pderiv j (rename e f)) = 0) → y = 0 := by
  intro y hy hg
  rw [eval_rename] at hy
  have hgrad (i : σ) : eval (y ∘ e) (pderiv i f) = 0 := by
    have h := hg (e i)
    rw [pderiv_rename e.injective,eval_rename] at h
    exact h
  have hz := hs _ hy hgrad
  funext i
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply,e.apply_symm_apply,Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hz (e.symm i)

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:107.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.measurable_word_inverse
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:107.text:
lemma measurable_word_inverse : Measurable (T.symm : Extension → Extension) := by
  apply Measurable.subtype_mk
  apply Measurable.prodMk
  · exact measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t =>
      ((measurable_pi_apply (t-1)).comp measurable_fst).comp measurable_subtype_coe)
  · exact measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i =>
      (measurable_of_countable (fun a : ZMod (WordParameters.length 40000 i) => a-1)).comp
        (measurable_phase i))

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:124.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.main
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:124.text:
theorem main :
    ∃ (X : Type) (_ : MeasurableSpace X) (μ : Measure X)
      (_ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ) (T : X ≃ᵐ X),
      StandardNonatomic μ ∧ Ergodic T μ ∧ FiniteKSEntropy μ T ∧
        ¬ HasSmoothPositiveVolumeModel μ T := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨μ,hstd,herg,hent⟩ := actual_system
  refine ⟨Extension,inferInstance,(μ : Measure Extension),inferInstance,
    wordMeasurableEquiv,hstd,herg,hent,?_⟩
  rintro (⟨d,hmodel⟩ | ⟨d,hd,hmodel⟩)
  · exact no_euclidean_model (μ : Measure Extension) herg.toMeasurePreserving d hmodel
  · let : NeZero d := hd
    exact no_halfspace_model (μ : Measure Extension) herg.toMeasurePreserving d hmodel
end SmoothObstruction

end

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:116.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.wordMeasurableEquiv
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:116.text:
noncomputable def wordMeasurableEquiv : Extension ≃ᵐ Extension where
  toEquiv := T.toEquiv
  measurable_toFun := measurable_T
  measurable_invFun := measurable_word_inverse

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Models:53.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.HasSmoothPositiveVolumeModel
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Models:53.text:
def HasSmoothPositiveVolumeModel {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) (T : X → X) : Prop :=
  (∃ d : ℕ, HasModelWith μ T (𝓡 d)) ∨
    (∃ d : ℕ, ∃ _ : NeZero d, HasModelWith μ T (𝓡∂ d))

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.StandardP.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.ConullIsomorphic
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.StandardP.text:
def ConullIsomorphic {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) : Prop :=
  ∃ (A : Set X) (B : Set Y), MeasurableSet A ∧ MeasurableSet B ∧
    μ Aᶜ = 0 ∧ ν Bᶜ = 0 ∧
    ∃ e : A ≃ᵐ B,
      MeasurePreserving e (μ.comap (Subtype.val : A → X))
        (ν.comap (Subtype.val : B → Y))

lemma words_subwordClosed : PhaseDynamics.SubwordClosed (length 40000) words := by
  intro i w hw r hr hlen
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := hw
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := slice_is_constituent (length_pos 40000 i) (word i) (children i a) r hr hlen
  change (fun j => concat (word i) (children i a) _) ∈ Set.range (word i)
  exact ⟨children i a b,hb.symm⟩

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.WordHierarchy.actual_system
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.text:
theorem actual_system : ∃ μ : ProbabilityMeasure Extension,
    StandardNonatomic (μ : Measure Extension) ∧
    Ergodic (PhaseDynamics.extensionShift (length 40000) (length_dvd 40000) words)
      (μ : Measure Extension) ∧
    FiniteKSEntropy (μ : Measure Extension)
      (PhaseDynamics.extensionShift (length 40000) (length_dvd 40000) words) := by
  exact PhaseDynamics.exists_system (length 40000) (length_dvd 40000) words
    (length_unbounded initial_threshold)
    (PhaseDynamics.finite_configs (length 40000) (length_dvd 40000) words
      words_subwordClosed words_nonempty)

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:81.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.no_halfspace_model
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:81.text:
theorem no_halfspace_model (μ : Measure Extension) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ) (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    ¬ HasModelWith μ T (𝓡∂ d) := by
  classical
  rintro ⟨M,top,meas,borel,t2,ct,compact,chart,manifold,ν,prob,S,hν,hS,hc⟩
  let : TopologicalSpace M := top
  let : MeasurableSpace M := meas
  let : BorelSpace M := borel
  let : T2Space M := t2
  let : SecondCountableTopology M := ct
  let : CompactSpace M := compact
  let : ChartedSpace (EuclideanHalfSpace d) M := chart
  let : IsManifold (𝓡∂ d) ∞ M := manifold
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := prob
  let : MetricSpace M := TopologicalSpace.metrizableSpaceMetric M
  let : Nonempty M := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure ν
  have hswitch := halfspace_switching (⟨ν,prob⟩ : ProbabilityMeasure M) hν S hS
  have hSi : MeasurePreserving S.symm ν ν :=
    MeasurePreserving.symm S.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv hS
  obtain ⟨r,hr,B,hB,hBc,hBf,hBi,hforward,hinverse⟩ :=
    ConullTransport.from_conjugate_bilateral μ ν T.toEquiv S.toEquiv hc
      (Classical.choice (nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ))
  exact no_switching μ hT ν S.toEquiv hS hSi r hr B hB hBc hBi hforward hswitch

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.WordHierarchy.Extension
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.text:

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.PhaseEntr.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.blockEntropy
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.PhaseEntr.text:
noncomputable def blockEntropy {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) (T : X → X) {q : ℕ} (P : X → Fin q) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ w : Fin n → Fin q,
    entropyTerm ((μ {x | ∀ j : Fin n, P ((T^[j.val]) x) = w j}).toReal)

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Obstructi.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.WordHierarchy.no_switching
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Obstructi.text:
theorem no_switching {M : Type} [MetricSpace M] [CompactSpace M]
    [MeasurableSpace M] [BorelSpace M] [Nonempty M]
    (μ : Measure Extension) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ)
    (ν : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (R : M ≃ M) (hR : MeasurePreserving R ν ν) (hRi : MeasurePreserving R.symm ν ν)
    (r : M → Extension) (hr : MeasurePreserving r ν μ)
    (B : Set M) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hBc : ν Bᶜ=0) (hBinv : R.symm ⁻¹' B=B)
    (hforward : ∀ t,∀ x∈B,r ((R^[t]) x)=(T^[t]) (r x))
    (hswitch : SmoothSwitching ν R R.symm) : False := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδworks⟩ := SymbolMass.symbol_success ν R R.symm hR hRi
    (initialSymbol ∘ r) (measurable_initialSymbol.comp hr.measurable)
  obtain ⟨b,C,Ds,hb,hbs,hDs,hshadow⟩ := hswitch (1/100) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨ii,jj,hij,hjt,hit,hcheap,hwindow⟩ := actual_cheap_scales initial_threshold hb hbs
  have hjtend := cheap_index_tendsto ii jj hit hjt
  have heC : ∀ᶠ a in atTop,|C| *(b (jj a)/rate 40000 (ii a))≤(3/1000:ℝ)*Real.log 2 := by
    have h : Tendsto (fun a => |C| *(b (jj a)/rate 40000 (ii a))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using hcheap.const_mul |C|
    have hp : (0:ℝ)<(3/1000:ℝ)*Real.log 2 := mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))
    exact h.eventually_le_const hp
  have hei : ∀ᶠ a in atTop,1 ≤ ii a := hit.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 1)
  obtain ⟨a,hai,haC,haD,hash⟩ := (hei.and (heC.and ((hjtend.eventually hDs).and
    (hjtend.eventually (hshadow δ hδ))))).exists
  obtain ⟨k,hkmin,hk,hwin,hQ⟩ := hwindow a
  let i := ii a
  let j := jj a
  let D := Ds j
  have hin : 1 ≤ i := hai
  have hkn : k≤K (S i)/8 := hk
  have hwin' : 2^k*length 40000 i=2^j := by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hwin
  have hm : (99/100:ℝ)≤D.law.real D.carrier := by
    have hh := haD.2.1
    norm_num at hh
    exact hh
  have hn : 0<2^j := by positivity
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hHG,hHm,hgood⟩ := hδworks D (2^j) hn hm haD.2.2 hash
  rw [←hwin'] at hgood
  obtain ⟨F,hF,hFm,hpass⟩ := transported_success μ ν R hRi r hr B hBinv hforward
    hT hB hBc i k hkn hQ D haD.2.2 H hH hHG hHm
      (by simpa only [Function.comp_apply,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hgood)
  let U : M → Fin (2^k-1) → A i := firstList i (2^k) ∘ r
  let W : M → Fin (2^k-1) → A i := firstList i (2^k) ∘ r ∘ (R.symm^[2^k*length 40000 i])
  have hU : Measurable U := (measurable_firstList i (2^k)).comp hr.measurable
  have hpast := hr.comp (hRi.iterate (2^k*length 40000 i))
  have hW : Measurable W := (measurable_firstList i (2^k)).comp hpast.measurable
  have hDmax : 2^k-1≤WordStep.D (S i) := by
    exact (Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hkn)
  have hent := firstList_entropy μ hT hin hQ hDmax
  have hentU : (249/250:ℝ)*(2^k-1:ℕ)*Real.log (Fintype.card (A i))≤
      entropy (observed ν U hU) := by
    have hh := observed_preserving ν μ r hr (firstList i (2^k)) (measurable_firstList i (2^k))
    change observed ν U hU=_ at hh
    rw [hh]
    exact hent
  have hentW : (249/250:ℝ)*(2^k-1:ℕ)*Real.log (Fintype.card (A i))≤
      entropy (observed ν W hW) := by
    have hh := observed_preserving ν μ (r ∘ (R.symm^[2^k*length 40000 i])) hpast
      (firstList i (2^k)) (measurable_firstList i (2^k))
    change observed ν W hW=_ at hh
    rw [hh]
    exact hent
  let : Nonempty D.J := ⟨D.label (Classical.choice ‹Nonempty M›)⟩
  have hC : Real.log (Fintype.card D.J)≤(3/500:ℝ)*(2^k-1:ℕ)*Real.log (Fintype.card (A i)) :=
    cell_cost i (2^k) (2^j) hQ hwin (hb _).le haC haD.1
  let : NeZero (2^k-1) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let v : A i := Classical.choice (levelNonempty i)
  let : Nontrivial (Space (S i)) := ⟨⟨v.val,0,v.property⟩⟩
  apply PairUpper.no_success_event ν D.label D.label_measurable U W hU hW (form (S i))
    (form_nondegenerate _) (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hentU)
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hentW)
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hC) (alphabet_log_large i) F hF hFm
  exact hpass
end SmoothObstruction.WordHierarchy

end

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.WordHierarchy.alphabet_nonempty
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.text:
lemma alphabet_nonempty (i : ℕ) : Nonempty (A i) := by
  have hs := s_pos_of_Kpos (show 0<K (S i) by
    change 0<K (sequence 40000 i)
    have := (step_conditions initial_threshold i).1
    omega)
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card (A i) := by
    rw [cardAlphabetReal]
    exact alphabetSize_pos hs
  exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by exact_mod_cast hp)

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.PhaseEntr.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.FiniteKSEntropy
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.PhaseEntr.text:
def FiniteKSEntropy {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) (T : X → X) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (q : ℕ) (P : X → Fin (q + 1)), Measurable P →
    ∃ h : ℝ, h ≤ C ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => blockEntropy μ T P n / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 h)

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:32.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.halfspace_switching
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:32.text:
theorem halfspace_switching [NeZero d] [ChartedSpace (EuclideanHalfSpace d) M]
    [IsManifold (𝓡∂ d) ∞ M]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure M) (hμ : SmoothPositiveDensity (𝓡∂ d) (μ : Measure M))
    (S : Diffeomorph (𝓡∂ d) (𝓡∂ d) M M ∞)
    (hS : MeasurePreserving S (μ : Measure M) (μ : Measure M)) :
    SmoothSwitching (μ : Measure M) S S.symm := by
  have hr : IsClosed (range (𝓡∂ d)) := by
    rw [range_modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace]
    exact isClosed_le continuous_const (by fun_prop)
  apply ManifoldCoordinates.switching_from_gauges (𝓡∂ d) hr μ hμ S hS
  intro ι inst a K hK hKU
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hcol⟩ := ChartDensity.global_halfspace_collar (μ : Measure M) hμ a K hK hKU
  exact ⟨C,hC.le,hcol⟩
end SmoothObstruction

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:16.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.euclidean_switching
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:16.text:
theorem euclidean_switching [ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) M]
    [IsManifold (𝓡 d) ∞ M]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure M) (hμ : SmoothPositiveDensity (𝓡 d) (μ : Measure M))
    (S : Diffeomorph (𝓡 d) (𝓡 d) M M ∞)
    (hS : MeasurePreserving S (μ : Measure M) (μ : Measure M)) :
    SmoothSwitching (μ : Measure M) S S.symm := by
  have hr : range (𝓡 d)=univ := by ext x; simp
  apply ManifoldCoordinates.switching_from_gauges (𝓡 d) (by rw [hr]; exact isClosed_univ) μ hμ S hS
  intro ι inst a K hK hKU
  refine ⟨0,le_rfl,?_⟩
  intro r hr₀
  refine ⟨∅,MeasurableSet.empty,by simp,?_⟩
  intro i x hx hxW
  rw [hr,interior_univ]
  exact subset_univ _

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:55.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.no_euclidean_model
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Main:55.text:
theorem no_euclidean_model (μ : Measure Extension) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ) (d : ℕ) :
    ¬ HasModelWith μ T (𝓡 d) := by
  classical
  rintro ⟨M,top,meas,borel,t2,ct,compact,chart,manifold,ν,prob,S,hν,hS,hc⟩
  let : TopologicalSpace M := top
  let : MeasurableSpace M := meas
  let : BorelSpace M := borel
  let : T2Space M := t2
  let : SecondCountableTopology M := ct
  let : CompactSpace M := compact
  let : ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) M := chart
  let : IsManifold (𝓡 d) ∞ M := manifold
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := prob
  let : MetricSpace M := TopologicalSpace.metrizableSpaceMetric M
  let : Nonempty M := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure ν
  have hswitch := euclidean_switching (⟨ν,prob⟩ : ProbabilityMeasure M) hν S hS
  have hSi : MeasurePreserving S.symm ν ν :=
    MeasurePreserving.symm S.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv hS
  obtain ⟨r,hr,B,hB,hBc,hBf,hBi,hforward,hinverse⟩ :=
    ConullTransport.from_conjugate_bilateral μ ν T.toEquiv S.toEquiv hc
      (Classical.choice (nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ))
  exact no_switching μ hT ν S.toEquiv hS hSi r hr B hB hBc hBi hforward hswitch

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.WordHierarchy.measurable_T
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.text:
lemma measurable_T : Measurable (T : Extension → Extension) := by
  apply Measurable.subtype_mk
  apply Measurable.prodMk
  · exact measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun t =>
      ((measurable_pi_apply (t+1)).comp measurable_fst).comp measurable_subtype_coe)
  · exact measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i =>
      (measurable_of_countable (fun a : ZMod (length 40000 i) => a+1)).comp (measurable_phase i))

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Models:18.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.ConullTransport.from_conjugate_bilateral
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.Models:18.text:
theorem from_conjugate_bilateral (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)
    (T : X ≃ X) (S : Y ≃ Y) (h : SmoothObstruction.ConullConjugate μ T ν S) (x₀ : X) :
    ∃ r : Y → X,MeasurePreserving r ν μ ∧
      ∃ B : Set Y,MeasurableSet B ∧ ν Bᶜ=0 ∧ S ⁻¹' B=B ∧ S.symm ⁻¹' B=B ∧
        (∀ n,∀ y∈B,r ((S^[n]) y)=(T^[n]) (r y)) ∧
        (∀ n,∀ y∈B,r ((S.symm^[n]) y)=(T.symm^[n]) (r y)) := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,B,hB,hBc,hSB,he⟩ := from_conjugate μ ν T S h x₀
  exact ⟨r,hr,B,hB,hBc,hSB,invariant_inverse S B hSB,he,inverse_time r T S B hSB he⟩
end SmoothObstruction.ConullTransport

end

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.PhaseDyna.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.PhaseDynamics.exists_system
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.PhaseDyna.text:
theorem exists_system
    (hunbounded : ∀ n, ∃ i, n < m i)
    (hfinite : ∀ n, ∃ x : Space A m, ∀ i ≤ n, Compatible m hm x i ∧ Legal m W x i) :
    ∃ μ : ProbabilityMeasure (extension m hm W),
      StandardNonatomic (μ : Measure (extension m hm W)) ∧
      Ergodic (extensionShift m hm W) (μ : Measure (extension m hm W)) ∧
      FiniteKSEntropy (μ : Measure (extension m hm W)) (extensionShift m hm W) := by
  let : CompactSpace A := Finite.compactSpace
  let : Fact (IsClosed (extension m hm W)) := ⟨extension_closed m hm W⟩
  let : CompactSpace (extension m hm W) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (extension_closed m hm W).isCompact
  have hn := extension_nonempty m hm W hfinite
  let : Nonempty (extension m hm W) := hn.to_subtype
  let : StandardBorelSpace (extension m hm W) := (extension_closed m hm W).measurableSet.standardBorel
  obtain ⟨μ,hμ⟩ := CompactInvariant.exists_ergodic_probability
    (extensionShift m hm W) (extensionShift m hm W).continuous
  let : NullSingletonClass (μ : Measure (extension m hm W)) :=
    noAtoms_of_phases μ (extensionShift m hm W) hμ.toMeasurePreserving m
      (fun i x => x.val.2 i) (fun _ _ => rfl) hunbounded
  refine ⟨μ,standardNonatomic_of_standardBorel (μ : Measure (extension m hm W)),hμ,?_⟩
  exact PhaseEntropy.finiteKS (fun x : extension m hm W => x.val.1)
    (fun x : extension m hm W => x.val.2) μ hμ.toMeasurePreserving
    (extension_coordinate_space m hm W) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl)
end SmoothObstruction.PhaseDynamics

end

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.PhaseDyna.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.PhaseDynamics.extensionShift
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.PhaseDyna.text:
def extensionShift : extension m hm W ≃ₜ extension m hm W where
  toFun x := ⟨shift A m x.val, (extension_shift_iff m hm W x.val).mpr x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨(shift A m).symm x.val, extension_shift_symm m hm W x.val x.property⟩
  left_inv x := Subtype.ext ((shift A m).left_inv x.val)
  right_inv x := Subtype.ext ((shift A m).right_inv x.val)
  continuous_toFun := ((shift A m).continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
  continuous_invFun := ((shift A m).symm.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.WordHierarchy.words_nonempty
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.text:
lemma words_nonempty (i : ℕ) : (words i).Nonempty := by
  let : Nonempty (A i) := alphabet_nonempty i
  exact Set.range_nonempty _

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordParam.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.WordParameters.length_dvd
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordParam.text:

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordParam.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.WordParameters.length_unbounded
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordParam.text:
lemma length_unbounded {s₀ : ℕ} (h₀ : 256 ≤ K s₀) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ i, n < length s₀ i := by
  refine ⟨n, (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := n)).trans_le (length_ge_two_pow h₀ n)⟩

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.StandardP.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.StandardNonatomic

OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.name: OAI.SmoothObstruction.PhaseDynamics.finite_configs
OAI.Dynamics.SmoothObstruction.WordHiera.text:
theorem finite_configs (hW : SubwordClosed m W) (hne : ∀ i, (W i).Nonempty) :
    ∀ n, ∃ x : Space A m, ∀ i ≤ n, Compatible m hm x i ∧ Legal m W x i := by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := hne n
  refine ⟨repeatWord m n w,fun i hi => ⟨?_,?_⟩⟩
  · simp [Compatible,repeatWord]
  · have htop := repeatWord_legal m W n w hw
    induction hi using Nat.decreasingInduction with
    | self => exact htop
    | of_succ i hi ih => exact legal_of_succ m hm W hW _ (fun _ => rfl) i ih
end SmoothObstruction.PhaseDynamics
