OAI.Combinatorics.BooleanFunctions.Walsh.name: OAI.SquareRootDegree.coordinate_reflection
OAI.Combinatorics.BooleanFunctions.Walsh.text:
theorem coordinate_reflection {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : Cube ι → ℝ)
    (hf : IsBoolean f) (hn : Nonconstant f) :
    ∃ g : Cube ι → ℝ, IsBoolean g ∧ Nonconstant g ∧
      fourierDegree g = fourierDegree f ∧ singletonSum g = absoluteSingletonSum f := by
  exact ⟨fun x => f (reflection (positiveMask f) x), isBoolean_reflection _ _ hf,
    nonconstant_reflection _ _ hn, fourierDegree_reflection _ _,
    singletonSum_positive_reflection _⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.BooleanFunctions.Walsh.name: OAI.SquareRootDegree.IsBoolean
OAI.Combinatorics.BooleanFunctions.Walsh.text:

  ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1

OAI.Combinatorics.BooleanFunctions.Walsh.name: OAI.SquareRootDegree.singletonSum_le_absoluteSingletonSum
OAI.Combinatorics.BooleanFunctions.Walsh.text:
theorem singletonSum_le_absoluteSingletonSum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (f : Cube ι → ℝ) : singletonSum f ≤ absoluteSingletonSum f :=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => le_abs_self (fourierCoeff f {i})

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.ComponentsMain:.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.actual_return_bernoulli
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.ComponentsMain:.text:
theorem actual_return_bernoulli (k : ℝ) (hk : 0≤k) (N : ℕ)
    (E : Set Torus) (hE : 0 < area E)
    (htotal : ∀ m : ℕ,0 < m → Ergodic (((standardMap k)^[N])^[m]) (normalizedArea E))
    (α : ℕ → ℕ → Torus → Bool) (hα : ∀ i j,Measurable (α i j))
    (hsep : Function.Injective (fun z => fun i j => α i j z))
    (hwb : ∀ M : ℕ,WeakBernoulliProcess (normalizedArea E)
      (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N) (joinedBinary α M)) :
    IsBernoulli ((standardMap k)^[N]) (normalizedArea E) := by
  let := normalizedArea_probability hE
  let := normalizedArea_nullSingleton E
  let e := iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N
  have heq : (e : Torus → Torus)=(standardMap k)^[N] := funext (iterateEquiv_apply _ N)
  have he : Ergodic e (normalizedArea E) := by
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [Function.iterate_one] using htotal 1 (by omega)
  have het : ∀ m : ℕ,0 < m → Ergodic (e^[m]) (normalizedArea E) := by simpa only [heq] using htotal
  obtain ⟨n,β,p₀,hβ,hβsum,hβentropy,hp₀,H,hcode₀,_hr,_hshift,_hjoint⟩ :=
    actual_return_full_entropy_iid_factor k hk N E hE htotal α hα hsep hwb
  have Hβ : FiniteRateSupremum (normalizedArea E) e (weightEntropy β) := by simpa only [heq] using H
  let zero : Fin (n+2) := ⟨0,by omega⟩
  let one : Fin (n+2) := ⟨1,by omega⟩
  have h01 : zero≠one := by
    intro h
    have hv : (0 : ℕ)=1 := congrArg Fin.val h
    omega
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hcode,hdecode⟩ := generating_iid_partition (normalizedArea E) e he het
    β hβ hβsum hβentropy Hβ α hα hsep hwb zero one h01 p₀ hp₀ hcode₀
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteWeightLaw β) := finiteWeightLaw_probability β hβ hβsum
  have hm := bernoulli_model_of_generating_iid (normalizedArea E) e p hp (finiteWeightLaw β) hcode α hsep hdecode
  simpa only [IsBernoulli,heq] using hm
end StandardMapEntropy

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.Centered.name: OAI.HyperbolicCoding.bernoulli_model_of_generating_iid
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.Centered.text:
theorem bernoulli_model_of_generating_iid (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (e : X ≃ᵐ X) (p : X → A) (hp : Measurable p) (β : Measure A) [IsProbabilityMeasure β]
    (hcode : MeasurePreserving (orbitName e p) μ (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => β)))
    (α : ℕ → ℕ → X → Bool) (hsep : Function.Injective (fun x => fun i j => α i j x))
    (hdecode : ∀ n : ℕ,∃ R : ℕ,∃ D : (Fin (2*R+1) → A) → ((Fin (n+1) × Fin (n+1)) → Bool),
      μ.real {x | joinedBinary α (n+1) x≠D (centeredWindow R (orbitName e p x))}≤2*(1/2 : ℝ)^(n+2)) :
    ∃ βR : Measure ℝ,IsProbabilityMeasure βR ∧
      ∃ (encode : X → (ℤ → ℝ)) (decode : (ℤ → ℝ) → X),
        MeasurePreserving encode μ (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => βR)) ∧
        MeasurePreserving decode (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => βR)) μ ∧
        (∀ᵐ x ∂μ,decode (encode x)=x) ∧
        (∀ᵐ w ∂Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => βR),encode (decode w)=w) ∧
        (∀ᵐ x ∂μ,encode (e x)=fun i : ℤ => encode x (i+1)) := by
  have hsep' : Function.Injective (fun x => fun i : ℕ × ℕ => α i.1 i.2 x) := by
    intro x y h
    apply hsep
    funext i j
    exact congrFun h (i,j)
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hl,_hr⟩ := measurable_decoder_of_generating_approximations μ (orbitName e p)
    (measurable_orbitName e hp) (fun i : ℕ × ℕ => α i.1 i.2) hsep'
    (fun i => binary_factors_of_joined_decoders μ e p α hdecode i.1 i.2)
  rw [hcode.map_eq] at hd
  let b : A → ℝ := embeddingReal A
  have hb : MeasurableEmbedding b := measurableEmbedding_embeddingReal A
  let βR := β.map b
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure βR := inferInstance
  let F : (ℤ → A) → (ℤ → ℝ) := fun w i => b (w i)
  let G : (ℤ → ℝ) → (ℤ → A) := fun w i => hb.invFun (w i)
  have hF : Measurable F := Measurable.of_eval (fun index => hb.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply index))
  have hG : Measurable G := Measurable.of_eval (fun index => hb.measurable_invFun.comp (measurable_pi_apply index))
  have hGF (w : ℤ → A) : G (F w)=w := funext (fun i => hb.leftInverse_invFun (w i))
  have hmpF : MeasurePreserving F (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => β))
      (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => βR)) :=
    ⟨hF,Measure.infinitePi_map_pi _ (fun _ => hb.measurable)⟩
  have hmpG : MeasurePreserving G (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => βR))
      (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => β)) := by
    refine ⟨hG,?_⟩
    rw [←hmpF.map_eq,Measure.map_map hG hF,show G ∘ F=id from funext hGF,Measure.map_id]
  let encode : X → (ℤ → ℝ) := F ∘ orbitName e p
  let decode : (ℤ → ℝ) → X := d ∘ G
  have hE : MeasurePreserving encode μ (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => βR)) := hmpF.comp hcode
  have hD : MeasurePreserving decode (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => βR)) μ := hd.comp hmpG
  have hleft : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,decode (encode x)=x := by
    filter_upwards [hl] with x hx
    exact (congrArg d (hGF (orbitName e p x))).trans hx
  refine ⟨βR,inferInstance,encode,decode,hE,hD,hleft,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [←hE.map_eq]
    apply (ae_map_iff hE.measurable.aemeasurable
      (measurableSet_eq_fun (hE.measurable.comp hD.measurable) measurable_id)).mpr
    filter_upwards [hleft] with x hx
    exact congrArg encode hx
  · exact ae_of_all _ (fun x => funext (fun i => congrArg b (congrFun (orbitName_shift e p x) i)))

end HyperbolicCoding

end

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Bernoulli.Ergod.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.eventually_actual_cyclic_weakBernoulli_component
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Bernoulli.Ergod.text:
theorem eventually_actual_cyclic_weakBernoulli_component :
    ∃ k₀ : ℝ,0<k₀ ∧ ∀ k : ℝ,k₀≤k →
    ∃ E : Set Torus,MeasurableSet E ∧ 0<area E ∧
      (standardMap k ⁻¹' E=E) ∧ Ergodic (standardMap k) (normalizedArea E) ∧
      (∀ᵐ z ∂normalizedArea E,∃ l : ℝ,0<l ∧ LyapunovSpectrumAt k z l) ∧
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N) (P : Fin N → Set Torus),
        (∀ j,MeasurableSet (P j)) ∧ ((⋃ j,P j) =ᵐ[area] E) ∧
        (∀ i j,i≠j → area (P i∩P j)=0) ∧
        (∀ j,(standardMap k '' P j) =ᵐ[area] P ⟨(j.val+1)%N,Nat.mod_lt _ hN⟩) ∧
        (∀ j,area (P j)=area E/(N : ℝ≥0∞) ∧ 0<area (P j)) ∧
        (∀ j,∀ r : ℕ,0<r → Ergodic (((standardMap k)^[N])^[r]) (normalizedArea (P j))) ∧
        (∀ j,∃ α : ℕ → ℕ → Torus → Bool,
          (∀ i r,Measurable (α i r)) ∧ Function.Injective (fun z => fun i r => α i r z) ∧
          ∀ M : ℕ,WeakBernoulliProcess (normalizedArea (P j))
            (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N) (joinedBinary α M)) := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hdef⟩ := eventually_meanDeficit_small (1/8 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨K,hK,?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hk0 : 0≤k := hK.le.trans hk
  obtain ⟨χ,hχ,hgap⟩ := exists_positive_spectral_gap k hk0
    (positive_standardLyapunov_of_deficit k hk0 (hdef k hk))
  exact actual_cyclic_weakBernoulli_component k hk0 hχ hgap

end StandardMapEntropy

end

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.ComponentsMain:.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.main_components
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.ComponentsMain:.text:
theorem main_components : MainComponentsObligation := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hpieces⟩ := eventually_actual_cyclic_weakBernoulli_component
  refine ⟨K,hK,?_⟩
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨E,hE,hEpos,hEinv,hEerg,hEspec,N,hN,P,hPM,hPU,hPD,hPC,hPA,hPT,hPW⟩ := hpieces k hk
  refine ⟨E,hE,hEpos,?_,hEerg,hEspec,N,hN,P,hPM,hPU,hPD,hPC,hPA,?_⟩
  · exact Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq hEinv
  · intro j
    obtain ⟨α,hα,hsep,hwb⟩ := hPW j
    exact actual_return_bernoulli k (hK.le.trans hk) N (P j) (hPA j).2
      (hPT j) α hα hsep hwb

end StandardMapEntropy

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Bernoulli.Ergod.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.actual_cyclic_weakBernoulli_component
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Bernoulli.Ergod.text:
theorem actual_cyclic_weakBernoulli_component (k : ℝ) (hk : 0≤k) {χ : ℝ} (hχ : 0<χ)
    (hgap : 0<area (spectralGapRegion k hk χ)) :
    ∃ E : Set Torus,MeasurableSet E ∧ 0<area E ∧
      (standardMap k ⁻¹' E=E) ∧ Ergodic (standardMap k) (normalizedArea E) ∧
      (∀ᵐ z ∂normalizedArea E,∃ l : ℝ,0<l ∧ LyapunovSpectrumAt k z l) ∧
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (hN : 0<N) (P : Fin N → Set Torus),
        (∀ j,MeasurableSet (P j)) ∧ ((⋃ j,P j) =ᵐ[area] E) ∧
        (∀ i j,i≠j → area (P i∩P j)=0) ∧
        (∀ j,(standardMap k '' P j) =ᵐ[area] P ⟨(j.val+1)%N,Nat.mod_lt _ hN⟩) ∧
        (∀ j,area (P j)=area E/(N : ℝ≥0∞) ∧ 0<area (P j)) ∧
        (∀ j,∀ r : ℕ,0<r → Ergodic (((standardMap k)^[N])^[r]) (normalizedArea (P j))) ∧
        (∀ j,∃ α : ℕ → ℕ → Torus → Bool,
          (∀ i r,Measurable (α i r)) ∧ Function.Injective (fun z => fun i r => α i r z) ∧
          ∀ M : ℕ,WeakBernoulliProcess (normalizedArea (P j))
            (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N) (joinedBinary α M)) := by
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := exists_reversibleRectangleBlock k hk hχ hgap
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := reversible_graph_families B
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := reversible_graph_rectangle G hk
  obtain ⟨F,hπ,hFH⟩ := R.powerAtoms_with_rectangle hk
  have he : MeasurePreserving (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) area area := measurePreserving_standardMap k
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := F.exists_totally_ergodic_cycle he
  let C := F.cycle he n
  let P (j : Fin C.period) : Set Torus := ((standardMap_measurableEquiv k).symm^[j.val]) ⁻¹' F.atom n
  have hP (j : Fin C.period) : MeasurableSet (P j) :=
    (F.measurable n).preimage ((standardMap_measurableEquiv k).symm.measurable.iterate j.val)
  have hPmass (j : Fin C.period) : area (P j)=area (F.atom n) :=
    ((he.symm (standardMap_measurableEquiv k)).iterate j.val).measure_preimage (F.measurable n).nullMeasurableSet
  have hEerg : Ergodic (standardMap k) (normalizedArea (F.atom 0)) := by
    have hh := (F.ergodic 0).smul_measure (area (F.atom 0))⁻¹
    simp only [zero_add,Function.iterate_one] at hh
    exact hh
  have htotal (j : Fin C.period) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0<r) :
      Ergodic (((standardMap k)^[C.period])^[r]) (normalizedArea (P j)) :=
    (hn r hr j).smul_measure (area (P j))⁻¹
  have hbase (r : ℕ) (hr : 0<r) :
      Ergodic (((standardMap k)^[C.period])^[r]) (normalizedArea (F.atom n)) := by
    simpa only [P,Fin.val_zero,Function.iterate_zero,preimage_id_eq,id_eq] using htotal ⟨0,C.positive⟩ r hr
  let _ := normalizedArea_probability (F.positive n)
  obtain ⟨α,hα,hsep,hwb⟩ := R.exists_weakBernoulli_partitions C.positive (normalizedArea (F.atom n)) hbase (hπ n)
  refine ⟨F.atom 0,F.measurable 0,F.positive 0,?_,hEerg,
    positive_spectrum_on_ergodic_component k hk (F.measurable 0) hEerg hFH,
    C.period,C.positive,P,hP,C.cover,C.disjoint,C.forward,?_,htotal,?_⟩
  · have hh := F.invariant 0
    simp only [zero_add,Function.iterate_one] at hh
    exact hh
  · intro j
    rw [hPmass]
    exact ⟨(ENNReal.eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast C.positive.ne') (by simp)).mpr C.mass,F.positive n⟩
  · intro j
    let d : Torus → Torus := (standardMap_measurableEquiv k).symm^[j.val]
    have hd : MeasurePreserving d (normalizedArea (P j)) (normalizedArea (F.atom n)) := by
      unfold normalizedArea
      rw [hPmass]
      exact (((he.symm (standardMap_measurableEquiv k)).iterate j.val).restrict_preimage
        (F.measurable n)).smul_measure (area (F.atom n))⁻¹
    have hdi : Function.Injective d := (standardMap_measurableEquiv k).symm.injective.iterate j.val
    refine ⟨fun i r => α i r ∘ d,fun i r => (hα i r).comp hd.measurable,?_,?_⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact hdi (hsep hxy)
    · intro M
      have hc : Function.Commute (standardMap_measurableEquiv k).symm (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) :=
        fun x => (inverseMap_standardMap k x).trans (standardMap_inverseMap k x).symm
      have hde : Function.Commute d (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) C.period) := by
        simpa only [funext (iterateEquiv_apply (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) C.period)] using
          hc.iterate_iterate j.val C.period
      have hde' : Function.Commute d (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) C.period).symm := by
        have hc' : Function.Commute (standardMap_measurableEquiv k).symm (standardMap_measurableEquiv k).symm :=
          fun _ => rfl
        simpa only [funext (iterateEquiv_symm_apply (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) C.period)] using
          hc'.iterate_iterate j.val C.period
      exact (hwb M).translate _ hd hde hde' (measurable_joinedBinary hα M)

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Bernoulli.Integ.name: OAI.HyperbolicCoding.iterateEquiv_apply
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Bernoulli.Integ.text:
lemma iterateEquiv_apply (e : X ≃ᵐ X) (n : ℕ) (x : X) : iterateEquiv e n x=e^[n] x := by
  change ((e.toEquiv^n) x)=_
  rw [Equiv.Perm.coe_pow]
  rfl

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.TypicalW.name: OAI.HyperbolicCoding.weightEntropy
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.TypicalW.text: noncomputable def weightEntropy (p : A → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ a,p a*(-Real.log (p a))

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.Centered.name: OAI.HyperbolicCoding.generating_iid_partition
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.Centered.text:
theorem generating_iid_partition (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [NullSingletonClass μ] [μ.OuterRegular] (e : X ≃ᵐ X) (he : Ergodic e μ)
    (htotal : ∀ m : ℕ,0 < m → Ergodic (e^[m]) μ)
    (β : A → ℝ) (hβ : ∀ a,0≤β a) (hβsum : ∑ a,β a=1) (hβentropy : 0 < weightEntropy β)
    (H : FiniteRateSupremum μ e (weightEntropy β))
    (α : ℕ → ℕ → X → Bool) (hα : ∀ i j,Measurable (α i j))
    (hsep : Function.Injective (fun x => fun i j => α i j x))
    (hwb : ∀ M,WeakBernoulliProcess μ e (joinedBinary α M))
    (zero one : A) (h01 : zero≠one)
    (p₀ : X → A) (hp₀ : Measurable p₀)
    (hcode₀ : MeasurePreserving (orbitName e p₀) μ (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => finiteWeightLaw β))) :
    ∃ p : X → A,Measurable p ∧
      MeasurePreserving (orbitName e p) μ (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => finiteWeightLaw β)) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ,∃ R : ℕ,∃ D : (Fin (2*R+1) → A) → ((Fin (n+1) × Fin (n+1)) → Bool),
        μ.real {x | joinedBinary α (n+1) x≠D (centeredWindow R (orbitName e p x))}≤2*(1/2 : ℝ)^(n+2) := by
  have hstart := generating_iid_stage μ e he htotal β hβ hβsum hβentropy H α hα hsep hwb
    zero one h01 p₀ hp₀ hcode₀ 0 zero_lt_one zero_lt_one
  let S₀ : GeneratingIIDStage μ e β α 0 := Classical.choose hstart
  have hnext (n : ℕ) (S : GeneratingIIDStage μ e β α n) :
      ∃ T : GeneratingIIDStage μ e β α (n+1),
        μ.real {x | S.partition x≠T.partition x} < S.budget/2 ∧ T.budget≤S.budget/2 :=
    generating_iid_stage μ e he htotal β hβ hβsum hβentropy H α hα hsep hwb
      zero one h01 S.partition S.measurable_partition S.iid (n+1) (half_pos S.budget_pos) (half_pos S.budget_pos)
  let next (n : ℕ) (S : GeneratingIIDStage μ e β α n) : GeneratingIIDStage μ e β α (n+1) :=
    Classical.choose (hnext n S)
  let z : (n : ℕ) → GeneratingIIDStage μ e β α n := fun n =>
    Nat.rec (motive:=fun n => GeneratingIIDStage μ e β α n) S₀ next n
  let q : ℕ → X → A := fun n => (z n).partition
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (z n).budget
  have hq (n : ℕ) : Measurable (q n) := (z n).measurable_partition
  have hbpos (n : ℕ) : 0 < b n := (z n).budget_pos
  have hb0 : b 0≤1 := (Classical.choose_spec hstart).2
  have hb (n : ℕ) : b (n+1)≤b n/2 := (Classical.choose_spec (hnext n (z n))).2
  have hpaint (n : ℕ) : μ.real {x | q n x≠q (n+1) x} < b n/2 :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hnext n (z n))).1
  have hgeom (n : ℕ) : μ.real {x | q (n+1) x≠q n x} < ((1/2 : ℝ≥0)^n : ℝ) := by
    rw [disagreement_symm]
    have hdecay := budget_geometric_decay b hb 0 n
    simp only [Nat.zero_add] at hdecay
    have hbn : b n≤(1/2 : ℝ)^n := hdecay.trans (by
      simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb0 (by positivity : 0≤(1/2 : ℝ)^n))
    have hh : b n/2≤b n := by linarith only [hbpos n]
    have hc := (hpaint n).trans_le (hh.trans hbn)
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_pow,NNReal.coe_div,NNReal.coe_one,NNReal.coe_ofNat] using hc
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hlim⟩ := exists_partition_limit μ q hq (geometric_repainting_summable μ q hgeom)
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteWeightLaw β) := finiteWeightLaw_probability β hβ hβsum
  have hlaw (n : ℕ) : LawClose (μ.map (word e (q n) n))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => finiteWeightLaw β)) (1/(n+1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [word_law_of_iid_factor μ e (q n) (hq n) (finiteWeightLaw β) (z n).iid]
    intro S hS
    simp only [sub_self,abs_zero]
    positivity
  have hcode := iid_law_of_growing_forward_words μ e he.toMeasurePreserving q hq p hp hlim
    (finiteWeightLaw β) (fun n => 1/(n+1 : ℝ)) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat hlaw
  refine ⟨p,hp,hcode,?_⟩
  intro n
  refine ⟨(z n).radius,(z n).decoder,?_⟩
  have htail := geometric_tail_limit μ q p hq hp hlim b (fun n => (hbpos n).le) hb (fun n => (hpaint n).le) n
  have hh := centered_decoder_perturbation μ e he.toMeasurePreserving (joinedBinary α (n+1))
    (q n) p (measurable_joinedBinary hα _) (hq n) hp (z n).radius (z n).decoder
  have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (Nat.cast_nonneg (2*(z n).radius+1) : (0 : ℝ)≤_)
  have he := (z n).error
  have hb := (z n).budget_small
  change _≤_+_ at hh
  change _ < (1/2 : ℝ)^(n+2) at he
  change (2*(z n).radius+1 : ℕ)*b n≤(1/2 : ℝ)^(n+2) at hb
  linarith only [hh,hd,he,hb]
end HyperbolicCoding

end

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.NoCriticalSeque.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.eventually_meanDeficit_small
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.NoCriticalSeque.text:
theorem eventually_meanDeficit_small (η:ℝ) (hη:0<η) :
    ∃K:ℝ,0<K ∧ ∀k:ℝ,K≤k → ∀n:ℕ,0<n → meanDeficit k n<η := by
  have hex:∃K:ℝ,∀k:ℝ,K≤k → ∀n:ℕ,0<n → meanDeficit k n<η := by
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨S⟩:=exists_critical_scale_sequence η hη (badGrowth_arbitrarily_large η h)
    exact no_critical_scale_sequence S
  obtain ⟨K,hK⟩:=hex
  exact ⟨max K 1,lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (le_max_right _ _),fun k hk=>hK k ((le_max_left _ _).trans hk)⟩
end StandardMapEntropy

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.Positive.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.actual_return_full_entropy_iid_factor
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.Positive.text:
theorem actual_return_full_entropy_iid_factor (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (N : ℕ)
    (E : Set Torus) (hE : 0 < area E)
    (htotal : ∀ m : ℕ,0 < m → Ergodic (((standardMap k)^[N])^[m]) (normalizedArea E))
    (α : ℕ → ℕ → Torus → Bool) (hα : ∀ i j,Measurable (α i j))
    (hsep : Function.Injective (fun z => fun i j => α i j z))
    (hwb : ∀ M : ℕ,WeakBernoulliProcess (normalizedArea E)
      (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N) (joinedBinary α M)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,∃ β : Fin (n+2) → ℝ,∃ p : Torus → Fin (n+2),
      (∀ a,0 ≤ β a) ∧ (∑ a,β a=1) ∧ 0 < weightEntropy β ∧ Measurable p ∧
      FiniteRateSupremum (normalizedArea E) ((standardMap k)^[N]) (weightEntropy β) ∧
      MeasurePreserving (orbitName (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N) p)
        (normalizedArea E) (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℤ => finiteWeightLaw β)) ∧
      rate (normalizedArea E) ((standardMap k)^[N]) p=weightEntropy β ∧
      (∀ z,orbitName (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N) p ((standardMap k)^[N] z)=
        fun i => orbitName (iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N) p z (i+1)) ∧
      (∀ r : ℕ,∀ γ : Torus → Fin (r+1),Measurable γ →
        rate (normalizedArea E) ((standardMap k)^[N]) (fun z => (p z,γ z))=weightEntropy β) := by
  let := normalizedArea_probability hE
  let := normalizedArea_nullSingleton E
  let e := iterateEquiv (standardMap_measurableEquiv k) N
  have heq : (e : Torus → Torus)=(standardMap k)^[N] := funext (iterateEquiv_apply _ N)
  have he : Ergodic e (normalizedArea E) := by
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [Function.iterate_one] using htotal 1 (by omega)
  have het : ∀ m : ℕ,0 < m → Ergodic (e^[m]) (normalizedArea E) := by
    simpa only [heq] using htotal
  obtain ⟨h,H,_hbound⟩ := exists_finiteRateSupremum (normalizedArea E) ((standardMap k)^[N])
    ((Real.log 1000+(∫ z,Real.log ‖standardDerivativeProduct k z N‖ ∂area))/area.real E)
    (fun r p hp => restricted_finite_rate_upper k hk N E hE
      (by simpa only [heq] using he.toMeasurePreserving) p hp)
  have H' : FiniteRateSupremum (normalizedArea E) e h := by simpa only [heq] using H
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := separating_weakBernoulli_positive_rate (normalizedArea E) e
    he.toMeasurePreserving α hα hsep hwb
  have hh : 0 < h := hM.trans_le (H'.upper _ (measurable_joinedBinary hα M))
  obtain ⟨n,β,hβ,hβsum,hβentropy⟩ := exists_finite_weight_entropy h hh.le
  have hpos : 0 < weightEntropy β := hβentropy.symm ▸ hh
  have Hβ : FiniteRateSupremum (normalizedArea E) e (weightEntropy β) := hβentropy.symm ▸ H'
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hcode,hr,hshift,hjoint⟩ := full_entropy_iid_factor (normalizedArea E) e he het
    β hβ hβsum hpos Hβ (⟨0,by omega⟩ : Fin (n+2)) (⟨1,by omega⟩ : Fin (n+2))
    (by intro h; have hv := congrArg Fin.val h; simp only at hv; omega)
  refine ⟨n,β,p,hβ,hβsum,hpos,hp,?_,hcode,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [heq] using Hβ
  · simpa only [heq] using hr
  · simpa only [heq] using hshift
  · simpa only [heq] using hjoint
end StandardMapEntropy

end

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Bernoulli.Integ.name: OAI.HyperbolicCoding.iterateEquiv
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Bernoulli.Integ.text:
def iterateEquiv (e : X ≃ᵐ X) (n : ℕ) : X ≃ᵐ X where
  toEquiv := e.toEquiv^n
  measurable_toFun := by simpa only [Equiv.Perm.coe_pow,MeasurableEquiv.coe_toEquiv] using e.measurable.iterate n
  measurable_invFun := by
    change Measurable (⇑((e.toEquiv^n)⁻¹))
    rw [←inv_pow,Equiv.Perm.inv_def,Equiv.Perm.coe_pow]
    exact e.symm.measurable.iterate n

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Components.Powe.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.exists_positive_spectral_gap
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Components.Powe.text:
lemma exists_positive_spectral_gap (k : ℝ) (hk : 0≤k)
    (hpos : 0<area {z | 0<standardLyapunov k hk z}) :
    ∃ χ : ℝ,0<χ ∧ 0<area (spectralGapRegion k hk χ) := by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hz (n : ℕ) : area (spectralGapRegion k hk (1/((n : ℝ)+1)))=0 :=
    le_antisymm (h _ (by positivity)) (bot_le)
  have hsub : {z | 0<standardLyapunov k hk z}⊆⋃ n : ℕ,spectralGapRegion k hk (1/((n : ℝ)+1)) := by
    intro z hzL
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1/standardLyapunov k hk z)
    apply mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨n,?_⟩
    change 1/((n : ℝ)+1)<standardLyapunov k hk z
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(n : ℝ)+1)).mpr
    have ha := (div_lt_iff₀ hzL).mp hn
    nlinarith
  exact hpos.ne' (measure_mono_null hsub (measure_iUnion_null hz))

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Defini.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.LyapunovSpectrumAt
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Defini.text:
def LyapunovSpectrumAt (k : ℝ) (z : Torus) (l : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ l ∧ ((l = 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℂ, v ≠ 0 → VectorGrowth k z v 0) ∨
    (0 < l ∧ ∃ s : ℂ, s ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ v : ℂ, v ≠ 0 →
      VectorGrowth k z v (if wedge s v = 0 then -l else l)))

end StandardMapEntropy

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.FullEntr.name: OAI.HyperbolicCoding.FiniteRateSupremum
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.FullEntr.text:
def FiniteRateSupremum (μ : Measure X) (f : X → X) (h : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ,∀ p : X → Fin (r+1),Measurable p → rate μ f p≤h) ∧
  (∀ ε : ℝ,0 < ε → ∃ r : ℕ,∃ p : X → Fin (r+1),Measurable p ∧ h-ε < rate μ f p)

omit [StandardBorelSpace X] [TopologicalSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
  [OpensMeasurableSpace X] in

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.TypicalW.name: OAI.HyperbolicCoding.finiteWeightLaw_probability
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Coding.TypicalW.text:
lemma finiteWeightLaw_probability (p : A → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a,0≤p a) (hs : ∑ a,p a=1) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteWeightLaw p) := by
  constructor
  simp only [finiteWeightLaw,Measure.finsetSum_apply,Measure.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,
    Measure.dirac_apply_of_mem (mem_univ _),mul_one]
  rw [←ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun a _ => hp a),hs,ENNReal.ofReal_one]

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.NoCriticalSeque.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.no_critical_scale_sequence
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.NoCriticalSeque.text:
theorem no_critical_scale_sequence (S:CriticalScaleSequence) : False := by
  obtain ⟨L⟩:=S.exists_limitLaws
  let α:ℝ:=1/(32*1200000004)
  have ha:0<α := by norm_num [α]
  have ha1:α≤1 := by norm_num [α]
  have haS:α*1200000004≤1/16 := by norm_num [α]
  obtain ⟨H,hH,hconv,hint,hbound⟩:=S.exists_terminal_cap_limit L ha ha1
  have hbalance:(∫d:NonAffineArray,capG α d.val ∂L.multi)=H :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique (S.capG_limit_balance L ha.le) (S.capG_prelimit_tendsto L ha.le ha1 hconv)
  have hstrict:=S.terminal_cap_strict L ha.le ha1 hH hbound
  have hrem:=S.remainder_cap_nonpos L ha.le ha1 haS
  rw [S.capG_integral_decomposition L] at hbalance
  linarith

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyConjugac.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.metricEntropy_standardMap_ge_partition
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyConjugac.text:
lemma metricEntropy_standardMap_ge_partition {r:ℕ} (k:ℝ) (p:FinitePartition r) :
    partitionEntropy area (torusStep k) p≤ metricEntropy area (standardMap k) := by
  rw [← coordinate_partitionEntropy]
  exact le_iSup_of_le r (le_iSup_of_le (coordinatePartition p) le_rfl)

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyEndpoint.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.main_entropy
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyEndpoint.text:
theorem main_entropy : MainObligation := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hdef⟩:=eventually_meanDeficit_small (1/8:ℝ) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨max K ((1000:ℝ)^4),lt_of_lt_of_le hK (le_max_left _ _),?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hKk:K≤k := (le_max_left K ((1000:ℝ)^4)).trans hk
  have hlarge:(1000:ℝ)^4≤k := (le_max_right K ((1000:ℝ)^4)).trans hk
  have hk0:0≤k := le_of_lt (hK.trans_le hKk)
  apply positive_entropy_of_uniform_deficit k hk0
  · unfold growthBase
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  · exact hdef k hKk
end StandardMapEntropy

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyParamete.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.entropy_subdivision_parameters
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyParamete.text:
lemma entropy_subdivision_parameters (M:ℝ) (hM:(1000:ℝ)^4≤M) :
    ∃N:ℕ,0<N ∧ 2*M≤(N:ℝ)^2 ∧ Real.log ((196*N:ℕ):ℝ)≤(3/4:ℝ)*Real.log M := by
  have hM1:1≤M := by nlinarith
  have hM0:0<M := by linarith
  let N:ℕ:=⌈Real.sqrt (2*M)⌉₊
  have hNp:0<N := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
  have hNl:Real.sqrt (2*M)≤(N:ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hNu:(N:ℝ)<Real.sqrt (2*M)+1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hMs:1≤Real.sqrt M := by simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hM1
  have hNs:Real.sqrt (2*M)≤2*Real.sqrt M := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
    constructor
    · positivity
    · nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hM0.le]
  have hN2:2*M≤(N:ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0≤2*M by positivity),Real.sqrt_nonneg (2*M)]
  have hN3:(N:ℝ)≤3*Real.sqrt M := by linarith
  have hR:((196*N:ℕ):ℝ)≤1000*Real.sqrt M := by push_cast; nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg M]
  have hRp:0<((196*N:ℕ):ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos (by norm_num : 0<196) hNp
  have hlogM:(4:ℝ)*Real.log 1000≤Real.log M := by
    have h:=Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1000^4) hM
    simpa only [Real.log_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] using h
  have hlogR:=Real.log_le_log hRp hR
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (1000:ℝ)≠0) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hM0).ne',Real.log_sqrt hM0.le] at hlogR
  exact ⟨N,hNp,hN2,by linarith⟩

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyEndpoint.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.integral_log_growth_of_deficit
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyEndpoint.text:
lemma integral_log_growth_of_deficit (k:ℝ) (hk:0≤k)
    (hdef:∀n:ℕ,0<n → meanDeficit k n<(1/8:ℝ)) (n:ℕ) :
    (7/8:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)*Real.log (growthBase k)≤∫z,Real.log ‖torusSegmentTransfer k z 0 n‖ ∂area := by
  by_cases hn:0<n
  · have hnp:(0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hl:=log_growthBase_pos k hk
    have hI:(7/8:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)≤∫z,productDistance k z 0 (n:ℤ) ∂area := by
      have hd:=hdef n hn
      unfold meanDeficit at hd
      have hh:(7/8:ℝ)<(∫z,productDistance k z 0 (n:ℤ) ∂area)/(n:ℝ) := by linarith
      exact ((lt_div_iff₀ hnp).mp hh).le
    have he:(∫z,productDistance k z 0 (n:ℤ) ∂area)=
        (∫z,Real.log ‖torusSegmentTransfer k z 0 n‖ ∂area)/Real.log (growthBase k) := by
      have hf:(fun z=>productDistance k z 0 (n:ℤ))=(fun z=>Real.log ‖torusSegmentTransfer k z 0 n‖/Real.log (growthBase k)) := by
        funext z
        simpa only [zero_add] using productDistance_forward k z 0 n
      rw [hf,integral_div]
    rw [he] at hI
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hl).mp hI
  · have he:n=0 := by omega
    subst n
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero,mul_zero,zero_mul]
    exact integral_nonneg fun z=>Real.log_nonneg (torusSegmentTransfer_norm_bounds k hk z 0 0).1

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyEndpoint.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.positive_entropy_of_uniform_deficit
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyEndpoint.text:
lemma positive_entropy_of_uniform_deficit (k:ℝ) (hk:0≤k) (hM:(1000:ℝ)^4≤growthBase k)
    (hdef:∀n:ℕ,0<n → meanDeficit k n<(1/8:ℝ)) : 0 < metricEntropy area (standardMap k) := by
  obtain ⟨N,hN,hN2,hNR⟩:=entropy_subdivision_parameters (growthBase k) hM
  obtain ⟨ε,Q,hε,hQ,hε1,hε2,hQε,hQC⟩:=entropy_grid_parameters (growthBase k) (by linarith [growthBase_ge_four k hk])
  have hlog:=log_growthBase_pos k hk
  have hblock (n:ℕ) : ((n:ℝ)+1)*(Real.log (growthBase k)/8)≤
      blockEntropy area (torusStep k) (gridPartition Q hQ) (n+1) := by
    have h:=grid_block_entropy_growth k ε hk hε hε1 hε2 Q N hQ hQε hN hN2 n
    have hg:=integral_log_growth_of_deficit k hk hdef n
    have hr:=mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNR (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0:ℝ)≤n)
    nlinarith
  have hp:ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (growthBase k)/8)≤
      partitionEntropy area (torusStep k) (gridPartition Q hQ) := by
    apply le_iInf
    intro n
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (show (0:ℝ)<(n:ℝ)+1 by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith [hblock n]
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by positivity))
    (hp.trans (metricEntropy_standardMap_ge_partition k (gridPartition Q hQ)))

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyParamete.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.entropy_grid_parameters
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyParamete.text:
lemma entropy_grid_parameters (M:ℝ) (hM:1≤M) :
    ∃ε:ℝ,∃Q:ℕ,0<ε ∧ 0<Q ∧ 2*Real.pi*ε≤1 ∧ M*ε≤1 ∧ 6/(Q:ℝ)≤ε ∧
      Real.log (4*ε/(Q:ℝ))≤-Real.log M := by
  have hM0:0<M := by linarith
  let ε:ℝ:=1/(10*M)
  let Q:ℕ:=⌈60*M⌉₊
  have hε:0<ε := by dsimp [ε]; positivity
  have hQ:0<Q := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hQr:(0:ℝ)<Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hQ1:(1:ℝ)≤Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hQl:60*M≤(Q:ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
  have hε1:2*Real.pi*ε≤1 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc,mul_one]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<10*M)).mpr
    nlinarith [Real.pi_lt_four]
  have hε2:M*ε≤1 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc,mul_one]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<10*M)).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hQε:6/(Q:ℝ)≤ε := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 6/(60*M) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by positivity) hQl
      _ = ε := by dsimp [ε]; field_simp; ring
  have hC:0<4*ε/(Q:ℝ) := by positivity
  have hCM:4*ε/(Q:ℝ)≤1/M := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 4*ε := div_le_self (by positivity) hQ1
      _ ≤ 1/M := by
        dsimp [ε]
        rw [← mul_div_assoc,mul_one]
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (show 0<10*M by positivity) hM0).mpr
        nlinarith
  have hlog:=Real.log_le_log hC hCM
  rw [one_div,Real.log_inv] at hlog
  exact ⟨ε,Q,hε,hQ,hε1,hε2,hQε,hlog⟩
end StandardMapEntropy

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Actual.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.actual_positive_lyapunov
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Actual.text:
theorem actual_positive_lyapunov :
    ∃ k₀ : ℝ, 0 < k₀ ∧ ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k →
      ∃ L : Torus → ℝ, Measurable L ∧ Integrable L area ∧
        (∀ z, L (standardMap k z) = L z) ∧
        (∀ᵐ z ∂area, LyapunovSpectrumAt k z (L z)) ∧
        (∀ᵐ z ∂area, Tendsto
          (fun n : ℕ => Real.log ‖standardDerivativeProduct k z n‖ / (n : ℝ))
          atTop (𝓝 (L z))) ∧ 0 < area {z | 0 < L z} := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hdef⟩ := eventually_meanDeficit_small (1 / 8 : ℝ) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ k := hK.le.trans hk
  exact ⟨standardLyapunov k hk0, measurable_standardLyapunov k hk0,
    integrable_standardLyapunov k hk0, standardLyapunov_invariant k hk0,
    ae_standardLyapunov_spectrum k hk0, ae_standardLyapunov_rate k hk0,
    positive_standardLyapunov_of_deficit k hk0 (hdef k hk)⟩

end StandardMapEntropy

end
end

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.integrable_standardLyapunov
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.text:
lemma integrable_standardLyapunov (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    Integrable (standardLyapunov k hk) area :=
  measurePreserving_recurrenceCoordinates.integrable_comp_of_integrable
    (transferLyapunov_limit k hk).2.1

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyLyapunov.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.PositiveLargestLyapunov
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyLyapunov.text:
def PositiveLargestLyapunov (k : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ E : Set Torus, MeasurableSet E ∧ 0 < area E ∧
    ∀ z ∈ E, ∃ l : ℝ, 0 < l ∧ LyapunovSpectrumAt k z l ∧
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => Real.log ‖standardDerivativeProduct k z n‖ / (n : ℝ))
        atTop (𝓝 l)

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.standardLyapunov
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.text:
noncomputable def standardLyapunov (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (z : Torus) : ℝ :=
  transferLyapunov k hk (recurrenceCoordinates z)

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Actual.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.ae_standardLyapunov_spectrum
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Actual.text:
lemma ae_standardLyapunov_spectrum (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂area, LyapunovSpectrumAt k z (standardLyapunov k hk z) := by
  filter_upwards [ae_standardLyapunov_rate k hk] with z hz
  refine ⟨standardLyapunov_nonneg k hk z, ?_⟩
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (standardLyapunov_nonneg k hk z) with hzero | hpos
  · refine Or.inl ⟨hzero.symm, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    apply PlaneLyapunov.all_growth_zero (standardDerivativeProduct k z)
      (standardDerivativeProduct_area k z) _ v hv
    simpa only [← hzero] using hz
  · refine Or.inr ⟨hpos, ?_⟩
    exact PlaneLyapunov.positive_flag (standardDerivativeProduct k z)
      (standardDerivativeProduct_area k z) (9*growthBase k)
      (mul_pos (by norm_num) (by have := growthBase_ge_four k hk; linarith))
      (standardDerivativeProduct_step_lower k hk z) hpos hz

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.standardLyapunov_invariant
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.text:
lemma standardLyapunov_invariant (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (z : Torus) :
    standardLyapunov k hk (standardMap k z) = standardLyapunov k hk z := by
  unfold standardLyapunov
  rw [standardMap_conjugacy]
  exact (transferLyapunov_limit k hk).2.2.2.1 _

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyLyapunov.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.main_entropy_complete
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyLyapunov.text:
theorem main_entropy_complete :
    ∃ k₀ : ℝ, 0 < k₀ ∧ ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k →
      0 < metricEntropy area (standardMap k) ∧
      PositiveLargestLyapunov k ∧
      (0 < metricEntropy area (standardMap k) ↔ PositiveLargestLyapunov k) := by
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁, hEntropy⟩ := main_entropy
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂, hLyapunov⟩ := actual_positive_lyapunov
  refine ⟨max K₁ K₂, lt_of_lt_of_le hK₁ (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  have hEnt := hEntropy k ((le_max_left K₁ K₂).trans hk)
  obtain ⟨L, hL, _hLint, _hLinv, hspec, hrate, hpos⟩ :=
    hLyapunov k ((le_max_right K₁ K₂).trans hk)
  have hLyap : PositiveLargestLyapunov k :=
    positiveLargestLyapunov_of_ae_spectrum k L hL hspec hrate hpos
  exact ⟨hEnt, hLyap, ⟨fun _ => hLyap, fun _ => hEnt⟩⟩

end StandardMapEntropy

end OAI

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.measurable_standardLyapunov
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.text:
lemma measurable_standardLyapunov (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    Measurable (standardLyapunov k hk) :=
  (transferLyapunov_limit k hk).1.comp measurable_recurrenceCoordinates

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Defini.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.standardDerivativeProduct
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Defini.text:
noncomputable def standardDerivativeProduct (k : ℝ) (z : Torus) (n : ℕ) : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
  Nat.rec (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℂ)
    (fun i A => (standardDerivative k ((standardMap k)^[i] z)).comp A) n

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.ae_standardLyapunov_rate
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.Lyapunov.Deriva.text:
lemma ae_standardLyapunov_rate (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂area, Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => Real.log ‖standardDerivativeProduct k z n‖ / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 (standardLyapunov k hk z)) := by
  have hh := measurePreserving_recurrenceCoordinates.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
    (transferLyapunov_limit k hk).2.2.2.2
  filter_upwards [hh] with z hz
  exact derivative_rate_of_transfer_rate k hk z _ hz

OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyLyapunov.name: OAI.StandardMapEntropy.positiveLargestLyapunov_of_ae_spectrum
OAI.Dynamics.StandardMap.EntropyLyapunov.text:
lemma positiveLargestLyapunov_of_ae_spectrum (k : ℝ) (L : Torus → ℝ)
    (hL : Measurable L)
    (hspec : ∀ᵐ z ∂area, LyapunovSpectrumAt k z (L z))
    (hrate : ∀ᵐ z ∂area, Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => Real.log ‖standardDerivativeProduct k z n‖ / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 (L z)))
    (hpos : 0 < area {z | 0 < L z}) : PositiveLargestLyapunov k := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hNsub, hNmeas, hNnull⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_superset_of_null (ae_iff.mp (hspec.and hrate))
  refine ⟨{z | 0 < L z} \ N,
    (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hL).diff hNmeas, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [measure_sdiff_null hNnull] using hpos
  · intro z hz
    have hzgood : LyapunovSpectrumAt k z (L z) ∧ Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => Real.log ‖standardDerivativeProduct k z n‖ / (n : ℝ))
        atTop (𝓝 (L z)) := by
      by_contra hbad
      exact hz.2 (hNsub hbad)
    exact ⟨L z, hz.1, hzgood.1, hzgood.2⟩

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:18.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.sum_take_ofFn
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:18.text:
lemma sum_take_ofFn [AddCommMonoid E] {N : ℕ} (v : Fin N → E) (k : ℕ) :
    ((List.ofFn v).take k).sum =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < k), v i := by
  induction N generalizing k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    cases k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k =>
      simp only [List.ofFn_succ, List.take_succ_cons, List.sum_cons,
        Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.zero_lt_succ, ite_true, Fin.val_succ,
        Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff]
      rw [ih]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Main:15.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.Filter.filtered_signed_prefixes
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Main:15.text:
lemma filtered_signed_prefixes {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ι → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, vectorMass (b i) ≤ signingScale^2) :
    ∃ ε : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, ε i = -1 ∨ ε i = 1) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n →
        ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k), ε i • WithLp.toLp 2 (b i)‖ ≤
          (2*bodyScale*stateRadius)*Real.sqrt (Fintype.card ι) := by
  let R := initialMatrix ι (Fin n)
  let L := familySteps b
  let ps : Fin (n+1) → List (Step ι (ι⊕Fin n)) := fun t => L.take t.val
  let H := normalizedPredictor b
  let K := bodyScale • applicationDomain (fun t => run R (ps t)) H
  have hlt : ∀ i,vectorMass (b i)<1 := fun i =>
    (hb i).trans_lt (by nlinarith [signingScale_pos,signingScale_lt_one])
  have hg : ShiftedSections.Good K := applicationDomain_good initialMatrix_coisometry
    (familySteps_good hlt) (familySteps_fresh b) (familySteps_nodup b) ps
    (fun t => List.take_prefix t.val L) H (normalizedPredictor_mass hb) (normalizedPredictor_column hb)
  let m : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (ι⊕Fin n) →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun i => rowMap (familyPredictor b i)
  have hm : ∀ i l : Fin n,i≤l → m i (EuclideanSpace.single (Sum.inr l) 1)=0 := by
    intro i l hil
    rw [show m i=rowMap (familyPredictor b i) from rfl,rowMap_single,familyPredictor_future b i l hil]
  have hslab : ∀ x∈K,∀ i,|m i x|<1/4 := by
    intro x hx i
    obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := Set.mem_smul_set.mp hx
    have hh := hy.2 i
    change ‖matrixMap (normalizedPredictor b i) y‖<2*slabRadius at hh
    rw [normalizedPredictor_norm] at hh
    have hh' := (div_lt_iff₀ signingScale_pos).mp hh
    change |rowMap (familyPredictor b i) (bodyScale • y)| < _
    rw [map_smul,smul_eq_mul,abs_mul,abs_of_pos bodyScale_pos]
    have hf := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hh' bodyScale_pos
    have he : bodyScale*(2*slabRadius*signingScale)=1/4 := by
      nlinarith [signingScale_cancel]
    simpa only [he] using hf
  obtain ⟨ε,x,hε,hx,hxout,hxeq⟩ := ShiftedSections.adaptive_linear_equations
    (Sum.inr : Fin n → ι⊕Fin n) Sum.inr_injective m hm hg hslab
  have hx0 : ∀ i,x (Sum.inl i)=0 := by
    intro i
    exact hxout (Sum.inl i) (fun j => Sum.inl_ne_inr)
  have hxeq' : ∀ i,x (Sum.inr i)=rowMap (rawRow (run R (L.take i.val)) (b i)) x+ε i := by
    intro i
    have hh := hxeq i
    change x (Sum.inr i)=rowMap (familyPredictor b i) x+ε i at hh
    rw [familyPredictor_form,noiseRow_eval _ _ hx0] at hh
    exact hh
  have hcancel (k : ℕ) : matrixMap (run R (L.take k)) x=
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k),ε i • WithLp.toLp 2 (b i) := by
    have hh := run_prefix_cancel (fun i => symmetricStep (b i) (Sum.inr i)) R x ε
      (fun _ => rfl) hxeq' k
    rw [initialMatrix_eval x hx0,zero_add,EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.sum_take_ofFn] at hh
    exact hh
  refine ⟨ε,hε,fun k hk => ?_⟩
  rw [← hcancel k]
  obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := Set.mem_smul_set.mp hx
  have hh := hy.1.1 (⟨k,by omega⟩ : Fin (n+1))
  change ‖matrixMap (run R (L.take k)) y‖ < 2*stateRadius*Real.sqrt (Fintype.card ι) at hh
  rw [map_smul,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos bodyScale_pos]
  have hf := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hh bodyScale_pos
  nlinarith

end EuclideanSteinitz.Filter

namespace EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom
open EuclideanSteinitz.Filter GaussianAR

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Main:81.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.signed_prefix_bound
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Main:81.text:
theorem signed_prefix_bound : SignedPrefixBound universalConstant := by
  classical
  intro d N hd _hN v hv
  let : Nonempty (Fin d) := ⟨⟨0,by omega⟩⟩
  let b : Fin N → Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (signingScale • v i).ofLp
  have hb : ∀ i,vectorMass (b i) ≤ signingScale^2 := by
    intro i
    have he : vectorMass (b i)=‖signingScale • v i‖^2 := by
      exact (EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq (signingScale • v i)).symm
    rw [he,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos signingScale_pos,mul_pow]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (v i),hv i] : ‖v i‖^2≤1)
      (sq_nonneg signingScale)).trans_eq (mul_one _)
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hpref⟩ := filtered_signed_prefixes b hb
  refine ⟨ε,hε,fun k hk => ?_⟩
  have hh := hpref k hk
  have he : (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < k),ε i • WithLp.toLp 2 (b i))=
      signingScale • ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < k),ε i • v i := by
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    change ε i • (signingScale • v i)=signingScale • (ε i • v i)
    exact smul_comm _ _ _
  rw [he,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos signingScale_pos,Fintype.card_fin] at hh
  have hc : universalConstant*Real.sqrt d=(2*bodyScale*stateRadius*Real.sqrt d)/signingScale := by
    unfold universalConstant
    ring
  rw [hc]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ signingScale_pos).mpr
  nlinarith

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:133.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.signing_implies_ordering
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:133.text:
theorem signing_implies_ordering (C : ℝ) (h : SignedPrefixBound C) :
    OrderingPrefixBound C := by
  classical
  intro d N hd hN v hv hzero
  let peak : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) → ℝ := fun π =>
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun k : Fin (N + 1) =>
      ‖walkPrefix (fun i => v (π i)) k.val‖)
  obtain ⟨π, _, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ peak Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hpeak (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ N) :
      ‖walkPrefix (fun i => v (σ i)) k‖ ≤ peak σ :=
    Finset.le_sup' (fun k : Fin (N + 1) => ‖walkPrefix (fun i => v (σ i)) k.val‖)
      (Finset.mem_univ (⟨k, by omega⟩ : Fin (N + 1)))
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsign⟩ := h d N hd hN (fun i => v (π i)) (fun i => hv (π i))
  let p : Fin N → Bool := fun i => decide (ε i = 1)
  let l : List (Fin N) := List.ofFn id
  have heps (i : Fin N) : (if p i then v (π i) else -v (π i)) = ε i • v (π i) := by
    rcases hε i with hi | hi <;> norm_num [p, hi]
  have hz : (l.map fun i => v (π i)).sum = 0 := by
    simpa [l, List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn, Equiv.sum_comp] using hzero
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_of_list_perm (signedOrder p l) (signedOrder_perm p l)
  have hpref : ∀ k ≤ l.length, ‖((l.take k).map fun i => v (π i)).sum‖ ≤ peak π := by
    intro k hk
    simpa [l, List.map_take, List.map_ofFn, sum_take_ofFn, walkPrefix] using
      hpeak π k (by simpa [l] using hk)
  have hsig : ∀ k ≤ l.length,
      ‖((l.take k).map fun i => if p i then v (π i) else -v (π i)).sum‖ ≤ C * Real.sqrt d := by
    intro k hk
    simp_rw [heps]
    simpa [l, List.map_take, List.map_ofFn, sum_take_ofFn, walkPrefix] using
      hsign k (by simpa [l] using hk)
  have hnew : peak (σ.trans π) ≤ (peak π + C * Real.sqrt d) / 2 := by
    apply (Finset.sup'_le_iff _ _).mpr
    intro k _
    have hh := signedOrder_prefix_bound p l (fun i => v (π i))
      (peak π) (C * Real.sqrt d) hz hpref hsig k.val
    rw [← hσ, List.map_take, List.map_ofFn, sum_take_ofFn] at hh
    exact hh
  have hβ : peak π ≤ C * Real.sqrt d := by
    have := hmin (σ.trans π) (Finset.mem_univ _)
    linarith
  exact ⟨π, fun k hk => (hpeak π k hk).trans hβ⟩

end EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:95.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.signedOrder_prefix_bound
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:95.text:
lemma signedOrder_prefix_bound [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) (v : α → E) (B D : ℝ)
    (hzero : (l.map v).sum = 0)
    (hprefix : ∀ j ≤ l.length, ‖((l.take j).map v).sum‖ ≤ B)
    (hsigned : ∀ j ≤ l.length,
      ‖((l.take j).map fun a => if p a then v a else -v a).sum‖ ≤ D)
    (k : ℕ) : ‖(((signedOrder p l).take k).map v).sum‖ ≤ (B + D) / 2 := by
  rcases signedOrder_prefix p l v hzero k with ⟨j, hj, he⟩ | ⟨j, hj, he⟩
  · rw [he]
    have hparts := (signed_parts p (l.take j) v).1
    have htwice : ‖(2 : ℝ) • (((l.take j).filter p).map v).sum‖ ≤ B + D := by
      rw [two_smul, ← two_nsmul, hparts]
      exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hprefix j hj) (hsigned j hj))
    rw [norm_smul] at htwice
    norm_num at htwice
    linarith
  · rw [he, norm_neg]
    have hparts := (signed_parts p (l.take j) v).2
    have htwice : ‖(2 : ℝ) • (((l.take j).filter fun a => !p a).map v).sum‖ ≤ B + D := by
      rw [two_smul, ← two_nsmul, hparts]
      exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hprefix j hj) (hsigned j hj))
    rw [norm_smul] at htwice
    norm_num at htwice
    linarith

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:51.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.signedOrder_perm
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:51.text:
lemma signedOrder_perm (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) :
    (signedOrder p l).Perm l := by
  exact ((List.Perm.refl (l.filter p)).append (List.reverse_perm _)).trans
    (List.filter_append_perm p l)

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Main:111.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.main
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Main:111.text:
theorem main : ∃ C : ℝ, SignedPrefixBound C ∧ OrderingPrefixBound C :=
  ⟨universalConstant,signed_prefix_bound,signing_implies_ordering universalConstant signed_prefix_bound⟩

end EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:120.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.exists_perm_of_list_perm
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:120.text:
lemma exists_perm_of_list_perm {N : ℕ} (l : List (Fin N))
    (hl : l.Perm (List.ofFn (id : Fin N → Fin N))) :
    ∃ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N), List.ofFn π = l := by
  have hlen : l.length = N := by simpa using hl.length_eq
  have hnodup : l.Nodup := hl.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_ofFn.mpr Function.injective_id)
  have hmem : ∀ i, i ∈ l := fun i => hl.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  let π := (finCongr hlen.symm).trans (List.Nodup.getEquivOfForallMemList l hnodup hmem)
  refine ⟨π, List.ext_getElem (by simp [hlen]) ?_⟩
  intro i hi hj
  simp [π, List.Nodup.getEquivOfForallMemList]

end Lists

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:11.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.walkPrefix
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:11.text:
noncomputable def walkPrefix {d N : ℕ} (v : Fin N → Vector d) (k : ℕ) : Vector d :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin N => i.val < k), v i

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.SigningData:93.text: lemma signingScale_pos : 0 < signingScale := div_pos (by norm_num) (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) bodyScale_pos) GaussianAR.slabRadius_pos)

OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:48.name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitzBergstrom.signedOrder
OAI.Analysis.Steinitz.Transference:48.text:

OAI.Analysis.StrictMeans.Main:7.name: OAI.StrictInverseFirstPower.main
OAI.Analysis.StrictMeans.Main:7.text:
theorem main :
    (∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 4 ∧
      ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), NormalizedUnivalent f →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ r → r < 1 →
          integralMean (-1) f r ≤ C * (1 - r) ^ (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) + ε)) ∧
    boundedSpectrum (-1) < (1 / 4 : EReal) ∧
    (¬ ∀ p : ℝ, boundedSpectrum p = kraetzerPrediction p) :=
  ⟨uniform_inverse_first_power, bounded_spectrum_strict, kraetzer_identity_false⟩

end StrictInverseFirstPower

OAI.Analysis.StrictMeans.Endpoints:48.name: OAI.StrictInverseFirstPower.kraetzer_identity_false
OAI.Analysis.StrictMeans.Endpoints:48.text:
theorem kraetzer_identity_false :
    ¬ ∀ p : ℝ, boundedSpectrum p = kraetzerPrediction p := by
  intro h
  have hp := bounded_spectrum_strict
  rw [h (-1)] at hp
  have hpred : kraetzerPrediction (-1) = ((1/4 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    norm_num [kraetzerPrediction]
  rw [hpred] at hp
  change ((1/4 : ℝ) : EReal) < ((1/4 : ℝ) : EReal) at hp
  exact lt_irrefl _ hp

end
end StrictInverseFirstPower

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.StrictMeans.Endpoints:42.name: OAI.StrictInverseFirstPower.bounded_spectrum_strict
OAI.Analysis.StrictMeans.Endpoints:42.text:
theorem bounded_spectrum_strict : boundedSpectrum (-1) < (1 / 4 : EReal) := by

  apply hs.trans_lt
  change ((1/4-ε : ℝ) : EReal) < ((1/4 : ℝ) : EReal)

theorem uniform_inverse_first_power :
    ∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 4 ∧
      ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), NormalizedUnivalent f →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ r → r < 1 →
          integralMean (-1) f r ≤ C * (1 - r) ^ (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) + ε) := by
  obtain ⟨ε,C,hε,hε',_hC,hbound,_hs⟩ := uniform_inverse_first_power_gap
  exact ⟨ε,C,hε,hε',hbound⟩

OAI.Analysis.StrictMeans.Endpoints:13.name: OAI.StrictInverseFirstPower.uniform_inverse_first_power_gap
OAI.Analysis.StrictMeans.Endpoints:13.text:
theorem uniform_inverse_first_power_gap :
    ∃ ε C : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 4 ∧ 0 < C ∧
      (∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), NormalizedUnivalent f →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ r → r < 1 →
          integralMean (-1) f r ≤ C * (1 - r) ^ (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) + ε)) ∧
      boundedSpectrum (-1) ≤ ((1 / 4 - ε : ℝ) : EReal) := by
  let b := (dyadicExponent+1/4)/2
  have hb : dyadicExponent < b := by dsimp [b]; linarith [dyadicExponent_lt_quarter]
  have hb0 : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_lt dyadicExponent_nonneg hb
  have hb1 : b < 1/4 := by dsimp [b]; linarith [dyadicExponent_lt_quarter]
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := uniform_integralMean_bound_above_dyadicExponent hb
  refine ⟨1/4-b,C,by linarith,by linarith,hC,?_,?_⟩
  · intro f hf r hr0 hr
    simpa only [show -(1/4:ℝ)+(1/4-b) = -b by ring] using hbound f hf r hr0 hr
  · rw [show (1/4:ℝ) - (1/4-b) = b by ring]
    apply iSup_le
    intro f
    apply iSup_le
    intro hf
    exact growthExponent_le_of_mean_bound f hf.1 hC (hbound f hf.1)

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CentralAvera.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.exists_central_mem_closed_orbit
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CentralAvera.text:
theorem exists_central_mem_closed_orbit (x : Algebra M) :
    ∃ c : Algebra (concreteCenter M),
      c.val ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (innerUnitaryOrbit M x.val)) := by
  have hex (y : Algebra M) : ∃ (B : FiniteInnerAverage M)
      (d : Algebra (concreteCenter M)), ‖B.apply y.val - d.val‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ := by
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · refine ⟨FiniteInnerAverage.identity M, 0, ?_⟩
      simp [hy]
    · obtain ⟨B, d, hd⟩ := exists_central_average y (‖y‖ / 2) (by positivity)
      exact ⟨B, d, by linarith⟩
  choose B d hd using hex
  let err (s : FiniteInnerAverage M × Algebra (concreteCenter M)) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
    s.1.apply x.val - s.2.val
  let residual (s : FiniteInnerAverage M × Algebra (concreteCenter M)) : Algebra M :=
    s.1.algebraApply x - centralInclusion s.2
  have hres (s) : (residual s).val = err s := by
    change (s.1.algebraApply x).val - s.2.val = _
    rw [FiniteInnerAverage.algebraApply_val]
  let step (s : FiniteInnerAverage M × Algebra (concreteCenter M)) :=
    ((B (residual s)).comp s.1, s.2 + d (residual s))
  have herr (s) : err (step s) =
      (B (residual s)).apply (residual s).val - (d (residual s)).val := by
    dsimp only [err, step]
    rw [FiniteInnerAverage.comp_apply, hres]
    dsimp only [err]
    rw [FiniteInnerAverage.apply_sub, FiniteInnerAverage.apply_central]
    change _ - (s.2.val + (d (residual s)).val) = _
    abel
  have hstep (s) : ‖err (step s)‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖err s‖ := by
    rw [herr]
    exact (hd (residual s)).trans_eq (by rw [← hres]; rfl)
  have hcorr (s) : ‖(step s).2 - s.2‖ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖err s‖ := by
    change ‖s.2 + d (residual s) - s.2‖ ≤ _
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
    have hn : ‖d (residual s)‖ = ‖(d (residual s)).val‖ := rfl
    rw [hn]
    have ht : ‖(d (residual s)).val‖ ≤
        ‖(B (residual s)).apply (residual s).val‖ +
          ‖(B (residual s)).apply (residual s).val - (d (residual s)).val‖ := by
      calc
        _ = ‖(B (residual s)).apply (residual s).val -
            ((B (residual s)).apply (residual s).val - (d (residual s)).val)‖ := by
          rw [sub_sub_cancel]
        _ ≤ _ := norm_sub_le _ _
    have h1 := (B (residual s)).norm_apply_le (residual s).val
    have h2 := hd (residual s)
    have hn' : ‖residual s‖ = ‖err s‖ := by rw [← hres]; rfl
    rw [← hn']
    have hnval : ‖(residual s).val‖ = ‖residual s‖ := rfl
    rw [hnval] at h1
    linarith
  let seq : ℕ → FiniteInnerAverage M × Algebra (concreteCenter M) :=
    fun n => Nat.rec (FiniteInnerAverage.identity M, 0) (fun _ s => step s) n
  have he0 : err (seq 0) = x.val := by
    change (FiniteInnerAverage.identity M).apply x.val - (0 : Algebra (concreteCenter M)).val = _
    simp
  have hpow (n : ℕ) : ‖err (seq n)‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)^n * ‖x‖ := by
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [he0]; simp only [pow_zero, one_mul]; rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      have h := hstep (seq n)
      change ‖err (seq (n + 1))‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖err (seq n)‖ at h
      rw [pow_succ]
      nlinarith
  have hcauchy : CauchySeq (fun n => (seq n).2) := by
    apply SeminormedAddCommGroup.cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (r := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (C := (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x‖) (by norm_num)
    intro n
    have h := hcorr (seq n)
    change ‖(seq (n + 1)).2 - (seq n).2‖ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖err (seq n)‖ at h
    have hp := hpow n
    rw [norm_sub_rev]
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hcauchy
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun n => err (seq n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
    apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hpow
    simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)).mul_const ‖x‖
  have hcval : Tendsto (fun n => (seq n).2.val) atTop (𝓝 c.val) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hc
  have havg : Tendsto (fun n => (seq n).1.apply x.val) atTop (𝓝 c.val) := by
    simpa only [err, sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using hzero.add hcval
  refine ⟨c, isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto havg ?_⟩
  exact Eventually.of_forall (fun n => subset_closure ((seq n).1.apply_mem_orbitHull x.val))

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.KaplanskySel.text:
theorem selfAdjoint_bicommutant_unitBall_approx
    (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : T ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))))
    (hsa : IsSelfAdjoint T) (hn : ‖T‖ ≤ 1) (V : Finset H)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a : A, ‖(a : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ V, ‖T x - (a : H →L[ℂ] H) x‖ < ε := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbn, hTb⟩ := selfAdjoint_bicommutant_closureBall_approx
    A T hT hsa hn V (half_pos hε)
  let R := 1 + ∑ x ∈ V, ‖x‖
  have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  obtain ⟨a, han, hba⟩ := normClosure_unitBall_approx A hb hbn
    (div_pos hε (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hR))
  refine ⟨a, han, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    have hs := Finset.single_le_sum (fun y (_ : y ∈ V) => norm_nonneg y) hx
    dsimp [R]
    linarith
  have hdist : ‖b x - (a : H →L[ℂ] H) x‖ < ε / 2 := by
    have hlt : ‖b - (a : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ * R < ε / 2 := by
      have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hba hR
      have he : ε / (2 * R) * R = ε / 2 := by field_simp
      rwa [he] at h
    have hle := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (b - (a : H →L[ℂ] H)) x
    exact hle.trans_lt ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxR (norm_nonneg _)).trans_lt hlt)
  have htriangle : ‖T x - (a : H →L[ℂ] H) x‖ ≤
      ‖T x - b x‖ + ‖b x - (a : H →L[ℂ] H) x‖ := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using dist_triangle (T x) (b x) ((a : H →L[ℂ] H) x)
  exact htriangle.trans_lt (by linarith [hTb x hx])

end

end KadisonKastler

end OAI

theorem injective_starAlgHom_completelyIsometric (φ : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) : CompletelyIsometric φ.toAlgHom.toLinearMap := by
  intro p q X
  calc
    ‖CStarMatrix.mapₗ φ.toAlgHom.toLinearMap X‖ =
        ‖rectangularCorner (CStarMatrix.mapₗ φ.toAlgHom.toLinearMap X)‖ :=

    _ = ‖CStarMatrix.mapₗ φ.toAlgHom.toLinearMap (rectangularCorner X)‖ := by

theorem exists_commutant_of_completelyBounded
    (π : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H)) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) {e : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hcb : CompletelyBoundedBy ((innerDerivation T).comp π.toAlgHom.toLinearMap) e)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : e / 2 < r) :
    ∃ D : H →L[ℂ] H, (∀ a, D * π a = π a * D) ∧ ‖D - T‖ < r := by
  let M := generatedVonNeumannAlgebra π.range
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hn⟩ := exists_near_algebra_of_finite_orbit_bound
    M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra (Generator.Tracial.vonNeumann_wotClosed M.commutant)
    T (div_nonneg he (by norm_num)) (complete_commutator_orbit_bound π T he hcb) hr
  refine ⟨D, ?_, hn⟩
  intro a
  exact (VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp hD (π a)
    (subset_generatedVonNeumannAlgebra π.range ⟨a, rfl⟩)).symm

end

end KadisonKastler

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CentralPairF.text:
theorem centralPairDecomposition_of_rankModel
    (M N : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (A B C S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    [IsClosed (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))] [IsClosed (B : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))]
    [IsClosed (C : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))] [IsClosed (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))]
    [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace S]
    (model : BorelCommonModel π D S.subtype)
    (hAC : A ≤ C) (hBC : B ≤ C) (hCS : C ≤ S)
    (Q R : ∀ n, VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℓ²(projectionDimensionIndex n, ℂ) 2
      (commonRankSourceMeasure model n)))
    (hQ : BlockAlgebraDecomposition Q (spatialTransportAlgebra (commonRankCoordinates model) M))
    (hR : BlockAlgebraDecomposition R (spatialTransportAlgebra (commonRankCoordinates model) N))
    (hQf : ∀ n, OperatorFieldDecomposition (commonRankSourceMeasure model n)
      (commonRankFiberAlgebra model (StarSubalgebra.inclusion (hAC.trans hCS)) n) (Q n))
    (hRf : ∀ n, OperatorFieldDecomposition (commonRankSourceMeasure model n)
      (commonRankFiberAlgebra model (StarSubalgebra.inclusion (hBC.trans hCS)) n) (R n))
    (hf : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂commonRankSourceMeasure model n,
      ScalarCenter (commonRankFiberAlgebra model (StarSubalgebra.inclusion (hAC.trans hCS)) n x) ∧
      ScalarCenter (commonRankFiberAlgebra model (StarSubalgebra.inclusion (hBC.trans hCS)) n x)) :
    Nonempty (CentralPairDecomposition M N A B C hAC hBC) := by
  refine ⟨{
    stratum := commonRankStratum model
    coordinates := liftedRankCoordinates model
    leftBlock := fun n => spatialTransportAlgebra (commonRankStratumEquiv model n) (Q n)
    rightBlock := fun n => spatialTransportAlgebra (commonRankStratumEquiv model n) (R n)
    leftBlocks := ?_
    rightBlocks := ?_
    representation := fun n x => (liftedRankRepresentation model n x).comp (StarSubalgebra.inclusion hCS)
    representation_measurable := ?_
    leftFields := ?_
    rightFields := ?_
    factors := ?_ }⟩
  · have h := blockAlgebraDecomposition_coordinate_transport (commonRankStratumEquiv model)
      Q (spatialTransportAlgebra (commonRankCoordinates model) M) hQ
    rw [spatialTransportAlgebra_trans] at h
    exact h
  · have h := blockAlgebraDecomposition_coordinate_transport (commonRankStratumEquiv model)
      R (spatialTransportAlgebra (commonRankCoordinates model) N) hR
    rw [spatialTransportAlgebra_trans] at h
    exact h
  · intro n c v
    exact liftedRankRepresentation_measurable model n (StarSubalgebra.inclusion hCS c) v
  · intro n
    have h := liftedRank_field_decomposition model (StarSubalgebra.inclusion (hAC.trans hCS))
      n (Q n) (hQf n)
    simpa only [sourceInclusion_comp] using h
  · intro n
    have h := liftedRank_field_decomposition model (StarSubalgebra.inclusion (hBC.trans hCS))
      n (R n) (hRf n)
    simpa only [sourceInclusion_comp] using h
  · intro n
    filter_upwards [hf n] with x hx
    constructor
    · simpa only [sourceInclusion_comp] using
        liftedRank_scalarCenter model (StarSubalgebra.inclusion (hAC.trans hCS)) n x hx.1
    · simpa only [sourceInclusion_comp] using
        liftedRank_scalarCenter model (StarSubalgebra.inclusion (hBC.trans hCS)) n x hx.2

end

end KadisonKastler

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CentralPairC.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.exists_centralPairCommonSource
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CentralPairC.text:
theorem exists_centralPairCommonSource [SeparableSpace H]
    (M N : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (hcenter : concreteCenter M = concreteCenter N)
    (C : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hCs : IsSeparable (C : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))
    (hC : C ≤ (concreteCenter M).commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    Nonempty (CentralPairCommonSource M N C) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hLc, hLs, hLM, hLg⟩ := exists_separable_generating_cstar_subalgebra M.commutant
  obtain ⟨R, hRc, hRs, hRN, hRg⟩ := exists_separable_generating_cstar_subalgebra N.commutant
  let : SeparableSpace C := hCs.separableSpace
  let : SeparableSpace L := hLs
  let : SeparableSpace R := hRs
  let S := jointCStarSource C (jointCStarSource L R)
  have hclosed : IsClosed ((concreteCenter M).commutant.toStarSubalgebra : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
    change IsClosed ((concreteCenter M).commutant : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
    rw [VonNeumannAlgebra.coe_commutant]
    exact Set.isClosed_centralizer _
  have hL : L ≤ (concreteCenter M).commutant.toStarSubalgebra := by
    intro T hT
    apply VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mpr
    intro z hz
    exact VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp (hLM hT) z hz.1
  have hR : R ≤ (concreteCenter M).commutant.toStarSubalgebra := by
    intro T hT
    apply VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mpr
    intro z hz
    have hzN : z ∈ concreteCenter N := hcenter ▸ hz
    exact VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp (hRN hT) z hzN.1
  exact ⟨{
    leftComm := L
    rightComm := R
    source := S
    left_closed := hLc
    right_closed := hRc
    source_closed := jointCStarSource_isClosed _ _
    left_separable := hLs
    right_separable := hRs
    source_separable := inferInstance
    left_mem := hLM
    right_mem := hRN
    left_generates := hLg
    right_generates := hRg
    original_le := le_jointCStarSource_left _ _
    left_le := (le_jointCStarSource_left L R).trans (le_jointCStarSource_right _ _)
    right_le := (le_jointCStarSource_right L R).trans (le_jointCStarSource_right _ _)
    central := jointCStarSource_minimal _ _ _ hC
      (jointCStarSource_minimal _ _ _ hL hR hclosed) hclosed }⟩

end

end KadisonKastler

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CommonRankCo.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.borelCommonModel
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CommonRankCo.text:
def borelCommonModel (σ : B →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hσ : ∀ b a, σ b * π a = π a * σ b) : BorelCommonModel π D σ := by
  let h := exists_measurable_common_representations π D σ hσ
  exact ⟨Classical.choose h, (Classical.choose_spec h).1, (Classical.choose_spec h).2⟩

theorem uniformFactorStability_of_properlyInfinite
    (hInfinite : UniformProperInfiniteFactorStability.{u})
    (hFinite : FiniteFactorPublishedInputs.{u})
    (_hTypeI : ∀ (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
      [CompleteSpace H] [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace H],
      PublishedTypeIInjectivity (H := H))
    (hProper : PublishedInfiniteFactorProperlyInfinite.{u}) :
    UniformFactorStability.{u} := by
  classical
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δI, hδI, hI⟩ := uniform_separable_typeI_strong_stability.{u} hε
  obtain ⟨δII, hδII, hII⟩ := uniform_II1_strong_stability hFinite hε
  obtain ⟨δPI, hδPI, hPI⟩ := hInfinite ε hε
  refine ⟨min δI (min δII δPI), lt_min hδI (lt_min hδII hδPI), ?_⟩
  intro H _ _ _ _ M N hM hN hgap
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial H with hH | hH
  · let : Subsingleton H := hH
    exact nearConjugacy_of_subsingleton M N hε
  · let : Nontrivial H := hH
    by_cases htype : IsTypeIFactor M
    · exact hI H M N htype
        (hgap.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
    · by_cases hfinite : FiniteProjectionIn M 1
      · have hII1 := isII1Factor_of_finite_of_not_typeI hM
          (show (0 : H →L[ℂ] H) ≠ 1 from zero_ne_one) hfinite htype
        exact hII H M N hII1
          ((hgap.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
      · exact hPI H M N hM hN (hProper H M hM hfinite)
          ((hgap.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (min_le_right _ _))

end

end KadisonKastler

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.SeparableRed.text:
theorem universalStrongStability_of_separable
    (hsep : SeparableStrongStability.{u})
    (hK : PublishedKaplanskyDensity.{u})
    (hCorrection : ∀ (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
      [CompleteSpace H], ∀ M : VonNeumannAlgebra H, PublishedMultiplicationCorrection M)
    (hCommutant : ∀ (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
      [CompleteSpace H], ∀ M : VonNeumannAlgebra H,
        PublishedBlockCommutantApproximation (Algebra M) H) :
    UniversalStrongStability.{u} := by
  intro ε hε
  let a := min (ε / 512) (1 / 8000)
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  have ha₁ : a ≤ ε / 512 := min_le_left _ _
  have ha₂ : a ≤ 1 / 8000 := min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hlocal⟩ := hsep a ha
  refine ⟨min δ (1 / 4), lt_min hδ (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  intro H _ _ _ M N hMN
  have htests := finiteCoefficientConjugations_of_separable_bound hK hlocal M N
    (hMN.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvn⟩ := concrete_unitary_of_finite_coefficient_tests
    (hCorrection H M) (hCommutant H M) ha.le htests
    (show 2 * a < 1 / 1000 by linarith only [ha₂])
    (show (1 / 4 : ℝ) + 2 * a < 1 by linarith only [ha₂])
    (hMN.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  exact ⟨v, hv, hvn.trans_lt (by linarith only [ha₁, hε])⟩

end

end KadisonKastler

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CommonCenter.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.separableStrongStability_of_common_center
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CommonCenter.text:
theorem separableStrongStability_of_common_center
    (hcommon : CommonCenterSeparableStability.{u})
    (hDix : ∀ (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
      [CompleteSpace H], ∀ M : VonNeumannAlgebra H, PublishedDixmierAveraging M) :
    SeparableStrongStability.{u} := by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hlocal⟩ := hcommon (a / 2) (by positivity)
  let δ := min (1 / 8000) (min (a / 1800) (τ / 1802))
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have hδ₁ : δ ≤ 1 / 8000 := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ₂ : δ ≤ a / 1800 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ₃ : δ ≤ τ / 1802 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro H _ _ _ _ M N hMN
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hc, hd⟩ := exists_common_center_neighbor
    M N (hDix H M) (hDix H N) hMN (by linarith only [hδ₁])
  let N₀ := unitaryConjugateAlgebra (star w) N
  have hdτ : kkDistance M N₀ < τ :=
    hd.trans (by linarith only [hδ₃, hτ])
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hva⟩ := hlocal H M N₀ hc.symm hdτ
  have hwN : Conjugates w N₀ N := by
    simpa only [star_star] using (conjugates_unitaryConjugateAlgebra (star w) N).symm
  refine ⟨w * v, hv.trans hwN, ?_⟩
  have hnorm := norm_unitary_mul_sub_one_le w v
  linarith only [hnorm, hw, hva, hδ₂, ha]

end

end KadisonKastler

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.KaplanskyDen.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.publishedKaplanskyDensity
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.KaplanskyDen.text:
theorem publishedKaplanskyDensity : PublishedKaplanskyDensity.{u} := by
  intro H _ _ _ A T hT hn V ε hε
  classical
  let D := hilbertMatrix (blockOffDiagonal T (star T))
  have hDsa : IsSelfAdjoint D := by
    change star (hilbertMatrix (blockOffDiagonal T (star T))) = _
    rw [← hilbertMatrix_star]
    congr 1
    ext i j : 2
    simp only [CStarMatrix.star_apply]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [blockOffDiagonal]
  have hDn : ‖D‖ ≤ 1 := by
    change ‖hilbertMatrix (blockOffDiagonal T (star T))‖ ≤ 1
    rw [norm_hilbertMatrix, norm_blockOffDiagonal, norm_star, max_self]
    exact hn
  have hD : D ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer
      (matrixOperatorAlgebra (ι := Fin 2) A : Set _)) := by
    rw [← generatedVonNeumannAlgebra_coe, generated_matrixOperatorAlgebra]
    change D ∈ matrixVonNeumann (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A)
    apply (mem_matrixVonNeumann_iff_entries _ _).mpr
    intro i j
    change operatorEntry (hilbertMatrix (blockOffDiagonal T (star T))) i j ∈
      generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A
    rw [operatorEntry_hilbertMatrix]
    have ht : T ∈ generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A := by
      change T ∈ (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
      rwa [generatedVonNeumannAlgebra_coe]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A).zero_mem
    · exact ht
    · exact (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A).toStarSubalgebra.star_mem' ht
    · exact (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A).zero_mem
  obtain ⟨a, han, ha⟩ := selfAdjoint_bicommutant_unitBall_approx
    (matrixOperatorAlgebra (ι := Fin 2) A) D hD hDsa hDn
    (V.image (tupleSingle (H := H) (1 : Fin 2))) hε
  let b := operatorEntry (a : FiniteHilbert (Fin 2) H →L[ℂ] FiniteHilbert (Fin 2) H) 0 1
  refine ⟨⟨b, (mem_matrixOperatorAlgebra_iff A a.val).mp a.property 0 1⟩,
    (norm_entry_le _ 0 1).trans han, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have ha' := ha (tupleSingle (1 : Fin 2) x) (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  have hentry : (D (tupleSingle (1 : Fin 2) x) - a.val (tupleSingle (1 : Fin 2) x)) 0 =
      T x - b x := by
    change D (tupleSingle (1 : Fin 2) x) 0 - a.val (tupleSingle (1 : Fin 2) x) 0 = _
    congr 1
    change operatorEntry (hilbertMatrix (blockOffDiagonal T (star T))) 0 1 x = T x
    rw [operatorEntry_hilbertMatrix]
    rfl
  have hle := PiLp.norm_apply_le
    (D (tupleSingle (1 : Fin 2) x) - a.val (tupleSingle (1 : Fin 2) x)) (0 : Fin 2)
  rw [hentry] at hle
  exact hle.trans_lt ha'

end

end KadisonKastler

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.PublishedCor.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.PublishedMultiplicationCorrection
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.PublishedCor.text:
def PublishedMultiplicationCorrection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : Algebra M →ₗ[ℂ] Algebra M →ₗ[ℂ] Algebra M,
    (∀ x y z, m (m x y) z = m x (m y z)) →
    (∀ x y, star (m x y) = m (star y) (star x)) →
    ∀ q : ℝ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 / 11 →
      HaagerupBound (m - LinearMap.mul ℂ (Algebra M)) q →
      ∃ L : Algebra M ≃ₗ[ℂ] Algebra M,
        (∀ x y, L (m x y) = L x * L y) ∧
        (∀ x, L (star x) = star (L x)) ∧
        CompletelyBoundedBy (L.toLinearMap - LinearMap.id) (10 * q)

variable {B C : Type*} [CStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B]
  [CStarAlgebra C] [PartialOrder C] [StarOrderedRing C]

omit [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B] in

theorem hilbertMatrix_operatorEntries (T : FiniteHilbert ι H →L[ℂ] FiniteHilbert ι H) :
    hilbertMatrix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix fun i j => operatorEntry T i j) = T := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change hilbertMatrix (CStarMatrix.ofMatrix fun i j => operatorEntry T i j) ξ i = T ξ i

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CentralPairC.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.publishedCentralPairDecomposition
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CentralPairC.text:
theorem publishedCentralPairDecomposition : PublishedCentralPairDecomposition.{u} := by
  intro H _ _ _ _ M N hcenter A B C hAc hBc hCc _hAs _hBs hCs hAg hBg hAC hBC hCcentral
  let : IsClosed (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := hAc
  let : IsClosed (B : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := hBc
  let : IsClosed (C : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := hCc
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := exists_centralPairCommonSource M N hcenter C hCs hCcentral
  let S := s.source
  let : IsClosed (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := s.source_closed
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace S := s.source_separable
  let : IsClosed (s.leftComm : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := s.left_closed
  let : IsClosed (s.rightComm : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := s.right_closed
  obtain ⟨Z, hZc, hZs, hZcomm, hZM, hZgen⟩ := exists_separable_central_source M
  let : IsClosed (Z : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := hZc
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace Z := hZs
  let : IsMulCommutative Z := hZcomm
  let π := Z.subtype
  let D := cyclicDecompositionData π.range
  have hπ : starSubalgebraCommutant π.range = (vonNeumannCenter M).commutant := by
    simpa only [π, subtype_star_range] using hZgen
  have hSN (b : S) (a : Z) : b.val * a.val = a.val * b.val := by
    have ha : a.val ∈ concreteCenter M := by
      rw [concreteCenter_eq H M]
      exact hZM a.property
    exact (VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp (s.central b.property) a.val ha).symm
  let model := borelCommonModel π D S.subtype hSN
  have hAS : A ≤ S := hAC.trans s.original_le
  have hBS : B ≤ S := hBC.trans s.original_le
  let ιA := StarSubalgebra.inclusion hAS
  let ιB := StarSubalgebra.inclusion hBS
  let κM := StarSubalgebra.inclusion s.left_le
  let κN := StarSubalgebra.inclusion s.right_le
  have hAgen : representationVonNeumannAlgebra (S.subtype.comp ιA) = M := by
    change representationVonNeumannAlgebra A.subtype = M
    rw [representationVonNeumannAlgebra_eq_generated, subtype_star_range, hAg]
  have hBgen : representationVonNeumannAlgebra (S.subtype.comp ιB) = N := by
    change representationVonNeumannAlgebra B.subtype = N
    rw [representationVonNeumannAlgebra_eq_generated, subtype_star_range, hBg]
  have hLgen : representationVonNeumannAlgebra (S.subtype.comp κM) = M.commutant := by
    change (starSubalgebraCommutant s.leftComm.subtype.range).commutant = M.commutant
    rw [subtype_star_range]
    exact s.left_generates
  have hRgen : representationVonNeumannAlgebra (S.subtype.comp κN) = N.commutant := by
    change (starSubalgebraCommutant s.rightComm.subtype.range).commutant = N.commutant
    rw [subtype_star_range]
    exact s.right_generates
  have hAM : A ≤ M.toStarSubalgebra := by
    intro T hT
    rw [← hAg]
    exact subset_generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A hT
  have hBN : B ≤ N.toStarSubalgebra := by
    intro T hT
    rw [← hBg]
    exact subset_generatedVonNeumannAlgebra B hT
  have hAL (a : A) (c : s.leftComm) : a.val * c.val = c.val * a.val :=
    VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp (s.left_mem c.property) a.val (hAM a.property)
  have hBR (b : B) (c : s.rightComm) : b.val * c.val = c.val * b.val :=
    VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp (s.right_mem c.property) b.val (hBN b.property)
  have hMc : M.toStarSubalgebra ≤ (starSubalgebraCommutant π.range).toStarSubalgebra := by
    rw [hπ]
    exact le_center_commutant M
  have hM'c : M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra ≤ (starSubalgebraCommutant π.range).toStarSubalgebra := by
    rw [hπ]
    exact commutant_le_centralCommutant M
  have hcenters : vonNeumannCenter M = vonNeumannCenter N := by
    simpa only [concreteCenter_eq] using hcenter
  have hNc : N.toStarSubalgebra ≤ (starSubalgebraCommutant π.range).toStarSubalgebra := by
    rw [hπ, hcenters]
    exact le_center_commutant N
  have hN'c : N.commutant.toStarSubalgebra ≤ (starSubalgebraCommutant π.range).toStarSubalgebra := by
    rw [hπ, hcenters]
    exact commutant_le_centralCommutant N
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQf⟩ := commonRank_algebra_decomposition model ιA κM M hAgen hLgen hMc hM'c
    (fun a c => Subtype.ext (hAL a c))
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRf⟩ := commonRank_algebra_decomposition model ιB κN N hBgen hRgen hNc hN'c
    (fun b c => Subtype.ext (hBR b c))
  have hAj : representationVonNeumannAlgebra (jointCStarSource A s.leftComm).subtype =
      starSubalgebraCommutant π.range := by
    exact (representation_joint_eq_center_commutant M A s.leftComm hAg s.left_generates
      hAM s.left_mem).trans hπ.symm
  have hBj : representationVonNeumannAlgebra (jointCStarSource B s.rightComm).subtype =
      starSubalgebraCommutant π.range := by
    rw [hπ, hcenters]
    exact representation_joint_eq_center_commutant N B s.rightComm hBg s.right_generates
      hBN s.right_mem
  apply centralPairDecomposition_of_rankModel M N A B C S model hAC hBC s.original_le
    Q R hQ hR hQf hRf
  intro n
  have ha := commonRank_factor_fibers S model A s.leftComm hAS s.left_le hAL hAj n
  have hb := commonRank_factor_fibers S model B s.rightComm hBS s.right_le hBR hBj n
  filter_upwards [ha, hb] with x hx hy
  exact ⟨hx, hy⟩

end

end KadisonKastler

end OAI
