OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.MatrixOperat.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.generated_matrixOperatorAlgebra
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.MatrixOperat.text:
theorem generated_matrixOperatorAlgebra (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    generatedVonNeumannAlgebra (matrixOperatorAlgebra (ι := ι) S) =
      matrixVonNeumann (ι := ι) (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra S) := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply generatedVonNeumannAlgebra_le_of_le
    intro T hT
    change T ∈ matrixVonNeumann (ι := ι) (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra S)
    rw [mem_matrixVonNeumann_iff_entries]
    exact fun i j => subset_generatedVonNeumannAlgebra S
      ((mem_matrixOperatorAlgebra_iff S T).mp hT i j)
  · intro T hT
    have he : ∀ i j, operatorEntry T i j ∈
        Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := by
      intro i j
      have h := (mem_matrixVonNeumann_iff_entries _ T).mp hT i j
      change operatorEntry T i j ∈ (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra S : Set _) at h
      rwa [generatedVonNeumannAlgebra_coe] at h
    choose a ha using fun i j => bicommutant_exists_strong_net S (operatorEntry T i j) (he i j)
    let X (d : Finset H × ℕ) : CStarMatrix ι ι (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
      CStarMatrix.ofMatrix fun i j => (a i j d).val
    let b (d : Finset H × ℕ) : Algebra
        (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra (matrixOperatorAlgebra (ι := ι) S)) :=
      ⟨hilbertMatrix (X d), subset_generatedVonNeumannAlgebra _
        (show hilbertMatrix (X d) ∈ matrixOperatorAlgebra S from
          ⟨X d, fun i j => (a i j d).property, rfl⟩)⟩
    apply Generator.Tracial.weak_operator_limit_mem
      (l := (atTop : Filter (Finset H × ℕ))) _ b
    intro ξ η
    have hc (i : ι) : Tendsto (fun d => ∑ j, (a i j d).val (ξ j)) atTop
        (𝓝 (∑ j, operatorEntry T i j (ξ j))) :=
      tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => ha i j (ξ j))
    have hi (i : ι) : Tendsto
        (fun d => inner ℂ (η i) (∑ j, (a i j d).val (ξ j))) atTop
        (𝓝 (inner ℂ (η i) (∑ j, operatorEntry T i j (ξ j)))) :=
      (continuous_const.inner continuous_id).continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hc i)
    have hs := tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i)
    have hrec (i : ι) : (∑ j, operatorEntry T i j (ξ j)) = T ξ i := by
      change (∑ j, T (tupleSingle j (ξ j)) i) = T ξ i
      have h := congrArg (fun ζ => T ζ i) (tuple_eq_sum_single ξ)
      simpa only [map_sum, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply] using h.symm
    have happ (d : Finset H × ℕ) (i : ι) :
        ((hilbertMatrix (X d)) ξ).ofLp i = ∑ j, (a i j d).val (ξ j) :=
      hilbertMatrix_apply (X d) ξ i
    change Tendsto (fun d => inner ℂ η ((hilbertMatrix (X d)) ξ)) atTop
      (𝓝 (inner ℂ η (T ξ)))
    simpa only [PiLp.inner_apply, happ, hrec] using hs

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CommonCenter.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.commonCenterSeparableStability_of_factors
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CommonCenter.text:
theorem commonCenterSeparableStability_of_factors
    (hFactor : UniformFactorStability.{u})
    (hCentral : PublishedCentralPairDecomposition.{u})
    (hK : PublishedKaplanskyDensity.{u})
    (hSelect : PublishedUnitaryBorelSelection.{u, u}) :
    CommonCenterSeparableStability.{u} := by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hlocal⟩ := hFactor (a / 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨τ / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro H _ _ _ _ M N hcenter hgap
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAc, hBc, hAs, hBs, hAM, hBN, hAB⟩ :=
    exists_near_separable_generators M N hgap
  have hMD : M.toStarSubalgebra ≤ (concreteCenter M).commutant.toStarSubalgebra := by
    intro T hT
    apply VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mpr
    intro z hz
    exact ((VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp hz.2) T hT).symm
  have hND : N.toStarSubalgebra ≤ (concreteCenter M).commutant.toStarSubalgebra := by
    rw [hcenter]
    intro T hT
    apply VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mpr
    intro z hz
    exact ((VonNeumannAlgebra.mem_commutant_iff.mp hz.2) T hT).symm
  have hAD : A ≤ (concreteCenter M).commutant.toStarSubalgebra := by
    intro T hT
    apply hMD
    rw [← hAM]
    exact subset_generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A hT
  have hBD : B ≤ (concreteCenter M).commutant.toStarSubalgebra := by
    intro T hT
    apply hND
    rw [← hBN]
    exact subset_generatedVonNeumannAlgebra B hT
  obtain ⟨C, hCc, hCs, hAC, hBC, hCD⟩ :=
    exists_closed_separable_common_superalgebra_in A B (concreteCenter M).commutant
      hAs hBs hAD hBD
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := hCentral H M N hcenter A B C hAc hBc hCc hAs hBs hCs hAM hBN hAC hBC hCD
  have hex (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ x ∂(D.stratum n).μ,
      ∃ v : unitary ((D.stratum n).K →L[ℂ] (D.stratum n).K),
        Conjugates v
          (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra
            ((D.representation n x).comp (StarSubalgebra.inclusion hAC)).range)
          (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra
            ((D.representation n x).comp (StarSubalgebra.inclusion hBC)).range) ∧
        ‖(v : (D.stratum n).K →L[ℂ] (D.stratum n).K) - 1‖ ≤ a / 2 := by
    filter_upwards [D.factors n] with x hx
    have hd := kkDistance_commonRepresentation_le hK A B C hAc hBc hCc hAC hBC
      (D.representation n x)
    have hdτ : kkDistance
        (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra
          ((D.representation n x).comp (StarSubalgebra.inclusion hAC)).range)
        (generatedVonNeumannAlgebra
          ((D.representation n x).comp (StarSubalgebra.inclusion hBC)).range) < τ := by
      linarith only [hd, hAB, hτ]
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvn⟩ := hlocal (D.stratum n).K _ _ hx.1 hx.2 hdτ
    exact ⟨v, hv, hvn.le⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvn⟩ := exists_bounded_conjugacy_from_centralPair hK hSelect
    M N A B C hAc hBc hAs hBs D (by positivity : 0 ≤ a / 2) hex
  exact ⟨v, hv, hvn.trans_lt (by linarith only [ha])⟩

theorem representation_joint_eq_center_commutant (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (A C : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    [IsClosed (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))] [IsClosed (C : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))]
    (hA : generatedVonNeumannAlgebra A = M)
    (hC : (starSubalgebraCommutant C).commutant = M.commutant)
    (hAM : A ≤ M.toStarSubalgebra) (hCM : C ≤ M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    representationVonNeumannAlgebra (jointCStarSource A C).subtype =
      (vonNeumannCenter M).commutant := by
  have hAg : (starSubalgebraCommutant A).commutant = M := by
    simpa only [representationVonNeumannAlgebra, subtype_star_range, hA] using
      (representationVonNeumannAlgebra_eq_generated A.subtype)
  change (starSubalgebraCommutant (jointCStarSource A C).subtype.range).commutant = _
  rw [subtype_star_range]
  exact jointCStarSource_bicommutant M A C hAM hCM hAg hC

end

  let := hH
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_central_mem_closed_orbit (M := N) ⟨x, hx.1⟩
  exact ⟨c.val, c.property, hc⟩

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.UnitaryBorel.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.exists_finite_borel_selector
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.UnitaryBorel.text:
theorem exists_finite_borel_selector
    {X : Type u} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X]
    {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace Y] [PolishSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    [BorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (R : Set (X × Y))
    (hR : MeasurableSet R) (hsec : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ y, (x, y) ∈ R) :
    ∃ f : X → Y, AEMeasurable f μ ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (x, f x) ∈ R := by
  classical
  by_cases hne : R.Nonempty
  · let := upgradeStandardBorel X
    let := TopologicalSpace.upgradeIsCompletelyMetrizable X
    have hA := hR.analyticSet
    rw [AnalyticSet] at hA
    obtain ⟨G, hG, hRange⟩ := hA.resolve_left hne.ne_empty
    have hsurj : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ a, (G a).1 = x := by
      filter_upwards [hsec] with x hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
      have hm : (x, y) ∈ Set.range G := hRange.symm ▸ hy
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨a, congrArg Prod.fst ha⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := exists_measurable_baire_section μ (fun a => (G a).1)
      (continuous_fst.comp hG) hsurj
    refine ⟨fun x => (G (g x)).2,
      ((continuous_snd.comp hG).measurable.comp hg).aemeasurable, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hfg] with x hx
    have hm : G (g x) ∈ R := hRange ▸ Set.mem_range_self (g x)
    have hp : (x, (G (g x)).2) = G (g x) := Prod.ext hx.symm rfl
    exact hp ▸ hm
  · refine ⟨fun _ => Classical.choice ‹Nonempty Y›, measurable_const.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hsec] with x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
    exact False.elim (hne ⟨(x, y), hy⟩)

OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Represent.name: OAI.KadisonSimilarity.vonNeumannCenter
OAI.Analysis.KadisonSimilarity.Represent.text:
def vonNeumannCenter (P : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : VonNeumannAlgebra H where
  toStarSubalgebra := P.toStarSubalgebra ⊓ P.commutant.toStarSubalgebra
  centralizer_centralizer' := by
    have he : (P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∩ (P.commutant : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) =
        Set.centralizer ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ P.commutant) := by
      rw [Set.centralizer_union]
      rw [← VonNeumannAlgebra.coe_commutant, ← VonNeumannAlgebra.coe_commutant]
      simp only [VonNeumannAlgebra.commutant_commutant, Set.inter_comm]
    change Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer
      ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∩ P.commutant)) =
      ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∩ P.commutant)
    rw [he]
    exact Set.centralizer_centralizer_centralizer
      ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ P.commutant)

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.PublishedKap.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.generatedVonNeumannAlgebra
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.PublishedKap.text:
def generatedVonNeumannAlgebra (A : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
    VonNeumannAlgebra H where
  toStarSubalgebra := StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ
    (StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
  centralizer_centralizer' := by
    let S := (StarSubalgebra.centralizer ℂ (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) :
      Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
    change (S ∪ star S).centralizer.centralizer.centralizer = (S ∪ star S).centralizer
    exact Set.centralizer_centralizer_centralizer _

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.CommonRankFa.text:
theorem commonRank_factor_fibers
    (A C : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    [IsClosed (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))] [IsClosed (C : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))]
    (hAS : A ≤ S) (hCS : C ≤ S)
    (hcomm : ∀ a : A, ∀ c : C, a.val * c.val = c.val * a.val)
    (hgen : representationVonNeumannAlgebra (jointCStarSource A C).subtype =
      starSubalgebraCommutant π.range) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂projectionStratumMeasure (cyclicCommonBaseMeasure π D) (commonModelProjection M)
      (commonRankBasis π D) n,
      ScalarCenter (commonRankFiberAlgebra M (StarSubalgebra.inclusion hAS) n x) := by
  have hf := commonModel_factor_fibers S M A C hAS hCS hcomm hgen
  have hr := (ae_restrict_iff_subtype (measurableSet_projectionRankStratum
    (commonModelProjection M) (commonRankBasis π D) (commonModelProjection_measurable M) n)).mp
    (ae_restrict_of_ae hf)
  filter_upwards [hr] with x hx
  rw [commonRankFiberAlgebra, representationVonNeumannAlgebra_eq_generated]
  exact fixedFiber_scalarCenter_of_nonunital M.field (commonRankBasis π D) (commonRankBasis_total π D)
    (StarSubalgebra.inclusion hAS) n x hx

end

OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.BlockCommuta.name: OAI.KadisonKastler.publishedBlockCommutantApproximation
OAI.Analysis.KadisonKastler.BlockCommuta.text:
theorem publishedBlockCommutantApproximation : PublishedBlockCommutantApproximation A K := by
  intro π T e he hcb r hr
  let H := Generator.FiniteHilbert (Fin 2) K
  let φ : CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (K →L[ℂ] K) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    hilbertMatrixHom
  let ρ := φ.comp π
  have hid : (innerDerivation (φ T)).comp ρ.toAlgHom.toLinearMap =
      φ.toAlgHom.toLinearMap.comp ((innerDerivation T).comp π.toAlgHom.toLinearMap) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro a
    change φ T * φ (π a) - φ (π a) * φ T = φ (T * π a - π a * T)
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul]
  have hc : CompletelyBoundedBy ((innerDerivation (φ T)).comp ρ.toAlgHom.toLinearMap) e := by
    rw [hid]
    intro p q X
    rw [matrix_map_comp,
      injective_starAlgHom_completelyIsometric φ hilbertMatrixHom_injective p q]
    exact hcb p q X
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hn⟩ := exists_commutant_of_completelyBounded ρ (φ T) he hc hr
  let B : CStarMatrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (K →L[ℂ] K) :=
    CStarMatrix.ofMatrix (fun i j => Generator.operatorEntry D i j)
  have hB : φ B = D := hilbertMatrix_operatorEntries D
  refine ⟨B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a
    apply hilbertMatrixHom_injective
    change φ (B * π a) = φ (π a * B)
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, hB]
    exact hD a
  · rw [← norm_hilbertMatrix]
    change ‖φ (B - T)‖ < r
    rw [map_sub, hB]
    exact hn

end

end KadisonKastler

end OAI

    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]

    · simp
  map_mul' := hilbertMatrix_mul
  map_zero' := by ext x i; simp [hilbertMatrix_apply]
  map_add' M N := by
    ext x i

  commutes' z := by
    ext x i
    simp only [hilbertMatrix_apply, CStarMatrix.algebraMap_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hji
      simp [Ne.symm hji]
    · simp

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.IterationBou.name: OAI.StrongThinTree.iterationPotential
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.IterationBou.text: def iterationPotential (r : ℕ) : ℝ := Real.exp (iterationB*(1-errorU r))

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.StepBounds:1.name: OAI.StrongThinTree.splitTau
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.StepBounds:1.text: def splitTau (r : ℕ) : ℝ := 2*Real.sqrt (splitEpsilon r)+splitEpsilon r

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.IterationBou.name: OAI.StrongThinTree.iteration_coefficient_step
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.IterationBou.text:
lemma iteration_coefficient_step {r : ℕ} (h : StepNumeric r) :
    iterationPotential (stepCount r)/(stepCount r:ℝ)*(1/2+3*splitTau r) ≤
      iterationPotential r/(r:ℝ) := by
  have hrR : (0:ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < r by have := h.rlarge; omega)
  have hsR : (0:ℝ) < stepCount r := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) h.lower
  have hs : 0 < stepCount r := Nat.cast_pos.mp hsR
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hsR hrR).mpr
  have hp := iterationPotential_step hs h.upper
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.ratio (iterationPotential_pos (stepCount r)).le
  have hp' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp hsR.le
  nlinarith
end StrongThinTree

end

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.IterationBou.name: OAI.StrongThinTree.iterationPotential_le

  nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Main:11.name: OAI.StrongThinTree.MultiGraph.connected_has_spanningTree
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Main:11.text:
lemma connected_has_spanningTree {n m : ℕ} (G : MultiGraph n m)
    (hG : G.Connected univ) : ∃T : Finset (Fin m), G.SpanningTree T := by
  classical
  let A : Finset (Finset (Fin m)) := univ.filter G.Connected
  have hA : A.Nonempty := ⟨univ,by simp only [A,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]; exact hG⟩
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hmin⟩ := exists_min_image A Finset.card hA
  refine ⟨T,(mem_filter.mp hT).2,?_⟩
  intro e he hc
  have hh := hmin (T.erase e) (by simp only [A,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]; exact hc)
  exact (not_le_of_gt (card_erase_lt_of_mem he)) hh

end MultiGraph

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Iteration:15.name: OAI.StrongThinTree.MultiGraph.packing_thinness
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Iteration:15.text:
theorem packing_thinness : ∃C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r →
    ∀(n m : ℕ) (G : MultiGraph n m), 2 ≤ n → G.TreePackable univ r →
      ∃T : Finset (Fin m), G.SpanningTree T ∧
        ∀S : Finset (Fin n), S.Nonempty → S ≠ univ →
          ((G.cut T S).card:ℝ) ≤ C/(r:ℝ)*(G.cut univ S).card := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hstep⟩ := sparsification
  have hRR : (0:ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < R by omega)
  have hI : ∀r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → ∀(n m : ℕ) (G : MultiGraph n m),
      2 ≤ n → G.TreePackable univ r →
        ∃T : Finset (Fin m), G.SpanningTree T ∧
          ∀S : Finset (Fin n), S.Nonempty → S ≠ univ →
            ((G.cut T S).card:ℝ) ≤
              R*(iterationPotential r/(r:ℝ))*(G.cut univ S).card := by
    intro r
    induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h r ih =>
      intro hr n m G hn hp
      have hrR : (0:ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < r by omega)
      by_cases hlarge : R ≤ r
      · obtain ⟨hnum,hstep'⟩ := hstep r hlarge
        obtain ⟨A,hA,hcuts⟩ := hstep' n m G hn hp
        have hsR : (0:ℝ) < stepCount r :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hnum.lower
        have hs : 1 ≤ stepCount r := by exact_mod_cast hsR
        have hlt : stepCount r < r := by
          have hh : (stepCount r:ℝ) < r := by linarith [hnum.upper]
          exact_mod_cast hh
        obtain ⟨T,hT,hthin⟩ := ih (stepCount r) hlt hs n A.card (G.restrict A) hn
          (G.restrict_packable A hA)
        refine ⟨liftEdges A T,(G.restrict_spanningTree A T).mp hT,?_⟩
        intro S hS hS'
        have ht := hthin S hS hS'
        rw [G.restrict_cut_card,G.restrict_cut_card,lift_univ] at ht
        have hcoef : 0 ≤ R*(iterationPotential (stepCount r)/(stepCount r:ℝ)) :=
          mul_nonneg hRR.le (div_nonneg (iterationPotential_pos _).le hsR.le)
        calc
          _ ≤ R*(iterationPotential (stepCount r)/(stepCount r:ℝ))*(G.cut A S).card := ht
          _ ≤ R*(iterationPotential (stepCount r)/(stepCount r:ℝ))*
              ((1/2+3*splitTau r)*(G.cut univ S).card) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcuts S hS hS') hcoef
          _ = R*(iterationPotential (stepCount r)/(stepCount r:ℝ)*(1/2+3*splitTau r))*
              (G.cut univ S).card := by ring
          _ ≤ R*(iterationPotential r/(r:ℝ))*(G.cut univ S).card :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (iteration_coefficient_step hnum) hRR.le)
              (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      · obtain ⟨F,hF,_⟩ := hp
        let i : Fin r := ⟨0,by omega⟩
        refine ⟨F i,(hF i).2,?_⟩
        intro S _ _
        have hrleR : (r:ℝ) ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast (show r ≤ R by omega)
        have hcoef : 1 ≤ R*(iterationPotential r/(r:ℝ)) := by
          rw [←mul_div_assoc]
          apply (le_div_iff₀ hrR).mpr
          have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (iterationPotential_one_le hr) hRR.le
          nlinarith
        have hc : ((G.cut (F i) S).card:ℝ) ≤ (G.cut univ S).card := by
          exact_mod_cast G.cut_card_le_full (F i) S
        exact hc.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hcoef)
  refine ⟨R*Real.exp iterationB,mul_pos hRR (Real.exp_pos _),?_⟩
  intro r hr n m G hn hp
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hthin⟩ := hI r hr n m G hn hp
  refine ⟨T,hT,fun S hS hS' => (hthin S hS hS').trans ?_⟩
  have hrR : (0:ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < r by omega)
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  rw [←mul_div_assoc]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (iterationPotential_le r) hRR.le) hrR.le

end StrongThinTree.MultiGraph

end
end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Main:24.name: strongThinTree
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Main:24.text:
theorem strongThinTree : MainStatement := by
  obtain ⟨C₀,hC₀,hpacking⟩ := MultiGraph.packing_thinness
  let C : ℝ := 3*max C₀ 1
  have hm : 1 ≤ max C₀ 1 := le_max_right _ _
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro k hk n m hn G hc
  by_cases hk2 : 2 ≤ k
  · let r := k/2
    have hr : 0 < r := Nat.div_pos hk2 (by norm_num)
    have hr' : 1 ≤ r := hr
    have hconn : G.EdgeConnected (2*r) := by
      intro S hS hS'
      exact (show 2*r ≤ k by dsimp [r]; omega).trans (hc S hS hS')
    have hpack := G.edgeConnected_treePackable hr (by omega) hconn
    obtain ⟨T,hT,hthin⟩ := hpacking r hr' n m G hn hpack
    refine ⟨T,hT,fun S hS hS' => (hthin S hS hS').trans ?_⟩
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    have hrR : (0:ℝ) < r := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hr
    have hkR : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hrR hkR).mpr
    have hkr : (k:ℝ) ≤ 3*(r:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ 3*r by dsimp [r]; omega)
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkr hC₀.le
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left C₀ 1) hrR.le
    dsimp [C]
    nlinarith
  · have hk1 : k=1 := by omega
    subst k
    have hconn : G.Connected univ := by
      intro S hS hS'
      exact card_pos.mp (hc S hS hS')
    obtain ⟨T,hT⟩ := G.connected_has_spanningTree hconn
    refine ⟨T,hT,?_⟩
    intro S _ _
    have hh : ((G.cut T S).card:ℝ) ≤ (G.cut univ S).card := by
      exact_mod_cast G.cut_card_le_full T S
    have hCle : 1 ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; linarith
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one,div_one] using
      hh.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hCle)

end StrongThinTree

end

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.name: OAI.StrongThinTree.MultiGraph.sparsification
OAI.Combinatorics.ThinTrees.Sparsificati.text:
theorem sparsification : ∃R : ℕ, 4 ≤ R ∧ ∀r : ℕ, R ≤ r → StepNumeric r ∧
    ∀(n m : ℕ) (G : MultiGraph n m), 2 ≤ n → G.TreePackable univ r →
      ∃A : Finset (Fin m), G.TreePackable A (stepCount r) ∧
        ∀S : Finset (Fin n), S.Nonempty → S ≠ univ →
          ((G.cut A S).card:ℝ) ≤ (1/2+3*splitTau r)*(G.cut univ S).card := by
  obtain ⟨RE,hRE,hE⟩ := extraction
  obtain ⟨RN,hN⟩ := eventual_step_numeric
  refine ⟨max RE RN,hRE.trans (le_max_left _ _),fun r hr => ?_⟩
  have hn := hN r ((le_max_right _ _).trans hr)
  refine ⟨hn,fun n m G hn' hp => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨X,hX,hpack⟩ := hE r ((le_max_left _ _).trans hr) n m G hn' hp
  exact G.sparsify_from_extraction hn' hn hX hpack
end StrongThinTree.MultiGraph

end
end

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.FiniteMar.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.finiteMarginal_isDeterminantal
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.FiniteMar.text:
lemma finiteMarginal_isDeterminantal {I : Type u_1} {K : I → I → ℂ}
    {μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool)} (hμ : IsDeterminantalLaw μ K)
    (S : Finset I) :
    IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw (finiteMarginal μ S) (fun i j : S => K i.1 j.1) := by
  classical
  intro A
  let emb : S ↪ I := ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩
  let T : Finset I := A.map emb
  let e : A ≃ T := Equiv.ofBijective
    (fun i => ⟨i.1.1, Finset.mem_map_of_mem emb i.2⟩)
    (by
      constructor
      · intro a b hab
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg (fun x : T => (x : I)) hab
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hi
        exact ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, rfl⟩)
  have hs : MeasurableSet {x : S → Bool | ∀ i ∈ A, x i = true} :=
    (Set.toFinite _).measurableSet
  rw [finiteMarginal, ProbabilityMeasure.map_apply' _
    (Measurable.of_eval (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.1)).aemeasurable hs]
  have hevent : (fun x : I → Bool => fun i : S => x i.1) ⁻¹'
      {x : S → Bool | ∀ i ∈ A, x i = true} =
      {x : I → Bool | ∀ i ∈ T, x i = true} := by
    ext x
    simp [T, emb]
  rw [hevent, hμ T]
  convert (Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self e (fun i j : T => K i.1 j.1)).symm using 1
  congr 1

end Problem336AdditiveD139

theorem group_factor_of_finite_response
    (hresponse : ∀ (F : Type u) [Fintype F] [Nonempty F]
      (ν : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)), StronglyRayleighFinite ν →
      ∀ (i : F) (h h' : F → ℝ) (D : ℝ), 0 ≤ D →
        (∀ j, |h j - h' j| ≤ D) → |tiltMean ν h i - tiltMean ν h' i| ≤ D / 2)
    {Γ : Type u} [Group Γ] [Countable Γ] [MeasurableSpace Γ]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool))
    (hSR : StronglyRayleighCountable μ) (hInv : InvariantBinaryLaw μ) :
    HasEquivariantIIDFactor μ := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := BrownianConstruction.exists_brownianPathMeasure
  exact GroupSampler.factor_of_innovation_law hresponse μ hSR hInv ν
    hν.toIsPreBrownianReal (group_innovation_map_eq μ ν hν)

end Problem336AdditiveD139

def HasEquivariantIIDFactor {Γ : Type u_5} [Group Γ] [MeasurableSpace Γ]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool)) : Prop :=
  ∃ Phi : (Γ → UnitLabel) → (Γ → Bool),
    Measurable Phi ∧
    (∀ (g : Γ) (u : Γ → UnitLabel),
      Phi (leftTranslate g u) = leftTranslate g (Phi u)) ∧
    Measure.map Phi (iidUnitLabels Γ) = (μ : Measure (Γ → Bool))

lemma tiltCovariance_nonpos_of_pairMass {F : Type u_8} [Fintype F]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) (h : F → ℝ) (i j : F)
    (hneg : tiltPairMass μ h i j false false * tiltPairMass μ h i j true true ≤
      tiltPairMass μ h i j true false * tiltPairMass μ h i j false true) :
    tiltCovariance μ h i j ≤ 0 := by
  rw [tiltCovariance_pairMass]
  exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (sub_nonpos.mpr hneg) (sq_nonneg _)

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Generatin.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.GeneratingSlice.covariance_row_nonneg_of_slice_bound
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Generatin.text:
theorem covariance_row_nonneg_of_slice_bound (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool))
    (h : F → ℝ) (i : F)
    (hbound : (slice (weight μ h) i true).eval 1 *
        (slice (weight μ h) i false).derivative.eval 1 -
        (slice (weight μ h) i false).eval 1 * (slice (weight μ h) i true).derivative.eval 1 ≤
        (slice (weight μ h) i false).eval 1 * (slice (weight μ h) i true).eval 1) :
    0 ≤ ∑ j : F, tiltCovariance μ h i j := by
  rw [covariance_row_eq_slice]
  exact div_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)

end GeneratingSlice

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Covarianc.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.sum_abs_row_le_twice_diag
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Covarianc.text:
theorem sum_abs_row_le_twice_diag {F : Type u_2} [Fintype F] (c : F → ℝ) (i : F)
    (hdiag : 0 ≤ c i) (hoff : ∀ j, j ≠ i → c j ≤ 0)
    (hrow : 0 ≤ ∑ j : F, c j) :
    (∑ j : F, |c j|) ≤ 2 * c i := by
  rw [sum_abs_row_eq c i hdiag hoff]
  linarith

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Elementar.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.tiltCovariance_self

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.twoCoordinateCoefficient
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.text:
def twoCoordinateCoefficient {F : Type u_1} [Fintype F]
    (weight : (F → Bool) → ℂ) (i j : F) (r : F → ℂ) (p q : Bool) : ℂ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ x : F → Bool, if x i = p ∧ x j = q then
    weight x * ∏ k ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j,
      if x k = true then r k else 1
    else 0

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Model:52.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.marginalGeneratingValue

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Main:65.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.invariant_positive_contraction_dpp_factor
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Main:65.text:
theorem invariant_positive_contraction_dpp_factor :
    ∀ (Γ : Type u_5) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ] [MeasurableSpace Γ]
      (K : Γ → Γ → ℂ) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool)),
      PositiveContractionKernel K → IsDeterminantalLaw μ K →
        InvariantBinaryLaw μ → HasEquivariantIIDFactor μ := by
  intro Γ _ _ _ K μ hK hμ hinv
  apply strongly_rayleigh_group_factor Γ μ ?_ hinv
  exact isDeterminantalLaw_stronglyRayleighCountable_of_finite K μ
    (fun F _ _ L hL ν hν => hν.stronglyRayleighFinite hL) hK hμ

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.BinaryPro.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.binary_projective_exists
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.BinaryPro.text:
theorem binary_projective_exists {I : Type u_3}
    (P : (S : Finset I) → Measure (S → Bool))
    [∀ S, IsProbabilityMeasure (P S)]
    (hP : IsProjectiveMeasureFamily (α := fun _ : I => Bool) P) :
    ∃ μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool),
      IsProjectiveLimit (α := fun _ : I => Bool) (μ : Measure (I → Bool)) P := by
  let m := projectiveFamilyContent hP
  have htend : ∀ {s : ℕ → Set (I → Bool)},
      (∀ n, s n ∈ measurableCylinders (fun _ : I => Bool)) →
      Antitone s → (⋂ n, s n) = ∅ →
      Tendsto (fun n => m (s n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro s hs hanti hempty
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := binary_cylinders_eventually_empty hs hanti hempty
    have heq : (fun n => m (s n)) =ᶠ[atTop] fun _ => 0 := by
      refine eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hsub := hanti hn
      rw [hN] at hsub
      have hz : s n = ∅ := Set.eq_empty_of_subset_empty hsub
      simp [hz, m]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.congr' heq.symm
  have hsig : m.IsSigmaSubadditive := by
    refine isSigmaSubadditive_of_addContent_iUnion_eq_tsum
      isSetRing_measurableCylinders (fun f hf hfU hdisj => ?_)
    exact addContent_iUnion_eq_sum_of_tendsto_zero isSetRing_measurableCylinders m
      (fun _ _ => projectiveFamilyContent_ne_top hP) @htend hf hfU hdisj
  let μ := m.measure isSetSemiring_measurableCylinders
    generateFrom_measurableCylinders.ge hsig
  have hlim : IsProjectiveLimit (α := fun _ : I => Bool) μ P := by
    intro S
    ext t ht
    rw [Measure.map_apply (Finset.measurable_restrict S) ht]
    change μ (cylinder S t) = P S t
    dsimp [μ]
    rw [AddContent.measure_eq _ _ generateFrom_measurableCylinders.symm _
      (cylinder_mem_measurableCylinders _ _ ht)]
    exact projectiveFamilyContent_cylinder hP ht
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hlim.isProbabilityMeasure
  exact ⟨⟨μ, inferInstance⟩, hlim⟩

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.GroupFact.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.group_innovation_map_eq
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.GroupFact.text:
theorem group_innovation_map_eq
    {Γ : Type u} [Group Γ] [Countable Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool))
    (ν : ProbabilityMeasure PathRealization.Path)
    (hν : IsBrownianReal (fun t (w : PathRealization.Path) => w t)
      (ν : Measure PathRealization.Path)) :
    (ReferenceObservation.law μ ν).map
      (fun ω => GroupInnovation.transform μ (PathRealization.referencePaths ω)) =
        Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : Γ => (ν : Measure PathRealization.Path)) := by
  let B := fun (t : ℝ≥0) (w : PathRealization.Path) => w t
  have hBm : ∀ t, Measurable (B t) :=
    fun t => (continuous_eval_const t).measurable
  have hBj : Measurable (fun p : ℝ≥0 × PathRealization.Path => B p.1 p.2) :=
    (continuous_eval.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst)).measurable
  apply ReferenceInnovationLaw.map_field_innovation_eq μ ν B hν.toIsPreBrownianReal
    hBm hBj (fun w => w.continuous) (ν : Measure PathRealization.Path) hν
    (groupDrift μ) (measurable_groupDrift μ) (groupDrift_mem_Icc μ)
    (ReferenceObservation.groupDrift_condExp_history μ ν B hν.toIsPreBrownianReal hBm)
  intro ω i t
  rw [GroupInnovation.transform_apply_real_time]
  rfl

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Elementar.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.twice_tilt_variance_le_half
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Elementar.text:
lemma twice_tilt_variance_le_half {F : Type u_6} [Fintype F]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) (h : F → ℝ) (i : F) :
    2 * tiltMean μ h i * (1 - tiltMean μ h i) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (tiltMean μ h i - 1 / 2)]

end Problem336AdditiveD139

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Main:75.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.translation_invariant_kernel_dpp_factor
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Main:75.text:
theorem translation_invariant_kernel_dpp_factor :
    ∀ (Γ : Type u_6) [Group Γ] [Countable Γ] [MeasurableSpace Γ] (K : Γ → Γ → ℂ),
      PositiveContractionKernel K → TranslationInvariantKernel K →
        ∃ μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool),
          IsDeterminantalLaw μ K ∧ InvariantBinaryLaw μ ∧ HasEquivariantIIDFactor μ := by
  intro Γ _ _ _ K hK htranslation
  apply translationInvariantKernel_factor_of_exists K htranslation
    (countable_positive_contraction_dpp_exists_unique Γ K hK).exists
  intro μ hμ hinvariant
  exact invariant_positive_contraction_dpp_factor Γ K μ hK hμ hinvariant

end Problem336AdditiveD139

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.MarginalB.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.stronglyRayleighCountable_of_finiteMarginal
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.MarginalB.text:
lemma stronglyRayleighCountable_of_finiteMarginal {I : Type u_1}
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool))
    (h : ∀ S : Finset I, S.Nonempty → StronglyRayleighFinite (finiteMarginal μ S)) :
    StronglyRayleighCountable μ := by
  classical
  intro S z hz
  by_cases hS : S.Nonempty
  · rw [← finiteGeneratingValue_finiteMarginal]
    exact h S hS z hz
  · have hS' : S = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hS
    subst S
    rw [marginalGeneratingValue_empty]
    exact one_ne_zero

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Translati.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.IsDeterminantalLaw.invariantBinaryLaw
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Translati.text:
theorem IsDeterminantalLaw.invariantBinaryLaw
    {Γ : Type u_1} [Group Γ] {K : Γ → Γ → ℂ}
    {μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool)}
    (hμ : IsDeterminantalLaw μ K) (hK : TranslationInvariantKernel K) :
    InvariantBinaryLaw μ := by
  intro g
  have heq : translatedLaw μ g = μ :=
    (translatedLaw_isDeterminantal hμ hK g).eq hμ
  exact congrArg ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure heq

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.StableWro.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.stable_affine_wronskian_bound
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.StableWro.text:
theorem stable_affine_wronskian_bound (p q : ℝ[X])
    (hpcoeff : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ p.coeff n)
    (hqcoeff : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ q.coeff n)
    (hstable : ∀ z w : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 < w.im →
      aeval z p + w * aeval z q ≠ 0) :
    q.eval 1 * p.derivative.eval 1 - p.eval 1 * q.derivative.eval 1 ≤
      p.eval 1 * q.eval 1 := by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · simp [hq]
  exact stable_wronskian_of_denominator_stable p q hpcoeff hqcoeff hstable
    (polynomial_slope_stable_of_affine_stable p q hq hstable)

end Problem336AdditiveD139

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.RayleighR.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.StronglyRayleighFinite.tiltCovariance_row_nonneg
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.RayleighR.text:
theorem StronglyRayleighFinite.tiltCovariance_row_nonneg
    {F : Type u_1} [Fintype F] {μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)}
    (hμ : StronglyRayleighFinite μ) (h : F → ℝ) (i : F) :
    0 ≤ ∑ j : F, tiltCovariance μ h i j := by
  classical
  apply GeneratingSlice.covariance_row_nonneg_of_slice_bound μ h i
  exact stable_affine_wronskian_bound
    (GeneratingSlice.slice (GeneratingSlice.weight μ h) i false)
    (GeneratingSlice.slice (GeneratingSlice.weight μ h) i true)
    (GeneratingSlice.slice_coeff_nonneg _ (GeneratingSlice.weight_nonneg μ h) i false)
    (GeneratingSlice.slice_coeff_nonneg _ (GeneratingSlice.weight_nonneg μ h) i true)
    (GeneratingSlice.slice_stable μ hμ h i)

end Problem336AdditiveD139

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.FiniteRes.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.finite_response_of_covariance_signs
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.FiniteRes.text:
theorem finite_response_of_covariance_signs {F : Type u_1} [Fintype F]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool))
    (hoff : ∀ (i j : F) (h : F → ℝ), i ≠ j → tiltCovariance μ h i j ≤ 0)
    (hrow : ∀ (i : F) (h : F → ℝ), 0 ≤ ∑ j : F, tiltCovariance μ h i j) :
    (∀ (i j : F) (h : F → ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => tiltMean μ (coordinatePerturb h j r) i)
        (tiltCovariance μ h i j) 0) ∧
    (∀ (i : F) (h : F → ℝ),
      (∑ j : F, |tiltCovariance μ h i j|) ≤
        2 * tiltMean μ h i * (1 - tiltMean μ h i) ∧
      2 * tiltMean μ h i * (1 - tiltMean μ h i) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2) ∧
    (∀ (i : F) (h h' : F → ℝ) (D : ℝ), 0 ≤ D →
      (∀ j : F, |h j - h' j| ≤ D) →
      |tiltMean μ h i - tiltMean μ h' i| ≤ D / 2) := by
  have hbound (i : F) (h : F → ℝ) :
      (∑ j : F, |tiltCovariance μ h i j|) ≤
        2 * tiltMean μ h i * (1 - tiltMean μ h i) := by
    have hb := sum_abs_row_le_twice_diag (tiltCovariance μ h i) i
      (tiltCovariance_self_nonneg μ h i)
      (fun j hj => hoff i j h (Ne.symm hj)) (hrow i h)
    simpa only [tiltCovariance_self, mul_assoc] using hb
  refine ⟨fun i j h => tiltMean_hasDerivAt_coordinate μ h i j,
    fun i h => ⟨hbound i h, twice_tilt_variance_le_half μ h i⟩, ?_⟩
  intro i h h' D hD hdist
  have hb := finite_response_lipschitz_of_directional_deriv
    (fun h => tiltMean μ h i) (fun h => tiltCovariance μ h i) ((1 : ℝ) / 2)
    (fun h v t => tiltMean_hasDerivAt_affine μ h v i t)
    (fun h => (hbound i h).trans (twice_tilt_variance_le_half μ h i))
    h h' D hD hdist
  convert hb using 1
  ring

end Problem336AdditiveD139

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.twoCoordinateWeight
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.text:
def twoCoordinateWeight {F : Type u_8} [Fintype F]
    (weight : (F → Bool) → ℝ) (i j : F) (p q : Bool) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x : F → Bool, if x i = p ∧ x j = q then weight x else 0

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.GroupSamp.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.GroupSampler.factor_of_innovation_law
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.GroupSamp.text:
theorem factor_of_innovation_law
    (hresponse : ∀ (F : Type u) [Fintype F] [Nonempty F]
      (ν : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)), StronglyRayleighFinite ν →
      ∀ (i : F) (h h' : F → ℝ) (D : ℝ), 0 ≤ D →
        (∀ j, |h j - h' j| ≤ D) → |tiltMean ν h i - tiltMean ν h' i| ≤ D / 2)
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (Γ → Bool))
    (hSR : StronglyRayleighCountable μ) (hInv : InvariantBinaryLaw μ)
    (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Path)
    (hν : IsPreBrownianReal (fun t (w : Path) => w t) (ν : Measure Path))
    (hlaw : (ReferenceObservation.law μ ν).map
      (fun ω => GroupInnovation.transform μ (PathRealization.referencePaths ω)) =
        Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : Γ => (ν : Measure Path))) :
    HasEquivariantIIDFactor μ := by
  apply PathRealization.factor_of_canonical_innovation_law μ ν hν
    (GroupInnovation.measurable_drift μ) 1 (GroupInnovation.abs_drift_le_one μ)
    (GroupInnovation.drift_mem_unitInterval μ) ((1 : ℝ) / 2) (by positivity)
  · intro t x y D hD hxy i
    simpa only [GroupInnovation.drift, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_comm] using
      groupDrift_response_of_finite_response hresponse μ hSR t x y D hD hxy i
  · intro g t x i
    exact congrFun (groupDrift_leftTranslate μ hInv g t x) i
  · exact hlaw

end Problem336AdditiveD139.GroupSampler

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Generatin.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.GeneratingSlice.slice_stable
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Generatin.text:
lemma slice_stable (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) (hμ : StronglyRayleighFinite μ)
    (h : F → ℝ) (i : F) (z s : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    aeval z (slice (weight μ h) i false) + s * aeval z (slice (weight μ h) i true) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [slice_generating_identity]
  apply hμ
  intro j
  simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
  apply mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _)
  split_ifs <;> assumption

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TiltScali.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.generating_monomial_rescale
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TiltScali.text:
lemma generating_monomial_rescale (h : F → ℝ) (x : F → Bool) (z : F → ℂ) :
    (∏ i : F, if x i = true then (Real.exp (h i) : ℂ) * z i else 1) =
      (Real.exp (∑ i : F, h i * boolReal (x i)) : ℂ) *
        ∏ i : F, if x i = true then z i else 1 := by
  classical
  rw [exp_bool_sum_eq_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  cases x i <;> simp

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.continuous_twoCoordinateCoefficient
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.text:
lemma continuous_twoCoordinateCoefficient {F : Type u_7} [Fintype F]
    (weight : (F → Bool) → ℂ) (i j : F) (p q : Bool) :
    Continuous (fun r : F → ℂ => twoCoordinateCoefficient weight i j r p q) := by
  unfold twoCoordinateCoefficient
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro x hx
  split_ifs
  · apply continuous_const.mul
    apply continuous_finsetProd
    intro k hk
    split_ifs <;> fun_prop
  · exact continuous_const

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.weighted_generating_two_coordinates
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.text:
lemma weighted_generating_two_coordinates {F : Type u_5} [Fintype F]
    (weight : (F → Bool) → ℂ) (r : F → ℂ) (i j : F) (hij : i ≠ j) (z w : ℂ) :
    (∑ x : F → Bool, weight x *
      ∏ k : F, if x k = true then twoCoordinateField i j r z w k else 1) =
    twoCoordinateCoefficient weight i j r false false +
      twoCoordinateCoefficient weight i j r true false * z +
      twoCoordinateCoefficient weight i j r false true * w +
      twoCoordinateCoefficient weight i j r true true * z * w := by
  classical
  simp only [twoCoordinateCoefficient, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x hx
  rw [monomial_two_coordinates x r i j hij z w]
  cases hxi : x i <;> cases hxj : x j <;> simp <;> ring

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Main:57.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.countable_positive_contraction_dpp_exists_unique
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Main:57.text:
theorem countable_positive_contraction_dpp_exists_unique :
    ∀ (I : Type u_4) [Countable I] (K : I → I → ℂ),
      PositiveContractionKernel K →
        ∃! μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool), IsDeterminantalLaw μ K := by
  intro I _ K hK
  exact positiveContractionKernel_existsUnique_of_finite_exists
    (fun F _ _ K hK => hK.exists_finiteDPP) I K hK

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Model:98.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.PositiveContractionFinite
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Model:98.text:
def PositiveContractionFinite {F : Type u_16} [Fintype F]
    (K : F → F → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i j, K i j = conj (K j i)) ∧
  ∀ c : F → ℂ,
    0 ≤ (∑ i : F, ∑ j : F, conj (c i) * K i j * c j).re ∧
    (∑ i : F, ∑ j : F, conj (c i) * K i j * c j).re ≤
      ∑ i : F, Complex.normSq (c i)

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Model:66.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.tiltPartition
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Model:66.text:
def tiltPartition {F : Type u_11} [Fintype F]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) (h : F → ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ x : F → Bool,
    Real.exp (∑ j : F, h j * boolReal (x j)) *
      ((μ : Measure (F → Bool)) {x}).toReal

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.DPPReinde.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.finiteDppFamily_projective
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.DPPReinde.text:
lemma finiteDppFamily_projective {I : Type u_11} (K : I → I → ℂ)
    (P : ∀ S : Finset I, ProbabilityMeasure (S → Bool))
    (hP : ∀ S, IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw (P S) (fun i j : S => K i.1 j.1))
    (hunique : ∀ (S : Finset I) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure (S → Bool)),
      IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw ν (fun i j : S => K i.1 j.1) → ν = P S) :
    IsProjectiveMeasureFamily (α := fun _ : I => Bool) (fun S => (P S : Measure (S → Bool))) := by
  classical
  intro S T hTS
  let e : T ↪ S := ⟨fun i => ⟨i.1, hTS i.2⟩,
    fun a b h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun x : S => (x : I)) h)⟩
  have hd : IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw (binaryPullbackLaw (P S) e)
      (fun i j : T => K i.1 j.1) :=
    isFiniteDeterminantalLaw_binaryPullback (P S) (fun i j : S => K i.1 j.1) (hP S) e
  have heq := hunique T (binaryPullbackLaw (P S) e) hd
  exact congrArg (fun ν : ProbabilityMeasure (T → Bool) => (ν : Measure (T → Bool)))
    heq.symm

end Problem336AdditiveD139

end

end OAI

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.twoCoordinateWeight_cast_eq_coefficient
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.TwoCoordi.text:
lemma twoCoordinateWeight_cast_eq_coefficient {F : Type u_14} [Fintype F]
    (weight : (F → Bool) → ℝ) (i j : F) (p q : Bool) :
    (twoCoordinateWeight weight i j p q : ℂ) =
      twoCoordinateCoefficient (fun x => (weight x : ℂ)) i j (fun _ => 1) p q := by
  simp only [twoCoordinateWeight, twoCoordinateCoefficient, Complex.ofReal_sum,
    ite_self, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x hx
  split_ifs <;> simp

end Problem336AdditiveD139

def PositiveContractionKernel {I : Type u_18}

  ∀ (S : Finset I) (c : S → ℂ),
    0 ≤ (∑ i : S, ∑ j : S, conj (c i) * K i.1 j.1 * c j).re ∧
    (∑ i : S, ∑ j : S, conj (c i) * K i.1 j.1 * c j).re ≤
      ∑ i : S, Complex.normSq (c i)

      Real.exp (∑ k : F, h k * boolReal (x k)) *

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.BrownianE.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.BrownianConstruction.exists_brownianPathMeasure

theorem exists_brownianPathMeasure :
    ∃ ν : ProbabilityMeasure C(ℝ≥0, ℝ),
      IsBrownianReal (fun t w => w t) (ν : Measure C(ℝ≥0, ℝ)) := by
  let ν := preBrownianMeasure.map brownianRealization
  refine ⟨ν, ⟨⟨fun I => ?_⟩, ae_of_all _ (fun w => w.continuous)⟩⟩
  have hm : Measurable (fun w : C(ℝ≥0, ℝ) => I.restrict (fun t => w t)) :=
    Measurable.of_eval (fun t => (continuous_eval_const (t : ℝ≥0)).measurable)
  refine ⟨hm.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  change Measure.map _ (preBrownianMeasure.map
    brownianRealization : Measure C(ℝ≥0, ℝ)) = _
  rw [ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map,
    Measure.map_map hm measurable_brownianRealization]
  exact (isBrownianReal_brownianRealization.toIsPreBrownianReal.hasLaw I).map_eq

theorem IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw.stronglyRayleighFinite_of_isHermitian
    {F : Type u_1} [Fintype F] {μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)}
    {K : F → F → ℂ} (hμ : IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw μ K)
    (hK : (Matrix.of K).IsHermitian) : StronglyRayleighFinite μ := by
  classical
  intro z hz
  rw [finiteGeneratingValue_eq_det μ K hμ z]
  have heq : ((1 : Matrix F F ℂ) + Matrix.of (fun i j => (z i - 1) * K i j)) =
      1 - Matrix.of K + Matrix.diagonal z * Matrix.of K := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact hermitian_pencil_det_ne_zero hK z hz

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Countable.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.positiveContractionKernel_existsUnique_of_finite_exists
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Countable.text:
lemma positiveContractionKernel_existsUnique_of_finite_exists
    (finite_exists : ∀ (F : Type u) [Fintype F] [Nonempty F] (K : F → F → ℂ),
      PositiveContractionFinite K →
        ∃ μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool), IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw μ K)
    (I : Type u) (K : I → I → ℂ) (hK : PositiveContractionKernel K) :
    ∃! μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool), IsDeterminantalLaw μ K := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ S : Finset I, ∃ μ : ProbabilityMeasure (S → Bool),
      IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw μ (fun i j : S => K i.1 j.1) := by
    intro S
    apply finite_dpp_exists_including_empty finite_exists S
    exact ⟨fun i j => hK.1 i.1 j.1, hK.2 S⟩
  choose P hP using hex
  have hproj := finiteDppFamily_projective K P hP
    (fun S ν hν => hν.eq (hP S))
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := binary_projective_exists
    (fun S => (P S : Measure (S → Bool))) hproj
  exact existsUnique_determinantalLaw_of_exists K
    ⟨μ, isDeterminantalLaw_of_projectiveLimit K P hP μ hμ⟩

end Problem336AdditiveD139

end

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Bivariate.text:
theorem bivariate_continuous_limit_rayleigh
    (A B C D : ℝ → ℂ) (a b c d : ℝ)
    (hA : ContinuousAt A 0) (hB : ContinuousAt B 0)
    (hC : ContinuousAt C 0) (hD : ContinuousAt D 0)
    (hA0 : A 0 = (a : ℂ)) (hB0 : B 0 = (b : ℂ))
    (hC0 : C 0 = (c : ℂ)) (hD0 : D 0 = (d : ℂ))
    (hstable : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z w : ℂ, 0 < z.im → 0 < w.im →
      A t + B t * z + C t * w + D t * z * w ≠ 0) :
    a * d ≤ b * c := by
  apply bivariate_stable_limit_rayleigh_of_eventually
    (l := nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) A B C D a b c d
  · simpa [hA0] using hA.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  · simpa [hB0] using hB.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  · simpa [hC0] using hC.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  · simpa [hD0] using hD.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  · have hpos : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), 0 < t := self_mem_nhdsWithin
    exact hpos.mono fun t ht => hstable t ht

end Problem336AdditiveD139

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.RayleighO.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.StronglyRayleighFinite.tiltCovariance_nonpos
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.RayleighO.text:
theorem StronglyRayleighFinite.tiltCovariance_nonpos
    {F : Type u_1} [Fintype F] {μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)}
    (hμ : StronglyRayleighFinite μ) (h : F → ℝ)
    (i j : F) (hij : i ≠ j) : tiltCovariance μ h i j ≤ 0 := by
  classical
  let weight : (F → Bool) → ℝ := fun x =>
    Real.exp (∑ k : F, h k * boolReal (x k)) *
      ((μ : Measure (F → Bool)) {x}).toReal
  let coeff (p q : Bool) (t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
    twoCoordinateCoefficient (fun x => (weight x : ℂ)) i j
      (fun _ => 1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) p q
  have hcont (p q : Bool) : ContinuousAt (coeff p q) 0 := by
    apply Continuous.continuousAt
    exact (continuous_twoCoordinateCoefficient
      (fun x => (weight x : ℂ)) i j p q).comp (by fun_prop)
  have hzero (p q : Bool) : coeff p q 0 = (tiltPairMass μ h i j p q : ℂ) := by
    simpa [coeff, twoCoordinateWeight, tiltPairMass, weight] using
      (twoCoordinateWeight_cast_eq_coefficient weight i j p q).symm
  apply tiltCovariance_nonpos_of_pairMass
  apply bivariate_continuous_limit_rayleigh
    (coeff false false) (coeff true false) (coeff false true) (coeff true true)
    _ _ _ _ (hcont _ _) (hcont _ _) (hcont _ _) (hcont _ _)
    (hzero _ _) (hzero _ _) (hzero _ _) (hzero _ _)
  intro t ht z w hz hw
  let field := twoCoordinateField i j (fun _ : F => 1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) z w
  have hfield (k : F) : 0 < (field k).im := by
    simp only [field, twoCoordinateField]
    split_ifs
    · exact hz
    · exact hw
    · simpa using ht
  have hstable := hμ (fun k => (Real.exp (h k) : ℂ) * field k) (fun k => by
    simpa only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, add_zero] using mul_pos (Real.exp_pos (h k)) (hfield k))
  have hscale : finiteGeneratingValue μ (fun k => (Real.exp (h k) : ℂ) * field k) =
      ∑ x : F → Bool, (weight x : ℂ) *
        ∏ k : F, if x k = true then field k else 1 := by
    unfold finiteGeneratingValue
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    rw [generating_monomial_rescale]
    simp only [weight, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    ring
  rw [hscale, weighted_generating_two_coordinates _ _ i j hij z w] at hstable
  exact hstable

end Problem336AdditiveD139

end

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.ResponseL.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.finite_response_lipschitz_of_directional_deriv
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.ResponseL.text:
theorem finite_response_lipschitz_of_directional_deriv
    {F : Type u_2} [Fintype F]
    (f : (F → ℝ) → ℝ) (c : (F → ℝ) → F → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hderiv : ∀ (h v : F → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (fun j => h j + s * v j))
        (∑ j, c (fun k => h k + t * v k) j * v j) t)
    (hrow : ∀ h : F → ℝ, ∑ j, |c h j| ≤ C)
    (h h' : F → ℝ) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hdist : ∀ j, |h j - h' j| ≤ D) :
    |f h - f h'| ≤ C * D := by
  let v : F → ℝ := fun j => h j - h' j
  have hsegment :
      ‖f (fun j => h' j + 1 * v j) - f (fun j => h' j + 0 * v j)‖ ≤ C * D := by
    apply norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment_01'
      (fun t _ => (hderiv h' v t).hasDerivWithinAt)
    intro t _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact covariance_direction_bound _ v D C hD hdist (hrow _)
  simpa [v, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hsegment

end Problem336AdditiveD139

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Main:21.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.finite_strongly_rayleigh_response
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Main:21.text:
theorem finite_strongly_rayleigh_response :
    ∀ (F : Type u_1) [Fintype F] [Nonempty F] (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)),
      StronglyRayleighFinite μ →
        (∀ (i j : F) (h : F → ℝ),
          HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => tiltMean μ (coordinatePerturb h j r) i)
            (tiltCovariance μ h i j) 0) ∧
        (∀ (i : F) (h : F → ℝ),
          (∑ j : F, |tiltCovariance μ h i j|) ≤
              2 * tiltMean μ h i * (1 - tiltMean μ h i) ∧
            2 * tiltMean μ h i * (1 - tiltMean μ h i) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2) ∧
        (∀ (i : F) (h h' : F → ℝ) (D : ℝ),
          0 ≤ D → (∀ j : F, |h j - h' j| ≤ D) →
            |tiltMean μ h i - tiltMean μ h' i| ≤ D / 2) := by
  intro F _ _ μ hμ
  exact finite_response_of_covariance_signs μ
    (fun i j h hij => hμ.tiltCovariance_nonpos h i j hij)
    (fun i h => hμ.tiltCovariance_row_nonneg h i)

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Countable.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.isDeterminantalLaw_of_projectiveLimit
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Countable.text:
lemma isDeterminantalLaw_of_projectiveLimit {I : Type u}
    (K : I → I → ℂ) (P : ∀ S : Finset I, ProbabilityMeasure (S → Bool))
    (hP : ∀ S : Finset I,
      IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw (P S) (fun i j : S => K i.1 j.1))
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool))
    (hμ : IsProjectiveLimit (μ : Measure (I → Bool))
      (fun S => (P S : Measure (S → Bool)))) :
    IsDeterminantalLaw μ K := by
  classical
  intro A
  have hm : (μ : Measure (I → Bool)) {x | ∀ i ∈ A, x i = true} =
      (P A : Measure (A → Bool)) {x | ∀ i : A, x i = true} := by
    have hμA : Measure.map A.restrict (μ : Measure (I → Bool)) =
        (P A : Measure (A → Bool)) := hμ A
    rw [← hμA, Measure.map_apply]
    · congr 1
      ext x
      simp [Finset.restrict]
    · exact Measurable.of_eval (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.1)
    · exact (Set.toFinite _).measurableSet
  rw [hm]
  have h := hP A Finset.univ
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_true_left] at h
  rw [h]
  refine (det_finset_univ (fun i j : A => K i.1 j.1)).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun d : DecidableEq A =>
    @Matrix.det A d _ ℂ _ (fun i j : A => K i.1 j.1)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.Generatin.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.GeneratingSlice.weight

def weight (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool)) (h : F → ℝ) (x : F → Bool) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (∑ j : F, h j * boolReal (x j)) * ((μ : Measure (F → Bool)) {x}).toReal

OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.MarginalB.name: OAI.Problem336AdditiveD139.isDeterminantalLaw_stronglyRayleighCountable_of_finite
OAI.Probability.StrongRayleigh.MarginalB.text:
lemma isDeterminantalLaw_stronglyRayleighCountable_of_finite
    {I : Type u} (K : I → I → ℂ) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (I → Bool))
    (hfinite : ∀ (F : Type u) [Fintype F] [Nonempty F] (L : F → F → ℂ),
      PositiveContractionFinite L → ∀ ν : ProbabilityMeasure (F → Bool),
        IsFiniteDeterminantalLaw ν L → StronglyRayleighFinite ν)
    (hK : PositiveContractionKernel K) (hμ : IsDeterminantalLaw μ K) :
    StronglyRayleighCountable μ := by
  apply stronglyRayleighCountable_of_finiteMarginal μ
  intro S hS
  let : Nonempty S := hS.to_subtype
  exact hfinite S (fun i j : S => K i.1 j.1)
    (positiveContractionFinite_restrict K hK S) (finiteMarginal μ S)
    (finiteMarginal_isDeterminantal hμ S)

end Problem336AdditiveD139

OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.Model:51.name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.FullEndpoint
OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.Model:51.text:
def FullEndpoint : Prop :=
  ∀ (U : Set ℂ), IsAdmissible U →
    (∀ a ∈ U, Nonempty (DiskCoordinate U a)) ∧
    Nonempty (ExteriorCoordinate U) ∧
    ∀ (a : ℂ), a ∈ U → ∀ (f : DiskCoordinate U a) (G : ExteriorCoordinate U),
      ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
        numericalRange A ⊆ U →
        let T := matrixAnalyticEval A f.toDisk
        StrictlyFeasible T ∧
        ∃ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ ∧ κ ≤ 2 ∧
          (∃ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsMinimizing T (κ ^ 2) H) ∧
          ∀ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsMinimizing T (κ ^ 2) H →
            let S := CFC.sqrt H
            let A' := S * A * S⁻¹
            let D := S * T * S⁻¹
            H.PosDef ∧ IsUnit S ∧
            D = matrixAnalyticEval A' f.toDisk ∧
            Dᴴ * D ≤ 1 ∧ spectralRadius ℂ D < 1 ∧
            ‖S‖ * ‖S⁻¹‖ = κ ∧
            (∀ R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsUnit R →
              (R * T * R⁻¹)ᴴ * (R * T * R⁻¹) ≤ 1 →
              κ ≤ ‖R‖ * ‖R⁻¹‖) ∧
            ∃ Λ : C(UnitAddCircle, Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
              (∀ t, (Λ t).PosSemidef) ∧
              (∫ t, Λ t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) = 1 ∧
              ∀ (m : ℕ), 0 < m →
                ∀ v : ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ,
                  AnalyticOnNhd ℂ v (closure U) →
                  completeAnalyticEval A' v =
                    (∫ t, Λ t ⊗ₖ v (boundaryPoint G t) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) ∧
                  ‖completeAnalyticEval A v‖ ≤ κ * analyticSupNorm U v

end StructuralCrouzeix
end

OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.Optimize.name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.optimal_metric_bundle
OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.Optimize.text:
theorem optimal_metric_bundle (D : AdmissibleDomain)
    {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)] (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hW : numericalRange A ⊆ D.domain) :
    let T := matrixAnalyticEval A D.interior.toDisk
    StrictlyFeasible T ∧
    ∃ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ ∧ κ ≤ 2 ∧
      (∃ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsMinimizing T (κ^2) H) ∧
      ∀ H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsMinimizing T (κ^2) H →
        let S := CFC.sqrt H
        let A' := S*A*S⁻¹
        let B := S*T*S⁻¹
        H.PosDef ∧ IsUnit S ∧
        B = matrixAnalyticEval A' D.interior.toDisk ∧
        Bᴴ*B ≤ 1 ∧ spectralRadius ℂ B < 1 ∧
        ‖S‖*‖S⁻¹‖ = κ ∧
        (∀ R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ, IsUnit R →
          (R*T*R⁻¹)ᴴ*(R*T*R⁻¹) ≤ 1 → κ ≤ ‖R‖*‖R⁻¹‖) := by
  let T := matrixAnalyticEval A D.interior.toDisk
  have hA : spectrum ℂ A ⊆ D.domain := (spectrum_subset_numericalRange A).trans hW
  have hT : spectralRadius ℂ T < 1 := D.coordinate_stable A hA
  refine ⟨strictlyFeasible_of_stable hT, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨τ,H₀,hf,hp,hm⟩ := exists_optimal_metric hT
  have ht : 0 ≤ τ := zero_le_one.trans hf.one_le
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt τ)^2 = τ := Real.sq_sqrt ht
  have hk : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt τ := by
    have hh := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hf.one_le
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using hh
  refine ⟨Real.sqrt τ,hk,minimizing_sqrt_le_two D A hW ⟨hf,hm⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · exact ⟨H₀,by simpa only [hsq] using (show IsMinimizing T τ H₀ from ⟨hf,hm⟩)⟩
  intro H hH
  have hH' : IsMinimizing T τ H := by simpa only [hsq] using hH
  have hpos := minimizing_posDef hH'
  have hu := metric_sqrt_isUnit hpos
  refine ⟨hpos,hu,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact (matrixAnalyticEval_similarity hu A D.interior.toDisk).symm
  · exact (matrix_contractivity_iff _).mpr (metric_similarity_contraction hH'.1 hpos)
  · simpa only [spectralRadius_eq_of_unital,spectrum_matrix_similarity hu] using hT
  · exact optimal_metric_condition_eq_from_minimality hH'.1 hpos hH'.2
  · intro R hR hc
    exact optimal_metric_sqrt_le_similarity hH'.1 hH'.2 hR
      ((matrix_contractivity_iff _).mp hc)

end StructuralCrouzeix
end

  Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv'.symm (primaryEval (Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv' A) f)

OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.Main:60.name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.fullEndpoint
OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.Main:60.text:
theorem fullEndpoint : FullEndpoint := by
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨hinterior,hexterior⟩ := hU.coordinates
  refine ⟨hinterior,hexterior,?_⟩
  intro a ha f G n hn A hW
  let : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0,hn⟩⟩
  let D := bundleDomain hU a ha f G
  have hWD : numericalRange A ⊆ D.domain := hW
  obtain ⟨hstrict,κ,hκlo,hκhi,hattained,hall⟩ := optimal_metric_bundle D A hWD
  refine ⟨hstrict,κ,hκlo,hκhi,hattained,?_⟩
  intro H hH
  obtain ⟨hp,hu,heval,hcontract,hstable,hcondition,hminimal⟩ := hall H hH
  refine ⟨hp,hu,heval,hcontract,hstable,hcondition,hminimal,?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Λ,hpos,hmass,hrep⟩ := D.common_positiveDensity_maximum_for_metric A H hWD hH.1
  refine ⟨Λ,(fun t => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (hpos t)),hmass,?_⟩
  intro m hm v hv
  obtain ⟨he,hb⟩ := hrep m hm v hv
  constructor
  · change completeAnalyticEval (CFC.sqrt H * A * (CFC.sqrt H)⁻¹) v =
      ∫ t, Λ t ⊗ₖ v (boundaryPoint G t) ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle
    change completeAnalyticEval (CFC.sqrt H * A * (CFC.sqrt H)⁻¹) v =
      ∫ t, Λ t ⊗ₖ v ((bundleDomain hU a ha f G).G t.toCircle)
        ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle at he
    simpa only [bundleDomain_boundaryPoint] using he
  · change ‖completeAnalyticEval A v‖ ≤
      (‖CFC.sqrt H‖ * ‖(CFC.sqrt H)⁻¹‖) * analyticSupNorm U v at hb
    rwa [hcondition] at hb

end StructuralCrouzeix
end

OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.Model:38.name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.StrictlyFeasible
OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.Model:38.text:
def StrictlyFeasible {n : ℕ} (T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (τ : ℝ) (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ), H.IsHermitian ∧
    (H - 1).PosDef ∧
    (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) τ - H).PosDef ∧
    (H - Tᴴ * H * T).PosDef

OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.UnitDisk.name: OAI.StructuralCrouzeix.isAdmissible_unitDisk
OAI.Analysis.StructuralCrouzeix.UnitDisk.text:
theorem isAdmissible_unitDisk : IsAdmissible (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
  have hfront : frontier (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) = sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 :=
    frontier_ball _ one_ne_zero
  refine ⟨isOpen_ball, isBounded_ball, convex_ball _ _,
    ⟨0, mem_ball_self zero_lt_one⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Nonempty (↥(sphere (0 : ℂ) 1) ≃ₜ ↥(frontier (ball (0 : ℂ) 1)))
    exact ⟨Homeomorph.setCongr hfront.symm⟩
  · intro p hp
    have hpn : ‖p‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp (hfront ▸ hp)
    have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by
      intro he
      simp [he] at hpn
    let χ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => p * exp (I * z)
    have hχa : AnalyticAt ℂ χ 0 :=
      analyticAt_const.mul ((analyticAt_const.mul analyticAt_id).cexp')
    have hχd : HasDerivAt χ (p * I) 0 := by
      simpa only [χ, id_eq, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero, one_mul, mul_one] using
        ((((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_mul I).cexp).const_mul p)
    refine ⟨χ, by simp only [χ, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one], hχa, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hχd.deriv]
      exact mul_ne_zero hp0 I_ne_zero
    · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      intro z
      rw [hfront, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
      change ‖p * exp (I * z)‖ = 1 ↔ z.im = 0
      rw [norm_mul, hpn, one_mul, Complex.norm_exp, Real.exp_eq_one_iff]
      simp [Complex.mul_re]
end StructuralCrouzeix
end

OAI.Analysis.LpDimension.LogLimits:12.name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.subpower_log_limit
OAI.Analysis.LpDimension.LogLimits:12.text:
lemma subpower_log_limit (f : ℕ → ℕ) (C r : ℝ) (hr : r < 1)
    (hpos : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0 < f n)
    (hup : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (f n : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (C*Real.log (n:ℝ)^r)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (f n : ℝ)/Real.log (n:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (n:ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hp : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C*Real.log (n:ℝ)^(r-1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by linarith : 0 < 1-r)).comp hlog
    simpa only [neg_sub, mul_zero, Function.comp_def] using hh.const_mul C
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hp
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => div_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _) (Real.log_natCast_nonneg _))
  · filter_upwards [hpos, hup, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with n hn hu hn2
    have hnR : (1:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < n by omega)
    have hl := Real.log_pos hnR
    have hf : (0:ℝ) < f n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hh := Real.log_le_log hf hu
    rw [Real.log_exp] at hh
    rw [Real.rpow_sub hl, Real.rpow_one]
    calc
      _ ≤ (C*Real.log (n:ℝ)^r)/Real.log (n:ℝ) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh hl.le
      _ = _ := by ring

end SubpolynomialLp

end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.LpDimension.Main:13.name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.source_main
OAI.Analysis.LpDimension.Main:13.text:
theorem source_main (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) :
    (∀ D : ℝ, 1 < D → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      GoodDimension.{u} p n D (dimension.{u} p n D) ∧
      Real.log (n : ℝ) / Real.log (1 + 2 * D) ≤ (dimension.{u} p n D : ℝ) ∧
      (dimension.{u} p n D : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (C * Real.log (n : ℝ) ^ gamma p)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 9 ≤ n →
      GoodDimension.{u} p n 1 (dimension.{u} p n 1) ∧
      ((n - 1) / 4) ^ 2 ≤ dimension.{u} p n 1 ∧
      dimension.{u} p n 1 ≤ n.choose 2) ∧
    (∀ D : ℝ, 1 ≤ D →
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (dimension.{u} p n D : ℝ) / Real.log (n : ℝ))
        atTop (𝓝 (if 1 < D then 0 else 2))) := by
  have hupper : ∀ D : ℝ, 1 < D → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      (dimension.{u} p n D : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (C * Real.log (n : ℝ) ^ gamma p) := by
    intro D hD
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hp2 with hlt|hgt
    · simpa only [gamma,ite_eq_left hlt] using below_main_upper.{u} p D hp hlt hD
    · simpa only [gamma,ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hgt.le)] using above_main_upper.{u} p D hgt hD
  refine ⟨?_,fun n hn => exact_dimension_bounds p hp hp2 n hn,?_⟩
  · intro D hD
    obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hupper D hD
    exact ⟨C,fun n hn => ⟨dimension_good p hp n hn D hD.le,
      dimension_packing_lower p hp n hn D hD.le,hC n hn⟩⟩
  · intro D hD
    by_cases hD1 : 1 < D
    · rw [ite_eq_left hD1]
      obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hupper D hD1
      have hγ : gamma p < 1 := by
        unfold gamma
        split_ifs
        · linarith
        · have hh : 0 < 2/p := by positivity
          linarith
      apply subpower_log_limit (fun n => dimension.{u} p n D) C (gamma p) hγ
      · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with n hn
        have hl := dimension_packing_lower.{u} p hp n hn D hD
        have hn1 : (1:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < n by omega)
        have hdpos : (0:ℝ) < dimension.{u} p n D :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos (Real.log_pos hn1) (Real.log_pos (by linarith))) hl
        exact_mod_cast hdpos
      · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with n hn
        exact hC n hn
    · have hDeq : D=1 := by linarith
      subst D
      simpa only [lt_self_iff_false,ite_false] using exact_dimension_log_limit.{u} p hp hp2

end SubpolynomialLp

end

OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Mixture.Domina.name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Mixture.directionLaw_domination
OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Mixture.Domina.text:
theorem directionLaw_domination (V N : Submodule ℝ E) (hVN : V ≤ N)
    (hj : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V) (hjn : Module.finrank ℝ V < Module.finrank ℝ N)
    (hnD : Module.finrank ℝ N < Module.finrank ℝ E) (e : Metric.sphere (0 : V) 1) :
    directionLaw V N ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^Module.finrank ℝ E •
      (SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw + latitudeLaw V e
        (((Module.finrank ℝ N : ℝ)-(Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ))/2)
        (((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)-(Module.finrank ℝ N : ℝ))/2)) := by
  have hk := V.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
  have hr := latitude_rank V e
  let : Nontrivial E := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℝ) (M := E) (by omega)
  let : Nontrivial V := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℝ) (M := V) (by omega)
  let : Nontrivial Vᗮ := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℝ) (M := Vᗮ) (by omega)
  let : Nontrivial N := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := ℝ) (M := N) (by omega)
  let : Nontrivial (latitudeSpace V e) := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos
    (R := ℝ) (M := latitudeSpace V e) (by omega)
  let a := ((Module.finrank ℝ N : ℝ)-(Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ))/2
  let delta := ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)-(Module.finrank ℝ N : ℝ))/2
  let A := ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)-(Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ))/2
  let b := (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ)/2
  let B := delta+((Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ)-1)/2
  have hjR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ V := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hjnR : (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ) < Module.finrank ℝ N := by exact_mod_cast hjn
  have hnDR : (Module.finrank ℝ N : ℝ)+1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.add_one_le_iff.mpr hnD)
  have hdimR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E := by positivity
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; linarith
  have hd : 0 < delta := by dsimp [delta]; linarith
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; linarith
  have hA : a ≤ A := by dsimp [a,A]; linarith
  have hB : b ≤ B := by dsimp [b,B,delta]; linarith
  have hshape : a+delta = A := by dsimp [a,delta,A]; ring
  have hAb : (Module.finrank ℝ Vᗮ : ℝ)/2 = A := by
    have hkR : (Module.finrank ℝ V : ℝ)+(Module.finrank ℝ Vᗮ : ℝ) = Module.finrank ℝ E := by
      exact_mod_cast hk
    dsimp [A]
    linarith
  have hbb : (Module.finrank ℝ Vᗮᗮ : ℝ)/2 = b := by
    have heq : Module.finrank ℝ Vᗮᗮ = Module.finrank ℝ V :=
      congrArg (fun U : Submodule ℝ E => Module.finrank ℝ U) (Submodule.orthogonal_orthogonal V)
    rw [heq]
  have huniBeta : MeasurePreserving (perpCoordinate V) SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw
      (betaMeasure A b) := by
    let : Nontrivial Vᗮᗮ := by simpa using (inferInstance : Nontrivial V)
    change MeasurePreserving (fun x : E => ‖Vᗮ.orthogonalProjectionOnto x‖^2) _ _
    simpa only [hAb,hbb] using sphere_projection_beta Vᗮ
  have hlatBeta : MeasurePreserving (perpCoordinate V) (latitudeLaw V e a delta)
      (betaMeasure a B) := by
    by_cases hj1 : Module.finrank ℝ V = 1
    · have hB1 : B = delta := by dsimp [B]; rw [hj1]; norm_num
      rw [hB1]
      exact latitudeLaw_beta_one V e hj1 (by omega) ha hd
    · exact latitudeLaw_beta_gt_one V e (by omega) (hjn.trans hnD) ha hd hshape
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (latitudeLaw V e a delta) := latitudeLaw_probability V e ha hd
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (betaMeasure A b) := isProbabilityMeasureBeta (ha.trans_le hA) hb
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (betaMeasure a B) := isProbabilityMeasureBeta ha (hb.trans_le hB)
  have hdir : directionLaw V N = mixtureLaw V (betaMeasure a b) := by
    rw [block_classification V (directionLaw V N) (directionLaw_unit V N)
      (directionLaw_invariant V N hVN), (directionLaw_beta V N hVN (by omega) hjn).map_eq]
  have huni : SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw = mixtureLaw V (betaMeasure A b) := by
    rw [block_classification V SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw
      SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw_ae_norm
      (fun u w => SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw_isometry (blockIso V u w)),huniBeta.map_eq]
  have hlat : latitudeLaw V e a delta = mixtureLaw V (betaMeasure a B) := by
    rw [block_classification V (latitudeLaw V e a delta) (latitudeLaw_unit V e ha hd)
      (latitudeLaw_invariant V e ha hd),hlatBeta.map_eq]
  have hscalar : betaMeasure a b ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞)^Module.finrank ℝ E •
      (betaMeasure A b+betaMeasure a B) := by
    have hAD : A-a ≤ (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) := by dsimp [A,a]; linarith
    have hBD : B-b ≤ (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) := by dsimp [B,b,delta]; linarith
    have h := SubsphereCurrent.betaMeasure_two_component ha hb hA hB hAD hBD
    simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2),
      ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat] using h
  change directionLaw V N ≤ _ • (SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw + latitudeLaw V e a delta)
  rw [hdir,huni,hlat]
  exact mixtureLaw_domination V _ hscalar

end SubsphereCurrent.Mixture
end

OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Model:185.text:
def RadiusWeightedFullEstimate : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d →
    (∀ W : ℝ, 1 ≤ W → ∀ (V : Type v) [Fintype V] [Nonempty V],
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ W →
      ∀ κ : V → Observation d (d/16) → ℝ≥0∞,
      (∀ v, Measurable (κ v)) → (∀ obs, ∑ v, κ v obs ≤ 1) →
      ∀ g : V → Sphere d → ℝ≥0∞,
      (∀ v, Measurable (g v)) → (∀ v s, g v s ≤ 1) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, (d : ℝ)/2 ≤ n → n ≤ d →
      norm d n (blockInput κ g) ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal W)^(1/((d/16 : ℕ) : ℝ))*ENNReal.ofReal (C^d)*(⨆ v, norm d (n-2) (g v))) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, (d : ℝ)/2 ≤ n → n ≤ d →
      ∀ π : Measure (Sphere d), IsProbabilityMeasure π →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      norm d n (terminalInput π ε) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C^d)*(ENNReal.ofReal ε)^((d : ℝ)/16))

end SubsphereCurrent.Weighted
end

OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Estimates.Weig.name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Weighted.weighted_block
OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Estimates.Weig.text:
lemma weighted_block {d n : ℕ} (hd : 128 ≤ d) (hn : (d : ℝ)/2 ≤ n) (hnd : n ≤ d)
    {W : ℝ} (_hW : 1 ≤ W)
    {V : Type v} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (hcard : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ W)
    (κ : V → Observation d (d/16) → ℝ≥0∞) (hκ : ∀ v, Measurable (κ v))
    (hκ1 : ∀ obs, ∑ v, κ v obs ≤ 1)
    (g : V → Sphere d → ℝ≥0∞) (hg : ∀ v, Measurable (g v)) (hg1 : ∀ v s, g v s ≤ 1) :
    norm d n (blockInput κ g) ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal W)^(1/((d/16 : ℕ) : ℝ))*ENNReal.ofReal ((131072 : ℝ)^d)*
        (⨆ v, norm d (n-2) (g v)) := by
  classical
  let : MeasurableSpace V := ⊤
  let : MeasurableSingletonClass V := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩
  apply iSup_le
  intro A
  apply (weighted_block_test hd hn hnd κ hκ hκ1 g hg hg1 A).trans
  have hc : (Fintype.card V : ℝ≥0∞)^(1/((d/16 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal W)^(1/((d/16 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    apply ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow _ (by positivity)
    exact_mod_cast ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hcard
  have hp : (32768 : ℝ≥0∞)^n*2^(n+1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((131072 : ℝ)^d) := by
    have hn1 : n+1 ≤ 2*d := by omega
    calc
      _ ≤ (32768 : ℝ≥0∞)^d*2^(2*d) := mul_le_mul'
        (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hnd) (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hn1)
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_mul,← mul_pow,ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity)]; norm_num
  calc
    _ = (Fintype.card V : ℝ≥0∞)^(1/((d/16 : ℕ) : ℝ))*
        ((32768 : ℝ≥0∞)^n*2^(n+1))*(⨆ v, norm d (n-2) (g v)) := by ac_rfl
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul' (mul_le_mul' hc hp) le_rfl

end

OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Estimates.Affi.name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Affine.estimate_one_seed
OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Estimates.Affi.text:
lemma estimate_one_seed {d n ell : ℕ} (hd : 128 ≤ d)
    (hn : (d+1)/2+2*ell ≤ n) (A : Test d n)
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [Nonempty J] [MeasurableSpace J] [MeasurableSingletonClass J]
    (hbudget : Real.log (Fintype.card J : ℝ) ≤ ((d/8 : ℕ) : ℝ)*d*Real.log 2)
    (L : Fixed.Stream (Vector d) J (ell*(d/16))) (hL : L.BorelRules)
    (hu : ∀ q, ∀ᵐ y ∂L.output q, ‖y‖ = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (∫⁻ z : Sphere A.space × (Fin (ell*(d/16)) → Vector d),
      L.angularSuccess ε (A.point z.1) z.2
        ∂(sphereLaw A.space).prod (Fixed.rowsLaw (Vector d) (ell*(d/16)))) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((16*((1000 : ℝ)^32)^ell*ε)/A.radius)^(2*(d/32))) := by
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
  let : Nontrivial A.space := Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (A.dimension ▸ hnpos)
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (sphereLaw A.space) := Fixed.sphereLaw_probability
  by_cases hsmall : 16*((1000 : ℝ)^32)^ell*(ε/A.radius) ≤ 1
  · apply Simulation.average_le_of_simulated A L hL hu ε
    intro w
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using simulated_numeric_bound hd hn A hbudget
      (Simulation.stream A L w) (Simulation.borel A L hL w) (div_pos hε A.radius_positive) hsmall
  · calc
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ _ : Sphere A.space × (Fin (ell*(d/16)) → Vector d), (1 : ℝ≥0∞)
          ∂(sphereLaw A.space).prod (Fixed.rowsLaw (Vector d) (ell*(d/16))) :=
        lintegral_mono (fun _ => prob_le_one)
      _ = 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.one_le_ofReal.2 (one_le_pow₀ (by simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hsmall)))

lemma directionLaw_bottom (N : Submodule ℝ E) [Nontrivial N] [Nontrivial E] :
    directionLaw ⊥ N = SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw := by
  apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
  intro f hf

      filter_upwards [SubsphereRegression.ambientSphereLaw_ae_norm (E := N)] with x hx
      exact (block_bottom_haar (show ‖(x : E)‖ = 1 from hx)).lintegral_comp hf

OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Kernels.Precis.text:
theorem explicit_precision : ExplicitPrecision.{u} := by
  intro M hM
  obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩ := SubsphereRegression.explicit_precision_old_model.{0} M hM
  refine ⟨max 3 d₁, ?_⟩
  intro d hd T ε hε hε10 Ω _ ρ hρ L hL hs
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := hρ
  let : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hs' : (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε := by
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · exact hs
    · exact L.uniformSuccess_of_pointwise ρ hL ε _ hs
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hgood⟩ := L.exists_good_seed ρ hL ε
  let K := (L.rules ω).borelVersion hω
  have hK : K.BorelRules := (L.rules ω).borelVersion_rules hω
  have hsuccess : (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ K.asTape.uniformSuccess K.tapeLaw ε := by
    rw [K.uniformSuccess_asTape hK ε]
    calc
      (2/3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε := hs'
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ z : UnitSphere d × Samples d T, (L.rules ω).conditionalSuccess ε z.1 z.2
          ∂(uniformSphere d).prod (sampleLaw d T) := hgood
      _ = ∫⁻ z : UnitSphere d × Samples d T, K.conditionalSuccess ε z.1 z.2
          ∂(uniformSphere d).prod (sampleLaw d T) :=
        lintegral_congr_ae ((L.rules ω).borelVersion_success_ae hω (by omega) ε)
  exact hd₁ d (by omega) T ε hε hε10 (KernelLearner.Tape d (M d) T)
    K.tapeLaw inferInstance K.asTape (K.asTape_admissible hK) (Or.inl hsuccess)

end SubsphereCurrent
end

theorem half_precision : HalfPrecision.{u} := by
  refine ⟨1 / (4 * (1024 + 512)) * Real.log 2, mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos (by norm_num)), ?_⟩
  intro M hM
  obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩ := SubsphereRegression.half_precision_old_model.{0} M hM
  refine ⟨max 3 d₁, ?_⟩

  let : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hgood⟩ := L.exists_good_seed ρ hL ε
  let K := (L.rules ω).borelVersion hω
  have hK : K.BorelRules := (L.rules ω).borelVersion_rules hω
  have hsuccess : (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ K.asTape.uniformSuccess K.tapeLaw ε := by
    rw [K.uniformSuccess_asTape hK ε]
    calc
      (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ L.uniformSuccess ρ ε := hs
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ z : UnitSphere d × Samples d T, (L.rules ω).conditionalSuccess ε z.1 z.2
          ∂(uniformSphere d).prod (sampleLaw d T) := hgood
      _ = ∫⁻ z : UnitSphere d × Samples d T, K.conditionalSuccess ε z.1 z.2
          ∂(uniformSphere d).prod (sampleLaw d T) :=
        lintegral_congr_ae ((L.rules ω).borelVersion_success_ae hω (by omega) ε)
  exact hd₁ d (by omega) T ε hε hε10 (KernelLearner.Tape d (M d) T)
    K.tapeLaw inferInstance K.asTape (K.asTape_admissible hK) hsuccess

end SubsphereCurrent

OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Estimates.Weig.name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Weighted.radius_weighted_full_estimate
OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Estimates.Weig.text:
theorem radius_weighted_full_estimate : RadiusWeightedFullEstimate := by
  refine ⟨131072,by norm_num,128,?_⟩
  intro d hd
  constructor
  · intro W hW V _ _ hcard κ hκ hκ1 g hg hg1 n hn hnd
    exact weighted_block hd hn hnd hW hcard κ hκ hκ1 g hg hg1
  · intro n hn hnd π hπ ε hε

    apply (weighted_terminal (by omega : 4 ≤ d) hn hnd π hε).trans
    apply mul_le_mul' _ le_rfl
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) d

lemma measurePreserving_swapFirstTwo {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {C : Type w}
    [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B] [MeasurableSpace C]
    (μ : Measure A) (ν : Measure B) (ρ : Measure C)
    [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] [SFinite ρ] :
    MeasurePreserving (swapFirstTwo A B C) (μ.prod (ν.prod ρ)) (ν.prod (μ.prod ρ)) := by
  exact (measurePreserving_prodAssoc ν μ ρ).comp
    (((MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := μ) (ν := ν)).prod (MeasurePreserving.id ρ)).comp
      (MeasurePreserving.symm MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc (measurePreserving_prodAssoc μ ν ρ)))

OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Estimates.Affi.name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Affine.log_card_of_width
OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Estimates.Affi.text:
lemma log_card_of_width {d J : ℕ} {W : ℝ} (hd : 128 ≤ d) (hJ : 1 ≤ J)
    (hJW : (J : ℝ) ≤ W) (hbudget : W^(1/((d/8 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ)^d) :
    Real.log (J : ℝ) ≤ ((d/8 : ℕ) : ℝ)*d*Real.log 2 := by
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < (d/8 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < d/8)
  have hJp : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < J)
  have hWp : 0 < W := hJp.trans_le hJW
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hWp _) hbudget
  rw [Real.log_rpow hWp,Real.log_pow] at hlog
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hp.le
  have he : ((d/8 : ℕ) : ℝ)*(1/((d/8 : ℕ) : ℝ)*Real.log W) = Real.log W := by
    field_simp
  rw [he] at hmul
  exact (Real.log_le_log hJp hJW).trans (by nlinarith [hmul])

OAI.Probability.Subsphere.Model:237.name: OAI.SubsphereCurrent.Fixed.rowsLaw

def rowsLaw (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
