    (fun P x => preimageExceptionCount x (extractedStructureCondition x P))
    tupleNormalization scale_eventually_pos _ hsmall
  refine ⟨C,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hC] with x hx
  intro P
  exact (preimageExceptionCount_le_totientCount x _).trans hx

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.normality_bounded_endpoint
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.text:
lemma normality_bounded_endpoint (M : ℕ) (hM : 4 ≤ M) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ S : ℝ, 2 < S → ∀ N : ℕ, 3 < N → N ≤ M →
    ((nonNormalPrimes S N).card:ℝ) ≤
      C*N/Real.log N*(B N)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) := by
  classical
  let C := 2*Real.log M*(M:ℝ)^(1/6:ℝ)/(B 4)^5
  have hB4 : 0 < B 4 := by exact doubleLog_nat_pos (n:=4) (by norm_num)
  have hM0 : (0:ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < M by omega)
  have hlogM : 0 < Real.log M := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < M by omega))
  refine ⟨C,by dsimp [C]; positivity,?_⟩
  intro S hS N hN hNM
  have hlogS : 0 < Real.log S := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hN0 : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have hlogN : 0 < Real.log N := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega))
  have hlogNM : Real.log N ≤ Real.log M := Real.log_le_log hN0 (by exact_mod_cast hNM)
  have hBN : B 4 ≤ B N := Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 4))
    (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4) (by exact_mod_cast (show 4 ≤ N by omega)))
  have hBpos : 0 < B N := hB4.trans_le hBN
  have hrpow : 0 < (Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlogS _
  by_cases hlarge : (N:ℝ) ≤ Real.log S
  · rw [nonNormalPrimes_empty_of_large_parameter hS (by omega) hlarge]
    simp only [Finset.card_empty,Nat.cast_zero]
    dsimp [C]
    positivity
  · have hSM : Real.log S ≤ (M:ℝ) := (le_of_not_ge hlarge).trans (by exact_mod_cast hNM)
    have hr := Real.rpow_le_rpow hlogS.le hSM (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/6)
    have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hB4.le hBN 5
    have h1 : 1 ≤ Real.log M/Real.log N := (one_le_div hlogN).mpr hlogNM
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (B N)^5/(B 4)^5 := (one_le_div (pow_pos hB4 5)).mpr hpow
    have h3 : 1 ≤ (M:ℝ)^(1/6:ℝ)/(Real.log S)^(1/6:ℝ) :=
      (one_le_div (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlogS _)).mpr hr
    have hprod : 1 ≤ (Real.log M/Real.log N)*((B N)^5/(B 4)^5)*
        ((M:ℝ)^(1/6:ℝ)/(Real.log S)^(1/6:ℝ)) := by
      exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le h1 h2) h3
    have he : C*N/Real.log N*(B N)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) =
        (2*N)*((Real.log M/Real.log N)*((B N)^5/(B 4)^5)*
          ((M:ℝ)^(1/6:ℝ)/(Real.log S)^(1/6:ℝ))) := by
      rw [show (-1/6:ℝ)=-(1/6:ℝ) by norm_num,Real.rpow_neg hlogS.le]
      dsimp [C]
      ring
    rw [he]
    exact (nonnormal_card_le_twice S N (by omega)).trans
      (by have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2*N by positivity); simpa using hh)

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Renew.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.regular_weighted_sum_eq_gamma
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Renew.text:
lemma regular_weighted_sum_eq_gamma :
    (∑' n : ℕ, renewalRegular n*rho^n)=gamma := by
  have hL : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖renewalTail n*rho^n‖) := by
    convert renewalTail_weighted_sum.1 using 1
    ext n
    exact Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (renewalTail_nonneg n) (pow_pos rho_pos n).le)
  have ht := tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_range_of_summable_norm hL summable_norm_regular_weighted
  have he (n : ℕ) : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
      (renewalTail j*rho^j)*(renewalRegular (n-j)*rho^(n-j)))=
      if n=0 then 1 else 0 := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n+1), renewalTail j*renewalRegular (n-j))*rho^n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hjn : j≤n := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega
        have hp : rho^j*rho^(n-j)=rho^n := by rw [← pow_add,Nat.add_sub_of_le hjn]
        calc
          _ = (renewalTail j*renewalRegular (n-j))*(rho^j*rho^(n-j)) := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [hp]
      _ = _ := by rw [renewalTail_regular_convolution]; split_ifs with hn <;> simp [hn]
  simp only [he] at ht
  rw [renewalTail_weighted_sum.2] at ht
  have hs : (∑' n : ℕ, if n=0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)=1 := by simp
  rw [hs] at ht
  have hmul := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => gamma*x) ht
  simpa only [← mul_assoc,mul_inv_cancel₀ gamma_pos.ne',one_mul,mul_one] using hmul

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prime.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.fordUnitPrimeBoxInput
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prime.text:
theorem fordUnitPrimeBoxInput : FordUnitPrimeBoxInput := by
  obtain ⟨D,hD,hbound⟩ := primeReciprocalLT_mertens
  refine ⟨D*(1+Real.exp 1)+2*Real.exp 1,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro m hm
  let a := Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ)-1))
  let b := Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ))
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have ha : 2≤a := by
    have hh : Real.exp 1≤a := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.one_le_exp (by linarith))
    linarith [Real.exp_one_gt_d9]
  have hab : a≤b := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  have hb : 2≤b := ha.trans hab
  have ha0 : 0<a := by linarith
  have hla : Real.log a=Real.exp ((m : ℝ)-1) := Real.log_exp _
  have hlb : Real.log b=Real.exp (m : ℝ) := Real.log_exp _
  have hlla : Real.log (Real.log a)=(m : ℝ)-1 := by rw [hla,Real.log_exp]
  have hllb : Real.log (Real.log b)=(m : ℝ) := by rw [hlb,Real.log_exp]
  have hmass : |primeReciprocalLT b-primeReciprocalLT a-1| ≤
      D/Real.log b+D/Real.log a := by
    calc
      _ = |(primeReciprocalLT b-Real.log (Real.log b)-Mertens.M)-
          (primeReciprocalLT a-Real.log (Real.log a)-Mertens.M)| := by
        rw [hlla,hllb]
        congr 1
        ring
      _ ≤ |primeReciprocalLT b-Real.log (Real.log b)-Mertens.M|+
          |primeReciprocalLT a-Real.log (Real.log a)-Mertens.M| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (hbound b hb) (hbound a ha)
  have he : |unitPrimeWeight m-(primeReciprocalLT b-primeReciprocalLT a)|≤2/a := by
    rw [← unitPrimeBox_reciprocal]
    exact shifted_reciprocal_error (unitPrimeBox m) ha
      (fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.2.1)
  have hsmall : 2/a≤2/Real.log a := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos (by linarith))
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos ha0]
  have htotal : |unitPrimeWeight m-1|≤D/Real.log b+(D+2)/Real.log a := by
    calc
      _ ≤ |unitPrimeWeight m-(primeReciprocalLT b-primeReciprocalLT a)|+
          |(primeReciprocalLT b-primeReciprocalLT a)-1| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
      _ ≤ 2/a+(D/Real.log b+D/Real.log a) := add_le_add he hmass
      _ ≤ 2/Real.log a+(D/Real.log b+D/Real.log a) := add_le_add hsmall le_rfl
      _ = _ := by ring
  have heq : D/Real.log b+(D+2)/Real.log a=
      (D*(1+Real.exp 1)+2*Real.exp 1)*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hla,hlb]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,← Real.exp_neg]
    rw [show -((m : ℝ)-1)=1+ -(m : ℝ) by ring,Real.exp_add]
    ring
  exact heq ▸ htotal

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.normality_small_parameter
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.text:
theorem normality_small_parameter : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ S : ℝ, 2 < S → ∀ n : ℕ, 3 < n → Real.log S ≤ (B n)^30 →
      ((nonNormalPrimes S n).card : ℝ) ≤
        C*n/Real.log n*(B n)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := prime_count_global_upper
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro S hS n hn hsmall
  have hcount : ((nonNormalPrimes S n).card:ℝ) ≤ Nat.primeCounting n := by
    have hh := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset (fun p => ¬IsNormalPrime S p) (Nat.primesLE n))
    rw [Nat.primesLE_card_eq_primeCounting] at hh
    exact_mod_cast hh
  apply hcount.trans ((hbound n hn).trans _)
  have hf := normality_small_parameter_factor hS hn hsmall
  have hbase : 0 ≤ C*n/Real.log n := by
    apply div_nonneg (by positivity)
    exact (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < n by omega))).le
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf hbase
  simpa only [mul_one,mul_assoc] using hh

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.conditional_companion_one_two_of_structure
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.text:
theorem conditional_companion_one_two_of_structure (hscale : FordScaleBounds)
    (hstruct : ExtractedStructureInput) (hpnt : PrimeNumberTheoremInput)
    (hbox : FordUnitPrimeBoxInput) (hren : FordRenewalInput) (hmertens : MertensProductInput)
    (h26 : FordLemma26Input) (h51 : FordLemma51Input) (hconc : FordCoordinateConcentrationInput)
    (hppt : ∀ d : ℕ, IsTotient d → PPTBoundedFiberPropagation d)
    (hseed : IsTotient (2^18*257)) (hmin : ell (2^18*257)=135268352) :
    ∀ k∈({1,2} : Finset ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧
      ∀ s∈Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, c≤A (fk k) s := by
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hkd⟩ := companion_seeds_one_two hseed hmin k hk

  obtain ⟨c,C,hc,_,hA,_,_⟩ := conditional_companion_positive_of_structure hscale hstruct hpnt
    hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hconc hk1 hd hkd (hppt d hd)

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Fiber.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.full_fiber_scale_family
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Fiber.text:
theorem full_fiber_scale_family (d : ℕ) (hd : IsTotient d) :
    ∃ a K : ℝ,0 < a ∧ 0 < K ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      0 < x ∧ ∃ S : Finset ℕ,a*(x/Real.log x)*G x (m x) ≤ (S.card:ℝ) ∧
        ∀ b∈S,0 < b ∧ ((d*b.totient:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ x ∧
          FullFiber d b ∧ (b:ℝ)/b.totient ≤ K := by
  obtain ⟨q,hqpos,hq⟩ := hd
  have hdpos : 0 < d := hq ▸ Nat.totient_pos.mpr hqpos
  obtain ⟨c,δ,L,hc,hδ,_hL,habundance⟩ := local_normal_candidate_abundance
  apply full_fiber_scale_of_local_count hc hδ d hdpos L
  apply local_full_candidate_count hc hδ d q hdpos hqpos hq L
    (habundance d hdpos) _ (local_suffix_regular_bound hc d hdpos L)
  filter_upwards [ppt_original_regular_count hc d hdpos L] with H hH
  filter_upwards [hH] with x hx
  intro F
  dsimp only
  intro _hinj hF
  exact hx F hF

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordB.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.ford_scale_bounds
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordB.text:
lemma ford_scale_bounds {b D r : ℕ} {y S : ℝ} {Y U : ℕ → ℝ}
    (h : FordComparisonParameters b y S D r Y U) : 1 < S ∧ 1 ≤ B S := by
  have hS := h.2.2.1
  have hS1 : 1 < S := (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (Real.exp_pos 1)).trans_le hS
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos (Real.exp 1)) hS
  rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog
  have hB := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hlog
  rw [Real.log_exp] at hB
  exact ⟨hS1,hB⟩

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Conce.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.fordCoordinateConcentrationInput
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Conce.text:
theorem fordCoordinateConcentrationInput : FordCoordinateConcentrationInput := by
  obtain ⟨C,c,hC,hc,hprefix⟩ := prefix_coordinate_concentration_unconditional
  have ha : 0 < a 1 := a_pos le_rfl
  refine ⟨C/a 1,c,0,div_pos hC ha,hc,?_⟩
  intro N _ B hB i hi
  have hfin := prefixRegion_volume_ne_top (by omega : 0 < N+2) B
  have hfordfin : volume (fordSimplex N B) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top hfin (measure_mono (fun _ hu => hu.1))
  have hbadfin : volume (prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0 ∩ fordCoordinateBad N B i) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top hfin (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left)
  have hmono : (volume (fordSimplex N B ∩ fordCoordinateBad N B i)).toReal ≤
      (volume (prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0 ∩ fordCoordinateBad N B i)).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono hbadfin (measure_mono (fun _ hu => ⟨hu.1.1,hu.2⟩))
  have hvol := shrinkLast_volume_bound (prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0) Set.univ
    MeasurableSet.univ (fun _ hu => hu) (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  simp only [Set.inter_univ] at hvol
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono
    (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hfordfin) hvol
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (inv_pos.mpr ha).le] at hreal
  calc
    _ ≤ (volume (prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0 ∩ fordCoordinateBad N B i)).toReal := hmono
    _ ≤ C*Real.exp (-c*(N+2-(i.val+1):ℕ))*(volume (prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0)).toReal :=
      hprefix N B hB i hi
    _ ≤ C*Real.exp (-c*(N+2-(i.val+1):ℕ))*((a 1)⁻¹*(volume (fordSimplex N B)).toReal) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

end TotientAsymptotic

end

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.TailB.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.AH_nonneg
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.TailB.text:
theorem AH_nonneg (H : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ r : ℝ, 1 ≤ r → 0 ≤ f r ∧ f r ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ AH H f s := by
  classical
  unfold AH
  apply mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg rho_pos.le _)
    (pow_nonneg (div_pos gamma_pos (alpha_pos s)).le _))
  apply finsum_nonneg
  intro d
  split_ifs with hd
  · apply mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (hf _ (one_le_ell_ratio hd)).1 (Nat.cast_nonneg d))
    rw [coefficient_eq_union_probability H hs d]
    exact measureReal_nonneg
  · exact le_rfl

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Cofac.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.primeEulerProduct

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Compa.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.ford_comparison_threshold
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Compa.text:
lemma ford_comparison_threshold (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ y₀ : ℝ,1 < y₀ ∧ ∀ y : ℝ,y₀ ≤ y →
      Real.exp 2 ≤ y ∧ 1 ≤ B y ∧
      ∀ S : ℝ,1 ≤ B S → R ≤ Real.sqrt (B S*B y) := by
  let y₀ := Real.exp (Real.exp (R^2+2))
  have he : 2 ≤ Real.exp (R^2+2) := by nlinarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (R^2+2),sq_nonneg R]
  have hbase : Real.exp 2 ≤ y₀ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr he
  have hy₀ : 1 < y₀ := (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)).trans_le hbase
  refine ⟨y₀,hy₀,?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hB : R^2+2 ≤ B y := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hy₀) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hy)
    simpa only [y₀,B,Real.log_exp] using hh
  refine ⟨hbase.trans hy,by nlinarith [sq_nonneg R],?_⟩
  intro S hS
  have hBy : 0 ≤ B y := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg R]
  apply (Real.le_sqrt hR.le (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hBy)).mpr
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS (show 0 ≤ B y by nlinarith [sq_nonneg R])]

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Local.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.ppt_bounded_fiber_of_scale_family
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Local.text:
theorem ppt_bounded_fiber_of_scale_family (d : ℕ)
    (hfamily : ∃ a K : ℝ,0<a ∧ 0<K ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      0<x ∧ ∃ S : Finset ℕ,a*(x/Real.log x)*G x (m x) ≤ (S.card:ℝ) ∧
        ∀ b∈S,0<b ∧ ((d*b.totient:ℕ):ℝ)≤x ∧
          FullFiber d b ∧ (b:ℝ)/b.totient≤K) :
    PPTBoundedFiberPropagation d := by
  obtain ⟨a,K,ha,hK,hfamily⟩ := hfamily
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hupper⟩ := ford_scale_upper
  refine ⟨a/C,K,div_pos ha hC,hK,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hfamily,hupper] with x hx hupper
  obtain ⟨hx,S,hcard,hS⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨hx,S,?_,hS⟩
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hupper (div_pos ha hC).le
  apply le_trans _ hcard
  convert hh using 1
  field_simp

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.scale_eventually_pos

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordC.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.ford_comparison_budget
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordC.text:
lemma ford_comparison_budget {b D r : ℕ} {y S A M C K : ℝ} {Y U : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hp : FordComparisonParameters b y S D r Y U)
    (hy : 1 < y) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hAK : 216*A ≤ K) (hMK : M ≤ K) (hCK : C ≤ K) :
    ((216*A)*(y/(D*r:ℕ))*(B y)^5/(Real.log y)^2/Real.log (Y 1))*
      (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,fordBandCost C k y S Y U)*
      (M*(b+1:ℝ)^D.primeFactorsList.length*
        (Real.log (Y b))^(20*(b:ℝ)*Real.log b+1)) ≤
    fordComparisonBound K b y S D r Y U := by
  classical
  let P := ∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,C*(k:ℝ)^2*(B y)^2
  let Q := ∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,Real.exp (fordBandCap k y S Y*(Real.log k+1))/
    (Real.log (U (k-1)))^2
  let Z := (Real.log (Y b))^(20*(b:ℝ)*Real.log b+1)
  have hBy : 1 ≤ B y := by simpa only [hp.2.1] using ford_cutoff_B_one_le hp (k:=0) (by omega)
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy
  have hY : 1 < Y 1 := by linarith [ford_cutoff_two_le hp hp.1]
  have hU (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (b-1)) : 1 < U j := by
    have hjb : j < b := by obtain ⟨_,_⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj; omega
    have hh := hp.2.2.2.2.1 j (Finset.mem_range.mpr hjb)
    linarith [ford_cutoff_two_le hp (show j+1 ≤ b by omega)]
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y 1) := Real.log_pos hY
  have hlogYb : 0 < Real.log (Y b) := Real.log_pos (by linarith [ford_cutoff_two_le hp (k:=b) le_rfl])
  have hQ : 0 ≤ (Real.log (Y 1))⁻¹*Q := by dsimp [Q]; positivity
  have hPbound : (216*A)*M*(B y)^5*P ≤ (K*B y)^(6*b) := by
    have hmono : P ≤ ∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,K*(k:ℝ)^2*(B y)^2 := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod₀
      · intro k _; positivity
      · intro k _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCK (sq_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (by positivity)).trans
      (ford_polynomial_budget hp.1 hBy (ford_band_count_le hp) hK hA hM hAK hMK (by linarith))
  have hQbound := ford_logarithmic_product_bound (y:=y) (S:=S) Y U hp.1 hy (by linarith)
    (by linarith [(ford_scale_bounds hp).2])
    (by linarith [ford_cutoff_B_one_le hp (k:=b) le_rfl]) hY hU
  have hprod : (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,fordBandCost C k y S Y U)=P*Q := by
    simp_rw [ford_band_cost_split]
    exact Finset.prod_mul_distrib
  have hinv : (Real.log y)^(-2:ℝ)=((Real.log y)^2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hlog.le]
    norm_num only [Real.rpow_ofNat]
  have heq :
      ((216*A)*(y/(D*r:ℕ))*(B y)^5/(Real.log y)^2/Real.log (Y 1))*
        (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,fordBandCost C k y S Y U)*
        (M*(b+1:ℝ)^D.primeFactorsList.length*Z)=
      (y/(D*r:ℕ))*((216*A)*M*(B y)^5*P)*
        (b+1:ℝ)^D.primeFactorsList.length*Z*(Real.log y)^(-2:ℝ)*
        ((Real.log (Y 1))⁻¹*Q) := by
    rw [hprod,hinv]
    ring
  change _ ≤ _ at hQbound
  rw [heq]
  have hout : 0 ≤ (y/(D*r:ℕ))*(b+1:ℝ)^D.primeFactorsList.length*Z*(Real.log y)^(-2:ℝ) := by
    dsimp [Z]; positivity
  have hh := mul_le_mul hPbound hQbound hQ (by positivity : 0 ≤ (K*B y)^(6*b))
  have hh' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh hout
  convert hh' using 1
  · ring
  · unfold fordComparisonBound
    have hpowe : (Real.log y)^(-2+(∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (b-1),a j*(B (Y j)/B y))+
        comparisonError b y S Y U)=
        (Real.log y)^(-2:ℝ)*(Real.log y)^((∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (b-1),a j*(B (Y j)/B y))+
          comparisonError b y S Y U) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hlog]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hpowe]
    push_cast
    dsimp [Z]
    ring

      (p : ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)))

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prefi.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.prefix_coordinate_concentration_unconditional
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prefi.text:
theorem prefix_coordinate_concentration_unconditional :
    ∃ C c : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < c ∧
    ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ B : ℝ, 0 < B → ∀ i : Fin (N+2), i.val < N →
      (volume (prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0 ∩ fordCoordinateBad N B i)).toReal ≤
        C*Real.exp (-c*(N+2-(i.val+1) : ℕ))*(volume (prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0)).toReal := by
  obtain ⟨M,K,hM,hK,hweights⟩ := prefixWeight_bounds
  let s := concentrationTilt M
  refine ⟨2*Real.exp (3*s*(K+1)),s/100,by positivity,
    div_pos (concentrationTilt_pos hM) (by norm_num),?_⟩
  intro N B hB i hi
  obtain ⟨hw,hS,hQ⟩ := hweights (N+2) i
  have hm : 2 ≤ N+2-i.val := by omega
  have hmN : N+2-i.val ≤ N+2 := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have hc := volume_simplex_fixed_deviation M K hM hK.le (N+2) (N+2-i.val) hm hmN B hB
    (prefixWeight (N+2) i) hw hS hQ
  have he : N+2-i.val-1 = N+2-(i.val+1) := by omega
  rw [he] at hc
  rw [prefixSimplexMap_bad_preimage]
  apply prefixSimplexMap_transfer
  · apply (measurableSet_standardSimplex _ _).inter
    apply measurableSet_lt measurable_const
    fun_prop
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hc

end TotientAsymptotic

end

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.conditional_companion_positive_of_structure
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.text:
theorem conditional_companion_positive_of_structure (hscale : FordScaleBounds)
    (hstruct : ExtractedStructureInput) (hpnt : PrimeNumberTheoremInput)
    (hbox : FordUnitPrimeBoxInput) (hren : FordRenewalInput) (hmertens : MertensProductInput)
    (h26 : FordLemma26Input) (h51 : FordLemma51Input) (hconc : FordCoordinateConcentrationInput)
    {d k : ℕ} (hk : 1≤k) (hd : IsTotient d) (hseed : k*d<ell d)
    (hppt : PPTBoundedFiberPropagation d) :
    ∃ cMinus cPlus : ℝ, 0<cMinus ∧ 0<cPlus ∧
      (∀ s∈Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, cMinus≤A (fk k) s ∧ A (fk k) s≤cPlus) ∧
      Tendsto (fun x => N k x/(tupleNormalization x*A (fk k) (theta x))) atTop (nhds 1) ∧
      ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, (cMinus/cPlus)*V x≤N k x ∧ N k x≤V x := by
  have herr := (conditional_companion_additive hscale hstruct hpnt hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hconc k hk).2
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hlower⟩ := companion_positive_bound hscale hstruct hpnt hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hk hd hseed hppt
  obtain ⟨c₀,c₁,_,hscale⟩ := hscale
  let C := |c₁|+1
  have hC : 0<C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hupper : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, normalizedCount (N k) x≤C := by
    filter_upwards [hscale,scale_eventually_pos] with x hs hN
    exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (N_le_V k x) hN.le).trans
      (hs.2.trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith [le_abs_self c₁]))
  have hA := coefficient_bounds_of_comparison (fk k) (normalizedCount (N k)) herr c C (hlower.and hupper)
  refine ⟨c,C,hc,hC,hA,?_,?_⟩
  · exact ratio_limit_of_normalized_error (N k) (fk k) c hc (fun s hs => (hA s hs).1) herr
  · filter_upwards [hlower,hscale,scale_eventually_pos] with x hl hs hN
    have hN' : c*tupleNormalization x≤N k x := (le_div_iff₀ hN).mp hl
    have hV : V x≤C*tupleNormalization x := (div_le_iff₀ hN).mp
      (hs.2.trans (by dsimp [C]; linarith [le_abs_self c₁]))
    refine ⟨?_,N_le_V k x⟩
    calc
      (c/C)*V x ≤ (c/C)*(C*tupleNormalization x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV (div_pos hc hC).le
      _ = c*tupleNormalization x := by field_simp
      _ ≤ N k x := hN'

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prime.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.prime_counting_ratio_tendsto
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prime.text:
lemma prime_counting_ratio_tendsto :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ)/(x/Real.log x)) atTop (nhds 1) := by
  have hi := Chebyshev.integral_theta_div_log_sq_isLittleO.tendsto_div_nhds_zero
  have ht := theta_real_ratio_tendsto.add hi
  simp only [add_zero] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (2 : ℝ)] with x hx
  rw [Chebyshev.primeCounting_eq_theta_div_log_add_integral hx.le]
  have hx0 : x≠0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith : (0 : ℝ)<x)
  have hl : Real.log x≠0 := (Real.log_pos (by linarith : (1 : ℝ)<x)).ne'
  field_simp

  · exact (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using hu)

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Merte.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.prime_log_mass_le
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Merte.text:
lemma prime_log_mass_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 N).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log p/(p : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.log 4*(2+Real.log N) := by
  classical
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n.Prime then Real.log n else 0
  have he (n : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), a i)=Chebyshev.theta n := by
    rw [Chebyshev.theta_eq_sum_Icc,Nat.floor_natCast,← Nat.range_succ_eq_Icc_zero,
      Finset.sum_filter]

  have hA (n : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), a i) ≤ Real.log 4*(n+1) := by
    rw [he]
    have hh := Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    have hc : 0 ≤ Real.log 4 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  have hb := weighted_sum_le_harmonic a (Real.log 4) (by simp [a]) hA N
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N+1), a i/(i : ℝ))=
      ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 N).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log p/(p : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.range_succ_eq_Icc_zero,Finset.sum_filter]
    simp only [a,ite_div,zero_div]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_subset (fun p hp => by
      have hh := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hp
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega,hh.2⟩)
    · intro p hp hnot
      have hp2 : p<2 := by
        have hh := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc,not_and_or,not_le] at hnot
        omega
      have hprime : ¬p.Prime := fun hh => (not_le_of_gt hp2) hh.two_le
      simp [hprime]
  rw [hsum] at hb
  have ht := (div_le_iff₀ (show (0 : ℝ)<N+1 by positivity)).mpr (hA N)
  have hh := harmonic_le_one_add_log N
  have hc : 0 ≤ Real.log 4 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh hc
  nlinarith

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Compa.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.companion_zero_case
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Compa.text:

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.normality_middle_parameter
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.text:
theorem normality_middle_parameter : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ S : ℝ,
    2 < S → 4 ≤ B S → ∀ N : ℕ, Real.exp 2 ≤ N → 1 ≤ B N →
    1 ≤ Real.log N/(200*B N) → Real.log S ≤ (Real.log N)^6 →
    ((nonNormalPrimes S N).card:ℝ) ≤
      C*N/Real.log N*(B N)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hlarge⟩ := normality_large_factor_count
  obtain ⟨D,hD,hsmall⟩ := normality_complement_count
  refine ⟨C+D,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro S hS hBS N hN hB hL hupper
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log N := by
    have hn0 := (Real.exp_pos 2).trans_le hN
    have hh := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hn0).mpr hN
    linarith
  have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (normality_middle_scale (by linarith : 1 < S) hB hlog hupper) hD.le
  have hs : ((normalitySmallFactorPrimes S N).card:ℝ) ≤
      D*N/Real.log N*(B N)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ D*N/(Real.log N)^2 := hsmall S N hN hB hL
      _ = D*(N/(Real.log N)^2) := by ring
      _ ≤ D*(N/Real.log N*(B N)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ)) := hscale
      _ = _ := by ring
  have he : ((nonNormalPrimes S N).card:ℝ) =
      ((normalityLargeFactorPrimes S N).card:ℝ)+((normalitySmallFactorPrimes S N).card:ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast nonNormalPrimes_card_split S N
  rw [he]
  have hl := hlarge S hS hBS N hN hB hL
  calc
    _ ≤ C*N/Real.log N*(B N)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ)+
        D*N/Real.log N*(B N)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) := add_le_add hl hs
    _ = _ := by ring

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.conditional_totient_scaling_of_structure
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.text:
theorem conditional_totient_scaling_of_structure (hscale : FordScaleBounds)
    (hstruct : ExtractedStructureInput) (hpnt : PrimeNumberTheoremInput)
    (hbox : FordUnitPrimeBoxInput) (hren : FordRenewalInput) (hmertens : MertensProductInput)
    (h26 : FordLemma26Input) (h51 : FordLemma51Input) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun x => V (c*x)/V x) atTop (nhds c) := by
  by_cases hc1 : 1 ≤ c
  · exact scaling_of_internal_comparison hc hscale
      (common_endpoint_comparison hscale hstruct hpnt hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hc1)
  · have hi : 1 ≤ 1/c := (one_le_div hc).mpr (le_of_not_ge hc1)
    have ht := inverse_scaling_of_internal_comparison (one_div_pos.mpr hc) hscale
      (common_endpoint_comparison hscale hstruct hpnt hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hi)
    simpa [div_div, mul_comm] using ht

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.SeedM.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.seed_least_preimage

    rw [Nat.totient_mul (by norm_num : Nat.Coprime (2^11) (257^2)),

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prime.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.unitPrimeBox_reciprocal
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prime.text:
lemma unitPrimeBox_reciprocal (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ unitPrimeBox m, (p : ℝ)⁻¹)=
      primeReciprocalLT (Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)))-
      primeReciprocalLT (Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ)-1))) := by
  classical
  let a := Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ)-1))
  let b := Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ))
  have ha : 0<a := Real.exp_pos _
  have hb : 0<b := Real.exp_pos _
  have hab : a≤b := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  have hsub : primesBelow a⊆primesBelow b := by
    intro p hp
    have hh := (mem_primesBelow ha.le).mp hp
    exact (mem_primesBelow hb.le).mpr ⟨hh.1,hh.2.trans_le hab⟩
  have hset : unitPrimeBox m=primesBelow b\primesBelow a := by
    ext p
    simp only [unitPrimeBox,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_Icc,Finset.mem_sdiff,
      mem_primesBelow ha.le,mem_primesBelow hb.le]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨_,_⟩,hp,hal,hbl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hp,hbl⟩,fun hh => (not_lt_of_ge hal) hh.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hp,hpb⟩,hpa⟩
      have hpa' : a≤(p : ℝ) := le_of_not_gt (fun hh => hpa ⟨hp,hh⟩)
      refine ⟨⟨hp.two_le,?_⟩,hp,hpa',hpb⟩
      apply (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).mp
      exact hpb.le.trans (Nat.le_ceil b)
  rw [hset,Finset.sum_sdiff_eq_sub hsub]
  rfl

end TotientAsymptotic

end

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordS.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.ford_scale_upper
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordS.text:
theorem ford_scale_upper : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, V x ≤ C*(x/Real.log x)*G x (m x) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hsmall⟩ := small_head_real_gaussian
  obtain ⟨D,hD,hbad⟩ := ford_structure_value_count
  obtain ⟨E,hE,hgood⟩ := ford_simplex_good_value_count
  refine ⟨A+D+E,by positivity,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hsmall,hbad,hgood,eventually_ge_atTop (0:ℝ),
    m_tendsto.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop 0)] with x hs hb hg hx hm
  let Q := (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter IsTotient
  let U := Q.filter (fun v => (fordPrime (ell v) 0:ℝ) < x^(1/4:ℝ))
  let W := Q.filter (fun v => ¬fordSimplexCondition x 0 (ell v))
  let T := Q.filter (fun v => x^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ fordPrime (ell v) 0 ∧
    fordSimplexCondition x 0 (ell v))
  have hmem (v) (hv : v ∈ Q) : IsTotient v ∧ (v:ℝ) ≤ x := by
    obtain ⟨hv,ht⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
    exact ⟨ht,(Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hv).2).trans (Nat.floor_le hx)⟩
  have hU := hs 0 (by omega) U (by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hv,hhead⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
    obtain ⟨ht,hvx⟩ := hmem v hv
    exact ⟨ht,hvx,ell v,(ell_spec ht).1,(ell_spec ht).2,hhead⟩)
  have hW := hb 0 hm W ell (by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hv,hfail⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
    obtain ⟨ht,hvx⟩ := hmem v hv
    exact ⟨(ell_spec ht).1,(ell_spec ht).2,hvx,hfail⟩)
  have hT := hg T ell (by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hv,hhead,hsimplex⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
    obtain ⟨ht,hvx⟩ := hmem v hv
    exact ⟨(ell_spec ht).1,(ell_spec ht).2,hhead,hvx,hsimplex⟩)
  have hcover : Q ⊆ U ∪ W ∪ T := by
    intro v hv
    by_cases hu : (fordPrime (ell v) 0:ℝ) < x^(1/4:ℝ)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv,hu⟩))
    by_cases hw : fordSimplexCondition x 0 (ell v)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv,le_of_not_gt hu,hw⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv,hw⟩))
  have hc : (Q.card:ℝ) ≤ (U.card:ℝ)+W.card+T.card := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card hcover).trans
      ((Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans
        (Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_union_le _ _) _))
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : 2≠0),neg_zero,
    zero_div,Real.exp_zero,mul_one] at hU hW
  change (Q.card:ℝ) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (U.card:ℝ)+W.card+T.card := hc
    _ ≤ A*(x/Real.log x)*G x (m x)+D*(x/Real.log x)*G x (m x)+
        E*(x/Real.log x)*G x (m x) := add_le_add (add_le_add hU hW) hT
    _ = _ := by ring

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Renew.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.gamma_pos
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Renew.text:
lemma gamma_pos : 0 < gamma := by
  apply inv_pos.mpr
  apply summable_moment.tsum_pos (i := 0)
  · intro n
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (a_pos (by omega)).le)
      (pow_nonneg rho_pos.le _)
  · simpa using mul_pos (a_pos (j := 1) le_rfl) rho_pos

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.conditional_main_theorem_of_structure
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.text:
theorem conditional_main_theorem_of_structure (hscale : FordScaleBounds)
    (hstruct : ExtractedStructureInput) (hpnt : PrimeNumberTheoremInput)
    (hbox : FordUnitPrimeBoxInput) (hren : FordRenewalInput) (hmertens : MertensProductInput)
    (h26 : FordLemma26Input) (h51 : FordLemma51Input) (hconc : FordCoordinateConcentrationInput) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun H => AH H (fun _ => 1)) (A (fun _ => 1))
      atTop (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    (∃ cMinus cPlus : ℝ, 0 < cMinus ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1,
      cMinus ≤ A (fun _ => 1) s ∧ A (fun _ => 1) s ≤ cPlus) ∧
    Tendsto (fun x => V x/mainTerm x) atTop (nhds 1) ∧
    ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → Tendsto (fun x => V (c*x)/V x) atTop (nhds c) := by
  obtain ⟨hu,hb,ha⟩ := conditional_totient_asymptotic_of_structure hscale hstruct hpnt hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hconc
  exact ⟨hu,hb,ha,fun _ hc => conditional_totient_scaling_of_structure hscale hstruct hpnt hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hc⟩

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.normality_threshold_conditions
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.text:
lemma normality_threshold_conditions {N : ℕ} (hN : 3 < N) (hB : 400 ≤ B N) :
    Real.exp 2 ≤ (N:ℝ) ∧ 1 ≤ B N ∧ 1 ≤ Real.log N/(200*B N) := by
  have hN0 : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log N := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega))
  have hquad := Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ B N by linarith)
  rw [show Real.exp (B N)=Real.log N from Real.exp_log hlog] at hquad
  have hlogbig : 200*B N ≤ Real.log N := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ B N by linarith) (show 0 ≤ B N-400 by linarith)]
  refine ⟨(Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hN0).mp (by nlinarith),by linarith,?_⟩
  exact (one_le_div (show 0 < 200*B N by positivity)).mpr hlogbig

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.TailB.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.coefficient_eq_union_probability
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.TailB.text:
lemma coefficient_eq_union_probability (H : ℕ) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) (d : ℕ) :
    (∑ᶠ T : Finset (TailDatum H),
      if T.Nonempty ∧ (↑T : Set (TailDatum H)) ⊆ witnesses H s d then
        (-1 : ℝ)^(T.card-1) * Real.exp (-(gamma / alpha s) *
          ∑' n : ℕ, rho^(H+n) * maxD (H+n) T)
      else 0) =
    exponentialProduct.real (⋃ η ∈ (witnesses_finite H hs d).toFinset, witnessEvent s η) := by
  classical
  let W := (witnesses_finite H hs d).toFinset
  have hW (T : Finset (TailDatum H)) :
      (↑T : Set (TailDatum H)) ⊆ witnesses H s d ↔ T ⊆ W := by
    constructor
    · intro h η hη
      exact ((witnesses_finite H hs d).mem_toFinset).mpr (h hη)
    · intro h η hη
      exact ((witnesses_finite H hs d).mem_toFinset).mp (h hη)
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := W.powerset.filter Finset.Nonempty)]
  · rw [measureReal_biUnion_eq_sum_powerset (fun η _ => measurableSet_witnessEvent s η)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨hTW, ht⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hT
    have hsub : (↑T : Set (TailDatum H)) ⊆ witnesses H s d :=
      (hW T).mpr (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hTW)
    rw [ite_eq_left ⟨ht, hsub⟩, witnessEvent_intersection_probability T ht
      (fun η hη => (hsub hη).1)]
    congr 1
    have hc : T.card + 1 = T.card - 1 + 2 := by
      have := Finset.card_pos.mpr ht
      omega
    rw [hc, pow_add]
    norm_num
  · intro T hT
    have ht : T.Nonempty ∧ (↑T : Set (TailDatum H)) ⊆ witnesses H s d := by
      by_contra h
      simp only [Function.mem_support, ite_eq_right h, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false] at hT
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr ((hW T).mp ht.2), ht.1⟩

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Renew.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.regular_tail_bound
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Renew.text:
private lemma regular_tail_bound (n : ℕ) :
    |∑' k : ℕ, renewalRegular (k+n+1)*rho^(k+1)|≤4*rho/(1-rho) := by
  have hg : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => 4*rho^(k+1)) (4*rho/(1-rho)) := by
    convert (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one rho_pos.le rho_lt_one).mul_left (4*rho) using 1
    · ext k
      rw [pow_succ]
      ring
    · rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hb (k : ℕ) : ‖renewalRegular (k+n+1)*rho^(k+1)‖≤4*rho^(k+1) := by
    rw [norm_mul,Real.norm_eq_abs (rho^(k+1)),abs_of_pos (pow_pos rho_pos _),Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (renewalRegular_bound _) (pow_pos rho_pos _).le
  have hs : Summable (fun k : ℕ => ‖renewalRegular (k+n+1)*rho^(k+1)‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hb hg.summable
  calc
    _ = ‖∑' k : ℕ, renewalRegular (k+n+1)*rho^(k+1)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑' k : ℕ, ‖renewalRegular (k+n+1)*rho^(k+1)‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hs
    _ ≤ ∑' k : ℕ, 4*rho^(k+1) := hs.tsum_le_tsum hb hg.summable
    _ = _ := hg.tsum_eq

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prime.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.shifted_reciprocal_error
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Prime.text:
lemma shifted_reciprocal_error (S : Finset ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 2≤a)
    (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, a≤(p : ℝ)) :
    |(∑ p ∈ S, (p-1 : ℝ)⁻¹)-(∑ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ)⁻¹)| ≤ 2/a := by
  classical
  by_cases hne : S.Nonempty
  · let L := ⌈a⌉₊
    let M := S.sup id
    have hLa : a≤(L : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil a
    have hL : 2≤L := by exact_mod_cast (ha.trans hLa)
    have hsub : S⊆Finset.Icc L M := by
      intro p hp
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨(Nat.ceil_le).mpr (hS p hp),Finset.le_sup (f := id) hp⟩
    have hLM : L≤M := by
      obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := hne
      exact (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hsub hp)).1.trans (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hsub hp)).2
    have hn (n : ℕ) (hn : n∈Finset.Icc L M) : (1 : ℝ)<n := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 1<n by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1; omega)
    have ht : (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc L M, (((n : ℝ)-1)⁻¹-(n : ℝ)⁻¹))=
        ((L : ℝ)-1)⁻¹-(M : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      have hh := Finset.sum_Icc_sub hLM (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ)-1)⁻¹)
      simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,add_sub_cancel_right] at hh
      simpa only [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib,neg_sub] using congrArg Neg.neg hh
    have hnon (n : ℕ) (hn' : n∈Finset.Icc L M) :
        0≤((n : ℝ)-1)⁻¹-(n : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      apply sub_nonneg.mpr
      exact inv_anti₀ (by linarith [hn n hn']) (by linarith)
    have hnonS : 0≤∑ p ∈ S, (((p : ℝ)-1)⁻¹-(p : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun p hp => hnon p (hsub hp))
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,abs_of_nonneg hnonS]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc L M, (((n : ℝ)-1)⁻¹-(n : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun n hn _ => hnon n hn)
      _ = ((L : ℝ)-1)⁻¹-(M : ℝ)⁻¹ := ht
      _ ≤ ((L : ℝ)-1)⁻¹ := sub_le_self _ (by positivity)
      _ ≤ 2/a := by
        rw [inv_eq_one_div]
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ)<L-1) (by linarith : 0<a)).mpr
        nlinarith
  · simp only [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne,Finset.sum_empty,sub_self,abs_zero]
    positivity

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.conditional_totient_asymptotic_of_structure
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Condi.text:
theorem conditional_totient_asymptotic_of_structure (hscale : FordScaleBounds)
    (hstruct : ExtractedStructureInput) (hpnt : PrimeNumberTheoremInput)
    (hbox : FordUnitPrimeBoxInput) (hren : FordRenewalInput) (hmertens : MertensProductInput)
    (h26 : FordLemma26Input) (h51 : FordLemma51Input) (hconc : FordCoordinateConcentrationInput) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun H => AH H (fun _ => 1)) (A (fun _ => 1))
      atTop (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    (∃ cMinus cPlus : ℝ, 0<cMinus ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1,
      cMinus ≤ A (fun _ => 1) s ∧ A (fun _ => 1) s ≤ cPlus) ∧
    Tendsto (fun x => V x/mainTerm x) atTop (nhds 1) := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,happ⟩ := value_finite_coefficient_approximation hscale hstruct hpnt hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hconc
    (a := 1) (by norm_num)
  apply coefficient_conclusions_of_internal_comparison hscale
  intro ε hε
  have he : ∀ᶠ H : ℕ in atTop, ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |normalizedCount V x-AH H (fun _ => 1) (theta x)| ≤ ε := by
    filter_upwards [happ,hδ.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds (show (0 : ℝ)<ε/2 by positivity))]
      with H hH hδH
    filter_upwards [hH (ε/2) (by positivity),eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hx hx1
    have hh := hx x (by simp) le_rfl
    rw [div_self (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hx1)),one_mul] at hh
    exact hh.trans (by linarith)
  exact eventually_atTop.mp he

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.normality_large_scale
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Norma.text:
theorem normality_large_scale : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ S : ℝ, 2 < S →
    ∀ N : ℕ, 3 < N → 1 ≤ B N → (Real.log N)^6 ≤ Real.log S →
    ((nonNormalPrimes S N).card:ℝ) ≤
      C*N/Real.log N*(B N)^5*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hfull⟩ := full_factor_tail_mass
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro S hS N hN hB hSlarge
  have hN0 : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log N := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega))
  have hlogS : 0 < Real.log S := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hBS : 6*B N ≤ B S := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_log (pow_pos hlog 6) hSlarge
    simpa only [Real.log_pow,B,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh
  have hSN : (N:ℝ) ≤ S := by
    have hb : B N ≤ B S := by linarith
    have hl := (Real.log_le_log_iff hlog hlogS).mp hb
    exact (Real.log_le_log_iff hN0 (by linarith : 0 < S)).mp hl
  let Q : Finset ℕ := (nonNormalPrimes S N).image (fun p => p-1)
  have hcard : Q.card = (nonNormalPrimes S N).card := by
    apply Finset.card_image_iff.mpr
    intro p hp r hr he
    change p-1=r-1 at he
    have hp2 := (Nat.mem_primesLE.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1).2.two_le
    have hr2 := (Nat.mem_primesLE.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).1).2.two_le
    omega
  have hb := hfull S (by linarith) N (by omega) (by linarith) hBS Q (by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn
    obtain ⟨hp,hbad⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    obtain ⟨hpN,hprime⟩ := Nat.mem_primesLE.mp hp
    exact ⟨by have := hprime.two_le; omega,by omega,nonnormal_full_factor_excess hprime hpN hSN hbad⟩)
  rw [hcard] at hb
  apply hb.trans
  have hpow : 1 ≤ (B N)^5 := one_le_pow₀ hB
  have hrpow : 0 < (Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hlogS _
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow
    (show 0 ≤ C*N/Real.log N*(Real.log S)^(-1/6:ℝ) by positivity)
  nlinarith

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1≤k) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun H => AH H (fk k)) (A (fk k)) atTop (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    Tendsto (fun x => normalizedCount (N k) x-A (fk k) (theta x)) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    ((∃ d : ℕ, IsTotient d ∧ k*d<ell d) →
      ∃ cMinus cPlus : ℝ, 0<cMinus ∧ 0<cPlus ∧

        ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, (cMinus/cPlus)*V x≤N k x ∧ N k x≤V x) ∧
    ((¬∃ d : ℕ, IsTotient d ∧ k*d<ell d) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0<x → N k x=0) ∧ (∀ s∈Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, A (fk k) s=0)) :=
  conditional_companion_theorem_of_structure fordScaleBounds extractedStructureInput primeNumberTheoremInput fordUnitPrimeBoxInput

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Colli.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.fordLemma51Input
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Colli.text:
theorem fordLemma51Input : FordLemma51Input := by
  obtain ⟨A,C,M,R,hA,hC,hM,hR,hcount⟩ := ford_raw_count
  obtain ⟨A₁,M₁,hA₁,hM₁,hcount₁⟩ := ford_raw_count_one
  obtain ⟨y₀,hy₀,hthreshold⟩ := ford_comparison_threshold R hR
  let K := 1+216*A+216*A₁+M+M₁+C
  have hK : 1 ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  have hAK : 216*A ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  have hA₁K : 216*A₁ ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  have hMK : M ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  have hM₁K : M₁ ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  have hCK : C ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; linarith
  refine ⟨K,y₀,by linarith,hy₀,?_⟩
  intro b y S D r Y U hy hp T hT
  have hy1 : 1 < y := hy₀.trans_le hy
  obtain ⟨hy2,hBy,hroot⟩ := hthreshold y hy
  by_cases hb : b=1
  · subst b
    exact (hcount₁ D r y S Y U hy2 hBy hp T hT).trans
      (ford_comparison_budget_one hp hy1 hA₁.le hM₁.le hK hA₁K hM₁K)
  · have hb2 : 2 ≤ b := by have := hp.1; omega
    exact (hcount b D r y S Y U hy2 hBy hb2 hp
      (hroot S (ford_scale_bounds hp).2) T hT).trans
      (ford_comparison_budget hp hy1 hA.le hM.le hC.le hK hAK hMK hCK)

end TotientAsymptotic

end

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Merte.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.primeReciprocalLT_mertens
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Merte.text:
lemma primeReciprocalLT_mertens : ∃ D : ℝ, 0<D ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 2≤x →
    |primeReciprocalLT x-Real.log (Real.log x)-Mertens.M| ≤ D/Real.log x := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := primeReciprocalLE_mertens
  refine ⟨C+1,by linarith,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hx0 : 0<x := by linarith
  have hl : 0<Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hxlog : Real.log x≤x := by linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx0]
  have he := (primeReciprocal_endpoint_error hx0).trans
    (one_div_le_one_div_of_le hl hxlog)
  calc
    _ = |(primeReciprocalLT x-primeReciprocalLE x)+
        (primeReciprocalLE x-Real.log (Real.log x)-Mertens.M)| := by congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ |primeReciprocalLT x-primeReciprocalLE x|+
        |primeReciprocalLE x-Real.log (Real.log x)-Mertens.M| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ 1/Real.log x+C/Real.log x := add_le_add he (hbound x hx)
    _ = _ := by ring

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordC.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.ford_comparison_budget_one
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordC.text:
lemma ford_comparison_budget_one {D r : ℕ} {y S A M K : ℝ} {Y U : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hp : FordComparisonParameters 1 y S D r Y U) (hy : 1 < y)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hAK : 216*A ≤ K) (hMK : M ≤ K) :
    ((216*A)*(y/(D*r:ℕ))*(B y)^5/(Real.log y)^2/Real.log (Y 1))*
      (M*(2:ℝ)^D.primeFactorsList.length*(Real.log (Y 1))^2) ≤
    fordComparisonBound K 1 y S D r Y U := by
  have hBy : 1 ≤ B y := by simpa only [hp.2.1] using ford_cutoff_B_one_le hp (k:=0) (by decide)
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log (Y 1) := Real.log_pos (by linarith [ford_cutoff_two_le hp hp.1])
  have hpoly : (216*A)*M*(B y)^5 ≤ (K*B y)^6 := by
    simpa using ford_polynomial_budget (b:=1) (by decide) hBy (by simpa using hBy) hK hA hM hAK hMK (by linarith)
  have hfac : 0 ≤ (y/(D*r:ℕ))*(2:ℝ)^D.primeFactorsList.length*
      Real.log (Y 1)*((Real.log y)^2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly hfac
  have hinv : (Real.log y)^(-2:ℝ)=((Real.log y)^2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hlog.le]
    norm_num only [Real.rpow_ofNat]
  convert hh using 1
  · field_simp
  · norm_num [fordComparisonBound,comparisonError,hinv]
    ring

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.PPTFi.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.extracted_structure_exception_small
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.PPTFi.text:
theorem extracted_structure_exception_small :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ P : ℕ in atTop, ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      preimageExceptionCount x (extractedStructureCondition x P) ≤
        ε*tupleNormalization x := by
  obtain ⟨C,_hC,hcount⟩ := ford_structure_exception_count
  intro ε hε
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun P : ℕ => C*Real.exp (-(P:ℝ)^2/4)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using ppt_natural_gaussian_tendsto.const_mul C
  filter_upwards [fixed_model_band_exception_small (ε/2) (half_pos hε),
    hlim.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds (half_pos hε))] with P hband hsmall
  filter_upwards [hband,hcount,scale_eventually_pos,
    m_tendsto.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop P)] with x hb hx hn hm
  have hs : preimageExceptionCount x (extractedSimplexCondition x P) ≤
      (ε/2)*tupleNormalization x := by
    calc
      _ ≤ preimageExceptionCount x (fordSimplexCondition x P) :=
        preimageExceptionCount_mono (fun _ hh => fordSimplexCondition_implies_extracted hm hh)
      _ ≤ C*(x/Real.log x)*G x (m x)*Real.exp (-(P:ℝ)^2/4) := hx P hm
      _ = (C*Real.exp (-(P:ℝ)^2/4))*tupleNormalization x := by
        unfold tupleNormalization
        ring
      _ ≤ (ε/2)*tupleNormalization x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall.le hn.le
  calc
    _ ≤ preimageExceptionCount x (modelBandsCondition x P)+
        preimageExceptionCount x (extractedSimplexCondition x P) :=
      preimageExceptionCount_and_le x _ _
    _ ≤ (ε/2)*tupleNormalization x+(ε/2)*tupleNormalization x := add_le_add hb hs
    _ = ε*tupleNormalization x := by ring

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Weigh.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.conditional_companion_additive

theorem conditional_companion_additive (hscale : FordScaleBounds)
    (hstruct : ExtractedStructureInput) (hpnt : PrimeNumberTheoremInput)
    (hbox : FordUnitPrimeBoxInput) (hren : FordRenewalInput) (hmertens : MertensProductInput)
    (h26 : FordLemma26Input) (h51 : FordLemma51Input) (hconc : FordCoordinateConcentrationInput)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun H => AH H (fk k)) (A (fk k)) atTop (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      Tendsto (fun x => normalizedCount (N k) x-A (fk k) (theta x)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,happ⟩ := weighted_value_coefficient_approximation hscale hstruct hpnt
    hbox hren hmertens h26 h51 hconc k hk
  apply coefficient_convergence_from_phase_comparison
  intro ε hε
  have he : ∀ᶠ H : ℕ in atTop, ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      |normalizedCount (N k) x-AH H (fk k) (theta x)| ≤ ε := by
    filter_upwards [happ,hδ.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds (show (0 : ℝ)<ε/2 by positivity))]
      with H hH hδH
    filter_upwards [hH (ε/2) (by positivity)] with x hx
    exact hx.trans (by linarith)
  exact eventually_atTop.mp he

end TotientAsymptotic

end

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordS.text:
theorem shrinkLast_volume_bound {N : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
    (S T : Set (Fin (N+2) → ℝ)) (hT : MeasurableSet T)
    (hS : ∀ u ∈ S, u ∈ prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0)
    (hST : ∀ u ∈ S, shrinkLast N u ∈ T) :
    volume S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((a 1)⁻¹)*volume (fordSimplex N B ∩ T) := by
  have ha := a_pos (j := 1) le_rfl
  have hford : MeasurableSet (fordSimplex N B) := by
    change MeasurableSet (prefixRegion (N+2) B 0 0 ∩
      {u : Fin (N+2) → ℝ | u (Fin.last (N+1)) ≤ u ⟨N, by omega⟩})
    exact (measurableSet_prefixRegion _ _ _ _).inter
      (measurableSet_le (measurable_pi_apply (Fin.last (N+1)))
        (measurable_pi_apply (⟨N, by omega⟩ : Fin (N+2))))
  have hincl : S ⊆ (shrinkLast N) ⁻¹' (fordSimplex N B ∩ T) := by
    intro u hu
    exact ⟨shrinkLast_mem_fordSimplex (hS u hu), hST u hu⟩
  apply (measure_mono hincl).trans_eq
  rw [← Measure.map_apply (shrinkLast N).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.measurable (hford.inter hT),
    Real.map_linearMap_volume_pi_eq_smul_volume_pi (by rw [shrinkLast_det]; exact ha.ne'),
    shrinkLast_det, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha)]

end TotientAsymptotic

end

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Merte.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.primeEulerProduct_rankin
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Merte.text:
lemma primeEulerProduct_rankin {u : ℝ} (hu : 0<u) (N : ℕ) :
    primeEulerProduct N ≤
      Real.exp (2*u*(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 N).filter Nat.Prime,
        Real.log p/(p : ℝ)))*(1+1/u) := by
  let S := (Finset.Icc 2 N).filter Nat.Prime
  have he : (∏ p ∈ S, Real.exp (2*u*Real.log p/p))=
      Real.exp (2*u*(∑ p ∈ S, Real.log p/p)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_sum,Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    ring
  calc
    primeEulerProduct N ≤ ∏ p ∈ S,
        Real.exp (2*u*Real.log p/p)*(1-(p : ℝ)^(-(1+u)))⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod₀
      · intro p hp
        have hp2 : (2 : ℝ)≤p := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.two_le
        exact div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      · intro p hp
        exact mertens_factor_le hu (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    _ = Real.exp (2*u*(∑ p ∈ S, Real.log p/p))*
        ∏ p ∈ S, (1-(p : ℝ)^(-(1+u)))⁻¹ := by
      rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib,he]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have hh := finite_power_euler_product_le (show 1<1+u by linarith) (Finset.Icc 2 N)
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hh

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Renew.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.fordRenewalInput
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Renew.text:
theorem fordRenewalInput : FordRenewalInput := by
  refine ⟨4*rho/(1-rho),div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) rho_pos.le) (by linarith [rho_lt_one]),?_⟩
  intro n
  have hp : rho^n≠0 := (pow_pos rho_pos n).ne'
  have hs := summable_norm_regular_weighted.of_norm.sum_add_tsum_nat_add (n+1)
  rw [regular_weighted_sum_eq_gamma,← normalized_renewal_eq_regular_partial n] at hs
  have he : (∑' k : ℕ, renewalRegular (k+(n+1))*rho^(k+(n+1)))=
      (∑' k : ℕ, renewalRegular (k+n+1)*rho^(k+1))*rho^n := by
    rw [← tsum_mul_right]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro k
    have hpow : rho^(k+(n+1))=rho^(k+1)*rho^n := by
      rw [← pow_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [hpow]
    have hn : k+(n+1)=k+n+1 := by omega
    rw [hn]
    ring
  rw [he] at hs
  have herror : g n-gamma*(rho^n)⁻¹= -∑' k : ℕ, renewalRegular (k+n+1)*rho^(k+1) := by
    apply (mul_right_cancel₀ hp)
    calc
      (g n-gamma*(rho^n)⁻¹)*rho^n=g n*rho^n-gamma := by field_simp
      _ = _ := by nlinarith [hs]
  rw [herror,abs_neg]
  exact regular_tail_bound n

end TotientAsymptotic

end

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordR.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.ford_raw_count
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.FordR.text:
theorem ford_raw_count : ∃ A C M D₀ : ℝ,
    0 < A ∧ 0 < C ∧ 0 < M ∧ 0 < D₀ ∧
    ∀ (b D r : ℕ) (y S : ℝ) (Y U : ℕ → ℝ),Real.exp 2 ≤ y → 1 ≤ B y → 2 ≤ b →
    FordComparisonParameters b y S D r Y U → D₀ ≤ Real.sqrt (B S*B y) →
    ∀ T : Finset (ShiftedPair b),(∀ t ∈ T,FordComparisonConditions b y S D r Y U t) →
    (T.card:ℝ) ≤
      ((216*A)*(y/(D*r:ℕ))*(B y)^5/(Real.log y)^2/Real.log (Y 1))*
      (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,fordBandCost C k y S Y U)*
      (M*(b+1:ℝ)^D.primeFactorsList.length*
        (Real.log (Y b))^(20*(b:ℝ)*Real.log b+1)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hinit⟩ := ford_initial_count
  obtain ⟨C,D₀,hC,hD₀,hiter⟩ := ford_state_iteration
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hterm⟩ := ford_terminal_mass
  refine ⟨A,C,M,D₀,hA,hC,hM,hD₀,?_⟩
  intro b D r y S Y U hy hBy hb hp hroot T hT
  have hy0 : 0 < y := (Real.exp_pos 2).trans_le hy
  have hy1 : 1 < y := (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)).trans_le hy
  have hlogy : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy1
  have hY1 : 0 < Real.log (Y 1) := Real.log_pos (by linarith [ford_cutoff_two_le hp hp.1])
  have hI : 0 ≤ (A*(y/(D*r:ℕ))*(B y)^2/(Real.log y/(6*B y))^3)*
      (Real.log y/Real.log (Y 1)) := by positivity
  have hP : 0 ≤ ∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,fordBandCost C k y S Y U :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg (fun k _ => fordBandCost_nonneg hC.le k y S Y U)
  have hcut (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b) : 2 ≤ Y k ∧ 1 < U (k-1) := by
    obtain ⟨hk2,hkb⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
    have hh := hp.2.2.2.2.1 (k-1) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
    have hlow : Y k < U (k-1) := by simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ k)] using hh.1
    exact ⟨ford_cutoff_two_le hp hkb,lt_of_le_of_lt (by linarith [ford_cutoff_two_le hp hkb]) hlow⟩
  have hi := hinit b D r y S Y U hy hBy (ford_cutoff_two_le hp hp.1) hp T hT
  have hm := hiter b D r y S Y U hy hBy hp hcut hroot T hT
  have ht := hterm b D r y S Y U hb hp T hT
  calc
    _ ≤ (A*(y/(D*r:ℕ))*(B y)^2/(Real.log y/(6*B y))^3)*
        (Real.log y/Real.log (Y 1))*fordStateMass T Y 1 := hi
    _ ≤ (A*(y/(D*r:ℕ))*(B y)^2/(Real.log y/(6*B y))^3)*
        (Real.log y/Real.log (Y 1))*
        ((∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b,fordBandCost C k y S Y U)*
          (M*(b+1:ℝ)^D.primeFactorsList.length*
            (Real.log (Y b))^(20*(b:ℝ)*Real.log b+1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hm.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hP)) hI
    _ = _ := by
      rw [ford_initial_scalar (by linarith : B y ≠ 0) (Real.log_pos hy1).ne']
      ring

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Merte.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.mertensProductInput
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Merte.text:
theorem mertensProductInput : MertensProductInput := by
  refine ⟨3*Real.exp (10*Real.log 4),by positivity,?_⟩
  intro N hN
  have hlog : (1/2 : ℝ)<Real.log N := by
    have hn : (2 : ℝ)≤N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have hh := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<2) hn
    linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  have hc : 0≤Real.log 4 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hu : 0<1/Real.log N := by positivity
  have hb := primeEulerProduct_rankin hu N
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (prime_log_mass_le N hN)
    (show 0≤2*(1/Real.log N) by positivity)
  have hexp : 2*(1/Real.log N)*(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 N).filter Nat.Prime,
      Real.log p/(p : ℝ)) ≤ 10*Real.log 4 := by
    have hi : 1/Real.log N≤2 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0<Real.log N)).mpr
      linarith
    have he : 2*(1/Real.log N)*(Real.log 4*(2+Real.log N))=
        4*(1/Real.log N)*Real.log 4+2*Real.log 4 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [he] at hm
    nlinarith
  have hlast : 1+1/(1/Real.log N) ≤ 3*Real.log N := by
    simp only [one_div_one_div]
    linarith
  calc
    primeEulerProduct N ≤ Real.exp (2*(1/Real.log N)*
        (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 N).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log p/(p : ℝ)))*
        (1+1/(1/Real.log N)) := hb
    _ ≤ Real.exp (10*Real.log 4)*(3*Real.log N) :=
      mul_le_mul (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp) hlast (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

end TotientAsymptotic

end

end OAI

OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Compa.name: OAI.TotientAsymptotic.N_zero_of_no_seed
OAI.NumberTheory.TotientAsymptotic.Compa.text:
lemma N_zero_of_no_seed (k : ℕ)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ d : ℕ, IsTotient d ∧ k*d < ell d) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    N k x = 0 := by
  classical
  unfold N
  have hempty : (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun v =>
      IsTotient v ∧ (k : ℝ) * x < ell v ∧ (ell v : ℝ) ≤ (k+1 : ℝ) * x) = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
    intro v hv ⟨hvt, hvx, _⟩
    have hvle : (v : ℝ) ≤ x :=
      (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hv).2).trans (Nat.floor_le hx.le)
    have hel : (ell v : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * v := by
      exact_mod_cast ell_le_mul_of_no_seed k hno hvt
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvle (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hel.trans hmul)) hvx
  rw [hempty]
  simp

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:25.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.source_final_error_eventually
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:25.text:
theorem source_final_error_eventually (B : ℕ) (ζ : ℝ) (hB : 2≤B) (hζ : ζ∈Set.Ioo 0 1)
    {n q : ℕ→ℝ} (hn : Tendsto n atTop atTop) (hq : ∀t,q t∈Set.Ioc 0 (1/2:ℝ))
    (hH : Tendsto (fun t=>(q t)^3*Real.log (n t)) atTop atTop) :
    ∀ᶠt in atTop,∀ (U : ConcreteLevelPair (q t) ⟨(hq t).1.le,by linarith [(hq t).2]⟩ (n t)
      ((n t)^(-100*(totalScoreExponent B (sourceDepth B ζ ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t)))+B+1)))
      (totalScoreExponent B (sourceDepth B ζ ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t))))
      (initialOverlapLower (q t))
      ((sourceOverlapConstant (q t))^(2*B*sourceDepth B ζ ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t))+2))
      (sourceDepth B ζ ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t)))
      (sourceHalfMoment B (sourceDepth B ζ ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t))) (n t)
        (sourceDepth B ζ ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t))))),
      U.error≤(n t)^(-2*totalScoreExponent B (sourceDepth B ζ ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t)))) := by
  have ht := SourceExpUpper.uniform (fun D _=>(D:ℝ)+1) SourcePolyUpper.depth.expUpper
    B ζ 1 hB hζ zero_lt_one hn hq hH
  filter_upwards [ht,hn.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with t ht hn2 U
  let D := sourceDepth B ζ ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t))
  let d := totalScoreExponent B D
  have hn0 : 0<n t := by linarith only [hn2]
  have hn1 : 1≤n t := by linarith only [hn2]
  have hD : (D:ℝ)+1≤n t := by
    have hh := ht D
    rw [sourceTargetScale_top,one_mul] at hh
    exact hh.trans (by simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hn1 (sourceEpsilon_le_one B D))
  have hd : 11/5≤d := (totalScoreExponent_bounds B D hB).1
  calc
    U.error ≤ ((D:ℝ)+1)*(n t)^(-100*(d+B+1))*n t := U.error_le hn0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hn0.le _)
    _ ≤ (n t)*(n t)^(-100*(d+B+1))*n t := by gcongr
    _ = (n t)^(-100*(d+B+1)+2) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add hn0,Real.rpow_two]
      ring
    _ ≤ (n t)^(-2*d) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hn1 (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg B (α:=ℝ)])

end TraceReconstruction

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:66.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.exists_source_slope
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:66.text:
theorem exists_source_slope {c : ℝ} (hc : c<1/(4*Real.log 2)) :
    ∃B : ℕ,2≤B ∧ ∃ζ : ℝ,ζ∈Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧ c<finalSlope B ζ := by
  have hn : Tendsto (fun B : ℕ=>(B:ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hn1 : Tendsto (fun B : ℕ=>(B:ℝ)+1) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun B=>by linarith) hn
  have h1 := hn1.const_div_atTop (1:ℝ)
  have h2 := hn.const_div_atTop (3/10:ℝ)
  have hlim := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x:=(1:ℝ))).sub h1).mul
    ((tendsto_const_nhds (x:=(1/4:ℝ))).sub h2) |>.div_const (Real.log 2)
  have hlim' : Tendsto (fun B : ℕ=>(1-1/((B:ℝ)+1))*((1/4:ℝ)-(3/10:ℝ)/(B:ℝ))/Real.log 2)
      atTop (𝓝 (1/(4*Real.log 2))) := by
    convert hlim using 1
    ring_nf
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hβ⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop 2).and (hlim'.eventually_const_lt hc)).exists
  refine ⟨B,hB,1/((B:ℝ)+1),⟨by positivity,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · have hBr : (2:ℝ)≤B := by exact_mod_cast hB
    exact (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
  · have hBr : (B:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast (show B≠0 by omega)
    have he : finalSlope B (1/((B:ℝ)+1))=
        (1-1/((B:ℝ)+1))*((1/4:ℝ)-(3/10:ℝ)/(B:ℝ))/Real.log 2 := by
      unfold finalSlope blockGain
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [he]
    exact hβ

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction.Init.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.sourceHalfMoment_bounds
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction.Init.text:
theorem sourceHalfMoment_bounds (B D i : ℕ) {n : ℝ} (hB : 2 ≤ B) (hn : 1<n) :
    1 ≤ sourceHalfMoment B D n i ∧
    (sourceHalfMoment B D n i:ℝ) ≤
      ((10^8:ℝ)*2^(10*B)*((B:ℝ)+4)*2+1)*((D:ℝ)+1)*2^(B*D) := by
  have hp := sourceScaleProduct_lower B D i hB
  have hp0 : 0<sourceScaleProduct B D i := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hp
  have he : (10^8:ℝ)*2^(10*B)*(totalScoreExponent B D+B+1)*Real.log n/
      Real.log (sourceTargetScale B D n i)=
      (10^8:ℝ)*2^(10*B)*(totalScoreExponent B D+B+1)/sourceScaleProduct B D i := by
    rw [sourceTargetScale,Real.log_rpow (by linarith : 0<n)]
    field_simp [(Real.log_pos hn).ne']
  have hd := totalScoreExponent_bounds B D hB
  have hA : 0<(10^8:ℝ)*2^(10*B)*(totalScoreExponent B D+B+1) := by positivity [hd.1]
  unfold sourceHalfMoment
  rw [he]
  constructor
  · exact Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.mpr (div_pos hA hp0)
  have hc := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg hA.le hp0.le)
  have hb := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA.le (by positivity) hp
  have he' : (10^8:ℝ)*2^(10*B)*(totalScoreExponent B D+B+1)/(1/(2*2^(B*D)))=
      (10^8:ℝ)*2^(10*B)*(totalScoreExponent B D+B+1)*2*2^(B*D) := by field_simp
  rw [he'] at hb
  have hdd : totalScoreExponent B D+B+1 ≤ ((B:ℝ)+4)*((D:ℝ)+1) := by nlinarith [hd.2]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdd (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 10^8*2^(10*B)))
    (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2*2^(B*D))
  have hp1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2^(B*D) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  nlinarith [show (0:ℝ) ≤ D by positivity]

end TraceReconstruction

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:94.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.subdivided_working_scale
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:94.text:
theorem subdivided_working_scale {n q : ℕ→ℝ} (hn : Tendsto n atTop atTop)
    (hq : ∀t,q t∈Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hH : Tendsto (fun t=>(q t)^3*Real.log (n t)) atTop atTop)
    {G : ℝ} (hG : 0<G) :
    Tendsto (fun t=>n t/G) atTop atTop ∧
    Tendsto (fun t=>(workingDeletion (q t))^3*Real.log (n t/G)) atTop atTop ∧
    ∀ᶠt in atTop,(q t)^3*Real.log (n t)/16 ≤
      (workingDeletion (q t))^3*Real.log (n t/G) := by
  have hN := hn.atTop_div_const hG
  have hl := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hn
  have hh : ∀ᶠt in atTop,(q t)^3*Real.log (n t)/16 ≤
      (workingDeletion (q t))^3*Real.log (n t/G) := by
    filter_upwards [hn.eventually_ge_atTop 1,hl.eventually_ge_atTop (max 0 (2*Real.log G))] with t hn1 hl
    have hn0 : 0<n t := by linarith only [hn1]
    have hl0 : 0≤Real.log (n t) := (le_max_left _ _).trans hl
    have hlg : 2*Real.log G≤Real.log (n t) := (le_max_right _ _).trans hl
    have hhalf : Real.log (n t)/2≤Real.log (n t/G) := by
      rw [Real.log_div hn0.ne' hG.ne']
      linarith only [hlg]
    have hb := (workingScale_bounds (hq t) hl0).1
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf (pow_nonneg (workingDeletion_bounds (hq t)).1.1.le 3)
    nlinarith only [hb,hm]
  exact ⟨hN,tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop hh (hH.atTop_div_const (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<16)),hh⟩

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:302.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.minTraceTV_le_pair

theorem minTraceTV_le_pair {n : ℕ} (q : ℝ) (x y : Word n) (hxy : x≠y) :
    minTraceTV n q ≤ traceTV q x y := by
  apply csInf_le (show BddBelow {t | ∃x y : Word n,x≠y ∧ t=traceTV q x y} from ?_) ⟨x,y,hxy,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨0,by rintro b ⟨u,v,_,rfl⟩; exact traceTV_nonneg q u v⟩

  ConcreteLevelPair q hq (sourceTargetScale B D n i)

    (initialOverlapLower q) ((sourceOverlapConstant q)^(2*B*i+2)) i (sourceHalfMoment B D n i)

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:213.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.quantitative_sample_lower_bound
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:213.text:
theorem quantitative_sample_lower_bound
    (s c : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1)
    (hc : c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (1 / (4 * Real.log 2)))
    (n : ℕ → ℕ) (q : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hn : Tendsto n atTop atTop)
    (hq : ∀ k, q k ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hscale : Tendsto (fun k => (q k) ^ 3 * Real.log (n k)) atTop atTop) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      ENNReal.ofReal ((n k : ℝ) ^ (c * Real.log ((q k) ^ 3 * Real.log (n k))))  ≤ 
        sampleComplexity (n k) (q k) s := by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,ζ,hζ,hα⟩ := exists_source_slope hc.2
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 1 (2/s))
  have hg1 : 1<(g:ℝ) := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hg
  have hg0 : 0<(g:ℝ) := by linarith only [hg1]
  have hgs : 1/(2:ℝ)^g<s/2 := by
    have hp : (g:ℝ)<(2:ℝ)^g := by
      clear hg hg1 hg0
      induction g with
      | zero => norm_num
      | succ g ih =>
        push_cast
        rw [pow_succ]
        have hg : (0:ℝ) ≤ g := Nat.cast_nonneg g
        have hp : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2^g := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
        nlinarith only [ih,hg,hp]
    have hbig : 2/s<(2:ℝ)^g := ((le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hg).trans hp
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ hs.1).mp hbig
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<2^g)).mpr
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hnr : Tendsto (fun t=>(n t:ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp hn
  let N := fun t=>(n t:ℝ)/(g:ℝ)
  let r := fun t=>workingDeletion (q t)
  have hr (t) : r t∈Set.Ioc 0 (1/2:ℝ) := workingDeletion_Ioc (hq t)
  have hsc := subdivided_working_scale hnr hq hscale hg0
  have hpair := source_final_pair_eventually B ζ hB hζ hsc.1 hr hsc.2.1
  have herr := source_final_error_eventually B ζ hB hζ hsc.1 hr hsc.2.1
  have hmargin := source_restored_exponent_margin B ζ c (g:ℝ) (s^2/(64*g))
    hB hζ hc.1 hα hg0 (div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hs.1) (mul_pos (by norm_num) hg0)) hnr hq hscale
  filter_upwards [hpair,herr,hmargin,hsc.1.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with t hp he hm hn2
  obtain ⟨U⟩ := hp
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ N t := by dsimp [N]; linarith only [hn2]
  have hN2 : 1<N t := by dsimp [N]; linarith only [hn2]
  have hk := (sourceHalfMoment_bounds B
    (sourceDepth B ζ ((r t)^3*Real.log (N t)))
    (sourceDepth B ζ ((r t)^3*Real.log (N t))) hB hN2).1
  obtain ⟨W,hW,hTV⟩ := U.restored_family (by have hh := (hr t).2; dsimp [r] at *; linarith only [hh])
    ⟨(hq t).1.le,(hq t).2.le⟩ (workingDeletion_bounds (hq t)).2.2 hk g (n t)
    (by field_simp; exact le_rfl)
  apply le_sInf
  rintro z ⟨m,hbudget,rfl⟩
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  by_contra hnot
  have hm' : (m:ℝ) ≤ (s^2/(64*g))*(N t)^(
      totalScoreExponent B (sourceDepth B ζ ((r t)^3*Real.log (N t)))) :=
    (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hnot)).trans hm
  have hclose (θ : Fin g→Bool) := (hTV θ m).trans
    (sample_tv_small hs hg0 hN1
      (by have hd := (totalScoreExponent_bounds B (sourceDepth B ζ ((r t)^3*Real.log (N t))) hB).1; linarith only [hd])
      (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (he U) hm')
  have hbad := family_testing_bound ⟨(hq t).1.le,(hq t).2.le⟩ W hW hclose hbudget
  linarith only [hbad,hgs,hs.1]

end TraceReconstruction

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:378.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.superpolynomial_sample_complexity
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:378.text:
theorem superpolynomial_sample_complexity
    (q : ℝ) (hq : q ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Set.Ioc 0 1)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => sampleComplexity n q s / ENNReal.ofReal ((n : ℝ) ^ C))
      atTop (𝓝 ⊤) := by
  let c : ℝ := 1/(8*Real.log 2)
  have hl : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hc : c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (1/(4*Real.log 2)) := by
    refine ⟨hc0,?_⟩
    dsimp [c]
    apply one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt
    · positivity
    · nlinarith only [hl]
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hH : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => q^3*Real.log (n:ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hn).const_mul_atTop (pow_pos hq.1 3)
  have hb := quantitative_sample_lower_bound s c hs hc id (fun _ => q) tendsto_id (fun _ => hq) hH
  have he := ((Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hH).const_mul_atTop hc0).eventually_ge_atTop (2*C+1)
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,(n:ℝ≥0∞) ≤
      sampleComplexity n q s / ENNReal.ofReal ((n:ℝ)^C) := by
    filter_upwards [hb,he,hn.eventually_gt_atTop 1] with n hb he hn1
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at he
    have hn0 : 0 < (n:ℝ) := zero_lt_one.trans hn1
    have hpow : (n:ℝ)^(C+1) ≤ (n:ℝ)^(c*Real.log (q^3*Real.log (n:ℝ))) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hn1.le (by linarith only [he,hC])
    have hnC : 0 < (n:ℝ)^C := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hn0 C
    have hdiv : ENNReal.ofReal ((n:ℝ)^(C+1)) /
        ENNReal.ofReal ((n:ℝ)^C) = (n:ℝ≥0∞) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos hnC,Real.rpow_add hn0,Real.rpow_one]
      rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hnC.ne',ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
    rw [← hdiv]
    exact ENNReal.div_le_div_right ((ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hpow).trans hb) _
  apply ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_top
  intro k
  filter_upwards [hbound,eventually_gt_atTop k] with n hn hk
  exact (show (k:ℝ≥0∞) < (n:ℝ≥0∞) by exact_mod_cast hk).trans_le hn

end TraceReconstruction

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:132.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.source_restored_exponent_margin
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:132.text:
theorem source_restored_exponent_margin (B : ℕ) (ζ c G a : ℝ)
    (hB : 2≤B) (hζ : ζ∈Set.Ioo 0 1) (hc : 0<c) (hα : c<finalSlope B ζ)
    (hG : 0<G) (ha : 0<a) {n q : ℕ→ℝ} (hn : Tendsto n atTop atTop)
    (hq : ∀t,q t∈Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hH : Tendsto (fun t=>(q t)^3*Real.log (n t)) atTop atTop) :
    ∀ᶠt in atTop,(n t)^(c*Real.log ((q t)^3*Real.log (n t))) ≤
      a*(n t/G)^(totalScoreExponent B
        (sourceDepth B ζ ((workingDeletion (q t))^3*Real.log (n t/G)))) := by
  let α := finalSlope B ζ
  have hα0 : 0<α := hc.trans hα
  obtain ⟨ρ,hρc,hρ1⟩ := exists_between ((div_lt_one hα0).mpr hα)
  have hρ0 : 0<ρ := (div_pos hc hα0).trans hρc
  have hρc' : c<ρ*α := (div_lt_iff₀ hα0).mp hρc
  let H := fun t=>(q t)^3*Real.log (n t)
  let J := fun t=>(workingDeletion (q t))^3*Real.log (n t/G)
  let d := fun t=>totalScoreExponent B (sourceDepth B ζ (J t))
  let K := blockGain B+(warmupBlocks B:ℝ)*blockGain B+α*Real.log 16
  have hsc := subdivided_working_scale hn hq hH hG
  have hdepth := sourceDepth_tendsto B ζ hB hζ.2 hsc.2.1
  have hd : ∀ᶠt in atTop,(ρ*α)*Real.log (H t)-ρ*K≤ρ*d t := by
    filter_upwards [hsc.2.2,hH.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      hdepth.eventually_ge_atTop (warmupBlocks B)] with t hj hp hD
    have hJ : 0<J t := lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos hp (by norm_num)) hj
    have hlog : Real.log (H t)-Real.log 16≤Real.log (J t) := by
      have hh := Real.log_le_log (div_pos hp (by norm_num)) hj
      simpa only [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hp) (by norm_num : (16:ℝ)≠0)] using hh
    have hs := (totalScoreExponent_slope_lower B ζ (J t) hB hD).le
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hα0.le
    have hbase : α*Real.log (H t)-K≤d t := by
      dsimp only [K,d,α] at *
      linarith only [hs,hm]
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase hρ0.le
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hex := eventually_exponent_margin hn hH hρc' ha hd
  have hsub := ((PowerRate.base hn).div_const hn hG).lower hn hρ1
  filter_upwards [hex,hsub,hn.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t he hs hp
  apply he.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ ha.le
  rw [Real.rpow_mul hp.le]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hp.le _) hs
    (by have hh := (totalScoreExponent_bounds B (sourceDepth B ζ (J t)) hB).1; dsimp [d]; linarith only [hh])

end TraceReconstruction

    (A : (Fin m→Trace)→Word n→ℝ) (x : Word n) :
    reconstructionSuccess q A x=((completeTraceLaw q hq x).product m).expect
      (fun z=>A (fun j=>(z j).val) x) := by

  rfl

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:332.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.superpolynomial_one_trace
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:332.text:
theorem superpolynomial_one_trace
    (q : ℝ) (hq : q ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0<C) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℝ)^C*minTraceTV n q) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let r := workingDeletion q
  have hr : r∈Set.Ioc 0 (1/2:ℝ) := workingDeletion_Ioc hq
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℝ)) atTop atTop := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hJ : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ=>r^3*Real.log (n:ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hn).const_mul_atTop (pow_pos hr.1 3)
  have hpair := source_final_pair_eventually 2 (1/2) (by omega) (by norm_num) hn (fun _=>hr) hJ
  have herr := source_final_error_eventually 2 (1/2) (by omega) (by norm_num) hn (fun _=>hr) hJ
  obtain ⟨D0,hD0⟩ := exists_nat_ge (5*(2*(C+1)))
  have hdepth := (sourceDepth_tendsto 2 (1/2) (by omega) (by norm_num) hJ).eventually_ge_atTop D0
  have hb : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,0 ≤ (n:ℝ)^C*minTraceTV n q ∧
      (n:ℝ)^C*minTraceTV n q ≤ 3/(n:ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hpair,herr,hdepth,hn.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with n hp he hD hn2
    obtain ⟨U⟩ := hp
    have hn1 : 1<(n:ℝ) := by linarith only [hn2]
    have hk := (sourceHalfMoment_bounds 2
      (sourceDepth 2 (1/2) (r^3*Real.log (n:ℝ)))
      (sourceDepth 2 (1/2) (r^3*Real.log (n:ℝ))) (by omega) hn1).1
    obtain ⟨x,y,hxy,hTV⟩ := U.restored_words (by linarith only [hr.2])
      ⟨hq.1.le,hq.2.le⟩ (workingDeletion_bounds hq).2.2 hk n le_rfl
    have ht := hTV 1
    rw [FiniteLaw.tv_product_one] at ht
    rw [completeTraceLaw_tv q ⟨hq.1.le,hq.2.le⟩ x y] at ht
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_one,one_mul,mul_one] at ht
    have hd : 2*(C+1) ≤ totalScoreExponent 2 (sourceDepth 2 (1/2) (r^3*Real.log (n:ℝ))) := by
      rw [totalScoreExponent_two]
      have hDD : (D0:ℝ) ≤ (sourceDepth 2 (1/2) (r^3*Real.log (n:ℝ)):ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
      linarith only [hD0,hDD]
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) _) (minTraceTV_nonneg_of_pair q x y hxy),?_⟩
    apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (minTraceTV_le_pair q x y hxy)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) C)).trans
    apply one_trace_power_bound hn1.le hC hd
    linarith only [ht,he U]
  exact squeeze_zero' (hb.mono fun _ h=>h.1) (hb.mono fun _ h=>h.2) (hn.const_div_atTop 3)

end TraceReconstruction

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:182.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.sample_tv_small
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:182.text:
theorem sample_tv_small {s G N d E M : ℝ} (hs : s∈Set.Ioc 0 1)
    (hG : 0<G) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hE : E ≤ N^(-2*d)) (hbudget : M ≤ (s^2/(64*G))*N^d) :
    Real.sqrt (M*G*N^(-d))+2*M*G*E ≤ s/4 := by
  have hN0 : 0<N := by linarith only [hN]
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ N^(-d) := Real.rpow_nonneg hN0.le _
  have hV1 : N^(-d) ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_zero] using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN (neg_nonpos.mpr hd)
  have hVV : N^(-2*d)=(N^(-d))^2 := by
    rw [←Real.rpow_natCast,←Real.rpow_mul hN0.le]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hprod : N^d*N^(-d)=1 := by rw [←Real.rpow_add hN0,add_neg_cancel,Real.rpow_zero]
  have hMV : M*G*N^(-d) ≤ s^2/64 := by
    calc
      _  ≤  ((s^2/(64*G))*N^d)*G*N^(-d) := by gcongr
      _ = (s^2/(64*G)*G)*(N^d*N^(-d)) := by ring
      _ = s^2/64 := by rw [hprod]; field_simp
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (M*G*N^(-d)) ≤ s/8 := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_left (div_nonneg hs.1.le (by norm_num) : 0 ≤ s/8)).mpr
    nlinarith only [hMV]
  have hE' : E ≤ N^(-d) := by
    rw [hVV] at hE
    nlinarith only [hE,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV1 hV0]
  have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE' (show 0 ≤ 2*M*G by positivity)
  have hss := mul_nonneg hs.1.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2)
  nlinarith only [hsq,he,hMV,hss]

theorem totalScoreExponent_bounds (B D : ℕ) (hB : 2 ≤ B) :
    11/5 ≤ totalScoreExponent B D ∧ totalScoreExponent B D ≤ 3+(D:ℝ)*B := by
  have hdim (i : ℕ) : (2:ℝ) ≤ (if i<warmupBlocks B then (2:ℕ) else B) ∧
      (((if i<warmupBlocks B then (2:ℕ) else B):ℕ):ℝ) ≤ B := by
    split_ifs <;> norm_cast
  have hlo : 0 ≤ ∑i∈Finset.range D,blockGain (if i<warmupBlocks B then 2 else B) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    unfold blockGain
    linarith [(hdim i).1]
  have hhi : (∑i∈Finset.range D,blockGain (if i<warmupBlocks B then 2 else B)) ≤ (D:ℝ)*B := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑_i∈Finset.range D,(B:ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        unfold blockGain
        linarith [(hdim i).1,(hdim i).2]

  constructor <;> linarith

OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction.Test.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.family_testing_bound
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction.Test.text:
theorem family_testing_bound {n m g : ℕ} {q s ε : ℝ} (hq : q∈Set.Icc 0 1)
    (W : (Fin g→Bool)→Word n) (hW : Function.Injective W)
    (htv : ∀θ,((completeTraceLaw q hq (W θ)).product m).tv
      ((completeTraceLaw q hq (W (fun _=>false))).product m)≤ε)
    (hm : SufficientBudget n q s m) : s≤1/(2:ℝ)^g+ε := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hs⟩ := hm
  let P := (completeTraceLaw q hq (W (fun _=>false))).product m
  have hθ (θ : Fin g→Bool) : s≤P.expect (fun z=>A (fun j=>(z j).val) (W θ))+ε := by
    have hb := FiniteLaw.expectation_diff_le_tv
      ((completeTraceLaw q hq (W θ)).product m) P
      (fun z=>A (fun j=>(z j).val) (W θ))
      (fun z=>⟨hA.1 _ _,hA.le_one _ _⟩)
    have hh := hs (W θ)
    rw [reconstructionSuccess_expect q hq] at hh
    change ((completeTraceLaw q hq (W θ)).product m).expect (fun z=>A (fun j=>(z j).val) (W θ)) - P.expect _ ≤ _ at hb
    linarith [htv θ]
  have hsum : (∑θ : Fin g→Bool,P.expect (fun z=>A (fun j=>(z j).val) (W θ)))≤1 := by
    unfold FiniteLaw.expect
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑z,P.mass z*1 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro z _
        rw [←Finset.mul_sum]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (P.nonneg z)
        calc
          _ = ∑x ∈ Finset.univ.image W,A (fun j=>(z j).val) x := by
            rw [Finset.sum_image (fun a _ b _ hab=>hW hab)]
          _ ≤ ∑x : Word n,A (fun j=>(z j).val) x := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
            (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun x _ _=>hA.1 _ _)
          _ = 1 := hA.2 _
      _ = 1 := by simp [P.total]
  have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun θ _=>hθ θ)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_bool,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hh
  have hp : 0<(2:ℝ)^g := by positivity
  have he : (2:ℝ)^g*(1/(2:ℝ)^g)=1 := by field_simp
  nlinarith only [hh,hsum,he,hp]

end TraceReconstruction

end
end
end

end OAI

theorem SourceExpUpper.uniform (f : ℕ→ℝ→ℝ) (hf : SourceExpUpper f)
    (B : ℕ) (ζ δ : ℝ) (hB : 2 ≤ B) (hζ : ζ∈Set.Ioo 0 1) (hδ : 0<δ)

  filter_upwards [source_uniform_exp_absorption B h ζ C δ hB hζ hC hδ hn hH
    (fun t=>zpow_pos (hq t).1 _) hrel] with t ht i
  exact (H _ _ (hq t)).trans (ht i)
