OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:307.name: OAI.TraceReconstruction.one_trace_power_bound
OAI.Probability.TraceReconstruction:307.text:
theorem one_trace_power_bound {N d C R : ℝ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hC : 0<C)
    (hd : 2*(C+1) ≤ d) (hR : R ≤ Real.sqrt (N^(-d))+2*N^(-2*d)) :
    N^C*R ≤ 3/N := by
  have hN0 : 0<N := by linarith only [hN]
  have he : (N^(-(C+1)))^2=N^(-2*(C+1)) := by
    rw [←Real.rpow_natCast,←Real.rpow_mul hN0.le]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hs : Real.sqrt (N^(-d)) ≤ N^(-(C+1)) := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_left (Real.rpow_nonneg hN0.le _)).mpr
    rw [he]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN (by linarith only [hd])
  have herr : N^(-2*d) ≤ N^(-(C+1)) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN (by linarith only [hd,hC])
  calc
    N^C*R ≤ N^C*(3*N^(-(C+1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hR,hs,herr]) (Real.rpow_nonneg hN0.le _)
    _ = 3/N := by
      rw [mul_left_comm,←Real.rpow_add hN0]
      rw [show C+ -(C+1)=(-1:ℝ) by ring,Real.rpow_neg_one]
      ring

      2 ≤ W.card ∧ (∀ w ∈ W, w.length = n) ∧

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CapInversion:.name: OAI.TreeEdit.near_cap
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CapInversion:.text:
lemma near_cap {N : ℕ → ℕ} {k₀ d : ℕ} (hN : ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → k ≤ N k)
    (hd : N k₀ ≤ d) : ∃ k, k₀ ≤ k ∧ N k ≤ d ∧ d < N (k + 1) := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ t : ℕ, d < N (k₀ + t) := by
    refine ⟨d + 1, ?_⟩
    exact (by omega : d < k₀ + (d + 1)).trans_le (hN _ (by omega))
  let t := Nat.find hex
  have ht : d < N (k₀ + t) := Nat.find_spec hex
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by
    by_contra hn
    have he : t = 0 := by omega
    simp only [he, add_zero] at ht
    omega
  refine ⟨k₀ + (t - 1), by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hh := Nat.find_min hex (show t - 1 < Nat.find hex by dsimp [t] at ht0 ⊢; omega)
    exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hh
  · convert ht using 1
    congr 1
    omega

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleParamet.name: OAI.TreeEdit.TorusTree.binaryLength_le_power
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleParamet.text:
lemma binaryLength_le_power {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) : binaryLength k ≤ k^(60*k^2) := by
  have hm := branching_le_power hk
  have hW : binaryWidth k ≤ k^8 := by
    have h40 : 40 ≤ k^6 := by have hh := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hk 6; norm_num at hh; omega
    exact (binaryWidth_le hk).trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_right (k^2) h40).trans_eq (by rw [← pow_add]))
  have hN : wordLength k ≤ k^((7+52*k)*k) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (k^7 * k^(52*k))^k := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hm) k
      _ = _ := by rw [← pow_add, ← pow_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ k^((7+52*k)*k)*k^8 := Nat.mul_le_mul hN hW
    _ = k^((7+52*k)*k+8) := by rw [← pow_add]
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by nlinarith)

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleParamet.name: OAI.TreeEdit.TorusTree.wordLength_ge
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleParamet.text:
lemma wordLength_ge {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) : k ≤ wordLength k := by
  have hT : 1 ≤ repetitions k := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
  have hm : k ≤ branching k := by
    dsimp [branching]
    have hk2 : 1 ≤ k^2 := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
    nlinarith
  have hbase : 1 ≤ branching k * repetitions k := (show 1 ≤ branching k by omega).trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hT)
  exact (hm.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hT)).trans (le_self_pow₀ hbase (by omega))

    eventually_exponential_lower (b := 128) (C := 1286400) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) 2,
    Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with k hw he hk
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hlen, hD⟩ := hw

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CapInversion:.name: OAI.TreeEdit.eventually_exponential_lower
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CapInversion:.text:
lemma eventually_exponential_lower {b C : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (r : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * Real.log k / 2) ≤ ((k : ℝ) / b) ^ k / (C * (k : ℝ) ^ r) := by
  have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => Real.log (k : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually_ge_atTop (4 * (Real.log b + Real.log C)),
    Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (max 2 (4 * r))] with k hl hk
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < k)
  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ k)
  have hkr : 4 * (r : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 4 * r ≤ k)
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (k : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hk1
  have hbpos : 0 < b := by linarith
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hlC : 0 ≤ Real.log C := Real.log_nonneg hC
  rw [← Real.exp_log (by positivity : 0 < ((k : ℝ) / b) ^ k / (C * (k : ℝ) ^ r))]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow,
    Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
  have hh1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hkpos.le
  have hh2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkr hl0
  have hh3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk1 hlC
  nlinarith

end TreeEdit

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CapInversion:.name: OAI.TreeEdit.sqrt_log_cap
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CapInversion:.text:
lemma sqrt_log_cap {A k d : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hk : 8 * A ≤ k) (hd : 1 < d)
    (hcap : Real.log d ≤ A * (k + 1) ^ 2 * Real.log (k + 1)) :
    Real.sqrt (Real.log d * Real.log (Real.log d)) ≤ 8 * A * (k * Real.log k) := by
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by linarith
  have hkp : 0 < k := by linarith
  have hAp : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hlogk : 0 < Real.log k := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogd : 0 < Real.log d := Real.log_pos hd
  have hlk : Real.log (k + 1) ≤ 2 * Real.log k := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.log (2 * k) := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by linarith)
      _ = Real.log 2 + Real.log k := Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith [Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hk2]
  have hlk0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (k + 1) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hL : Real.log d ≤ 8 * A * k ^ 2 * Real.log k := by
    calc
      _ ≤ A * (k + 1) ^ 2 * Real.log (k + 1) := hcap
      _ ≤ A * (2 * k) ^ 2 * (2 * Real.log k) := by gcongr; linarith
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hll : Real.log (Real.log d) ≤ 4 * Real.log k := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.log (8 * A * k ^ 2 * Real.log k) := Real.log_le_log hlogd hL
      _ = Real.log (8 * A) + 2 * Real.log k + Real.log (Real.log k) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
          Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
        ring
      _ ≤ Real.log k + 2 * Real.log k + Real.log k := by
        have ha := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 8 * A) hk
        have hb := Real.log_le_log hlogk (show Real.log k ≤ k from by linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hkp])
        linarith
      _ = _ := by ring
  apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · positivity
  · have hh : Real.log d * Real.log (Real.log d) ≤
        (8 * A * k ^ 2 * Real.log k) * (4 * Real.log k) := by
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hll hlogd.le).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (by positivity))
    have hAA : 32 * A ≤ (8 * A) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := hh
      _ = (32 * A) * (k * Real.log k) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (8 * A) ^ 2 * (k * Real.log k) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAA (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleParamet.name: OAI.TreeEdit.TorusTree.binaryLength
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleParamet.text: def binaryLength (k : ℕ) : ℕ := wordLength k*binaryWidth k

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleParamet.name: OAI.TreeEdit.TorusTree.length_log_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleParamet.text:
lemma length_log_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    Real.log (binaryLength k : ℝ) ≤ 60*(k : ℝ)^2*Real.log k := by
  have hN : 0 < binaryLength k := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : 0 < k) (binaryLength_ge hk)
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.log ((k^(60*k^2) : ℕ) : ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hN) (by exact_mod_cast binaryLength_le_power hk)
    _ = _ := by rw [Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring

end TreeEdit.TorusTree

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CapInversion:.name: OAI.TreeEdit.all_caps_of_witnesses
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CapInversion:.text:
theorem all_caps_of_witnesses {N : ℕ → ℕ} {A : ℝ} (hA : 1 ≤ A)
    (h : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      k ≤ N k ∧ Real.log (N k : ℝ) ≤ A * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log k ∧
      ∃ W : Finset (List Bool), 2 ≤ W.card ∧ (∀ w ∈ W, w.length = N k) ∧
        Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * Real.log k / 2) ≤ c1 W) : BinaryLowerBound := by
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp h
  let K := max k₀ ⌈8 * A⌉₊ + 2
  have hK0 : k₀ ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; omega
  have hK2 : 2 ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; omega
  have hKA : 8 * A ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
    exact (Nat.le_ceil (8 * A)).trans (by exact_mod_cast (show ⌈8 * A⌉₊ ≤ K by dsimp [K]; omega))
  refine ⟨1 / (16 * A), by positivity, N K, ?_⟩
  intro d hd
  have hdr : 1 < (d : ℝ) := by
    have hKd : K ≤ d := (hk₀ K hK0).1.trans hd
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < d)
  obtain ⟨k, hkK, hkd, hdk⟩ := near_cap (k₀ := K)
    (fun j hj => (hk₀ j (hK0.trans hj)).1) hd
  obtain ⟨hNk, hlogk, W, hW, hlen, hdist⟩ := hk₀ k (hK0.trans hkK)
  have hlog : Real.log (d : ℝ) ≤ A * ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.log (N (k + 1) : ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hdk.le)
      _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using (hk₀ (k + 1) (by omega)).2.1
  have hb := sqrt_log_cap hA (hKA.trans (by exact_mod_cast hkK)) hdr hlog
  have hexp : Real.exp ((1 / (16 * A)) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (d : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log (d : ℝ)))) ≤
      Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * Real.log k / 2) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 / (16 * A)) * (8 * A * ((k : ℝ) * Real.log k)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by field_simp; ring
  exact ⟨N k, hkd, W, hW, hlen, hexp.trans hdist⟩

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.TorusLowerBou.name: OAI.TreeEdit.TorusTree.witnesses_eventually
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.TorusLowerBou.text:
lemma witnesses_eventually : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop,
    ∃ W : Finset (List Bool), 2 ≤ W.card ∧ (∀ v ∈ W, v.length = binaryLength k) ∧
      ((k : ℝ)/128)^k / (1286400*(k : ℝ)^2) ≤ c1 W := by
  filter_upwards [good_halfturn_eventually] with k hk
  obtain ⟨hk2, j, C, hgood⟩ := hk
  exact binary_witness hk2 j C hgood

end TorusTree

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.TorusLowerBou.name: OAI.TreeEdit.TorusTree.binary_witness
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.TorusLowerBou.text:
theorem binary_witness {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (j : Fin (16*k) ↪ Pool k)
    (C : Config (Pool k) (residueModulus k) (branching k) k)
    (hgood : Good (resolution k : ℝ)⁻¹ poolPrime j k C (point 2)) :
    ∃ W : Finset (List Bool), 2 ≤ W.card ∧ (∀ v ∈ W, v.length = binaryLength k) ∧
      ((k : ℝ)/128)^k / (1286400*(k : ℝ)^2) ≤ c1 W := by
  let : NeZero (fineModulus j) := ⟨(fine_parameters hk j).1.ne'⟩
  let : NeZero (resolution k) := ⟨(pow_pos (by omega : 0 < k) (8*k)).ne'⟩
  let A := State (ZMod (fineModulus j)) (branching k) k
  let Γ := Symbol (branching k) (resolution k) k
  let N := FiniteTree.length (branching k) (repetitions k) k
  let B := Delimiter.width (Fintype.card Γ)
  have hN : N = wordLength k := FiniteTree.length_eq _ _ _
  have hB : B = binaryWidth k := by
    dsimp only [B, Γ, Delimiter.width, binaryWidth, alphabetSize]
    rw [symbol_card]
  have hNp : 0 < N := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : 0 < k) (hN ▸ wordLength_ge hk)
  have hBp : 0 < B := by dsimp [B, Delimiter.width]; omega
  let w : A → Word Γ N := sampledWord poolPrime j (repetitions k) (resolution k) k C
  let z : A := diagonal (A := ZMod (fineModulus j)) (m := branching k) k (fineModulus j/2 : ℕ)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Delimiter.transfer Γ
  let instG : AddCommGroup A := stateAddCommGroup (A := ZMod (fineModulus j)) (branching k) k
  let instF : Fintype A := stateFintype (A := ZMod (fineModulus j)) (branching k) k
  let wb (x : A) : Word Bool (N*B) :=
    ⟨encode c (w x).val, by rw [length_encode, (w x).property]⟩
  let hadd : HAdd A A A := ⟨@Add.add A instG.toAdd⟩
  have hsep (x : A) : (N*B : ℝ) ≤ (2*B*(128 : ℝ)^k) * ed (wb x).val (wb (@HAdd.hAdd A A A hadd x z)).val := by
    have hh : (N : ℝ) ≤ (128 : ℝ)^k * deficit (w x).val (w (@HAdd.hAdd A A A hadd x z)).val := by
      exact_mod_cast sampled_separation hk j C hgood x
    have he := (hc N (w x) (w (@HAdd.hAdd A A A hadd x z))).2.1
    calc
      _ ≤ B * ((128 : ℝ)^k * deficit (w x).val (w (@HAdd.hAdd A A A hadd x z)).val) := by nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (Nat.cast_nonneg B)]
      _ ≤ B * ((128 : ℝ)^k * (2 * ed (wb x).val (wb (@HAdd.hAdd A A A hadd x z)).val)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg B)
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
        dsimp only [wb]
        linarith
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hobs (F : A → RealL1) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
      (hlip : ∀ x y, dist (F x) (F y) ≤ a * ed (wb x).val (wb y).val) :
      @FiniteFourier.average A instF (fun x => dist (F x) (F (@HAdd.hAdd A A A hadd x z))) ≤
        a * (N*B : ℕ) * (20*(k : ℝ)⁻¹^k) := by
    have hlip' (x y : A) : dist (F x) (F y) ≤ (a*B) * ed (w x).val (w y).val := by
      calc
        _ ≤ a * ed (wb x).val (wb y).val := hlip x y
        _ ≤ a * (B * (ed (w x).val (w y).val : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast (hc N (w x) (w y)).2.2) ha
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hh := concrete_displacement hk j C F (a*B) (mul_nonneg ha (Nat.cast_nonneg B)) hlip'
    convert hh using 1
    push_cast
    ring
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hlen, hdist⟩ := @binary_transfer A Bool instF instG inferInstance (N*B) 1 (Nat.mul_pos hNp hBp) (by norm_num : 0 < 1)
    wb z singletonCode (2*B*(128 : ℝ)^k) (20*(k : ℝ)⁻¹^k)
    (by positivity) (by
      have hkreal : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
      exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr hkreal) _))
    (fun x y => by
      rw [encode_singletonCode, encode_singletonCode]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
    (fun x => by simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using hsep x) hobs
  refine ⟨W, hW, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    simpa only [mul_one, hN, hB, binaryLength] using hlen v hv
  · have hkreal : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k by omega)
    have hBreal : (0 : ℝ) < B := by exact_mod_cast hBp
    have hwidth : (B : ℝ) ≤ 40*(k : ℝ)^2 := by rw [hB]; exact_mod_cast binaryWidth_le hk
    have heq : (804*(2*B*(128 : ℝ)^k)*(20*(k : ℝ)⁻¹^k))⁻¹ =
        ((k : ℝ)/128)^k / (32160*B) := by
      rw [div_pow, inv_pow]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq] at hdist
    apply le_trans _ hdist
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (pow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (by positivity)
    nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleObstruc.name: OAI.TreeEdit.TorusTree.good_halfturn_eventually
OAI.Combinatorics.TreeEdit.CircleObstruc.text:
lemma good_halfturn_eventually : ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, 2 ≤ k ∧
    ∃ (j : Fin (16 * k) ↪ Pool k) (C : Config (Pool k) (residueModulus k) (branching k) k),
      Good (resolution k : ℝ)⁻¹ poolPrime j k C (point 2) := by
  filter_upwards [torus_parameters_eventually] with k hk
  obtain ⟨hk2, j, hr10, hgrid, hε, herr⟩ := hk
  refine ⟨hk2, j, ?_⟩
  have hhalf : (resolution k : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ ‖point 2‖ := by
    have hR : 2 ≤ resolution k := by
      calc
        2 ≤ k := hk2
        _ = k ^ 1 := by simp
        _ ≤ resolution k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by omega) (by omega)
    have hn : ‖point 2‖ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [point]
      simpa using AddCircle.norm_half_period_eq (1 : ℝ)
    rw [hn]
    simpa only [one_div] using inv_anti₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (by exact_mod_cast hR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ resolution k)
  have hh := good_probability (L := residueModulus k) poolPrime (fun p => (pool_properties p).1) Subtype.val_injective
    hr10 (show 1 ≤ k ^ 3 from one_le_pow₀ (by omega)) (fun p => (pool_properties p).2.2)
    (fun p => Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ p)) j hgrid hε herr k (point 2) hhalf
  have hex := probability_exists (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 9 / 10) hh)
  exact hex

end TreeEdit.TorusTree

namespace TreeEdit.TorusTree

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:10.name: OAI.CanonicalFace198.facesThrough
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:10.text:
def facesThrough (P : Set A) (x : A) : Set (Set A) :=
  {F | Convex ℝ F ∧ IsExtreme ℝ P F ∧ x ∈ F}

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:23.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.LocalLabels
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:23.text:
def LocalLabels (G : LooplessGraph V E) (v : V) (c : E → Fin 3) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, ∃! e, G.Incident v e ∧ c e = i

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.AffineMap.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.localExtension_injective
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.AffineMap.text:
theorem localExtension_injective (G : LooplessGraph V E) (c : E → Fin 3) (v : V)
    (hc : LocalLabels G v c) : Function.Injective (localExtension G c v hc) := by
  intro x y h
  exact congrArg (oldRestriction : (E ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (E → ℝ)) h

end TriangleFace198
end

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Faces:52.name: OAI.CanonicalFace198.image_minFace
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Faces:52.text:
theorem image_minFace (f : A →ᵃ[ℝ] B) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {P : Set A} {K : Set B} (hP : Convex ℝ P) (hK : Convex ℝ K)
    (hface : IsExtreme ℝ K (f '' P)) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ P) :
    f '' minFace P x = minFace K (f x) := by
  have hfx : f x ∈ K := hface.subset ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · have hpreConvex : Convex ℝ (P ∩ f ⁻¹' minFace K (f x)) :=
      hP.inter ((convex K (f x)).affine_preimage f)
    have hpreExtreme := extreme_affine_preimage f hface.subset (extreme hK hfx)
    have hleast := least hpreConvex hpreExtreme ⟨hx, self_mem K (f x)⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (hleast hy).2
  · apply least ((convex P x).affine_image f)
    · exact hface.trans (extreme_affine_image f hf (extreme hP hx))
    · exact ⟨x, self_mem P x, rfl⟩

end CanonicalFace198

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.name: OAI.MatchingEntropyBounds.Refined.reattach

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Main:13.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.local_face
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Main:13.text:
theorem local_face {V : Type uV} {E : Type uE}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq E] (G : LooplessGraph V E) (c : E → Fin 3) (v : V)
    (hc : LocalLabels G v c) :
    let H := triangleExpansion G c v
    let f := localExtension G c v hc
    let Q := {y | y ∈ H.polytope ∧ H.cutMass y (triangleVertices v) = 1}
    f '' G.polytope = Q ∧
    Convex ℝ Q ∧ IsExtreme ℝ H.polytope Q ∧
    (∀ x, oldRestriction (f x) = x) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ Q, f (oldRestriction y) = y) ∧
    (∀ x e, f x (Sum.inl e) = x e) ∧
    (∀ x i, f x (Sum.inr i) = x (localEdge G c v hc i)) ∧
    (∀ x, (∀ e, x e = (1/3 : ℝ)) → ∀ e, f x e = (1/3 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ G.polytope, CanonicalFace198.minFace H.polytope (f x) = f '' CanonicalFace198.minFace G.polytope x) := by
  dsimp only
  have him := expansion_image_eq G c v hc
  have hex := expansion_image_extreme G c v hc
  refine ⟨him, ?_, ?_, restriction_extension G c v hc, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← him]
    exact (convex_convexHull ℝ (Set.range G.indicator)).linear_image (localExtension G c v hc)
  · rwa [← him]
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := him.symm ▸ hy
    rfl
  · intro x e
    rfl
  · intro x i
    rfl
  · intro x hx e
    rcases e with e | i
    · exact hx e
    · exact hx (localEdge G c v hc i)
  · intro x hx
    exact (CanonicalFace198.image_minFace
      (localExtension G c v hc).toAffineMap (localExtension_injective G c v hc)
      (convex_convexHull ℝ (Set.range G.indicator))
      (convex_convexHull ℝ (Set.range (triangleExpansion G c v).indicator)) hex hx).symm

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Labels:12.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.labels_of_degree_three
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Labels:12.text:
theorem labels_of_degree_three {V : Type uV} {E : Type uE}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq E] (G : LooplessGraph V E) (v : V)
    (hdeg : Fintype.card {e : E // G.Incident v e} = 3) :
    ∃ c : E → Fin 3, LocalLabels G v c := by
  classical
  let q : {e : E // G.Incident v e} ≃ Fin 3 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hdeg
  let c : E → Fin 3 := fun e => if h : G.Incident v e then q ⟨e,h⟩ else 0
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  intro i
  refine ⟨(q.symm i).val, ⟨(q.symm i).property, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp [c, (q.symm i).property]
  · intro e he
    have hq : q ⟨e,he.1⟩ = i := by simpa [c,he.1] using he.2
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (q.injective (hq.trans (q.apply_symm_apply i).symm))

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq E] in

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Main:51.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.triangle_expansion_face
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Main:51.text:
theorem triangle_expansion_face {V : Type uV} {E : Type uE}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq E] (G : LooplessGraph V E) (v : V)
    (hdeg : Fintype.card {e : E // G.Incident v e} = 3)
    (_hmatching : Nonempty G.Matching) :
    ∃ (c : E → Fin 3) (hc : LocalLabels G v c),
      let H := triangleExpansion G c v
      let f := localExtension G c v hc
      let Q := {y | y ∈ H.polytope ∧ H.cutMass y (triangleVertices v) = 1}
      f '' G.polytope = Q ∧
      Convex ℝ Q ∧ IsExtreme ℝ H.polytope Q ∧
      (∀ x, oldRestriction (f x) = x) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Q, f (oldRestriction y) = y) ∧
      (∀ x e, f x (Sum.inl e) = x e) ∧
      (∀ x i, f x (Sum.inr i) = x (localEdge G c v hc i)) ∧
      (∀ x, (∀ e, x e = (1/3 : ℝ)) → ∀ e, f x e = (1/3 : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ G.polytope, CanonicalFace198.minFace H.polytope (f x) = f '' CanonicalFace198.minFace G.polytope x) := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := labels_of_degree_three G v hdeg
  exact ⟨c,hc,local_face G c v hc⟩

end TriangleFace198
end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.AffineMap.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.restriction_extension
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.AffineMap.text:
theorem restriction_extension (G : LooplessGraph V E) (c : E → Fin 3) (v : V)
    (hc : LocalLabels G v c) (x : E → ℝ) :
    oldRestriction (localExtension G c v hc x) = x := rfl

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq E] in

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:26.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.localEdge
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:26.text:
def localEdge (G : LooplessGraph V E) (c : E → Fin 3) (v : V)
    (hc : LocalLabels G v c) (i : Fin 3) : E := Classical.choose (hc i)

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.name: OAI.MatchingEntropyBounds.Refined.triangleExpansion
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.text:
def triangleExpansion (G : LooplessGraph V E) (c : E → Fin 3) (v : V) :
    LooplessGraph (V ⊕ Fin 2) (E ⊕ Fin 3) where
  left := Sum.elim (fun e => reattach v (c e) (G.left e)) (fun i => triangleTip v (i + 1))
  right := Sum.elim (fun e => reattach v (c e) (G.right e)) (fun i => triangleTip v (i + 2))
  loopless := by
    intro e h
    rcases e with e | i
    · have hh := congrArg (triangleCollapse v) h
      exact G.loopless e ((collapse_reattach v (c e) (G.left e)).symm.trans
        (hh.trans (collapse_reattach v (c e) (G.right e))))
    · fin_cases i <;> simp [triangleTip] at h

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:29.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.localExtension
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:29.text:
def localExtension (G : LooplessGraph V E) (c : E → Fin 3) (v : V)
    (hc : LocalLabels G v c) : (E → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (E ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ) where
  toFun x := Sum.elim x (fun i => x (localEdge G c v hc i))
  map_add' x y := by ext e; cases e <;> rfl
  map_smul' a x := by ext e; cases e <;> rfl

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.name: OAI.MatchingEntropyBounds.Refined.collapse_reattach
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.text:
theorem collapse_reattach (v : V) (i : Fin 3) (w : V) :
    triangleCollapse v (reattach v i w) = w := by
  by_cases h : w = v
  · subst w
    fin_cases i <;> simp [reattach,triangleTip,triangleCollapse]
  · simp [reattach,h,triangleCollapse]

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:35.name: OAI.TriangleFace198.oldRestriction
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:35.text:
def oldRestriction : (E ⊕ Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (E → ℝ) where
  toFun y e := y (Sum.inl e)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

end TriangleFace198

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.name: OAI.MatchingEntropyBounds.Refined.triangleVertices
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.text: def triangleVertices (v : V) : Finset (V ⊕ Fin 2) := Finset.univ.image (triangleTip v)

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:13.name: OAI.CanonicalFace198.minFace
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleFace.Model:13.text:
def minFace (P : Set A) (x : A) : Set A := ⋂₀ facesThrough P x

end CanonicalFace198

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.name: OAI.MatchingEntropyBounds.Refined.triangleTip
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.text: def triangleTip (v : V) (i : Fin 3) : V ⊕ Fin 2 := ![Sum.inl v, Sum.inr 0, Sum.inr 1] i

OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.name: OAI.MatchingEntropyBounds.Refined.triangleCollapse
OAI.Combinatorics.MatchingEntropy.Triang.text: def triangleCollapse (v : V) : V ⊕ Fin 2 → V := Sum.elim id (fun _ => v)

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Main:6.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.sharp_terminal_leave_expectation
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Main:6.text:
theorem sharp_terminal_leave_expectation :
    Tendsto (fun n => expectation n (fun G => (G.card : ℝ))/normalization n)
      atTop (𝓝 sharpConstant) := by
  have hmean : Tendsto (fun n => expectation n (normalizedLeave n)) atTop (𝓝 sharpConstant) := by
    apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
    intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp sharp_terminal_leave_l2).2 (ε^2) (sq_pos_of_pos hε)] with n hn
    have hh := pmfMean_sq_le (terminalLaw n) (fun G => normalizedLeave n G-sharpConstant)
    rw [pmfMean_sub,pmfMean_const] at hh
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hε.le).mp
    rw [sq_abs]
    exact hh.trans_lt hn
  simpa only [expectation_normalizedLeave] using hmean

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.normalization
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.text: noncomputable def normalization (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.expectation_normalizedLeave
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.text:
lemma expectation_normalizedLeave (n : ℕ) :
    expectation n (normalizedLeave n) =
      expectation n (fun H => (H.card : ℝ))/normalization n := by
  change pmfMean (terminalLaw n) (fun graph => (graph.card : ℝ)/normalization n) =
    pmfMean (terminalLaw n) (fun graph => (graph.card : ℝ))/normalization n
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,pmfMean_mul_const]

end SharpTerminalLeave

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.expectation
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.text:
noncomputable def expectation (n : ℕ) (f : Graph n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ G, (terminalLaw n G).toReal * f G

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.pmfMean_sub
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.text:
theorem pmfMean_sub {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    pmfMean p (fun a => f a - g a) = pmfMean p f - pmfMean p g := by
  simp only [pmfMean, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.pmfMean_sq_le
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.text:
theorem pmfMean_sq_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (pmfMean p f) ^ 2 ≤ pmfMean p (fun a => f a ^ 2) := by
  have h := pmfMean_nonneg p
    (fun a (_ : a ∈ p.support) => sq_nonneg (f a - pmfMean p f))
  rw [pmfMean_sq_sub] at h
  nlinarith

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.pmfMean_nonneg
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.text:
theorem pmfMean_nonneg {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) {f : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ a ∈ p.support, 0 ≤ f a) : 0 ≤ pmfMean p f := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : a ∈ p.support
  · exact mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (h a ha)
  · have hz : p a = 0 := by simpa only [PMF.mem_support_iff, not_not] using ha
    simp [hz]

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Main:3.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.sharp_terminal_leave_l2
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Main:3.text:
theorem sharp_terminal_leave_l2 :
    Tendsto (fun n => expectation n (fun G =>
      (normalizedLeave n G-sharpConstant)^2)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,C,hprefix⟩ := uniform_prefix_obligation
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    exact Eventually.of_forall (fun n => ha.trans_le
      (pmfMean_nonneg (terminalLaw n) (fun G _ => sq_nonneg (normalizedLeave n G-sharpConstant))))
  · intro b hb
    have hb2 : 0 < b/2 := by linarith
    filter_upwards [hprefix,main_l2_prefix_failure_bound c C hc (b/2) hb2,
      (tendsto_order.mp prefix_failure_l2_envelope_tendsto).2 (b/2) hb2] with n hpre hmain htail
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpre (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*(n : ℝ)+1)
    linarith only [hmain,hh,htail]

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Tracki.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.prefix_failure_l2_envelope_tendsto
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Tracki.text:
theorem prefix_failure_l2_envelope_tendsto :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2*(n : ℝ)+1)*
      Real.exp (- (Real.log n)^(4/3 : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have h1 := prefix_failure_envelope_superpolynomial 1
  have h0 := prefix_failure_envelope_superpolynomial 0
  simpa only [Real.rpow_one,Real.rpow_zero,one_mul,mul_add,add_mul,mul_zero,
    add_zero,Function.comp_def,mul_assoc] using (h1.const_mul 2).add h0

end SharpTerminalLeave

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.pmfMean_markov_sq
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.text:
theorem pmfMean_markov_sq {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) (f : α → ℝ)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    pmfMean p (fun a => if ε < |f a| then 1 else 0) ≤
      pmfMean p (fun a => f a ^ 2) / ε ^ 2 := by
  classical
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hε)).mpr
  rw [← pmfMean_mul_const]
  apply pmfMean_mono
  intro a _
  split_ifs with ha
  · simp only [one_mul]
    exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by rw [abs_of_pos hε]; exact le_of_lt ha)
  · simp only [zero_mul]
    exact sq_nonneg _

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Proces.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.main_l2_prefix_failure_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Proces.text:
theorem main_l2_prefix_failure_bound (c C : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      expectation n (fun H => (normalizedLeave n H-sharpConstant)^2) ≤
        δ+(2*(n : ℝ)+1)*prefixFailure n c C := by
  classical
  intro δ hδ
  filter_upwards [goodPrefix_normalized_l2 c C hc δ hδ,eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with n hg hn
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  change pmfMean (terminalLaw n) (fun H => (normalizedLeave n H-sharpConstant)^2) ≤ _
  rw [terminalLaw_prefix_disintegration,pmfMean_bind]
  calc
    _ ≤ pmfMean (prefixLaw n) (fun G => δ+(2*(n : ℝ)+1)*
          (if GoodPrefixGraph n c C G then 0 else 1)) := by
      apply pmfMean_mono
      intro G hG
      by_cases hgood : GoodPrefixGraph n c C G
      · simp only [ite_eq_left hgood,mul_zero,add_zero]
        exact (hg G hgood).le
      · simp only [ite_eq_right hgood,mul_one]
        have hsub : G ⊆ completeGraph n := evolve_support_subset _ _ hG
        have hh : pmfMean (finish G) (fun H => (normalizedLeave n H-sharpConstant)^2) ≤
            2*(n : ℝ)+1 := by
          rw [← pmfMean_const (finish G) (2*(n : ℝ)+1)]
          apply pmfMean_mono
          intro H hH
          exact normalizedLeave_error_envelope hn0 ((finish_support_subset hH).trans hsub)
        linarith
    _ = _ := by rw [pmfMean_add,pmfMean_const,pmfMean_const_mul]; rfl

end SharpTerminalLeave

end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Main:7.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.sharp_terminal_leave
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Main:7.text:
theorem sharp_terminal_leave :
    Tendsto (fun n => expectation n (fun G =>
      (normalizedLeave n G - sharpConstant) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      Tendsto (fun n => probability n (fun G =>
        ε < |normalizedLeave n G - sharpConstant|)) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => expectation n (fun G => (G.card : ℝ)) / normalization n)
      atTop (𝓝 sharpConstant) :=
  ⟨sharp_terminal_leave_l2,sharp_terminal_leave_probability,sharp_terminal_leave_expectation⟩

end SharpTerminalLeave
end
end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.probability
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.text:
noncomputable def probability (n : ℕ) (P : Graph n → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact expectation n (fun G => if P G then 1 else 0)

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Tracki.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.uniform_prefix_obligation
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Tracki.text:
theorem uniform_prefix_obligation : UniformPrefixObligation := by
  refine ⟨1/80000,by norm_num,(3*(8001 : ℕ)+2 : ℕ),?_⟩
  filter_upwards [prefix_good_history,prefix_rooted_upper_failure 8001,
    prefix_balanced_noise_failure 8001,prefix_triangle_noise_failure,
    prefix_codegree_noise_failure,four_prefix_margins] with n hgood hr hb ht hc hmargin
  let μ := historyLaw (PMF.pure (completeGraph n)) (fun _ => step) (prefixTime n) (prefixTime n)
  have hm : μ.map (fun ω => ω (historyIndex (prefixTime n) (prefixTime n))) = prefixLaw n := by
    rw [historyLaw_marginal _ _ _ _ le_rfl,markovLaw_triangle_step]
    rfl
  unfold prefixFailure
  rw [← hm,pmfMean_map]
  have hpoint : ∀ ω ∈ μ.support,
      (if GoodPrefixGraph n (1/80000) (3*(8001 : ℕ)+2 : ℕ) (ω (historyIndex (prefixTime n) (prefixTime n))) then (0 : ℝ) else 1) ≤
      (if PrefixRootedUpper 8001 n ω then 0 else 1)+
      (if PrefixBalancedNoise 8001 n ω then 0 else 1)+
      (if PrefixTriangleNoise n ω then 0 else 1)+
      (if PrefixCodegreeNoiseGood n ω then 0 else 1) := by
    intro ω hω
    by_cases h₁ : PrefixRootedUpper 8001 n ω <;>
      by_cases h₂ : PrefixBalancedNoise 8001 n ω <;>
      by_cases h₃ : PrefixTriangleNoise n ω <;>
      by_cases h₄ : PrefixCodegreeNoiseGood n ω
    all_goals simp only [h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄,ite_true,ite_false]
    · rw [ite_eq_left (hgood ω hω h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄)]; norm_num
    all_goals split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hs := pmfMean_mono μ hpoint
  simp only [pmfMean_add] at hs
  apply hs.trans
  have hs' := add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add hr hb) ht) hc
  calc
    _ ≤ ((Real.exp (-2*(Real.log (n : ℝ))^(4/3 : ℝ))+
        Real.exp (-2*(Real.log (n : ℝ))^(4/3 : ℝ)))+
        Real.exp (-2*(Real.log (n : ℝ))^(4/3 : ℝ)))+
        Real.exp (-2*(Real.log (n : ℝ))^(4/3 : ℝ)) := hs'
    _ = 4*Real.exp (-2*(Real.log (n : ℝ))^(4/3 : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := hmargin

end SharpTerminalLeave
end
end

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.pmfMean_const
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Probab.text:
@[simp] theorem pmfMean_const {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) (c : ℝ) :
    pmfMean p (fun _ => c) = c := by
  simp only [pmfMean, ← Finset.sum_mul, pmf_weight_sum, one_mul]

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.sharpConstant
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.text:

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Main:5.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.sharp_terminal_leave_probability
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Main:5.text:
theorem sharp_terminal_leave_probability (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n => probability n (fun G =>
      ε < |normalizedLeave n G-sharpConstant|)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply squeeze_zero
  · intro n
    apply pmfMean_nonneg (terminalLaw n)
    intro G _
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · intro n
    exact pmfMean_markov_sq (terminalLaw n) (fun G => normalizedLeave n G-sharpConstant) ε hε
  · simpa only [zero_div,expectation,pmfMean] using sharp_terminal_leave_l2.div_const (ε^2)

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.normalizedLeave
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.text:
noncomputable def normalizedLeave (n : ℕ) (G : Graph n) : ℝ :=
  (G.card : ℝ) / normalization n

OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.name: OAI.SharpTerminalLeave.terminalLaw
OAI.Combinatorics.TriangleRemoval.Model:.text:
noncomputable def terminalLaw (n : ℕ) : PMF (Graph n) :=
  evolve (completeGraph n) (n.choose 2)

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:61.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.main
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:61.text:

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:54.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.normalized_counterexample
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:54.text:
theorem normalized_counterexample : NormalizedCounterexample := by
  have he : 0 < η/4 := by norm_num [η]
  have hs : η/4 < η/2 := by norm_num [η]
  refine ⟨2*n (η/4),finiteFamily (η/4) he,finiteFamily_covers he hs.le,?_⟩
  exact (relativeCost_le_totalArea _).trans_lt (finiteFamily_ratio_lt he hs)

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:18.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.finiteFamily_expansion
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:18.text:
theorem finiteFamily_expansion {ε : ℝ} (he : 0 < ε) (hsmall : ε ≤ η/2) :
    |totalArea (finiteFamily ε he)/H - (1/2-(13/6000:ℝ)*ε^2)| ≤ 14*ε^4 := by
  rw [finiteFamily_total]
  exact uniform_scalar_sum (small_abs_le_one he hsmall) (ceil_count_pos he) (ceil_step_le he)

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Shadows:.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.shadowArea_ge_H
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Shadows:.text:
lemma shadowArea_ge_H {u : Space} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) : H ≤ shadowArea u := by
  rw [shadowArea_formula hu]
  let A := max (H*|u 0|) |u 2|
  let B := max (H*|u 1|) |u 2|
  have hA : H*|u 0| ≤ A := le_max_left _ _
  have hB : H*|u 1| ≤ B := le_max_left _ _
  have hAz : |u 2| ≤ A := le_max_right _ _
  have hBz : |u 2| ≤ B := le_max_right _ _
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := (abs_nonneg _).trans hAz
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans hBz
  have hAs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg H_pos.le (abs_nonneg (u 0))) hA 2
  have hBs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg H_pos.le (abs_nonneg (u 1))) hB 2
  rw [mul_pow,H_sq,sq_abs] at hAs hBs
  have hAB := mul_le_mul hAz hBz (abs_nonneg _) hA0
  have hu2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq u
  rw [inner_coord,hu] at hu2
  have hz2 : |u 2| * |u 2| = (u 2)^2 := by nlinarith only [sq_abs (u 2)]
  change H ≤ A+B
  nlinarith only [hu2,hAs,hBs,hAB,hz2,H_sq,H_pos,hA0,hB0]

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Cylinder.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.finiteFamily
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Cylinder.text:
def finiteFamily (ε : ℝ) (he : 0 < ε) : Fin (2*n ε) → TriCylinder :=
  (Fin.append (lowerFamily ε he) (upperFamily ε he)) ∘ Fin.cast (two_mul (n ε))

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Cylinder.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.finiteFamily_covers
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Cylinder.text:
lemma finiteFamily_covers {ε : ℝ} (he : 0 < ε) (hsmall : ε ≤ η/2) :
    Covers (finiteFamily ε he) := by
  rintro z ⟨x,y,t,_ht0,_ht1,hx,hy,rfl⟩
  rcases finite_coordinate_cover_ceil he hsmall hx hy with ⟨j,hj,hl⟩ | ⟨j,hj,hu⟩
  · refine ⟨Fin.cast (two_mul (n ε)).symm (Fin.castAdd (n ε) (⟨j,hj⟩ : Fin (n ε))), ?_⟩
    simp only [finiteFamily, Function.comp_apply, Fin.cast_cast, Fin.cast_eq_self,
      Fin.append_left]
    exact lowerCylinder_hit _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hl.1.1 hl.2 hl.1.2.1 hl.1.2.2
  · refine ⟨Fin.cast (two_mul (n ε)).symm (Fin.natAdd (n ε) (⟨j,hj⟩ : Fin (n ε))), ?_⟩
    simp only [finiteFamily, Function.comp_apply, Fin.cast_cast, Fin.cast_eq_self,
      Fin.append_right]
    exact upperCylinder_hit _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hu.1.1 hu.2 hu.1.2.1 hu.1.2.2

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Basic:54.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.relativeCost
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Basic:54.text:
def relativeCost {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m → TriCylinder) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin m, area (c i).base / shadowArea (c i).axis

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Basic:69.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.NormalizedCounterexample
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Basic:69.text:
def NormalizedCounterexample : Prop :=
  ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ c : Fin m → TriCylinder, Covers c ∧ relativeCost c < 1 / 2

end TriangularCovering

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:38.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.main_asymptotic
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:38.text:
theorem main_asymptotic : MainAsymptotic := by
  refine ⟨η/2,14,by norm_num [η],by norm_num,?_⟩
  intro ε he hsmall
  exact ⟨finiteFamily ε he,finiteFamily_covers he hsmall.le,
    finiteFamily_expansion he hsmall.le,finiteFamily_strict he hsmall⟩

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:31.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.finiteFamily_strict
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:31.text:
lemma finiteFamily_strict {ε : ℝ} (he : 0 < ε) (hsmall : ε < η/2) :
    totalArea (finiteFamily ε he) < A_min/2 := by
  rw [projection_minimum]
  have h := (div_lt_iff₀ H_pos).mp (finiteFamily_ratio_lt he hsmall)
  linarith only [h]

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:23.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.finiteFamily_ratio_lt
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:23.text:
lemma finiteFamily_ratio_lt {ε : ℝ} (he : 0 < ε) (hsmall : ε < η/2) :
    totalArea (finiteFamily ε he)/H < 1/2 := by
  have hr := (abs_le.mp (finiteFamily_expansion he hsmall.le)).2
  have hesq : ε^2 < (η/2)^2 := (sq_lt_sq₀ he.le (by norm_num [η])).2 hsmall
  have hc : 14*ε^2 < (13/6000:ℝ) := by norm_num [η] at hesq; linarith only [hesq]
  have hneg := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sq_pos_of_pos he) (sub_neg.mpr hc)
  nlinarith only [hr,hneg]

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Shadows:.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.projection_minimum
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Shadows:.text:
theorem projection_minimum : A_min = H := by
  unfold A_min
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply csInf_le
    · exact ⟨H,by rintro a ⟨u,hu,rfl⟩; exact shadowArea_ge_H hu⟩
    · exact ⟨tiltV 0 0 0,xAxis_unit,xAxis_shadow.symm⟩
  · apply le_csInf
    · exact ⟨H,tiltV 0 0 0,xAxis_unit,xAxis_shadow.symm⟩
    · rintro a ⟨u,hu,rfl⟩
      exact shadowArea_ge_H hu

end TriangularCovering

namespace TriangularCovering

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:44.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.relativeCost_le_totalArea
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Main:44.text:
lemma relativeCost_le_totalArea {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m → TriCylinder) :
    relativeCost c ≤ totalArea c/H := by
  unfold relativeCost totalArea
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ENNReal.toReal_nonneg H_pos
    (shadowArea_ge_H (c i).unit_axis)

OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Basic:60.name: OAI.TriangularCovering.MainAsymptotic
OAI.Geometry.TriangularCovering.Basic:60.text:
def MainAsymptotic : Prop :=
  ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 < C ∧
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < δ →
      ∃ c : Fin (2 * n ε) → TriCylinder,
        Covers c ∧
        |totalArea c / H - (1 / 2 - (13 / 6000 : ℝ) * ε ^ 2)| ≤ C * ε ^ 4 ∧
        totalArea c < A_min / 2

    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : AdmissiblePotential g) :

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Energy.Basic:36.name: OAI.TriangularUniversal.energy
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Energy.Basic:36.text:

lemma GaussianPair.energy_bound {α : ℝ} (p : GaussianPair α) (hp : GaussianLatticePoisson p)
    {C : Set Plane} (hD : DensityOne C) : latticeEnergy (gaussPot α)≤energy (gaussPot α) C := by
  rw [p.sharp_value hp]
  have he : (∫ z,schwartzLP p.first z).re-(schwartzLP p.first 0).re=p.second 0-p.first 0 := by
    rw [schwartzLP_integral,schwartzLP_apply]
    rfl
  rw [←he]
  apply TriangularUniversal.density_lp (schwartzLP p.first)
  · intro w
    rw [schwartzLP_fourier,p.fourier_first]
    rfl
  · intro w
    rw [schwartzLP_fourier,p.fourier_first]
    exact p.positive w
  · intro x _
    rw [schwartzLP_apply]
    exact p.minorant x
  · exact hD

theorem universal_energy_minimum (g : ℝ → ℝ) (C : Set Plane)
    (hg : AdmissiblePotential g) (_hC : LocallyFinite C) (hd : DensityOne C) :
    latticeEnergy g ≤ energy g C ∧ latticeEnergy g = energy g A := by
  have hb (α : ℝ) (hα : 0<α) :
      TriangularUniversal.latticeEnergy (TriangularUniversal.gaussPot α)≤
        TriangularUniversal.energy (TriangularUniversal.gaussPot α) C := by
    rw [←latticeEnergy_eq_support]
    exact gaussian_energy_bound hd α hα
  have hu := TriangularUniversal.universal_from_gaussian_bounds hd hb hg
  constructor
  · rw [latticeEnergy_eq_support]
    exact hu.1
  · rw [latticeEnergy_eq_support,A_eq_support]
    exact hu.2
end AtomicTriangular

lemma universal_from_power_bounds (C : Set Plane)
    (hpower : ∀ v : I, latticeEnergy (powerPotential v) ≤ energy (powerPotential v) C)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : AdmissiblePotential g) : latticeEnergy g ≤ energy g C := by
  rw [latticeEnergy_shift_iSup hg]
  apply iSup_le
  intro n
  have hε : 0<(1:ℝ)/(n+1) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨ρ,_,he,hl⟩ := shifted_mixture_energy g hg hε C
  rw [← he]
  apply (lintegral_mono (fun v => hpower v)).trans
  exact hl.trans (shifted_energy_le hg hε.le C)
end TriangularUniversal

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Energy.Potential.name: OAI.TriangularUniversal.power_bounds_from_gaussians
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.Energy.Potential.text:
lemma power_bounds_from_gaussians {C : Set Plane} (hD : DensityOne C)
    (hgauss : ∀ α : ℝ, 0<α → latticeEnergy (gaussPot α)≤energy (gaussPot α) C)
    (v : I) : latticeEnergy (powerPotential v)≤energy (powerPotential v) C := by
  by_cases h0 : (v:ℝ)=0
  · have hl : latticeEnergy (powerPotential v)=0 := by
      unfold latticeEnergy
      apply ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.mpr
      intro x
      have ht : 0<‖x.val‖^2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr x.property.2)
      simp only [powerPotential,h0,Real.zero_rpow ht.ne',ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
    rw [hl]
    exact zero_le
  by_cases h1 : (v:ℝ)=1
  · have he : powerPotential v=(fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
      funext t
      simp only [powerPotential,h1,Real.one_rpow]
    rw [he,energy_one hD]
    exact le_top
  have hv : 0<(v:ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne v.property.1 (Ne.symm h0)
  have hv1 : (v:ℝ)<1 := lt_of_le_of_ne v.property.2 h1
  let α : ℝ := -Real.log (v:ℝ)/Real.pi
  have hα : 0<α := div_pos (neg_pos.mpr (Real.log_neg hv hv1)) Real.pi_pos
  have he : powerPotential v=gaussPot α := by
    funext t
    rw [powerPotential,Real.rpow_def_of_pos hv]
    unfold gaussPot
    congr 1
    dsimp [α]
    field_simp
  rw [he]
  exact hgauss α hα

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.GaussianMinorant.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.AtomicConstruction
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.GaussianMinorant.text:
def AtomicConstruction (α : ℝ) (f : Plane → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsUnit (1 - R) ∧ IsUnit (1 + R) ∧
  (1 - R) * Uplus = Yf + R0 * (gamma 1 + gamma 0) ∧
  (1 + R) * Uminus = Yf + R0 * (gamma 1 - gamma 0) ∧
  ∃ (δ : Fin 2 → Fin 20 → ℝ) (a : Fin 2 → InputCoefficients),
    (∀ side, (∑ j : Fin 20, |δ side j|) < (1 / 10 ^ 5 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ side, (a side).C = if side.val = 0 then -(3 / 500) else 3 / 500) ∧
    (∀ side (j : Fin 11),
      (a side).finiteC j =
        correctedFinite side (gaussianZ α) (δ side) ⟨2 * j.val, by omega⟩ ∧
      (a side).finiteD j =
        correctedFinite side (gaussianZ α) (δ side) ⟨2 * j.val + 1, by omega⟩) ∧
    (∀ side, Summable (fun n => |(a side).tailC n| + |(a side).tailD n|) ∧
      (∑' n, (|(a side).tailC n| + |(a side).tailD n|)) < (3 / 10 ^ 9 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ x, (f x : ℂ) =
      (inputComplex (a 0) x + 𝓕 (inputComplex (a 1)) x) /
        (normalizingDen (gaussianZ α) : ℂ))

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.GaussianMinorant.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.Construction.HasAtomicConstruction.atomicConstruction
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.GaussianMinorant.text:
lemma Construction.HasAtomicConstruction.atomicConstruction {α : ℝ} {f : Plane → ℝ}
    (hf : HasAtomicConstruction α f) : AtomicConstruction α f := by
  obtain ⟨hminus, hplus, heqplus, heqminus, a, δ, ha, hδ, hf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨hminus, hplus, heqplus, heqminus, δ, a,
    (fun side => (hδ side).1), (fun side => (ha side).1), ?_,
    (fun side => (hδ side).2), hf⟩
  intro side j
  constructor
  · have hj := (ha side).2.2.2 ⟨2 * j.val, by omega⟩
    simpa [finiteCoordinates, correctedFinite] using hj
  · have hj := (ha side).2.2.2 ⟨2 * j.val + 1, by omega⟩
    simpa [finiteCoordinates, correctedFinite, Nat.add_div] using hj

OAI.Analysis.Triangular.GaussianMinorant.name: OAI.AtomicTriangular.sharp_gaussian_minorants_with_construction
OAI.Analysis.Triangular.GaussianMinorant.text:
theorem sharp_gaussian_minorants_with_construction (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ∃ f : SchwartzMap Plane ℝ,
      Radial f ∧ (∀ x, f x ≤ gaussian α x) ∧
      (∀ w, (realFourier f w).im = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ (realFourier f w).re) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ A, a ≠ 0 → f a = gaussian α a) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ dualA, w ≠ 0 → realFourier f w = 0) ∧
      (1 ≤ α → AtomicConstruction α f) := by
  obtain ⟨f, hradial, hminorant, hfourier, hcontact, hzero, hconstruction⟩ :=
    sharp_gaussian_minorants_atomic α hα
  exact ⟨f, hradial, hminorant, hfourier, hcontact, hzero,
    fun hlarge => (hconstruction hlarge).atomicConstruction⟩

end AtomicTriangular

end

OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.CyclicHom.name: OAI.TriangularHilbert.cyclicNorm_smul
OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.CyclicHom.text:
lemma cyclicNorm_smul (B C : Plane → ℂ) (u v : ℂ) :
    cyclicNorm (u • B) (v • C) = (‖u‖ₑ*‖v‖ₑ)*cyclicNorm B C := by
  have he : (fun z : Plane => cyclicMax (u • B) (v • C) z ^ ((3:ℝ)/2)) =
      (fun z : Plane => (‖u‖ₑ*‖v‖ₑ)^((3:ℝ)/2)*cyclicMax B C z^((3:ℝ)/2)) := by
    funext z
    rw [cyclicMax_smul,ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num)]
  rw [cyclicNorm,cyclicNorm,he,
    lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg (by norm_num) (ENNReal.mul_ne_top enorm_ne_top enorm_ne_top)),
    ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2/3),← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
  norm_num
end

OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.CyclicNor.name: OAI.TriangularHilbert.cyclicNorm_le
OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.CyclicNor.text:
lemma cyclicNorm_le (B C : Plane → ℂ) (hB : MemLp B 3 volume) (hC : MemLp C 3 volume) :
    cyclicNorm B C ≤ (mainConstant : ℝ≥0∞)*eLpNorm B 3 volume*eLpNorm C 3 volume := by
  by_cases hb0 : eLpNorm B 3 volume = 0
  · have hb := (eLpNorm_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).mp hb0
    rw [cyclicNorm_congr_ae hb (EventuallyEq.refl _ _),cyclicNorm_zero_left]
    exact bot_le
  by_cases hc0 : eLpNorm C 3 volume = 0
  · have hc := (eLpNorm_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).mp hc0
    rw [cyclicNorm_congr_ae (EventuallyEq.refl _ _) hc,cyclicNorm_zero_right]
    exact bot_le
  let u : ℂ := (eLpNorm B 3 volume).toReal
  let v : ℂ := (eLpNorm C 3 volume).toReal
  have hu : ‖u‖ₑ = eLpNorm B 3 volume := by
    rw [← ofReal_norm]
    simp only [u,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg,
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hB.ne]
  have hv : ‖v‖ₑ = eLpNorm C 3 volume := by
    rw [← ofReal_norm]
    simp only [v,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg,
      ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hC.ne]
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    exact hb0 (by simpa only [he,enorm_zero] using hu.symm)
  have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    exact hc0 (by simpa only [he,enorm_zero] using hv.symm)
  have hiB : MemLp (u⁻¹ • B) 3 volume := hB.const_smul _
  have hiC : MemLp (v⁻¹ • C) 3 volume := hC.const_smul _
  have hnB : eLpNorm (u⁻¹ • B) 3 volume = 1 := by
    rw [eLpNorm_const_smul,enorm_inv hu0,hu,ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hb0 hB.ne]
  have hnC : eLpNorm (v⁻¹ • C) 3 volume = 1 := by
    rw [eLpNorm_const_smul,enorm_inv hv0,hv,ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hc0 hC.ne]
  calc
    cyclicNorm B C = cyclicNorm (u • (u⁻¹ • B)) (v • (v⁻¹ • C)) := by
      rw [smul_smul,smul_smul,mul_inv_cancel₀ hu0,mul_inv_cancel₀ hv0,one_smul,one_smul]
    _ = (‖u‖ₑ*‖v‖ₑ)*cyclicNorm (u⁻¹ • B) (v⁻¹ • C) := cyclicNorm_smul _ _ _ _
    _ ≤ (‖u‖ₑ*‖v‖ₑ)*(mainConstant : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      gcongr
      exact cyclicNorm_le_unit _ _ hiB hiC hnB hnC
    _ = (mainConstant : ℝ≥0∞)*eLpNorm B 3 volume*eLpNorm C 3 volume := by
      rw [hu,hv]
      ac_rfl
end
end TriangularHilbert

OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.CyclicNor.name: OAI.TriangularHilbert.cyclicNorm_le_unit
OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.CyclicNor.text:
lemma cyclicNorm_le_unit (B C : Plane → ℂ) (hB : MemLp B 3 volume) (hC : MemLp C 3 volume)
    (hnB : eLpNorm B 3 volume = 1) (hnC : eLpNorm C 3 volume = 1) :

  apply ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow _ (by norm_num)

  rw [integral_cube_eq_one B hB hnB,integral_cube_eq_one C hC hnC] at h
  simpa only [show momentConstant*((1:ℝ)+1) = 2*momentConstant by ring] using h

OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.Main:25.name: OAI.TriangularHilbert.maximalNorm_eq_cyclicNorm
OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.Main:25.text:
lemma maximalNorm_eq_cyclicNorm (F G : Plane → ℂ) (hF : MemLp F 3 volume) (hG : MemLp G 3 volume) :
    maximalNorm F G = cyclicNorm (cyclicB F) (cyclicC G) := by
  unfold maximalNorm cyclicNorm
  congr 1
  calc
    (∫⁻ z : Plane, maximal F G z ^ ((3:ℝ)/2)) =
        ∫⁻ z : Plane, cyclicMax (cyclicB F) (cyclicC G) (-z)^((3:ℝ)/2) := by
      apply lintegral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [maximal_eq_cyclicMax_ae F G hF hG] with z hz
      rw [hz]
    _ = _ := measurePreserving_reflect.lintegral_comp_emb (Homeomorph.neg Plane).measurableEmbedding
      (fun z => cyclicMax (cyclicB F) (cyclicC G) z^((3:ℝ)/2))

OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.Main:11.name: OAI.TriangularHilbert.maximal_eq_cyclicMax_ae
OAI.Analysis.TriangularHilbert.Main:11.text:
lemma maximal_eq_cyclicMax_ae (F G : Plane → ℂ) (hF : MemLp F 3 volume) (hG : MemLp G 3 volume) :
    maximal F G =ᵐ[volume] (fun z => cyclicMax (cyclicB F) (cyclicC G) (-z)) := by
  filter_upwards [measurePreserving_reflect.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
    (ae_cubicSliceGood (cyclicB F) (cyclicC G) (memLp_cyclicB hF) (memLp_cyclicC hG))] with z hz
  rw [maximal,ite_eq_left hz.goodPoint]
  simp_rw [truncation_eq_cyclicHard]
  exact (cyclicMax_eq_iSup hz).symm

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.finite_execution_not_optimal
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.text:
theorem finite_execution_not_optimal :
    crossRowRestriction initial ∧
    ForcedSingletonStep initial middle 0 1 ∧
    ForcedSingletonStep middle finalState 1 0 ∧
    (¬ ∃ j, finalState.remaining j) ∧ stop finalState ∧
    feasible initial output ∧ feasible initial better ∧
    output 2 = 0 ∧ better 2 = 0 ∧
    (output 1 : Coeff) = eval (lowerForm initial 0 1) output ∧
    (output 0 : Coeff) = eval (lowerForm middle 1 0) output ∧
    eval initial.cost output = eval finalState.cost output ∧
    eval initial.cost better < eval finalState.cost output := by
  refine ⟨initial_crossRowRestriction, first_forced, second_forced,
    final_terminal.1, final_terminal.2, output_cost_and_feasible.1,
    better_feasible_and_cost.1, rfl, rfl, output_backsubstitution.1,
    output_backsubstitution.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [output_cost_and_feasible.2.1, output_cost_and_feasible.2.2]
  · rw [better_feasible_and_cost.2.1, output_cost_and_feasible.2.2]
    norm_num

end TruffetV4Counterexample
end

end OAI

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:3.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.feasible
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:3.text:
def feasible (s : State) (w : Fin 3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, eval (s.rows i).rhs w ≤ eval (s.rows i).lhs w

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:8.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.ForcedSingletonStep
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:8.text:
def ForcedSingletonStep (s s' : State) (i : RowIndex) (j : Var) : Prop :=
  wellFormed s ∧ wellFormed s' ∧
  bounded s ∧ ¬ stop s ∧ ¬ switch s ∧ ¬ failure s ∧
  (∀ r k, eligible s r k ↔ r = i ∧ k = j) ∧
  (∃ k, (substitute s.cost j (lowerForm s i j)) k ≠ ⊥) ∧
  s' = advance s i j

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:5.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.eligible
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:5.text:
def eligible (s : State) (i : RowIndex) (j : Var) : Prop :=
  s.remaining j ∧ lower s i j ∧ ((∃ k, dominating s k) → dominating s j)

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:2.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.wellFormed
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:2.text:
def wellFormed (s : State) : Prop := ∀ j, ¬ s.remaining j →
  s.cost (column j) = ⊥ ∧ ∀ i,
    (s.rows i).lhs (column j) = ⊥ ∧ (s.rows i).rhs (column j) = ⊥

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.first_forced
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.text:
lemma first_forced : ForcedSingletonStep initial middle 0 1 := by
  classical
  unfold ForcedSingletonStep
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, advance_first.symm⟩
  all_goals
    norm_num [fin3_two_ne_one, fin3_two_ne_zero, coeff_one_add_neg_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
      ← WithBot.coe_one, ← WithBot.coe_add, wellFormed, bounded, stop, switch, failure, eligible, dominating, lower, upper,
      initial, middle, finalState, nullForm, substitute, lowerForm, column, Fin.forall_fin_succ, Fin.exists_fin_succ]

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.second_forced
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.text:
lemma second_forced : ForcedSingletonStep middle finalState 1 0 := by
  classical
  unfold ForcedSingletonStep
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, advance_second.symm⟩
  all_goals
    norm_num [fin3_two_ne_one, fin3_two_ne_zero, coeff_one_add_neg_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
      ← WithBot.coe_one, ← WithBot.coe_add, wellFormed, bounded, stop, switch, failure, eligible, dominating, lower, upper,
      middle, finalState, nullForm, substitute, lowerForm, column, Fin.forall_fin_succ,
      Fin.exists_fin_succ]

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:7.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.substitute
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:7.text:
def substitute (f : Form) (j : Var) (g : Form) : Form := fun k =>
  if k = column j then ⊥ else max (f k) (f (column j) + g k)

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.text: private lemma fin3_two_ne_zero : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:1.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.finalState
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:1.text:
def finalState : State where
  rows := fun _ => ⟨nullForm, nullForm⟩
  cost := ![⊥, ⊥, (1 : Coeff)]
  remaining := fun _ => False

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:6.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.lowerForm
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:6.text:
def lowerForm (s : State) (i : RowIndex) (j : Var) : Form := fun k =>
  if k = column j then ⊥ else
    (s.rows i).rhs k + ((-WithBot.unbotD 0 ((s.rows i).lhs (column j)) : ℝ) : Coeff)

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.coeff_one_add_neg_one
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.text:
private lemma coeff_one_add_neg_one : (1 : Coeff) + ((-1 : ℝ) : Coeff) = 0 := by
  change (((1 : ℝ) + (-1) : ℝ) : Coeff) = (0 : Coeff)
  norm_num

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.initial_crossRowRestriction
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetCounter.text:
lemma initial_crossRowRestriction : crossRowRestriction initial := by
  intro i r hir α
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases r
  · exact (hir rfl).elim
  · refine ⟨![0, 0, 3-α], ?_⟩
    norm_num [fin3_two_ne_one, fin3_two_ne_zero, coeff_one_add_neg_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
      ← WithBot.coe_one, ← WithBot.coe_add, eval, initial]
    have hreal : (0 : ℝ) < α + max 1 (-2 + (3-α)) := by
      linarith [le_max_right (1 : ℝ) (-2 + (3-α))]
    exact WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hreal
  · refine ⟨![0, 0, 1-α], ?_⟩
    norm_num [fin3_two_ne_one, fin3_two_ne_zero, coeff_one_add_neg_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
      ← WithBot.coe_one, ← WithBot.coe_add, eval, initial]
  · exact (hir rfl).elim

OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:4.name: OAI.TruffetV4Counterexample.dominating
OAI.Optimization.Tropical.TruffetModel:4.text:
def dominating (s : State) (j : Var) : Prop :=
  s.remaining j ∧ (∃ i, lower s i j) ∧ ∃ i, upper s i j

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Normali.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.reindex_language
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Normali.text:
theorem reindex_language {Sigma Q Q' : Type*} (A : TwoNFA Sigma Q) (e : Q ≃ Q') :
    (A.reindex e).language = A.language := by
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨q, p⟩, haccept, hrun⟩
    refine ⟨(e.symm q, p), haccept, ?_⟩
    have h := hrun.lift (fun c : Q' × Fin (w.length + 2) => (e.symm c.1, c.2))
      (p := fun c d => (c, d) ∈ A.step w) (fun _ _ h => h)
    simpa only [Function.onFun, reindex, relStar, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h
  · rintro ⟨⟨q, p⟩, haccept, hrun⟩
    refine ⟨(e q, p), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [reindex, Set.mem_preimage, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using haccept
    · exact hrun.lift (fun c : Q × Fin (w.length + 2) => (e c.1, c.2))
        (fun c d h => by
          simpa only [Function.onFun, step, reindex, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
            Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h)

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Model:3.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.language

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Recogni.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.diagram_recognition_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Recogni.text:
theorem diagram_recognition_lower_bound (h m : ℕ) (hh : 2 ≤ h) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (τ : List (SetRel (Fin h) (Fin h)) → Diagram m)
    (hzero : τ [] = Diagram.identity m)
    (hmul : ∀ u v, τ (u ++ v) = Diagram.comp (τ u) (τ v))
    (l r : Diagram m) (a b : Fin m)
    (hlanguage : ∀ w, (a, b) ∈ (Diagram.comp (Diagram.comp l (τ w)) r).forward ↔
      ¬ (relationProduct w).Nonempty) : lossBound h ≤ 2 * m := by
  obtain ⟨S, φ, hsurj, hreverse⟩ := diagram_relation_image τ hzero hmul l r a b hlanguage
  apply order_reversing_image_bound m h hm hh S S.one_mem (by
    intro z w hz hw
    change z * w ∈ S
    exact S.mul_mem hz hw)
    (fun z => (φ z).toRel)
  · intro R
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hsurj (RelationMonoid.ofRel R)
    exact ⟨z, congrArg RelationMonoid.toRel hz⟩
  · intro z w
    change (φ (z * w)).toRel = (φ z).toRel ○ (φ w).toRel
    rw [map_mul, RelationMonoid.toRel_mul]
  · exact hreverse

end TwoWayComplementation

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Source:.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.sourceLanguage
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Source:.text:
def sourceLanguage (H : Type*) : Set (List (SetRel H H)) :=
  {w | (relationProduct w).Nonempty}

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Main:11.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.complementation_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Main:11.text:
theorem complementation_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin n),
      ∀ s : ℕ, ∀ B : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin s),
        B.language = A.languageᶜ → 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ 2 * (s + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := sourceLanguage_state_bound (Fin (n - 2))
  have hsize : Fintype.card (Fin (n - 2)) + 2 = n := by simp; omega
  let A' := A.reindex (finCongr hsize)
  refine ⟨A', ?_⟩
  intro s B hB
  have hAlang : A'.language = sourceLanguage (Fin (n - 2)) := by
    rw [TwoNFA.reindex_language, hA]
  obtain ⟨τ, l, r, a, b, hzero, hmul, hrecognition⟩ := B.diagram_representation
  have hbound := diagram_recognition_lower_bound (n - 2) (s + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    τ hzero hmul l r a b (by
      intro w
      rw [← hrecognition w, hB, hAlang]
      rfl)
  simpa only [lossBound, Nat.sub_sub, Nat.reduceAdd] using hbound

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Source:.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.sourceLanguage_state_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Source:.text:
theorem sourceLanguage_state_bound (H : Type*) [Fintype H] :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel H H) (Fin (Fintype.card H + 2)), A.language = sourceLanguage H := by
  classical
  let e : Option (Option H) ≃ Fin (Fintype.card H + 2) :=
    (Fintype.equivFin _).trans (finCongr (by simp))
  refine ⟨(sourceAutomaton H).reindex e, ?_⟩
  rw [TwoNFA.reindex_language, sourceAutomaton_language]

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Main:31.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.complementation_lower_bound_finite
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Main:31.text:
theorem complementation_lower_bound_finite (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin n),
      ∀ (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q], ∀ B : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q,
        B.language = A.languageᶜ →
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) - 1 ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := complementation_lower_bound n hn
  refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
  intro Q _ B hB
  have hbound := hA (Fintype.card Q) (B.reindex (Fintype.equivFin Q)) (by
    rw [TwoNFA.reindex_language, hB])
  have hreal : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ 2 * ((Fintype.card Q : ℝ) + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast hbound
  linarith

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Explici.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.explicit_complementation_family
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Explici.text:
theorem explicit_complementation_family (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin n),
      A.language = sourceLanguage (Fin (n - 2)) ∧
      (∀ (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q],
        ∀ B : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q,
        B.language = A.languageᶜ →
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) - 1 ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := sourceLanguage_state_bound (Fin (n - 2))
  have hsize : Fintype.card (Fin (n - 2)) + 2 = n := by simp; omega
  let A' := A.reindex (finCongr hsize)
  have hAlang : A'.language = sourceLanguage (Fin (n - 2)) := by
    rw [TwoNFA.reindex_language, hA]
  refine ⟨A', hAlang, ?_⟩
  intro Q _ B hB
  let B' := B.reindex (Fintype.equivFin Q)
  obtain ⟨τ, l, r, a, b, hzero, hmul, hrecognition⟩ := B'.diagram_representation
  have hbound := diagram_recognition_lower_bound (n - 2) (Fintype.card Q + 1)
    (by omega) (by omega) τ hzero hmul l r a b (by
      intro w
      rw [← hrecognition w, TwoNFA.reindex_language, hB, hAlang]
      rfl)
  have hnat : 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card Q + 1) := by
    simpa only [lossBound, Nat.sub_sub, Nat.reduceAdd] using hbound
  have hreal : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ 2 * ((Fintype.card Q : ℝ) + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  linarith

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Explici.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.explicit_family_main
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Explici.text:
theorem explicit_family_main (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin n),
      A.language = sourceLanguage (Fin (n - 2)) ∧
      (∀ (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q],
        ∀ B : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q,
        B.language = A.languageᶜ →
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) - 1 ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)) ∧
      (131 ≤ n → ∀ (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q],
        ∀ D : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q,
        D.Deterministic → D.language = A.language →
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hcomp⟩ := explicit_complementation_family n hn
  refine ⟨A, hA, hcomp, ?_⟩
  intro hn Q _ D hdet hD
  exact deterministic_liveness_lower_bound n hn Q D hdet (hD.trans hA)

end TwoWayComplementation

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Determi.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.deterministic_rate
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Determi.text:
theorem deterministic_rate (n s : ℕ) (hn : 131 ≤ n)
    (hb : 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 31) ≤ 4 * (s + 1) ^ 2) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ (s : ℝ) := by
  let k := (n - 4) / 127
  have hk : 1 ≤ k := by dsimp [k]; omega
  have hrate : 4 * k ≤ (n - 4) / 31 := by dsimp [k]; omega
  have hbR : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n - 4) / 31) ≤ 4 * ((s : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hb
  have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * k) ≤ 4 * ((s : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 :=
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hrate).trans hbR
  have he : (2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * k) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 4 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [he] at hp
  have ht : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    simpa only [pow_one] using
      (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hk)
  have hsq : (((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * ((s : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith only [hp]
  have hs : ((2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ((s : ℝ) + 1) :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp hsq
  change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ k ≤ (s : ℝ)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht)
    (show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k + 1 by positivity)]

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Determi.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.deterministic_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Determi.text:
theorem deterministic_bound (h s : ℕ) (hh : 2 ≤ h)
    (D : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin h) (Fin h)) (Fin s))
    (hdet : D.Deterministic) (hD : D.language = sourceLanguage (Fin h)) :
    2 ^ ((h - 2) / 31) ≤ 4 * (s + 1) ^ 2 := by
  let A := D.pullAlphabet (relationEquiv (Fin h))
  have ha : A.Deterministic := hdet.pullAlphabet _
  apply (OneWayLiveness.main_theorem h hh).2 false s (toDMachine A ha)
  intro w
  rw [toDMachine_accepts]
  change w ∈ (D.pullAlphabet (relationEquiv (Fin h))).language ↔ _
  rw [D.pullAlphabet_language, hD]
  exact sourceLanguage_map_iff w

end CompanionBridge

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Determi.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.deterministic_liveness_lower_bound
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Determi.text:
theorem deterministic_liveness_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 131 ≤ n)
    (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q]
    (D : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q)
    (hdet : D.Deterministic) (hD : D.language = sourceLanguage (Fin (n - 2))) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ) := by
  have hb := CompanionBridge.deterministic_bound (n - 2) (Fintype.card Q) (by omega)
    (D.reindex (Fintype.equivFin Q)) (hdet.reindex _) (by
      rw [TwoNFA.reindex_language, hD])
  apply deterministic_rate n (Fintype.card Q) hn
  simpa only [Nat.sub_sub, Nat.reduceAdd] using hb

end TwoWayComplementation

end OAI

OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Source:.name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relationProduct
OAI.Combinatorics.TwoWayAutomata.Source:.text:
def relationProduct {H : Type*} (w : List (SetRel H H)) : SetRel H H :=
  w.foldr SetRel.comp SetRel.id

OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Basic:111.name: OAI.PureTypeSystem.SystemStronglyNormalizing

OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Normalizati.name: OAI.PureTypeSystem.relational_exclusion
OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Normalizati.text:
theorem relational_exclusion {S : Type u} [Fintype S] {P : Specification S}
    (hw : SystemWeaklyNormalizing P) : RelationalExclusion P := by
  intro C hC ho ht hf
  obtain ⟨Γ,γ,hΓ,⟨L⟩⟩ := LogicSetup.exists_setup C hC ho ht
  obtain ⟨K,⟨R⟩⟩ := ChannelSetup.exists_setup_return (L := L) hC ho hf
  let KY := L.quantifiers K.logicalVertex K.directLogical
  let KP := L.quantifiers K.predVertex K.directPred
  obtain ⟨b,hb,mb⟩ := R.specialized_formed.relational_bottom KY KP
  exact no_proof_at_target hw hΓ
    ⟨.terminal (L.witnesses.allData L.base L.triple.codomain),L.witnesses.normal L.base L.triple.codomain⟩ hb mb

OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Normalizati.name: OAI.PureTypeSystem.RelationalExclusion
OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Normalizati.text:
def RelationalExclusion {S : Type u} (P : Specification S) : Prop :=
  ∀ C, IsComponent (PrimaryEdge P) C →
    (∃ I ∈ C, SignedPath (PrimaryEdge P) I I true) →
    (∃ I J K, ProfileTriple P I J K ∧ I ∈ C ∧ J ∈ C ∧ K ∈ C) →
    ¬ ForbiddenConfiguration P C

OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Basic:108.name: OAI.PureTypeSystem.SystemWeaklyNormalizing
OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Basic:108.text:
def SystemWeaklyNormalizing {S : Type u} (P : Specification S) : Prop :=
  ∀ Γ, ValidContext P Γ → ∀ M, Legal P Γ M → WeaklyNormalizing M

OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Basic:79.name: OAI.PureTypeSystem.StronglyNormalizing
OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Basic:79.text:
def StronglyNormalizing {S : Type u} (M : Expr S) : Prop :=
  Acc (fun N M : Expr S => Beta M N) M

theorem finite_normalization_of_exclusion {S : Type u} [Fintype S] {P : Specification S}
    (hw : SystemWeaklyNormalizing P) (he : RelationalExclusion P) :
    SystemStronglyNormalizing P := by
  apply stronglyNormalizing_of_application
  intro Γ f a D E hf ha hsf hsa
  obtain ⟨s,t,hat⟩ := hf.has_axiom
  let Ω := ContextTowerConstruction.tower P hat
  exact application_sn_of_ground Ω hw
    (all_ground_eq_top Ω hw (interfaces_of_exclusion Ω hw he)) hf ha hsf hsa

OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Normalizati.name: OAI.PureTypeSystem.normalization_of_finite_exclusion
OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Normalizati.text:
theorem normalization_of_finite_exclusion
    (exclude : ∀ (S : Type u) [Fintype S] (P : Specification S),
      SystemWeaklyNormalizing P → RelationalExclusion P)
    {S : Type u} {P : Specification S} (hw : SystemWeaklyNormalizing P) :
    SystemStronglyNormalizing P := by
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨Γ,f,a,D,E,hf,ha,hsf,hsa,hbad⟩ := exists_bad_application hn
  have htype := HasType.application hf ha
  obtain ⟨F,Γ',M',T',ht,hn',hw'⟩ := htype.finite_counterexample hbad hw
  have hsn := finite_normalization_of_exclusion hw' (exclude _ _ hw')
  exact hn' (hsn Γ' ht.valid M' ⟨T',.inl ht⟩)

end

OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Typing:960.name: OAI.PureTypeSystem.exists_bad_application
OAI.Computability.TypeSystem.Typing:960.text:
theorem exists_bad_application {S : Type u} {P : Specification S}
    (h : ¬ SystemStronglyNormalizing P) :
    ∃ Γ f a D E, HasType P Γ f (.pi D E) ∧ HasType P Γ a D ∧
      StronglyNormalizing f ∧ StronglyNormalizing a ∧ ¬ StronglyNormalizing (.app f a) := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  apply h
  apply stronglyNormalizing_of_application
  intro Γ f a D E hf ha hfs has
  by_contra hb
  exact hn ⟨Γ, f, a, D, E, hf, ha, hfs, has, hb⟩

OAI.Analysis.Commutator.StableUniversalA.name: OAI.Kadison.CentralSpectral.universal_bound
OAI.Analysis.Commutator.StableUniversalA.text:
theorem universal_bound {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [CompleteSpace H] (P : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (Y : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (h : ℕ) (hh : 1≤h) (X : Matrix (Fin h) (Fin h) (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hX : ∀ i j,X i j∈P) :
    ‖diagonalAmplification h Y*matrixOperator h X-matrixOperator h X*diagonalAmplification h Y‖≤
      9368*commutatorSeminorm P Y*‖matrixOperator h X‖ :=
  SeparableTest.bound_of_small_separable_bound P Y h hh X hX (by norm_num) separable_uniform_bound

end Kadison.CentralSpectral

end

end
end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Commutator.SeparableUnivers.name: OAI.Kadison.SeparableTest.bound_of_small_separable_bound
OAI.Analysis.Commutator.SeparableUnivers.text:
theorem bound_of_small_separable_bound {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (P : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (Y : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : ℕ) (hh : 1≤h)
    (X : Matrix (Fin h) (Fin h) (H →L[ℂ] H)) (hX : ∀ i j,X i j∈P)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0≤c) (hsmall : SeparableBound.{0} c) :
    ‖diagonalAmplification h Y*matrixOperator h X-matrixOperator h X*diagonalAmplification h Y‖≤
      c*commutatorSeminorm P Y*‖matrixOperator h X‖ :=
  bound_of_separable_bound P Y h X hX hc hsmall.lift hh

end Kadison.SeparableTest

end

end
end

end OAI

OAI.Analysis.Commutator.StableUniversalA.name: OAI.Kadison.CentralSpectral.separable_uniform_bound
OAI.Analysis.Commutator.StableUniversalA.text:
theorem separable_uniform_bound : SeparableTest.SeparableBound.{0} 9368 := by
  intro H _ _ _ _ M Y h hh X hX
  obtain ⟨μ,hμ,U,hU,hind,hsep⟩ := exists_stable_center_spectral_model M
  let : IsFiniteMeasure μ := hμ
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (Space ℕ ℂ) := separable_space
  let : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (Lp (Space ℕ ℂ) 2 μ) := hsep
  apply bound_of_stable_bound M Y h X hX (by norm_num)
  exact stable_model_bound M μ U hU hind (map Y) h hh (fun i j => map (ι:=ℕ) (X i j))
    (fun i j => map_mem_algebra M _ (hX i j))

OAI.Analysis.Commutator.Definitions:21.name: OAI.Kadison.matrixOperator
OAI.Analysis.Commutator.Definitions:21.text:
def matrixOperator (h : ℕ) (X : Matrix (Fin h) (Fin h) (K →L[ℂ] K)) :
    (PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin h => K) →L[ℂ] (PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin h => K) :=
  (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ (fun _ : Fin h => K)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => ∑ j : Fin h,
      (X i j).comp (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin h => K) j)))

OAI.Analysis.Commutator.Definitions:27.text:

  (PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℂ (fun _ : Fin h => K)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => Y.comp (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin h => K) i)))

end Kadison

OAI.Analysis.Commutator.UniversalMain:16.name: OAI.Kadison.uniform_commutator
OAI.Analysis.Commutator.UniversalMain:16.text:
theorem uniform_commutator :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (K : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
      [CompleteSpace K] (P : VonNeumannAlgebra K) (Y : K →L[ℂ] K)
      (h : ℕ), 1 ≤ h → ∀ (X : Matrix (Fin h) (Fin h) (K →L[ℂ] K)),
      (∀ i j, X i j ∈ P) →
      ‖diagonalAmplification h Y * matrixOperator h X -
        matrixOperator h X * diagonalAmplification h Y‖ ≤
        C * commutatorSeminorm P Y * ‖matrixOperator h X‖ := by
  refine ⟨9368,by norm_num,?_⟩
  intro K _ _ _ P Y h hh X hX
  exact CentralSpectral.universal_bound P Y h hh X hX

end Kadison

end

end
end

OAI.Analysis.Commutator.Definitions:18.name: OAI.Kadison.commutatorSeminorm
OAI.Analysis.Commutator.Definitions:18.text:
def commutatorSeminorm (P : VonNeumannAlgebra K) (Y : K →L[ℂ] K) : ℝ :=
  sSup {r : ℝ | ∃ a : K →L[ℂ] K, a ∈ P ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ 1 ∧ r = ‖Y * a - a * Y‖}
